the impact of wto accession on china 's economy has been researched in many articles .
however , judging from different industries and sections as well as the economic sectors of public and non - public ownership , there are differences in these advantages and disadvantages .
otherwise , we will suffer from seeking generalities .
so the accession to the wto will bring about different advantages and disadvantages for different economic sectors , and the countermeasures are different as well .
so far , only limited researches have been conducted on the issue of wto accession and the non - public economy .
this has given the non - public economy some characteristics different from those of the public economy .
so far as the industrial structure is concerned , the non - public economic sector is allowed to exist and develop only in the industries and sections not monopolized by state - owned enterprises , thus giving rise to the incomplete and abnormal industrial structure of the non - public economy .
( generally , agriculture is considered as the collectively owned economy , but in fact , farmers own all the means of agricultural production , except for land . here , i will not discuss how to identify the ownership of agricultural economy . )
the non - public economy has developed most in china 's advantageous sections , including the textile industry and other labor - intensive industries , the household electric appliances manufacturing industry , commerce , catering trade , construction , and various non - financial trades .
hence , with the current industrial structure , the non - public economy will be less affected by the disadvantages of wto entry and be much benefited by the advantages .
how should the non - public economic sector cope with the situation after wto accession ?
different non - public enterprises should adopt different countermeasures according to their specific conditions .
the characteristics of the non - public economy are being clear in property rights , being flexible in mechanism , being strong in motility , being fast in policy making , and being much motivated and restricted by profits .
in the competitive sphere , the non - public economy is superior to the state - owned economy ; and while competing against foreign enterprises , the non - public businesses are more competitive than the state - owned enterprises .
in principle , the non - public enterprises should access in different forms the spheres where state - owned enterprises have bowed out .
this will be favorable for china to cope with the situation of competing against foreign enterprises after joining the wto .
so far as the scale structure is concerned , a number of non - public enterprises with a large scale and abundant strength should be developed in some sections .
the non - public enterprises are required to review their past behaviors with these rules and actually straighten out the inappropriate ones .
of course , in all economic and trade contacts , the principle of stressing honesty and credit must be upheld , others ' intellectual property rights must be respected , and forging must be avoided .
the non - public economy needs to be reformed so that it can keep abreast of the situation after wto accession .
not only those small and medium - sized enterprises , quite a few large non - public enterprises are also required to reform their property rights system .
due to some historical reasons , some non - public enterprises have already grown up .
because the property rights of these enterprises were wrongly affiliated and their civil entity was wrongly positioned , legal disputes have taken place frequently and these disputes have often been erroneously judged , thus incurring many losses and hindering the development of enterprises .
if this problem is not resolved , the losses will be even graver after china enters the wto .
to cope with the heated competition after entering the wto , the qualified non - public enterprises should establish the modern enterprise system and improve management according to the norm of the modern enterprise system .
thus far , there is no unified national chamber of commerce of the non - public enterprises in china .
for this reason , the all - china federation of industry and commerce should give necessary help to the non - public enterprises .
this is the only way to enable our non - public enterprises to compete against foreign enterprises together with the state - owned enterprises at the sections accessible by foreign enterprises .
otherwise , if we merely depend on state - owned enterprises , our strength will be not enough .
to this end , we should present channels to the non - public sector to get bank loans .
the lack of theoretical clarity means , in the final analysis , indistinct views of future wars and lack of a profound grasp of the kind of war we will be fighting in the future .
virtual reality helps simulate the likely forms of future wars and presents us with clear images .
virtual reality wars are closely related to the " on - going " wars , such as the gulf war and the kosovo war , but they also go beyond them .
virtual reality and simulation can help achieve this transcendence .
the primary mission of theoretical research is to explore the mechanism and essence of future wars .
when doing military theoretical research in the new century , we must move from simulation to virtual reality and from the present to the future . we must create a " virtual reality war " with clear its characteristics so that we can innovate and develop truly useful military theories .
virtual reality expands the space of thinking the space of thinking determines the theoretical level .
traditional space of thinking concerns the past and present in time frame and rarely touches on the future .
we believe that the future is a function of the past and present and that we can deduce the future from the past and the present .
according to kuhn , the creation of new scientific theories involves essentially change of the mode of thinking .
the significance of einstein 's theory is in that it expanded the space of people 's thinking , which led to the birth and development of nuclear and rocketry technologies .
the significance of system theory lies also in that it expands the space of people 's thinking and gives birth to " combined operations , " systematic warfare , " " integrated warfare , " " internet warfare , " etc. virtual reality opens broader space of thinking for military theoretical creativity .
fourth , it helps accomplish " interactive thinking " and brings about the integration of people , weaponry , technology , and military thinking , thereby enhancing flexibility and creativity in military thinking .
virtual reality can simulate various future possibilities , including all the available resolutions . this further enhances the rational choice and comparability of the developing reality .
the availability and comparability of options make it possible to design the future and create new theories .
through virtual reality , one can design various possible developments of a future war .
however , one can choose only one solution . even though theoretically , virtual reality can have all the different solutions , in practice we do not need all the solutions . as a result , future wars will have broader space and can be planned .
in light of these possibilities , we can , through virtual reality - based military theory , seek the optimum solutions among the various possibilities and choose and create the most suitable theory for the development of our armed forces .
the availability of options in virtual reality also reflects in the fact that theories can be tested and verified to provide basis for developing and creating new theories .
in the wave of new military revolution , the cycle of renewal of military theories becomes shorter . some theories become obsolete even before they are applied . as a result , a brand new way of studying wars has emerged , namely , the use of virtual reality experiment .
virtual reality experiment is taken seriously abroad .
army building and the introduction of combat programs and theories in the united states all require repeated tests and verification in related laboratories .
for example , before the introduction of the concept of " information warfare strategy , " it was given to the rand corporation to conduct virtual reality experiment to thoroughly test its connotation , characteristics , and related issues .
britain , russia , japan , france , and israel are all actively planning their own warfare theory laboratories .
our armed forces are also giving due emphasis to the building of warfare laboratories .
of course , as a brand new invention , the development of virtual reality still has a long way to go . however , the virtual reality theoretical research approach is an irreversible trend .
in the study of military philosophy and dialectics , we must face the issue of virtual reality squarely and explore its essence , function , and methodology from a philosophical perspective so as to guide the research of military theory .
undoubtedly , virtual reality will be a powerful tool in military theoretical innovation .

looking over history , understanding and using maps is a required course for soldiers .
what new methods are there to acquire battlefield information ?
what is the relationship between guided missile target - strike precision and maps ?
in overall terms , this involves two parts , one being the provision of battlefield positioning data and positioning methodology , and two being the provision of geospatial data in the war zone , including imaging data , elevation modeling data , and topographical element data .
accordingly , in addition to building geospatial databases , military mapping departments must also provide commanders and their staffs with spatial data visualization methods .
three is using virtual reality technology to create a simulated battlefield environment , giving commanders the feeling that they are there , and this can be seen as a kind of three - dimensional , dynamic map which one can enter .
we can see from this that using spatial data and visualization methods to provide battlefield mapping support has now gone far beyond traditional mapping support methods .
the various visualization methods mentioned above are all achieved in map form . however , they are no longer merely maps that are printed on paper , but are rather produced in multimedia form , and have changed from being static to dynamic and from one to multiple dimensions , representing a substantive leap forward for maps .
whether we are talking about digitized image data or digitized data on topographical features and physical objects , both can be called " digital maps , " and this is the basis for achieving a digitized battlefield , and it also is a reflection of the basic position of military mapping in modern warfare .
to achieve the above goals , there must be major changes in military mapping theory and technical methodology , and therefore there must be scientific and technical innovations .
for example , the goal of the " shuttle radar topography mission (srtm) " completed recently by the u.s. spacecraft " endeavor " was to use space microwave radar to obtain a global digital elevation model to make a global , three - dimensional topographical map .
in recent years , the revolutionary changes in geodetic mapping and the numerous advances in the areas of aerospace remote sensing and map - making are to a great extent directly or indirectly attributable to the great advances in satellite navigation technology .
at present , there are two global navigation satellite systems operating in space , one being the gps system of the united states and the other being russia 's global navigation satellite system (glonass) .
the operating principles of these two systems are the same , and their basic constellations both comprise 24 medium - orbit satellites positioned at an altitude of about 20,000 kilometers .
gps is currently undergoing a " modernization " process to improve its navigation performance .
also , europe 's galileo satellite navigation system will be appearing in a few years .
naturally , it is not enough to discuss navigation satellite systems only from a mapping perspective .
however , with regard to the mobile launches required by modern warfare , the situation is somewhat different .
the applications of the digital world will be very widespread , and its application in local wars under high - tech conditions will constitute one of the important factors in prevailing in war - - the digitized battlefield .
obviously , whoever has the digitized battlefield has the initiative in war .
however , the fry also took advantage of the battlefield environment , including the complex topography of the country , the dense vegetation , and the extremely variable weather conditions to make it difficult for nato 's reconnaissance and bombing to be effective , and they actually destroyed or damaged numerous u.s. planes , including an f-117 stealth fighter .
people have reason to express optimism about the current state of foreign debt .
the latest statistics on foreign debt , which were released this week by the state administration of exchange control , indicate that the structure of all the foreign debt registered in china is becoming more rational all the time , and debt risk is gradually decreasing .
by examining this group of figures , one can discover a significant phenomenon : the structure of the foreign debt increases here and decreases there . in fact this change began in 1998 .
the balance of mid - and long - term foreign debt at that time was an increase of $ 15.08 billion over 1997 , whereas short - term foreign debt decreased by $ 800 million .
at the end of 1999 , this change was even more apparent . mid - and long - term foreign debt rose 6.2 per cent , and short - term foreign debt fell 12.5 per cent .
this is because , according to the standard of judgment used by the international financial world , the key to whether or not the structure of a foreign debt is rational is the proportion of its entire foreign debt which is short - term .
based on this usual practice , current short - term foreign debt of 10 per cent of total foreign debt is far below the internationally recognized warning line .
internationally , there is definite reasoning behind the demarcation of this sort of warning line .
ability to repay debt remains quite strong as they analyze the structure of foreign debt , people paid even more attention to the issue of ability to repay it .
normally speaking , a debt service ratio is a proportion of its total foreign debt balance and its gdp . internationally , a proportion of 20 per cent or less is often seen as normal .
calculated in this way , currently debt service ratio should be 15.3 per cent , still some way from the warning line of debt service which is not rational .
looking at it from another angle , people can still draw a rather optimistic conclusion .
analysts frequently use the ratio between foreign currency reserves and short - term foreign debt as a measure of the strength of debt repayment ability . they believe that if this ratio is greater than 1 , the situation is quite suitable .
according to statistics , last year the balance of foreign exchange reserves was 154.7 billion rmb [ $ 18.6 billion ] . comparing that with short - term foreign debt in 1999 , the final figure is more than 10 .
foreign currency reserves are ten times the amount of short - term foreign debt , indicating that china still has quite a strong ability to repay debt .
the published figures indicate that of the $ 151.83 billion in foreign debt , $ 47.3 billion was sovereign debt service incurred by state council ministries and commissions .
a reduction in non - sovereign foreign debt would , however , indicate to a certain degree a decrease in the ability of these organizations to borrow , so people should be paying close attention .
wen jiabao , member of the cpc central committee political bureau , vice premier of the state council , and head of the national general headquarters for flood prevention and drought control , today in beijing chaired the first plenary session in the year 2000 of the national general headquarters for flood prevention and drought control .
at the session , the national general headquarters for flood prevention and drought control analyzed the situation of flood prevention and drought control this year , clearly defined duties , and arranged jobs for the present .
wen jiabao made an important speech .
wang shucheng , deputy head of the national general headquarters for flood prevention and drought control and minister of water resources , reported the work done following the flooding time of last year and posed ideas for the work in the next step .
the session pointed out that flood prevention and drought control is a long - standing mission .
since the establishment of the new china , great achievement have been made in water conservancy .
as a result , the flood prevention ability for large rivers was conspicuously boosted .
the session posed : paying attention to the job with unremitting efforts and always being prepared are the basic experiences we gained from the flood prevention and drought control efforts over these years , and they also serve as an important principle .
over the past two years , some regions have overcome large - scale floods , accumulated precious experiences , and strengthened embankments .
all the regions should do jobs as if large - scale flood and drought are coming , overestimate the difficulties of work , and make better preparations . by so doing , we can really reach the status of being prepared all the time .
flood prevention projects , dykes for large rivers in particular , are important protective screens against floods , and the function of them are irreplaceable .
the flood - prevention projects set up by the state should be constructed with great efforts , and we should strive to ensure the quality of them and accomplish them as soon as possible so they can go into service sooner .
second , propaganda should be strengthened to boost all people 's awareness toward flood prevention and drought control .
the session decided that the main tasks for the flood prevention and drought control work at present are : ensuring the safety of areas along large rivers , large - scale reservoirs , and large - and medium - scale cities .
we should pay attention to both flood prevention and drought control in the same time , so we can strive for a bumper agricultural harvest . the session set up important requirements for achieving success in the following jobs .
first , attention should be given to accomplishing the restoration of project destroyed by floods and the projects for flood prevention and relief .
second , we should conscientiously inspect the implementation of all the measures for passing the flooding time .
third , we should attach great importance to the safety issue of reservoirs and water gates in flooding time .
reservoirs and water gates with defects are the weak parts for the flood prevention drive every year . once hit by torrential rain and flood , it is very likely that the embankment of some reservoirs will collapse and lead to ruinous disasters for the downstream regions .
we should pay great attention to it .

during the study , we convened more than 20 symposiums of all sorts and inspected on site scores of pilot projects in farmland reforestation , land management , sand control and farmland reclamation , and flood water and river management .
through on - site studies and surveys , we acquired a new understanding and appreciation of land resources , population growth , environmental work , and farmland protection in the west , of the relationship between township construction and farmland protection , of the adjustment of the agricultural structure , and of land development and management .
1 ) rethink the supposedly ample land resources in western china .
in contrast , there is immense room for land improvement .
this resource profile and production method are in urgent need of transformation and modernization .
it has been more than 20 years since china adopted a strict family planning policy . nationwide , the results of this policy have been striking .
in some places , fertility has far exceeded what is allowed under the policy .
if the issue of population growth is mishandled , the competition for living space will produce unimaginable consequences .
investments ( by regional , prefectural , and county governments ) in the project totaled ( as published ) yuan , so they called it the 100 million yuan project .
less than 20 years later , however , 80 percent of the trees and grass planted have been destroyed and the land has reverted to farmland .
the design of the project may have been flawed and post - completion management may have lagged , but the main reason for the project 's failure is excessive population growth . reports indicate that there were fewer than 300,000 people in the area when the project started .
this reminds us of the family planning policy . it is understandable why the policy showed special consideration to minority nationalities and allowed multiple births in its early days .
the over - harvesting of licorice roots and over - grazing by sheep and cattle are the main reasons behind the ecological degradation on the steppes and the spread of sandy wasteland .
both yanchi county and tongxin county in ningxia are located on hilly grassland . excessive population growth and over - grazing have resulted in 45 percent of the grassland turning into deserts .
we can thus see that there are only so many people a piece of land can sustain and there are only so many cattle and sheep the grassland can sustain . this is something we must pay attention to .
3 ) rethink farmland reforestation .
the project failed because of the following : 1 ) farmland reforestation must be based on land improvement and finding alternative land for the peasants .
3 ) forestry management should focus on state - owned tree farms and state - owned desolate mountains planted with saplings , instead of reforested farmland .
thus the lead player in farmland reforestation should be a coordinating group centered upon the land management department and featuring participation by the forestry , agricultural , and water conservancy departments . farmland reforestation may proceed healthily only with the local government taking the lead in comprehensive planning .
land protection in western china should respect four characteristics west china differs substantially from eastern china in soil quality , geological features , altitude , and climate .
even within western china itself , its southwestern region is quite different from the northwest . thus formulating a policy in line with local conditions is the basis of success .
through our on - site investigation in the west , we believe the great development of the west , farmland protection , farmland reforestation , land improvement , the adjustment of the rural structure , and township construction should all comply with the special characteristics of the west .
the population cannot exceed what the land can bear . if it does , environmental degradation will inevitably ensue . a striking example is the mountainous region in the west .
thus , before we appropriate farmland in the west for whatever use , we must first consider the livelihood of the peasants who live on the land . we must do so regardless of whether the land is to be used for township construction , infrastructural development , or reforestation .
the issue of the peasants ' future livelihood must be resolved . to rely on the government to provide grain for a few years is not enough to ensure that the environment will not be damaged again .
we need to instill a long - term outlook and cultivate the concept of comprehensive improvement .
nor are its effects limited to an increase in the acreage of farmland . on the contrary , it also has overall environmental benefits , social benefits , and economic benefits .
this type of linkage is inseparable from the geographical characteristics of western china . because there is scarce room between the mountains and because of the dire shortage of land resources , the only way to achieve all - round benefits is to plan comprehensively .
further , the comprehensive development of land may create green tourist attractions as a way of developing the tourist industry to increase local revenues . fourth , the urgency of protecting basic farmland .
it also is an issue in real life that we must face up to .
the four basic characteristics noted in this article also must be taken into account and complied with .
otherwise we cannot even begin to talk about the sustainable utilization of land resources or the idea of altering the environment , not to mention sustainable economic and social development .
environmental development and protection in western china affects not only the west but also central and eastern china , even the entire country .
if we do not consider the development of the west from the high plane and give the west preferential treatment in funding and in policy matters , we will not be able to modernize the whole country .
( the writer is the leader of the farmland protection policy research group for the great development of the west . )

us indifference contrasts sharply with its new africa policy stressing the need to establish close ties with african countries . itself from africa while to let go its hold , the united states is looking for replacement for peacekeeping forces . profit - making first is essence of new us africa policy .
in late 1995 , the clinton administration reviewed , in light of africa 's new situation and the us global strategy , africa 's strategic importance and us strategic interests there , and started drawing up a new africa policy .
in june 1997 , clinton came up with a - african new partnership plan calling for a close partnership with african countries into the 21 st century . this indicated the united states had formally put its new africa policy into effect .
since the united states attached greater importance to africa after re - positioning it strategically , there has been no fundamental change in its substitute status . what is uppermost in clinton 's mind is us interests in africa .
first , the united states values africa 's market potential .
last , the united states depends heavily on the important strategic mineral resources in africa . democratization , liberalization , and rights protection are the political interests the united states has been pursuing in africa .
to attain this strategic objective , it used as bait such economic conditions as expanding trade , increasing investment , and cutting or waiving debts , and forced african countries to initiate political and economic reforms , them according to its subjective desire .
since its peacekeeping forces suffered a defeat in somalia , however , the united states has been reluctant to directly get involved in africa 's internal affairs , but it does not intend to give up its leading role in settling local disputes , to say nothing of allowing political turbulence to jeopardize its interests .

second , it called international conferences to discuss ways to settle africa 's security problems .
for example , immediately after the sierra leone crisis erupted , clinton sent jesse jackson , a black human rights leader in the united states , to mediate the crisis .

the primary source of arms and equipment for the taiwan armed forces is the united states , and the secondary source is a small number of western countries ; us arms account for the great majority of taiwan 's arms .
what moves the united states will make in arms sales to taiwan following the inauguration of the new leader of the taiwan authorities on 20 may is an important issue of concern .
the united states is the main supplier of arms to the taiwan authorities , 95 percent of whose arms come from the united states . the supply of these arms can be roughly divided into three stages .
although sino - us relations were consolidated and developed , a few anti - china forces in the united states continually submitted anti - china bills , and instigated congress to pass the " taiwan relations act. "
the second stage was from 1991 to 1995 .
this period could also be roughly divided into two major stages , with 1993 marking the division .
before 1993 , the cold war had just ended and us military strategy was facing a new readjustment ; for a time they could not find an enemy and lost direction in military building .
in these circumstances , congress was facing powerful pressure from the trend of obtaining a " peace dividend " and had no alternative but to greatly reduce military expenditure and spending on equipment and personnel ; the intensity and proportion of the cuts reached 40 to 60 percent , something that had never happened before .
since the united states refused to sell high - quality arms and equipment to taiwan , the latter turned to europe in pursuit to new sources of arms .
from 1993 to 1995 , taiwan eventually purchased from france 60 mirage-2000-5 fighters , six lafayette missile frigates , and air - to - air missiles , along with portable anti - aircraft missiles , antitank missiles , large wire - guided torpedoes , and shipborne point defense missile systems .
in addition taiwan purchased from germany 36 fox armored vehicles , 12 tank mine clearers , and four mwv-50 minesweepers ; two submarines from the netherlands ; and one ocean survey vessel from italy .
the third stage was from 1996 to 1999 .
in these circumstances , fearing that china would use force against it , taiwan hurriedly rushed to the united states to buy arms .
in order to protect this " unsinkable aircraft carrier , " the united states went all - out to sell arms , and so this became the most frenzied period for us arms sales to taiwan .
the main characteristics of us arms sales to taiwan at this time were : first , equipment associated with existing equipment was sold to make up full sets .
in view of this they supplied appropriate parts , maintenance facilities , and ammunition .
this is an important characteristic of us arms sales to taiwan , because combat strength can be formed more easily and rapidly by this means .
on many occasions the state of these relations has been expressed in the question of arms sales to taiwan ; when relations are relatively good , the united states sells fewer arms to taiwan and the quality is not so good ; when relations are bad , the united states immediately improves the quantity and quality .
second , the united states regards arms sales to taiwan as an important weight in balancing cross - strait relations .
third , the united states regards taiwan as a " garbage can " for arms and equipment .
the f-16, e-2t , and patriot missile all fall within this category ; the united states will absolutely not sell taiwan the b-2 stealth bomber , the los angeles - class nuclear submarine , and the f-22 fighter .
of course , the most appetizing items at present are certain extremely sensitive hi - tech weaponry such as the aegis destroyer and the patriot-3 missile , because their technologies are not more than five to 10 years old .
arms sales to taiwan represent just a small move on the us chessboard , and the question of when to sell taiwan what kind of weapons and in what quantity and quality is closely related to the entire state of the chess game .
taking a general view , the next us move in arms sales to taiwan will be determined by three main factors : first is the legal obligation .
even if the act is vetoed by the president , it is completely possible for the united states to continue selling arms to taiwan in line with the 1979 " taiwan relations act " ; of course the arms sold are at least limited by obligation to defensive weapons .
second is the balance of military strength .
apart from that , still bigger fish can be caught and more economic profit reaped when the waters are muddied .
everything the united states has done in its arms sales to taiwan has been weighed up around these two issues , to seek a new point of balance .

the financial policy .
over the past few years , china issued about 100 billion yuan worth of additional construction bonds each year , which is a very prudent action .
in fact , the volume of issuing construction bonds definitely can be increased and controlled within the limits of tolerance .
at present , the issues of special treasury bonds for social security funds should be increased as soon as possible , and the social security system should be perfected so as to remove people 's worries for the future , improve residents ' consumption anticipations , and increase their expenditures .
to be in agreement with the expansive macroeconomic regulation and control policy , the introduction of taxation policy should be positively coordinated with other policies in a bid to accelerate the growth of the three major demands rather than produce the effect of canceling out one another .
the monetary policy .
to cope with the deflationary trend , we should change the previous prudent and conservative attitude toward the monetary policy , positively coordinate it with the financial policy , and follow up the policies closely to form the dual pushing forces for economic growth through the practice of a positive financial policy and moderate monetary policy .
efforts should be concentrated on the introduction of major policies and measures for direct financing , such as the founding of industrial investment funds and initial investment funds , the establishment of the " secondary market " to facilitate the transactions of listed high - tech enterprises , and so on .

comrade jiang zemin put forward his important thinking of " three represents " during his work inspection in guangdong .
the thinking of " three represents " is the foundation for the building of our party .
ever since the day of its birth , our party has remained an advanced political party that always marches at the head of china 's social development .
the historical mission , the historical position , and the historical roles of our party have always been linked with its advanced nature .
what is so advanced about it ?
a most fundamental manifestation is that our party represents the development demands of china 's advanced social productive forces , represents the orientation of china 's advanced culture , and represents the fundamental interests of the overwhelming majority of people in china .
these " three represents " serve as a foundation for all the activities and all the undertakings of our party , and even for its existence and development .
whenever we succeed in upholding these " three represents , " our party will be able to undergo flourishing growth , win the support of the masses of people , and withstand the impact of any kind of storm .
whenever we deviate from or fail to completely abide by the " three represents , " we will face various problems , the masses will show discontent , and our party will encounter difficulties and setbacks .
in the new century , we are faced with a complicated environment both inside and outside the country wherein there are not only rare opportunities but also severe challenges .
we are currently shouldering the heavy responsibility of leading the people to build socialism with chinese characteristics , to comprehensively build a prosperous society , and to advance toward the objective of basically realizing socialist modernization .
the tide and trend of the times , as well as the situation and special features of social changes , have all placed many new subjects before us .
so long as our party can always uphold the " three represents up " and be a qualified " representative in the three aspects , " it can always remain at an invincible position , can always win the wholehearted support of the people of all nationalities of the entire country , and can lead people to forge forward .
the thinking of " three represents " is the basis of our ruling power .
during the first half of the 20 th century , through revolutionary struggles over a long period of time , our party led the people to overthrow the rule of imperialism , feudalism , and bureaucratic capitalism ; founded a new china , and seized the ruling power of the country .
our party 's ruling position is entrusted by history and the people .
in the new century , our party has shouldered more arduous tasks in administering the country and will have to resolve a greater number of more complicated problems in this respect .
the thinking of " three represents " is the source of our strength .
what makes our party become increasingly stronger and grow into a big party today which has more than 61 million members ?
what enables our party successfully lift the country from the state of poverty and blankness , attain tremendous achievements in economic and social development , ensure sufficient food and clothing for its 1.2 billion people , and bring about a well - off life by the end of this century ?
why can our party always " have deep roots and luxuriant leaves " despite the mistakes it has committed and the setbacks it has suffered , successfully withstand the tests of storms and hardships of all kinds , and win the support of the masses of the people ?
the reason for all this is that our party can always give a fundamental impetus to the development of china 's social productive forces , promote china 's cultural progress , and do solid work and seek benefits for the people in a down - to - earth manner .
this is the source of all our strength , and also the secret of our never - ending success and growth .
in the past , to run china 's affairs well , the party was the key ; in our future efforts to run china 's affairs well , the party will still be the key .

comrade hu qiaomu was an outstanding marxist theoretician , an encyclopedic scholar , and , from the 40 's to the 80 's , the cpc 's important leader in the ideological theoretical , cultural propaganda front .
he had great attainments and original insights in numerous academic disciplines , including philosophy , the humanities , and social sciences .
as a result , all the articles , speeches , and talks on major international and domestic issues made by comrade hu qiaomu during his lifetime , which had a great impact on the above - mentioned academic spheres , have been basically collected and passed on to the world forever .
amid the great storms of international political struggle , he wrote plenty of famous articles that exerted a very great impact .
he was responsible for the work of drafting the resolution on the party 's certain historical questions since the nation 's founding , and successively made 30 - plus speeches at the party central committee 's meetings and within the draft panel .
" as for works that disseminate individualism and bourgeois humanism , we of course have to criticize it , and we have to do so no matter who stands it our way . "
in " qiaomu 's collection " , what we read is comrade hu qiaomu 's numerous pithy views on the work on the cpc 's history , news and publication , literature and art , and linguistics .
these views , which were perceptions of law acquired after in - depth studies of these areas in long - term practice , are of long - term guiding significance .
he said : as far as the research work on party history is concerned , we must have firm party spirit , narrate the party 's history from the party 's standpoint , yet we must be strictly scientific .
he once guided the work of yanan " jiefang ribao " and chongqing " xinhua ribao " , wrote a whole bunch of editorials , commentaries , and other press releases .
in the spring of 1982 , comrade hu qiaomu criticized , on just grounds and with restraint , the emerging erroneous trend in society that propagated the one - sided view of the " people 's nature " of the party newspaper in an attempt to deny the party 's leadership over journalistic work .
he was one of the founders of the publication undertaking of the new china .
following the third plenary session of the 11 th party central committee , comrade hu qiaomu directly guided the major projects in the new china 's publication history .
he was the director of the general editorial board of " china encyclopedia " as well as the initiator of " contemporary china book series " .
in june 1983 , he took charge of the drafting of the cpc central committee 's and the state council 's " decision on strengthening publication work " , which defined the nature , task , and guiding principle of publication work in the new period .
after 1985 , comrade hu qiaomu was very concerned about the enactment of " copyright law " and " publication law " , voiced his guiding opinions from drafting to revising , and devoted a great effort to making laws on our country 's publication work .
regarding the question of how to handle well the relationship between economic benefit and social benefit - - a long - perplexing issue for the publication industry , comrade hu qiaomu proceeded from the actual situation and made a lot of suggestions .
these suggestions were accepted by the central authorities as well .
comrade hu qiaomu was also the one who pushed ahead with the reform of chinese characters and the socialist literature undertaking .
in 1982 , he , on the basis of long - term research on the font structure of chinese characters , set forth the 15 principles of simplifying chinese characters , thus offering the basic thinking for bringing about the informationization of chinese characters .
he time and again pointed out that chinese characters could not be eliminated and would still be used for a very long time , so phonetic transcription would be a very long process .
by so doing , the work of character reform in the new period has been put on a feasible foundation .
he pointed out : in the new historical period , it is very essential to replace the old slogan " for politics " with the new " two for " [ liang wei ] slogan .
compared with the formulation of " for politics " , the " two for " slogan is more straightforward in expressing the service goal of our literature and art and opens up a yet broader service channel for our literature and art .
lauding outstanding writers ' works and criticizing erroneous trends of creation is comrade hu qiaomu 's principal way to guide the work of literature and art .
regarding the one - sided dissemination of the ideological trend of the modernist school , he , proceeding from a host of facts in the history of chinese and foreign literature , made a scientific analysis and criticism .
on the one hand , he affirmed that artistic creation is always needed , but at the same time pointed out : the most fundamental principle is that art cannot deviate from life and creation cannot deviate from art .
regarding the excellent creations of our country 's writers and artists , he always enthusiastically made speeches and wrote articles to affirm and praise them .

hong kong , may 22 (zts) - - taiwan 's new leader chen shui - bian used the term " formosa " twice in his inaugural speech on may 20 .
many people held that there could be some skillful political contrivance behind ah bian 's " three cheers " for " formosa " in his " inaugural ceremony . "
" formosa " is a word of portuguese origin .
portugal invaded taiwan a number of times after that .
the fact is , the chinese had been living in taiwan as early as in the third century . the island was called yizhou at that time . china began calling it taiwan since the ming dynasty in the 13 th century .
" formosa " was just the name used by foreign explorers .
when taiwan was under japanese occupation , it was called " formosa " by the japanese . for this reason , separatists in taiwan in the 1960 s and 1970 s also referred to taiwan as " formosa . "
peng ming - min , the " godfather of taiwan independence , " gave the following explanation several years ago : " the chinese call this island taiwan . in order to show our opposition to china , we are calling it ' formosa ' the way the portuguese did . "
during the 1950 s and 1960 s , official us and japanese documents also often referred to taiwan as " formosa . " this name was only abandoned after the establishment of sino - us and sino - japanese diplomatic ties .
chen shui - bian , then a lawyer , represented the staff of " formosa " magazine at court .
could it be that while making the " five - no " promises to beijing , including the promise " not to declare the independence of taiwan , " he also had to make known his future political goals to the " taiwan independence " forces within the dpp in his inaugural speech ?
chen shui - bian 's fellow party members probably know such skillful political contrivance very well deep down .

before i visited nansha islands [ the spratlys ] , what i heard most often were those heart - touching stories about the hardships , patriotism , and dedication of the chinese garrison troops there .
from their simple talks imbued with ardent love for the country 's maritime territory , i realized these defenders ' earnestness in safeguarding the country 's maritime rights as well as their eagerness to see the development of the motherland 's maritime resources .
shocking statistics i never realized that i would show my ignorance during my first contacts with the garrison troops in nansha .
shortly after i stepped onto the yongshu reef , a fighter asked me this question , coldly : " do you know which is china 's largest provincial - level administrative region ? "
" it should be hainan province .
in addition to its 34,000 sq km of land mass , hainan also has 2.1 million sq km of waters , including the 820,000 sq km of nansha island groups which we are garrisoning . "
if that was only the first lesson the garrison troops gave me , their understanding of and concern for the motherland 's territorial waters made me regard them with admiration .
when are we going to develop our maritime resources that belong to us in the first place ?
when resources on the land are depleting and mankind is paying attention to oceans with rich resources , it has become an indisputable fact that " the 21 st century is the century of the sea . "
the increasingly fierce disputes between countries for maritime rights and resources are particularly conspicuous in nansha .
one document prepared by the china national offshore oil corporation shows that , in 1999 , china extracted from the sea 16.17 million tons of oil and 4.39 billion cubic meters of natural gas , but none from the seas in the nansha areas .
without a doubt , this should be a warning signal to us .
today when the country has started to develop the western parts of china in a big way , nansha , the 820,000 sq km maritime territory with rich resources should not become " a place to be forgotten . "
after i have visited nansha , i might also add that , if you have never visited nansha , you have no idea of the threat and great challenges confronting china in protecting its maritime territories and maritime rights .
without a doubt , china is a major maritime country , which has 18,000 km - long shorelines and 3 million sq km of maritime territories .
especially in the nansha areas , china 's neighboring countries have been seriously encroaching upon its oil and fishery resources there .
while what we are doing here - - defending nansha and guarding the motherland 's southern gate - - is a sacred cause , we also expect that nansha can contribute to the motherland 's modernization with its rich maritime resources .
since neighboring countries are extracting oil and catching fish in the nansha areas , we hope our country will intensify its efforts in developing and exploiting nansha 's resources so that the protection and development of nansha can proceed at the same time . "
today when the whole world has to deal with such problems as rapid population growth and depleting land resources , developing maritime resources is something countries the world over have been doing .
how to protect maritime resources from encroachment and how to develop these resources have become an urgent , important matter confronting all countries , including china .
at a time when the " maritime century " is around the corner , china - a nation that used to lead the world in maritime technology and a nation having been humiliated for losing its maritime sovereignty - can no longer afford to wait at this historical hour !
meticulously studying and implementing this important thinking is of immense realistic significance and far - reaching historic significance for comprehensively pushing forward the great project of constructing the party and realizing the great transcentury goal of the chinese nation .
standing at the turn of the century , china is facing both opportunities and challenges .
whether or not we can continuously improve our party s leadership skills and governing skills and whether or not we can strengthen our capabilities in fighting and preventing corruption and in protecting ourselves against risks are the two historic topics lying ahead of members of the communist party of china (cpc) .
the cpc is the vanguard of the chinese working class , is the sincere representative of the interests of all chinese nationalities and comprises the core leaders of the chinese socialist cause .
as early as the beginning period of planning to establish the cpc in 1921 , comrade mao zedong proposed establishing a party with the nature of being the vanguard .
the proposal of the three represents has given us further enlightenment for the direction of our construction in the new age .
the represents is both the basis of positioning the party and the foundation of governing the country as well .

beijing , 23 may (xhk) - - the 10 th issue of banyuetan bimonthly , which is published here , has carried an article written by wang jisi , director of the institute of north america under the chinese academy of social sciences , under the title " does globalization mean westernization ? "
as it has turned out , our exploration of the relationship between globalization and westernization today comes down in one continuous line with the discussion over the past 100 years on the relationship between modernization and westernization .
the crux of the issue lies , first of all , in the question as whether globalization is an objective development trend or just something that represents the subjective wish or the ideology of the west to dominate the world .
secondly , it lies in the question as what the political implication of " westernization " really is , and also in the question of whether developing countries can prevent themselves from becoming dependencies of the west during the process of participating in globalization .
the globalization we are talking about here mainly refers to the global process of an accelerated development in the fields of commodity exchange , capital flow , information transmission , personnel exchanges , and technological transfer .
to certain countries , controlling such a process from inside the country may still prove possible ; yet to the whole world , there is no other choice than globalization .
some people are trying to prove a " global americanization " by citing such facts as that american - style fast food and pop music have swept the world , the products of the microsoft have dominated the world 's software market , and that english has almost become a world language .
however , in the face of the fact that chinese costumes and chinese restaurants have also reached every corner of the world , no one has ever mentioned a " global sinicization . "
this is quite a natural thing , because the effect and influence produced by the two cannot be mentioned in the same breath .
nevertheless , china has , after all , achieved an economic and technological take - off amidst the trend of globalization .
in their eyes , " globalization " first represents the longing of western capital for the infinitely extensive new overseas markets that have never emerged before .
the financial crises in mexico , russia , and asia have brought no harm to the fundamental interests of the united states and europe , and many a western capital group has even reaped some profits from the crises .
however , from a long - term point of view , the economic growth of western countries depends on the stability and development of the global economy .
do not believe in " beautiful " lies we must be clearly aware that the west 's propagation of globalization carries a specific political intention .
us president clinton has taken the lead in advocating the idea that : " the barriers , obstacles , and boundaries experienced by our fathers and grandfathers in their world are being smashed today . "
it is true that the majority of americans are even richer than before , yet the trend of polarization continues .
the rise of the ultra - rightist wing in austria and other european countries , the rise of right - wing religious forces in the united states , and the emergence of an anti - foreign tendency of " new isolationism " have all served to show a strong reaction by western society to globalization .
although the leading groups of western countries have made attempts to expand their political influence with the aid of globalization , the objective trend is independent of their will .
when engaged in globalization , one must not forget nationalization therefore , it can be said a one - sided concept to regard globalization as a synonym for westernization .
first , in the struggle for international economic and political dominance , we must pay close attention to the formulation of the " rules of the game . "
second , deepening reform , adjusting the structure , and striving to enhance economic competitiveness is an essential condition for us to remain at an invincible position during the globalization process .
comrade jiang zemin has pointed out that chinese enterprises should draw on the advanced experiences of foreign enterprises , go out of the country , face the world and brave the storm , and enhance their own competitiveness in economic globalization .
the objective trend of globalization is calling for international cooperation on a global scale , and a global cooperation has far exceeded the scope of the economy .

under the guidance of deng xiaoping theory , a number of localities , such as ningbo , took the lead in introducing a competition mechanism into their work of cadre management as early as 1984 .
ever since then , many localities have engaged themselves in explorations and practices in this aspect .
as a result , the reform of an open selection and promotion of leading cadres has been spread from certain localities to all parts of the country , and has been developed from the stage of explorations and experiments to the stage of a gradual perfection and maturity .
the practice of open selection and promotion of leading cadres is a natural choice made by the party in adapting its organization work to the development demands of a socialist market economy .
today , china 's reform and opening up is on a magnificent scale , and its socialist market economy is enjoying a flourishing growth .
it is beyond all doubt that along with the constant development of the country 's socialist market economy , the practice of an open selection and promotion of leading cadres will surely grow increasingly wider in scope , and will enjoy fair competition of a higher degree .
the practice of an open selection and promotion of leading cadres is a major reform of the systems relating to the selection and appointment of cadres in china .
under such circumstances , the practice of an open selection and promotion of leading cadres is precisely an exploration that aims at giving shape to such a mechanism and system , and is precisely an innovation made on the basis of carrying forward our fine traditions .
we should emancipate our mind , and should approach the importance of an open selection and promotion of leading cadres from the high plane of the country 's overall interests .
the national conference for organization department heads held early this year pointed out the need for bringing about a vigorous development to the work of an open selection and promotion of leading cadres .
we should gradually standardize and perfect the procedures and methods designed for an open selection and promotion of leading cadres , and reinforce the work of organizing examinations and the work of building a database for examination questions .
meanwhile , we should increase the intensity of the work , and standardize and systemize the work of an open selection and promotion of leading cadres .
examinations are a key link in an open selection and promotion of leading cadres .
building up a high - quality , unified , and standardized central database for examination questions at the national level in line with high standards is a major way for enhancing the scientific level of examinations , and is also an effective measure for enhancing the work efficiency .
at the same time , we should also pay close attention to the comprehensive utilization of the database for examination questions , and strive to improve the study and development of modern technologies for the assessment and evaluation of able personnel .

of late , the party central committee has particularly stressed the need to strategically adjust the economic structure .
in general , is structural adjustment a very crucial factor for developing the economy ? [ liu shijin ] structural adjustment is one of the basic factors propelling economic development .
under such circumstances , the united states made a strategic adjustment of its economy , aimed at grabbing the commanding point in the world 's technological development . it made all - out efforts to develop high - tech industries with emphasis on information technology and , at the same time , applied high technology to traditional industries .
in the late 80 's , china 's economic development was hampered by a series of " bottlenecks , " including the shortages of energy , transportation and communications facilities , and raw materials , which forced its economic growth to slow down .
how does the current structural adjustment differ from those in the past ? [ liu shijin ] under the impact of economic globalization in these years , the original patterns of division of labor and allocation of resources are undergoing important historic changes .
put another way , it has reached a crucial stage where there could be no motive power to propel its further growth unless we make a large - scale adjustment of its structure .
differences between the current economic structural adjustment and the previous ones can be summarized as follows : first , this is an " upgrading type " adjustment carried out with the background that the economy of shortage has ended and most traditional industries are turning out more products than demanded .
the structural adjustment in the early 1980 's was of the " makeup type , " and that in the 1990 's was a combination of the " gap - filling type " and " upgrading type . "
second , this is an " accommodating type " adjustment aimed at boosting china 's industrial competitiveness in the world with the background that economic globalization is proceeding at an accelerated pace and china is going to join the wto .
first , contradictions exist among the three categories of industries .
second , contradictions exist between urban and rural areas .
in terms of development , there is a steadily growing gap between the southeastern coastal areas and the central and western regions .
in addition , some problems still exist between different administrative areas , such as different product and production - elements markets for different areas , blockade imposed on each other , and the implementation of the self - protectionism policy .
fourth , contradiction exists with respect to products and productive capacities .
there is a surplus supply of products of low technological level and low added value , and the productive capacity for such products is also excessive . as for high - tech and high - added - value products , both their supply and productive capacity are inadequate . some of these products have to be imported .
fifth , contradictions exist in the industrial structure .
for a long time , problems of low quality , overlapping , scattering , and small - scale operations have existed in china 's industrial and enterprise structures . the most striking problem is overlapping projects built by different administrative departments and areas .
sixth , contradictions exist in the consumption pattern .
seventh , contradictions exist in the structure of the financial industry .
the present financial structure based on a few big state banks can hardly provide diverse and effective services to meet the requirements of non - state - owned enterprises , especially small and medium - sized enterprises , which have emerged and are playing an increasingly important role in china 's economic development .
eighth , contradictions exist in the ownership system .
we should use development to motivate adjustment and proceed with industrial upgrading to force certain industries and enterprises to withdraw . and we should use adjustment to inject vitality into development . second , we should properly deal with the relationship between reform and adjustment .

beijing , 24 may ( xinhua ) - - the implementation of the " regulation on the real - name system for individual bank accounts " has been advancing steadily and smoothly since 1 april this year .
with regard to some deposit work methods , the circular points out : time deposits or installment savings , that should be transferred automatically between bank accounts according to the contracts signed between individuals and banking institutions before 1 april 2000 , should go along with the relevant regulations which were effective before 1 april 2000 .
depositors should observe the real - name system when consigning money at their hometowns or the places other than their hometowns for automatic deposits and withdrawals .
the circular reiterates the rules for banks to maintain secrecy for depositors .
the circular urges that all commercial banks and relevant banking institutions should do deposit work strictly in line with the " regulations on the real - name system for individual deposit accounts . "
all banking institutions should do a good job of disseminating and explaining the real - name system , adopt various measures to give conveniences to depositors , and offer good - quality and high - efficiency services to depositors .

a sage once said : " i would rather be a lotus flower than a duckweed . "
this was the only time he mentioned " one china " in his speech , moreover he prefaced it with the attributive " future " ; the meaning of this is very clear , that is , one china is not the present reality but is in the future .
this principle has been formed by the chinese people in the course of the struggle to defend national sovereignty and territorial integrity ; it has an incontrovertible basis in historical fact and law , and is absolutely not some " issue . "
the chinese government 's stance on the one china principle has always been consistent , firm , and clear , that is , there is only one china in the world , taiwan is part of china , and china 's sovereignty and territorial and territorial integrity brook no division .
taiwan has never been a state in history and has always been an inseparable part of chinese territory .
in 1895 , after defeat in the 1894 - 95 war with japan , the corrupt qing government was forced to sign the " treaty of shimonoseki " by which taiwan was ceded to japan ; the chinese government resumed the exercise of sovereignty over taiwan on 25 october 1945 .
the chinese government consistently exercised sovereignty over taiwan after that .
the prc was established in 1949 . this was the historic choice of the chinese people on the question of the right to represent china .
as the sole legitimate government of china , the prc government naturally enjoys and exercises sovereignty over the whole of china , including taiwan .
although the two sides of the strait have not yet been reunified , this abnormal state of affairs has not granted taiwan international status and rights ; there has been no change in taiwan 's legal status as part of chinese territory , and there has been no change in chinese possession of sovereignty over taiwan .
the one china principle has been universally acknowledged by the international community .
it was precisely based on this consensus that cross - strait peace and stability were maintained for a long time .
the one china principle is the basis of the peaceful and stable development of cross - strait relations and it should be the basic and elementary cross - strait consensus .
whether or not to accept and recognize the one china principle has become the yardstick for testing whether the leader of the taiwan authorities upholds national sovereignty and territorial integrity or continues to stubbornly push the separatist policy of " taiwan independence . "
the attendees also expressed their determination to oppose " taiwan independence " and to promote reunification and their strong wish to materialize the motherland 's reunification .
the leader of the taiwan authorities should go with the historical tide , comply with the people 's wish , make a wise choice , and not be condemned by history for splitting the motherland .
in his speech , lin shangyuan , vice president of the huangpu military academy alumni association , said : our struggle with taiwan 's splittist forces is by no means a struggle whether or not we want democracy and of which kind of system we should adopt , but a struggle whether or not they want reunification or splitting .
however " taiwan independence " elements may distort reality , they cannot change taiwan 's status as a part of china .

beijing , 25 may ( xinhua ) - - the cpc central committee , state council , and central military commission [ cmc ] held a television and telephone conference in beijing this afternoon to sum up work regarding the withdrawal of the military , armed police , and political and legal organs from business activities .
wei jianxing , member of the standing committee of the cpc central committee politburo , secretary of the secretariat , and secretary of the central discipline inspection commission , presided at the meeting .
hu jintao said that in july 1998 , at the suggestion of comrade jiang zemin , the cpc central committee made an important policy decision that the military , armed police , and political and legal organs should no longer take part in any business activities .
in the past two years , under the correct leadership of the cpc central committee , state council , and cmc , and with the common efforts of the military and the localities , this work has developed smoothly and healthily and achieved marked success .
by the end of 1998 the military , armed police , and political and legal organs had completely cut ties with all the enterprises they were running ; by march this year the work of withdrawing from business activities had been basically completed and achieved the predicted target .
practice has proven that this major policy decision of the central authorities is highly popular with the party , the military , and the people , and is completely correct .
the main methods and experiences are as follows : first , bring people 's thinking into line with the central intentions and do a good job in thorough and meticulous ideological and political work .
second , firmly grasp the targets and principles of the work and institute strong and effective organizational leadership .
the central authorities proposed specific guidelines for this work , and comrade jiang zemin issued a series of important instructions on doing a good job of it , thus clearly pointing out the way for us to tackle the work .
the principal responsible comrades of large military units and of regions and departments attached great importance to the work , seriously shouldered their responsibilities , and tackled the work in thorough and meticulous fashion at every stage .
third , persist in proceeding from reality and institute all - round and specific policy guidance .
fourth , display the spirit of unity and cooperation and strengthen coordination between the sectors concerned .
under the unified leadership of the central authorities , all sectors concerned have borne the overall situation in mind , closely cooperated , and formed a joint force ; this was an important guarantee for dealing with complex contradictions and smoothly promoting the work .
hu jintao pointed out that while affirming the achievements and summing up the experiences , it is also necessary to see that there are also a number of shortcomings in the work .
present at the main location of the meeting were responsible comrades of the central and state organs and departments concerned ; responsible comrades of large military units and armed police stationed in beijing ; and responsible comrades of discipline inspection and control organs stationed in central and state organs .

it can be regarded as certain that china will enjoy us normal trade relations status , which means there will be one big obstacle less for the future development of sino - us relations .
china and the united states reached a bilateral accord last november on china 's entry into the world trade organization (wto) .
according to wto regulations , the legislative organs of the two countries must grant each other most favored nation [ mfn ] treatment ( the united states changed this to normal trade relations in 1998 ) before the accord can come into effect .
the standing committee of the national people 's congress long ago passed the sino - us agreement , and the house vote was only delayed until now on account of argument in the us congress .
pntr is the acronym for permanent normal trade relations and is the new way of stating the former " mfn treatment for china . "
according to us estimates , following the passage of the pntr bill , chinese exports to the united states can rise by about 7 percent a year , while us exports to china can rise by 10 percent a year .
bilateral economic cooperation , including allowing market entry , patent rights , private investment , and joint ventures , will rise to a higher level .
as everyone knows , since 1989 the us senate and house have annually examined and discussed an mfn agreement for china , and this has been regarded as a political means for constraining china .
clinton 's desire to do away with the " mfn card " which certain congressmen had played for 10 years was an extremely arduous political project .
early this year , president clinton set up a " staff group " in the white house composed of senior aides and advisers ; its sole task was to work with president clinton in endeavoring to have congress pass the china pntr bill .
the first breakthrough - style victory for the clinton staff group came on 9 may when they gained support for pntr from former presidents carter and ford .
clinton made still greater efforts in meeting congressmen or lobbying them by phone every day ; he also emphasized that this was a strategic issue related to " national security . "
on 21 may albright said with emotion when interviewed on abc 's " this week " program : " president clinton and his staff group have made extremely great efforts to get pntr for china through congress , and he has spoken with practically every congressman .
i myself believe that this bill is the most important national security vote in congress this year , because it will truly provide an opportunity to change america 's all - round relationship with china . "
the lobbyists included the chairman of the shanghai and hong kong american chambers of commerce and five former chairmen of the hong kong chamber .
from 15 to 20 may the chambers of commerce had 120 meetings with congressmen , the department of commerce , the national security council , the pentagon , and the office of the us trade representative .
the result of the house vote shows that support for pntr is a common democratic and republican policy on china , something rarely seen in the past 10 years .

this is a sensible move on the us part .
the passing of the bill will help both china and the united states develop economic and trade relations on the basis of equality and mutual benefit , and help create conditions for the healthy and steady growth of sino - us relations .
the passage of the bill creates a win - win situation for sino - us economies and trade .
us vice president al gore also issued a statement , pointing out that the passage of the bill by the house of representatives will bring better employment opportunities to us industrial workers and be conducive to us interests and security .
however , it is regrettable that proceeding from a hegemonist mentality , some people in the united states have tried to use the bill to interfere in china 's internal affairs and attached some clauses detrimental to china 's interests .
the chinese side has indicated its strong concern and dissatisfaction about this and said it is absolutely unacceptable to china .
the chinese government has made solemn representations to the us government .
china is the largest developing country in the world , while the united states is the largest developed country in the world . the two economies share a very strong complimentarity .
since the establishment of sino - us diplomatic relations , trade volume between the two countries rose from $ 2.45 billion in 1979 to $ 61.5 billion in 1998 , an increase of nearly 2,500 percent .
china has become the fourth largest trading partner of the united states , while the united states is the second largest trading partner of china .
sino - us trade has provided the united states with nearly 300,000 high - paid and hi - tech employment opportunities and created at least 1 million jobs for us wholesalers , retailers , and transport companies .
there are now 29,000 sino - us joint - venture enterprises on the chinese mainland . they have created 1 million employment opportunities for china .
according to an estimate by a us company , by the year 2005 , us exports to china will double the present level and , in the next five years , us farm produce exports to china will reach $ 2 billion a year .
thanks to its superiority in value - added services , hong kong 's sales industry and banks , as well as financial , insurance , telecommunication industries , tourism , and other service industries , will gain a lot of benefit .
as the mainland and the united states are hong kong 's two largest trading partners , a stable economic and trade relationship between the two countries is most important to hong kong .

practice has fully proven that the central policies on grain reform are entirely correct and have played an important role in protecting peasants ' enthusiasm for grain production , giving impetus to agricultural structural adjustment , precipitating the sustained , rapid , and healthy development of the national economy , and maintaining social stability .
however , there are still some problems existing in the current grain production and circulation which need to be taken seriously and resolved .
in some principal grain producing areas , there is a greater gap in grain risk funds and a deficiency in storing capacity which has hampered the implementation of the procurement policy without limitation .
the meeting stressed that further carrying out and improving various policies and measures for the structural reform of grain production is a major issue that has a bearing on safeguarding peasants ' interests , giving impetus to agricultural development , and maintaining stability in rural areas .
the core of " three policies and one reform " is to purchase peasants ' surplus grain at protective prices without restriction .
under the present situation featured by the low market prices and the failure of state - owned grain enterprises to unlimitedly purchase grain at protective prices , the relaxation of grain markets will inevitably lead to further decline of grain prices , directly do harm to peasants ' interests , and dampen their enthusiasm .
only by " purchasing without restrictions " can we " relax the restrictions " on the markets , which is a principle that we must adhere to .
the meeting called for various localities and departments to genuinely seek unity of thinking , act in concert , ensure that government decrees are carried out without impediment , and carry out the central policies on grain reform to the letter .
at present , it is necessary to properly conduct the preparatory work for the procurement of summer grain in a down - to - earth manner .
in increasing grain risk funds and constructing storing facilities , stress should be put on the principal grain producing areas .
the meeting proposed that further widening the grain purchasing and marketing channels is an important measure for improving the grain circulation structural reform .
with regard to the grain varieties excluded from the scope of purchases at protective prices , grain consuming enterprises and marketing enterprises will be allowed to purchase grain in the rural areas after the examination and approval of the industrial and commercial administrative departments at prefectural ( city ) or county level .
it is necessary to optimize the structure of varieties , enhance grain quality ; accelerate the implementation of seed engineering , import , select , and disseminate fine varieties , and optimize the crop variety structure in a comprehensive way .
at present , stress should be put on the building of an agricultural product quality standard system , a testing and checking system , and a market information service system .
in the areas with poor ecological environment , cultivated land unfit for grain production should be returned to forestry or animal husbandry step by step in a planned way .
the meeting stressed that grain is a special commodity and strategic material that has a bearing on the national economy and people 's livelihood .
it is our strategic principle to base ourselves on china 's realities to achieve basic self - sufficiency in grain and ensure safety in grain production , which must be adhered to for a long time .
to ensure the safety in grain production , the most important thing is to protect grain production capacity , and the crux of it lies in effectively protecting peasants ' initiative in growing grain .
the meeting stressed that doing a good job of grain production and circulation has an impact on the overall situation of national economic development and social stability .
various localities should further put into effect the provincial governor responsibility system in relation to grain and strengthen leadership in grain production and circulation work .
