in the late 1970 s , the practice of household output - linked contract operations which was first adopted in xiaogang village , fengyang county , spread across china , playing a leading and exemplary role in nationwide rural reform .
in march of this year , the cpc central committee and the state council decided to begin a rural tax reform pilot project covering anhui province as a whole .
before the start of the tax and fee reform , the problem of peasants ' burden was , for a time , rather serious in anhui province .
in many localities , peasants ' actual burden exceeded 10 percent .
huai county is anhui 's rural areas in microcosm .
before the tax and fee reform , huaiyuan county was supposed to collect 26 million yuan in agricultural tax , but the township overall arrangement money , which was a fee in nature , and village retention money totaled 85 million yuan , which was more than three times the agricultural tax .
rural cadres cannot get the overall arrangement money and the retention money from the grain stations and thus would search every home for money , thereby sharpening their conflict with peasants .
in 1993 , xinzhen township , woyang , was the first to introduce the practice of collecting 30 yuan per mu in agricultural tax and fee on a trial basis , thereby effectively stopping authorized levies on peasants .
experts at the cpc provincial committee , the provincial government , and the relevant departments quickly discovered the positive significance of this reform touching upon the rural tax and fee system .
the three models explored all had their respective characteristics , and peasants at large showed unprecedented support and cooperation for the reform , resulting in rapid stabilization of rural society .
the relevant department of fuyang city recently conducted a questionnaire survey of peasants citywide ; 100 percent of the respondents indicated approval and support with regard to the question , " can the tax and fee reform reduce peasants ' burden , " and the question , " do you support or oppose this reform . "
peasants described such reform measures as " one tax , clean and simple . "
the county also tells each peasant household the items and amount of its burden , issues a tax notice , a full tax payment certificate , and supplemental receipts to each household , and provides tax breaks to individual households .
according to estimates , the tax reform policy currently being implemented across anhui province is reducing peasants ' burden by over 50 percent in some localities .
peasants in taihe county as a whole will pay over 90 million yuan less in taxes and fees .
" in the past , we did not understand all those numerous taxes and fees of all kinds , but now they are gone . we now only have to keep one receipt for the agricultural tax and the supplement to the tax . "
bureaucracy streamlining is the key to burden reduction the huge township bureaucracy is the source of the township fiscal situation of " many consumers but few producers " and is an important cause of the growing burden on peasants .
the way to eliminate the township " fiscal crisis " is to effectively carry out bureaucracy streamlining , while trying every means to develop financial resources .
" it will not be possible to thoroughly reduce peasants ' burden without reducing the number of township officials . "
secretary li zhuang of the cpc huaiyuan county committee said : " there is still a lot of potential for streamlining . "
last year , in the process of rural tax and fee reform , anhui province laid off 11,000 surplus township personnel , thereby saving nearly 600 million yuan in fiscal spending .
guanji town , taihe county reduced the number of administrative personnel from 162 to 77 in one move .
according to township cadres , efforts to streamlining township bureaucracy were made several times before , but the vicious circle of streamlining - expansion - streamlining again - expansion again remained .
localities in anhui have adopted necessary safeguard measures for laid - off township cadres .
in the process of laying off personnel , chaohu city sent high - quality cadres to villages to teach techniques in an effort to help peasants market agricultural and sideline products or to develop leading enterprises so as to advance local economic development .
the rural tax and fee reform has forced the function of grassroots governments to undergo significant changes .
previously , governments were exhausted by endless standing - reaching , upgrading , levy - collection , and fund - gathering operations . peasants were forced to carry out many operations based on officials ' willful decisions after the money had been collected ; in some cases , peasants were even deprived of their autonomy .
under such a management system based on government authority and high targets , townships were exhausted by all kinds of stand - reaching activities and had to put aside social and public services .
after the adoption of the reform , under ordinary circumstances governments only take part in investments in public interest projects such as road , water , electricity , school , and agricultural infrastructure projects and will no longer take part in profit - based investment and operational activities in the name of owners of collective economic entities .
shuangfu town , taihe county , once built a chemical plant through collecting 2 million yuan from peasant households , but the equipment was sold as scrap steel before the enterprise engaged in production for a single day .
village cadres have also been emancipated from the need to urge people to deliver grain and money as in the past and now have the energy to devise plans for the villages ' development .
tax and fee reform involves many aspects and is urgent , difficult , and complicated . many segments of the process require improvement and breakthrough in reform .
but , it can be expected that with the deepening of rural tax and fee reform , china 's rural economy will demonstrate even greater vitality and vigor and that peasants at large will build new splendor in the field of hope .

on the morning of 26 may at zhongnanhai , zhu rongji held a forum on further improving the social security system .
relevant responsible comrades from the relevant departments under the state council and from some provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities , including beijing , hebei , inner mongolia , liaoning , and shaanxi , reported on their efforts to ensure the payment of old - age pensions to retirees and basic living allowances to laid - off workers .
in his speech , zhu rongji first expounded on the importance , necessity , and urgency of speeding up the building of the social security system .
he said that guaranteeing the broad masses of workers ' basic rights and interests and providing them with basic living guarantees are the communist party 's nature and basic purpose .
meanwhile , the building of this system is also conducive to improving the people 's psychological expectations , expanding consumption , and promoting the sustained and fast growth of the economy .
in short , the improvement of this system is a great principle for ruling the state and bringing peace to the country ; it is also a matter associated with the building of a fundamental system governing the socialist undertaking .
zhu rongji pointed out that the party central committee with comrade jiang zemin as the core has paid full attention to the building and improvement of the social security system and made a series of important decisions and instructions . we must intensify our understanding and keep a firm grip on the implementation of these decisions and instructions .
enterprises and institutions are only asked to pay social insurance premiums according to the law . and they will no longer take on the routine duties of distributing basic social insurance expenses and managing the people with social security .
we should draw on foreign experiences and lessons to reasonably define the standards .
the people will find it difficult to support themselves and their families if the standards are too low . at the same time , the various fronts are not able to bear the excessively high standards .
the high - tier social security funds needed should be resolved through supplementary and commercial insurance programs .
third , it is necessary to improve the current system of three lines of support - - the basic old - age insurance system , the system to provide the basic cost of living for laid - off workers and the unemployment insurance system , and the system to ensure a minimum standard of living for the urbanites .
the laid - off workers who do not get re - employed by the time their unemployment insurance expires will be all allowed to enter the program of the minimum living standards for the urbanites . fourth , it is necessary to socialize the management and service of social guarantees .
social insurance money should be distributed by society .
we should standardize and systemize the collection , payment , and use of social insurance funds ; achieve publicity , transparency , and safety ; and guarantee and increase the value of such funds through effective management .
sixth , we should set up in a step - by - step manner a standard , transparent , all - functional , and wide - coverage social security information network , with a view to modernizing the management .
zhu rongji stressed that the key to further improving the social security system hinges on a stable and reliable fund - raising mechanism .
according to the law , various categories of enterprises and institutions in the urban areas and their staff and workers should pay social insurance premiums on time and in full .
we should plug the loopholes , collect all the funds that should be collected , and reduce losses .
meanwhile , all levels of finances should further readjust the budgetary expenditure structure and increase the proportion that is earmarked for social security .
we should pay firm attention to studying feasible methods , such as liquidating some state assets and issuing long - term social security bonds , in an effort to set up a national social security fund .
zhu rongji urged that we must thoroughly implement the current social guarantee policy and achieve " two guarantees " while at the same time making good preparations for improving the social security system .
we should conscientiously sum up , commend , and popularize the good experiences in achieving " two guarantees " gained by shaanxi , beijing , and dalian .
notices of criticism should be circulated to the areas with new late payments .
this year , we should strive to have old - age insurance premiums fully , instead of partially , paid by individuals and basically socialize the payment of old - age pensions .
all localities should try every possible means to increase social insurance funds and use their extra - budgetary financial resources to supplement social insurance funds .
so , we must further strengthen leadership , carefully make plans , and carry out the work in a step - by - step manner .
on the basis of in - depth investigation and study and repeated assessments , the special group under the state council set forth a specific implementation plan at the end of last year . upon approval by the central authorities , this plan will be carried out on a trial basis among some selected areas .
the governments should actually renew their thinking ; change their functions ; regard the building of a good social environment for reform , opening up , and economic development as their key duty ; and exert great efforts to build a social security safety net .
beijing , 29 may ( xinhua ) - - tomorrow , renmin ribao will carry a signed article entitled " ten big advantages of peaceful reunification . "
the full text of the article is as follows : ten big advantages of peaceful reunification chen kongli what advantages will peaceful reunification bring ?
according to my research , the advantages brought by peaceful reunification may be summarized into the following ten points .
the people on both sides of the strait will be the biggest beneficiaries of peaceful reunification .
second , jointly share and enjoy security , stability , and peace [ subhead ] after reunification , with an environment of peaceful coexistence , security , and stability in cross - strait relations , the entire people of our nation can jointly share and enjoy such peace .
the security issue that the masses in taiwan are most concerned about can be guaranteed . they will no longer worry about the reappearance of tension and the possibility of a war . the dispute between reunification and independence inside taiwan can also be solved . this will be beneficial to taiwan 's social stability .
fourth , economic cooperation and mutual benefits [ subhead ] in the economic field , cross - strait cooperation will continue to expand in scope , and develop to a higher level with closer ties being built up to the realization of regional integration .
at that time , the two sides of the strait , together with hong kong and macao , will become a huge economic entity in east asia . the people throughout the country will become the beneficiaries of the long - lasting prosperity and development of this economic entity .
for the part of taiwan , with the removal of artificial , structural , and policy obstacles , cross - strait economic and trade cooperation will be developed according to the rules of the market economy .
while facing the coming of the knowledge economy era , the two sides may reinforce their cooperation , jointly formulate a strategy for sustainable development , seek mutual benefits through complementing each other and joint development .
for the part of taiwan compatriots , the current laws , regulations , and methods related to them on the mainland side can only be formulated unilaterally .
in the future , the opinions of the taiwan side can be better solicited for making improvements , or corresponding laws can be formulated to give explicit stipulations , thus better protecting their legitimate rights and interests .
sixth , unprecedented enhancement of international status [ subhead ] the comprehensive national strength of china after reunification will be further enhanced , and its international status will be continuously raised .
china will establish diplomatic relations with almost all countries in the world and participate in almost all international organizations .
taiwan will also be able to smoothly solve problems in its foreign affairs .
on the contrary , without moving onto the path of reunification , the issue of so - called " international space " for taiwan will never be solved . this is not because the " menace and pressure " from the mainland , but because the one china principle is generally accepted by the world .
at present , taiwan 's military expenses exceed $ 10 billion per year . as long as the hostilities between the two sides of the strait are terminated , taiwan will be able to save a huge amount of military expenditure and shift the financial resources to social welfare and other fields which need the resources more urgently .
this will obviously be beneficial to the people of taiwan .
eighth , scientific and technological cooperation , complementing each other 's advantages [ subhead ] the mainland is carrying out a strategy of " relying on science and education for national regeneration , " and taiwan is also pursuing a plan for building the " science and technology island . "
the basic science and technology , the human resources in science and technology , and the scientific and technological achievements on the mainland side and the applied science and technology and the management expertise and the ability and experience in marketing on the taiwan side represent their respective advantages .
cultural and educational cooperation between the two sides will be of decisive significance in tapping our nation 's intelligence and human resources , enhancing the cultural quality of the whole nation , and regenerating the chinese culture .
both sides have respective advantages in their cultural and educational development . in recent years , cultural and educational exchanges have achieved certain results .
all peace - loving people in all asia - pacific countries and in the whole world will be glad to see this .
deng xiaoping said : " we should jointly struggle for the realization of the motherland 's reunification and for our national regeneration . "
he linked the motherland 's reunification with national regeneration .
we can say that the greatest benefit of reunification lies in the fact that the two sides make common development and thus jointly enhance china 's comprehensive national strength and realize the great ideal of regenerating china .
the common interests and the common development prospects of the two sides of the strait constitute a strong driving force for reunification .
therefore , peaceful reunification will require the benign interaction and joint efforts of the two sides .
therefore , i often ask taiwan compatriots : " what benefits do you think there should be ? "
i believe that peaceful reunification is beneficial to the nation and to the people , and the credit will last for many generations to come .
its benefits will be immeasurable , and will be demonstrated one by one in the future .
no one , neither you nor me , will be able to fully mention all the benefits . this is the exact charming point of peaceful reunification .

equipment development must take this as the standard .
the development strategy of " three steps forward " requires that all reform elements be coordinated with each other , to avoid any developmental imbalance , contradictions or conflicts .

changing from a platform as the basis to using networks as the basis ; trying to find new areas for growth in reasonable combinations of equipment elements equipment revolutions in different ages have all been constrained by the level of societal productive forces at any given time .
in the industrial age , the mechanical processes and industrial level were being perfected all the time , promoting the development of the airplane , the tank , armor , and other operational platforms , with raising the level of the platform as the primary avenue for seeking growth in combat strength .
the introduction of computer networks has caused the modern military 's combat strength to realize explosive growth .
at the same time as promoting weapons and equipment systemization and integrated development , networks have also promoted information flow among all types of weapons and equipment systems and even unitary weapons and equipment , enabling combat strength to possess the exponential factor of 1 + 1 > 2 .
actually though , it is incorrect to blindly trust the pursuit of development of equipment in strides on knowledge of a few weapons .
at the same time , if we must consider relying on one or a few weapons systems of superior performance , it will be difficult in the end to fight a war , with the comprehensive application of all kinds of weapons and equipment in combined operations being the only path to victory .

improving support methods and enhancing support efficiency .

through the asian financial crisis , people have seen the complexity of economic globalization and the damage that may be brought about through inappropriate countermeasures .
in fact , the dual - character nature has originally existed in the market mechanism , that is , the coexistence of benefits and risks , and opportunities and challenges .
speaking from this viewpoint , there are advantages and disadvantages in economic globalization for all countries .
however , these advantages and disadvantages are different for different countries .
this is because market systems and operating mechanisms as well as market competitiveness and market risk resistance capabilities of different countries in the world are different . therefore , although the rules of competition are equal , it is impossible for different countries to have equal advantages and disadvantages while participating in economic globalization .
developed countries of the west are those that formulate and manipulate the " rules of games " for international finance and trade . major international economic organizations are in fact also controlled by developed countries of the west . all these provide a platform for the west to conveniently force its will on developing countries .
faced with increasingly greater pressure from the west , the large number of developing countries will have a more difficult task to ensure the security of their own economies .
therefore , although economic globalization may allow some developing countries to seize opportunities , accelerate development , and minimize the differences between them and the developed countries , to the majority of developing countries , economic globalization may mean more challenges .
the changes in era and development in economic globalization have not resulted in the loss of the national economy .
while widening opening up to the outside world , we must also adopt measures suited to our national conditions and international practice to protect and support the development of the national economy . furthermore , these protective measures must not be negative .

china 's per capita gross domestic product in 1997 was nearly $ 1,000 , and the rate of household consumption was 47.5 per cent .
first of all , the main reason for insufficient consumer demand is the slowing of the growth of directly disposable personal income .
but at present , china still lacks an effective means of fiscal regulation and control by which to shrink the income disparity .
third , the income of agricultural people is low , and it is increasing only slowly . this is a major obstacle in the way of stimulating the agricultural village consumer market .
under these circumstances , accelerating marketplace reform of the [ income ] distribution system is not only an imperative for stimulating consumption , even more so it is an essential requirement of market economy reforms .
reform of the distribution system is not just an issue related to consumption .
under the current circumstances , with the level of revenue from commercialized consumer products in china still being low , it is not easy to be optimistic about accomplishing in full the objective of stimulating consumption by direct methods such as lowered interest and consumer credit .
therefore , we should really and truly lighten the burden of personal outlay , and increase personal income .
if we are to reform the income distribution system and form up a rational income distribution structure , i propose the following : 1 .
reform the " low salary " system of units within the system , and gradually move remuneration for labor toward complete monetization .
first , move remuneration for labor toward complete monetization as quickly as possible .
every sort of welfare - type income or bonus , subsidy , or thing issued in kind should be put into salaries .
the extent of the increase should be commensurate with social security and its individual contribution proportion .
looking at the final outcome , an individual would pay contributions totaling about 15 per cent of his salary .
it refers to a method whereby decisions on workers ' wages are arrived at through negotiations between enterprises ( employers ) and labor unions ( workers ) , under the protection and constraints of national laws .
the agreed wage system regulates the operation of the labor market under market economy conditions . it is a requirement for promoting reform of the social security system and reform of the housing and welfare distribution systems , and for promoting the rational flow of labor .
it is an important measure for coordinating the interests of enterprises and workers , and for protecting both sides ' legal rights .
fourth , truly implement " the principle of allocate by labor and allocate by essential factors , " and resolve as quickly as possible certain major problems in the area of distribution .
some state - run enterprises have acted as test beds for the managerial annual salary system , but it has made no essential breakthrough .
it is also necessary to continue to give an important place to increasing the income of intellectuals in salary distribution reform .
for unreasonable income disparity resulting from monopolization , we must use effective policy measures , and even the legal system , to constrain monopolization . we must break down sectoral monopolization , change the sole owner nature within these sectors , and increase competition within the sectors .
for example , some suggest establishing individual public employment fund accounts and recording most of an increased public service subsidy for public employees in these accounts to serve as a long - term mortgage for diligent , honest , and clean government from public servants .
then according to these boundaries , gradually clean up levies and establish taxes [ in their place ] [ qing fei li shui ; see point 3 below ] .
strengthen the role of tax assessment in regulating personal income .
second , we must improve consumption tax and tax on interest income .
as for the newly imposed tax on interest , this needs further improvement .
third , we must gradually clean up levies and establish taxes , lighten the burden on agricultural people , and reduce consumers ' anticipated outlays .
there are two aspects to cleaning up levies and establishing taxes which relate most importantly to consumer demand .
fourth , we must begin collecting inheritance tax and gifts tax as quickly as possible . 4 .
strengthen support to the low income stratum through transfer payments .
normally speaking , the objective of government transfer payments is to assist the weak , to allow the weak to be able to obtain basic subsistence support to get through times or hardship or to survive , and thus to do something about the gap between society 's rich and poor .
( personnel employed at enterprises [ which are state - owned and which are closing ] and people who have not left their agricultural village can be seen as personnel who have left but not yet entered the work marketplace . )
judging by the status of their capabilities , unemployed and laid - off people are normally all superior to agricultural workers , whether in terms of educational level , work skills , work adaptability , ability to interact and understand , or physical stamina .
clearly agricultural workers are the weakest , and they should receive more attention than the unemployed and laid - off .
besides this , government should also increase its legislative and judicial intervention in income distribution .
we must alleviate or avoid contradictions about distribution between labor and capital , and maintain social stability .

the first improvement : the intensity of investment in research and development has notably increased .
the " national technical innovation project " organized and implemented by the state economic and trade commission in 1993 has expanded to seven groups approving 294 national level enterprise technical centers , of which 221 belong to 520 key enterprises , accounting for 74 percent .
according to statistics , science and technology funds for large and medium - sized industrial enterprises in 1998 across china and research and development funds were 48.01 billion yuan and 21.6 billion yuan respectively , increases of 9.5 percent and 12.9 percent respectively over 1997 .
according to estimates by the aforementioned sixth group of 231 national level enterprise technical centers , in 1998 the average investment in research and development funds accounted for 2 percent of enterprise sales income , 1.3 percentage points higher than the national industrial enterprise average .
the second improvement : the development of enterprise technical innovation is in coordination with pilot cities selected for technical innovation .

the fifth improvement : initial scale was achieved for a technical innovation services system with cities as the base .
the sixth improvement : the apportioning of science and technology forces has been completely changed .

during these two decades , the mainland [ zu guo da lu ] has positively implemented the policy of peaceful reunification and " one country , two systems " toward taiwan , and persisted in taking the one - china principle as the precondition and foundation for developing the cross - straits economic and trade relations .
thanks to the mainland 's positive promotion and the joint efforts made by the compatriots across the straits for many years , considerable headway has been made in the cross - straits economic and trade cooperation .
taking a panoramic view of the development of the cross - straits economic and trade relations , people can see that there always exists the struggle between the observation of the one - china principle and the violation of this principle .
in this process , the mainland has taken the one - china principle as a guide , flexibly adopting different policies and measures at different stages of development of the cross - straits relations , and positively promoting the cross - straits economic and trade exchanges .
the cross - straits economic and trade relations witnessed a rapid development from 1988 to 1995 , and the emergence of this exceptionally favorable situation in this period was primarily attributable to a series of measures formulated and implemented by the mainland to encourage taiwan businessmen to make investment in and conduct trade with the mainland .
in january 1995 , president jiang put forth his eight - point proposal to taiwan , stressing the need to vigorously develop the cross - straits economic and trade exchanges and cooperation .
between 1988 and 1995 , the total amount of cross - straits trade increased from $ 360 million to $ 17.862 billion , with an average annual growth rate of 26.6 percent .
after 1996 , the cross - straits economic and trade cooperation came to a situation of tortuous development .
during his visit to the united states in june 1995 , li teng - hui openly advertised his line of splitting the motherland internationally .
in 1996 , li teng - hui again proposed the " no haste , be patient " policy to restrict taiwan investment in the mainland . li teng - hui 's perverse acts caused the taiwan 's investment in the mainland to decrease , and the growth rate of the cross - straits trade tended to decline .
in order to facilitate the cross - straits economic and trade cooperation , the mainland formulated and published the " detailed regulations on the implementation of protecting taiwan investment , " and various local governments also introduced policies and measures to support investment and trade of taiwan - funded enterprises .
in the meantime , it has also indicated that the cross - straits economic and trade relations have the characteristics of rapid development speed , great interdependence , strong complementarity , and ever - increasing interconnection .
it is thus obvious that the above characteristics of the cross - straits economic and trade cooperation have conditioned the interdynamic character of investment and trade across the straits .
hence , only by forming a rational division of labor between the two sides of the straits and promoting the optimum allocation of resources under the action of market mechanisms can the two sides attain common development through mutual benefit and complementarity .
the international economic and trade situation is favorable to the development of the cross - straits economic and trade relations .
in the wake of economic growth in 1999 , the world economy will continue to grow in 2000 . according to the latest forecast of the imf , the global economic growth rate this year will be 4.2 percent , and the growth rate of world trade will be 6 to 7 percent .
the better performance of the world economic powers and the principal trade partners in the asian region and the two sides of the taiwan straits will provide favorable conditions to the growth of the cross - straits trade . 2 .
the continuous development of the economies on both sides of the straits will propel the growth of the cross - straits trade .
the accession to the wto will provide new opportunities for the development of the cross - straits economic and trade relations . 1 ) the environment for the cross - straits economic and trade cooperation will be improved .
2 ) the reduction of tariffs and nontariff measures will accelerate the development of the cross - straits trade .
the investment environment will be further improved , as the mainland will open new investment spheres , particularly the service trade , to the outside world , which will provide business opportunities for taiwan investors .
4 ) it is beneficial to promoting the industrial division of labor and cooperation between the two sides of the straits so as to achieve common development by complementing each other 's advantages .
for instance : using certain provisions of the wto to restrict the " three links . "
creating obstacles under the pretext of expanding room for survival in the international community .
the most crucial of all is whether or not the new taiwan leader will discard his stand of taiwan independence and the " two - state theory " and return to the one - china principle , which is the crux of the matter .

in recent years , copyright piracy and illegal publications have had a severe impact on china 's publishing and culture market .
piracy activities not only have seriously infringed upon the legitimate rights of authors and publishing units , but also undermined the implementation of our country 's strategy of rejuvenating the nation through application of science and technology and promotion of education , affected socialist spiritualization , and damaged the nation 's publishing industry .
the essence of piracy is " theft . " piracy is not only harmful , but also a crime .
therefore , the harm of copyright piracy to society is obvious . it is not that " piracy is harmless " and " piracy is not a crime , " like what a small number of people think .
as a means for disseminating knowledge and civilization and for reflecting the authors ' labor and wisdom , publications are a collective display of achievements of social civilization . similarly , it reflects the efforts and innovative spirit of a nationality in the process of creating and promoting mankind civilization .
general secretary jiang zemin once said : " innovation is the soul of a nationality . "
in today 's world , where economic globalization is making rapid development , scientific and technological progress is changing everyday , and countries are intensifying their competition to raise comprehensive national strength , it is particularly important to stir up and encourage the national innovative spirit .
however , the unchecked spread of pirated publications have seriously hurt the enthusiasm of innovation of scientists , artists , and authors and owners of various copyrights , thereby generally hampering the improvement of national quality .
innovation is the sense of progress and the driving force for development of civilization , and innovation needs the society to jointly safeguard it .
the crackdown on piracy benefits the country and people , eliminates the confusion of the society , and offers protection for the people 's innovative achievements . therefore , it will surely further stimulate the people 's sense of innovation and promote healthy development and continued progress of our society .

lawyers chen shui - bian , su chen - chang [ su zhenchang ] , chang chun - hsiung [ zhang junxiong ] , and hsieh chang - yen [ xie changyan ] " volunteered " to come forward to defend the accused .
one can see from this that right from the start " taiwan independence " activities had deep origins in " democracy and human rights . "
the dpp was established on 28 september 1986 ; all its members were elements active in the anti - kmt " tangwai movement . "
people do not exist for the state and social systems , which exist for the people . "
" the future of taiwan should be decided by the whole body of its inhabitants " . . .
" all people have the right of self - determination and can freely decide on their political status , and freely pursue economic , social , and cultural development .
no government or combination of governments has the right to determine taiwan 's political sstatus . "
people who understand international law know that an unequal international treaty the signing of which is forced by military aggression is not valid , and so whether or not after its defeat in the war japan signed a document on returning taiwan to china does not affect the legal status of taiwan as chinese territory .
the " taiwan independence " elements ' theory of " self - determination by the inhabitants " also has absolutely no leg to stand on .
it is precisely because of this that at the dpp 's second congress in november 1987 a number of " taiwan independence " elements even wanted to write into the party program " the people have the right to advocate taiwan independence . "
the fact is that not only did the kmt make use of the fear of communism in those years to reject reunification , but , still more , the dpp took advantage of this fear to advance step by step toward its dream of " taiwan independence . "
chen shui - bian 's [ chen shuibian ] " 20 may " inaugural speech had a lot to say about " democracy and human rights " and relations with international human rights organizations . many readers feel that they cannot understand this speech which appeared to be a kind of " human rights manifesto . "
in fact , this is the " magic weapon " by which the democratic progressive party [ dpp ] and " taiwan independence " set up shop .
right from the start " taiwan independence " had close ties with anti - china forces and human rights organizations in the united states , japan , and so on , and from a certain angle , " taiwan independence " depended for its growth on the foreign milk of international anti - china forces and human rights organizations .
international factors in the development of " taiwan independence " before the 1960 's , japan was the center of " taiwan independence " activities .
after the 1970 's , europe and america , and especially the united states , became the main bases and source of support for " taiwan independence . "
this catered to the mental state of taiwan compatriots who did not know about the mainland , and was also very much to the taste of anti - china forces and human rights organizations in certain western countries and met their anti - china needs , providing " grist to the mill " for their anti - china activities .
in the past 20 years , large numbers of high - ranking intellectuals have returned to taiwan after study in america and europe and they have gradually taken hold of real power in taiwan 's socioeconomic , political , cultural , education , and military fields .
in order to intervene more directly in taiwan 's " democracy and human rights " movement and provide effective support for " taiwan independence , " on 20 may 1986 us congressmen headed by edward kennedy and stephen solarz announced the establishment of a " committee for the promotion of taiwan democracy . "
the committee 's statement minced no words in declaring that the reason why they were supporting taiwan democratization was to ensure us economic and strategic interests in taiwan .
and the " taiwan relations act " passed by congress openly ensured , in the form of a us domestic law , that while maintaining formal diplomatic relations and conditional cooperative relations with the prc , the united states would maintain close ties with china 's taiwan province .
for a long time , heedless of the prc 's protests , the united states has continually sold advanced weapons to taiwan , thus heightening tension in the taiwan strait and boosting the morale of " taiwan independence " and backing it in rejecting reunification .
this point is best shown by the course of the " taiwan independence " activities of annette lu [ lu xiulian ] .
from the time that she left the law studies institute of taiwan university and moved into society in 1969 up to becoming " vice president " today , almost her entire career has been linked to " taiwan independence . "
her " taiwan independence " career epitomizes the activities of " taiwan independence " over the past 30 years .
one can also fully see from it the close ties between " taiwan independence " and us and european anti - china forces and human rights organizations .
on 13 december 1978 [ as received ] , annette lu and seven backbone elements of the " mei li tao incident " were arrested , and lu was sentenced by military court to 12 years in jail for the crime of sedition .
in may 1986 , as arranged by a us human rights organization , annette lu was given permission to travel to los angeles under the pretext of getting medical treatment .
afterwards she went to germany and the netherlands to take part in amnesty international activities .
in early 1990 she again visited the united states at the invitation of the asia association , where she came into contact and learned experience from several score political bodies .
on returning to taiwan , she raised the slogan " a country can only be democratic if there are democrats there first . "
on 20 may the same year , the day that lee teng - hui became the eighth " president , " annette lu set up the " league of democrats " with herself as chairman ; the league 's program was to call on citizens to participate in building democracy .
at the end of 1990 , annette lu joined the dpp .
in early 1991 she launched a so - called " i love taiwan movement , " which was another " taiwan independence " activity which she cleverly whitewashed ; one of its key contents was to " rebuild our international personality and enhance the dignity of the taiwan people . "
in this activity , it was stressed that " taiwan is the mother of us all , " while the mainland of the motherland was smeared as " china 's nightmare . "
before the convening of the 46 th un general assembly on 17 september 1991 , annette lu published advertisements in the taiwan press soliciting " taiwan independence " [ word indistinct ] , and she then organized a " publicity group on the return of taiwan to the united nations " and sent it to new york .
on 18 september annette lu and other " taiwan independence " elements held a street demonstration in the busiest area of new york , and attempted to convey wrong information to the american public to mislead them and expand their own international influence .
at the same time they published a long article in the new york times entitled " the united nations should open its door to taiwan , " clamoring that " the 23 million people of taiwan enjoy basic international human rights " and " taiwan 's future should be decided by the taiwan people themselves . "
on 27 september 1991 annette lu held a news conference in los angeles in which she vigorously attacked the mainland of the motherland and spoke on " taiwan independence " and the " rationality and legality of taiwan 's return to the united nations . "
the 35 october 1991 marked the 20 th anniversary of taiwan 's expulsion from the united nations . on that day annette lu published an " open letter to president lee teng - hui appealing for immediately joining the united nations , " and an " open letter to us president bush . "
they slandered the motherland and shouted " taiwan independence " slogans .
during one month in the united states on this occasion , annette lu asked to meet us officials and congressmen and exerted herself in running about for " taiwan independence . "
sparing no effort for " taiwan independence " at noon on 22 september 1993 , the un general assembly general affairs committee vetoed the " proposal " of seven central american states on " taiwan 's un entry . "
annette lu seized the chance to set up an " alliance of world female politicians " with herself in charge .
in july the same year , she attended as an observer the un " second world meeting of new and restored democracies " in nicaragua , where she met the dalai lama .
during the celebrations marking the 50 th anniversary of the founding of the united nations , annette lu spent a great deal of money in hiring a yacht carrying a large banner " welcome taiwan 's accession to the united nations " which anchored in the river in front of the un building .
on 20 may 1996 annette lu was appointed " national strategy adviser " by lee teng - hui .
in the same month she launched a drive to " help the united nations , and honor new taiwan " and also led a " love and peace propaganda group " to new york to proclaim resolve and demands for taiwan to join the united nations .
on 4 february 1998 , annette lu and amnesty international jointly held the annual asia - pacific regional meeting and also staged an " evening party to express thanks for human rights , " to " thank ai for its assistance to the taiwan human rights movement over a long period . "
on 20 march , at the invitation of the taiwan public affairs association and the us office in taiwan , she went to the united states to attended a seminar on " 20 years of the taiwan relations act. "
she met wang dan in taoyuan on 28 march .
we thank veteran schemer mr. lee for unreservedly given the world the direction by hitting the nail on the head .
we believe that the words " challenging the impossible , " which were full of the spirit of japan 's militarism and bushido , were also his true words .

although " taiwan independence " elements have consistently played the word game to deceive the countrymen with their incompatible words and action , to clearly know what they are thinking and going to do now , it is still necessary to carefully study what they have said .

this appears to be very miserable and sympathetic .
it is noteworthy that now a human rights theory has emerged in the international community that is very likely to be used by " taiwan independence " to resist reunification .
we can even assume that chen shui - bian has already used it to draft his inaugural speech .
annan 's " globalization " concept is not simply economic but has incorporated important political and cultural contents .
on the basis on this concept and understanding , annan affirmed : " global affairs are no longer confined to the scope of foreign affairs ministries , and countries are no longer the only sources for solving many problems of our small planet .
various different nongovernmental activists have become more and more influential .
they have joined decision - makers of countries to formulate new policies for running the world . "
therefore , annan has proposed to hold a " heads of state conference of the millennium " of the un and a " people 's congress of the millennium . "

here , everyone will know why chen shui - bian talked at length about " democracy and human rights " and relations with international human rights organizations , amnesty international , and ngo 's .
as a matter of fact , these organizations are now more likely to provide greater support and a stage for " taiwan independence " elements to carry out their activities .
annette lu stated it well , it is crucial to have the opportunity to speak and allow " taiwan 's voices be heard " in the international community . what she wanted is exactly this point .
as chen shui - bian and annette lu have become taiwan 's " president " and " vice president , " you cannot always feel that people who voted and supported them are all idiots .
the best policy - regarding " taiwan independence " , we must press them hard as for how to deal with " taiwan independence " , currently the mass media 's focus has fallen mostly on whether or not military force will be employed .
this kind of viewpoint says that china is a large country and should be completely self - confident ; as long as they do not acknowledge " taiwan independence " , taiwan cannot possibly at any time be independent . time is full of variables , and these kinds of variables are not necessarily detrimental to reunification .
the reasons used to support this kind of viewpoint are mainly that the disparity of the current economic levels of the two sides of the taiwan strait is considered to be too great . china should continue to concentrate its energy on speeding up modernization reforms and construction .
not only china , but taiwan also has people advocating this viewpoint , even to the point that taiwan 's new authorities also mentioned - when giving their impressions upon being elected on march 18 - that after the cross - strait economic disparity lessens and china achieves modernization , talking about reunification will be easier to carry out .
after lee teng - hui [ li denghui ] brought out the " two states theory " , cross - strait exchanges faded rapidly , and personnel exchanges also greatly lessened - in particular , the mainland personnel entering taiwan clearly lessened .
the result of this is that the momentum of the " centrifugal rate " [ meaning dissent and discord in society ] in taiwan 's social mentality sped up , and this is also a type of vicious cycle extremely beneficial to " taiwan independence " .
this fact illustrates that " taiwan independence " has not only mounted the stage , but also , in fact , controls more and more media and cultural resources .
on the contrary , it is an extremely widespread practice for the taiwan mass media to wittingly and unwittingly present the chinese communist party and the mainland as something vile , and purposely avoid talking about the phenomenon of " one country , two systems " .
the truth is that the current residents of the island of taiwan were afraid of china using military force to counter " taiwan independence " , but that they did not hear china 's voice . they did not effectively understand or communicate with each other ; each side considered themselves .
you cannot possibly carry out large - scale propaganda activities to directly reach the 23 million taiwan residents . under this situation , strengthening the impact on taiwan by the mass media of china , hong kong and macao has already become extremely important .
the advantages and disadvantages of military operations from an overall perspective , non - military operations are already unable to reach the goal of effectively containing " taiwan independence " , and military operations already cannot be avoided . we must make a decision early .
everyone knows that in the past few years the taiwan authorities have consistently taken advantage of china 's military training and exercises to create a mentality of fear of the [ chinese ] communists , and to sow discord in the feelings of the taiwan compatriots toward china .
lee teng - hui is this way , and chen shui - bian is even more so ; his speech of " may 20 th " is the most typical example . there is no need to say more about this .
the problem is that we must think of a way to cause the taiwan authorities to have no way to take advantage of the situation to create a mentality of fear that serves their " taiwan independence " .
the first choice is the best policy outside of peaceful means .
the simplest reason is : attacking taiwan is attacking " taiwan independence " [ elements ] , and is not directed against all of taiwan 's common people .
the second choice is the intermediate policy .
however , using hundreds of billions of dollars u.s. to solve all the problems at one time is better than facing [ the prospect of ] having an anti - china " taiwan independence " country . this way is very worthwhile , and also has less risk .
the reason is that if we are unable to accurately hit the goal and the base which the " taiwan independence " [ elements ] rely on to stubbornly resist , no matter how vigorous the exercises are , they will still be fruitless efforts .
as well , at present there is not any reason to deny the possibility of the taiwan authorities acting in this way when the time comes .
such being the case , it will then be difficult for china to find opportunities to use military force to attack taiwan .
in the past few years , the taiwan authorities , particularly the " taiwan independence " elements , want to bring taiwan into the united states ' theater missile defense system (tmd) , in order to receive the united states ' military and political protection .
there have appeared at present powerful forces for " taiwan independence " , and they [ the above powers ] have no alternative but to make a choice on this problem of whether to support china 's reunification or taiwan 's splitting away .
the standard for choosing is still how to comply even more with their long - term strategic interests .

just as our ancestors once climbed down from the trees , and thus set themselves on a pathway with no return , so has human society transformed itself from an agrarian economy to an industrial economy and then to an information economy , changes which are just as irreversible .
actually , the components of the information economy were in existence some time ago , and it can be said that when humanity first began to understand nature and to use natural science to develop commercial products , information had already started its function of promoting economy .
for a very long period of time , mankind could only rely on nature for his daily bread ; he could not rely on information to eat . that is why our ancestors came up with gods great and small , and why there are so many temples of all kinds .
as humans became to know themselves , they began to understand and make use of the power of information .
if we stand and gaze on the flow of history , mankind is like a child who has just begun to learn about the world .
the entrance of humanity into the modern technological age is just that short , just an eyeblink compared with the past and future of humans .

on monday us president bill clinton started his visit to four countries , including portugal , germany , russia , and ukraine .
from his tight one - week schedule , one can see that an important item on the agenda of his visit is to explain to the european union (eu) and russia the national missile defense (nmd) system to be deployed by the united states .
it can be imagined that he will face joint opposition from his european allies and russia .
the eu says no to the united states the first leg of clinton 's foreign trip is lisbon , the capital of portugal . at the us - eu summit to be held there , the nmd program of the united states will be an important topic of discussion .
long before the nmd program was introduced , most of the us western allies did not support it , while some expressed their serious concern and even explicitly adopted a dissenting attitude .
in particular , since russia ratified in mid - april the russian - us strategic arms limitation treaty ii ( salt ii ) , thus breaking the deadlock over nuclear disarmament which has been going on for many years , the eu countries almost unanimously have been opposed to the us deployment of nmd .
the other day , french president jacques chirac expressed his serious feeling of unease about us plan to deploy nmd . he also warned the united states that the nmd program would jeopardize efforts by the international community to prevent nuclear proliferation and curb the arms race .
germany said that the us plan violated the antiballistic missile treaty signed by the united states and the soviet union in 1972 and that it would have serious consequences for arms control as a whole and possibly would endanger unity within nato .
it is said that at the us - eu summit and during clinton 's visit to germany , german chancellor gerhard schroeder will tell clinton personally the aforesaid misgivings of the german side .
it can be predicted that during his trip , clinton will have a heated debate with his allies over the issue of nmd .
russia takes a tough stance in order to deploy nmd , the united states must persuade russia to agree to revise the antiballistic missile treaty .
clinton , who will soon step down , and vladimir putin , who has just taken up his post , will face this knotty problem at their first meeting .
apparently , it will be to no avail .
while evaluating cross - strait policy mentioned in the speech of the new leader of taiwan authorities , the statement also expressed mainland china 's stance on the overall issues of the current and future cross - strait ties , and proposed relevant specific suggestions .
please enlighten me after you have heard my views .
i. the new leader of taiwan authorities must make concrete efforts to show that he accepts the one - china principle .
what are the criteria for examining the " goodwill " of the new leader of taiwan authorities in facilitating " peaceful reconciliation [ he jie ] , " " cooperation , " and " peace " in cross - strait ties ?
when a person who previously advocated " taiwan independence " said today he would not declare " taiwan independence , " it only showed that he could not resist or fight the overall objective conditions . he is far from having any " goodwill " at all .
it is because of the following reasons : first , during the past 50 years since 1949 , even though both sides of the strait disagreed on the political implications [ han yi ] of one china , they have upheld the one - china principle .
in other words , they have upheld that there is only one china , that taiwan is part of china , and that china 's sovereignty and territorial integrity are inalienable .
second , in seeking common ground while preserving differences , mainland china has been flexible and pragmatic in its stance of upholding the one - china principle .
based on this foundation , we will hold equal consultations and jointly discussion reunification .
if taiwan authorities do not purposely intend to facilitate splittism and " taiwan independence , " it should not be difficult for them to declare their stance of upholding the one - china principle in the sense that they intend to safeguard china 's sovereignty and territorial integrity .
consequently , to return to the basic point where cross - strait ties can peacefully and steadily develop , we naturally should return to the state of mutual trust and common foundation where we both uphold the one - china principle .
in light of the above factors , only if the new leader of taiwan authorities explicitly declares his stance of upholding the one - china principle , can cross - strait ties expect to fundamentally change from the current deadlock and gradually begin to improve .
ii . cross - strait dialogues and talks must be held under the one - china principle . safeguarding the consensus reached by taiwan 's straits exchange foundation [ sef ] and the arats that " both sides of the strait jointly uphold the one - china principle " is the starting point for materializing cross - strait contacts .
that there is only one china in the world and that taiwan is part of china are objective reality . cross - strait contacts and consultations have always been held under this reality and foundation .
mother mainland which regards safeguarding china 's reunification as its mission absolutely will not allow such schemes .
recently , in the statement published under authorization , the cpc central committee taiwan affairs office and the state council taiwan affairs office have made explicit and concrete proposals on ways to resume cross - strait contacts and dialogues .
second , taiwan authorities must reiterate the basic stance that " both sides of the strait jointly uphold the one - china principle , " and that " both will jointly strive to seek national reunification , " in accordance with the eighth document previously submitted by the sef to the arats .
here , it is necessary for us to further clarify the situation about the sef - arats consensus reached previously .
in their respective expressions , the arats and the sef explicitly promised each other that they would uphold the one - china principle and seek national reunification .
other than the sef 's above published expression , the sef also published another " manuscript of statement [ sheng ming gao ] " later .
it showed : even though both sides did not reach a consensus on the political implications of one china , both sides did have a consensus in respectively expressing the stance that both sides of the strait jointly uphold the one - china principle .
at that time , because the arats and the sef could not reach a written agreement , they adopted the format of respectively verbally expressing the sef - arats consensus .
such remarks certainly did not suit historic facts .

we can see a pattern in the development of cross - strait relations over the past 20 - plus years . that is , people on the two sides of the strait have been promoting the cause of the motherland 's peaceful reunification under the one - china principle .
mr. liao said : " if you indecisively postpone things to other days , you will not only worry yourself needlessly , but you will also make it difficult for me to bring up the matter " it also said : " how can you maintain sovereignty over part of the country ? "
unfortunately , what we said came true and kmt lost its opportunity after the passage of 18 years .
we always hoped that lee teng - hui [ li tenghui ] would show some achievements in cross - strait relations in the 20 years he was in office .
in the end , lee teng - hui could not escape the fate of being forsaken by history , being forced to resign early from his post , and earning himself waves of infamy until today .
when the new taiwan leader stepped into office , we repeatedly admonished : the one - china principle is the prerequisite and basis for the peaceful reunification of the two sides of the strait , and it cannot be evaded .
if he must take the " pro - taiwan independence " line , he will enter a blind alley .
do not say that we have not warned him . cross - strait relations must develop under the one - china principle , or nothing can be accomplished .
looking at the issue from the angle of a narrow , small , and isolated island , and of exercising sovereignty over part of the country , is after all not a permanent solution .
third , the one - china principle reflects history and reality , and should not be challenged , changed , or evaded .

there is no middle lane , and it is impossible to gain advantage from both the concepts .

if he fails to do that , and moves against the historical trend , the matter then will concern the rise or fall , or the continuation or termination , of the taiwan leader himself and his party . we hope he will consider this carefully .

over the past three years since direct shipping began on a trial basis , vessels have sailed between the two shores on a total of 4,228 voyages , delivering a total of nearly 0.9 million teu containers .
in the past , i once said that lee teng - hui had adopted a policy of plugging his ears while stealing a bell and the taiwan authorities had stubbornly clung to their " three noes " policy so that vessels had had to sail between the two shores via a third place .
however , even if they sail around the earth three times and have their shipping documents changed in japan , nothing will change the fact that the cargo is made in the mainland of the motherland rather than in japan .
if so , why is it that the shipping and trade circles of the two shores have to suffer such inconvenience and spend such extra money ? it is entirely because lee teng - hui had wanted to have his political needs met for splitting the motherland ; obstructing the " three links " ; and seeking taiwan independence .
both " direct shipping between designated points on a trial basis " and " shipping between the two shores via a third place " are nothing but " an expedient measure " adopted by the taiwan authorities with an eye on erecting obstacles to direct shipping across the strait .
realizing the genuine " three links , " including direct shipping on the sea , is bound to benefit the common economic development of both shores and conforms with the common interests of the people of both shores .
the direct passenger transportation between the two shores on the sea represents the common aspiration of the people on the two shores and conforms with the fundamental interests of the people on the two shores and should thereby be realized on an earlier date .
during this year 's election of the new leader of taiwan , three running candidates had invariably adopted a " positive " attitude towards the " three links " across the strait and this shows that the " three links " across the strait complies with popular feelings .
the reunification of the motherland also represents a historical trend no one can resist .
whether or not he accepts the one - china principle on the question of reunification with china is the touchstone for testing whether the leader of the taiwan authorities safeguards national sovereignty and territorial integrity or continues to stubbornly promote the separatist line .
the new leader of the taiwan authorities was evasive and ambiguous in his may 20 speech . this was a tactic he was forced to employ under the circumstances .
on this question , we must reiterate our stand once again .
a look at all the facts and laws relating to taiwan suffices to prove that taiwan has been an inseparable part of chinese territory .
the people of taiwan are descendants of the chinese nation who emigrated from the motherland at various times .
the taiwan region has always been under the administration of the chinese government .
during the 100 years after the mid-19th century , the down and out chinese nation was bullied by the great powers , and the people of taiwan were not spared .
in 1895 , japan coerced the qing government into signing the unequal " treaty of shimonoseki " through a war of aggression and forcibly occupied taiwan .
the chinese government resumed the exercise of sovereignty over taiwan on october 25 .
the central people 's government of the prc founded on october 1 , 1949 took over the government of the roc as china 's only legitimate government and only legitimate international representation . naturally it fully enjoys and exercises sovereignty over china , including of course sovereignty over china .
more than 160 countries in the world have established diplomatic relations with the prc . they all recognize the one - china principle and promise to handle their relations with taiwan within the one - china framework .
in fact , the taiwan authorities acknowledged taiwan as a part of china for 30 to 40 years after 1949 .
a unified and integrated china is in the common interest of chinese people on both sides of the strait .
people who attempt to split the country dare to attempt the impossible precisely because they show no consideration for the sentiments of the chinese nation and underestimate the determination and ability of the chinese government and the chinese people to safeguard territorial integrity .
anyone who undermines china 's sovereignty and territorial integrity , promotes the separatist line and works for " taiwan independence " in any way will not come to a good end .
everyone who is sincere in improving cross - strait relations should unconditionally and unequivocally accept the one - china principle . only on this basis will it be possible to create an environment of long - lasting stability and peace and realize the aspirations of the taiwan people to achieve sustained prosperity and development .
it is the cpc 's consistent principle to make work arrangements for non - party cadres and insist that party members should work in cooperation with non - party personalities in the state power .
in march 1978 , comrade deng xiaoping said that non - party cadres are also cadres of the party and state , hence , party committees at all levels should support and give free rein to their work .
at present , arrangements of work for the non - party cadres are insufficient , rather than excessive .
this system is different from the multiparty system or two - party system of the western countries , and also different from some countries ' single - party system .
making work arrangements for non - party cadres is conducive to bringing all positive factors into play and uniting all forces that can be united to fight together for the great cause of reform , opening up , and the drive for socialist modernization .
although non - party cadres are not party members , yet they are an important component of the party 's rank of cadres and hold a considerable proportion in the total number of cadres in china .
among them , there are a large number of intellectuals , and many comrades are experts and scholars with specialized knowledge in various subjects .
they have a vast reservoir of enthusiasm and creativity , so they are a vital force indispensable for reform , opening up , and modernization .
furthermore , the vast numbers of non - party personalities are always a special important force in the cause of the reunification of our motherland .
he particularly stressed that the democratic supervision from non - party personalities will " provide our party with the supervision that can hardly be provided merely relying on our party members , discover some shortcomings and errors in our work that we have failed to discover , and give useful assistance to our work . "
as we all know , democratic parties and personalities without party affiliation participating in administration and discussion of state affairs and exercising democratic supervision hold a very important position in china 's political life .
giving free rein to democratic parties and non - party personalities in participating in administration and discussion of state affairs is good for the state 's policies , laws , and major decisions to embody the masses ' will to the maximum and conducive to enhancing the scientific and democratic level of the party and government 's policy decisions .
taiwan is now at a crossroads faced with the choice between two different futures and two different destinies .
history and reality tell us : taiwan 's future lies in the complete reunification of the motherland .
only through reunification will taiwan have a vast international space and a respectable international status alongside the mainland of the motherland and will the taiwan populace truly enjoy the dignity and honor being chinese .
on the world political arena , china , as one of the five permanent members of the un security council and the largest developing country , has a weighty international status and a positive , major impact on peace and development for mankind , which have won high international dignity and honor for itself .
only through reunification will the taiwan economy 's stable development find a solid support and the taiwan populace 's well - being be fundamentally guaranteed .
the taiwan economy is typically an island economy . it is relatively developed yet very fragile due to the lack of reserve strength for development .
natural resources are extremely scarce on the island of taiwan , which relies on exports for more than 80 percent of its energy and major strategic supplies . the island has a narrow market and is unduly dependent on external markets , with external trade accounting for more than 96 percent of the gnp .
by contrast , the vast expanse of the mainland of the motherland that measures more than 9.6 million square kilometers is rich in natural resources and the huge market of 1.3 billion people has become the largest new market in the whole world .
the course of development of economic and trade relations across the taiwan strait over the past two decades has fully proved this .
since 1979 , cross - strait economic and trade relations have gone through a development process during which they came out of the dark into the light , expanded from a small to a large scale , grew from unity to diversity , and shifted from a slow to a rapid pace .
the contributions of the development of cross - strait economic and trade relations to the taiwan economy have been manifested in at least three areas as follows : first , it has promoted taiwan 's economic growth .
this has become the most crucial factor influencing taiwan 's economic growth .
according to analysis by taiwan 's " council for economic planning and development , " taiwan 's economic growth rate will drop at least nearly two percentage points if cross - strait economic and trade dealings were to be discontinued .
second , it has promoted taiwan 's economic transformation and industrial upgrading .
over the past two decades , taiwan business investment in the mainland has seen a rapid growth and constant rise in level .
from 1987 through 1998 , the accumulative number of taiwan businesses investing in the mainland increased to 41,422 from 80 , accumulative sum of agreed investment increased to $ 41.279 billion from around $ 100 million , and investments actually utilized accumulated to $ 21.42 billion .
as a result of economic and trade cooperation with the mainland , the proportions of primary and secondary industries in the island 's total output value have kept declining , while that of tertiary industry has gradually risen , thereby effectively promoting taiwan 's economic transformation and industrial structural adjustment .
third , it has lowered the degree of taiwan 's dependence on the us market .
this has had an important effect on taiwan 's economic stability .
economic prosperity and comprehensive progress of the social life cannot do without a secure , stable political environment .
nevertheless , taiwan , being a typical hilly island and surrounded by the sea , is narrow in space and lacks strategic depth . crowded with 23 million people , the 36,000 square kilometer island is absolutely unable to resist forced entry by a power . at the moment , the taiwan authorities are going against the historical trend .
this in fact is nothing more than wishful thinking and undoubtedly is a move to invite disaster by letting in invaders . they will end up being controlled by others .
judging from current international politics , taiwan is merely a " chess piece " on the us strategic chessboard that serves to fulfill us interests as well as an " unsinkable aircraft carrier " deployed by the united states in the pacific far east .
reunification is beneficial to both sides , while separation is detrimental to both sides . the new taiwan leader should make a correct historical choice on the issue of adhering to the one - china principle and accomplishing peaceful reunification .
if the new taiwan leader really cares about the interests of the 23 million taiwan compatriots and really cares about peace and stability in the asia - pacific region , then he should unhesitatingly recognize the one - china principle as soon as possible .
reunification is beneficial to both sides of the taiwan strait , while separation is detrimental .
these have become a consensus among all people of chinese descent around the world , including the peoples on both sides of the taiwan strait and our compatriots in hong kong and macao .
those splittist forces that advocate " taiwan independence " should soberly face the reality as early as possible and stop challenging china 's territorial and sovereign integrity .
in the event any forces dare to split taiwan from the motherland 's territory , the 1.2 billion chinese people are going to defend the state 's sovereign and territorial integrity with their lives and blood .

the " seminar on china 's financial development strategies " jointly sponsored by the people 's bank of china , china securities regulatory commission , and china insurance regulatory commission was held in shanghai today .
this is an important meeting held by china 's financial circles at the turn of the centuries to explore the strategies for china 's financial development in the next century .
at the meeting , the issues regarding reform and development strategies for china 's banking industry in the coming five years were thoroughly and systematically discussed .
according to the sponsors of the seminar , the wto accession will produce tremendous and far - reaching impacts on china 's banking industry .
over the past few years , china 's banking , securities , and insurance sectors have conducted a certain amount of study on how to cope with the challenges brought by china 's wto entry from their respective angles of business operations .
at present , in drafting the tenth five - year plan for development in china , it is also necessary to study the major policy decisions on the reform and development of the banking industry during the tenth five - year plan period .
the in - depth opening up and the extensive application of information technology have produced or are producing profound impacts on china 's securities market in terms of information environment , organizational structure , operational modes , and competition pattern .
china 's securities industry should positively carry out online trading and make further advance toward standardization so as to play a still more important role in economic development .
the meeting stressed that the structure currently adopted in china of practicing separate operation and separate supervision of banks , security companies , and insurance companies conforms to china 's national conditions .
with the competition of the financial sector and the application of financial information both growing on an extensive scale , the businesses of banks , security companies , and insurance companies are overlapping to a greater extent .
the meeting maintains that as the eastern region has accumulated rich experience in the in - depth reform and expanded opening up , it should fully exercise the radiating effect to contribute to the central and western development .
being china 's largest financial center and city , shanghai has a great variety and number of financial institutions , ample funds , and developed financial markets .
shanghai mayor xu kuangdi said in his speech at the seminar that the giant advances of shanghai 's banking industry in the 1990 's has played a tremendous promoting role in its sustained , rapid , and healthy economic development .
during these 10 years , shanghai 's gdp grew by 5.3 fold at the current price , and the credit balance of various financial institutions across the municipality rose from 86 billion yuan in 1990 to 520 billion yuan in 1999 , also increasing by 5.3 fold .
the shanghai municipal government will , as always , support and coordinate with the state financial regulatory departments and various major financial institutions , further accelerate the building of laws and regulations and market environment , and create a favorable environment and more market opportunities for the development of various financial enterprises in shanghai .
preparations for the current seminar were undertaken by the shanghai municipal people 's government .
