the central committee has acted in line with this new state of agricultural development , setting forth the need to make a strategic adjustment of our agricultural and rural economic structures , to raise our agricultural and rural economic quality and efficiency .
since this is a difficult but pressing mission , we need to stress it firmly and well .
the priority in adjusting our agricultural structure is to adjust the structure or makeup of our grain production .
grain is the most important staple farm product , the major source of income for peasants , particularly in key producing areas , and the major conflict in current farm product marketing .
to solve our grain shortage , we have made long - standing hard efforts .
we now have abundant grain , which is a good thing .
that china has solved the food problem for our population of over 1.2 billion people , is an amazing achievement .
but the surplus has also brought certain new problems such as grain - selling difficulties , increased purchasing and storage pressure , falling grain prices , and peasants producing more but earning less .
so doing a good job of adjusting our grain crop cultivation structure , to ensure that grain production is better suited to market demand , will be of key significance in increasing peasant income and intensifying grain circulation reform .
we need to speed up our seed project , importing , breeding , and disseminating improved varieties , in an all out effort to optimize our crop variety structure .
pursuing the policy of higher prices for better quality , to shrink the limits of price protection , is aimed mainly at guiding peasants to adjust their structure , so that grain production and circulation promote each other .
government at all levels needs to intensify guidance , providing better service .
optimizing the regional structure , to bring comparative advantages into full play , is a key principle in china 's macroeconomic guidance of grain production , as well as a basic line of thinking on keeping an overall grain balance .
when suitably adjusting our grain acreage , we need to fully consider local resource terms and production features , and the nation 's regional division of labor . 1 .
due to our past grain shortage , in order to fill our stomachs , we went all out to reclaim wasteland , cultivating steep slopes and grasslands , which worsened our ecological deterioration .
our current more abundant grain supply provides the terms for gradually withdrawing from cultivation those arable areas that are unsuited to grain production , returning them to forests and grasslands , to improve our ecology .
this will not only bring enormous ecological and social benefits , but also contribute to sustainable agricultural development . 3 .
china 's per capita grain output has just passed 400 kg .
if china 's grain processing and transformation level is raised sharply , then our current grain output will not be enough .
while livestock raising accounts for over 50 percent of agriculture in the developed nations , it accounts for only a little over 30 percent in china . and china 's ratio of farm product processing output value to agricultural output value is also far lower than that in the developed nations .
we need to resolve to develop livestock raising faster .
we need to endeavor to develop livestock raising into a large industry .
our current grain abundance provides such terms , with our steadily rising living standards also providing such demand .
we need to sharply develop our farm product processing , particularly food processing , extending the agricultural industrial chain , to raise our farm product added value .
in the adjustment of our grain structure , there are two matters that must always be stressed . 1 .
we need to adhere to the principle of not slackening our grain production , to actively develop diversified operations .
since two decades of practice has proved this principle to be correct , we need to continue to adhere to it in future . 2 .
we need to keep our grain cultivation acreage essentially stable , which is the grounds for overall balance .
while acting in line with market change to carry out a suitable annual adjustment is essential , we definitely have to prevent sharp volatility .

in his " inaugural speech " delivered on 20 may , the new leader of the taiwan authorities exerted his utmost to evade and obscure the one china principle , which he referred to as " a future issue . "
however , all the facts and laws concerned have borne out that taiwan is an inseparable part of china .
though japan had in history once forcibly seized taiwan through an aggressive war , after japan launched a full - scale war of aggression against china in 1937 , the chinese government declared to the whole world that china had abrogated the " treaty of shimonoseki [ 1895 ] " and would recover taiwan .
later on , both the " cairo declaration " and the " potsdam proclamation " stipulated that japan shall return to china all the chinese territories it had seized , including the northeast , taiwan , the penghu islands .
in 1945 , japan surrendered and pledged in " japan 's surrender terms " to " faithfully fulfill all the obligations provided for in the potsdam proclamation . "
on 25 october of the same year , the chinese government recovered taiwan and penghu and resumed its exercise of sovereignty over taiwan .
during the korean war period , the us government dished out the theory of " undecided status of taiwan , " which was of course opposed by the chinese government .
it is in the course of developing normal diplomatic relations with foreign countries and in its struggle aimed at safeguarding china 's sovereignty and territorial integrity that the chinese government has adhered to the one china principle and has won both understanding and support from a growing number of countries and international organizations .
some people within the taiwan authorities have claimed that " separate statement by each side " rather than the one china principle was the consensus reached by the arats and the sef in 1992 . this trick aimed at denying facts has laid bare the hypocritical nature of the taiwan authorities ' " sincerity " and " goodwill . "
the fact is that the eighth proposal submitted by the sef to the arats that year , which carried some eight views , declared in no uncertain terms such a basic stand : " both sides shall adhere to the one china principle " and " the two shores of the strait shall seek national reunification . "
the taiwan authorities should not indulge in sophistry . if they take out and read the original documents , the issue can be clarified .
however , as long as the taiwan authorities refuse to recognize the one china principle , the cross - strait relations are expected to remain deadlocked and turbulent and this will harm taiwan 's social stability and economic development to a grave extent .
the earlier they recognize the one china principle , the sooner the cross - strait relations will witness and improvement .
if they still trust in luck , the taiwan authorities are bound to see themselves landing in increasing passivity and entering a blind alley in the end .

as we all know , the abm treaty signed between the united states and the soviet union during the cold war is the foundation of the world 's arms control system represented by the united states and the soviet union ( russia ) that has lasted for nearly 30 years now .
at the time of signing , while eyeing each other with hostility , neither side was in a position to take care of the other .

"

government will first carry out an appraisal of four indexes : the effectiveness of missile defense , the expense of deployment , the impact on arms control treaties and the degree of missile threat the united states is facing , before making the final decision .

the drastically soaring momentum of domestic grain price started from the second half of 1993 and reached its peak in 1995 . it began to decline in 1996 , and has even presented a negative tendency since 1997 until today .
in 1999 , china 's domestic grain price still remained the same as , or even lower than , the level of the international markets .
thus , except for the sharp net imports in 1995 and 1996 , china 's grain has presented a situation of net exports from 1992 up to the present .
that is why we must take the initiative in conforming to the trend of the global economic integration , positively readjust china 's agricultural industrial structure , cut down the proportion of grain production , and more thoroughly participate in the international division of labor with regard to grain production and conduct more international grain transactions .
though the monetization degree of peasants ' income has reached 84 percent , yet the staple food purchased from foreign countries only accounted for 13 percent , while the portion of self - supporting grain reached as high as 87 percent .
the imports of large quantity of grain by china will raise the grain prices in the international markets in a short period of time , and then restrain the grain imports afterward .
thus , china 's grain which never has subsidies and has even been discriminated will gain space for price increase , or even demonstrate a greater overwhelming superiority for a period of time .
in short , we are of the opinion that even if restrictions are totally lifted , china will not import grain in large quantities in the near future , nor will it break away from the existing pattern of regulating supply and demand . 2 .
the sino - us agreement on agricultural cooperation indicates that china 's grain supply - demand pattern will not undergo great changes in the near future the contents of the sino - us agreement on agricultural cooperation drawn up in the united states in april 1999 are divided into two parts .
the first part is about technical cooperation and exchanges .
this part dwells on the work that has been conducted between china and the united states , which will not arouse people 's doubts and misgivings as it is obviously a " win - win " undertaking .
it is specifically involved in three aspects : citrus , meat , and wheat .
the above contents of the sino - us agreement on agricultural cooperation has once again proved the consistent situation that " no defense is set up " in china 's agriculture and china 's trade of grain .
the other just involves the operational transparency .
as the foregoing stated , china 's imports of grain never have definite restrictions on quotas .
the transparency thus increased will only enhance its efficiency in economic operations .
originally , it had nothing to do with the protection of domestic grain growing peasants , and now it has no direct relation with them either .
such being the case , it is absolutely not the chinese peasants that should have worries about the wto accession .

moscow , 7 jun ( xinhua ) - - the struggle between the united states and russia centering around whether or not the us - ussr anti - ballistic missile [ abm ] treaty should be amended is getting fiercer and fiercer , with each side insisting on its own position .
the abm treaty , which was signed by the then leaders of the ussr and the united states in moscow in may 1972 , only allows both sides to establish an anti - missile defense system around their capitals and around an underground - launching silo of continental ballistic missile .
it was on this basis that the united states and the ussr sat down to talk on nuclear arms control and disarmament .
with the end of the cold war , the united states has experienced a rapid expansion of its hegemonist desire .
in march last year , both the house of representatives and the senate of the us congress adopted the nmd bill , which possibly can be put into effect within this year .
if the treaty is amended in accordance with the will of the united states , the strategic balance that has been formed for many years between russia and the united states will be sabotaged .
russian foreign minister igor ivanov warned said : if the united states adopts unilateral action and breaks the abm treaty , thus destroying the strategic disarmament mechanism established by russia and the united states , russia will make a response to such a move .
however , it is not russian president putin 's intention to be at loggerhead with the united states , which also does not conform to the foreign policy of russia 's new government .
the united states also agreed to make joint effort with russia to establish an early warning missile launch information exchange center .
experiencing moscow 's diplomatic setback , putin tried to undermine us position by seeking support from nato countries .
he held that such a move not only could avoid an unbalance of strength in the region but also ensure the safety of each and every european country .

china joined the " nuclear weapons nonproliferation treaty " in 1992 .
in its treaty accession document , china stressed that its aim was certainly not to prevent the proliferation of nuclear weapons per se , but rather a process of steps and measures to achieve an all - out ban on and the thorough destruction of nuclear weapons .
at the 1995 convention to deliberate on and extend the treaty , china supported an unconditional extension of the treaty .
chinese vice premier and foreign minister qian qichen led a delegation to and addressed the convention .
while the treaty has played a positive role for years in curbing nuclear proliferation , since the treaty also undeniably contains limitations and flaws , providing differing rights and duties for signatories , parts of it are unbalanced .
and on 10 june 1998 , the chinese government issued the " export control regulations for dual - use articles and related technology " to firmly control exports of dual - use articles and related technology .
china has always supported and participated in international cooperation to prevent nuclear proliferation , actively meeting all of the international commitments that it has made .
in july 1993 , china officially promised that , on a voluntary basis , it would notify the iaea of all nuclear material imports and exports , and exports of nuclear equipment and related non - nuclear material .
in may 1997 , china sent observers to attend a meeting of the " sanger commission , " a multilateral nuclear export control mechanism , officially joining that commission in october 1997 .
in september 1998 , china reached agreement with the iaea on an additional protocol to the security oversight agreement , promising to declare to the iaea the related details of nuclear cooperation with non - nuclear countries .

this senior official with years of experience in disarmament told xinhua in an exclusive interview that china 's stand on the revision of the abm treaty is clear and steadfast .
he said that the treaty , which restricts the development and deployment of any national missile defense (nmd) system , safeguards the relative strategic balance and stability among the united states , russia and other nuclear powers .
in his view , the united states insists on revising the abm treaty because it wants to develop its nmd . it claims that it is only trying to protect itself from " missile threats " of the so - called " rogue states , " but its real aim is to seek an absolute military advantage and security .
the unilateral bent and military adventurism of us foreign policy will become more prominent , and other big powers will act in response .
he pointed out in particular that the united states recognizes the status of the abm treaty as the cornerstone for maintaining global strategic balance and stability and the prerequisite of nuclear reduction of the united states and russia .
for this reason , the russian side has stated clearly that it will withdraw from a series of arms control agreements if the united states breaks the abm treaty .
he said that china hopes that the united states will think thrice before it takes any action on the question of the abm treaty and consider the strong reaction that it will bring from the international community so as not to " lift a rock only to drop it on its own toes . "
the chinese side is opposed to this , he said .
he specially emphasized that china is adamantly opposed to attempts by any country to include taiwan in the tmd system in any form .
this is a serious infringement of china 's sovereignty and territorial integrity and is a gross interference in china 's internal affairs , something that the chinese people will never allow , he said .
this move will lead to the deterioration of international security and jeopardize the security of other countries , including china , and china will be forced to reassess its security environment and defense needs under the circumstances , he said .

in mid - may , the israeli knesset passed two measures proposed by the opposition , that in future any change to the jerusalem border must be approved by a majority of that body , and that palestinian refugees who were in other places would not be allowed to return to israel or areas controlled by israel .
the palestinians insist that israel return all occupied territory to the west of the jordan river , including jerusalem , and that israel also have a universal plebiscite on this question .

this achievement from albright 's middle eastern mediation trip presages a chance for palestinian - israeli talks to move out of the impasse , and to be one degree farther under american guidance .
the americans felt that in order to find a permanent peaceful solution , palestine and israel should both be brave and sincere , and make some large , historical decisions .
of late , the us has said on numerous occasions that it wishes to continue working hard to promote progress on middle eastern peace , and presented an american suggestion as to how to solve the serious problems , including that of 3.5 million palestinian refugees .
as for the question of the creation of a palestinian state , the us attitude has become more and more forthright : israel will find it more effective to establish diplomatic channels with one nation than with many factions .

the fact that palestinian - israeli talks are ever drawing nearer a final solution comes from the greater inner resistance in israel .

barak stressed that his government will continue to promote the policy of peace talks , and said that he was prepared at any moment to face an early election .

after world war ii , the ways wars are fought have changed many times , and they have now evolved into conventional high - tech regional wars .
this is primarily because air powers , which have become increasingly high - tech , are now playing an increasingly active part in wars .
as result of the rapid development of the information technology , cold and hot weapon systems have become increasingly information - dominated , and modern warfare has become one in which information collection takes precedence over any troop deployment .
an important feature of the information - dominated weapons is their system attributes . this is to say that future warfare will be one of systems versus systems .
training troops in science and technology is essentially a task of turning science and technology into the power that drives military training to increase the troops ' ability to win the war .
at this new period , the chinese air force is facing an enormous challenge .
compared with the air forces of foreign powers , the biggest difference between them and the chinese air force is our insufficient training in military technology .
we must have a strong sense of urgency and build a technologically strong air force that can learn , master , and apply science and technology ; and we must make " winning the battles " the starting point and the objective of training pilots in science and technology .
pilots trained by outmoded , conventional ways are not competent enough to fight a high - tech war . pilots only know how to " take off , land , check meters and gauges , perform special skills , and fall into formation " are unable to win a high - tech war .
only when we explore the features and laws of how regional high - tech wars were waged and address the real , important issues of training pilots in science and technology can we guide the training of troops in science and technology into new and unknown areas .
in future regional wars , our strong adversaries who possess high - tech weaponry may engage us in aerial battles with their superior technology . these battles will be abrupt and decisive . our adversaries will go all out to seize the initiative by taking full advantage of nighttime and complex weather conditions .
the first aerial battle we will fight may be the decisive one .
because of the deployment of the huge amounts of high - tech weaponry in today 's battles , the ways and tactics with which traditional aerial battles were fought have changed significantly . the capacity for electronic confrontations has especially become an important yardstick for the air force 's combat readiness .
what must be emphasized is that the methods of operating the chinese air force 's new weaponry not only refer to pilots ' tactical movements in aerial battles , they also include operational principles , use of information about the enemy , mobilization of the air force , command and guidance , coordination plans , and pilots ' tactics .
thus , our operational methods should not be methods merely for ordinary aerial battles between small detachments ; they should be methods for high - tech aerial battles fought between regiments and divisions , and even for combined operations .
along with the country 's economic growth , the air force 's weaponry will continue to be renewed . nevertheless , the situation where the air force 's weaponry is outmoded will not be improved in a short time .
thus , in order to be prepared for military struggles , we must be prepared to fight with what is available . our tactical research must also establish its footing on this starting point , and it must strive to achieve a breakthrough in using them effectively for specific missions .
when we are able to attack our enemy 's weakness with what we are strong in battles , we can turn the passive situation and inferiority into our initiative and superiority and win the aerial battles .
as long as our pilots can give full scope to our tactical potential , maximize the capabilities of the available weaponry , and give full play to our tactical and quantitative superiority , we can make up the qualitative inadequacy of our weaponry .
our experiences show that , as long as we pay attention to the specific missions and effectiveness of our tactical research , we can turn the research results into real fighting power and we can win big victories at low cost .
this is because only when we measure up militarily and theoretically can we skillfully operate high - tech weaponry , maximize its operational effectiveness , and become invincible in future operations .
some people say that the history of mankind 's civilization is a history of creations , and the development process of modern aerial battles is an even more magnificent history of creations .
in modern aerial battles , virtually all situations " have never been taught or seen during training , " every tactics employed in an aerial battle has to be new , and innovations are essential for winning in every aerial battle .
as pilots who are the main players in aerial battles , we will have important responsibilities to bear in future aerial warfare . the results of the battles will have a direct impact on the victory of the operations , and may even on the situation of the war as a whole .
a combat mission may sink a warship , destroy a base , devastate an important target , and may even destroy a city and kill thousands of people . airplane pilots can even wipe out property of immense value .

wang yongzhi , chinese rocket expert , academician of the chinese academy of engineering , and chief architect of china 's manned spaceflight project , made an academic report entitled " china 's manned spaceflight " at the forum on 8 june disclosing that information .
the report points out that manned spaceflight is so far a chinese project biggest in scale , most complicated in system , and most difficult in technology .
pursuant to the target of china 's spaceship development , under the prerequisite of ensuring safety and reliability , the basic requirements and management methods for manned spaceships should embody chinese characteristics and technological progress .
the report says that a manned spaceship is composed of many systems , such as an astronaut system , a spaceship application system , a manned spaceship system , a carrier rocket system , a launch site system , and a landing system .
the project research procedures are divided into four stages , namely , design , initial research , normal and unmanned spaceship experiments , and manned spaceflight experiments .
it is a complicated system centering on the astronaut with a combination of medical science and engineering . it involves the science of space life , spaceflight medical engineering , other important fields , the selection of astronauts , and the training of astronauts who can perform manned spaceflight .
the report adds that through seven years of arduous efforts by chinese scientific and technological personnel , the basic task for manned spaceflight and the research on the seven systems of manned spaceships have been fulfilled as scheduled .

beijing , 12 jun ( xinhua ) - - according to a zhongguo qingnian bao report today , the central military commission recently decided to officially provide military lawyers for political institutions of the group armies , divisions , and brigades of the chinese people 's liberation army .
as learned , this is the first of its kind in the history of the chinese armed forces .
the lawyers ' law provides that military lawyers , when performing their duties , are entitled to the same rights enjoyed by lawyers in society and undertake the same responsibilities as these lawyers do .
the report says that providing specialized military lawyers and resolving law - related issues for officers and men by legal means have become the common demand of officers and men .
this has also arisen from the need to win a local war under high - tech conditions in the future .
as international laws , including the war law and armed conflict law , have become increasingly important in adjusting and regulating war , engaging in legal combat will help provide a legal basis and protection for a military action , thus safeguarding one 's own country 's international reputation and national interests .

this will be the first summit meeting held between the north and the south since the korean peninsula was divided in 1945 . as a major breakthrough in north - south political relations , the summit meeting is expected to draw global attention .
the summit meeting has been postponed for six years it is known to all that the korean peninsula has remained divided for more than half a century , during which time the korean war broke out and went on for three years .
for a long time , though the north and the south have held dialogues or had contacts with each other at various levels on quite a few occasions in order to improve bilateral relations , the lack of trust between the two has remained .
though it is now eight years since the cold war ended , the haze of the cold war has yet to leave the korean peninsula once and for all ; the pattern of north - south confrontation has remained basically unchanged ; and the north and the south have even had several serious armed conflicts involving bloodshed .
however , realizing lasting peace and stability on the korean peninsula is a common aspiration shared by the people of both the north and the south of the peninsula and the north and the south have made unremitting efforts towards this end .
since the 1970 s , the north and the south of the peninsula have held political , military , economic , and sports talks at various levels or through various channels , including those between their red cross associations , and have achieved some results .
since entering the 1990 s , especially since the end of the cold war between the east and the west , the north and the south of the peninsula have developed closer contacts with each other .
in february 1992 , the prime ministers of the two sides signed in pyongyang " the agreement on reconciliation , nonaggression , exchanges , and cooperation between the north and the south . "
what merits mention is that in as early as 1994 , then - dprk - state - president kim il - song and then - rok - president kim yong - sam decided to hold a summit meeting in july , 1994 .
after that , as the new dprk leader devoted himself to economic construction at home , the rok had a new leader , and some other factors arose , the north - south summit failed to materialize .
over the past two years , both the dprk and the rok have put forth proposals on holding talks between the north and the south authorities with a view to bringing about reconciliation and cooperation .
on 22 november , 1999 , the fourth round of the four - party talks on the question of the korean peninsula ended in geneva , which officially launched a working group to " ease tension on the peninsula " and a working group to " establish a mechanism for peace on the peninsula . "
with regard to the specific issues discussed by the two work groups , the chinese delegation put forward at the meeting five principled propositions with four basic points in order to ease tension on the peninsula .
the dprk side also put forth a proposal on holding high - level political talks between the north and the south .
since the end of the cold war , the international security situation has by and large moved towards as peace and development have turned into a common topic shared by the international community .
since the end of the cold war , though the pattern of confrontation on the korean peninsula has remained basically unchanged , maintaining stability has also remained as the mainstream development of the situation on the peninsula .
in particular , in recent years , dialogues on the korean peninsula and cooperation between neighboring countries on the question of the korean peninsula have continued to gain momentum .
now that the leaders of the north and the south of the korean peninsula have agreed to hold a summit meeting , this is bound to help eradicate animosity between the two sides and push the korean peninsula further towards .
some analysts have estimated that during the meeting , the two sides will discuss a wide range of issues relating to the peninsula .
through consultations , the two sides are expected to reach a sort of consensus on quite a few issues . as for the remaining issues , the two sides are likely to hold further consultations and come up with solutions step by step in future .
nevertheless , public opinion and some analysts still maintain that although the north - south summit is expected to proceed as scheduled , given some deep - rooted problems between the two sides , the two sides will still have to make more painstaking efforts to resolve those problems .

belgrade , 12 jun ( xinhua ) - - li peng , chairman of the chinese national people 's congress [ npc ] standing committee , addressed the fry assembly on 12 june .
my wife and i , as well as all the other members of the delegation , are deeply touched by the sincerity and warmth of the yugoslav people , even though we have been here for less than two days .
allow me to use this opportunity to express my sincere gratitude to the federal assembly and the government of the fry for their warm invitation and hospitality and to convey the chinese people 's warm greetings and best wishes to the yugoslav people .
the yugoslavs , who have been living in the balkan peninsula for generations , have consistently treasured independence and are fond of peace .
during world war ii , the yugoslav people fought persistently and courageously against the fascists and made an indelible contribution to the final victory .
a year ago , when the independence and sovereignty of yugoslavia were again seriously endangered , the yugoslav people waged a brave and tenacious struggle , defying the power - wielders and withstanding pressure .
over the past year , the yugoslav people have achieved remarkable successes in rebuilding the country and reviving the economy despite awful international circumstances .
belgrade , the heroic city , is still standing proudly on the sara river . history has shown once again that the yugoslav people are invincible with their glorious tradition !
we chinese people heartily respect the yugoslav people , who have displayed an indomitable spirit in defying powers , withstanding pressure , and emerging from troubles ever stronger . we believe that you will be able to overcome current difficulties and achieve new successes in reinvigorating the economy .
when mankind was approaching the 21 st century , nato , led by the united states , flagrantly delivered air strikes on the sovereign state of yugoslavia and used military force to grossly interfere in yugoslavia 's internal affairs .
this constituted an offense against the un charter and the universally recognized norms that regulate international relations , and this seriously endangered stability in europe and peace in the world .
the war has not only brought a catastrophe to yugoslavia , but also caused enormous sufferings to members of all ethnic groups in kosovo and the neighboring countries .
whether this war has done any good to anybody is a question to be pondered by the international community , including the vast majority of european countries .
the weapons are silent today , but it is regrettable that the kosovo issue has not been settled , ethnic conflicts are far from being eased , and the problem of refugees is still acute . the balkan region is still very far from peace and stability .
this shows sufficiently that peace cannot be achieved with bombings .
regional conflicts and disputes can only be resolved through peaceful consultations among the different concerned parties in this region , and a country 's internal problems can only be solved by its own people .
after the bombing of the embassy , the yugoslav government and people offered us various forms of help .
i would like to use this opportunity once again to express our deep gratitude for this .
the war involved many fundamental issues , such as the preservation of international security , and how to eliminate international conflicts and strengthen the authority of the united nations .
we have been consistently maintaining that un authority should be respected .
the inviolability of state sovereignty is one of the basic principles laid down in the un charter and a precondition for the people in all countries to enjoy human rights .
principles such as equal sovereignty among all nations , mutual respect of sovereignty , and non - interference in each other 's internal affairs are the main norms of modern international relations . they are of important significance to the preservation of international order and peace in the world .
in order to preserve peace and stability in the world in the present international climate , in which there are many complex and profound changes , these principles should be further strengthened rather than weakened .
the two world wars and the nearly-50-year-old cold war brought untold suffering to mankind .
since the end of the cold war , world peace , national development , and human progress have become a common desire and aspiration of the people throughout the world .
however , the grim reality warns us that the world is far from being tranquil , hegemony and power politics are being manifested in new forms , peace and development are still facing serious challenges .
the contemporary world is in a transition toward multi - polarity .
of course , we should also be aware that the eventual formation of a multi - polar model will be a long historical process .
developed countries are benefiting most from the economic globalization , while developing countries , which are vulnerable on the whole , face higher risks and greater challenges . this cannot but arouse the attention and concern of the world public .
eliminating the gap between the rich and the poor and the achievement of general development and prosperity represent an urgent task for the international community .
at the turn of the century , an observation of the two main development trends toward multi - polarity and economic globalization has attracted everyone 's attention to the question of what the new international political and economic order should be like .
we take the view that the well - known five principles of peaceful coexistence that were put forth in the 1950 s , the un charter , and other universally recognized norms in international relations are not outdated , but , on the contrary , should represent the basis for establishing a new world order .
the ultimate aim of its foreign policy is to develop friendship and cooperation with all countries in the world and to advance general development .
when it comes to the issue of the balkans , china has always been on the side of justice and has never had selfish interests , respecting fully the social systems and the roads of development chosen by the countries in the region .

beijing , 12 jun ( xinhua ) - - a report released by relevant chinese departments shows that china has continued to improve its social security system , basically paid in full and on time pensions of demobilized and retired personnel , and made new breakthroughs in medical insurance reform .
the report is jointly announced by the ministry of labor and social security and the state statistical bureau .
the report comprehensively introduces the development of china 's labor and social security sectors in 1999 .
the report shows that the pension insurance coverage in china 's cities and towns has continued to increase .
through fundraising channels such as strengthening fund collection , clearing arrears by enterprises , and increasing fiscal income , the pension of retired personnel who have joined the insurance plan has basically been released in full and on time . meanwhile , arrears of pensions in past years amounting to 13.34 billion yuan was released .
from july 1997 , china has adjusted the wage level of some 27 million retired enterprise personnel , a per capita increase of 145 yuan for the monthly income of retired enterprise personnel and per capita increase of 60 yuan for the monthly income of retired personnel .
the level of release of socialized pensions has increased annually . in 1999 , the socialized pensions for 14.03 million retired personnel were paid , the rate of release socialized pensions reached 47 percent .
progress has been made in the reform of medical insurance for workers in cities and towns .
as of the end of 1999 , 36 regions of overall planning at prefectural level and 23 regions of overall planning at county level formally carried out reform plans for basic medical insurance .
the income of basic medical insurance funds for the whole year was 2.45 billion yuan , with a surplus of more than 800 million yuan during the year .
the report also shows that china 's unemployment insurance coverage has continued to expand .
as of the end of 1999 , the number of people who participated in unemployment insurance nationwide was 98.52 million , an increase of 24.3 percent over the previous year .
meanwhile , reform in industrial injury and child birth insurance is being deepened , thereby laying down a good foundation for establishing a sound social security system .

it was early summer in the depths of the taihang shan .
groups of officers and soldiers in camouflage painting were launching fierce attacks at their " enemy " in a forward position either by breaking through obstacles for forced occupation of a beach , conducting an armed crossing and rapid marching , or riding combat vehicles .
this was a scene of a fully - armed all - personnel mobile combat exercise organized by a division of the beijing military region .
to enhance their comprehensive mobile supply capability under complicated terrains and weather conditions , they extensively conducted innovations to repair all kinds of weapons and equipment - - total of more than 1,200 pieces of equipment were repaired .
during the course of exploring new ways of conducting military operations in the plateau and the desert , this division has insisted on the principle of integrating reform and innovation with seeking truth with scientific methods . the division has tried to introduce new operational methods while achieving technical breakthroughs .
during this long - distance mobilized operational maneuver , the division has created many conditions and drill subjects . it has fully utilized new technologies and integrated coordination with technical repairs .
they also have conducted 18 comprehensive drill subjects in the daban plateau where terrain conditions are very complicated . these drill subjects include anti - air raids , providing supplies during mobilized operations , and providing fuel to vehicles in battlefields where roads are narrow .
in the middle of the desert where screens of yellow sands prevail , this division has carried out new - style " striking at three things and defending against three things " [ " three - three " ] . the division has utilized artificial concealment , fake battlefields , and camouflage to carry out tight defensive protection .
through the use of such tactics as " covering up " in the sea of sand , the unit has been able to " move while hiding . "
a responsible person of the state press and publications administration was recently interviewed by our reporter on this matter .
reporter : what is your evaluation of the current state of propaganda in china 's newspapers and periodicals , especially small papers and periodicals ?
the " publication control regulations " and the relevant regulations on newspaper and periodical control lay down that in publishing newspapers and periodicals it is necessary to have a set business scope and a specific operational purpose ; this is the most basic regulation on running papers and periodicals .
second , they provide erroneous public opinion guidance .
in running newspapers and periodicals , it is first necessary to stress politics and persist in guiding people through correct public opinion .
third , there are serious leaks , in particular , there are conspicuous problems of leaking military secrets in reporting on military affairs .
fourth , they publish false reports .
for the sake of departmental economic interests , some paper and periodical publishers sell some of the space in their papers and periodicals or even all of their publishing rights to other persons or units .
this is serious violation of discipline and the rules , which results in a few papers and periodicals becoming the tools of certain people for extorting money or propagating erroneous viewpoints .
seventh , there is no end to payment for news despite repeated prohibition , and this seriously damages the solemnity of press work and the image of press workers .
these problems of violations of discipline and rules are rather conspicuous in small papers and periodicals and have aroused widespread concern in society . the masses have strong views on these problems and hope that the party and government departments concerned will strengthen control .
reporter : please talk about the significance of establishing a system for warning papers and periodicals on breaches of discipline and the rules .
reporter : what are your demands on implementing the system of warning newspapers and periodicals on breaches of discipline and rules ?
hence , it is first necessary that the departments concerned fully understand the extreme importance of strengthening newspaper and periodical control for the overall situation of the work of the whole party and state , and further enhance political awareness and their awareness of the overall situation and of their responsibilities .
third , the newspaper and periodical publishing houses must strengthen internal control and the establishment of rules and regulations , and enhance their awareness of self - discipline .
the units in charge must " be dutybound to defend their territory , " and seriously carry out their responsibilities as the units in charge .
fourth , in the process of implementing this warning system , it is necessary to pay attention to integrating this system with other relevant systems of rules and regulations in newspaper and periodical control , and administer things according to law .
we believe that the implementation of this warning system will further promote the healthy and prosperous development of china 's newspaper and periodical business .

li peng , chairman of the chinese national people 's congress standing committee , is making an official friendly visit in yugoslavia .
over the last couple of days , we have seen that the land is fertile and agriculture is developed here . it is the wheat harvesting season and we have seen golden wheat fields everywhere .
the fry does not have any food grain shortage and it has bread to feed the people .
after the nato bombings , the western countries stepped up economic sanctions against the fry , causing a shortage of supplies , currency devaluation , higher commodity prices , and worsening inflation in the fry . in 1999 , the commodity prices rose 42 percent on an average .
those who suffered the most from the bombings and the economic sanctions were the ordinary people of yugoslavia . many industrial and mining enterprises suspended production due to lack of funds and vast numbers of workers and staff members were compelled to take a furlough , getting only a part of their wages .
however , the yugoslav people , with the glorious tradition of opposing aggression , have not been intimidated by the barbarous war , and they have not lost hope for their future .
in the communications infrastructure , the bridge on the danube river at novi sad and european highway no. 75 have been either repaired or rebuilt . so far , the fry has restored 40 of the 58 highway and railroad bridges destroyed in the bombings and all its major highways have been basically open to traffic .
on 29 may , a railroad - highway bridge at novi sad was restored and formally reopen to traffic .
it was the first railroad - highway bridge on the danube river rebuilt since the nato bombing .
before the beginning of winter last year , the fry government had restored a large number of hospitals , schools and houses which were destroyed in the bombings . so , those who lost their houses could be sheltered and fed during the winter .
while actively carrying out the reconstruction , the fry has also actively adopted measures to ensure social stability .
in the fry 's economy , agriculture is a strength with a strong foundation . the government , attaching great importance to agriculture , is taking effective policy measures to support agricultural development .
even in 1999 when the fry suffered the bombing , its agricultural output value still increased by nearly 3 percentage points as compared with the preceding year .
in belgrade stores , the bread supply is always abundant .
its average annual agricultural output is three times the demand of its people . golden wheat crops are everywhere on the black fertile soil in belgrade in june .
in the autumn of last year , the fry reaped good harvests of all its major agricultural crops and the good harvests helped ensure social stability .
we , the reporters accompanying chairman li peng on the visit , have witnessed the fry people 's commendable indomitable character and their spirit of constantly striving to become stronger .
the fry has abundant natural resources and occupies an important strategic position . the fry people , working hard , will certainly be able to make their country even more beautiful and better .

a year ago , us - led nato started the kosovo war .
kosovo is a an autonomous province of the yugoslav federation , so the latter has the right to administer it in any form including the use of force . this is something within the authority of a state as prescribed by international law .
on 25 march , us president clinton also stressed on television that nato armed intervention in kosovo civil war was mainly prompted by its humanitarian stance and for the purpose of preventing greater disasters .
the kosovo issue was one concerning the yugoslav federation internal jurisdiction . the conflict between government forces and albanian ethnic guerilla forces was purely an internal affair of yugoslavia . it was neither an international issue , nor a humanitarian disaster .
because of the sanction , yugoslavia foreign trade dropped sharply .
during the kosovo war , many people were forced to leave home and wander about as refugees , who were once 1.2 million in number .
the war not only failed to protect human rights , but people lost their rights of subsistence and personal security altogether .
a nation sovereignty gives expression to its supreme interests .
the sovereignty principle serves as the core , foundation , and soul of international relations .
no country is allowed to interfere in any affair essentially within another country domestic jurisdiction , under any excuse or through any international organization .
not only has the un charter enshrined a clear provision about the principle , but all countries including the united states also expressed recognition of the principle in the special on non - interference and no meddling in each other internal affairs passed by the 36 th un general assembly on 9 december 1981 .
the un charter makes it clear that the united nations , in principle , shall not meddle in any country internal affairs .
the on the principles governing international law adopted in 1970 acknowledges the equality principle of state sovereignty : no violation of state sovereignty is allowed , sovereignty is a matter within a nation internal jurisdiction .
the sovereignty principle has become a universally accepted norm governing international relations .
over the last few years , in the air offensive against libya , panama , and iraq ( in the desert fox ) , afghanistan , or the sudan , the us army basically made a urgical attack on its enemy by taking advantage of its air superiority , fighting a quick battle to force a quick decision .
all these military actions proved unprecedentedly successful , and they accumulated certain experience from them . however , us troops then gradually developed a bad habit of overly depending upon aircraft , guided missiles , accurately guided bombs , and other hi - tech weapons .
their air raids lasted 38 days , a longer time , in the gulf war. the kosovo war , however , lasted 78 days , possibly the longest air war since world war ii .
according to a report , only two soldiers were killed in accidents during the kosovo war , and none was killed on the battlefield .

therefore , in this sense , the future war will mainly be a war decided by air and information supremacy . there should be no doubts about this . however , can a war be always won by only depending upon air raids with information supremacy ?
we should notice that in the kosovo war , air force played a decisive role , but the fact is that nato did not win the war as they had the gulf war , because they failed , among other reasons , to completely destroy the yugoslav federation s military strength .
therefore , we cannot conclude from the kosovo war that in the future hi - tech limited war , ground forces will be of no use .
in the 1991 gulf war , only 8 percent of accurately guided weapons were used .

the mysterious answers remain to be given and figured out later . why did accurately guided weapons fail to hit targets ? it was not because they were inaccurate , but because yugoslav troops ingeniously sought cover from the enemy fire .
such a fighting method has been tested in many previous limited wars , and proved very successful .

innovative military science research - - a strategic move in building stronger armed forces through science and technology li zongshu ( political commissar , major general ) : military science research is an important part of the country 's scientific cause .
the fundamental mission of carrying out innovative military science research is to continue to provide the power for building stronger armed forces through science and technology and provide a powerful support for training the armed forces in science and technology .
without innovative military science research , we will neither be able to upgrade our weaponry nor improve the quality of our armed forces .
while the chinese armed forces have achieved world - renowned successes in their modernization over the past several decades , their modernity still falls quite far behind that of developed countries .
this gap may continue to widen because of the various restraining factors , especially inattention to innovative military science research .
the most important point to note is that , innovative military science research is the fundamental requirement for ensuring " winning in battles . "
the chinese armed forces , which have yet to become fully mechanized , are now confronting another grim challenge from the development of information - based weaponry .
create the mechanisms for innovations - - the foundation of ensuring continual innovations zhao tasheng ( academy president and major general ) : creating the mechanisms for nurturing innovators is an urgent task .
chairman jiang pointed out : " talented personnel are the most important resource for scientific - technological advancements and for economic and social development . "
this is to say that building the platform and mechanisms for nurturing innovators should become the strategic mission for innovations . as leading cadres , we should create an environment in which all scientists and technicians can compete fairly .
we must create a good environment in which people can be brought together by their career prospects , encouraged by policies , and warmed by genuine care and concern - - an environment in which the really top - notched personnel can distinguish themselves .
we have developed measures for putting them to good use , keeping them from leaving , training young people , and letting go those whose performance is just ordinary .
meanwhile , we have also developed the incentives useful for arousing the initiative and creativity of scientists and technicians , and for encouraging innovations in scientific research .
because of this policy , many talented scientists and technicians have come to the fore and our research projects have been fruitful .
scientific innovations are a systems engineering project , which not only requires scientists ' untiring efforts , but also administrative mechanisms for supporting and protecting innovations .
this is to say that , after a research project has been established , the project manager should have the authority to choose and hire the people he needs and form them into a research group that will address difficult research issues under his guidance .
when this group has accomplished the project , this research collective will automatically dissolve , and all its personnel , including the manager , will re - enter the personnel markets .
huang cuifen ( academician of the china institute of engineering ) : creating new , scientific mechanisms for scientific research is very important .
in our future innovative research , we must continue to clearly define different responsibilities .
we must absolutely ensure the accomplishment of important , mandatory research projects of the armed forces . for those research projects concerning modernization of the armed forces , we must organize and coordinate all quarters to accomplish them .
turning scientific and technological achievements into productive and fighting forces is the ultimate goal of scientific innovations .
create an atmosphere for innovations - - the guarantee for encouraging more innovations wang hai ( research fellow ) : creating a new atmosphere requires , first of all , a new mindset .
falling behind mentally is the primary cause of scientific - technological backwardness .
science researchers should have the spirit and the courage to become the first .
" the essence of science rests in innovation . " mankind will never make advancements if it is satisfied with what it has achieved in science and technology . scientific research only acknowledges the best , not the second best . if our research keeps following others ' footsteps , it is no longer significant .
modern sciences and technologies are now developing very rapidly . disciplines are highly divided . but different disciplines do infiltrate each other , and new disciplines emerge constantly .
under such circumstances , counting on individual efforts to achieve innovations can no longer keep pace with the development of the time .
that is why some people say that the time for individual research , like what newton and edison did in the past , has ended and has been replaced by a knowledge - based economic era in which researchers have to work together and tackle difficult problems collectively .
experiences show that this is an effective way to expedite major innovations .
scientists and technicians need a channel , through which information can flow freely , in order to understand the latest academic activities in the world and choose the areas where to work to make a breakthrough in their research .

the sixth review conference of the parties to the treaty on the non - proliferation of nuclear weapons [ npt ] was held in new york from 24 april to 20 may. this was the first review conference held in the new millennium since the indefinite extension of the npt in 1995 .
among 187 state parties to the npt , 158 attended the meeting . un secretary general kofi annan and foreign ministers and vice ministers of more than 20 countries , including secretary of state albright of the united states and foreign minister igor ivanov of the russian federation , spoke at the meeting .
representatives of more than 10 international organizations attended the meeting as auditors . a total of 141 non - governmental organizations sent representatives to participate in the opening session . the international media also gave it extensive coverage .
for the first time , the five countries promised not to target nuclear weapons at any other country .
military alliances have been strengthened , and hegemonism and power politics manifest themselves from time to time .
the united states has stepped up the development , deployment , and proliferation of its advanced ballistic missile defense system , thus posing a severe threat to the global strategic balance and stability .
first , it is beneficial to the promotion of the process of global nuclear disarmament .
the issue of nuclear disarmament constitutes the key point of consecutive review conferences .
at the 1995 npt review conference , non - nuclear states agreed the indefinite extension of the treaty in exchange for the promise of nuclear states to gradually carry out nuclear disarmament .
during this review conference , they wanted to exert pressure against nuclear states to push forward the process of nuclear disarmament .
these promises will be beneficial to resuming the stagnated process of nuclear disarmament and instilling vitality into the process of nuclear disarmament .
with regard to the issue of nuclear tests in south asia , most countries criticized india and pakistan for going against the tide of history by carrying out one after another nuclear tests .
third , it is beneficial to enhancing the understanding of all parties concerned about the importance and necessity of the issue of international cooperation in peaceful use of nuclear energy .
fourth , it has helped the international community increase its attention to the necessity of maintaining global strategic stability .
in their speeches , the russian foreign minister , the swedish foreign minister , and the chinese delegation clearly criticized the united states for developing and deploying the nmd system .

the flood prevention responsibility system must be implemented from the provincial and city levels to the county , township and village levels . tasks must be assigned to specific people and requirements must be concrete and clear so that inspection and checking can be easily carried out .
leading cadres responsible for tasks of preventing and fighting floods should earnestly undertake their responsibility , rush to their posts in good time , properly grasp the construction of flood prevention facilities , ensure preparation against floods is made , and organize work to fight floods , deal with emergency , and evacuate and rescue the people . 2 .
it is necessary to ensure such zones can be used whenever necessary .

it is necessary to quicken the process of risk - elimination and reinforcement projects .
it is necessary to put project quality in a prominent position , carry out quality control and management in all directions and in the entire process , and do careful organization and construction work .
it is necessary to earnestly take measures to ensure important railways , major highways and reservoirs upstream from towns and cities will not collapse .
before the flood season comes , it is necessary to seize the time to formulate plans for forecasting floods and to carry out work with clear aims .
in case a flood occurs , it is necessary to strengthen monitoring work , make continuous forecast in order to provide a timely basis for dispatching people and materials to deal with floods .
it is necessary to ensure a contingent of people and materials for dealing with emergency are available .
local governments should properly organize a contingent of people to deal with emergency and stand in combat readiness .
governments at various levels should store up materials for fighting floods and dealing with emergencies in accordance with the principle of each level undertaking respective responsibility .
it is necessary to pay attention to the flood prevention work of tributaries and small and medium reservoirs . 6 .
it is necessary to give correct command , make correct decisions , and do flood prevention work in unity .
it is necessary to give play to the role of professional departments and engineering and technical personnel , and carefully listen to the views of specialists .

the erroneous general impressions of , and the pointless countermeasures taken by , china 's agricultural sector on the country 's accession to the wto .
an analysis of reasons (i) erroneous general impressions and pointless countermeasures .
it has been showed clearly by the facts mentioned above that china 's feeble agriculture is never within the vision of the mainstream international community .
as for the other misunderstanding , people believed that advanced countries would focus their attention on china 's agriculture , and would allow china to exchange concessions in agriculture for a stand of making no concession in the industrial and service sectors .
this was also a wishful thinking cherished by both the decision - making authorities and the vested groups of trade barriers .
in the wake of the china - us agricultural talks , one popular view in the society was that china should make no concession in the fields of finance , telecommunications , service trade , automobile , and petrochemistry lest others would secure an " one - sided win " in profit - reaping in these fields .
to gather up the threads among the noises concerning the china - us agricultural agreement , we must first understand one fact : to different industries and different groups in different countries , the process of economic globalization and trade liberalization carries different implications .
in other words , a country will have both " winners " and " losers " in this process .
the reallocation of resources resulted from globalization will inevitably lead to a readjustment of interests .
in advanced countries where capital and technological factors are comparatively sufficient , capital - and technology - intensive industries are enjoying a relative advantage ; whereas in developing countries where labor factor is comparatively sufficient , labor - intensive industries are enjoying a relative advantage .
therefore , the tariffs in advanced countries are not tariff barriers , and are mostly based on agricultural products and manufactured goods ; while the agricultural sector in developing countries is at a relatively advantageous position , and the high tariff barriers on imported goods are usually meant for industrial goods .
what is more , in their domestic market , developing countries usually press down the price of the labor factor in agriculture , so that they can maintain the high monopoly prices and high monopoly profits of industrial goods on the basis of low monopoly prices of agricultural products and an extremely humble income of peasants .
in this sense , relatively speaking , the " chicken ribs " concerning china 's accession to the wto does not lie with the country 's agriculture or grain .
in a word , in china , agriculture and peasants are the " winner " in the globalization process , and a rational response should be to accelerate this process and to strive for an early accession to the wto .
basing on the above train of thought , in china , those who are holding a most negative approach towards the country 's entry into the wto should be the industries and groups which have the least relative advantage but are best protected .
under both circumstances mentioned above , these industries and groups have all along regarded their own private profits as the interests of the whole people , and what they have done will end up slowing down the globalization process of the chinese economy .
we should provide the public with a clear picture of all these .
there is no free banquet in this world .
in the end , we may have to draw support from the mainstream force of the mainstream international community to reorganize the strength , and to readjust the balance of force , among different sides inside the country .
the speech of premier zhu rongji pointed out the bright future of china , heartened the confidence of 1.2 billion people in building a prosperous , powerful , and democratic china , and inspired the willingness of foreign businesses to increase investment in china .
science and education will see bigger development . through reforms on science and education , efforts will be made to closely coordinate development of science and technology with economic construction .
it is necessary to strengthen capacities of making technological innovations , promote transformation of technological achievements into practical productive forces , and actively form a mechanism and a social environment in which outstanding talents will be inspired to find their way to distinctions .
fourth , the efforts of opening up to the outside world will be accelerated , and expanded in all aspects .

beijing , 15 jun ( xinhua ) - - the state council recently issued a circular demanding that the local governments concerned and the state council departments attach great importance to putting into effect the legislation law and do a good job in this work in all respects .
the circular says that the " prc legislation law " will come into effect on 1 july 2000 .
this is a major affair in building socialist democracy and legal system in china .
government legislative work is an important component part of state legislative activities , and has a bearing on the building of political power .
drawing up and instituting the legislation law is bound to play a positive role in ensuring in system the quality of government legislative work and safeguarding the unity of the socialist legal system .
in connection with the reality of their own localities and departments , the local people 's governments concerned and the state council departments must formulate specific work plans for study , publicity , training , and implementation of the legislation law , and seriously organize their execution .
through its annual arrangements for legislative work , the state council can decide that one or a number of departments can be specifically responsible for drafting work regarding items to be included in the legislative plan ; the state council 's legislative affairs office can also draft them or organize the drafting .
when submitting legislation proposals , the state council departments must act in light of the overall work arrangements of the central authorities and the state council , arrange them in order of gravity and priority , and ensure the key points while taking care of the ordinary ones .
when the local people 's governments concerned draft and formulate local rules and regulations , and the state council departments formulate rules and regulations , they must act in accordance with the above demands , pay attention to eliminating local or departmental protectionism , and comprehensively and accurately implement the party 's line , principles , and policies .
the circular points out that the local people 's governments concerned and the state council departments should act in line with the provisions of the legislative law and the " regulations on putting on record laws and regulations " and strictly report and send in laws and regulations for putting on record .
the state council legislative affairs office must intensify the work of putting on record and examining laws , rules , and regulations , and strive to explore new ways and methods of doing a good job in this work .
the localities and departments must also establish and put on a sound basis a system for putting on record and examining rules and regulations and documents of this nature , and properly resolve problems of " fighting according to law [ yi fa da jia ] . "
the circular points out in conclusion that in implementing the legislation law and further enhancing government legislative work , it is essential to have a government legislative work force with relatively high political and professional qualities .

beijing , 15 jun ( xinhua ) - - the chinese foreign ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation [ moftec ] issued a statement saying that it has decided to extend the period of investigation into the antidumping case of stainless cold - rolled sheet for another six months .
in accordance with article 15 of the " prc antidumping and antisubsidy regulations , " the period of antidumping investigation normally should be completed within one year from the date of its announcement . under special circumstances , it can be extended to 18 months .
the moftec statement noted that since the case involves a large number of exporters and the investigation can by no means be completed within the planned one - year period , the moftec has decided to extend the investigation period in accordance with the above stipulation .

dai xianglong said : there are two major trends of development in today 's world . one is political pluralization , and the other is economic globalization .
the development of information technology and information industries will result in large - scale decline in the cost of transportation and communication , which then will promote the rapid development of international trade , transnational investment , and international finance and will closely integrate the world economy .
economic globalization is reflected mainly in trade liberalization , production internationalization , and financial globalization .
dai xianglong cited a series of figures to explain the above - mentioned viewpoint . global trade of commodities and labor services totaled $ 7.1 trillion in 1998 , accounting for 24 percent of the gdp of the world .
in 1998 , the 60,000 multinationals in the world played a leading role in the world economy because they created 40 percent of the world 's gdp , and their trade volume and direct foreign investment accounted for 60 and 90 percent , respectively , of the world 's total .
in the meantime , there was large - scale flow of international capital . transnational investment exceeded $ 800 billion in 1999 , more than four times over 1990 .
financial globalization is prominently reflected in the large - scale flow of international capital , the cross - border operations of financial institutions and financial business according to the same rules , and the vigorous development of the international financial market .
judging from a long - term point of view , financial globalization has a positive significance in the effective distribution of resources and improvement in people 's living standards of various countries because it has greatly raised the efficiency of the world 's financial market .

beijing , 15 jun ( xinhua ) - - at a lunch for those attending the 2000 conference of the " 21 st century forum , " dai xianglong , governor of the people 's bank of china , delivered a speech entitled " take up the challenge of financial globalization . "
developing countries must deepen reform , go after profit , try to avoid losses , proceed in an orderly way , and take part in economic and financial globalization step by step .
economic globalization should not exclude regional economic integration , and the latter is the basis for the former .
we hope that a stable u.s. dollar exchange rate will be maintained . we welcome the issue of the euro and approve of an agreement signed in chiang mai , thailand , by the 10 members of the association of southeast asian nations (asean) along with china , japan and korea on currency exchange .
second , international financial supervision and control should be strengthened .
the international community should establish necessary systems and standards , check the disorderly flow of short - term international capital , and exercise effective supervision and control over hedge funds , high - leverage institutions , and offshore financial centers .
at the same time , public and private sectors should both bear due responsibility for bringing the positive effects of financial globalization into full play .
we welcome the setting up of a dialogue mechanism by the group of 20 states .
china will continue to support and actively participate in the activities of the 20 - state group , support the reform of the imf , and make a contribution to establishing new international monetary and financial systems .
now china has freed itself from the negative effects of the asian financial crisis .
china will accede to the world trade organization before long .
second , we will reform interest rates in order to make them market - oriented .
we will institute a market interest rate system with the interest rates of the central bank as the basis , the interest rates of the money market as the intermediary , and the interest on deposits or loans determined by market supply and demand .
third , we will institute a modern commercial bank system .
we will promptly replenish solely state - owned commercial banks with capital through various channels and , on a trial basis , reform solely state - owned commercial banks into state - holding commercial banks under a joint - stock system .
we will support commercial banks in making financial innovations and actively developing intermediate business .
with china 's accession to the wto , we will steadily push forward the process of capital account convertibility of the renminbi .
fifth , we will open wider to the outside world financially and raise the level in this regard .

this is also the case with the internet .

beijing , 19 jun ( xinhua ) - - at present , summer planting , harvesting and field management are in full swing .
however , in some major grain - producing areas , the tendency of ignoring grain production has appeared .
in some drought - hit areas , local cadres have given up irrigating farmland and organized young and middle - aged laborers to work in other places .
in other localities , people erroneously thought that readjusting the structure of agriculture meant growing less grain crops or not growing grain crops at all and they reduced the area of farmland for growing grain crops by a big margin .
following grain harvests in successive years , the situation of supply being greater than demand has emerged in grain production in our country . the economic results of grain production have decreased and this has affected the peasants ' enthusiasm about input .
the initiative of cadres in agricultural management has also been affected and these cadres have taken a laissez - faire attitude toward grain production .
agricultural specialists have pointed out that at present , although the situation of grain supply being greater than demand has appeared in our country , the grain supply of our country will still be on the short side in the long run .
in the future , the three tendencies of an increasing population , decreasing farmland and constantly improving livelihood of the people will not change and the demand for grain will grow .
an important factor leading to bumper grain harvests for five successive years is good climate .
in the second half of the 1990 's , our country was in the wet period and the climatic conditions were favorable on the whole .
over half of the farmland across the country has no irrigation facility .
about 80 percent of the existing irrigation facilities were built before 1970 and after many years of operation , they are aging and need repairs badly . moreover , these facilities have not formed a complete set and the percentage of farmland guaranteed by irrigation is not high .
that an unfavorable situation in grain production has occurred this year is a signal .
since spring , the most serious drought in 10 years has occurred and the crops in over 200 million mu [ 1 mu = 6.6666 a ] of land have been affected .
plagues of locusts have occurred in henan , shandong , hebei , tianjin , xinjiang and anhui . plagues of meadow webworms have occurred in hebei , shanxi , inner mongolia , heilongjiang and jilin . serious plagues of striped rice borers have also occurred in areas along the middle and lower reaches of the chang jiang .
however , grain production should not be ignored simply because of this .
it is necessary to readjust the structure of agriculture , and grain production should develop in the direction of better quality and specialization while maintaining a certain level of output .
at present , the situation of drought is quite serious .
various localities should energetically take actions to mobilize the broad masses of the people and organize cadres and agricultural technicians to go to the first line to do all they can to resist drought and ensure summer planting , harvesting and field management .
more than half of the wheat has been gathered in and grain procurement will soon begin .
the central authorities have formulated the policy of open - ended purchase of surplus grain from the peasants at protective prices and various localities must firmly implement it .
