basically , there are now conditions for accelerating the development of the western region , and the time is ripe for doing so .

basing itself on actual conditions and bringing its advantages into full play " xinjiang 's important position in the large - scale development of the western region is based on its established conditions . "
xinjiang is a good place , with a vast area and abundant resources .
ground resources , such as water , soil , light , and heat , make xinjiang an ideal area for the development of agriculture , forestry , and animal husbandry .
xinjiang has more than 60 million mu of farmland and 130 million mu of wasteland suitable for reclamation , and it is a typical area with much land and few people .
people 's general impression of xinjiang is " its shortage of water . " in fact , however , there are quite a few water resources in xinjiang .
it has an oil deposit of nearly 30 billion tonnes .
for a country with a large population like ours , these reserve resources are very important .
readjusting the structure and laying stress on the key points when this reporter asked about how to set about the development of xinjiang , secretary wang thought a while and said : the most important thing to do now is to pay close attention to readjusting the structure .
the development of xinjiang should proceed from reality , and breakthroughs should be made in key projects . in areas where there are favorable conditions , we should push them on to an expressway .
we think they are along the two railway lines on the northern and southern feet of tianshan mountain , especially those north of the mountain , starting from urumqi in the east to usu in the west .
we want to recommend the most advantageous areas to investors so that they can quickly grain returns on their investment there .
the economic belt on the northern foot of tianshan mountain should strengthen its integration and form the largest top - quality cotton and yarn production centers , the largest grape wine brewing center , and the most important livestock products - producing and " red industry " area .
xinjiang should promote its large - scale development by opening itself to the outside world in a bid way .
one should not fear coming to grief at the mention of opening to the outside world .
to this end , we have done some work and made new plans . "
then , secretary wang told this reporter : xinjiang should give first priority to the building of water conservancy projects and accelerate the development of three major rivers - - ertix , ili , and tarim .
xinjiang has rich underground water resources , and less than 10 percent of them have been developed .
energy and communications construction is also being sped up .
with thermal power generation as the basis , hydraulic power generation projects along the ertix , ili , and tarim rivers have been started one after another .
propelled by the information revolution and the internet , the tide of economic globalization has swept across the whole world at unprecedented speed in recent years .
how should asia and china respond to it at the turn of the century ?
to explore this issue , from 14 to 16 june , the national committee of the chinese people 's political consultative conference [ cppcc ] hosted a high - level " forum " conference that was attended by influential political figures and accomplished experts and scholars from over 20 countries and regions in the world .
the theme of the " 21 st century forum " - 2000 conference was " economic globalization - - asia and china . " the meeting focused on discussing the development and impacts of economic globalization , countermeasures to be taken by developing countries , and opportunities and challenges facing asia and china .
they have fully demonstrated their scholarly talent , experiences , and wisdom .
their analyses and foresights attracted the great attention and concern of domestic and foreign media and relevant quarters .
tan sri dato ' ajit singh , former secretary general of the association of southeast asian nations [ asean ] , spoke highly of the " forum " at the conclusion of the meeting . he said : free , equal , and pragmatic academic discussions were held during the meeting , and satisfactory results were obtained .
a significant feature in contemporary economic development , economic globalization has become a general trend whose momentum of development is " irreversible . " this is a consensus reached by many participants at the meeting .
regardless of their viewpoints , participants shared a common view . they all expressed the belief that we must conform to the trend , and blend into the tide of economic globalization .
il sakong , chairman of the institute for global economics , south korea , delivered a very representative speech . he said : developing countries should find the best way to respond to the challenges of globalization . if they disregard globalization and seal off the country , they will widen their gaps with other countries in the world .
he opined when analyzing the reasons : this is related to the countries ' participation in economic globalization for many years .
bukhari pointed out emphatically : china 's experience has set an example for other developing countries . however , there are two sides to everything .
that includes economic globalization , which is a " double - edged sword " that contains the two major elements of advantages and disadvantages .
take asian countries and china for example . their development has benefited from economic globalization , but they have also been subject to the latter 's tremendous impacts .
many participants discussed the asian financial crisis in this respect . they pointed out : the financial crisis was closely related to economic globalization , and was a malpractice brought by it .
moving toward advantages , avoiding disadvantages , and seeking development are the major challenges to developing countries .
in the face of challenges , the most important thing is to handle one 's own affairs well .
many chinese and foreign scholars noted : because blending into globalization entails fierce competition , we must have actual strength in order to win in the competition .
in the regional area , we should consider such issues as establishing a regional monetary fund and reforming the asian development bank .
their viewpoints were echoed by others .
the day for china 's wto accession is approaching , and china 's economy will further blend into the global economy .

the deeds of wei dianju , the political commissar of a red army regiment of nanjing military region command , as this paper reported today , have proved again with convincing facts an important statement by general secretary jiang : " creating good personal images is vitally important " for leading cadres .
the personal images of cadres , as an external embodiment of their internal qualities , is the source for their prestige .
in general , the prestige of political workers , especially political work leaders , includes two aspects : power - based influences and non - power influences .
once a cadre is assigned to a leading position of political work , he is granted a power - based influence .
this kind of influence is indispensable and effective but also limited because it is based on enforcement and the external world while the non - power influence works in a wider range and for a longer period of time because is appealing and is based on a person 's internal world .
this is an important reason for the officers and soldiers from wei dianjue ' regiment exclaiming : " we 're willing to follow such a political commissar in times of peace no matter how hard we work , and we wo n't regret following such a political commissar in wartime even if we die in battle . "
it is often heard from some political cadres that the ideological and political work is difficult to do now and the work is not ideally effective . no matter how much you try to persuade a person with reason , he will not be moved , like the saying , " neither oil nor salt will work . "
it will be unfair to blame educators in a one - sided manner .
a military troop once took a poll of over 300 of its officers and soldiers asking , " why is n't the ideological and political work ideally effective ? " as many as 78.5% of surveyed people believed that unsatisfactory personal images is the most important reason .
though how representative this survey is still needs further study , at least it can demonstrate the solid fact that officials and soldiers pay close attention to the personal images of political cadres .
a common saying goes : " one should put on his clothes in the right position in order to see one 's upright image in the mirror ; one should first set examples for one 's subordinates in order to make them uncorrupted . "
the problem does not lie in the " oil or salt " itself but in the unsatisfactory personal images of the " oil and salt " disseminators .
to some extent , one 's image is the banner he upholds , image is a power and image is the life of political cadres .
whether or not political workers can create good images will influence the effectiveness of the political work , on the images of political workers themselves as well as on the image of our party as a whole .
regarding creating good personal images , we must first solve the problem of what criteria to adopt for it .
the " standard image " must conform to the " three represents " that general secretary jiang proposed .
as it influences adhering to the party 's nature of being advanced and on the guiding principle of the of the political work , we must pay close attention to it .
in order to create good personal images , we should comprehensively understand the meaning of personal image .

the personal image of a cadre is the comprehensive embodiment of his qualities in different aspects .
wei dianjue has created a good personal image as the political commissar of a red army regiment due to both his charisma and his competence and proficiency in promoting the ideological and political work .
every cadre should devote unswerving efforts to these two aspects .

because people , and people alone , are the objects of our ideological and political work , noting their distinctive thinking and behaviors and understanding the law of their changes is especially significant for tightening and improving ideological and political work under the new situation .
the all - army conference on political work pointed out that ideological and political construction must begin with noting the distinctions of the objects of our work during the initial stage of socialism .
without studying the objects of our work , we cannot possibly understand their distinctive natures , and doing our work in light of these objects ' distinctions will be impossible .
the exemplary models of ideological and political work that the central propaganda department has commended at one time or another this year have fully proved this point .
this is one important reason why some cadres , especially political cadres , often sigh that their ideological and political work is ineffective , and their job is difficult . there are two reasons why these cadres pay no attention to studying the objects of their work , or why they fail to study these objects thoroughly .
subjectively , they do not fully understand the importance ; and objectively , they do not want to do hard work . people - related issues are admittedly quite complex . studying these issues is often difficult .
the hard work that needs to be done over a long period of time has often discouraged people or made them take the detour .
to study the objects of ideological and political work , we must establish our footing on our times and study the distinctive features of the people at this time .
marx said that people are the grand total of relations between social sectors .
thus , studying the objects of our work must be associated with the developments and changes in the world and with the macro background of the country 's reform , opening up , and the development of the socialist market economy .
people 's thinking and behaviors are an ever - changing process in action . this is especially so today when our society is constantly changing .
as the saying goes , " the water in the river is longer the same water when we dip our feet into it the second time . "
at different times and spaces , the same object may think and behave differently .
why is it that " falungong " can bewitch some veteran cadres who used to be believers in marxism ?
why is it that some former advanced elements with halos over their heads have suddenly become felons behind bars ?
this proves that we must not observe people - - who are the greatest " variable " - - with an established view or the same formula , but observe and understand them from their actions .
" attempting to retrieve a sword dropped into the river by making a mark on the side of the boat , " empiricism , and trying to deal with new issues with old formulas are bound to go nowhere and the results will be insignificant .
to study the objects of our work , we need to set different levels for different people and do our job accordingly .
generals and rank - and - file soldiers are different in terms of their knowledge .
even among young people , those who come from developed areas think and behave differently from those who come from undeveloped areas , and so are those who are well educated and those who are not .
ideological and political work is a systems engineering project .
this has been a question of public concern . the reporters have heard some viewpoints at the free discussions of the " 21 st century forum . " the facts may prove that the answer is correct .
noted chinese economist wu jinglian said that small and medium enterprises would not be eliminated by economic globalization . on the contrary , they would face enormous opportunities .
the current economic globalization is a new economy represented by the information industry and the small and medium size enterprises are precisely the main force of the new economy .
no matter how the new economy develops , it can give full play to its role only when it is closely integrated with the traditional economy . moreover , the traditional economy will make use of the achievements of the new economy to increase its efficiency .
so long as the small and medium size enterprises have their leading products , they can use the modern information network and operational means to expand their market worldwide and participate in global competition .
when compared with the large enterprises , the small and medium size enterprises can keep their cost at a relatively low level . this is one of the essential factors to allow small and medium size enterprises exist in the global economic competition .
the small and medium - size enterprises , which have made gratifying achievements , have their own specialties , and they perform better than the perfect " aircraft carriers . "
when economic depression or structural decline occurred in the industrialized nations , the small and medium - size enterprises played the role of boosting economic growth , offering employment , promoting technological progress , and maintaining social and economic stability .
there are economists who predict that small and medium enterprises will become the image of enterprises in the 21 st century .
after all , we are in an unprecedented economic era .
zhang sai , director of the china society for productive forces and director of the china institute for study of national conditions , said that for whatever reasons , in the course of economic globalization , small and medium - size enterprises should prepare in the course of participation and participate in the course of getting prepared .
when the seas are in turmoil , heroes are on their mettle .
to this end , special stress should be laid on the following four aspects : 1 . putting economy on water in the primary position and energetically developing water - saving irrigation and dry farming .
in doing the anti - drought work , we should adhere to the principle of opening up water sources and economizing on consumption simultaneously , with priority given to economizing on water .
tightening unified management and scientific control of water resources .
first , water for urban dwellers ' domestic consumption and for key industrial and mining enterprises should be guaranteed .
there must not , under any circumstances , be " water shortage " in the urban areas , and cities lacking sufficient water sources should take precautions beforehand and lose no time in studying countermeasures .
the areas short of sufficient water have even greater needs to intensify management , guarantee the key points , and stress effectiveness . 3 .
reforming management structure and establishing a new mechanism for economy on water .
the existing water resource management structure and water consumption mechanism should be radically changed .
first , in planning the economic layout and formulating industrial policies , the state must give full consideration to the water resource conditions and strive to build up water - saving agriculture , water - saving industry , and water - saving society .
second , the water pricing mechanism must be improved and perfected to gradually rationalize water prices , fully exercise the regulating role of market mechanism in the development and utilization of water resources and , through the pricing lever and economic interest mechanism , promote economical and rational water consumption .
while reasonably fixing water prices , punitive water prices must be imposed on those who consume water excessively or waste water resources .
fourth , we should incrementally rationalize the unified management structure of water resources , enhance the authority of the management organs along the river valleys , and appropriately harmonize the contradictions arising from water consumption among different regions and departments , and in different seasons .

beijing , 18 jun ( xinhua ) - - the ninth plenary session of the three gorges project construction committee [ tgpcc ] under the state council was recently convened in beijing . zhu rongji , premier of the state council and director of the committee , made a speech .
he emphasized that the three gorges project is a great undertaking of the chinese nation for a thousand years , and quality is the lifeline of the project .
eight years have passed since the construction preparations for the project were launched in 1993 .
the second phase of the project , which started in 1998 , has proceeded smoothly and the quality is generally good .
as a result of the ceaseless efforts of the builders , by april 2000 168.8 million cubic meters of earth and stone work had been completed and 12.51 million cubic meters of concrete had been poured , including 4.58 million cubic meters poured in 1999 , which set a world record .
by the end of last march , 227,000 people living in the dam area had been resettled and 13.33 million square meters of new housing had been built for them .
the tgpcc , the three gorges general company , and the units concerned must step up education in quality awareness for the cadres and workers taking part in the project 's construction , and continually enhance the overall quality of the workforce .
the meeting pointed out that it is necessary to strive to complete the task laid down for this year 's resettlement work , to ensure that normal water storage in the project can be completed by 2003 .
at the same time , we must properly resettle the workers of bankrupt and closed enterprises , ensure their basic living needs , and actively expand opportunities for their reemployment .
the state departments concerned and chongqing municipality and hubei province must speed up the pace of environmental protection and ecological construction in the dam area , revise and perfect the original plans , and draw up specific implementation schemes .
the " three represents " are first of all a new demand on party building .
how can we consistently maintain the party 's soaring vitality in the new situation ?
this examination , however , has not yet ended .
the tasks shouldered by our party in the new situation are glorious but arduous , the tests we face are severe and profound , and the problems we will encounter are manifold and complex .
with the " three represents " as the guideline , we should carry out in - depth investigation , seriously study and properly resolve new problems encountered in party building in the new situation , and explore new lines of thought and find new methods in the spirit of reform and innovation .
we should take the " three represents " as a major yardstick for testing the advanced nature of the party , and check to see whether the measures we adopt and the work we do meet the demands of the " three represents . "
the " three represents " is also a new demand on the various tasks in building socialism with chinese characteristics .
the " three represents " should not only be expressed in building the party itself but also in all work which the party leads , and should imbue all aspects and the entire process of socialist modernization .
we must deepen the reforms and build a relatively perfect socialist market economy system .
we must persist in the guideline of rejuvenating the country through science and education and the strategy of sustainable development , and get a good grasp of implementing the strategy of major development of western china .
we must strengthen and improve ideological and political work , step up the building of socialist spiritual civilization and the building of democracy and the legal system , and preserve social stability and national security .

zhang wannian , vice chairman of the central military commission , today [ 19 june ] met with yuji fujinawa , chairman of japan 's self - defense forces joint staff council , and his party in beijing .
zhang wannian said : in recent years , relations between china and japan have maintained a trend of development .
in 1998 , president jiang zemin paid a state visit to japan . based on historical lessons and in the spirit of facing toward the future , china and japan jointly established a friendly and cooperative partnership [ you hao he zuo huo ban guan xi ] aimed at promoting peace and development .
regarding problems existed between the two countries , zhang wannian emphatically hoped that the japanese side would effectively follow the spirit and principle of the " sino - japanese joint statement " and the " sino - japanese joint declaration " and properly handle historical issues and the taiwan question .
zhang wannian reiterated the chinese government 's principled stand on the taiwan question .
the chinese government will firmly adhere to the basic policy of " one country , two systems " but we shall not undertake to renounce the use of force [ dan bu cheng nuo fang qi shi yong wu li ] .
he said : in recent years , the exchange of defensive matters between japan and china has developed smoothly .
he hoped that the two sides could strengthen dialogue , enhance friendship and further promote exchange and cooperation in all fields .
yuji fujinawa said : the japanese government 's stand on the taiwan question has been reflected in the " sino - japanese joint statement " and the " sino - japanese joint declaration . "
kui fulin , deputy chief of general staff of the chinese people 's liberation army , and zhan maohai , director of the foreign affairs office of the ministry of national defense , were present at the meeting .

the success of the dprk - rok summit on the korean peninsula has set some people thinking about the resolution of the taiwan issue .
the current situation on the korean peninsula has taken shape under a special international environment after world war ii . it is approved by international agreements and the united nations . the status of the " 38 th parallel " is guaranteed by international laws and major powers .
both the dprk and rok are sovereign states universally recognized the world over and both countries have joined the united nations of their own free will .
un resolution 1782 has explicitly resolved the question of china 's representation . most countries in the world have established diplomatic relations with the prc on the basis of the " one china " principle . there is no question whatsoever of " dual recognition . "

by calling on the chinese government to give up such a right it will only encourage the internal and external forces harboring ulterior motives , thus making it impossible to reunify the motherland .
in fact , they are boosting the morale of " taiwan independence " or " independent taiwan " under this smokescreen . the crucial issue is to resist reunification and evade " one china . "

in a recent interview with our reporter , a responsible official of the relevant department of the fujian province stated that fujian welcomes taiwan mazu pilgrims ' direct voyage to the mazu temple in meizhou , and that it will do its best to offer them convenience .
this responsible official added that the 5,000 - year glorious culture of the chinese nation is an important tie linking compatriots on the two sides of the strait .
the two sides of the taiwan strait have their common ancestry and language .
there are nearly 1,000 mazu temples in taiwan , and the number of their believers has exceeded 10 million .
the mazu temple in meizhou has received nearly one million taiwan believers . many taiwan believers have regarded pilgrimage to the meizhou island as their lifelong wish .
in recent years , more than 100,000 taiwan believers come to mazu temple yearly to worship the god and seek their roots and ancestry .
since direct voyage between the two sides of the strait has not yet been realized , believers can only come by a roundabout route . they have to spend lots of time , energy and money during the trip .
this responsible official stressed that compatriots on the two sides of the strait are all chinese , and that they are blood brothers and sisters .
diplomatic relations between the two governments were just restored after discussions in april of this year .
informed sources in beijing describe two groups of those being smuggled into europe by air - - those who possess real passports , and those who have purchased false foreign passports . they certainly are not poor people and are even newly wealthy people who are of the mind to go abroad to make money .
it is said that those being smuggled from such heavily populated cities as beijing , dongbei , tianjin , and shanghai can smoothly reach europe if they pay 20,000 yuan in nake handling .
sources in beijing say that there often are some travelers who are returned on the same airplane and this all has to do with the illegal smuggling .
it is said that in april a joint smuggling scheme between the shanghai airport and port was uncovered , and five chinese businessmen holding fake passports for small african countries were detained and interrogated . their backgrounds involved an international human smuggling ring stretching across asia and africa and also included diplomatic officials of african nations .
on 22 may , following the two - person team of immigration experts from the canadian embassy in china , a five - person group of immigration experts from the usa arrived at the frontier inspection station of fuzhou airport , which belongs to fujian public security frontier defense headquarters .
according to statistics , the frontier inspection station has already tracked down 68 different kinds of smuggling crimes , and handled people suspected of being smuggled , and repatriated a total of 115 people .
smuggling is the " same old problem " of the coastal area of fujian .
according to official statistics , the number means that the effect of anti - smuggling is noticeable . but on the other hand , it shows that there is resurgence and a rising tendency of fujian smuggling activity .
the related departments of fujian have not been negligent at all . last year they held two all provincial workshops in a row on anti - smuggling to do research and organize work against smuggling activity , and to firmly strike and stop group smuggling activity .
therefore , it is not difficult to see fujian 's determination and resolution to hold back the smuggling " black tide " .
there are three situations in smuggling . presently , the smuggling activity of fujian has three situations . one is smuggling groups in a boat . the scale is growing .
last year , the frontier defense department tracked down four smuggling crimes in which more than 100 people were involved .
based on an examination and investigation of those more than 3,300 smuggled people who got repatriated last year , more than 2,300 of them were smuggled in groups , which is 70.4% of total .
so it shows that reducing the frequency of smuggling to cut down on ratio of risk , and expanding the scale of smuggling to keep high profits are the reasons that the main organizational form for " snake heads " is still to use boats and smuggle in big groups .
second is that smuggled people are still mainly from a few cities of fujian , and there is a tendency of a younger age and a phenomenon of political opportunism .
due to the influence of factors of geography and relatives , the smuggled people from fujian are still many and are not getting less . the smuggled people are mainly concentrated in changle , fuqing , lianjiang , and other coastal towns .
regarding the spot that smuggled people put out to sea , the coastal harbors like fuzhou , ningde , and putian are more used .
beside this , other than the economic consideration , snobbishness is one of the reasons that cause smuggling .
there was an overseas chinese who came back from the usa to the village where he lived . all the leaders of the village tried to please him and nodded and bowed . even his families were higher than other people .
therefore , he did not think twice about borrowing money and paying high interest to be smuggled .
smuggling is difficult . it is a hairbreadth escape . not too long ago , the writer of this article interviewed three young women who were smuggled into taiwan and were repatriated .
a taiwan " snake head , " whose family name is lin , told them that they could work and make a fortune in taiwan . he arranged matters for them and prepared to smuggle them in meizhou of guangdong province , but actually he sold them to taiwan to be somebody 's " brides . "
when they were ready to put out to sea in the fujian coastal area , the frontier defense arrested them .
we are ashamed to see our parents . . . "
the writer also interviewed smuggled people in the detention house that keeps smuggled people who were repatriated from the usa and mexico .
however , she found out that they took an old cargo ship , scores of people were squeezed in a cargo hold . they ate porridge and a little pickle .
the " snake head " beat everybody and even raped some girls .
she regrets what she did , and she felt ashamed to see her husband who she had just married .
another young guy was from changle and was a cook .
he mistakenly believed the canvassing of the " snake head . "
finally , they arrived in mexico and went on land , but the " snake head " hid people in many places in batches . they were transferred many times during that period , and finally got to the border of the usa .
he was hidden in a pile of papaya in a fruit truck . when the truck got to the border , the police stuck an electric prod into the truck . he screamed with pain and got arrested .
he tried to jump out of the car on the way to being repatriated and ended up ripping his foot tendon and police got him back . journalist saw that his feet were swollen like chinese bread . it is assumed that he will be crippled for the rest of his life .
people are hidden in the secret cabin of the " fu an hao " boat .
not too long ago , the former captain , shen lingeng , hurried to the eastern area of fujian from shanghai , and gave himself up to the police voluntarily .
he got 66,000 rmb and 80,000 yen .
where did this steamboat hide the smuggled people ?
police finally found the secret cabin in the " fu an hao " steamboat through a careful and detailed check .
the secret cabin was in a crevice between the cargo hold and the engine room . the entrance was in the first hold on the port of the main deck ( duty office of the engine room . )
when the boat was examined , the duty office of the engine room was full of stuff . the frontier defense soldiers moved away the stuff and found welding marks . that was the entrance of the secret cabin .
the smuggled people ate , drank , and defecated in this tiny , dark place , spending more than 10 days at sea on this smuggling trip .

jia chunwang said : the problem of narcotics seriously disrupts the development of the social productive forces .
it not only weakens the body of a drug addict or even causes him to lose the ability to work and become a " good - for - nothing , " but also has swallowed many drug addicts ' lives .
in recent years , china has expended massive human , material , and financial resources on saving and treating drug addicts , conducting anti - narcotics education , and intensifying narcotics - seizing law enforcement . as a result , the limited resources could hardly be used for promoting the development of the social productive forces .
it can be said that wherever narcotics spread , the social productive forces there would be seriously damaged .
the problem of narcotics causes serious pollution to the socialist spiritual civilization and hinders the healthy development of china 's advanced culture .
currently , there are already 681,000 registered drug addicts in the country .
the use of narcotics not only brings lifelong misfortune to the drug addict himself but also seriously harms his family , often breaking up the family and killing some of its members and thus unsettling the neighbors .
narcotics also cause the spread of various contagious diseases such as aids , venereal diseases , and hepatitis to seriously harm the physical and mental health of mankind .
according to statistics , more than 80 percent of drug addicts in the country are youngsters below the age of 35 .
at the same time , it strengthened work to implement mandatory rehabilitation of drug addicts and to provide social assistance and education for rehabilitated people after they left rehabilitation centers . in 1999 , the country sent more than 220,000 persons for mandatory rehabilitation and 120,000 persons for rehabilitation and reeducation through labor .
we have strengthened anti - narcotics cooperation with the un international drug control program as well as the surrounding countries and regions and relevant countries , effectively promoting the development of international anti - narcotics work .
under such grim circumstances , anti - narcotics work is still a long way from meeting general secretary jiang zemin 's requirement of " three represents " and our anti - narcotics work remains a long - term , arduous task .
they must build a sound leadership responsibility system for anti - narcotics work , define the goals and tasks , and have a strict system for investigating and affixing responsibility .
jia chunwang pointed out : public security organs , being the main force in the anti - narcotics struggle , must dare to take heavy responsibilities in the struggle .
they should intensify work to block up the source and cut off the flow of narcotics , increase investment in scientific and technical equipment , resolutely block the inflow of narcotics , and take strict precautions against the outflow of precursor chemicals used for making narcotics .
they should do a good job of the centralized rectification and improvement of key areas .
they should vigorously carry out the activities of " cracking major cases , cracking down on gangs , and arresting narcotics smugglers " to crack more cases and seize more narcotics .
they should comprehensively strengthen work to prohibit the use of narcotics and rehabilitate drug addicts and conscientiously see to it that every drug addict found is taken in for rehabilitation and every rehabilitated person who goes back to drug addiction is sent for reeducation through labor to strive to lower the rate of repetitious drug addiction .
the key to doing well in anti - narcotics work lies in raising the anti - narcotics consciousness of all the people .
therefore , we should continue paying close attention to and doing a good job of propaganda and education , particularly the proper education of youngsters , and the mobilization and organization of the masses as projects in anti - narcotics work that get at the root .
jia chunwang stressed : the problem of narcotics is a complicated social problem and anti - narcotics work is a system engineering project that involves the entire society .

to seek freedom and happiness and to oppose suppression and slavery , the masses have , over the past several thousand years , been carrying out waves after waves of struggles against oppression and slavery , thereby forcefully promoting historical progress .
only marxism discovered for the first time the law of development of human society , namely existence decides consciousness , material production decides spiritual production , economic foundation decides super structure , the relations between productive force and production and the contradictions between economic foundation and superstructure push social progress .
particularly marxism 's discovery of surplus value made it possible for a thorough understanding of the relations between labor and capital . marxism shows the law of the inevitable demise of capitalism and of the certain victory of socialism . marxism gives people a " bright sunshine shines " feeling .
marxism 's reflection and pursuit of social development and mankind 's ultimate fate indeed epitomize human civilization .

it is the embodiment of truth , justice , science , and of character .
we do not want to impose our belief and our world outlook on others , but we believe in the power of truth and justice and we believe that truth and justice will ultimately prevail over erroneous thinking and evil .
( 6 ) we believe in marxism .

marxist philosophy is dialectical materialism and historical materialism and is the world outlook for communists . marxism 's scientific prediction of achieving communism through socialism is the highest social ideal for communists .

conviction is subjected to the influence and coordination of belief , supports and belongs to belief , and enriches and develops belief .

at present , the drought situation is extremely grim in most areas north of the chang jiang river , which has affected china 's agricultural production .
meanwhile , the backward agricultural production mode of broad irrigation is still adopted in some localities , resulting in the low utilization rate of water resources , and giving rise to the extremely conspicuous phenomenon of the frightful waste of water .
as it is universally known , china is a country seriously short of water , its per capita possession of water resources is only one - fourth of the world 's per capita level , holding the 110 th place in the world .
owing to the fact that china 's ability to resist agricultural disasters is still weak , agricultural production has not yet completely extricated itself from the restrictions of nature , and water shortage and drought have become the principal factors that bedevil the steady development of agriculture .
in spite of all this , people 's awareness of water crisis is still very weak , and the phenomena of wasting water can be seen everywhere from cities to rural areas .
the drought this year once again reminds people that it is time that we must have a firm grasp of economizing on water .
however , opening water sources irrationally to fight against drought for a period of time will disrupt ecological environment , form a vicious cycle , and eventually lead to exhaustion of water .
data have also shown that the effective utilization rate of water used in agriculture throughout the country is only 30 to 40 percent at present , while in the developed countries , the utilization rate has reached 70 to 80 percent .
doing accounts from an economic point of view , we will find that reducing water consumption is much more worthwhile than transferring water to combat drought .
in the meantime , the production mode of broad irrigation has led to the substantial loss of pesticides and fertilizers , which not only causes pollution , but lowers the utilization rate of means of production .
water - saving irrigation can enhance the effectiveness of means of production , lower the costs of agricultural production , and reduce pollution in rivers . since it can achieve many things at one stroke , it deserves to be introduced energetically .
the dissemination of water - efficient agriculture is a systems engineering .
at present , the tasks of anti - drought work are arduous , and time is pressing .

pirating first of all encroaches on the fruits of the author 's mental labor and the investment returns of publishers and producers , and inhibits enthusiasm for knowledge innovation .
before the 1990 's , 20 or 30 operatives in nantong , jiangsu , formed themselves into the zhihao printed cloth market , but the market developed only slowly because of endless fighting and beatings over pattern designs .
after the nantong city copyright bureau intervened , it confiscated pirated printed cloth and also set up points for registering copyright for works ; these operatives were thus forced to invest and design themselves their own copyright patterns .
the number of operatives has now reached 2,000 , foreign companies have also invested in them , and they have become one of the three largest printed cloth markets in the country .
cao guangfu , deputy director of the jiangsu provincial copyright bureau , said with deep feeling : " it is copyright management that has cultivated a big market ! "
pirating also causes losses to consumers , which is what certain " accessories " to pirating had not expected .
pirated editions are always crudely made , and contain hundreds of mistakes , and thus spread erroneous knowledge and absurd information .
the biggest victims are youngsters seeking to learn .
parents who wanted their children to do well in life would certainly have been afraid after the event if they had known that the supplementary educational materials their children were using came from this " specialized printing village . "

at present , the issue of economic globalization has attracted lots of attention and discussions , because of its rapid and forceful arrival and its enormous impact .
faced with the rapid development of economic globalization , countries in the world are seeking countermeasures .
ma : could you talk about the development process of the economic globalization ?
the development of international trade evolves from simple commodity exchanges to international division of labor whose scale has not only constantly expanded but whose position and role have constantly enhanced in economic growth ; in many countries it even becomes the engine of economic growth .
cross - border capital flow , first as a means of international trade settlement , has evolved into an independent form of investment whose scale achieved a surprising growth .
therefore , integration refers to a mechanism of mutual link and dependence formed between various countries ' economies ( signifying the reduction and removal of various obstacles in trade and exchanges ) .
thus , economic globalization that is built upon economic internationalization and on the basis of the perspective of integrated development becomes a reality .
ma : what is the significance and impact of economic globalization ?
at the same time , in a global market system , economic operation 's style , practices , and rules will tend to be coordinated with each other .
we may say that many countries open up their economies so as to adapt themselves to and to take advantage of the opportunities brought by economic globalization .
therefore in practice , countries with a high degree of opening tend to realize quicker development .
ma : how to recognize the opportunities and challenges brought by economic globalization ?
for various countries ( companies ) , they can on the one hand gain more development space and optimize resource deployment in economic globalization ; on the other hand , economic globalization places them in an environment where the scope of competition is even bigger and competitors are even stronger .
therefore , people are worried that economic globalization will widen the gap between various countries ' economies and lead to even more serious polarity .
of course , world economic development is a multi - level , pluralistic , and diversified dynamic process and opportunities and competition in world economic development also exist and proceed under a complex structure formed by various components .
for most participants , it is possible for them to seek out their own opportunities , discover their advantages , and proceed to realize their relative interests .
under many circumstances , they can , through efforts , as well turn competitive disadvantages into certain advantages . the situation of those late comers who finally catch up is like that .
those who only ( or excessively ) stress risks without ( or almost fail to ) emphasizing opportunities are untenable .
at the davos world economic forum conference held in end 1997 , " globalization with a human face " was made a topic of discussion .
but as " competition is merciless " and depending on multi - nationals ' " mercy " to solve the issue of serious polarity is unreliable . it is still necessary to rely on reforming international economic system and enhancing global and regional cooperation to provide development opportunities for disadvantaged participants .
another risk of economic globalization is the impact and dangers caused by a large - scale flow of the key economic elements .
for instance , major trading partner countries ' sharp drop in the economic growth and their sudden tightening of foreign trade policies ( like protectionism , sanctions , and others ) contract market demand that in turn produce a great impact on relevant countries ' economic growth .
third is the impact of capital flow .
the global financial market network makes such cross - border and trans - regional flow of capital very easily .
such fluctuations not only impact on capital market but also on trade conditions as well as on the entire economy .
zhang : economic globalization sets many new demands on its participating countries .
of the demands , raising one 's own capabilities is of particular importance .
the result was an open breaching for speculators and helplessness before the impact .
such cooperation should be made on a global scale as well as within the region .
economic globalization also signifies that we have more and more common problems like environment , resources , and ecology that impact on our very survival .
the former practice is mainly to " send charcoal in snowy weather , " while the latter practice is mainly to " add flowers to the brocade . "
since 1979 , our country has , in fact , taken the road of " adding flowers to the brocade . "
in the past 20 years , the entire national economy has made a turn of a breakthrough nature , that is , it has moved from an economy of shortage to relatively surplus .
under such circumstances , it is necessary to change to the practice of " sending charcoal in the snowy weather " at an appropriate time in future , that is , to change the practice of further developing the developed areas to the practice of further developing the backward areas .
the central and western regions are rich in mineral resources , which can be used as important bargaining counters to attract foreign businessmen . a strategy of resources for funds can be implemented to speed up the industrialization of the central and western regions .
regarding projects for intensively processing mineral products , on which restriction on foreign investment is imposed , such restriction should be removed in the western region with the exception of an extremely few on which strict restriction must be imposed .
while relaxing restriction on service trades and on the exploitation of resources , it is necessary to formulate specific policies as soon as possible to encourage foreign businessmen to transform old state - owned enterprises in the western region .
foreign businessmen who make investment in the transformation of money - losing enterprises can be allowed to use technology as intangible assets to become shareholders while investing an amount of funds not less than the value of the intangible assets .
wen jiabao said : china 's western region covers more than half of the country 's total land area but in economic development , the west lags far behind other parts of the country due to historical and other reasons .
the large - scale development of the country 's western region will help the coordinated development of local economy and sustained development of china 's economy as a whole .
the focus of such development at present and for a period of time to come is on building the infrastructure , preserving the ecological environment , and promoting science and technology as well as education .
we will act according to laws governing the market and scientific laws and combine government support with the role of market mechanisms and reliance on our own efforts with the opening of china wider to the outside world .
on opening china wider to the outside world , wen jiabao said : china and the european union reached an agreement on china 's entry into the world trade organization [ wto ] not long ago .
this will bring about new opportunities to the development of sino - eu economic and trade relations .
wen jiabao said : mutual visits by chinese and british heads of state in recent years , president jiang zemin 's successful visit to britain in particular , have tremendously pushed ahead the exchanges and cooperation between the governments and peoples of the two countries .
the amount of trade between china and britain in 1999 was nearly $ 7.9 billion or a rise of nearly 20 percent from the previous year .
the amount of bilateral trade in the last four months of this year topped $ 2.8 billion , up 43 percent from the same period last year .
britain ranked first among eu member states in terms of investment in china .

beijing , 22 june (zxs) - - over 300 pyramid marketing agents were tricked into going to guizhou by fellow villagers who lied to them about recruitment by guiyang motor factory for pyramid marketing that would earn them a monthly wage of 1,200 yuan .

administrations of industry and commerce in jiangxi , hubei , hunan , and other provinces and cities investigated more than 50 cases of pyramid marketing and covert pyramid marketing , and dispersed more than 10,000 pyramid marketing agents .
local administrations of industry and commerce also successively investigated and handled pyramid marketing and covert pyramid marketing cases that involved considerably large sums of money and more pyramid marketing agents .
chen wansheng , a worker at the nanyang city foreign economic relations and trade department in henan province , carried out covert pyramid marketing in the guise of chain sales , and obtained illegal profits of over 1.6 million yuan renminbi using deceptive means . recently he was investigated and handled by nanyang city administration of industry and commerce .
anhui provincial administration of industry and commerce successively persuaded 3,000 pyramid marketing agents to return to their hometowns , coordinated with relevant departments to send away 1,295 pyramid marketing agents , and supervised relevant enterprises in clearing away and returning goods as well as in paying over 17.45 million yuan transportation fees .

the two sides agreed to strengthen cooperation in energy , transportation , telecommunications , science , technology , industry , banking , tourism , agriculture , mining , environmental protection and other fields , and encourage the relevant companies of the two countries to explore the possibilities of further cooperation in the field of petroleum and natural gas .
the chinese side welcomed the initiative of president khatami for dialogue among civilizations and the designation by the un of the year 2001 as the year of dialogue among civilizations .
the two sides agreed that china and iran , two great ancient civilizations in asia , should enhance exchanges and cooperation in cultural , educational and social areas to develop and substantiate the dialogue among civilizations . these will be effective steps towards enhanced international cooperation in this field .
the chinese side highly appreciated the consistent pursuance by the iranian government of the one - china policy . the iranian side reiterated that it would adhere to its position that there is only one china in the world and the government of the people 's republic of china is the sole legal government representing the entire chinese people .
both sides stand for world multipolarization . they stressed the necessity [ english version uses " need " ] to establish an equitable , just , fair and reasonable new international political and economic order that is free of hegemonism and power politics and is based on equality .
the two sides underscored the importance of establishing an international community for cooperation , participation and dialogue and against the use or threat of force and imposition of economic sanctions to settle disputes between countries .
the two sides support the important role played by the un in safeguarding world peace and security and in helping developing countries raise their development level . the two sides stressed the importance of adhering to the principles and purposes of the un charter .
and at the same time both sides took note of the legitimate rights of any country for peaceful uses of nuclear energy , chemical and biological technology in a transparent manner under the supervision of the relevant international organizations .
the two sides emphasized the importance of realizing a comprehensive , just and lasting peace in the middle east with the belief that a sustainable peace in the region can not be attained without recognition of the rights of the palestinian people , including the right of the palestinian refugees to return to their homeland .
the two sides stressed the necessity to implement all the un resolutions on iraq to the full and expressed their profound sympathy with the iraqi people over their sufferings . the two sides once again appealed to the international community to render the iraqi people necessary humanitarian help .
the two sides held that an earlier solution to the afghanistan issue was in the interest of regional security and stability and stressed the need to seek a political settlement through negotiation between the parties concerned and establish a broad - based government representing all factions and ethnic groups .
the two sides appreciated the role of the un and the organization of the islamic conference in this regard .
the two sides stressed the necessity [ english version uses " importance " ] of respect for human rights and for the history , culture and religions of each country in defending and developing human rights and fundamental freedoms .
the two sides considered the visit to china by h.e. president khatami as a major event in china - iran relations in that it would contribute to promote further development of the existing friendly relations and cooperation between the two countries in the new century .

the fujian provincial government has made proper preparations , and will , if necessary , send personnel to britain to help identify the dead and deal with the aftermath of the dover tragedy .
governments in fujian at various levels have always supported legal emigration and opposed illegal emigration .
they have been resolute and taken effective measures . in 1999 , fujian 's border guards cracked 132 cases of illegal emigration , involving 2,012 people and arrested 586 organizers for illegal emigration . they received 4,048 stowaways who were extradited in 38 batches by foreign countries .
recently , to attain excessive profits , foreign organizers for illegal emigration continually manipulated the masses ' eagerness to get rich , changed their tactics , and plotted and organized illegal emigration .
international organized criminal syndicates were solely responsible for the tragedy in britain 's dover which shocked the whole world .
commenting on reports by some mass media that the dead of the dover tragedy came from fujian , the responsible official said : the fujian provincial government is paying very close attention to the case .
the tragic deaths of illegal immigrants at dover have profoundly exposed the evil ways of the organizers of illegal immigration in pursuing huge profits heedless of people 's lives .
organized illegal immigration is a global transnational criminal activity , and the vast profits to be gained are about the same as those from drugs trafficking .
blinded by greed , the human snake gangs unscrupulously lure certain people to illegally immigrate to developed countries ; they shut them in ship containers or holds or sealed container trucks , with the result that some of the illegals die of hunger , thirst , or suffocation .
at the same time china has intensified law enforcement and strengthened border and sea seizures .
china has also stepped up education for its citizens in abiding by the law and has also exposed to the masses the various tricks of the human smuggling gangs and their evil behavior in acting in total disregard of human life .
the momentum of big increases in human smuggling in the coastal regions has now been curbed .
due , however , to the fact that the criminal activities of the " snakeheads " are actually a type of transnational crime , international cooperation is required .
as a result the human snakes become semi - legal residents from the moment they arrive and also receive living expenses .
the criminal gangs naturally take advantage of such lax laws and regard england as a target for large - scale illegal immigration .
certain countries provide so - called " political asylum " and refugee visas for citizens of other countries ; such a move is actually a lure and encouragement for illegal immigrants and provides the criminal gangs with an opportunity .
in china today , which is carrying out reforms and opening up , there is actually no such thing as " political persecution . "
the chinese government has demanded that britain seriously investigate this serious incident and pursue the crimes of the backstage manipulators .
the chinese government 's stance in opposing illegal human smuggling and illegal immigration has always been specific , and china has always adopted the attitude of active cooperation with the countries concerned in handling illegal immigration ; china will take back those verified to be chinese citizens who had left mainland china .
since last year the united states and canada have sent back to china a total of over 1,000 chinese illegal immigrants .
the relevant government departments have been very cautious in handling the incident , refusing to say anything for the time being ; people outside the government have been making all kinds of comments . especially , in fuqing city which was reportedly hit hard by this incident , many ordinary people are worried and sad in private .
on the morning of 20 june , two media establishments owned by fujian province reported that 58 east asian " human snakes " died of suffocation in a container truck in the process of illegally entering britain .
all the government agencies involved in the matter of stealing out of china and into other countries , such as the public security , frontier defense , and propaganda agencies , have refused to release any information .
if a household in such coastal counties ( cities ) and districts as fuqing of fuzhou , changle , lianjiang , pingtan , and mawei has had anyone who , having left in the recent two or three months , has not returned , such households have been asked to report such absences .
consequently , people turned to economically better europe ; especially , because such european countries as britain , the netherlands , and belgium were rather lax in controlling immigration , it was relatively easy to successfully steal into those countries .
the female fruit vender said that one of her relatives had stolen into britain and , subsequently , had stayed there for over three years , sending home a lot of money in remittances .
many borrowed money at very high interest rates in order to steal into a foreign country . if one can find a job after stealing into a foreign country , then such an amount of money can be paid back in two or three years .
in the recent 20 years or so , governments at all levels in fujian province have been intensifying their pursuit of the issue of combating the problem of stealing out of china and leaving china without authorization .
in the past , the human snakes who had attempted to steal out of china and into another country or been repatriated would , at most , receive some education or be fined .
now , not only the fines involved would be heavy , but there would also be such penalties as imprisonment , education through labor , or even prison terms .
at the same time , public security and frontier - defense cadres and officers specialized in fighting illegal and unauthorized departures are now operating under a responsibility system characterized by rewards and punishments .

today , responsible persons in concerned departments of the general political department of the people 's liberation army [ pla ] have accepted the interviews of reporters regarding issues of universal concern to the people , requesting the conscientious implementation of the spirit of the " decision " , creating a new - type military talent .
since the 14 th party congress , the military has continuously directly accepted higher level institute graduates into the corps , using this as the chief channel for importing and accepting talent from each locality .
however , in the present new situation of developing a socialist market economy , this work has encountered new contradictions and issues .
national defense oriented students are taken into the typical high level institution in accordance with their discipline planning , and with our open social recruitment of students , the typical middle student upon reaching graduation can freely report for examination .
the basic courses and specialized courses for students in the national defense discipline and for students entering academies in the same term are basically identical .
students in the national defense discipline can enjoy the national defense scholarships .
scholarships will also be offered to the portion of troops chosen from in - school that are immediately required for specialized and voluntary troop grass roots level command work or voluntary assignment to border or difficult regions .
this responsible person stressed that based on the high or low quality level of the military cadres selected from general high level universities , speaking in a definite sense , their level of quality impacts the entire level of military development and the success or failure of our undertaking .
guaranteeing the quality of selection and cultivation requires that we mainly do work on three links : first , making exact selections of cultivation prospects .
second , we must follow the standards of general high level education .
planning and arranging well the cultural knowledge study and military political training of the students , we must as quickly as possible realize the organic integration of the norms for military talent cultivation and of the norms for general high level education , raising the efficiency of talent cultivation .
military employment units must , based on the graduated student cadres ' specialties , fortes and troop requirements , rationally allocate their employment , carrying out regularized passing on of experience , and fully putting into play their role to create a fine atmosphere and conditions .
finally , this responsible person said that after establishing a military cadre cultivation system relying on general high level education , military academy training tasks will then incorporate the necessary adjustments .
in this way , it is beneficial to military base academies superior assistance in personnel cultivation , fully raising the overall quality of the military cadres corps .
can taiwan 's believers of mazu goddess sail directly to fujian 's meizhou to worship mazu ?
the mazu belief dates back to ancient times mazu is a goddess of the sea worshipped by residents along china 's southeast coastal areas . it has been called the " goddess of peace of the strait . "
according to the records of the " general genealogy of lin 's clan , " refugees from the north flocked to the coasts of putian and meizhou in the early period of the northern song dynasty .
lin mo did a lot of good things for the people in his lifetime and unfortunately died during a sea rescue .
at that time , emigrants from the mainland endlessly moved to taiwan .
there is a large number of mazu believers in taiwan .
about 100,000 taiwan compatriots make their pilgrimage to mazu 's birthplace in fujian 's meizhou dao annually .
the background on the proposal of " direct shipping for religious purposes " fujian 's meizhou dao is opposite the main taiwan island across the sea , and there is only some 100 kilometers of straight - line distance between the two localities .
however , taiwan 's mazu believers must make a detour via a third locality to make their pilgrimage to meizhou dao every year . it not only causes delays , but also huge wastes of money . thus , many mazu believers can only " make their pilgrimage from across the sea . "
to this end , the believers have on many occasions forwarded their requests to the authorities with the hope to travel directly to meizhou to make their pilgrimage .
there is a large number of mazu believers on the island , and they are always the key targets for all sides who fight for their support .
the candidate for the democratic progressive party [ dpp ] even visited the zhenlan temple twice and personally vowed that he would certainly support " direct shipping for religious purposes " after winning the election .
with the repeated promises of the new leader of the taiwan authorities and his government - elect , mazu believers became very excited and thought that there was hope to realize their long - cherished wish .
the taiwan authorities go back on their words just when the people were busily preparing for the pilgrimage , the taiwan authorities made a sharp turn in their attitude .
at a news conference on 6 june , annette lu publicly opposed " direct shipping for religious purposes " and stressed that " taiwan 's security should be above all else . " she further accused the believers of suppressing the government with the excuse of " god 's will . "
meanwhile , the new leader of the taiwan authorities and " premier " tang fei exchanged opinions on " small - scale three links " and " direct shipping for mazu pilgrimage , " and decided that they will not be implemented for the moment .
because of this , taiwan 's mazu believers have been very disappointed .
tsai chia - fu [ cai jiafu ] , chairman of the kmt 's internal affairs committee , said that they wanted the mainland to know their goodwill .
further , it has been done before . this is beyond criticism , and there is nothing wrong with it .
what is the intention of blocking direct shipping ?
another dpp 's " legislator " chang ching - fang [ zhang qingfang " was even more direct by saying that a direct pilgrimage by 6,000 to 7,000 would have a very large impact internationally and " would be unfavorable to taiwan 's arms purchase and its defense program . "

the management system for the work of relying on regular higher education to train military cadres a management system of responsibility at every level under the unified leadership of the state council and the central military commission will be applied to the work of relying on regular higher education to train military cadres .

tian fengshan said : our country has a large population and little land ; farmland is the lifeblood that has a bearing on national security and social stability and on the chinese nation 's subsistence , development , and rejuvenation .
in 1991 , we became the first country in the world to designate a " land day , " which is aimed at forming throughout society a good habit of treasuring land and preserving farmland .
the consciousness of treasuring farmland has somewhat been enhanced and the new concepts of land use control and intensive land utilization have begun to take shape among the broad masses of cadres and people .
land administration laws , regulations , and systems have been gradually perfected ; mechanisms for the macromanagement of land resources have begun to be set up ; and the functions of macroregulation and control have preliminarily showed .
the phenomena of illegal approval and utilization of land have been contained to a certain extent and there has lately been a marked decrease in the illegal utilization of land .
first , the consciousness of treasuring and rationally utilizing land and of conscientiously preserving farmland is still not firm and grass - roots cadres at some localities are unable to properly handle the relation between economic construction and farmland preservation .
fourth , the infringement of peasants ' land rights and interests is a frequent phenomenon in the process of farmland conversion and land requisition .
he stressed in particular : law has entrusted to the various provincial ( regional , municipal ) governments the duty of ensuring the total area of farmland in their own administrative areas does not decrease .
tian fengshan opined : to preserve farmland well , the key lies in strictly implementing the land use control system and strictly controlling the conversion of farmland for urban and rural construction .
he said : from now on , we should make further efforts to strictly examine whether the conversion of any agricultural land into construction land is in conformity with the overall land utilization planing and strictly examine the situation of implementing the plan for replenishing farmland and of paying out funds for replenishing farmland .
we should study how to improve the collective land property rights system in the countryside to protect peasants ' land rights and interests as well as their status as the mainstay so as to bring into full play the initiative of the broad masses of peasants in preserving farmland .
in urban and rural construction , we should fully tap the potential of existing construction land through measures such as transforming old towns , putting land stocks back into circulation , and putting " hollow villages " in order .
tian fengshan said : from now on , we should earnestly implement a system for preserving basic cropland .
we should strictly put into effect the rule that " prohibits damage to the arable layer of or construction of permanent works or buildings on any farmland undergoing a readjustment of the crop mix . "
in conclusion , tian fengshan told this reporter : to preserve farmland well , the land and natural resources departments will make further efforts to carry out administration in strict accordance with the law and strengthen supervision over law enforcement .

this way , our party will be able to continually display its progressiveness in the new century and act as a staunch leading core in building socialism with chinese characteristics .

making a quicker adjustment to dprk policy has been a very conspicuous phenomenon of us diplomatic measures lately .
on the 19 th , the united states partially lifted its 50 years - old economic sanctions against the dprk and removed the restrictions on business links , air links , and personnel exchange between the two countries .
on the same day , state secretary albright announced that the united states would no longer use the term " rogue state " but replace it with " state of concern . "
for a long time , the dprk had been included in the us blacklist of " rogue states . "
the united states did not say explicitly that the re - labeling move was a reaction to the summit meeting between the heads of the north and the south on the korean peninsula , but people can easily discern the subtle intrinsic connection between the two .
before that , for half a century , it had been pursuing a policy of full - scale containment against the dprk with blockades , embargoes , and sanctions , in a bid to finish the dprk off for good .
as proven by facts , this policy is a failure .
according to the us version , the dprk already has the capability to develop nuclear weapons and long - range missiles , thus threatening us national security and jeopardizing its diplomatic endeavor against the proliferation of nuclear weapons .
clinton accepted this view and began to pursue a " stick and carrot " policy toward the dprk .
last september , he made an announcement on partially lifting the embargo against the dprk , which could be considered the " carrot " in exchange for the dprk 's postponement of long - range missile development .
but this plan had never materialized .
nine months later , the united states decided to honor its promise . obviously the timing of which is not something that just coincided with the recent dprk - rok summit meeting .
from the perspective of washington , it is in the best us strategic interest in northeast asia if the north and the south on the korean peninsula are neither hostile nor friendly to each other and they neither go to war nor get reunified .
before the north - south summit meeting , what the united states was most concerned about was it would be dragged into any military clashes erupted on the korean peninsula .
in case clashes erupt at that strip of land , heavy casualties will be unavoidable and the fate of 37,000 rok - based us soldiers will be sealed .
in its view , reconciliation and reunification on the korean peninsula will jeopardize us strategic interests in asia .
what bears the brunt is the justification for the stationing of us troops in the rok .
moreover , with the acceleration of the north - south reunification process on the korean peninsula , this issue will be getting more and more heated .
during the summit meeting , the dprk reiterated its demand for the withdrawal of us troops from the korean peninsula . this has also been discussed by the us domestic media , and a call for troops withdrawal from the rok can be faintly heard .
the us government and military have said that they will not hastily withdraw the rok - based us troops and shut down the military bases , but the development of the situation is something independent of the united states ' will .
in fact , the united states has already sensed that its influence over the korean issue is declining .
it wants to have a greater say and increase its influence over the peninsula issue by improving us - dprk relations .
as far as dprk - us relations are concerned , this is , of course , not a good sign .
