beijing , 25 jun ( xinhua ) - - since spring , china has been suffering the most serious drought for 10 years .
some 200 million mu of land are affected by drought , 20 million people have problems in getting drinking water , and water supplies are short for over 400 cities .
although many experts have determined that china is a water - deficient country , and although people of foresight have warned us that a crisis will appear in water resource supply and demand , still more people hold that this is all a long way off from themselves .
a crisis in water resource supply and demand breaks out in a year of great drought : agriculture is short of water , industry is short of water , and there is even a frequent emergency in supplying water for people 's daily necessities .
over 200 million people in more than 20 provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities throughout the country are being affected by water shortage in varying degrees .
china has an average of 2,300 cubic meters of fresh water per head of population , only one - quarter of the world average .
glancing through the " deficit " water account books , we will understand that the great drought this year is only an advance warning of the water resources crisis , and still greater crises lie ahead .
there is the crisis of agricultural production being subject to heaven .
this is particularly conspicuous this year ; 100 million mu of crops are seriously affected , and there is no harvest at all on 15 million mu ; the summer grain harvest alone was reduced by over 10 billion kg .
at present china 's grain supply exceeds demand , as a result of good rainfall and successive bumper harvests .
unless this management setup is reformed in good time , it will cause a still faster deterioration of the water resource situation facing us , and the water crisis will break out still more intensely .
the artificially separated management of underground and surface water , of the upper and lower reaches of river basins , of water supply for urban and rural areas , and of water quantity and quality cause great confusion in water resource management and the protection of the water environment .
only thus can we ensure that china 's limited water resources can be used in an effective and rational way , and thus ease the contradictions in the water crisis .
water wastage in china each year is roughly equal to the water deficit .
if we could effectively economize in water , we could at least achieve balance in supply and demand from the existing water resources .
excessively low water charges result in the cost of input in water economy being too high , and so water economy is not worth the cost .
the peasants are unwilling to use the spray irrigation micro irrigation , and drip irrigation facilities built with state investment .
in order to economize in water , it is necessary to establish a mechanism for charging for the use of water resources ; water for agricultural use should be charged according to production costs , and water for the towns and industry should be charged according to the production costs and a reasonable profit .
at a time when the great drought has exposed a crisis , many people pin their hopes more on future water diversion and are unwilling to seek the causes from the deep - seated management setup , believing that all problems can be resolved by diverting water from south to north china .
such a fanciful notion is of no use whatever in resolving the problem .
given the existing setup , water diverted from the chang jiang would also be all used up and wasted .
the various crises exposed by the great drought require us to wake up .
china has passed a water - rich period , and the future water resource situation will become more grim .
as the population increases and the economy and society rapidly develop , the water resource shortage will pose a serious threat to china 's future sustainable development .

now economic growth and the development of enterprises in developed countries depend mainly on innovations in and the development of science and technology , science and technology industries are developing the fastest , the proportion of high - tech enterprises ' output value in such countries ' total industrial output value continues to increase .
in world trade , the quantities of products directly related to high - tech industries account for one - fourth of the total .
it can be said that the competition between the manufacturing industries of various countries in the future will be actually a kind of competition among high - tech industries .
it is therefore necessary to speed up the transformation of traditional industries with high technologies .
the total output of the manufacturing industry in our country is large , but it results from a huge number of enterprises of this industry .
these are also the main reason why it is difficult for enterprises in our country to readjust their product mix and to bring about technological upgrading .
therefore , accelerating the merger and reorganization of enterprises and turning the favorable scale of a whole industry into the favorable scale of its individual enterprises is an important way to increase enterprises ' comprehensive strength and level of technological development .
the government should make it convenient for the enterprises of these industries to reorganize themselves , to form unions , and to engage in high - risk investment and for high - tech industries to get involved ; at the same time , the government should also provide the necessary assistance .
meanwhile , as for products whose supply is saturated in the domestic market , such as color television sets and refrigerators , we should encourage highly competitive large and medium - sized enterprises turning out such products to set up factories abroad and to produce and market their products locally .
we should move our surplus capacity in the production of household electric appliances to countries whose development levels are lower than ours but which have great potential demand .
moving such equipment abroad will stimulate the export of china - made component parts . this may be called achieving several things at one stroke .
vigorously develop the service industry and make it a primary driving force for steadily promoting economic development viewing from the trend of international developments , the service industry will become the first and largest industry in the world and a driving force for steadily promoting the development of the world economy .
the appearance of this trend is not fortuitous but objectively inevitable .
for our country , developing the service industry can play a role in stimulating sustained economic growth ; moreover , because the service industry has such distinctive characteristics as diversification , individuality , and meeting changeable demand , it can better bring our country 's comparative advantages into full play and provide more job opportunities .
now the first thing the government should do is to untie investors , to fully introduce a competitive mechanism , and to allow the service industry to develop itself at full speed under the stimulation of competition .
open the domestic commodity market wider to the outside world , but the opening of the financial market needs to go slowly economies in the world are being closely integrated with each passing day , and the opening of various counties to the outside world has become an irresistible trend .
the experience of the development of the world economy shows that a country can improve its competitiveness faster , make better use of two kinds of resources and markets , and promote the sustained and healthy development of its economy only when it opens itself to the outside world .
concretely speaking , we should do the following things : a. we should further reduce nominal tariff rates , take a more positive attitude toward importation , import as much advanced technology and equipment as possible , maintain a more or less balance between imports and exports , and not put one - sided emphasis on a favorable balance .

under the condition that the world economy is getting closer and closer toward integration , a country should not only import foreign products and capital , but " go out of the country . "
" going out " includes the export of products as well as capital , with stress on the latter , which means making direct investment in foreign countries .
it needs to unequivocally define that the enterprise is the main body of " going out . "
some people think that it is the state - owned enterprise that should " go out " first . this view is incorrect .
the comparative competitive advantages are the only criteria for judging who is the main body of " going out , " so any enterprise having comparative competitive advantages may " go out . " third , will the risks of " going out " be guarded against by the administrative restraints or by the restraints of enterprises ' interests ?
hence , the principal measure for guarding against the risks of " going out " is the interest restraints of enterprises , which means that enterprises will consciously take the initiative in guarding against the risks under the restraints of their interests .
the enterprises ' interest restraints mainly stem from their structural superiority , that is , the modern enterprise system instituted in them . that is why the precautions against risks hinge on the enterprise structural reform and perfection .
fourth , is " going out " a pure market objective or a multiple objective ?
now when we talk about the necessity of " going out , " more often than not we stress that china needs to occupy international markets through " going out " owing to the surplus production capacity , which means taking the market occupation as an objective of " going out . "
in short , we should think over the issue of achieving multiple objectives by way of " going out . "
fifth , with regard to the property organizational form of the enterprises that are " going out , " should we adopt the form of sole proprietorship or the form of joint investment with foreign capital ?
judging from the actual conditions in the world at present , enterprises solely owned by a country usually have greater difficulty in " going out , " while enterprises jointly invested by different countries can usually " go out " more easily .
sixth , is " going out " a kind of political achievements or an enterprise 's conduct of its own choice ?
the government should not compel enterprises to " go out . "
the government 's role can only be a service provider rather than an authority for examination and approval .
while " going out , " of course we must adhere to the international practices and cannot apply the rules formulated by ourselves .
as it is impossible for enterprises to rely on government protection for " going out , " they can only rely on their own innovation , which covers the structural innovation , the management innovation , the technical innovation , and the cultural innovation .
only by innovation can the enterprises enhance their competitive power and become invincible in international competition .

owing to a favorable political and economic climate at that time , yoshiro mori decided to hold a general election ahead of schedule , hoping to gain the upper hand ; further expand the strength of the liberal democratic party in the diet ; and consolidate his own ruling position through the general election .
despite his repeated explanations and apologies , yoshiro mori has failed to cool anger within the political circles and on the part of public opinion .
on 30 may , the political parties not in office put forth a motion of no confidence in the house of councilors , demanding the immediate resignation of the mori cabinet , on the ground that yoshiro mori " lacks both qualifications and qualities to serve as the prime minister . "
since the electoral campaign started on 13 june , the government and the opposition have been locked in an intense publicity campaign aimed at winning votes .
not long before , the liberal democratic party had set 229 seats as its bottom line in the current general election while the three political parties , namely , the liberal democratic party , the new komeito , and the new conservative party , had set 254 seats as their goal for sustaining a stable majority .
if the two goals are reached , the three political parties , namely , the liberal democratic party , the new komeito , and the new conservative party , will be able to stay in power and yoshiro mori will be able to stay in office as the prime minister .
though voters are not satisfied with yoshiro mori and his cabinet , the economy , which has witnessed a recession for many years , has already begun taking a turn for the better , and this is perhaps an important weight which will determine the voters ' will .
the opinion polls conducted by various papers have also shown that the liberal democratic party is likely to win a majority of between 241 and 263 seats .
quite a few analysts have also stated that it seems that the voters will choose the ruling coalition and stability . this is because though having not yet brought about a robust economic growth in japan , the liberal democratic party has after all prevented a more serious economic crisis .

doing a good job of economic protection involves important measures to improve the survivability of economic targets during wartime and the overall defensive capabilities of the cities .
in its post - war industrial readjustment , the former soviet union made an effort to develop industries in the eastern region , particularly in siberia .
on the other hand , the united states has put a great emphasis on civil defense efforts , listing civil defense along with the " star wars " program and anti - missile systems as a " three - tier defensive system . "
the united states believes that dispersing urban industries and populations and limiting the size of the cities is an important means of reducing the damage from a nuclear strike , and has proposed that the future should be the " age of industrial defense and dispersion . "
for this reason , beginning in the reagan administration , they have implemented an urban dispersion program under the civil defense authorities which has cost $ 4.2 billion .
doing a good job of economic protection represents an important guarantee for achieving stable development of the national economy , guarding against natural disasters , and preventing major accidents .
at the same time , because of the large - scale , rapid development of cities , large populations and production / residential facilities have gathered in and around the cities . thus , as soon as they are hit by various natural disasters , the material damage and human casualties can be very serious .
with the development of science and technology , man 's efforts at predicting and preventing natural disasters and accidents can definitely be more timely and accurate , and the ability to respond to various sudden incidents can be faster and more decisive .
however , among certain accidents , there is an increasing threat to economic targets and humans from high - energy fissionable materials and extremely toxic chemical substances .
at the same time , they mobilized a large number of helicopters and technicians , arranging for the emergency shipment of materials and sealing off the leaking part in the reactor .
accordingly , to improve the overall defensive capabilities of cities and major economic targets , we must put economic prevention in an important strategic position .
this kind of change was realized in the overwhelming majority of countries one after another in the 1990 's .
the form of simple resistance - oriented protection has developed to the form of comprehensive compound protection .
in the 1970 's , to protect economic targets , various countries depended largely on reinforcement of facilities and applied a variety of measures for enhancing economic targets ' capacity of resisting the impact wave pressure .
along with the development of weapons , the simple resistance - oriented protection was proven consuming too much money and being not only uneconomical but also hard to get the desired results .
even greater importance has been attached to the overall efficiency .
on the other hand , should we define a key economic target in too narrow a sense , we would tend to limit our protection scope and suffer irretrievable losses in a war .
a so called key economic target should refer to the forces that support the state economy .
insofar as our existing human , financial , and material resources are concerned , it is unrealistic for us to conduct all - round protection .
rather , we should still take measures to arrange for production or protect other targets with clear - cut stress ; bring into play the individual subjective initiative ; and successfully fulfill the task of protecting all sorts of targets in accordance with the principle of combining peacetime needs with wartime needs and integrating military resources with civilian resources .
the targets for attack by the nato during the kosovo war were sorted in order of importance as strategic command systems , national air defense systems , communications facilities , economic bases in support of the war , and armed forces .
china should focus its main efforts on protecting key economic bases in military struggles that it will face in the future .
after the kosovo war , we have deeply studied theories and tactics on protection of key economic bases and achieved good results . however , merely pondering the protection of economic bases is not enough .
first , we should proceed from the high plane of the overall situation to work out a reasonable plan for the overall distribution of key economic bases .
the integration of peacetime needs and wartime needs in order to protect the economic targets , we should not rely on the pre - war or wartime emergency measures alone . instead , we should set great store by and step up our efforts to formulate , design , or implement our plans step by step in peacetime .
since the majority of the economic construction projects are mainly aimed at directly serving the peacetime economic construction , their operation or utilization functions have tended to contradict their wartime protection to a certain extent .
in appraising or demonstrating both investment results and costs on the part of the key economic construction projects , we must take into account their wartime protection efficiency and ensure the organic unity of their peacetime economic efficiency and their wartime protection efficiency .

industrial output is growing faster , with the operating quality of industrial enterprises markedly improved .
for the first five months of 2000 : industrial added value was 890.4 billion yuan , up 11 percent from the same time in 1999 .
that includes state - owned and state - owned , stock - control industrial enterprises having earned 69.2 billion yuan in profits , up 3.1 times from the same time in 1999 .
economic efficiency is markedly improved .
for the first four months , the overall index of economic efficiency for industrial enterprises was 101.8 , up 15 points from the same time in 1999 , for the highest level in recent years .
the consumer market is tending to be brisk in the midst of stability , with the consumer confidence index rising .
our gross consumer goods retail value for the first four months was up 11.5 percent from the same time in 1999 , for the highest growth value in the last 30 months .
and during the same period , the number of china 's newly approved foreign - invested enterprises [ fie ] and the value of the contracted use of foreign capital were both up more than 20 percent from the same time in 1999 .
the financial situation is stable , with foreign exchange reserves continuing to increase .
out balance of international payments is good .
china 's foreign exchange reserves have now climbed to $ 158 billion .
the " 2000 spring report " issued recently by the cass " china economic situation analysis and projection " taskforce notes : in 2000 , china 's deflationary trend will continue to be curbed , with economic operations continuing in a suitably fast growth state , and the 2000 gdp projected to be up 7.5 percent from 1999 .
the gdp growth target set by the chinese government at the beginning of 2000 was around 7 percent .
the analysis of economists is : the chinese economy is probably entering a period of stable adjustment .
while economic vitality has increased for the first five months of 2000 , the boom rebound remains preliminary , with faster economic growth projected to take some time .

the recent case in which the u.s. justice department accused microsoft of monopolizing the market attracted considerable attention in the business world in china .
these two incidents made the related departments in china once again aware that , as one of the major rules of the game in a market economy , there should be an " anti - monopoly law " in china as soon as possible .
it is reported that china 's " anti - monopoly law " has been under active study for some time .
in the past , china always had a planned economy and there was no competition among the enterprises , so there was no need to formulate an anti - monopoly law .
related legal experts point out that , because china is presently in the transition period from a planned economy to a market economy and because there is a certain process involved in recognizing the essential nature of a market economy , it is impossible to entirely eradicate state - ownership types of monopolistic behavior from economic life .
however , monopolies in china are unlike those in other countries , most of which involve industrial / trade monopolies , whereas in china they are administrative monopolies .
private economic monopolies may reap excessive profits , while administrative monopolies often lead to low efficiency in the organization and management of the enterprise and in its utilization of resources .
some experts in china believe that when individual departments popularized the self - regulation of industrial / trade prices as a kind of experience in 1998 , this actually constituted a kind of monopolistic behavior .
on 1 april of this year when the civil aviation administration of china (caac) implemented a uniform ticket price policy for jointly operated air routes , it was actually a kind of monopolistic behavior .
in the price wars among color televisions , dvds , and air conditioners that have stirred up trouble on the markets recently , care must also be taken to guard against suspiciously monopolistic dumping price cuts in which [ a company ] relies solely on abundant capital to overwhelm its opponents .
actually , as early as 1987 china had already begun to prepare to issue an anti - monopoly law and a law prohibiting competition by unfair means as one law , but in 1993 it was only the latter law that was promulgated .
there were two major reasons why the anti - monopoly law could not be promulgated : one was the widespread administrative monopoly behavior in china , which was manifested prominently in local protectionism and which kept the anti - monopoly law from emerging .
the other involved erroneous perceptions , primarily that there was no urgency in opposing monopolies because china was in the initial stage of developing a market economy and had not yet achieved economies of scale .
experts stress that china 's future anti - monopoly law will adopt the common methodology of the vast majority of nations , that is , only prohibiting actions which abuse one 's monopolistic position , not prohibiting the existence of a monopoly per se .
naturally , an anti - monopoly law is not a panacea .

collectivism - - basic principle in socialist ideology , morality [ subhead ] (viii) collectivism is a necessity in the development of human civilization .
for their survival , primitive people had to form tribal collectives to hunt food and resist natural disasters .
such collective organization and sense of primitive people can be regarded as the sprout of modern collective organizations and collectivism .
under the oppression of the exploiting classes and in the struggle against the exploiting classes , collectivism was tempered and enhanced to a higher level .
thus , although socialized production under the system of private ownership advanced work cooperation and coordination , it did not give rise to collectivism in real terms .
such diversification brings about a new subject for the development of the collective spirit .
the following story may give a good explanation .
in the early 18 th century , a scottish sailor brought a pound of gunpowder and a rifle onto a desolate and uninhabited island by himself after a conflict with the captain .
without a collective , a single person 's development is impossible , and that civilized person may just degenerate into a " barbarous person . "
the former national women 's volleyball team was a collective with a strong sense of collectivism , and it also enabled every team member to fully develop her individuality .
coach yuan weimin said : " each of the 12 team members should have her specific individuality , and only thus can the team play a good game .
if their individual characteristics were removed , the team would have no hope to win . "
the collective is soil that provides nutrition for individual development ; while the development of individuals represents the flowers and fruits on the soil .
it is substantively different from " feudal totalism " which strangles individuality and negates individual interests , and is also antagonistic to the extreme egoism advocated by capitalism .
the principle for handling the relationship of interests of the three sides , fundamentally speaking , is aimed at protecting and developing the entire people 's " individual interests . "
without guaranteeing state and collective interests , there is no guarantee for an individual 's long - term and fundamental interests . by insisting on making an individual 's interest subordinate to collective and state interests , one may fundamentally prevent one 's individual interests from being harmed in the long run .
(xi) an advantage of socialism is the ability to concentrate strength and resources to do something big .
all this demonstrated the strength of our system and our collectivism .
while facing pressure from rapidly developing science and technology in the developed countries , and facing the economic globalization trend , it is more necessary for us to carry forward the spirit of collectivism and struggle by relying on the superiority of the socialist system and relying on the strength of the collective .
scientific socialism developed from theory to practice , and from one nation 's practice to many nations ' successful practice .
when seeing the setbacks encountered by socialism in the world , some westerners predicted that socialism rose in the 20 th century but will perish within 21 st century .
in cpc - led china , which accounts for one - fifth of the world 's population , the banner of socialism is still fluttering , and the whole nation is full of vigor .
although we are facing many problems and difficulties and there exist certain errors in our work , the achievements we have made are acknowledged by the world . this is what the chinese people all really feel and is also admitted by most people in the world .
socialist china stands firmly in the east of the world .
if we deviate from socialism , we may lose our foundation and orientation . if socialism is shaken , the whole cause of reform , opening - up , and modernization will be shaken , and the future of the state and the nation will be ruined .
(xiv) the setbacks of socialism in the world never indicate that socialism has no superiority and never mean socialism 's failure .
capitalism has had a history of 300 to 400 years , and also traversed twists and turns in its development and experienced intense struggle between restoration and anti - restoration . even now , the feudalist tail remains in many capitalist countries .
the process of capitalism 's development is full of failures , crises , and setbacks .
like all other new things , socialism also has to experience a process of gradual development and improvement in practice .
as a brand - new social system , socialism may experience twists and turns in its development over a long period .
socialism is in keeping with the law that governs the historical development of human society , and its future is bright . socialism may encounter setbacks , but that is only a transient phenomenon .
(xv) in some people 's minds , capitalism means wealth and socialism means poverty . this is not in keeping with facts .
in more than 100 countries that adopted the capitalist system in the world , less than 20 are regarded as developed countries .
between 1981 and 1995 , in a period of only 15 years , we quadrupled our gnp .
(xvi) it should also be noted that we did not stand on the same starting point with capitalism in our development .
under the two different social systems , the means of development are also absolutely different .
the capitalists used inferior and low - cost commodities to knock open the closed door of backward nations , and turned weak and small nations into their vassals with gunboats .
however , we mainly rely on the superiority of the socialist system , rely on our own efforts and hard work for development .
the socialist system is better than the capitalism system in terms of fundamental political and economic systems , as public ownership is superior to private ownership .
however , in the initial stage of socialism , for various reasons , such superiority cannot be brought into full play .
china has only 7 percent of the world 's cultivated land , but feeds 22 percent of the world 's population .
this is never easy . in 1999 , china 's steel output was 786 times that in the early years of the prc , and grain output was 4.48 times . what did we rely on ?
we relied on the party 's leadership and the socialist system .
there are great differences in our country between the 38 years under the rule of the warlords and the kuomintang regime and the 50 years under the leadership of the communist party .
(xix) when describing socialism and communism they understood , marx and engels said : " for us , communism is not a condition that should be established and not an ideal that the reality should be changed to .
by communism , we mean a movement in reality that eliminates the current condition . "
socialism is not something completely flawless and pure . it is from the womb of old society , and is a new thing growing up in real society .
we cannot imagine that the ideal objective of socialism , the superiority of socialism , and the nature of socialism may be realized all of a sudden without a long , complicated , and tortuous course of gradual development in steps and stages .
we cannot imagine that the conception and system of socialism may be completely and thoroughly displayed in the initial or certain stage .
this is because socialism is not a subjective blueprint nor a " concept " to be maintained in people 's minds .
in contemporary china , the state 's strength , the nation 's regeneration , and the people 's happiness are all closed linked with socialism .
we may select four timeframes to outline the basic fact , and this may help us better understand the issue .
especially from the middle of the ming dynasty , the closed - door policy , the self - important and conservative mentality , and the trammel of tradition made the nation ignore the world 's general trend , stand against reforms , and miss good opportunities for development .
china moved from a condition of being humiliated to a condition of being rich and powerful .
fifty years since the founding of new china .
china won national independence and the people 's liberation . the chinese people stood up , and scored great achievements .
it is more undeniable that the chinese people of all ethnic groups really held their destiny in their own hands , earthshaking changes occurred in the country with long history , and a new look appeared on the vast land of china .

as of the end of may this year , china had approved a total of 349,500 foreign investment companies , with $ 623.3 billion in foreign capital agreements and $ 320.614 billion in foreign capital actually used .
furthermore , the approach of bringing in primarily mid - to long - term capital not only enables china to use foreign capital aggressively , but also to avoid the impact of short - term international capital - flow shocks and the infection of international financial crises .
because of this , maintaining a certain level of capital coming in will continue to be a priority for our foreign - capital utilization efforts in the days to come , and in addition we must also achieve a greater amount of opening up with regard to the areas and regions where foreign businesses invest .
at present , the cumulative direct foreign investment that china has brought in comes to more than $ 300 billion , and once we join the wto ( world trade organization ) this level will grow even faster .
in time , sooner or later these foreign investments will gradually come due , which will inevitably result in rather considerable foreign exchange demands , which will put a certain amount of pressure on our international balance of payments .
accordingly , to adapt to the changing circumstances and promote the long - term dynamic stability in our international balance of payments , as well as safeguarding national economic security and the interests of foreign investors , we must concentrate hard on the key issue of improving the quality of utilization of foreign capital .
experts believe that there are several issues worth paying attention to in our efforts to attract foreign capital in the days to come .
second , we should formulate scientific and rational policies to guide foreign commercial investment industries , enhancing foreign economic policy coordination , integrating the attraction of foreign capital with the readjustment of the industrial structure and with expanding exports and improving the level of technical development , and improving the nation 's overall competitiveness .
this is a fundamental approach to ensuring quality in the utilization of foreign capital , and is also a long - term plan for maintaining the international balance of payments .

many people , both on taiwan and abroad , felt as though they had been plunged into a deep fog upon hearing these words .
the words " human rights " are precious and spiritual in the human heart .
however , the moment someone puts human rights and diplomacy together , human rights seem to sink , becoming almost a tool of intention , plummeting an infinity downward from their original lofty position .
and now what people all over the world render unto human rights is not high respect , but rather fear . 1 " human rights diplomacy " is not a stranger to people in many developed nations , nor is it an alien concept to chinese .
the us uses " human rights diplomacy " methods under the moral banner of maintaining human rights , to be completely antagonistic to other nations ' sovereignty and human rights .
this allows rationalization of interference in the internal affairs of other countries when an adequate reason cannot be found in a world based on sovereignty .
when the united states determines that a " human rights crisis " has appeared within another nation 's territory , she does not hesitate to trample the sovereignty of other countries , and to use military force to interfere .
this might lead us to remember somalia , or perhaps kosovo .
us president clinton has proclaimed in the past that in the new world order , there is only one principle , and that is human rights above sovereignty .
the reason was very simple : the congressmen felt that this treaty was a threat to american sovereignty , and that the question of whether the us performed nuclear testing was completely up to the united states in its sovereignty .
it is evident from this that on the american scale , human rights come out far above the sovereignty of other nations , but that the common human rights of people all over the world are below american sovereignty .
today , when the world does not accept the western " human rights diplomacy " as correct , taiwan 's leaders want to run along behind in the dust of the united states , raising the banner of " human rights diplomacy . "
let us first try to understand the taiwanese version of " human rights diplomacy " on its face .
taiwan 's principal leaders have already announced to the world that the people of taiwan have reached a new high point in their guarantee of human rights .
is taiwan prepared to exercise " human rights diplomacy " with her " allied " nations ? it seems unlikely . not only is this a large and impractical undertaking for taiwan , but an operational point cannot be found .
and they are n't that brave , either . " human rights diplomacy " taiwan - style is different from the american variety . however , the two do share some deep ties .
the us has always had a long - term strategic goal : she has always sought to do her utmost to foment separatism within nations which are viewed as posing a possible threat to the leadership position of the united states . the final result is to cause the breakup of that nation .
this method will help the us to construct an age permanently without opponents .
since 1990 , there has been an average of more than three new nations created each year .
actually , taiwan has already gotten to the bottom of the united states ' " human rights diplomacy , " and understands particularly well the real purpose of the " human rights diplomacy " which the us is using on china .
and at the same time that the us is crippling china , taiwan can achieve her goal of " walking away " from china , becoming one of the 300 nations designed by the united states .
from this perspective , taiwan 's proposal of " human rights diplomacy " is really " walking away diplomacy . "
opposition to china and support for taiwanese separatism is hidden behind the placards supporting taiwanese human rights .
calling out " human rights " as their slogan , taiwan 's " human rights diplomats " feel that they are able to act even more recklessly , participating in multilateral organizations on international human rights , expanding taiwan 's space , and limiting chinese sovereignty .
right now , compared to former taiwanese leader lee teng - hui [ li denghui ] , taiwan 's leaders are feeling even more clearly that " taiwan independence " could lead to disastrous results .
they want to walk out , but they are not willing to pay the price for so doing .
the moment china is forced to use military force against increasingly - distant taiwan , the taiwanese will go at once to the " international human rights system " shouting for " humanitarian interference . "
if things play out in that fashion , the first step of " human rights diplomacy " can be seen . it really infers a bit of preparation for war .
this would mean an eternal split across the strait of taiwan .
beginning in the late 1980 s , chinese on both sides of the strait moved beyond the period of " irreconcilable blood feud . " at the olympic games , at the asian bank 's annual meeting , there finally appeared the spectacle of chinese from both sides in the same venue .
if the leaders on both sides of the strait regard these changes as a prelude to the reunification of the nationality , then afterward there will certainly appear even more right and harmonious occasions .
the regrettable thing is that then - taiwan leader lee teng - hui [ li denghui ] misunderstood that these changes created a predictable vista for development should taiwan step out on her own .
he began to make difficulties for chinese sovereignty on all sides .
no matter whether it was the " money diplomacy " or the " pragmatic diplomacy " of the lee tenghui [ li denghui ] era , or today 's " human rights diplomacy " taiwanese - style , all seek to break down chinese sovereignty .
taiwan 's " human rights diplomacy " seeks to break chinese sovereignty , and in today 's world , there are three camps in place .
in seeking to break down the third of these camps , taiwan 's " human rights diplomacy " can be said to face difficulties at every turn .
lee tenghui went too far , consequently creating a great resistance toward the " taiwan independence " tendency .
the resistance from the first camp has already been deeply felt in the designers of " human rights diplomacy . "
before and after chen shui - pian 's [ chen shuibian ] inaugural speech , taiwan 's opposition parties and the people of the island have brought out a demand for " respect for the constitution . "
the second camp , waving the flag of chinese sovereignty before the international community , are precisely the one that the designers of " human rights diplomacy " wish most to topple .
after many years of " diplomatic " efforts , taiwan 's rulers can be said to have all sorts of feelings welling up in their hearts .
taiwan 's leaders are often unwilling to think that us diplomacy might still have another important direction , which is pragmatic .
regardless of the fact that the us has this or that strategic concept , and is the only superpower in the world today , the united states also knows that she cannot do precisely as she wants on her own .
in east asia and other international areas , the united states still needs the cooperation of large nations such as china .
they are likewise unwilling to take a lesson in the spirit of pragmatism from the actual history of american diplomacy . 4 the people of taiwan have the right to have the rights that all chinese people should enjoy in international society , and no one should take them away .
this is an unfortunate consequence of history .
it is also a problem that the government of mainland china and the mainland chinese people want to solve through peaceful reunification .
it is sincerely hoped that not long in the future , chinese on both sides will be able to face the future and find a way to solve this key issue by joining hands to surpass the individual and plan the future of the chinese people with an open heart .
the problem taiwan must first solve is the position of taiwan in china . then and only then can the chinese on both sides of the strait discuss china 's position in the world .
we have never denied the value of human rights ; we merely hope that taiwan 's leaders will not let human rights become a tool of " taiwan independence . "
from another point of view , the designers of " human rights diplomacy " have given us inspiration .

in their minds , making another round of cold war type arms competition will be necessary and has profound significance .

in moscow , clinton did his best to ask russians to make some concessions .
therefore , the united states must deploy anti - ballistic missiles [ abm ] defense in alaska .
those are like words in the " arabian nights . "
at this exciting moment , the us " new york times " on 9 june carried a reporter 's headline article on the front page titled " the pentagon controls anti - ballistic missile experiment ; the missile defense program of the department of defense is in fact only a figure - head . "
it may be due to this reason , the us third nmd firing test was postponed from 27 april 2000 to 27 june and further postponed to 7 july .
since it is quite clear that such " missile against missile " defensive system is unworkable , why do us congressmen and government officials still energetically want to develop this costly " sky network " system and enthusiastically stage this " show " for us taxpayers and various countries in the world ?
however , people of insight are convinced that this is due to the wishes of arms dealers and politicians and the continuation of the cold war ideology .
in the minds of the american people , the united states possesses advanced military technologies and powerful economic strength and these can offset the soviet union 's superiority in weapons and number of military personnel .
the reagan administration held that the us defense plan should consider the soviet union as the main opponent and carry out arms competition with the soviet union for a long period so as to drag down the soviet union into collapse .
after the end of the cold war , the bush administration continued this " competition strategy " and attached importance to competition in high technologies and improvement of the quality of the us armed forces .
this strategic thinking is still being praised by the clinton administration today .
the united states ' current development of its theater missile defense [ tmd ] and nmd systems is precisely a concrete demonstration of its " competition strategy . "
nevertheless , history has told people that even a strong country like the united states cannot continue its marathon - type arms competition .
we hope it is not true , for otherwise it will be a miscalculation .
the reason is that china will not follow the road of arms expansion and preparations against war just because the united states wants to set up the tmd system in east asia and deploy the nmd system in alaska , much less being lured into " competing " with the united states .
this has proven that china has selected a correct road for development . china will not change its policy and follow the road of arms competition . third , china follows a positive defensive strategy [ ji ji fang yu zhan lue ] .
china will not be dragged down into collapse by even $ 6 trillion [ liu yi yi ] , not to mention $ 60 billion .

beginning 14 june , the us and philippine navies have started a joint military exercise which is expected to conclude on 27 june .
subsequently , the united states will also hold similar military exercises with brunei , indonesia , singapore , and thailand .
nevertheless , in recent years , a very attention - catching characteristic has occurred in the us military exercises : namely , it has held more frequently joint military exercises with its allied forces , bilateral or multilateral joint military exercises .
one joint military exercise rises after another [ subhead ] according to incomplete statistics , since the outbreak of the kosovo war last year , the us military and the troops of other countries have held more than 40 joint military exercises of relatively larger scales , on average as many as nearly three per month .
in addition , the us military also holds various regular or irregular small - scale joint military exercises with its allied forces .
that was a joint military exercise held in recent years involving the largest number of troops .
the " karat - - 99 " exercises conducted by the us troops and the forces of asean countries covered both antisubmarine defense , air defense , mine warfare , amphibious warfare , coastal underwater warfare , diving and rescuing operations and logistic and equipment protections . the whole exercise involved nearly 30 subjects .
thirdly , these exercises contained a lot of high - tech elements .
in order to make these high - tech weaponry systems more effectively display their roles in the future warfare , the us troops attached great importance to largely applying these high - tech weaponry systems in the usual joint - forces military exercises .
besides , in almost every joint - forces military exercise , the us troops made a stage pose of its most advanced tanks , airplanes , vessels , guns , missiles , and other high - tech weaponry and equipment from its arsenals to test their tactical technological functions .
fourthly , these exercise had clear aims in mind .
for example , the location chosen for the " star 99 " joint military exercise of the united states , egypt , and so on was in the alamein coast of northern egypt . its main combat operational targets were iraq and iran .
as this exercise was of a very clear directional nature , it caused concerns and oppositions from many peripheral countries around japan .
besides , the joint military exercises between the united states and south korea and between the united states and japan are mostly conducted under a battle environment in the korean peninsula , very naturally north korea was the imaginary enemy .
very obviously , under the new international environment , the united states vigorously conducting joint - forces military exercises in the whole world should very naturally harbor its ulterior motives .
the alliance strategy is an important component for the us defense policy as well as one of the major strategic elements of the us national security strategy . over the last few decades , the united states has already built a large - scale alliance system in the whole world .
secondly , to display its military strength and exert pressures on countries concerned .
the united states is always a country following the policy of military strength .
thirdly , to test the " new strategy " of nato and make preparations for its new interventionism .
the essence of this " new strategy " is the " globalization " of nato , namely turning nato into a " world police " to undertake the role of " world security and defense " and serve the implementation of the us hegemonism and power politics .
due to the requirement of this kind of " hegemonic strategy , " holding joint - forces military exercises outside its territory with allies has become an important pattern for the us when testing this " new strategy " of nato .
through holding this kind of regular bilateral or multilateral military exercises , the united states is attempting to further test the feasibility of this " new strategy " of nato , so as to lay a foundation for the implementation of its " new interventionism " within the whole world .
fifthly , to make a display of its weaponry and equipment to promote arms sales for the us arms dealers .
every time when conducting joint military exercise with troops of other countries , the united states would make a special display of a large batch of advanced weapons and equipment in front of its allies .
according to foreign reports , after the conclusion of every military exercise , the arms dealers can always get a large number of arms order forms .
no wonder some people say , it is the big us arms dealers who are the biggest winners of every joint - forces military exercise , after all .
it is an important reform of our army 's cadre training system , opening a new , important road to training new - type qualified military personnel for our army and further improving the existing military personnel training system with our army 's characteristics . it will certainly and greatly promote our army 's modernization .
as time goes on , the new system will show its profound significance even more strikingly .
on the future information - based battlefield , knowledge will become a dominant factor for combat effectiveness , and the trial of strength between ourselves and the enemy will more evidently be a trial of high - quality personnel .
this is a fact beyond any doubt as those contemporary wars that used a large amount of high - tech means have shown us .
the qualified personnel matter has become an important content of the readjustment of military development strategy in some major military powers today .
in view of the changes in the world politics and military structure , chairman jiang zemin of the central military commission has profoundly pondered a series of important questions concerning our army 's building and development .
to meet the new situation , chairman jiang has clearly pointed out that it is a very urgent historic task for us to strive to cultivate and bring up a large number of high - quality , new - type qualified military personnel .
chairman jiang has not only repeatedly emphasized the important role of qualified personnel in army 's modernization , and he has also built a farsighted , scientific structure for our army 's cadre training system .
he pointed out at an important meeting of the army in 1997 : " in cadre cultivation , the army should gradually shift to a road of relying on both itself and regular higher education simultaneously and select high - quality qualified personnel from a larger area . "
for this reason , the armies of all countries without any exception attach importance to improving the quality , particularly the scientific and cultural qualities , of their officers .
in the russian army , the indian army and the japanese self - defense force , the officers with college - level education account for 90 percent , 98 percent and 50 percent of the total respectively , and the officers with a post - graduate education also account for a large percentage .
however , our army also has a conspicuous problem in the work of strengthening the cadre ranks - - that is , there exists quite a big gap between the requirements of the cadres ' important responsibility and the level of their scientific and cultural qualities .
he said that our army 's cadre ranks must be developed in an allaround way and up - to - standard ideologically and politically and in terms of scientific and educational level , military occupational specialty , and physical and mental conditions , and they must have a good overall quality .
chairman jiang , considering the question of cultivating qualified military personnel with a broader view , proposes that military education be merged into the bigger system - - the national education .
at present , the higher education is developing rapidly in our country , and this provides a good opportunity and condition for the training of high - quality military cadres .
in view of such a situation , chairman jiang has pointed out to us a new way of training military cadres by both military schools and civilian schools at the same time .
relying on regular higher education to train military cadres is the only way to train new - type qualified military personnel .
he said : " in addition to recruiting new cadres from among the graduating students of local colleges and universities , the army from now on should take various measures to target the cadre recruitment at the new students of those colleges and universities and have them committed to joining the army as soon as they graduate . "
he also pointed out : " both the schooling of officers and the cultivation of personnel of general - purpose specialties may rely on the national education . "
chairman jiang fully approved of the plan , and said cheerfully that it was a good idea .

the reserve officers ' selection and training work offices were formally set up and began operation at the two schools .

now , " regulations ( for trial use ) for the work of the reserve officers ' selection and training work offices at regular colleges and universities " have been promulgated . relevant supporting rules and regulations , such as the procedures for the management and use of national defense scholarship , will also be promulgated successively later .
to make the road of " training by both military and civilian schools " a success requires cooperation and mutual support between the army and local authorities .
on this , chairman jiang has unequivocally instructed : " to do this work well requires joint military - civilian efforts , " and " the comrades of local governments and education departments at various levels and of colleges and universities should be concerned about and support the work of training qualified personnel for the army .

the leaders of some provinces and municipalities and the relevant departments , attaching great importance to the work of training military cadres at regular colleges and universities , have attended the ceremonies for signing the agreements between the army and civilian schools , and they vigorously support the military cadre training work .
the promulgation of the " decision " will bring a great vitality to our army 's building of its cadre ranks and further promote its modernization .
- - establishing the system of " training military cadres by both military and civilian schools " will bring about remarkable changes in the knowledge structure of our army 's cadre ranks .
however , a great deal of work remains to be done to solve this problem once and for all .
- - establishing the system of " training military cadres by both military and civilian schools " will further improve the system for cultivating new - type , qualified military personnel .
it is difficult for the pla 's schools to completely satisfy the army 's demand for qualified personnel due to such constraints as training capacity , educational standard , and new students ' quality .
- - establishing the system of " training military cadres by both military and civilian schools " will prompt the army leaders at all levels to further renew their concept on qualified personnel .
with the constant progress in our army 's modernization , the leaders of pla units at various levels have greatly changed their concept on education and qualified personnel .
questions and doubts like these have already become a historical echo of the early eighties ; while today , calling qualified personnel , longing for qualified personnel and putting qualified personnel in important positions have become a unique " military camp phenomenon . "

- - establishing the system of " training military cadres by both military and civilian schools " will help the army improve its quality and facilitate the process of strengthening itself with science and technology .
the history of our national defense construction and army modernization shows that a brilliant chapter of it has been written by the cadres who graduated from regular colleges and universities .
in a certain group army , there are only a small number of cadres who graduated from regular colleges and universities , but 45 percent of its achievements in science and technology and training reform were made by them .
the high - quality military personnel will bring about a qualitative leap in army building and generate a powerful motive force for strengthening the army with science and technology .
the ship of reform , a reform of relying on regular higher education to train military cadres , is sailing on the course charted by chairman jiang and advancing toward the tomorrow of the army 's modernization .
the state council and the central military commission have officially promulgated the " decision on building up the system of educating and cultivating military cadres with reliance on civilian colleges and universities . "
building up the system of educating and cultivating military cadres with reliance on civilian colleges and universities is a scientific decision that chairman jiang made with a strategic perspective on the world 's military changes and for accelerating the construction of our military 's ranks of high - quality cadres .

state council issues regs on enterprises ' financial , accounting reports : the first chapter general provisions article one to standardize enterprises ' financial accounting reports and to ensure the truthfulness and completeness of the financial accounting report , and in line with the " prc accounting law , " the regulations are stipulated .
article two enterprises ( including companies , the same below ) should comply with the regulations when making and providing financial accounting reports to the outside .
the financial accounting reports termed by the regulations refer to the documents reflecting the financial status of an enterprise on a certain date and the business performance and cash flow in certain accounting period .
persons in charge of the enterprises should be responsible for the truthfulness and completeness of the financial accounting reports of their enterprises .
article five certified accountants or accountant offices , when auditing enterprises ' financial accounting reports , should observe related laws , administrative regulations , and the regulations on practices of certified accountants , and be responsible for the auditing reports they produce .
article seven an annual and a semi - annual financial accounting report should include : 1 .
an accounting statement ; 2 .
annotations of accounting statement ; 3 .
a statement of the financial situation .
an accounting statement should include a statement of asset liability and a statement of profits , cash - flow report , and some other related appendixes .
article eight quarterly and monthly financial accounting reports usually refer to merely an accounting statement , and an accounting statement should at least include a statement of asset liability and a profit report .
quarterly and monthly reports should have annotations if they are required by the national unified accounting system .
on an asset liability statement , assets should be listed item by item in line with its liquidity , and include current assets , long - term investment , fixed assets , intangible assets , and other assets .
the assets of banks , insurance companies , and non - banking financial organizations , which are of a special nature , should be one by one indicated according to their natures . 2 .
on an asset liability statement , liabilities should be categorized in line with their liquidity , and include floating liability and long - term liability .
the rights and interests of owners refer to the economic returns of an enterprise enjoyed by owners , which are the balance after debts are deducted from the assets .
income does not include the money collected for the third party or customers .
on a profit report , expenditure should be categorized and listed in line with its nature . 3 .
profit refers to the business performance of an enterprise in a certain accounting period .
on a profit report , profits should be specified in different profit structures such as operating profit , total profit , and net profit .
article 11 cash - flow statement reflects the inflow and outflow of cash and money equivalent ( below called cash for short ) of an enterprise in a certain accounting period .
of this , the definition and listing of business activities , investment activities , and fund - raising activities should observe the following regulations : 1 . business activities refer to enterprises ' trade and transactions excluding investment and fund - raising activities .
investment activities refer to enterprises ' purchase and construction of long - term assets and the investment and other appointment activities , excluding the investment on money equivalent .
article 12 related appendixes should be supplementary statements reflecting the financial situation , business performance , and cash flow of enterprises . usually appendixes are mainly profit distribution statements , and some of the appendixes are made under the stipulation of the national unified accounting system .
the profit distribution statement is a report reflecting enterprises ' realized net profit and the distribution of profit not distributed in the previous year or the make - up for the loss .
on a profit distribution statement , profit distribution should be categorized and listed item by item .

article 21 prior to making financial accounting report , besides a complete clarification of assets and verification of debts , enterprises should also complete the following jobs : 1 .

problems , once found in the jobs stipulated above , should be handled in line with the stipulations of the national unified accounting system .

beijing , 28 jun ( xinhua ) - - the state council held a televised conference today , working out plans for comprehensively implementing the " prc accounting law. "
he said that standardizing accounting behavior according to law and giving full play to the functional role of accounting will be very important for standardizing the economic order , optimizing the distribution of resources , improving operation and management , and strengthening macroeconomic regulation and control .
li lanqing pointed out that the " accounting law , " as an important law for china 's socialist market economy and the highest law standardizing accounting behavior , will play a basic role in social economic activities .
we should adopt various means to extensively publicize the " accounting law , " foster a concept in society that accounting information must be true and intact , and offer reliable accounting information for social economic activities .
it is necessary to maintain the authority of the state accounting system and no department will be allowed to formulate and release financial and accounting policies without approval .
li lanqing stressed that all departments should closely cooperate with each other to comprehensively tackle the accounting order .
the banks at all levels should strengthen inspection over the opening and use of bank accounts , and ban the practices of opening multi - accounts in violation of the regulations . the securities supervisory organs should monitor the accounting information released by the listed companies .
an internal control system and restraint mechanism should be established and improved , and the basic management system should be improved to control and prevent malpractices and operation risks through the improved system and effective mechanism .
wang zhongyu , state councilor and concurrently secretary general of the state council , presided over today 's televised conference .
at the televised conference , finance minister xiang huaicheng proposed specific requirements for the implementation of the " accounting law. "
we should continue to extensively publicize the " accounting law " and create a fine social environment for doing well accounting work according to law , he said .
all units should be urged to establish accounts and inspect the reorganization according to law , and ensure the quality of accounting information released .
we should establish a unified state accounting system , further standardize the accounting behavior and the criterion for accounting information , and improve the quality of accounting information .
the laws should be strictly enforced to strengthen supervision and inspection over accounting .
those participating in the televised conference included officials responsible for the relevant departments of the central and state organs , people 's government of the provinces , autonomous regions , municipalities , and cities , and large state enterprises .
the prc accounting law was amended and adopted by the 12 th session of the 9 th national people 's congress standing committee . president jiang zemin signed the decree , which is to go into effect commencing 1 july .

with regard to income tax treatment on income gained or losses incurred through an enterprise 's equity investment transfer , the circular stipulates that : ( 1 ) the income or loss from an enterprise 's equity investment transfer refers to the balance from income minus cost generated by withdrawing , transferring , or settling the equity investment .
( 2 ) if the invested enterprise is operating at a loss , it shall settle its account and make up the difference in accordance with the regulations . the investing enterprise shall not adjust or lower its investment cost , nor shall it declare an investment loss .
( 3 ) the cost of these non - monetary assets accepted by the invested enterprise may be determined by evaluation and verification .
on principle , for the purpose of income tax treatment , the transfer of an enterprise 's assets as a whole shall be regarded as two economic operations of selling all these assets at fair prices and investing . income generated or losses incurred from the asset transfer shall be computed and determined in accordance with regulations .
exchange of assets as a whole between two enterprises located in different provinces ( autonomous regions and municipalities ) requires examination and verification by the state administration of taxation .
( 3 ) in cases where the transaction of exchanging enterprise assets as a whole is as described in clause ( 2 ) of this article , the cost of assets transferred from one side to the other side shall be determined according to the net book value of these assets in the original enterprise .

beijing 29 jun ( xinhua ) - - while many asian countries just began to see the light of economic recovery , china 's major economic indicators have climbed all the way since the beginning of this year , taking the lead in leaving behind the shadow of the asian financial crisis .
zhu rongji 's viewpoint was widely echoed by economists here .
experts have been of the view that china 's economy has entered the best period since the asian financial crisis . this indicates that china has finally cast aside the huge shadow that had disturbed china 's economic development for nearly three years .
during the first five months of this year , china 's exports , which were hit hardest by the financial crisis , increased by 36.8 percent from the same period of last year , reaching $ 92.3 billion , a new record since 1997 .
china 's robust exports growth , which had continued for 20 years , abruptly dropped from 20 percent in 1997 to 0.5 percent in 1998 .
utilization of foreign fund also dropped to the lowest level in nearly 20 years .
china 's exports , which were still struggling at the low ebb during the first half of that year , unexpectedly stopped declining and began to rebound during the second half of the year , resulting in 6.1 percent exports growth for the whole year .
during that period , sales noticeably increased and the continued price drop began to slow down .
authoritative people have held that , in addition to continuous rises in exports and retail sales of social commodities , another eye - catching bright spot in china 's economy this year is that industrial efficiency has improved and profits have doubled and redoubled .
according to the latest statistics , during the first five months of this year , the overall profit of the country 's industrial enterprises amounted to 125.4 billion yuan , up 1.3 times from the corresponding period of last year .
china 's recent economic development trend also has drawn attention from the international community .
currently , chinese consumers widely hold a favorable view on the prospects of china 's economic growth .
nevertheless , china has never overlooked the radical problems in its economic working .
chinese leaders have repeatedly pointed out that insufficient demand for essential goods , lagging in structural adjustment , and other " persistent economic ailments " are still obstructing china 's economy from developing in a sustained and healthy manner .
besides , it appears that new breakthroughs have been made in dprk - russia , dprk - us , and dprk - japan relations .
this major shift in the dprk 's foreign policy has attracted wide attention in the international community .
an article of britain 's financial times pointed out : the korean peninsula is one of the last battlefield of the cold war in the world . the dprk 's " diversification " of diplomatic relations , particularly the success of the north - south summit , is conducive to alleviating the tense situation on the korean peninsula .
three stages of the dprk 's diplomatic relations in the past decades , the dprk 's foreign policy has gone through the three stages of " one - sidedness , " " independence and isolation , " and " diversification . "
therefore , the dprk either terminated its relations or lowered the level of diplomatic relations with east european countries , and temporarily closed the embassies or recalled the ambassadors .
the drastic changes in the soviet union and east europe dealt double blows to the dprk 's international status and domestic economy .
however , beginning from 1995 , the dprk was hit by droughts and floods in successive years . under the pressure of severe famine , it began to break its usual practice and called on the international community to provide humanitarian aid .
launching new diplomatic offensive from 1994 to 1998 , the dprk 's foreign aid from the international community came mainly from china , the rok , the united states , and west europe .
china provided grain aid to the dprk every year .
the united states , however , provided grain and fuel aid to the dprk on the condition that " the dprk abandon its nuclear weapons development plan . "
apart from a million metric tonnes of grains and chemical fertilizers , it also provided food , farm chemicals , automobiles , farm cattle , and home electrical appliances .
meanwhile , russia has indicated that it will participate in negotiations on the korean peninsula issue . a recent report said that at kim chong - il 's invitation , russian president putin will pay a short visit to the dprk in the later part of july .
dprk - us relations is an important factor that affects the stability of the situation on the korean peninsula .
in the few years since the signing of dprk - us nuclear agreement in 1994 to 1998 , the us government has changed its policy on the dprk .
in september last year , the united states released a report on the new dprk policy . the theme is to adopt a policy that centered on aid for the dprk , to be supplemented by the application of pressure on the dprk . this is what the united states termed " dialogue first , containment later . "
as the dprk was under japan 's colonial rule in the past , and as japan has followed the united states and supported the rok for a long time , it has not been able to improve dprk - japanese relations for a long time .
at that time , the dprk and japan jointly arranged for a visit to the dprk by a japanese parliamentary delegation , and then japanese prime minister keizo obuchi also sent a confidential letter to kim chong - il through someone .
in early april this year , talks on the normalization of dprk - japanese diplomatic relations began .

recently , there are rumors in overseas markets that china will be allowing the free float of the yuan exchange rate .
chinese officials have denied the rumors , pointing out that there will not be a floating exchange rate in the near future .
after the financial crisis in 1997 , the chinese government promised to maintain its currency stability and not to devalue the yuan .
the industry believes that the widening of the exchange rate band could signal the appreciation of renminbi .
a dealer said that judging from recent developments , the market was expecting china to widen the yuan exchange rate band , and this widening could be seen as an important move toward the ultimate free convertibility of the yuan .
he noted that under the existing system , the central bank merely regulated the market through the difference between the buying and selling prices , which is quite a passive move .
the new policy implies that these enterprises will be able to hold more foreign exchange .
what is more , the forthcoming wto accession should provide the external drive for the authorities to adjust the almost fixed yuan exchange rate formation mechanism .
with the recovery of the domestic economy and the growth in consumer demand , coupled with the forthcoming wto accession , china should experience a strong boost in imports beginning in the second half of the year .
according to analyses made by chinese and foreign data research institutions , china 's import growth will exceed its export growth . the trade balance is expected to fall to us $ 27.4 billion this year and to us $ 25.1 billion next year .
moreover , the current account balance will be reduced , and capital account deficits may threaten the ability of the chinese economy to maintain a seven percent growth rate .
the downward float of the yuan exchange rate will increase the competitiveness of chinese products in domestic and overseas markets following china 's wto accession and make domestic financial institutions and physical assets more attractive to foreign investors .
in the view of some experts , although china has basically opened renminbi trading under the current account , free convertibility is still not freely convertible under the capital account .
china will not be in a position to promote the free float of the yuan exchange rate without opening the capital account .
faced with the challenge of growing capital flow following wto accession , china 's monetary authorities are expected to gradually relax their capital and foreign exchange controls . this is also the reason why the authorities should adopt a more flexible exchange rate system as quickly as possible .

and , kim chong - il unexpectedly appeared at the sun'an airport in pyongyang . when kim tae - chung hurriedly walked down the airplane 's ramp and prepared to shake hands with kim chong - il , he was already standing there and waiting for kim tae - chung with two hands out - stretched .
