beijing , 2 july ( xinhua ) - - comrade jiang zemin 's important thesis of " three represents " is a succinct generalization and scientific summation of the party 's historical experience in revolution , construction , and reform in the last nearly 80 years .
historical materialism maintains : economics is the basis and politics is the concentrated expression of economics . as ideology , culture is the active reflection of social being and can have a great role and impact on economics and politics .
advanced culture is the rational distillation of social practice and the ideological crystallization of accumulated progress of human civilization .
one may well say that comrade jiang zemin 's thinking of " three represents " is both the inheritance and development of the theory on party building of marxism - leninism - mao zedong thought and deng xiaoping theory and the adherence and development of the spirit of the party 's 15 th national congress .
adequately understanding the importance and urgency of cultural construction in line with the requirements of its 15 th national congress and from the height of the prosperity of the socialist cause and national rejuvenation is an important prerequisite for the entire party to better represent the advance orientation of china 's advanced culture .
the culture contains two basic component parts - - socialist ideas and ethics as well as modern science and culture , with each complementing and promoting the other and each being indispensable to the other .
modern science and culture constitute the foundation for knowledge about the entire modern production and civilization and they are intellectual conditions for mankind to more effectively conquer and utilize natural forces and promote social modernization and comprehensive progress .
modern science and technology constitute a " primary productive force " and moreover , the scientific spirit and methods generated therefrom can help mankind eradicate ignorance and backwardness and overcome superstition and falsehood .
to represent the advance orientation of china 's advanced culture , most importantly we must always uphold the guiding status of marxism - leninism - mao zedong thought and deng xiaoping theory .
deng xiaoping theory is the inheritance and development of mao zedong thought and marxism of china today .
only the marxism that suits the realities in china can become the spiritual pillar of the chinese people and the common ideal of socialism with chinese characteristics .
in the course of reform and development , china 's economic sectors , bodies of interest , social organizations , and life styles are getting increasingly diversified .
to better represent the advance orientation of china 's advanced culture , we must further implement the party 's guidelines and principles concerning cultural work , continuously study new developments , and resolve new problems .
born at a time when the fate of the nation was hanging in the balance , the cpc is a party formed by advanced elements of the working class and has all along regarded the " maintenance of its advanced nature " as the foundation for the building of the party .
through the various historical periods of revolution , construction , and reform in china , the cpc , being the core of leadership , has always led the times and relied on the people 's strength to bring about national independence and liberation and make brilliant achievements in socialist modernization .
today , with mankind about to enter the new century , profound changes in the international and domestic situation are confronting the cpc with unprecedented challenges and trials .

beijing , 2 jul ( xinhua ) - - in his important exposition on the " three represents , " general secretary jiang zemin made a new generalization of the party 's character , gave a penetrating summation of its historical experience , and identified the key to carrying forward its cause pioneered by our predecessors .
over the course of struggle of nearly 80 years , our party has traversed two major historical stages .
on the strength of the advance nature of its guiding ideology and program , our party attracted and pooled together a large number of advanced elements who were deeply dedicated and willing to sacrifice for the sake of the chinese people 's emancipation and well - being .
the party 's history shows that the key to practice lies in integrating marxism with china 's reality and grasping the law of socialist development .
not only is it necessary to understand the universal and general laws , it is also necessary to have a profound and sober understanding of the special laws governing china 's revolution and socialist development .
this requires us to have an insight into the general international situation and a profound understanding of china 's conditions . it requires us to put forward a correct political line and formulate feasible principles and policies based on a clearly defined historical mission .
if we understand only the general laws and not special laws or if we do not know how to apply these laws , we still cannot avoid suffering setbacks or even ending up badly beaten . during the early period after the party 's founding , the party 's program was advanced .
at that time , the party , however , did not have a profound understanding of china 's national conditions and of the laws governing the development of china 's revolution . as a result , the cause of revolution did not develop smoothly .
this situation began to change only after the zunyi meeting , which established mao zedong 's leadership position .
party building is another key to achieving the goal of the " three represents . "
the party 's historical experience also shows that undertaking organizational construction , like formulating the political line , must also be consistent with china 's national conditions .
to achieve the " three represents , " our party must always stand at the forefront of the times .
whether our party dares to meet the challenges and seize the opportunities , especially in the historical turning points , is a great test .
had our party dared not meet the challenge and drastically adjust its policies in light of the changing circumstances in these critical moments , the chinese revolution could not have succeeded , china 's socialist construction could not have won the bountiful results , and the pace of the revitalization of the chinese nation would have postponed .
with the deepening of our reform and opening up and with the establishment of a socialist market economic structure , our country 's construction and our society 's development also face a host of new problems that need to be resolved .
opportunities coexist with challenges , and both are testing our party 's ability to serve as a ruling party and our party 's governing standards .
beijing , 2 july ( xinhua ) - - during the first half of this year , the three engines - - investment , consumption , and exports - - for driving up china 's economy kept pace with one another , showing an extraordinary vitality .
according to an authoritative person 's prediction , it is expected that china 's economic growth rate in the first half of the year would reach 8 percent or so and it is likely that the situation in which economic growth rate has been declining continuously during recent years will be reversed during the year .
this indicated that china 's economy has broken through the haze of the asian financial crisis and started to warm up in an all - round manner .
early this year , the timely input of an additional 100 billion yuan worth of state treasury bonds added vitality to the running economic train .
of this , investment for renovation and transformation rose by nearly 20 percentage points over the same period last year ; investments in fixed assets in the central and western regions increased by two digits which were noticeably higher than that of the eastern region .
this indicated that china has reinforced efforts in the adjustment of industrial and regional structures .
it is expected that the consumption level of the people will be gradually raised this year thanks to the fairly stable family incomes and the good economic development prospects .
in addition , individual purchase of houses also brightened the hot spot of consumption of real estate .
in may , the total retail sales of consumer goods in society increased by 11.5 percent over the same period last year , and the growth rate was the highest of all months during this year .
it is predicted that the total retail sales of consumer goods in china in the first half of this year would increase by more than 10 percentage points .
exports which once saw a serious downslide in the same period last year showed gratifying signs of improvement this year .
what is noticeable is that the high value added machinery and electronic products have hitched up foreign trade with a strong pulling force .
according to statistics , in these five months , exports of machinery and electronic products in guangdong province alone exceeded $ 18 billion , an increase of 37.3 percent over the same period last year .
since the beginning of this year , the comprehensive index of economic efficiency of china 's industrial enterprises has reached the highest point in recent years ; profits earned by enterprises have increased by 100 percent ; and the rate of deficit reduction of money - losing enterprises increased noticeably .
in the previous five months , profits made by industrial enterprises reached 125.4 billion yuan after their deficits were deducted from the profits , an increase of 130 percent over the same period last year .
experts pointed out that china 's economic upward trend in the first half of the year was closely related to the series of macroeconomic regulation and control policies adopted by the country .
since the second half of last year , the central authorities have adopted a series of policies to expand domestic demand and promote exports .
these policies included increasing the issuance of state treasury bonds , raising wages , extending the duration of holidays , improving the consumption environment , and promoting consumer credit .
the authoritative person said that in the second half of this year , china will continue to implement a proactive monetary policy , further expand domestic demand , accelerate structural readjustment , and improve the investment environment .

many major discoveries and inventions in ancient times made ineradicable contributions to human civilization and progress .

since the founding of the people 's republic of china , chinese scientists and engineers have exhibited their wisdom and talents and creatively resolved many major scientific and technological problems , swiftly narrowing the gap with advanced world levels in some important fields and effectively bringing forward china 's economic and social development .
not only can china successfully provide adequate food and clothing for its 1.2 billion people with no fear of deficiency , but its people 's lives and social civilization are also improving .
china is in a crucial period of development , facing a number of such major tasks as optimizing its economic structure , rationally utilizing its resources , preserving its ecological environment , promoting regional coordination , improving the quality of its population , and thoroughly eliminating impoverishment .
thus china has urgent demands to meet for its scientific and technological progress .
as early as the end of the 1980 s , mr. deng xiaoping already put forward the famous theory that " science and technology are the primary productive forces . " this has become an important guideline for china 's development .
china will devote its efforts to building a state innovation system and will , through cultivating a good environment , bring about knowledge innovations , technological innovations , and structural innovations , to enhance the entire society 's innovation awareness and the state 's innovation capability .
the chinese government supports scientists in conducting basic research on combining the state 's needs and forward science ; respects scientists ' unique sensitivity and creativity ; and encourages them to engage in " curiosity - motivated research . "
in the 50 years to come or even longer , china 's development will rely , to a large extent , on the innovative achievements of today 's basic research and high - tech research as well as on outstanding human resources nurtured by such research .

chinese scientists should also contribute to some major scientific fields under international cooperation .
china 's participation is indispensable in controlling global weather changes and desertification and in protecting the variety of living things .
i am convinced , positive scientific and technological exchanges and cooperation among countries of different social systems , economic modes , cultural traditions , and development levels are beneficial to the relevant parties and the entire world 's development .

how to maintain , reinforce , and improve the party 's leadership is an important theoretical and practical issue .
clearly defining functions and responsibilities , rationalizing mutual relations local party committees are responsible to the central leading body and shoulder the responsibility for comprehensively leading local political , economic , cultural , and social development .
this mainly refers to the necessity of clearly defining the functions and responsibilities of the three party leading groups in the municipal people 's congress standing committee , the municipal government , and the cppcc municipal committee .
to properly play a role as the core of leadership among all organizations at the same level , the municipal party committee should improve and properly handle relations between all quarters concerned for the purpose of controlling the across - the - board situation and coordinating all quarters concerned .
second , the municipal party committee should focus on general orientation and guideline principles ; the municipal government should mainly grasp the concrete programs and methods for fulfilling concrete tasks .
as there are various duties performed by various organizations , their working mechanisms also vary .
- - forming a work pattern .
through a period of practice and exploration , we have gradually formed a pattern of the municipal party committee 's leadership work , which can be summed up as " one body , " " three party leading groups , " and " several departments . "
in such a work pattern , collective leadership is integrated with division of work among individuals . all individuals strive to fulfill their duties well , join hands to advance the common work , and form a joint force inside the collective .
- - regularizing functional division of work .
first is strengthening the functions of the plenum .
the third category is " decision . " after the standing committee discusses affairs related to the overall situation , decisions are made according to the principle of the minority obeying the majority .
third is clearly defining the position of the secretary meeting .
the secretary meeting of the municipal party committee is mainly held to exchange information , discuss major affairs , analyze the situation , study guiding principles , and prepare and raise issues for discussion in the standing committee .
this is an important step in the forming of consensus among the leading members , and will help improve the work efficiency of the standing committee .
- - intensifying investigations and studies .
when making long - term work arrangements , we also have organized comprehensive investigations and research . such comprehensive investigations and research were normally made twice every year .

in history , taiwan has been successively invaded and occupied by japan , u.s. , britain , france , netherlands , and spain on 16 occasions , and was twice degraded to a colony of another country .
the times of foreign invasion into taiwan , the duration of foreign occupation of taiwan , and the fierceness of taiwan people 's resistance are unmatchable in the chinese history .

during world war ii , the japanese government forced over 200,000 taiwan youths to serve the army and die for nothing at all .
facts have proven that whenever taiwan is away from the motherland , it loses its independence in decision making .
from the perspective of the international politics today , taiwan is merely a " pawn " on the strategic chessboard of the u.s. ; how the u.s. moves the " pawn " completely depends on its needs .

only by realizing reunification will there be security guarantee for taiwan , peace and tranquility between people on both sides of the taiwan strait , and the hope for taiwan to share the honor and self - esteem of china as a world power .
taiwan authorities are burdened with mammoth military expenditure in the past two decades or so , taiwan authorities spent approximately us $ 10 billion [ as published ] in defense affairs every year , and weapon procurement alone costs us $ 43 billion [ as published ] .
when he was still in power , lee teng - hui did his utmost to increase spending on defense affairs with a view to enhancing taiwan 's clout in " resisting reunification and seeking independence . "
as a result , taiwan 's expenditure in defense affairs has grown rapidly . according to a report published by stockholm institute of international peace , taiwan imported weapons worth a total of us $ 13.311 billion from 1994 to 1999 , ranking first in the world .
to this piece of information , taiwan 's media analyzed : every 1 million residents in taiwan pay as much as us $ 540 million in military spending , which is the highest mark in asia . in financially wealthier japan , every 1 million japanese only share us $ 370 million in military spending . "
taiwan is again seeking to increase its defense budget this year to as much as 15.8 percent of the total budget , from which nt $ 90.5 billion will be mainly used on purchasing weaponry from abroad .
it is reported that in the coming decade , taiwan will spend us $ 27.64 billion to purchase 106 kinds of weapons and equipment , and us $ 12.5 billion to establish a so - called guided missile defense system , and so on .
excessive military expenditure and weapon procurement will certainly severely influence taiwan 's economic development despite its sound economic foundation , taiwan 's excessive military spending will certainly affect its economic development .
take 1998 for example , taiwan 's spending on defense affairs amounted to nt $ 2.5749 trillion , whereas the spending for economic development was nt $ 2.4432 trillion , far lower than the military spending .
despite these serious problems , taiwan 's military authorities are still drawing up a long list of weapon procurement . if the money for weapon procurement could be saved , many economic problems of this island could be solved .
taiwan 's economy is largely dependent on foreign trade and is prone to foreign influence taiwan is a typical island - type economy , which has been focusing its export on american and european markets and enjoying high trade surpluses against u.s. and europe .
in 1998 and 1999 , taiwan 's exports to u.s. reached us $ 64.8 billion , more than one fourth of taiwan 's total exports .
taiwan is subject to japan in obtaining technical skills , as two thirds of its imported technical skills are from japan , particularly in information industry .
this excessive dependence on foreign countries is surely a hidden trouble to taiwan 's economy .
taiwan seems to have maintained close relationship with u.s. and japan , but once the benefits for these countries disappear , this close relationship will no longer exist . even when u.s. and japan have secured their interests in other areas , they are still upset to see taiwan gain more profits in economy .
moreover , mainland china 's reform and opening up to the outside world will also offer a great opportunity for taiwan to upgrade its industry .
as of the end of 1999 , the accumulated total volume of cross - strait imports and exports exceeded the mark of us $ 160 billion , including us $ 110 billion of taiwan 's trade surplus against mainland china , or over 90 percent of taiwan 's total trade surplus .
no country would tolerate such a big trade deficit against another country .
only by making mainland china its hinterland will taiwan be able to make further development .
taiwan 's economy is directly affected by cross - strait relationship , which sometimes fluctuates economic prosperity and social development cannot be achieved without a safe and stable environment .
secondly , it aggravated taiwan 's losses in foreign trade .
moreover , many taiwan residents are indulged in stock investment .
" money diplomacy " will not expand taiwan 's " room of survival " in order to separate taiwan from the motherland , the taiwan authorities have been trying to " expand its room of survival in international community " and promoting " money diplomacy " in recent years .
natural factors lead to taiwan 's deficiency of self - defense taiwan has a main island and numerous surrounding islets .
it requires 400,000 troops to guard some 80 islets . with scattering targets of defense and arduous and overlapped defense missions , once a major battle operation is staged , taiwan will surely face the situation of attending to one thing and losing sight of another or having too many problems to tackle all at once .
strategically , such topography has limited leeway and is unfavorable for battle involving large corps . what is more , taiwan 's military posts are too close to each other , and are prone to various forms of attacks from all directions .
taiwan depends on sea and air transportation for imported and exported cargoes , of which 99 percent are shipped via sea . the handling capacity of taiwan 's three major ports - - kaohsiung , keelung , and taichung - - accounts for about 95 percent of its total port capacity .
taiwan has limited strategic reserves and scarce resources ; its annual output of major resources useful in time of war is not high .
if a blockade or sabotage were imposed on taiwan , taiwan 's shortage of resources would become even worse , making it difficult to maintain a sustained war operation .
even u.s. pacific fleet commander blair admitted : taiwan 's security cannot be built on the quality and quantity of weapons it purchased , but basically lies in the change of cross - strait relationship .
reunification brings benefits to both sides , while splittism does them harm .
as long as the reunification of the motherland remains unfulfilled , taiwan will have no security .
a unified and strong motherland will always be a reliable guarantee for taiwan 's security , but there is a timetable for reunification .

an informed source in seoul revealed to the washington post that the united states had secretly agreed to the request of south korea earlier this year to " extend its existing missile range " to strike pyongyang direct .
this should have elated south korea . but since the situation surrounding the peninsula has changed dramatically and the two heads of state of the two koreas have met with each other and signed a joint statement , what should south korea do now ?
it has no choice but spit back the " greasy meat " from its mouth and put the " missile expansion plan " on the back burner .
a knowledgeable south korean speaks the truth : " because of the summit meeting , we have shelved our own missile plan . if we go ahead with it , it will spoil the excellent situation opened up by the summit meeting . "
according to a ten - year - agreement signed between the united states and south korea in 1979 that was renewed in 1990 , south korean missiles were intended for striking north korean military targets near border areas and should not reach pyongyang ; hence south korean missiles ' range was limited to within 112 miles .
in the mid 1990 s , south korea kept on lobbying the united states , saying it needed missiles whose range could reach pyongyang and most parts of north korea to cope with north korea 's threat . the united states finally agreed to south korea 's demand and extended its missile range to 186 miles .
lately , north korea has made a series of " sorties " and improved its relations with the outside world by launching aggressive diplomatic offensive . this indeed is a move worth congratulating .
now , north korea has pledged to halt its missile plan and reached a consensus with south korea . the peninsula 's final reunification will be realized through a peaceful way .
now , the united states should have nothing which to object .

as a new opportunity presents itself on the peninsula , all peace - loving countries should treasure it .
there should be no more room for the nmd and tmd and their likes .

it consists of more than 130 enterprises and institutions , including five large research institutes , such as the china research institute of carrier rocket technology and the china research institute of space technology , two large scientific research and production bases , and several directly subordinate research institutes and plants .

wang liheng pointed out : china has ranked as one of the major space industry countries in the world , but its aerospace technology is still lagging behind the world 's advanced level .
major manifestations of this is the rather few carrier rockets it has launched and the lack of mass production capacity for applied satellites . we are vigorously making efforts to narrow the gap .
wang liheng said : china 's accession to the wto poses both an opportunity and a challenge to its aerospace science and technology .
the wto accession will provide a relaxed environment for china to expand exports of aerospace technology and use foreign capital and will create favorable conditions for it to strengthen international exchanges and cooperation .
in some satellite technology , however , china is still falling rather far behind the international level and will probably suffer from some impact of foreign satellites .

beijing , 3 jul ( xinhua ) - - after the serious explosion accident at the jiangmen firework factory , jiang zemin issued an important instruction .
on 1 july , the leading comrades of the state council held a meeting attended by responsible comrades of relevant departments as well as guangdong province and jiangmen city to discuss and arrange the work of dealing with the aftermath of the accident , and guaranteeing industrial safety .
the participants to the meeting seriously studied general secretary jiang 's important instructions on industrial safety since the beginning of this year .
the meeting pointed out that the party central leadership and the state council always attaches great importance to industrial safety , and has organized the formulation of various relevant laws and regulations .
the reason why accidents continued to happen even though the central authorities issued instructions and orders again and again was that some local governments , departments , and units ignored these instructions , loosened management , failed to take action to meet the requirements , or even neglected their duties .
the relationship between safety and production , between safety and business , between safety and development must be properly handled . leading bodies at all levels must take industrial safety as one of their main tasks , and really take action to guarantee industrial safety .
it is necessary to spare no effort to rescue wounded people , try by all possible means to reduce casualties and losses , adopt effective measures to properly handle the aftermath of the accident , thus guaranteeing social stability and public order .
in the course of the investigation , it is not only necessary to find out the immediate cause of the accident , but also pay attention to problems in management .
on the basis of finding out the cause of the accident and assigning responsibilities to the right people , those who should bear responsibilities for the accident and the relevant responsible persons must be severely punished according to the laws , and should be exposed in the media .
the meeting decided that intensive actions should also be taken to handle the ship capsize in sichuan on 22 june , the aircraft crash in hubei on 22 june , and the explosion at shujiang firework factory in chongqing according to the same principles .
in particular , it is necessary to seriously inspect and find out the loopholes in the industrial safety management of explosive materials , thoroughly eliminate all hidden perils .
in the course of local governments ' institutional reforms and enterprises ' restructuring and reorganization , industrial safety management can only be strengthened , and must not be weakened .
it is necessary to further improve the safety management system by clearly defining responsibilities and raising the work efficiency . the functional departments in charge of industrial safety management must fulfill their duties by close cooperation and strictly enforcing the laws and regulations .

after giving full credit to the squadron 's party branch for its performance in conducting the " three stresses " education by positive examples , fu quanyou expressed his ardent hopes and said : the key to strengthening grass - roots construction lies in strengthening our fighting bastions .
the quality of our leading bodies and cadres determine the kind of military units and soldiers we will have .
firepower warfare is the leading force , main theme , and soul of all kinds of modern war .
of course , one side of the situation reflects the strong sense of creating new thinking by military theorists . to a certain extent , the situation promoted the exploration and development of military theory on information warfare .
therefore , this article clearly calls for focusing our attention on firepower warfare in winning a local war under high - tech conditions of high technologies in the future .
since the beginning of using hot weapons in war until now , firepower warfare has become the most basic means to achieve the objective in a war .
war is the continuation of political struggle among countries , regions , classes , nationalities , and groups .
in order to realize the political goal of a war , the pure military goal is to " destroy the enemy and preserve oneself " just as mao zedong said .
therefore , the opposing sides of a war will not only destroy as many enemies of the other side as possible but also do their best to preserve their own people .
during the long age of cold steel , due to the low level of productive forces , the basic method and means for war can be summarized as " hand - to - hand fighting plus running . "
therefore , since the advent of hot weapons in war several hundred years ago , governments and militaries of countries of different social systems quickly and unanimously favored firepower . firepower has gradually become the basic means to win in a war .
from the rifle to artillery , from artillery to the guided missile , from the short - range missile to the long range missile , the icbm , and cruise missiles , and from fighters to strategic bombers , the firing range or distance of delivery has become farther and farther .
the main combat units of all service arms are equipped with firepower weapons . from soldiers armed with rifles and hand - carried missiles to heads of states who control the button for nuclear war , almost all personnel of the armed forces in a real sense are armed with firepower weapons .
various combat platforms , reconnaissance and communications equipment , and electronic confrontation and logistical support centered on firepower warfare are constantly developing and improving .
combat based on firepower has more and more become the most basic means to achieve the objectives in wars of different scales . it has become the core means in the complicated and dazzling acts of war .
however , in the early phase of this period , after using long - range firepower to sufficiently destroy the enemy , the battle must mainly rely on surprise attacks by infantry and tanks to win a final victory .
the emergence of nuclear weapons has pushed the theory and practice of firepower warfare to the extreme , and has also pushed mankind to the brink of extinction .
fighting with highly accurate , effective , and rapid reaction firepower is to put a country to a harsh test and is also a demand on a country 's war preparations and building of armaments .
the rapid reaction of firepower is frightening , and various targets on the battleground " can be destroyed whenever they are discovered . "
various countries in the world have generally attached great importance to firepower of brand new qualities and levels . firepower has become and will continue to be the hot point in a new round of arms competition .
facing the trend of rapid development and the challenge of this kind of brand new firepower , governments and the militaries of various countries cannot relax to the slightest degree and are all making active preparations to adjust to the changing situation .
first of all , the principles , types , patterns , and methods of fighting have undergone profound and great changes , and the change is continuing .
the command , coordination , and logistical support of firepower warfare are also undergoing major changes .
owing to the change of combat strategy and the market situation , military enterprises are instinctively prone to develop and produce long - range and highly accurate and effective firepower and related equipment .
the orders for weapons will continuously shift from conventional weapons to long - range , highly accurate and effective weapons .
the military 's theoretical combat study of theory and testing , and training , all must develop by following the trend of fighting with long - range , accurate , and highly effective firepower with rapid reaction capability .
accordingly , we must clearly focus our attention on firepower warfare in winning a local war under modern conditions , especially under high - tech conditions .
from the state 's preparations for war to the building of the armed forces , we must all focus our attention on winning a war with firepower .
although firepower warfare is the basic means in modern wars , it is never isolated . it will need the guarantee and support of mobility , capability in information warfare , engineering work , logistics , equipment , and technology .
since the development of firepower , various kinds of guns , artillery , missiles , and bombs have quickly been attached to various delivery systems and become a family of powerful and new weapons .
ships equipped with firepower have become warships .
airplanes equipped with firepower have become fighters and bombers .
those new weapons of firepower can become more powerful and give full play to their fighting capability when they are installed on advanced mobile platforms .
let us suppose those airplanes , military vessels , and tanks are not equipped with firepower ; they can at best be just means of transportation .
through careful study , we can see that all theories for winning a war have not exceeded the scope of firepower warfare . at a minimum , they cannot cast away the spirit of firepower warfare .
today , there is no reason to criticize those people who use military theories to point out certain deficiencies in the building of our army and put forward good opinions on making up for those deficiencies .
however , if they inappropriately exaggerate the role of certain weapons platforms and promise to win a war with a single service arm , it will be a laughable thing and very harmful .
any viewpoint and method of relying on a single service arm will obstruct our study on how to solve the problem of integrating and coordinating firepower in a joint operation and waste valuable time in army building .
the correct practice should be studying in an all - round way to employ the firepower of various arms of services in a joint operation and fully raise the firepower capability of various arms of services .
information has no doubt been an important factor in winning wars since ancient times .
spies , secret agents , beacon towers , and information trees used in ancient times were methods and means for determining the enemy situation and communications in the field of information .
however , information technologies and information warfare all emerged to meet the needs of firepower warfare .
they develop according to the development of firepower warfare , and so they are fundamentally to serve firepower warfare and are subordinate to the needs of firepower warfare . the often - mentioned us army digital units are developed on the basis of digital field artillery .
therefore , whether studying new war theories or making preparations for military struggle , it is imperative to center on firepower warfare and take the coordinated use of information warfare and all kinds of logistical support into consideration .

over the past several years , china and italy have gradually expanded political exchanges .

most of these ships try to evade customs monitoring and stealthily ship goods abroad , bringing serious loss to the state in terms of tax revenue .
on the banks of the noted beilun river along the sino - vietnamese border , the reporters saw the customs ' anti - smuggling vessels waiting for orders .
director liu of the dongxing customs pointed out at the baosuyan waters , telling the reporters that this is the only way for smuggling boats to sneak into china , which is known as the " marine throat . "
on the night of 28 may , the waves were beating in the darkness and the climate was deteriorating .
the smugglers took the risk and attempted to pass through the only channel .
however , they never expected that the customs ' anti - smuggling boat no. 609 was waiting for them in the face of the stormy waves .
the smuggling boats were captured immediately when they appeared .
the move made the smugglers panic - stricken , and manifested the might of the customs in plugging the sources of smuggling .
following the anti - smuggling personnel , the reporters came to lulinkou in the middle section of the beilun river .
there are lots of peasants ' homes along the river that have become the dens of the smugglers .
in order to set up a defense network , nanning customs organized several mobile detachments to implement the " onshore plugging " and " land inspection " tactics , carrying out 24 - hour patrol along the river that gave no way out to the smugglers .
thanks to a series of actions taken to smash the dens , the smugglers had no place to hide on the land and their smuggling channels were thoroughly crushed .
engaged in a fierce battle with the smugglers , customs officers are continuing their victorious pursuit to severely crack down on the smuggling activities .
beijing , 5 jul ( xinhua ) - - i. fully understand the importance of urban and rural planning urban and rural planning and development constitute an important component of socialist modernization .
urban and rural planning is a strategic task with a strong bearing on the overall and general situation . it touches on many different spheres , including politics , economy , culture and social life .
chinese cities have witnessed rapid growth since the beginning of reform and opening up . small cities and towns have mushroomed and the rural areas have undergone tremendous changes .
however , many problems still exist in urban and rural development .
the following are some of the main problems : first , expansion is taking place blindly without taking the objective laws of urban construction and development into consideration .
some cities have been selling land on a large scale , with the result that there is a serious shortage of land resources , a massive overstock of real estate property , and chaos in the urban layout .
second , construction in violation of law continues unabated in spite of repeated prohibitions . the interurbia is worst affected by illegal construction .
third , the hyperintensive development of old urban areas has resulted in the deterioration of the environment .
in the old urban areas of many cities , particularly the downtown areas of some large cities , there is an over - density of buildings and population . urban greenbelts are seriously encroached upon and the quality of the living environment is on the decline .
fourth , the management of transportation planning and construction is lagging behind .
owing to the rapid growth of motor vehicles , there is an acute shortage of roads and a general lack of parking spaces . this , coupled with poor management , has resulted in traffic congestion in most big cities .
fifth , urban development and regional development are not well - coordinated , and there is a serious overlapping of infrastructure facilities .
seventh , the historical and cultural appearance and natural scenery are badly devastated in some areas .
eighth , the new buildings in many cities lack of a holistic awareness .
there are many reasons for the above problems .
objectively speaking , china 's urban and rural areas have gone through a period of development unmatched in history since the 1980 s . the scale and speed of construction are both unprecedented . problems in urban and rural planning and development are inevitable in a period of institutional changes .
third , the legal system for urban and rural planning is unsound and the plans drawn up are lacking in authority .
this important thesis shows that the gradual drop in the percentage of the agricultural population and the relative increase in the percentage of the urban population is an objective law of china 's modernization .
in order to make a success of this task , we must respect the governing law of things , respect history , respect science , respect practice and respect the experts .
specifically , we must have a good grasp of the following 10 tasks in urban and rural planning .
( 1 ) take all factors into consideration in drawing a comprehensive layout .
in the formulation of urban and rural development plans , we must take into account the national economic and social development plan as well as the natural environment , resources , historical and present conditions and future development of various localities in drawing a comprehensive layout .
urban and rural plans must scientifically fix the layout of urban and rural construction and the scale of development on the basis of the overall economic and social development plan in order to achieve the rational distribution of resources .
( 2 ) make rational and economical use of land and water resources .
china has a huge population but a relative shortage of resources , and land resources are particularly in short supply .
second , we should make full use of land that is lying idle .
those plots that should returned to farming should be returned to farming , and those that should be turned green should be turned green .
third , land - use applications for construction projects should be examined and approved in accordance with statutory procedures .
sixth , importance should be assigned to the development and utilization of urban underground space .
at present , the focus of attention should be put on the downtown areas of big cities . the development and utilization of urban underground space should be incorporated into town planning to achieve unified planning and comprehensive development .
the shortage of water resources has in fact become an important inhibiting factor in its economic construction and urban development .
it is necessary to give priority to the assurance of domestic water supply to residents while making overall plans for water for industrial , agricultural and other uses and assigning special importance to the protection of the source of drinking water .
in cities with a shortage of water resources , the development of water - consuming industries should be restricted .
fourth , the construction of sewage treatment facilities should be accelerated to improve the capacity for sewage treatment while assigning importance to the recycling of sewage resources .
fifth , the protection of underground water resources should be strengthened .
in places where underground water resources have been over - exploited , further exploitation should be kept under strict control .
with their high concentration of non - agricultural industries , people and motor vehicles , pollution is a prominent problem in cities .
a basic task of urban planning is to protect and improve the environment . first , it is necessary to gradually reduce the building and population density in the downtown areas of big cities and transform the old city areas .
second , the distribution of cities must be conducive to the development of the ecological environment .
site selection for urban construction projects should be carried out strictly in accordance with plans .
projects that cause serious pollution in cities should be closed down , suspended or relocated .
third , the distribution and scale of urban greenbelts should be rationally determined , and increased efforts should be made to build public green space , residential green space , greenbelts in production areas as well as scenic forests to form a greening system that links spots and lines to cover the whole area .
urban greenbelts must not be encroached upon .
fourth , the sewage and garbage handling capacity of cities should be enhanced .
fifth , great importance should be assigned to the planning and construction of facilities for the prevention of fire , explosion , floods , earthquake and other disasters and for fire fighting in order to be better able to resist various disasters .
( 4 ) properly handle the relations between urban construction and regional development .
conscientious efforts should be made to grasp the work of drawing up province - wide urban development plans and to strengthen the guiding role of province - wide urban planning in the urban and rural construction and development of the whole province ( autonomous region ) .
at present , there is a lack of unified planning and effective coordination in the exploitation and utilization of resources in inter - provincial administrative regions as well as in the distribution of infrastructure , and problems are becoming more and more prominent .
for example , places like the changjiang delta and the beijing - tianjin - tangku area should make positive efforts to carry out regional planning in order to accumulate experience .
( 5 ) promote the adjustment of the industrial structure and improve the functions of cities .
greater efforts should be made to improve the urban infrastructure and urban environment and enhance the comprehensive functions of cities in order to create a better working and living environment for the masses .
the land - use distribution should be rationally adjusted and the land - use structure should be optimized in order to achieve the goal of making rational distribution of resources and improving the urban environment .
urban planning should put forward clear - cut planning requirements for the relocation , transformation and adjustment of existing industrial enterprises in cities , especially in downtown areas . layout plans and land - use arrangements should be properly made for the development of tertiary and hi - tech industries .
planning and construction of transportation and telecommunications projects should be strengthened in line with the rapid development of the hi - tech and information industries and the changes they have brought to people 's livelihood .
planning for residential areas should be strengthened and the construction of comfortable and affordable housing should be stepped up .
residential areas should be rationally distributed and care should be taken to ensure that they have well - coordinated facilities , complete functions , convenient amenities and a beautiful environment .
in the planning and construction of residential areas , it is necessary to take into consideration the trend of the aging population and fully demonstrate our concern for old people .
a good job should be done in the planning and construction of scientific and technological , educational , cultural , health , sports and other social service facilities .
( 6 ) correctly guide the development of small towns and villages .
accelerating the development of small towns is a major strategy adopted by the party central committee . it is also the objective requirement of social and economic development .
the large gap between town and country and the large agricultural population are important factors that have long inhibited china 's coordinated economic and social development .
governments at all levels must fully understand the importance of the development of small towns and bring the development of small towns into line with the national economic and social development plan .
in the development of small towns , it is necessary to uphold the principles of unified planning , rational distribution , suiting measures to local conditions , carrying out comprehensive development and providing the necessary facilities , and carry out development and construction on the precondition of unified planning .
( 7 ) effectively protect historical and cultural legacies .
china is an ancient civilization with a long history and a splendid culture . it has rich historical and cultural legacies .
the protection of fine historical and cultural legacies is a matter of great importance in taking over and carrying forward the remarkable cultural traditions of the chinese nation .
how well a city protects its historical and cultural legacies is an important hallmark of its civilization .
in the construction and development of a city , it is necessary to correctly handle the relations between modernization and the protection of history and culture and respect its history of development so that it will have greater substance and details with the passage of time .
a city is an organic body that is constantly developing and renewing itself .
( 8 ) make increased efforts to protect scenic spots and places of historical interest .
scenic spots and places of historical interest have a lot of precious natural and cultural legacies . they are natural museums of natural history and cultural history .
the effective protection and rational utilization of scenic and historical resources are of great importance to the improvement of the ecological environment , the development of tourism , the promotion of ethnic culture , the stimulation of patriotic passion , and the enrichment of people 's cultural life .
in the development of scenic spots and places of historical interest , it is necessary to properly handle the relations between protection and utilization and put protection in the first place .
the prerequisite for making a success of work relating to scenic spots and places of historical interest is planning , the core is protection and the key is management .
no development zones or holiday resorts should be built in these places , and scenic resources and sites must not be sold , or sold in disguise , in any name or form .
the style and image of a city is an important manifestation of its material and spiritual civilization .
every city should create its own image in the light of its local , ethnic , historical and cultural characteristics .
for many cities , cleaning up the environment comes before making themselves beautiful . great efforts should be made to solve the problem of " filthiness , disorder and poor conditions . "
in short , we should pay attention to real results and do more tangible things for the people .
strengthening the building of the legal system is the guarantee for the scientific formulation and effective implementation of plans and is the fundamental way to do a good job of urban and rural planning .
first , we should improve legislation and establish and improve the system of urban and rural planning statutes .
second , we should earnestly strengthen the implementation and management of plans .
planning departments must earnestly discharge their management functions and ensure that the plans are effectively implemented .
the departments concerned should give support to the management of plans and make joint efforts to defend the authority of urban and rural plans .
planning management departments at all levels must seriously investigate and deal with land - use offenses and illegal constructions .
leadership at all levels should take the lead in exercising administration in accordance with law and defend the authority and seriousness of urban and rural plans .
the responsibility is heavy and the task is arduous .
( 1 ) the work of urban and rural planning should be put in an important position .
doing a good job of urban and rural planning is an important duty of governments at all levels .
provincial governors should grasp well the planning of cities and towns within their province .
county magistrates should grasp the planning of towns within their county .
( 2 ) great efforts should be made to acquire the knowledge of urban and rural planning and development .
concrete and technical issues of planning should be left to the planners .
decisions on major issues that have a bearing on the overall situation must be made by the provincial , city and county leaders .
state and local public administration academies must include urban and rural planning as a compulsory course for the education and training of cadres .
( 3 ) democratic decision making and scientific decision making must be upheld .
in the process of formulating plans , leading cadres must extensively listen to the views and suggestions of all quarters concerned . in particular , the views of experts should be respected .
in the solution of major issues in urban and rural planning , it is necessary to repeatedly exchange views and hold discussions with the planning departments and experts . there must be several plans for comparison . projects without plans for comparison will not be approved .
( 4 ) mutual coordination should be strengthened .
urban and rural planning is a highly comprehensive task that involves many different aspects . the departments concerned must give energetic support , offer their full cooperation , actively take part in the formulation and review of urban and rural plans , and consciously abide by the plans that have been approved .
planning personnel should have the courage to uphold principle , handle matters impartially , be honest and clean , and oppose all kinds of unhealthy practices .

at the end of last year , the pentagon of the united states began to draw up the next " four - year defense evaluation report , " to be released in 2001 .
information warfare - - can a power with the information edge fear nothing ? information warfare is also called computer warfare at times .
as a new combat method that has emerged against the backdrop of the information era , information warfare will undoubtedly have a profound impact on military ideology , strategic principles , defense building , troops establishment , and armament .
as a military superpower , the united states naturally has shown extremely great enthusiasm in this field . while fully confident of its ability to launch this kind of warfare , the united states is very worried that it may become an even greater victim itself .
first , the more we rely on it , the more the risks exist .
a recently published " report of the national defense science commission special work group on information warfare " of the united states pointed out : " to many countries , offensive information warfare is attractive because the cost is cheap compared to the development , maintenance , and utilization of advanced military capability .
the latter method is particularly appealing .
the latest information on ways to use design features and security loopholes of commercial computer software are easily available on the internet . "
it is disclosed that during the gulf war period , the bush administration once considered undermining the iraqi government 's computer system for financial affairs . however , this was objected to by the cia because the united states had more weaknesses and was afraid of revenge .
second , the united states has continued to monopolize information warfare technology .
the costs of microsensors and video - frequency monitors for use in information warfare are very high . however , the large part of technology used for attacking this kind of information system , mainly computers and modem units , are very cheap .
anyone can be armed as a warrior of information warfare without any large amount of capital by visiting computer shops seen everywhere .
donald lazam [ name as transliterated ] , a former department of defense official responsible for communications work , held that with a computer and modem , " a few quick - witted persons can create life - threatening economic chaos for the enemy . "
besides , the us information system can be attacked even more easily .
the united states is a country where it is most extensively and commonly in use .
john mcconnell , director of the national security agency , pointed out : " the united states is more vulnerable to attacks by computer invaders than other countries . "
air force academy instructor chad jevlansky [ name as transliterated ] , said : " when the united states is enthusiastic in talking about the huge potential of information warfare , it should reflect itself . "
the military on the other hand is worried that dependence on it may become a breach in the us military 's defense and the united states could become a loser in the information warfare arms race , which could ultimately lead to an " electronic pearl harbor " incident .
however , looking at the us military 's performance in several recent local wars [ ju bu zhan zheng ] , many weaknesses still exist in the us military 's operations and development . first , the us military 's high - tech weapons have high requirements for weather conditions and battlefield environment .
therefore , adverse weather conditions and battlefield environment can affect the combat effectiveness of high - tech weapons .
some trucks of us units in europe have run more than one million miles , and the naval and air force troops could not but dismantle usable spare parts of some aircraft for use by other planes .
even the american people themselves have recognized that this will jeopardize the capability of their mobilization , deployment , operations , and capability of winning wars .
third , the united states is facing the severest crisis in manpower resources since the end of the vietnam war .
apart from these , there is a serious problem of a brain drain in the us military .
for example , many pilots of the air force have switched to local civil aviation companies that pay higher salaries , resulting in extreme shortage of pilots in the us military . it is expected that by 2002 , the air force will be short of 1,200 pilots .
they must go through corresponding training before they can be employed . control of space - - can a space technology power solely establish a space net ?
the united states is one of the first countries to have extended its military tentacles into space .
it is pointed out in the long range plan of the us space command that " us interests and investment in space must be fully protected to ensure our country 's freedom of movement in space . "
technologically speaking , the united states ' capability is still the best in the world .
as other localities in the world understand more about space , even a us spy satellite , the jewel on the crown of the us intelligence system for many years , has become not so effective .
countries that are under us surveillance have , through analyzing us technology and formulating satellite tracking methods , learned how to evade the eyes of the american people .
when india conducted the nuclear test , the united states was severely criticized by all sides as it could not obtain this intelligence beforehand .
part of the reason is that the pentagon is greatly dependent on space for its military action .
at an arms exhibition in moscow , this russian company displayed a map of iraq , showing the number of jamming devices needed to block global positioning system throughout the boundary of iraq .

all sides will concentrate efforts on making the " shanghai five " a regional mechanism for the five countries to carry out multilateral cooperation in various fields . 2 .
all sides reaffirm their hope that central asia will become a peaceful , good - neighborly , and stable region for developing international cooperation on an equal basis and their opposition to any conflicts , threats , and external interventions that may complicate the situation in this region .
in view of this and in consideration of the current regional and surrounding geopolitical circumstances , all sides have determined to deepen cooperation in the political , diplomatic , economic and trade , military , military technological , and other fields to consolidate regional peace and stability . 3 .
all sides indicate they will never allow the use of their own territory for carrying out any actions detrimental to the sovereignty , security , or social order of any of the five countries .
all sides state their support , in accordance with the one - china principle , for the prc 's desire and effort to safeguard unity of the country .
all sides have taken notice of the political and other challenges currently confronting the world , including the attempt to change the established practice for settling international and regional issues , and stress they will unswervingly promote the strengthening of the united nations ' role as the only universal mechanism for safeguarding international peace and stability .
that treaty is the cornerstone of the maintenance of strategic stability as well as the basis for further reducing strategic offensive weapons .
all sides hold that the deployment of a bloc - based , closed [ ji tuan xing de feng bi de ] theater missile defense [ tmd ] system in the asia - pacific region will undermine stability and peace in that region and lead to an escalated arms race .
all sides support china 's stand of opposing the inclusion , in any form and by any countries , of taiwan in a tmd program . 9 .
all sides state that this year is the 30 th anniversary of the signing of the nuclear nonproliferation treaty and the fact that this treaty has withstood the test of time proves that it is an effective tool for containing the threat of nuclear proliferation and reducing the danger of an outbreak of nuclear conflicts .
all sides support the united nations ' efforts and leading role in seeking a political settlement of the afghan conflicts and call on all parties to the conflicts to maintain restraint and hold peace talks as soon as possible in consideration of the interests of all social groups and strata in afghanistan . 12 .
all sides hold that the asian conference on measures for mutual cooperation and trust is a positive process on the asian continent and has , along with other existing organizations and mechanisms in asia , further created conditions for holding political dialogues on safeguarding regional peace , enhancing mutual trust , and developing multilateral cooperation . 14 .
all sides will comprehensively encourage the rationalization and development of economic and trade partnerships within the five - nation framework based on the principle of equality and mutually beneficial cooperation .
all sides attach great importance to environmental protection , including the use of water resources , in this region and will launch bilateral and multilateral cooperation in this field . 17 .
all sides attach importance to carrying out cooperation between foreign affairs departments of the five countries and consider it appropriate to hold annual meetings of foreign ministers for examining issues of the development of mutual cooperation by the five countries in various fields , discussing international and regional situations , and bringing their positions into line . 18 .

since the meeting in shanghai of the five countries ' heads of state in 1996 , the " shanghai five " has become a universally - acknowledged special term for the five countries of china , tajikistan , russia , kazakhstan , and kyrgyzstan .
during the meeting , the five countries ' heads of state exchanged extensive views on the regional situation and on international issues of common interest and reached a broad consensus on building a " big building " for good - neighborly , friendly , and peaceful cooperation oriented toward the 21 st century .
the " dushanbe statement " not only pointed a clear direction for the five countries to further enhance coordination and cooperation in the new century but also decided on the concrete tasks of cooperation and the ways for enforcing practical and effective cooperation .
the world 's longest land area borderlines will become the links that closely bind the friendship among the people of five countries .
therefore , the five countries ' maintaining and developing good - neighborly and friendly cooperative relationship is undoubtedly of extremely important significance for maintaining peace and stability in the region and even in the world .
at present , all the five countries are faced with the arduous tasks of invigorating the economy , of catching up with the tide of scientific and technological development , and of coping with the globalization challenges ; hence the earnest desire to have a long - term stable and peaceful environment for construction .
the development of the situation not only further increases the necessity and urgency of enhancing cooperation among the five countries but also sets even higher demands on the level of future cooperation and on the cooperation priorities among the five countries .

the column host 's remarks : scientific theories regard the masses of the people as their material weapon , while the masses of the people use scientific theories as their spiritual weapon .
then , how can we resolve the issue of study style ? people generally believe that study style is no more than an issue of application or a job of integrating theories with practice .
in other words , they should also understand the importance of reading books and studying theories .
the study of theories is not only a precondition for integration of theories with practice , but also an inherent content in our solution to the issue of study style .
at present , we still need to redress the first erroneous tendency with intensified efforts ; yet at the same time , we should by no means overlook the second tendency .
according to the result of a sample survey conducted by a certain department , ever since the distribution of the " study plan for medium - and high - ranking army cadres " to lower levels , only 58 percent of the respondents have engaged themselves in theoretical studies in strict accordance with the planned speed .
when responding to the question " can you complete the reading of 3.7 million - character assigned books in line with the quality and quantity requirements within three years , " 33 percent expressed their lack of confidence .
putting aside its representativeness , this survey has at least told us that the phenomenon of neglecting theoretical studies does exist in reality , and that we should take and resolve the problem seriously .
the two are mutually complementary , and none can be dispensed with .
as the saying goes : " with the skin gone , to what can the hair attach itself ? " without mastering theories , any talk on applying theories will only prove an empty talk .
without theories , we would be like a blank sheet paper . what do you think we have in our hands to apply to practice ? "
the problem of overlooking the need to study and master theories is imputable to causes with one 's work , yet a most important cause is his own ideological understanding on the issue .
such is an one - sided understanding .
this is also an erroneous understanding .
undoubtedly , we need to apply what we have learned to our practical work ; and in a certain sense , doing practical work is also some kind of study .
" even if it can accumulate and form a pond , the water will prove far from enough to hold a big ship . "
we should not only " read books with the head down " but also " think deeply with the head up " ; and should try our utmost to master correct viewpoints , concepts , and methods .
in the past 100 years , the human race have gained an unprecedented profound understanding of themselves .
this was reflected in a concentrated manner by the completion of a working draft of the human genome map announced simultaneously by the governments of the united states , britain , japan , germany , france and china on 26 june .
for several thousand years , people have always been perplexed by the essence of the phenomenon that " plant melons and you get melons , sow beans and you get beans " - - namely , the genetics question .
the genome concept was put forward in 1920 , meaning the sum total of all genes and chromosomes . the human genome contains all the genetic information on growth , ailment , aging and death . the human race have only one common genome .
the genetic difference of different races and different individuals lies mainly in the alignment of a few genes .
the 26 june announcement told people that with the concerted efforts made by scientists of many countries , a working draft on 3 billion base pairs has been completed .
the implementation of the human genome project will lead to the development of a large number of genetic engineering drugs which will be sold in market to serve people .
for instance , the human genome sciences , inc. of the united states has had at least three genomic drugs ready for clinical use .
the human genome project will comprehensively push ailment diagnosis to the molecular level and bring about a major reform of the treatment plan .
everything in the world has its good and bad sides .
for instance , some people have even proposed and been implementing a " gene weapon " plan . its essence is to study the unique genes of different races and different ethnic groups and then adopt a certain tactics to use them in a certain target ethnic group for the ultimate goal of causing that group to perish .
such a possibility was recognized in the 1996 government experts ' reports of such countries as the united states , britain , russia and germany .
since 1997 , britain has formed a group , composed of biotech , medical and other experts , to study how to deal with it .
so , to discover and protect the unique and susceptible genes of a certain ethnic group has become an important matter concerning the growth , survival , and life or death of that group .
it is very likely that to " understand " the " double dutch " will take more time than the working draft took ( 10 years ) . it will be more difficult to analyze and know the implications of the base sequences than to determine the sequences .
all the party organizations and leading cadres at all levels should earnestly study and understand the spirit of this speech of comrade jiang zemin , unify their thinking and understanding onto the spirit of the central authorities , and strive to open up new prospects for ideological and political work .

according to the latest information from the pest prevention section of the technology popularization center of the ministry of agriculture : locusts have appeared this summer in varying degrees in over 100 counties of 13 provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities , including hebei , henan , shandong , tianjin , and xinjiang .
in addition there was a high base figure of sources of the insects last year and many of them survived the winter , thus causing a plague this year .
by the end of june the first locust peak , that is , the summer peak , had been basically brought under control , but the hidden dangers have not been eliminated , and a certain number of remnants will lay eggs and threaten the autumn crops .
at present the task of prevention and control of dense swarms over 23 million mu has been completed , but the task of dealing with them in autumn remains very heavy .
professor zhang zehua of the biological prevention and control research center of the chinese agricultural science academy said : " a locust plague on the grasslands is a smokeless conflagration which must be extinguished immediately !
why migratory locusts again " blot out the sun " at a time when many young people do not know what locusts are , apart from locusts on the grasslands , east asian and asian migratory locusts have dealt heavy blows at china 's coastal regions and central and western areas this year .
according to ministry of agriculture statistics , at one stage the density of some migratory locust swarms reached 1,000 to 4,000 per square meter .
locusts appeared in the dagang area of tianjin in 1985 , from where they swarmed into hebei province , shocking people for a time .
since the latter part of the 1990 's , the threat of locusts has been gradually intensifying , and this year there is a serious outbreak .
how can locusts " come back from the dead ? " professor chen yonglin , a locust research expert , gives this analysis : an important reason for this is the changes of climate .
last year there was serious drought in north , northwest , and northeast china and the huang - huai region .
this year we have seen one of the worst droughts ever ; in the huang - huai region it was the worst for 50 years , and hubei actually had its worst spring drought for 100 years .
the fall in water levels or drying up of rivers , lakes , and reservoirs , plus the development of coastal shoreline provide a continually increasing environment for locusts to breed and reproduce .
professor chen yonglin said that the destruction of vegetation has provided the conditions for locusts to breed .
as industries of various kinds have developed in recent years , more and more vegetation has been destroyed ; in particular , with the indiscriminate tree felling along the rivers and lakes , soil erosion has intensified and there is more open land , and so there are more breeding grounds for locusts .
by now there are only 82,000 mu of the forest remaining , and even the diversiform - leaved poplar [ hu yang ] , described as " the tree of life amid desolation , " has died in great swathes .
what requires still greater vigilance is the fact that desertification now covers 38 percent of china 's total land area , and is more than 200 percent greater than the arable area ; china has one of the most serious desertification problems in the world .
in order to improve the ecological environment in west china , china has adopted measures in recent years to return farmland to lakes , shores , and pasture .
the leaders concerned of the ministry of agriculture hold that although china 's locust control technology is of advanced international standard , our hardware lags far behind developed countries , with the result that the infrastructure and the technology do not form a complete set at all .
although initial success has been achieved in the battle against locusts in some areas , the locust plague in china can hardly be wiped out in a short time , and it is essential to establish the idea of locust control and plague elimination over a long period .
there are over 20 million mu of land in china suitable for locust breeding , and the environment for this is increasing ; in addition prevention and control is only being done on 16 percent of the area where grassland locusts have appeared , and it remains difficult to control them effectively .
in the long term , however , it is necessary to focus on ecological construction in order to effectively prevent and control locust plague .
while improving the water , vegetation , soil , and small climate in areas suitable for locust breeding , it is also necessary to combine plant , biological , resource , and environmental protection .
experts concerned have proposed the gradual popularization of biological pesticides to control locusts , to resolve the current problems in the large - scale use of organo - phosphates .
the outbreak of this locust plague has warned us yet again : we can no longer sacrifice the environment as the price for economic development .

during his visit , prc president jiang zemin held talks with turkmenistan president saparmurad niyazov .
both sides agreed that president jiang zemin 's visit to turkmenistan was a complete success and helped bring the sino - turkmenistan friendship and cooperation to a new height . 2 .
both sides unanimously agreed that there are enormous potential and good prospects in trade and economic cooperation between the two countries .
both sides expressed their willingness to further expand trade and economic cooperation on the basis of equality and mutual benefits so that they will reach a level commensurate with the economic potential of the two countries .
both sides have attached importance to strengthening mutually beneficial cooperation in the energy field .
china will actively encourage chinese enterprises to take part in the prospecting , tapping and marketing of oil and natural gas in turkmenistan .
the two sides agreed to conduct feasibility study on the project of laying a natural gas pipeline linking turkmenistan and china on the basis of the actual progress of china 's project to transmit natural gas from the western part of the country to the east . 6 .
both sides will further strengthen exchanges and cooperation in science , technology , culture , education , health , media , sports and other fields . the governments of the two countries will create necessary conditions for this . 7 .
both sides held that the ancient silk road played an important role in developing the friendship between the people of the two countries and the exchanges between the eastern and western civilizations .
the prc supports turkmenistan in actively pursuing a foreign policy of permanent neutrality and thinks this policy has a constructive influence on the development of the situation of the region .

service has become the main theme in insurance competition in the first half of this year .

"

we should mutually respect one another and uphold equality of national sovereignty .
