the controversy in the field of international disarmament and arms control over the us deployment of an abm system has recently become white hot ; the focus is on the us insistence on deployment of a national missile defense [ nmd ] system , which russia resolutely opposes , while the european allies are also critical .
people are worried that the us move in obstinately clinging to its course will result in the " abm treaty , " which has for many years been the cornerstone supporting international disarmament and arms control , existing only in name , and this will thus threaten the entire process of international disarmament and arms control .
the struggle around the question of revising the " abm treaty " in recent years the united states has started to develop and deploy an abm system under the pretext of guarding against the so - called " missile threat from irresponsible states . "
this system includes nmd and theater missile defense (tmd) .
according to this act , the united states will deploy nmd as soon as the technical conditions are ripe .
the united states plans to deploy 20 interceptor missiles in alaska by 2005 , and to increase the number to 100 in two years after that .
at the same time , it will build radar stations within the united states and in greenland and england , and launch satellites carrying special monitoring devices .
the lower - tier system intercepts incoming missiles at a height of 20 to 40 km .
the upper - tier system intercepts missiles in the final stage of mid - trajectory or in early reentry , at the extremity of the atmosphere , at an altitude of 40 km , or else above the atmosphere , and its defensive coverage is relatively great .
at present two upper - tier defense systems are in development : one is the army 's " thaad " system , and the other is the navy 's " theaterwide defense " system .
successful interception tests have been carried out in both these systems ; in particular , thaad was twice successfully tested last year after many failures .
some us technology for the lower - tier tmd system is ready and it is hoped to deploy it in the near future .
the united states is now pushing its tmd program in east asia , including japan , south korea , and even taiwan .
the legal obstacle to us development and deployment of abm defense comes from the " abm treaty . "
this was signed by the united states and the soviet union in 1972 and came into effect that year .
this undoubtedly means removing the essence from the " abm treaty , " the upper - tier defense system being developed in nmd also violates the " abm treaty , " since it is capable of countering strategic missiles and does not accord with the provisions of the treaty on limiting mobility .
so far , however , there has been no substantive progress in us - russian consultations on revising the " abm treaty . "
this is undoubtedly something that russia does not want to see .
on 30 may , president chirac stated in paris that us development of nmd and revision of the " abm treaty " threatens the international nuclear disarmament and arms control process , upsets the global strategic balance , and will spark off a fresh arms race .
german chancellor schroeder has twice explained in person to clinton the danger of pursuing nmd , and asked the united states to reconsider .
europe is worried that if the united states builds nmd , the european allies that are not protected by nmd will be more likely to suffer attack by strategic missiles , and this will shake the basis of the traditional european - us relations of sharing security and danger and good and bad fortune .
nmd will also further widen the military disparity between europe and the united states , increase european military dependence on the united states , and extend still further into the distant future the european goal of making its own decisions on defense .
as the foundations of the balance of global forces and nuclear disarmament , almost all the nuclear disarmament treaties and important arms control treaties in the past quarter - century have been agreed on the basis of the " abm treaty . "
following that , this will also affect other nuclear powers in joining at an early date the process of multilateral negotiations on world nuclear disarmament , and will ultimately lead to a halt and even retrogression in the international nuclear disarmament process .
at present the united states and russia have switched from competing in quantity to competing in quality in nuclear weaponry .
so far russia has carried out 10 sudden defense [ tu fang ] live tests of the topol - m icbm .
russia plans to deploy 300 to 500 of these missiles in the first decade of the 21 st century .
if russia builds a certain abm defense capability , this will arouse the concern of britain and france and they will take countermeasures .
a nuclear arms contest may unfold in a new field .
once the " abm treaty " limitations are broken , this is bound to greatly speed up the process of placing weapons in space and spark an arms race in space .
in these circumstances , space will become a new theater of the world arms race , and the consequence is bound to be the undermining of global security and stability .
of course , further observation will be needed to see when the united states will deploy nmd .
the us defense department announced on 20 june that the third interception test of a nmd missile , originally scheduled for april ( and then postponed till june ) , will take place on 7 july .
us nmd technology requires further development , and there is no way yet of determining its reliability .
in short , since nmd technology is not yet perfect , and nmd is strongly opposed by the international community , the united states may delay a decision on the deployment issue , but it will by no means abandon the continued development of nmd .
for the sake of preserving its national security and great power status , it will be very difficult for russia to agree to this .

this year 's " rimpac 2000 " exercise was the 17 th exercise since 1971 and was noted for being of the largest scale in history .
compared with all previous ones , this year 's exercise has set three unprecedented " mosts " . first , it has involved the largest number of countries .
third , this year 's exercise involved the largest number of forces .
this year 's " rimpac 2000 " exercise involved more than 50 warships or vessels , more than 200 planes , and more than 20,000 troops from the seven countries ' ground , naval , air , marine , or coast guard units .
for this reason , the troops involved in the exercise built a refugee camp on the island of hawaii and staged both a simulated relief operation and a simulated refugee management exercise .

beijing , 8 jul ( xinhua ) - - the 13 th issue of the xinhua - sponsored " ban yue tan " magazine carries an article by wang shujuan entitled : " nmd [ acronym published in english throughout article ] : a dangerous signal . "
the full text of the article reads as follows : us president bill clinton 28 june announced that he would make a decision on whether to begin building the nmd system " sometime in the following weeks . "
according to an estimate , the cost of building and deployment of the nmd system is extremely expensive and will reach $ 60 billion . the us department of defense has already included $ 15 billion for the system in its 2001 - 2005 budget report .
it should be said that the united states planned to deploy the nmd system a long time ago .
after the end of the cold war , it was changed to become a ballistic missile defense system .
the nmd system is more advanced . once developed in shape , it will be a three - in - one solid defense system of early warning satellites , radars , and computer guidance [ dian nao zhi dao ] .
second , it is to break the nuclear balance between the united states and russia .
third , it is to entangle the west european countries and increase the gap of their weapons and equipment with the united states so that they can only follow us commands .
one family 's happiness has made several families worried it is not difficult to see that the us deployment of nmd threatens russia the most , and so russia has energetically opposed it from the beginning .
in january this year , when the united states asked russia to revise the " abm treaty , " russia firmly said " no . "
therefore , russia struck first in order to gain the initiative . the state duma successively approved " start ii " and the " comprehensive nuclear test ban treaty " in april .
moscow has also made efforts to promote the talks on " start iii " and hoped to reduce the number of nuclear warheads to 1,500 , while the united states only agreed to reduce the number to 2,500 .
from 3 to 4 june , heads of state of the united states and russia held talks in moscow for as long as 10 hours , yet no breakthrough was made on practical issues .
on 5 june , putin visited italy and put forward a suggestion on russia and west european countries jointly establishing a missile defense system . he hoped to strengthen cooperation with west european countries on this issue and jointly contend with the united states .
on 9 june , russian foreign minister ivanov announced putin 's five - point suggestions on establishing an all - europe non - strategic anti - ballistic missile system .
the united states of course will not let russia cut the ground from under its feet .
just two days prior to clinton 's trip to europe , leaders in germany and france respectively delivered speeches to oppose the development of nmd .
in order to eliminate the worry of the european countries , clinton declared at the us - europe summit that the united states would share missile defense technologies with europe and said " not doing so would be immoral . "
nevertheless , european countries are unwilling to accept us authority over themselves .
since the united states started to dream about the building of a missile sky network , china has always opposed the idea .
on the one hand , the united states claims that nmd is not directed at china ; but on the other hand , its internal report shows that the united states has considered china as its main potential threat .
the chinese government has through various ways expressed its own stand to the us side : china firmly opposes the development of nmd by the united states .
on 20 june , the us department of defense announced that the third test of nmd 's missile intercepting technologies would be held on 7 july this year . this is the second postponement of test by the united states .
in october last year and january this year , the us military conducted two similar tests .
the first test might be said to have been successful , but the second test ended in failure . scientists of the us massachusetts institute of technology revealed that the us military had intentionally covered up facts in the nmd testing and noted that the intercepting missile could not distinguish between genuine and false incoming missiles .
the " new york times " revealed that in order to make the nmd test successful , the us department of defense intentionally adopted more simple and fewer target warheads to let intercepting missile discern them more easily .
public opinion holds that , despite oppositions , the united states will never give up its nmd program .
this is mainly due to : 1 ) the united states is convinced that potential enemies are still existent ; 2 ) the us military needs a pretext to increase military expenditure ; and 3 ) the us ordnance industry wants to make profits and will energetically persuade the us government to make its decision as quickly as possible .
from 3 to 7 july , chinese president jiang zemin attended the " shanghai five " summit in the tajik capital dushanbe and visited two central asian countries , tajikistan and turkmenistan .

of china 's frequent activities of " heads of state diplomacy " recently , president jiang 's trip to central asia carries a very important weight and especially attracts people 's attention .
after the disintegration of the soviet union and the end of the cold war , there have been repeated changes in the international situation .
after going through turbulence in the first few years , international relations have entered the adjustment and evolution stage in recent years , whether we view them from the angle of global strategy of the major powers or from the angle of relations between countries in various regions .
central asian countries are situated in the central part of the eurasian continent , a very important geographical position .
it was exactly under the abovementioned background that the " shanghai five , " a meeting of five heads of state of china , kazakhstan , kyrgyzstan , russia , and tajikistan , was first held in china 's shanghai in 1996 .
the meeting was held during the past four years from shanghai to moscow , alma - ata , and bishkek . the dushanbe meeting this year completed the rotation of holding the meeting in each of the five nations once .
in reviewing the journey taken by the " shanghai five , " people are pleased to say that the " shanghai five " has passed its initial stage and entered into the stage of development and harvest .

this was the first meeting between the two after president putin assumed office , which was also an opportunity for the two leaders to meet face to face to deepen understanding and establish friendship .
although this was the first time that the two leaders met , as president jiang and president putin have exchanged viewpoints on major bilateral and international issues through telephone conversations several times , china and russia share identical or similar views on many major issues . therefore , they are not unfamiliar to each other .
the two sides exchanged opinions extensively on issues of common concern in a friendly atmosphere .
china and russia are permanent members of the un security council and both shoulder the arduous tasks of safeguarding stability and seeking development . the two countries have established a strategic cooperative partnership that is not directed at a third country but will be conducive only to the stability and development of the region and even the whole world .

however , the current situation of safe production is still quite grim .
according to the decision of the state council , an urgent circular on related matters is hereby issued as follows : 1 . it is necessary to immediately start a general inspection of safe production and straighten up and improve key industries .
news and other mass media should actively coordinate with the current general inspection on safe production and create a strong and favorable public opinion to promote this work .
through the adjustment of production structure , it is imperative to close and weed out those fireworks and firecrackers plants , lighter plants , small oil refineries , small coal pits and other small plants and mines that are not in accord with conditions for safe production .
enterprises and units that produce and operate easily combustible things and poisonous and dangerous items in cities with dense population should be dispersed to other places and make necessary adjustments . 2 .
it is necessary to further make clear responsibility and promptly investigate and severely punish those who are responsible for accidents .
various localities , departments and units should further make clear responsibility , improve and implement a responsibility system for safe production , and establish and perfect rules and regulations for safe production and implement them in a strict manner .
it is imperative to investigate and make clear the cause of serious accidents and strictly handle those who are responsible for accidents in accordance with the law .
those who should be disciplined , dismissed or punished by the law must be strictly handled .
the ministry of public security , the state administration for industry and commerce and the state bureau of quality and technical supervision should strictly carry out their supervision and law enforcement duties , strictly perform their tasks according to the law , and strengthen the execution of the law .
all concerned departments should strictly follow the state regulations and strengthen supervision and inspection of safe production and day - to - day management .
for accidents due to those who were derelict of duty , committed misconduct or acted wrongly out of personal consideration , it is imperative to strictly investigate and handle those responsible persons until affixing their criminal responsibility according to the law .
concerned department of local governments at various levels should follow the above practice , carry out their duties , be responsible for their own units , work in close coordination , and jointly do a good job in safe production .
in the course of reform of local organizations , the supervision and management of safe production should be strengthened and must not be weakened . 4 .
it is necessary to strengthen propaganda to raise the consciousness of safe production by the whole people .
various localities , departments and units should strengthen safety education and training work and enhance the consciousness of safe production of the whole people .
propaganda departments at various levels and enterprises and undertakings should adopt various forms to publicize and educate people on safe production and , in particular , on related laws and regulations , in an extensive and deep - going way .
news units should also expose activities in violation of laws and regulations on safe production and major accidents . through typical examples , we should educate the broad masses to understand and observe law , enhance the concept of legal system , and raise their consciousness of safety and self - protection .

the customs law , which was drafted in 1987 , will contain 9 chapters and 102 articles after the amendment .
reportedly , the current amendments mainly include : clearly defining the legal grounds for the customs to investigate smuggling and for the public security organs to investigate , detain , arrest , and try cases . the law stipulates that they should follow the provisions of the criminal procedural law .
from now on , the anti - smuggling police corps of the customs will have laws to follow and their operation will be bound by the law .
the new law improves the customs monitoring and supervisory system in four aspects : the law clearly defines the responsibility of the enterprises making a declaration to the customs , improves the bonded tax system and offering added articles on management over processing trade , strengthens the tax levying system , and improves the customs guarantee system .
while deliberating the draft law , the legislators said that smuggling through cargo channels accounts for over 80 percent of the total smuggling cases in china . for this reason , the improvement in the monitoring and supervisory system in this regard will be of practical significance in cracking down on the wild smuggling activities .

brussels , 9 jul ( xinhua ) - - chinese state council premier zhu rongji will begin an official visit to the european union [ eu ] headquarters in brussels , capital of belgium , on 10 july .
this is the first major visit by a chinese leader to the eu in the 25 years since sino - eu diplomatic relations were established .
china and the eu established diplomatic relations in may 1975 .
china has also repeatedly reiterated that china and the eu are important forces on the world stage today in preserving peace and promoting development , and comprehensively developing a lasting , stable , and mutually beneficial cooperation relationship with the eu is also an important component of chinese foreign policy .
starting in 1998 , china and the eu established a system for an annual meeting of leaders at which the two sides hold discussions and consultations on issues of common concern .
in recent years there have been frequent high - level exchange visits ; in 1999 chinese president jiang zemin and national people 's congress standing committee chairman li peng successively visited a number of eu member - states ; the queen of the netherlands , the president of finland , and the german chancellor also visited china .
this year three chinese vice premiers have visited a number of eu member - states ; and the prime minister of spain and other eu member - state leaders have visited china .
the frequent high - level dialogues and exchanges between china and the eu have deepened the understanding of both sides and greatly stimulated the development of sino - eu relations .
the economies of china and europe are strongly complementary and there are broad spaces for cooperation ; sino - eu economic and trade relations have developed rapidly in recent years .
according to statistics , since the 1990 's the eu has invested in 12,000 projects in china with total agreed investment of 40 billion euros and actual investment of 22 billion euros .
eu experts forecast that judging by the momentum of trade development in the first quarter , eu - china trade this year will show a big increase over last year .
although sino - eu relations are continually developing in steady fashion , due to differences in political system , cultural traditions , and economic development levels , the two sides have different views on a number of issues such as human rights , and this is quite normal .
although in the trade field the eu has removed china from the list of " non - market economy countries , " chinese goods still cannot completely enjoy market economy country treatment in respect of antidumping and quantity restrictions .
in greeting in the summer sunshine the visit of the chinese premier , brussels , " capital of europe , " is also greeting a splendid future in the development of sino - eu relations .

the summit of china , russia , tajikistan , kazakhstan and kyrgyzstan issued the " dushanbe statement " which mentions their decision to further develop the multilateral cooperation mechanism within the framework of the " shanghai five . "
putin took office and replaced boris yeltsin on 7 may this year and he attended the five - nation summit for the first time . therefore , dushanbe became a place for the two presidents to meet for the first time .
the first summit of china , russia , kazakhstan , kyrgyzstan and tajikistan was held in shanghai in 1996 . then the " shanghai five " summit has been held one after another in moscow , alma ata , bishkek , and dushanbe . this year , a cycle has been completed .
a meeting of the security and law - enforcement departments and a meeting of the defense ministers of the five nations have been held within the framework of the " shanghai five " in addition to the annual meetings of the heads of state in the past four years .
on the eve of the five - nation summit , a meeting of the foreign ministers of the five nations was also held .
because of this , the " dushanbe statement " includes the decision on the five nations jointly cracking down on ethnic splittism , international terrorism and religious extremism , as well as illegally trafficking of weapons and drugs , illegal immigration , and other criminal activities that threaten regional security and development .
the five nations will sign a multilateral treaty or agreement , hold regular meetings of people responsible for their respective law - enforcement , frontier defense , customs and security departments , and conduct antiterrorism and anti - violence exercises whenever necessary .
it has been analyzed that " ethnic splittism " mentioned here includes " xinjiang independence " elements in exile in central asia ( who are also called elements of " the eastern turkistan independence movement " ) .
the five - nation summit also reaffirmed in the " dushanbe statement " that the five - nation cooperation mechanism is not directed at any other nation and that it is of an open nature .
after the five - nation summit , president jiang zemin paid a state visit to tajikistan , the host nation of the summit , and to turkmenistan . this pushed china 's relations with these two countries to a new stage of development .
a specialist said that china has long regarded " sending natural gas from the western region to the east " as an important project of the strategy of developing the western region and the crux of smoothly carrying out such a project depends on guaranteed long - term reliable sources of natural gas .
the 16 th meeting of the standing committee of the ninth national people 's congress deliberated and adopted the amendment to the product quality law. what major impacts will the newly revised product quality law have on further promoting the improvement of product quality in the country ?
li chuanqing : with the party central committee and the state council attaching great importance to the issue of quality in recent years , the overall standard of product quality in the country has improved considerably and a number of advanced enterprises featuring quality and efficiency have sprung up .
however , the current situation of product quality is still very grim in the country .
therefore , the revision of the product quality law was already extremely urgent .
reporter : what were the major revisions made to the product quality law to counter these problems ?
to break down local and departmental protectionism , we also stipulate that no units nor individuals must repel the entry into their localities or departments by products that are up to quality standards but not made in their own localities nor by their own units or enterprises .
second , a restrictive mechanism has been established for enterprises ' product quality , with the stress being laid on producers ' responsibility for the quality of products they produce .
producers and marketeers are not allowed to refuse product quality supervision and inspection organized and conducted by a product quality supervision department in accordance with the law .
those that refuse product quality supervision and inspection conducted in accordance with the law shall have their business licenses revoked as a penalty in serious cases .
in other words , a marketeer will still be punished according to the law if he does not have ample evidence to prove his ignorance of the fake or shoddy nature of the products being marketed .
there is also a provision that those that provide transportation , keeping , storage , or other facilities and conditions for the production or marketing of fake or shoddy products or that provide production techniques for making fake products shall bear legal responsibility without exception .
fifth , the restrictions on product quality supervision departments , testing agencies , and certifying agencies have been strengthened .
product quality testing agencies and certifying agencies shall be given legal sanctions ranging from a fine , the revocation of testing or certifying qualifications , up to the investigation and affixment of criminal responsibility for any acts of falsifying test results or issuing false certificates .
sixth , a product quality supervision and reporting system has been set up to bring into full play the masses ' enthusiasm in joining the crackdown on fake products .
in conclusion , li chuanqing said : i believe these important revisions to the product quality law will further encourage all circles of society to pay attention to and support product quality work and more forcefully put down fake and shoddy products to improve the overall standard of product quality in the country .

beijing , 3 jul ( xinhua ) - - china made important progress in the reform and turnaround of state enterprises in the first half of this year .
the textile , metallurgy , oil , petrochemical , and other major industries have doubled their benefits . the goals of the three - year reform and turnaround of state enterprises will be attained this year as scheduled .
an authoritative department survey showed that since the beginning of the year , some of 6,599 loss - making state - owned and state holding enterprises have not only eliminated losses but reaped great benefits , becoming an important force for stimulating national economic growth .
the proportion of state enterprise profits in the industry - wide profits rose from seven percent at the start of the year to around 20 percent .
a source pointed out that as a " breach " set by the central authorities in the reform and turnaround of state enterprises , the textile industry has not only made a turnaround one year ahead of time but has also yielded good economic returns in the first half of the year .
it carries important practical significance and plays an exemplary role , thereby further strengthening popular confidence in realizing the reform and turnaround of state enterprises .
in the first half of the year , the turnaround of state enterprises proceeded smoothly and attracted attention from economic circles .
in particular , the implementation of measures designed to exercise aggregate control , readjust the economic structure , close down " five kinds of small enterprises , " and eliminate the backward productive capacity has played an important role in pushing for a rebound in industrial efficiency .
while promoting the turnaround of enterprises , all localities and industries will further optimize the structure , change the mechanism , and strengthen management in order to lay a good foundation for the long - term reform and development of state enterprises .
success has been made in the restructuring of the metallurgy industry , with 225 small steel mills closing down one after another .
the textile industry is intensifying technological innovation with the aim of improving international competitiveness in textile linings . this will also enhance industrial competitiveness in the market .
stepping up restructuring and speeding technological progress have become the important means of fully increasing the efficiency of large and medium - sized state enterprises .
with six months to go before the completion of the three - year goal of turning around large and medium - sized state enterprises , all localities must keep sober - minded and continue to intensify the turnaround of state enterprises without the slightest relaxation of their efforts .

china 's privately - run enterprises developed during a shortage economy when demand was vigorous . at the time , quite a few enterprises latched onto one or two good products , took aim at a vacuum in the marketplace , went all out with marketing , and were able to achieve quick success .

the privately operated economy developed in gaps to which the state - owned economy paid no attention . there were some industrial sectors which the privately operated economy could not enter .
the 15 th congress of the chinese communist party in 1997 , and the fourth plenary session of the 15 th central committee of the chinese communist party in 1999 , rejected the soviet - style point of view that the greater the proportion of the national economy which is the state - owned economy , the better .
adjustments in the structure of regional economies present new opportunities development in the different economic regions of china is uneven .
this is definitely connected with the fact that at different times , different areas have had different ideas of the significance and role of developing the privately - run economy .
the first and fastest to develop were various provinces along the east coast . there , a transformation in point of view occurred as the degree of openness to the outside increased . policies there were relaxed , and the climate for development was excellent .
several decades of the practice of socialist economics have left some people with lingering fears about the development of the privately - run economy .
thus , relying on the spirit of the 15 th party congress and continuing to push forward a transformation in point of view , and continuing to promote an improvement in the sphere of public opinion , will facilitate further development in the privately - run economy . 2 .
the environment in which the privately - run economy is to develop awaits continued improvement .
considered from the point of view of ruling the country by law , the most important thing is the establishment and implementation of laws .
so further improvements are required . although there have been improvements in circumstances in which privately - run enterprises do not get fair treatment , such situations still persist . continued improvements are yet to be made .
privately - run enterprises all indicate that opportunities for financing and raising funds are unequal .
small and medium - sized privately - run enterprises in particular find it extremely difficult to get loans . a structure for loan guarantees is not everywhere to be found , and the scope of its services is narrow . the non - governmental funding structure is undeveloped . industrial and capital development cannot obtain financial capital support .
the tax burden for privately - run enterprise is heavy . many non - tax expenses are shared out . in some areas , rampant collection of fees and imposition of fines persists .
privately - run enterprises are subject to many controls on the use of land , the use of electricity , and entry to industrial sectors . the stage is small . therefore , improvement of the environment must continue . this will facilitate development in this new phase of history . 3 .
the quality of privately - run enterprises themselves awaits further improvement .
thus , these enterprises must adapt to the larger environment , and improve themselves .
this brings up the question of how to regard the family business system .
privately - run enterprises in their initial phase usually implement family - style , patriarchal management . they rely on family cohesiveness and pulling together to overcome the various difficulties associated with creating an enterprise .
the family business system frequently becomes a stumbling block . having contributed to the establishment of the enterprise , members of the family themselves feel content with the status quo .
in privately - run enterprises rests the hope for the development of the market economy in china . yesterday , our privately - run enterprises wrote a history of success in the establishment of enterprises , but glories of the past do not foretell the future .
our privately - run enterprises must take the initiative and say good - bye to the past . they must continually improve their own qualities . they must forge a glorious tomorrow through technical and management innovation .

the us defense department announced on 8 july that the us military conducted the third test on the interception technology of the proposed national missile defense system [ nmd ] , but the test failed .
the entire system is composed of seven parts , including high - and low - level infrared exploratory satellites , early warning radar , land - based interceptor missiles , and kill vehicles .
the pentagon found the cause of the failure of the third try .
but the cause of failure rather perplexed the us military : to sum up , the problem arose from an unexpected area .
at 0019 local time , the us military launched a " minuteman - ii " missile with a dummy warhead from vandenberg afb , california as an " incoming " enemy missile .
according to a plan , the us defense department needs to carry out three interception tests of the entire system prior to making the deployment ready review (drr) on the nmd system this june . two test successes are required to pass the drr .
after that , the clinton administration will decide whether to deploy the nmd system or not .
the decision will be primarily based on four factors ; namely , the degree of technological maturity of the nmd system , the existence of the threat posed by ballistic missiles to the us proper , the cost for research and development and for deployment , and the impact on arms control .
the failed second interception test on 18 january this year has undoubtedly impacted on the progress of the entire plan and the drr result , which further influenced the clinton administration 's deployment decision .
these moves have demonstrated that the us 's decision to develop and deploy the nmd system has not been affected in the slightest . despite the fact that the deployment timetable could be postponed due to the impact of the degree of technological maturity , its targets of development and deployment plan remain unchanged .
the us national interests of maintaining its sole - superpower status determine this .
as a measure to counter the republicans following his reelection , clinton changed it to " great possibility of the start of deployment in 2005 after he was reelected to the white house .
the total number of interceptor missiles will be increased to 200 - 250 . several bases will be built in other areas . at the end of this stage , some protection for 50 us states will be provided .
the scale of development and the number of deployments of the nmd system will vary in line with the us assessment of the degree of threat .
in a document forwarded to russia on revising the " anti - ballistic missile treaty , " the united states put forward the first deployment of 100 interceptor missiles on a nmd system base in alaska since the 100 interceptor missiles will at best intercept 20 - 25 relatively primitive facility - penetrating nuclear warheads .
if by 2015 the total number of missiles that pose a threat increases to 150 , it will be necessary to deploy a total of 750 interceptor missiles .
this is a practical return to the bush administration 's " small star wars plan , " namely , the development goal of the " national ballistic missile defense " system as put forward in the " global protection system to defend against limited attack . "
according to the plan worked out by the us defense department then , the total number of the defense targets would not exceed 200 .
since the clinton administration decided to develop the nmd system , the united states has invested $ 10.5 billion . this year it has decided to put in additional $ 2.2 billion , making the total spending on the nmd system $ 12.7 billion .
strong opposition from international society and divided domestic views the birth of the nmd has elicited strong opposition from international society , and opposition by russia has been most fierce .
therefore no sooner than the plan saw the light of day than russia had aggressively launched diplomatic efforts and expressed firm opposition to the us deployment of the tmd and nmd on the one hand , and on the other hand adopted a string of effective military measures .
in line with russian president putin 's order , russia has re - commissioned the tu-160 long distance strategic bombers .
russia is gradually implementing and revising and improving its military theories to counter the us strategic deterrence .
the us allies in europe that used to dance to the us tune also joined the ranks of opposition .
germany and france have all along opposed the nmd .

beijing , 10 jul ( xinhua ) - - the " liaowang " weekly , run by xinhua and distributed on 10 july , published hong jianjun 's article entitled " progress and prospects of nato 's eastward expansion . "
poland has already reduced its population of soldiers from 400,000 in the 1990 s to 233,000 at present . at the same time , hungary and czech republic have also cut down the number of their soldiers to 60,000 , respectively .
and , hungary plans to turn all its 60,000 soldiers into career soldiers by 2005 .
nato 's military authorities demanded that the three countries should , right after joining nato , give priority to improving their soldiers ' english ability in an effort to make them understand and become familiar with nato 's rules and procedures as soon as possible and enhance their coordinated operations and commanding capacity .
to this end , czech republic has already promulgated among its troops the regulation that a military officer must pass nato 's english test before being promoted .
now , all the pilots of hungary 's air force and 60 percent of the force 's ground personnel are receiving the middle - and high - level english training .
in poland , 12 percent of its soldiers , including 7,000 officers , have mastered appropriate english ability after the training .
to enhance the capacity of coordinating with the troops of other member countries , the three countries have frequently participated in the military exercises and overseas actions of nato .
in addition , the air forces of the three countries have also greatly increased the flight training hours in order to make their pilots familiar with and master nato 's air control system and execute nato 's " quick - reaction and early - warning " task as soon as possible .
the three countries have merged themselves to the defense affairs system of nato .
since 1991 , nato has carried out the strategic principle of " collective defense plus crisis handling " and has organized the quick reaction troops .
after joining nato , poland , czech republic , and hungary , respectively , dispatched a brigade to join the quick reaction army group of nato .
eastward expansion is a major step taken by the western countries , led by the united states , to weaken russia and expand nato 's superiority and strategic space .
to this end , the united states and other western countries have in recent years utilized political and economic means to drive a wedge between russia and its neighboring countries , to weaken the traditional influence of russia , and to make some countries deviate from russia .
leaders of the three baltic nations and georgia have also openly asked for joining nato .
after signing the " special partnership charter " with nato in 1997 , ukraine also expanded its military cooperation with nato and stepped up its tendency of inclining to the west .
what attracts our special attention is that nato general secretary robertson and us defense secretary cohen respectively visited the baltic nations of latvia and lithuania in march and june this year .
nato 's expansion to the former ussr region has posed an even grimmer situation to the security of russia .
the first round of nato 's eastward expansion has pushed nato 's defense line toward the boundary of russia by 700 to 900 kilometers .
nato 's fighters in the territory of poland already have the capacity of threatening russia 's important cities , such as st petersburg , murmansk , and kursk .
if baltic countries are admitted into nato , russia will lose all the buffer zones in its northwest frontiers and face directly to the military pressures of nato .
if nato deploys the early warning system in the air of these countries , the entire northwest region of russia will be under the surveillance of nato .
not long after robertson visited riga , the russia military declared that " its stance of opposing nato 's eastward expansion remains unchanged , and its army will adopt effective measures to cope with this threat . "
this fund will be primarily spent on the project of integrating the commanding , communication , liaison , and air defense systems of the three countries with the military system of nato and on the project of repairing and modernizing the major military bases and facilities of the three countries .
in fact , however , this fund cannot nearly meet the practical demands . as a result , nato cannot but ask its new member states to raise military expense by one to two fold , reaching the average level of nato .
as a result , the more such countries join nato , the heavier is the burden on the united states and europe , and nato 's operational capacity of " military integration " will be weakened greatly .
prospects of development in the future expanding the sphere of nato 's influence by reducing russia 's strategic space through geological expansion is the set principle of nato as well as a major part of the united states ' global strategy for the 21 st century .
the continued eastward expansion of nato will bring about tremendous economic benefits to the united states as well .
all the countries joining nato must renovate their armies according to nato 's standards . this will bring new markets to the munitions industry of the united states .
it was estimated that the replacement of fighters of the three new member states alone will cost $ 10 billion , and in the next 10 years , the three countries must each spend $ 300 million to $ 500 million at least on an average to buy munitions every year .
without doubt , the united states , that boasts the no . 1 munition producer in the world , will get most orders .
all these factors have decided the united states ' determination of continuously promoting nato 's eastward expansion and not excluding the possibility of admitting any european country , including the three baltic countries , into nato .
nato 's member countries in europe are basically identical to the united states in dealing with the eastward expansion issue , but they also have their own viewpoints in choosing new member countries and expanding the scale .
doubtlessly , west europe also hopes that nato 's boundary will expand eastward as far as possible so as to reduce and get rid of the potential threats from russia .

text of the article follows : over the last two months , debate among eu member countries over the future development model of europe 's unification has cropped up again .

what germany and france referred to as the " vanguard " of eu in fact is the " nucleus europe " viewpoint .

foreign minister of portugal , the chair country , expressed the hope that talks on " strengthening cooperation mechanism " would be separated from some countries ' wish to build a " strong core " and that member countries would not engage in dispute .
a few years ago , eu concentrated its energies on building a great internal market and an economic and monetary union , as well as on implementing a unified currency policy ; therefore , debate over the nature of eu 's future was put aside temporarily .
since euro was put into use last year , eu has quickened the step of implementing a common foreign policy and a common security and defense policy . currently , eu not only is working toward building a political union , but also the political union has begun to show a noticeable tendency of becoming a military group .
if it fails to carry out reform , it is completely possible that an expanded eu will be paralyzed .
these ideas became much controversial in europe at that time .
in order not to affect europe 's unification process , eu has adopted a rather ambiguous concept of the definition of its development model .
in may this year , german foreign minister fischer again proposed to establish a " nucleus europe , " causing a great disturbance among eu members .
france and germany had their own intentions in actively advocating establishment of a " nucleus europe " .
in particular , after eu is expanded , geographically germany will be in a central position ; so undoubtedly it will play a nucleus role .
in the last few years , the france - germany " engine " has not worked very well and has lost steam ; as such , europeans ' enthusiasm in unification has declined and their support for unification has weakened sharply .
while its final goal remains indefinite , eu has been busy implementing its ambitious expansion plan and internal reform . if the debate on " nucleus europe " is not properly dealt with , it might lead to a crisis which could affect europe 's unification process .

central people 's government , central military commission have in real earnest guaranteed enforcement of hong kong garrison law the hong kong garrison law is an important law , which was formulated in accordance with both the constitution and the hong kong sar basic law and has embodied the principle of " one country , two systems . "
the hong kong garrison law has defined in an explicit way the rights or responsibilities of the central authorities on such issues as the defense of the hong kong sar and the stationing of troops in the hong kong sar .
the central people 's government and the central military commission have attached a high degree of importance to and have taken forceful measures to guarantee in real earnest the enforcement of the hong kong garrison law .
the observance and enforcement of a law will first and foremost hinge on studying and understanding the law .
such regularized and systematized legal education has raised the legal quality of the officers and men of the hong kong garrison to a great extent and has laid a solid ideological foundation for consciously enforcing or carrying out the hong kong garrison law as well .
hong kong garrison stationed or managed troops or performed its duties in accordance with law , conscientiously abided by or enforced hong kong garrison law consciously abiding by a law is the key to enforcing a law .
the hong kong garrison law has clearly defined the relations between the garrison and the sar government .
the garrison has positively supported the sar government in its work but has never interfered with the matters within the sar autonomy .
in accordance with the decision of the npc standing committee and the provisions of the hong kong basic law , the chief executive of the hong kong sar published a public notice on 2 july 1997 , declaring that the hong kong garrison law and four other national laws shall be enforced in the hong kong sar .
after completing the relevant legal procedures , the hong kong garrison law came into force in hong kong .
in accordance with the decision of the npc standing committee , the hong kong sar government accelerated its work of adapting the laws previously in force in hong kong by giving priority to such a topic as adapting the laws pertaining to the garrison .
such legal measures taken by the sar government have provided a guarantee for the smooth enforcement of the hong kong garrison law in hong kong .
article 42 of the hong kong basic law stipulates : the hong kong residents and other persons in hong kong shall have the obligation to abide by the laws in force in the hong kong sar .
this has shown that the hong kong garrison law is a successful law . nevertheless , whether or not a law is truly successful should mainly be judged by what function or role it has played in the social life and by whether or not it has been enforced well .
since being enforced , the hong kong garrison law has played an important role in guaranteeing that the garrison shall perform its duties in accordance with the law ; in standardizing the relations between the garrison and the sar government ; in safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of the garrison ; and so on .
the practice of the garrison and the enforcement situation of the garrison law have fully borne out that hong kong garrison law is indeed a successful law , which marks a magnificent beginning in our country 's legislative history .
the opinion polls have reflected to a certain extent the judgment and wishes of the hong kong residents .
having served as a vanguard in building civilization and set a fine example in abiding by the law , the hong kong garrison has already become a model in managing our army in accordance with the law .

editor 's note : network - - a huge and invisible net , following the arrival of the information era , is extending toward every corner of the globe .
the network has created rapid development , and network economy , network culture , and network education . . . are now like surging tides [ ellipses as received ] .
what are the typical characteristics of network warfare ?
can we win the network warfare of tomorrow ?
to answer these series of questions , it will not help to rely on the speculation of ideas and impulsive feeling . what we need is a fervent concern and cool thinking .
these achievements are very good inspirations in our in - depth study of the network warfare .
there are new computer terminal users who log on to the internet every day , every hour , and every minute .
in 1946 , the world 's first computer was made . it was only used as a tool for ballistic missile computation at that time .
however , when the number of computers increased with each passing day , and when the computers were linked together through circuits , servers , and routers , and possessed a certain topological structure , the internet began to take shape .
in 1969 , the us military 's arpanet was the first to be formed .
by 1990 s , particularly in the later half , the internet entered an exceptionally rapid development period and gradually linked the whole globe into a huge network .
the " explosive " growth of internet users has resulted in its presence in every corner of the world .
the military and civilian networks are moving toward integration .
although this has brought some impact to the security of the military networks to a certain extent , generally speaking , the overall efficiency of the system has been enhanced .
therefore , only a very small number of core portions of military networks of various countries is completely independent , the remaining networks are linked up with civilian networks through various methods .
strategic , operation , and tactical networks are moving toward integration .
integration will be the inevitable end - result of the network development .
the network world is not peaceful as open or secret network confrontations have always occurred with the development of networks .
in april 1999 , us newsweek disclosed that clinton approved a top secret plan by the central intelligence agency : using computer hackers to break into foreign bank accounts of federal republic of yugoslavia president milosevic and other yugoslav leaders to undermine their government .
the tentacles of military confrontation have extended to the network area , and the struggle in the world of virtual networks first emerged in the kosovo war .
on 29 march last year , yugoslav and russian computer experts successively broke into the white house website , rendering the website inoperative on that day .
the mail server of us marines that contain operation information was practically blocked by the " melissa " virus .
the command control system of us aircraft carrier " nimitz " was also forced to suspend for more than three hours because of hacking .
the openness and security nature of networks are two contradictions that can never be thoroughly resolved .
to military networks , as long as they have the slightest link with civilian networks , there is the possibility of being broken into by enemies via civilian networks .
with a phone , we can enter into the limitless network world .
when mobile phones are used in network confrontation , the border line between a " mobile phone " and a " trigger " will be even more indistinct . the " mobile phone " will be more frightening than the " trigger . "
in fact , network warfare in a broad sense has emerged long ago and is being conducted around us all the time . on the other hand , network warfare in the narrow sense , the network warfare in the military field , strictly speaking , has not truly emerged yet .
in network confrontation , there will be no use of swords , gunfires , or vehicles . the release of virus , theft of data , ignition of network bombs can be done in an instant . the task can be carried out without leaving a trace .
in network warfare , the action is fast and the time is short . before the enemy can find out , the network action has been completed .
only a click is needed for supporting the front with networks .
this has changed the traditional method of supporting the front with centralized personnel and material resources . it is the pooling together of technical skills and wisdom , and accomplishing the goal through moving the computer mouse in the internet .

chapter iii taxation policy article 5 the state encourages the development and production of software products in the country .
article 6 software enterprises that are set up in our country shall enjoy the preferential income tax policy for enterprises .
newly established software enterprises that have been verified can enjoy the preferential policy of " two - year tax exemptions and three - year 50 - percent tax reductions " on the enterprises ' income taxes beginning from the fiscal year they record profits .
article 7 key software enterprises that are under state planning but did not enjoy preferential tax exemptions in those years shall be levied a reduced enterprise income tax of 10 percent .
article 11 support shall be given to the joint establishment of research and development centers by domestic enterprises , scientific research institutes , institutions of higher learning , and foreign enterprises .
the ministry of foreign affairs and relevant departments shall draw up relevant specific methods .
article 16 methods of foreign - exchange administration that suit the characteristics of software trade shall be adopted .
foreign trade , customs , and foreign exchange administration methods that differ from other products shall be used for exporting software products according to the characteristics of software products trade ( including software - packaging processing ) , so that the needs of software enterprises to engage in the international commercial activities can be fulfilled .
chapter vi income distribution policy article 18 software enterprises can make their own decisions about the total salaries and salary scale in the enterprises in line with the relevant state laws and statutes , and based on the enterprises ' economic returns and average social salaries .
article 19 incentive mechanisms for income distributions among science - and - technology personnel in software enterprises shall be established to encourage enterprises to handsomely reward science - and - technology personnel who make outstanding contributions .
patented and non - patented technologies brought into the enterprises by groups or individuals can be directly valued in the enterprises and converted into shares for allocation .
we shall gradually include software and computer application knowledge in the scope of evaluation when assessing engineering and technical personnel for technical posts .
( 3 ) the state bureau of foreign experts and ministry of education shall jointly set up special funds to support high - level software science research personnel who pursue advanced studies abroad , and to hire foreign software experts to lecture and work in china .
article 24 we shall implement the strategy of globalization of qualified personnel to attract domestic and foreign software technical personnel to set up software enterprises in the country .
chapter viii purchasing policy article 25 domestic enterprises shall take precedence over others in undertaking state - invested major engineering projects and key application systems , and chinese - produced software systems shall be preferentially used under the condition of parity of performance and prices .
chapter vix confirmation system for software enterprises article 28 the confirmation standard for software enterprises shall be drawn up by the ministry of information technology and telecom industries , together with the ministry of education , ministry of science and technology , state administration of taxation , and other departments .
enterprises that fail their annual evaluation shall lose their qualifications as software enterprises , and shall cease to enjoy relevant preferential policy .
article 30 software industry associations or relevant associations at or above the prefectural ( or city ) level , and that are authorized by the departments in charge of information technology and telecom industries at a higher level , shall assume the specific responsibility of organizing the confirmation and annual evaluation of software enterprises .
article 31 the ministry of information technology and telecom industries , and the state bureau of quality and technical supervision will be responsible for drawing up a national standard for software products .
chapter x intellectual property rights protection article 32 departments of copyright administration under the state council shall standardize and strengthen the software copyrights registration system , encourage copyrights registration for software , and provide key protection for registered software according to state laws .
article 33 to protect the legitimate rights and interests of chinese and foreign copyright holders , all units are not allowed to use unauthorized software products in their computer systems .
article 34 we shall intensify crackdowns on smuggled and pirated software , and strictly investigate and handle activities that organize the manufacturing , production , and sales of pirated software .
beginning in the lower half of 2000 , the ministry of public security , ministry of information technology and telecom industries , state administration of industry and commerce , state intellectual property office , state copyright administration , and state administration of taxation will regularly carry out special struggle to jointly crack down on pirated software .
article 36 departments in charge of information technology and telecom industries shall fully enhance the roles of software industry associations in market surveys , information exchanges , consultations and evaluations , industrial self - discipline , intellectual property rights protection , confirmation of qualities , and policy research , and promote healthy development of the software industry .
article 37 association members shall jointly bear the costs of activities conducted by the software industry associations , but the financial authorities may provide moderate support upon submission of application by the departments in charge .
article 39 the output value and export volume of software products shall be included in the jurisdictions of relevant state statistics , and will be listed independently in the it industry catalogue .
chapter xii policy for ic industry article 40 enterprises inside and outside china shall be encouraged to set up joint - venture and wholly foreign - owned ic manufacturing enterprises inside china .
article 42 preferential taxation policy that encourages foreign businesses to invest in energy and communications is applicable to ic manufacturing enterprises that fulfill one of the following requirements : ( 1 ) more than 8 billion yuan renminbi investment ; and ( 2 ) ic with thickness of less than 0.25 microns .
article 43 customhouses will provide customs - clearance convenience to the manufacturing enterprises that fulfill the stipulations in article 42 .
the specific method will be formulated by the general administration of customs .
article 44 tariffs and import - linked vat shall be exempted for manufacturing - related raw and semifinished materials and consumable goods that are imported for their own use by manufacturing enterprises that fulfill the stipulations in article 42 .
article 46 the shortest depreciation life span for manufacturing equipment in ic manufacturing enterprises shall be three years .
article 49 departments that examine and approve ic projects shall confirm ic enterprises after soliciting the opinions of taxation departments at the same level .
article 50 ic design products shall be regarded as software products , and shall fall under the legal protection of intellectual property rights .
the state encourages assessment and registration of ic design products .
article 51 the ic design industry is regarded as a software industry on which relevant policy on software industry is applicable .
chapter xiii supplementary articles article 52 any software or ic enterprises that are set up in our country shall enjoy these policies regardless of their ownership .
article 53 these policies shall take effect on the day of promulgation .

in its part , hong kong enjoys its special status as a special administrative region .
under the " one country , two systems " arrangement , hong kong enjoys full autonomy in handling its economic , trade , financial , and banking affairs .
under the hong kong basic law , the hong kong dollar can be freely convertible , hong kong sets no foreign exchange controls , and hong kong still can maintain its status as a free port and an independent tariff zone .
this shows that , the effects of china 's wto membership notwithstanding , shanghai will not replace hong kong . instead , the two places will work closely together and support each other . like performers working together in beijing opera , it appears that the best shows will be coming soon .

a recent national conference on grain production and circulation reiterated that it is necessary to further reform and improve the grain circulation system and to resolutely purchase peasants ' surplus grain at protective prices and without limitations while vigorously readjusting and optimizing the agricultural structure and effectively protecting the peasants ' interests .
increasing peasants ' incomes is a matter concerning the overall situation ; it has a bearing not only on the development of the rural economy and social stability but on the expansion of domestic demand and the smooth development of the national economy as a whole .
first , it is necessary to increase the gain risk fund and to solve the problem of unavailable financial subsidies that are supposed to be available .
purchasing peasants ' surplus grain at protective prices and without limitations is bound to increase the stock of grain and enterprises ' losses ; if financial subsidies are not increased correspondingly , such enterprise will not be able to purchase peasants ' surplus grain without limitations .
various localities should take measures to prevent the grain risk fund from withholding from level to level and to ensure that the financial subsides are available on time and in full .
second , it is necessary to continue to build additional granaries for grain reserves to solve the problem of inadequate storage facilities .
the state has decided to build granaries capable of storing 10 billion kilograms of grain this year and the next .
all localities must firmly do this job well and ensure the quality of such construction projects .
peasants should be guided to eliminate the grain varieties that are unsalable in the market and to increase the output of marketable , special grain varieties .
second , efforts should be made to optimize the structure of the agricultural industry .
in addition , it is essential to optimize the distribution of agriculture and grain production .
the basic way to increase peasants ' income is to expedite the strategic readjustment of agriculture and the rural economy , but this will take some time to achieve actual results .
now it is all the more urgent to give more to the peasants , to ask for less from them , to effectively lighten their burdens so that they will get a chance to rest and build up their strength .
lightening peasants ' burdens will enable them to gain more material benefits and constitutes an increase in income for them .

wen jiabao stressed : water is the lifeblood of man 's survival as well as the lifeline of agriculture and economic construction as a whole .
the " research on china 's strategy for the sustainable development of water resources " is a major comprehensive consulting project conducted by the chinese academy of engineering .
after more than a year of intense work by 43 academicians and nearly 300 experts outside the academy , they came up with nine reports on special topics and a comprehensive report and achieved a number of major research results .
from now on , we must be clear about our orientation , be determined to do solid work , and improve the efficiency of water use in our country in connection with the modernization of agriculture and urban and rural construction .
wen jiabao fully affirmed the research results achieved by experts and expressed thanks to the academicians and experts for their hard work .
wen jiabao said : academicians and relevant experts have all along been very concerned about the problem of water resources .
the research report is full of new meanings and objects and deepens the understanding of the problem of our country 's water resources .
various relevant departments under the state council should earnestly study experts ' suggestions and fully adopt their opinions in practical work .
wen jiabao pointed out : we should be broader in thinking and deepen our understanding of the problem of water resources .
first , we should take water conservancy facilities as the strategic focus of economic and social development .
on the basis of scientific plans , we should construct water conservancy projects in a down - to - earth manner and step up the efforts to build such projects with the increase of our national strength .
whether china can better solve the problem of water resources depends on economizing on water and on improving the utilization ratio of water resources .
our country is short of water resources on one hand , but the waste of water resources is serious on the other ; so there is a great potential for saving on water .
third , we should be firmly determined to tackle the problem of water pollution .
this problem is getting more and more serious , bringing tremendous harms to the ecological environment and people 's health and aggravating the shortage of water resources .
fourth , a comprehensive consideration should be given to the building of a ecological environment and the use of water resources , and overall planning should be made for both of them .
ecological construction cannot be carried out without water resources , and the latter are a prerequisite and the basis for the former .
meanwhile , ecological construction must be conducive to the sustainable use of water resources .
second , we should adopt new ideas and give priority to saving on water . this is not only an immediate but also a long - term requirement .
it is necessary to encourage people and take effective measures to economize on water in industry , agriculture , cities , and rural areas as well as in production and daily life .
unremitting effort should be made to encourage people to further strengthen their concept of saving on water , to achieve breakthroughs in the application of water - saving techniques and the formation of a water - saving mechanism , and to raise the water - saving work to a new level .
wen jiabao said : we should be on the alert against a sudden change of drought or flooding for the worse and be prepared against serious flooding .
since the beginning of the flood season this year , torrential rain has fallen frequently in some areas , and flooding has successively occurred along huai he , zhu jiang , and chang jiang , and the work of flood control has entered a critical stage .
while doing a good job in the work of flood control along major rivers , we should also do well in flood control along medium and small rivers and in preventing natural disasters in mountain areas and pay close attention to reservoirs ' riding over the flood season .
we should be especially vigilant against unexpected disasters caused by torrential rains , typhoons , or mud - rock flows , give first priority to the safety of people 's lives , and reduce the losses of flood to the minimum .
song jian , vice chairman of the cppcc national committee and president of the chinese academy of engineering , attended the meeting .

in 1976 , taiwan 's chungshan science institute established the ching feng project control center .
according to the goal of the center , the range of its ching feng missiles was designed to reach 300 kilometers . the missiles were test fired seven times in the ta peng base in pingtung county , and , in a test firing , an " all - purpose missile " hit the target .
the " tien ma project " was designed for the development of medium - range ground - to - ground missiles with a range of 1,000 kilometers .
