what was the consensus of 1992 ?
the lee teng - hui era in taiwan has ended , and a new leader has mounted the stage .
what in fact was the 1992 consensus of the two associations on the one china principle ?
meeting in hong kong in november 1992 , the two associations reached a consensus that " the two sides of the strait both uphold the one china principle " with each side giving its respective interpretation in the form of verbal statement .
regarding the connotation of one china , the sef stated that " each side has its different understanding , " while the arats stated that " routine talks " do not involve this .
the one china principle is related to china 's sovereignty back in the 1980 's , deng xiaoping specifically pointed out to britain 's mrs. thatcher during negotiations on the hong kong issue : " sovereignty issues are not open to discussion . "
it absolutely cannot be discussed as an " agenda . "
the one china principle that we speak of here does not say that " the one china is the prc , " thus expressing the motherland 's tremendous goodwill and sincerity .
emphasizing the one china principle is for the purpose of peaceful consultation .
the taiwan issue is left over from the kmt - cpc civil war , that is , it is caused by a civil war that has not ended .
many other problems can be peacefully and rationally settled one by one within the framework of one china .
if this can be accomplished , there will be genuine cross - strait " goodwill and reconciliation , active cooperation , and lasting peace . "
otherwise , there cannot be .
comrade jiang zemin said that the key to handling china 's affairs well is with the party .
this is the profound theoretical gift of the chinese communist party to the new millennium .
we must not forget our forefathers !
on the other hand , he also repeatedly pointed out that the current world situation is changing with each day and one cannot be a true marxist without moving forward with new ideology and viewpoints and developing marxism .
it was often discussed from the point of view of the relationship between class and party and the masses . many emphasized that " the chinese communist party is the vanguard of the chinese working class , the true representative of the interests of all the chinese people " .
this is not incorrect , but as we go forward into the new century , the country 's outside environment and self - image have seen tremendous changes , and china is facing new opportunities and serious challenges for which new additions are needed .
as a result , understanding of the advanced nature of the party must have general requirements as well as special requirements related to the specific historical tasks of the party during each period .
with respect to the traditional " one represent " , the ideology of the " three represents " has a more modern spirit and is better able to explain the completeness of the party 's advanced nature .
the ideology of the " three represents " is put forward from the point of view of strengthening party building , but it is not merely a party building theory .
comrade jiang zemin 's speech represented a new way of thinking and a new point of view in keeping with the times . it is a theory that takes overall responsibility for the great cause of building socialism with chinese characteristics .
the " three represents " ideology has put forward the newest summation of the past 80 years of the party 's construction history with regard to the new understanding of the party 's advanced nature .
why was the chinese communist party established ?
because following the opium wars , china had become a semi - colonial , semi - feudal nation . invasion by the big imperialist powers and domination by feudal reactionary forces weakened and impoverished china pushing it to the edge of destruction .
in order to pursue national independence , liberation of the people , national strength , and social prosperity , worthy chinese people advanced wave upon wave and bravely struggled , but none were able to achieve success .
at the beginning of the 20 th century , as a result of the new cultural movement and the russian october revolution , a group of patriotic and progressive intellectuals accepted marxist theory which represented advanced culture and a forward direction .
they penetrated the industrial working masses that represented the advanced productive force , propagated revolutionary theory , and combined the two . the result was the birth of the chinese communist party .
the fatal weakness of the old democratic revolution ultimately was the lack of " three represents " leadership strength which prevented its victory .
the task of the chinese communist party leadership of the new democratic revolution was very clear - - in view of the fact that china was a large semi - colonial , semi - feudal state , " two paths " needed to be defined if the party 's struggle objectives were to be realized .
first , national independence and liberation of the people had to be achieved - - this was the biggest liberation of the productive force and required opposition of the imperialist and feudal military forces as well as unification of the petty bourgeoisie and the national bourgeoisie classes to establish a broad , united revolutionary battlefront .
under the correct ideological leadership , the party brought about the first nationalist - communist alliance and launched a strong worker - peasant revolutionary movement , took party in leading the northern expedition , and enabled the first victory in the domestic revolution .
there were some errors during certain periods of the revolution 's journey regarding the lines , principles , policies , and strategies .
the 29 year period from the establishment of the new china until the party 's 11 th plenum of the third central committee was the second major phase of the chinese communist party 's 80 year history .
the first issue was well resolved , but the second was not .
first was to thoroughly build on the remarkable successes achieved by the new democracy in accordance with mao zedong 's new democratic theory during the first three years following the founding of the people 's republic .
next was to carry out socialist transformation of agriculture , the handicraft industry , and capitalist industry in accordance with the overall transitional line put forward by the party during the large - scale launch of industrial construction .
the basic socialist system hand been initially established at that time .
the party 's eighth national congress drew accurate inferences regarding the principal contradictions chinese society and the country 's principal tasks .
following the eighth national congress , a new series of principles and ideas imbued with creative spirit - - including destroying capitalism while still being able to have capitalism - - was put forward with the publication of mao zedong 's " regarding correct handling of the problem of people 's internal contradictions " in 1957 .
the healthy development of the economy and society during the eight years following the establishment of the new china were the living embodiment of the party as the true representative of the requirements for development of china 's advanced social productive force .
for these reasons , a party rectification movement and the " three anti 's " campaign were launched not long after the country 's establishment , and group of corrupt elements were eliminated . the party 's serious resolve was manifested through the serious punishment of the corruption of liu qingshan and zhang zishan .
this was a good start , but it could not guarantee that the development process of building socialism would all be smooth sailing .
the party 's understanding of the rules of revolution was clear and was not as quickly grasped as the rules for construction .
these were : the three years of the " great leap forward " and the people 's communization movement , and the ten year of the " cultural revolution " .
this tortuous process illustrated that the issues of building socialism had not been resolved .
what then is the relationship between this tortuous period of history and the " three represents " ?
in mao zedong 's eyes , subjectively he undoubtedly wanted to speed up development of the productive force and uphold marxism .
what , however , are the requirements for development of an advanced productive force and the direction for forging ahead of advanced culture ?
how are these things accomplished ?
in theory , he did not make this clear .
the original intention in launching the " great leap forward " and the people 's communization movement was to promote major development of the productive force .
the original intention in launching the " cultural revolution " was to bring about healthy development of the socialist cause and enable the party to represent the basic interests of the chinese people with even more faithfully .
the third major phase of the party 's 80 year history continues for the past 20 - odd years from the 11 th plenum of the third central committee at the end of 1978 until now .
seeing that the basic reason for past mistakes lies with the serious faults in handling some issues due to the lack of full clarification of what socialism is and how it should be constructed , resolution of this problem has become and will continue to become the main theme of the new era of modern socialist construction .
these three big transformations were the basic content of the 11 th plenum of the third central committee along with the present path set forth of upholding four basic principles .
for the first time , this theory systematically responded to the series of basic issues in building socialism with chinese characteristics and brought about the second historical leap in integrating basic marxist principles with china 's specific reality .
for more than 20 years now under the guidance of the deng xiaoping theory , china has seen enormous , earth - shaking changes and entered another resurgent , flourishing age in the history of the chinese nation .
looking back on the party 's 80 year history , it is not difficult to see that , even though there have been various faults during the third major phase , there have not been such big setbacks and reversals as there were in the previous two phases .
comparatively speaking , the people have had far fewer sacrifices , and the country has seen far fewer vacillations .
when all is said and done , the ideology of the " three represents " cannot be left out .
v. comrade jiang zemin 's clear cut advancement of the " three represents " ideology is not by chance .
the key to being able to correctly answer the new international and domestic problems and handle china 's circumstances well is with the party .
each aspect of deng xiaoping theory needs to be enriched and developed in practice .
in reality , some aspects of it have already been greatly enriched and developed .
more important , however , is the question of party building .
comrade deng xiaoping 's response to the question of what socialism is profoundly revealed the basic nature of socialism and opened up new boundaries for understanding socialism .
it can also be said that comrade jiang zemin 's response to the question of building what kind of party profoundly revealed the party 's basic nature and raised new boundaries for understanding the party .
china 's development cannot be separated from the rest of the world , and building socialism with chinese characteristics cannot be separated from the rest of the world .
- - it has embodied the innovative consciousness in keeping with the times .
the development of science and technology is changing with each passing day in today 's world , replacement of knowledge is accelerating with an unprecedented rhythm , and the flowing together of various ideological cultures is even more acute .
both the demands for development of an advanced productive force and the forward direction of advanced culture represent a spirit of the times .
for the communist party to act as the vanguard of organization , it must have innovative consciousness and a spirit of keeping with the times , otherwise it will lose its advanced nature .
- - it has embodied the steadfast belief in vigorous reform - - " reform is the device that will decide china 's fate " .
similarly , various specific party systems also need to be reformed .
- - it has embodied the rousing spirit of china .
more than 100 years ago , sun zhongshan made a call for " rousing china " .
the guomindang party that he formed , however , could not shoulder this task .
only with the communist party were there expectations of not shouldering this important task .
sun zhongshan wanted to rouse china , and mao zedong and deng xiaoping hoped even more to rouse china .
the " three represents " put forward by comrade jiang zemin is the party 's strong ideological weapon for striding into the new century .
we must continue to hold high the great banner of the deng xiaoping theory , work hard to study and carry out the important ideology of the " three represents " , and bring about the glorious resurgence of the chinese nation in the new century .

china has made great achievements in tibetan studies over the past 50 years and has established the guiding position of marxism - leninism - mao zedong thought and deng xiaoping theory in tibetan studies . it has also established a fairly systematic and complete system for research , publication and personnel training in tibetan studies .
there are over 50 research institutions for tibetan studies and over 2,000 people engaged in tibetan studies in the whole country . together they have scored numerous achievements . " the home of tibetan studies is in china " has become the consensus in chinese and foreign tibetan studies circles .
what was tibet like before its peaceful liberation in 1951 ?
facts have fully proved that the fine traditional culture of tibet has been properly protected and taken over since the establishment of new china and has been carried forward and developed in the new era .
reporter : spoken and written languages are important carriers of cultural legacies . what is the present situation in the study and use of the tibetan language in tibet ?
for example , there was not a single tibetan newspaper , radio station or tv station in the whole of tibet before liberation . now there are 24 tibetan newspapers and magazines . the tibetan edition of xizang ribao ( tibet daily ) has a daily circulation of 16,000 copies .
tibet people 's radio broadcasts 14.5 hours of tibetan language programs a day and tibetan - language programs of the tibet television station are aired 12 hours a day via satellite .
a bilingual education system with the tibetan language as the principal medium of instruction is enforced throughout tibet . tibetan language teaching materials and teaching references for primary up to senior middle schools have been compiled , translated and published .
the university of tibet has trained nearly 1,000 junior middle school tibetan language teachers since 1989 .

tang jiaxuan said that the chinese delegation 's official visit to bulgaria , germany , luxembourg , the netherlands , italy , belgium , and the eu headquarters was an important diplomatic action of china with regard to europe at the turn of the century .
during the visit , premier zhu held talks and meetings with the main leaders of these countries and the eu , made extensive contacts with industrial , business , and financial circles , held a thorough and frank exchange of views on issues of common concern , and discussed great schemes for promoting the development of bilateral relations .
the atmosphere of the visit was good , and everywhere the chinese delegation went , the masses often spontaneously waved in welcome .
during the meetings and talks , even on issues involving differences , both sides chatted calmly and frankly and expressed the spirit of mutual respect and seeking common ground while reserving differences .
this fully expressed the great enhancement of china 's international status and the ever - increasing importance attached to china 's international role under the leadership of the cpc central committee with comrade jiang zemin as the core .
a total of 13 economic , cultural , and legal accords were signed with various countries during the visit .
premier zhu exchanged views with national leaders on major issues including a number of sensitive issues .
for instance , on the taiwan issue , on various occasions he explained china 's principles and policies on settling the taiwan issue and deepened the understanding of these countries regarding this issue .

he met individual leading industrialists and businessmen on 12 occasions and made five speeches to industrialists and businessmen .
in addition he visited and inspected a number of representative enterprises and projects and enhanced his understanding of economic development in the countries visited .
fourth , the impact was good .

the visit spanned east , central , and west europe and included both large and medium and small countries .

standing on the threshold of the wto ( world trade organization ) , we must have a sober understanding of the fact that the wto will present opportunities as well as challenges and pros as well as cons , and the key is how we respond .
but these things alone are not enough .
joining the wto means that the degree to which china 's economy is blended into the international economy will gradually rise .
in addition , the wto has one important basic principle , namely , " gradual liberalization , " which requires each member country to gradually open its markets , including the financial markets .
in addition to altering foreign exchange receipts and disbursements , the wto will also pose new challenges for china 's monitoring of foreign exchange , which will be reflected in the following several areas : 1 .
naturally , wto membership will pose new demands for china 's local and foreign currency money market regulation capabilities .
and it is also precisely for this reason that it was only at the end of 1996 that china opened up rmb convertibility with regard to current account transactions , while still maintaining exchange controls on capital account transactions .
obviously , exchange transactions form the basis for stability in the rmb exchange rate and foreign exchange reserves .
as a foreign exchange management department , faced with this confused flow of foreign exchange funds , we must understand the direction and quantity of this flow , making it a priority in establishing a real - time , accurate , sensitive monitoring network to grasp market / fund trends .
accordingly , we should do more in exploring economic methods that are suited to the governing rules of economics , studying the linkage effects of various policy tools and utilizing the central bank 's monetary policy tools to intervene in and regulate the local and foreign currency money markets .
this is an inevitable challenge that will be faced by the foreign exchange management authorities and the central bank under the new situation , and is also necessary to maintain a stable rmb exchange rate , the level of the state 's foreign exchange reserves , and the international balance of payments .

the existing system of arms control agreements is complicated and fragile ; once some important part is weakened , the entire system becomes unstable . if the anti - ballistic missile treaty crumbles , then all disarmament treaties concluded over the past 30 years will be put in jeopardy .
the commander in chief of russian strategic rocket forces yakovlev warned recently that , if the united states deployed the nmd system , russia might develop medium - and intermediate - range missiles once again .
russia would have absolutely no difficulty in deploying medium - range missiles again . it could use existing technology for producing the means of delivery , which is much more economical than manufacturing intercontinental ballistic missiles .
in order to counter the us nmd system , russia might once again develop intercontinental ballistic missiles with multiple warheads .
in this case , the already unreliable us missile defense system would be rendered even more unreliable .

" fighting a decisive battle offshore " invites criticisms recently , the words " fighting a decisive battle offshore " have generated a lot of heated discussions on the taiwan island .
it began when the new leader of the taiwan authorities flung a new military strategic concept of so - called " fighting a decisive battle offshore " while attending a military gathering .
his remark immediately stirred up great controversy on the island .
" fighting an offshore decisive battle " has a broad political meaning . it refers to sending military force to enemy lands .
the taiwan military does not have the ability nor is it making such a plan .
the taiwan military was also quick to indicate that it did not have a plan to wage battles on the mainland , and was certainly not developing ground - to - ground missiles .
how does the concept of " fighting a decisive battle offshore " come about ?
the strategic concept of " tenacious defense and effective deterrence " was changed to " effective deterrence and tenacious defense . "
on the surface , the two differ only in the order of words . but , in actual fact , the latter has a significantly stronger meaning of taking the initiative to wage a battle .
according to the taiwan military 's account , it was a change from being passive to becoming active .
less than a month after assuming power , the new leader of the taiwan authorities already put forth the strategic concept of so - called " fighting a decisive battle offshore " while attending the graduation ceremony of the " army academy " on 16 june .
what that means is , the taiwan authorities are attempting to shift the battlefield westward from the central line of the strait and even onto the mainland .
wishful thinking out of touch with reality in putting forth the concept of " fighting a decisive battle offshore , " what the taiwan authorities counted on was none other than those weapons and equipment bought from foreign countries at hefty prices .
in recent years , although the taiwan military has bought quite a number of advanced weaponry and now owns approximately 400 warplanes and nearly 20 medium - sized warships .
yet to rely on these things to " fight a decisive battle offshore " is tantamount to using an egg to hit a rock .
furthermore , since the taiwan military relies mainly on foreign procurement for its weaponry supply , what happens with regard to these " foreign magical weapons " can only be : one plane down is one plane short , and one vessel sunk is one vessel short , with no possibility whatsoever for large - scale replacement .
once the " three axes " are used up , there is hardly anything to sustain the battle .
so what means are there to fight the third stage of battle ? such a battle ideology contradicts the taiwan military 's overall strategic guiding ideology of " long - lasting strategy and quick tactics . "
covered by an air unit and warships , our special combat force personnel rapidly withdrew from the scene by transportation plane .
a transportation regiment of the air force focused its efforts on ensuring flights and conducted training strictly according to its plan .
a naval base took the initiative in providing a site for diving training with experts and key technicians sent for on - the - spot guidance .
during coordinated training , the special forces unit took the initiative in serving as a " grindstone " for fraternal units to experiment some new anti - special - operations courses , from which both sides benefited much .

beijing , 16 july ( xinhua ) - - china 's state - owned enterprises ( soes ) have shown a great upward turn in their quest to reform and move out of difficulties .
according to the newest statistics , of 6,599 soes and state - controlled large and medium sized enterprises which had been losing money , currently 3,463 have managed to get out of their difficulties , accounting for 52.5 percent of such firms .
a group of soes with the ability to change rapidly , and with good levels of management and good business results , have constantly moved ahead resolutely .
looking at the results by industry , of the 14 targeted industries , apart from coal and military works , the others all showed profits .
from january through may , soes and state - controlled industrial enterprises posted a profit of 69.2 billion yuan , an increase of 3.1 percent over the same period last year .
at the same time , a group of large and medium - sized soes have burst forth from their shells , maintaining good prospects for development .
shanghai 's baogang group corporation gained the most of the benefits of reorganization , and has seen its corporate efficiency improve day by day .
hubei qingjiang hydroelectric power company promoted the " owner responsibility , integrated construction and management , development of flow areas , and rolling development " to create a better economic efficiency .
anyang color picture tubes company incessantly strengthened its innovative abilities , and its products now enjoy a 45 percent domestic market share .
sheng huaren said that the success of these large and medium - sized soes was one more step in increasing the confidence of the cadres and the masses in doing a good job on soes .
li lanqing , member of the cpc central committee political bureau standing committee and vice premier of the state council , also visited the exhibition .
at present , the efficiency of many war industry enterprises is not high . an important cause to this is that they are restrained by the traditional ideas of the planned economy and before they produced products for civilian use , they had not properly conducted market survey or feasibility study .
after such projects were put into operation , it was difficult to sell the products and they had to carry a heavy burden .
only in this way , shall we be able to increase the strength for national defense .
departments for producing goods for civilian use that have undertaken tasks of war industries should give priority to such tasks .
wu bangguo , zou jiahua , zhu guangya , hu qili , zhou tienong , and comrades responsible for relevant departments also visited the exhibition .

the three - day us - dprk missile talks held in kuala lumpur , the capital of malaysia , came to a close on july 12 .
the talks centered on north korea 's export of missile technology .
north korea demanded us $ 1 billion a year from the united states as compensation for stopping its export of missile technology .
the two countries had their first meeting on the missile question in berlin in april 1996 to discuss north korea 's development and export of missiles and missile technology . however , no agreement was reached at that meeting .
the recent kuala lumpur meeting was the latest round of missile talks between the two countries after a lapse of 16 months .
in recent years , the dprk missile question has become a prominent issue that is followed with interest by washington .
the united states has all along been accusing north korea of developing missiles and missile technology .
us intelligence agencies believe that north korea has developed the scud and nodong medium - range missiles with a range of 340 - 2,200 kilometers and is developing the daepodong medium - to - long range missile .
north korea announced its launching of a man - made earth satellite on august 31 , 1998 .
at the same time , the united states accused north korea of exporting missiles or missile technology to countries like iran and pakistan , and even suspected that the missiles with a range of over 1,500 kilometers launched by these countries were made with the help of north korean missile technology .
the united states raised this question on the basis of a control regime established in 1987 to restrict the export of missile technology .
about 30 countries have joined this regime to restrict the development and export of missiles with a range of over 300 kilometers and a payload of over 500 kilograms , as well as relating new technologies .
in a meeting of representatives at the vice minister level in berlin last september , north korea promised to freeze its plan for the testing of long - range missiles while the united states announced the partial lifting of 50 - year economic sanctions against north korea in return .
the north koreans emphasize that they develop missiles for self - defense and that us allegations of " a north korean missile threat " is totally groundless .
chang ch ' ang - ch ' un , director of the us affairs department of the dprk foreign ministry , representing the north korean side , emphasized that the united states posed a threat to north korean security with its deployment of thousands of missiles in east asia .
the two sides carried out some bargaining in their discussion of the question of north korea 's export of missiles and missile technology .
the us side insisted that north korea should abide by the missile technology parameters and stop its export of missiles and missile technology .
it suggested that north korea could stop the export of missile technology if the united states agreed to provide the country with us $ 1 billion a year as compensation .
the us side did not accept such terms of compensation .
when the kimchangri " underground nuclear facilities " triggered another us - dprk confrontation in 1999 , the two sides again came to an agreement through negotiations .
the united states was allowed to carry out inspections at the kimchangri underground facilities , and promised to provide north korea with potato seeds and potato cultivation techniques .
the us - dprk missile talks will ultimately be resolved one way or another , but that will depend on what kind of compromise they are willing to make outside the missile issue .

beijing , 17 jul ( xinhua ) - - main statistics released recently by a relevant state department on macroeconomic operations show : in the first half of this year , china 's national economy saw the trend of full recovery , with faster economic growth and gdp growth reaching 8.2 percent .
inflation also went down from 21.7 percent in 1994 to six percent in 1996 .
by effectively controlling economic overheating and inflation , china successfully achieved an economic " soft landing . " there was a sudden change in the situation , however .
because of the outbreak of the asian financial crisis , the surfacing of china 's underlying economic structural contradictions , and changes in the supply - demand relations at home , china 's annual gdp growth continued to go down .
to avoid the possible economic downturn and to maintain sustained rapid healthy national economic development , the central authorities have resolutely made major policy decisions to expand domestic demand and implement the proactive fiscal policy .
in 1998 , china issued additional long - term construction treasury bonds worth 100 billion yuan , increased fixed asset input , and sped up infrastructure construction .
in the course of implementing the proactive fiscal policy , it has striven to give play to the monetary policy and comprehensively applied various economic levers to support economic development .
with the support of the above measures , china 's economic operation has shown new prospects since the second half of last year , such as an export rebound , a warming - up of the consumer market , and a downward price trend .
in particular , the policy decision to insist on not devaluing the renminbi has contributed to stabilizing asian and world economies .
in the first half of this year , china 's gdp rose 8.2 percent , which is way above the world 's economic growth . moreover , the quality of its economic growth has improved significantly .
in economic restructuring , there have been marked improvements in the aggregate control of some surplus and obsolete productive capacities and products , such as the textile , coal , metallurgical industries , and the electronic information industry is becoming a new impetus to economic growth .

in 1999 when jiangxi province openly selected from the whole country 13 leading cadres of deputy department head level , over 600 people sent in their names , 114 of which were for the post of deputy director of the provincial party committee 's research office .
the masses report : " the open selection of leading cadres has cut the road for those running after official posts . "

in recent years henan province has actively explored new mechanisms for selecting , appointing , and employing cadres ; by now the system of making them known to the public has been practiced for 3,661 leading cadres in the province , including 827 at county and office levels .

last year alone guangxi dismissed , downgraded , or switched to non - leadership duties 32 incompetent or incapable cadres at department and bureau level and 516 cadres at county and office levels .

of the 30 departmental - level cadres openly selected in guangxi in 1998 , two were dismissed from their posts as a result of examination by the organization at the end of their trial period .
since 1999 guangxi has practiced a trial period for 1,776 newly selected cadres ; at the end of their trial period , four office - level cadres and seven section - level cadres could not be formally appointed to their posts because they failed the examination .

hong kong , 17 jul (zts) - - russian president putin is starting his first visit to china on 17 july .
before beginning his journey , he stated that china is russia 's strategic partner , and developing relations with china is one of the main priorities of russian foreign policy .
he held that certain of china 's experiences in economic reform are completely suitable for russia , and he will refer to china 's experiences to create a good investment environment for domestic and foreign investors .
it seems that these two aspects are his main goals in visiting china .
putin was elected president of russia in march and formally took up office on 7 may. previously he became prime minister last september and became acting president when yeltsin resigned at the end of december .
after he was made prime minister he started to carry out readjustment and reform of the russian economy and gradually reversed the momentum of economic decline year after year .
in june this year putin presided over drawing up a 10 - year social and economic development program , which demands that economic growth be no less than 5 percent a year and that the economy is revived by 2010 .
in fact , china and russia established a strategic cooperation partnership in 1996 , when yeltsin was in charge of the government , to deal with the new post - cold war international pattern .
the sino - russian strategic cooperation partnership will continue to develop in the new century , and russia will continue to actively develop cooperation with great china in the economic and cultural fields and on international issues .
foreign minister ivanov arrived in beijing two days before putin started his visit , to hold talks with chinese foreign minister tang jiaxuan and prepare for the summit talks between president putin and president jiang zemin .
as everyone knows , during the cold war china and the soviet union both had decisive influence in the korean peninsula .
in addition to the efforts of the two sides , china acted as a spur and match - maker for the reconciliation between north and south korea and their consensus on unification .
in the new situation , russia wants to mend its relations with north korea and have a greater say in northeast asia .
in the past few years china and russia have resolved the border problem on the 4,000 km eastern section ; and china , russia , and the three central asian countries have resolved the problem on the 3,000 km western section through the " shanghai five " framework mechanism , and also signed a border military trust accord .
during his visit to china , putin can only strengthen cooperation on the border issue and there is no need for him to exert effort on defusing the contradictions .
putin 's first visit to china will further promote the traditional friendship and mutual understanding between the two states and peoples and inject new vitality into implementing and developing the sino - russian strategic cooperation partnership .
the chinese and russian leaders will decide on a long - term plan for developing bilateral relations ; when the world is about to enter the 21 st century , the strengthening of the sino - russian strategic cooperation partnership is of major significance for establishing a new world order .

in making such development , our armed forces should take a new leap in building a contingent of qualified personnel .
only by paying close attention to building a contingent of qualified personal as a fundamental task will it be possible for us to implement the grand strategy of strengthening our armed forces through science and technology .
to build a contingent of qualified personnel , it is still necessary for us to continue emancipating our minds and adopting new concepts .
as science and technology are changing and influencing the development of human society at an unprecedented speed , as a knowledge - based economy is approaching us , people are feeling the need for qualified personnel more urgent than ever before .
in his report to the 15 th cpc national congress , president jiang pointed out that qualified people are the most important resource for scientific and technological progress and for economic and social development .
these years , the concept of " respecting knowledge and professionally trained people " have been accepted by people ; in practical work , however , it is far from treating and taking qualified personnel as the primary resource .
some units are willing to spend millions of yuan in purchasing equipment but unwilling to spend tens of thousands of yuan in sending cadres to school for training or study .
this phenomenon in which hardware and equipment are valued more than software and qualified personnel is , in the final analysis , a reflection of a skewed concept of qualified personnel .
with increased competition in qualified personnel and knowledge and with the deepening of the state personnel system , the situation in building the contingent of qualified personnel in the armed forces has become ever grimmer .
in units where conditions permit , they may set up some temporary positions to engage experts of great academic attainments to work on a regular or irregular basis .
it can be seen from this that using qualified personnel instead of owning them has at least two advantages : 1 . the channels for bringing in qualified personnel are widened .
if units want to own intellectual resources , they have to pay an expensive " reserve cost . "
therefore , we should not seek a closed concept of qualified personnel that units must " own the personnel they use . "
it is necessary to stress the concept of distribution according to knowledge .
we have stressed distribution according to work for a long time .
with the development of the times , tremendous changes have taken place in the connotations of the word " work . " it represents not only the accumulated quantity of work but , more importantly , the output and efficiency of such work - - namely , the quality of such work .
therefore , distribution according to knowledge should become a major form of distribution in the era of the knowledge - based economy .
only when the value of outstanding or top - notch people 's knowledge is realized or only when the first - rate personnel are giving top remuneration will it be possible to stabilize and attract more and more outstanding people .
it is necessary to stress the concept of supporting and training qualified people first .
this is also true with building a contingent of qualified personnel .
those who have made achievements should be commended and awarded .
leaders should pay attention to discovering people with a potential and in the process of growth and give them some support or help .
management should be stressed as a concept of providing services .
such " high consumption of college - trained people " does harm to the people concerned as well to the country .
if a unit has competent people but does not pay attention to them and train them , it wo n't work either .
some units have obtained new weapons and equipment , but their authorized strengths fail to keep up with the new situation ; without competent personnel and new training , the new weapons and equipment cannot play their role . as a result , the fighting capacity is affected .
what is important is to make overall planning and coordinated development .
it is necessary to do overall research on when to bring in what equipment and how to have the authorized strength and the training of personnel keep up with the new situation .
president jiang said : there must be competent personnel in advance , and we would rather have personnel wait for equipment , instead of having the latter wait for the former .
beijing , 18 jul ( xinhua ) - - president jiang zemin and russian president putin today signed a " joint statement by the prc president and the russian federation president on the antiballistic missile [ abm ] issue . "
the 1972 " treaty on restricting the antiballistic missile system " ( hereafter called the " abm treaty " for short ) still remains the cornerstone of global strategic stability and international security and is the basis of key international agreements on reducing and restricting offensive strategic weapons and preventing the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction .
safeguarding and strictly observing the " abm treaty " is of vital importance .
therefore china and russia firmly oppose this plan .
any damage to the " abm treaty " could trigger a new round of arms race , bringing about a turn for the worse in the positive trend that has appeared in world politics since the end of the cold war .
the country that proposed an amendment to this basic treaty in disarmament will be held totally responsible for undermining international stability and security and for the all the consequences arising therefrom .
an analysis of the current international reality suggests that the demand of a certain country to amend the " abm treaty " under the pretext of a so - called missile threat does not hold water at all .
the proposal for a so - called " amendment " to the " abm treaty " is aimed at covering up the relevant country 's attempt to violate the provisions of treaty .
it is of great and practical significance in the present strategic situation to preserve the completeness and effectiveness of the " abm treaty . "
political , legal , and diplomatic means must be employed to strengthen international efforts to prevent the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction and their carriers , probe the possibility of gradually forming a global monitoring system to prevent the proliferation of missiles and their technology , and conduct extensive and nondiscriminative dialogue and cooperation in this field .
nonstrategic missile defense that is not prohibited by the " abm treaty , " and international cooperation in this field , should not harm the security interests of other countries , should not lead to the establishment or strengthening of close - type military or political blocs , and should not undermine global or regional stability and security .
based on this position , china and russia are seriously worried about , and firmly oppose , a certain country 's plan to deploy in the asia - pacific region a nonstrategic missile defense system that might have the aforesaid negative impacts .
incorporating taiwan into a foreign country 's missile defense system in whatever form is unacceptable and will seriously undermine regional stability .
based on the strategic partnership characterized by equality and trust , china and russia will continue their close cooperation in the aforesaid issues and strengthen their cooperation in other related fields under the framework of each undertaking its international responsibilities , to safeguard their own as well as regional and global security .

we should pay attention to education on the concept of people 's war .
with the rapid development of modern science and technology , profound changes are taking place in the sphere of military science and technology in the world .
however , the success of the armymen and people of yugoslav in overcoming a powerful opponent with a weak force tells us that people 's war remains the weapon for overcoming a powerful enemy .

a tossed stone raised a thousand ripples .
jiafangjun bao on 4 july published he tiemao 's article and li qiang 's letter , which have drawn the wide attention of readers .
are wars getting more and more flexible ?
many discussions have been initiated .
this question has aroused a drive of contention among military academies , which has drawn the wide attention of readers .

the miserable way of wars is being changed - - by li zhiqiang from the no. 1 team of graduate students clauswitz said in his " theory of war " : " war is a kind of violent conduct .
the second world war lasted eight years and caused more than 50 million victims and $ 4 trillion losses .
the appearance of weapons of mass destruction , such as nuclear weapons , causes different theories on purposes and means of wars . unlimited use of means of high - tech wars cannot realize the purposes of wars but may bring great losses to the two parties of wars .
the gulf war lasted only 42 days . the multi - national force itself spent more than $ 65.1 billion .
3 ) buffered by the timely and appropriate release of energies during clashes .
the us air raids on libya 's " golden gorge " only lasted 12 minutes . in this action , the united states dropped 150 tonnes of bombs , destroyed five major targets of libya , attained its goal , and simultaneously avoided the escalation of this war .
the reality of changing the use of violence from unlimited to controllable realistically indicates that along with the ceaseless improvement in the civilization degree of human society , the miserable way of wars that were applied in the past has been changed .
the " solidity " of wars is being weakened along with economic globalization - - by sun jianxiang from the second team of graduate students through new technical revolution and international economic and technological exchanges , production and capital are advancing toward globalization .
when the city gate catches fire , the fish in the moat suffer from it .
the united states ' invasion of vietnam and somalia and the former soviet union 's invasion of afghanistan were " warnings " to us .
besides , the practice of each using and infiltrating the other for its own ends in international economic contacts makes " economic warfare " more economically beneficial and attractive to economically stronger countries than " gunboat " policy .
imposing economic sanctions is a kind of " economic warfare . "
if we list " economic warfare " as a kind of war , it would be a kind of soft war [ ruan xing zhan zheng ] . if the number of soft wars is increasing , the general concept of wars is going to be flexible .
violence becomes more and more limited - - by wang wei , associate professor from the military theory teaching and research section criterion on wins and losses of wars produces a great impact on ways to applying means of war and using violence .
in the past , wiping out the enemy 's effective strength , attacking cities , and seizing territories were measures of value on wars .
at that time , the people were the foundation for combat effectiveness ; lands and cities were where economic interests fundamentally lied .
under such circumstances , the space of wars was getting larger and larger , the duration of wars was getting longer and longer , and violence continued escalating .
other methods can be applied in the economic field to obtain the same economic benefits as the efforts to attack cities and seize lands .
as a result , the control over the will of the opposing side to attain political and economic goals becomes a measure to decide whether to win or lose a war .
the question of whether to win or lose depends on the choice of means and forms of wars . for instance , while deciding bombing and attacking targets , we should try all means possible to reduce casualties of the people .
in the new century , wars are still in pursuit of the realization of strategic benefits . however , the realization of strategic benefits is not completely limited to wars . that is to say , the role of violence is getting more and more limited .
along with the smash of nuclear monopoly and the balance of nuclear powers and thanks to the restraint by nuclear retaliation , international public opinions , and international conventions , a success has been made in objectively containing the escalation of war violence .
the existence of nuclear threat presses the people to apply the old forms of conventional wars to resolve political problems and to treat nuclear weapons as a backstage manipulator . in a certain sense , this backstage manipulator is more important than leading actors on the stage .
modern wars , with the threat of nuclear weapons , become noticeably limited in nature . meanwhile , threatened by nuclear weapons , means of wars are restricted and violence is brought under control .
in this sense , the " flexibility " of wars is certainly reasonable .
in one of nato 's air raids on kosovo , the main building of the headquarters of the socialist party of yugoslavia was destroyed while a hospital for gynecology and obstetrics nearby this building was safe and sound .
in reality , the " weakening " of wars in such a way may reduce damages to non - military targets when offenders occupy an active position . at the same time , it is very often that attacks against military targets become crueler .
the destruction of civilization by high - functional weapons in high - tech wars , particularly the damages to the sides with noticeably weak combat capability , is crueler than before .
although the gulf war was over more than 9 years ago , the iraqi people have not yet freed themselves from the war disasters .
those countries that had nothing to do with the kosovo war experienced ecological casualties for a long period of time even after the war because of nato 's use of radioactive weapons and quasi - chemical attacking weapons .
the us army even dropped five missiles with a circle error probability of one meter to the chinese embassy in yugoslavia , killing three innocent chinese reporters . this piratical act seriously trampled on the international law and the law of war .
it is thus clear that wars have not been weakened and that high - technology warfare is still a fight between blood and fire , as well as a bloody politics .
from the cold steel age to the hot steel age , from the mechanized war age to the thermonuclear steel age , even in the current times of information welfare , and in the future knowledge and new - concept warfare ages , each progress in antipersonnel means only indicates the change of ways for bleeding .
the russian troops used their courage and lives to write a heroic and stirring story in the operation between russia and chechenya .
this war broke out at the turn of the century , with miseries and bleeding .
by no means do modern wars go without bleeding . to win a modern war , we should have the will , determination , and mental preparations to " be ready to die in battlefields . "
without the russian troops ' bleeding and heroic deaths , there would be no a complete victory in the second chechen war and the unification and integration of the federal republic of russia .
blood is red ; it is a banner of determination and strength .

in this extremely unfavorable environment , the vast numbers of agricultural cadres and peasants have fought the drought with great courage , actively adjusted the agricultural mix , and striven to stabilize grain production , ensuring the stable working of the agricultural and rural economy .
this year 's drought has affected the huanghuai , jianghan , northern china , and northwestern china regions , which are china 's major wheat production regions .
spring drought is extremely damaging to ear sprouting of wheat , so the drought has had a serious effect on this year 's summer grain production .
funds for drought fighting have been appropriated continuously .
so far , drought - fighting funds appropriated by various departments of the state council have exceeded one billion yuan ; at the same time , local treasuries at various levels also have spent large amounts of funding on fighting the drought .
since the national teleconference on drought fighting work was held , the henan provincial treasury has raised another 20 million yuan for drought fighting , and the hebei and gansu provincial treasuries have each appropriated 15 million yuan for drought fighting .
irrigation facilities in all localities have been in operation around the clock , and more than 2.2 million electromechanically - equipped wells , 33,000 irrigation areas and water pumping stations , and more than 6 million sets of mobile drought fighting equipment have been on high - speed operation .
drought fighting and relief work in drought - hit areas currently is still being carried out in full swing .
as of the end of may , sichuan and some other provinces had completed harvesting winter wheat , harvesting in the jianghuai region had entered the peak period , and harvesting had moved from the southern to the northern part of henan , kicking off wheat harvesting in the central plains region .
the large numbers of peasants in wheat growing areas have mechanized wheat harvesting operations and carried out work in a meticulous way , notably increasing the speed of harvesting .
as of this date , more than 300 million mu of wheat in the country have been harvested and harvesting of winter wheat has basically been completed .
area of machine harvesting now accounts for 67 percent of the total harvested area , which is five percent higher than the same period of last year .
according to statistics of the ministry of agriculture , this year 's summer grain growing area is more than 20 million mu , or six percent , less than last year , a relatively large reduction over the last few years .
the total wheat growing area reduced in jiangsu , hubei , sichuan , anhui , zhejiang , and hunan accounts for more than 50 percent of the total area reduced across the country .
while worrying about a reduction in summer grain output , agricultural experts have pointed out : this year , summer grain harvesting has had three noticeable positive factors .
first , winter wheat production has been further centralized to more favorable areas ; second , wheat of a large number of poor - quality strains has been eliminated and areas exclusively for growing wheat of fine - quality varieties has increased .
according to statistics , this year 's area exclusively for growing wheat of good - quality varieties has reached 55 million mu .
third , " agriculture to order " has developed rapidly .
this year , the " order " areas exclusively for growing winter wheat of good - quality varieties is nearly 20 million mu , making it a new growth factor of adjustment of the agriculture structure and of incomes of peasants .
however , continued drought in some localities has caused great difficulties to summer farming .

at what speed will the chinese economic train move into the new century ?
state statistics bureau press spokesman ye zhen opined that china 's economy will remain in the posture of sound development of the first half of the year and that this year 's annual economic growth rate will be higher than last year 's .
he cited : the production of the major energy and raw materials accelerated and the increase in enterprise inventory declined in the first half of the year , foreboding further expansion of domestic demand , which will pull along the production field for an all - round improvement .
state statistical bureau spokesman ye zhen today revealed that total domestic production for the first half of the year reached 3.9491 trillion yuan . based on comparable prices , this represents an 8.2% increase over the same period last year and a 0.6% acceleration over the same period last year .
ye zhen gave these remarks at a press conference held by the information office of the state council .
ye indicated that during the first half of this year , china 's speedy economic growth was primarily driven by industry in the secondary and tertiary sectors .
in the first half of the year , consumer prices rose just 0.1% compared to the same period last year .
income in cities and rural areas rose .
ye zhen said that during the first half of this year , fast growth in consumption and exports as well as increased investment stability constituted a " troika " which jointly drove economic growth .
total social investment in fixed property was 1.0176 billion yuan , an increase of 11% over the same period last year . of this figure , investment by state - owned enterprises and other economic types was 753.8 billion yuan , an increase of 12.1% .
according to ye 's introduction , concurrently with the rapid economic growth , during the first half of this year the quality of china 's economic performance continued to rise .
for the first 5 months of the year , industrial enterprises had an overall economic efficiency index of 107.3 , an increase of 16.4 points over the same period last year ; actual total profit to enterprises increased 130 percent , and there was a 7.7% reduction in the number of enterprises registering losses .
industrial linkage between supply and marketing regained normal levels .
ye zhen said that during the first half of this year , china 's international balance of payments situation was good , with a continued increase in national foreign reserves .
at the end of may , the nation 's foreign reserves reached us $ 158.0 billion , an increase of us $ 3.3 billion over the beginning of the year .
the exchange rate for the renminbi remained stable .
a reporter asked what ye 's views were concerning the slowing in increases in farmers ' income .
ye zhen answered that the slowing tendency in growth to farm income was due to many factors .
he felt that with the promotion of these measures , china 's farm income would gradually rise .

however , in some local contest areas , they are taken lightly and not enforced vigorously , and it is not considered proper to emphasize them .
when there are rules that are not obeyed and laws that are not followed , with the passage of time , the rules will gradually become things that do n't matter .
this kind of paralysis has now become an impediment to our understanding and conceals potential problems .
intense confrontations and competitions give soccer an appeal that is difficult for other events to match , and for that reason it is particularly loved by the general public .
from those who follow soccer with interest to those who participate physically , both are in it for physical and mental pleasure .
this is something which should be treasured and looked after with great care .
however , soccer fields are also public places where people are densely concentrated and the personnel situation is complicated , and the possibility of a small number of lawless individuals looking for an opportunity to engage in criminal activity is heightened .
with a mixture of soccer fans of different levels and character , when people get caught up in their emotions , it is easy for vigilance regarding the incitement of an incident to become relaxed .
those people who indiscriminately insult the judges on the soccer field and those outside the field who resist the enforcement of the law may no longer be considered fans who love soccer , but are black sheep .
not only are they not to be tolerated by soccer , they are not to be tolerated by soccer fans in general , either .

washington , 18 july ( xinhua ) - - us house of representatives voted 281 - 147 through a debate on 18 july to reject a bill designed to prevent extension of normal trade relations [ ntr ] with china for another year .
the house had to debate and vote on the issue of extending ntr status to china for another year this year because the senate has yet to vote on the bill .
republican representative bill archer , the house ways and means committee chairman , said at the end of the voting that he was disappointed that the house had to vote on the issue after it approved the bill to grant pntr status to china .
he said : granting pntr status to china will help open the chinese market , and american agricultural exports to china alone will increase three times .
supporters of the bill have expressed their concerns that the repeated delays could affect the smooth passage of the bill , which could fall prey to the political struggle between the two parties in an election year .

dan xianglong said : during the first half of this year , the pboc increased refinancing of credits to banking institutions with a total amount of more than 150 billion yuan , increasing by 200 billion yuan as compared with the same period in the previous year .
the supply of money increased in a stable manner , the currency liquidity improved month by month , and the withdrawal of currency from circulation was quite normal .
deposits of all types in financial institutions totaled 4.07 trillion yuan , increasing by 364.5 billion yuan over the beginning of this year or 270 billion yuan over the same period of last year .
short - term loans increased by more than 160 billion yuan over the same period last year , while intermediate and long term loans increased by more than 40 billion yuan .
as of end of june , chinese financial institutions ' foreign currency deposits amounted to $ 113.7 billion , increasing by $ 10.5 billion over the beginning of this year . of which foreign currency deposits by individuals in cities and rural areas reached $ 63.4 billion , increasing by $ 8.1 billion over the beginning of this year .
as of end of june , the balance of household savings deposits totaled 6,284.2 billion yuan , up 348.7 billion yuan from the beginning of this year , but the increase was 231.8 billion yuan less than that of the same period last year .
besides , the collection of income tax from interests and the system of making deposits with actual names of depositors also , to a certain extent , affected the residents ' depositing money in financial institutions .
during the first half of this year , the stock market accumulated a total fund of 82.3 billion yuan , increasing by 48 billion yuan over the same period last year .
as of end of june , the four financial assets management companies accepted more than 1,300 billion yuan of non - performing loans from four state commercial banks , of which 71 percent completed fund settlement .
the rectification of various financial institutions and the work of sorting out and consolidating rural cooperative foundations were conducted smoothly .
following the international custom , the pboc branches organized more than 50,000 man - trips to inspect the quality of assets and genuine profit and loss of more than 38,000 financial institutions ( including branch offices ) in order to promote the improvement of internal management of commercial banks .
opening up to the outside world in the financial field was further expanded , the amount of foreign exchange reserve further increased , and the exchange rate of rmb became stable .
as of end of june this year , the total assets of foreign banks in china reached $ 32.3 billion , including $ 20.8 billion of loans .
at the end of june , china 's total foreign exchange reserves reached $ 158.6 billion , up $ 3.9 billion over the end last year .
the exchange rate of rmb has maintained the tendency of slight appreciation .
touching on the pboc 's related future steps , dang xianglong summarized them in the following points : ( 1 ) it is necessary to correctly handle relations between financial risks and support to economic growth , and maintain an appropriate increase of the supply of money .
( 2 ) it is necessary to further improve the financial adjustment device geared to the need of a market economy .
( 3 ) it is necessary to improve the guiding system for monetary policy and the efficiency of financial operation .
it is necessary to formulate methods to evaluate the performance of state - run commercial banks and promote the establishment of an effective encouragement and constraint system .
it is necessary to improve the system of drawing and writing off reserve fund for bad loans .
( 4 ) it is necessary to use the credit leverage to promote the adjustment of economic structure .
it is necessary to continue to do a good job in the follow - up work of transferring debt to equity so as to promote the change of operation mechanism of enterprises .
( 5 ) it is necessary to improve financial services and support the large - scale development in china 's west region .

it is necessary to use the means of refinancing and rediscount to increase the strength of financial institutions in the west region .

a western political and economic forum the group of eight , internationally called g-8 for short , is an economic and political forum held since 1975 by several of the most developed industrialized countries in the world .
each year , the participating countries hold a summit meeting plus several ministerial - level conferences .
initially , there were six participating countries , namely the united states , japan , germany , france , britain , and italy .
starting from 1991 , the ussr ( later russia ) was invited to the meeting to hold dialogues with the heads of g - 7 .
in 1997 , russia attended all meetings except those discussing financial questions and certain economic issues .
in 1998 , russia became a full meeting participant , signifying the birth of the g - 8 .
in general , economic issues have been relatively outstanding subjects discussed at g-7 and g-8 summits . examples are macroeconomic management , international trade , and relations with developing countries . meanwhile , however , the summits have preserved a very clear political and ideological tradition .
the forum commenced at the time of cold war .
if the collapse of the fixed exchange rate system and the oil crisis in the 1970 's are said to have impacted the economy of the west , then soviet expansion , the rise of communism in europe , and the failure suffered by the united states in vietnam produced an enormous political impact on the western world .
as a forum , it has always held the banner of " the market economy , democracy , and human rights . "
a communique issued by its 1975 meeting contained these words : " we came together because of shared beliefs and shared responsibilities .
our success will strengthen democratic societies everywhere . "
according to a canadian scholar engaged in g-8 research , the greatest achievement made by g-7 in the 1990 s was that it ensured the peaceful " transition to democratic politics and the market economy " of the former soviet union and east european countries .
in this process , the g-7 persisted in its dual policy of support and sanction .
although at the beginning of the kosovo crisis russia took a tit - for - tat stand against western countries , at the g-8 summit , yeltsin decided to identify himself with the western partners and joined them in working out a plan to solve the crisis .
the theoretical connotation of the english word " governance " is rather complicated . it refers to a framework on the global level composed of accepted principles , norms , and systems , which can provide a basis for cooperation without the intervention of powerful central authorities .
according to the ideal of these scholars , g-8 should function as a tool for global democratic governance . it should not only preserve the democratic system of its members , but expand this system to all of the world and see to it that its values become a globally accepted principle .
the members of g-8, as a forum , cannot reach or implement an agreement on building a new international order .
as for the agenda of this summit meeting , former japanese prime minister keizo obuchi stated four topics in february , namely , information - technology revolution , development , health , and cultural diversity .
what 's more , the japanese government hopes that the it revolution will create economic miracles for the country .
the japanese government , some western media reports say , hopes that the digital revolution will lift japan 's stagnant economy , like the " kamikaze " fighters in world war ii .
according to an estimate by the japanese departments concerned , if it is popularized in japan as widely as in the united states , its it businesses and it - related businesses will push the country 's gdp growth to 4.21 percent .
to eliminate the economic - growth gap due to difference in the extent of popularization of information technology between developed and developing countries , the japanese government said that g-8 will respond to the concerns over this question expressed by the people of various countries .
this is obviously a very unfavorable political situation for a presiding state of g - 8 .
former prime minister keizo obuchi hoped that japan could show its best to the g-8 summit . now , this objective is definitely hard to achieve .
as far as the heads of g-8 going to okinawa for the summit are concerned , though they are believed to share the same democratic values , they have different interests and stands on many major issues .
european countries also take a critical stance .
the summit may evade this issue , which concerns the future relations among g-8 members .
this issue was raised at last year 's cologne summit .
even though russian took an active part in discussions on this issue and was a signatory of the related statement , it was sharply antagonistic to the g-7 stand on the chechen question .
on the question of it , g-8 also has contradictions .
japan will advocate an it revolution at this meeting , but its proposals may not produce significant results because it has been accused of being reluctant to open its telecommunication market .
regretfully , however , only a small part of the debts of three countries have been remitted .
now , britain , the united states , and canada have made proposals for remitting the unpaid debts , while japan insists on resetting a timetable . to japan , the debt issue is obviously a trouble .
if japan and the eu want to reach an agreement on a free - agriculture framework , they have to make compromise on the question of transgenetic foods .
as for how to make a proposal on this question at the okinawa summit acceptable to both the eu and united states , japan has to display superb diplomatic skills .

in view that numerous home electrical appliance enterprises recently have formed a so - called price alliance , this reporter interviewed professor lin yifu , director of the china economic research center of the beijing university .
is the current price war vicious competition ?
as known to all , a price alliance is formed under the banner of quelling a price war , stopping vicious competition , and protecting national industry .
allies of the alliance have held that the recent price war not only has failed to enable efficient enterprises to win and to eliminate the inferior ones , on the contrary , it has led to a decline in enterprises ' economic efficiency and brought severe challenges to enterprises ' survival and development .
lin yifu held a completely different view on this problem .
he said : the problem with china 's home electrical appliance industry actually is not the fierce price competition .
competition by reducing prices is not necessarily vicious competition and selling commodity at prices lower than the costs also is not necessarily vicious competition .
if an enterprise 's technological and management levels are high and its production costs are low , and if it sells its products at prices higher than the costs , the selling prices very likely will be lower than those of other enterprises of the same industry .
price war is not the real cause that has led to the increased losses of some enterprises .
why is it difficult for efficient enterprises to stand out and poor ones to be eliminated ?
to scramble for and increase market share , enterprises can only continue to tap the potential of price cutting and resort to price competition .
is price alliance against the law ?
article 14 of the " price law " stipulates : business operators must not collude with one another , manipulate market prices , and infringe on the right and interests of other business operators and consumers .
price alliance should absolutely be rejected .
beijing , 21 jul ( xinhua ) - - the annual group of eight [ g - 8 ] summit is being held in okinawa , japan from 21 to 23 july .
okinawa is the largest of the islands .
its fishery industry is well - developed , and it is the aviation hub of okinawa .
naha had trading ties with china , korea , and java as early as in the mid-14th century .
elongated in shape , the main island of okinawa used to be an isolated island with " barren hills and untamed rivers . "
it was occupied by us troops before the end of world war ii .
okinawa was returned to japan in 1972 , but many military installations have remained there .
military bases and military installations built by us troops in japan take up 20 percent of okinawan land , and they serve as the largest supply base for us forces in the far east and as the frontline for us special forces troops .
there were 28 criminal cases in the first five months of this year alone .
the call for stricter discipline in the us military , a reduction of us bases , and a thorough revision of the status of forces agreement , which accords special status to us service personnel stationed in japan , is growing .
okinawa was the site of a fierce battle between us and japanese troops during world war ii . several hundred thousand okinawans died in the battle . there are many memorials dedicated to the war dead . the himeyuri monument in the south is a memorial dedicated to the teachers and students of a girls school in okinawa .
okinawa prefecture built a peace prayer and memorial hall to help people gain a better understanding of history .
okinawa is a mirror that reflects the dark side of war as well as people 's hopes for peace .

third , it will establish a sound system for sharing information and feedback on concluded cases among agencies within the procuratorial departments so as to organically integrate supervision over case prosecution and the work of investigation and promote cooperation , coordination , and common progress .

although the international impact of this summit has been growing , it is by no means a publicly - recognized international body , and the international function of the g-8 has led to many discussions on all sides .
the g-8 summit evolved from the g-5 summit ( us , britain , france , germany and japan ) and the g-7 summit ( us , britain , france , germany , japan , italy and canada ) .
in recent years , the agenda has gradually broadened , to range from political and military topics to anti - terrorism ; it now extends from human rights to telecommunications networks , from nuclear arms bans to drug interdiction , and the scope of discussions has become ever bigger .
but it is precisely because the topics discussed are too numerous , and those actually implemented after the summit 's conclusion too few , that the summit has often turned into idle talk .
it is worth special attention that the question of the united states ' deployment of the national missile defense [ nmd ] system caused controversy at the conference of foreign ministers , and it is anticipated that it will raise even more controversy at the actual summit .
the g-8 summit 's " idle talk " on international issues is limited in terms of its international influence . however , at times their stouthearted work is surprising .
for example , last year 's g-8 surpassed its authority and meddled in the affairs of others , putting their fingers in the kosovo question , to give one example .
this was a direct attack on the authority of the united nations security council .
at the time , quite a few developing nations criticized the methods of the g - 8 .
chinese experts say that the g-8 made the united nations path unfeasible , and that the actual effect was to use the united nations as a kind of tool . when it was useful , it was on call at any instant ; when it was not useful , then it could get its marching orders at any moment .
on the india - pakistan nuclear testing question , since the positions and interests of the g-8 and the five standing members of the un security council were congruent , the spirit and demands of the joint communique issued by both sides was mutually beneficial and constructive ; the one making the other more beautiful .
by circumventing and nullifying the united nations in this way , the g-8 is actually going around china . they are currently planning ways to make china lose her opportunity for participation in and major influence on international affairs , and to make china lose the right to exercise her rightful power in the un .
at the same time , expert commentators say that this also exposes the hidden agenda of the g-8 to gradually replace the un security council .
as a developing nation , china cannot join the g-8, but is willing to maintain ties with the g-8 member states .
according to the analyses of observers , china 's declining to join the g-8 is based on three principal reasons . one is the fact that china is not willing to weaken the function of the united nations and the un security council .
as a permanent member of the un security council , china puts great emphasis on the un and the security council , and hopes to strengthen their functions ; she is even more willing to emphasize the important function of the un and its security council in international affairs .
the g-8 at times circumvents the united nations , making the un impotent , or doing its own thing , and this is what china strongly objects to .
china feels that representing the interests of developing nations in talks with developed nations will be beneficial in increasing china 's voice on the international stage .
thirdly , china cannot accept unequal participatory status .
although china is not willing to participate in the g-8 summit , she is willing to maintain dialogue with the g - 8 .
china hopes to continue with this type of communication .
