although since the end of world war ii the united states has not experienced simultaneous launching of two modern wars , on two occasions they suffered the lesson of being utterly routed in wars when they fought more than two opponents at the same time .
with such profound lessons , americans dare not and cannot simultaneously launch two modern wars .
americans certainly cannot forget the korean war in the 1950 's , which even americans themselves had to admit was " the wrong war fought in the wrong place , at the wrong time , against the wrong enemy . "
according to all - round us national strength and the contrast in military strength between the two sides , the united states should have won a brilliant victory .
the united states , however , suffered stunning blows during this three - year war .
still less will they forget the vietnam was of the 1960 's , when the united states struggled desperately in the quagmire of a war which went on for 14 years . the united states sent in 550,000 troops , of whom 58,209 were killed or missing .
although these two wars ended long ago , they had a tremendous psychological impact on americans , and even today they have lingering fear .
today , however , far from eliminating these after - effects , americans have ever greater fear of falling into the quagmire of wear .
hollow , americans !
bullying the strong with strength , and bullying the weak and fearing the strong has been the americans ' consistent style .
from another aspect , the united states lacks sufficient capacity to successfully fight two simultaneous modern wars under hi - tech conditions .
us troop deployment is extremely scattered , and armed forces totalling less than 1.2 million are dispersed at strategic points all over the world , such as the korean peninsula , japan , the middle east , and europe . . .
the extremely scattered us military already undertakes to do a difficult job as best as it can in sticking out a fist , and successfully fighting two simultaneous modern wars can only be fantasy .
irritating , americans !
apart from limits on their strength , americans have all kinds of worries about simultaneously fighting two modern wars .
they have at least two big worries : dead bodies and a sliding economy .
on the eve of the gulf war saddam threatened the united states that " the gulf will become a second vietnam . "
an important reason why nato did not launch a ground war in kosovo was that the americans were scared of dead bodies .
obviously , it was precisely to avoid such a situation that in its last few modern wars the us military has concentrated totally superior manpower and firepower to wage asymmetrical warfare and achieve so - called " zero casualties " in order to win the american public 's support for war .
in their air campaign against the yugoslav federation , the americans not only failed to achieve their military objectives while pursuing a " zero casualty " rate , but also lost several combat planes , and gained nothing in return .
apart from the dead , american 's greatest worry is probably their own economy on the slide .
hence in recent partial wars americans have paid extremely great attention to controlling the scale and duration of the war ; in this way the united states can attain its military objectives and also lead forward the development of its defense industries , thus hitting two birds with one stone .
former allies , strange bedfellows .
obviously it is not sufficient just to rely on the force of the united states itself in launching two simultaneous modern wars .
this strategy was fully expressed in the gulf war and the air campaign against the yugoslav federation , especially in the gulf war .
as european countries are growing stronger all the time , however , the momentum for european countries to fly their own colors is rising ever higher .
the united states can no longer get help from the european countries without paying any price , as it could before .
panic , americans !
if there is a spear , there is a shield . the myth of the us military 's " trump card " - - " surgical " asymmetrical warfare - - is now gradually being broken .
" successfully fighting two simultaneous modern wars " is still harder to talk about .
the united states waged a large - scale air campaign against the yugoslav federation in 1999 .
the americans awoke as if from a dream .
what can the americans use now to simultaneously fight two modern wars ?
in short , the united states possesses modern armed forces and weapons and world - leading military technology .
the more this is so , the more must we have correct understanding of the modernization and high technology of the us military and the more must we avoid superstition and being misled , and clearly see where the essence lies .

the reorganization of stocks has stimulated market purchasing power , and new content has been added to the old topic of conversation on the reorganization of assets .
people in the market believe that the recent strong development in these two cities ' reorganization of stock market assets is not only caused by a rebound technologically but also by basic policy support .
the reorganization of assets of listed companies is a typical behavior of optimizing the allocation of resources on the securities market , the hotspot in china 's stock markets during recent years , and an everlasting matter on the securities market .
this time the management echelons have called for disclosing the information of organizing the relevant assets on the securities market in a more strict and standardized manner , aiming to promptly and adequately disclose the information in an effort to create a fair and open market investment environment .
this implies that in the future , major asset reorganization will not merely be selectively carried out in listed companies whose conditions are unusual . on a legal and standardized basis , listed companies may implement the sales and acquisition of major assets on their own initiative .
relevant persons said that in the future , large scale asset reorganization carried out in accordance with the standardized demand on china 's securities market will spread like a storm .

in the first half of 2000 , china 's gdp grew 8.2 percent , for a marked economic rebound .
china 's economic development is growing markedly more tied to the stock market .
the expanded domestic and foreign demand has brought an overall production improvement , with industrial operating quality markedly improved . it is understood that over one - half of the losing large and medium state - owned enterprises [ soe ] and state - owned stock - control or holding enterprises have now overcome their difficulties .
the stock market with its sensitive feelers , enormous enticement , and potential market appeal has been the first to reflect the improved macroeconomic state .
therefore , the stock market is playing an increasingly decisive role in china 's national economic development .
the clear management awareness and active guidance of the stock market and redefinition of the market role has brought a sharply bullish market for the first half .
the bullish state of the shanghai and shenzhen stock markets reflects a sharp change that is now occurring in the chinese economy , or that a new economic growth cycle has arrived .
the pertinent experts project that , in the new growth cycle of china 's national economy , the coming decade will see average growth of 7 percent a year . projected from which , the current rise in the shanghai and shenzhen stock markets is only the initial development stage of a long - term bull market .
while the economy has taken a key turn and the stock market is skyrocketing , we also need to clearly recognize that deflation remains the key limiting factor to a macroeconomic rebound , with our inherent economic growth grounds remaining quite weak .
as to the stock market per se , raising the quality of listed companies and tightening securities market oversight remain a heavy and protracted mission .

beijing , 31 jul ( xinhua ) - - summer grain production declined this year due to serious drought and other reasons , and peasant incomes were affected .
the departments concerned at all levels throughout the country must be seriously concerned for this and adopt proper measures to resolve the current problems in agricultural production and increase peasant incomes .
we must fully understand from the level of the overall situation the importance and urgency of increasing peasant incomes , regard this as the starting and base point in the development of agriculture and rural economy , and devote great effort to resolving this problem .
given that changes have occurred in the supply - demand relationship in agricultural products , merely relying on increasing output , raising prices , and extension - style expansion to increase peasant incomes represents a path that gets narrower all the time .
second , we can increase the peasants ' nonagricultural income and also effectively increase agricultural labor productivity by reducing the number of laborers directly engaged in agriculture , switching more rural laborers to secondary and tertiary industries , and also guiding the rational movement of rural laborers to meet the objective needs of the towns and the developed areas .
third , an important guarantee for increasing peasant incomes is to further restructure national income distribution and increase support and protection for agriculture .
the most important thing for increasing peasant incomes is to protect , guide , and give play to the peasants ' initiative , lighten their burdens , and let them rest and build up their strength .
lightening their burdens means they can increase income and is in fact an increase of income .
hence , we must continue to unswervingly implement the central policies on lightening the peasant 's burdens , and intensify supervision and checks in this respect .
apart from that , we should cure both the symptoms and the cause , gradually reform the rural taxation and charges system , and harmonize according to law the relationship between the interests of the state , the collective , and the peasant .
this is a policy for curing the cause in lightening the peasants ' burdens .
the slowdown in the growth of peasant incomes bears characteristics of the current stage and of transition .
the switch of china 's agriculture and rural economy from the style of quantity expansion to that of quality and economic returns requires a rather long process and time .
hence , resolving the problem of increasing peasant incomes is a long - term and arduous task in agriculture and rural work in the new stage .
we must fully understand this point .
in agricultural restructuring , it is first necessary to make efforts to achieve comprehensive improvement of agricultural product quality .
at present there is a surplus of most agricultural products , but contradictions remain in their quality , while supply of many high - quality products cannot meet demand .
we should therefore speed up the introduction , cultivation , and popularization of fine strains , devote efforts to developing speciality products with high added value , and gradually achieve high quality of all agricultural products .
this will not only effectively increase the added value of these products , extend the agricultural industrial chain , enhance the overall returns on agriculture , and increase peasant incomes , but will also help to open up the markets and enhance china 's agricultural competitiveness .
acting in light of local conditions and taking advantage of relative regional strong points is the basic principle for the agricultural pattern .
we must fully exploit the situation of grain abundance to carry out rational readjustment of the regional pattern , develop agriculture with local characteristics , agriculture with high returns , and agriculture that earns foreign exchange , and actively promote diversified operations .
in doing a good job in increasing peasant incomes at present , we must in particular get a good grasp of poverty relief work .
in the next five months we must further stabilize the status of agriculture as the foundation , focus efforts on restructuring agriculture and rural economy , and do everything possible to increase peasant incomes , thus creating good conditions for achieving the economic goals of the whole year .
rights and obligations of criminal suspects and defendants their main rights are : 1 .
right to get legal assistance - - after the first interrogation or starting from the date when compulsory measures are taken by an investigation organ against a criminal suspect or defendant , he or she may appoint a lawyer for legal counseling who may file an appeal or accusation on his or her behalf . 2 .
right to use one 's native language in the legal proceedings . 5 .
right to request release on bail while awaiting a trial - - criminal suspects in detention , and their legal representatives , close relatives , or lawyers have the right to request release of the suspects on bail while awaiting a trail . 6 .
criminal suspects have the right to refuse to answer interrogations irrelevant to the case . 7 .
right to request additional verifications or re - verification - - criminal suspects may request additional verifications or re - verification of conclusions of verifications used as evidences . 9 .
right to file an appeal against a military procuratorate 's decision not to institute legal proceedings . 10 .
their main obligations are : they should honestly answer questions asked by investigators . if relevant legal stipulations are met , they are subject to arrest , detention , monitoring of their houses , release on bail while awaiting a trial , being summoned for interrogations , and other compulsory measures .
rights and obligations of victims their main rights are : victims and their legal representatives and close relatives have the right to appoint a litigation attorney . 2 .
they have the right to request avoidance of investigators and their close relatives who have interests in the case , and investigators who have been entertained by the parties concerned or their representatives or who have met with the parties concerned or their representatives in violation of relevant regulations . 3 .
they have the right to use their native language during the proceedings . 4 .
they have the right to file an appeal to a military procuratorate at a higher level against a military procuratorate 's decision not to institute legal proceedings , and to request institution of public prosecution or legal proceedings at a military court . 6 .
they have the right to institute an affiliated civil action against the defendant for the material losses caused by the defendant 's criminal act . 7 .
their main obligations are : they should honestly relate the case to investigators and subject themselves to investigators ' legal physical inspection .
they have the right to verify the written records , and , if omissions or mistakes are found , may request additions or corrections . 4 .
before testifying , they have the right to request investigators to show their identification documents and relevant legal documents . 5 . they have the right to sue investigators who infringe upon their litigation rights or make personal insults against them .
their main obligations are : they have the obligation to truthfully testify the development of a case they know .
when investigating and verifying a situation , they shall not produce the original or duplicated copies of the materials from a report , or expose the informant .
they shall publicize , report , and reward people who have rendered meritorious service in reporting , but shall not make known in public the names and units of the informants unless the latter have given the permission for them to do so .
one shall be investigated for responsibility for a crime according to law if he strikes back at an informant in retaliation and his action constitutes a crime .
if his action does not constitute a crime , his case shall be transferred to and handled by the competent department .
grass - roots military procuratorates shall have jurisdiction over appeals against their decisions on criminal cases ( unless otherwise stipulated ) and appeals against criminal adjudication and rulings made by military courts at the same level and that have already taken effect .
crimes committed at post refer to crimes of abuse of power committed by state working personnel while performing their duties .
in the army and armed police , it refers to crimes of abuse of power or crimes committed while performing duties by the military officers , police officers , and nonmilitary cadres as well as noncommissioned officers and men responsible for performing the duties of the aforementioned personnel .
fourth , other crimes committed by military officers , police officers , and nonmilitary cadres by abusing their power .
the crimes committed at post in the army and armed police shall be investigated and handled directly by the military procuratorate .

please brief me on the situation of the china ordnance equipment group corporation after that restructuring .
the china south industries group corporation is the largest one of the ten military industry group corporations . it has 57 industrial enterprises and 11 wholly - owned or holding enterprises of other categories and institutions , with a total payroll of more than 240,000 and total assets of 36.93 billion yuan .
reporter : in the one year or so since it was founded , on what area has this corporation focused its major attention in work ?
it has founded an institute of ordnance and equipment , with emphasis on enhancing its new weaponry overall development and top - level designing capacity and its system organization and coordination capacity . 2 .
while raising its automobile and motorcycle development ability , it has also stepped up international cooperation and the import , assimilation and innovation of technologies .
reporter : at present , the automobile , motorcycle and automobile parts industries are facing intense competition in domestic market , as well as the challenge of economic globalization . as a producer of mainly products for civilian use , how will your corporation deal with the situation ?
wang dechen : yes , most of our products for civilian use are of competing industries , and the competition in the automobile and motorcycle industries is particularly intense . with drastic drop in automobile and motorcycle prices , the two industries have entered a period of marginal profit .
what is even more serious is that the automobile , motorcycle and automobile parts industries will also face the challenge of transnational companies after china 's accession to the wto .
after we join the wto , our mini - cars and motorcycles will not necessarily be in a disadvantageous position in terms of price . however , we are lagging far behind the transnational companies in terms of grade of products , new product development ability , new technology development and application ability , and specialized personnel .
we must take full advantage of the restructuring opportunity to fundamentally raise the competitive power of our enterprises in three to five years through such measures as assets rearrangement , cooperation with foreign enterprises , restructuring , and scientific and technological innovations .

beijing , 1 aug ( xinhua ) - - with efforts made over more than two years in the past , substantive progress has been made in the work of reforming state - owned enterprises and freeing them from difficult business conditions throughout the country .
by the end of june this year , the number of large and medium - sized state - owned enterprises running in the red decreased from 6,599 to 3,626 . that is , 54.9 percent of them have stopped business losses . among them , 1,127 enterprises began to make profits .
under the favorable situation , it is more necessary to calmly and soberly size up the situation in the work of freeing state - owned enterprises from business predicaments , and make greater efforts in the second half of the year to win an across - the - board victory .
the favorable situation in freeing state - owned enterprises from difficulties did not come easily .
first , this is the result of the correctness and effectiveness of the policies and measures adopted by the central leadership .
the local authorities in various areas and all relevant departments have attached great importance to the work of reforming state - owned enterprises and freeing them from business difficulties , and have done a great deal of down - to - earth work for this purpose .
all provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities included the goal of stopping business losses incurred by state - owned enterprises within three years in their work plans and took it as a major task .
when facing the ever intensifying competition , a batch of enterprises effectively carried out reforms and made major progress in deepening the reform of the labor , personnel , and distribution systems .
while viewing the current situation in freeing state - owned enterprises from difficulties , we should more firmly keep our confidence in achieving the three - year goal for reforming state - owned enterprises and freeing them from difficulties .
the painstaking practice of the state - owned enterprises in past years has laid a solid foundation for achieving the three - year goal on time .
this year , the state continued to pursue the positive financial policy . after the issuance of 100 billion yuan of national debts earlier this year , the state decided to issue another 50 billion yuan of national debts in the second half of the year .
at the same time , the adjustment of the industrial structure will be further advanced ; the scope of consumption will be broadened ; and the social security system will be set up at a faster pace .
all this will further improve the economic environment of our country , and will provide more favorable conditions for reforms in state - owned enterprises and for the efforts to free them from difficulties .
while viewing the current situation in freeing state - owned enterprises from difficulties , we should soberly note that there remain a lot of difficulties in achieving the goal of reforming state - owned enterprises and freeing them from difficulties .
we should not be unrealistically optimistic when viewing the achieved results , should not relax our efforts to any bit , and should go all out to achieve the goal by winning a decisive victory in the decisive battle , thus laying a solid foundation for the trans - century reform and development of the state - owned enterprises .

the united states announced that this was the first time they had added a humanitarian rescue operation to the combined " circum - pacific " war drills .
on 11 july , the united states sent to romania a 800 - member unit composed of servicemen and reservists from the army , navy , air force , and mainly from the marine corps to take part in a " humanitarian " rescue exercise code - named " saving eagle . "
the " humanitarian rescue operation " has become an important task for the us army in a certain period at present and in future . the " humanitarian rescue operations " will be concentrated in the west pacific , southeast asia , central europe , and east europe .
the us idea of disguising themselves as an " angel " or a " vulture " originated during the gulf war. after 10 years of evolution , the us army has increasingly intensified the idea .
the us army stressed the need to follow , before joining in the " non - war military operation , " the principles of having a clear objective , seeking unity of action , finding a legal basis for sending troops , and ensuring the safety and sustained operation of the us army .
in the several years afterwards , the - war military operation " theory was applied to practice and proved feasible .
since the kosovo war , the us army has been more upbeat about the " non - war military operation " with " humanitarian assistance " as its core .
this is the reason that the us army has frequently staged " non - war military operation " exercises focusing on " humanitarian assistance " in the recent period .
it is not difficult to find out the reasons for the us army being keen on conducting multinational " humanitarian assistance " exercises throughout the world as it is now .
during the 1990 s , as it did not have to face such a strong rival as the former soviet union , the united states unscrupulously moved its troops into the stage from behind the scenes where they were during the cold war , in dealing with regional affairs .
since the gulf war , the us direct involvement in regional affairs has apparently increased in terms of frequency and intensity .
the us army has become the best tool for us interference in global affairs . especially since the united states announced that it has so - called " humanitarian interests " all over the world , the " non - war military operation " has become a required course for the us army .
the " combined concept 2020 admitted that since the threats , such as terrorism and weapons of mass destruction , to the united states proper are on the increase , it is more and more meaningful for the us army to take part in and support the operations of other governments .
therefore , while helping the united states pursue its global interests , the us army has to protect us institutions and nationals at home and abroad from being attacked .
the united states also tries to keep its allies under control . take the " circum - pacific " exercise , for example . during the exercises in the past , it was the us army which took lead in waging a decisive war with another marine power .
when commenting on this matter , a japanese reporter said : " as far as the united states is concerned , multinational military exercises not only serve to cut the us budget , but also help the united states to consolidate its leadership over other participating countries , killing two birds with one stone . "
the " vulture " and the " angel " belong to different species .
the former is violent , and the latter is kind . the fact is the us army is neither a " vulture " nor an " angel . "

under the system of feudal serfdom , tibet had no schools in the modern sense ; the illiteracy rate was 95 percent , and only a very small portion of the population , namely monks and serf owners and their children were able to learn and use the tibetan language .
the study , use , and development of the language was extremely restricted .
the government at all levels in the tibet autonomous region has actively promoted the study , use , and development of the tibetan language .
in 1995 , under government auspices , a set of tibetan language computer code was compiled , with the result that the fruits of this outstanding traditional culture have advanced toward the world and achieved unprecedented development . 1 .
since 1989 tibet university has opened special classes to teach tibetan language teachers for junior middle schools , and these have so far trained 1,438 such teachers together with 313 tibetan language translators and researchers .
great progress has been made in translating teaching materials , and the translation of 181 textbooks on 16 subjects for primary and middle schools has been completed , together with 122 kinds of teaching reference books and 16 teaching guidelines .
since 1996 tibet university has stepped up the compilation of books in the tibetan language , on the basis of taking thorough stock of teaching materials .
in addition a great deal of software and data and pictures for teaching tibetan have been produced .
the regional judicial department and the regional office for popularizing legal knowledge have translated and published two volumes of " textbook on common laws " in 120,000 tibetan words .
in the media , radio and television have basically achieved the goal of being geared to the grass roots and using tibetan as the main language .
the tibet people 's radio station now broadcasts 20 programs in tibetan , and its translation capability has increased to 1,800 hours a year ; the area of its coverage increased from 18 percent in 1987 to 66 percent in 1998 , a rise of 48 percentage points .
the station broadcasts 12 house of tibetan - language programs each day . the literature and art shows broadcast at the tibetan new year and the tibetan plays broadcast every tuesday , thursday , and saturday evening have been enthusiastically welcomed by the peasant and herdsman masses and town dwellers .
in 1998 30 films were dubbed in tibetan and 120 hours of dubbed tv broadcasts were made .
a special tibetan - language tv satellite channel officially opened on 1 october 1999 , thus putting an end to the lack of any special tibetan - language channel .
xizang ribao has invested heavily in building up a computerized tibetan language editing and typesetting system , and every day there is one page , and sometimes one and a half or two pages , directly composed in tibetan .
tibetan reporters directly use tibetan in their interviews and editing .
both xizang keji bao and xizang keji xinxi bao have published tibetan editions for distribution to peasants and herdsmen , who have greatly welcomed this .
posts and telecommunications are a service and information sector ; in accordance with demands , their work personnel must be familiar with both chinese and tibetan terms for their work .
posts and telecommunications publicity material and graphs , signboards , posters , and services use both languages .
the posts and telecommunications departments have published and distributed " chinese - tibetan concordance for posts and telecommunications " and opened up tibetan - language telegram and paging services , this has greatly helped the tibetan masses and promoted the development of posts and telecommunications in the region .
in recent years over 30 influential medium - length or long tibetan novels or collections of stories have been published .
all amateur artistic troupes in the region use the tibetan language to write scripts and perform , while the 10 professional troupes also mainly perform in tibetan .
since 1989 the tibet people 's publishing house and the tibet ancient documents publishing house have published 441 books in the tibetan language , and many high - quality tibetan - language books have won prizes in the interior .
at present , 20 tibetan - language newspapers and periodicals are being published .
tibetan language translation undertakings have also rapidly developed along with tibet 's reforms , opening up , and modernization .
translation work is playing an irreplaceable role in all undertakings in tibet and is effectively promoting the study , use , and development of the tibetan language . 2 .
the work of developing tibetan - language computer software is now under way .
regularization of terminology is a basic project in popularizing cultural education and developing science and technology .
starting in 1995 , tibet set to work on studying and drawing up the " general principles and methods on the standardization of tibetan language terminology " and deciding on the theoretical principles .
in the wake of the development of market economy in recent years , there was a big increase in the forms and styles of script used in society , while at the same time a good deal of confusion arose in this field , which had some negative impact .
at present the cultural level of the masses in tibet is not high , a large proportion of adults in the rural and pastoral areas are illiterate , and it is necessary to rely on and use the tibetan language to popularize scientific and cultural knowledge , improve labor skills , and enrich the people 's cultural life .
hence , it is particular important to draw up practical measures for vigorously promoting the healthy and rapid development of tibetan language work in the new era .
at the same time , it is intensifying supervision and checks , conducting investigation and study , promptly finding out and getting a handle on the situation and problems in unfolding tibetan language work , and studying and drawing up improvement measures .
russia and china strongly oppose the united states nmd plan . a number of us allies have also expressed their disapproval one after another .
the united states , which has long praised itself as maintaining the status quo , is now the biggest destructor of the world strategic order and stability .
however , one point remains unchanged : the fact that within the global strategic situation , the important large nations have always maintained different levels of strategic balance among themselves .
this is one of the major reasons why peace has been maintained and world war avoided for more than 50 years following world war ii .
this treaty stopped the united states and the soviet union ( russia ) from constructing overall defensive strategic missile systems . this not only took care of the mutual strategic threat between the two major nuclear powers , but objectively speaking also established a strategic balance among the smaller nuclear nations and the nuclear powers .
this kind of strategic balance greatly diminished the possibility of the outbreak of a nuclear war .
after the conclusion of the cold war , the standoff between the two superpowers ended , and the nuclear threat was reduced . peace and development were the mainstream of the times .
however , the us considered itself to be the victor in the cold war , and sought a unipolar world with a sole superpower hegemonist .
this amply demonstrates that the united states , which has long praised itself as maintaining the status quo , is now day by day turning into the biggest destructor of the world strategic balance and stability .
the united states claims that it is developing nmd in order to defend against missile threats coming from countries which the us considers problematic , such as korea , iran , and iraq .
with the calming of the situation on the korean peninsula , and constant improvements in relations between the us and korea and the us and iran , the above - listed american excuses are clearly more and more untenable .
who knows whether those within the us who are responsible for developing the nmd will trot out some new excuses or not .
in actuality , there are those who strongly promote the establishment of nmd within the united states who are at no pains to conceal this fact . they announce again and again that nmd will expand the so - called " freedom of movement " of the united states overseas .
since the conclusion of the cold war , the international situation has always tended toward calm , on the whole , and although relations between the major nations have at times seen bumps , cooperation is still the major trend .
the foundation for this cooperation is interactive trust , mutual understanding and caring for the other side 's security concerns . it does not lie in plotting to destroy the fundamental security interests of the other nation .
and the nmd system developed by the united states constitutes a direct challenge to a world strategic balance which is already weakened . it will fundamentally damage the existing relations of strategic balance among large nations , and threaten the security interests of other countries .
this practically speaking proves that since the us has put all its might behind the development of nmd , and demanded revisions to the abm treaty , there has been various degrees of damage to the trust and cooperative relationships between the united states and other large nations , including some of her allies .
this situation will worsen as the nmd plan is further promoted .
the us nmd plan will also destroy the progress of international military control and disarmament , or even cause a new round of competition in military buildup .
on the military side , attack and defense have always been intertwined entities .
since the conclusion of the cold war , great progress has also been made on multilateral nuclear disarmament , as well as in extending the " nuclear non - proliferation treaty " , and on negotiations for finalizing the " comprehensive testing ban treaty . "
but with the american nmd plan , the future progress of bilateral nuclear disarmament between the united states and russia and international multilateral nuclear disarmament is cast into doubt , and some agreements which have already been reached may be threatened with breakup .
in such a situation , medium and smaller nations with nuclear capacity will have an even more cautious attitude towards their participation in the nuclear disarmament process .
this clearly opposed the united states nmd plan , and shows that international society does not approve of the united states undertaking nmd ; the majority of us allies are no exception .
based on the shared responsibility for the maintenance of world peace and stability and common security interests , china and russia have taken a unanimous stand on the abm question .
china has always held high the banner of opposition to the united states nmd plan , a standpoint which is determined by china 's international position and security environment .
as a standing member of the un security council , and the largest developing nation on earth , maintaining global strategic balance and stability is an inescapable responsibility of china .
this fact notwithstanding , the locations , scope and abilities of nmd deployment announced by the united states show that this system will directly harm chinese strategic security interests .
consequently , china cannot but express her serious concern and strong opposition to the united states nmd plan .
china 's opposition to the united states nmd plan is not meant to threaten the security of the us or any country .
china 's development of nuclear weapons has not been done in order to show off , nor is it done with the intent of using or threatening to use military power .
china developed nuclear arms during a particular period of history , and they were developed totally for self defense . the development of nuclear arms was done to break the real nuclear threat that china was facing at the time .
china 's development of a limited national defense capability has as its sole aim the maintenance of national sovereignty , respect and territorial integrity .
china will not participate in a competition on military buildup with any other nation .
in the process of china 's modernization , china 's national defense capabilities have naturally gradually modernized also .

people are generally worried that the increasingly widening digital gap will make the poor countries lag further behind the rich countries .
it can be said that the appearance of the digital gap is a new , major sign of the widening gap between rich and poor in the world today .
due to the widening gap between rich and poor in the world , the poor countries are still faced with difficulties in shaking off poverty .
at the moment , the preferential credits the rich countries extend to the poor ones are still falling drastically .
at the moment , investments from the rich countries to the poor countries are also dropping markedly .
direct foreign investments to the poorest countries fell from 21 percent of the gdp of the poor countries in the 1970 s to 17 percent in the 1980 s , and to 14 percent in 1990 s .
at present , the poor countries are still heavily in debt .
olusegun obasanjo , president of nigeria , which holds the presidency of the group of 77 developing countries , cited an example , saying : of nigeria 's $ 3.5 billion state budget , $ 1.5 billion is set aside for debt repayment .
without investment , there would be no economic growth ; without economic growth , it would be impossible to reduce poverty .
faced with this challenge , the eight heads of state expressed their willingness to close the gap between rich and poor but , with each singing its own tune , their statements lack substance .
although japanese prime minister yoshiro mori was aware of the need to turn the " digital gap " into a " digital opportunity , " the okinawa summit failed to seize this " opportunity " and do more practical work to close the " digital gap . "
no wonder un general secretary kofi annan expressed his disappointment at this .
they were not enthusiastic about holding a dialogue with the heads of state of developing countries , with three heads of state being absent from the dialogue conference .

the user units generally are of the opinion that the " shenwei " computer system is stable , reliable , interchangeable ; can accommodate all kinds of topics in the field of national economy ; and can solve many computational problems that originally could not be solved in the field of large - scale scientific computation in our country .

vice provincial governor pang daomu said that china 's " wto entry " will provide hunan 's agricultural sector with opportunities and conditions for development .
however , we will face challenges as follows : first , opening the province 's market wider to the outside world may bring sharper competition to some of the province 's agricultural products , enterprises , and industries .
after china enters the wto , we must observe wto regulations governing the opening of markets to the outside world . this will bring certain pressure to hunan in terms of the speed of opening its agricultural market to the outside world and the steps that it will take to open up its market .
second , hunan 's agricultural production and development are unsuitable to and lag far behind the requirements of the wto regulations concerned .
he said that hunan has set forth a 16 - character measure to develop its agriculture - - stabilizing grain production , intensifying livestock production , supporting processing industries , pioneering markets , readjusting structures , and improving systems .
with regard to " stabilizing grain production and intensifying livestock production , " we should stabilize the output of grain and oil - bearing crops and speed up the development of animal husbandry .
on " supporting processing industries and pioneering markets , " we should open up various channels to assimilate capital to support the development of agricultural , forest , livestock , and aquatic product processing industries and should actively open up domestic and international markets for agricultural products .
on " improving systems , " we should further set up and improve the farm product management system under which the peasants engage in production , enterprises pioneer markets , and the government offers services . meanwhile , we should set up a system to ensure the quality of agricultural productions to meet the requirements of the wto .
vice provincial governor pang daomu stressed that we cannot and should not simply and unilaterally understand the pros and cons of china 's " wto entry . "
to this end , the agricultural sector in hunan should seek unity of thinking , provide against the future , work hard , and make full preparations .

according to a report in japan 's 29 july " sankei shimbun , " the japanese cabinet meeting adopted the 2000 defense white paper , " the defense of japan , " on 28 july . what is conspicuous about the document is that content about " being wary of china 's military developments " was added to it .
to put it bluntly , it is a red herring , designed to distract the attention of relevant countries that are concerned about the expansion of japan 's military strength and to direct it toward china .
but as to whom it really is that others should be " wary " of , we must let facts speak .
but japan 's military strategy has changed from " territorial defense " to " dealing with peripheral developments " and achieved a shift from being " defensive " to being " aggressive . " furthermore , it attempts to bring china 's taiwan into the scope of " peripheral developments . "
this way , if " something happens " in the taiwan strait in the future , japan can join the united states in military action .
in order to temper its ability to handle " peripheral developments , " japan has strengthened joint exercises in the pacific ocean with the united states and , in particular , has tried to step up exercises in such waters as the south china sea .
japan ignores china 's sovereignty over diaoyu island and turns a blind eye to the provocative behavior of its right - wingers landing on the island .
as far as the equipment of its three armed services is concerned , japan boasts the world 's most advanced weapons , such as aegis missile destroyers , f-2 fighter planes , and model 90 tanks .
japan is vigorously developing advanced armament for the very purpose of " laying a foundation " for interfering in " peripheral developments . "
this shows that what we must really remind the world to be wary of are the military trends in japan .
judging by the recent developments , there is a deeper purpose encapsulated in japan 's latest defense white paper , which suggests " being wary of china 's military developments ; " that is , to find a new excuse for japan 's development of its military power .
under such circumstances , japan needed to find a new " rationale " for its military development .
claiming that china 's medium - range missiles " have brought the asian region , including japan , into their range " is the new excuse that japan has made up in order to further develop the theater missile defense system in collaboration with the united states .
after the cold war ended , some western countries , including japan , invented the " china threat theory , " and it was mainly aimed at the fast - developing economy of china at the time .
but after it comprehensively adjusted its military strategy a few years ago , japan gradually began clamoring about the so - called " military threat " from china .
many high - ranking politicians spoke at great length about the " military threat " that china poses to japan , trying to invent an excuse for the development of its military power .
this would not only spell harm and nothing else to the sino - japanese relations , but would also have a vicious impact on the peace situation in east asia and even the world .
since a special national grain reserves system was instituted in 1990 , the national grain reserves system with central grain reserves as its mainstay had operated for 10 years .
in the past 10 years , the central grain reserves played a very important role in regulating grain supply in the market during bumper - and poor - harvest years and in protecting the interests of the peasants .
to solve these problems , it was necessary to keep to the direction of reform and to reform the central grain reserves management system .
in december 1998 , the leader of the state council issued an instruction calling for reconsidering the management and operation of state grain reserves according the principle of separating the functions of the government from those of the enterprise and the new situation .
in january 2000 , the state council decided to set up the china national grain reserves management company to exercise vertical management of central grain reserves .
instituting a vertical management system through the china national grain reserves management company , a large state - owned enterprise , is conducive to bringing into play the role of central grain reserves in macroeconomic regulation and control .
after setting up the china national grain reserves management company , the central grain reserves management system has been changed from level - to - level management to vertical management ; the three levels of management within the company belong to the same entity of interests , with unified objectives .
this institutionally ensures the smooth implementation of government decrees as well as flexible and appropriate operation within the central grain reserves management system ; thus , all activities concerning grain will be coordinated as in a chess game , and the regulating and controlling efficiency of central grain reserves will be improved .
in the future , if central grain reserves are to be stored in granaries which do not belong to the central government , the management of such granaries will be exercised through the examination of qualifications and economic contracts .
this will be conducive to clearly defining the responsibilities , rights , and obligations of the units in charge of the granaries in which central grain reserves are stored ; then , the security of central grain reserves will be guaranteed by economic and legal means .

would the taiwan authorities dare to boast about a " decisive battle offshore " just by relying on their army of 400,000 , 430 aircraft , and several score combat ships , if they did not have the backing of external forces ?
to tell the truth , this stuff was learned from the americans .
would the taiwan authorities ' so - called " decisive battle offshore " be in the taiwan strait , or would it be pushed into the mainland 's interior ?
after the " decisive battle offshore " idea came out , it triggered fierce argument and criticism within taiwan .
their so - called " offshore " means holding command of information , the air , and the sea in the taiwan strait , to prevent enemy forces from assembling and to check the enemy units on the opposite shore .
the air force has accounted for over $ 20 billion and the navy for $ 15 billion of the taiwan military 's $ 38 billion spending on " second generation weapon systems . "
however , an analysis of taiwan 's military combat capability , especially of its naval and air forces , will readily show that the taiwan military 's so - called " decisive battle offshore " can only be described as a dangerous and dubious wishful thinking .
for instance , the taiwan military lacks long - range precision strike weapons .
although the taiwan military has developed " ching feng " [ qing feng ] ground - to - ground tactical missiles and " tien ma " [ tian ma ] missiles , these have not been built up into any scale .
at present they are also developing the " tien chi " [ tian ji ] missile , but they have not yet made a breakthrough in a large number of technological points .
in terms of taiwan 's geographical conditions , its surrounding seas are vast , the line is long with many points , its coastline has a total length of 1,139 km , and taiwan 's combat ships could hardly cope with all - round large - scale naval warfare .
taiwan investigators have discovered that the f-16 fighter , extolled by the taiwan military as the " trump card , " has a total of 390 faults .
this fully shows that " foreign weapons " are unreliable .
since taiwan completely relies on foreign countries for its main combat hardware , should war break out , how can they fight a " decisive battle " when one is shot down after another and they are eventually all shot down ?
the taiwan military 's bases lack sufficient depth and can easily be attacked .
the taiwan air force now has eight main military airbases : taoyuan , hsinchu , chiayi , kungkuan , tainan , pingtung , hualien , and so on .
most of these are near the west coast .
ground - to - ground missiles can accurately hit and destroy taiwan military airbase that poses a threat to the mainland .
even if these planes can take off , they will end up with no home to go to .

section chief sun from the rural investigation corps under the state statistical bureau pointed out that the impacts of reduced summer grain output on the grain markets are limited , the prices of grain may stop falling and pick up , but they will not fluctuate drastically .
judging from the current situation , the drop in grain production in the whole year is an inevitable outcome , but it will not fundamentally change the setup of supply exceeding demand in china .
the prolonged situation of supply exceeding demand in the grain markets has caused the grain prices to fluctuate at low prices .
the way of solution is to comprehensively readjust agricultural structure , achieve the transformation of agriculture from quantity expansion to quality elevation , and develop a modern agriculture characterized by fine quality and high effectiveness .
an expert concerned pointed out that the reduced output of summer grain held a very small proportion in the total amount of grain output in china , which will not make a fundamental change in the setup of supply exceeding demand in the domestic markets .
in addition , peasants ' per capita cash income had an actual growth of 1.8 percent in the first six months , the growth rate has slowed down , and peasants ' living expenses presented a tendency of restorative growth .
section chief sun from the rural investigation corps under the state statistical bureau considered it a normal phenomenon that the prices of wheat , corn , and rice are rising in the markets at present .
as wheat is the principal crop of the summer grain that has reduced output , the fluctuation of wheat prices is not at all surprising .
meanwhile , as the market supply of corn and rice is in a suspended period now , the fluctuation of prices is also normal , but the possibility of a falling situation later cannot be ruled out as well .
the expert is of the opinion that china 's ability in producing grain is not stable , it is difficult for the grain production to make advances , whereas it is vulnerable to retrogression .
at present , it is the opportune moment for making agricultural structural adjustment , but it is imperative to step up planning and ensure that the reduced production of grain must be conducted under the bottom line of security for china .
after all , china is a country with a large population , and the production of grain cannot be slackened at any time .

by setting forth this goal , the cpc central committee demonstrated its strong determination and extraordinary courage in making sure that state enterprises are well run . it played an extremely significant role in mobilizing the whole party and the whole nation and became a strong impetus driving the reform and development of state enterprises .
much progress has been made in reforming state enterprises and lifting them out of difficulty [ subhead ] the three - year goal for reforming state enterprises and lifting them out of difficulty was proposed just before the onslaught of the grim tests of the asian financial crisis and the exceptionally serious floods in china .
insufficient effective demand in society and a significant downturn in the economic efficiency of enterprises brought about a host of difficulties hampering the effort to achieve the three - year goal .
state - owned and state - controlled industry reaped 90.3 billion yuan in profits , 2.06 times the figure for the same period last year .
such a big margin of increase in economic efficiency has not been seen in recent years .
the economic efficiency in the majority of regions has improved significantly .
compared to the same period last year , enterprises in state - owned and state - controlled industry in 25 out of the 31 provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities nationwide were profitable as a whole .
all three provinces in northeast china , a key region for the three - year program of relieving enterprises of their difficulties , managed to increase their gain by big margins .
the economic efficiency of key industries has continued to improve .
compared to the same period last year , among the 14 key industries , metallurgical , petrochemical , machinery , electronics , light industry , textile , pharmaceutical , tobacco , and gold industries saw their profits increased and the power industry maintained a relatively high level of profitability .
within that picture , 93 important large and medium - sized enterprises in the metallurgical industry reaped 5.43 billion yuan in profits , representing an increase of 3.5 times ; those in the petrochemical industry brought in a profit of 39.43 billion yuan , representing an increase of 2.7 times .
nonferrous metal and building materials industries reversed loss to gain .
new progress has been made in helping large and medium - sized enterprises reverse loss and extricate themselves from straitened circumstances .
after more than two years ' efforts , by the end of june this year , the number of loss makers had been cut down to 3,626 , 54.9 percent of the original total .
if the relevant work is well performed , it is possible to reverse loss to gain by the end of this year . the reasons for such good results in the reform and development of state enterprises are manifold .
secondly , various regions and various departments have set great store by it and conducted a great deal of down - to - earth and effective work .
various departments concerned have worked closely together , supported each other , and done a great deal of work .
the significant improvement in the economic efficiency of state enterprises has further reinforced our confidence in realizing the three - year goal for reforming state enterprises and lifting them out of difficulty .
practice has proven that this goal of reforming and ending difficulties for state enterprises within three years , proposed by the 15 th party congress and the first plenary session of the 15 th cpc central committee has greatly boosted the morale of the whole party and the whole nation and aroused the enthusiasm in all quarters .
further efforts are called for in order to achieve the three - year goal of reforming state enterprises and lifting them out of difficulty [ subhead ] the prospect for achieving the three - year goal of reforming state enterprises and lifting them out of difficulty is positive and full of hope .
apart from the efforts made by enterprises themselves , support from state policies has played an important role in the improvement of their efficiency and it is also inseparable from the improvement of the world economic situation .
the foundation of those enterprises that have come out of difficulty is still very fragile ; the majority of them do not have a high level of profitability , their internal management is not yet solid , and their adaptability to market changes is not strong .
because the mechanism for exiting the market is underdeveloped and the social security system is less than perfect , a batch of enterprises that should have pulled out of the market have failed to do so in good time .
some age - old , deep - level problems facing enterprises , such as inflexible mechanisms , having more hands than needed , and excessive debts , have yet to be thoroughly solved .
the enterprises ' capability of innovation , competitiveness , and ability to protect themselves against risks are still rather weak . in order to truly embark on a virtuous circle , they need the protection of the right mechanism and the support of the right technology , which are both unavailable .
we should combine the phased goal of reforming and developing state enterprises with the long - term goal , focusing on the change of mechanisms and technological innovation in enterprises , so that the results of the three - year program of reforming and ending difficulties are better manifested as higher efficiency , changed mechanisms , and greater competitiveness .
at present , continued efforts should be made to conduct the following work properly as a priority .
firstly , it is necessary to intensify the merger and bankruptcy process and perfect the mechanism for exiting the market for state enterprises .
provided that social stability is guaranteed , the intensity of the shutdown and bankruptcy process should be further increased .
thanks to the joint efforts of various parties , the vast majority of enterprises recommended last year for the proposed conversion of creditor 's rights into stock rights have signed agreements to this effect with financial assets management companies .
thirdly , it is necessary to expedite the technological transformation of enterprises and raise their capabilities in technological innovation .
technological transformation must center on variety , quality , efficiency , and expansion of export . high and new technology and advanced , applicable technology should be used to transform a batch of key enterprises in the important industries to develop products that enjoy competitive advantages and to stem redundant development in an effective way .
the function of the established enterprise technological development centers should be fully exploited , so as to improve the enterprise 's capability of independent innovation .
continued efforts should be made to further decontrol and enliven small state enterprises in a variety of ways .
the joint reorganization of enterprises should be promoted on the basis of specialized division of labor and cooperation , to create a scenario of large , medium - sized , and small enterprises being organically linked and developing in harmony .
on the basis of reviewing past experience , it is necessary to establish and develop a management system for large enterprises and enterprise groups that complies with the requirements of the market economy and caters to the characteristics of china .
sixth , active efforts should be made to promote the development of the modern enterprise system and change the operational mechanisms of enterprises in a conscientious way .
it is necessary to broaden the avenues of financing for enterprises and achieve the diversity of investors through various means .
it is necessary to continue to make a success of the regulation and control of total supply and demand in accordance with the market demand .

however , because of the chinese government 's flexibility in carrying out its monetary and financial policy , china has been able to maintain a relatively high economic growth . but the phenomenon of declining commodity prices - - a sign of deflation - - has not been mitigated .
deflation is triggered by greater supply than demand in the overwhelming majority sectors of the national economy .
according to statistics , 30 percent or even more chinese manufacturers have excessive production capacity .
the most pressing task now is to do everything possible to digest the excessive productive capacity so that the country can walk out from the deflation predicament and resume its sustained , rapid and healthy economic growth .
when excessive production capacity commonly exists , enterprises have problems finding investment opportunities and consumers are uncertain with their future incomes , monetary policies , such as lowering interest rates and increasing credit , are unlikely to encourage investments and consumption .
one important way to do so is to speed up the construction of the socialist market economy and remove the institutional barriers and policies that restrict nongovernmental investments .

the chinese government should also actively help taiwan businessmen who have had special difficulties and problems , take the initiative to strengthen communications and association with them , know their practical operational and living problems , listen to their views , and organically combine lawful management with readiness to solve problems .

shenyang , 7 aug ( xinhua ) - - the eighth cross - strait academic seminar on promoting china 's modernization cosponsored by the association for relations across the taiwan strait [ arats ] and the taiwan " academic research foundation for promoting china 's modernization " closed in shenyang today .
vigorously developing cross - strait exchanges and cooperation and creating conditions for peaceful reunification are the greatest hope and fundamental interests of compatriots on both sides of the strait .
during the seminar , responsible persons of liaoning province and shenyang city gave briefings on the situations of local state - owned enterprise reform , opening to the outside world , and the future social economic development and planning .
the participants also visited shenyang jinbei bus company , shenyang high and new technological development zone , and other state - owned enterprises , high and new - tech industries , and modern agricultural projects .
gao guozhu , vice governor of liaoning province , li yafei , secretary general of arats , and wang sheng , chairman of the board of directors of the taiwan " academic research foundation for promoting china 's modernization , " attended the closing ceremony .
the two - day meeting focuses mainly on discussing issues encountered in china 's modernization process , including extricating state - owned enterprises out of difficulty , institutional reform , developing the third industry - - especially the information industry - - rural industrial adjustment , and the transfer of excess labor force .
in his speech at the opening ceremony , li bingcai , deputy director of the state council 's taiwan affairs office , said : this meeting was convened at a time when there is constant development in cross - strait economic and technological cooperation .

china is facing a very acute problem in the geological environment .
china is now one of the countries in the world facing the most serious geological problems .
since the flood season this year , serious and repeated geological disasters , including landslides and mud - rock flows , have killed and injured over 500 people and caused economic losses of several hundred million yuan .
geological disasters pose a serious threat to economic construction and the people 's lives and property in many regions throughout the country , and constitute one of the important factors restraining our economic development and social progress .
during the last two years , as instructed by the leadership of the party central committee and the state council , the slrm sent work teams to the severely afflicted areas to help combat disasters when the season for floods started .
but china , as a disaster - ridden country , has a long way to go before it can bring geological disasters under control . long - term and strenuous efforts are needed .
it is necessary to investigate and assess china 's potential geological disasters , fully understand the law of the growth and spread of geological disasters , designate the areas where geological disasters occur frequently , and revise and improve the program of preventing and controlling geological disasters in light of economic and population distributions .
two , we must further strengthen legal system building .
the " methods for preventing , controlling , and coping with geological disasters " promulgated by the slrm has provided a legal guarantee for the relevant work . we must vigorously propagate and earnestly put into effect the " methods , " bringing the prevention and control of geological disasters into the orbit of the legal system .
in the meantime , we should strengthen law enforcement and prosecute according to law those engaged in illegal productive activities such as unauthorized extraction of minerals , excessive pumping of underground water , and indiscriminate construction , which bring on geological disasters causing enormous losses .
we should tell the masses , through varied and colorful publicity and educational campaigns , what geological disasters are and how to combat them so as to increase their knowledge on geological disasters and enhance their capability of preventing and reducing them .

at 2100 hours in the evening , the ninth company suddenly telephoned the medical team , saying that small lumps mysteriously appeared on the face of a new soldier named chen zhen , possibly due to reaction to the altitude , and asked the group leader whether it should immediately send him down the mountain for hospital treatment .

the regiment leader received a dozen or more letters on this kind of requests .

therefore , the regiment took the opportunity to hold a big discussion on " scientific knowledge on highland " and activities such as contests on highland knowledge .
the increase in combat effectiveness began from - - solving difficult issues by relying on scientific planning yunufeng is dubbed the mountain of gods by the local people .
on the afternoon of 24 july , at the foot of the mountain , combat vehicles rumbled on , guns fired , and thick gun smokes filled the snow - covered base , as drills to enhance the infantry regiment 's attack tactics were intensely carried out .
this is the first large - scale live tactical drills in snow - clad highland at the altitude of 5,500 meters in the military region 's history of training .
looking at the fierce soldiers at the training base , everyone present on the scene was filled with a sincere respect for the soldiers .
although the soldiers carried heavy equipment during their training , no one showed any signs of altitude sickness .
at the 3,800 - meter xiangpishan , during the ninth company 's anti - air landing exercises , after just more than 100 meters of running on assault , two soldiers fell to the ground in shock , and a third laid on the ground and screamed wildly , saying that his body was going to explode .
in this training , a total of 26 soldiers suffered from altitude reaction due to a lack of oxygen , and the number of non - combat personnel was reduced by up to 40 percent because of the sickness .
later , we only learned from experts of altitude sickness of the 22 hospital that the screaming soldier 's altitude reaction was the most serious at that time as he was in need of oxygen most . if oxygen was not promptly given , he would develop pulmonary emphysema , and his life would be in danger .
if we do not scientifically understand the altitude , it will truly become a " killer . "
because of the lack of oxygen , the respiratory center will be responsively excited , the respiratory rate will increase , and the breathing will be deep .
at an altitude of 3,000 to 4,000 meters , asthma will occur noticeably . if the degree of exercise is increased , altitude reaction will show .
with the increase in the altitude , the saturation rate of the human body 's artery blood oxygen will also drop from 90 percent at sea level to 85 percent at 4,000 meters , and to only 70 percent at 6,000 meters .
as soon as the altitude adaptability training began , the regiment visited leaders of soldiers ' posts in qinghai and tibet . they learned from them that many people from the inland suffered from altitude reaction when they first arrived on the highland . the adaptability period is usually 10 days .
therefore , the regiment made this proposal : " spend the first three nights well and stabilize the first 10 days . " within these 10 days , the soldiers were not allowed to do any vigorous exercises , hike up the mountain without authorization , and do training without carrying oxygen .
the training was conducted in three stages at the altitudes of 3,500 meters , 4,500 meters , and 5,500 meters .
further , the troops fine - tuned their training according to the principle of placing physical functions ahead of skills , training method ahead of tactics , and psychology ahead of physiology to gradually increase the strength and degree of difficulty in training .
the troops achieved big quality improvement in their psychological and physical training through scientific training .
in the process of adaptability training , in line with the reality that it had no standards for physical conditions training at an altitude of 2,500 meters , the regiment conducted tests on the troops ' physical conditions and shooting capability .
scene five : at the temporary firing range at the western plateau , the first light weapon firing confrontation after the troops ' arrival at the highland was held between the 1 st and 4 th companies . after a round of firing , only 2 out of 10 soldiers were outstanding in their firing .

why did some commanders treat network warfare coldly ?
this high - technology project 's lot on the drill ground , as well as these comments , provoked the deep thought of some people with broader vision .
although not every one of them could be viewed as a brilliant exercise , he said that he has rarely seen such cold treatment as that encountered by this network information warfare drill .
he told these reporters that he reckoned before the exercise that this project might not be as well received as those combat exercises on a magnificent scale . for this reason , he and others together thought of quite a number of methods to increase its viewability .
he believed one of the reasons undoubtedly was that the drill was hard to " perceive directly through the senses . "
although network warfare is called warfare , it in fact has no gunshots nor scenes of charging . no bombs are seen for " electronic bombs " and there is no wall in a " firewall . " everything is conducted in an invisible electromagnetic space and the battle is over in just a few dozen seconds .
therefore , it is very difficult to provoke people 's interest .
however , he said this is not the fundamental reason . the " root " of the problem probably lies in their understanding of modern warfare .
some comrades verbally call for meeting the challenge of informationalized warfare but inwardly always feel that such a challenge is still far away from us .
take our group army for example . the number of computers possessed by our unit has doubled over these two years alone .
network attack and protection have become operational issues having an effect on the reality of victory or defeat .
the second worry is that some comrades ' training concept is lagging behind the requirements of winning wars .
with the development of high - technology warfare and continual renewal of our army 's equipment , we would become unfamiliar with even the training patterns we used to be familiar with .
in the counter - air - raid drills nowadays , less shells and more missiles are used and there is rarely a scene where thousands of guns are fired at the same time upon the issuance of an order as in the past .
furthermore , the sight of officers and men carrying guns in their hands and shouldering weapons while charging and shattering enemy positions cannot possibly occur in anti - reconnaissance , anti - interference , and anti - precision - strikes , and similar drills .
he asserted quite confidently : it will not be long before they become a new hot issue on the drill ground .

in face of the forthcoming challenges and opportunities , what do china 's farmers think ?
a survey shows that with china 's wto entry just around the corner , farmers are still full of confidence about their own " native products " in face of the " foreign goods . "
however , what worries us is that in despite of their confidence , our farmers know little about their competitors abroad .
the farmers were asked the question : " after china enters the wto , what kind of impact will it wield on the sales of our farm products ? "
farmers ' lack of concern about the impact of china 's wto entry is also shown by the following fact . only slightly over 10 percent of the respondents have ever heard about the report that " us oranges had entered china in march this year . "
comparatively speaking , women in rural areas were even less concerned about any current event as compared with men . in this incident , only 8.9 percent of the women in rural areas heard the aforementioned report , nearly 6 percent lower than that of men .
naturally grain of our own is better when comparing the domestically produced rice , fruits , and meat with their foreign counterparts , peasant households that know little about foreign brands expressed their full confidence in their own native products .
comparing rice , fruits , or meat , more than 40 percent of the peasant households polled said that " native products are better than imports , " while significantly lower percentage , or less than 20 percent of the households surveyed , believed that " imports are better than native products . "
geographically , farmers in liaoning ( 64.1 percent ) and those in shaanxi ( 58.9 percent ) believed that " native rice , fruits , and meat are better than imports . " however , more than 30 percent of the farmers in hubei " would prefer imports to domestic products . "
it is strictly geographical in nature . china has a vast territory . its geographical differences are significant .
however , as compared with " foreign brand name products , " the brand names of our native products do not shine that much .
we are sure that following the development of the production and the agro - science and technology and the improvement of farmers ' quality and their sense of competition , china 's " native farm products " are entirely able to compete with " foreign name brands . "
the storm is about to burst and china 's wto entry is just around the corner .
in the past seven years , however , the un general affairs committee has each time specifically refused to put the so - called " taiwan issue " on the un 's agenda , and the taiwan authorities ' conspiracy to split china has never succeeded .
it can be predicted that their " farce of joining the united nations " is certain to fail again this year .
at the same time , it must be pointed out that the united nations is an intergovernmental international organization composed of sovereign states and its members can only be sovereign states .
as everyone knows , taiwan has been an inalienable part of china since ancient times and is a province of china ; it is absolutely not a sovereign state , and naturally has no qualifications to join the united nations .
previously , officials of the chinese embassy in the united states made earnest representations to the us government criticizing us " transit " treatment granted chen shuibian as undoubtedly " sending the wrong signal to taiwan independence and separatist forces . "
this has sent another wrong signal to the taiwan authorities : the united states will intervene in the taiwan strait dispute and prevent the mainland from achieving reunification by the use of force .
developments , however , are always independent of man 's will .
on the other hand the united states tries to constrain chen shuibian 's " taiwan independence " activities , but it cannot necessarily succeed in this regard .
whether or not force is used against taiwan will be determined by the " three ifs " mentioned in the white paper on taiwan ( if taiwan independence occurs , if foreign forces intervene , and if things drag on without solution ) , and will also take into consideration the possibility of foreign military intervention .
hence , when us secretary of defense cohen visited china in mid - july , chinese defense minister chi haotian earnestly said when meeting him that china hopes that the united states will not send taiwan the wrong signals regarding the taiwan problem .

changes are brewing up in the taiwan strait situation , and the situation of " peace without reunification " desired by the united states cannot last long .
