the purpose of putting newspapers online is to increase readership and speed up news dissemination .
the china radio international [ cri ] , as one of the world 's three largest international radio stations , of course has refused to be left behind - - 10 of its broadcasts in 43 languages have been made available online .
the radio station mainly uses short - wave transmission for its radio broadcasts to outside the country .
all these have injected new vigor into radio broadcasting and provided an unprecedented opportunity for our broadcasts to effectively reach western countries .
over the last nearly two years since the cri website was established , it has played a special role in stepping up china 's propaganda broadcasts to foreign countries .
all of these important activities were broadcast live on the internet by the cri , enabling the station to provide live radio broadcasts and internet transmissions simultaneously , and enabling the audience to conveniently and quickly receive live broadcasts .
after live broadcasting of some important events , the station 's workers immediately processed the scripts and recordings used for live broadcasting to prepare special programs for replay on the internet .
since 1999 , cri has conducted 16 live broadcasts on the internet on various important events , using english , portuguese , mandarin , and the guangzhou dialect .
it requires a large amount of money to build a high - standard website . in addition to hardware investment , routine maintenance and operation also require quite a lot of money .
the bandwidth of the cri website was only 1 million mhz , which was far narrower than websites of its kind in european countries and the united states , thus restricting the speed and efficiency of connecting to the network and the number of clicks .
to rapidly narrow the gap between the cri website and those of foreign countries , since february this year , cri has carried out a sweeping change in the layout of its website . the change started from the technical aspect .
after clicking on the website , one can see a visually marvelous navigational map . after getting into the website , a visitor can choose a sub - site in the language he or she prefers , giving great convenience to website visitors .
the first change of the website 's layout was completed in june , and the second change is being carried out in full swing .
since july this year , the station has continued to add new languages to its website . its goal is to gradually increase the languages on the web to 43 within three years , and to build the website into a multi - language , diversified , and multi - media website for propaganda toward foreign countries .

through the internet , the web sites have actively introduced china 's state of development and china 's culture and history ; let the world know china ; boosted the international community 's confidence in china ; promoted mutually beneficial cooperation and friendly exchanges ; and become the outstanding feature in key internet news reporting .

beijing , 11 aug ( xinhua ) - - comrades , friends : as the chinese peasants ' and workers ' democratic party celebrates the 70 th anniversary of its founding , let me express warm congratulations on behalf of the cpc central committee !
after the founding of the new china , the peasants ' and workers ' democratic party achieved marked results in safeguarding and consolidating the people 's political power , participating in socialist transformation , and promoting socialist construction .
history shows that the peasants ' and workers ' democratic party is a close political partner of the cpc and always shares weal and woe and cooperates closely with the cpc , and that it holds an important position and plays an important role in china 's political life .
both the cpc as a ruling party and the peasants ' and workers ' democratic party as a party participating in the government should better shoulder their glorious mission given by the times and the people .
this is a correct principle we adopted after paying heavy costs and drawing a lesson from both positive and negative experiences since the founding of the people 's republic .
over more than 20 years , under the guidance of this principle , our national economy has been developing rapidly , the people 's living standards have been markedly improved , our international status has been raised continuously , and earthshaking changes have occurred in all parts of our country .
taking economic development as the central task is the most important consensus of opinion among the entire chinese people , and is the fundamental way to resolve various contradictions .
at present , the process of economic globalization is obviously quickening ; the scientific and technologic revolution is making leaps and bounds ahead . the developed countries are expanding their economic strength by making use of various advantages , and many developing countries are also adjusting their policies to catch up vigorously .
while facing such a situation , we must boost a sense of urgency , a sense of crisis , and a sense of responsibility . we should concentrate our energy , waste no time , and try by all possible means to strengthen ourselves .
we should guarantee that all democratic systems can be effectively implemented and various forms of democracy can be fully put into practice , and that various democratic channels can be more effectively operational according to the specification of the prc constitution in the general pattern of our country 's state and political system .
we cannot copy the model of another country in a simplistic way , and we cannot act hastily or recklessly . recklessness will not lead to democracy , but will just cause chaos to society and bring about disasters to the people .
the cpc - led multi - party cooperation and political consultation system is a basic political system in keeping with the national conditions of our country .
all of us should dearly cherish , conscientiously implement , and continuously improve this system with chinese characteristics and obvious advantages .
without prolonged coexistence , there is no supervision at all .
on the other hand , mutual supervision is the purpose of prolonged coexistence . without supervision , prolonged coexistence will lose its significance . mutual supervision should certainly be two - way .
however , as the communist party is holding a leading position in our country , whether its principles and policies are correct will have a direct bearing on the people 's interests and the state 's future ; when we talk about mutual supervision , we mainly refer to various democratic parties ' supervision over the communist party .
the cpc is a faithful representative of the fundamental interests of the broadest people , and it has no special interests of its own and thus should not fear or reject supervision .
we sincerely hope that the vast members of various democratic parties will make more criticisms and be critical friends of the communist party .
we hope that all democratic parties , including the peasants ' and workers ' democratic party , will also active explore new ways for their self - building according to the current situation and their respective characteristics on the basis of carrying forward their fine tradition .

during late spring and early summer of 2000 , drought wreaked havoc on the vast land of northern china , causing water shortages in the industrial and agricultural sectors and in people 's daily life .
excessive drilling of underground water in north china has created the world 's largest underground funnel and has caused surface subsidence and a series of environmental problems .
it is this excessively inflated " result - seeking " mentality that has led to the increasingly aggravated water crisis in north china .
a few years ago hebei 's cangzhou city put forward the goal of " turning cangzhou into china 's third chemical industrial city " .
to attract a major project that consumes 20 million cubic meters of water a year , a certain county government " generously " exempted the investor from paying three years of water surcharge .
in the minds of many cadres , attracting investment and undertaking projects appear to have nothing to do with water conservancy departments . some , while being familiar about the relevant regulations , are not willing to get the water conservancy department involved , fearful the project would be aborted during the feasibility study .
when a water conservancy cadre urged the local leader to consider the sustainable use of water resources in starting up projects , the leader gave him a sharp warning , saying " if i do not have water today , what do i care if my grandchildren have water or not ! "
hebei 's suning county was an advanced county in learning from dazhai in agriculture in the 1970 s . after liberation , local cadres and masses started drilling motor - pumped wells to develop agriculture .
people figuratively said that because of drilling , suning is almost like a honeycomb .
during our visit to the countryside in north china , we saw many well drilling advertisements on walls . some localities even put forward slogans calling for " drilling 10,000 wells " and launching " 1,000 wells drilling campaign . " many cadres are not aware of the serious consequences of excessive drilling of underground water .
they generally feel that water is an inexhaustible natural resource .
treating symptoms instead of the disease cannot cure the patient during our visit , we have found that the water conservation measures adopted in various localities are far from being able to meet the needs of the current conditions .
in the course of economic development , north china has built an industrial structure very incompatible with the distribution of its water resources . such an irrational economic structure poses a tremendous threat because it aggravates north china 's water crisis .
yet , along the very fuyang he are large tracts of rice paddies and lotus roots ponds .
a tense situation with people fighting for water has emerged during the peak season of water use .
anxious agricultural experts have said that if this condition persists , it is impossible to drastically reduce the agricultural use of water , and the water crisis will further aggravate .
dr. shi yubo of the water resources department under the ministry of water resources believes that to maintain the balance between water supply and demand , we must on the one hand do our best to increase supply and on the other hand try every means to reduce demand .
he said that controlling demands based on supply is the inevitable option for north china and even for the whole country , that this policy should guide the construction of small towns , and that blind development and expansion in disregard of the supply of natural resources should not be allowed .
at present , north china 's primary task is to speed up improving the varieties and adjusting agricultural cropping structure .
drought - enduring crops , such as oil - bearing crops , cotton , sweet potato , and peanuts , should be planted in areas where water resources are poor .
a ministry of water resources cadre said that the practice of " everyone singing his or her own songs " is the typical end - result of the current multiheaded water management system .
they obviously do not care how much water they use as long as they do not pay for water used for agricultural purpose . this is why it is relatively difficult to popularize advanced water conservation techniques , such as sprinkling and drip irrigation , and promote the efficient use of water .
this has , of course , increased the peasants ' burden , but it also stopped the practice of wanton water squandering .

beijing , 14 aug ( xinhua ) - - the work of extricating state - owned enterprises from difficulties has now entered the " sprint " stage , the key sectors are maintaining a good development momentum , and overall economic development has entered the crucial stage of reversing the continuous decline in growth rate of recent years .
we are facing both good opportunities and also severe challenges ; very many predictable and unpredictable dangers and difficulties of all kinds lie on the way ahead .
hence we must do still better at grasping the economic momentum , advance on the crest of victory , and maintain sustained , healthy , and rapid development of the national economy .
china 's economic development has undergone many turns in recent years ; the cpc central committee and state council have seriously studied and boldly mastered the changes in the economic situation and made efforts to grasp the initiative in economic work and to promote economic development along a correct orientation and healthy track .
china successfully achieved an economic " soft landing " in 1996 .
the pressure for a decline in economic growth rate started in the second half of 1997 , under the impact of the asian financial crisis .
the central authorities promptly readjusted the policy and made the major policy decision on expanding domestic demand , and also regarded this as a long - term strategic guideline for china 's national economic development .
starting in 1998 , in order to maintain steady economic growth , china instituted an active fiscal policy and also made efforts to bring into play the role of monetary policy , and made comprehensive use of a variety of measures to regulate and control economic operations .
these policy measures effectively curbed a possible slide in the national economy and played an important role in drawing forward sustained economic growth and stimulating a rebound in economic returns .
from withstanding the asian financial crisis to expanding domestic demand , and from successfully controlling inflation to actively curbing deflation , the successful control of the economic situation by the cpc central committee and state council has further enriched china 's experience in macroeconomic regulation and control .
third , all areas and departments have seriously implemented the central authorities ' guidelines and policies and carried out their arrangements , coordinated all the activities of the whole country as in a game of chess , worked with initiative , and brought into full play our political advantages .
this year , a good momentum of steady rebound has emerged in our national economy . growth in the first half of the year was 8.2 percent .
in the first seven months of the year , china completed industrial added value [ wan cheng gong ye zeng jia zhi ] of 1.2956 trillion yuan , up by 11.4 percent over the corresponding period of last year .
the inherent vitality of economic growth remains insufficient , however , and at the same time , the international and domestic economic situation has become more complex with each passing day .
in grasping the momentum , it is first necessary to have a clear picture of the laws of economic development .
economic development has its own laws for the up and down process of moving from troughs to peaks .
momentum is a dynamic state , and opportunities and challenges can arise at any time .
we must seize the opportunities and not miss them , and clear the way to forge ahead instead of sticking to old ways .
at present the world economy is warning up again , while the momentum of our national economy is gratifying , and these two factors fuse into the last big opportunity of this century for speeding up our economic development .
we cannot be sluggish in the slightest degree .
while deepening state enterprise reforms and speeding up restructuring , we must actively study how to deal with post - wto development strategy , be prepared for a rainy day , turn challenges into motive force , and make all preparations for fusing into global economic integration .
in grasping the momentum , we must get a good grasp of the rhythm of economic development .
in the next stage we must continue to unswervingly implement the economic policies laid down by the cpc central committee and state council , and guard against the emergence of economic phenomena such as duplicate construction , which would cause the economic train to veer from the correct track .
in grasping the momentum , it is also necessary to cautiously choose the economic development strategy .
when a new momentum appears in economic development , all sectors and trades must draw up highly effective policies and strategy based on their specific conditions .

a few days ago , the overhauled website of the china internet information center - - www.china.org.cn - - was officially reopened to chinese and overseas net - surfers .
availing itself of this opportunity , the center started a major overhaul two months ago . with the help of a substantial increase in investment , it expanded its editorial and technical force and redesigned its content .
unlike other media websites which go after " novelty and speed , " china.org.cn aspires to be a " super cyber magazine . "
the content of the renovated website comprises two main components , that is , dynamic roll - on news columns and special databases that give an introduction of china 's overall conditions .
the dynamic and the static components are hyper - linked and complement each other to form a three - dimensional information setup that is unique to the internet .
basic facts regarding china are divided into special topics , thus making it easy for foreign net - surfers to search and quote information .
since the website comes directly under the guidance of the state council 's information office , it is able to promptly reflect the policies of the chinese government and its functional institutions .
with the assistance of the china foreign languages publishing and distribution administration and the dozen or so foreign language magazines and publishing houses under it , the information provided on this website is professionally edited and is therefore much more readable , informative and easy to search .
most of the reports in china.org.cn are accompanied by relevant news items and other references which provide the background material . this is made possible by the website 's own huge database .
for example , the " china in brief " database has over 100 entries under more than 20 headings . with a total wordcount of several hundred thousand characters and over 100 pictures , this database is itself an encyclopedia on china .
the renovated china.org.cn website is available in 11 versions , published in 10 languages , including chinese in both simplified and full forms , english , french , german , japanese , spanish , russian , arabic , italian and esperanto .
information in each version is selected and edited according to the culture of receptors in different regions . the style and flavor of the web pages also differ according to the cultural characteristics of different regions to fully take care of the reading habits of readers of different countries .
in addition , experts of the foreign languages bureau with decades of experience in overseas propaganda have been invited to give them backup support by assisting them in making the final checks and passing on experience .
with such a professional team , china.org.cn is able to closely follow the movements of major media throughout the world and promptly respond to international public opinion on major issues so that the world understands the attitude and views of the chinese government on major international affairs .

the supreme people 's court today [ 16 august ] has promulgated the " method on selecting and appointing chief justice by the people 's court , " and people 's courts at various levels throughout the country will fully implement the selection system for chief justices [ presiding judges ] within two years .
being the most basic trial organization of the people 's court , the collegial panel is directly responsible for the trial of various legal cases .
through direct trial of a legal case , members of the collegial panel hear statements of litigants and other participants in proceedings at court investigation , cross examination and court debate . this is an important prerequisite for fair trial and impartial judgment .
people other than the collegial bench express their opinions and made decisions based on the report of the collegial bench . as a result , there were frequently " trials without making judgments " and " making judgments without participating in trials . "
this practice is in violation of the principle of direct trial , the stipulations of procedural law , and the law of judicial work .
on the issue of trial efficiency , since the decision of judgment in handling cases according to administrative procedures in the past was invariably made by the president of a chamber or president of the people 's court , and the trial of a case would involve more links and require more time .
with the establishment of a socialist market economy and the expansion of the judicial role of people 's court , the court will handle more cases , including difficult and new types of cases .
this method will greatly increase the efficiency of trials , shorten time required for trials , and more effectively protect the legitimate rights and benefits of litigants .
the selection of the chief justice will be conducive to building a contingent of high quality judges and establishing a scientific judge system . according to open , equal , competitive and selective principles , outstanding judges of high quality will be selected and appointed as the chief justice .
the selection of the chief justice will certainly promote the establishment of a trial system in accordance with the adjudication rule , lessen the administrative hue in judicial work , ensure independent power in administering justice , and protect judicial impartiality .

gist of contents : * in our country , the current culture is a kind of plural culture .
however in such a plural culture , we must guarantee the singularity of guiding ideology , and must not pursue plurality of guiding ideology .
it is absolutely wrong to think that we do not need to stress the special importance of deng xiaoping theory in the social life and the ideological field of our country because marxism - leninism , mao zedong thought , and deng xiaoping theory come down in one continuous line .
in his important speech at the central ideological and political work conference , comrade jiang zemin pointed out : " to reinforce and improve ideological and political work , the fundamental way is to maintain and consolidate the guiding position of marxism in the ideological field of our country . "
why must we maintain , consolidate guiding position of marxism in ideological field to answer this question , we should first make an analysis of the current situation in the ideological field of our country .
the situation in the ideological field of our country is good on the whole .
if we do not pay attention to this and cannot resolve various contradictions and problems in good time , the guiding position of marxism in the ideological field may be affected or even weakened .
first , we should note that current culture in our country is a kind of plural culture , and this is determined by the plurality of economic elements and interest relations at the current stage in our country .
since there exist groups of people representing different economic relations and bearing different interests , and there are differences in their age structure and cultural background , then it is inevitable that their values , hobbies , and cultural selections are diverse .
an important task for our cultural departments and departments for producing cultural products is to satisfy the diverse cultural needs of different groups of people .
that is to say , our plural culture must be plural culture under the guidance of marxism , and the guiding position of marxism is the backbone of such plural culture .
this will be extremely dangerous .
in short , maintaining the singularity of the guiding ideology is a prominent task in the ideological field at present , and we must never take it lightly .
second , we should note the influence caused by the " westernization " and " division " attempts of the hostile forces in the west to the ideological field of our country .
huntington 's theory about " conflicts of civilization , " which was rather sensational for a time , was a specimen of the cultural strategy of the united states .
standing on the position of taking the western culture as the center and proceeding from the global strategy of the united states , it expressed a basic attitude toward the confucian civilization represented by china and the muslim civilization represented by the arab region .
according to huntington , the confucian civilization and the muslim civilization have values , historical tradition , and cultural tradition totally different from those in the western civilization , and it is hard to mix them with the western civilization , so the two civilizations will eventually cause serious threats against the western civilization .
in the future , state - to - state conflicts will more and more take the form of conflicts triggered by the differences in civilization and values . therefore , the west should keep a " sense of crisis " with regard to civilization .
under the conditions of opening up to the outside world , cultural exchanges between our country and the outside world , including western countries , will continue to expand . this is normal and also conducive to the development of our country 's cultural undertakings .
at the same time , however , we must keep a high degree of vigilance against the cultural infiltration from the west .
finally , we should note that although new china has been established for half a century , the legacy thoughts , ideas , and habits of old society have not completely disappeared from the historical stage . once there is an opportunity , they certainly come out to stir up trouble and disturb our reform , development , stability .
this is the reason why there are trends of thought doubting and negating marxism from the right and the " left . "
the trends of thought from the two sides may alternately become prominent , but they all challenge and affect the guiding position of marxism in the ideological field .
the trend of thought from the right mainly finds expression in bourgeois liberalization .
over more than 10 years , the special economic zone has achieved the results as they are now in economic development , but collapse may occur just overnight .
collapse is easy , while construction is so difficult .
at present , some people in our society advocate privatization and call for selling all state - owned enterprises , advocate the political viewpoint of liberalism , which is a typical viewpoint of bourgeois liberalization .
this is a typical " leftist " point of view .
we are now facing the critical moment of building socialism with chinese characteristics . whether our cause will continue to maintain a good situation in its development in the new century will , in addition to other conditions , depend heavily on how well our ideological work is done .
in his important speech , comrade jiang zemin enunciated a series of fundamental theoretical and practical issues that have a bearing on the overall situation , gave a new summary to the status of ideological and political work in the overall tasks of the party and the state , and also set forth new requirements .
this is the sense of the overall situation , the sense of responsibility , and the sense of position that comrade jiang zemin required party committees at all levels and especially principal leading comrades of the party committees must have .
however , it should also be noted that there still exist shortcomings in our theoretical work and ideological education , which still cannot meet the needs in the development of the situation and the requirements set forth by the party .
the main problem is the divorce of theory from practice and the masses .
all of our ideological and cultural institutions and cultural products should be favorable to the spread of scientific theories and progressive culture , should promote the molding of good souls , and must not provide any channel for the spread of wrong things .
at present , although the erroneous viewpoints and erroneous trends of thought have not occupied a dominating position in the ideological field of our country , we should still prevent their spread and prevent them from challenging the guiding status of marxism in the realm of ideology .
if this question is not understood clearly , it is impossible for us to really maintain and consolidate the guiding position of marxism .
marxism is a developing science . although it was born more than 150 years ago , in different historical periods , it has been continuously innovated and developed through its integration with the new characteristics of the times on the basis of adopting new practical experience and new scientific achievements .
in the history of marxism 's development , there are milestones represented by engels , lenin , mao zedong , and deng xiaoping .
deng xiaoping theory is marxism in contemporary china , and the guiding ideological for the whole party as affirmed by the 15 th cpc national congress . this has been written into the party 's constitution .
deng xiaoping expressed his attitude toward marxism vividly in two sentences : the old ancestors ' must not be discarded ; but we should also dare to say something new that the old ancestors did not say .
as deng xiaoping said : " genuine marxist - leninsit must understand , inherit , and develop marxism - leninism according to current conditions . "
deng xiaoping theory is marxism in contemporary china , and represents the new development stage of marxism in china . "
in contemporary china , upholding deng xiaoping theory is genuinely upholding marxism - leninism and mao zedong thought ; holding high the banner of deng xiaoping theory and is to genuinely hold high the banner of marxism - leninism and mao zedong thought .
at present , although some problems exist in the ideological field and are nonessential , the mainstream is still good .
this is the foundation for doing a good job in the ideological field , and this is the fundamental reason why the mainstream of the ideological field is good .
one feels this even more keenly during a trip overseas .
the usa indeed is a developed country .
in 1978 , before reform and opening up , the dissemination rate of telephones was only 0.38 percent . in many regions the " crank " telephone was still in use , which reflected a technology lag of 75 years behind the usa .
not until 1985 did china see its first 10,000 - customer program - controlled telephone system , in the city of fuzhou .
in the following ten years , the telecommunications industry , which has been considered to be the most serious " bottleneck " of china 's economy , has achieved unprecedented development . mobile telephones especially have grown geometrically and are now among the best in the world .
telephones are no longer a luxury item . they have become the " constant companion " of the average chinese citizen .

in china a lot of people work as hard as they can to earn and save money . for now they make do with rented housing , planning to buy a house outright when they have saved enough money .

carrying out comprehensive institutional reform is a strategic task set by the 15 th cpc congress , is urgently required by the establishment of a socialist market economic system , and is an important part of political system reform .
how has been our country 's institutional reform proceeding ?
what have been the characteristics ?
in general , institutional reform is proceeding in an active and orderly manner , developing rather smoothly .
the most prominent characteristics have been : moving steadily , always proceeding on the basis of reality , acting in accordance with objective laws and laws of nature , embodying characteristics of the times , pursuing no rigid uniformity , pursuing no formalistic stuff , and making no making loud noises .
secondly , the reform has cut internal bureaucracy and personnel through eliminating bodies unsuited for current work on the basis of functional adjustments and changes and eliminating and merging bodies characterized by excessive division of labor and functional overlapping , leading to an average personnel cut of 20 percent .
local personnel planning departments have worked conscientiously to serve as advisors and assistants , overcoming difficulties and working overtime , thereby making positive contributions to the approval and implementation of reform plans .
our country is vast in territory , with uneven economic and social development across the localities and great regional differences in the level of market maturity and resource endowments .
all this has determined that in carrying out institutional reform in the localities , it is necessary to proceed on the basis of reality and to accommodate local conditions in accordance with the center 's requirements .
second , there have been breakthroughs in separating government from enterprises and progress in separating government from public institutions and social undertakings .
third , new incision points for changing functions have been seized , and real results have been achieved in reforming the system of administrative approval .
zhejiang now has 1,372 items subject to approval , after a reduction of 751 items or 54.7 percent .
only by reducing the number of items subject to approval and grasping the items calling for approval , will it be possible to complete the transformation of functions and to truly reduce personnel .
fourth , the personnel strengths of bodies are cut significantly , and there has been innovation in institutional arrangements .
innovations and experiments have been conducted in institutional adjustments , and exploration and practice have been carried out for the sake of future institutional arrangements .
also , for example , some coastal provinces have established maritime and fishery regulatory agencies in view of the needs of management of maritime resources , so as to advance the enforcement of maritime laws .
in our view , all these reforms and experiments are in line with the direction of reform , but it is also necessary not to be too hasty .
it is proper to refer to some of the above - discussed practices in the institutional reform of governments below the provincial level .
in addition , in view of the harms and losses brought by counterfeit , fake , and shoddy products , existing because of ineffective law enforcement and supervision , to production and people 's lives , some localities have strengthened law - enforcement and regulatory agencies in conjunction with the adjustment of the regulatory system .
fifth , standard rules on the framework of arrangements of working bodies of provincial - level governments have been established , thus objectively clarifying the scope of personnel decision - making of the standing committee of the national people 's congress in an objective manner .
in the past , provincial - level government agencies were undiversified in personnel composition , a situation which did not facilitate the work of institutional determination ; also it was unclear which bodies should have their responsible officials be subject to decisions by the standing committee of the national people 's congress .
first , structural adjustments of institutions of higher learning have been pursued through superordinate supervision , joint establishment efforts , and delegation of authority , in an effort to gradually establish a system of management of higher education characterized by central and provincial management and by having provincial - level governments serve as the principal bodies .
second , efforts have been made to advance the transformation of the system on scientific research institutions , with some being changed into scientific research enterprises and some joining enterprises to become enterprises ' technological innovation centers , so as to advance the combining of science and technology with the economy and the combining of research with production .
third , efforts have been made to advance the work of making geological exploration units local entities , with such units moving toward society , and efforts have been also made to transform engineering , survey , and design units into enterprises and to change the relevant system , so as to make them take part in market competition .
fourth , efforts have been made to proceed with the change of the system governing newspaper units of the various departments , leading to the establishment of newspaper groups .

[ editor 's note ] from the end of may to the end of july , a certain division of the xinjiang military district trained its soldiers for 45 days so that they could adapt themselves to the conditions of plateaus on the kalakunlun shan .
the authors went with the deep - thrust detachment and trudged over glaciers , snow plateaus and valleys with marshland for two days .
it has been learned that over 300 people of the division are " night tigers " like wang yilin .
the leaders of the division held that night fighting , being a kind of operation to take the enemy by surprise on cold plateaus where the vegetation is rare and the ground is bare , will continue to play its role despite the development of weapons and equipment .
the authors watched the firing practice at night of four kinds of anti - tank weapons and three kinds of air - defense missiles and cannons , and their percentage of hits reached 85 percent .
most of the night training at the foot of the mountain was similar to that during the daytime . gas masks were worn or flannels were used to cover up the mouths . the troops were trained as if they were in an oxygen - deficient environment on plateaus .
such gratifying changes have reflected the great vitality of training troops with science and technology , and have also given expression to the new achievements in the research and prevention of high plateau illnesses of our armed forces .
since the beginning of the 1990 s , the mountain sickness research institute of the xinjiang military district has constantly made breakthroughs in its research and prevention of plateau diseases .
with the development of training troops with science and technology and the breakthroughs made in the research and prevention of plateau diseases , the quality of the training for the troops to adapt themselves to the conditions of plateaus has constantly been improved .
in order to inspect the comprehensive response capability of the division , the leading organ at a higher level decided to ask the division to carry out the adaptation training on plateaus ahead of schedule this year and the time for preparation was shortened from 15 days to three days .
the icy slopes seemed to lead to the sky . the authors saw the troops passing one icy slope after another .
in the hinterland of the kalakunlun shan , the authors , together with the troops , withstood the test having no logistics supply for more than half a month because the road was destroyed by floods .
in order to increase the capability to win a modern local war on plateaus , a certain armored regiment moved forward over 500 km in separate companies and reached the kalakunlun shan .
a training expert said the participation in organic units of the armored troops in the training for the troops to adapt themselves to conditions of plateaus will increase the mobility of operations on plateaus in future , quicken the rhythm of war , and intensify the fierceness of war .
we solve one crucial problem in the laboratory today , we can be more confident in winning wars tomorrow .
the strong sense of responsibility , as reflected by this remark made by the scientists and technicians working for an aircraft research institute under the air force , is worth learning for every professional who works in military science and technology .
the actual development of modern high - tech wars shows that whoever takes the lead in innovation and development of military sciences and technology will hold the initiative in future battlefields .
the large number of scientific and technological workers of the military must have an overall view of the whole development of national defense modernization and must be well aware of the mission and responsibility on their shoulders .
our own obligation of serving to wars requires that we really focus our scientific and technological work on solving technical problems that affect future wars .
our own obligation of serving to wars requires scientific and technological personnel with a totally new attitude .

like the republican national convention at the beginning of this month , the democratic party was also out to ingratiate themselves with voters and rack their own brains . gore and his running mate made several important moves .
first , they played the " common people " card .
during the convention , the slogan " fighting for the common man " was everywhere ; from the campaign platform to the speeches of lieberman and gore , everyone was making particular mention of this theme .
gore said , " my focus is on working families , " " every hard - working american family deserves to open the door to their dream , " and " let us make sure that our prosperity enriches not just the few , but all working families . "
secondly , the convention reconstructed gore 's " self - image . "
ever since the beginning of the election , the american media has been full of phrases describing gore as clinton 's " shadow , " " wooden , " and " dry . " this has greatly reduced gore 's support among voters .

at the convention , the economic achievements of the past eight years were brought out time and again .
the majority of the achievements under clinton 's democratic administration were areas where gore worked hard , and so gore is the best choice to maintain this economic prosperity .

beijing , 21 aug ( xinhua ) - - the 17 th standing committee meeting of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] , which opened today , will examine and discuss the draft extradition law .
it has been learned that since 1993 , china has signed extradition treaties with 11 countries and participated in some international conventions carrying extradition articles .
in 1994 , the ministry of foreign affairs began drafting and studying the extradition law .
this people 's congress standing committee has included the extradition law in the legislative plan .
hu kangsheng explained the drafting of the extradition law. first of all , he gave a briefing on conditions for extradition and the refusal of extradition .
on the examination procedures for extradition , hu kangsheng said : in order to ensure that extradition can be correctly carried out in line with law , the draft law outlines the examination procedures .
hu kangsheng also explained the procedures for sending an extradition request to foreign countries , and the relationship between the extradition law and the extradition treaty .

china 's internet has developed swiftly over the past years .
there are 27,000 websites nationwide . it is estimated that 32 new websites were set up each day in the past two years .
thanks to the efforts made by the broad masses of website employees , there emerge a host of high - grade websites with distinguishing features and wide influence at home and abroad .
these websites belong to government departments , institutions , mass organizations , news media , and some companies in society .
the development situation of china 's internet is generally good . most of the websites are healthy in terms of contents , thus giving a positive push to the construction of the " two civilizations . "
however , we should notice that a small number of websites have ignored their responsibility to society . some distributed false news and spread information with unhealthy contents . in violation of state relevant regulations , some wantonly spread " rumors " to confuse the public , thereby having produced extremely bad influence among the masses .
some websites ' pursuit of quick success and instant benefits is the main reason for causing the aforementioned problems .
they think that with more users , they are able to attract risky investors , list their stocks on stock markets , and make a lot of money .
in fact , this kind of thinking is extremely wrong .
in a long - term point of view , its main value is to serve the people 's production and livelihood .
many websites have a clear understanding of this point .
only by so doing will we be able to actually make contributions to the construction of the socialist material and spiritual civilizations and to pioneer a vast , unlimited path for the development of china 's internet .

at about 1000 , wang zhihui , chief judge of the hubei provincial higher people 's court , solemnly announced that the court had rejected the appeals of nande economic group [ neg ] , its chairman mu qizhong , and other officials of the group ; and upheld the court 's verdicts for them in the first trial .
after hearing the announcement , mu qizhong , who was " sentenced to life imprisonment and had his political rights deprived for life " at the first trial , looked pale in front of the sanctity and dignity of the law . . . [ ellipses as received ] .
mu qizhong , who was good at " catching the white wolf empty - handedly " and who swindled foreign exchange in the name of importing goods , eventually put himself in jail ( subhead ) mu qizhong was quite well known .
shortly after the country embarked on reforms and opening up , he was imprisoned after being found guilty of " speculation , speculating in stock markets , and evading taxes . "
after he was released , he soon became very active again within business circles like a maverick . his weird idea of doing business was " doing business without any money " and " using other people 's money to work for us . "
between 1989 and 1992 , mu qizhong started a business by skillfully " borrowing " a friend 's business license and certification . without spending one cent , he bought four russian - made airplanes through barter , taking advantage of the time differences between airplane transportation and train transportation . he became filthy rich overnight .
in june 1995 , mu qizhong acquainted a man , surnamed ho , who said he worked for an australian company and who used be an employee at the hubei light industrial goods import - export company .
under the arrangement , the hubei company , by acting as an importer , established a lc with an enormous amount of money at the hubei branch of the bank of china .
in theory , for a 180 - day time credit , the lc issuing bank , after paying the money in advance , had nearly six months to reclaim the loan .
the money was far from enough to purchase the title of the satellite .
most of the money was used for opening more lc , and some was used for debt payments and business expenses . because of this , the hubei branch of the bank of china lost more than $ 35 million , or 290 million yuan .
on 8 february 1999 , public authorities put mu qizhong under arrest , on charges of lc defrauding . on 1 november the same year , the wuhan municipal intermediate people 's court began to try the case .
thus , lc played their appropriately role , turning commercial credit between importers and exporters into bank credit .
currently , one - third of international trade is conducted through lc , and quite a portion of the credit service plays the role of providing indirect loans .
mu qizhong , however , is the first one in the country whom judicial authorities have characterized as " a felon guilty of lc fraud . "
even when the government authorities began to investigate the case , they treated it as an economic and civil dispute issue .
during the trial , several lawyers who took part in the litigation reported mu , thinking that he was a criminal suspect .
at the courtroom of the first trial , mo qizhong who habitually distorted facts in doing his business , time and again yelled : " neg still has 50 tons of gold in foreign countries and neg is fully capable of repaying all the lc money . "
of course , that was again another lie that he used to fool people . the fact was that the so - called " lc loans " he carefully plotted had inflicted on the hubei branch of the bank of china a total loss of $ 35 million .
however , law experts and people within financial circles maintain that the actual damage has far exceeded the loss of the bank 's credit and interests , more importantly the case undermined the nation 's financial order .
in lc business , the currency the importer uses to pay the lc for the goods it imports is foreign exchange , but it uses local currency to pay the lc issuer , and so the process involves a conversion of currencies .
the total amount of money neg obtained by cheating the branch bank with 31 negotiable lc through the hubei company exceeded $ 75 million . this is to say that it bilked the same amount of foreign exchange from the bank . from the angle of defrauding foreign exchange , the case was an extraordinarily major one .
" when an vehicle overturns , the vehicle behind it should be warned ; " people in society should work together in building a " firewall " against lc fraud ( subhead ) many people think that the lc system can be used as a tool for fraud because it is inherently defective .
the fact is that lc is a matured financial tool that plays an important role in international trade because of its superiority and flexibility in payment .
currently , the country is still perfecting its various laws and regulations for lc management .
in 1996 , the bank of china promulgated the " regulations for managing the settlement , receipt and payment of foreign currencies . "
in 1997 , the state foreign exchange administration promulgated the " measures for controlling domestic institutions ' use of international commercial loans . "
all these regulations are relevant to the lc business .
article 195 of the new , amended " prc criminal law " promulgated in 1997 has also specifically defined the " crime of letter of credit fraud . "
however , china 's financial fraud is rising , and the amounts of money involved are becoming increasingly bigger .
while it is true that the increase of financial fraud has some thing to do with active trading activities , we should not ignore the social backgrounds of these cases .
thus many law experts consider it incomprehensible why the importer , the hubei corporation , chose to ignore the arrival of goods after the lc issuer had paid for it enormous amounts of money in advance .
they add that all leading cadres , foreign trade businesses , and bank personnel should tighten their efforts to study to improve their knowledge about economic theories and application so that they will not be totally unaware even when they are involved in a fraud .
once china joins the world trade organization , they say , the importance of an intangible " fire wall " will become even more noticeable .
it is still not to late to take remedial measures .
with laws , awareness , and vigilance , we certainly can build a dragnet that can prevent financial fraud .

comrade jiang zemin has given a series of important instructions on deepening the reform of the personnel system relating to cadres and setting up and improving a mechanism that enables cadres to work vigorously at higher or lower levels and outstanding people to bring their abilities into full play .
recently , a responsible official of the organization department of the cpc central committee answered the questions raised by these reporters about implementation of this " outline . "
question : following its publication , the " outline " has evoked strong repercussions .
would you tell us why it was necessary to formulate and issue this " outline " ?
answer : the cause of socialist modernization in our country is entering a new state of development , and the contingent of cadres as a whole is in an important period of replacing old cadres with new ones .
large numbers of cadres and the broad masses have complained strongly about this situation and earnestly called for speeding up the reform of the personnel system relating to cadres .
now our country has initially build a basic framework for the socialist market economy and made important progress in the reform of the fiscal and taxation systems , banking , foreign trade , planning , investment , circulation , distribution , and other fields .
with the step - by - step development of socialist democracy , the masses of the people have enhanced their awareness of democracy and the legal system with each passing day ; the degree of the masses ' participation in personnel work relating to cadres has also noticeably increased .
it is the general trend and popular feeling to further deepen the reform of the personnel system relating to cadres .
in recent years , various localities and departments have actively made explorations according to their respective realities and boldly practiced what they have found in their explorations , coming up with many good methods and systems ; they are very active in reforming the personnel system relating to cadres , but they urgently need overall planning and macro guidance .
question : the " outline " is rich in content and involves many aspects . how can people understand and grasp it as a whole ?
answer : the ranks of leading cadres in party and government organizations are the backbone of the party 's cause .
the reform of the system of leading cadres in party and government organization is an important aspect of the reform of the political system .
selecting leading cadres in an open way is an important reform of the system of selecting and appointing cadres .
through several years of effort , the number of leading cadres under the prefectural or department level who are selected and appointed in an open way should be more than one - third of the total number of newly promoted cadres at the same levels .
when there are vacancies in party and government organizations , the persons selected for such vacancies should be determined through competition and on their merits as much as possible .
meanwhile , it is essential to combine the open selection of cadres and competing for jobs on merits closely with the selection and training of young cadres and the improvement of the reserve cadre system . 2 .
it is necessary to make leading cadres known to the public before their appointments .
various measures are to be taken to solve the problem of making cadres ready to work at lower levels .
in line with the characteristics of different types of positions at different levels , the standards according to which an unfit or incompetent cadre is determined and confirmed should be set in detail .
the channels for cadres to take lower - level positions should be widened through waiting for a position , transfer , resignation , or demotion .
new progress should be made in the exchange of cadres .
on the basis of our work in the past several years , we should further institutionalize the exchange of cadres .
in coordination with the implementation of the strategy for the large - scale development of the western region , we should accelerate the pace of training cadres with their original positions retained for them and the exchange of other cadres in the eastern , central , and western regions .
we should strengthen ideological education and improve relevant policies and the incentive and guaranteeing mechanisms for the exchange of cadres ; we should enforce strict discipline in the work concerning the exchange of cadres , guide cadres in following a rational direction of exchange , and study and solve practical problems in this work . 5 .
we should actively explore ways and methods for organization , discipline - inspection , and supervision departments to coordinate closely with one another and to exercise effective supervision .
we must make sure that no one should be nominated without democratic recommendations , that no one should be discussed without appraisals by a party organization , and that no one should be approved for appointment without approval by the majority of a party committee during its collective discussion .
answer : deepening the reform of the personnel system relating to cadres is an extensive and deep revolution , it calls for making all - round innovations in personnel work concerning cadres form ideas to work methods to the management system and to the operating mechanism , and it is strong in political and policy nature .
to perform this work well and carry out the tasks and requirements set in the " outline , " it is necessary to achieve " three combinations " while adhering to the correct guiding principles . 1 .
we should combine package reform with breakthroughs in key areas .
through the exploration and practice of reform and opening up in the past 20 - odd years , time is ripe now for carrying out the reform of the personnel system relating to cadres as a whole .
to do so nationwide means carrying out the reform of the personnel system relating to cadres in all localities and departments and developing it in a coordinated way ; for each locality and department , it is necessary to carry out various reform measures in an all - round way and to coordinate them step by step .
on the other hand , we should fully respect the initiative of the masses , arouse the enthusiasm of basic units , and encourage the basic units to actively make explorations and be bold in practice . this is the source of strength for the reform of the personnel system relating to cadres . 3 .
in the new situation , we must study and resolve new problems , explore new ways and new methods , and make innovations in thinking , system , and work in the spirit of reform .
answer : the objectives and tasks of the reform of the personnel system relating to cadres are clearly defined , what needs to be done is to carry out such tasks and fulfill such objectives .
stress should be laid on making plans and arrangements for the work in the period of the 10 th five - year pan , especially in the coming two to three years .
no rigid uniformity should be imposed , things should not be handled in an oversimplified way , and nor should formalism be practiced .
it is necessary to make overall plans for the reform of the personnel system in state - owned enterprises and institutions and to vigorously carry out such plans so as to achieve tangible results .
third , we should effectively perform ideological and political work as well as publicity work through mass media .
we should give full publicity through mass media to the reform of the personnel system relating to cadres and guide people in fostering correct ideas and fortifying their confidence in reform in order to create a favorable social environment for such reform .

beijing , 22 aug ( xinhua ) - - the national people 's congress [ npc ] standing committee , on the basis of this year 's schedule for law enforcement inspection , will inspect the implementation of the law of criminal procedure .
at today 's meeting , liang guoqing , deputy procurator general of the supreme people 's procuratorate ; and luo feng , vice minister of public security , reported their departments ' performance in implementing the law of criminal procedure .
then chairman li peng took the floor .
the second session of the fifth npc in 1979 , by enacting the country 's first law of criminal procedure , put an end to the situation where there was not a law to follow in handling criminal cases .
the comprehensive revision of the law by the fourth session of the eighth npc in 1996 has been significant for normalizing the procedure , improving judicial authorities ' efficiency and quality in handling criminal cases , and ensuring judicial justice with the proper execution of the criminal law .
he pointed out : ensuring the efficiency of the legal system of criminal procedure requires a good law . more importantly , this law must be followed , law enforcement must be strict , and lawbreakers must be held accountable .
for example , in the process of taking criminal procedure , judicial authorities often detain suspects or defendants for longer periods than the law permits , extort confession from them by torture , illegally grant them medical parole , commute their sentences , release them on bail , restrict lawyers from discharging their duties , and so forth .
problems like these are quite serious in some regions and departments .
your main mission is to activate the supervisory procedures within public security and judicial organs .
during the inspection , you should go deep into the reality of life and extensively listen to the views of people in all quarters .
to accomplish the inspection project , all inspection groups should work in close coordination with the local people 's congresses .
cao zhi , vice chairman of the npc standing committee and head of the inspection group , chaired today 's meeting .
some standing committee members set forth that in differentiating between service invention and non - service invention , consideration should be given to whether the differentiation is operable .
jiang chunyun , vice chairman of the standing committee of the npc , maintained that it is not quite proper to have courts handle all disputes over patent rights . the national patent administrative department should give full scope to its functions .
the disputes that cannot be resolved by such agencies can be handed over to courts . standing committee member li yining maintained that in our real life , it is very easy to get into an argument when we differentiate between service invention - creation and non - service invention - creation .
so , li yining suggested that the differentiation should be made by a certain authoritative organization . if anyone refuses to obey , courts will hold trials .
some standing committee members maintained that harsher punishment should be given to those who infringe on patent rights .
if one makes a profit of one million yuan from piracy , a fine of 50,000 yuan cannot count as a punishment .

while discussing the future of information technology , experts attending the 16 th world computer conference were also taking a deep look at the link between information technology and economic development .
experts agreed that the development of information technology will produce a profound influence on the future of economy .
statistics have showed the time needed for popularizing the use of different mass media among 50 million people : it took 38 years for radio to become popular , 13 years for television , and only five years for the internet .
this is not only true to science and technology themselves , but also true to economic development .
hu qili , chairman of the cppcc national committee and president of the 16 th world computer conference , said at the opening ceremony : " the two industrial revolutions since the 18 th century once reset the development course of the human society .
today , scholars studying the productive forces and social development of man are surprised to find that the development of information technology has already placed us in the midst of a great era not inferior to the two industrial revolutions in significance .
or we can also say that this era has just started . "
information technology is currently changing the operational mode of economy , especially commerce .
along with the development and application of network technology , an enterprise 's use of the network is a most crucial factor that determines whether this enterprise can succeed in the market .
at the same time , the operation of an enterprise will become increasingly dependent on the network ; and it will rely on the network for rapid and smooth information , material , and capital flow . the network will act as the brain and the nerve center that commands the functions of an enterprise .
no matter whether it is providing products , information , or services , the network will always give an unparalleled competitive edge to its users ; and without the network , not only will an enterprise be reduced to an disadvantageous position , it may even be squeezed out of the circles of e - commerce .
the development of information technology has brought new challenges to enterprise management .
wu cheng , academician of the chinese academy of engineering and professor in qinghua university , told these reporters that the influence produced by the development of information technology has prompted enterprises to accelerate their efforts in building up a new - type modern enterprise system .
besides , because of the strong integrative nature of information technology , enterprises will have to lay a greater stress on a coordinated production in their management , for no enterprise can possibly produce all the components and parts it needs .
from this we can see that future competitions will be global competitions , and protectionism of every description will find it increasingly hard to survive .
speaking of the economic growth in developing countries , experts also pointed out that although many developing countries still remain at the stage of industrialization or even agriculturalization [ nong ye hua ] and are currently faced with the arduous task of developing themselves , information development does not contradict their industrial and agricultural development .

at 1700 hours on 21 august , mikhail motsak , chief of staff of russia 's northern fleet , announced at the fleet 's base in northern murmansk that all the officers and men of nuclear submarine " kursk " were dead .
norwegian and british rescue personnel have terminated their rescue efforts .
the " kursk " nuclear submarine was built in 1994 and commissioned in 1995 . it carries 24 strategic nuclear missiles and has two nuclear reactors and four torpedo launchers . it has a crew of 107 and weighs 13,900 tonnes , with a deepest dive of 300 meters and a range of 120 days .
it is currently the russian navy 's latest and most advanced strategic nuclear submarine and one of the world 's largest strategic nuclear submarines . it is used specifically to destroy aircraft carriers .
the " kursk " nuclear submarine was stranded 108 meters under water on the seabed in the barents sea at 2300 hours on 12 august while participating in a military exercise of the northern fleet .
after the accident occurred , russia immediately launched rescue efforts .
the government formed an accident investigation and handling committee headed by deputy prime minister ilya klebanov . the navy sent a dozen or more vessels , including the flagship " peter the great " and aircraft carrier " admiral kuznetzov , " and aircraft to launch an urgent rescue in the waters of the accident .
the russian navy used various measures to try to rescue the " kursk " nuclear submarine on many occasions , but failed because of bad weather and other reasons .
the united states , britain , germany , and norway made proposals to participate in the rescue .
the russian side announced on 16 august that it was willing to accept foreign help .

the us joint chiefs of staff [ jcs ] issued " joint vision 2020 " in may 2000 .
big appetite of the " joint vision " the joint vision points out that " us global interests and global responsibilities are long - term .
at present there is no sign that these interests and responsibilities . . . will disappear . "
in line with this , the essence of the jcs joint vision is a programmatic document for the us military 's development planning and military guidance for the next 20 years .
the us military 's so - called innovation proposed in joint vision refers to the combination of hew " things " and new " methods " of carrying out missions .
in accordance with the demands of future war , in order to further enhance the efficiency of combined operations , in its joint vision the jcs has laid stress on the talent basis , the mutual compatibility basis , and the command and control basis .
the us military regards talent as the basis for winning victory in war .
so - called " mutual compatibility " in the us military does not just refer to telecommunications but includes " mutual support between weapon systems , between units or branches and other weapon systems , and within units or branches . "
the main aim of joint vision in proposing " mutual compatibility " is focused on independent combat by the us military overseas or joint action with allied ( multinational ) units .
whatever the scale of military action , only with " mutual compatibility " can the us military enhance the combat functions of its overall strength and win victory in military action .
mobile capability refers to " the capability of joint forces to seize positional superiority with the action rhythm of decisive speed and pressure and overwhelming superiority in the course of carrying out their assigned military missions . "
in other words , the joint forces must " control the theater space " at the appropriate time and place .
for this reason , the joint forces must enhance their capability in applying " information , deception , battle , mobility , and counter - mobility means . "
precision strike capability refers to " discovery , surveillance , and identification , and target tracking , selection , and organization , and applying the appropriate system to produce the desirable strike and assessment results " in all military actions .
precision strike does not simply refer to the action of striking with precision weapons , it also includes destroying targets with conventional weapons , committing special combat units , psychological warfare , and so on .
the us military 's aim in precision strikes is to use the advanced sensor technology and accurate strike systems it possesses to enhance the combat results of the joint forces and thus lower the political risks in war and also reduce its own casualties .
the joint vision proposed the term " timely logistics , " first to distinguish it from the previous concept of " logistics , " and second , in light of the uncertainties of the future combat theater and the new demands that these place on logistics .
all - round defensive capability refers to " the capability of the joint forces to defend their personnel and other military resources . "
information warfare [ iw ] capability means that while using and protecting one 's own information environment , the enemy are not allowed to use theirs .
thus the " joint vision " regards " iw " as an extremely important capability for the joint forces in gaining all - round superiority .
by this analysis , in the future the united states will depend on its " five kinds " of superiority in reconnaisance intelligence , electronic warfare , air war , precision strikes , and naval warfare to promote its hegemonism throughout the globe .
this trend of development of the us military must arouse a high degree of vigilance on the part of the world 's peoples .
allow science and technology in troop training to move toward real battlefield situations , make troop training just like fighting a real battle , and make fighting a place for troop training . thus we can enable the troop training battlefield to serve as a stage congealing the wisdom and capabilities of the entire army .
every military revolution includes a revolution in military training .
since the 1970 s , in the process of the inception , rise , and development of the new military revolution , the american military has carried out two military training revolutions .
in the 10 years following the conclusion of the vietnam war , the us army carried out its first training revolution , with three substantive areas .
third was that under the simulated situational conditions of operational training centers , responsive investigation and examination was carried out .
the essence of this military training revolution was to apply information technology and methods with the computer as the core to raise training efficiency .
the main characteristics of this revolution were : integrating real combat training , simulated realistic training , and simulator training , in order to adapt to the rapid development of high tech military technology .
the second training revolution of the us military not only was an addition on to the gradual process of the first training revolution , but even more was a leap in quality .
accompanying the advent of the global military training revolution , china 's army in its scientific and technical training of a mass nature also spectacularly expanded throughout the entire force .
scientific and technical training of the troops adapted to the model of global military development , and was a revolution of deep change in the history of china 's military training .
if we refer to the two training revolutions of the americans in our considerations , science and technical training of the troops should take simulated training as the point of breakthrough , moving toward real combat situations . according to the needs of real combat , we should initiate innovation of tactics technology .
however , if we further specify " guidance by requirements , " the clearest supposition is " guidance by the operational mission . "
this is because although everyone speaks of fighting a local war under high technology conditions , the operational mission for different units varies .
some traditional theories , outlooks , and concepts that only adopt to operations and training under common conditions , as well as training content , methods , and criteria established on this basis are gradually losing their original value .
contemporary high technology localized warfare is moving toward diversification , and has engendered a forceful impact on our army 's traditional operational and training theories .
this unit is totally " enemy familiarized ; " they carry out their training in accordance with the operational methods of the former soviet union , wearing enemy uniforms , employing enemy weapons and equipment , and implementing " combat " according to the war methods of the enemy side .
during peacetime , using a fabricated operational opponent " blue army " to train the troops , for raising troop combat strength , is a basic path for moving toward more real combat situations .
in this respect , the us military , the russian military , the english military , and some western european military powers , no matter if in regard to ideological concepts or in real training practice , have all passed in front of china 's army .
they have upheld the most effective measures , which has been to foster a simulated opponent at training bases with near - real combat conditions to sharpen their own warfare experience .
to enable training to really " oppose , " we must also make breakthroughs in simulation technology , decreasing people as the main subjective factor , and creating objective conditions for the opposition .
the chief conclusion the us military has drawn from its experience and lessons since the vietnam war is : troop training must be organized in a futuristic way .
learning and researching warfare in the laboratory .
prior to the gulf war , the us military , in order to formulate a " white snow plan , " simulate an " electronic bombing " plan of iraq . this plan in addition to the later application of a computer virus , both achieved the effect of a " first victory strategy . "
evaluating ' theoretical grounding ' in testing if military training is divorced from comprehensive and strict examination , it then loses the basis for evaluation of whether training is good or bad , and the competitive mechanism cannot be engaged .
" military training is a soft criterion ; " what is the criterion for whether training is good or bad ?
training testing and evaluation then becomes the " point of support " for stimulation of training vitality .

jump - starting smart capability ' training platform ' base - oriented training is the main mode for functional training .
science and technology troop training must move toward real combat situations and must realize the aforementioned real battle objectives using the platform of " military bases . "
military base training is campaign and tactical training carried out through the specialized training agency and military organization entity of the military training base .
this training , when compared to traditional training modes , is different most essentially in its organization of training .
military base training can unite training between all branches of the military .
at present , the training of all the branches of china 's army is basically in a state of disparate entities all with their own systems .
in agencies at the theater level and above , those that control campaign training do not control combined training , while those that control combined operations do not control branch training . the level of concern is lacking , and the difficulty in organizing joint training is very high . this requires solutions at the system level .
with military base training as the point of conjunction , we can form a training organizational system which flows both horizontally and vertically . military base training can link up the functions of academies , units , and scientific research units .
this is because military base training seeks to heighten the training level in troop evaluation in accordance with the needs of real combat , and testing and research agencies create new training and operational concepts .
