since the beginning of this year , the ministry of labor and social security has reinforced efforts in the work of basically completing the task of socializing the distribution of pensions by the end of this year in accordance with the state council 's proposal .
in the past , the pensions of retired workers of enterprises were provided by enterprises .
the fourth plenary session of the 15 th cpc central committee further explicitly advanced the idea that " when retirees leave their original enterprises , their pensions should be provided by social service organs and they should be placed under the management of communities . "
the practice of socializing the distribution of pensions will solve , in terms of the management system , the problem of enterprises delaying the pension payments , and will really guarantee the distribution of pensions .
in the past , pensions were provided by enterprises , but no one could tell whether the pensions were provided for the retirees or not , how much money was provided , and how much was in arrears .
after the implementation of the practice of socialized distribution of pensions , the social insurance organs will have to " deal " with retired workers . the retirees may go to nearby banks or post offices every month to receive the full amount of pensions provided by social security organs . thus , their basic livelihood will be guaranteed .
socialized distribution of pensions is a common practice of all countries in the world . none of the countries which has established a social insurance system has provided pensions through enterprises .
as reflected in various localities , in the past , some enterprises with a fairly great number of retired workers had to assign a person to take charge of issuing pensions every month , and this wasted a lot of human and material resources .
in accordance with the requirement of the ministry of labor and social security , social insurance organs at all levels will distribute pensions by making full use of the advantages of extensive distribution of networks and perfect service facilities of social service organs such as banks and post offices .
with regard to retired workers who live in remote areas and have particular difficulties which prevent them from going to social service organs to receive pensions , social insurance organs will directly send the pensions to them .
dalian , 23 aug ( xinhua ) - - china has achieved breakthrough progress in the work of distributing pensions through social channels .
this has been learned by reporters at the national conference on distributing pensions through social channels , which opened here today .
at the conference , labor and social security minister zhang zuoji said : socialized distribution of pensions is an important task of improving the pension insurance system and an important measure for guaranteeing the distribution of the full amounts of pensions to retired workers on time .
it is necessary to establish and improve the basic database of workers and retirees , develop on - line operations with banks and post offices , and provide convenient and quick services for retirees .
he said : as of the end of july this year , 130 million people nationwide had joined the pension insurance program , an increase of 16.1 percent over last year .
all localities should strengthen supervision and inspection , complete the collection of the full old - age insurance premiums by the end of september , and strive to increase income from the collection of funds by 20 billion yuan during this year .
all localities should guarantee the issuance of full amount of pensions on time with a high sense of political responsibility , and through the adoption of such measures as improving the provincial - level regulatory funding system and adjusting the structure of financial budgetary expenditures .

the agricultural and rural work committee of the national people 's congress [ npc ] today held in beijing a symposium on china 's water problem and revision of the water law .
li peng pointed out : water is a basic resource on which mankind 's survival relies . china 's water problem is unique .
flooding and droughts have always been a sting in the heart of the chinese nation .
frequent flooding and droughts in the past show that water resources not only are the lifeline of agriculture , but also the lifeline of the economy .
since the founding of new china , leaders of the few generations have placed great importance on the water problem .
under the leadership of the party and government , we have unremittingly launched large - scale construction of water conservancy projects , and achievements drawing worldwide attention have been scored .
advanced technology should be adopted for using water for agricultural purposes , and we should step up adjustment of the agricultural structure , in order to enable our limited water resources to yield the maximum economic benefits .
discharge of industrial sewage and waste water should be reduced and water for industrial use should be recycled in order to raise efficiency of water utilization .
by treating water resources according to the law and adopting a market mechanism , we should ensure that water resources are exploited and utilized in a scientific and reasonable manner .
since it was promulgated 12 years ago , the law has played an important role in strengthening management of water resources and ensuring reasonable exploitation and utilization of water resources .
the npc standing committee also promulgated the water and soil conservancy law , water pollution prevention law , flooding prevention law , and other relevant laws , providing favorable conditions for dealing with water problems .

under the pressure of nato 's eastward expansion , russia 's intention in intensifying its cooperation with asia - pacific countries is to contain the united states and preserve the international and regional balance of forces .

russia hopes by means of political , economic , and diplomatic means to eliminate the threat to its security caused by separatism , terrorism , and cross - border crime , so as to create a favorable environment for russia 's domestic economic construction .

beijing , 25 aug ( xinhua ) - - the decision of the state council on revising the " method governing the types of badges for the people 's policemen of different ranks and governing the wearing of such badges . "
the revised article 3 : " badges for the people 's policemen of different ranks : badges for police commissioners and deputy police commissioners are composed of silver - colored national emblems with olive branches encircling around .
badges for the people 's policemen in charge of administrative work have a dark blue background ; those for the people 's policemen with specialized technical jobs have a blue - gray background .
the revised article 5 : " the badge for police commissioner is made up of a national emblem with an olive branch encircling around . the badge for deputy police commissioner is made up of an olive branch encircling half of a national emblem .
the badge for superintendent is made up of an olive branch . the badge for grade-1 superintendent is made up of three quadrangular flowers ; that for grade-2 superintendent , two quadrangular flowers ; and that for grade-3 superintendent , a single quadrangular flower .
the badge for grade-1 police inspector is made up of three quadrangular flowers ; that for grade-2 police inspector , two quadrangular flowers ; and that for grade-3 police inspector , one quadrangular flower .
the badge for grade-1 police sergeant consists of three quadrangular flowers ; that for grade-2 police sergeant , two quadrangular flowers ; and that for grade-3 police sergeant , a single quadrangular flower .
the badge for an ordinary policeman consists of one quadrangular flower . the badge for grade-1 policeman is made up of two quadrangular flowers and that for grade-2 policeman , one quadrangular flower . " 4 .
the revised article 6 : " badges for the people 's policemen with specialized technical jobs and the badge - wearing methods are the same as those for the same levels of the people 's policemen in charge of administrative work . " 5 .
the revised article 10 : " this method will come into force from 1 october 2000 . "
when dressed in uniforms or on - duty clothes , the people 's policemen should wear hard badges . while wearing training clothes or standard shirts , they should button up their badges on shoulders .
when dressed in clothes for various purposes , they should wear shell - like soft badges . article 5 : the badge for police commissioner is composed of a national emblem with an olive branch encircling around . the badge for deputy police commissioner is made up of an olive branch encircling half of a national emblem .
the badge for ordinary policeman has a single quadrangular flower . the badge for grade-1 ordinary policeman contains two quadrangular flowers and that for grade-2 ordinary policeman , one quadrangular flower .
article 6 : the people 's policemen with specialized technical jobs should follow the same badge - wearing methods as those who are at the administrative posts of the same levels .
the organs that grant approvals for personnel removals should withdraw badges from those who have been removed from the police .
none are permitted to use the badges that are similar to police badges .
article 9 : the ministry of public security is responsible for the explanation of this method . article 10 : this method will come into effect from 1 october 2000 .
" the departments of provincial , autonomous regional , and municipal people 's governments that are in charge of patent - related work shall be responsible for patent regulatory work within their own administrative regions . " 3 .
article 6 shall be revised as : " an invention - creation accomplished by anyone in carrying out a task for his unit or by utilizing mainly the material and technological resources of his unit shall be a service invention - creation .
the right to apply for a patent for a service invention - creation shall belong to that unit ; upon approval of the application , that unit shall become the patentee .
" any patent of invention of a chinese unit under collective ownership or of a chinese individual that is of great significance to state interests or public interests and in need of popularized application shall be dealt with by reference to the provision in the preceding section . " 8 .
" the patent administration department of the state council shall handle international patent applications in accordance with relevant international treaties entered into by the prc , this law , and relevant provisions of the state council . " 11 .
article 21 shall be revised as : " the patent administration department of the state council and its patent reexamination board shall handle applications and requests pertaining to patent in conformity with legal provisions and in accordance with the requirements of objectiveness , impartiality , accuracy , and promptness .
the patent right for invention shall become effective as of the date of public announcement . " 15 .
article 43 shall be changed to article 41 and be revised as : " the patent administration department of the state council shall set up a patent reexamination board .
any patent applicant who is unconvinced by the decision of the patent administration department of the state council to reject his application may , within three months from the date of receipt of the notification , request a reexamination by the patent reexamination board .
after reexamination , the patent reexamination board shall make a decision and notify the patent applicant of the same .
any decision to pronounce a patent right invalid shall be registered and publicly announced by the patent administration department of the state council .
however , any losses inflicted in bad faith by the patentee on another person shall be compensated .
article 55 shall be changed to article 52 and be revised as : " when making a decision to grant a mandatory license for practical application , the patent administration department of the state council shall promptly notify the patentee of the decision and shall register and publicly announce it .
" in a decision to grant a mandatory license for practical application , the scope and period of the practical application shall be stipulated as per the grounds for mandatory licensing .
when the grounds for mandatory licensing disappear and no longer arise , the patent administration department of the state council shall , after examination , make the decision to terminate the mandatory license for practical application as per the request of the patentee . " 23 .
in addition , the wording of some of the articles shall be altered accordingly and the order of articles adjusted accordingly in accordance with this decision .
this decision shall go into effect on 1 july 2001 .

beijing , 25 aug ( xinhua ) - - the 17 th session of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] standing committee , having successfully completed all the items on its agenda , closed at the great hall of the people this morning .
president jiang zemin today signed presidential decree no. 36 on promulgating the decision . chairman li peng chaired and addressed the meeting .
wang weicheng , chairman of the npc law committee , delivered a report first on opinions on revising the draft decision on amendments to the patent law .
he said that the committee members believe the draft decision has incorporated the opinions of the npc standing committee and relevant quarters and become quite mature and so they suggest it be adopted by this standing committee session .
chen guangyi , chairman of the npc financial and economic committee , made a report on the committee 's examination of a proposed issuance by the ministry of finance of additional long - term treasury bonds to raise construction funds and a draft plan for readjusting the central budget for 2000 .
so , the financial and economic committee recommends that both the proposed issuance of 50 billion yuan of additional treasury bonds and the draft plan for readjusting the central budget for 2000 be approved .
the session voted through the decision of the national people 's congress standing committee on amendments to the patent law , and the decision will come into force on 1 july 2001 .
it also adopted a resolution on approving the state council 's proposal on issuing additional treasury bonds and the plan for readjusting the central budget for this year .
the session also voted through a decision of the national people 's congress standing committee on ratifying the sino - lithuanian treaty of civil and criminal judicial assistance .
it adopted the report of the national people 's congress standing committee 's credential committee on examination of the qualifications of the deputies elected in a by - election .
after the session completed all the items on its agenda , chairman li peng addressed the meeting .
after a serious examination and discussion , the committee members approved of the report .
in implementing the strategy for rejuvenating the nation by applying scientific and technological advances and promoting education , it is necessary to particularly work well in two respects .
the objectives put forward by the state council are clear and definite , and the measures adopted by it are effective .

the situation of our land resources remains very grim , we are still far away from reaching the goal of an overall balance in farmland use , and a further step must be taken to enforce relevant laws .
the committee members hold that since the beginning of this year , our economic development has gained a good momentum and a series of positive changes have taken place in our economic performance , and this is very gratifying .
however , we should also see that these changes are still initial ones , the foundation of economic recovery has not yet been solid , some structural and deep - seated problems in economic development have not been solved , and the situation of insufficient effective demand has not basically improved .
li peng emphasized : it is necessary to constantly deepen the reform of state - owned enterprises and step up the readjustment of industrial structure .
great efforts should be made to develop high - tech industries with information and technology as their representatives , step up technological transformation , and develop and produce products that have a ready market , so as to enhance the competitive power and economic efficiency of enterprises .
recently , some serious accidents have occurred from time to time .
li peng said : to deepen reform and maintain social stability , it is necessary to accelerate the establishment of an adequate social security system .
we should adhere to a principle of basing ourselves on the present , aiming at the future , working out an overall plan , and implementing it step by step .
in conclusion , li peng said : since the year 2000 is the last year of the ninth five - year plan , doing a successful economic work this year will be of great significance .

in the final analysis , putin 's foreign policy has a fairly strong pragmatic tint . in other words , his foreign policy gives greater emphasis to military security and economic development .
strategically , this policy firmly upholds russia 's national interests while emphasizing flexibility in pursuing these interests tactically .
in actual operation , the policy considers both the east and the west , even though the emphasis tilts toward the nato and the eu . strategic maneuvering to oppose the us nmd one of the difficult problems facing putin after entering kremlin is the us plan to deploy the " national missile defense " [ nmd ] system .
however , during the russian - us summit in moscow in early june , clinton politely turned down his offer .
while attacking the issue up front , putin also launched offensive from the flank .
during his visit to britain , italy , spain , germany , and other european allies of the united states , he made the stirring proposal that europe and russia join hands in building a missile defense system .
putin , astute and resourceful , also vigorously worked on asian countries .
indian defense minister has indicated that when necessary , india will join hands with russia to build an anti - ballistic missile system .
an important emphasis of putin 's diplomatic work is to make diplomacy serve the needs of domestic economy .
during his visit to europe , he had extensive exchange with the governments and business communities of the countries he visited to increase their understanding of russia 's new economic policy and the prospects of reform so that they would have greater confidence to invest in russia .
during his visit to belarus , ukraine , and four other cis countries , putin reached agreements with them on debt repayment , energy supply , and other issues . this has led to an improvement of bilateral economic relations .
the cis summit that he chaired approved the establishment of cis free - trade zones and the development plan for the period prior to 2005 . this has laid a good groundwork for cis economic integration .
during his visit to china last july , putin said that further developing all - round cooperation in the economic , trade , science and technology , and military fields is one of the important direction for expanding and deepening the equal , trustworthy , strategic cooperative partnership between china and russia .
russia continues to regard india as a major arms buyer . it has signed agreements to sell india a heavy cruiser , admiral gorshkov , and plans to supply india with su-30 fighters .
during his visit to japan next september , putin may very likely use the occasion to support japan 's demand to enter the un security council and become a major political power , in return for japan 's economic aid to russia .
winning international support to isolate rebellious bandits in chechnya to cut off chechnyan rebellious armed forces ' foreign aid and route of retreat and to create conditions for a comprehensive and complete settlement of the chechen issue , putin has been working actively to obtain the understanding and support of the international community .
thanks to his efforts , the cis has set up an anti - terrorists center to jointly coordinate crackdown on extremist forces represented by the chechen rebellious bandits .
the characteristics of his diplomatic maneuvering are to say less and do more , do what is within russia 's capacity , and pragmatism . like a two - head eagle watching magnificently at the eurasian continent , he is trying to maneuver between the east and the west to create a space favorable to russia 's strategy .

there will not be a great risk in increasing the issue of 50 billion government bonds after the disclosure of the news regarding the additional issue of 50 billion government bonds , people 's greatest anxiety is that the scale of debts is already big , will the sudden increase of 50 billion yuan bring about risks ?
in the specific practice of a country , however , it is very difficult to ascertain the concrete amount of government bonds .
government bond burden rate (% ) = ( balance of government bonds ) 1,060.685 billion yuan / (gdp) 8,205.4 billion yuan = 12.93% < 60% ( all of them are figures in 1999 ) the warning index for government bond burden rate universally acknowledged in the world is 60% .
judging from china 's government bond burden rate at 12.93% , the debt scale is below the warning limit , which means there is still a certain potentiality for the issue of bonds .
furthermore , let us observe the issue from the angle of deposit rate .
for many years , china 's deposit rate has been relatively high , and the funds in banks have been relatively abundant .
a large amount of funds were held up in banks unable to lend out , yet interest should be paid on schedule , which have affected the operational profits of the financial institutions .
by the end of june , china 's foreign exchange reserves reached $ 158.6 billion .
the prices of production factors including land , equipment , labor , and so on are at a relatively low level .
in addition , as minister xiang huaicheng said , the funds of government bonds come from bank deposits , they are the people 's money earned by hard toil , so it is necessary to take good care and make proper use of the funds in a spirit of being highly responsible for the people .
all the above factors indicate that the additional issue of 50 billion yuan worth of long - term construction bonds will not trigger a great risk .

in the 50 years since new china was established , especially in the last 20 years of reform and opening up , transportation in the western region has also made fairly quick developments .
high - speed roads reached 19.54 million km in length .
the proportion of roadways through townships and administrated rurally was 96 percent and 80 percent , respectively .
however , due to the influences of such variables as history , natural topography and environment , and economics and society , at present , the development level of the road transportation for the western region lags a fair amount behind the east , and the gap is widening .
speaking quantitatively , in 1980 , the density of roadways in china 's eastern region was 4.2 times that of the western region , but by 1999 , the gap had widened to almost five times .
backwardness in transportation sectors has become an important factor constricting the development of the social productive forces in the west , influencing the rise of the living standards of people of all nationalities , and also restricting the development of projects in the western region such as in science and technology , education , culture , and health .
therefore , accelerating transportation construction in the west holds major significance for ensuring the smooth implementation of the strategy of a grand opening up in the west .
including the construction of the provincial roadways , and at the same time focusing on national roadway renovation , and reform of regional road net technology and other levels of structural renovation , including construction of roadway hub stations and national border roadway construction ; the total length of construction is almost 210,000 km .
those townships and rural areas with qualifications - - especially townships and rural areas in older , out - of - the - way , and unique regions - - must gradually realize thoroughfares throughout , enabling the extent of roadway connection to be noticeably heightened .

beijing , 28 aug ( xinhua ) - - " recruit all kinds of talented people . "
this has been a dream for people with high ideas in history .
today , when the nation is about to enter the 21 st century , the public functionary system with chinese characteristics has been basically established , and the system of recruiting public functionaries through examination has been widely practiced .
practice over the past seven years has shown that " recruitment through examination " and " open , equal , competitive selection of the best " has become the major principle of recruitment at china 's various levels of administrative organs .
and a large number of outstanding people have become public servants through examination .
shortcomings in the state administrative organs ' recruitment mechanism had frustrated many outstanding people . with the constant development of china 's open - up and of the socialist market economy , the traditional method of cadres selection can no longer adapt to the development of the times .
in august 1994 , the personnel ministry held the first examination to recruit public functionaries to fill 490 vacancies at the state council 's 30 departments . some 14,000 sat for the examination , creating a magnificent scene of thousands of people sitting for examination .
eighteen provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities including liaoning and jilin held provincial , prefecture , county , and township - level examination . orienting themselves toward the entire nation , breaking with position and with regional restrictions , guangdong , shanghai , hainan , and other areas recruited all kinds of talented people .
as of early 1999 , the planned number of public servants to be recruited in the nation was 150,000 , and some 1.5 million candidates sat for the examination .
an outstanding grade truly becomes a ticket for outstanding people " an outstanding grade has truly become a pass for outstanding people , " a public servant who took part in the examination several years ago remarked with deep emotion .
his remark represents countless citizens ' heartfelt praise for the reform .
the " big doors " of the state administrative organs are opening up for outstanding people .
during a public recruitment of public servants in shaanxi in 1996 , a vice - governor 's daughter failed the test , while a man from a vegetable market passed the test with flying colors and became a public servant .
the best manifestation of fairness is a break with personal position and with regional restrictions .
in 1994 , the railways ministry took the lead among state organs to break regional restrictions to recruit staff across the nation .
following its step , the state oceanic administration , the ministry of communications , and other agencies also made new moves in that direction .
hubei provincial government general office accepted people from other areas to sit for the examination to become public servants . a person not of hubei origin came out on top in the examination . of 10 recruited , four were not wuhan city natives .
in 1995 , jilin openly recruited 684 county - level public functionaries . of 512 farmers who took part in the examination , 13 were successful .
wang limin , a farmer from yangmu village , yongji county , passed the test with an excellent grade .
my parents wanted me to present gifts to the testing unit , but i did not . i passed the test anyway . "
relevant departments have published dozens of policy documents that stipulated the scope and budget of recruitment through examination and cover examination discipline in a bid to set rules to abide by in the practical implementation of the examination system .
putting the work of recruitment of public servants via examination on a legal track has effectively ensured that various levels of administrative organs can select best staff members in an open , equal , and competitive manner , thereby putting a stop to unhealthy practices .
in 1995 , the personnel ministry decided to punish six examination candidates by forbidding them to take part in the state organ examination in the next five years for having violated examination rules during a state organ examination .
therefore , many countries , developing countries in particular , give priority to raising public servants ' quality and to raising administrative efficiency in an attempt to raise their countries ' competitiveness .
in that connection , a person in charge of the personnel ministry said that china would strive to constantly renovate the recruitment system through examination , to improve the content and method of examination , and to explore ways of elimination and filtration of people through examination .
guarding closely the " gate " of recruitment and ensuring the political and professional quality of public functionaries are the goals that china strives to realize in improving the recruitment through examination system .
basing on the current examination content , various ministries and commissions have added comprehensive quality and psychological evaluation to the examination content this year so as to find out candidates ' abilities to analyze and solve practical problems . they are also considering adding the testing of candidates ' computer knowledge in the examination content .
a responsible person at the personnel ministry pointed out the need for localities to make explorations in line with the above thinking .

beijing , 28 aug ( xinhua ) - - the national old - age work conference wrapped up yesterday upon successfully completing its work .
the aging population is a major social issue faced by all countries worldwide today ; it has raised broad concerns in the international community .
china 's population is aging at a rapid rate ; the old - age issue has become increasingly acute .
in 1999 , the number of people aged 60 or older topped 126 million , accounting for 10 percent of the total population . according to internationally accepted standard , the age structure of china 's population has begun to enter the aging stage .
the problem has broad economic , political , cultural , social and other ramifications that have to do with the national economy , the people 's livelihood , and the overall situation of reform , development , and stability .
attaching importance to the problem and strengthening old - age work is very meaningful and is also an important and pressing strategic task .
progress and success in old - age work have played an important role in economic development , social progress , and social stability .
but we should also realize that china is in the primary stage of socialism ; our old - age work 's foundation is weak and cannot meet the needs of the aging population .
in particular , china 's aging population is an issue that has surfaced in the midst of establishing and perfecting the social security system ; the country has insufficient means in terms of the material base and legal safeguard to solve the problem .
we must fully understand the importance , the arduous nature , and the urgency of solving this problem as we strengthen leadership , increase input , and step up effort .
old - age work involves all domains , and there is a lot of work to be done .
we must further improve the social security system and set up an old - age safeguard mechanism that involves the state , society , families , and individuals to ensure that the old people 's everyday , medical , and other basic needs are met .
we must put the emphasis of old - age work on the community , rely on the community to vigorously develop the old people 's service industry , and further perfect the community 's function to serve the old .
the development of an industry to provide services to the old should embark on the socialized and industrialized path .
old people are an important component in society . they have made important contributions to the country 's construction and development .
to continuously satisfy the masses of old people 's growing material and cultural needs and solve their practical problems are the unshirkable responsibility of society .

united nations , 28 august ( xinhua ) - - the opening ceremony for the millennium world peace summit was being held at the meeting hall of the un headquarters in new york the afternoon of 28 august .
min zhiting is president of the china taoist association and also a member of the chinese religious leaders delegation attending the summit .
he extended his respects to the 1,000 religious leaders or so and other representatives from various countries and brought them the prayer for peace of all chinese taoists .
wearing a dark color taoist hat and a taoist robe made of course cloth , master min had an elegant bearing of the sage - like type .
being refinedly , artistically , and simply dressed , master min was especially attractive from among religious leaders in various costumes .
at an interview with the reporters after the opening ceremony , min zhiting said : taoism is china 's indigenous religion and has a history of over 1,700 years .
taoism upholds nature and what its followers wear exactly embodies its own doctrines and characteristics .
because it upholds nature , taoism does not encourage people to live in taoist temples to practice taoism , and it would " rather persuade 10 followers to resume secular life than encourage 1 person to become a priest or nun . "
despite this , there are over 1,600 taoist temples , big or small , across china , home to more than 26,000 priests and nuns , and over 60,000 priests and nuns live with their families in a scattered way .
let quality determine who goes up and who comes down ; this is competition in the sunlight . "
pushing appointment to posts through competition is a reform and improvement of the traditional cadre selection and appointment system . the practice of appointment to posts by competition emerged among our cadre rank in the wake of implementing the civil service mechanism .
since the current structural reform of the organs started , this system has been applied for 100 department - level [ si ji ] posts and over 800 section - level [ chu ji ] posts in state council ministries and commissions .
the intensity of practicing this system in the localities is increasing all the time .
the general office of the shanxi provincial government has adopted the method of competition to select candidates for all section - level posts in offices in its organs , and 43 " winners " have now taken up posts as section heads or deputy heads .
phenomena of relying on the passage of time to " endure for " official posts , using connections to " run after " official posts , and even " buying official posts " with cash were common occurrences .
appointment to posts through competition has brought gratifying changes : " runners after official posts " and " buyers of official posts " have been shut out , and there is no market for " manipulations in the dark " such as " internal decisions " and the " back door . "

a system of appointing special inspectors is implemented to carry out supervision on major national construction projects .
special inspectors for major national construction projects are appointed by the state development planning commission to supervise the construction and management of major national construction projects .
members of the state development planning commission will deliberate with relevant departments of the state council or provincial , autonomous regional , or municipal people 's governments and establish a list of major national construction projects to which special inspectors will be sent in accordance with this procedure .
inspection of major national construction projects will be carried out according to the principle of proceeding according to law , impartiality and fairness , and being practical and realistic .
the relationship between a special inspector and a unit under inspection is that between one who supervises and one who is being supervised .
three to five assistants shall normally be assigned to each special inspector to assist in his work .
( 2 ) inspect a construction project 's public bidding , quality , and progress ; track and monitor the project 's construction .
a special inspector may carry out special ad hoc inspections according to actual needs .
a special inspector may adopt the following methods in his inspection work : ( 1 ) listening to reports by key responsible persons of the unit under inspection about the construction project ; holding meetings at the unit under inspection on inspection issues ; attending meetings on inspection issues held by the unit under inspection .
( 3 ) checking , examining , investigating , and verifying public bidding , quality , and progress of the construction project .
the unit under inspection shall accept inspection carried out by special inspectors according to the law ; provide material , such as documents , contracts , agreements , statements , and reports , relevant to the construction project to the special inspector regularly and truthfully ; report major issues concerning the construction and management of the project .
no refusal , cover - up , or false reporting is allowed . article 11 . relevant departments of the state council and relevant local people 's governments should support and cooperate with the special inspectors ; inform them about situations related to the units under inspection and provide the inspectors with relevant material .
the state development planning commission should strengthen ties with relevant departments , such as the financial , auditing , and construction departments , as well as with the banks , so as to inform each other of relevant situations .
article 12 . when a special inspector discovers problems during his inspection , he should verify the situations with the unit under inspection and listen to its views . if the unit under inspection has different opinions , the state development planning commission may carry out verifications according to the actual situation .
article 13 . each time a special inspector finishes his inspection work on a construction project , he should promptly submit his inspection report .
article 14 . the inspection report shall be put forth by the special inspector and examined and approved by the state development planning commission , which shall report major items and situations to the state council .
article 16 . the state development planning commission shall be in charge of appointing and removing special inspectors .
the position of special inspector shall be occupied by a public servant of department level who is under 55 years of age .
article 17 . the state development planning commission is in charge of appointing and removing assistant special inspectors .
the position of assistant special inspector shall be occupied by a public servant of section level or below who is generally under 50 years of age .
( 2 ) uphold principles , have honesty and self - restraint , faithfully perform his duties , and be able to observe confidentiality .
( 3 ) familiar with project construction and management , possess such expert knowledge as finance , auditing , or engineering and technology , and have the corresponding abilities to make integrated analysis and judgement .
( 4 ) have undergone specialized training .
article 18 . the state development planning commission is in charge of selecting and sending special inspectors and their assistants and should draw personnel from relevant departments of the state council .
article 20 . the principle of avoidance shall be observed in assigning special inspectors . a special inspector shall not be assigned to a construction project which he once supervised or worked in , or one in which any of his close relatives is a senior management official .
article 21 . expenses incurred by a special inspector in his inspection work shall be paid for by the state finance .
article 22 . a special inspector and his assistants must not disclose trade secrets of a unit under inspection .
( 3 ) acts that violate articles 22 and 23 of this procedure .
article 26 . if the unit under inspection discovers that a special inspector and his assistants commit acts that violate article 22 or 23 , or clause 1 or 2 of article 25 , it has the right to report the violations to the state development planning commission .
( 2 ) issue a circular of criticism .
( 3 ) suspend payment of national construction funds for the unit .
( 5 ) suspend examination and approval of similar new projects of the relevant locality or department .
issues that involve the responsibilities and limits of authority of other relevant departments of the state council and relevant local people 's governments shall be handed over to those relevant departments of the state council and those local people 's governments .
major handling decisions should be reported to and approved by the state council . article 28 . after issuing a notice ordering rectification by a specified date , the state development planning commission should track and monitor the rectification situation and organize another inspection at an appropriate time , until the rectification goals are met .
relevant localities , departments , and units should conscientiously carry out rectification according to the contents and requirements of the rectification notice .
( 2 ) resisting or delaying without sound reason the supply of material on the project 's financial , quality , and management situations to the special inspector .
( 3 ) covering up or forging relevant material .
( 4 ) any other acts that prevent the special inspector from performing his duties according to the law .

outsiders really had no clear idea .

in view of this situation , the 15 th cpc congress adopted the idea of carrying our judicial reform so as to ensure the fair administration of justice .
with preparatory work of over a year and the center 's approval , the supreme people 's court and supreme people 's procuratorate are performing " major surgical operations " on themselves .
the supreme people 's court has recently established a case - filing chamber specially in charge of the work of filing cases and an adjudication supervision chamber specially in charge of the work of adjudication supervision , resulting in the separation of adjudication initiation , adjudication administration , and adjudication supervision from each other .
the supreme people 's procuratorate has divided the complaint and petition department into a complaint department and a criminal petition department which are , respectively , in charge of handling ordinary people 's complaints and reexamining petition cases .
with the division into two departments , each is performing its assigned function . as a result , ordinary people 's complaints and petitions can be timely resolved .
the supreme people 's court and the supreme people 's procuratorate have adjusted operational departments to enhance judicial operation on the basis of meeting needs of actual work .
the department of job position crime prevention , the general anticorruption bureau , and the procuratorial department on cases of dereliction of duty and infringement of rights form a new arrangement on punishing job position crimes through working both to seek cures and to treat symptoms .
the work of competitive appointment for bureau - level leadership posts in nonadjudication departments and the work of selecting presiding judges through open procedures have now entered their final phases , and enthusiastic and hard - working people are actively pursuing their candidacies in the selection process .
according to a source at the supreme people 's court and the supreme people 's procuratorate , the finalists and candidates are mostly backbone personnel of the departments , with high ethical and talent qualities .

in the first half of this year , china 's agriculture and rural economy operated steadily around the central task of agricultural structure readjustment so that the situation as a whole was relatively good .
the decrease of summer grain crops formed a striking contrast to the increased production of summer oil - bearing crops .
the sown area of rapeseed across the country was 107 million mu , increasing by more than 10 million mu over last year , and the total output was 10.6 million tonnes , increasing by more than 10 percent over last year .
both the sown area and output of summer oil crops exceeded the highest record in history .
the intensity of structural readjustment has been increased .
it is estimated that this year the area for grain will be reduced by over 50 million mu or over 3 percent to below 1.65 billion mu .
the output of poultry and eggs and that of milk grew by 4.2 and 9.4 percent respectively .
what particularly makes people feel anxious about is the slow growth of peasants ' income .
the continued low prices of agricultural products and the greater difficulty in finding jobs elsewhere have directly led to the decline of peasants ' income growth .
looking forward to the whole year , the situation of peasants ' income growth allows of no optimism , to which all localities should pay serious attention .
based on the current situation that drought continued to deteriorate in some localities , a comrade in charge of the ministry of agriculture pointed out that all localities should take the fight against drought as a focal point of current agricultural and rural economic work .
at present , with the drought in most areas of northern china continuously expanding , the drought in some areas of southern china began to surface .
according to the forecast of the national agricultural technological popularization center , the plant diseases and insect pests of wheat , rice , and other crops will be even more serious , and it is estimated that more than 1.6 billion mu will be affected this year .
therefore , all localities should adopt corresponding effective measures to strive for a better harvest in grain production for the whole year .
in making structural adjustment , the ideas of leading cadres at all levels should be adjusted first so as to really orient the adjustment to the market demands , because only those agricultural products that are demanded in the markets have a way out .
in light of the new situation emerging in the agricultural industrial structure , it is necessary to accelerate the process of agricultural industrialization .
third , the party 's rural policies should continue to be carried out conscientiously to maintain stability in the rural areas .
the summer grain harvest will begin very soon , the policies regarding unlimited procurement of peasants ' surplus grain at protected prices and procurement of quality grain at favorable prices must be genuinely carried out , and the phenomena of restricting purchases , rejecting purchases , and forcing down the grades and prices must be avoided .
in doing the rural work , there are a thousand and one things to attend to , but to increase peasants ' income by every possible means is the most fundamental .

among the 46 japanese - us joint naval exercises carried out in 1997 , 34 were basic training exercises , accounting for 74 percent of all their joint exercises . these included 13 large - scale exercises .
small - scale special trainings include ship navigation training for vessels of japan 's joint fleet and the us seventh fleet . usually one warship from each side participates in the training , which takes place once a year .
the annual integrated exercise that takes place each fall is the largest exercise of japanese naval forces . us naval forces have been participating in this exercise every year since the 1980 s . hence , this exercise has also become a regular exercise of the japanese and us naval forces .
there are four main types of japanese - us joint exercise of the army , and they take place four to seven times a year .
participating on the japanese side are about 100 commanding officers from various military districts . on the us side are about 200 commanding officers of the army level .
the second type is joint field exercise .
it began in 1984 and takes places two to four times a year . it usually takes place in japan together with the command post joint exercise . the japanese side is organized in units of armies . the participating force of each exercise is about 1,000 troops .
the third type is joint military exercise in cold and snow - bound places .
the fourth type is exercise of land troops .
it is an irregular command post exercise involving all troops of the japanese army . a total of five such exercises had taken place by january 1994 . the sixth is scheduled to take place this year .
this exercise is carried out in coordination with japanese naval and air forces .
there are mainly five types of regular japanese - us air force exercises , and they take place dozens of times a year .
the two sides flew over 1,000 sorties during " exercise cope north " in 1997 .
the integrated exercise of aviation general units is the largest exercise of the japanese air force and takes place once a year .
us forces have been participating in this exercise every year since the 1980 s .
the japanese - us joint exercise of the three services code - named " keen edge " began in 1986 , and altogether six such exercises had taken place by the end of 1998 .
joint exercises no longer what they were with the further strengthening of japanese - us military cooperation and the acceleration of military integration , tremendous changes have taken place in combined action exercises between the troops of the two countries . the following are the main changes : 1 .
as the object of japanese defense turned from the single threat from the soviet union to " pluralistic threats " after the cold war , the objects of japanese - us joint military exercises have also changed , and coping with conflicts in the surrounding regions has become an important content of these exercises .
" exercise keen edge " held in september 1993 involved coping with " enemy situations " in the north and the southwest .
rimpac ' 96 and ' 98 both had conflicts in the asia - pacific region as their background .
" exercise keen edge " ' 96 was a combat exercise which took the western parts of japan 's northwestern territory as a certain place in north korea . 2 .
after the end of the cold war , japanese - us joint military exercises not only have not reduced in scale but have become longer in duration . the number of bases used is also on the increase .
in some joint exercises , us troop participation was quite limited and japanese troop participation was over a dozen times larger .
these exercises were all highly offensive by nature . 3 .
" exercise keen edge " ' 94 included drills on defense against ballistic missiles .
the coordination of combat command has been added to tactical and technical drills in japanese - us air force joint exercises since 1995 .
new drills were conducted on japanese forces providing fuel and missile supplies to us warships after 1996 .
" exercise keen edge " ' 98 was carried out under the joint command of cinpac headquarters and japan 's joint staff council .
after 1997 , the two sides began to adopt the provision of logistic and intelligence support by the japanese troops to the us troops and the execution of mine - sweeping duties , ship inspection , sea rescue and other duties in open sea as items of their joint military exercise .
during " exercise keen edge " ' 98 and the annual integrated exercise of the japanese navy , emphasis was put on logistic support provided by the japanese to the us forces .

the european union , hong kong , the philippines , and other places have all adjusted their rates upwards .
under the circumstance , and as china 's macroeconomic situation improves , people are naturally wondering if the rmb interest rate will rise with the tide .
ten percent of the economists even predicted that the rmb interest rate might be raised somewhat in the second half of this year .
whether the rmb interest rate will be raised depends on a mix of different factors .
in fact , all signs point to the likelihood that the adjustment of the rmb interest rate henceforth will be coordinated with the reform to let the market determine the interest rates .
letting the market decide the interest rates will become the central bank 's new weapon when it uses monetary policy to regulate and control the economy .
wang yuanlong , research associate with bank of china 's international financial research institute , said this is the best time to decontrol interest rates .
according to his analysis , first , the price level has remained low in the last year or two , showing signs of a general deflation , and the sustained negative price increase is providing the condition for the country to pursue reform to allow the market to set interest rates .

during the more than seven years of construction , some quality problems have emerged in the three gorges project . various parties participating in the construction have handled these problems conscientiously and ensured no hidden dangers remain .
the biggest dam in the three gorges project is 175 - meter high with a capacity of 39.3 billion cubic meters .
according to its design , the three gorges dam must be able to withstand the worst possible flood .
the construction quality of the three gorges project not only affects the efficiency of flood prevention , electricity generation , and shipping , but also has a direct impact on the life and property of the tens of millions of people in the lower stretches .
in accordance with existing standards promulgated by the state , ministries , and commissions , and taking into consideration the three gorges project 's special requirements on quality , the china three gorges project corporation has set quality standards higher than existing standards established by the state , ministries , or commissions .
the three gorges project has established a four - level project quality supervision and management mechanism that includes self - inspection by construction units , inspection by supervision units , supervision by the three gorges project corporation , and control by the quality experts ' team of the state council 's three gorges project construction committee .
more than 860 supervision engineers currently work at the construction site of the three gorges project .
various supervision units carry out strict 24 - hour stand - by supervision on inconspicuous constructions and the concrete - pouring process .
in order to step up supervision , the three gorges project also appoints renowned international companies to conduct supervision and give consultation on key items and construction facilities .
last year , the three gorges project registered 4.48 million cubic meters of concrete pouring , exceeding the world record on concrete pouring in a hydropower project by more than 1 million cubic meters .
the group conscientiously analyzes the cause of any shortfall in quality , finds out which relevant personnel is responsible for the shortfall , and strictly orders a rework until the design 's quality requirements are met .
beijing , 3 september ( xinhua ) - - though our country 's foreign import and export trade has grown by a large margin over the past years , an undercurrent has all along pounded at our normal foreign trade channels .
it was learned that the newly built " electronic law enforcement system " has set up a public data center based on a modern connection mode known as " multi - entry to one terminal . "
in the recent 10 years or so in particular , the world economy as a whole , prompted by the progress of high technology , has been showing a tendency of accelerated development in spite of countless difficulties and setbacks .
however , people are also seeing the following with increasing worries : while the western economy , particularly the us economy , continues to grow fairly rapidly , many developing countries have experienced economic slowdown with some even suffering from economic stagnation or retrogression .
the south - north gap that the international community has tried to narrow in recent years , particularly the gap between the most developed nations and the most undeveloped nations , has become wider and wider , instead of being narrowed .
such a situation is worrying even the former international monetary fund chief camdessus . he has pointed out that if the south - north gap continues to grow , poverty will lead to social unrest and conflict which will eventually destroy the order of the human society .
while the world economic growth is continuing , the number of the least developed nations is increasing year by year , totaling 48 today , compared to 36 ten years ago .
in this regard , the situation of africa is even grimmer .
in last several years , africa 's economic growth rate was around 4 percent , but its gdp accounted for only 1 percent of the world 's gdp and its trade accounted for only 2 percent of the total international trade volume .
while the economic globalization trend is fast growing , the gap between the world economy and africa 's economy is becoming wider and wider . africa is in a serious danger of being marginalized .
why the south - north gap is becoming wider and wider ?
history shows that besides the interior problems in some developing countries , the most important cause for the ever growing gap lies in the failure to establish in the world a just and rational economic order , which benefits the common development and prosperity of all countries .
it did not embody as it should the legitimate interests and reasonable demands of the developing countries , most of which were still under the colonial or semi - colonial rule at that time .
the developed countries , taking advantage of the international economic rules favorable to themselves , have built up their economic superiority by expanding all over the world to seek more resources and markets .
however , the developing nations have to passively obey the unfair and irrational economic order ; and so , their development has been seriously restricted .
the old international economic order is greatly obstructing the development of the developing countries whose economy relies mainly on resources export , making them suffer a series of serious problems such as fund shortage , heavy indebtedness and worsening conditions in trade and ecological environment .
in a certain sense , the developed countries achieved their economic development at the expense the interests of developing countries .
beginning from the early seventies , at the strong request of many developing countries , the united nations stipulated that the rich countries provide development assistance to poor , especially the least developed nations .
in fact , however , most of the developed countries have failed to honor their commitment , as their assistance fund has never reached the promised amount , and has gone down steadily in recent years .
the united states , a country with the greatest economic strength , has also been the most stingy country . the us government appropriated only 0.11 percent of its gdp as official development assistance in fiscal year 2001 , setting the lowest record of the post - war period .
when providing assistance , the western nations often attach some harsh conditions which do not tally with the actual situation of the poor countries , making the assistance nominal or inefficient .
for instance , to stop the increase of its poor population , africa must achieve an economic growth of 5 percent ; to reduce its poor population , it must achieve an economic growth of 7 percent ; and it is impossible for africa to attain this goal without a new international economic order .
rich countries should indeed stick to their commitment and provide more assistance to the developing countries .
in addition , the developed countries should make great efforts to open their markets to the developing countries , expand trade and transfer new and advanced technologies to the developing countries .
this is the way to benefit the developing countries , and to eventually benefit the developed countries as well .
to develop economy is the fundamental way out for poor countries to get themselves out of their plight .
the developing countries should first ensure political and social stability ; and then restructuring their economy according to their national conditions , formulate policies that conform to their conditions of economic development , and accelerate their economic development .
people are ardently expecting that the un millennium summit will sum up useful experience of the world economic development , display a blueprint of common development of the world economy , and make the 21 st century a century of common development and common prosperity of all countries .

once you are hired by the state administrative organ , you have got an " iron bowl . " this shows a striking malpractice under china 's traditional personnel management system .
over the past four years , more than 11,000 public servants were dismissed because they were not qualified . the problem that public servants " can be hired but not dismissed " has been effectively resolved .
you can be hired but cannot be dismissed , and you can be promoted but not demoted .
the market economy is , in essence , an economy of competition , in which the superior survive and the inferior are eliminated .
only thus can public servants feel the pressure and , therefore , boost their work morale .
to build a resignation and dismissal system for public servants , we should have a personnel system that meets the requirements of the market economy . this means that we should institute perfect measures to eliminate unqualified personnel and do away with the " iron bowl " practice .
in four years , shenyang city dismissed 163 unqualified government workers , accounting for 4 percent of the total number of public servants in that city .
based on the trial implementation of this system , the ministry of personnel decided in 1995 to have the system popularized nationwide in one or two years so that there would be a good resignation and dismissal system for government workers in this country .
in addition , 11,624 public servants resigned and left civil service during those four years .
in the absence of a suitable way to remove them , they were allowed to remain and became a big obstacle to the streamlining of that organ . with the implementation of the resignation and dismissal system , these people have been " requested " to leave , resulting in a remarkable improvement of the organ 's work morale .
the resignation and dismissal system , which removes the employment relationship between public servants and administrative organs , plays a vital role in transforming the government functions , raising their work efficiency , punishing corruption , and building a diligent and clean government , says the above - mentioned responsible officer of the ministry of personnel .
because of this , resignation and dismissal occupy an important position in the civil service system .
on the one hand , the implementation of the resignation and dismissal system for public servants has been integrated with the systems for testing and hiring government workers , for evaluating their work performance and disciplining them , and for them to file appeals and accusations .
meanwhile , the integration of dismissal and annual job evaluation has made it possible to accurately and fully based dismissal on job evaluation or , in other words , to have job evaluation really manifest its effect .
in - depth reform of the personnel system requires successful implementation of the resignation and dismissal system .

in the past , we spent a great deal of human resources , materials and money on guarding against the forgery of supporting documents and attained considerable results . however , that only was a temporary solution and not a permanent one .
the " electronic law - enforcement system at ports " has adopted the method of " electronic account + on - line inspection " for management . this has enabled relevant management departments to check each other 's electronic law - enforcement data through computer networks , thus fundamentally eliminating opportunities for lawless people to forge documents .
the " golden taxation project " can , by means of the detection of forged documents and cross - inspection , effectively guard against and crack down on crimes of forging documents , illegally issuing value - added invoices , and evading taxes .
a new and important task before us at present is to resolutely crack down on crimes of illegal export tax reimbursement .

we must put , as soon as possible , the special export taxation vouchers under the control of the branch computer inspection system for value - added taxes of the " golden taxation project , " and include the vouchers for the payment of value - added taxes on import goods in the management of the golden taxation project .

fourth , we must adhere to the principle of high starting points and high standards . we must emphasize reality and application , but we must also do things in advance and give full consideration to the needs of future development .
various departments should exchange data with each other and share information resources .
they must strengthen the building of the legal system and the revision of relevant laws and regulations , and provide a legal guarantee to the implementation of the " golden customs , " " golden taxation , " and other projects .
besides , they must strengthen the improvement and training of personnel .
advanced technology is controlled and used by men .

a modern government should have fewer personnel and higher efficiency .

"
computer network plays a prominent role a survey conducted by the institutions of higher education in shanghai shows that most of the college students spent two to four hours a day on computer network .
right now , student organizations and various academic departments of many colleges have set up their own homepages on the network and acted as bridges between the faculty members and students and among the students themselves .
the suggestion to let the ideological and political work enter the computer network has helped the university computer network take on an entirely new aspect .
the no. 8 student dormitory building of the department of computer science of the fudan university is one with more computers than other dormitory buildings in the whole university . nearly each dormitory in the building has one to two computers . students have also formed a computer network , linking more than 100 computers in the whole building .
many faculty members have asked the department to unravel the network so as to prevent it from affecting students ' academic studies .
however , the leadership in the university and faculty members of the department of computer science have decided that instead of forbidding students to get onto the network , it might as well turn this regional network into a site for the exchange of ideas between the faculty members and students .
students warmly support this decision . the students led by faculty member wang hongzhou had quickly set up a " network chat room " and other sections that carry out theoretical studies , provide psychological consultation , and disseminate professional knowledge . they also developed an anonymous bulletin board under the chat room .
it allows students to express their views and make suggestions to the faculty members on methods of teaching .
every week , the department of computer sciences also organizes faculty members and students to exchange views by means of the chat room on the computer network .
in order to promote campus culture in a healthy way , the shanghai jiaotong university has strengthened the administration of societies and organizations since february this year and extended its ideological and education work to such societies and organizations .
the university implements a system of " quarterly evaluation for promotion " and divides the societies and organizations into three categories - - the star group , the class - a group , and the qualified group .
societies and organizations that fail to meet the criteria twice in a row will be regarded as disqualified .
while strengthening its administration of the societies and organizations , the shanghai jiaotong university has energetically supported them in developing their activities and assigned a special instructor for each society or association .
yan lan , a member of the university video association , said that in the past , the association only played some video cd 's when it carried out its regular activities . all the activities have ended when the vcd player stops .
in face of the situation in which societies and organizations pay excessive attention to technologies , arts , and recreations , the shanghai jiaotong university has brought into full play the role of the party members to successfully form a youth volunteers service group .

on the campus of the shanghai jiaotong university , the number of student members of the society for the study of deng xiaoping theory has reach 4,200 .

exploring the path of development in the 21 st century the united nations millennium summit that has caught world attention is being held 6 - 8 september at the united nations headquarters in new york city .
how indeed can a just and reasonable new international political - economic order be built to further safeguard world peace and security and accelerate the development of the developing countries has become a major topic before the united nations , and unarguably it will be the millennium summit 's main topic of discussion .
in recent years , the international community has tried to bridge the growing north - south gap .
on this issue , camdessus , former imf managing director , has pointed out with concern that if the north - south wealth gap is allowed to continue to widen , the poverty issue will trigger social disturbance and conflict and eventually ruin the general order of the human society .
statistics show that the difference in per capita gdp between the developed and the developing countries has grown from 43 - folds in 1983 to more than 60 - folds today .
the united nations development program 's human development report 1999 showed that the developed countries which have 20 percent of the world population own as much as 86 percent of the world 's total output value and have captured as much as 82 percent of the global export market .
meanwhile , the developing countries which have more than 75 percent of the world population but only 14 percent share of the world output value and 18 percent share of the global market .
in this respect , the african region is facing the most grim situation .
but the developing countries could only passively submit to the unjust and unreasonable economic order ; their right to develop was seriously restrained .
the old international economic order greatly obstructed the growth of the developing countries where exporting resources was their economic mainstay , and as a result , these countries were plagued with serious problems such as the lack development funds , mounting debt burdens , deteriorating trade conditions and ecological environment .
beginning in the early 1970 's , compelled by the masses of developing countries , the united nations mandated that the rich countries must provide development aid for the poor countries , especially the least - developed countries .
the developed countries also promised to earmark 0.7 percent of their gnp as official foreign aid to help develop the poor countries .
the united states , the richest country today , is the most stingy : for fiscal year 2001 , the united states government plans to spend only 0.11 percent of its gdp on foreign aid , setting the lowest post - war record .
for example , africa must attain 5 percent economic growth rate just to stop the increase in its poor population , and it must attain 7 percent economic growth rate to quickly reduce its poor population .
without a new international economic order , it will be impossible for africa to achieve this goal .
this not only will benefit the developing countries but will ultimately benefit the developed countries too .

since the beginning of this year , major progress has been made in reforming and bailing out state - owned enterprises .

various signs in national economic development this year indicate that as a result of three years of hard work , china 's economy has overcome the impact of the asian financial crisis , and an important turn for the better has emerged in the economy .
gdp in the first half of the year was 8.2 percent up on the corresponding period of last year , and some experts believe that economic growth this year could be higher than last year .
exports rebounded strongly during the period ; total value of exports was $ 114.5 billion , a rise of 38.3 percent over the corresponding period of last year , while value of imports was $ 102.1 billion , up by 36.2 percent .
total social investment in fixed assets was 1.0176 trillion yuan , a rise of 11 percent compared with the corresponding period of last year , thus reversing the decline in the rate of increase in the second half of last year .
at a time when a slightly warming breeze is blowing in the national economy , experts also remind us that the basis for the current economic rebound is not yet solid , and the contradiction of insufficient demand in economic operations has not been fundamentally resolved .
a difficult problem facing economic growth is that of how to stimulate the rural market .
at present , the growth in peasant incomes has slowed ; in the first half of this year the peasants ' cash income increased by only 1.5 percent ; this was not only far below the increase in incomes of urban residents but was also lower than the rate of increase in the corresponding period of last year .
looking at investment demand , the major part of the current growth in investment depends on support by the state , and especially state bonds , and a permanent investment growth mechanism has not yet formed ; social investment is not lively enough , and nongovernmental investment cannot keep timely pace .
profits of the petroleum , electronic telecommunications , and electric power industries accounted for 54.5 percent of entire industrial profit ; and the profits of large and medium - sized enterprises accounted for over 70 percent of all industrial profit .
it is evident from this that we cannot be blindly optimistic regarding the foundation of the improved returns of industry .
the positive changes in the national economy can most fundamentally be ascribed to the active fiscal and steady monetary policies adhered to in sustained fashion by the cpc central committee and the state council over the past two years and more .
at the same time , reforms of the economic setup and restructuring need to be speeded up .
the structure of agriculture and the rural economy will be further readjusted and optimized , so as to consolidate the status of agriculture as the foundation .
reforms of state enterprises will be continually deepened , and industrial restructuring will be intensified .
we should seize the opportunity provided by the turn for the better to bring the economy into a virtuous circle and achieve sustained development of the national economy .
the us state department recently published a study report on the global arms trade in 1999 , which claimed that us arms exports totalled $ 11.8 billion , accounting for one - third of the global total , and the united states remains the largest arms exporter .
first , us arms exports have displayed a marked trend of yearly increase .
second , the united states still holds the dominant position in the fierce competition of the world arms market .
since the world economy has just extricated itself from the impact of financial crisis , expanding their share of arms exports is of important significance for the economic recovery of the developed countries , hence the competition in the global arms market is becoming hotter by the day .
although russia , the second largest arms exporter last year , increased its exports to $ 4.8 billion , nearly double that of 1998 , this was only about 40 percent of the us figure . total arms sales of west european countries were several billion dollars below the us figure .
deep study shows that there are still more important aims in us arms sales policy .
us arms sales policy also serves its global strategic aims , hence its arms sales are focused on europe , asia , and the middle east .
the countries of west europe have consistently been one of the main purchases of advanced us arms , and as nato expands eastward , us arms dealers have shifted their business to poland , the czech republic , and hungary .
in the asia - pacific region , apart from further relaxing controls on arms controls to japan and australia , the united states has also stepped up sales to other east asian countries .
the middle east has always been a main region for us arms sales .
last april , us defense secretary cohen personally took a trip to that region , openly acknowledging that his visit was linked to the sale of $ 8 billion worth of aircraft and missiles .
third , playing at a balancing policy and reaping the spoils without lifting a finger .
the so - called us policy of balance in foreign arms sales is in fact aimed at influencing the policy of other countries and controlling regional situations through arms sales .
the us policy on arms sales to taiwan exposes still more clearly its strategic intention to influence cross - strait relations by this means , even at the risk of increasing regional tension .
the peacekeeping mechanism of the united nations for maintaining world peace is now faced with a stern challenge .
some western nations and other blocs bypassed the united nations in carrying out military intervention of another country , seriously damaging the reputation of the un security council . the kosovo war serves as an example .
