various sectors related to petroleum have been impacted by the price increases .
the direct reason for the price increase is the fluctuations in world petroleum prices . the price of a barrel of crude oil on the world market has already passed us $ 30 , which is a 10 - year high .
but that situation has now changed .
china 's coal production reached 1.4 billion tons in 1996 , but it was just 1.045 billion tons last year , a drop of 16.4% off the 1998 figures . economic prosperity and development have meant ever - higher demand for oil .
the main problem is limits on the production of a few oil fields which have been in production for many years . the development of new oil fields has not been able to take up the slack , creating a situation in the last few years where crude oil production has n't been able to catch up .
according to the national bureau of statistics , in 1999 , total crude oil production in china was 160 million tons , a 0.1% increase over the previous year .
additionally , some people predict that in the next few years domestic crude oil production will remain at last year 's levels .
since the mid-1990s , china has thus become a net oil - importing nation , and china 's economic dependence on international petroleum is increasing .
the most direct effect is the difficulty in establishing the fuel oil tax , and sectors which are related to oil product consumption such as public transport , civil aviation , highways , and railroads have all paid the price for the oil price hikes .
guangzhou harbor authority saw a 3 million yuan increase in oil costs , which means that they will have difficulty in bringing their operations to profit this year .

experts in the field say that adjustment of prices for domestic oil products is a necessary choice to keep china 's oil prices on track with the prices on the international market .

clinton recently left to the next president the difficult problem of nmd [ national missile defense ] deployment .
this trillion - dollar plan was reduced in 1989 to the " brilliant pebbles " scheme .
" brilliant pebbles " was formally cancelled in 1993 and replaced by " ballistic missile defense " (bmd) .
bmd shifted the targets of missile interception from russia to third - world countries possessing missile technology , and was composed of two parts : the first part laid down that long - range icbm 's with a range of over 3,000 km capable of hitting the united states were targets for " national missile defense " (nmd) .
the second part laid down that short and medium - range mrbm 's with a range of under 3,000 km , which could hit us forces , bases and facilities overseas , would be dealt with by " theater missile defense " (tmd) .
tmd and nmd are one and the same , both are abm systems ; the only difference is in the area of deployment and the grade of capability .
on 17 march the us senate passed by 97 votes to three a bill on establishing nmd .
on 18 march , the house of representatives passed the bill by 317 votes to 102 .
new political gamble on the face of it , nmd is a military matter , but actually it is a political issue and an important bargaining chip in the united states in election year .
but this is a dangerous gamble !
after the nmd bill was passed by both houses of congress , countries around the world accused the united states of acting in perverse fashion and failing to keep its word .
this was because this move obviously violated the us - soviet " abm treaty " of 1972 , which clearly set limits on the development of abm systems by the two parties ; each side was only permitted to build one abm base , so as to provide the basis for limiting and reducing strategic missiles .
the russian defense minister said : " the united states has undermined the basis for the strategic arms reduction agreement and also wants to further strengthen its strategic advantage , so russia will be forced to respond . "
will not a new arms race begin ?
in wishing to jointly develop abm systems with west europe , israel , and japan , the united states is openly violating the norms of mtcr , and is in fact proliferating medium - range missile technology .
this is because it is completely possible to use abm heat - resistant structures and materials for manufacturing long - range missiles , while the guidance systems , rocket parts , and fuel technology can also be switched to ground - to - ground missiles .
representative ( kucinici ) said that the bill on building the abm system will have an unfavorable impact on the progress made in arms reduction , and " a new arms race will pose a still greater threat to the united states . "
the us allies are no exception either ; germany maintains an attitude of opposition ; france has made this criticism : " this program does not accord with strategic reality at all , and if implemented , it will have disastrous international consequences , . "
the swedish foreign minister said : " the us move in developing nmd runs counter to the current efforts of the international community in the fields of nuclear disarmament and the prevention of nuclear proliferation . "
it goes without saying that nmd is a hugely expensive program , and behind it lie vast profits for arms manufacturers .
at the same time hundreds of billions of dollars were spent on building the national information highway and the national defense information highway , resulting in fortunes for the software and internet industries .
this naturally greatly displeased the arms manufacturers , and so the passage of the nmd bill with the support of republican congressmen representing the interests of the arms industry meant that they gained a source of wealth .
the first stage of nmd , up to 2005 , would require the expenditure of $ 29.6 billion ; the second stage , up to 2010 , $ 6.1 billion ; and the third stage , up to 2015 , $ 13.1 billion .
in addition $ 10.6 billion would be required for developing other spacecraft and placing them in orbit .
it is evident how the " snowflake money " of american taxpayers has found its way into the pockets of the arms manufacturers !
wearing down the opponents .
occupying markets .
sharing the expense .
japan alone will spend 20 to 30 billion yen in the next five to six years in developing tmd .
us missile defense agency deputy director martin has paid a special visit to japan with four different plans " for japan to choose from " ; the most expensive plan b will cost $ 16.3 billion .
the us military carried out three tests of the nmd interception technology last 2 october , 18 january , and 7 july .
the first was successful ; the second failed , because a small metal nitrogen pipe ruptured , with the result that the interceptor missile could not find the target ; and the third test also failed , because of a fault in the rocket separation apparatus .
moreover , even if the tests had been successful , as the mit 's science and technology and national security professor ( bostor ) said : " the experiments show that the system being proposed cannot distinguish between a warhead and the simplest decoy !
actual combat revealed that contrary to predictions , this defense line did not hamper the german army invasion but was just wishful thinking , and this has come down in history as a laughingstock in trying to please the public with claptrap .
president clinton has called a temporary halt to the deployment of this defense system ; although this is an expediency made under all sorts of pressure , it is after all a wise move .
guided missiles at door in bully 's show of force ; hue and cry in security - anxious asia a not very long report published in the washington times on august 25 once again exposed the u.s. air force 's dangerous attempt in the pacific region .
according to the report written by two reporters of the paper , " early this month the pentagon deployed 63 conventional cruise missiles on guam .
" according to pentagon officials , such forward deployment as installation of the guided missiles on guam 1,500 miles from the philippines means u.s. bombers can in 12 hours use the air - to - ground attack warheads to hit at any place in the asia - pacific region . "
this action of the united states has aroused intense concern in all countries in the world , countries in the asia - pacific region in particular . to quote a foreign military analyst : " this is tantamount to placing the cruise missiles at the door of the asian countries . "
asia : focus of u.s. contention for global strategic interests a look at america 's history will easily reveal to us that , as a typical maritime state , the united states has built up its fortune through aggression and expansion .
neighboring on hawaii , the philippines , japan and new guinea , it is 5,300 km from hawaii where u.s. pacific command is located but only over 2,000 km from the asian - pacific countries where u.s. long - range bombers can reach in less than three hours .
from the military strategy point of view , guam is a u.s. springboard to asia and plays a vital role in implementing the asia - pacific strategy of the united states .
after world war two , the united states has built it into a naval and air base and a strategic support base of the u.s. military in west pacific .
beginning from 1996 , the united states has on many occasions organized airborne expeditionary bomber units to fly to the andersen afb on guam and the [ xi - er - m ] afb on hawaii to test these aircraft 's ability to get their cruise missiles replenished without flying back to the u.s. proper .
in 1998 , 12 cruise missile specialists arrived at the andersen afb under u.s. military 's secret arrangement to begin preparatory work for the deployment of cruise missiles there .
consequently , [ as indicated ] in the " new military strategy of the united states " formally issued by the pentagon of the united states to its subordinate units in the first half of this year , the focus of u.s. strategic deployment began to quietly shift toward asia .
it is precisely out of this kind of cold war psychology that various kinds of " theories of threat " have been dished up . once again , focus is directed at guam 's military role in the asia - pacific region .
what is worth noting is , just as the u.s. air force is busy deploying cruise missiles on guam , the u.s. navy is also doing its utmost to assert its position in the military .
although the u.s. air force did not directly mention which country the cruise missiles on guam are aimed at , it would be clear without mentioning when the large type naval exercise is brought into the picture .
just a little conversion will let us figure out the times needed by the u.s. military 's strategic bombers to fly from guam to reach the air space of various asian - pacific countries .

united nations , 6 sep ( xinhua ) - - president jiang zemin delivered an important speech on 6 september at the millenium summit of the united nations .
at present , the people in many countries are still suffering from the scourge of wars and turmoil .
hegemonism and power politics still exist .
local conflicts caused by ethnic , religious , territorial or resources factors keep cropping up .
separatist , terrorist and extremist forces of various kinds are causing incessant damage to the international community .
the environment , drugs , refugees and other global issues have become more acute .
both history and reality have shown : - - respect for each other 's independence and sovereignty is vital to the maintenance of world peace .
- - building common security is the prerequisite to the prevention of conflicts and wars .
there is a need to thoroughly discard the cold war mentality , establish a new security concept centered on mutual trust , mutual benefit , equality , and cooperation .
all international disputes and regional conflicts should be solved through peaceful means .
the multipolar setup is different from the situation in history characterized by major powers vying for supremacy and dividing up spheres of influence .
all countries should be independent and autonomous . cooperation between countries and partnership relations in various forms should not be directed at third parties .
maintaining world peace is a prerequisite to promoting common development ; and promoting common development is an important guarantee for maintaining peace .
the rich become richer and the poor become poorer .
development of modern science and technology and of economic globalization have not benefited all the countries in the world . imbalance in world development is becoming more acute .
over 1.3 billion people in the world live under the absolute poverty line , with less than one us dollar for living expenses per capita per day .
the developed countries possess 86 percent of the world 's gdp and occupy 82 percent of the world 's export markets , while the developing countries - - which account for the overwhelming majority of the world 's population - - possess only 14 and 18 percent respectively .
if there is no fundamental change to such a situation , the international community will not be able to avoid turmoil and it will be difficult to promote common development in various countries and to realize common prosperity in the world .
north - south dialogue should be promoted on the basis of equality and south - south cooperation conducted extensively .
only through enhanced south - south cooperation can third world countries expect to reduce probable risk brought about by economic globalization and to realize their own prosperity and progress .
in the final analysis , developing countries need to rely on constant enhancement of their development capabilities to realize development .
rapid sci - tech development has become a new and major engine for creating wealth .
advanced science and technology , which realizes mankind 's wisdom and creative spirit , should be used to promote peace and development on a global scale and bring benefits to all people in the world .
all international political , economic and trade organizations should listen carefully to developing countries ' calls and maintain the rights and interests of developing countries .
all countries in the world should develop economic , trade , and technological exchanges and cooperation by following the principle of equality and mutual benefit , so as to share the results of economic globalization and sci - tech progress .
to maintain world peace and promote common development , advocacy and enforcement of democratic principles in international affairs is required .
countries in the world , big or small , rich or poor , strong or weak , are equal members in the international community and have rights to be involved in and to deal with international affairs .
in this era , the world 's destiny should be decided jointly by the people in various countries in the world .
this is a colorful world .
as in the universe , there can not be only one color , nor should there be only one civilization , one social system , one development mode , and one value concept in the world .
all countries and all nationalities have contributed to the development of human civilization .
diversity between different nationalities , religions , and civilizations should be respected .
there is a need to promote exchanges between various civilizations and to borrow from each other based on the spirit of equality and democracy to seek common progress .
since its inception half a century ago , the united nations , with the support of the vast number of member countries , has done much useful work to ease regional conflicts , eliminate old colonialism , and promote world peace , cooperation , and development .
the positive role of the united nations should only be strengthened and not weakened . the authority of the united nations should be maintained and not harmed .
in handling international affairs , no country or group of countries should take an attitude of using the united nations when it is needed , and abandon it when it is not .
the united nations and its security council should go along with the trend of history and carry out reforms as necessary and appropriate under the principle of equitable geographical distribution , so as to give expression to the will of all its member states ; the developing countries in particular .
the founding of the people 's republic of china and the great achievements in the course of its construction represent a huge contribution to world peace and development .
the chinese people will unwaveringly advance along the path of building socialism with chinese characteristics , and will steadfastly complete the great cause of the motherland 's reunification according to the " peaceful reunification , one country , two systems " principle .
socialist and modernized china will surely stand firmly in the orient .
china 's development is a contribution to world peace and development .
china will , as always , fulfill its obligations and duties .
all un member states and statesmen of various countries shoulder an important and historic mission entrusted by the times , which is to realize a lasting peace in the world and to promote common development and common prosperity in all countries .
the people of the world possess wisdom .

xiamen , 7 sep ( zhongxin she ) - - to meet wto requirements , china is stepping up efforts to sort out and revise its foreign economic laws and regulations .
it is planned that the amendment bill ( draft ) will be soon completed and submitted .
in addition , anti - dumping laws , anti - subsidy laws , and safeguard measures are also being drafted and will be submitted to the state council upon further improvements .
efforts are also being stepped up to formulate new laws and rules and departmental regulations pertaining to the import and export of goods and materials and technologies as well as those pertaining to foreign capital utilization .
statistics show that among the six sets of existing chinese foreign economic and trade laws , two sets pertain to foreign trade and four have to do with foreign investments ; there are 44 administrative rules and a preliminary compilation of 754 departmental rules and other regulatory documents , 664 of which are still effective .
upon joining the wto , china will set up a policy support center to provide those at home and abroad with the relevant laws and rules in a timely fashion .

united nations , 7 sep ( xinhua ) - - chinese president jiang zemin gave an important speech at the summit of the un security council on the afternoon of 7 september .
mr. chairman , the united nations was founded 55 years ago . this pioneering move had a profound influence on the course of international relations in the aftermath of world war ii .
the world is not peaceful , and various factors that threaten world peace and security have continued to exist . regional conflicts arising from racial , religious , and territorial disputes are on the rise , and there are complex conflicts and problems hampering the common development of countries .
the call for peace , stability , and development is growing among people in various countries .
to effectively defuse contradictions , resolve conflicts , and achieve lasting peace and common security , it is imperative to settle disputes through dialogue , negotiation , and consultation in strict accordance with the purposes and principles of the united nations charter .
resorting to armed force on the slightest pretext and interfering in other countries ' internal affairs in the name of " humanitarianism " is not only contrary to the purposes and principles of the united nations charter , but it can also give rise to grave consequences .
according to the united nations charter , the security council has primary responsibility for the maintenance of international peace and security .
we must jointly maintain , not undermine , the security council 's authority ; and we must jointly strengthen , not weaken , the security council 's role .
the united nations should draw a lesson from its past experience .
to make un peacekeeping operations more effective , both radical and stopgap measures must be taken to eradicate the root cause of conflict .
in keeping with the requirements of the times , the security council should undertake the necessary reforms to strengthen its role , maintain its authority , and improve its efficiency .
to this end , all member states should patiently hold discussions in order to reach consensus .
mr. chairman , the current term of the security council has designated african issues as key areas of concern ; this is certainly very important .
many countries and regions across the african continent are engulfed in turmoil and endless war , which have not only displaced and impoverished innocent people but have also hindered africa 's economic and social development .
africa 's poverty and backwardness is a result of long - term rivalry among , and despoliation by , old - line colonialists . an africa which has already achieved national independence should absolutely not become a forgotten corner of the world .
the un security council should pay more attention to african issues and increase its input in africa .
china is a permanent member of the security council ; it is also a developing country .
as long as we have strong determination and work indefatigably , the lofty common ideal of peace and development entertained by people all over the world can surely be realized .
this is the second summit meeting held by the security council since 1992 .
the main theme of the present meeting is to " ensure the role of the security council in safeguarding international peace and security , especially in africa . "
president jiang zemin attended the meeting and made an important speech on the security council 's role and its reform , un peacekeeping operations , and the issue of africa .
vice premier qian qichen and foreign minister tang jiaxuan accompanied president jiang zemin and attended the meeting .
when talking about the current international situation , jiang zemin pointed out : at the turn of the century , there have been profound changes in the international situation .
how to enable the united nations to more effectively maintain international peace and security in order to create a good environment for the development of all countries has become an urgent problem .
jiang zemin pointed out : to dissolve contradictions and conflicts effectively and achieve a lasting peace and common security , it is necessary to strictly comply with the purposes and principles of the un charter . disputes , if any , must be settled through dialogue , negotiation , and consultation .
all member countries should hold discussions with patience and strive to reach unanimity through consultation .
jiang zemin also talked about the issue of africa .
he pointed out : africa is an important member of the world community .
there will be no world peace and prosperity to speak of without african stability and development .
in dealing with problems facing africa , it is necessary to fully respect the sovereignty of african countries and pay close attention to the opinions of african countries and regional organizations such as the organization of african unity .
lastly , jiang zemin reiterated that china is ready to work together with other member countries of the united nations to strengthen the security council 's role in safeguarding international peace and security , support its continued efforts to seek a solution to regional conflict , and give impetus to its increased support for africa .
leaders of the other security council members also spoke at the meeting , reiterating their support for the security council to continue to play an active role in safeguarding international peace and security .
the chinese delegation took an active part in discussing the final document .
at china 's request , the final document incorporated various aspects , such as respect for the state sovereignty , political independence , and territorial integrity of all member countries , prohibition of the use or threat of force in international relations , and peaceful resolution of international disputes .

at this un millennium summit , all the participating countries are divided into four groups ; and the roundtable sessions for the four groups are chaired , respectively , by singapore prime minister goh chok tong , polish president aleksander kwasniewski , venezuela president hugo chavez , and algerian president bouteflika .
as these reporters have learned , to encourage the leaders of all participating countries to speak their mind freely , the roundtable sessions for the four groups have adopted the form of a free exchange of views , and all the views expressed at the session are off the record and will not be disclosed to the media .
anyone who wishes to speak at the session should first raise his hand , and can start to speak upon recognition by the chairman ; and the time set for each speaker is three minutes .
before the end of each roundtable session , the chairman will make a summary , which is limited to five to seven minutes .
the un security council summit , which was held at 1330 hours local time today , was another major item on the agenda of this un millennium summit .
the un security council is composed of five permanent member states and 10 rotating non - permanent member states .

new york , 8 sep ( xinhua ) - - china 's president jiang zemin delivered a speech entitled , " join hands to build sino - us relations oriented toward the new century " on 8 september in new york at a luncheon hosted by sino - us friendship groups .
for a long time , all of you present here have made positive efforts and worked hard to increase the mutual understanding and friendship between the chinese and the american people and to promote the improvement and development of the sino - us relations .
i wish to take this opportunity to express my sincere thanks and good wishes to you and through you to all the american friends who have cared for and supported the development of the sino - us relations .
the world today is undergoing profound changes .
modern science and technology with information technology and life science at its core have provided new and strong impetus to mankind 's social development .
however , factors affecting regional and world stability continue to exist , regional conflicts keep occurring , and the gap between the south and the north keeps widening .
faced with a world that is full of opportunities and challenges , how to bring healthy , stable , and continually developing sino - us relations to the 21 st century is a pressing task that is thrust before the people and statesmen of our two countries .
the people of china and the united states began exchanges 200 years ago .
according to chinese customs statistics , the trade between the two countries amounted to only $ 2.4 billion 21 years ago , but reached $ 61.4 billion by 1999 .
to promote the development of sino - us relations , we should better understand each other 's countries and peoples .
history and reality have shown that prejudice , more than ignorance , could make us estranged from the truth , and prejudice , more than the barriers of mountains or rivers , could cut off mutual contacts and exchanges .
in the course of developments over the past 5,000 years , the chinese nation has created a brilliant culture , which has made great contributions to the progress of mankind 's civilization .
but the chinese people 's efforts to strive for national invigoration have never stopped for even a moment .
in the future , we will continue to dedicate ourselves to carry out economic construction and to constantly raise the living standards of all the chinese people .
this has always been a goal of struggle for the chinese government .
the chinese nation has the glorious tradition of loving peace .
we persist in carrying out friendly and cooperative relations with countries in the world on the basis of respecting one another 's sovereignty and territorial integrity , mutual non - aggression , mutual non - interference in internal affairs , and the five principles of peaceful co - existence .
the chinese nation is a nation that loves democracy and freedom .
the founding of the new china is a great achievement of this struggle .
the chinese government has made unremitting efforts to maintain and promote the democratic rights of the chinese people and the civil rights , political rights , and basic freedom of the chinese people which have been maintained and safeguarded according to the law .
in the past 20 years alone , china has helped 200 million people out of poverty , which is almost the same as the population of the united states .
china has some 2,000 radio and television stations , some 2,000 newspapers , some 8,000 periodicals , some 100,000 new books published annually , 16 million internet users , some 27,000 web sites , some 70,000 chinese domain names , and some 61 million mobile phone subscribers .
china 's 56 nationalities have established a new type of ethnic relationship that is marked by equality , mutual help , and unity .
various undertakings in the regions inhabited by ethnic minorities have made long strides in development and their society enjoys comprehensive progress .
soon after the founding of the new china , tibetan people began democratic reforms .
the serf system that mixed politics with religion was thoroughly scrapped , and millions of serfs who were oppressed in the past as slaves became the masters of their fate .
languages , religions , customs , and conventions of china 's minorities , tibetans included , are protected and respected , and their cultural traditions have developed continuously .
in tibet , many tibetan children study at schools with tibetan as the teaching language .
the chinese constitution specifically stipulates that citizens have freedom of religious worship .
all state organs , social groups , and individuals shall not force citizens to worship or not to worship certain religions , discriminate against citizens who have a religion or citizens that do not have a religion .
there are many representatives from various religions at china 's national people 's congress and at the chinese people 's political consultative conference .
wanting all the countries in the world to practice a certain political system and using a country 's value concept to judge the diverse choices made by the people of other countries is also not democratic .
no country is perfect .
china and the united states should enhance exchanges and dialogue on the basis of equality and mutual respect .
proper handling of the taiwan issue is a key to establishing sino - us relations oriented to the new century .
the chinese people love peace and would very much hate to see fratricide .
we have the greatest sincerity in trying our best to seek peaceful reunification .
the source that leads to tension in the taiwan strait is those who try to engage in " taiwan independence " and try to split taiwan from china .
i have said many times that as long as the taiwan authorities recognize the one - china principle , we can sit together with them and talk . we can discuss anything . we can go to taiwan or taiwan 's leader can come to the mainland .
as all know , the taiwan issue is the most important and most sensitive issue in sino - us relations .
the taiwan issue has caused most of the ups and downs in the sino - us relations over the past several decades .
both the us democratic party and the republican party have made explicit commitments to the taiwan issue , which is to pursue the one - china policy , by abiding by the three sino - us joint communiques , mutually respecting sovereignty and territorial integrity , and mutual non - interference in each other 's internal affairs .
after taiwan reunites with the mainland , it can still maintain economic and cultural ties with the united states .
last november , china and the united states signed a bilateral market access agreement on china joining the wto .
market opening should be a two - way street .
the complementary nature of the economic relations between china and the united states is strong , and the potential for developing economic and trade cooperation is great .
china 's economy will continue to maintain a rapid growth in the next five to ten years .
we are embarking on a large - scale development of china 's western regions in a planned and step by step manner to bring about coordinated development in the regional economy .
it is estimated that by that time commodity and service imports alone will top $ 3,000 billion .
both china and the united states are nuclear countries and are permanent members of the un security council .
china , the united states , and other countries in the world should work toward the lofty goal of realizing global security .
both china and the united states are great countries .
we should climb high so that we can look far and persevere in viewing and handling the two countries ' relations from a strategic and long - term perspective .
the cold war mentality is a product of the old times , which is not compatible with the lofty cause of world peace and development and the wishes of the chinese and american people to improve and develop the sino - us relations .
let us with one heart and one mind , steer the ship of sino - us relationship toward a future that is full of hope against the backdrop of the ray of dawn of the new century that arises over the horizon .

according to the washington post , from 9 to 14 august , eight us b-52 strategic bombers carried 63 conventional air - launched cruise missiles from the united states to guam island , 10,000 km away , close to west pacific asian countries .
the us defense department confirmed this news on 28 august , and said that this move " will give us bombers the ability to attack any place in the asia - pacific region within 12 hours . "
the us military has built three chains of bases in the asia - pacific region , from japan , south korea , and southeast asia in the west to the us west coast in the east , in order to form a posture of " encircling and hemming in " asia - pacific countries .
in recent years the united states has consistently tried to deploy cruise missiles , which are important strategic strike weapons , outside us territory , in order to continually strengthen its asia - pacific strategy .
two years ago the us air force general staff secretly ordered the air force to study measures for strengthening strategic bomber capacity in the asia - pacific region ; the deployment of cruise missiles on guam was placed on the agenda again , and many secret military exercises were held .
hence , in view of this , the recent us deployment of cruise missiles on guam will put into effect the us strategic attempts over many years .
on 25 august ( haynes ) , spokesman for the us air force pacific command , mined no words in stating : " in the past two years the us air force has been working to turn anderson base on guam into a forward base for us long - range bombers . "
" deploying this type of missile at this location is equivalent to possessing the capacity to engage in launching and strikes from the us mainland and return to anderson base to rearm with extra cruise missiles without the need to fly back 10,000 miles to the us mainland " [ sentence as received ] .
" since that is an ideal location , the us military can throw forces at the whole of asia from there . "
zhao yiping : the united states has chosen guam as the location for its first cruise missile deployment outside us territory , what kind of strategic position does guam have in us asia - pacific strategy ?
wang weixing : guam is situated at the southern end of the marianas in the west pacific ; it is the largest island in the archipelago , with an area of 541 square km .
in 1521 the spanish navigator magellan led his expedition to the marianas , and they went ashore at uatac bay in guam for water and provisions ; since then the western world has known about guam .
guam subsequently came under spanish , us , and japanese rule . it was recaptured by the united states in the pacific war in 1944 and formally placed under us jurisdiction .
guam is termed the westernmost us territory and " the place where the american day begins . "
in order to run this position , since world war ii the united states has developed it into an important naval and air base and strategic support base in the west pacific .
there are still over 6,000 combat personnel on guam .
the entire economy of the island serves the us naval and air bases .
when the korean war broke out , anderson base on guam was the most important staging post for heavy bombers on their way from the us mainland to the korean peninsula .
after the vietnam war broke out in 1965 , long - range b-52 flew many missions from guam and indiscriminately bombed vietnam for eight years .

the issue not only has an impact on preparations for a military combat but is also related to the direction of development of military theories .
however , there exist defects in the viewpoint of firepower combat regarding such issues as view of combat , theories of methods , and feasibility , which should be corrected .
first , the thinking of firepower combat is the core content of west 's combat theories in the era of mechanization .
based on this kind of understanding , war definitely is full of dense smells of gunpowder . this is no doubt profound disclosure on the essence of war .
henceforth , the " theory of mechanized warfare , " " tanks subdue , " " control of the air " , " nuclear warfare , " and other theories were published successively , which formed the theoretical system of having firepower combat as the focus adopted in the modern history of the west .
there exist huge differences between viewpoints of the east and west on war , which embody a concentrated reflection of the different ways of thinking between the east and west .
under the condition of high technology , materials , resources , and information have been listed side by side as the three most important elements in current competition in the world . information is in the process of becoming a more important resource and wealth than materials and energy .
the us military already engaged in studies of information warfare in the 1970 s .
the ensuing gulf war symbolized the beginning of transition of combat to information warfare .
firepower combat and information warfare does not contradict each other ; instead , the two are an inseparable whole .
information warfare is meant to safeguard and enhance firepower combat , and firepower combat is the basis of war . it is impossible to decide the outcome of a war by launching information warfare exclusive of firepower combat .
nowadays , it is not true that capitulation takes place in non - firepower attack only . in both the gulf war and kosovo war , the us military had to include firepower combat ultimately .
if both parties of a war fully understand the power of information warfare , there definitely will be a new pattern to war .
therefore , ignoring the studies of information warfare is a conceptual backwardness . the focus of " winning " of our military should be placed on enhancing the comprehensive combat power characterized by a combination of information warfare and firepower combat .
our military has placed the basic point of preparations for military combat on winning a local war fought under a high - tech condition .
actual preparations have entered upon the stage of operations at the level of military tactics .
there is indeed an important issue worthy of attention considering combat operation . this is exactly the issue of concrete patterns of firepower combat at the three levels of strategy , campaign , and military tactics .
a local war fought under the high - tech condition mostly has the nature of a decisive battle . therefore , a strategic decision has significant influence on the outcome of a war .
a major issue in terms of command of a campaign is implementation of a high degree of unity .
finally , it is the pattern of operation at the level of military tactics , with optimal countermeasure being the key .
the basic countermeasure of our military in terms of utilization of firepower at the level of military tactics is to implement the new " defense and assault in three aspects , " which is an important issue that each arm of the services must resolve and the key to reducing losses .

only by possessing staunch ideal and conviction can the advanced classes and masses of people under the leadership of a marxist political party arouse their historical initiative for creating the future .
to build socialism with chinese characteristics , it is inevitable to discard those individual inferences with utopian elements about socialism as well as those dogmatic understandings about marxism and erroneous viewpoints labeled with marxism and it is inevitable to uphold and develop theory of scientific socialism .
the successful practice and great achievements of reform and opening up have gradually made building socialism with chinese characteristics deeply rooted among the people and welcomed and accepted by the vast numbers of people as a matter of course .
socialism must reflect and realize the interests of the people .
whether the conviction in socialism is staunch or not does not depend on whether the people shout the slogan loudly or not but whether the masses are willing or not to do it or not .
since the reform and opening up , the great forces hidden among the masses of people have been fully released , the masses of people have unprecedentedly demonstrated a creative spirit and their enthusiasm , initiative , and creativity have been brought into play on an unprecedented scale .
the conviction of the people in socialism has been transformed into concrete practice for developing economy , improving livelihood , and building a prosperous , powerful , democratic , and civilized socialist country .
emancipating minds , starting up brains , and thinking in an independently manner have become a common tendency in the whole nation and daring to practice , make innovations , and be pioneers have become a new trend of the times .
through making efforts over the last 20 years or so , we have eventually opened up a most lively , active , and creative ideological and political situation in the history of our party and country and the ideological level and understanding capability of the masses of people have been greatly increased .
the reform is not only a fundamental transformation of the old structure but also a transformation of thinking patterns and an ideological revolution of the people .
the long - term influence of feudalism and small - producers ' force of habit have left many outdated concepts and backward mentalities among the people .
these outdated concepts and backward mentalities safeguard the old and decadent morality and convictions , deny the legitimate interests and pursuits of the people , and hinder the progress and development of the society .
during the long - term process of revolution and construction , the struggle against outdated concepts and backward mentalities has greatly mobilized the initiative and creativity of the broad masses of the people for transforming the society .
daring to practice , make innovations , and be pioneers is a new social spirit nurtured by the reform and opening up .
it requires and encourages people to make bold experiments and innovations , blaze new trails , and pioneer new undertakings .
the creative spirit of the masses of people is respected , the spirit of daring to think and act and be pioneers is recommended and admired in the society , and the new experiences acquired by the masses at the grass - roots level have become a powerful base for the party to formulate policies .
building socialism with chinese characteristics is a completely new undertaking and we are taking a completely new road without any ready - made experience to be shared .
integrating socialism with market economy and fulfilling the historical task of modernization in a country with a weak foundation is even more a pioneering undertaking which has never been undertaken by anybody before .
changing from the previous conservative and closed state of minds to today 's situation of being lively and opening up , the reform spirit and creative vitality of the people are released at once .
although sometimes people might make incorrect remarks and do incorrect things , having warm and lively discussions should at least be better than dead silence ; a vivid and invigorating situation should at least be better than a lifeless and spiritless one , and advancing in making explorations should at least be better than remaining stagnant .
we should uphold those correct things and correct those incorrect things and promptly revolve problems whenever they crop up .
if it is proved in practice to be correct , they will accept it and carry it out by actual efforts . if it is proved in practice to be incorrect , they will resist it .
very often , the correct understandings are produced on the basis of practice through making comparison and differentiation .
the reform and opening up has enabled people to widen their field of vision , enrich their experiences , activate their thinking , and learn how to make comparison and differentiation .
no matter what the thinkings and concepts are , they must be tested in the comparison of practice and supplemented and revised in the comparison of practice .
striving to conduct objective and comprehensive analyses of various phenomena emerging in the social life and forming the correct understanding of their own are also indications that people 's thinking are maturing day by day .
therefore , new situations and new issues which were never experienced before are appearing in the face of people in almost every hour and minute .
through the reform and opening up for more than 20 years , the attitudes of the masses of people towards new things and new phenomena have made historical progresses .
the masses of people resolutely support and actively participate in the reform and opening up and actively throw themselves into the great cause of building socialism with chinese characteristics , which is the main current and the essential quality of the social thinking and social practice .
ideological maturity is an important indication of a nation truly becoming mature .
relying on the correct understandings which are formed in practice , we can make ideological and theoretical judgment through making objective and cool - headed comparisons under richer and as a matter of course more complicated cultural and theoretical background . this is an indication of the psychological progress of a nation .
along with the development of the social , political , economic , and cultural life , the independent and optional space for people 's ideological activities will become more extensive .
and along with the expansion of the reform and opening up and the deepening of the mutual influence and infiltration of the world economy and culture , people should have a bigger scope for making comparison and differentiation of various ideologies and cultures .
therefore , it is more necessary for us to have a mature national idea and national spirit .
just like the ideological maturity of an individual should need a process , the ideological maturity of the masses of people should also inevitably need a process .
and it is normal if some deviations occur during this process .
regarding some issues in the ideological realm , we should not take them lightly nor attach too much importance to them .
it is important to conduct guidance . it is necessary to believe in the strength of practice and attach importance to the self - education of the masses . we are now building and perfecting the socialist market economic structure .
in opening up to the outside world , the decadent ideology and culture of the western bourgeoisie would also avail themselves of this opportunity to get into china and exert influence in some realms and scopes .
especially , those residual ideology of feudalism which existed in our county 's society for a long time , including the ideological concepts of feudal and superstition , ignorance , and backwardness , and the dregs of the society would also float up again under the new historical conditions .
to guide and educate the masses with marxist world outlook , life outlook , and concept of values , we need to make long - term and unremitting efforts .
it is necessary to distinguish between essentials and nonessentials .
one of the important tasks of the party 's ideological and political work is to guide cadres and the masses to distinguish between essentials and nonessentials and between correctness and fallacy .
in contemporary china , the correct and progressive ideological concept under the guidance of marxism is the main current of the whole social ideology and some wrong and backward concepts running against marxism are only branch currents .
nevertheless , in an opened society , it is unavoidable that the correct thinking is entangled with incorrect thinking and progressive concepts and backward concepts are mutually influencing each other .
on the road of building socialism with chinese characteristics , problems will crop up at any time .
we must master the overall situational development with a broad outlook and cool - headedness . we should neither overlook issues nor exaggerate issues but resolve whatever existing issues , including those issues about conviction , faith , confidence , trust , and others on the part of some people .
it is important to conduct guidance .
very often , the creation and spreading of wrong ideological trends is due to our overlooking the " branch currents . "
especially nowadays when the communication technology is highly developed , the information disseminated by various mass media is " exploding , " and the means of dissemination are highly modernized , if you do not occupy this modern stage on which various ideologies and cultures are surging against each other , other people will occupy it .
we must regard marxism as guidance to strengthen the theoretical study and propaganda of those major issues in realistic socialism and use the lively scientific theories which people can personally feel in life to educate , convince , and arm the masses , and employ the achievements of reform and opening up to influence and inflect the masses .
it is not necessary nor possible to provide a detailed and perfect answer to every concrete issue but we should and we can provide the masses with a scientific ideological weapon to fundamentally improve the capability of the masses to distinguish between right and wrong , grasp the essence , and master laws .
this is exactly where the mission , responsibility , and charm of the ideological and political work lies .
the masses of people have never been as spiritedly , enthusiastically , and vigorously as now developing whole - heartedly the productive forces , improving and increasing their livelihood , and striving to create a brand - new social civilization while remolding and improving their own ideology .

from the center to the localities , no department is allowed to upgrade the set standards , or to do this in disguised fashion in the form of inspection and assessment ; 3 . it is prohibited to collect administrative fees and charge that have no legal basis .

stroyev expressed warm welcome to chairman li peng 's visit , which he called a very high - level visit between russia and china .
he said that although the russian parliament is the host , the visit would give a powerful boost to the development of russia 's strategic partnership with china as a whole , adding that russia assigns great importance to relations with china and respects the road of development chosen by china according to its own conditions .
he said that the russian and chinese parliaments have had frequent contacts , noting that federal council delegations have visited china and have had fruitful exchanges with china 's npc .
he said that the two countries also cooperate closely on the maintenance of stability and the fight against extreme nationalism .
he agreed with stroyev 's appraisal of sino - russian relations , noting that china and russia hold identical or similar views on many issues .
at the millennium summit in new york , president jiang zemin fully expounded china 's views and positions and president putin also gave a speech on the occasion , he noted .
we have an important consensus on the trends of multipolarization and economic globalization ; we are both against hegemonism ; and we both believe that the people of all countries have the right to choose their own road of development and live their own life , he said .
li peng said that china shares a common border stretching more than 4,000 kilometers with russia and the friendship between the two peoples goes back a long time .
president puton 's recent trip to china has instilled new vitality into the relations between the two countries , he said , and he believed that the road of mutually beneficial bilateral cooperation will become broader and broader .
he hoped to further promote the development of bilateral relations through cooperation between china 's npc and the upper and lower houses of the russian parliament .
li peng said that interregional exchanges constitute an important component of state - to - state relations .
on a train on the south xinjiang railroad , he heard a briefing given by the ministry of railways and the urumqi railway bureau on railroad construction in xinjiang and the operation of the south xinjiang railroad , and he called on them to bring into further play the important role of the south xinjiang railroad .

we should pay attention to such ecological projects as restoring farmland to forest and grassland , and afforesting barren hills and desolate land step by step in a planned way so as to improve the ecological environment and production conditions in the western region .
to vigorously develop science , technology and education and raise the scientific , technological and educational level and the overall quality of the people of all nationalities is an important condition for success in the large - scale development of the western region .
only the combination of qualified personnel and science and technology can convert abundant natural resources into advantages in economic development .

beijing , september 13 (zxs) - - chinese president jiang zemin said in his talks with visiting argentine president fernando de la rua here today that he hoped the two governments would make a joint effort to build a cooperative partnership for the 21 st century from a strategic vantage point .
china is very satisfied with the results , he said .
jiang zemin said that as a big country in latin america , argentina plays an important role in international and regional affairs . he said that china and argentina are important developing countries in asia and latin america , and both sides have common interests and take a similar stand on many major international issues .
on the question of economic relations and trade , jiang zemin said that bilateral economic relations and trade have been developing well in recent years , pointing out that argentina is china 's major trading partner in latin america .
he said that the chinese and argentine economies are highly complementary and the potential for trade is great .
he hoped that entrepreneurs from both sides would increase their contacts and exchanges in order to explore and increase the possibilities of economic cooperation and trade .
fernando de la rua agreed with jiang zemin 's views on bilateral relations , economic cooperation and trade .
he said that he has brought up the issue of establishing more friendly relations with china since he assumed office and that the present visit is the first step toward this goal . fernando de la rua said that argentina and china are both working for economic development and the improvement of people 's livelihood .
he said there are plenty of trading opportunities in the two countries , adding that he has brought with him entrepreneurs from argentina on this visit and hopes that more argentine delegations will be visiting china in future .
fernando de la rua said that argentina and china have many points in common in international affairs and support each other , adding that both countries devote themselves to the maintenance of world peace and follow the principles of non - interference in the internal affairs of other countries and respecting the sovereignty of other countries .
he said he totally agrees with what president jiang had said at the un millennium summit , pointing out that argentina and china should further strengthen mutual trust and enlarge their scope of cooperation .
he said he believes that bilateral relations will see further progress provided that the two sides make a joint effort in a pragmatic manner .
fernando de la rua reiterated that the argentine government upholds the one - china policy and supports the complete reunification of china .
fernando de la rua said that mercosur is very much interested in developing relations with china , and that argentina is willing to exert further efforts to promote relations between mercosur and china .
fernando de la rua invited president jiang zemin to visit argentina next year . jiang zemin thanked him and gladly accepted the invitation .
after the meeting , the two heads of state attended the ceremony for the signing of the sino - argentine agreement on cultural exchanges and cooperation in the sphere of geoscience .

tang jiaxuan pointed out that adhering to the purpose and principles of the " un charter , " promoting the democratization of international relations , safeguarding world peace and stability , and promoting national development and prosperity are the primary missions of the united nations in the new century .
he emphasized that the democratization of international relations requires that we adhere to the principle of equality of national sovereignty as laid down in the charter .
countries may be big or small , rich or poor , and powerful or weak , but they are all equal as members of the international community , no member should suffer discrimination , and the sovereignty of all of them is inviolable .
this is the requirement of the advance of the times ; it is essential for building a fair and just new international political order , and it is also the basis for un conduct and the source of its vitality in the new century .
he stated that the democratization of international relations should also be fully expressed in reforms of the united nations .
the primary task in reform of the security council is to increase the representation of the developing countries .
the 20 th century was a century of unprecedented world economic prosperity , and also the century in which the gap between rich and poor became widest .
the 1990 's was the period when economic globalization advanced most rapidly , and was also a period when the north - south gap continued to grow .
world bank data show that low - income countries , which account for over half the world 's population , have only 6 percent of global income , whereas the developed countries with one - sixth of the world population have 80 percent of total world income .
what is particularly worrying is the fact that the gap between developing and developed countries in the hi - tech field is becoming still wider .
spurring the establishment of a new international economic order of equality , cooperation , and common development , and ensuring that economic globalization benefits the whole world represent an unavoidable major task for the united nations in the new century .
in formulating and amending international economic rules , priority should be given to considering the needs of the developing countries , and this process should help them to speed up their development and reduce their risks in participating in globalization .
the united nations should mobilize all possible resources to spur the international community to narrow the " numbers gulf " and help the developing countries to grasp as soon as possible the science and technology progress opportunities represented by the information revolution .
the " abm treaty " of 1972 is a major cornerstone of global strategic stability .
any action in weakening the integrity and effectiveness of this treaty will have a far - reaching and negative impact on international peace and security .
putting into effect such a scheme can only bring seriously negative consequences for the security of the nations .
the resolution on " upholding and observing the ' abm treaty ' " which was passed by an overwhelming majority at the 54 th un general assembly expressed the strong will of the majority of nations for upholding and strictly observing the " abm treaty . "
the united nations should continue to pay serious concern to the actions of the countries concerned in developing abm systems and undermining global strategic stability , and take the necessary steps to prevent the development of this dangerous trend .
strengthening one 's own security cannot be done at the cost of sacrificing the security of other countries .
seeking unilateral " absolute " security is not only impossible but will also cause still more insecurity .
security can only be achieved through dialogue on the basis of equality and mutual understanding and accomodation . ; security can only be upheld through mutual respect and peaceful coexistence ; and security can only be consolidated through pursuing mutually beneficial cooperation and developing together .
he pointed out : mankind had its fill of the suffering of war in the 20 th century .
large - scale humanitarian disasters must be prevented in the 21 st century , and the tragedy of the slaughter of large numbers of innocent civilians cannot be repeated .
hegemonism and power politics still exist in the world today .
regional conflicts sparked by territorial disputes , ethnic contradictions , and religious controversies are occurring all the time .
we believe that in carrying out intervention , the united nations should work to remove the source of conflict instead of making it last still longer ; and it should promote reconciliation among all parties to the conflict , instead of deepening hostility and confrontation .
tang jiaxuan said in conclusion that peacekeeping actions remain an important means of the united nations in carrying out its responsibility to preserve international peace and security .
it is essential to uphold and strengthen the security council 's responsibility and political leadership for peacekeeping actions , and uphold the purpose and principles of the " un charter . "
it its peacekeeping activities the united nations should persist in seeking truth from facts , act according to its capabilities , and use its limited resources in places where the need is most urgent .

washington , 13 sep ( xinhua ) - - on 13 september , the us senate rejected , by 65 to 32 , the thompson amendment , which was designed to link the granting to china of the permanent normal trade relations with the arms nonproliferation issue .
the amendment , which was rejected , was cosponsored by tennessee republican senator thompson and new jersey democratic senator torricelli .
by linking the china normal trade relations issue with the so - called arms nonproliferation issue , the amendment was designed to obstruct the passage , in the senate , of the bill granting china permanent normal trade relations .
on the same day , the senate rejected six other amendments which were also designed to obstruct the passage of the china trade bill in the senate . they include an amendment attacking china 's family planning policy , which was put forward by senator helms from north carolina .
senator baucus , democrat from montana , said : the china trade bill is one of the most important items on the agenda of us - china relations . the rejection of the thompson amendment has removed a major obstacle to the smooth passage of the bill .
senator biden , democrat from delaware , said : the thompson amendment was a " serious diplomatic blunder . "
the us chamber of commerce and national association of manufacturers issued statements on the same day , welcoming the senate rejection of the thompson amendment .
over 50 agricultural organizations in the us have sent letters to senators this week , urging them not to attach amendments to the china trade bill lest the us lose the china market .
according to reports , the senate will vote on the china trade bill later this week or early next week .

beijing , 14 sep ( xinhua ) - - on 31 july , the beijing municipal no. 1 intermediate people 's court sentenced cheng kejie to death for the crime of taking bribes , deprived him of political rights for life , and confiscated all his personal property .
after hearing the case , the beijing municipal higher people 's court held that the ruling from the first trial established that the facts surrounding cheng kejie 's crime of bribery were clear , the law was correctly applied , the appropriate measurement of penalty was given , and the judicial procedure was conducted according to law .
according to item 1 , article 189 of the " criminal procedural law of the people 's republic of china , " the court rejected cheng kejie 's appeal and upheld the original verdict .
a person who extorts bribes shall be punished severely . "
section 2 , article 383 : " a person who has been involved in corruption many times but has not been dealt with , shall be punished according to the accumulated amount of the graft . "
section 1 , article 57 : " a criminal element who is sentenced to death or life imprisonment shall be deprived of political rights for life . "

at the end of 1993 , the two decided to get married after divorcing their respective spouse . they also decided that , when cheng was still in office , they should accumulate the money they would need after their remarriage .

in the old society , i was called a " male ghost . " i thought my fate was bad . "
raidi said : in old tibet , 5 percent of the main stratum serfs ruled 95 percent of the serfs and slaves , who did not have personal freedom or human rights .
they could only depend on serf owners and were called " tools that could speak . "
after tibet 's peaceful liberation , the million of serfs were emancipated and liberated . they could live a happy and good life only after becoming the masters of society .
legqog , chairman of the tibet autonomous regional people 's government , also responded to taiwan reporters ' request and spoke on his personal life . he said : before tibet 's peaceful liberation in 1951 , the million serfs did not have the chance to attend schools at all .
there were only a few private schools in old tibet , only for the children of three major feudal lords , and less than 2 percent of tibetan children attended schools .
he said : " my childhood was spent in the old society . i was supposed to become a slave at a serf owner 's manor when i was eight years old . luckily it was the time of peaceful liberation , and i could shake off the fate of becoming a slave .
i relied on state funding to attend schools and became a teacher after graduating from middle school . later , with the training given by the cpc , i gradually became a leader . "
through the efforts in nearly 50 years , tibet has now established a fairly comprehensive educational system and village and town health care network .
they said that in tibet today , there are thriving undertakings , growing businesses , economic development , social progress , and ethnic unity .

novosibirsk , 16 sep ( xinhua ) - - siberia in september is full of the dry and crisp air of autumn , and the weather is very pleasant .
on the morning of 16 september , genial sunshine illuminated every corner of novosibirsk city , which borders the ob river .
li peng , chairman of the chinese national people 's congress standing committee , was riding in a car to visit academgorodoka 25 km away from the siberia hotel where he was staying .
dobretsov , president of the siberian branch of the russian academy of sciences , was awaiting the arrival of the guests here . at around 1000 , when chairman li peng got off from the car , dobretsov presented bouquets to li peng and his wife , and shook hands enthusiastically with them .
novosibirsk governor toloconsky and his wife , who had been waiting for a long time , also came forward to greet the distinguished guests from china .
novosibirsk academgorodok is another name for the seat of the siberian branch of the russian academy of sciences , which covers 17,000 hectares .
academgorodok has a beautiful and serene natural setting , with green and luxuriant plants and flowers .
the siberian branch of the academy was built in 1975 . it has nine science centers , 60 research institutes , more than 30,000 staff members , 125 communication academicians , and around 6,500 doctors and doctorands .
the renowned national novosibirsk university in academgorodok , which integrates teaching with scientific research , is a center for cultivating technological talents .
at the meeting hall of academgorodok , dobretsov was pointing at a topographic map on the wall and briefing chairman li peng on the distribution of mineral resources in the siberian area and the responsibilities of the science centers .
he said : i received his excellency jiang zemin , president of your country , at this hall more than a year ago , and today i welcome you , your excellency mr. chairman .
we are very honored that high - ranking leaders of china have visited this place successively . this has indicated clearly that china has strong interest and friendly sentiments toward siberia and academgorodok .
the scientific workers of both sides are engaging in exchanges frequently .
the painstaking work of chinese scientists is embodied in some research achievements here .
he especially emphasized the important significance of strengthening technological cooperation between russia and china on economic development .
after listening to the briefing , chairman li peng said : novosibirsk academgorodok has long enjoyed a good reputation , and is one of the most important science bases in russia .
it has played an important role in exploitation of the resources in siberia and development of space technology and biological engineering .
in receiving the gifts , dobretsov said with deep feeling that these valuable gifts reflect the profound sentiments of friendship of the people and scientific workers in china toward their counterparts in russia .
li peng briefed the host on the current situation and reform progress of the science and technology in china .
he said : the strategy of bringing prosperity to the country through science and education was proposed in china , and the major direction of the reform conducted on the scientific system is to turn scientific research results into productive forces .
dobretsov said china 's experiences in reform of the technological field merit use for reference .
beijing , 16 sep ( xinhua ) - - renmin ribao on 17 september will carry a commentator 's article : " earnestly intensify supervision of cadres . "
we should realize that at present cadre supervision is still a weak link .
comrade jiang zemin pointed out : " party committees should assume overall responsibility in the management of cadres . they should truly manage well such links as discovery , cultivation , selection , appointment , education , and supervision . "
organization departments , which are the functional party - committee departments in charge of cadre - related work , shoulder the important responsibility of cultivating , educating , selecting , and appointing cadres , but also have an extremely important duty in supervising the selection and appointment of leading bodies , leading cadres , and cadres .
the main tasks of organization departments in cadre supervision are first , to strengthen supervision of leading bodies and leading cadres from the perspective of organizational work .
at the same time , they should also intensify supervision of leading cadres who hold key positions in key departments in charge of administration , law enforcement , personnel , and property ; leading cadres in units that perform twofold management ; young leading cadres ; and leaders of major key state - owned enterprises .
second , it is necessary to intensify supervision on the selection and appointment of cadres , and focus on ensuring the implementation of the " provisional regulations on the selection and appointment of party and government leading cadres . "
it is necessary to continue intensifying inspections on the progress of implementing the " regulations , " and supervise party committees at all levels and organizational departments in implementing the " regulations " to the letter .
we must fully rely on the masses in order to do a good job in supervising cadres .
relying on the masses to intensify supervision on the selection and appointment of leading cadres and cadres is an important guarantee for doing a good job in supervising cadres , and is also a concrete manifestation of taking the mass line in cadre supervision .
we should further expand the masses ' rights to be informed , participate in , choose , and supervise work concerning cadres ; actively widen the channel for mass supervision ; build and perfect the mass supervision system ; and fully enhance the masses ' supervisory roles .
to strengthen mass supervision , some localities and departments in recent years have came up with such effective measures and methods as holding regular activities to democratically criticize leading cadres , the system of giving public notices before appointing cadres , and the system of giving advance notices on testing for cadres .
we must combine supervision with education in order to do a good job in cadre supervision .
we should pay attention to using positive and negative examples to educate and warn cadres .
at present , in line with the central authorities ' demands , we should earnestly focus on the admonitory education that uses the representative cases of cheng kejie and hu changqing .
we should earnestly promote innovations in the cadre supervision system , and proceed from adhering to and improving effective rules and regulations to build new systems according to new realities .
party committees at all levels should attach great importance to cadre supervision and strengthening leadership . all relevant departments should cooperate closely , support each other , work and manage things together , and join forces .
at the same time , we should combine the efforts to intensify cadre supervision with the efforts to encourage cadres to boldly explore and create in a pioneering spirit .
we should abide by the requirements of relevant laws and statutes to rigorously standardize the power of leading cadres , but we should also pay attention to protecting and arousing their enthusiasm for work , and fully manifest the party organizations ' trust and concern for the cadres .

the 20 th century is a stage which has witnessed human civilization going through an enormous change and leap to quality from quantity accumulation over several thousand years . in a short period of one hundred years , frequent and radical changes have taken place in every aspect of the social life of mankind .
the study of information warfare has been growing vigorously and is well under way without signs of slackening . the tip of the mast of the sail of knowledge military has emerged on the horizon .
how could an accurate understanding about the numerous and complicated changes and grasp the essence of knowledge warfare be achieved ?
engels clearly pointed out here the three elements of studying concrete war patters , that is , people , weaponry , and establishment of military system .
in knowledge warfare , there will be marked changes to people , weaponry , and establishment of military system .
however , the role of people is played out in various specific forms in terms of different war patterns . war in the agricultural economic era is like " wrestling , " a trial of stamina for soldiers who used cold steel and stabbing weapons , and corresponding to the trial are soldiers of stamina .
knowledge is combat power , a conclusion which has been acknowledged gradually .
in the gulf war which has the nature of a miniature information warfare , the wide gap in possession of knowledge between soldiers of the united states and iraq became one of the decisive elements of victory or defeat of the war .
some data shows that the cultural quality of iraqi officers and men was extremely low , and half of them were actually illiterate , which led to a situation in which a huge amount of high - tech weaponry and equipment lacked scope for its capacities .
no wonder someone described the future high - tech warfare as " being directed by master 's degree holders , commanded by university students , and conducted by experts . "
knowledge - intensive weaponry that embodies the capacity of knowledge innovation of servicemen will lead the development of weaponry system toward the direction of information , intelligence , and integration .
among armament of all kinds , the proportion of electronic and information facilities will be bigger and bigger , and the role of which will become more and more important .
integration of weaponry system means integration of functions and structure of weapons .
troops in knowledge war the development of weaponry system and the enhancement of quality of people under the pattern of knowledge warfare will provide material foundation and intellectual support for the reform of the establishment of military system .
in the industrial era , the commanding system of a military is characterized by a vertical structure in which one level has control over the next . horizontally , there is no connection in the system and shows a structure of a " tree " shape .
once a " trunk " is cut off , the whole system will break down . the facts of war have proved that this kind of " commanding system characterized by a high degree of concentration from top down " is in urgent need of reform .
in adapting to the need of knowledge warfare , it is necessary to transform the commanding system of a vertical and long " tree " shape into a commanding system of flat " net " shape .
the structure of such commanding system has the characteristics of flat appearance , horizontal connection , and vertical and horizontal integration .
a flat appearance requires reduction of commanding levels , shortening of information flow path , and bringing into full play the role of horizontal network , which make sure that as many combat units as possible will be at the same level of information flow .
