many friends in media circles have said excitedly to me : general secretary jiang gave very incisive and brilliant replies to the american journalist 's questions on " press freedom " !
colleagues in media circles have reacted so strongly because there is a lot of controversy in media circles at home and abroad about " press freedom , " and viewpoints differ .
some of them did not understand the situation in china , while others had ulterior motives and took the opportunity to attack the " lack of freedom " in socialist countries .
how should we view the issue that there is no " press freedom " in china ?
china 's press is free , but this freedom must be subordinate to and serve the preservation of state and public interests . "
there is no such thing in the world as absolute abstract " press freedom , " there is only relative specific " press freedom , " and the countries of the west are no exception .
would they allow the existence of press freedom that damages national interests ?
at the same time , we adhere to the guideline advocated by comrade mao zedong of " letting a hundred flowers bloom and a hundred schools of thought content " in propaganda and ideological work .
all this is forceful proof that there is " press freedom " in china .
general secretary jiang said : " china has over 1.2 billion people , and guidance by the press is indeed very important . "
he said when inspecting the renmin ribao office a few years ago : " correct media guidance is happiness for the party and people ; erroneous media guidance is a disaster for the party and people . "
the view that sets " press freedom " against " press guidance , " holding that if one talks of " press freedom " one cannot talk of " press guidance " or that if one talks of " press guidance " then there is no " press freedom , " is wrong .
our news media serve the people and socialism , and must insist on correct media guidance at all times .
if the guidance is wrong , it brings calamity on the state and people , and the lessons of this are profound .
media circles should attach great importance to these problems and take warning from them .
certain western media , however , including some internet reports , always use " press freedom " as a pretext for arbitrary unverified reportage ; some of them report gossip and take the partial for the whole ; some distort the facts and conceal the truth ; and some fabricate stories and start rumors to confuse the public .
when us - led nato wantonly attached the yugoslav federation last year , certain western media carried a great deal of reportage that distorted the facts and did everything possible to defend the aggressive outrages of the hegemonists , thus completely exposing the true features of their " press freedom . "
of course , the great majority of western media workers have a sense of justice and are also friendly toward the chinese people .
china is one of few countries that have nuclear submarines . china also has a conventional submarine force that is the largest in scale in the world .
to ensure the operational safety of submarine units has long been a major work of china 's submarine force .
for this reason , the chinese navy has established a submarine rescue exercise center at the qingdao naval submarine academy . more than 200,000 personnel have received submarine escape training , with a success rate of 100 percent .
moreover , the chinese people 's navy also has a submarine support and rescue fleet of a considerable scale .
china 's submarine support vessels mainly consist of the following types : fully - equipped rescue vessels " dajiang " class submarine rescue vessels - - these are rescue ships with the largest displacement and most equipment among the chinese navy 's submarine rescue vessels .
they are equipped with two sets of high frequency sonar , rescue submarines , escape capsules , deck decompression chambers , air compressor systems , and helium - nitrogen - oxygen systems .
" dajiang " class submarine rescue vessels are also equipped with long - distance communication facilities and helicopter platforms . they can be used as research ships .
since their commissioning , " dajiang " class submarine rescue vessels have participated in major scientific research programs as well as military and rescue operations , including research activities in the antarctica and underwater launch of carrier rockets by submarines .
the " zhifu " salvage vessel can carry out rescue and salvage operation as well as submarine salvage under the conditions of three - meter waves , three - knot ocean currents , and force eight winds . its major operation methods are float salvage , hoisting salvage , towing a vessel in distress , and diving rescue operations .
at present , the " zhifu " salvage vessel has the largest marine rescue capability in china . it shows that china has achieved the world 's level in marine rescue equipment .
they were commissioned in the mid - 1980 s . they are equipped with submarine support equipment and salvage support facilities . they are mainly used for assisting the operation of other submarine rescue vessels and providing technical support for submarines .
large - sized salvage vessels can carry them . they can carry out wet - type rescue operation at a 200 - meter underwater level , with a maximum 600 - meter underwater operation capability .
under the leadership of the party central committee and with the deep concern of the people throughout the country , the shenzhen special economic zone (ssez) has been actively advancing towards a socialist market economy with its reform sails high atop the mast .
we are pleased to see that shenzhen is at the forefront of the whole country in range , progress and overall quality of the reform of its governmental and administrative system . their reform and exploration are an important inspiration for the whole country .
shenzhen 's experience shows that the development of a market economy must be accompanied by reform of the political system that focuses on the system of government .
without this reform , past phenomena , including slack administration , low efficiency , bureaucracy and formalism , could not have been overcome . this would have severely impeded the development of the productive forces .
as comrade deng xiaoping said : " without reform of the political system , we cannot insure fruitfulness and further progress in the reform of the economic system , which will impede the development of the productive forces and hinder the realization of the four modernizations . "
the planned economic system left to government departments at all levels many issues with which they should not be concerned , that they cannot handle well , and that they cannot manage at all .
implementing such measures as reducing administrative examinations and approval , bidding for the right to assign land - use permission and engineering projects , and centralized governmental purchasing will , in terms of system , improve efficiency and curb corruption so that the government only does what it should .
government must administer well what it should and resolutely keep its hands off issues that it should not touch .
shenzhen 's experience also shows that the establishment of a clean and highly efficient government adapted to the operational mechanism of a socialist market economy , instead of being done overnight , requires unswerving efforts over a long period of time .
in the past decades , governments at all levels were based on the planned economy in institutional setup , administrative system and management model .
this system required that the government comprehensively handle , direct and control all economic and social issues , large and small . in this situation , government became a full - function one , doing everything and in charge of everything .
in order to realize these changes , government should undertake revolutionary reform in structure , function , role and position .
changing the function of government and establishing a clean and highly efficient government are both the earnest hope of the people throughout the country and a significant issue to which the party central committee and the state council have been paying great attention .

the tenth five - year plan is china 's first economic and social development blueprint in the 21 st century .
according to authoritative sources in beijing , at this year 's high - level meeting in beidaihe , the tenth five - year plan was one of the major issues in the agenda .
as the economic background for the new plan is totally different from that for the ninth five - year plan , brand - new methods are being used for the formulation of the tenth five - year plan , major breakthroughs will be made in the guiding principles , contents , methods , and forms of the plan .
some experts hold that the tenth five - year plan will have a far - reaching impact on the orientation of china 's economic reforms and development in the next five years or a even longer period .
the next five to ten years will be an important period for china 's economic and social development , and will be of critical importance for china 's development in the new century .
effectively promoting the strategic adjustment of the economic structure , promoting the two fundamental changes , and maintaining the sustained , high - speed , and healthy development of the national economy is the main themes in china 's economic development in the early years of the 21 st century .
jiang zemin 's speech will be the general guideline for the forthcoming tenth five - year plan .
the main tasks for the industrial development during the tenth five - year plan are as follows : first , while developing labor - intensive industries , selectively develop some capital - intensive industries .
second , on the basis of technologically upgrading the manufacturing industries , expand the overall production capacity of the manufacturing industries .
during the tenth five - year plan , the pace of the strategic reorganization of the state - owned economy will be quickened .
while prominence will be given to some key projects and enterprises , the size of the state - owned economy will be cut down in the industry .
the government will gradually relax the policy for changing rural residents to urban residents and the restrictions , thus encouraging the migration of population into cities . the process of solving the existing problem with regard to giving the right of residence to some 70 million people who have moved into various cities will be quickened .
during the tenth five - year plan , the infrastructure facilities will be further strengthened .
properly handling the relationship between structure , quality , efficiency , and growth rate , accomplishing structural upgrading , and making comparatively fast growth on the basis of enhancing quality and improving efficiency will be the basic targets of the tenth five - year plan .
he pointed out : the tenth five - year plan is a plan for promoting a great development of the socialist economy , and also an open plan for enhancing the overall competitive power of the national economy .
this is not only different from the background for the five - year plans between 1953 and 1978 , but also different from the background for the four five - year plans in the 1980 s and 1990 s .
zeng peiyan , minister of the state planning commission , recently said that the strategic adjustment of the economic structure will be a fundamental measure for promoting economic development and social progress in the period of the tenth five - year plan .
reportedly , the main orientation of the structural adjustments in the period of the tenth five - year plan will be as follows : being oriented to the market , relying on scientific and technological progress and technical innovations , promoting the optimization and upgrading of the industrial structure , and striving to expand domestic demand .
reinforcing the status of agriculture as the foundation of the national economy as a whole , develop high - output , high - quality , and high - efficiency farming , bring industrial management and operation style into farming .
integrate the transformation of state - owned enterprises with their reorganization and the improvement of their management , thus forming a batch of highly competitive enterprise groups which do business across different regions , across different trades , across different forms of ownership , and even across different countries .
while guiding intellectual resources to the western region , the chinese government will hire foreign experts focused on the pillar and special industries in the western region . both the central and local governments will offer support and preferences in the form of increased expenditure and subsidies .
with this as the purpose , the project to guide intellectual resources to the western region will be an important component part of china 's development of the western region .
reportedly , more than 80,000 foreign experts come to work in china every year . these experts , who are distributed in various sectors of economic construction , have made outstanding achievements in agriculture , animal husbandry , education , and the petrochemical industry .
the next year will be the first year of china 's tenth five - year plan and a crucial one for china 's development of the western region .
china badly needs large numbers of qualified personnel , specialized in certain fields , who are proficient in management and who also are familiar with international practices .
the chinese government will do its utmost to offer a fine external environment for the international exchange of qualified personnel , will meet international standards in accession of qualified personnel , market regulations , and intermediary services , and take the road suited to its national conditions and also conforming to general international standards .
wan xueyuan disclosed that the state bureau of foreign experts affairs is planning the establishment of an international personnel market in china . following the establishment , foreign expert organizations will have their permanent organs set up in beijing 's zhongguancun , which will attract and hire all kinds of experts for various localities .

hong kong , 18 september (zts) - - the us senate has decided to hold a final vote on the passage of the bill to grant permanent normal trade relations (pntr) status to china on 19 september .
in may , the pntr bill was passed by the house of representatives , and before it is submitted to president clinton for official validity , the bill should be approved by the senate .
however , in order to trade interests with the democratic party and clinton administration on other issues , some republican senators who controlled the senate 's procedural affairs deliberately shelved the pntr bill for two months , with the aim of enabling congress to bargain with the white house , until the resumption of congress after its summer vacation .
as the time of the present congress is limited , it will be entirely impossible for the house of representatives to debate and vote on the bill once again .
the senate voted 69 - 28 to reject the motion of linking the bill with religious freedom .
the second vetoed amendment attaching side conditions to the bill was proposed by senator robert byrd of west virginia . he demanded the us sell the state 's clean energy technology to china so as to increase its economic returns .
however , some senators pointed out : this unilateral demand does not work in reality .
the senate voted 65 - 30 to reject the amendment .
the third vetoed amendment attaching side conditions to the bill was framed up by senator jesse helms of north carolina , who asked the us to continue the annual discussion of the issue of granting china pntr status . in fact , he was simply opposed to the pntr bill .
hence , his amendment was criticized by most senators . the senate voted 81 - 13 to reject the back - tracking bill .
the fourth vetoed amendment attaching side conditions to the bill was co - sponsored by senators fred thompson of tennessee and robert torricelli of new jersey . the amendment demanded the us impose restrictions on china 's military cooperation with other countries so as to prevent the proliferation of china 's nuclear and missile technologies .
hence , numerous obstacles attempting to hinder the passage of the pntr bill have been removed .
what merits attention is that when the senate was dissuading some senators to abandon their amendment trying to link the motion on the name of taiwan in joining the wto , it was possible for the white house to make some concessions in this regard .
in his letter to the senate , clinton expressed his opposition to taiwan 's joining the wto as a separate customs territory of china and his support of taiwan 's joining the wto in the name of " chinese , taipei . "
a spokesman of the chinese ministry of foreign affairs pointed out : the issue of the two sides of the taiwan strait joining the wto should be settled according to the principle set forth in the statement by the chairman of the gatt council in 1992 .
it was explicitly written in the statement that taiwan , penghu , kinmen , and matsu should join the wto in the name of a separate customs territory of china and stipulated that taiwan should join the wto after the mainland .
chinese and american officials reached a " win - win " trade agreement in beijing in november last year .
nevertheless , the agreement could not be put into effect mainly due to reasons from the american side .
when the us house of representatives passed the pntr bill in may , it attached some conditions to it . this way of doings thing was reproached by china .
luckily , most senators treasured the overall interests and vetoed amendments attaching inappropriate conditions to the bill one after another , thus safeguarding the common interest of china and the us .
these views attracted serious attention at home and abroad and were questioned and refuted from all sides .

beijing , 19 sep ( xinhua ) - - according to the calculation of an authoritative department , china 's gdp will reach 8,600 billion yuan in 2000 and , if converted to the us dollar according to the present exchange rate , will exceed $ 1,000 billion .
this shows that china has comprehensively accomplished its second - step strategic plan for the modernization drive . in the five years that will soon be over , china successfully has withstood the assaults of the financial crisis sweeping asia .
its national economy has maintained sustained , rapid , and healthy development ; its overall national strength has risen markedly ; and , in terms of gdp , it has successively crossed two 1,000 - billion - yuan levels in five years .
china 's gdp was 6,600 billion yuan in 1996 , reached 7,300 billion yuan in 1997 , was 7,900 billion yuan in 1998 , topped 8,000 billion yuan to reach 8,200 billion yuan in 1999 , and will reach 8,600 billion yuan this year .
it is estimated that in the ninth five - year plan period , china 's national economy will grow by an average annual rate of more than 8 percent , much higher than the average development level of the world economy , thus substantially narrowing the gap between china and the developed countries .
at present , china 's economic aggregate has leapt to seventh place in the world , and its foreign exchange reserve has reached $ 158 billion .
during the implementation of the ninth five - year plan in the past five years , the chinese national economy has achieved leapfrog development and advanced by leaps and bounds .
among major farm produce , cereal , meat , cotton , peanut , rapeseed , and fruit rank first in the world ; tea , soybean , and sugar cane rank third .
every time when the life of the human society strides towards a new field , hegemonism will also bring war into that field , for example , the field of information today .
it is precisely a misleading concept , and a very dangerous one too , that one should put all his stakes on the development of one field .
the war of high technology is a war designed by western powers themselves .
taking a look at the last two wars during the last decade of this century , we can see that they were both wars of technology , not wars of art .
whether or not an army can gain the upper hand in a war also hinges on its building at peacetime . in view of this , it is a must for us to firmly hold the initiative of the army building in our hands at peacetime , and this is a lesson written in blood .
the reason why the us army is able to win the two wars at the end of this century is that they have successfully held in hand the initiative of the army building at peacetime , and have designed its own pattern of war .
talking about the people 's war in the information era , the role played by the factor of technology has opened up a wider arena for the people 's war .
meanwhile , the information era has also provided the whole people with a means to protect state security , making it possible for the whole people to participate in the war .
in the information era , the people 's war builds up its reserve and deterrent power at peacetime ; and the reserve we are talking about here has a wider implication .
the people 's war in the information era is exactly a process of designing our own war , and is therefore an innovation ; and innovation proves to be the lifeline of an army .
when we talk about man here , we refer to man as a whole , not individuals .
in our fight against formidable enemies under present conditions , although we cannot compare with them technically , we must overpower them in the art of war .
taiwan lacks sufficient innate all - round combat strength .
there are precisely many weak points of insufficient innate combat strength in taiwan , which has no way of enhancing its combat strength . first , taiwan lacks strategic depth .
taiwan covers a small area , it is long and narrow from north to south , has no economic hinterland , and lacks strategic depth .
the central mountain range runs from north to south , splitting taiwan into east and west parts , and troops can only be deployed in the western part , in an area of under 10,000 square km .
this was also one of the main factors making the taiwan authorities content to exercise sovereignty over a part of the country for a long time .
in combat conditions of modern missile technology and long - range aircraft , however , the taiwan strait , with an average width of 200 km , is no longer regarded as a natural barrier in war but an area easily subject to missile attack .
third , taiwan is very difficult to defend .
taiwan is an isolated island with a total coastline of several thousand km , and the area to be defended is quite large and there are many scattered targets ; the whole island can turn into a target for attack of landing , thus increasing the difficulties of the defense .
in particular , given the limited troop strength and armament in taiwan , it is extremely difficult to have all - round defense and to fight in all directions .
fourth , the economic pattern is susceptible to attack .
the main economic centers are concentrated in the western coastal corridor ; in particular , the most important ones are taipei county and city , taoyuan county , and hsinchu science park in the north , and kaohsiung county and city in the south .
the northern and southern parts of taiwan account for 80 percent of gdp , and the eastern part only 1.74 percent .
if taiwan 's economy suffers setbacks , the support capacity for military combat will be affected .
the well - known mainland military writer qiao liang said when interviewed by the taiwan chungkuo shih pao [ zhongguo shibao - - china times ] that there is no way of comparing in simple military terms the strong and weak points of the two sides of the strait .
based on geopolitical reality , there is no comparison in military strength between the two sides , and no matter how many arms taiwan buys , it cannot reverse the fact that taiwan lacks strategic depth .
taiwan is unable to cope with protracted war .
taiwan 's is a typical island - style shallow economy .
the products that taiwan produces can only realize their value and sustain the island 's production activities by being exported in great quantities .
according to an investigation published by the taiwan " economic ministry " in 1999 , 40.8 percent of taiwan 's annual manufactured products worth nearly 7 trillion yuan go for export .
the only industries with domestic sales are the food and drink , printing , petroleum , and cigarette industries .
as a far as output value is concerned , the volume of the electronic and electrical machinery industry ranks first , with annual export volume at 1.54 trillion yuan , representing half of total foreign sales .
taiwan is highly dependent on foreign countries for energy and strategic materials .
taiwan lacks energy and strategic materials ; it depends on imports for primary energy sources such as oil , coal , natural gas , and nuclear energy materials , and its total external dependence for energy is over 95 percent .
in 1998 taiwan itself produced less than 4 percent of its total energy supply , including 0.06 percent of its coal and oil supplies and 0.95 percent of its natural gas supply .
this means that imported energy accounted for over 96 percent of taiwan 's total energy supplies . this shows the high degree of taiwan 's dependence on foreign countries for energy , and taiwan 's economic fragility .
taiwan 's main sources of oil and natural gas are the middle east , southeast asia , australia , and the united states .
apart from energy materials , taiwan depends very heavily on imports of major strategic materials such as grain , iron and steel , and precious metals .
although taiwan has plenty of rice , it depends to a serious degree on exports for miscellaneous grain such as wheat , maize , and soybeans , and at present it imports about 10 million tons of these a year .
the characteristic of high concentration of industry and a relatively single - product economy is likely to suffer blows from global economic and unforeseen events , especially war .
total output value in 1997 of the hi - tech industry , composed of 10 major new science and technology industries , was%50.3 billion , representing 23.9 percent of total output value of manufacturing industry .
the hi - tech industry is mainly concentrated in the north , especially in the hsinchu science park .
this industrial characteristic and pattern is prone to be affected by global economic ups and downs and unexpected events .
the blows caused to the economy by the " big power cut of 29 july " and the " major earthquake of 21 september " in 1999 are conspicuous proofs of this .
through manufacturing its own weapons and purchases from abroad , it can be said that the taiwan military is equipped with a large armament of all types of weapons .
its weaponry , however , is not as strong and advanced as taiwan boast , since there are many hidden hazards and problems , which may become mortal wounds for taiwan in a military conflict in the taiwan strait . first of all , there are evident shortcomings in its weapon strength .
taiwan now has 400,000 men under arms , including 220,000 in the army , which includes 200,000 - - an insufficient number - - for deployment on taiwan island , and several tens of thousands on the three offshore islands of jinmen , mazu , and penghu .
the 200,000 troops on taiwan island need to deployed in all parts of the island , with the result that their force is scattered and their combat capacity is insufficient .
the navy and air force each have less than 70,000 men , only 80 percent of whom are actual combat personnel .
if war breaks out in the strait , these armed forces cannot confront the mainland 's superior force of over 2.7 million men , and still less can they fight protracted war against the mainland of the motherland ; this determines that taiwan will be at a military disadvantage in cross - strait military confrontation .
although taiwan has over 400 combat planes , only 300 of them are truly advanced types , that is , 60 mirage 2000 - 5 , 130 idf , and 150 f - 16 a / b .
the army has 1,800 tanks of various types and over 900 armored vehicles .
this quantity of weapons is obviously insufficient in modern warfare .
there are some 300 combat planes for air combat , and only two - thirds can be in action at any one time .
there are some 30 surface warships for sea combat , and only four submarines which lack a full range of weapon systems ; such a force is obviously insufficient to cope with large - scale warfare and is unable to display effective combat strength .
third , there are also hidden hazards in foreign weaponry .
the " advanced nature " of the so - called advanced weapons that taiwan imports has already been greatly discounted .
otherwise , if they contravene the standards laid down by the americans , they will suffer us interference , and this affects the performance of taiwan artms purchase and import .
with regard to the mirage 2000 - 5 combat planes which france sold to taiwan , the united states did not shrink from serious friction with its french ally and putting pressure on france by demanding that the planes not be equipped with advanced missile attack systems .
fourth , there are difficulties in military logistics and maintenance .
taiwan has a great variety of weaponry produced in various countries and lacks compatible complete sets , so it is difficult to form highly efficient comprehensive combat capability .
such diversification means that it is very difficult to achieve effective compatibility between different branches of the armed forces , between different weapon systems , and within such systems , and this seriously affects combat capability .
there is insufficient military defensive capability .
defense and offense are a pair of contradictions .
hence , no matter how powerful and advanced the defensive systems , they cannot stand undefeated and will eventually be broken .
in conditions of modern electronic jamming , it is worth wondering how strong is taiwan 's capability in early warning and command and control .
the taiwan military has understood this point , and in arguing in favor of chen shuibian 's slogan on " fighting a decisive battle offshore " it holds that the original plan to regard the " chiashan base " as the final screen is no longer appropriate .
if war breaks out , this base will be attacked with missiles , the tunnel entrances will collapse under the attack , and large quantities of weapons will be buried inside , thus losing combat capability .
a missile defense network is not omnipotent .
this traditional antiaircraft defense system cannot confront a vast missile offensive capability .
taiwan 's present antimissile defense capability remains very fragile .
taiwan purchased about 200 patriot - ii missiles from the united states and completed their deployment in 1998 , mainly to defend the greater taipei region in north taiwan .
according to expert analysis , the success rate of this missile is under 20 percent , and it takes at least 10 " patriots " to intercept one missile , costing over $ 6 million .
although they have actual combat experience in intercepting " scud " missiles , it will be rather difficult for them to intercept tactical missiles with separated warheads , and at present they have no combat experience in this respect .
poor overall combat quality of the armed forces .
nearly 20,000 of those drafted in 1998 had criminal records .
since the quality of the troop resources is poor , the problem of crime in the armed forces is on the rise , and soldiers of such quality can hardly display effective combat capability .
the most likely possibility for the outbreak of war in the taiwan strait is a taiwan declaration of independence , which is something that neither the taiwan people nor the armed forces wish to see .
thus , if war breaks out in the taiwan strait on account of " taiwan independence , " it can be predicted that given the military 's thinking of opposition to " taiwan independence , " effective combat capability will be very hard to accomplish .
after the dpp came to power , the mental drift within the armed forces intensified , their morale dropped even further , and many officers asked for early retirement .
all this will further affect the morale and combat capability of the taiwan armed forces .
since the kmt withdrew to taiwan , apart from the relatively large - scale combat of the " 23 august [ 1958 ] bombardment of jinmen , " taiwan 's armed forces have only engaged in small - scale military actions with the mainland and have no other actual combat experience .
the taiwan armed forces with their lack of actual combat experience will be incapable of resisting the mighty people 's liberation army .
information warfare is a new concept , but its contents are not necessarily all new .
future armed forces , and even the entire national defense system , will become increasingly informationized , to form a huge system composed of countless information obtaining and processing nodes and information transmission channels .
once a state of war is declared , information warfare is , actually , in an auxiliary position . information warfare is one of the key factors in future war , but it is not the main method or core activity in confrontation between armed forces .
in future war , all software destruction methods , including electronic warfare and computer network warfare , will become increasingly important .
this point manifested itself very clearly during the kosovo war . because the federal republic of yugoslavia adopted a tactic of preserving its air defense system , nato aircraft had no way of thoroughly destroying its system . as a result , nato did not gain air supremacy until the end of the war .
however , improving the armed forces ' informationization and developing their information capability are different from enhancing the armed forces ' ability to carry out information warfare .
in short , it is imperative to understand the importance and huge potential of information warfare in future war and to bring its important role into play , but it is dangerous to blindly exaggerate and misinterpret its role in war .
information warfare is only a part of armed forces buildup and future war , it does not represent the overall aspect .
guangxia ( yinchuan ) enterprise company , ltd. took the lead of all enterprises and invested a huge sum of money in treating the desert , developing a sand - based industry . this has changed the ancient desert into thousands of hectares of oases .
furthermore , if they are mishandled , it is possible that they will not only not bring forth money , but also have an impact on the ecological environment .
as a listed company , guangxia ( yinchuan ) enterprise company naturally pursues economic profits .
the valuable point is , however , that the company accurately located the nexus between economic gain and the ecological environment and has managed both .
we should study and lay down relevant policies and mobilize and guide more social forces to involve themselves in constructing and protecting the ecological environment .
two , priorities should be given to science and technology in the development of western china .
without the support of science and technology , guangxia would not have succeeded .
we often say that the western regions should develop by leaps and bounds .
an important point in developing the rural economy is to cultivate and strengthen leading enterprises through which thousands of scattered farmers are linked to the constantly changing overall market , thus leading farmers to more income and to the development of the rural economy .
if there are more leading companies like guangxia , we will be more powerful and more fruitful in organizing and involving research academies or institutes and farmers in development .
guangxia , when developing its sand - oriented industry , employed thousands of farmers , each of whom could earn as much as 5,000 - 6,000 renminbi a year .
with this income , farmers became enthusiastic .
when concretely implementing this plan , we must solve problems in farmers ' eating , housing , clothing and daily necessities , and resolve their worries for the future .

reform practiced at ningxia 's hydraulic research institute and the forestry research institute has demonstrated the dominant trend where research institutes can enter the market , and the earlier the better .
of course , everything should be based on reality . instead of simply copying , disregarding conditions , and blindly and unscientifically developing deserts , we should learn the spirit of the guangxia company .
the practice of this company shows that western china is a vast area that promises great achievements .
the development of war is a process of inheritance and development . in a sense , the superiority of mechanized war can be applied to information war as well . as a complete form of operation , information war cannot entirely shake off the shadow of mechanized war .
viewing from the essence , both information warfare and firepower are forms of information war .
firepower warfare is an operation devoted to wiping out or destroying the enemy 's effective strength or installations with high - tech firepower in order to attain the purpose of operation .
the major contents of information warfare include real object destruction , electronic warfare , military deception , operation secrecy , and psychological warfare .
viewing from weaponry , the weaponry serving information war also contains the firearms transited from mechanized war , such as aircraft , carriers , submarines , and all sorts of guns and arms .
the antipersonnel effect of these weapons has been used until now and has never been discarded .
without the control of information , there will be no control of the sea and the air .
as the most representative nation , the united states has not only vigorously developed the theory of information warfare but also given prominence to the development of information weaponry .
however , no matter how fast high - tech weapons develop and how advanced and powerful information weapons are , personnel remain the decisive factor for the victory or failure of war , and this is an unchangeable truth .
the development of information weapons is the extension of personnel capability , and this has never weakened the role of personnel factor in war .
on the contrary , the more high and information technologies are applied to weaponry , the higher quality of personnel is required , and the more important the personnel factor is .
it can be said that information war under the future high - tech condition will be a talent war embracing knowledge warfare , strategy warfare , technology warfare , and computer warfare .
high - quality personnel are the most fundamental factor for the victory or failure of information war .
even the us army that owns high - tech weaponry cannot deny this .
for the time being , chinese army 's high - tech weaponry still lags rather behind some developed nations . to win a future war , preparations for military struggle must be focused on training talented military personnel , particularly the versatile command talents who meet the requirements of information war .

beijing , 19 sep ( xinhua ) - - international terrorists have again caused incidents in central asia .
during august several groups of armed elements entered the uzbekistan and kyrgyzstan border regions in a bid to establish a base in the southern uzbek mountains directed at the uzbek regime , and at the same time to open up a route for the transport of narcotics and arms .
causes of terrorism in central asia the emergence of international terrorism in central asia is directly linked to local religious extremist forces and cross - border smuggling gangs .
a number of religious extremists fled abroad , where they continued to engage in antigovernment activities .
they set up bases inside and outside these countries , trained armed men , and engaged in narcotics and arms smuggling and terrorist activities .
the 1991 civil war in tajikistan was directly linked to extremist religious forces , and such forces were heavily involved in the subsequent antigovernment activities in tajikistan and uzbekistan .
there were several explosions , hostage taking , assassinations , and other terrorist incidents in uzbekistan and kazakhstan .
the instability in tajikistan made it possible for international narcotic smuggling organizations to ship narcotics from afghanistan into central asia via tajikistan , and thence to russia and europe .
according to reports , every year nearly 100 tons [ as received ] of narcotics are shipped from afghanistan to the russian and european markets via central asia .
apart from that , there is no end to the smuggling of arms and military technology despite repeated prohibitions .
the long war in afghanistan has provided a site for islamic extremist terrorist organizations from west asia and elsewhere to make trouble .
hence , the afghan civil war and the partial instability in central asian countries are the main causes of the rampant terrorism .
after the breakup of the soviet union , these zones of instability started to expand to neighboring post - soviet spaces , and new regions of instability started to form in certain " border " areas of the former soviet union .
there is a serious degree of official corruption , inequalities such as the polarization of rich and poor have intensified , and there is a lot of dissatisfaction in society .
there are also serious ecological problems in central asia .
regional conflicts are another problem threatening security in central asia .
after civil war broke out in tajikistan in 1992 , internal turmoil and struggles between various political forces became ever sharper .
afghanistan , however , has been embroiled in war for the past 20 years , and the flames of this war have already reached the border of tajikistan .
at one time the majority of these countries attached extreme importance to security cooperation with the united states and nato , and distanced themselves from russia .
russia and the central asian countries swiftly got together after terrorist incursions caused a deterioration of the situation in southern kyrgyzstan in august 1999 .
in september and december , russia and uzbekistan reached a series of agreements in important fields ; in october , russia undertook to help kyrgyzstan to ensure its national security ; and from october 1999 to april 2000 russia , uzbekistan , tajikistan , kazakhstan , and kyrgyzstan held three joint military exercises .
th central asian states ' hopes to strengthen cooperation with russia are based on economic and security considerations .
the third summit in almaty in july 1998 and the fourth in bishkek in august 1999 both reached this consensus : resolutely oppose ethnic separatism and religious extremism , and make joint efforts to crack down on international terrorism , narcotics smuggling , and other cross - border criminal activities .
we must realize , however , that there are very many factors for instability , covering a very large scope , within the five countries of central asia , and in these circumstances , any slight error can cause consequences affecting the entire situation .

beijing , 19 sep (zxs) - - this morning , some special social law - execution supervisors went for the first time to beijing municipal prison no. 2 , where most inmates are serving a life sentence or awaiting execution , to supervise the open review devoted to recommending commutation and parole for inmates .
according to stipulations , when a prisoner or his relative disagrees with the decision of the review committee , he shall lodge an appeal within 10 days .
currently , the beijing municipal prison administration has already established a strict open review system . that is : giving a mark to inmates ' performances every day , giving awards to them regularly according to their marks , giving commutation and parole according to their awards , and openly reviewing the commutation and parole cases at three levels .
it was claimed that the method of mutual supervision at various levels made the commutation and parole work more transparent and fair , encouraged prisoners to mend their ways , and prevented prison administrators from committing corruption .
consequently , the " veil of mystery of the prison " has been lifted gradually .

washington , 19 sep ( xinhua ) - - the us senate on the afternoon of 19 september us eastern time passed a bill on permanent normal trade relations (pntr) with china by an overwhelming vote of 83 - 15 after a heated debate .
once signed by president bill clinton , the bill will become law .
on the other hand , however , the senate legislation kept the contents of the house bill that harm china 's interest and interferes in china 's internal affairs .
in this connection , the chinese government has expressed the chinese side 's solemn and just stand of resolute opposition to the us government .
on september 5 , the senate began comprehensive debates on the bill and voting on the relevant amendments .
during the debates , most senators held that granting pntr status to china conforms to the economic and security interests of the united states and is conducive to promoting the normal development of us - china relations .
a few senators , however , in order to block the bill from passage , proposed more than 20 amendments trying to link trade with china with issues unrelated to trade .
after repeated votes , the senate overwhelmingly rejected these amendments .
when china and the united states established diplomatic ties in 1979 , they signed an agreement on bilateral trade relations , which would grant mfn treatment to each other .
this discriminatory practice on the part of the us side has long constituted an impediment to the healthy and steady development of the economic and trade relations between the two countries .
the chinese side has always opposed this unilateral annual review and called for an early solution to the issue of mfn treatment .
hu chusheng stressed that the world trade organization requires all its members to observe the principle of non - discrimination and grant unconditional most - favored - nation (mfn) treatment to each other .
the permanent resolution of mfn status has long been desired by the people .
people of insight in the us have for many years made active and unremitting efforts to achieve such an objective at an early date , to which we want to express appreciation .

viewing from the current situation , except funds , the other three conditions are not available .
first , the technology is unripe .
the development of the nmd system was started in 1993 . although some progress has been made , there is still a considerably wide gap between the current ripeness of technology and the level of deployment .
three tests have been conducted since the development of the nmd system .
the first test was conducted in october 1999 , which appeared to be successful , but its success was achieved by taken " technological measures " ; its combat environment was man - made , and the intercepting speed was relatively lowered .
both the second and third tests ended in failure .
this shows that the united states ' missile - intercepting technology is not so magic as it has advertised or as people have imagined .
second , the allegation of threat is sheer fiction .
the united states ' development of the nmd system is aimed , as it has declared , to cope with the threat of " rogue countries . "
therefore , only by developing a missile defense system will it be possible for the united states to cope with such a threat .
since the end of the cold war , russia has been beset with economic difficulties ; the balance of strategic weapons between russia and the united states now tilts to the latter .
if it has to be said that there is a threat , it is the united states ' threat to russia .
now let us take a look at china .
china is a country with nuclear weapons and is developing missile technology .
but there is no comparison between china 's strategic weapons and russia 's and the united states ' strategic weapons , especially the latter 's ones .
more important , china has always developed armament on the principle of self - defense .
with its assumptions based on the ranges of missiles , the report regarded russia and china as threats , harping on the same old tune of the cold war .
as for the so - called " threat " imposed by north korea , iran , iraq , and other countries , that is only a pretext the united states has taken pains to find in recent years .
in playing up the threat , the united states has been finding a pretext and preparing public opinion for its development of the nmd system ; essentially , it has been seeking offensive and defensive strategic superiority and trying to achieve the purpose of dominating the world .
the day before the third test of the nmd system in july , 50 american nobel - laureate scientists submitted a joint letter to clinton , trying their best to urge him to immediately stop the nmd testing and not to decide on the deployment of the system during his term of office .
the voice of opposition is ever stronger in the international community .
russia clearly pointed out that exactly like the star - war program during the cold war , the nmd system will pose a serious threat to russian national security and undermine the peace and stability of the asia - pacific region and even of the world .
on the issue of the nmd system , even the united states ' european allies have also challenged it with opposing views .
the leaders of germany and france clearly expressed their opposition to the united states ' development of the nmd system , and even britain did not indicate its support for the nmd system .
influence : positive influence is limited , but negative influence is hard to estimate the u.s. decision to postpone the deployment of the nmd system has been well received by the international community .
russian president issued a statement pointing out : the u.s. decision to postpone the deployment of the nmd system is a well - considered and responsible action , which will be conducive to strengthening strategic stability in the world and enhancing the prestige of the united states in the international community .
it is hoped that the u.s. government will contact and discuss this issue more with other countries in order to further make a decision in the fundamental interests of various countries and their people in the world .
the international community welcomes the u.s. decision to postpone the deployment of the nmd system because this may have positive significance to some extent and will produce a positive influence on relaxing international tensions and a new arms race caused by the nmd system .
all peace - loving people in the world are hoping for a change in this situation .
it is hoped that the united states ' such a decision will play a role in cooling the increasingly hot nuclear arms race .
however , the positive influence produced by the u.s. decision to postpone the deployment of the nmd system should not be overestimated .
this is because clinton announced that the nmd system would not be deployed for the time being , not forever .
it is now the crucial moment for the u.s. presidential election , and the two opposite camps have put political colorings on the nmd system .
although the democratic presidential candidate consented to clinton 's decision , gore would want to develop the nmd system " in a limited way " when elected .

as long as continued efforts are made , the success rate of nmd testing will be continuously improved ; then , by 2005 the nmd system will be able to be deployed as scheduled .

during the period of the " ninth 5 - year " plan , the average yearly gnp growth rate has exceeded 8 percent , the gdp for 2000 will reach 8.6 trillion yuan , and the total economic volume has jumped from no. 9 to no. 7 in the world .
the position of the agricultural base continues to be strengthened , the overall production capacity of grain is stabilized at around 0.5 billion tons so a bumper harvest year has a surplus and lean year is balanced .
industry maintains a rapid growth rate and is expected to attain an average growth rate of over 11 percent .
the outputs of major industrial products are among the front row in the world , of which major products like coal , steel , chemical fibers , digital stored program control exchangers , and others rank no. 1 in the world .
the state 's foreign exchange reserve exceeds $ 150 billion , ranking no. 2 in the world .
the national defense construction has attained new achievements and the strength of national defense has been further enhanced .
the gdp increased by 8.2 percent over the previous period , social demands have increased in an all - round way , imports and exports have grown by a big margin , and economic operation is getting into the track of a benign cycle .
the effective supply level has noticeably increased and the state of commodity shortage has basically ended .
the readjustment of economic structure has attained initial results .
the market relations between supply and demand have effected a historical change from a sellers ' market to a buyers ' market .
the per capita consumption of protein food for urban and rural residents has surpassed the average world level .
in 1999 , the per capital consumption of meat , eggs , and aquatic products respectively reached 47.3 kg , 17 kg , and 32.7 kg .
high - tech industries are rapidly developing and have become new points of economic growth .
especially , the communication industry is drastically and rapidly developing . the users of fixed telephones and mobile telephones will respectively reach 140 million and 73 million , an increase of 100 million and 69 million respectively over the end of the " eighth 5 - year " plan .
the quality and effectiveness of economic growth has also constantly improved . the society - wide labor productivity and the energy consumption and saving rate per 10,000 yuan output have all surpassed their planned targets .
the scale of railway construction has also reached the highest level in history . the jingjiu , nankun , hanji , and xikang railway lines as well as the baocheng , xinhe , and zhuliu second railway lines have laid tracks or been put into use . the operational mileage of these new railways have reached 6,000 km .
a large number of urban infrastructure construction projects like the no. 2 shanghai underground line , the second no. 8 beijing underground line , the no. 1 guangzhou railway line , and water supply projects like diverting the water of songhuajiang river into changchun have been built and put into use .
generally speaking , the livelihood of the people has attained a moderately high standard of living and the problem of adequate food and clothing for the poverty - stricken population in the rural areas has been basically revolved .
in 1999 , the per capita disposable income of residents living in cities and towns and the per capita net income of peasants respectively reached 5,854 yuan and 2,210 yuan , an increase of 1,571 yuan and 632 yuan over 1995 , with the actual yearly growth rates being 5.6 percent and 5.4 percent .
the consumption structure of residents has noticeably improved and the living quality has further enhanced .

in 1979 , china and the united states signed a sino - us trade relationship agreement that gave mfn status to each other . this is a mutually beneficial trade arrangement under which both sides , on the basis of equality , will not levy discriminatory tariff on each other 's export products .
over the past 20 years , the sino - us relationship has made rapid development .
according to chinese customs statistics , in 1979 bilateral trade was only $ 2.4 billion , which sharply increased to $ 65.1 billion last year , up 25 times in the past 20 years .
now , the united states is china 's second largest trading partner and china is the fourth largest trading partner of the united states .
according to an authoritative department 's projection , by 2010 , china 's commodity and service imports alone will top $ 3 trillion .
china 's development will provide an even bigger market and greater economic and trade cooperation opportunities to various countries in the world , including the united states .
the united states ' solving the issue of permanent normal trade relations for china has created a long - term and stable environment for sino - us economic cooperation .

the premise for upholding and consolidating the guiding position of marxism is the correct understanding of marxism .
marxism is an irrefutable truth marxism is a scientific theory .
the materialist concept of history , which shows the dialectical relationships between productive forces and relations of production and between the economic base and superstructure , regards the development of human society as a natural process of history .
it thus reveals the general law of the development of human society , and , so far , it is the only scientific concept of history .
in many other fields such as sociology , politics , history , literature and art , military science , and ethics , marx and engels also made unique contributions .
in the several - thousand - year history of human culture , there have been numerous theories , affecting in one way or another the process of historical development . however , no other theories than marxism have produced such a tremendous and far - reaching effect on human historical development .
under the influence of the " october revolution , " a number of socialist countries were founded one after another . all this shattered the situation of capitalism dominating the world and opened a broad avenue for mankind to march toward communist society .
in russia , lenin integrated the general principle of marxism with the reality in russia and thus created leninism , which elevated marxism to a new stage .
in china , the chinese communists , represented by mao zedong and deng xiaoping , combined marxism with the concrete situation of this country and brought about two great historic leaps of marxism , opening a new vista for this theory .
in other countries and regions in the world , quite a number of communists have likewise applied and developed marxism without cease in their own ways and based on their respective national conditions .
this is a basic manifestation of the inexhaustible vitality of marxism .
marxism displays enormous vitality in china 's practice china 's modern and contemporary history has proved that only marxism can guide the chinese people to win great victories in revolution and construction .
marxism has enabled the chinese people to stand up .
it was not until the " may 4 th movement " period , when advanced chinese intellectuals with li dazhao and others as representatives selected marxism and when the chinese communist party was founded under their guidance and used marxism to reassess china 's destiny , that the chinese revolution put on a new look .
thereafter , based on the marxist theory , our party proceeded step by step to establish and improve the political , economic , and cultural systems of china 's socialist society .
the name marx came to china in 1899 .
counted from that time , it has been a mere 100 years since marxism came to china .
if we count from 1921 when the chinese communist party was founded , it has been less than 80 years since marxism became a guiding thought for china 's revolution and construction .
setbacks and mistakes in socialist practice cannot mar the brilliancy of marxism marxism represents the truth . it has great vitality .
in the late 1980 's and early 1990 's , drastic changes took place in eastern europe , the soviet union disintegrated , and the socialist movement in the world was at a low ebb .
the reasons for the drastic changes in eastern europe were complicated , and summing up the experiences of those changes and drawing lessons from them are still an important task lying before us .
the victory of russia 's october revolution and the brilliant success of the soviet union 's socialist construction were results obtained under the guidance of marxism .
in the soviet union , the socialist system showed its immense superiority .
one important reason was the dogmatization of marxism .
marx and engels pointed out the inevitable trend of socialism replacing capitalism and the basic principle of socialism in the future . for historical reasons , however , they did not and could not give a detailed description of future socialism .
they stressed time and again : " our theory is not dogmatic . " the practical application of the basic marxist principle " can change at any time and in any place , depending on the prevailing historical conditions . "
lenin 's innovative application of the basic marxist principle to russia 's reality resulted in the victory of the " october revolution . "
after the victory of that revolution , lenin made several adjustments of the economic system and finally implemented a " new economic policy , " which brought about initial success in socialist construction .
this system played a positive role at one time , but because people were subject to dogmatism and their minds were ossified and because no prompt reform was carried out to suit the changed situation , the system gradually lost its vitality and became a fetter for socialist enthusiasm as well as an obstacle to the development of socialism .
although later soviet leaders tried to reform the system , their reform went to the other extreme , that is , they departed from the basic marxist principle and gave up the guiding role of marxism .
under the guidance of marxism , china has made great achievements in socialist construction .
nevertheless , the greatness of our party lies in that it is good at summing up experience , both positive and negative , from international and domestic practices and drawing lessons therefrom .
we must gear up the learning and study of marxism and reinforce our belief in this theory it is quite important to reinforce our belief in marxism and enhance our learning and study of this theory .
just as comrade jiang zemin put it , " without seriously learning and studying the marxist theory , we will lose our bearings in the complicated situation . we will be unable to distinguish between right and wrong , become ideologically unarmed , and make very big mistakes . "
we must study marxism so as to understand it correctly .
marxism , leninism , mao zedong thought , and deng xiaoping theory are in the same vein . they form an integrated scientific system with very rich contents .
we must justly and forcefully uphold and publicize marxism .
for some 150 years , marxism has all along represented the direction of development of human society .
we must guide people to see marxism in a comprehensive way from a dialectical - and historical - materialism viewpoint and a dialectical - ideology perspective .
this is a cardinal issue concerning the development of marxism in china in the 21 st century as well as the future and destiny of the chinese nation .
examples are further adjusting and improving the ownership structure , deepening the reform of state - owned enterprises , improving the distribution system and methods of distribution , building and improving the social security system , perfecting the democratic supervisory system , and ensuring social stability and unity . all these are questions we should seriously study and resolve .
meanwhile , the current international situation remains relatively complicated . while peace and development are the main themes at present , hegemonism and power politics still exist . the unfair and unreasonable international economic order is still playing its role , and the wealth gap between developing and developed countries keeps widening .
all these problems concern not only the question of how human society will develop , but also the course we should take to seize opportunities , meet challenges , and develop ourselves .
only by scientifically analyzing the international and domestic issues from the marxist viewpoint , can we ceaselessly promote the progress of mankind and the development of china 's socialist modernization cause .
divorced from practice , marxism will lose its vitality .
in the final analysis , the scientific spirit of marxism is seeking truth from facts and acting in accordance with the objective law , while its values are oriented toward serving the people wholeheartedly .

whether one is speaking of china or of the economic history of the world , this kind of achievement in economic growth can be termed miraculous .

the accomplishment of the " 9 th five - year " plan shows that we are ushering a more open china into the 21 st century .

in looking back over the past five years , everyone is struck by the fact that , in the late 1990 s , the domestic and foreign environments faced by reforms and opening up in china and the drive to modernization were the most complex they had been since the beginning of reforms and opening up .
looking back over the past five years , people are also struck by the fact that , during this time , our party , our nation , and our people have withstood one challenge and test after another , overcoming difficulties and dangers one after another .

since 1998 , the adoption of a series of macro - regulatory policies such as issuing government bonds , lowering interest rates , adjusting distribution , encouraging consumption , and boosting exports , etc. , has shown clear results , laying an excellent foundation for having an accurate grasp of the economic situation and achieving an economic takeoff .

a reporter asked why protestantism and catholicism were called " foreign religions . "
han wenzao answered : the reason that protestantism and catholicism were called " foreign religions " in the old china was not that they were religions from foreign countries , but because they were used by the imperialists .
first , the introduction of both the protestantism and catholicism to china had to do with the power politics of various western powers , and the two religions were able to survive by relying on the influence of power politics .
in the modern history of china , the signing of many unequal treaties involves direct participation by western protestant missionaries , and the occurrence of many religion - related criminal cases is closely related to the western catholic missionaries .
second , after the introduction of the christianity and catholicism to china , the missionary work was controlled by foreign protestant missionary societies and foreign catholic study societies .
is n't it true that these two alone would render catholicism and protestantism full of foreign flavor ?

recently we summed up the experiences over the past 50 years and came to a clearer understanding that only the " three - self " is the correct direction and principle for running the protestant churches .
we must adhere to the direction of the " three - self , " so as to resist the plot of the antagonistic forces to " westernize " and " split " china by using christianity .
under the guidance of the three - self principles , we must strengthen the construction of ourselves ; in particular , we need to make great efforts in the aspect of building theological thinking , so as to lead believers to truly adapt to the socialist society in their thinking .
such a movement will be continued in the future . "

in its brief statement , the european central bank said that it had initiated the action , and that the joint action taken by europe , the united states , and japan had proceeded from their " common anxiety about the latent impacts of the recent changes in the euro 's exchange rates on the world economy . "
it has been reported that apart from the european central bank , the us federal reserve board , and the japanese central bank , the central banks of britain , canada , germany , france , and italy also took part in the action of joint intervention .
although the western countries did not disclose the amount of foreign exchange involved in the joint effort to support euro , germany 's commerzbank inferred that it was a " considerable amount " .
as a result of the support , the exchange rate of euro picked up vigorously , and once rose from 1 euro against 0.85 us dollar on the previous trading day to over 0.90 us dollar .
however , if we make a careful analysis on the actual conditions of the euro and the present circumstances of europe , the united states , and japan , people will find that this joint action is absolutely necessary .
first , the euro exchange rate has been seriously distorted , so it called for the action of market intervention to correct it .
mussa , chief economist of imf , pointed out recently that owing to the difference in economic development between europe and the united states as well as the structural problems existing in the european economy , it is still understandable that the exchange rate of euro against us dollar fell from 1:1 . 16 to 1:1 .
economists maintain that to intervene in the foreign exchange markets , the following two conditions are necessary : 1 ) joint action taken by the western countries ; and 2 ) the currency to be supported must have appropriate economic strength .
second , the joint intervention action conforms to the interests of all parties .
so far as europe is concerned , although a weak euro is beneficial to exports , yet it will give rise to the danger of inflation .
however , there is very limited room for raising the interest rate now , as continued increase of interest rate may produce the side effect of checking economic growth .
as the day is approaching for denmark 's referendum to decide whether or not it should join the euro area , the euro - area countries also intended to give support to the danish " pro - euro faction " through the intervention action in order to lessen the negative impacts brought by the sliding euro .
according to the public opinion in europe , the us government had no intention of changing the situation of a strong dollar on the eve of general election , because the firmness of us dollar will create a favorable condition for the further economic growth in the united states .
based on its analysis , the reason why the united states agreed to take part in the joint action was that the weak euro had harmed us corporations ' profits in europe as their sales volume diminished .
similarly , owing to the " reasons in europe , " intel 's income also fell by a wide margin in the third quarter .
therefore , it is obviously beneficial to the united states that the imbalance of euro against dollar is gradually reversed through coordinated intervention .
however , some people think that in face of the foreign exchange markets in which the volume of transaction amounting to $ 1.5 trillion to $ 2 trillion is reached every day , the trial of various central banks is yet to be seen .
therefore , how much effort that the united states will make in its action to maintain the status of euro is an issue that merits people 's attention .

tokyo , 24 september ( xinhua news agency ) - - from 22 to 24 [ september ] , rok president kim tae - chung paid a three - day visit to japan .
his first visit to japan after taking office as president of the rok was in 1998 , when the main topic of the discussion was how japan should regard its colonial rule in the korean peninsula and apologize for the crime of waging an aggressive war .
in order to push forward the talks on the normalization of diplomatic relations between japan and the dprk , japanese prime minister yoshiro mori intends to hold a summit meeting with kim chong - il , leader of the dprk .
kim tae - chung welcomed the above - mentioned requests made by yoshiro mori and also asked japan to lend its support for the development of the south - north relations on the korean peninsula .
therefore , the rok and japan agreed at the meeting to continue their consultations in the future , so that progress in the rok - dprk relations and that in the japanese - dprk relations can influence each other positively .
hundreds of thousands of rok and dprk natives resident in japan , a legacy of japan 's previous occupation of the korean peninsula , have been fighting for their right to participate in local politics for many years .
kim tae - chung had expressed the strong wish that japan would ratify the " suffrage grant bill , " which would give rok natives resident in japan the right to participate in local politics , before the end of this year .
at this summit meeting , kim tae - chung once again asked yoshiro mori to exercise leadership on this issue and take a decision .
that caused some impediment to yoshiro mori 's decision .
therefore , in response to kim tae - chung 's request , yoshiro mori merely said that he " would make an effort to this end . "
besides , in order to strengthen the cooperation between japan and the rok in the field of information technology , japan and the rok published a " japan - rok information technology proposal . "
the fact that these people were with him on this visit indicates that kim tae - chung wishes to strengthen economic and cultural exchanges with japan .
the rok side is actually very worried about japan , as even a temporary reduction of tariffs would increase its trade deficit .
meanwhile , japan must also consider the issue of concluding free trade agreements with other surrounding countries , so that the japanese - rok relations can play a central role .
however , judging by this japanese - rok summit , japan has no such intentions , at least for the time being .
therefore , the media here are of the opinion that if japan fails to take seriously the problems that stand between japan and the rok , the bilateral relations may , at any time , regress to the state of mutual hostility witnessed a few years ago .
formally , this japanese - rok summit seems to have been a rather smooth event , but at the news conference jointly held by yoshiro mori and kim tae - chung , the unhappy look on kim tae - chung 's face was very obvious .

beijing , 23 sep - - state planning commission chairman zeng peiyan recently said here that our mental , work , and talent preparations for china 's accession to the world trade organization [ wto ] are incomplete .
he pointed out that generally speaking advantages outweigh disadvantages in china 's wto accession , but in the near term , there will be more challenges and blows that opportunities and development ; in particular , the challenges for state enterprises will be even more severe .
zeng peiyan pointed out that , first of all , certain people have conceptual errors ; they lack correct understanding of the seriousness of the commitments to be undertaken after wto entry , holding that china need not necessarily strictly observe its wto accession commitments , since other parties also circumvent the rules and regulations .
our basic attitude toward wto accession is that we must actively take part in drawing up the rules on international trade and investment , uphold china 's proper interests , and make use of the limited transitional period that we have gained to speed up our restructuring and improve the international competitiveness of our industries .
