effective macroeconomic readjustments and control in the period of the ninth five - year plan , reforms , opening up , and the modernization drive in our country were faced with an extremely complicated situation .
china 's economic train ran speedily into the ninth five - year plan .
to guarantee the smooth and stable running of the train in the early stage of the ninth five - year plan , the primary task in macroeconomic readjustment and control was to curtail and hold back the inflation rate , which was too high .
however , in the latter stage of the ninth five - year plan , deflation and insufficient demand became a prominent problem which weakened the momentum of economic growth . at the same time , there were increasing lay - off and unemployment , and enterprises were running below capacity and their business results got worse .
in 1998 , the rarely serious floods occurring in both south and north of our country just added more difficulty to the stern situation .
while the high inflation rate was curbed , a high economic growth rate was maintained . this was rarely seen in the economic development history of the world , but china succeeded in doing this .
through macroeconomic readjustments over several years , in 1996 , the general price level was lowered to 6.1 percent from the all - time high of 21.7 percent in 1994 , while the economic growth rate reached 9.7 percent . the achievement of a high growth rate and a low inflation rate attracted attention from the whole world .
over many years , we were always plagued by inflation and excessive demand . all of a sudden , we were faced with a totally different situation when deflation and insufficient demand appeared , and we almost had no experience in dealing with such a situation .
since 1998 , the state has issued a total of 310 billion yuan of long - term national debts , which correspondingly engendered 320 billion yuan of bank loans , mainly for infrastructure construction .
at the same time , policies and measures were adopted for expanding consumption and increasing exports , thus alleviating the problems caused by insufficient demand and stopping the tendency of deflation and promoting the rebound of economic growth .
in the first half of this year , the economic growth rate in our country reached 8.2 percent , and the whole year 's growth rate is expected to be higher than last year 's .
from curbing inflation to stopping deflation , this was a substantive change in the task for macroeconomic control .
the making of such a change was an important and timely strategic decision made by the party central leading body and the state council according to its correct analysis of the domestic and international situation and development tendencies , with principal contradictions being grasped accurately .
adjusting policies in good time according to the principal contradictions in different periods and at different stages is a primary prerequisite for successful macroeconomic control .
along with the decline in the level of prices , the central bank decided to stop accepting new value - protection savings in april 1996 , and then lowered the interest rates for various savings accounts in may and august . after that , interest rates were lowered seven times up to june 1999 .
in november last year , the state began to levy interest taxes on savings accounts .
all these measures promoting the outflow of savings to the field of consumption . - - - - comprehensively employing various economic levers and forming a joint force in macroeconomic readjustment and control .
while comprehensive macroeconomic readjustment policies and measures were adopted , reforms in various aspects were also advanced with reforms in state - owned enterprises as the central link , and the role of institutional innovations was brought into full play for driving economic growth .
the previous several years marked a period in which most measures for reforming and restructuring state - owned enterprises were adopted .
reforms in the financial and grain circulation systems and the social security system were also advanced positively .
the experience in exercising macroeconomic control in this period was our valuable assets .
no matter how complicated the situation is and how serious the difficulties may be , with the guidance of the party central leadership and the state council , the ship of the chinese economy will certainly sail ahead successfully by cleaving through the waves .

2 ) the eternal principle guiding the external policy of the united states is not the so - called " reputation " but its national interests .
this was evidently proved by the two important stages in the development history of sino - us relations in 1972 and 1979 .
the apprehension about the soviet union swiftly deploying continental nuclear forces and the anxiety for extricating itself from the vietnam war caused the united states to give up its consistent policy toward taiwan and turn to establishing diplomatic relations at liaison office level with china .
in 1969 and 1970 , the us intelligence department discovered that the soviet union respectively deployed 250 and 270 continental missiles in these two years and beginning from 1968 deliberately delayed the process of the strategic arms limitation talks .
meanwhile , in 1970 the domestic anti - vietnam war campaign in the united states was so intense to have become violent movements in university campuses . quoting the words of kissinger , at that time the white house was shrouded in the fear for the next round of anti - war protests and demonstrations .
and an improvement in the us - sino relations would also make moscow improve its relations with the united states . "
during the middle and late 70 s of the 20 th century , the global expansion policy of the soviet union prompted the united states to once again push forward the us - sino relations and abolish the us - taiwan military alliance treaty .
thus , it can be seen that the changes in the us policy towards taiwan should be subordinated to the us global interests .
after the end of the cold war , the us strategy about china based on the us global strategic blueprint required the united states to maintain a " constructive " cooperative relation with china , control the worsening degree of the us - sino relations , and avoid having direct military conflicts with china .
by the end of the 20 th century , while studying a general blueprint for the us foreign policy in the 21 st century , the us strategists and think tanks analyzed the two basic paradoxes or two basic challenges confronting the us diplomacy in safeguarding its global interests at the turn of the century .
therefore , conducting cooperation with major nuclear countries to prevent the proliferation of this kind of weapons and " prevent , deter , and reduce the attacks of nbc weapons against the native land of the united states " was regarded as the most important principle for the life - and - death national interests of the united states .
( the us national interests committee : " the national interests of the united states " , washington , english edition of 1996 , page 4 ) therefore , the us congress granted a special appropriation and started the famous nairn - lugg [ na en lu ge 4780 1869 1687 2706 ] plan . "
the us strategists explicitly put the cooperation with china in the field of " preventing the proliferation of wmd weapons and the nbc weapons and technologies " as a life - and - death interest of the united states in the asian - pacific region .

during the eighth five - year plan period , it was still very difficult for most ordinary city dwellers in china to feel the impact of " information industry " on their own livelihood .
during the ninth five - year plan period , information industry pronouncedly became a new growth point of china 's national economic development , the main body of the high and new technology industry , and the representative of new productive forces .
the total output of the information equipment manufacturing industry ( including software ) increased from 245.7 billion yuan in 1995 to 778.2 billion yuan in 1999 and the aggregate of telecommunication business increased from 98.9 billion yuan in 1995 to 211.3 billion yuan in 1999 .
in 2000 china is no longer a country that can only produce analogue color television sets and has now undergone a comprehensive change from chiefly producing low - grade consumer goods to producing investment products that require the use of high technology .
program - controlled switchboard was a " group breakthrough - making " key product of the it equipment manufacturing industry during the ninth five - year plan period .

in 1998 , of the top 100 electronic enterprises in china , color television set manufacturing enterprises lost their number - one place for the first time .
china has thus become the third country , which is able to develop high - performance computers , following the united states and japan .
a strategic industry that promotes structural readjustments during the ninth five - year plan period , the information industry not only contributed to the national economy and increasingly spurred the development of other industries but also it had become a strategic industry that promoted china 's economic restructuring .
during the ninth five - year plan period , the rate of telephone subscribers across china was 16 percent ; that of telephone subscribers in cities was 29 percent ; and the ratio of telephone subscribers in administrative villages in the country 's total number of administrative villages was 85 percent .
the numbers of fixed and mobile telephone subscribers were expected to be 140 million and 73 million or 100 million and 69 million more than the figures respectively during the eighth five - year plan period .
the number of data and multimedia telecommunication subscribers reached nearly six million .

the application of the internet in china has developed from ordinary web - surfing to the direction of the value - creating internet economy .

" saving oneself while destroying the enemy " is the military objective of warfare .
in a narrow sense , it mainly refers to saving the combat capabilities and will to fight of one 's own side , and one 's combat capabilities and will to fight in turn derive primarily from one 's actual military strength .
mechanized warfare and warfare prior to that were essentially manifested as all - out violence and destruction .
under contemporary high - tech conditions , because of rapid advances in the quality of military technology , we are seeing unprecedented developments in the types of weaponry and the range , precision , lethal power , and destructive force of various weapons , and they are playing an increasingly important role in the outcome of warfare .
because of the systemization , integration , and computerization of weapons , to maximize its effectiveness , no weaponry can do without system support , and overall coordination and information support .
the political , economic , and military areas of the entire state are closely linked , and the wellspring of combat capabilities and the will to fight is the country 's overall strength .
obviously , in high - tech local warfare , a shift is occurring in the implications of the focus of " saving oneself and destroying the enemy . "

balancing relations with east and west since putin took over the kremlin , while carrying out drastic political and economic reforms at home , he has also carried out major readjustments in foreign policy , and drawn up an all - round policy of consolidating the cis and balancing relations with east and west .
according to russia 's new diplomatic thinking , east and west are like two wings of russian diplomacy , and diplomacy can only soar to the heights and freely hover over the international arena if the two wings fly together .
putin 's " two - wing diplomacy " inherits and develops yeltsin 's " double - headed eagle diplomacy . "
russia , however , paid a heavy price for this fond dream .
although the cold war had ended , the west never dropped its vigilance against russia , and its conspiracy to weaken russia did not change in the slightest .
russia did not succeed in fusing into the west , and on the contrary lost its traditional influence in the east , while its own interests and great power image were seriously damaged .
drawing a lesson from bitter experience , yeltsin was forced to readjust his diplomatic strategy and started to practice a " double - headed eagle diplomacy " simultaneously geared to both east and west .
the cis , europe - america , and asia are listed as the three priority development orientations in putin 's new foreign policy .
the series of diplomatic activities launched by putin since taking office have further confirmed this point .
apart from the cis , which has a special position , all of putin 's diplomatic activities in the past nine months have been concentrated in europe - america and asia .
putin 's practice of " two - wing diplomacy " is determined by russia 's practical needs and long - term interests .
second , the tragic experiences of history show that in order to maintain its great power status , russia must practice an independent foreign policy and cannot follow again the disastrous pro - western road .
for russia , carrying out a balanced foreign policy of no confrontation with the west and no alliance with the east can be regarded as the wise choice .
putin 's " two - wing diplomacy " is not only more active and shows greater initiative than yeltsin 's " double - headed eagle diplomacy " ; the conditions for implementing it are also markedly better than for this predecessor .
since putin took office , russia 's economy has gradually rebounded , the political situation has been unprecedentedly stable , diplomatic activities are no longer constrained by internal political struggles , and all factions have basically achieved consensus on practicing a balanced foreign policy .
in order to show his sincerity for improving relations with west europe , putin has unfrozen relations with nato , which had been frozen for a long time , and urged the state duma to ratify start-2 and the comprehensive nuclear test ban treaty .
russia and britain have established a " special relationship " and are preparing to develop this into a " new strategic relationship . "
italian companies look with favor on the italian market and have signed agreements for big investments in russia .
apart from france , west europe has gradually lowered the tone of accusation against russia over the chechen problem .
although time is still needed for russia to comprehensively build relations of trust with west europe , relations between the two sides have emerged from stagnation , and a momentum of positive development has started to appear .
another major achievement of putin 's west european diplomacy is that it has gained the sympathy and understanding of many west european countries over the question of us deployment of national missile defense [ nmd ] .
on the key abm issue , however , the differences between the two countries were hard to reconcile .
it is worth noting that although russia and the united states are mutually opposed on the abm issue , both sides hope to maintain the momentum of cooperation , which was not easily attained , and to do everything possible to avoid sharpening the contradictions and provoking new confrontation .
stepping up and deepening cooperation with the east the shift of putin 's diplomacy from west to east does not mean that there has been a change in russia 's policy of attaching importance to the east .
although the east comes slightly behind the west in priority order , and developing relations with the east is not as pressing as improving relations with the west , there has been no decline of the status of the east in russian foreign policy .
on the contrary , in light of russia 's practical and long - term interests in the east , and the special role of the east in balancing relations with the west , the importance of the eastern factor in russian foreign policy has been further enhanced .
china remains the most important factor in putin 's eastern strategy .
putin 's eastern diplomacy started with china and reaffirmed china 's priority status in russian foreign policy . during putin 's visit to china in july , china and russia reiterated continuing to develop their strategic cooperation partnership and raised this relationship to a new level .
the two sides stressed that they will work together to build a multipolar world and oppose the building of the us nmd system .
building an enduringly stable relationship of friendship and cooperation with china is not only in russia 's vital interest but also helps to expand russian influence in the asia - pacific region .
while developing toes with china , russia attaches great importance to balancing relations with other asian countries , especially india and japan .
compared with russia 's relations with china and india , its relations with japan notable lag behind .
putin , however , seemed more relaxed than japanese prime minister yoshiro mori .
this major result of his visit not only enabled putin to shine at the g-8 summit , but also removed an important pretext for the united states in building the nmd system .
nevertheless , improving relations with the dprk does not mean sacrificing russia 's partnership with the rok .
in order to balance relations with north and south korea , putin will visit the rok by yearend to consolidate friendship and cooperation with the rok .
although putin 's " two - wing diplomacy " has not been evident for long , it has achieved notable results .
russia has not only successfully broken down its isolation in the west and created a good atmosphere for cooperation , but has also further consolidated its position in the east and expanded its influence in asia .
on the basis of preserving its own interests , russia has maintained relative balance between east and west .
in particular , this balance has become still more stable since russia improved its relations with the cis members .
shanghai , 25 sep - - since ancient times , chinese people have always been proud to proclaim that there is only one china .
thus , it is odd that this ironclad truth seems to have become " rusty " of late .
it seems that china 's sovereignty has suddenly became a piece of pie that anyone can share a slice , and that the future of china 's unification and the path for achieving it can be considered as a " stake " with the name of " option . "
in the history of cross - strait relations , the many versions of " two chinas " have never been so heatedly discussed as they are today by those who behave subserviently and slavishly and those who are watch wind directions , doing so in different disguises .
even though the two sides of the strait differ on the definition of one china , this is china 's own business that has nothing to do with the united states in any way .
the compromising framework china and the united states reached in the " shanghai communiqu " in 1972 set the principle of one china .
the position the united states assumed for its intervention was that it was " uncertain which one is china . "
this passage formalistically created the situation where the united states is involved in " two sides of one china . "
the 1979 sino - us " communiqu on the establishment of diplomatic relations " embodied the severance of us - taiwan diplomatic ties , the principle of one china in the united states ' china policy , and the shift of us stand toward the prc .
that was the chinese interpretation of what taiwan scholars called " international version , " namely : there is but one china in the world , the people 's republic of china is the only legitimate government that represents china , and taiwan is an inseparable part of china .
in the " taiwan relations act " the congress later adopted , the us government amended its position and gave in a little , but the position did not exceed the framework that us - taiwan relations must be unofficial .
the " august 17 " communiqu signed in 1982 set limits to the quality and quantity of arms the united states would sell to taiwan .
in the three , the united states indeed left something unsaid on the issue of one china . this has been a trick the uncle sam always plays .
however , in the three , the basic position of china and the united states was one of settling the taiwan issue together in a cooperative manner .
the former included the " second channel " and " intermediate agreement " advocated by some former political figures and scholars ; and the latter could be observed in the plans for " suppressing " china with the backing of absolute military superiority under the " unipolar strategy " concept .
the mainland 's strategic options are : the two sides may discuss specific issues under the current framework of cross - strait ties on the premise that the principle of one china must be acknowledged .
the fact that the dpp did not directly rebuff the national construction party 's proposal of creating a " republic of taiwan " showed that seeking " covert independence " had become the dpp 's main option .
for example , with respect to the principle of one china , the people 's first party [ pfp ] , in its document - - " our basic views toward cross - strait relations " - - it released last august , puts forth the concept that there is cultural , historical , and geographical chinas .
realistically , it also proposed " coexistence between the two sides . " politically , it proposes " self - determination by the inhabitants " of the two sides on grounds that " the republic of china has been in existence " since 1912 .
exchanges in cultural and other spheres between nongovernmental sectors and other organizations have become increasing frequent and unstoppable .
some us political figures have specifically sent the signal to taiwan that they will " firmly support our loyal allies . "
with respect to the integrity and inviolability of national sovereignty , one china is an objective fact and a mandatory need .
the history of china shows that china was strong when it was unified , and weak when it was divided .
the concept of one china is the base for rallying chinese people of all ethnic groups to build a strong and prosperous country .
as long as chinese people on the two sides of the strait work with the spirit for gold medals in the olympic games , we can do away with interference and build a framework governing the relations between the two sides .
the brilliance of the ninth five - year plan was not restricted to the dazzling fruits of economic development , because the triumphant advance of economic reform was just as remarkable .
the spirit of reform ran through the ninth five - year plan .
the establishment of a socialist market economy , which was first put forward at the 14 th national party congress and was eventually included into the national economic plan , became an objective that we unswervingly worked for .
there were all kinds of hard nuts to crack - - the establishment of a modern enterprise system , the establishment of a social security system , the perfection of macro control , and so on .
however , the tasks of development were particularly formidable and the economic environment was unusually complicated during the ninth five - year plan .
we were baffled by successive bouts of inflation and deflation . we were also quite seriously hit by the asian financial crisis .
how did china , a country with so many tasks waiting to be tackled , make its strides forward ?
the modern enterprise system , the market system , the macro control system and the social security system are the four pillars of the socialist market economy .
major progress was made in the reform of state - owned enterprises .
swift progress was made in market development .
the market for capital , labor , technology and other production factors was growing rapidly . the national economy became more marketized and the fundamental role of the market in the distribution of resources was obviously strengthened .
the system of macro control was gradually improved .
the reform of the financial , taxation and banking systems was deepened .
a big stride forward was made in the reform of government institutions . the state council provided a good lead in institutional reform by substantially streamlining its organs and personnel and improving efficiency .
a macro control system that meets the needs of the market economy has taken shape .
a basic old - age pension and unemployment insurance system was established ; overall planning of old - age pensions and insurance at the provincial level was further standardized ; the number of old - age pension dispensing points was increased ; and the reform of the medical insurance system was launched .
the work of " two assurances " continued to be strengthened , and a preliminary system of " three guarantees " for the basic livelihood of the workers of state - owned enterprises , unemployment insurance and minimum subsistence for urban residents was established .
putting stress on dialectics of reform the triumphant advance of reform during the ninth five - year plan did not move on a single front but pressed onward on all fronts as a whole with breakthroughs at selected points .
reform is a great project of social systems engineering .
thanks to these comprehensive and supporting measures of reform , the vitality of state - owned enterprises increased markedly and the target of getting these enterprises out of their plight was basically attained .
the obvious success in the reform of state - owned enterprises also gave impetus to economic recovery and social stability .
the experience of these reforms is immensely valuable .

over a period of time , the topic of monopolies has been heard often and well remembered by people .
in its march toward a market economy , china should have cut back on the practice of monopolies . however , the trick of " enterprise summits , " which is quite popular nowadays is , without exception , a monopoly measure in disguised form .
in june , as if in a competition , manufacturing enterprises of color tvs , color picture tubes , and washing machines engaged in price checking , limited production , or various promotion tricks in different modes and names .
their practices were either disagreed to by state authorities concerned , or miscarried in the process , while some enterprises ran into a situation in which they failed to keep things under control .
during the implementation of planned economy over the past several decades in china , there was no need to formulate an " anti - monopoly law , " which therefore has become a gap in the legal system .
after china decided to implement the market economy system , people have found that the issue of monopolies and anti - monopoly are omnipresent and involved in every production and circulation field . people can no longer find any reasons to ignore the issue .
however , the administrative monopoly formed through implementation of the planned economy of several decades is deep - rooted and has distinct chinese characteristics .
it most cases , it is business monopoly in foreign countries , but it is administrative monopoly in china .
therefore , one after another , relevant people and legal experts have demanded the publication of the anti - monopoly law at an early date .
the chinese government has maintained a prudent attitude on formulating and publishing the anti - monopoly law .
therefore , when formulating the anti - monopoly law , china will formulate a set of feasible and authoritative regulations in accordance with the international norms and by integrating the international norms with the practical situation in china .

seoul , 27 sep ( xinhua ) - - on 25 and 26 september , rok and dprk military and economic representatives respectively met on cheju island and in seoul in the rok for the first talks between defense ministers and the first south - north economic cooperation business meeting .
the rok and dprk held their third ministerial - level meeting on cheju island on 27 september .
the most eye - catching of these talks and contacts was that between rok defense minister cho song - t ' ae and kim il - chol , vice minister of the dprk national defense commission and minister of the people 's armed forces .
this was not only the first meeting of defense ministers since the division of the korean peninsula more than 50 years ago , but also means that rok - dprk relations are gradually developing in all - round fashion following the june summit in pyongyang .
a situation of multichannel engagement has emerged in rok - dprk relations .
armies one million strong confronting each other across the demarcation line represent one of the root causes of the tension on the korean peninsula .
it was precisely in this situation that the first talks between rok and dprk defense ministers have been held .
media comment here says that for the heavily - armed military authorities of the two sides to sit down and talk " is in itself of particular important symbolic significance , " which has " opened a new chapter in south - north military relations . "
rok presidential palace spokesman ( park chun - yok ) said that the successful holding of the defense ministers ' talks and the economic cooperation business meeting has " formed three main shafts of easing tension , achieving economic cooperation , and carrying out personnel exchange . "
the two defense ministers stressed in their talk that they will support in the military aspect the implementation of the " declaration , " which means that the development of south - north relations now has a powerful additional guarantee .
before the talks , however , the dprk side decided that the meeting should be held on cheju island in the rok , in order to " display its sincerity for carrying out the ' declaration . ' "
at the same time , the dprk delegation directly entered the rok at the panmunjon military demarcation line .
this shows that the two sides will respect the existing military demarcation line and armistice agreement , and on this basis will resolve problems of easing military tension .
the dprk and rok have agreed that the second meeting of defense ministers will take place in the dprk in mid - november , thus showing the continuity of military dialogue .
however , the continuity of military dialogue provides the possibility for reaching specific agreements in the future .
people believe that so long as the two sides keep up the dialogue they can continually find points in common and reach new agreements , thus gradually easing the tension on the korean peninsula .

however , once china accedes to the wto , according to its commitment , the protective trade barriers will be incrementally reduced or abolished , the degree of liberalization in relation to trade and service trade will be heightened , and china 's domestic enterprises will be confronted with direct competition with foreign enterprises .
if the tax preferential policies differentiating treatment between domestic and foreign enterprises are not adjusted , china 's enterprises will evidently be thrown into a disadvantageous position in competition so that their difficulty in competition will increase .
therefore , china must incrementally adjust and finally abolish its tax preferential policies differentiating domestic and foreign enterprises after its wto accession , and replace it with a tax preferential policy that treats the domestic and foreign enterprises basically in the same way .
the right time for policy adjustment the adjustment of differentiated tax preferential policies will very probably bring about a decline in direct foreign investment and imports of equipment by foreign - invested enterprises , for which it is necessary to make calculation and mental preparations in advance .
what we need to study and take measures are how to minimize the negative effect ( meaning the cost ) of the possible decline of foreign investment in this policy adjustment .
the adjustment and ultimate abolition of the preferential taxes on import equipment will increase the costs of imports , but the corresponding reduction of tariffs will lighten the tax burdens of the import equipment , thus partially offsetting each other .
however , if we do not express our intention of restoring the collection of taxes on imported equipment while lowering tariffs , it means that we will have to continue this policy after entering the wto .
second , it will be the most appropriate time for china to integrate the income tax of domestic enterprises with that of foreign - invested enterprises when its economic growth is basically stabilized at about 7 percent and the macroeconomic environment is relatively relaxed .
it is better not to make a one - time adjustment to the tax preferential policies toward foreign investors . instead , the adjustment should be carried out step by step and completed in several years , but a clear and definite timetable for the adjustment should be given to the foreign investors .
fourth , when the preferential policy toward foreign investors in terms of income tax is abolished , the introduction of reform regarding the transformation of value - added tax can be considered .
fifth , in the entire course of adjusting the tax preferential policies , the original tax scale should be kept intact as much as possible or even expanded to some extent .

by joining hands in conducting scientific research , we have brought about a series of breakthroughs for military telecommunications technology .
lieutenant general wang zheng , who is known as " pioneer of our army 's telecommunications undertaking , " was not only the initiator of our army 's scientific research in telecommunication electronics but also the founder of our country 's scientific research in telecommunications electronics .
in early 1973 , premier zhou enlai invited wang zheng to xinhua hall [ in zhongnanhai ] and showed him a photo of a satellite ground telecommunications station , which was given by us president richard nixon during his visit to china .
after carefully thinking it over , wang zheng made " a military pledge " to the premier , promising to " have a ground station built within three years . "
shortly afterwards , in accordance with an instruction issued by premier zhou , a leading group for developing a china - made telecommunications satellite and a joint team for tackling technological bottlenecks , comprising scientists from within and without the army , were set up .
after working hard together for nine years , they successfully launched the first china - made static telecommunications satellite on 8 april , 1984 .

after the new china was founded , we again provided telecommunications support with the army playing a pivotal role and by urging the army and the people to join hands in this respect and thus guaranteed our command over operations or major military activities .
by joining hands in training qualified personnel , we have quickened the pace of training qualified military telecommunications personnel .

beijing , 27 sep ( xinhua ) - - this year all localities have seriously implemented the party 's rural guidelines and policies and done a lot of work centering on the focal tasks of increasing peasant incomes and promoting rural stability .
generally speaking , the situation in the rural areas is good .
there are , however , a number of outstanding problems in the rural areas that cannot be neglected .
it is difficult for the peasants to increase income .
in these circumstances , the actual income of peasants in the main grain - producing areas will decline somewhat , and peasants in the disaster areas are facing many difficulties in production and livelihood .
the peasants ' burdens are too heavy .
the problem of heavy burdens on the peasants has not been well resolved , and is still rather serious in some localities .
some grassroots cadres have become seriously divorced from reality and the masses in their work ; they are not good at consulting the masses when doing things , are unable to handle rural contradictions in the new period , and display a simple and crude work style by issuing compulsory orders , arousing discontent among the masses .
the problem of heavy burdens on the peasants has become a major problem directly affecting rural economic development and social stability .
it is essential to adopt effective measures to resolve the problem of excessive burdens on the peasants , cure both the symptoms and the cause , and sort out things in comprehensive fashion .
some of them have been reiterated time and time again , and the key now lies in properly implementing them . 1 .
the retention and overall planning charges [ ti liu tong chou fei ] paid by the peasants this year must not exceed 5 percent of their net incomes last year and must not exceed the budgeted figure for 1997 ; in cases where this has been exceeded , the figure must be resolutely reduced and the peasants reimbursed .
in order to properly lighten the peasants ' burdens , i reiterate and emphasize here the following policies : 1 .
these taxes must be levied in accordance with reality , and we cannot set targets for the peasants and set flat rates of tax according to the number of people and area of land . 2 .
it is prohibited to upgrade set standards for the peasants to contribute money , material , and labor .
it is forbidden to put forward new fees and charges by changing their names . 4 .
it is prohibited to force people to substitute funds for labor . 7 .
it is forbidden to take funds and materials from the peasants by illegal means .
in the coming period we must carry out an all - round stocktaking of middle and primary school fees .
in the future , no more fees can be charged during the period of compulsory education in the rural areas , apart from payment for textbooks and miscellaneous payments laid down by the state in unified fashion .
the central and provincial price and financial departments must work with the education departments to reformulate unified standards of school fees , and the standards set by departments below provincial level must all be abolished .
excessive charges for electricity in the rural areas have always been a problem that has aroused strong reaction among the masses , and we must summon up resolve to settle this problem .
in the course of revamping the rural power grids , it is prohibited to collect various additional charges along the way or to raise funds from the peasants .
sort out the problem of indiscriminate apportionment of newspaper and periodical subscriptions .
at present excessive and indiscriminate demands have been set regarding newspaper and periodical subscriptions in the rural areas , and this has become a heavy burden on the peasants .
localities and departments are forbidden to set targets and tasks and to set apportionments at each level , and they are also forbidden to treat subscriptions to newspapers and periodicals as an aspect of checking up on work .
provinces ( autonomous regions , municipalities ) hit by natural disasters must do a timely job in reducing or waiving agricultural taxes and charges in the disaster areas .
in cases where local revenue is affected due to the reduction or waiver of taxes and charges in disaster areas , the central treasury will provide appropriate subsidies through methods such as diverting expenditures .
the financial departments have decided to work with the agricultural and other departments concerned in carrying out verification after the autumn harvest , and also to firm up the subsidies for the provinces ( autonomous regions , municipalities ) concerned ahead of schedule .
the provincial ( autonomous regional , municipal ) treasuries must also do a good job of diverting expenditure to prefectures ( cities ) and counties ( cities ) that have been hit by serious disasters .
ii .
trial - point work in reforming rural taxes and charges has been carried out relatively smoothly this year , and initial results have been achieved ; the peasants ' burdens have been markedly lightened , cadre - masses relations have been improved , and the masses support the reforms .
we must therefore practice for a long time the guideline of giving more to the peasants and taking less from them .
on the one hand we must assign agricultural development first place in the national economy , readjust the structure of national income distribution , increase investment in agriculture , and ensure that all sectors vigorously support agriculture .
this is beneficial not only for expanding domestic demand and promoting economic development but also for consolidating the worker - peasant alliance and maintaining enduring tranquillity in the country .
the leading cadres at all levels must have a clear understanding on this point .
lightening the peasants ' burdens depends in the final analysis on developing the rural economy and increasing peasant incomes .
in all rural work we must persist in taking economic construction as the focus , seriously implement the party 's rural policies , protect and mobilize the peasant 's production initiative , push forward the strategic restructuring of agriculture and the rural economy , and comprehensively enhance the returns in agriculture and rural economy .
iii . tangibly transform the ideological style of the grassroots cadres . this is the guarantee for lightening the peasants ' burdens .
in doing a good job in rural work , we must rely first on the policies and second on the cadres at all levels .
first , we must unswervingly uphold the party 's mass line .
whatever we are doing in the rural areas , we must safeguard the peasants ' interests and cannot damage them .
the masses will greatly object if the cadres become divorced from them .
this state of affairs must be changed .
we must learn how to deal with the peasants , respect the aspirations of the peasant masses , and respect the peasants ' decisionmaking powers in production operations .
second , we must uphold the ideological line of basing all our actions on reality and seeking truth from facts .
in order to truly lighten the peasant 's burdens , we must correct the guiding ideology in our work .
" first , food , second , construction " is the guideline that we must uphold for a long time to come .
we must be pragmatic in carrying out rural work , and must absolutely not pursue formalism .
certain localities pursue all kinds of actions in raising set targets that are divorced from reality , and pursue so - called " image projects " which exhaust the people and drain the treasury , and the peasants are extremely resentful at this .
of course , the responsibility for these problems does not all lie in the grass roots , since many fund collections , apportionments , and raising of set standards is done under pressure from the upper - level departments .
the government at all levels and the departments concerned must truly change their functions and work style , serve the grass roots , and create a good work environment for the grassroots cadres .
the central and provincial departments must take the lead and play an exemplary role in carrying out the central policy regulations on lightening the peasants ' burdens ; they must absolutely not indiscriminately levy fees and charges on the peasants , thus adding to the burden of the peasants and the grass roots .
third , we must learn how to correctly handle rural contradictions in the new period .
it is necessary to correctly distinguish and handle the different kinds of contradictions .
county ( city ) party committee secretaries and county ( city ) governors and mayors are the number one responsible persons in lightening the peasants ' burdens , and are directly responsible for this work in their localities .
whether or not they can lighten the peasants ' burdens and properly handle various contradictions in the rural areas and maintain stability in rural society should be regarded as an important criterion in examining the cadres .

even though the names of these cults are numerous , bizarre , under different categories , and in different times , their anti - science , anti - mankind , anti - society , and antigovernment nature are the same .
a huge number of facts have fully proven that these cults can be serious threats to national security .
shoko asahara , the notorious leader of aum shinrikyo sect , warned that a destructive " ultimate world war " would surely break out between 1997 and 2001 .
he said that " aum shinrikyo " had already made good preparations for the " ultimate war " and that only by " joining his sect can people be saved , " and only followers of " aum shinrikyo " can survive the war .
in all apparent seriousness , he said that human civilization has experienced at least 81 " cyclical changes " and that " if people slide further downwards they will be facing destruction , a total destruction , that will result in them being completely destroyed in shape and spirit . "
as the spearhead of his attack is aimed directly at the theoretical basis for the founding of our party and country , this is a wanton provocation against the founding of our party and country , and a serious threat to the security of our country and the future of our nation .
within the " aum shinrikyo sect " there is a pyramidal stratified system which was even modeled on the organizational structure of the cabinet of the japanese government .
after luring " falungong " practitioners into his " kingdom , " li hongzhi gradually separated them from the realistic society ideologically , in action , and even organizationally .
in all the provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities of the whole country , he set up 39 main stations , 1,900 tutorial stations , and 28,000 practicing points which once brought over 2.1 million practitioners under his control .
the evil nature of these cults determines their fanatical , cruel , and destructive behavior patterns and also determines that the violent and terrorist activities of cults are more cruel , crazy , and horrible than those general social violent incidents .
this tragic case shocked the whole world .
according to incomplete statistics , in recent years there have been more than 27 cases of collective suicides involving more than 10 cults ' followers in the whole world .
shoko asahara ordered his cult to be equipped with at least 1,000 rifles and 1 million rounds of ammunition , and set up underground ordnance works to manufacture conventional weapons , as well as highly toxic gas like sarin , and biochemical weapons .
cults have also brought great dangers to the people of our country .
desiring to see the world plunged into chaos , li hongzhi frequently stirred up incidents and incited " falungong " practitioners to besiege news units and party and government organs . since 1996 , li hongzhi and his " falungong " cult organization have planned and commanded over 78 incidents of unlawful assembly .
cults financially exploit their followers , unlawfully reap huge profits , disrupt production and financial order , and seriously endanger the security of the national economy [ subhead ] on the matter of unlawfully obtaining money , the objectives of cults are surprisingly identical .
by seizing by force and grinding the faces of the poor , these cult organizations have seriously disrupted normal social production and financial order , and directly threatened the economic security of the country .
to analyze the means of cults to unfairly accumulate wealth , the most commonly used trick is duping and deceiving the masses and luring and forcing followers to " donate " personal property to the sects or seek donations from society through fraud and deception .
among these cults , some are just killing for money . for example , the leader of the " movement for the restoration of the ten commandments of god " in uganda lied to his followers that doomsday was coming and asked them to sell all their properties .
when the followers of this sect had handed over all their property and started collectively burning themselves to death , the sect leader ran away with large sums of money .
another common practice for cults to grab and plunder by artful deceit or by force is selling so - called " miraculous objects " with " the extraordinary capability of sect leaders " or forcing followers to pay high tuition fees and medical fees to savagely rob followers of their money earned by hard toil .
therefore , in just a few years , the amount of money illegally obtained by the " aum shinrikyo sect " through fraud and deception was as much as over 100 billion yen .
they would reinvest their money , which was obtained through fraud and deception , and use legal operations to cover their illegal activities of reaping huge profits , so as to accumulate more and more capital to develop their strength .
the " solar temple " secretly engaged in international arms smuggling and earned hundreds of million of us dollars . with this money they engaged in real estate business under the cover of being investors in europe and canada to conduct dirty and evil " money laundering " activities .
in just two years from 1992 to 1994 , under the signboard of " teaching and curing people " and through running study courses , li hongzhi and his " falungong " organizations earned and collected by unfair means over 3 million yuan .
these large sums of money were often pocketed or wantonly squandered by the cults ' leaders and their stalwarts .
while the " aum shinrikyo sect , " " branch davidians , " and the " people 's temple , " and other cults required their followers to be ascetic monks , the leaders of these sects were living in the world of wine and women , and leading a life of extravagance and depravity .
at present , in the whole world there are about 10,000 cult organizations enlisting more than 100 million followers and bringing great harm to most countries .
with its headquarters in japan , the " aum shinrikyo sect " also has overseas branches in russia , the united states , germany , sri lanka , and so on .
the influence of the " solar temple " is spread over 12 countries in europe and america .
the " church of scientology " also set up branches in 57 countries .
those cult organizations like " falungong " have also set up their branch organizations in many countries and regions .

in the late 1970 s , sino - vietnamese relations once turned tense and worsened .
it was not until november 1991 that the two parties and countries realized normalization of relations after leaders of both china and vietnam pronounced an end to the past and declared the opening up of a future .
after normalization of bilateral relations in 1991 , cooperation and exchanges between china and vietnam in various fields have developed constantly in both depth and scope .
high - ranking leaders of both sides have maintained a frequent exchanges of visits and maintained close contacts .
over the past several years , through the joint efforts of both sides , sino - vietnamese relations have maintained a good momentum of development .

based on the consensus reached by the leaders of the two states , both sides are intensifying talks to strive for an end to negotiations on border demarcation in the beibu gulf by the end of 2000 .

under the condition that the international situation has undergone extensive and profound changes , the strengthening of good neighborly and friendly relations and promotion of comprehensive cooperation between the two sides are of important significance to the peace and development in both china and vietnam , the southeast asian region and the world .

it is essential to strictly observe party discipline and state law and build a solid defense line of party discipline and state law ours is a party with strict organizational discipline ; this is determined by the party 's nature and tasks .
strictly observing and enforcing party discipline is an important guarantee for safeguarding the party 's solidarity and unity , strengthening its cohesion and combat strength , and fulfilling all its tasks .
ours is a socialist country , and ruling the country according to law is the basic principle by which the party leads the people to run the country .
this requires that every party member and cadre must at all times regard party discipline and state law as his norms for action , and succeed in carrying our orders and prohibitions and strictly observing party discipline and state law .

they must take the lead in implementing democratic centralism ; party committees must hold collective discussions to decide on major policy decisions , important appointments and dismissals , arrangements for major projects , and the use of large sums of money .

the party constitution lays down that every party member , however high or low his post , must be assigned to a party branch or group or other designated organization , and accept supervision by the masses inside and outside the party .
there can be no privileged party members who do not take part in party organizational life or accept supervision from the masses inside and outside the party .
leading party - member cadres take part in party organizational life as ordinary party members and accept education , control , and supervision by the party organization .
in stepping up control and supervision of the leading cadres , it is essential to establish and perfect a control and supervisory mechanism , and improve the methods and means of control and supervision .
the party organizations at all levels are responsible for control and supervision of the leading cadres , and they must be bold in supervision and good at control .

selecting and appointing people who are both virtuous and able to leading posts is a matter of great importance .
party committees at all levels must comprehensively implement the four criteria for building the cadre contingent and adhere to the principle of selecting and appointing cadres with both political integrity and work ability , strictly control the quality of cadre appointment , and prevent errors in assessing and selecting candidates .
in addition to laying stress on a cadre 's political position and standpoint , and behavior in abiding by political discipline , we should also examine whether the cadre is honest and incorrupt in performing official duties , and take this as a major criterion for assessing the quality of a cadre .

the responsibilities of all people involved in various links of recommending , examining , deciding personnel appointments should be explicitly stipulated .
thus , when a problem occurs in a certain link , discipline action should be taken against those bearing responsibility strictly according to the regulations .
it is necessary to maintain and improve the system of combining collective leadership with individual responsibilities in the division of work , and further improve the mechanisms for collective leadership .
all major issues must be subject to collective discussion , and must be decided according to the principle of the minority obeying the majority .
while reinforcing collective leadership , we cannot and should not weaken individual responsibilities . individual responsibilities in the division of work form the foundation for collective leadership .
it is necessary to establish and perfect the mechanisms for supervising the behavior of cadres and bringing their powers to check and balance .
the principal party and government leaders hold a critically important position in a leading body and bear much greater responsibilities . once they are not effectively supervised and are free from check and balance , they may easily become special figures free from any control and may gradually degenerate into corrupt officials .
therefore , the key to intensifying supervision over leading cadres lies in intensifying supervision over senior and intermediate - level cadres and especially principal party and government leaders .
the internal supervision and the check - and - balance capacity inside leading bodies must be increased .

the work of auditing leading cadres ' economic responsibilities should be taken as an important link in the efforts to improve party style and maintain clean government , and solid results should be achieved in this regard .
to carry out in - depth anti - corruption struggle , we must follow the mass line .

that is , the action to check corruption by punishing those involved must be momentous and the punishments should be more severe .
second , corruption cases must be handled efficiently and immediately once they are discovered , and no one is allowed to delay the handling of such cases or try to cover up them .
fourth , major and serious cases should be properly handled .
if the cases involve senior cadres or famous people , they must be handled more seriously , because such people have greater influence and their malpractices may be much more harmful .

japan has been china 's largest trading partner for seven consecutive years , and it has been the main source of foreign capital for our country . and china has been japan 's second largest trading partner and a major market for the latter 's exports .
now sino - japanese economic and trade relations have gradually formed a framework of cooperation at multiple levels , in various fields and a variety of forms , with steady development , and complementing each other with their own advantages , and such relations present a favorable situation of continuous development .
sino - japanese trade scale keeps expanding since the start of china 's reform and opening up , sino - japanese trade has developed rapidly , reaching new levels one after another .
china 's total volume of trade with japan was $ 6.909 billion in 1979 , topped $ 10 billion in 1981 , and exceeded $ 60 billion in 1999 .
the continuous expansion of the trade scale has benefited from the constant optimization of the product mix .
now raw materials are no longer exported , which have been replaced by mechanical and electronic products as well as textile and garments with higher added value , accounting for 31.5 percent and 20.6 percent of the country 's total volume of trade with japan .
in china 's export trade , japan is the largest market for our country 's precision instruments , coal , petroleum , inorganic chemicals , meat , aquatic products , vegetables , and grain , and japan carries a big weight in our foreign trade .
the peak of actual investment appeared in 1997 , with $ 4.33 billion .
the fields in which japanese enterprises have invested have also expanded , and they have developed from garments , foodstuffs , and other labor - intensive projects to electronics , machinery , automobiles , building materials , and other technology - and capital - intensive projects .
so , the objectives of investment have greatly changed .
broad prospects for sino - japanese economic and trade cooperation in the new century subject to the influence of change in the domestic and international situation , the steadily developing sino - japanese economic and trade relations are faced with some new problems .
all this requires both sides to further strengthen their cooperation and jointly seek solutions in order to shift sino - japanese economic and trade cooperation from the accumulation of quantities to the improvement of quality .
looking forward to the future , there will be favorable prospects for sino - japanese economic and trade cooperation on the basis of the achievements made .
economically , china and japan are strongly complementary , it is objectively necessary and possible for both sides ' economic and trade cooperation , and there is a tremendous potential in this regard .
japan 's organizations for trade promotion , the japanese - chinese economic association , japanese - chinese organizations for investment promotion , the japanese - chinese economic and trade coordination committee , and other nongovernmental organizations have played an irreplaceable role in promoting the development of bilateral cooperation .
the current political relations between china and japan are good . especially the exchange of high - level visits - - president jiang zemin 's visit to japan in 1998 and prime minister keizo obuchi 's visit to china in 1999 - - have provided an important basis and guarantee for the development of bilateral economic and trade cooperation .
various surveys of investment markets conducted by japan in recent years show that japanese enterprises regard china as their first - choice investment market in the coming three to 10 years .
china 's accession to the wto will bring foreseeable all - round opening of all investment fields , and the large - scale development of the western region will provide opportunities for foreign enterprises to enter china 's market .
the location of such cooperation will shift from coastal areas to the central and western regions .
this will bring a new round of rapid growth in japanese enterprises ' investments in china , which will further expand the scale of sino - japanese trade and result in an all - round development of bilateral economic and trade cooperation .
economic globalization will make more space for bilateral cooperation .
considering from the angle of expanding the trade scale and strengthening international cooperation , both sides may study the possibility of using china 's advantages in resources and manpower and japan 's advanced technology and marketing experiences to jointly exploit markets in third countries and then to develop regional cooperation .

beijing , 29 sep (zxs) - - reviewing the ninth five - year plan in retrospect , the state development planning commission said that during these five years , the total number of people having obtained jobs continued to grow , and the situation of employment was basically stable in china .
in a propaganda material furnished to the media , the state development planning commission talked about the employment issue .
china 's economy was battered by the asian financial crisis during this period . as a result , exports decreased by a big margin , domestic demand was seriously inadequate , and economic growth slowed down , which directly hampered the elevation of employment level .
the unemployment rate for the jobless who have registered as urban residents will be controlled within 3.5 percent , which still remains at a relatively low level .
the number of workers employed by urban private and individual units grew very rapidly to reach 39.4 million at the end of 1999 .
in addition , remarkable achievements have been made in the work of providing basic living expenses to the laid - off staff and workers from the state - owned enterprises and offering new jobs to them .
according to statistics , in the first four years of the ninth five - year plan period , nearly 30 million staff and workers were laid off , among whom the staff and workers laid off from the state - owned enterprises totaled about 23 million .

the term iis in these measures refers to services that provide internet users with information through the internet .
article 3 . iis are divided into commercial and noncommercial iis .
the state adopts the system that obligates commercial iis to be licensed and noncommercial iis to report their services for the record .
no one may provide iis if he has not been licensed , or has not reported its services for the record .
a commercial iss provider shall apply for its operating license from an iss administration of a province , autonomous region , or municipality under the central government 's direct jurisdiction , or from the state council department in charge of information industries , for operating iss value - added telecommunications business ( to be called license below ) .
the telecommunications administration of a province , autonomous region , or municipality under the central government 's direct jurisdiction , or the state council department in charge of information industries , shall complete examining and approving an application within 60 days after receiving the application , and decide whether the application is approved or disapproved .
for a case that is approved , the administration shall issue the applicant with an operating license ; and for a case that is not approved , it shall notify the applicant in writing and explain why his case is not approved .
after an applicant receives the license , he shall , with the license , have the registration formalities processed at authorities that handle business registration .
a noncommercial iss provider shall report its operations for the record at a telecommunications administration of a province , autonomous region , or municipality under the central government 's direct jurisdiction , or at the state council department in charge of information industries .
an iss provider planning to provide e - announcements shall submit a special request , or report its special request for the record , according to relevant state regulations when it applies for a commercial iss license , or when it reports its special request for providing noncommercial iss for the record .
the telecommunications administration of a province , autonomous region , or municipality under the central government 's direct jurisdiction , or the state council department in charge of information industries , shall publicize the names of all the iss providers that have been licensed for operations ; or that have had their reported requests recorded and filed .
a noncommercial iss provider may not provide compensatory services .
article 13 . an iss provider shall provide internet users with good services , and it shall guarantee that its information is legal .
departments in charge of information , publishing business , education , public health , and pharmaceuticals ; departments in charge of business administration ; and departments in charge of national security , shall , acting according to the law , supervise the contents of the internet information in areas under their respective jurisdictions . article 19 .
article 24 . if iss providers violate other laws or regulations when performing their services , the relevant supervisory authorities in charge of information , publishing business , education , public health , and pharmaceuticals , or the business administrations shall penalize them according to the relevant laws and regulations .
article 26 . iss providers that began to operate before these measures are promulgated shall have the necessary formalities processed according to the provision in these measures within 60 days after these measures have been promulgated .

japanese opinion believes that the formulation of the " japan contingencies legislation " will provide a stronger legal basis for implementing the laws relating to the new japanese - us defense cooperation guidelines , including the " peripheral events law. "
they include the following three laws : the " peripheral events law , " the " revised law on the self - defense force , " and the " law on the japanese - us agreement on mutual provision of material and logistical services in goods and labor . "
since the diet has already passed these laws , why does the mori cabinet also want to formulate " japan contingencies legislation ? "
the japanese foreign minister at the time said when defending the laws in the diet that " peripheral events " should include " civil wars and coups in other countries " without explaining which " other countries " these were .
that is to say , so long as japan and the united states view it as a requirement of developments , they can at any time include any place in the asia - pacific region within the scope of defense cooperation .
there is great arbitrariness in the execution of this law , in fact there is no law to follow , and this is prone to arouse controversy and opposition among the government and the public .
people 's concern is aroused over how this question will be explained in the " japan contingencies legislation " formulated by the mori cabinet .
so - called inspection of shipping means that when a conflict breaks out in a peripheral country , in order to enforce an effective sea blockade and impose economic sanctions on the country where the conflict is occurring , japan will help the us military to carry out inspections of suspect vessels on the open sea .
when a compromise was hard to reach , in order to get the laws passed as soon as possible , the japanese government decided to delete from the laws everything about inspecting shipping before the final vote in the lower house , and prepared to draw up other legislation for that issue .
third , the laws relating to the new guidelines are constrained by japan 's existing constitution .
article nine of the japanese constitution states that , aspiring to an international peace based on justice and order , the japanese people forever renounce war as a sovereign right of the nation and the threat or use of force as a means of settling international disputes .
such action , which is regarded as unconstitutional , is opposed by all sectors and the opposition parties in japan , thus causing all kinds of obstacles to the implementation of the laws relating to the new guidelines .
it is by no means accidental that the mori cabinet has decided to formulate the " japan contingencies legislation . "
what the japanese government wants is to further strengthen japanese - us defense cooperation by this move , to provide a basis for japan to use its military force to intervene in international or regional affairs , and proceed to create conditions for achieving its goal of being a political and military power .
there is also another side to the matter , however , since this move will bind japan more firmly to the chariot of us global military strategy ; in addition to narrowing japan 's independent room for diplomatic maneuver , it may involve japan in the danger of the vortex of war .
the perverse action of the mori cabinet will also threaten peace and development in the asia - pacific region , and cannot but arouse the concern and vigilance of all countries in the region .

beijing , 2 oct ( xinhua ) - - what is " canonization ? "
in catholic church , " saints " refer to the deceased persons whose souls ascended to heaven , who are role models of religious believers and have their veneration .
the church has regulations and procedures to follow for " canonization , " or canonizing someone to become a " saint . "
historically , " canonization " was often used to achieve a political purpose , and there were controversies within the church , and between the church and the state , on the deceased persons who would be " canonized , " or on whether or not they met the criteria for " sainthood . "
however , at st. peter 's square of the vatican , a farce was staged , during which some foreign missionaries who had committed ugly and evil crimes in china and their followers were canonized as " saints . "
the vatican 's " canonization " opened up historical scars deep in the hearts of the chinese people .
until now , the locals still express immense hatred when they mentioned these missionaries .
these missionaries were no " saints " whatsoever . instead , they were out - and - out sinners . during the eight - power allied forces ' war of aggression against china , countless numbers of the ordinary chinese people were killed or wounded , families were ruined , and family members dead .
it was a calamity in the history of mankind .
among those who died a premature death were some chinese catholics . they were the victims of the imperialist war of aggression and the preys of colonialist missionary forces . they were no " martyrs of beliefs " whatsoever .
is it indeed " rectifying the name of history " or is it distorting and tampering with history and trying to absolve some missionaries of their crime and responsibility of being accomplices to the imperialist invasion of china ?
how could one who deceives oneself succeed in deceiving others ? trying to cover up a misdeed only makes it more conspicuous .
against the general backdrop of aggressing china by western powers , generally speaking , foreign missionaries served as the instrument of imperialist and colonialist aggression of china .
establishment of missionary work stations and expansion of missionary work areas were closely linked to imperialist plot to carve up china and delimit spheres of influence .
the vatican 's perverse act naturally is opposed by the chinese people and all upright people of the world .
in an attempt to confuse the public , the vatican has time and again said that the purpose of the " canonization " was to " express respect for the chinese people , " a " good - will " act .
the vatican 's " canonization " decision is by no means a simple religious act , but an attempt to serve its practical political purposes by reversing a historical verdict , an act to interfere in china 's internal affairs using a religious issue .
although such repentance is not specific or sufficient and the inflicted countries and nations are not satisfied with it , the vatican has made a gesture after all . what is worthy of attention is that the vatican has not mentioned a word about its numerous crimes against the chinese people in history and has avoided mentioning them .
on the one hand , the vatican said we should not get entangled by the past and should face the future . on the other hand , it tried to reverse historical verdicts through " canonization . "
the vatican has repeatedly said it is willing to improve sino - vatican relations , but has repeatedly set obstacles to improving such relations in action .
the carefully planned " canonization " activities this time can serve as extremely good materials for education by means of negative examples . they have enabled the chinese people to see through the hypocritic mask of the vatican and understand clearly its anti - china political feature .
china is determined to have reunification and make development and this is an irresistible historical trend .
the china today is no longer the china over 100 years ago , which was poor and weak and was bullied by others at will .
in the past decades since then , the chinese catholic church has attained spectacular achievements and has won the understanding and support of the catholic circles of many countries in the world .
under new historical conditions , the chinese catholic church will continue to unswervingly follow the road of independently running the church and create brighter and more beautiful prospects .
beijing , 2 october - - renmin ribao will publish a signed article entitled " exposing the true colors of ' saints ' " on 3 october .
on 1 october , the roman curia canonized as " saints " 120 foreign missionaries and chinese catholics who were said to have been " killed in china . "
who were these so - called " saints " ?
why did the vatican insist on canonizing them as " saints " in spite of strong opposition from the chinese government and the chinese catholic church ?
let us examine the lives of a few typical foreign missionaries among these " saints . "
case 1 : " saint " auguste chapdelaine ( 1814 - 1856 ) known as ma lai to the chinese , chapdelaine was a catholic father from missions de paris .
according to the " treaty of whampoa " forced upon the qing court by the french government , french missionaries were allowed to preach in five designated trading ports not but in inland areas .
in 1852 , ma lai secretly began preaching in inland provinces like hunan and guizhou . in 1855 , he went to xilin county in the remote parts of western guangxi to preach illegally .
there are many accounts of these in the local archives of the guangxi zhuang nationality autonomous region .
ma lai regarded the chinese custom of worshipping one 's ancestors as heresy and ordered his followers to destroy their ancestral tablets at home . he also forbade them to sweep the graves of the deceased and required his followers and their children to marry nobody other than fellow catholics , which led to many family and clan feuds .
in order to expand the influence of his church , ma lai repeatedly went to guizhou , where he forged ties with local bandits on the guizhou - guangxi border through local catholics . he relied on them to expand his influence and control the local gentry and officials .
people in xilin , dingan and other places exposed that ma lai had broken the catholic code of conduct by taking with him a young and beautiful widow by the name of cao in his missionary work .
he held mass for his church followers when they got married , but he often took this opportunity to rape the bride .
infuriated by ma lai 's abominable deeds , the local people brought a lawsuit against him at the county government in 1856 . a newly - appointed magistrate by the name of zhang minfeng acted with justice and sentenced him to death .
this was the famous " xilin religious case , " which was quite well - known in history . the french government used this as an excuse to collaborate with britain in starting the second opium war against china , which brought even greater catastrophe to the chinese people .
case ii : saint albericus crescitelli ( 1863 - 1900 ) he was an italian missionary who was known to the chinese as father guo xide .

communications satellites were born in 1958 .
more than 200 countries and regions have achieved international and domestic telecommunications through using communications satellites , and the earth has become a " global village " ; communications satellites have become the paving stones for entering the age of the information highway .
by depending on weather satellites , mankind can forecast weather for the whole world instead of a few km in each direction , and forecasting has expanded from short - range and ad - hoc forecasts to forecasting medium and medium long - term trends .
the world now has over 100 weather satellites operating in polar and static orbits , and these are faithfully reporting every day on the atmosphere , reducing or guarding against natural disasters , and monitoring the environment .
earth resources satellites were first launched in 1972 .
at present 1,300 departments and systems in over 150 countries are directly " benefiting " from the resource satellites .
apart from that , various national land census satellites , marine satellites , astronomical satellites , and scientific survey and technical experimental satellites are also displaying their abilities in their own fields .
in using space technology , mankind has also carried out surveys from near and far in the vast expanse of space beyond earth and gained new understanding of space phenomena such as electromagnetic radiation , the solar wind , magnetic storms , and the aurora .
it is precisely because space technology has pushed the boundaries of global civilization to the vastness of the universe that no other engineering technology in the world can , like space technology , capture the minds of the millions of the people and their widespread and permanent attention .

china 's satellite navigation technology has had wide applications in many sectors such as geographical surveys , ship and aircraft navigation , and traffic management .
