the 20 th century , which is now coming to an end , has been one that has seen both glories and frustrations , as well as victories and setbacks .
the birth , development , and tortuous development course of the socialist system form the main theme of this century 's history .
this declares to the world that scientific socialism is still keeping its strong vitality .
there is no doubt that it is of important theoretical and practical significance to sum up and study the issue of socialist theory and practice at the turn of the century and upon the arrival of the new millennium .
i. deepening the understanding of socialism through practice there are many factors contributing to the achievements and setbacks , and to high tides and low ebbs in the development of socialism across the world in the 20 th century . one of the key issues is the correct understanding and handling of the universality and particularity of socialism .
whether in terms of theoretical accumulation and development , or in terms of exploratory practice and experience , our understanding of socialism is deeper , richer , and more concrete today than ever before .
correctly understanding the universality and particularity of socialism means , in substance , to clarify the following questions : what is socialism and how to build socialism ?
we were not totally clear about these questions in the past .
in a general sense , first of all , this refers to the natural development trend toward socialism and represents an advanced and totally new form of society which will ultimately replace capitalism in the future .
in other words , each and every country and nation will inevitably take the road of socialism , which is an irresistible objective law .
second , this universality is further expressed as a general principle that must be pursued ; in other words , the stipulated features of the socialist system , or the substantive nature of socialism .
these stipulated features were summarized by writers of marxist classics from different angles , on different occasions , and in different periods .
then , what are the basic characteristics and main principles that reflect the substantive nature of the socialist system ?
both the socialism with chinese characteristics and the socialism that suits vietnam 's national conditions are organic , dialectic integration of universality and particularity of socialism .
as long as this essential requirement is fulfilled , the socialist cause will be full of vitality and will constantly flourish ; whenever this essential requirement is not met , the socialist cause will go off the right track or even meet with setbacks .
back in the early 1960 s , comrade mao zedong pointed out : " during the construction of socialism , we are learning while working .
the basic content of socialism with chinese characteristics while integrating the general principles of marxism with the specific reality of revolution and construction in their country , the chinese communists have succeeded in accomplishing two historical leaps , thus produced corresponding theoretical results .
the theoretical product of the first leap is mao zedong thought , and that of the second leap is the theory on building socialism with chinese characteristics , namely , deng xiaoping theory .
the creation , molding , and establishment of the theory on socialism with chinese characteristics was not an easy task to accomplish .
it is a new attempt in the historical development of marxism to build socialism in an eastern country like china with relatively underdeveloped economy and culture .
focusing his attention on the fundamental issue of " what is socialist and how to build socialism , " comrade deng xiaoping , as the chief architect of china 's reform and opening up , profoundly , brilliantly , and creatively revealed the nature of socialism and enhanced our understanding of socialism to a new level of science .
he upgraded the emancipation and development of productive forces , making it the fundamental and first task of socialism , and classifying it as a part of the essential content of socialism , thus emphasizing the most substantive attribute of socialism - - the necessity of creating a higher labor productivity .
to the final analysis , the key to emancipation of the mind in china in the new era lies in the emancipation of the mind in terms of understanding the nature of socialism .

beijing , 3 oct ( xinhua ) - - comprehensively carrying out organizational reform is a strategic task set forth at the 15 th party congress , an urgent demand for intensifying economic restructuring and promoting economic and social development , and a key component of political reform .
cities , counties , and townships will soon begin to restructure their organizations .
third , according to the requirements of the party central committee and the state council , the changes due to the re - organization of some departments , and the feature of vertical management , departments reformed their leadership system and downsized their subordinate discipline inspection and supervisory organizations .
the government has made a key breakthrough in changing its functions change of government functions is a key link of organizational reform .
through organizational reform starting in 1998 , the government has made a great breakthrough in changing its functions .
thus , the governments at various levels may bring their enthusiasm and creativity into full play .
this time , the state council has re - designated duties for its departments , readjusted more than 100 duties , and resolved a number of long - standing problems due to inharmonious relations between various departments .
great effort has been made to downsize organizations and reduce the staff reorganizing and closing specialized departments directly in charge of the economy and intensifying macro - economic control and law - enforcement and supervision departments are the main efforts that the state council has made to downsize its departments .
the organizations that have been downsized can mainly be divided into two categories : the first category is specialized economic departments in charge of enterprises . for instance , the departments managing mechanical , coal , petrochemical , metallurgical , and textile industrial enterprises were shut down in a step - by - step manner .
the second category includes organizations with similar businesses and those that could be merged .
through reform , the state council closed 11 departments , a cut from 40 to 29 , and closed more than 200 internal divisions and bureaus within departments .
through organizational reform , the state council has reduced the number of its office workers from 32,000 to more than 16,000 , a cut of nearly 50 percent .
appropriately diverting laid - off workers to other sectors is an important condition for ensuring the smooth progress of organizational reform .
the governments at various levels have adopted a series of effective measures to properly divert surplus workers to other sectors .
state functionaries at various levels become younger in their average age . the proportion of state functionaries under 49 years old rises from 53.6 percent before organizational reform to 59.3 percent . the average age of working personnel in some departments and committees is 37.5 years old .
with regard to the educational structure , the educational background of working personnel has further been upgraded . the proportion of state functionaries who are university graduates and undergraduates rises from 69.7 percent before reform to 77.4 percent and the ratio of those with master and doctorate degrees rises from 14 percent to 20.8 percent .

starting website to keep up with the times large amounts of information , a high speed of dissemination , plentiful contents , a high degree of interaction , and strong service are important characteristics of the internet , which is called the fourth medium .
right from the first day it was set up , the jiefangjun bao internet version [ jbiv ] has made full use of these advantages of the internet to give publicity to the pla .
the first piece of information it published was on the large celebrations and grand military review on the 50 th anniversary of the founding of the state . the whole world saw on the internet in a real - time manner the chinese pla 's brilliant image as a mighty , civilized army .
there was very enthusiastic response from both within and outside the country as soon as jbiv appeared on the internet . not only were the broad masses of military enthusiasts fond of browsing it on the internet but government agencies , universities , and research institutes from many countries visited it one after another .
among them , the propaganda and reportage on the national day military review and our army 's march into its garrison in macao as well as commentaries on the taiwan issue were hot items for reprinting by media both within and outside the country .
after browsing the new internet version of this army newspaper , many netizens sent e - mails praising it for contents that were constantly enriched and webpages that got increasingly good - looking .
at this first anniversary of its establishment , editors of the internet version are in the process of planning and preparing for further adjustment and expansion of the contents and enhancement of service and the degree of interaction to conform to the new requirements of information development to even better fit in with the readers ' needs .
from the start , jbiv has been rather attentive to drawing other news media 's development experience and paid attention to developing an internet medium by making use of its own traditional superiority under the conditions of insufficient personnel and funds and relatively weak technical support .
this army newspaper 's superiority is embodied mainly in two aspects : 1 . an advantage shared by all conventional media in having a team of editors and reporters of relatively high quality ; 2 . an exceptional advantage in military information resources .
through a team of keen - witted and capable correspondents built throughout the army , it is able to collect information on various aspects of the army , navy , and air force as well as the missile unit , logistic service , scientific research and equipment , armed police corps , and reserve force of national defense .
its unique superiority in the resources of original military information has laid a good foundation for the development of this army newspaper 's internet version .
before revamping its layout , comrades from this army newspaper 's internet version , faced with the existing circumstances of central and local news media enjoying a head start and rapid development , pondered again and again over ways to establish their own brand when both personnel and equipment were lacking .
because of their long experience in journalistic work , coupled with the army 's superiority in network technology , they felt they could adopt the methods of cooperating with one another after a division of work , assigning each person multiple tasks , and " getting outside help " in organizing some brilliant campaigns .

obviously not .

the development of hong kong 's democracy i believe there is no need for us to dodge the development of democracy .
we also believe hong kong should promote the development of democracy .
as a matter of fact , there are a multitude of ways to develop democracy .
the united states , france , and germany have traveled separate ways on the road to democracy .
the germans vote with rationality to elect politicians to rule their countries ; there is no attempt to please the public with claptrap or showmanship .
this is because they must rationally face the history of the two world wars , and they are capable of rationally facing the future .
hong kong should develop a harmonious , not confrontational democratic system . this has two important elements .
this is because in doing so , we will see democracy as a tool to " oppose china " and " resist communism , " which will block hong kong 's road to democracy .
i believe hong kong 's democracy should develop under the " one country , two systems " formula through mutual respect and communications with the mainland .
i also do not agree with another argument .
this argument , as a matter of fact , not only overrates hong kong 's ability but also fails to understand history .
it is an unrealistic , childish idea .
china has a population of 1.3 billion and has complicated social , economic , and cultural factors . it cannot adopt the management approach of a city with only six million people .
second , we must recognize the actual situation in hong kong society .
we must realize that some 10 percent of the taxpaying individuals and institutions in hong kong shoulder hong kong 's social expenditure for the overwhelming majority of the people . in other words , a minority of people and companies are paying the lion 's share of taxes to push forward social progress .
should the development of hong kong 's political system reflect this characteristic ?
for example , we could increase democratic elements in the election of functional groups .
there are also people who argue that taiwan 's democracy could also be a good model .
let me ask this : if a legislator needs an election budget running up to hundreds of millions of dollars , how could the legislator balance his or her income and expenditure after winning the election ?
the basic law stipulates that a review shall be conducted in 2007 . accordingly , we should experiment with the current system for a period of time , review the experience from time to time , and develop our political system when the entire society gradually reaches consensus .
hong kong 's relations with the asia - pacific region and the international community we oppose political internationalization .
however , we cannot deny that hong kong is an international trade , transportation , and financial center .
under the new circumstances when the chinese mainland and taiwan enter the world trade organization [ wto ] , hong kong unavoidably must , under the framework of " one country , two systems , " appropriately handle its relations with the mainland and its relations with the international community as china 's special administrative region [ sar ] .
these questions need to be considered by hong kong 's political , economic , and cultural circles .
hong kong has already done this .
it has a basic social security net capable of protecting the poorest people who need help the most .
there are , however , no ideal approaches to resolving once and for all the gap between the rich and the poor resulting from the polarization of society in terms of the possession of knowledge .
this is because in a knowledge - intensive economic era , we cannot free ourselves from the problem of the widening gap between the rich and the poor if we do not tackle the problem of the polarization of society in the possession of knowledge .
i believe that after three or four years , as hong kong 's economy develops vigorously , a large number of new service industries will emerge - - for example , the opening of the disney theme park - - and this will ameliorate the situation through the creation of job opportunities for low - skilled workers .
actually , the on - going vocational training in various fields is a form of unemployment subsidies .
it is a task for our policy research institute to study and find a solution to this difficult issue in hong kong society . i hope we can find a hong kong - style approach to this issue as soon as possible . 6 .
everything was put off until after 1 july 1997 for the sar government to deal with .
after the sar government took over , it was in a period of adjustment . this is why it went through many ups and downs in the first three years .
do we carry out reform to deal with the problems accumulated over the decade and more step by step or in one stroke ?
therefore , we must realize the importance of reform .
obviously , the tactics of reform is also important . we must carry out reform stage by stage and group by group in the proper order .
this is something we need to examine and we need to draw upon our past experience .
we must realize that a socially responsible government leader may encounter great difficulties from time to time .
this is because he or she may not know in advance the strong reaction to the reform . he or she must make choices in an extremely difficult circumstance .
at the same time , people may also be able to realize that the government headed by mr. tung is responsive to the citizens .
take information technology for example . information technology changes with each passing day . a year of delay in policymaking often means five years of delay in productivity .
this is also true in the case of education .
yet , he has chosen a separate course .
in this sense , the sar government is truly the government of the hong kong people . 7 .
it has a sound legal system , a well - established financial system , a versatile entrepreneur spirit , and so on and so forth .
one of the key issues is the issue of talented people .
i believe this issue concerns mainly how to attract outstanding personnel from the mainland and abroad , especially the former .
this requires a complete set of comprehensive immigration policy .
everyone knows the whole world wants to have talented chinese personnel .
recently , the united states hastily closed the case of wen ho lee . i believe it has something to do with the great impact the case has on ethnic chinese intellectuals in the united states .
obviously , the event has also something to do with the climate of the us general election .
today when science and technology is so advanced , hong kong may not necessarily need to build the hardware , such as silicon chips production bases or basic theory research centers . rather , it should bring into play the advantage of information technology and attract talented people from the mainland to use the software and create greater values .
when the government formulated this program , it might not have a good understanding of the situation in the mainland .
for example , the term " talents " refers to doctor 's degree holders from famous colleges . in fact , more often than not the united states or some other countries have long grabbed these people .
when implementing this program , hong kong citizens should realize the importance of this program and should not approach it from a narrower perspective , believing the talented people from the mainland are taking away hong kong people 's means of livelihood .

putting capital directly on the stock market has been a desire cherished by domestic insurance enterprises for years .
in october last year , china began to let insurance capital go to the stock market indirectly by allowing insurance companies to use five percent of their total amount of assets to buy securities investment funds .
in march this year , pingan insurance , xinhua life insurance , and two other insurance companies were given approval to raise the percentage of the capital put on the stock market from five to 10 percent .
in the first half of this year , securities investment funds held by chinese insurance companies exceeded 9.1 billion yuan , showing a more than 3.5 - fold increase . the average rate of return from operation of insurance capital was close to 11 percent , well above the previous rate of five to eight percent .
raising to a significant extent the percentage of capital that can be invested in the stock market shows that china 's administrative authorities affirm and encourage the operation of insurance capital on the stock market .
in addition , china will allow insurance companies to form fund - management companies or take part in the establishment of open - end funds .
this year china has , for the first time , approved the establishment of three insurance agency companies .
approval has also been given to two additional foreign insurance companies to do business in china . four foreign insurance companies have been allowed to enter the chinese market . and two chinese joint - stock insurance companies have been given approval to sell their shares to foreign investors .
with the xinhua life insurance company selling its shares to foreign investors , the state of affairs where chinese insurance companies had " only chinese capital " has become a matter of the past .
experts say that the insurance industry is one of the fastest - growing industries in china since the start of the reform and opening - up drive .
for the first half of this year , the total amount of premiums received was close to 80 billion yuan , up 6.7 percent compared with last year 's corresponding period .

during the ninth five - year plan period , many laid - off employees like ms. wang zhaolan opened up new realms of life through their own hard work and with the help of the social security system which had just taken shape .
in july 1996 , the " shanghai textile industry reemployment service center " was founded . it was china 's first reemployment service center .
as the reform intensifies , reemployment service centers are gradually integrating into the unemployment insurance system .
the laid - off employees have stopped merely collecting subsistence pay from reemployment service centers and have started collecting financial compensation monies and severing their working relationship with enterprises in order to enjoy unemployment insurance benefits .
those who have failed to be reemployed by the time unemployment insurance expires are entitled to the minimum livelihood guarantee benefits for urban residents .
currently , there are already 1.279 million people nationwide collecting unemployment insurance pay .
as at the end of june this year , the total number of urban laid - off employees who had stayed unemployed and the registered unemployed stood at 11.2 million .
among them , 6.77 million were employees laid off from state enterprises : 95 percent of them had entered reemployment service centers and 96 percent collected subsistence pay .
the livelihood guarantee fund per person per month for laid - off employees was 323 yuan and the subsistence pay per person per month was 205 yuan .
last year , 4.92 million employees laid off from state enterprises managed to be reemployed , giving a reemployment rate of 42 percent .
so far , 99.292 million people nationwide have taken out unemployment insurance .
marked results have been achieved in vocational training and the labor reserve system has been popularized on an extensive scale .
last year , 5.13 million unemployed people and laid - off employees took part in reemployment training and 3.23 million of them were reemployed after the training ; 3.38 million people took part in vocational skills certification and 2.92 million of them obtained vocational qualification certificates .
guaranteeing the subsistence pay for employees laid off from state enterprises and ensuring the full and timely payment of pension for retired personnel ( i . e . " two guarantees " ) is one of the central tasks of the governments at all levels for the ninth five - year plan period .
retroactive payment of arrears of pension for retired personnel has been successful .
the work to reform and regulate the social endowment insurance in rural areas is also progressing in a sound way .
so far , provincial - level plans have all be published ; 90 percent of all prefectural cities have formulated implementation proposals and 143 areas under centralized planning have entered the phase of organizing implementation , covering a total population of 13.96 million .
a social security system has now taken shape , which incorporates endowment , unemployment , and medical insurance , is independent of enterprises and nonprofit institutions , and delivers socialized management services .
beijing , 5 oct ( xinhua ) - - some chinese historians and religious experts met at a forum in beijing today to expose the vatican 's anti - china actions in the name of " canonization . "
over 20 experts and scholars from the chinese people 's university , beijing university , beijing teacher - training university , chinese academy of social sciences , and chinese youth political college , as well as the journal of religions in china were present at the forum .
the scholars used many facts to point out that , in modern chinese history , catholicism and protestantism came to china along with the big western powers ' colonialist aggression against china .
missionary work at that time was part of the aggression . the aggressor troops paved the way for the missionaries ' activities , and the missionaries served as the guides and the tools of the aggressor troops .
they were the people 's spontaneous patriotic , anti - imperialist actions , which eventually led to the boxers ' movement that shocked the world . all peace - loving people who upheld justice the world over strongly condemned the western missionaries for their heinous crimes against the chinese people .
the scholars also pointed out : such missionaries as auguste chapdelaine , albericus crescitelli and franciscus de capillas killed in china committed countless crimes and misdeeds . the local chinese people still denounce them today .
as disclosed by a chinese authoritative department , over the past 20 years since reform and opening up , the total amount of foreign capital actually used across the country has reached $ 320 billion , and the actual results of importing foreign capital have exceeded the targets set in the ninth five - year plan .
among the world 's 500 large - sized multinational corporations , nearly 400 have made investment in china .
the access of foreign investors has played a positive role in china 's economic development .
fund shortage has been a long - term restraining factor in china 's modernization .
according to the forecast of a pertinent sector , during the ninth five - year plan period , the accumulative total amount of foreign capital used in china will reach $ 280 billion , increasing by $ 110 billion over the figure during the eighth five - year plan period .
this amount of $ 280 billion will make up for the fund deficiency in china 's construction , as the proportion of foreign investment in china 's fixed asset investment will reach about 40 percent .
the large - scale western development as china 's strategy for economic equilibrium has been officially put into effect , and the construction of a number of foreign invested projects will , without doubt , play a decisive role in the opening up and economic development in the central and western regions .
in addition , the advanced technology and management experience brought by the foreign investment have given impetus to structural adjustment and industrial upgrading .
according to statistics , the number of people directly or indirectly absorbed by foreign - invested enterprises has exceeded 20 million , approximately accounting for 10 percent of the entire country 's urban labor forces .
he said : to encourage foreign investment , china will seize the opportunity of the economic globalization to adapt itself to the new situation of the information revolution and knowledge - based economy that are advancing by leaps and bounds and create a steady and relax environment conducive to foreign investment .
along with the repeated improvement of china 's investment environment , foreign - invested enterprises also readjusted their investment in china .
for example , steve ballmer , who succeeded bill gates as microsoft ceo , recently declared that the corporation will increase nearly $ 40 million for its investment in china in the next few years and double the size of the microsoft asia technological center in shanghai .
they include many world 's famous research institutions such as microsoft china research institute , intel china research center , lucent technologies china laboratories , and so on . most of them were founded in the past five years .
the reason why multinational corporations are keen on opening their " branches " of research and development centers in china is just as richard wagoner , ceo of general motors corp . put it : " in china , there are the best development opportunities in the world , so we will not let slip such opportunities . editor 's note : in the autumn of 1998 , the people 's liberation army [ pla ] has started mass activities of applying science and technology in military training in response to chairman jiang 's great call and in accordance with the unified arrangements of the central military commission and the general departments .
the scientific and technological military training is an epoch - making reform of the pla 's military training .
over the last two years , the scientific and technological military training has brought about profound changes in the guiding principle , contents , means and methods of military training , as well as in military tactics ; and has played an important role in enhancing the troops ' ability of winning in future high - tech war .
after being appraised by experts , some people suggested that the achievement be submitted to higher levels immediately for science and technology award .
he instructed : " let 's take the ' babes ' to the mountain and forest and fire them over and over . do n't be afraid to damage them . it is better to discover problems today than in actual battlefield . "
so , the artillery pieces were moved from the reform experiment building to " battlefield . "
judging by usefulness , not by " empty talk " in mid - august , the reporters witnessed a comprehensive tactical skill appraisal for individual soldiers at a motorized infantry regiment .
although the fighters have been taught about terrain , chemical defense , infrared rays and other knowledge in classroom , it is not so easy for them to apply it accurately in actual battle environment .
several years of learning high - tech knowledge has widened the vision of the officers and men and enhanced their sense of crisis and sense of urgency .
a passageway has been opened between classroom and battlefield , and the study of high - tech knowledge has been organically integrated with the drill on high - tech combat skills .
the scientific and technological military training has shifted from " elimination of illiteracy " in terms of high - tech knowledge at the beginning to application today , and from popularization of new knowledge to specific research and development .
in its initial stage , the scientific and technological military training was relying on several " sensible persons " to train several " top soldiers " and produce several " high - quality products . " now , it has leaped to applying scientific and technological knowledge in enhancing the troop units ' overall combat effectiveness .
all the units are striving for higher overall efficiency , instead of comparing with each other in terms of " component parts . "
they have set up reform achievement popularization award and new technology application award , striving to enable all services and arms to share reform achievements .
a certain automatic command system could not perform its advanced functions in the field due to lack of supportive elements .
since the beginning of this year , the units under the guangzhou military region have successively completed auxiliary projects for more than 80 reform achievements , making the parts fast and the whole strong .
with the relationship between studying and implementing " three represents " and enhancing the ability of " winning the war " properly handled , army building will be promoted to a new level .
enhancing the ability and quality of leadership in " winning the war " is an important criterion for strengthening party committees in the new situation .
the important thinking of " three represents " is the program for party building in the new period and the fundamental basis and important criterion for strengthening party committees at all levels . it has also set new and still higher demand on the party building of the military .
making high - standard preparation for military struggles and enhancing the ability of " winning the war " represent the noble mission entrusted on the military by the party and the people , the highest interest of the nation , and the mandatory lever testing and measuring all the party committees of the military .
to effectively perform the historical responsibility for leadership over the task of " winning the war , " however , members of party committees should improve their own ability and quality and further embrace the new ideas compatible with the " three represents . "
first , they should firmly embrace the idea that " winning the war is the irrefutable truth . "
when judging whether a locality meets the requirement for representing the development of advanced productive forces , economic development rate is used ; when judging a military unit , combat effectiveness is adopted .
therefore , it is necessary for party committees to always regard " winning the war " as the focus of their self - improvement endeavor and to resolutely refrain from raising unrealistic slogans , doing anything merely for " creating a good impression , " and carrying out emulation drives without a practical meaning .
second , they should firmly embrace the idea that members of party committees should be the examples in " winning the war . "
only by improving their ability of leadership in " winning the war " can " members " of party committees gain the initiative in work .
some people only pay lip service to combat effectiveness and devote their efforts to the work that creates fame easily instead of the fundamental work that enhances combat effectiveness . such an attitude cannot stand the test of war .
only by strengthening the idea that solving problems means making achievements and that the more the problems are solved , the greater the achievements will be , can combat effectiveness be improved continuously .
in theory , we should emphasize using advanced military theories to guide army building .
in mindset , we should continuously promote the reform of the military with an innovative spirit .
some leading cadres ' outdated ideas have hindered army building from developing toward a still higher level .
to meet the requirement for " three represents , " they should emancipate their minds and have the courage to create the new and , in particular , to make breakthroughs in some key work and difficult issues .
to intensifying and improving study , we should meet the needs of the situation and tasks , continuously transform our ideas , broaden our horizon , and study harder to improve the quality in " winning the war . "
only by proceeding from the need in actual combat to carry out difficult and strict training and management in peacetime and win a victory in the training field , can we win a victory in the battlefield .
to improve their leadership ability and quality , party committees should not only intensify study , but they should also attach importance to improving military units in line with the standard and need in actual combat , so that the military units and the party committees ' leadership ability and quality can improve simultaneously .
some party committees have neglected this issue and paid more attention to peacetime need at the expense of wartime need , separating their peacetime improvement efforts from wartime need .
comrade jiang zemin recently pointed out : the party 's work in all fields must persistently meet the requirements of the " three represents " and must always implement and embody such requirements .
he also particularly stressed the need to implement the requirements of the " three represents " in the work of building a high quality cadre contingent .
maintaining the party 's absolute leadership over the armed forces is the most important and fundamental political principle for this army , and is also the fundamental requirement for putting " three represents " into practice in this army .
to meet and implement this requirement , in the handling of cadre affairs , the key lies in selecting and appointing good cadres , thus guaranteeing that the gun will always be held in the hands of people being loyal to marxism .
cadre appointment is always a major and important political issue .
in a certain sense , a cadre without ability is a product of inferior quality , but a cadre who does not meet the political standards is a dangerous item .
in the general assessment of a cadre , the political and ideological assessment should also be properly integrated with the work ability assessment , and attention should be paid to preventing one - sidedness and simplistic practice .
for the armed forces , to implement the idea of representing the requirements in the development of advanced productive forces actually means to represent the advanced fighting capacity .
at present , when making preparations for the military struggle , the most important thing is to guarantee that we will win the war , and this is the paramount principle and requirement for selecting and training cadres and reinforcing leading bodies at all levels and in all units .
it is necessary to innovate our thinking and adjust the angle of view .
emphasizing the concept of relying on the masses and building up a solid and profound mass foundation for the work of cadre management in the party .
democratic recommendation , comments , and appraisal is the main form and practice for expanding the degree of democracy in the aspect of cadre appointment .
cairo , 5 oct ( xinhua ) - - egyptian president mubarak , palestinian national authority chairman arafat , and us secretary of state albright held a meeting on 5 october in sharm el sheikh , in the southern part of egypt 's sinai peninsula , to discuss palestine - israel conflicts and other issues .
the meeting should have been a four - party meeting between palestine , israel , egypt , and the united states .
however , a meeting held earlier in paris between palestine , israel , and the united states broke down due to serious differences among the three parties , and therefore barak decided not to participate in the four - party meeting in egypt , and he directly flew back to israel from paris .
the sharm el sheikh meeting only lasted one hour .
after the meeting , albright and egyptian foreign minister moussa held a press conference .
other than revealing to reporters that the meeting discussed forming an international investigation committee , albright and moussa did not mention any specific things about the meeting .
according to informed sources , because at the paris meeting the united states noticeably sided with israel on investigating and punishing the troublemakers and on other issues , at the sharm el sheikh meeting albright was severely criticized by both egypt and palestine .
albright said palestine has agreed to take measures to ease the tense situation .
moussa said israeli troops even resorted to using tanks and airplanes to cope with barehanded innocent civilians and kill women and children , and " as an arab , i feel very angry . "
albright did not say a word about barak 's absence .
he said , " if some people do not wish to come to egypt to discuss peace , then they had better not come . we will never compel such people to do what they are not willing to . "
when albright said currently the primary task was to " end bloodshed , violence , sacrifice , and pain , and to enable the situation to calm , " moussa was driven beyond forbearance .
exasperated , he said it was not enough just to enable the situation to calm .
he said , " so many innocent civilians , women , and children were harmed , and so many houses were destroyed - - this is unacceptable to us . "
on 4 october , ' arafat , albright , and israeli prime minister barak held talks in paris .
due to serious differences between palestine and israel over the methods of organizing an international investigation into the cause of the clashes , the paris talks failed to produce an agreement .
prior to that , ' arafat , barak , and albright had all agreed to an invitation for a four - party meeting with mubarak in sharm el sheikh following the paris talks .
but because of differences between palestine and israel at the paris talks , barak left paris the morning of 5 october and flew back directly to israel , making the originally planned four - party sharm el sheikh talks into trilateral talks .
according to a report , the israeli side suggested at the paris meeting forming an us - israel - palestine investigation committee and said the committee 's final report should " only serve as a reference . "
the united states supported israel 's suggestion .
egypt and france , the current rotating chairman of the eu , supported this suggestion .
due to the us backing israel on the issue at the sharm el sheikh trilateral meeting , moussa gave a veiled criticism of the us position at a news conference .
but moussa said that palestine and israel had not reached an agreement on the security issue , that the " situation in the occupied territories was very serious and kept on deteriorating , which was not helpful to the peace process . "

this was putin 's first visit to india since assuming office as russian president in april this year . it was also the first visit by a russian president to south asia since 1993 .
public opinion believed that putin 's visit would give further impetus to the development of russian - indian relations .
during his visit , putin had " extensive " talks with indian leaders on bilateral issues and on the regional and international situation . the two sides established a strategic partnership and reached a consensus on many issues .
they will not participate in any political - military blocs alliances or armed conflicts targeted against the other side , and will not enter into treaties or agreements that will encroach upon the independence , sovereignty , territorial integrity or national security and interests of the other side .
the 5 october indian - russian joint declaration said that the two sides have decided to hold a meeting at the highest level once a year and that the ministries and commissions concerned will hold discussions on a regular basis .
a group of eminence will be established to help the two governments and other institutions further consolidate their bilateral relations and strengthen regional and international cooperation .
at the same time , the two sides also signed a memorandum on the peaceful use of atomic energy .
india and russia also signed 11 other agreements , including agreements on scientific and technological cooperation and on the joint exploration of petroleum and natural gas in areas off the coast of eastern india , and a memorandum of understanding on judicial cooperation .
the two sides also reached a consensus on an action plan for cooperation in information technology .
however , there are still differences between india and russia on a number of issues .
putin urged india to sign the comprehensive test ban treaty as soon as possible . in his speech at the indian parliament , he said that india should " seek ways of preventing nuclear proliferation while considering its own interests . "
on economic and trade relations , both sides agreed that us $ 1.6 billion in annual trade did not reflect the trading potential between the two countries , but failed to find any feasible means of furthering their economic and trade relations .
at a meeting held in his honor in mumbai by the indian federation of industry and the federation of industry and commerce , putin urged indian industrialists and businessmen to invest in russia and strengthen bilateral trade .
he complained that india 's anti - dumping measures against russian goods had obstructed the development of trade between the two countries and urged the indian government to solve this problem .

new delhi , 5 oct - - another hot spot appeared in india 's power diplomacy in early october .
this visit has been seen as a continuation of traditional indian - russian friendly relations over the past half century , and it has also produced a qualitative change and gained a new connotation in this relationship in the new situation .
this new connotation is first of all expressed in the reaffirmation of their bilateral strategic partnership .
the statement emphasized that this relationship is based on the principles of equality of sovereignty , territorial integrity , mutual noninterference in internal affairs , mutual respect , and mutual benefit , and on the enduring mutual understanding and trust between the two countries .
taking a practical look at the new connotation , we find a marked imprint of indian power diplomacy and " balance " diplomacy .
following its nuclear test in may 1998 , india held that it had the capital for aspirations to great power status , and india was in great need of russian support in the course if its sustained diplomatic efforts to this end .
in the six months since then , india has hosted visits by the prime ministers of japan and australia , and its power diplomacy has been very lively .
according to some analyses , putin 's visit to india was to a very great extent aimed at checking the west .
a signed commentary in the times of india on 2 october pointed out that india has become a new balancing factor amid the changes in global strategic relations .
when engaged in power diplomacy , india cannot neglect the fact that the world powers are all making full use of the " balancing trick . "
hence , the statement on the new indian - russian strategic partnership particularly pointed out that this partnership is not aimed at any other country or group of countries , and india and russia have no intention of establishing a military and political alliance .
this is significant for both countries . apart from that , permanent membership of the un security council has been pursued by india for a long time , as a symbol of great - power status .
the new strategic partnership sets out that india and russia will strengthen long - term cooperation in national defense and military technology and promote all - round development of bilateral relations in science and technology and economy and trade .
as reports here claim , the russian president 's agenda in india took in a wide scope " from national defense to diamonds . "
thus each has a proper role to play , india with its particular need for arms , and russia with its particular need for hard currency .

during the period under the ninth five - year plan , the coordinated regional development became one of the key guidelines for the sustained , steady , and healthy development of china 's national economy and society . the state promulgated a series of important measures in succession , giving unprecedented impetus to the coordinated regional development .
according to an analysis by an authoritative department , the highlights of the achievements made in the coordinated development of regional economy in china under the ninth five - year plan include the significant acceleration of economic development in central and western regions and the continuous emergence of economic " bright spots . "
the eastern , central , and western regions are moving toward harmonization at roughly the same speed .
the industrial structure in central and western regions has also shown a tendency toward optimization , with the quality of economic operations significantly enhanced .
since the beginning of the ninth five - year plan period , the state has significantly increased the scale of investment in fixed assets in central and western regions , which has resulted in the rapid improvement of the infrastructure in this part of the country .
in 1996 , investment in fixed assets in central and western regions accounted for 34.7 percent of the total investment in fixed assets nationwide . last year , this index went up to 38.8 percent .
the export growth forecast for various regions in the first half of this year indicates that export in central regions grew by nearly 32 percent , exceeding the growth level of less than 28 percent in eastern regions . the export growth rate in western regions also reached 27 percent , close to the comparable level in eastern regions .
under the guidance of the macroeconomic policies of the state , since the ninth five - year plan period began , eastern and western regions have conducted extensive cooperation through both governmental measures and the market mechanism and the link between regions has been gradually strengthened .
within that picture , macroeconomic guidance from the government mainly takes the form of region - to - region mutual support .
the market mechanism , on the other hand , shall come into being principally through the enterprises ' own initiative .

beijing , 9 october - - as of october 14 , the infrared sensor on china 's domestically developed " resource one " satellite will mark its first full year in service amid the harsh conditions of space .
the remote infrared space sensor is an integrated system which is the melding of the newest technology in optics , infrared physics , optoelectronics , precision machining , computing , space electronics and spatial control disciplines .
for many years , this technology was firmly controlled in the hands of a small number of developed countries .
in the mid-1980s , when china 's technological workers started the " resource one " satellite project , they were determined to produce a remote infrared sensor of the type then used only by us terrestrial satellites .
specialists indicate that even more important , this success comes against a backdrop of a high - quality , competitive infrared remote sensor development team and a well - equipped base of advanced infrared remote sensor testing techniques , which will serve as a basis for the future development of even more advanced infrared remote space sensors .
we have learned from the " world space week " that is underway in beijing that , in its future space technology development , china will focus on applied satellites and carrier or delivery rockets .

the china research institute of atomic energy science , birthplace of mainland china 's nuclear industry , is also mainland china 's center for developing nuclear weapons .
a taxi driver said : this place did not have any road signs several years ago , let alone the signboard of " the china research institute of atomic energy science . "
now all these are available . this shows that the circumstances are changing . the global strategic structure is also changing . even the most secret location also need to gradually take off its mysterious veil and begin to facilitate exchanges with the outside world .
the china research institute of atomic energy science was formerly called the institute of modern physics under the chinese academy of sciences [ cas ] , which was founded in 1950 .
after the chinese communists successfully manufactured atomic and hydrogen bombs and satellites , seven out of the 23 scientists upon whom honors were conferred came from his institute . sixty one experts from his institute were successively elected as academicians of the cas and the chinese academy of engineering [ cae ] .
through the toil of the scientists of the older generation , including qian sanqiang , very soon mainland china successfully tested its first atomic bomb in 1964 .
later , the united states discovered that mainland china used the upstream uranium and related raw materials [ you yuan liao ] to manufacture the atomic bomb , indicating that mainland china was capable of developing the whole process of manufacturing atomic bombs .
the us government detained american - chinese scientist li wenhe [ lee wen - ho ] for leaking secrets of nuclear weapons .
when asked to comment on how to maintain china 's status as a nuclear power , zhao zhixiang became serious . he said that the issue was too sensitive and that he could not comment on it .
zhao zhixiang said : the number of mainland china 's nuclear warheads is much lower than that of the united states . therefore , strategically , mainland china mainly uses them as a deterrent .
he could not understand an allegation circulated by outsiders that mainland china would probably use nuclear weapons against taiwan .
he could not understand why taiwan has such worries .
the china research institute of atomic energy science has 35 subordinate institutes with over 3400 scientists and researchers . when the retirees are taken into account , the total number will be over 5000 people .
it has hospitals , schools , markets , and some other facilities , just like a small community .
with their bleak appearances , we can visualize their residents ' poor living conditions .
under the market economy , even china 's most important scientific research institute should also begin to gear toward the market and earn money to feed this large group of personnel .
perhaps when the scientists first joined their researching careers , they did not expect that they would have to learn to do business .

geng biao was born into a poor peasant family in liling county , hunan province .
in 1922 , the cpc committee of xiang district , with mao zedong as secretary , sent jiang xianyun , xie huaide , and so on to shuikou shan to organize a workers ' movement .
geng biao was dispatched by the party organization to take part in the task of secretly receiving and transporting firearms from an enemy munitions factory at dongyang ferry near shuikou shan . he bravely and tactfully distracted the enemy sentinels and ensured the success of that assignment .
the workers ' red guards , armed with those firearms , later went to jinggang shan and were incorporated into the 4 th army of the red army , led by mao zedong and zhu de .
after the great revolution failed , he took part in several insurrections to " storm the city " by peasants and workers in liling against the white terror .
after the party organization and the revolutionary forces suffered serious losses , he returned to liuyang after passing through many other places . he found the party organization and became commander of the liling guerrilla force in liuyang , actively involved in guerrilla warfare .
in august 1928 , he was transferred to cpc membership .
in september 1930 , on the party 's instruction , geng biao led his guerrilla force to join the main force of the red army .
after the red army entered guizhou , he took his troops to force - cross wu jiang at jiangjie ferry , paving the way for the central column and other units to smoothly cross the river .
just before the conference , geng biao led the 4 th regiment of the red army to capture the natural barrier , loushan pass , and occupy such places as tongzi , niulan pass , and songkan .
geng biao firmly supported the decision of the cpc central committee . he carefully kept , to this day , the " statement to red army officers and men , " a document relaying the gist of the zunyi conference .
geng biao was profoundly enlightened and conscientiously obeyed the decision made by his superiors .
in the phase of full - scale counterattack in the anti - japanese war , he , together with other leaders staying in the shanxi - chahar - hebei military region , directed troops to capture zhangjiakou , a strategic town north of the great wall , and annihilated a large number of japanese troops and puppet army soldiers .
under the leadership of comrade ye jianying , he put up tit - for - tat confrontations with the us representatives and kmt representatives for the sake of peace and democracy .
in september 1948 , the main force of the 2 d formation of northern china military region was given the order to garrison the line along central and western parts of hebei to protect the cpc central committee at xibaipo .
geng biao , together with yang dezhi and luo ruiqing , led the troops to advance 800 li with astounding willpower , marching day and night and braving wind and snow . they encircled and eventually annihilated the enemy 35 th army .
with such outstanding exploits , the " yang - luo - geng formation " became far - famed .
after the founding of new china , the cpc central committee decided to transfer a batch of leading cadres from the armed forces to the diplomatic front .
a general becoming an ambassador does not count as a transfer to civilian work , so you can keep your name on the army roll .
during the cultural revolution , he was engaged in tit - for - tat struggle against the behavior of the lin biao - jiang qing clique who seriously disrupted and undermined the cpc central committee 's diplomatic policies .
geng biao fought under the bright red flag of the party , struggled all his life for the party and the people , and dedicated himself selflessly .
he stood by principles , upright and never stooping to flattery , and his faith in the party never wavered even when he was in adversity .
when he joined the party , the party organization issued him a certificate of membership of the cpc .
for decades , through hail of bullets in the raging battleground , he always carried on him this party membership certificate , printed with the hammer - and - sickle sign .
comrade geng biao had superlative talents as a military commander and abundant experience in administering the armed forces .
he was valiant , tenacious , resourceful , and full of stratagems and was good at building his units according to changes in the situation and tasks . he accumulated a wealth of experience in the administration of the armed forces and in operations .
during the central red army 's first campaign against the " encirclement and suppression " in december 1930 , geng biao was a staff officer in the division headquarters .
in the course of the operations , he discovered that some commanding officers were unable to take advantage of the terrain and surface features , but instead fought recklessly , causing huge casualties to their units . therefore , he resolutely assisted the direction of the units , breaking through the enemy positions with accurate tactical maneuvers .
he did not stop directing the battle after his right leg was wounded . in the xiangjiang battle , he was suffering from malaria , but held on and led his troops in a life - and - death battle with an enemy force more than 10 times their size .
in the ganquan battle , he personally led a commando to storm the city . his neck was slit by a hand - grenade shrapnel , blood gushing out , but he continued to lead his troops in the grappling , until comrade peng dehuai ordered him to leave his commanding post .
geng biao was not only a brave soldier , but was also good at summing up his experience and exploring the laws of operational command .
he was good at judging the hour and sizing up the situation and seeing the whole picture .
in the early stage of the liberation war , the units of the shanxi - chahar - hebei military region found themselves in a passive situation for a time .
one of the plans was something he called " breaking off a crab 's legs . " this plan compared the enemy in shijiazhuang to a crab and intended to clean up its periphery first , turning it into an isolated city , before capturing it .
this plan was put into practice after being discussed and improved upon by the military region and subsequently submitted to the cmc for approval . it was credited with victories in several campaigns and battles and helped break off the " crab legs " before shijiazhuang was liberated .
when the units were fighting in the xushui area , the main force of the enemy 3 d army stationed in shijiazhuang went up north as reinforcement .
having received information to this effect , geng biao immediately discussed it with the formation 's leadership and , seizing the opportunity for combat , resolutely sent troops southward , annihilating over 10,000 enemy troops in the qingfengdian area . luo lirong , commander of the enemy army was taken captive .
the victory of the qingfengdian campaign paved the way for the shijiazhuang campaign .
geng biao was not only experienced in military operations , but also good at studying military theories in light of practice .
in 1936 , he studied at wayaobao red army university . after 1941 , he attended the study class of the formation that had stayed in yanan and later went to study at the central party school .
he saw " a study and comparison of the thinking of clausewitz and sun zi " written by a japanese author in the yanan library , so he copied out the book , cut stencils , and made over a dozen bound , mimeographed copies to give to his comrades - in - arms .
in his long military career , geng biao set great store by the development of units .
he emphasized that units should acquire cultural knowledge and technical knowledge . he set an example himself in this regard .
when he visited units to arrange or inspect work or went to the frontline to observe the terrain and the enemy 's situation , he would often drive himself .
in july 1980 , in accordance with the spirit of comrade deng xiaoping 's instructions on the need for the army to " lose weight " and to reform its system and establishment , he oversaw the formulation of " a proposal of the cmc for streamlining and reorganization . "
through that round of streamlining and reorganization , such units as the construction engineering corps and railway corps were transferred and put under the relevant departments of the state council and local governments in complete organic units , cutting the size of the army by hundreds of thousands .
iii . comrade geng biao was long engaged in diplomatic work and the party 's international liaison work . he was a general - turned - diplomat .
he applied his rich experience in military struggle to diplomatic work and effectively safeguarded our national sovereignty and dignity .
during the war to resist us aggression and aid korea , geng biao was china 's ambassador to sweden .
when the united states violated the norms of international law and used bacterial weapons in korea , he exposed the united states ' war crime with utter indignation , arousing the sympathy and support of the international media .
acting on instructions from china , he also met with the swedish vice foreign minister who had just been elected secretary general of the united nations and persuaded him to do some facilitative work for the restoration of china 's lawful seat in the united nations .
this played a positive role in helping bring about the geneva conference and the sino - us ambassadorial meeting .
in accordance with the spirit of this instruction , he led the comrades in the embassy to conduct frequent and fruitful work in pakistan and promote the development of sino - pakistani relations and the stability of the international situation .
after he became vice foreign minister , he took part in overseeing the conclusion of border treaties and border agreements between china and such countries as burma , nepal , afghanistan , and pakistan and contributed to the security and stability around china .
he gave the diplomats of countries like sweden and pakistan an account of the red army 's long march and the illustrious history of our army fighting for the people 's interests , winning the respect of our international friends .
when he was working in the foreign ministry and the international liaison department of the cpc central committee , he submitted to the center his viewpoints and suggestions on the improvement of diplomatic and international aid work and the development of inter - party relations , many of which were adopted by the center .
comrade geng biao went on fighting till he breathed his last for the cause of the party and the people .
he was concerned with the people 's weal and woe and made donations in money and in kind to the public in poor areas and disaster - stricken areas on many occasions .
after he left the leadership post , he continued to show concern for the important matters of the party , the state , and the army . he wrote many letters to the cpc central committee and the cmc , making suggestions about economic construction and the development of national defense and the armed forces .
he adhered to the party 's basic line , gave his sincere support to the cpc central committee with comrade jiang zemin at its core , and was full of confidence in the future of the party and the country .
as we celebrate the double ninth festival , we cherish all the more comrade geng biao , our respected predecessor on the diplomatic front .
comrade geng biao began his diplomatic career of more than 20 years in early 1950 , when he first came to the foreign ministry .
he made important contributions to opening and developing new china 's diplomatic undertakings during his successive services as chinese ambassador to the kingdom of sweden and concurrently minister to denmark and finland , ambassador to pakistan , vice foreign minister , member of the party committee of the foreign ministry , ambassador to burma , and ambassador to albania .
comrade geng biao was new china 's senior diplomatic cadre of the first generation who became an ambassador after serving in the army as a general .
he had a good grasp of theories and policies and attached great importance to investigation and study . he put forward proposals in a timely fashion in light of the development of the international situation and the needs of domestic construction in an effort to provide reliable basis for the central committee 's policymaking .
as the saying goes , the first step is always difficult .
he made friends with members of the royal families of the host countries and with people in the political , military , and business circles . he enjoyed great popularity among them and was called " a great ambassador from a great country . "
shortly after he served as ambassador to sweden , the international situation took a big turn , as flames of war broke out on the korean peninsula and our country embarked on a course of war to resist us aggression and aid the democratic people 's republic of korea .
comrade geng biao therefore met with swedish foreign minister and foreign envoys in sweden on many occasions to brief them on the situation .
after the united states launched germ warfare in korea , he immediately mobilized embassy personnel to contact people of all circles to expose the us crimes .
she later wrote a detailed investigation report and published it in swedish newspapers .
during his service as ambassador to pakistan and burma , comrade geng biao made relentless efforts to develop good - neighborly relations between china and pakistan and between china and burma by actively promoting friendly exchanges between the governments and peoples and by actively advancing bilateral economic and cultural cooperation and trade .
during his term as ambassador to albania , he expressed his views to the central committee on improving diplomatic and foreign aid work in connection with the unreasonable demand and waste of aid by the aid recipient country .
after seeing his report , chairman mao said : " geng biao dares to speak the truth and report the situation truthfully . he is a good ambassador . "
in the face of lin biao and the gang of four 's serious interference and sabotage of the central committee 's diplomatic line during the " great cultural revolution , " comrade geng biao displayed the selfless and undaunted spirit of a proletarian revolutionary by upholding principles , resisting pressure , and defying the gang of four .
in foreign affairs , the power was once taken away from the central committee as a result of the interference of lin biao , chen boda , and the gang of four during the initial period of the " great cultural revolution . "
because of this , comrade geng biao was labeled a member of the " february adverse current " and the " geng - huang anti - party clique . "
to overcome personnel shortage in the embassy , he asked diplomatic personnel to help take care of administrative and logistic work . diplomats and their spouses were all asked to help prepare food and arrange banquets .
at that time , there was only one chauffeur in the embassy and he was too busy to meet the work demands . in light of this , comrade geng biao asked everyone to learn to drive and he himself took the lead in driving himself to conduct various activities .
when he was vice foreign minister in charge of the asian department and the general office , china was in a serious economic difficulty , and many diplomatic personnel were ill because of the shortage of food .
comrade geng biao served as ambassador for many years . during this period , he received one high - ranking party and government delegation after another .
we will always cherish the memory of comrade geng biao and other people like him who made contributions to new china 's diplomatic undertakings over the last 50 years .
but a relatively widely accepted view is that china 's accession to the wto will provide a stabler , more transparent , and fairer environment for foreign investors in china .
in the meantime , the upgrading and adjustment of the composition of foreign investments in eastern china will also present new opportunities to the central and western parts of the country where resources and cheap labor abound .
therefore , there is still ample room for foreign investors to invest in manufacturing industries in china .
it is hard to expect a large amount of foreign funds to pour in as soon as china joins the wto . experts believe that in the next two to three years the amount of foreign funds flowing into china will still remain around $ 40 billion a year .
what can be expected is that there will certainly be a new high tide of foreign investments in china in the wake of the growth of the market economy in china and the constant improvement in the investment environment .
experts predict that in five to 10 years the amount of foreign funds china draws in may increase to around $ 80 billion each year .

beijing , 10 oct ( xinhua ) - - this morning [ 10 october ] at the great hall of the people , state president jiang zemin met with tanzanian president benjamin william mkapa , who is here to attend the " china - africa cooperation forum - - ministerial conference beijing 2000 . "
jiang zemin warmly welcomed the participation of the delegation led by president mkapa at the china - african forum .
the chinese government has all along attached importance to africa .
jiang zemin said : this grand meeting is the first multilateral collective dialogue between china and africa held to meet the needs of the future and to discuss matters of vital importance within the scope of south - south cooperation .
jiang expressed his belief that with the joint efforts of china and africa , this meeting certainly will achieve complete success , thus promoting further development of sino - african friendly cooperation in all fields in the new century .
two years ago during his visit to china , mkapa said he reached consensus with the chinese on how to further strengthen ties of trade and economic cooperation between the two countries .
richardson also stressed that the decision was made personally by president bill clinton , saying , " president clinton has authorized the release of 30 million barrels of oil from the strategic oil reserves in the next 30 days to alleviate market pressure and reduce oil prices . "
a decision made under double pressure since the beginning of this year , petroleum prices on the international market have been rising continuously , setting an all - time high in 10 years , the increase and once reached 200 percent .
the united states , as the largest oil consumer , reacted strongly in order to protect its economic interests .
us federal reserve chairman alan greenspan warned the us congress that the continuous high price of oil would " have very serious consequences for the us economy " and would increase inflationary pressure .
the us house of representatives adopted a bill by an overwhelming majority , threatening to reduce economic aid and military sales to " opec " member countries and demanding that they increase oil production .
however , president clinton could only influence " opec " but could not influence oil prices .
on 12 september , the price of north sea brent crude in the london exchange once rose to $ 34.37 per barrel , setting an all - time high since the gulf war. light oil on the new york exchange even rose to $ 35.85 per barrel .
it appeared that the only way to solve the crisis was to release national strategic oil reserve .
members of the clinton administration had fierce debate on how to solve this contradictory problem .
on 21 september , democratic presidential candidate al gore at a campaign meeting openly called on president clinton to release strategic oil reserve to stabilize oil price and help people tide over the winter safely .
when al gore started to play the " oil price card , " there were only 47 days before the us presidential election on 7 november .
at this crucial moment , any candidate who can attract the center of attention of voters will undoubtedly attract the votes of " those people who cannot make up their mind . "
public opinions generally held that the decisive factor of the general election in the year 2000 would be the middle class whose life is not so easy . al gore 's " oil price card " has met their need .
different judgments in international community venezuelan energy and mines minister ali rodriguez , the current chairman of " opec , " noted that the us government decision is conducive to lowering oil prices and stabilizing the international oil market .
he stressed that the high oil price was not simply caused by an imbalance in supply and demand . speculative activities in the market and excessive oil taxes levied by a number of oil - consuming countries are the real cause of the increase of oil prices .
some " opec " member countries noted that the action by the clinton administration was taken out of political considerations , not really to quell the oil crisis .
some individual " opec " member countries even thought the us practice of using strategic oil reserves might lead to a confrontation between the us and " opec , " which could lead to a drastic fluctuation in oil prices and might not be helpful in solving oil shortages in the us during the winter .
however , the united kingdom , france , spain , and other countries of the european union generally welcomed the us action of using strategic oil reserves to stabilize oil prices , because the high oil price has started to threaten social stability in many european countries .
western countries are all finding their own ways out the us government , after announcing the use of strategic oil reserves , immediately put the first batch of 5 million barrels of oil into its domestic market and decided to place another batch of oil on the market when necessary .
in view of the effectiveness of the us emergency policy in dealing with oil crisis , some european countries are also considering the use of their strategic oil reserve to meet the situation of high oil price .
however , for the future of the eu , there is the danger of " trying to look like a tiger but ending up looking like a dog . "
( girs gantland ) , spokesman of the energy organization of the eu , said that the current oil price situation has not reached the stage of imperatively using strategic oil reserves .
besides , " the situation in the us is not necessarily suitable for the eu . " " if the strategic oil reserves of the main oil - consuming countries start to fall , the defense against oil crises will be weakened . "
under such circumstances , using strategic oil reserves without careful consideration may lead to the bankruptcy of the oil market and even the entire economic system , if a large - scale oil crisis breaks out .
the current international oil price crisis has had serious effects on the society , economy , and energy policy of the us and european countries . countries like the united kingdom and france cannot but adopt various measures to limit oil consumption .
however , japan , as a western developed country , is basically not " invaded " by the current oil crisis .
although japan is not influenced by the current oil price hike , the shrewd japanese still have sensed , from the us petroleum policy , the importance of strategic oil reserves to the development of the national economy .

at the " sino - africa cooperation forum " held in beijing today , foreign minister tang jiaxuan said establishment of a new type of partnership between china and african nations within the framework of south - south cooperation will be a positive contribution to the establishment of a new international political and economic order .
strengthening unity , promoting cooperation , striving for the favorable and preventing the unfavorable , and meeting the challenges - - these will be the inevitable choice for developing countries to pursue development in the new century .
only by relying on themselves and strengthening unity among them can developing countries fundamentally change their unfavorable situations and bring about early establishment of a just and reasonable new international political and economic order .
in the course of friendly exchange between china and african countries over the last half century since the founding of new china , the two sides have always sympathized with and supported each other .
tang jiaxuan pointed out : facing the development and changes in the international situation , how sino - africa relations can be developed to a higher level and can more effectively cope with new problems and new challenges are a problem which china and african countries have been pondering .
some african countries have proposed that , to meet the new situation , china and african countries establish a channel of collective dialogue and cooperation so that they can step up consultations and exchange on issues concerning peace and development that the two sides are concerned about .
china and africa enjoy profound traditional friendship ; they do not have any conflicts of interests ; they share extensive common interests in maintaining peace and promoting development .
they are completely capable of exploring for new ideas - - and it is necessary for them to do so - - on establishing a new framework for the development of sino - africa relations in the new century .
for this reason , the chinese government proposed to convene the " sino - africa cooperation forum - - beijing 2000 ministerial meeting , " which drew warm responses from african countries .
the holding of this forum reflects the common wishes of china and african countries , and it is an important manifestation of unity and cooperation among developing countries .
the forum plans to issue two documents , namely , the " beijing declaration of the sino - africa cooperation forum " and " program of sino - africa economic and social development and cooperation " .
tang jiaxuan expressed the belief that the two documents will be adopted without a hitch and they will be a guide to action for china and african countries to carry out cooperation on an equal and mutually beneficial basis in the new century .
in conclusion , tang jiaxuan pointed out : sino - africa cooperation is long - term and strategic .
