beijing , 10 oct ( xinhua ) - - in answering a reporter 's question at today 's press conference , foreign ministry spokesman zhu bangzao commented on the escalation of conflict between israel and palestine .

a report asked : the palestine - israel situation is deteriorating day by day and the prospects of peace are dim .
is china ready to play its role in the middle east peace process ?
zhu bangzao answered : china expresses deep concern over the escalation of conflict between israel and palestine .
a few days ago , the un security council adopted a resolution condemning israel for using force , which caused serious casualties of ordinary palestinian people . china cast an affirmative vote on the resolution .
the china red cross society will provide emergency humanitarian assistance to palestine .
violent conflict will only deepen mutual hatred and will not help fundamentally solve the problem .
zhu bangzao said we strongly urge parties concerned to exercise restraint and stop taking any action or making any remark that is detrimental to the peace process .
we hope palestine and israel will resume peace talks as soon as possible , and , on the basis of relevant un resolutions , take a flexible and pragmatic stand to seek a final solution to the palestinian issue and restore the legitimate ethnic rights of the palestinian people .

on october 10 , people in the north korean capital of pyongyang are holding a gala to solemnly celebrate this glorious day .

people believe that , under the leadership of the wpk headed by kim chong - il , the north korean people definitely will meet the challenge of the new century with a brand new look to open a new phase of national construction and development .

with rapid development of trade between china and japan , japan has been china 's largest trading partner for seven years in succession since 1993 , while china has also become japan 's second largest trading partner and one of the latter 's important export markets .
as china 's drive of reform and opening up to the outside world deepens , japan 's investment in china has increased accordingly , with its investment in china amounting to $ 7.58 billion in 1995 .
impacted by its sluggish economy and the asian financial crisis , japan 's investment in china has stagnated for some time .
however , beginning from the first half of this year , there has been noticeable momentum for recovery in japanese investments in china .
by the end of july , china had cumulatively absorbed $ 37.026 billion in the form of contracts from japan , of which $ 26.58 billion had been put into practical use , with the number of investment projects cumulatively reaching 19,542 .
since 1981 , china has received 98 non - reimbursable aid projects from japan , with aid funds amounting to 112.063 billion yen or about 25 percent of the total amount of non - reimbursable aid china received from foreign countries . the aid funds were used in such areas as education , public health , and agriculture .
thanks to chinese and japanese leaders ' efforts to attach importance to and promote economic and trade cooperation between the two countries , tremendous achievements have been scored in this aspect so far .
japan 's increased investment and assistance to china has helped china import technology , equipment , and managerial expertise and thus accelerated the process of china 's modernization .
at the same time , china 's vast market has also provided japan with abundant natural resources , enormous labor , and a vast area for investment .
it is in the fundamental interests of the peoples of the two countries and will play a role not to be ignored in maintaining good political relations and stabilizing the regional situation for china and japan to further strengthen cooperation in investment and economic and trade fields .
the economies of asia and japan are now recovering and large - scale development of china 's western regions has been launched .
this serves as new opportunities for the two countries to develop economic and trade cooperation .
china and japan must further join hands and work together to create a better tomorrow for economic and trade cooperation .

the equipment supporting force of a certain army of the chengdu military district , playing different roles , entered the " battlefield " of gun smoke as three red signal shells were fired and penetrated the skies of the plateau .
a practical drill , to show the capacity of equipment support with real soldiers , live ammunitions , and real equipment , had begun .
in the past , people 's impression of the " functions " of equipment support departments was not to lose any weaponry , and not to let weapons get rusty and become rotten . in this way , they could be called qualified " equipment soldiers . "
evidently , this equipment support concept is far from meeting the needs of future war .
how does one change this concept and turn the " custodians " and " technicians " into combatants ?
the equipment department of chengdu military region has stood on the van of the tide of military reform at the present time and studied ways to enhance the combat effectiveness of equipment with quick awareness .
therefore , it pushed equipment support training from the " back stage " to the " front stage . "
the scene of the drill .
the main attack combat was very acute : our armored attack unit was neutralized by enemy fire , which damaged three tanks and two armored transport vehicles .
the enemy fire neutralized our motorized infantry unit and damaged 15 light weapons , and the unit was in urgent need of ammunition replenishment .
our artillery group was hit by the enemy 's long - range gunfire attack , and suffered damage to three 37 - caliber artilleries and two 57 - caliber artilleries . it was in urgent need of ammunitions replenishment and quick repair of equipment .
equipment that could not be repaired was sent to the designated damaged equipment center ; the division 's supporting group rapidly organized forces to replenish the antiaircraft artillery group and artillery group with ammunitions , and sent two artillery repair units to the antiaircraft artillery group and artillery group to help repair the damaged weaponry .
during this drill , the equipment department focused attention on the system for managing new equipment and probed into the characteristics and law governing equipment support in war time . in view of the adjustment and reform of the system for managing equipment , it also studied and practiced procedures and methods for ensuring equipment support during war time .
the training to ensure equipment support is an important part of military training and the basic way for enhancing the support capacity during peace time . the training quality will directly affect the implementation of work related to combat readiness .
in the training method , it followed the road of simulated training , network training , and base training .
a military theoretician pointed out that the relationship between combat effectiveness and ordinary technical weapons is a multiplication relationship , and the relationship between combat effectiveness and informationized high - technology weapons is one of index relationship .
we must get rid of the concept of traditional equipment " custodians " and foster the modern equipment and technology support concept that equipment support is also an essential factor of combat effectiveness .
changing behind - the - scenes performance into on - stage performance a notice on the situation of the enemy : sixteen bombers of the " blue " army air unit left the a airport in two groups and flew toward our side , indicating that they might attack our division .
previously , equipment work was in a subordinate status . it was a sort of " passive " support , working " behind the scenes . "
in the drill , it was only a kind of behind - the - scenes support .
during this drill , equipment support walked onto the stage and played a main role .
the new equipment management system has developed the functions and scope of equipment support , ranging from command control and planned management to maintenance and supply , forming a complete independent system .
they made valuable explorations and probed into the following questions : what are the characteristics of equipment support in future operations ?
what kind of guiding ideology and support principles should we establish ?
how to establish in the battlefield the independent system of the equipment department 's commanding center ?
how to handle the weaponry damaged in the cause of operations ?
on the other hand , drawn by the combat tasks , it changed equipment support 's " subordinate role " into " main role , " and let it walk from the " back stage " to the " front stage . "
changing the decentralized form into an integrated form the decentralized form of equipment support cannot be formed into combat effectiveness , because it is not the kind of combat effectiveness restrained by scientific permutations and combinations .
during this drill , this department planned for the guiding principles and target system for building equipment for combat readiness in the theater in a scientific way , and changed the decentralized form into an integrated one .
changing " fixed - point " support to mobile support for many years , fixed - point support has become the main form of our military 's equipment support .
however , the mobility of local war under modern high - technology conditions has unprecedentedly expanded .
enhancement of future ground and air maneuver capability ensures quicker attack speed and quicker defensive response .
high - technology weaponry has complicated functions and is very systematic . it forms an integrated combat effectiveness during mobile operations . we need a long - time training and adaptability and to do much work in equipment support .
therefore , to meet the needs of future operations , we must strengthen mobile support training and fully prepare for equipment support , because this is an important factor for " winning victories " in local wars under high - technology conditions in the future .

watt 's invention of the steam engine triggered the first industrial revolution and had a far - reaching and profound impact on human society .
electrical power , nuclear power , aerospace , computers , the genome project , and other such major scientific and technical achievements have become new milestones and have entered the annals of the development of engineering and technological sciences .
we can expect that the 21 st century is bound to be a century of even faster developments in science and technology , particularly the engineering and technological sciences .
none of the achievements that china has made in the drive to modernization would be possible without the enormous support of the engineering and technological sciences .
the more than 10 million engineering and technical personnel in china have made historical contributions to china 's development and the world 's progress in engineering and technological sciences .
having respect for the creative labor of engineers and training a large group of engineering and technical talent is an inevitable requirement for the promotion of economic and social development .
this is the reason that china established the chinese academy of engineering .
all these things require that we enhance our research in the engineering and technological sciences , striving to achieve the design , construction , and operation of new engineering systems .
china 's engineering and technological sciences will usher in a new surge of development .
in the new century , mankind must continue to forge ahead on the basis of the scientific and technical achievements we have already made , and we must also strive to resolve a series of new challenges that we will face .
china will unwaveringly implement a strategy of sustainable development , strengthening cooperation with the countries of the world and doing a better job of protecting the environment in which the chinese people and the people of all the countries of the world live so that future generations will have an even finer space in which to develop .
finally , i wish you great success for the conference and may the engineers of every country make great contributions to the creation of an even brighter future for mankind !

traveling in space has all along been the happy dream of mankind since the ancient times .
the successful launching of the first man - made earth satellite on 4 october 1957 struck up a tune of prelude of mankind 's entry into the space .
in the subsequent 40 - odd years , the space technology developed rapidly , and considerable headway was made in space application and space science as well .
the highly effective application of aerospace technology in the fields of telecommunications , broadcast , meteorology , resources , satellite navigation and orientation , and so on has brought about tremendous changes in human productive forces and lifestyles and pushed forward economic development and social progress .

beijing , 11 october ( xinhua ) - - the fifth plenary session of the 15 th cpc central committee has completed its various tasks satisfactorily and concluded successfully .
the fifth plenary session of the party 's 15 th central committee was convened at an historical moment when china had successfully fulfilled its ninth five - year plan at the turn of this century and its drive of reform and opening up to the outside world and modernization have entered a new stage of development .
comrade jiang zemin delivered an important speech at the plenary session .
we have achieved the first two steps of the strategic goal of modernization , overall economic and social development , and a better - off level for the people 's livelihood .
at the very beginning of the new century , china will enter a new development stage of building a well - to - do society and speeding up the pace of modernization and begin implementing the third - step strategic plan .
this is a new milestone in the chinese nation 's history of development .
undoubtedly , this is a magnificent goal and an arduous mission .
we must establish more firmly the guiding ideology " development is of overriding importance . "
the " proposals " explicitly point out that the main theme of the 10 th five - year plan is development . we must unswervingly adhere to the principle of taking economic construction as the center , seize opportunities and speed up development .
the practice in the construction of our country has also proved that if the productive forces develop slowly , it will be difficult to resolve various kinds of contradictions and problems exiting in economic and social life , and it will also be difficult to meet the people 's demands for improving their living standard .
at no time should we forget this historical experience .
we must , on the basis of persistently seeking unity between speed and efficiency , enable the national economy to develop at a relatively rapid speed .
we must energetically promote innovation in structure and innovation in science and technology .
innovation in science and technology is playing a more and more important role in economic and social development , and has become the crucial factor for developing the productive forces .
we must regard constantly improving the people 's living standard as the fundamental starting point in all our work .
this is also the integration point in correctly handling the relationship between reform , development and stability .
we must put constantly increasing the income , and improving the living standard , of the people in the urban and rural areas in an important position in accordance with the requirements of comprehensively building a fairly well - off society and quickening and promoting modernization .
on the basis of speeding up economic development , we must continuously meet the growing needs of the people 's material and cultural life . in particular , we must properly solve the problems of the income of the peasants , employment , social security , and other problems that the people are generally concerned about .
we must energetically expand employment , continue to implement preferential policies to encourage people to create jobs for themselves , perfect the social security system , establish a good social order , and ensure the people can live and work in peace and contentment .
we must continue to work hard to advance socialist spiritual civilization and development of democracy and legal system , and promote coordinated development of the economy and society .
we must uphold the direction of " serving the people and serving socialism " as well as the principle of " letting a hundred flowers blossom and a hundred schools of thought contend " to promote a thriving socialist culture and reject unhealthy culture .
we must deepen education in socialist legal system and raise the legal concept of all the people , primarily leading cadres at all levels .
to achieve the goals put forward in the " proposals " to take hold of new victories in the cause of building socialism with chinese characteristics , the crux lies with the party .

gaza , 10 oct ( xinhua ) - - these days , violent conflicts have taken place between palestine and israel one after another , and military confrontation has emerged between lebanon and israel as well , making the situation in the middle east turbulent and uneasy .
this can be seen in the frequent middle east visits of some important persons , the endless hot - line contacts , and the intensified efforts to calm down the palestinian - israeli conflicts and rescue the peace process .
why is the international community so keen to resolve the violent conflicts between palestine and israel ?
first , the background of the current mediations is clear at a glance .
since 4 july , un secretary general annan , french president chirac , and us secretary of state albright have invited palestinian leader arafat and israeli prime minister barak to paris to seek solutions to the problems .
on 5 october , egyptian president mubarak negotiated with arafat and albright in sham al - shaykh in egypt .
during that period , annan talked with arafat on four occasions and with barak on two occasions , and ivanov also talked with barak on two occasions .
after his first round of talks with arafat , annan called on the two sides to end their conflicts and reopen their talks .
after meeting with arafat and barak , ivanov reiterated his willingness to help the two sides control the current tense situation .
the united states also indicated on many occasions that violent means could n't resolve the middle east problems .
second , arafat has already expressed his relative flexibility .
it was reported that on 10 october arafat ordered the military head of the fatah movement , the main body of the palestine liberation organization , not to hit back at the israeli army with weapons .
in the meantime , the protests of palestinian refugees in southern lebanon and their attacks in the israeli - lebanese border areas have been brought under control as well , and the military confrontation between the two sides appears to be alleviated .
however , to thoroughly resolve the palestinian - israeli conflicts and the new lebanese - israeli crisis , we still need some more time , and the parties concerned are required to keep working for this .
more importantly , the gist of the help - the - poor measures put forward in the policy address lies in the word " help . "
for instance , the organization of cleaning service contracting and the setting up of housework assistant teams are already being carried out . in the future , a fund may also be set up to offer loans .
in the area of employment assistance , the policy address proposed " creating " job opportunities by way of increasing appropriations and hiring more employees .
most of the new jobs will be on a two - year contract .
in contrast with " helping the poor , " vigorous development of education is the one and only road to enhancing society and individuals ' ability of subsistence and development .
particularly in the present age of knowledge economy , new knowledge and high techniques have significantly replaced physical strength and low technology following the popularization of information technology and the uneducated practically are already unable to keep pace with the times and establish themselves in society .
the government must therefore vigorously invest in and develop education to fundamentally solve the problem , be it for the need of social development or for " helping the poor . "
compared to the united states ' 81 percent or even shanghai 's 69 percent , there is of course an urgent need for hong kong 's present ratio of university and college places to high school graduates of below 30 percent to catch up .
therefore , the chief executive in his fourth policy address made the appeal for " sharing common goals " while vigorously helping the poor and developing education . the ultimate basis for " sharing common goals " is the basic law .
premier zhu 's visit to japan is a major event in sino - japanese relations ; the two governments have long prepared for this , and both sides have earnest expectations .
as important neighboring countries , china and japan have a history of exchanges over more than 2,000 years , in which friendship has been the main theme ; the exchange and precipitation of traditional eastern culture has made for indivisible intimacy between their two peoples .
the normalization of sino - japanese diplomatic relations in 1972 opened a new chapter in the history of the two countries .
the speed of development of their relations and the magnitude of the changes have provided valuable experiences for countries with different social systems to engage in international cooperation and practice peaceful coexistence .
there have also been friction and arguments , and even twists and turns , between the two countries since the establishment of diplomatic relations .
when president jiang zemin visited japan in 1998 , it was determined that china and japan would " work to build a friendship and cooperation partnership of peace and development , " thus pointing out the orientation for their relationship .
people with foresight in china and japan understand that both countries benefit if they are at peace , and both are harmed if they fight , and mutual suspicion between them just allows others to profit .
against the background of the era of peace and development , it is only by strengthening cooperation that china and japan can achieve the goals of asian regional cooperation and all - round rejuvenation , and better meet the challenges of economic globalization and fierce international competition .
the existence of the historical problem between china and japan has a very big impact on their diplomatic relations and on the feelings of their peoples .
chinese consistent attitude to historical problems is " take history as a reference and look to the future . "
there is an old saying " past experience , if not forgotten , is a guide for the future . "
by taking history as a reference , one can look to the future ; evading and distorting history on the one hand seriously hurts people 's feelings in east asian countries which were victims , and on the other hand hits hard at japan 's national image and hampers the progress of japanese diplomacy .
the japanese people love peace and oppose war , and there are only a very few militarists ; the japanese people have the confidence and the ability to avoid repeating the mistakes of history .
the problem of history is a problem of understanding for the japanese people , and in the final analysis the solution of this problem is determined by the japanese people 's own awareness , and requires time and patience .
the new generation in china and japan have now become the main body of society in both countries , and changes have taken place in the objects of the historical problem , so the method of dealing with them naturally needs readjusting .
friendship between the peoples of the two countries is the basis of sino - japanese relations .
the three generations of the chinese leadership have expounded at length in this respect .
before the establishment of new china , chairman mao zedong pointed out that " imperialist governments must be distinguished from the peoples of these countries . "
this not only expressed the demeanour of a great country , but was also a strategic policy decision based on the overall situation of sino - japanese friendship and china 's supreme national interests .
opposing japanese militarism is in the common interests of the chinese and japanese peoples .
at the same time , however , certain moves of japan in following the united states in its security strategy damage or threaten chinese interests .
japan is uneasy about china 's rapid rise and lacks mental preparations and a positive response attitude regarding the new pattern in east asia ; it is therefore extremely sensitive over china 's military security strategy and corresponding activities .
this is a new problem that has emerged in the new environment , which needs to be resolved through dialogue , consultation , and coordination between china and japan ; specific problems should not hamper overall cooperation , while methods based on sentiment do not help in the slightest to resolve problems .
there has been a lack of major sino - japanese cooperation projects since the 1990 's , but there are tremendous potentials for economic and trade cooperation between them ; the development of west china and china 's entry to the wto provide still more favorable opportunities for sino - japanese cooperation .
japanese business circles should take a long - term view and adopt a still more open attitude in the field of technology cooperation .
the older generation of leaders from the era of normalization of sino - japanese relations is gradually dying out , and it is extremely important to cultivate new forces , and especially young people , for sino - japanese friendship .
china and japan need economic cooperation , and still more do they need mutual political trust ; they need fund and material input , and still more do they need emotional investment .
at the turn of the century , the national condition and the condition of the peoples of china and japan are in the process of change and readjustment , and sino - japanese relations are also in an extremely crucial period .
premier zhu 's visit to japan is extremely timely and important .
we believe that the leaders of the two countries can take a broad and long - term view , grasp the overall situation , and firmly propel onward the ship of sino - japanese friendship .

as china is the largest developing country and africa is the largest developing continent , their mutual strengthening of consultation and cooperation and joint pursuit of development will make a positive contribution to world peace and development and the progress and prosperity of mankind .

beijing , 12 october ( xinhua ) - - chinese president jiang zemin and algerian president abdelaziz boutefllika signed here today the " prc - algeria joint communique . "
they also discussed ways to strengthen the relationship between the two countries in a bid to establish a strategic cooperation that is in line with the interests of both countries .
the algerian side reiterates its support for china 's unremitting efforts to realize the peaceful reunification of taiwan with the motherland .
the two sides are willing to work together to constantly explore new and more effective ways and means of cooperation to deepen and widen their economic and trade relations .
the two sides agree that the government departments of the two countries should continue to create favorable conditions and provide convenience for the two - way trade and investment .
the two sides agree that marked and profound changes are taking place in the world today .
while international tension is easing as a whole ; the world is moving rapidly toward multi - polarity ; and economic globalization is fast advancing , it is the common desire of the people of the whole world to strive for peace and development .
china and algeria will work together to strengthen the unity and cooperation between the developing countries , to establish an equitable and just new world order , and to narrow the gap between the south and the north .
they unanimously agree that the right to life is a fundamental human right , and that it is an internal affair of a sovereign country . each sovereign country has the right , in accordance with its own national conditions , to choose the mode of human rights promotion and protection .
the two sides call on the international community to pay more attention to africa and invest more there .
the two sides believe that the african people will , through their own efforts and with the help of the international community , embark on a road of tranquillity and development in the new century .
his excellency president bouteflika expresses admiration for his excellency president jiang zemin 's efforts in consolidating and strengthening china - africa relations . he also expresses appreciation for china 's cancellation of debts owed by the most underdeveloped and poorest african countries .
the two heads of state are pleased to see the success of the forum on china - african cooperation held in beijing from october 10 to 12 , and agree that the forum has invigorated the south - south cooperation and opened up bright prospects for the establishment of partnership between the developing countries .
both sides are willing to make joint efforts to strengthen the role of the united nation in maintaining international peace and safety and to support all types of efforts for the peaceful solution of regional conflicts .

beijing , 13 oct ( xinhua ) - - statistics from the people 's bank of china show that in the first three quarters of this year , china 's financial sector maintained its healthy development momentum , with money supply growing steadily .
this indicates that the current money supply is adequate and appropriate .
the outstanding amount of money in circulation ( m0 ) at the end of september was 1.3895 trillion yuan , up 13.4 percent from the same period last year .
in the first nine months , the amount of net cash input was 43.9 billion yuan , or 61.2 billion yuan less than the same period last year .
the amount of cash input in september alone was 51.6 billion yuan , 34.4 billion yuan less than the same period last year .
in the first nine months , new individual housing and consumption loans reached 166.3 billion yuan , 102.1 billion yuan more than the same period of last year . they accounted for 38 percent of all the new loans by financial institutions , a clear indication of the change of the financing structure .
financial institutions also vigorously increased loans for infrastructure projects and technological upgrading in support of the implementation of the state policy to boost domestic demand .
the exchange rate of renminbi at the end of september was steady at one us dollar for 8.2790 yuan .

beijing , 14 oct ( xinhua ) - - the project of diverting water from huang he to tianjin was completed successfully . on 13 october , huang he 's weishan sluice gate was opened , beginning to transmit water to tianjin .
despite great efforts to save water , it is expected that tianjin will lack 300 to 400 million cubic meters of water by next year 's flood season .
to ease the serious water shortage of tianjin , the state council decided to transmit water to tianjin to meet the urgent need .
since the 1970 's , the state has diverted water from huang he to tianjin on five occasions .
the major tasks of the current emergency transmission project are to dredge and dig canals and river courses , to rebuild and reinforce water transmission buildings , and to plug water entrances along rivers .
as of 10 october , hebei and shandong completed 6.2 million cubic meters of earthwork , 120,000 cubic meters of stonework , and 22,000 cubic meters of concrete work .
the related projects in tianjin also met the transmission requirements .
while carrying out the project , pertinent departments of the state council closely coordinated with each other and made concerted efforts to ensure the smooth progress of the construction .
the ministry of water resources was responsible for organizing the construction of this project , made specific arrangements for various items of work , strengthened the regulation and management of the volume of huang he water , and sent work teams on many occasions to inspect and guide the work along the water transmission lines .
the state development planning commission and the ministry of finance intensified the examination of investment and operational expenses and allocated money to the right place in a timely manner .
the state power company raised the volume of discharged water of liujiaxia hydropower station in a timely manner .
tianjin , hebei , and shandong took the overall situation into account and mobilized the vast numbers of cadres and the masses to work hard for more than one month , thus ensuring the accomplishment of this project on schedule .
this is a vivid manifestation of the superiority of socialist system .
all provinces and municipalities along this line should continue to carry forward the spirit of unity and coordination in order to ensure that huang he water will be transmitted to tianjin in good quality , in full amount , and on schedule .
at 1505 on 13 october , wen jiabao came to huang he 's weishan sluice gate , the source of the waters of this project , and opened the sluice gate . then , the waters of huang he began rolling to tianjin .
also joining the inspection were liu jiang and wang shucheng , responsible comrades of the pertinent departments of the state council .

zhu rongji pointed out : the south - to - north water diversion project is an exceptionally large infrastructure project designed to solve the problem of serious water - resource shortage in the north of china .
ours is a country lacking water resources ; at the same time , the distribution of water resources is uneven in terms of time and regions .
many rivers and lakes have dried up , ground water has been overused , the ground has sunk or caved in some places , and the water body pollution has been serious .
in some areas , water shortages have resulted in the deterioration of the ecological environment , directly endangering the health of the people .
to solve the problem of serious water shortage , the relevant departments under the state council have since the 1950 s organized experts in various circles to conduct long - time surveys , investigations , and feasibility studies on diverting water from the south to the north .
therefore , there are conditions for divert some water from chang jiang to the north .
giving briefings on south - to - north water diversion at this discussion meeting were wang shucheng , minister of water resources ; tu yourui , chairman of the board of directors of the china international engineering consulting company ; and liu jiang , vice minister of the state development planning commission .
they gave comprehensive briefings on investigations , research , and feasibility studies on the south - to - north water diversion project and views on the building of the project conducted or provided by departments and experts concerned .
according to the briefings , there are three plans - - the western - , central - , and eastern - line plans - - for divert water from the south to the north .
in many localities , the flood irrigation of farmland is adopted , the consumption of water by industrial production is too excessive , and the waste of water by city residents in daily life is also alarming .
we must conscientiously make plans and set objectives for water saving ; under no circumstance must we allow the occurrence of a phenomenon in which water is diverted and wasted in a big way .
the key is to set up a mechanism for the formation of rational water rates , and we should give full play to the role of water rates as a lever .
we should gradually raise the water rates by a relatively big margin , which will be the most effective measure for economizing on water .
once the ecological equilibrium is lost , it will be very difficult to restore it .
particularly in areas from which water is diverted , close attention must be paid to the effects of water diversion on their ecological environment . careful consideration must be given to protecting the ecological environment before the water diversion project can be started .
now there are basic conditions for speeding up the construction of the south - to - north water diversion project .
meanwhile , accelerating the building of some major infrastructure projects can effectively stimulate domestic demand and develop the estate market , and it also can increase the staying power for sustainable development and promote a sound circle of economic activities .
we should conscientiously study and thoroughgoingly implement the gist of the fifth plenary session , boldly engage ourselves in practice in the light of realistic conditions , pay close attention to implementation , forge ahead in a pioneering spirit , and win new victories in china 's reform , opening up , and modernization building in the new century .
in the face of the new situation , wherein new and high technologies are growing rapidly , the trend of economic globalization is undergoing a constant development , and international competitions are becoming increasingly acute , we must seize the present opportunity and speed up our development , wu bangguo stressed .
we must lose no time in accelerating the strategic readjustment of the country 's economic structure ; do a good job in industrial restructuring and transformation , and in optimizing and upgrading the structure of our industries ; and vigorously develop new and high technologies , and further improve our ability of technological innovation .
meanwhile , we must use new and high technologies , as well as advanced applied technologies , to transform traditional industries ; and strive to enhance both the overall quality and the international competitiveness of our industries .
at the same time , we will introduce the strategy of " going out " ; encourage and support , by different means , those qualified enterprises to make investments or set up factories outside the country and to participate in international competitions .

while celebrating the victory of our proposition , we should also think over the true meaning of development right and let our people and government officials understand its implication .
in the era of the planned economy , development right was , in fact , comprehended as the " government 's development right . "
at the present stage , the old economic system is undergoing changes , and the people 's decisionmaking right on development is being established and began to be gradually safeguarded .
however , we have to note that the old concept of development right has not been fundamentally shaken , and the masses ' actual decisionmaking right on development has yet to be protected through institutional building .
a major harm of neglecting the autonomy of the masses ' development right is that it has " facilitated " the emergence of some officials ' corrupt behaviors and deepened the social contradictions .
this kind of " farms " are the falsified products of the power relationship , because the risks have totally fallen on the peasants , while the township and town governments almost can ensure stable yields despite drought or flood .
the substitution of the " government development right " for the peasants ' right to make decisions on development is the major cause of the languished rural economy in some localities .
in order to promote development , the government can conduct propaganda and give demonstrations , but it cannot resort to coercion or issue arbitrary orders .
second , the foundation of development right is property right .
without the protection to property right , how can we talk about development ?
in some localities , the development right of peasants has been trampled on wantonly , which has led to their loss of development ability . the fundamental reason is that their property right on land has not been protected .
although the principle of fairness itself is a very abstract idea , yet the basic rules contained in the market economic structure have been universally agreed upon as ones that are most capable of embodying fairness , even if many of them are still less than satisfactory .
although the government is not the main body of development right , still it is the organ to effectuate the protection of development right .
second , providing material guarantee to achieving the people 's decisionmaking right on development , particularly the material public goods that the people are unable to supply .
what the government provide to the social development in these two aspects are the most important things of a public nature , and the so - called " taking the public ownership as the leading factor " should be embodied here .
frankly speaking , with society advancing to the present stage , the government has already found it difficult to cope with the above two tasks , how is it still capable of directly entering the development competition ?

beijing , 15 oct - a military simulation system of the current advanced international level in the form of an online exercise technological platform has been manufactured after six years of development jointly carried out by dozens of the whole army 's academies and schools and scientific research units .
this was the first time our army used a computer simulation system to organize a large scale , joint antagonistic training , the staff members ' " six joints " [ liu hui ] operations , and remote teaching between commanding officers ' headquarters of various arms and services located in different places .
the online drills exchange organized by the general staff department was a major content of the army - wide activities to exchange achievements in conducting scientific and technological training .
the main feature of this online training was reliance on the net , interchange by steps [ fen bu jiao hu ] , counteractions from different localities , and virtual reality .
it enabled command posts of the training to simultaneously carry out , over the simulation net and from their different locations but under identical battlefield conditions , joint training of various arms and services in antagonistic operations .
the university 's president xing shizhong and political commissar wang maorun served as the general directors of the online leading organs for the counteraction exercises .
this online drill , which has been a coagulation of the collective wisdom of the whole army , is a pioneering undertaking in the history of training of our army . it has four characteristics . first , the overall design aimed high .
second , technology of the means used for demonstration was new .
the latest military models , computer network and intelligence technology were employed for this online demonstration . the fact that computer network environment was used as the carrier marked a giant , historical step our army has taken in developing the method of military training .
third , achievements in subject study were solid .
fourth , exercise results were better .
there cannot be any trace of fake when carrying out training , which is the preparation for real war .
it is necessary to stick closely to the requirements of a real war in studying and training for method of operation that guarantees victory , stick closely to the reality in summing up experiences in online training , and promote translating achievements in scientific and technological training into fighting power .
in addition , it was also decided to transfer and assign political cadres to departments that bear a heavy academic workload .
this surely will boost the opinion and strengthen ideological and political construction throughout military academies and universities .
this is the central military important guiding principle for this strategic work .

with regard to the urban and rural structure , during the 20 and more years of reform and opening up , china 's urban and rural economy has developed at high speed , but the division between town and countryside has continued , while the progress of urbanization has slowed down .

when the democratic progressive party 's [ dpp ] chen shui - bian was taipei mayor , the taipei education board promoted " mother - tongue teaching materials , " which was a language and cultural movement aimed at cultivating " taiwan independence thinking . "
it is absolutely not worth refuting such a twisted logic since people can understand all about it if they visit southern fujian .
thirteen years ago , returning from an early mourning walk , a taiwan political science professor who was visiting xiamen told me excitingly in hometown dialect , saying , " old townsfolk , it is incredible !
people in xiamen speak in our taiwan language . taiwan 's influence on the mainland is really great . "
only after i told him that the " taiwan language " was actually fujian 's meinan dialect that he began to realize the fact .
as a matter of fact , many taiwan people , including myself , have been through the same experience .
the root of the meinan dialect can be traced back to china 's central plain .
meinan people say they are " heluo people " ( or fulao people ) , and they speak the heluo dialect ( or the fulao dialect ) .
" heluo " refers to the huanghe [ the yellow river ] and the luohe [ the luo river ] in the central plain .
the hakkas see the central plain as their " home town . "
dialects , like languages , differ from standard language in that they are used in a certain area ; they are spoken languages of an area and absolutely should not be considered low - class or backward , and they meet the requirements of day - to - day personnel exchanges in certain areas .
it was wrong of the taiwan authorities in the past to punish those who spoke dialects at schools and in public places .
debasing and suppressing dialects has only hurt the taiwan people 's feelings and caused a sense of antagonism among the populace .
we firmly oppose the taiwan authorities ' past practices .
for instance : first , the taiwan dialect can be spoken but cannot be put into written form . some are trying to " create " a written form of the taiwan dialect , claiming that " just 90 to 100 hours of training in taiwan language reading is enough to write in the taiwan language . "
as there is no granting of a patent for " creating " a language and anyone can " create " a language , it will easily lead to chaos .
we are now in the information age . with constant scientific and technological development , people not only have to speak with one another , they also need to give verbal commands to machines .
third , seen from the perspective of the history of the chinese language , the " national language " and taiwan 's local dialect " both evolved from the ancient chinese language and are " tributaries " of the river .
artificially tearing history apart , making the taiwan dialect an official language , regarding the " national language " as a language for barbarians , and branding a hostile " ethnic " stamp on the " national language " are harmful to the peaceful co - existence of various ethnic groups on taiwan .
remember that one important factor in ethnic conflicts in the world is language differences .
the utilization rate of dialects is falling .
in feudal society , one 's accent could not be changed at will . there is a saying , " i would rather sell my house than change my accent . "
now such a language concept has become much weaker .
at the same time , mandarin seeks constant nourishment and enrichment from dialects .
the same also applies to japan , where young people no longer speak dialects .
i think it is the law of the development of dialects , which cannot be changed by human will .

editor 's note : popularizing scientific knowledge , advocating scientific thought and the scientific method , and propagating the scientific spirit have received increasingly broad attention in recent years .
comrade jiang zemin has emphasized that propagating the scientific spirit is fundamental .
the cpc has traditionally paid serious attention to the powerful force of the scientific spirit . marx consistently regarded science as a driving force and a revolutionary force in history .
this force is both a material force and a spiritual force .
science " goes with philosophy , on the one hand , and practice , on the other . "
according to engels , the marriage of science and philosophy resulted in materialism , the age of enlightenment , and the political revolution in france .
the marriage of science and practice resulted in the industrial revolution and the social revolution in england .
the 21 st century is just around the corner . as a revolutionary force that propels history forward , science is set to play a powerful role unimaginable to people in the past .
scientific knowledge , scientific thinking , the scientific method , and the scientific spirit permeate one another and are intermingled with one another , forming an integrated whole , a spiritual force .
two major slogans were sounded during the new cultural movement of the may 4 era , namely democracy and science .
he enumerated the various superstitious phenomena of the times and concluded that " only science can completely cure us of such thinking devoid of common sense and such unreasoned beliefs . "
writing in xiang jiang commentary , mao zedong praised chen duxiu as " the star of the ideological community " and said , " the countrymen believe in spirits and ghosts , superstitious phenomena , fatalism , and power .
they totally deny there is the individual , there is the self , and there is the truth .
both chen duxiu and mao zedong were talking about the role of science in the spiritual realm , in opposing superstition .
all of that still has instructive significance for us today .
the scientific spirit is the essential stuff that makes science science , that enables science to move forward continuously .
writing in keji daobao , cai decheng sums up the scientific spirit to include five major elements : objective basis , rational skepticism , multidisciplinary thinking , debate on the basis of equality , and empirical testing .
i myself have offered the following definition : the scientific spirit means respecting facts , respecting the truth , opposing superstition , opposing blind obedience ; it means innovating and breaking new ground ceaselessly ; it means opposing conservatism and sticking to old ways ; it means empirical testing , critical rational thinking , and free discussion .
if we are to summarize the scientific spirit using the simplest language and in terms familiar to the most people in this country , we should say that the most fundamental thing about the scientific spirit is seeking truth from facts .
" advocate seeking truth from facts , advocate objective truth , advocate consistency between theory and practice . " mao zedong 's " three advocates " exactly define the scientific spirit for us .
" take practice as the only criterion of determining the truth . " the great debate on the criterion of truth advocated and supported by deng xiaoping precisely embodies the scientific spirit of seeking truth from facts and approaching marxism with a scientific attitude .
shishi [ 1395 0057 ] refers to facts that exist in reality . qiushi [ 3061 2508 ] means exploring and seeking truth that reflects objective reality and objective laws . shishi qiushi means respecting science that reflects objective facts , objective laws , and objective truth .
superstition and blind obedience , on the other hand , mean obsessively believing in and blindly following some established ideas . one is so fettered by these ideas that one fails to question whether they are in line with reality , whether they are rational , and whether they stand the test of practice .
in terms of ideological line , historically our victories derived from seeking truth from facts , while our errors and setbacks came about because we went against seeking truth from facts .
deng xiaoping led our party in bringing order out of chaos , correcting its errors , and returning to mao zedong 's correct path . he particularly emphasized that seeking truth from facts was the essence of mao zeong thought .
seeking truth from facts is also the essence of deng xiaoping theory .
the practice that determines the truth of scientific theories is experimentation , not performance .
yet some gurus that propagate mystical powers are crazy about performances in halls and living rooms and on dining tables .
after watching a performance , some people love broadcasting to others what they have seen , saying , " i have seen it , so it must be true . "
or they may say , " if you do n't believe it , you do not recognize facts and science . "
however , performance belongs in the realm of magic , entertainment , and leisure activities .
we should make people understand that only things that are designed in accordance with the scientific method , are justifiable to the scientific community throughout their process and in all their conditions , and can be inspected and verified by the scientific community can be confirmed as facts that have significance in scientific research .
science is full of vitality and innovativeness precisely because it continuously breaks new ground and blazes the trail .
the history of science is nothing other than the history of endless innovation and ground - breaking in practice as well as in theory .
these days one year is equivalent to decades , a century and even longer in the ancient society .
if one does not carry on with marxism and refine it with new thinking and new ideas , one is not a true marxist . "
sticking to conventions will only lead to backwardness and even failure .
but there are two kinds of skeptical critical spirit . one is a scientific skeptical critical spirit , the other is an unscientific or anti - scientific skeptical critical spirit .
the latter is divorced from the source of practice and testing and rests on subjective speculation ; in terms of cognitive theory , it is relativism that rejects objective truth .
the history of science is littered with theories that have been superseded by facts .
why ca n't we innovate , break new ground , and start a scientific revolution ?
as a matter of fact , the critical issue in the debate is not whether or not existing science can achieve a breakthrough , but whether those mysterious phenomena trumpeted by some people are all empirical facts or observed facts verifiable through the scientific method .
only when people command scientifically verified facts would the question arise as to whether or not something is explainable by modern science .
what is also at issue here is the relations between old and new theories in scientific development , the law of the evolution of old theories into new theories .
the evolution of old theories into new theories is not a matter of total repudiation . rather , the scientific content of the original theories should be incorporated into the new theories .
combining the scientific spirit with the humanistic spirit even as the scientific community emphasizes the propagation of the scientific spirit , another loud voice is being heard calling for the humanistic spirit .
our party also emphasizes the need to put the building of the spiritual civilization in a more prominent strategic place .
the spiritual civilization has two major components : science , education , and culture , on the one hand , and ideals , ethics , and discipline , on the other .
pondering on the lesson we should learn from the rise of superstition and pseudo - science , many comrades have said that our education falls short not only because there is not enough scientific spirit , but also because there is not enough humanistic spirit .
the meaning of life , the pursuits of life , its purpose , ideals , beliefs , ethics , values , things like that . all that is noble , virtuous , and healthy in these things is the humanistic spirit we want to propagate .
birth , getting old , sickness , death , the vicissitudes of lie , success , failure , opportunity , risk . when a person lacks a scientifically enlightened attitude and lofty philosophical sentiments when confronted with the ups and downs of life , he will readily fall captive to mysticism and superstition .
we should not regard the humanistic spirit and scientific spirit as mutually exclusive .
otherwise , we would easily drift into mysticism and anti - rationalism .
the birth of modern science liberated man from the bondage of theocracy . was n't that full of the humanistic spirit ?
the fine tradition of ethics in the scientific community is another kind of precious humanistic spirit .
in the past as in the present , in china as in foreign countries , outstanding individuals in the scientific community fight hard for the truth , for science , for human progress . bursting with the spirit of sacrifice , they are ready to give up their lives .

at a time when the world soon steps into a new century , china releases a long white paper on the state of its national defense .
the white paper , which has more than 30,000 chinese characters , examines and analyzes the whole situation . the document has attracted worldwide attention .
the white paper has seven parts , including the foreword ; but it has devoted three parts to examining the taiwan issue .
the emphasis that the white paper has placed on the taiwan issue shows beijing 's attention to the issue .
the full name of the white paper is " china 's national defense in 2000 . "
although it provides a comprehensive review of the situation of china 's national defense , people are primarily concerned with how it approaches the taiwan issue . not only taiwan 's media , but also hong kong 's newspapers have directed their greatest attention to this issue and have given it prominent space .
when relaxation has suddenly appeared in the korean peninsula , a region that used to be considered the source of unrest , as result of the rapprochement between north and south korea , people have become increasingly concerned with the taiwan issue .
just as the white paper states , factors of instability and uncertainty in the world have noticeably increased , and the world is not peaceful at all .
one of the " factors of instability and uncertainty " is the " complex and grave situation in the taiwan strait . "
the white paper states the motherland 's taiwan policy and the mainland 's position on settling the taiwan issue ; and it analyzes the current situation in the taiwan strait . the gravity , danger , and urgency of the issue are thought - provoking .
while reporting the white paper , newspapers in both hong kong and taiwan have paid special attention to this statement : " taiwan independence " means provoking war again , and fomenting splits means relinquishing peace across the strait .
" taiwan independence " means war .
the first one who expressed this view was state council vice premier qian qichen , who is in charge of hong kong and taiwan affairs .
with respect to opposing " taiwan independence " and safeguarding state sovereignty and territorial integrity , china 's position has always been firm , and its stand has always been resolute . if chen shui - bian [ chen shuibian ] and his supporters harbor any illusions at all , they are absolutely to no avail .
the white paper again mentions the three " if " situations - - the three situations where china will use force .
this change of one single character word tells that the mainland is treating taiwan equally and is not acting like a big place swallowing up a small place .
the change of one character fully indicates the mainland 's good will and sincerity for peaceful reunification as well as the mainland 's treatment for taiwan on an equal footing .
huge flower - like parachutes with vehicles for shock tactics that weighed several tonnes hanging on them reached the ground . paratroopers , who looked like twinkling stars , assembled while they were coming down . once the paratroopers jumped into the vehicles for shock tactics , the vehicles dashed toward the " enemy 's " positions nearby .

meanwhile , under the international background of the western community once again disseminating the " theory of china threat " from which a great clamor has arisen , what is the special significance for the chinese government to publish one more white paper at a time when a new century is arriving very soon ?
publishing white papers on national defense is an important pattern for strengthening international dialogues and cooperation .
especially , under the condition of the times focusing on peace and development , this practice is adopted by more and more countries and has formed a kind of international practice .
the white paper entitled , " china 's arms control and disarmament , " published by the chinese government in 1995 and the white paper entitled , " china 's national defense , " published in 1998 have evoked active repercussions and produced excellent results at home and abroad .
and this new white paper on national defense can more comprehensively reflect the development situation of china 's national defense in recent years .
this white paper entitled " the national defense of china " has organically integrated history with the reality and very convincingly refuted this fallacy with objective facts and detailed and accurate data .
china is the largest developing country in the world .
china is a responsible major country and a staunch force for safeguarding world peace and stability .
answer : undoubtedly , the judgment about the international security situation and china 's security environments is a premise for formulating its national defense policy .
this was the kernel content of the national defense policy at that time . however , since the 80 s , a situation of overall peace and stability has emerged in the grand international environment and china 's peripheral environment and local warfare has become a major threat of war .
on the aspect of guidance on military strategy , we have changed from basing ourselves on preparing to cope with large - scale enemy invasions to focusing on coping with local warfare and military conflicts which might happen .
situation and environment are constantly changing .
however , no matter how these changes are taking place , the defensive nature of china 's national defense policy will not change .
meanwhile , the social system , development strategy , and living styles which are chosen by china and compatible to its national conditions will not generate factors for conducting external aggression and expansion .
answer : china 's national defense expenses for 2000 amount to $ 14.6 billion , which is only equivalent to 5 percent of those of the united states , 30 percent of japan , 40 percent of the united kingdom , 48 percent of france , and 64 percent of germany .
china 's national defense expenses are mainly comprised of three parts : personnel living expenses , operation maintenance expenses , and equipment expenses .
the safeguard scope of china 's national defense expenses include both forces on active service and militiamen and forces on reserve duty as well as social expenditures like providing for some retired officers and education of army men 's children , and so on .
these are not included in the national defense expenses of other countries .
what do you think about these kinds of queries ?
however , the defensive nature of national defense policy and the determination of safeguarding national interests are unified .
if anyone wantonly infringes upon china ' sovereignty and seriously endangers china 's security , china has the right to adopt means which it deems necessary , including military means , to launch resolute counterattacks .
fundamentally speaking , china ensuring the scale of its armed forces is based on safeguarding national security and interests .
and the scale of armed forces should not be lower than the need of the national security and interests .
a series of incidents like these have alerted the chinese people and made china quicken its steps of national defense and army modernization .
question : following hong kong and macao who have returned to the motherland in succession , resolving the taiwan issue and eventually realizing the great cause of reunification of the motherland has seemed increasingly urgent .
and people have noticed that in generally stating china 's national defense policy , the white paper of " china 's national defense in 2000 " has added a paragraph of text to especially expound the basic propositions of the chinese government about the taiwan issue .
in your view , on the issue of taiwan what kind of military standpoint has this white paper of " china 's national defense in 2000 " transmitted to the people of the world ?
answer : the white paper of national defense has especially emphasized : resolving the issue of taiwan and realizing the complete reunification of china is in the fundamental interests of the chinese nation .
china always upholds the principle of one china and employs the basic guiding principle of " peaceful reunification and one country , two systems " as well as jiang zemin 's eight - point proposition about developing cross - strait relations and pushing forward the progress of peaceful reunification of the motherland to resolve the issue of taiwan .
the chinese government endeavors to seek realizing national reunification by peaceful means but does not pledge giving up the use of force .
making taiwan independent means stirring up a war once again and creating disintegration means giving up peace between the two shores .
on issues relating to state sovereignty and security , china never makes concession and compromise .
possessing nuclear weapons for purpose of self defense question : the us government has proposed developing and deploying nmd and tmd , which has made people in the world worried about the strategic balance among nuclear countries . people are concerned about whether china will reposition its nuclear policy as a result .
answer : the white paper has reemphasized china 's consistent nuclear policy , namely pledging not to be the first to use nuclear weapons , not to use or threaten to use nuclear weapons against non - nuclear countries , not to participate in nuclear arms race , and not to deploy nuclear weapons abroad .
it is completely out of the need for self defense that china possesses a small amount of nuclear weapons .
on this basis , the white paper has further explicitly pointed out that china maintaining a small number of but highly efficient nuclear weapons is for containing any possible nuclear attacks against china by other countries . any of this kind of behavior will result in china launching retaliatory nuclear counterattacks .
army building : reducing quantity but improving quality question : since the founding of new china , china has on many occasions unilaterally cut down the number of its army , which has caught widespread attention of the people in the world .
would you please tell us the starting point of china 's large - scale disarmament ?
and what is china 's basic line of thinking and focus in developing conventional armed forces ?
answer : as far as the conventional armed forces are concerned , china has endeavored to control its quantity and scale within the scope which is necessary for safeguarding national security and permitted by its national strength and unilaterally cut down the number of its army on many occasions .
afterwards , readjustments were made in succession , and the scale of its army was further reduced .
by the end of 1999 , china announced to have completed the task of further cutting down the number of its army by 0.5 million . at present , the general scale of the chinese people 's army is maintained at 2.5 million troops .
this aspect has reflected the defensive nature of china 's national defense as well as the good wish of the chinese people for peace and stability .
as china is a big country with a population of 1.2 billion people , the scale of its army is very small according to the proportion of its population .
moreover , the chinese army also includes those frontier and sea defense troops , military service mobilization organs , farms management organs , nonmilitary personnel , and the active personnel of reserve duty , who are all not included in the army in many countries .
in his article entitled , " the historical experiences regarding the building of the army over 20 years , " chairman jiang zemin deeply pointed out : " as our country is vast in territory and complex in landform , due to relatively backward equipment functions and low mobility , the army needs to maintain a certain scale .
along with the rapid changes and progresses of science and technology as well as the resultant accelerated development in military reform in the world and the unprecedented improvement of the effectiveness of weaponry systems , strengthening the quality building of our army seems increasingly important and urgent .
a basic guiding principle for the modernization building of the army is reducing quantity and improving quality .
because the price for modernized , especially high - tech , weaponry and equipment is very expensive and our country is still not yet wealthy , in a period of time the input in national defense still cannot completely meet the need of the building of national defense .
the live drama " extracting teeth from a tiger 's mouth " was played out by a certain " heroic " tank unit under the beijing military region .
the predecessor of this tank unit is northeast tank battalion , our army 's first tank unit formed on 1 december 1945 at majia wanzi . battle hero dong laifu who commanded the " heroic " tank named by the central military commission came from this unit .
the driving speed of the retrofitted " heroic " tanks have doubled , and the tanks ' effective cruising range and the first shell hit rate have risen considerably . the armored unit has also performed maneuvers including on - the - move firing , long - distance shooting , and beyond - sight attacks .

on deepening reform and expanding opening up to the world in the final analysis , restructuring and economic development depend on reforms .
the " proposals " make all - round arrangements in view of the new situation facing us during the 10 th five - year plan .
first , we must unswervingly deepen the reforms of the state - owned enterprises .
the most important thing is to establish a modern enterprise system , promote the share - holding system revamp , and intensify scientific management .
we must encourage large and medium - sized state enterprises to put into effect the share - holding system through a variety of ways such as regulated listing , chinese - foreign joint ventures , and mutual purchase of shares .
at the same time , put on a sound basis the enterprise corporate administrative structure , deepen reforms within the enterprises , and establish effective incentive and constraint mechanisms .
an important problem that must be resolved in promoting the reform of state enterprises is to truly effect separation of government and enterprises , otherwise the enterprises cannot become main players ion market competition .
under the socialist market economy setup , the task and function of the government is to enforce the law and management and to concentrate efforts on doing a good job in macro regulation and control and creating a good market environment , and not to directly intervene in the enterprises ' operational activities .
all enterprises must attach importance to management and strengthen it , administer the enterprises in strict fashion , resolutely turn around the universal situation of backward management , slack discipline , and chaotic order , and improve the standard of scientific management .
second , we must uphold the basic economic system of having public ownership as the mainstay along with the development of economy under a variety of ownership systems .
pluralism in the ownership structure is required by the multilevel nature of the standard of the productive forces .
we should break down department and sector monopolies and regional blockades , establish and perfect as soon as possible a nationally unified market setup of equal competition and regulated order , and give full play to the basic role of the market in resource allocation and restructuring .
during the 10 th five - year plan , we should focus on fostering and developing the market in key elements , and regulate and develop the securities market .
fourth , we should strengthen and improve macro regulation and control .
we should adopt corresponding macroeconomic measures in light of the changes in the macroeconomic situation .
of course , we must also pay attention to guarding against financial ; risks and inflation .
china 's opening up will enter a new stage during the 10 th five - year plan period .
positive efforts should be made to attract foreign multinational companies to invest in china , set up technological development centers , and participate in reorganization and transformation of state - owned enterprises .
it is not necessary for the chinese side to hold a controlling share in joint ventures , except in important ones that concern national security and the economic lifelines of the country .
we should resort to diverse ways to encourage and support enterprises with the necessary conditions to invest and set up factories outside china in order to give impetus to exports or seek partners in the exploitation of resources .
efforts should be made to raise the level of consumption , expand the spheres of consumption , and optimize the consumption structure .
special attention should be paid to the improvement of the living conditions , transportation and communications of urban and rural inhabitants and to the provision of more consumer services .
we should also improve the quality of the environment , provide better medical care , establish a good social order , and see to it that people can live and work in peace .
an important link in improving people 's livelihood is to create more jobs and increase people 's income .
we should make continuous efforts to increase the income of urban and rural inhabitants , especially the income of low - income workers , on the basis of economic development .
the distribution of income is a major issue that we must exert to resolve under the new situation .
the " proposal " gives detailed explanations on this question , pointing that with the development of the productive forces , scientific and technological work and management now play an increasingly important role in social production as important forms of labor .
we should encourage the participation of production factors such as capital and technology in the distribution of income , and establish and improve mechanisms of incentives and constraints for the distribution of income .
fourth , we should make careful preparation for the transition to the new social security system .
we should make unremitting efforts to conduct education on the party 's basic theory and basic line and carry forward the spirit of patriotism , collectivism and socialism in order to form and consolidate a common ideal and spiritual pillar in our community .
importance should be attached to the study and guidance of different trends of thought in society as well as their different forms of expression , and efforts should be made to strengthen the building and management of various ideological and cultural positions , especially news websites .
the dissemination of popular science should be stepped up and energetic efforts should be made to unfold activities of promoting cultural and ethical progress among the masses .
we should uphold the principles of putting social benefits above everything else and combining social benefits with economic benefits , deepen the cultural reform , and continue to implement and improve policies in support of cultural undertakings .
we should unswervingly uphold and improve our basic political system .
in keeping with the requirements of economic restructuring and modernization , we should continue to promote the reform of the political system and strengthen the development of democracy and law .
we should make decisions more scientific and democratic , further expand grassroots democracy , and ensure that the masses can directly exercise their democratic rights according to law .
