q : can you suggest a solution to the current situation ?
a : there are two indicators for solving the problem of confidence : the first is the cross - strait policy , and the second is the problem of the fourth nuclear power plant .
for the cross - strait issue i think we should return to the 1992 consensus .
we should first talk about economic cooperation , then the mutual relationship will get closer and we will not drift apart from each other so that the chinese communists do not have to fear for our independence and use force on us .
with so much capital invested already , we should consider the sequelae of discontinuing the construction , especially the serious damage to the business reputation of our country , not to mention that to compensate 100 billion nt $ is a big loss .
this will fit both the policy program of the democratic progressive party and the reality . moreover , there should be a solution plan in the industrial and financial sectors .
when i visited bell lab in new york during my trip to the u.s. a few days ago , i found the forces expressed by the new economy in the u.s. came from these r & d units . but what worries me is that none of the r & d talent came from taiwan .
q : taiwan independence is viewed by others as the divine tablet of the democratic progressive party . but in an article you published recently you espouse forming a cross - strait common market . this seems to have deviated from the " no haste , be patient " policy when the nationalist party was in power .
now we should enter another stage because both sides are joining the world trade organization ( wto ) . the economic mode must face transformation and adjustment . under such circumstances , we must not use the old thinking to consider the cross - strait relationship . political leaders on both sides should recognize clearly this new situation .
during world war ii , german and france fought each other . before that there were wars between prussia and france . the enmity between the two countries was over a hundred years and it was all but over economic interests .
since 1987 the cross - strait political problems have never been solved , yet the cross - strait economy has been evidently joining together and is becoming more and more intimate .
in 14 years the amount of cross - strait trade has reached 275 billion u.s. dollars . there have been more than 40 thousand cases of taiwanese investments in china with a value reaching 50 billion u.s. dollars . cross - strait visits by the people have reached 27 million person - times .
after the tian ' anmen square incident in 1989 , the entire world withdrew capital from the mainland , and only taiwanese businessmen were entering the mainland . and thanks to the contributions by taiwanese businessmen , the mainland could generate an economic take - off after two or three years of reorganization .
at the same time , this is also beneficial for taiwan for taiwan had upgraded its industries and succeeded in economic transformation . now high - tech industries make up 70 percent of the exports and the labor - intensive industries have also found an outlet .
thus we have to return to the specific proposition in the 1992 consensus . if there were no consensus in 1992 , then how could there be the 1993 gu - wang talks ? as for the 1992 consensus , both sides must have already known exactly how things stand .
popularly elected president should respect people 's will q : what do you think of president chen shui - bian 's recent recurrent formulation of using " huaren " to replace " zhongguoren " as the term for chinese ?
a : i do not want to comment on this .
after i found out , i took advantage of the opportunity to make a suggestion to mr. chiang ching - kuo . later the executive yuan studied it and passed the three principles for transit trade through hong kong , to decriminalize it and legalize it . this is a practical way of doing things .
my view still needs to be discussed by various sectors [ of society ] . after the theory becomes more concrete , at least a consensus should be gathered domestically .
the plunging range of stock price has surpassed 40 percent . in the four months since the new government assumed power , the market value of capital has shrunk greatly . the influence in this aspect is too big . the second is the instability in the exchange rate .
now after the new government taking over , the exchange rate of the new taiwan dollar has reached that level . the third is bank loans are stagnating .
the fourth is that domestic investments are slowing down and major investments have almost stopped .
if the current economic situation does not improve , then the problem with unemployment will gradually appear . and the waiting period for getting a job has reached longer than half a year . the sixth is the rising commodity prices .
the eighth is the exodus of businesses . now many businesses have shut down factories and gone bankrupt . among them , the traditional industries have suffered from the impact most .
the tenth is the finance of the government has deteriorated and public constructions are stagnating or regressing . currently in the fundamental aspect of the economy , export and import trade is not bad .
however , this is mainly due to orders from the first half - year . the economic situation as a whole is deteriorating . stagnant inflation is in the forming . financial institutions are facing crises .
technical aspect , fundamental aspect and policy aspect q : some people think a nativistic financial storm may break out next year ?
take the case of beyer as another example , it was rejected by the local government which was in the hands of the democratic progressive party . this had caused international businesses to have reservations about the production and manufacturing environment in taiwan .

their conclusion is these alternative plans can not be expected to be the main source of power . for as important a policy as the fourth nuclear power plant , my suggestion is we should return to the fundamental aspect and let experts call the shots .
q : is there room for cooperation between the nationalist party and the people 's first party in the future ? a : there is still much time before the election next year . besides , the political situation changes so rapidly .
a typical case of the political operation of the semi - presidential system is france . but our country is different from france . so if it is implemented there will indeed be some incompatibility .
the implementation of the spirit of the constitution depends on the human will and the collaboration of the agency which interprets the constitution , but the human will is more important .

according to the third - step strategic objectives , our country 's per capita gross domestic product should reach the level of middle - level developed countries , with modernization being basically achieved .
to achieve this great strategic objective , the " proposal " calls for a 100 - percent increase of our country 's gross domestic product over 2000 in the first decade of the new century .
this means that our country 's average annual economic growth rate should be around 7 percent .
only in this way will it be possible to resist pressures applied by hegemonism and power politics , to safeguard national sovereignty and independence , and to continually improve china 's status and role in the international arena , so as to make greater contributions to the maintenance of world peace .

" more development , fewer problems ; less development , more problems ; no development , problems everywhere . "

the first five years of the new century will be an important period of economic and social development of our country .

"
as seen by people , the cpc central committee became determined to adopt all measures to improve our armed forces ' armaments immediately after the outbreak of the war to resist the united states and help korea .

therefore , in order to prevail at a low cost in a future high - tech local war against a modernized strong enemy , our armed forces must attach great importance to modernization construction of armaments in an effort to reduce the distance from any strong enemy .

it is better to have personnel wait for equipment than to have equipment wait for personnel .

seoul , 20 october (xna) - - chinese premier zhu rongji spoke at the third asia - europe meeting [ asem ] here today .
asem members have carried out fruitful dialog and cooperation in the political , economic , trade , scientific , technological , cultural , educational and other spheres , thus promoting understanding and friendship between the peoples of the two continents .
the asian economy has shown encouraging signs of recovery and european integration is steadily advancing .
in 1999 , the gross domestic product [ gdp ] of asem members was us $ 15,000 billion , about half of the world total .
steady economic growth and scientific and technological progress in asia and europe will instill new vitality into the all - round development of the asia - europe partnership .
in order to further expand cooperation between asia and europe in economy , trade , science , technology and other spheres , i propose that we should exert ourselves in the following directions : first , asia - europe cooperation in trade and investment should be expanded to meet the needs of the optimization of the industrial structure .
the current situation demands that new breakthroughs be made in economic cooperation between asia and europe .
next , further efforts should be made to promote cooperation in the financial field .
there should be mutually beneficial cooperation and exchanges aimed at consolidating financial control , strengthening the monitoring of international short - term capital flow , and training international financial and financial management personnel .
thirdly , both sides should further open up their markets . more positive steps should be taken to enlarge market access , reduce quantitative restrictions and eliminate non - tariff barriers so as to bring about a bigger growth in import and export trade between the two sides .
new developments have been made in scientific and technological cooperation between the two sides since the asem science ministers meeting in beijing in october 1999 .
the tapping of human resources is an important factor in promoting economic growth . it is also an important area for asia - europe cooperation .
institutes of higher learning on both sides should be encouraged to cooperate in scientific research and hold academic exchanges . cooperation between business circles in the training of management and technological innovation personnel should also be promoted .
developed countries among asem members have a leading edge in research and development in environmental technologies , while asian developing countries among the members are assigning increasing importance to sustainable development .
thus , there are good prospects for environmental cooperation between asia and europe .
the two sides should strengthen cooperation in increasing the overall productivity of agriculture , promoting technologies for the intensive processing of agricultural products and developing ecological agriculture .
fifth , positive efforts should be made to create the necessary conditions for the opening of new spheres of asia - europe cooperation .
china wishes to work for a brighter future for asia , europe and the world together with other asem members .

according to a report by the world health organization [ who ] , the ebola virus disease has broken out in northern uganda .
as of 18 october , 94 suspected patients of ebola virus were discovered , 39 of whom died already .
to control the epidemic situation , uganda 's ministry of health has set up a state - level quarantine team , and the who has dispatched epidemiological specialists to the epidemic area for conducting epidemiological survey and adopting control measures .
the incubation period of this disease is five to 14 days . its clinical symptoms include sudden fever , headache , muscle - ache , and corneal hyperemia .
another few days later , there may be the tendency of hemorrhaging with different degrees of seriousness . a hemorrhage can be regarded as the reason for death , but most patients may die of hepatic failure , renal failure , or other fatal complications .
and , the secretion and excreta of this person as well as the articles and things touched by him should be strictly sterilized or subject to other types of sanification .
because there is still no effective medicine or vaccine against this virus thus far , the information in regard to the epidemic situation and the consultations and service on international tourist sanitation and health care should be offered to the persons sent to the above - mentioned epidemic area .
after concluding his visit in japan , chinese premier zhu rongji on 17 october began a visit to the republic of korea , where he also attended the asia - europe meeting in seoul .
economic cooperation and trade between china and south korea constitute an important part of relations between the two countries .
to avoid the recurrence of a trade war such as the recent one on " garlic and telephone , " both sides agreed to establish a negotiation channel in order to prevent any trade dispute from occurring again .
as a mater of fact , sino - south korean trade has been developing rather fast in recent years . south korea has risen to be china 's fourth largest trade partner .
according to estimates of the chinese side , last year total volume of bilateral trade between china and south korea reached us $ 25.04 billion , up 25.8 percent over the previous year .
but trade deficit on the chinese side has been fairly serious , which amounted to us $ 9 billion last year .
for this reason , zhu rongji expressed the hope in his talks with both the president and prime minister of south korea that the south korean side will ease up its restrictions on chinese products , particularly farm products and coal , so as to reduce deficit on the chinese side .
the south korean leaders said they will adopt active measures to expand imports of chinese products .
according to figures released by the chinese side , investments made by south korean business circles in china have exceeded us $ 5 billion , ranking sixth in the amount of foreign capital imported by china .
in the past two years , investment made by south korean enterprises in china went down for a while due to the impact of financial crisis in asia but has increased recently .
in the several speeches he delivered in seoul , zhu rongji heaped praise on the summit meeting between south korea and north korea which has eased up the situation in the korean peninsula .
we give high appraisal of the political resolution made by president kim tae - chung and chairman kim chong - il and deeply respect you for your farsighterdness and sagacity .
kim tae - chung highly praised the efforts made by china in helping south korea and north korea to reconcile .
for this purpose , he held that south korea , north korea , china and the united states should continue to hold a four - party talk to discuss this problem and reach a unanimous agreement .
observers note that , because china has helped south korea and north korea to move toward reconciliation , the stalemate that came into shape during the cold war in northeast asia may undergo a gigantic change .
therefore , zhu rongji was happy to see these positive changes in the situation while visiting south korea and attending the asia - europe meeting .
the state council decided to conduct the fifth national census on 1 november this year .
the issue of population is always an important one that concerns the overall situation .
finding out the state of population is of great significance to the state 's work in formulating population , educational , and employment policies ; drawing up strategies and plans for national economic and social development ; correctly handling the relationships between population , resources , and economy ; and promoting sustainable development .
in finding out the total number , quality , and composition of china 's population as of 2000 , we are summing up the new china 's history of population development for a half century and laying the foundation for analyzing the state of population in future .
as china is the most populous country in the world , an accurate survey of china 's population is also an important contribution to finding out the world population .
the circumstances will be more complex and the task more arduous for the fifth national census in comparison to the previous four , as it will be conducted under the conditions of a socialist market economy now practiced in our country .
governments at all levels and all departments concerned must proceed from the overall situation of national interests to resolutely implement them without any reservation and widely publicize [ the census ] to make it known to every household and individual .

hong kong will not become the center for transferring illegal immigrants . it is not only because of the hong kong law enforcement authorities ' outstanding efforts and the close cooperation between the hong kong and foreign law enforcement organs , but also because of the effective communication and cooperation between hong kong and mainland china .
hong kong and mainland china have been maintaining close contacts and effective cooperation in dealing blows to international criminal activities of human smuggling .
the hotline telephones set up by the guangdong border defense department and the hong kong police may allow them to grasp the latest trends in human smuggling activities in guangdong and hong kong at any time .
the effective cooperation between both sides has not only greatly reduced the number of illegal immigrants to hong kong each year since the reversion of hong kong , but has also effectively dealt blows to international criminal cliques ' activities of transferring illegal immigrants to other countries via hong kong .
to effectively check and deal blows to this kind of criminal activities , all we can do is to exchange information with law enforcement departments in these three places where the organizations involved with illegal immigrants , as well as the transfer and reception organizations are located . only thus , can we achieve noticeable results .
in answering questions raised by reporters , chinese premier zhu rongji , who is visiting the rok , pointed out that human smuggling activities are controlled by international criminal cliques .
hence , it will not work to just rely on the efforts of one side . only by seeking cooperation from all sides and dealing blows to these activities with joint efforts can they be effectively checked .
premier zhu rongji 's statement once again showed that in resisting and attacking human smuggling criminal activities , china has always adopted a clear - cut attitude , firm stand , and vigorous measures .
this showed that the organization , transfer and reception of this batch of illegal immigrants was a one - line operation . to crack down and destroy all points on this line , it is necessary to strengthen international cooperation .
hong kong is an international transportation center , handling nearly 10,000 containers daily . it is no wonder why it has been used by international criminal cliques as the transfer port for illegal immigrants .
in fact , a considerable number of human smuggling cases were cracked in hong kong or cracked in foreign countries with information provided by hong kong .
the hong kong customhouses have a set of effective mechanisms for spot checking goods . this has enabled them to prevent snake heads from using containers to smuggle illegal immigrants .

the western forum of china will always have cooperation and exchanges as its substance , integrate the handling of concrete matters with the discussion of ideological guidelines , and serve as a window for opening to the outside world to vigorously advance the large - scale development of the western region .
the large - scale development of the western region has also widely aroused the international community 's close attention .
the central authorities determined that every year , the scowrd is to take the lead in conducting in the western region a large conference on the large - scale development of the western region .
sichuan has a population of 85 million as well as a relatively sound economic foundation , relatively solid economic strength , and relatively high levels of science , technology , and education .
the opening up and development as well as accelerated growth of sichuan province not only carry a big weight in the implementation of the strategy of developing the western region on a large scale but are of really great significance to the strategic structural readjustment of national economic development .
there was only four months ' time from the beginning of the preparations to the official opening of the " 2000 western forum of china . "
this could be proved by the fact that 1,700 persons have now signed in for the forum , the attendance at which was originally estimated to be 600 .
this support will mainly be in the areas of infrastructure development and ecological environmental protection and development .

emily lau , a legislative council [ legco ] member from " the frontier , " has always been an anti - china troublemaker in hong kong who acts truculently and arrogantly at legco .
realizing that she could take advantage of the opportunity , emily lau immediately took actions .
in late 1996 , she abruptly and groundlessly pointed fingers at the hong kong branch of xinhua at that time , saying that it had " blacklisted " her and kept a file of her personal information . in a letter sent through an attorney , she demanded xinhua to hand over the file to her .
director jiang enzhu did not assume his hong kong office until 1997 . when lau filed the lawsuit , zhou nan was the director of the hong kong branch of xinhua and jiang enzhu was still chinese ambassador to britain .
now , a year and a half have gone by after the court pronounced the verdict , emily lau has yet to pay the court the hk $ 1.6 million .
according to the hong kong law , if a litigant loses a lawsuit and refuses to pay the court expenses , the court has the authority to order his or her property be frozen and issue an " order of bankruptcy , " obligating the party concerned to sell his or her property to pay the unpaid fees .
if she can have her way , is it not true that she can act like a mad dog and file lawsuits against people everyday since the public will pay the bills ? of course , emily lau cannot possibly realize her wishful thinking .

as a matter of fact , according to the law , when a legco member is involved in financial or debt - related disputes , or has been ordered to declare bankrupt , he or she can no longer continue to serve as a legco member and must resign .

at today 's press conference for chinese and foreign reporters on the activity of " focusing on china 's zhejiang province - - a date with hangzhou , " governor chai songyue answered the reporters ' questions on the spot .
answer : state enterprise reform is the central link of china 's overall economic structural reform .
therefore , not only we but also the whole world are concerned about this issue .
state enterprises do not take up a large proportion in zhejiang .
judging by the composition of zhejiang 's industrial sector , state enterprises make up about 10 percent of the province 's industry .
today , state enterprises are still playing a leading role in a number of major industries and trades in the province which have a great bearing on the national economy and people 's livelihood , such as power , communications , postal and telecommunications services , and a number of major raw and semi - finished materials industries .
ever since the beginning of reform and opening up , our province has upheld the practice of mainly relying on the public - owned economy while vigorously promoting non - public - owned economies , and this practice has created conditions for us to properly handle the resettlement and the unemployment of laid - off workers from state enterprises .
according to relevant estimates , it should not be a big problem for zhejiang to attain a gdp growth of over 11 percent this year .
such a favorable situation has created important conditions for the province to create new jobs for its labor force , especially to ensure the reemployment of laid - off workers from state enterprises .
in the past , people tended to equate state enterprise workers to state cadres , and they were unwilling to take up jobs in ordinary service industries .
this can also be considered an important factor .
question raised by a reporter from the international broadcasting corporation of france : the 15 th cpc central committee has just held its fifth plenary session , at which it has drawn up a grand blueprint for china 's 10 th five - year plan .
our formulation of the plan will highlight two issues : one is the conscientious implementation of the gist of the " proposals " of the central authorities ; while the other is the need to link our implementation with the realistic economic and social development in zhejiang .
in other words , we will sum up the basic experiences that zhejiang has gained from its reform and opening up over the past more than 20 years and at the same time , conduct special studies and analyses of a number of predominant problems that are currently existing in zhejiang 's economic life .
in the face of these predominant problems , we will study them one by one and bring out corresponding solutions ; and on this basis , we will then determine the tasks that we should fulfill , as well as the targets that we should meet , within the coming five years .
this involves many concrete issues which i am not going to dwell on here .
can you tell us what concrete measures the central authorities are likely to take to make this happen ?
question raised by a reporter from taiwan 's morning news of young china [ shao nian zhong guo chen bao ] : according to what we have learned , taiwan and zhejiang have today formed very close ties in economic and trade cooperation , and are enjoying many cooperation opportunities .
down the ages , there had been frequent exchanges , especially commercial and trade exchanges , between zhejiang and taiwan .
i am a native of zhoushan , zhejiang province . when i was at the young age of seven or eight , that is , before liberation , i used to see fishermen from my hometown and from taiwan going to each other 's places for business , and there were also frequent exchanges and contacts among kinsfolk .
this serves to show the deep historical origins [ of the cross - strait exchanges ] .
due to reasons that are known to all , however , taiwan , as one of china 's provinces , has been completely cut off from the mainland motherland for a long period of time .
it can be said that zhejiang is one of china 's provinces and municipalities which have attracted a fairly large amount of taiwan investment .
second , the scale of investment is constantly expanding .
judging by the current investment scale , the number of taiwan - invested projects involving an investment of $ 10 million and above has exceeded 100 in our province , among which 30 involve an investment of as much as over $ 30 million .
today , investment projects can be found not only in the fields of agriculture , light and textile industries , commerce and trade , building materials , and machinery , but also in high technological industries , such as electronic and information industries .
according to statistics released by relevant departments of our province , the taiwan enterprises which have come to invest in our province are generally successful in their investments , and they have attained a fairly good economic efficiency .
around 80 percent of the joint ventures , solely owned enterprises , and cooperative enterprises have already made satisfactory economic returns .
in short , we highly welcome taiwan compatriots to invest , start an enterprise , and seek common development in zhejiang .
what are the main characteristics of individual and private economies in zhejiang ?
will the government make any changes to the policies and the investment environment concerning the development of individual and private economies ?
as it is known to everyone present here , individual and private economies , as well as other non - public - owned economies , have become an important component part in china 's socialist market economy , and have been written into china 's constitution .
as far as zhejiang province is concerned , ever since the beginning of reform and opening up , we have upheld the practice of mainly relying on the public ownership while vigorously promoting non - public - owned economies ; as it has turned out , individual and private economies in our province have undergone a rapid development .
the private economy has already become a major force in zhejiang 's economic development , and this can be seen clearly not only from its proportion and market share but also from the great vigor of its present development and the sound prospects of its future development .
nevertheless , judging by the basic natures of these systems , i believe they basically fall into the category of non - public - owned economies as a whole , or we can call them non - government - run economies .
this major characteristic can serve to explain why the non - public - owned economies in zhejiang have attained a relatively faster growth and have developed a comparatively stronger economic vigor .
meanwhile , the non - public - owned enterprises in zhejiang have closely linked their production bases with the market , turned out products with unique features , developed their own fist products [ highly competitive products ] , and have given a certain scale to their production and have attained a sound scale efficiency .
for example , a total of 108 villages engaged in specialized production have emerged in zhejiang , with an individual and private economic output value of 10 million yuan ; besides , we also have over 100 townships and towns engaged in specialized production , and their output value has exceeded 100 million yuan .
today , considerable changes have also taken place in their sales methods : some have already started their online businesses on the internet , while many have set up sales points in foreign countries in a bid to enter the international market .
the last characteristic is that along with the development of production , private enterprises are constantly expanding in scale , and great results have been achieved in the field of technological progress .
besides , we have more than 6,500 non - government - run scientific and technological enterprises which enjoy a fairly high scientific and technological content , among which over 400 are enterprises using new and high technologies .
by the end of last year , zhejiang had already had 144 large private enterprise groups , and i predict that the figure will grow higher this year .
as regards what other measures that the government will adopt to promote the development of private enterprises , i believe that we , as the government , should undertake its due responsibilities in this respect .
this is our attitude towards enterprises : we will provide sound services for all enterprises located in zhejiang , should they be state enterprises , collective enterprises , individual and private enterprises , or foreign - invested enterprises ; and we will create better conditions for a fair competition according to relevant laws and regulations of the state .
in my opinion , this is an issue of essential importance .
if there were any deficiencies in our support for the development of private enterprises in the past , we will surely make improvements in the future .
for example , according to the feedback given by comrades working in the provincial federation of industry and commerce , some localities have yet to assign sufficient importance to private enterprises in terms of fund - raising and market access . these are the problems that we need to attend to by working out corresponding solutions .
may i ask what you expect to get in return from the journalists who have come on invitation to cover this activity ?
i believe that our friends in the press circles , especially our journalist friends from outside the country , have come to cover this activity in zhejiang for the purpose of promoting friendship , strengthening cooperation , and seeking common development .
i believe your efforts will not be spent in vain .
you have come here , giving publicity to zhejiang and china and helping to promote friendship , exchanges , and cooperation of china and zhejiang with other parts of the world . in my opinion , your contribution in this respect is the best thing we can expect in return .
during the visit , yu yongbo will exchange opinions with rostker on the regional situation , bilateral relations , and other issues of common concern . he will meet with other leaders of the us government and us army , and visit units of the us armed forces and military academies .
the activities will be helpful to enhancing mutual understanding and improving and developing bilateral relations , especially military relations between the two countries .
taipei - - taiwan president chen shui - bian said he is willing to hold dialogue with mainland china " based on existing foundations . "
he stressed that the taiwan side has already made all preparations and that talks can be held anytime ; however , talks cannot be held with willingness from just one side , but require joint actions from both sides .
however , he still would not directly answer the question on whether he is a " chinese , " but indicated that he is a " citizen of the republic of china [ roc ] . "
it was his first exclusive interview with overseas chinese media since he became taiwan president on 20 may. the lianhe zaobao press delegation was led by zhou jingrui , senior executive vice president ( chinese newspaper group ) of the singapore press holdings group .
taking the year 1992 as an example , the two sides of the strait did hold dialogue and discussions on the topic of " one china " but did not reach consensus .
taiwan does not accept the mainland 's claim that the " principle of one china " was a consensus reached by both sides . neither does the mainland accept taiwan 's claim of " one china , respective interpretations . " the two sides therefore did not speak the same language [ ge shuo ge hua ] .
he held the view that , despite not speaking the same language , there must be some common points upheld and a certain spirit forged ; otherwise the 1993 meeting in singapore between ku chen - fu and wang daohan would not have occurred .
" what i call existing foundations are : agreements we have had , which i acknowledge ; consensus we have reached , which i accept ; and tacit understandings we have agreed to , which i do not oppose .
however , the two sides of the strait cannot go on speaking different languages and should sit down to find common ground first .
chen shui - bian said : in resuming consultations based on existing foundations , we can argue about which issues should be discussed all over again .
the two sides of the strait must look ahead and seek new consensus , which is better than going round and round following old set patterns .
in the so - called shelving of disputes , we can still discuss disputes . but basically there must be dialogue . to have dialogue , there must be exchanges .
as president , i must conform to the people 's will and let the people decide taiwan 's future .
he said : such a word game has not much meaning really .
where you say you are from is not the most important . "
the three - point consensus in economic and trade relations reached between the two sides are : promoting and signing a singapore - taiwan agreement on a free trade zone ; promoting financial cooperation ; and forging tactical alliances in telecommunications , information , and the internet .
he described senior minister lee as a very outstanding politician and a world - class leader . he has his personal observation , valuable experience , and personal thinking .
he said : " i believe that listening to more good opinions will open up my field of vision very well , and be of great help to me .
i have said that as a state leader , i must listen to the people 's voices and different voices .
it is rather meaningless if i listen only to the voice of one person . however , different opinions and different voices can lead us to further thinking and allow us to make some adjustments , and may help us walk a smoother path . "
he said : senior minister lee is not a mediator . however , he is absolutely a friend who will give forthright admonitions to taiwan and , of course , " is such a friend to ah - bian [ chen shui - bian ] personally . "
he said : we met for nearly six hours this time ( referring to last september ) over two meal meetings and a formal meeting .
" this is a very rare opportunity . i would like to thank him very much . "
he said that during his meetings with senior minister lee last september , they in fact spent a lot of time discussing issues besides cross - strait affairs , such as a taiwan - singapore economic and trade cooperation plan .
he said that senior minister lee 's visit was of great significance , and thanked the senior minister and singapore government very much .
it has been only four months or more in taiwan 's first change of ruling political party , " what can you do ? he gave me a lot of encouragement , expectation , and advice . we must be thankful for all this . he has given me great support and cheering up .
however , as they involve technical issues such as customs clearance , quarantine , and safety , the two sides of the taiwan strait still have to sit down for negotiations on implementing the " three links . "
he was responding to a speech delivered by senior minister lee kuan yew yesterday morning at the us foreign affairs council in new york .
he said that he did not know the contents of the conversation between senior minister lee and jiang zemin during their meeting in june . furthermore , there is a very short time between now and us presidential election on 7 november .
" regardless of his words , senior minister lee has his observations . however , i also have my contacts . on cross - strait affairs , especially on our work on the united states , and relations between the united states and china , we have fixed channels of information .
we must prevent unnecessary confrontations and eliminate war in the taiwan strait .
" this is our conviction and the bounden duty of the taiwan leader .
i still feel that the governments and peoples on the two sides of the taiwan strait should work hard jointly to pursue the goal of friendly reconciliation , active cooperation , and everlasting peace . "

cheju of rok , 21 oct ( xinhua ) - - on 21 october , chinese foreign minister tang jiaxuan gave the following speech to reporters on the results achieved by premier zhu rongji in his visit to japan and rok and his participation in the third asia - europe meeting .
in this period , premier zhu also attended the third asia - europe meeting in seoul , and he announced to the world china 's standpoints on and proposals for advancing asian - european cooperation in depth .
the whole visit was pragmatic , smooth , successful , and achieved expected results .
on various occasions during the visit , premier zhu comprehensively enunciated our principles and policies of attaching importance to the development of relations with japan .
yoshiro mori and leaders of various main political parties in japan also made positive responses to this , and stressed that china is the most important close neighbor of japan , and japanese - chinese friendship is the fundamental and overwhelming interest .
premier zhu pointed out : the key to preserving the political foundation for sino - japanese relations lies in the proper handling of history and taiwan issues .
any words and deeds in an attempt to dodge , play down , or even distort history are wrong .
it is hoped that japan will be able to really adopt a correct approach to history and draw a useful lesson from history , thus continuously adhering to the correct course of peace and development .
all governmental and nongovernmental circles in japan agreed to further promote the development of sino - japanese friendship with the spirit of " drawing a lesson from history and being oriented to the future . "
both sides achieved a consensus of opinion on this important issue , and this will be conducive to the proper handling of the historical issue between the two countries in the future and will consolidate the political foundation for sino - japanese relations .
( 2 ) increasing mutual understanding .
he repeatedly stressed the importance and urgency of further increasing mutual understanding and enhancing mutual trust , and set forth a series of measures for this purpose .
both sides agreed to set up a hot line between the two governments , strengthen and expand the bilateral security dialogue mechanisms , and exchange visits of warships . efforts will be made to increase mutual understanding .
in particular , he conducted face - to - face dialogue with the japanese masses , answering their questions by presenting facts and reasoning things out , and this achieved very good results . people - to - people friendship is the foundation for good relations between china and japan .
as some people in japan had misgivings about china 's development , premier zhu cited various facts and statistics to stress that china cannot and will not form any threats against japan , and friendship between china and japan is in keeping with the fundamental interests of both peoples .
the japanese foreign minister affirmed that premier zhu 's visit enabled the japanese people to better understand the importance of japanese - chinese relations and made them keep firmer confidence in promoting japanese - chinese friendship .
( 3 ) promoting mutually beneficial cooperation .
premier zhu briefed the japanese government and economic circles about our country 's new development strategy and the major turning point appearing in china 's economy at present , and pointed out the new major aspects of strengthening economic cooperation between china and japan .
premier zhu also inspected a robot manufacturing company and the magnetic levitation test center , and took a test ride on the new high - speed train . there , he made an on - the - spot investigation of high and new technological development conditions in japan .
( 1 ) expressing our country 's firm stance for supporting reconciliation and independent and peaceful reunification between the south and the north .
he stressed : being the largest neighboring country of the peninsula , china sincerely hopes that the process of south - north reconciliation will continue to forge ahead , and firmly support the peninsula 's realization of its independent and peaceful reunification .
both sides expressed willingness to further promote the establishment of the peninsula 's peace mechanism via the four - party talks .
( 2 ) promoting the sino - rok cooperative partnership into a new stage of full cooperation in all aspects .
premier zhu stressed many time that his visit to rok was aimed at further advancing the sino - rok friendly and cooperative relationship in this orientation .
the rok side completely agreed with the chinese side 's opinion on bilateral relations , and indicated that strengthening bilateral relations is in the interest of both peoples , thus hoping that the exchange and cooperation with china will be further carried out in depth .
both sides agreed to advance the sino - rok cooperative partnership into a new stage of full cooperation in all aspects .
both sides also agreed that china will set up cultural centers in rok , thus further increasing mutual understanding between the two peoples .
economic cooperation is a major component part of sino - rok good - neighborly and friendly relations .
both sides agreed to set up sino - rok investment promotion institution , set up the sino - rok 21 st century economic cooperation research society , and set up a project for supporting tree planting and forest building in china 's western region .
both sides agreed to actively seek methods of guaranteeing the healthy and long - term development of bilateral trade in the form of expanding balance .
the leaders of the three sides will hold meetings during the fourth east asian leaders ' meeting later this year .
this will play a positive role in promoting the development of regional cooperation in east asia .
( 1 ) explicitly proposing that the asia - europe meeting be turned into a model of intercontinental cooperation on an equal footing .
premier zhu 's proposals won widespread support among leaders attending the meeting , and were included in the relevant documents adopted by the meeting .
( 3 ) actively and pragmatically carrying out the activities of the asia - europe meeting .
the successful holding of the third asia - europe meeting laid a good foundation for asian - european cooperation in the new century .
thanks to our party 's repeated call to straighten out the style of study , many fine traditions have thus gradually taken shape .
however , in the new situation there are still some bad styles of study around us and moreover , they have many new manifestations and characteristics .
therefore , in the new century , we should continue to attach great importance to the style of study issue , vigorously promote good styles of study , and firmly oppose and get rid of various bad styles of study .
we should master the marxist stand , viewpoint , and method overall and use them to guide our research on the practical life .
we should shun from rigidly adhering to some specific expositions and tailoring realities with a few isolated words and phrases we learned , and indulging in dogmatism and book worship characterized by indiscriminate copying of words and phrases .
this is the true meaning of historical materialism .
to master and adhere to this tenet , we should pay close attention to and properly solve the numerous strategic problems concerning the economic and social development in the new period .
with the completion of the task mentioned above , we would enjoy the support of the masses of the people and be able to establish ourselves all along in an unassailable position .
every major breakthrough in marxist theory and every historic leap in the practice of socialism are the outcome of theoretical innovations achieved in the course of integrating the marxist basic tenets with concrete practice .
we should develop theory through practice rather than binding practice with books .
this is the most fundamental requirement for us to foster and develop a good style of study .
to improve the style of study , we should adopt a scientific attitude toward our study of all other knowledge and foreign practices and experiences .
with the development of science and technology as well as economic globalization , exchanges and mergers of various civilizations in the world have taken place in an increasingly fast and intensive way .
we should observe the world with the marxist broad field of vision , promptly grasp the trends of world development , and be good at absorbing the quintessence of world civilization and drawing experiences both positive and negative from others .
in the meantime , we should notice that the practices and experiences of any countries have their own unique contents , nature , and limits to which they are applicable . it is impossible to indiscriminately copy and apply them to china in a summary fashion .
beijing , 22 oct (xinhua) - - currently , a series of major changes are taking place on the korean peninsula which have the significance of making a turning point .
after the meeting between the heads of the north and south on the korean peninsula in june this year , the democratic people 's republic of korea [ dprk ] and the united states are improving their relations at an unusual speed .
in the meantime , other western countries are successively seeking to develop relations with the dprk .
from 9 to 12 october , cho myong - nok , first vice chairman of the dprk national defense commission visited the united states as a special envoy to dprk leader kim chong - il , with positive results achieved .
the dprk and us governments issued a joint communique in washington which announced that both sides decided to take measures to fundamentally improve relations between the two countries and devote themselves to the building of a " new type of relations that break away from the antagonistic condition in the past . "
these two visits mark important steps in the improvement of relations between the dprk and the united states and a major event in relations between the two countries which have turned from confrontation to the process of mitigation .
with the end of the cold war , international relations have witnessed changes , and a trend of mitigation and improvement has emerged in dprk - us relations .
since the beginning of 1990 s , diplomatic contacts between the dprk and the united states have increased gradually .
the two countries have constantly engaged in formal diplomatic dialogue on the " nuclear " and " missile issues , " which have given rise to fierce confrontations between the two countries .
the dprk - us dialogue has not only resolved or eased up the disagreement of the two countries regarding the nuclear and missile issues , but has also led to engagement in cooperation between the two countries regarding security on the korean peninsula and the humanitarian issue .
the dprk has started to adjust its foreign policies , and made great efforts to improve relations with the surrounding countries in addition to paying attention to opening up relations with western countries , and actively seeking to improve relations with the united states .
the report submitted by perry , former us defense secretary and then dprk policy coordinator , after his visit to the dprk has partially changed the us policy of obstinate containment against the dprk .
with the progress reached in the dialogue on the missile issue of the dprk , the united states has announced to lift partially the economic sanctions toward the dprk .
in particular , the historic meeting between the heads of the dprk and the republic of korea [ rok ] held in pyongyang in june this year has brought both sides onto the track of reconciliation and cooperation , and opened up new prospects for mitigation on the korean peninsula .
various active factors on the korean peninsula and its surrounding areas and positive interactions at every relevant link have promoted the progress of the mitigation between the dprk and united states , and created favorable conditions for the improvement of relations between the two countries .
the final goal for the improvement of relations between the dprk and the united states is to realize normalization of relations .
the nuclear convention signed between the dprk and the united states in geneva in october 1994 has stipulated clearly that the two countries would realize complete normalization in political and economic relations , and the two countries would establish liaison offices in each other 's capital until a diplomatic relationship at ambassadorial level is built .
the visit has not only created an atmosphere for the improvement of relations between the dprk and the united states , but also played an important role in foreshadowing the seeking of realization of relations between the two countries .
the confrontation between the dprk and the united states which has lasted for several decades has not only damaged the interests of both sides , but also jeopardized the peace and stability on the korean peninsula and of the region .
the north and south of the korean peninsula , surrounding countries , and the international community are all reluctant to see an abnormal condition in relations between the dprk and the united states .
recently , both britain and germany have indicated the wish of establishing diplomatic relations with the dprk . japan is planning to send foreign minister yohei kono to visit pyongyang to discuss with the dprk on the issue of promoting normalization of diplomatic relations .
analysts maintain that although the process of the improvement of relations between the dprk and the united states has been accelerated remarkably , the two countries still need to remove some important barriers in order to realize normalization of relations ultimately .
only when the united states abolish its containment policy toward the dprk , give a concrete guarantee to the dprk on the security issue , and stop from implementing its asia - pacific strategy under the name of the dprk " threat , " will the mitigation and development of dprk - us relations be assured .
the dprk and the united states have decided through consultation to make joint efforts to delete the dprk from the us list of " countries which support terrorism , " a promise which awaits the united states to turn it into reality .
the dprk and the united states were belligerent countries during the korean war. the two sides still need to announce an end to the state of war through negotiations in order to allow the two countries to recognize each other and establish normal state relations .
in addition , the us government has to remove the restraint and interference from the hard - line opposition group in the united states in its efforts of improving dprk - us relations .

beijing , 22 oct ( xinhua ) - - the 23 october issue of liaowang will carry an article that calls the " tenth five - year plan " ( 2001 - 2005 ) an important transition period in china 's economic development .
the article says , china 's economy has entered the era of all - out competition .
faced with a new developmental environment , china 's social production and its economic system and mechanisms have proven to be unsuitable in many ways . this has been the main reason for the series of problems in the economic functions since 1998 .
all - out competition will be the most prominent characteristic facing china 's economic development under the " tenth five - year plan . "
this will be a very difficult course and will truly test china 's economic development and economic reform .
the article maintains that this transition period will be marked by the following characteristics : based on comparative advantages , china will rely on two interactive relationships to increase its industries ' competitiveness .
the article says , overall , china 's industrial development mode has entered the comprehensive transition phase .
in the wake of rural economic development , especially with the development of the non - agricultural sectors , those sectors that have attained the highest standard of development have begun to integrate into the urban economy at a faster pace .
with regard to the restructuring of the economic system , the article maintains that , faced with a competitive environment , the economic structure and the economic mechanisms will inevitably make a gradual change from irregular to standardized , from disorderly to orderly .
at the heart of the new economic law and order is the clarification of the property rights relationship and the standardized , transparent income allocation process .
because these changes involve adjustments of the basic interests of all aspects of society and will change the way people make their living , the reform will increasingly touch on the interests of every aspect of society and will become more difficult .
this means the state must judge the hour and size up the situation in the reform process and assume an orderly and gradual course .

the state council has decided to begin the fifth national census on 1 november 2000 .
a clear understanding of the country 's population status is essential for the state to formulate its population , education and employment policies ; and to achieve a sustainable economic and social development .
china is the most populous country in the world , and so the fifth national census , in addition to being a matter of concern for the people at home , is also something the whole world will watch . it is a greatly significant task with far - reaching influence .
the fifth national census will proceed when the country is building a socialist market economic system .
compared with the previous censuses , the forthcoming census will collect information of more areas than before and the scale will be much larger . meanwhile , it will also have to face a greater floating population and other new and more complex situations .
accomplishing this census with high quality has everything to do with the efficient organization and leadership of governments at various levels .
the census is a task governed by strong policies .
governments , census offices , and relevant departments at all levels must strictly abide by these policies . any conduct that distorts and interferes with these policies is impermissible .
the census is also a task in which the masses will be greatly involved .
to do their part in the fifth national census , they must not hide anything , not leave out anything , and not provide any misinformation .
during the course of the census , they must seek truth from facts and reject any spurious information .
those who violate the " statistics law " and the census procedures , who interfere with the project , or who fabricate census statistics shall be strictly punished according to the law .
the census registration will soon begin .
all census offices must have be aware of those problems that might appear during the census and be prepared to deal with them .
surrounding the need to ensure the quality of the census , they must prepare themselves more fully and more earnestly so as to make sure that the census will be accomplished according to schedule .
we are convinced that , because of the correct leadership of the party and the government , the full cooperation from all departments , the hard work of all census offices and census takers , and the active participation of the masses , the fifth national census will be a complete success .

the solid results achieved by the third asem did not come easily .
when the first asem was held in bangkok in 1996 , the amazing economic achievements in various asian and european countries at that time made european countries look at asia optimistically , and made them willing to carry out equal and cooperative dialogue with asian countries .
however , at the second asem in london two years ago , because many asian countries were affected by the financial crisis and encountered some difficulties in their economic development , there were various doubts among some european countries about whether the two continents could further strengthen their cooperation .

therefore , asian and european countries should carry out equal and friendly consultations and give prominence to and expand their consensus with the spirit of respecting each other and seeking common grounds while reserving differences , thus making joint efforts to establish their cooperative partnership in the new century .
article 4 open funds should be set up by fund mangers . the setting - up of open funds must be examined and approved by the china securities regulatory commission .
article 9 the setting - up and placement period of open funds should not exceed three months .
without meeting the above requirements , open funds cannot be set up .
fund managers should bear the placement expenses , and the raised capital , plus the bank account interest , should be returned to fund subscribers within 30 days upon the expiration of the placement period .
article 11 open funds may set restrictions on the proportion of the open fund units held by individual accounts , and these restrictions should be stated in placement prospectuses .
article 12 in the period right after the setting - up of open funds , fund managers may accept only subscriptions but not withdrawals within the period fixed in fund contracts and placement prospectuses . however , this period should not exceed three months .
article 13 the anticipated scale of open funds may be stated in contracts and prospectuses . after the anticipated scale is attained , no applications for entering the funds will be accepted .
if fund mangers are found to violate the stipulations of contracts , it should be stated whether fund trustees have adopted appropriate measures .
when entrusting other agencies to handle the business relating to the subscription , purchase , and withdrawal of open fund units , fund managers should sign agreements with relevant agencies .
article 18 commercial banks and the agencies recognized by the china securities regulatory commission may handle the business relating to the subscription , purchase , and withdrawal of open fund units under the authorization of fund managers .
when commercial banks initiate the business relating to the subscription , purchase , and withdrawal of open fund units , they must go through the examinations and get approvals of the china securities regulatory commission and the people 's bank of china .
article 21 the business concerning the registration of open fund units may be handled by fund managers and by commercial banks or the agencies recognized by the china securities regulatory commission on a commission basis .
commercial banks should accept the examination and obtain the approval of the china securities regulatory commission to manage the registration business of open funds .
article 27 when applying for purchasing fund units , investors must pay the money in full .
as soon as the money is paid in full , applications become effective immediately .
if investors ' applications for withdrawing their fund units are accepted , fund managers should pay back the money in full .
and the rest should be paid on the following open day according to the stipulations of fund contracts and placement prospectuses .
article 30 when an investor applies for withdrawing more than 10 percent of his total money in the fund on an open day , his case is called a huge withdrawal .
the portion that has not been refunded that day should be refunded at the next open day , with the value being calculated in terms of the net value of fund assets on the next open day .
at the same time , a public notice should be carried in the designated media and other related media .
the time of notification and public notice should not exceed three transactions days of securities exchanges .
when the suspension period is over , and the funds reopen , fund managers should make a public notice on the latest net value of fund assets . article 33 open funds may collect application commission , but the commission may not exceed 5 percent of the sum of the fund units to be purchased .
after deducting the basic service charge , the remaining sum of withdrawal commission should be owned by the funds .
open funds may apply adjustable rates of purchase and withdrawal commissions . the forms and conditions to collect commissions and the rates of commissions should be stated in contracts and placement prospectuses .
article 34 the investment orientation should conform to the stipulations of contracts and placement prospectuses . if the name of the funds shows the orientation of investment , at least 80 percent of the non - cash assets of the funds should belong to the investment of the name showed by the funds .
article 35 the income distribution of open funds should be conducted according to the stipulations of contracts and prospectuses .
article 37 all relevant organs of open funds should keep according to law all the records of the businesses and activities of the funds as well as all their account books , statements , and other materials .
article 39 this set of provisions shall take effect upon its promulgation .

human society 's change from the pastoral civilization to agricultural civilization and from agricultural civilization to industrial civilization was the qualitative leap of the human social and economic development after the structural adjustments were repeatedly accumulated to a certain stage .
today , the tidal waves of a new scientific and technological revolution marked by the universal application of information technologies are sweeping across the globe with great momentum , and the trend of accelerated reorganization of the world economic structure is increasingly prominent .
in face of this historic , large - scale adjustment , those who conform to the trend of the times will prosper , while those who go against it will perish . that is why we must lose no time in making strategic adjustments to the economic structure .
new ideas are necessary for the development under the new situation .
after 50 years of construction since the founding of new china , particularly after 20 - odd years of rapid development since reform and opening up , china has said good - bye to the shortage economy , and its level of productive forces has scaled to a new height .
china 's economic development has basically ended the stage of providing adequate food and clothing to the people , and their lives have , on the whole , reached the level of moderate prosperity and begun to advance toward the building of a well - to - do society in every aspect .
at present , the problem restricting china 's economic development is chiefly manifested in the relatively conspicuous structural contradictions .
a number of problems and contradictions that exist in the current economic life are mostly related to the irrational economic structure .
in the course of economic development , we have long been accustomed to the traditional model of economic growth , so that the situation of blind investment , redundant construction , " large and all - embracing , " and " small and self - contained " was very serious , and many industries had enormous excess production capacity .
from these two 60 percentage points , it is not difficult for us to see that the traditional industrial structure and product mix were not suited to the changes of market demand and the requirements of the people 's elevated living standards .
judging from the international sphere , battered by the knowledge - based economic waves , various countries , the developed countries in particular , are stepping up their economic structural adjustment .
the economic structural adjustment focused on information application had provided " fresh blood " for the us economy to irradiate vigor and vitality in the 1990 's .
the annual report of the " 2000 digital economy " published by the us department of commerce revealed that since 1995 , more than 30 percent of the us economic growth had been contributed by the information industry .
at present , some developing countries are seizing the opportunities to energetically readjust their own economic structures with a view to attaining leaping development .
after many years of efforts , our neighboring country india has achieved rapid development in aerospace and information industries , the software industry in particular .
at present , india has become the second largest country in the world only next to the united states in the production of computer software .
the value of its computer industry reached $ 4 billion in the 1998 - 1999 fiscal year , increasing by 100 times over the figure 10 years ago .
under such a situation , we must have a firm grasp of the structural adjustment in a decisive manner .
the speed and result of adjustment determine , in a certain sense , a country 's competitive power and affect its international standing in the future .
hence , early understanding and rapid adjustment will place us in an active position , while late understanding and slow adjustment will throw us into passivity .
people have paid increasingly greater attention to such a harsh reality : with the process of economic globalization gathering pace and the scope of opening to the outside world expanding , national boundaries have been broken by fierce market competition , and the two markets , domestic and international , are gradually integrated .
the practice of strategic economic structural adjustment is also an urgent need for expanding space of economic growth and achieving sustainable development .
this has demonstrated the foresight and sagacity of the party central committee at the turn of the centuries .
the fifth plenary session of the 15 th party central committee has sounded the clarion call for the chinese nation to march toward the new century .
first of all , please talk about the conditions and the environment that the " 10 th five - year " plan will need .
answer from prof . liu guoguang ( hereinafter referred to as answer ) : i believe that the " 10 th five - year " plan will depend on three new conditions : first , tremendous changes have taken place in the productive forces .
during these five years , we achieved an 8 - percent rate of growth and developed ourselves at a steady pace . all this greatly strengthened our productive forces .
the phenomenon of shortages of industrial and agricultural products basically came to an end , and a buyer 's market emerged .
second , the socialist market economic system has been preliminarily established . there are also tremendous changes in the institutional environment .
third , remarkable changes have taken place in the international environment .
international economic ties have been further strengthened .
therefore , people at home and abroad are paying full attention to the formulation of the " 10 th five - year plan . "
there is only one target in the " proposal " - - figures .
to develop the socialist market economy in china does not mean to deny the role of the government .
we do not let the market economy take its own course and become a free market .
therefore , it is necessary to formulate plans . nevertheless , the plan worked out under market economic conditions is not the same as the plan formulated under planned economic conditions in the past .
under the current plan , the government does not control everything . it only controls the major policy , the major direction , and the major strategy .

question : what is the main train of thought of the " 10 th five - year " plan ?
answer : the main train of thought includes four aspects .

in the previous five - year plans , there were many titles and subtitles - a , b , c , d and 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 and so on .
the 10 th five - year plan focuses on major issues and important guiding principles and major policies .
up to this point , it centers on structural readjustments . all these constitute the master stroke .
after that , it delves into employment and the improvement of people 's living standards . all this is the basic point and the end result in formulating the plan .
this train of thought is quite clear - cut .

a gap means potential .

therefore , we have the conditions to develop ourselves more rapidly .
to " maintain a sustained , prompt , and sound development " was our original formulation . now we talk about attaining " relatively rapid development . " development is the absolute principle ; however , development does not mean placing undue emphasis on speed .
development means to produce readily marketable goods , not to produce goods and keep them in storage .
therefore , we must rely more on the advancement of science and technology and on system reform so as to improve the overall quality in promoting economic growth .

beijing , 23 oct ( xinhua ) - - china will amend three laws on foreign - invested enterprises to further meet the needs of opening wider to the outside world and accession to the wto .
shi guangsheng said : in these amendments , the stipulations asking chinese - foreign cooperative enterprises and solely foreign - funded enterprises to " balance their foreign exchange budget " under the relevant laws will be deleted .
he explained : the stipulations were enacted at that time mainly because during a certain period after implementing the policy of reform and opening up , china 's foreign trade was under - developed , and there was a shortage of foreign exchange and smaller amount of the country 's foreign exchange reserves .
the foreign currencies needed by foreign - funded enterprises to purchase raw materials and spare parts or pay wages , share dividends , and bonuses can now be purchased through banks or paid through their foreign exchange accounts .
he said : the original stipulations are no longer suitable under wto regulations . the deletion of these stipulations is necessary to meet the needs of joining the wto .
this amendment has also abolished the stipulations requiring foreign - invested enterprises to give priorities to the chinese market when buying raw materials and fuels .
like local enterprises of all categories , all foreign - invested enterprises enjoy the power to make their own decisions on purchases .
on the issue of compulsory exports , this amendment will revise the stipulations on the law on compulsory exports by solely foreign - funded enterprises , and change them to stipulations on the country encouraging the exports .
shi guangsheng said : through the amendment , the law will abolish the stipulations requiring solely foreign - funded enterprises in china to export all or most of their products , and allow them to enjoy the right to make their own decisions on the sale of their products , like local enterprises of other categories .

both sides reviewed the development of bilateral economic and trade ties since 16 th meeting of the china - eu mixed commission held in 1998 . they expressed their satisfaction with such a development .
particularly , the agreement reached by china and the eu in may this year on china 's accession to the world trade organization [ wto ] has effectively pushed forward the development of economic and trade cooperation between china and the eu .
at present , china 's cooperation in economic and trade cooperation with the eu has become an important component of china 's efforts to develop its foreign trade .
according to statistics provided by the chinese side , the total volume of import and export trade between china and the eu in 1998 and 1999 reached $ 104.5 billion , representing an increase of 26.4 percent over the period covering 1996 and 1997 .
in addition , during the period covering 1998 and 1999 , the eu established 1,871 investment projects , with actual input of $ 8.77 billion , an increase of 26.9 percent over the last two - year period .
china also imported a large amount of technologies from the eu , with a total amount of $ 16.29 billion , an increase of 35.1 percent over the previous two - year period .
lamy agreed with shi guangsheng 's appraisal and suggestions regarding bilateral economic and trade ties .
members of the eu delegation participating in the meeting included eu officials as well as indymion wilkinson , eu ambassador to china .
