what does it mean ?
b : the " proposal " has made development the theme of the " tenth five - year plan . " this is a major decision made by the third generation leading group upon judging the hour and sizing up the situation , and it has very profound meaning .
on the one hand , the magnificent task of socialist modernization poses an objective requirement for us to accelerate development .
this means that beginning in the new century , china will enter a new period of comprehensive construction of a comparative well - off society and acceleration of the modernization process .
we have both the objective need and the positive conditions , which means our country must , and we can , seize the opportunity to accelerate development .
a : " development is a hard fact . " we have been saying that for years , and today , the party central committee is reiterating this " hard fact " and is making it a long - term guiding ideology in china 's modernization . does it mean development is more important than anything else ?
development is the most important issue that holds the key to the country 's future and its fate .
from the standpoint of historical materialism , economics is the foundation of human society , and without this foundation , all social activities are in vain .
today , no country can afford to neglect development , and this is especially true for china .
this contradiction extends to every aspect of our social life and affects and even dominates all other contradictions .
to properly resolve this main social contradiction , basically we must vigorously develop the productive forces ; otherwise , little else can be accomplished .
comrade deng xiaoping once said , " the key to china 's solving all problems lies in its own development . "
therefore , " development is a hard fact " is especially meaningful to today 's china .
for example , many people say that the development of higher education in china is too slow . everybody wants the state to set up more universities , so that every high school graduate has the opportunity to receive formal higher education .
this is good , but the country so far is not capable of providing what the people want .
universal higher education requires a corresponding input of manpower , financial resource , and material resource .
if china is to accelerate the rate of universal high - school and even higher education , the only way is to accelerate the pace of economic development .
b : for this reason , we say that there are many problems china must solve today , but the foremost problem is development .
development is china 's overwhelming central task .
b : indeed , with the concerted effort of the whole party and the entire nation , the chinese nation 's modernization construction has entered a new era of rapid development .
but we should also realize that if we compare ourselves with the developed countries , because of our country 's economic development 's low starting point and low base , despite the fairly rapid rate of economic development in recent years , we still lag far behind the developed countries as far as the overall economic volume is concerned .
moreover , china has a population of more than 1.2 billion and growing at a rate of 13 million a year ; our per capita output value is low .
therefore , if china is to be rich and strong and catch up with or even surpass the developed countries , we must continue to work relentlessly . our burden is heavy and the road is long , and we cannot afford to ease up even one little bit .
a : then we must remain confident , do solid work , engage in arduous struggle , and accelerate development .
b : so far as our country is concerned , it wo n't do if we do n't develop ; it wo n't do if our development is slow .
to fall behind is to take a beating .
china is still but a developing country and lacks international competitiveness , and in the process of participating in the economic globalization , we must compete with the developed countries as equals . can we still keep up the rapid development ?
b : your concern is understandable .
indeed , in this globalization process , the developed capitalist countries can use their strong economy , the strength in science and technology , and their advantage of having an early start to not only occupy the fast track but to formulate a set of rules that are more beneficial to their own development .
therefore , participating in the economic globalization process , especially joining the wto , will bring many new problems . all sorts of deep - seated contradictions need to be resolved .
the others may have the advantage of having an early start , but we also have our advantage of having a later start .
a : in what areas will this historical opportunity manifest itself ?
the rise of the intellectual economy has changed the traditional way of countries relying on their natural resources to compete with one another .
in the globalization process , modern science and technology , represented by information technology and the life sciences , has opened up vast prospects for the development of the world 's productive forces .
three , economic opportunity .
a : time does not wait , nor does opportunity .
on the issue of development , we indeed must have a sense of urgency .
but many contradictions and problems have also surfaced in the last few years amid our development .
if we neglect development , we might be able to prevent or reduce certain social contradictions and problems , but that in itself is the greatest problem , the greatest hidden trouble , and the greatest danger .
some people hit the nail in the head when they say , " big development , small problems ; small development , big problems ; no development , all problems . "
development itself is a process of continuous exposure and resolution of problems , therefore at no time can we use the excuse of avoiding contradictions and problems to " put the squeeze " on development .
a : then it appears that the social contradictions and problems that have surfaced during development may be attributable to many factors , but ultimately they are rooted in the socioeconomic conditions .
to truly resolve these conflicts and problems , we must begin with development , begin with improving the socioeconomic conditions .
take the problem of the re - employment of the laid - off workers for instance .
based on the experts ' rough estimate , every one percentage point increase in the gdp provides a million new jobs .
but , constrained by the level of economic development , in many ways china will find " its spirit is willing but the flesh is weak " when it comes to providing that kind of social security today and for sometime to come .
b : the new challenges and new opportunities require us to have the correct , proper new ideas that go with the flow but also are realistic and practical for us .
at the same time , we must pay attention to the ecology and to environmental protection to achieve sustainable development .
our development must be sustainable development ; it must be comprehensive development of the economy , society , and the ecological environment .
this is a long - term plan that has to do with the chinese nation 's survival and development .
the approach that sacrifices the environment for the sake of rapid economic growth is not the goal we want to pursue .
our development should be the kind of coordinated development that balances material civilization and spiritual civilization .
comrade jiang zemin emphasizes in particular that , " when we say development is a hard fact , we are talking about comprehensive economic and social development . it includes the development of material civilization as well as spiritual civilization . "
a socialist society is a comprehensively developed society , and only by taking care of both civilizations can we meet the essential requirements of socialism .
a : when it comes to development , there is always an issue of the correct handling of the relationship among reform , development , and stability .
there is no development without a stable political and social environment . this is the consensus we have reached since reform and open up , after paying a steep price .
b : stability is the precondition of reform and development . whether we are talking about deepening reform or accelerating development , we must always proceed in a stable environment . our economic system is in the midst of changing tracks , and there is a process to go through to change the people 's thinking and concepts .
there are fairly dramatic changes in the interest relationships , and there are fairly sharp contradictions , which gives great realistic meaning to stability .
to accelerate development is to better achieve long - term , bona fide stability .
if we use stability as excuse to slow down or even halt development , it inevitably will lead to greater instability .

deng xiaoping indicated in his talks made in southern china in 1992 , " there is a problem now , that is formalism , " and " i suggest this problem be grasped . "
based on this requirement , the entire party has taken many methods to resolve this problem for many years and yielded a lot of results as well .
however , formalism is very stubborn . once a kind of formalist phenomenon has been negated , another kind will crop up right away .
contents determine forms , and forms reflect contents .
without forms , there will be no things , and contents cannot be manifested .
however , if forms become " formalism , " there will be problems .
when forms are put in the first place , contents must be subordinated to forms .
if forms become the purpose of a job , everybody will work for forms and pay no attention to practical results .
some leading cadres have to copy with the endless forms everyday , just like rushing to endless fairs one by one . under such a situation , how can they have energy to go down to the grass roots and the masses ?
consequently , cadres complain incessantly , and the masses are dissatisfied with cadres .
worse still , once the forms are over - emphasized , all sorts of fraudulent behaviors will emerge naturally for the purpose of decorating the appearance and pleasing leaders .
then , the work that has been assigned cannot be carried out thoroughly , and the slogans that have been offered cannot be implemented actually .
they might claim an obviously white color to be black , insistently exaggerate 10 to be 100 , and pack an accident to be achievement .
in addition , many problems are covered by formalism .
in the final analysis , some cadres ' pursuit of forms and false reputation is just for decorating their appearances and gaining appreciation and promotion from leaders .
because the criteria and systems for appraising cadres ' official achievements have not been standardized yet and the system to supervise cadres has not been established , there is still a very thick soil for breeding formalism , and there is still the condition for the growth and spreading of formalism .

in order to fulfill our sacred mission of maintaining national unification and safeguarding national security , our military must make great efforts to strengthen our abilities in fending off information - based invasion and ensuring information security .
but some military units have yet to fully understood the urgency and strategic significance of strengthening the work of information safety and confidentiality .
leaders and institutions at all levels must understand the great significance of this from the strategic perspective of the overall situation . they must take the lead in updating concepts , change the guiding principle in our work , and focus peoples attention on information security .
they should accelerate their efforts in this work in their spirit of being responsible for the party , the country and the military .
they should promote education on information safety and confidentiality . this includes strengthening the sense of information security throughout the large number of officers and soldiers , and broadening their understanding of information confidentiality so as to integrate the wisdom and strength of all people and plug all loopholes in information security .
every officer or soldier is expected to keep this in mind .

washington , 26 oct (xna) - - the china - us joint economic committee [ jec ] held its 13 th session in washington on 26 october .
senior officials of both countries discussed developments in macroeconomic policies and economic structural reforms , cooperation in law enforcement , as well as initiatives for promoting growth in the less developed areas of their economies .
however , both sides noted the risks posed by oil price volatility to global economic recovery and to developing countries dependent on the oil market , as well as the need to stabilize oil prices at sustainable levels .
both sides noted that the us economy has been growing strong , with a low rate of unemployment and inflation contained .
in order to maintain sustainable economic growth , fiscal and monetary policies should continue to be prudent and national savings rate should be raised .
the chinese economy has continued to maintain its strong growth this year .
both sides emphasized that china 's prospective wto accession will further promote china 's integration with the world economy and promote the development of global trade and investment .
both sides agreed that the strengthening of regional cooperation under the backdrop of economic globalization will contribute to global stability and development .
both sides expressed satisfaction over the recent progress made in the " asean + china , japan and republic of korea " framework of cooperation in asia .
fighting financial crimes .
both sides agreed that poor banking supervision , corruption , money laundering and other violations of the law have undermined the credibility and efficiency of the international financial system .
both sides looked forward to the strengthening of cooperation in this regard . they also noted that the apec recently agreed to set up a working group that would conduct a survey of the domestic legal and regulatory frameworks for fighting financial crime in various economies . law - enforcement .
both sides discussed ways to strengthen cooperation under existing agreements regarding trade in goods made by prison labor .
they also discussed developments of the shanghai pilot project for customs clearance and hoped that the project could be completed on time .
regional economic development initiatives .
both sides discussed policies for the solution of their own regional economic disparities .
the chinese side expounded its strategy of " the large - scale development of the western region " while the us side gave a briefing of its " new market " and other regional economic development initiatives .
he pointed out that china 's strategy of developing the western region will improve the ecological environment and promote the coordinated development of regional economies .
he urged the us government to continue its implementation of sound economic and financial policies in order to further promote economic prosperity in the developing countries as well as the stability of the global financial market .
he welcomed china 's public announcement of data after imf 's article iv consultation with china in july this year .
on the key issue of strengthening the financial sector , he welcomed china 's intention to liberalize interest rates .
he expressed his concern for the sustainability of china 's medium - term fiscal policies , considering in particular the contingent liability of the financial sector as well as possible expenditures for the social security net , pension funds , infrastructure construction and environmental protection in future .
representatives on the us side came from the department of the treasury , the federal reserve board , the us customs service , the us trade representative 's office , the national committee on economic affairs , the council of economic advisers , the state department and the department of commerce .

beijing , 28 oct ( xinhua ) - - a contract for building china 's largest joint venture - - the nanhai petrochemical project - - was officially signed here today .
li peng , chairman of the standing committee of the national people 's congress , attended the signing ceremony .
the first phase of this project involves an investment of $ 4.05 billion and is expected to go into operation in 2005 , with a yearly output capacity of 800,000 tonnes of ethylene and 2,300,000 tonnes of petrochemical products .
he added that since china is the fastest growing economy in the world , " i believe that shell will get the best returns by signing this contract at a time when china is about to enter the wto . "
meanwhile , china has expanded the forms of foreign investment to securities , bonds , and bot [ preceding abbreviation in english ] and has also taken a major turn from paying attention to quantity to concentrating on improving quality .
the nanhai petrochemical project was first put forward in 1988 . the two sides signed a framework agreement in the netherlands in 1997 .
shell is going to inject a number of the most advanced patented technologies into this project , which will mainly produce downstream chemical industrial products , many of which china is unable to produce at present .
shell is currently operating or building more than 20 petroleum and petrochemical projects in china and has seen remarkable economic returns .
over the past 20 years or so since the implementation of the opening - up policy , chin has assimilated about $ 330 billion foreign direct investment , only next to the united states and ranking second in the world .
economists predicted that china will greet a new high tide of foreign investment over the next decade .

comrade deng xiaoping profoundly pointed out : " emancipation of the mind means to break with the force of habit and the shackle of subjective prejudice under the guidance of marxism , study the new situation and resolve new problems . "
only by emancipating the mind can the goal of seeking truth from facts be attained ; only by persisting in seeking truth from facts can the mind be really emancipated .
the purpose of emancipating the mind is to seek truth from facts .

in the course of implementing the spirit of the fifth plenary session , we can gain new enlightenment , absorb new nourishment , intensify new wisdom , produce new strength , and win new victory by further profoundly recognizing the importance of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts and consciously persisting for it .
marxism is the outcome of seeking truth from facts , and the " truth " sought by the founder of marxism after he conducted scientific studies of all previous " facts " of the human society and all " facts " in different eras .
deng xiaoping theory is the " truth " sought by the party 's second leadership collective who studied china 's " facts " of the present age by means of marxism and mao zedong thought .
( 4 ) seeking truth from facts is a magic weapon enabling us to stand in an unconquerable position .
it can be said that a history of chinese revolution , construction and reform is a history in which the party and the people struggled arduously and made great efforts to build a strong country under the banner of emancipation of the mind and seeking truth from facts .
in our party 's theoretical creations , seeking truth from facts occupies a lofty position ; in all our party 's practices , seeking truth from facts emits brilliant rays of light .
we owe all our successes and victories to the practice of seeking truth from facts .
without seeking truth from facts , people would not have used the countryside to encircle the cities , would not have finally seized the roads of cities , and would not have won a victory in the chinese revolution .
without seeking truth from facts , people would not have brought order out of chaos and conducted reform in an all - round manner .
similarly , our setbacks and miscalculations were also originated from our deviation from the practice of seeking truth from facts .
emancipation of the mind and seeking truth from facts is a banner which our party has always held high as well as the experience which we should treasure most .
( 5 ) seeking truth from facts is the core of the scientific innovative spirit .
the process of innovation is to seek and grasp the process of the objective law governing the development and changes of things , that is , the process of seeking " truth " based on facts .
innovation and seeking truth from facts are identical in essence .
all valuable innovations can only be established on the basis of seeking truth from facts .
only by persisting in seeking truth from facts , managing things in accordance with the objective law concerning the development of things can we see efficiency and results from our hard work and arduous struggle , and can we unceasingly make the masses of people gain and increase visible interests every day .
( 7 ) seeking truth from facts is the essence of proletarian political parties .
proletarian political parties came into being in compliance with the development of history . their historical responsibility is to seek the inevitable and inherent law governing social development , act in accordance with it , and mobilize and organize the masses of people to promote historical progress .
the masses of people have stressed the practice of seeking truth from facts and the need to seek truth from facts most .
our party is open and straightforward , upright and without any concealment and cheating . ( 8 ) seeking truth from facts is reliable and cannot be defeated .
seeking truth from facts - - a firm and clear - cut political character ( 9 ) the key to fulfilling the task of cross - century development and the grand objective of the modernization drive lies in the party .
in party building , the building of work style is one of the very important aspects .
a party that wants to explore with pioneering spirit , establish ties with the masses , forge ahead vigorously with exerted effort , and be full of vitality must regard emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts as a clear - cut political character , and must manifest it in all its activities .
to implement the spirit of the fifth plenary session and strive to improve the party work style , we must exert efforts to resolve the issues of dogmatism , bureaucracy and formalism in our practical work , because they are the major enemies when we seek truth from facts and conduct our activities .
( 10 ) dogmatism is also called book worship .
its characteristics are paying attention to the higher levels at the expense of reality , refusing to proceed from the reality of development and changes , and never specifically analyzing the specific situation .
in history , our party suffered losses many times because of dogmatism . comrade mao zedong said : we suffered great losses because we did everything in line with printed documents .
we must not restrict practice by means of book worship , but develop books through practice . this is the truth which the cpc has profoundly understood through nearly 80 years of struggle .
the marxist classic writers openly stated that their doctrines are not dogmas , but a guide to action .
we should conscientiously study and apply the marxist classical works , but should not indiscriminately copy word for word from books and practice dogmatism and book worship ; we should study modestly and use things of other countries for reference , including things from western countries .
( 11 ) bureaucracy .
bureaucracy was originated to a great extent from the consciousness of regarding an official as the basic aim formed from the feudal society of china - - taking officials as the foundation and doing everything in order to become an official .
this kind of consciousness spread in china for several thousand years and still has a very deep influence to this day .
lenin once rebuked bureaucracy , saying : if anything that could destroy us , it is bureaucracy .
it will be very difficult for people who are tainted with the bad habit of bureaucracy to seek truth from facts ; serious bureaucrats will not or are not willing to seek truth from facts .
bureaucracy must be sternly criticized and resolutely checked .
formalism should also be sternly criticized and resolutely checked .
shouldering the historical responsibility of national rejuvenation , we need to more firmly and consciously persist in emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts .
presently , new things are emerging in an endless stream and new problems are cropping up unceasingly . only by emancipating the mind , seeking truth from facts , can leaders rapidly adapt themselves to objective reality and realize a change in environment and gain initiative in grasping work .
the purpose of study is to apply .
when there are contradictions between individual interests , collective interests and people 's interests , communist party members , especially leading cadres , should not hesitate to give up individual interests . they should safeguard the practice of seeking truth from fact , and should not give up this practice for the sake of individual interests .
of course , when we discover our mistakes , we should correct them in a fact - seeking manner . by no means should we " continue the wrong way " for the sake of saving face and getting popular trust .
this is a severe test of party spirit for a person .
when new things appears , it is possible that not many people will recognize them .
those who support new thinking , new viewpoints and new things will not be recognized by all people , and sometimes they have to pay a price for it .
a real materialist is a selfless and a fearless person .
he should be one who has the courage to sacrifice his own interest for the sake of people 's interests and to struggle against dogmatism , bureaucracy and formalism for the sake of people 's interests . he should be ready to openly admit and resolutely correct his own mistakes in his understanding and work .
these are our royalty , loftiness , honor , and strength .
because of this , the people trust and support us ; the party 's undertakings become ever victorious in their forward march and are being vigorously developed .
( 16 ) to persist in seeking truth from facts , we must go deep into the reality of life and maintain close ties with the masses .
( 17 ) to persist in seeking truth from facts , we must promote democracy and guarantee making decisions in a scientific way .
particularly , we must standardize the policymaking procedures , ensure that people dare to speak the truth , different views will be respected , and that the masses of people , experts and scholars can have opportunities to fully express their views .
( 18 ) seeking truth from facts is an ideological line , work style , knowledge target , and the orientation to which we must exert efforts .
the cognitive ability of each and every person and of the people of every generation is very limited .
it does not mean that a person who achieves in seeking truth from facts at a time will always seek truth from facts . a person who deals with a matter in a fact - seeking way will not necessarily do everything in a fact - seeking way .
once when we understand this point , we must keep in mind the practice of seeking truth from facts , firmly grasp it , practice it with perseverance and for the rest of our life .

beijing , 31 oct ( xinhua ) - - the 18 th meeting of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] standing committee , which concluded today , adopted the law on the national common language .
the law will be effective on 1 january 2001 .
the common language law , which comprises four chapters and 28 articles , includes general provisions ; the use , management , and supervision of the national common language ; and supplementary provisions .
the law also stipulates : various nationalities have the freedom to use and develop their own spoken and written languages .
the use of minority nationalities ' spoken and written languages shall be in accordance with relevant provisions of the constitution , the law governing autonomy in nationalities ' regions , and other laws .

article two all those who breed or fish for aquatic animals or plants or are involved in other fishery production activities in the inland waters , shoals , territorial sea waters , or exclusive economic zones of the prc or in all other water areas under the jurisdiction of the prc shall abide by this law .
article three the state shall implement for fishery production the principle of maintaining an aquaculture industry as the mainstay while simultaneously developing an aquaculture industry , a fishing industry , and a processing industry by suiting measures to the local conditions and by laying different stress on different aspects .
article four the state shall encourage scientific and technological research and popularize advanced technology in the fishery industry and shall raise the scientific and technological standard of the fishery industry .
article seven the state shall supervise and manage the fishery industry by exercising unified leadership over or managing it level by level .
the fishery administration departments of the people 's governments at and above the county level shall supervise or manage in accordance with administrative divisions fishing activities in such water areas as rivers , lakes , and so on .
the state fishery administration and fishing port supervision and management institutions shall take charge of fishery administration or fishing port supervision and management involving foreign nationals or foreign fishing vessels .
article nine the fishery administration departments and the fishery administration , supervision , or management institutions affiliated to these departments as well as the personnel concerned shall be prohibited from participating or getting involved in fishery production or fishing activities .
the state council shall issue specific measures on examining and issuing an aquaculture license .
individuals or collectives may contract for the purpose of aquacultural production collectively owned or whole - people - owned water areas or shoals used by collective agricultural economic organizations .
article 13 if a dispute arises among aquacultural producers in water areas or shoals suitable for aquaculture as defined by a state plan , it shall be handled according to procedures provided for in a relevant law .
before such a dispute is settled , no one may sabotage aquacultural production .
article 16 the state shall encourage and support selection , breeding , or popularization of fine aquatic varieties .
the import of young aquatic varieties containing transformed gene shall undergo a safety check and specific administration work shall be conducted in accordance with the relevant regulations issued by the state council .
article 18 the fishery administration departments of the people 's governments at and above the county level shall step up technological guidance for aquacultural production and strengthen prevention and control of diseases .
article 19 those involved in aquacultural production shall be banned from using bait or forage containing poisonous materials .
chapter three : the fishing industry article 21 the state shall adopt financial , credit , loan , and revenue measures and some other measures to encourage and support the development of an ocean fishing industry and shall arrange for fishing forces in both inland and offshore waters in light of the amount of fishable fishery resources .
article 22 the state shall define the total amount of fishable fishery resources in accordance with the principle of keeping the fishable amount smaller than the growth amount of fishery resources and shall introduce a fishing quota system .
those planning for fishing activities in sea areas under the jurisdiction of foreign countries shall obtain in advance approval from the fishery administration departments of the state council and shall abide by the relevant treaties or agreements , to which the prc is a signatory or participant , as well as the laws of the foreign countries concerned .
fishing permits approved and issued by the fishery administration departments of the people 's governments at and above the county level in the local areas shall abide by fishing quotas set by the fishery administration departments of the people 's governments at higher levels .
article 25 units or individuals involved in fishing activities shall carry out fishing activities in accordance with fishing activities , fishing sites , time limit , amount of fishing tackle , and fishing quota listed in a fishing permit and shall abide by the state regulations on protecting fishery resources .
article 26 newly built , renewed , renovated , purchased , or imported vessels for fishing purposes shall be launched only after passing inspection conducted by and obtaining approval from a relevant fishing vessel inspection department .
the state council shall work out specific management measures for this purpose .
article 27 in building a fishing port , the parties concerned shall abide by a unified state plan and uphold the principle of those who invest obtaining due profits .
chapter four : multiplication and protection of fishery resources article 28 the fishery administration departments of the people 's governments at and above the county level shall make a unified plan for fishing waters under their jurisdiction and shall employ measures to multiply and protect fishery resources .
no unit or individual shall be allowed to conduct fishing activities without approval of the fishery administration departments of the state council in an aquatic resource protection zone set up for the purpose of protecting variety and quality of aquatic resources .
production , marketing , or use of banned fishing tackle shall be prohibited .
no fishing activities shall be permitted in a forbidden fishing zone or during a closed fishing season .
the amount of young fish in a catch shall not exceed an officially approved percentage .
sale of illegal catch shall be banned in a forbidden fishing zone or during a closed fishing season .
article 31 fishing for young aquatic animals of high economic value shall be prohibited .
article 32 while building a sluice gate or a dam in a water passage where fish , shrimp , or crabs live , which might harm fishery resources to a serious extent , construction units concerned shall build facilities for fish to pass through or employ other remedial measures to this end .
article 33 in water areas with functions like aquaculture , water distribution , water storage , irrigation , and so on , the administration departments concerned shall set the minimum water level for fishery production .
article 34 reclamation of land from a lake shall be prohibited .
no reclamation of land from shoals in coastal areas shall be allowed without approval of the people 's governments at and above the county level .
article 37 the state shall focus on protecting rare wild aquatic animals which are on the brink of extinction , such as white - flag dolphin and so on , and shall prevent such rare wild aquatic animals from dying out .
catching , killing , or harming major wild aquatic animals , which are protected by the state , shall be prohibited .
those who catch major wild aquatic animals , which are protected by the state , for such purposes as scientific research , raising , training , breeding , or exhibition or under special circumstances shall abide by the stipulations of " the prc wildlife protection law. "
the fishery administration departments of the people 's governments at and above the county level shall investigate and deal with in a timely fashion those found selling illegal catch in a forbidden fishing zone or during a closed fishing season .
those found manufacturing or selling banned fishing tackle shall have their illegal fishing tackle , which they have manufactured or put on the market , and their illegal income confiscated and shall be ordered to pay a fine of no more than 10,000 yuan .
article 40 those found letting whole - people - owned water areas or shoals lie waste for one year without reasonable explanations since contracting such water areas or shoals for aquacultural production shall be ordered to exploit or utilize such water areas or shoals within a deadline by the organs which have issued an aquacultural production permit to them .
article 41 those who have not yet obtained an aquacultural production permit in accordance with the law shall have their catch and illegal income confiscated and shall be ordered to pay a fine of no more than 100,000 yuan if found carrying out fishing activities without authorization .
article 42 those found carrying out fishing activities in violation of fishing activities , fishing sites , time limit , and amount of fishing tackle listed in their fishing permit shall have their catch and illegal income confiscated and may also be ordered to pay a fine of no more than 50,000 yuan at the same time .
article 44 those found illegally producing , importing , or exporting young aquatic products shall have their young aquatic products and illegal income confiscated and shall be ordered to pay a fine of no more than 50,000 yuan .
those found involved in aquatic products operations without examination and approval shall be ordered to immediately stop such operations ; shall have their illegal income confiscated ; and may also be ordered to pay a fine of no more than 50,000 yuan .
article 45 those found carrying out fishing activities in an aquatic resource protection zone shall be ordered to immediately stop such fishing activities ; shall have their catch and fishing tackle confiscated ; and may also be ordered to pay a fine of no more than 10,000 yuan .
article 47 those found causing damage to ecological environment of fishing waters or causing a pollution accident in fishing waters shall be investigated and punished in accordance with the provisions of " the prc marine environmental protection law " and " the prc water pollution prevention and control law. "

beijing , 1 nov ( xinhua ) - - order of the president of the people 's republic of china ( no .
39 ) the " decision of the national people 's congress [ npc ] standing committee on amending the ' prc law for protecting the rights and interests of returnees and dependents of overseas chinese ' approved at the 18 th session of the npc standing committee on 31 october 2000 is hereby promulgated .
this law is drawn up on the basis of the constitution for the sake of protecting the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants .
article 2 .
returned overseas chinese refer to overseas chinese who have returned to china for permanent residence .
overseas chinese dependants in this law include the spouses , parents , children and their spouses , brothers , sisters , grandparents , maternal grandparents , grandchildren , and maternal grandchildren of overseas chinese and returned overseas chinese , as well as other relatives with whom overseas chinese and returned overseas chinese have long - term support relations .
returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants are entitled to their citizen 's rights stated in the constitution and the law , and they undertake citizen 's obligations prescribed in the constitution and the law .
the state takes appropriate care of returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants according to their actual situations and their distinctive characteristics . the state council , or relevant authorities in charge under the state council , shall draw up the specific measures . article 4 .
returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants have the right to lawfully apply for forming social groups and carry out lawful social activities to meet their needs .
the local governments shall provide relief to those returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants who are unable to work , who do not have financial resources , or who really have living problems .
article 11 . the state encourages and guides returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants to invest in setting up industries , especially high - tech enterprises . people 's governments at all levels shall give them support , and the law protects their legitimate rights and interests in this regard .
equipment and supplies that the relatives of returned overseas chinese or overseas chinese dependants donate for public causes in the country may have their tariffs , or taxes for goods that increase in value after being imported , reduced or exempted according to the law or administrative regulations .
article 13 . according to the law , the state protects the ownership of private houses owned by returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants .
when the private houses owned by returned overseas chinese or overseas chinese dependants have to be requisitioned , dismantled , or relocated , the construction units must rationally compensate them and properly resettle them according to the relevant state regulations .
article 14 . people 's governments at all levels must take care of returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants with respect to jobs , and give them the necessary guidance and services .
article 16 . returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants are entitled to the inheritance or gifts their overseas relatives give them .
the law protects the rights and interests of returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants when they receive inheritance from abroad .
article 19 . the state protects the rights of returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants to visit their relatives overseas .
article 20 . according to state regulations , returned overseas chinese and overseas chinese dependants may apply for permanent residence overseas . for those who have been approved to leave the country for permanent residence overseas , no organization or individual may infringe upon their legitimate rights and interests in this respect .
when returned overseas chinese workers or overseas chinese dependant workers live permanently overseas after they have left their offices for recuperation , retired , or resigned , they will continue to receive their pensions and other forms of pension payment .
article 23 . when the legitimate rights and interests of returned overseas chinese or overseas chinese dependants are violated , the victims have the rights to ask the relevant authorities in charge to handle the situation according to the law , or file lawsuits at a people 's court .
article 29 . the state council shall draw up implementation measures on the basis of this law .
the standing committees of people 's congresses of provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities under the central government 's direct jurisdiction may formulate their implementation measures on the basis of this law and the implementation measures of the state council .
article 30 . this law becomes effective on 1 january 1991 .

article 3 : the establishment of foreign - funded enterprises must be conducive to china 's national economic development .
the state encourages the founding of foreign - funded enterprises that are capable of exporting their products or have advanced technologies .
the industries in which the establishment of foreign - funded enterprises is prohibited or restricted by the state are determined by the state council .
foreign - funded enterprises must abide by the chinese laws and regulations , and must not harm china 's social and public interests .
under specific circumstances , however , the state may impose requisition on foreign - funded enterprises according to legal procedures in light of the necessity of public interests , and appropriate compensation will be made for it .
the date of issuing business license to the foreign - funded enterprise is the date on which the enterprise is established .
article 9 : a foreign - funded enterprise should make investment in the chinese territory within the allotted time ratified by the examination and approval organs ; the industrial and commercial administrative organs have the right to revoke its business license if it fails to make investment before the deadline .
the industrial and commercial administrative organs conduct examination and exercise supervision of the conditions about the investment of foreign - funded enterprises .
article 10 : the separation , merger , and other major changes of a foreign - funded enterprise should be reported to the examination and approval organs for approval , and the procedures for registration of changes should be gone through with the industrial and commercial administrative organs .
article 11 : foreign - funded enterprises can conduct their activities of operation and management in light of their approved articles of association without intervention .
article 12 : the workers and staff members employed by foreign - funded enterprises should sign contracts according to the law , in which the terms on employment , dismissal , remuneration , fringe benefits , labor protection , labor insurance , and others should be explicitly stipulated .
foreign - funded enterprises should provide the trade unions in their enterprises with necessary conditions for activities .
article 15 : goods and materials such as raw and semifinished materials , fuel , and so on needed by foreign - funded enterprises within the approved range of operations can be purchased from the domestic or international markets in the principle of fairness and reasonableness .
if a foreign - funded enterprise makes reinvestment in china with its after - tax profits , it can apply for the return of part of the income tax already paid for the portion used in reinvestment according to the state 's stipulations .
foreign - funded enterprises should open their bank accounts with the bank of china or other banks designated by the state industrial and commercial administrative organs .
the salary income and other proper income of the foreign workers and staff members employed by the foreign - funded enterprises can be remitted to foreign countries after their personal income taxes are paid according to the law .
article 20 : a foreign - funded enterprise 's term of operation should be applied by the foreign investor and approved by the organs in charge of examination and approval .
article 21 : the suspension of foreign - funded enterprises should be publicly announced in good time , and their accounts should be settled according to legal procedures .
before the liquidation is wound up , foreign investors shall not dispose of the properties belonging to the enterprises except those under liquidation .
a cooperative enterprise that conforms to the stipulations of the chinese law on conditions of being a corporation will acquire , in accordance with law , corporate capacity in china .
article 3 the state protects the legal rights and interests of a cooperative enterprise , and chinese and foreign cooperators in accordance with law .
article 4 the state encourages establishment of productive cooperative enterprises in exporting goods or advanced technology .
the examination and ratification organs should decide whether to approve or not within 45 days of the day of receiving the application .
article 6 after an application for the establishment of cooperative enterprise is ratified , it is necessary to apply for a business license with the department in charge of industry and commerce within 30 days since the day of receiving the ratification certificate .
the date of issuance of the business license for the cooperative enterprise is the founding date of the enterprise .
article 9 chinese and foreign cooperators should fulfil their obligations in paying up investment on schedule and implementing the cooperation conditions according to the law , rules , and agreed terms of the cooperative enterprise contract .
article 10 it is necessary to obtain agreement from the other party and report to the examination and ratification organs for approval if either party of the chinese and foreign cooperators transfers whole or a part of party 's rights and obligations as stipulated in the cooperative enterprise contract .
one party of the chinese or foreign cooperators serves as chairman of the board of directors or director of the joint management body , and the other party serves as vice chairman and deputy director .
article 13 such matters as employment , dismissal , pay , welfare , labor protection , and labor insurance should be stipulated through establishment of a contract in accordance with law .
article 14 staff and workers of a cooperative enterprise can establish a labor union , and develop labor union activities in accordance with law to safeguard the legal rights and interests of the staff and workers .
the cooperative enterprise should provide the necessary environment for the enterprise 's labor union activities .
article 16 a cooperative enterprise should open a foreign exchange account at banks or other financial institutions authorized by the state foreign exchange control authorities to operate a foreign exchange business .
article 20 a cooperative enterprise can enjoy preferential treatment in tax reduction and exemption by paying taxes in accordance with the state stipulations on taxation .
article 21 chinese and foreign cooperators should distribute profits or products and share risks and losses in accordance with the agreed terms of the cooperative enterprise contract .
if , as agreed in the cooperative enterprise contract , the foreign cooperators are allowed to reclaim investments before paying income tax , it is necessary to submit applications with the financial and tax authorities , which will examine and approve in accordance with the state stipulations on taxation .
article 22 profits obtained by foreign cooperators who have fulfilled their obligations as stipulated by law and the agreed terms in the cooperative enterprise contract , other legal revenues earned and the fund shared upon termination of the operation of the cooperative enterprise can be remitted to foreign countries .
the cooperative enterprise should cancel registration with the department in charge of industry and commerce and the tax authorities when the term of the enterprise expires or the operation of the enterprise is terminated ahead of schedule .
the chinese and foreign cooperators should submit an application to examination and ratification organs 180 days prior to the expiration of the cooperation term if the cooperators agree to extend the cooperation term .
the examination and ratification organs should decide whether to approve the application within 30 days of the date of receiving the application .
chinese and foreign cooperators who have neither entered any arbitration clauses into the cooperative enterprise contract nor reached a written arbitration agreement after the disputes arise can submit the case to a court in china .

beijing , 2 nov ( xinhua ) - - the two - day legislative work meeting of the national people 's congress (npc) standing committee ended today . li peng , member of the politburo of the cpc central committee and chairman of the npc standing committee , attended the meeting and made a speech .
vice npc chairmen jiang chunyun , zhou jiahua , and buhe chaired the meeting respectively .
yang jingyu , director of the state council 's legislative affairs office , briefed the participants on the state council 's work in implementing the ninth npc standing committee 's legislative plan , enforcing the legislation law , and strengthening the government 's legislative work .
li peng listened to their speeches attentively for two days in a row and also delivered an important speech .
up to the present , 271 laws and 113 law - related decisions and interpretations totalling 384 have been examined and adopted .
during this period , the state council has formulated more than 800 administrative laws and regulations , local people 's congresses and their standing committees that have legislative powers have formulated more than 8,000 local laws and regulations , and various departments under the state council and local governments have formulated more than 30,000 regulations and statutes .
we should give free rein to the laws in guiding and standardizing reform practice .
in formulating the laws , we should proceed from actual necessity , lay emphasis on stability , and pay attention to the perspective . only by combining these two can we suit the formulation of laws to the requirements of reform and development and promote the development of productive forces .
he emphasized that in performing the legislative work , we must proceed from the people 's fundamental interests , persist in taking the constitution as the basis , and ensure that the laws thus formulated will accord with the overall interests of the state and the fundamental interests of the people .
li peng said emphatically : an important experience of the legislative work is that it should always be carried out around the party and state 's central tasks and adapted to the progress of reform , opening up , and modernization .
he said : administering the country according to law is a huge social systems engineering , which include such links as law formulation , law enforcement , administration of justice , observation of law , and law popularization .
the vitality of the laws lies in implementation .
if the laws fail to be implemented , then they are mere scraps of waste paper .
these circumstances seriously damaged the authority and dignity of the law , infringed upon the citizens and legal persons ' legitimate rights and interests , tarnished the image of the party and country , impaired social stability , and hampered the healthy development of the cause of reform , opening up , and modernization .
therefore , while taking firm control of the legislative work , we must pay serious attention to the effective enforcement of the laws .
he said : in order to guarantee the effective enforcement of the laws , it is imperative to further intensify the supervisory work , improve the supervising mechanism , and perfect the supervising and constraining mechanism for the exercise of powers according to law .

economic restructuring in broad sense zhou : the basic line of the " proposal " is economic restructuring . in this " proposal , " this economic restructuring covers more areas . the first one is the industrial structure .
in addition to the aforementioned three structures , it is also necessary to readjust the consumption structure , the income structure , and the ownership structure . however , all these must be readjusted with focus on the readjustment of the aforementioned three major structures .
right now , the reason for lack of consumer demands is the retarded growth of farmers ' income .
therefore , we must implement the policy of levying less corvee and taxes to reduce farmers ' burdens . it is also necessary to develop township enterprises and small cities and towns and raise the level of agricultural industrialization . all these are extremely important .
liu : in industrial restructuring , there is an issue of handling well the relationship between industrialization and the development of the information industry .
some comrades believe that the issue of industrialization is settled , since the development of the information industry has been put forward .
in developed countries , the information industry is developed after they have completed their industrialization .
this means to say that we must use high and applicable technologies to transform traditional industries such as the textile industry , the light industry , the metallurgical industry , the petroleum industry , the transportation industry , and the energy industry .
in addition , we must selectively but energetically develop high - tech industries such as the information industry , the bioengineering industry , and the new materials industry .
liu : you are right .
this issue is connected with how to handle well the relationship between the labor - intensive industry and the technology - , knowledge - , and capital - intensive industries .
after all , the labor - intensive industry offers more jobs for the people .
in china , the " tertiary industry " accounts for more than one - third of the gdp in the country . the service sector makes up more than 70 percent of the gdp in developed countries , while the world average is 50 percent .
this sector includes banking , transportation , commerce , education , and urban services of all kinds , residential services , and tourism .
emphasis on scientific , technological , and institutional innovations zhou : the driving forces for development mentioned in the " proposal " attach importance to two " innovations " - - institutional innovation and scientific and technological innovation . the task in this connection remains arduous . what is your view ?
we had made progress in the 1990 's in establishing the market economic system in the cities and building a modern corporate system for the state - owned enterprises .
during this period , small enterprises had achieved relatively remarkable progress in opening and rejuvenating themselves and restructuring . large enterprises were faced with difficulties in transforming themselves . they need to exert even greater efforts in this connection .
also , enterprise management and enterprise technical transformation involve issues of technological innovations and upgrading .
since the beginning of the new period , the living standards of the urban people have been greatly raised . everyone reaps actual benefits from the reform and opening - up program .
however , there are also problems in the people 's daily life .
the first one is the issue of employment , while the second one is the difference in income distribution .
however , the method of trying to raise the rate of inflation in an attempt to increase the rate of employment is inappropriate .
section 13 of the " proposal " has included provisions and proposals to " actively expand employment and improve the social security system . "
we must solve this problem by deepening reform and adopting comprehensive measures . particularly , we must curb illicit income .
some of the people who administer the " examination and approval economy " often abuse their power for private gains .
for relatively fair distribution of earnings , there is an issue of mechanism .
we still have a great deal of work to do in this connection including the overall collection of income tax and inheritance tax and the enactment of the gift tax .
the formulation in the " proposal " that you just mentioned is an encouragement to scientific and technological innovations .
with the development of the productive forces , the role of science , technology , and management as a major form of labor has become more and more significant in social production .
background of the theory of " two fundamental changes " zhou : the fifth plenary session of the 15 th cpc central committee had once again advanced the " two fundamental changes " - - fundamental changes in the economic system and the mode of economic growth .
i remember that you wrote an article in the 1980 's in connection with these two changes and that you have become one of the major founders on this theory .
liu : theoreticians had already put forward the changes in the economic system and the mode of economic growth in the mid - 1980 's . this theory has epitomized and reflected the two main lines that have run side by side in china 's economic development since the implementation of the reform and opening - up policy .
however , it was not until the formulation of the " ninth five - year " that these two fundamental changes had become a consensus and an official guideline for development .
it is entirely logical that the guideline of effecting the " two fundamental changes " was put forward when the " ninth five - year " plan was formulated between 1995 and 1996 .
during the period of the " ninth five - year " plan , the most significant change in the economic life in china was the fact that we had completely extricated ourselves from the difficult position of the economy of shortages and successfully accomplished the transition from a seller 's market to a buyer 's market .
this indicates that china 's productive forces have been significantly accelerated . fundamentally speaking , this should be regarded as the result from the change in the economic system .
the governments at various levels have also gradually realized that in order to sharpen our competitiveness in the development of our national economy , it is necessary to vigorously readjust the structure , pay attention to the quality in economic growth , and give prominence to scientific , technological , and institutional innovations .
in terms of speed , china 's economic performances during the period of the " ninth five - year " plan were outstanding as compared with either the developed countries or the developing countries .
more important is the fact that the quality of economic growth has been significantly improved . the economic structure has also gradually become rational . economic efficiency has been gradually raised . particularly in the last two years of the " ninth five - year " plan period , industrial enterprises had made substantial profits .
facts have proven that to advance " two fundamental changes " is an effective measure .
thank you for the interview .
recently , some people called for enacting legislation for " reeducation through labor " as soon as possible .
this author holds that there is no need to enact a law for " reeducation through labor . "
labor reeducation is mainly applied to lawbreaking people whose cases are not as serious as deserving criminal punishment , so they are sent to work in labor reeducation sites and forced to receive reeducation and transformation through labor .
the decision on sending a person to labor reeducation is proposed by the public security organ and approved by the labor reeducation management committee formed by the public security , civil affairs , and labor departments .
such administrative procedures include the following characteristics : first , being internal . the decision on sending a person to labor reeducation is made and approved through internal procedures .
third , not being a criminal case in a court of law . the decision on sending a person to labor reeducation is not made through the trial in a court of law . there is no court hearing and no need to present evidence and witnesses or hold debates in court .
it is obviously improper to allow the adoption of a punishment measure resulting in depriving people of personal freedom in such a simple and easy way .
after the criminal procedural law was amended in 1996 , administrative detention was rescinded .
as this prevents prolonged detention in some cases , the improper adoption of coercive measures has been reduced , and people 's civil rights have been better protected .

speaking on the relationship between township and town people 's governments and village committees , cao zhi pointed out : township and town people 's governments must lawfully guide , support , and assist , but must not interfere in the villagers ' lawful autonomy .
cao zhi pointed out : villagers ' committees are not grass - roots government organizations of the state but are autonomous organizations of the masses in the rural areas . their relations with the township and town governments are not administrative relations between upper and lower departments .
therefore , township and town governments cannot directly interfere in the affairs within the scope of villagers ' lawful autonomy , but they should take the initiative to guide , support , and assist villagers ' committees to pave the road for villagers ' autonomy .
on how to handle the relationship between villagers ' meetings and villagers ' congresses , cao zhi said : villagers ' meeting is the foundation and basic format for villagers to exercise their powers in democratic autonomy . the meetings elect villagers ' committees and supervise their work , make decisions on major matters concerning villagers ' interests .
on the other hand , the villagers ' congress is only supplementary to the villagers ' meeting .
however , in the process of enforcing the law , some localities have replaced villagers ' meetings with villagers ' congresses , which does not conform to the purpose of legislation .

whether a presidential candidate wins the election or not depends on the number of electoral votes he garners .
in all , there are 538 electoral votes nationwide , representing 50 states as well as the district of columbia . a presidential candidate needs only to secure 270 electoral votes , which is more than half of the total , to be elected president .
the number of electoral votes of each state is the same as the number of seats representing the state in congress . the district of columbia has three electoral votes .

according to local law of florida , the ballots will be recounted .
obviously , florida has become very crucial and whoever wins in that state will enter and host the white house .
the reason why the current general election has been so unusual is because of worldwide concern of what direction the first us president elected in the new century will lead the united states .
in order to attain this core goal , the global strategy of the clinton administration mainly includes three aspects : to strengthen us security , to promote us economic prosperity , and to promote democracy and human rights abroad .
if gore is elected , he will maintain the basic stability of this policy .

no matter whether the democratic party or the republican party becomes the ruling party , the united states will put the development of military strength in an important position and will continue to regard it as the major means to maintain its position of " hegemony of one superpower " in the new century .
however , the difference between the two parties in the foreign economic and trade policy is quite big .
viewed from the long future , the ruling party , either the democratic party or the republican party , will combine free trade with regulated trade , but there may be some difference in emphasis and concrete practices .
regarding the us domestic economic policy , both gore and bush jr regard maintaining us economic prosperity and transforming the us society as the key point , support a balanced budget , and call for reducing taxes .
george w bush added that if the results of the vote recount are consistent with what he has hoped for , the republicans will have won the presidential election .
in the meantime , albert gore said that though he and his campaign partner lieberman have won more votes cast by voters , the constitution stipulates that it is votes cast by presidential electors that shall determine who has won a presidential election .

the officials of the florida government announced on 8 november that florida will wind up its recount of votes by 9 november .

by early this morning , the us general election , which cost $ 3 billion and lasted for the better half of a year and which was hotly contested as never before , was still unable to produce a new president .
although the governments of many countries , which follow the us presidential election with great interest and want al gore to win , do not openly show their feelings , they are uneasily waiting for the final election results .

numerous difficult diplomatic problems the new us president 's attitude toward the national missile defense [ nmd ] system is also a cause for concern among various countries .
early last september , clinton announced that the united states would not deploy the controversial nmd for the time being . by taking this decision , he threw away a scalding hot potato and left a knotty problem for the next president .
during the election campaign , george w. bush claimed on numerous occasions that if he were elected , he would speed up the deployment of nmd .
if he is really elected , he will probably re - start the nmd program .
no matter how it turns out , as a president , he must take into account the strong reaction in the country and the majority of countries in the world , including the us allies .
the iraqi issue is also a difficult diplomatic one to be faced by the new us president .
the united states attempted to force saddam husayn out of office by imposing sanctions against iraq but , despite the change of three us presidents starting with george h.w. bush , saddam husayn still firmly remains in office while the iraqi people have paid a great cost because of the sanctions imposed in the past 10 years .
still need time to make adjustments the statements made by various candidates during the election campaign should not be taken as evidence or should be taken with a grain of salt .
if george w. bush takes office , he will proceed from the us national interests and reexamine his foreign policy statements during the election campaign ; if al gore is elected , he will not completely follow clinton 's diplomatic line either .
whoever is elected needs some time to think and make adjustments .
the palestinian - israeli clash that begun in the end of september has lasted more than a month , claiming some 170 lives , wounding some 5,000 people on the palestinian side , and causing over $ 900 million of economic losses .
the palestinian - israeli talks , a major link in the current middle east peace process , are entering the last stage . but both parties are stuck in such core issues as the status of jerusalem , the declaration of palestinian state , and the return of palestinian refugees .
in july this year , at us president clinton 's initiative , israeli prime minister ehud barak and palestinian leader yasir arafat held trilateral summit talks in camp david trying to get the stalled talks on the final status moving .
although israel has loosen up a bit over its unnegotiable position of " jerusalem being israel 's eternal , united capital , " the camp david talks still ended without results .
after the failed talks , the palestine side , weighing pros and cons and taking the current situation into consideration , decided to put off the date of the declaration of a palestinian state in order to create relaxed atmosphere and conditions .
despite the facts that palestine and israel resumed talks in washington later and another meeting between the heads of both sides on 25 september , these efforts produced no results .
on 4 october , arafat , barak , and the us secretary of state madeleine albright held a trilateral meeting without results .
the palestinian side stressed that israeli troops should first pull out from the palestinian region . israel , however , insisted that palestinians should stop violence first .
some sharp and deep changes have emerged recently in the middle east .
facts have shown that as the palestinian - israeli talks enter the most critical stage , the most sensitive problems over the status of jerusalem , the establishment of the palestinian state , and the return of palestinian refugees can not be avoided .
regarding the palestinian - israeli talks , the palestinian side made it clear that israel 's bloody repression means the end of peace talks and that the intifada will continue until the legitimate rights of palestinians are thoroughly restored .
the palestinian said also indicated that the palestinian - israeli talks could be resumed only when all the israelis withdraw from the palestinian region and when all the jewish settlements in the occupied land are dismantled .
in syrian - israeli talks , as syria reiterated that israel must unconditionally withdraw from the golan heights , the prospects of peace talks are made even more unpredictable .
the boat of peace talks must be rowed ahead with sincerity and with the will to implement agreements , both of which are indispensable .

the following sidelights are true records of the close fight between bush and gore .
life or death depends on florida after voting in the election ended on 7 november and counting began , a complicated situation of one overtaking the other and then being overtaken was played out at different localities .
the bush camp instantly erupted in wild joy , and the senior bush and junior bush congratulated each other in celebration , whereas the gore camp was in utter despair . gore himself had no choice but to call his opponent to concede defeat .
it was totally unexpected that sometime after 0400 hours , florida election officials claimed that the number of votes separating the two candidates was only 1,210 and more than 2,000 absentee votes remained to be counted .
according to florida election regulations , such a narrow difference necessitates a recount .
gore then telephoned bush to retract his congratulatory telephone message conceding defeat .
bush 's victory celebration had to be abruptly put on hold .
such an extraordinary turn of events in an extraordinary night left the fates of the candidates unknown and made them feel that as if each day were a year .
since the time difference between the eastern and western united states is three hours , some printed media committed a faux pas by not waiting for the final result and going to press in the early morning .
the english - language new york post today splashed the renowned name of " president - elect " bush in big red letters across its front page , while a chinese - language newspaper in new york carried a front - page headline reading " bush narrowly wins . "
readers who bought the paper had the wrong impression and spread the wrong news until they realized they had been " fooled " when other people corrected them .
bush keeps his backyard , and gore painfully loses his home state bush 's record as governor of his home state of texas has been fair , and he is quite popular there , winning the 32 electoral votes of texas .
as for gore , who was born in tennessee and spent most of his youth in washington , d.c. , the last time he ran for public office in his home state was 10 years ago . many voters in tennessee think he would not speak out for his people .
in yesterday 's election , results in two - thirds of tennessee 's electoral precincts showed that bush won 52 percent of the votes cast , while gore only garnered 47 percent .

beijing , november 9 (xna) - - in order to strengthen management over software products and promote development of the software industry in china , the ministry of information industry recently issued the " provisions governing software products . "
according to these provisions , the development , production , sale , import / export and other activities relating to software products should abide by the relevant laws , regulations and standards of china .
these provisions have clarified the management responsibilities of the ministry of information industry over all software products in china .
a system to register and record software products will be implemented . software products not registered , not kept on record or which have been removed from the registry are not allowed to be marketed or sold within china .
the software products made by the production units should possess all legal copyrights or approval from the copyright owner or other authorities to produce said copyrighted material .
the software production unit is responsible for carrying out inspections on the contents of its software products .
units producing software products , including units producing and manufacturing carriers of software products ( such as disks , magnetic disks , chips and others ) , must not produce software products that are not registered or recorded . no unit or individual may produce pirated software , nor develop or produce decrypting software .
there are also regulations in the provisions that cover the sale and supervisory management of software products . in addition , the provisions have clarified punishments to deal with violations of these provisions .
