beijing , 8 november ( wen wei po ) - - it is fair to say that the 54 th us presidential election has been full of twists and turns , fulfilling this prophetic remark made by president clinton before all this happened : " i have truly never seen any election campaign like this before . "
the experts here in beijing are now calling the 2000 us presidential election the most reassuring one for beijing since 1979 .
tao wenzhao , deputy director of the institute of north america of the chinese academy of social sciences and secretary - general of the chinese society of american studies , gave an interview to this reporter here in beijing .
one can also see this as one of the characteristics of this election .
tao , a research fellow , explained that in all the us presidential election campaigns since 1979 , when china and the united states established diplomatic relations , the issue of sino - us relations has not , for the first time , become a hot topic this year .
as to the statement made by bush jr. that " china and the united states are not in a strategic partnership , but in a strategic rivalry , " experts do not see any essential difference between the two and it was put forward more for the sake of campaign propaganda .
tao wenzhao said : partnership does not exclude competition and nor does competition exclude cooperation . the essential nature of the sino - us relations is and will continue to be a pattern of cooperation in some fields , competition in some fields , and mixed cooperation and competition in some other fields .
why is it that the china card has not been played in this year 's us general election ?
experts have analyzed the situation and are of the opinion that there are two reasons for this .
the most manifest example is that the us senate and house adopted the pntr [ permanent normal trade relations ] proposal by an overwhelming majority this year .
in this respect , both bush and gore are internationalists , not trade protectionists , and both are for granting china a permanent normal trading status and for china 's accession to the wto [ world trade organization ] .
it is fair to say that the mainstream opinions in the two parties have indeed reached a common consent , at least on a number of issues concerning sino - us relations .
the fact that votes for the two candidates are very close at this election is largely a result of the convergence of their policies . on the taiwan issue , which has attracted much attention , bush once said : " the united states will assist taiwan in defending itself . "
experts here in beijing responded to that remark by saying : this is not a new statement , as it is the original gist of the united states ' " taiwan relations act. "
the election campaign has generally given the impression that as far as the relations across the taiwan straits are concerned , bush is tougher and more clear - cut than gore , but in essence , they are both more inclined to maintain the current ambiguous strategy .
the second viewpoint is that the united states and japan have a military alliance between them spanning over half a century , so us - japanese relations are far more important than sino - us relations .
since the 1960 s , petroleum has risen above 40 percent of the world 's energy consumption , and has become the primary energy source in the world .
petroleum security has become a common issue that all countries in the contemporary world are facing .
first , petroleum has a bearing on china 's economic lifeline , but the domestic output now cannot satisfy the consumption demand , and china 's reliance on exported oil resources is increasing continuously .
since the period of the eighth five - year plan , oil consumption has been increasing by an average rate of 4.9 percent each year ; while in the same period , the output of crude oil has been increasing only by 1.7 percent per year .
beginning 1993 , china changed from an oil exporting country to a oil importing country .
in 1999 , china imported a total of some 40 million tons of crude oil and oil products , accounting for over 20 percent of oil consumption in the whole country that year .
in the next 20 years , although the domestic crude oil output will continue to show an upward tendency , the increase rate will be very limited . it is expected that in 2010 and 2020 , the output will be 170 million tons and 180 million tons separately .
the degree of china 's reliance on foreign oil resources will increased from the current level of 20 percent to over 40 percent in 2010 and over 50 percent in 2020 .
second , in the next 20 years , oil supply and demand in the world will be basically balanced , but changes may occur in the supply pattern . the competition around oil resources will become more intense .
in the past 10 years , the world 's oil output increased by an average rate of about 1.4 percent each year . in 1999 , the output of crude oil was 3,450 million tons ; and the consumption of oil was 460 million tons [ as printed ] , up by 1.6 percent .
according to the forecast made by a relevant institution , in the next 10 to 15 years , it is likely that the world 's petroleum production will maintain a 1.4 percent increase rate .
in general , the world 's oil consumption will increase at a rate slightly higher than the production increase rate .
in the world , the unevenness in the distribution of oil resources and markets may be further aggravated and may cause more serious problems .
according to a forecast , the conventional exploitable oil reserve in the world is 311,300 million tons .
in particular , the remaining exploitable oil reserve in the middle east accounts for 64 percent of the world 's total , and the found resources account for 25 percent of the world 's total .
after 2010 , the proportion of opec 's oil output in the world will increase from 39 percent at present to over 50 percent .
in the whole world , oil supply will more heavily rely on the middle east . as for oil consumption , at present , and in the next 10 to 20 years , nearly 80 percent of petroleum is consumed in north american , asia - pacific , and europe .
in the asia - pacific region where china is located , the contradiction between oil supply and demand is particularly prominent .
it is expected that in 2005 , the asia - pacific region will exceed north america and become the world 's number one oil consuming region . within 10 to 15 years , china will exceed japan , and become number one oil consuming country in this region .
the middle east and north africa will continue to be the region with the richest oil resources in the world . as the world will rely more and more heavily on petroleum , the contention for oil resources in this region will also become more and more intense .
central asia - - russia oil producing region is located between the two major oil consuming regions of europe and asia . the market for oil exploitation there has just been opened , and has attracted many transnational oil companies , especially those from the western countries , to participate in the competition there .
the potential of oil resources in russia ' far east region and its geographical position have also attracted attention from various countries in east asia .
in the past 50 years , the contention for oil resources has never paused .
the central part of the oil policy in central asia is to support the participation of the western oil companies in the region 's oil exploitation and is aimed at building oil transportation channels to directly link the oil resources in this region to the european and american markets without passing through the territories of russia and iran .
in particular , the two supply suspensions in 1973 and 1979 caused worldwide oil crises . the direct reasons for the supply suspensions were the outbreak of wars and conflicts among oil producing countries in the middle east , and this resulted in cutting down the oil transportation channels .
on the other hand , china enjoys both geographical and political advantages in accessing to the oil resources in central asia and russia . the central asian countries and russia have set up strategic cooperative partnerships with our country .
in northeast asia , japan and rok also share common interests with us in keeping the stability of the regional oil market .

for nine consecutive years , the un general assembly has adopted resolutions on passing cuba 's proposal demanding us abolition of its economic , trade , and financial blockade against the country .
in comparison with last year 's votes , of which 155 were for the proposal , two against , and eight abstentions , there are 12 more countries supporting cuba 's proposal this year .
the 9 november un general assembly session became a session of denouncing the united states for its blockade policy against cuba . not only the majority of asian , african , and latin american countries unanimously supported cuba 's proposal , but eu nations also expressed their opposition to this us policy with one voice .
more and more people asked : at a time when the cold war has long been over , why does the united states still stubbornly persist in this policy ?
facts have proven more and more explicitly that the us blockade policy is " harming others but not benefiting itself . "
as the cuban people are carrying out a resolute struggle and pressure is mounting in the united states , the us government has had in recent years to indicate many times its readiness to relax the situation , but no actual action has been taken .
last month the us senate and house of representatives respectively passed a bill on lifting food blockade and medicine blockade against cuba . these bills were incorporated in the law with president clinton 's endorsement .
but due to disruption by anti - cuban forces , the newly enacted law consists of some unreasonable restrictive clauses , aggravating the blockade against cuba instead of relaxing the situation . this , of course , met with a firm opposition from the cuban government and people .
according to an associated press report , unofficial latest results show that the republican party candidate and texas governor george w. bush still temporarily leads the democratic party candidate and vice president al gore by a slim margin .
vote counts in 66 of 67 counties in florida indicate that bush leads al gore by only 229 votes .
according to us election law , a presidential candidate must take over half of 538 electoral votes of the 50 states and washington , district of columbia , to get elected .
in the us presidential election on 7 november , votes for the republican and democratic candidates were very close , and capturing florida 's 25 electoral votes will finally decide who will be the next us president .
the first vote count published in the early morning of 8 november by local media showed that bush led al gore in florida by only 0.5 percent point .
according to florida law , a recount of votes is required when the vote difference between two candidates is less than 0.5 percent .
katherine harris , secretary of state of florida , announced on 9 november us eastern time that 53 of 67 counties had turned over the results of the vote recount to the state government .
according to local law , 14 counties that still have not submitted results of vote recounts will report to the state government before 14 november , and the florida election vote counting committee will confirm the vote recount results of various counties after it receives all reports from 67 counties .
in addition , the state election officials will also count overseas ballots received before 17 november .
he said the democratic party would also call for manual vote counting in palm beach county and in three other counties , as well as supporters filing lawsuits over the election issues .
according to local press reports , some 19,000 ballots have been disqualified in florida 's palm beach county . some voters complain that due to improper ballot design they had mistakenly cast votes for the reform party candidate pat buchanan instead of for al gore .
some voters in that county have filed lawsuits with federal and district courts , and called for a re - election in the county .

hong kong , 10 november ( zhongguo tongxun she ) - - a string of mistakes and media fiascos in the us presidential election have turned the whole event into a joke of the century .
the british newspaper , the times , said that the us presidential election has been " an irony of democracy . " under the existing election system , gore , who has won the popular vote , may lose to bush jr. , who has won the majority of the electoral votes .
the mirror , another british paper , pointed out : " the united states has become the laughing stock of the world today ; " " this kind of situation can only be expected to happen in a banana republic . "
germany 's die welt even remarked : " the united state 's election system is now out of date and reform is very necessary , as even the recognition of the president who is eventually elected has become a question . "
as the system dictates , whoever wins the majority vote from a whole state will win all the electoral votes from that state .
unexpectedly , the sensitivity of the state of florida attracted the attention of the media world , leading to an endless string of drawbacks , mistakes , and farces .
at around 2000 on 7 november , national broadcasting company [ nbc ] was the first to announce gore 's victory in florida , winning 25 electoral votes and very likely to become the new master of the white house .
other media bodies quoted this story one after another , causing quite a stir .
but two hours later , cable news network [ cnn ] indicated that election statistics from florida were questionable and retracted the earlier story quoting gore 's win .
columbia broadcasting system [ cbs ] , public broadcasting system [ pbs ] , and nbc all changed their tone subsequently , saying that a recount was to be held in florida .
after another three hours , at around 0100 on 8 november , the four leading television networks in the united states separately announced that bush jr. had taken the 25 electoral votes from florida and stepped over the threshold of 270 electoral votes that must be had in order to become president .
( this time , new york times tripped up and repeated the historical joke of chicago daily tribune mistakenly reporting in 1948 that " dewey defeats truman " to become president . )
the us press has admitted that this process has greatly undermined the public credibility of the media .
gore and his campaign team originally felt sure of success and he was about to make a speech upon his victory , when he watched the reports from the electronic media , all saying the same thing , and felt as if cold water had been poured over him .
but , unexpectedly , that was followed immediately by the news that a recount was necessary in florida , whereupon gore called bush jr. again to " retract congratulations , " to both sides ' great embarrassment .
the misreporting by the media also caused the heads of state of a number of countries to send embarrassing congratulatory messages and those countries had no choice but to stop their transmission halfway .
the united states has always advertised itself as the " father of democracy , " peddling the us - style democratic system to the whole world . but very strangely , no country in the world has copied the us system whereby presidential elections are decided by electoral votes .
the main reason is that it has many loopholes and drawbacks .
there are a total of 528 electoral votes in the whole country and a candidate who wins 270 such votes will become the president .
the biggest drawback of this system is that even if a candidate wins the popular vote , he may not become president .
because the number of votes for gore and that for bush jr. were very close and the preliminary result showed that gore was only over 1,000 votes behind , less than 0.5 percent , the votes must therefore be recounted according to the rules .
the first problem was miscount . gore was not over 1,700 votes behind : the difference was over 700 votes only .
thirdly , many black people complained that they were stopped from casting their votes at the polls , which was obviously a sign of racial discrimination .
therefore , the maladies exposed by this presidential dystocia have given rise to an appeal from us opinion makers for amendment of the constitution to change the presidential election system .
durbin , democratic senator from illinois , said : " we should revise the presidential election system and end the state - based electoral system that has been in place for two centuries . "

zhuhai , 11 nov ( xinhua ) - - the china aerospace science and technology corporation is a leading force in china 's aerospace high - tech arena .
being an organ empowered and invested by the state , the china aerospace science and technology corporation is a large state - owned and solely invested enterprise founded on 1 july last year based on some enterprises and institutions under the former china aerospace industry corporation .
it employs 110,000 workers , of whom , 41,000 are specialized technicians , including 1,300 - plus research staff , 25 academicians of the chinese academy of sciences and the chinese academy of engineering , and 24 academicians and telecommunications academicians of the international academy of aerospace science .
most rockets launched during this period were new models and produced a great influence . in particular , the development and successful launch of the " shenzhou " experimental spaceship greatly inspired the national spirit , intensified national unity , and enhanced china 's position in the world .
at the same time , the leading party group of the corporation proposed putting the development of civil - use products in a strategic place , actively transferred aerospace high technology to production of civil - use products , and expedited the development of civil - use products .
when asked what level china 's aerospace technology is in , wang liheng said that although china is a developing country , it has already joined the ranks of the world 's major space countries .
china is one of the minority of aerospace high - technology countries that has mastered satellite recovery technology , low - temperature and high - energy rocket technology , cluster rocket technology , stationary satellite launching , monitoring , and controlling technologies , and the technology of launching several satellites with one rocket .
china also has the capacity of launching , monitoring , and controlling international commercial satellites .
it should be clearly noted , however , that china 's aerospace technology still lags behind the united states and russia , especially in the field of communications satellites .
wang liheng said , as the pioneer of the new high - tech industry of our times and as the major material and technological foundation for the new economic era , space technology will certainly play a key role in promoting the progress of the civilization of mankind and society in the 21 st century .

the dispute over ballot counting may develop to a large - scale election lawsuit , and will increase factors for instability of the united states and affect its relations with foreign countries .
this shows once more the us democracy is not what the united states claims it to be . nor is it the most ideal democratic system , as some people have prettified it to be .

according to the confirmed election result , the number of ballots cast by us voters supporting gore is slightly greater than that supporting bush jr. however , if bush jr. wins in florida , he will become the us president .
in other words , the candidate with the greater support of the voters cannot become the president , while the one with slightly less support will be elected .
if the two sides start a legal war it will be more difficult to determine who will win in future .
the united states always takes pride in its general election system [ pu xuan zhi ] and its election activities , regarding them as ways to give expression to democracy .
however , such us democracy has more and more become a gambling race for spending money and it has moved farther and farther away from the ordinary people .
the extremely inflated money politics has caused great resentment among the us public .
during the current election , the united states has squandered away $ 4 billion .
in the election of the us congress , over 90 percent of the candidates who spent more money were elected .
in the united states , there is a corner forgotten by the people . there are 32 million americans , accounting for 12 percent of the total , living below the poverty line .

the president elected in this way has never been the representative of the majority . much less can the elected president represent all the people .
however , the electoral system , which is lubricated with money , inevitably produces a congress specially for a small number of rich people .
the washington post disclosed that the us congress is " a congress of the rich , is ruled by the rich , and works in the interest of the rich . " this pierced to the truth with a single pertinent remark .
the us democracy mainly consists of the general election system , the two - party system , the congress system , and the system of the separation of the three powers , and is the product of the historical development of us society .
what form of democracy is practiced in the united states is the business of the americans .
however , it is extremely wrong to say that us democracy is the sole universal mode .
that the united states imposes its democracy on others has precisely expressed its hegemony in a concentrated manner .
what the united states should do is not attack the political systems of other countries , but correct all kinds of malpractice in us democracy .

shanghai , 12 nov ( xinhua ) - - the global information wave at the turn of the new century is pushing the gargantuan shanghai municipality to the forward position in china 's efforts to transform itself into an information - based society .
in june this year , a high - level asia - pacific regional forum on urban information was held in shanghai . its theme was to " promote the role of information in cities to jointly create new hometowns for the future . "
during the forum , shanghai signed four agreements with several countries and regions , including the united states , singapore , and hong kong to cooperate in developing digital library , distance learning , distance medical care , and other it [ information technology ] applications .
after inspecting shanghai 's achievements in it development , unesco president praised shanghai , saying that " shanghai 's achievement and experience in developing it give valuable inspiration to other cities in the asia - pacific region . "
an it port reveals its beauty shanghai , which sits on a major river and faces the ocean , has prospered as a port .
in drawing up shanghai 's ninth five - year plan , decision - makers in shanghai adopted the strategic policy decision to make shanghai an " it port . "
mayor xu kuangdi said : " unless we transform shanghai into an information - based municipality , there is not going to be modernization , and shanghai has no future . "
along with the implementation of shanghai 's ninth five - year plan , shanghai 's profile as an it port has become increasingly clear .
at present , shanghai has built the world 's largest regional cable television network with subscriptions topping three million households . this year , it has completed bidirectional modification of 700,000 households , enabling them to enjoy pay per view program and other services soon .
without a high - standard , relatively independent technology and manufacturing system as support , the establishment of an information - based municipality will become castles in the air .
shanghai has designated information industry its leading strategic industry and has given all - out support to the industry in hopes of using it as a catalyst and promoter to raise the economy 's overall quality and core competitiveness .
during the ninth five - year plan , shanghai 's information industry grows at an annual rate of 30 percent . its total output value is expected to reach 130 billion yuan this year , replacing auto industry as shanghai 's top pillar industry .
shanghai 's stored program controlled telephone switching system , optical fiber , optical transmission equipment , chips , electron tubes , and other competitive products each has captured more than 30 percent of the market share in china .
if a country lacks its own intellectual property rights [ ipr ] and competitive edge in this two areas , it will not be able to hold the lifeline of its information industry in its hands , and its network and information security will be at risk .
in light of this , shanghai started the shanghai information port security protection project , a national network security pilot project ; established a national network security industrial base ; and gave top priority to ic 's and software in the development of its information industry .
the " 909 project , " which centers on the production of ic 's with a total investment of $ 1.2 billion , is the largest strategic project undertaken by the electronics industry .
the shanghai huahong group , the project undertaker , has begun to harvest from its investment . this year 's sales are expected to reach three billion yuan and profits 500 million yuan , making huahong the " flagship " of china 's ic industry .
huahong has developed china 's first patented and completely secured non - contact memory chips and contact cpu chips , and the quality of its leading products , the 64 - megabit and 128 - megabit sdram , has reached the dominant international standard .
through asset management , huahong has acquired shanghai beiling , shanghai xianjin , and other ic manufacturers and has developed an overall capacity for producing 4 " , 5 " , 6 " , and 8 " chips .
a number of competitive software companies in the park have formed an export alliance to establish famous chinese and world brandnames .
recently , the first batch of information security products developed by six shanghai software companies received certification from the national information security testing , evaluation and certification center and became popular software used in china 's financial , stock trading , e - commerce , and other areas .
shanghai also planned to build 10 world 's first - rate ic production lines in zhangjiang .
construction of two production lines with an investment of nearly $ 3 billion has already started .
by early 21 st century , china 's " silicon valley " will emerge on the bank of huangpu jiang .
shanghai 's traditional industries have enjoyed brilliant development in the past but are facing unprecedented challenge today as the new economy begins to rise rapidly .
at present , more than 100 large and medium - sized industrial enterprises in shanghai have established national or municipal level technical centers , which have turned out a multitude of new products .
between january and september this year , baoshan earned 2.64 billion yuan , 5.5 times that of the same period of last year .
today , shanghai has another new engine to power the upgrading of its traditional industries - - the shanghai supercomputing center .
the center is open to all enterprises , colleges , and research institutes .
in the face of opportunities and challenges , shanghai municipality is striving to build a superior platform to transform itself into an information - based municipality and advance toward the magnificent goal of becoming an international economic , financial , and trade center .
it is strongly capable of developing and producing aerospace and high - tech products , making system engineering designs and making innovations .
xia guohong said , as a high - tech military industry group with the military in the dominant position , it can find much to do in converting military products for civilian use and in producing aerospace products .
the ground - probing radar , which formerly was used to find mines , can now be used to survey the quality of construction projects , such as whether a highway is a shabby work .
the small satellites and the solid - [ fuel ] carrier missiles we are developing now call for only small investment and low cost , but they can be widely applied in civilian usage areas such as preventing forest fires , monitoring floods and surveying the seas .
xia guohong said , the 21 st century will be one full of challenges and opportunities , it will also be a century in which high aerospace technologies can accomplish a great deal .
first , with regard to the orientation of development , [ we will ] always adhere to aerospace as the principal pursuit and strive to narrow the gap between our country and the world powers in the national defense strength and in security and defense capabilities .
third , under the guidance of state policy , innovate the systems , innovate mechanism and innovate management and resort to various economic means to constantly improve the quality of and ability in our own operations .
fourth , adapt to the global trend of economic integration and further improve the level of opening up .
some explorations were made of this ore belt at the end of the 1970 's . after some further explorations in the past two years , the prospecting institute finally made a major discovery .
this ore belt begins in the county town of nanzhao in the west and stretches over 70 kilometers southeasterly through yunyang and fangcheng to yangce in biyang county .
according to information currently available , this size is the biggest in china and also rarely seen anywhere in the world .

will the existing no haste , be patient policy be readjusted ?
at present , people of all sectors are concerned about three possible readjustments of the no haste , be patient policy : the first is the upper limit of $ 50 million . the second is the category of special applications for examination . the third is whether or not " total quantity control " will be exercised .
as a matter of fact , it was once rumored that " total quantity control " will be exercised to standardize the investment on the mainland by listed companies . however , a relevant personage pointed out that it is doubtful whether or not total quantity control is feasible .
first , if total quantity control is exercised , how will the new government exercise such control .
the examination standards for investment applications will be relaxed or tightened according to the above indexes . however , there will be a serious problem in such practice .
besides , do such examination standards imply " first come , first win " ?

beijing , 8 nov ( xinhua ) - - a few days ago the national ministry of labor and social security [ molss ] issued the " procedures for the application for and issuance of unemployment insurance monies . "
article 8 an unemployed person shall draw monthly unemployment insurance money in person at the handling agency and shall at the same time truthfully explain to the handling agency about his job application and the vocational guidance and vocational training he receives .
article 9 an unemployed person who seeks medical treatment for his illness during the period of drawing unemployment insurance money may apply to the handling agency according to the rules for a medical subsidy .
any unemployment insurance money yet to be drawn by the unemployed person for that month may be collected together by his or her family members .
article 11 during the period of drawing unemployment insurance money , an unemployed person shall actively seek employment and accept vocational guidance and vocational training .
when seeking employment during the period of drawing unemployment insurance money , an unemployed person may , according to the rules , enjoy preferential policies including a fee reduction or exemption on employment agency services .
article 12 during or after the period of drawing unemployment insurance money , an unemployed person may apply , according to the rules , for enjoying the benefit of minimum livelihood guarantee for urban residents provided he meets the local requirements for urban residents to enjoy the minimum livelihood guarantee .
a person whose eligibility has been verified after examination shall be issued with unemployment insurance money computed as from the day of his unemployment registration .
article 16 the scales of unemployment insurance money and unemployment insurance benefits including medical subsidy , funeral subsidy , pension , and allowances for vocational training and employment agency services shall be implemented in accordance with relevant provisions of individual provincial , autonomous regional , and municipal people 's governments .
article 18 an unemployed person whose term of entitlement to unemployment insurance money is due to expire soon shall be notified one month in advance of the expiration by the handling agency .
article 19 the handling agency shall provide consulting services to unemployed persons , employing units , and the general public by way of getting ready written information , opening service windows , and setting up consulting telephones .
article 20 the handling agency shall be responsible for compiling , according to the rules , statistics on unemployment insurance monies applied for and issued .
among them , the medical subsidy and allowances for vocational training and employment agency services shall be taken as half of the total amount of unemployment insurance money to which the unemployed person is entitled .
article 23 in cases where the unemployment insurance relationships of an unemployed person are relocated to a different centralized control area within the same province or autonomous region , the unemployment insurance payments shall be dealt with in a manner specified by the provincial - level labor security administration department .
article 24 an unemployed person who has moved to a different centralized control area may , with proofs issued by the handling agency at the area from which his unemployment insurance relationships were moved out , draw his unemployment insurance money at the handling agency at the present area .
chapter v supplementary provisions article 25 the handling agency shall order the return of any unemployment insurance money or other unemployment insurance benefits found to have been drawn by anyone who does not meet the requirements or have been swindled by illegal means such as alteration and forging of relevant material .
article 27 in the event of a dispute with the handling agency over his entitlement to unemployment insurance benefits , an unemployed person may apply for administrative reconsideration by the labor security administration department in charge of that handling agency .

article 4 local people 's governments at all levels must strengthen their work of managing coal mine safety , supporting and assisting the coal mine safety supervision organization in their lawful conduct of safety inspections at coal mines .

article 10 safety inspectors under the coal mine safety supervision organization safety inspectors under the coal mine safety supervision organization must be fair , upright , familiar with laws , regulations and charters pertaining to coal mining operations , possess the appropriate professional knowledge and related work experience , and must pass an examination to be appointed .
article 18 if any fatal accident occurs , the coal mine safety supervision organization shall be responsible for organizing the subsequent investigation .
the investigation organized by the coal mine safety supervision organization shall be undertaken in accordance with the national regulations on procedures for investigation of accidents and the guidelines for management of same .
chapter 3 coal mine safety inspections article 20 the coal mine safety supervision organization shall investigate the actual situation with regard to the implementation of the coal law , the mine safety law and other related mining safety laws , regulations and national safety standards , industry safety standards , coal mine safety regulations and industry technical standards .
article 21 . construction project plans by coal mines must be in compliance with the regulations on coal mine safety and industry technical requirements .
article 22 after work is completed on construction projects , or before the project goes into production , the safety measures and conditions must be inspected and accepted by the coal mine safety supervision organization .
in the course of performing inspections and approvals of safety measures for mine construction , the coal mine safety supervision organization shall complete such inspection within 30 days of receipt of documents requesting same , shall sign off as approving or not approving the plan , and shall provide a written response .
article 23 the coal mine safety supervisory organization shall review and supervise accident prevention and response plans by mines , and shall inspect the plans for measures set by mines to discover and eliminate potential causes of accidents , as well as the implementation of such measures .
( 1 ) no use of specialized anti - explosive electronic equipment ; ( 2 ) no use of specialized blasters ; ( 3 ) no use of specialized equipment for lifting and lowering personnel ; ( 4 ) use of open flame or open electricity for illumination .
article 28 if the coal mine safety supervision organization discovers that any equipment , tools , instruments , gauges , or protective products in use in the mine are not up to national safety standards or industry safety standards , it shall order an immediate work stoppage .
article 34 in exercising their authority for inspections , the coal mine safety supervision organization and its personnel shall show appropriate safety inspection identification .
article 44 if a mine director or other supervisor is found in any of the following situations , the mine safety supervision organization shall issue a warning to him or her ; if serious consequences result , and criminal acts are involved , criminal responsibility shall be determined .
article 47 in cases where digging or production licenses have been revoked in accordance with these present regulations , the mine 's business license shall be revoked by the industrial and business administrative management organ .

beijing , 13 nov ( xinhua ) - - regulations on protection of radio and television broadcasting installations chapter one .
all units and individuals have the right to stop acts that harm radio and television broadcasting installations , and they have the right to report such acts to relevant departments .
management units of radio and television installations should put up protection signs around radio and television broadcasting installations specifying protection requirements .
article 19 . if a construction project truly has to stand in the way of dedicated aerial transmission paths used by existing radio and television signals , the urban planning administration department that is in charge should obtain consent from the relevant radio and television administration and management department before giving approval to the project .
chapter three .
article 26 . the person who damages a radio or television installation shall be responsible for making compensation according to the law if the damaged radio or television installation cannot be restored to its original conditions .
chapter four .
supplementary article article 27 .
the regulations on protection of radio and television broadcasting installations promulgated by the state council on 24 april 1987 shall be annulled concurrently .

washington , 14 nov ( xinhua ) - - international observation : when will the us presidential election results come out ?
an all - time intense run for the us presidency has emerged . who is going to be the next president of the united states is still an enigma .
what is the outcome of the election ?
the current electoral situation is that the candidate who wins the 25 votes in florida will be elected . unfortunately , there is something wrong with the vote count in florida .
florida state secretary harris , from the republican party , announced on 13 november that the deadline for vote recount should be 1700 , 14 november . this might leave the manual vote count unfinished and allow the democratic party to fail to attain the hope of " recapturing the votes . "
this judgement did not favor al gore ; however , at least the manual vote count may continue . thus , al gore 's camp decided to adopt a wait - and - see attitude and temporarily did not bring any lawsuit .
besides , the two candidates did not make any comments in public .
feeling uneasy about the two sides ' resorting to legal maneuvers , major us media urged the two sides to " put the interests of the state above personal interests " for fear of taking " the country down a dangerous road . "
sources here said that although the two sides still fiercely insist on their arguments , such as bringing lawsuits and winning favor from the media , the current stalemate will not last long .
the aforementioned analysis concluded that the disputes over votes between bush and al gore will probably bring forth the following few results : first , florida 's vote count result should be based on the number of votes counted before the deadline of 14 november plus the number of overseas votes that will arrive before 17 november .
under such circumstances , bush will possibly be able to enter the white house by winning a tiny number of votes .
this will further make the " fight over vote counts " more complicated , bring difficulties to the smooth election of the next president by the electoral college on 18 december , and bring a historically unprecedented challenge to the us constitutional government system .

bandar seri begawan , 16 nov ( xinhua ) - - the eight asia - pacific economic cooperation (apec) informal leadership meeting was successfully concluded on the afternoon of 16 november in brunei .
the declaration of the apec leaders adopted by the meeting stressed the need to jointly meet the challenges in the new century through free and open trade and investment and extensive cooperation , thus seeking common development in the global economy and bringing more benefits to the people .
chinese president jiang zemin and leaders or representatives of the other 19 apec members attended the meeting .
leaders attending the meeting pointed out in their declaration that apec should take care of the interests of both developed and developing members , make effort to provide a safer and more stable financial environment , strengthen the development and construction of human resources for the purpose of meeting the challenges of economic globalization .
the declaration said : the leaders noted that at present , many people , especially those in rural and remote areas still cannot benefit from economic growth .
the leaders instructed their own ministers and officials to further work out the details of the current cooperation plan so that solid results can be achieved .
the leaders instructed their ministers to formulate more effective strategies for economic restructuring , further improving the social security systems , optimizing governmental management , and creating a benign environment for financial institutions and industrial and commercial enterprises .
the declaration held that it is necessary to work out and complete the formulation as early as 2001 a balanced and comprehensive agenda that gives expression to the wishes of all wto members so that a new round of wto talks may be started next year .
they expressed welcome to the substantive progress in the talks for china 's accession to wto , and urged wto members to complete the talks on china 's accession to wto as soon as possible .
the declaration pointed out : the sub - regional and bilateral trade agreements are conducive to the realization of multilateral trade liberalization within the framework of wto , and are in keeping with the stipulations and rules of wto .
the leaders of apec members pointed out : the revolution of information and communication technology is the greatest driving force for globalization .
the first step is to double the number of people being able to go online in this region by 2005 so that more people may benefit from the " new economy . "
in the declaration , the leaders expressed welcome to the high - level meeting held by china and brunei next year on the development of human resources with the participation of business leaders , government officials , and other professionals .
the meeting also adopted a " new economy action agenda . "
the agenda affirms the measures adopted by apec for promoting the development of the " new economy . "
these measures include electric commerce , paperless transactions , and the development of human resources related to electronic commerce .
at the meeting , president jiang zemin also gave a briefing on the preparations china had made for hosting the ninth apec informal leadership meeting in shanghai in 2001 .
he said : the meeting will be the first get - together of the apec family in the new century .
apec now has 21 members . they are australia , brunei , canada , chile , china , china hong kong , japan , rok , indonesia , malaysia , mexico , new zealand , papua new guinea , peru , the philippines , russia , singapore , china taipei , thailand , the united states , and vietnam .
in particular , it is necessary to pay special attention to informationization as a key link , give priority to enhancement of economic and social informationization , and strive to realize a leap forward of the information industry .

bandar seri begawan , 16 nov ( xinhua ) - - at a news conference held at the international convention center here on the evening of 16 november , chinese foreign affairs minister tang jiaxuan said : china is satisfied with the successful conclusion of the eighth apec informal leadership meeting .
the meeting held discussions , reached important consensus , and adopted the " leaders ' declaration " on issues such as globalization , new economy , economic development in the asia - pacific region , cooperation in the sub - regions , and current cooperation and prospects of apec .
he said that the chinese side is satisfied with the results of the meeting .
tang jiaxuan held that the achievements of this meeting can be summarized in four aspects : first , the leadership meeting reviewed the situations in the international community and the asia - pacific region regions in the past year , and exchanged opinions and reached consensus in key future work of apec .
they pointed out that the asian region has rid itself of the troubles and shadows of crisis and the economy has recovered fully and entered the growth stage .
second , the leaders attending the meeting held discussions on the issues of globalization and new economy , and adopted a " plan of action . "
they pointed out that economic globalization driven by technological revolution and accelerated development of the new economy is the general trend of the world 's economic development in the new century .
the meeting stressed that in the process of globalization and development of the new economy , we should pay attention to the division between the rich and poor .
therefore , apec should strengthen economic and technical cooperation in capability building and human resources development to meet challenges , seize opportunities , and reduce the " digital gap " so that globalization and new economy will contribute toward common prosperity in the asia - pacific region .
as a specific measure , the meeting decided that china and brunei will jointly sponsor a high - level meeting on human resources building in china next year .
the leaders attending the meeting unanimously held that apec should continue to urge another round of wto negotiations as early as possible .
the relationship between the planning of subregional trade and development of the multilateral trade system should be mutually complementary and promotional , and the development should abide by the principles and standards of the multilateral trade .
fourth , the leaders also exchanged opinions on global oil prices , calling on oil consumer nations and oil producers to hold dialogue and take concerted efforts in stabilizing oil prices within a reasonable scope .
tang jiaxuan also answered other questions raised by reporters .
he expressed satisfaction over the meeting results .
shi guangsheng said in the current situation , opportunities and challenges co - exist for the asia - pacific region .
when touching on the relations between china and apec , shi guangsheng said that china is a member of the asia - pacific region , most of china 's major trading partners are apec members , and china 's major investment areas are in the asia - pacific region .
shi guangsheng noted that china would host the ninth apec informal leadership meeting in 2001 and a number of other related meetings and activities .
china 's foreign trade and economic cooperation ministry 's chief negotiator long yongtu briefed on talks between china and mexico over china joining the wto .
there are still some technical problems that remain to be solved .
long yongtu said that mexico 's " anti - dumping " measures against china 's products violate the wto rules .
both sides are conducting consultations over the issue of reducing the measures ' transition period , but this will not affect the overall situation of china joining the wto .
the spokesman appealed to the united states to comply with the international trend of peace , detente , reconciliation , and cooperation and immediately suspend such policies as sanctions and blockade against sovereign states , which run counter to the demand of the times .
second , a batch of functionaries working in various organs , who were found involved in graft or bribery cases , have been investigated and punished .

beijing , 17 nov ( xinhua ) - - the state council recently called a national conference in beijing to discuss ways to crack down on export rebate fraud .
zhu rongji , member of the cpc central committee political bureau standing committee and premier of the state council , attended the meeting and gave an important speech there .
like what we have done in cracking down on smuggling and the crime of defrauding foreign exchange , we must harshly crack down on export rebate fraud with heavy blows .
wu yi , alternate member of the cpc central committee political bureau and state councilor , delivered a report at the meeting , which she chaired .
not long ago , the state council organization affairs group launched a pilot project in guangdong 's chaoyang and puning cities on cracking down on export rebate fraud .
the recent state council meeting was held on the basis of the experiences gained from that pilot project and the victories won from fighting that initial battle .
the moves have powerfully promoted export and contributed significantly to the sustained , rapid , and healthy development of the national economy .
however , we must also be soberly aware that , because of the benefits from rebates , lawless activities of defrauding export rebates have also become increasingly rampant .
the meeting pointed out : all regions and departments must act quickly , and earnestly carry out a deep - going struggle of cracking down on export rebate fraud so as to create in society a deterrence so powerful that export rebate fraud and lawless elements have no place to hide .
all localities must earnestly inspect their situations , making sure that there are no unattended corners .
law enforcers and party and government cadres who work in collusion with the export rebate cheaters , no matter whom they may be associated with , must be seized , investigated , and punished .
personnel of administrative and law - enforcing bodies who have caused export rebate fraud owing to their negligence of duties must also be handled strictly without leniency .
we must step up the publicity work by publicizing the important cases so as to educate the masses and deter the felons .
the meeting stressed : all regions and departments must tighten their leadership and firmly implement the state council 's unified plan .
we must fully understand the grave consequences of defrauding export rebates , the importance of cracking down on such fraud , and heighten our sense of urgency and awareness .
we should heighten our political awareness , take into consideration the interest of the whole , display our party spirit , surmount the obstacles created by local protectionism , do away with all the interferences , and earnestly proceed with the struggle .
while we should divide the responsibilities , we should also cooperate fully with one another and never try to shift responsibilities .
to ensure normal progress of the inspection , party committees of all provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities under the central government 's direct jurisdiction must actively coordinate their work with the state council 's work groups in conducting the inspection and help them deal with whatever problem they may encounter during the inspection .
the meeting pointed out : while cracking down on export rebate fraud , we should deal with the root causes as well as the phenomena at the same time .
departments concerned should effectively guard against and crack down on export rebate fraud by taking full advantage of modern technology and speeding up accomplishing the " financial and taxation project " and establishing the " electronic law enforcing system for ports . "
we should make special efforts in building up contingents of law enforcers and comprehensively improve their competence so that we can control and guard against corruption from the source , and so that there will not be any more loopholes that the felons can exploit .

at present , the biggest challenge faced by the builders of the three gorges project is how to reduce quality accidents or quality defects to the maximum extent and ensure that the first batch of four generating units will begin generating electricity by the year 2003 .
over the next three years , the three gorges project is set to wind up installation of metal structures and mechanical or electrical equipment ; begin storing water in a reservoir at the primary stage ; and ensure that the first batch of generating units will begin generating electricity and a permanent ship lock will be open to traffic .
during his latest visit , li peng laid stress on cultivating such a concept as " quality first , " which is clearly right to the point .
the three gorges dam is 2,309 meters long and 181 meters tall with total water storage capacity standing at 39.3 billion cubic meters .
however , in order to ensure the chinese nation 's development over the next 1,000 years , the three gorges project will have to be built as impregnable as possible .
in september of this year , a serious accident also occurred on the three gorges project construction site , which left some workers dead and injured , with the result that some concrete works were delayed for as long as one month . such accidents have further intensified the existing contradiction between construction pace and quality control .
without inspection , it would be impossible to guarantee quality .
in recent months , the state leaders and ordinary construction workers alike have set a high degree of store by quality control for the three gorges project .
the state council 's three gorges project construction committee has of late convened its ninth plenary meeting , which stated with particular stress : we should ensure " strictly impartial " quality supervision and inspection for the three gorges project .
china three gorges project corporation also set up a general quality inspection office in august , which has since instituted a " one - vote veto " system and has sent its first batch of professional quality inspectors general to the three gorges project construction site , including experts from some foreign quality inspection and management companies .
besides , china is also considering hiring some world - renowned authorities or experts to join the ranks of those in charge of quality control for the three gorges project .
while stressing and setting great store by quality of the three gorges project , people should also stress and set great store by quality of the work of relocating people from areas affected by the project and quality of environmental protection in the areas concerned .
a relevant personality pointed out in particular : in order to guarantee quality , we should introduce a new structure for the three gorges project .
just as li peng pointed out : " we must build the three gorges project in the spirit of reform , and the purpose of reform is to seek development and higher efficiency . "
accompanied by wu guanzheng , member of the political bureau of the cpc central committee and secretary of the shandong provincial cpc committee , and li chunting , governor of the province , premier zhu rongji inspected linyi , jining , jinan , and other places from 12 to 17 november .
zhu rongji also held separate forums to hear basic - level cadres ' views on rural banking , the reform of state - owned enterprises , the establishment of the social security system , and other issues .
the stress of this inspection by zhu rongji was on agriculture and problems of rural areas and peasants .
thanks to the success of the party central committee 's rural policies in recent years , agriculture , especially grain production , in our country has been raised to a new level , and this has effectively supported the development of the national economy and the stability of society .
if this situation is not changed , it will seriously affect peasants ' enthusiasm , shake the foundation of agriculture , and even endanger the national economy as a whole .
therefore , we must take developing and strengthening agriculture and increasing peasants ' incomes as the most important task in our economic work .
zhu rongji pointed out : it is necessary to take more effective measures to strengthen agriculture and increase peasants ' incomes .
first , we should vigorously promote the readjustment of the agricultural structure and improve agricultural quality and efficiency .
in readjusting the agricultural structure , stress should be placed on two aspects : on the one hand , the pattern of " companies bringing along peasant households " should be adopted , and such companies should play a role in linking the market with peasant households .
on the other hand , peasants should take the initiative in readjusting their crop and aquacultural structures according to changes in the market , and governments at various levels should strengthen their market - information and technical services .
various localities should raise a grain risk fund to the full and make it available promptly .
such problems exist to some extent in some localities , and they must be resolutely rectified .
an experiment has been conducted on this work in the whole province of anhui and other areas this year , and it is very well received by the peasants .
on the basis of summing up experiences in the conduct of this experiment , we should further expand the scope of the experiment and then speed up the pace of implementing it across the country .
zhu rongji stressed : readjusting the agricultural structure and increasing peasants ' incomes are in a great need for financial support .
now it is essential , above all , to do a good job in an experiment being conducted in jiangsu province on the reform of the management system of rural credit cooperatives and to actively explore the financial system , operating mechanism , management system , and ways of services in the countryside .
rural credit cooperatives must keep to the orientation of serving agriculture , the rural areas , and peasants ; strive to increase their credit funds ; improve their methods for providing loans ; and improve the level of their financial services .

deepening the reform of state - owned enterprises must be combined with readjusting the layout of the national economy and optimizing the industrial structure .
with the market as the guide and technological progress as the support , we should speed up the reorganization and transformation of enterprises , continue to eliminate backward and surplus production capacities , and improve the quality of our national economy as a whole and its international competitiveness .
zhu rongji said : with the deepening of reform of our country 's economic system and its upcoming accession to the world trade organization (wto) , state - owned enterprises are facing ever more intense market competition , and they must have a sense of urgency and risk .

at the same time , efforts should be made to earnestly do a good job in guaranteeing a minimum living standard for city residents .

at apec 's eighth informal summit , which lasted for a whole day , the leaders of all member states aired their views freely and conducted an in - depth discussion on a number of topics , including economic globalization , a " new economy , " a multilateral trade structure , and sub - regional trade arrangements .
chinese president jiang zemin was one of the three state leaders who have attended all the eight apec informal summits .
since china will be the host of apec 's next informal summit , president jiang zemin became the focus of attention both inside and outside the meeting hall .
president jiang 's important speech at the summit was regarded by the local media as the " keynote speech " of this summit ; while his address delivered at the luncheon of the apec business summit was also emphasized by both the chinese and the foreign media .
apec is shouldered with an important mission of promoting the economies of the region ; yet ever since the outbreak of the asian financial crisis , the organization has encountered unprecedented challenges and tests .
in view of this , president jiang pointed out penetratingly at the meeting : " a complete solution to the various problems that are currently facing the economic development in today 's world depends , in the final analysis , on the establishment of a fair and rational new international economic order . "
in our era when peace and development are the main themes , " development " has become a task of prime importance for the large numbers of developing member states .
meanwhile , at a time when economic development is highly unbalanced and 80 percent of the world 's wealth is enjoyed by only 20 percent of the world 's total population , developed member states have the duty to provide greater technological aid for developing member states .
indeed , china 's constructive role in apec is growing increasingly stronger , and chinese entrepreneurs are more and more active on the arena of this organization .
people still remember that at the 1993 seattle meeting , no chinese entrepreneur were involved in related activities ; yet this year , more than 20 leaders of china 's enterprise circles were present at the meeting , busy making friends and seeking business partners .
since china is to host apec 's first informal summit of the 21 st century next year , president jiang zemin briefed the meeting on the preparations currently carried out by the chinese side , and he sent out warm invitations to all the leaders of apec member states .

cairo , 19 nov ( xinhua ) - - visiting chinese vice premier wu bangguo held talks on bilateral issues and the middle east situation with egyptian deputy prime minister and minister of agriculture and land reclamation youssef wali in kairo on 19 november .
since the establishment of their diplomatic relations , the two countries ' friendly cooperative relations have developed smoothly despite changes in the international situation , and the two peoples have established sincere friendship .
the strategic cooperative relations oriented to the 21 st century - - relations jointly established by president jiang zemin and president mubarak - - have promoted the constantly developing chinese - egyptian friendly cooperative relations to a new development period .
wu bangguo said : china has all along treated egypt as the most important cooperative partner in the arab world and africa .
he added : through both sides ' long - term joint efforts , economic and trade cooperation between the two countries has reached a certain scope and level , but there is still great potential to tap .
china is convinced that the two countries will become important partners in economic and trade cooperation .
on the middle east issue , wu bangguo said : china has all along been very concerned about the development of the middle east situation and the middle east peace process .
not long ago , serious armed clashes broke out between israel and palestine , seriously threatening the stability and peace in the middle east region .
china condemns israel for using force to harm palestinian civilians .
egypt has played a unique role in the middle east peace talks , and china appreciates and supports egypt in continuing to display its positive influence and role .
it has always supported the just cause of the arab countries and palestine as well as the middle east peace process , and has contributed its efforts to this end .
china will , as always , actively promote the middle east peace talks and is willing to maintain consultations and strengthen coordination with egypt on this issue and make joint efforts for an early realization of peace in the middle east .
at the talks , deputy prime minister wali said : president mubarak and president jiang zemin have established strategic cooperative relations between the two countries . i believe wu bangguo 's current visit will further promote these relations toward in - depth development .
he added : in recent years the two countries have registered rapid development in their economic and trade cooperative relations , but there is still great potential .

president clinton will be relieved of his office very soon , and this is probably his last meeting with president jiang zemin .
jiang zemin highly appreciated clinton for the positive efforts that he has made to improve and develop the sino - us relations during his tenure of office and hoped that he would continue to show solicitude for and give support to the relations between the two countries .
over the past eight years since clinton came to power , he has made some important decisions on some major issues with regard to the sino - us relations , which have furthered the development of the relations between the two countries .
then , he took the " expansion of us - chinese cooperative spheres " as the " best way " of achieving the goals of policies toward china , and enabled this policy to hold a dominant position among the us policymakers .
as a result , the two sides have reached a consensus on establishing a constructive strategic partnership , come to an agreement on china 's entry into the wto , and resolved the problem of granting the permanent normal trade relations status to china .
however , as no one is able to endure the huge costs brought by a strategic confrontation , avoiding confrontation and seeking cooperation will become an inevitable choice of the two sides .
the course of developing sino - us relations over the past eight years has indicated that a healthy , steady , and cooperative relationship between china and the united states conforms to the interests of the peoples of the two countries and the world .
people believe that , given some ups and downs , the sino - us relations will still make continuous advances in the next century .

dispatch by staff reporter wu yimin from bandar seri begawan : no sooner had president jiang zemin concluded attending the activities of the eighth informal conference of leaders of the asian - pacific organization for economic cooperation [ apec ] than he began his state visit to brunei darussalam .
this is the first visit by a chinese head of state to this country , which means " country of peace " ( in malay ) .
during this state visit , president jiang zemin conducted exchanges in a deepgoing manner with leaders of brunei and personages of the industrial and commercial circles there and deepened their mutual understanding .
the two sides have also signed three cooperation agreements on investment protection , tourism cooperation , and crude oil trade oil .
contemplating the present and recalling the past with emotion , we can discover that the friendly intercourse between the peoples of china and brunei has been going on for thousands of years .

article 3 . the famc shall consider maximum preservation of assets and reduction of losses as its principal business objective and shall independently assume civil liability according to law . article 4 .
the people 's bank of china [ pboc ] , the ministry of finance [ mof ] , and china securities regulatory commission [ csrc ] shall severally exercise supervision and control over the famc within their respective statutory terms of reference .
the famc shall be issued by the pboc a " financial corporate body license " and go through registration formalities with the industrial and commercial administration authorities according to law .
the credentials of senior managerial staff of the famc must be examined by the pboc to determine their competence for their posts .
the composition , responsibilities , and working procedures of the famc 's board of supervisors shall accord with the " provisional regulations on the board of supervisors of key state financial institution . "
article 12 . within the line set by the state council , the famc shall acquire the capital of the relevant loans on book value and the corresponding uncollected interest receivable , charged to profit or loss ; the uncollected interest receivable that is not charged to profit or loss shall be transferred without compensation .
the debtors , guarantors , and the parties concerned in respect of the original loan contracts should continue to perform their obligations provided for in such contracts .
article 14 . funding for the acquisition of bad loans by the famc shall come from : ( 1 ) transfer of part of the relending by the pboc to the state - owned , sole - investor commercial banks ; and ( 2 ) issuance of financial bonds .
article 15 . issuance of financial bonds by the famc requires examination and approval by the pboc in conjunction with the mof .
the proposals and agreements on the conversion of creditor 's rights into stock rights shall be examined and verified by the setc jointly with the mof and the pboc and shall be implemented upon approval by the state council .
article 19 . those enterprises where creditor 's rights are to be converted into stock rights shall , as required by the modern enterprise system , change the mechanisms of their business operation , establish a standard corporate control structure , and strengthen enterprise management .
article 21 . the stock rights in enterprises held by the famc maybe assigned to investors both in and outside china in accordance with the applicable regulations of the state ; they may also be bought back , according to law , by those enterprises where creditor 's rights have been converted into stock rights .
article 22 . those enterprises where creditor 's rights have been converted into stock rights should go through relevant registration formalities , such as alteration of business property rights , in accordance with the applicable regulations of the state .
article 23 . the setc shall be responsible for the organization , guidance , and coordination in respect of the conversion of creditor 's rights into stock rights among enterprises .
chapter 5 . company operation and management article 24 . the famc shall operate under a responsibility system of management by business objectives .
the mof shall , in light of the quality of bad loans , set a business target for the famc in dealing with bad loans and follow up with assessment and supervision .
in the event of nonpayment of the famc 's credit because of the debtor 's insolvency or other reasons , the case shall be dealt with according to the state council 's regulations .
article 27 . the famc may , in light of its business requirements , engage the services of intermediaries with accounting , asset assessment , legal service , and other qualifications , to assist in its business operations .
article 30 . the famc should subject itself to the audit and supervision by the audit authorities according to law .
the famc should engage a certified public accountant acknowledged by the mof to conduct annual audit of its financial position and submit audit reports to all relevant supervisory and administrative departments in a timely manner .
chapter 6 . company termination and liquidation article 31 . upon termination of the famc , the mof shall set up a liquidation team to conduct liquidation .
article 32 . regarding any final losses that the famc may incur as a result of disposing of bad loans , the mof shall propose a solution , which shall be implemented upon approval by the state council .

beijing , 20 nov (xinhua) - - with the approval of the party 's central committee and the state council , the study class on special financial subjects for cadres at provincial and ministerial levels was held in beijing today .
how seriously the leaders at various levels take the financial work and how effectively they perform it have a bearing on whether or not they are able to properly put into practice the important thinking of " three represents . "
li lanqing pointed out that intensifying the building of a legal system is the foundation for establishing the public finance .
once the budgets are passed according to legal procedures , they must be strictly carried out according to law and must not be changed or accommodated at random .
li lanqing stressed that to set up a framework of public finance , it is imperative to foster a new concept on financial management , and its basic ideas can be summarized in the following words : " appropriate proportion , suitable centralization and decentralization , reasonable income and expenditure , and proper use of funds . "
these " two proportions " are obviously on the low side in china at present .
that is why we must make great efforts to earnestly straighten out the financial distribution order and positively organize financial income .
in some localities , the authorities collect more fees in order to maintain the size of staff , and recruit more staff members with the increased fees , thus forming a vicious cycle which has added greater burdens to peasants , enterprises , and society .
the so - called " reasonable income and expenditure " means that financial income must take taxation as the main body and a small amount of necessary stipulated fees as the complement , and in handling financial expenditure , we must abide by the principle of " regarding construction as important as taking meals . "
we should supplement , improve , and perfect the tax system in line with the requirements of the socialist market economic structure .
the urgent task at the moment is to further deepen the reform of tax collection and management system in order to institute a modern tax collection and management system which has a solid management foundation , applies advanced collection and management means , separates collection from management and inspection , and enforces laws while providing services .
personalities in charge of various ministries and commissions of the state council and various provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities participated in the study class .

article 18 . enterprises in which debts are to be turned into equity shall be recommended by the state economic and trade commission to financial - assets management companies .

beijing , 20 nov - - reviewing the sino - us strategic relationship the us presidential election remains in the balance with the outcome unclear .
as to what impact the final result will have on future sino - us relations , i interviewed professor yan xuetong , executive deputy director of the international questions research institute of beijing 's qinghua university .
the us china policy in itself involves two aspects , that is , engagement and containment ; if bush jr. takes office , the containment aspect will grow a bit , but he will not completely abandon the engagement policy .
the main reason for the two major changes in the strategic relationship was the result of changes in the basis of the strategic interests of the two sides .
at the same time , the us government was anxious to withdraw from vietnam , and also needed china 's strategic cooperation .
the sino - soviet border clashes of 1969 meant that china too was facing a serious military threat from the soviet union , and so china decided to carry out a major strategic readjustment and join hands with the united states to match the soviet union .
negative impact of the taiwan issue yan xuetong stressed in particular that whether bush jr. or gore takes office , one point is exceedingly clear , that is , the next us president 's china policy will tend more toward taiwan on the taiwan issue .
the taiwan issue will thus have a negative impact on sino - us relations , the only difference being whether this will be a small or a big impact .
the main orientation of their china policy is identical , and the only difference is in degree .
the us policy on taiwan is extremely explicit ; the united states does not support taiwan achieving independence through war .
the united states only supports taiwan 's becoming independent through peaceful means and not through armed force .
in this sense , therefore , so long as taiwan does not declare independence , there will be no fundamental change in us china policy .
there are no two ways about the united states becoming militarily involved in the taiwan strait , and the possibility of them not getting involved does not exist ; the only question is the degree of involvement .
yan xuetong pointed out in conclusion that whether bush jr. or gore takes office , he will have to squarely face the fact of china 's continually growing strength .
engaging in all - round confrontation with china will damage the united states ' own interests ; in particular the republican bush wants to continue to policy of engagement with china .
it can be estimated therefore that sino - us relations in the next four years will basically maintain their post - cold war posture , that is , the deep - seated contradictions in their bilateral relationship will gradually deepen , but will not become acute .
