beijing , 23 nov ( xinhua ) - - at present , the masses are complaining of two extremely serious unhealthy practices in the actual work of our government : formalism and bureaucracy .
bureaucracy is a state of mind and a style of work characterized by divorcing oneself from the masses and reality and acting as bureaucrats and overlords .
at present , bureaucracy has the following striking manifestations : first , some cadres stay high above others and are divorced from the masses .
they deceive their superiors and delude their subordinates and make false work performance . and they do not hesitate to waste manpower and public funds . as for the people 's well - being and demands , they are indifferent and insensitive . second , some cadres merely follow the old practice with no intention of making progress .
they are lax , indifferent to anything , and satisfied with the present situation .
there is a serious bureaucratic style , and the work efficiency is quite low . it is hard for common people to enter the government office to see an official , and the official is always unapproachable .
work plans are always under " study " and " consideration . " these officials refuse to do anything unless they can gain something . when they have gained something , they act arbitrarily .
because of their high " official positions , " they have a bad temper and are self - conceited , insisting on " what i say counts . "
they are never tired of hearing words of flattery , but would fly into a rage when someone gives them an honest advice .
in dealing with the masses , these officials never do the work of persuasion and education , but exercise coercion and commandism .
bureaucracy runs counter to our party 's nature and basic purpose and is incompatible with the requirements of the " three represents . "
our party originated from and represents the people . it has taken root among the people and aim at serving them .
leading cadres at all levels , high and low , are the servants of the people . they have no reason to put themselves above the masses .
the crucial point of bureaucracy is divorcing oneself from the masses and acting as bureaucrats and overlords .
this mentality is : " being an official is the fundamental requirement . " everything you should do is aimed at becoming an official , and once you become an official , you will have everything .
accordingly , some party members and cadres have relaxed their efforts to remold their world outlook and temper themselves in accordance with the party spirit , but have deliberately or unwittingly become slaves to the " officials as the foundation " mentality .
with this mentality , they are irresponsible for the work of the party and state and the interests of the nation and people ; they are only responsible to themselves , their relatives , and their small group .
to oppose bureaucracy , we must resolutely eradicate the " officials as the foundation " mentality from the minds of our party members and cadres .
it is true that bureaucracy is a stubborn disease , but it is not true that there is no " medicine " to cure it .
these " three fears " enable us to offer three good ways to overcome bureaucracy : one is to promote democracy , follow the mass line , and let the masses set the criterion for criticism .
the masses have sharp eyes .
they can see bureaucracy most clearly , have felt its detrimental effects most profoundly , and hate it most bitterly .
the more earnestly the mass line is carried out and the greater democracy the masses enjoy , the more difficult it is for bureaucracy to exist .
our successful experience in conducting the " three stresses " education campaign [ stress on theoretical study , political awareness , and upright conduct ] has proved that persisting in style rectification on an open basis and fully mobilizing and relying on the masses are the most effective ways to prevent and overcome bureaucracy .
party members and cadres should not act as overlord above the masses , but should be the people 's servants . they should not be awe - inspiring bureaucrats , but should preserve the true color of laboring people at all times .
the second way is to temper our party members and cadres , especially young cadres , by sending them to grassroots units to work .
when cadres have affection for the masses , they can deal with the masses properly , work energetically , and be conscientious and responsible . even when complicated contradictions and problems arise , they can easily find solutions .

the solution to the water shortage problems in cities has a direct impact on the livelihood of the people , has a direct impact on the society and stability , and has a direct impact on the sustainable development of cities .
the circular emphasizes the necessity of unified planning , optimizing water distribution and ensuring water supply in cities through various channels .
plans for the comprehensive use of water resources in cities should include special planning for the long - term and medium - term supply and demand of water resources , sources of water supply , water saving , the use of polluted water , and the protection of water resources .
cities in dry areas with water shortages should attach importance to the use of rainwater , floods and slightly salty water . coastal cities should pay attention to desalination and the direct use of seawater .
the circular points out the necessity of persistently putting saving water in the most important place and striving to build water - saving cities .
the people 's governments of various localities , especially city governments , should rationally determine the scales of cities , and readjust and optimize the urban economic structure and the industrial distribution on the basis of the situation of local water resources and the environmental capacity for water .
they should regard the building of water saving cities as their goals and make great efforts to conduct water saving activities in cities .
greater efforts should be made to implement relevant state policies for water saving technology and technical standards , and to formulate and implement mandatory standards for the use of water saving devices .
it is necessary to take effective measures to speed up the technical transformation of urban water supply networks and reduce leakage in such networks .
it calls for seriously implementing the " law for the prevention of water pollution of the people 's republic of china " and improving the quality of surface water within a certain time limit .
the quality of the environment of surface water of various municipalities , provincial capitals , cities of special economic zones , coastal cities and key tourist cities must meet the state standards .
during the 10 th five - year plan period , all cities officially designated as such must formulate plans for improving water quality and implement a management system to ensure that the quality of inter - locality rivers will meet the required indexes .

singapore , 24 nov ( xinhua ) - - on the afternoon of 24 november , chinese state council premier zhu rongji attended the meeting of leaders from asean countries , china , japan , and the rok ( " 10 + 3 " ) and made an important speech there .
leaders from 13 east asian countries attended the meeting . the leaders exchanged opinions on two subjects , namely , the prospects for east asia and the strengthening of east asian cooperation .
the atmosphere of the meeting was friendly . substantive results were achieved .
at the meeting , premier zhu rongji enunciated china 's opinion on the current situation in east asia and the prospects for east asian cooperation , and made concrete proposals for strengthening such cooperation .
zhu rongji first said : since the beginning of this year , the economy in east asia has kept a stable rebounding tendency , and many countries in this region have recorded a growth rate higher than expected .
the political situation has also made positive progress .
we express sincere welcome and support for such development .
at the same time , unstable factors still exist in this region .
in the course of economic and technological development , the gap between developing countries and developed countries in east asia has been getting wider .
for a fairly long period to come , the east asian countries will all continue to face an arduous task in safeguarding their national security and speeding up their economic development .
zhu rongji said : the " joint declaration on east asian cooperation " published by the last " 10 + 3 " informal summit meeting was an important document in the process of the east asian cooperation , as it pointed out the orientation and the main fields of east asian cooperation .
over the past year , under the guidance of the " joint declaration on east asian cooperation , " " 10 + 3 " cooperation has been making positive progress in financial , human resources development , economic , and trade cooperation .
such mechanisms as the financial ministers meeting , the economic ministers meeting , and the foreign ministers meeting have been set up .
exchange and cooperation through non - governmental channels have also been conducted actively .
he said : the results achieved in the " 10 + 3 " cooperation fully show that regional cooperation in east asia is in keeping with the needs and interests of all countries in this region , and also indicate the confidence and wishes of the east asian countries in strengthening their cooperation and seeking common development .
under the situation of economic globalization and in the increasing development of regional economic integration , east asian countries need to further expand their regional cooperation .
most countries in east asia are developing countries with widely diverse characteristics , and in particular , there exist distinct differences in the level of development among them .
east asian cooperation should be aimed at development , respect the existence of diversity , and make progress gradually in an orderly and well - planned way .
east asian countries may also exchange opinions on regional and international affairs of common interest , thus enhancing coordination and increasing mutual understanding and trust .
east asian cooperation should pursue a principle of openness .
zhu rongji said : to further promote the continuous development of east asian cooperation , asean , china , japan , and the rok may focus joint efforts on following five tasks for the time being : first , increasing input to the development of the mekong river valley .
the development of the mekong river valley is conducive to narrowing the gap between countries in this region in economic development .
the chinese side also hope that japan and the rok will also make contributions , with their financial and technological advantages , to the development and utilization of resources in the mekong river valley .
second , attaching great importance to the development and cooperation of the information industry .
third , increasing the intensity of cooperation in the development of human resources .
the development of human resources should be taken as the foundation and a main field of east asian cooperation .
fourth , effectively implementing the " chiang mai initiative . "
the chinese side also holds an open attitude toward any ideas for advancing financial cooperation in the next stage through step - by - step discussions within the " 10 + 3 " framework .
east asian countries are strongly complementary to each other in the field of agriculture .
the chinese side hopes to start the " 10 + 3 " agriculture and forestry ministers meeting as soon as possible .
china is willing to host an agricultural technology and cooperation forum for the purpose of promoting the starting of east asian agricultural cooperation .
tourist cooperation is an effective way to promote mutual understanding among east asian countries .
this will also be conducive to promoting mutual understanding and trust .
zhu rongji said : being a member of east asia , china is keeping a rather fast and benign economic development tendency .
we are formulating the 10 th five - year plan .
at present , we are working intensively to make preparations in all fields for china 's accession to the world trade organization (wto) .
he said : " we have noted that some asean countries have misgivings about possible competition from china in exports to developing countries and attracting investments from those countries after china joins the wto .
china 's competitive rivals in the export markets , such as the united states and other developed countries , are not southeast asian countries .
for the part of asean countries , china 's accession to wto will indicate the expansion of their market and an increase in their business opportunities .
in fact , along with the quickening process of china 's accession to wto , bilateral trade between china and asean countries has shown signs of substantive increases .
i believe , china 's accession to wto will just bring about greater opportunities for cooperation between china and asean , and the mutually beneficial cooperation between china and asean will have bright prospects . "
in particularly , asean leaders welcomed the cooperation proposals set forth by chinese , japanese , and rok leaders .
at the end of the meeting , singaporean prime minister goh chok tong , who is chairman of the meeting , said that the meeting came up with many useful proposals for strengthening regional cooperation , and reaching consensus on many issues , so it was a very successful meeting .
on the evening of 24 november , premier zhu rongji and his wife , lao an , attended a banquet given by prime minister goh chok tong and his wife .

developing high technology and narrowing and eliminating the " digital divide " with the developed countries is an urgent task facing us .
china proposes therefore that a " china - asean seminar on information technology cooperation " be held in china in 2001 to specifically explore questions of how to strengthen bilateral cooperation in the information technology field . 5 .
china has conducted agricultural cooperation in various forms with most asean countries in recent years , which has yielded gratifying results .
we want to promote mutual agricultural development through strengthening cooperation , and to gradually form an agricultural cooperation network for china and the 10 asean countries . 6 .
strengthen trade and investment ties .
the asean countries can become one of the focal areas for chinese enterprises in " going abroad . "
in this respect , the two sides can set up a china - asean economic cooperation group within the framework of the china - asean joint committee of economic and trade cooperation , to discuss issues of strengthening bilateral economic ties , facilitating trade and investment , and other affairs of mutual interest .
china 's wto accession means still more the expansion of markets and increase of business opportunities ; the opportunities outweigh the challenges , and the advantages outweigh the disadvantages .

beijing , 26 nov ( xinhua ) - - zhang zuoer , minister of labor and social security , recently signed an order to promulgate the " interim measures for collective wage negotiations . "
the measures are applicable for collective wage negotiations conducted by businesses in china and the wage agreements they sign .
the representatives who represent the enterprise should be a corporate entity , or persons designated by the corporate entity .
the law protects the legitimate rights and interests of workers ' representatives . the enterprise may not take any discriminatory actions against them , nor can it dissolve or change the labor contracts with them against the law .
they also emphasize that , within seven days after a wage agreement has been signed , it should be referred to the department in charge of work security for examination .
then , after the department has expressed its concurrence , the two sides of the negotiations should inform the sides they represent about the wage agreement that has become effective .
these measures are applicable in collective wage negotiations lawfully held by enterprises in the prc , and in the wage agreements they sign .
the term " wage agreement " mentioned in these measures refers to the collective contract that has been signed on wage matters .
after a collective contract has been signed , the wage agreement , as an annex of the collective contract , has the same validity as the collective contract .
according to law , county - and higher - level labor security administrations shall examine all the wage agreements and supervise their enforcement .
chapter iii . representatives at the collective wage negotiations article 9 .
the representatives to take part in collective wage negotiations shall be chosen in accordance with lawful procedures .
the workers ' congress should represent the workers .
for an enterprise where its workers ' congress has yet to be formed , the workers themselves shall nominate their representatives through a democratic process , and each of the nominees shall have the concurrence of at least 50 percent of the workers .
the workers ' chief representative should be the workers ' congress chairman , and this chairman may , by writing , entrust another person to represent him . in an enterprise where a workers ' congress has yet to be formed , the workers ' representatives to take part in the negotiations shall collectively nominate a chief representative .
the chief representative of the enterprise shall be its legal representative . this legal representative may , by writing , entrust another person to represent him .
article 11 . during the negotiations , the chief representatives of the two negotiating sides shall take turns to serve as the executive chairman of the negotiations .
article 13 . the two negotiating sides enjoy equal rights with respect to putting forth proposals , vetoing a proposal , and explaining a proposal .
article 14 . the negotiations performed by the negotiating representatives chosen within an enterprise should be considered as normal work , and their wages , bonuses , allowances , subsidies , insurance , and other benefits shall remain unchanged .
the law protects the legitimate rights and interests of the negotiators who represent the workers .
the enterprise shall not take any discriminatory measures against these representatives , nor dissolve or change their contracts against regulations .
article 15 . the negotiating representatives should abide by the negotiation rules set by the two sides , perform their representative responsibilities , and bear the responsibility of keeping the enterprise ' commercial secrets confidential .
the negotiating representatives of neither side may resort to violent actions , threat , bribery , or deception during the negotiations .
article 16 . the negotiating representatives should be fully knowledgeable of facts about wage allocation . they should extensively solicit the views of all quarters , and they should answer questions raised by the workers whom they represent about the collective wage negotiations .
the procedures of collective wage negotiations article 17 .
article 18 . on the premise of not violating any relevant laws and regulations , the two sides , within five days after the negotiations begin , have the obligations to provide each other with the facts and information essential for the collective wage negotiations .
article 20 . after an agreement has been reached at the collective wage negotiations , the executive department of the enterprise shall prepare the wage agreement document , which will become official after the chief representatives of the two negotiating sides sign and seal it .
article 22 . within 15 days after receiving the agreement , the labor security department shall examine the credentials of the two sides ' representatives present at the collective wage negotiations , the provisions in the wage agreement , and the signing procedures .
article 23 . within five days , the two negotiating parties shall notify in an appropriate manner the effective wage agreement to the personnel of their respective side .
article 24 . under normal circumstances , collective wage negotiations shall be conducted once a year .
either the workers ' side or the enterprise may , within 60 days before an existing wage agreement expires , notify the other side about its intention for carrying out another round of collective wage negotiations so that the old wage agreement can be properly replaced by a new one .
supplementary articles article 25 . in case these measures have not set any rules for collective wage negotiations or wage agreement , the rules set in the " regulations for collective contracts " shall be followed .
in his speech at the opening ceremony , chinese ambassador li zhaoxing pointed out : the basis and premise of peaceful settlement of the taiwan issue is that the taiwan authorities must recognize the principle of one china .
the latest development in taiwan shows that the taiwan leader has no intention to improve cross - strait relations , and this is the deeper cause why taiwan is experiencing political turbulence and increased economic difficulties .
in his opening speech , cheng chun - fu , president of the global chinese anti - independence and reunification promotion alliance and well - known scholar from us temple university , said : it is beyond all doubt that taiwan has been china 's sacred territory since ancient times .
cheng chun - fu appealed to the taiwan authorities to abandon the " taiwan independence " position without any condition and forthwith return to the principle of one china .
shen tse , a 94 - year old former kuomintang general , made a special trip from new york to attend the conference . he said that he entered the whampoa military academy and joined the national revolution 77 years ago for the purpose of achieving the country 's reunification and the nation 's prosperity .
regrettably , the two sides of the taiwan strait have remained divided to date .
today , the taiwan authorities stated publicly that they " would not declare independence , " and yet in practice they have refused to accept the principle of one china and are unwilling to abandon the " taiwan independence " program .
liang su - yung , president of taiwan 's cross - strait peaceful unification promotion association , said : us policy toward the two sides of the taiwan strait has a great influence on the situation in the taiwan strait .
he appealed to the us authorities to continue upholding the principle of one china and explicitly pledge not to send troops to interfere in a conflict in the taiwan strait .

the first global chinese meeting on opposing taiwan independence and promoting china 's peaceful reunification was held in berlin , germany last august . representatives of overseas and ethnic chinese from more than 60 countries attended the meeting .
the whole meeting was a positive , pragmatic , and friendly one and attained consummate success .
when asked about premier zhu 's attendance at the meeting , wang yi said : this was yet another important multilateral diplomatic exercise conducted by a chinese leader in its neighboring region at the turn of the century .

accordingly , a new method of training , known as the " vessel exchange system " training , has been put into practice in an effort to boost the detachment 's combat effectiveness through the scientifically reformed training method .
when the first crew has come back after the at - sea training , the second crew , having undergone on - shore and in - port training , immediately take over the " whale " [ the submarine ] and set out for its on - sea training .
with this training system , two crews can compare with each other and thus raise their levels of skills . every crew member receives the training with great enthusiasm , seizing every minute and second to raise his ability .
the purpose is to temper the crew 's ability to sustain hardships and to carry out the combat duty under hard conditions . this year this detachment has carried out the " vessel exchange system " training with remarkable results .
no sooner had the joint us - japanese military exercise ended on 17 november than the shocking news of the us kitty hawk aircraft carrier battle group being successfully penetrated by russian 's sukhoi-27 and sukhoi-24 fighters during the exercise spread .
a great replay of the event and the undoing of the myth the joint us - japanese exercise , code - named " keen sword 2000 , " was held in the sea of japan and participated by the us naval and air forces in japan and by the japanese maritime defense forces .
the kitty hawk : pull down three defense lines of " iron curtains " objectively speaking , the us battle group has complete , three - dimensional , and highly efficient reconnaissance , early warning , monitoring and control systems , enjoys advantage in information war , and possesses powerful and comprehensive defense operation capabilities .
to deal with opponents from various directions , the us battle group usually has three lines of " iron curtain " defense system .
but at this stage , the aircraft carrier mainly conducts analysis and tracking of targets .
under normal circumstances , enemy aircraft , surface vessels , or submarines need to penetrate layers and layers of encirclements ( 5 - 7 layers of intercepting lines or intercepting firepower ) to attack the aircraft carrier .
first of all , there is advanced onboard electronic equipment .
its onboard " police whistle " iii all - directional radar warning system can effectively discover an enemy 's various detection waves , determine position , make analyses , and provide timely warnings and instructions to the pilot .
onboard , electronic equipment not only can fulfill navigation and piloting tasks but is also able to interfere with an enemy 's electronic fire control system .
in addition , the russian aircraft 's superior mobility is a reliable guarantee for successful penetration .
the su-24mr displays a superb performance of maintaining a speed 1,320 - km / hr when executing an extremely low 200 - meter flight .
the su-27's sea - skimming flight 's maximum straight and level flight speed can reach 1.1 mach .
high - speed sea - skimming flight format can greatly reduce us troops ' radar measuring and tracking distance and the gap in air defense system generated therefrom is exactly a " safe passage " for su-27's successful penetration .
how the myth was unravelled ?
that another country 's aircraft has been able to successfully penetrate the " kitty hawk " battle group cannot be said a normal situation given the battle group 's air defense capabilities .
seen from the americans ' perspective , they cannot imagine that any one would dare to make such an attempt .
since the end of the cold war , the united states has considered itself " the only superpower in the world . "
the americans have become quite used to a nonchalant style .
it was possible that the radar system on the kitty hawk was not switched on at all or if the radar was on , personnel on air defense duty were not really in a state of alert .
the russians have never stopped shadowing the kitty hawk .
over the years , russian 's electronic reconnaissance vessels , reconnaissance submarines , and monitoring satellites have locked on the kitty hawk , thereby providing a large amount of reliable materials for the russian air force to be well - informed about the formation and performance of the us battle group 's radar network .
people know that the su-27 carries an impressive array of onboard weapons and it is loaded with 10 pieces of killer weapons under its wings .
russia 's warning people know well russian planes did not " tease " the kitty hawk just for " the sake of fun . " it appears the incident was more like a warning to the united states .

faced with such a severe challenge , the call from international society demanding a reduction in greenhouse gas emissions has been heightened daily .
developed countries historically have been the chief source of greenhouse gas emissions , and the effect of their " accumulated emissions output " on the present trend in the global climate cannot be denied .
therefore , developed countries ' taking the lead to control pollution and reduce emissions is perfectly reasonable , and they are duty - bound .
however , certain developed countries have ignored the call of international society , and have ignored the various measures and contributions adopted by developing countries to deal with climate changes .
these countries have attempted to set down obligations that are difficult for developing countries to sustain at the present stage , using these obligation standards as prerequisites for approval of the " tokyo protocol " .
on an even deeper note , the united states has relied on its own wealth and power - bragging status to require that developing countries buy " pollution rights " from the united states if they are to continue to receive american transfers of technology .
the american position not only has met with opposition from the majority of the developing countries , but has even aroused the protest of the european community . it is the sharp opposition between the united states and the european community that led directly to the fragmentation of the conference .
the position of developed countries in regard to the environmental issue is extremely clear , and that is that " only officials will be allowed to set fires , while the common citizen will be prohibited " , or to find any way to evade their own responsibilities , or to shift responsibilities or problems to the developing countries .
in regard to the issue of the environment and trade , the attitude of the developed countries is that both can be played to a successful result .
under the guise of science and technology , a certain developed country has wantonly hunted and captured a rare species of animal - - whales , in order to gain greater profit , and they have regarded international treaties as waste paper .
a few developed countries has manipulated the economic difficulties of developing countries to turn developing countries into markets for dumping trash .
the majority of developed countries not only have not kept to their own promises regarding increasing official developmental support in international society , but have attempted through technological monopoly and trade barriers to conduct a " new economic colonialism " .
following this line of thought , the developed countries actions in regard to international political issues have also been so false !
environmental protection is the common task of all countries of the world , and is a great program that will have impact on our descendants . developing countries , as the main polluters of the contemporary world , of course are obligated to take up their expected responsibility in halting global climate change , and should adopt leadership steps .
at the same time as enjoying the fruits of economic globalization , of course the developed countries should also bear the responsibility of maintaining the healthy development of economic globalization .

beijing , 30 nov ( xinhua ) - - a central economic work conference convened by the cpc central committee and state council was held in beijing from 28 to 30 november .
jiang zemin , li peng , zhu rongji , li ruihuan , hu jintao , wei jianxing , and li lanqing attended the conference .
the speech comprehensively summed up work in 2000 , analyzed the current situation , and proposed the general demands and main tasks in economic work next year .
zhu rongji , member of the cpc central committee politburo standing committee and premier of the state council , made an important speech on economic work arrangements for next year .
the conference pointed out that this has been a year of marked success for china 's economic work .
these notable changes indicate that we have already overcome the difficulties caused by the asian financial crisis , and reversed the slowdown in growth rate over the previous two years ; a major turn has been achieved in national economic development .
reform and development of science , technology , and education have made major progress , and various undertakings such as population , resources , environment , culture , public health , and sports have been comprehensively promoted .
" three stresses " education has unfolded in depth .
summing up the experience of the past few years , the most basic one is that we have persisted in applying development methods to resolve problems on our advance , readjusted the macroeconomic policy at the right time in light of the development and changes in the situation , and continually perfected these measures in the course of practice .
the conference held that overall economic work in 2001 is facing a relatively favorable situation at home and abroad .
so long as we grasp things effectively , take advantage of our relative strong points , and pursue profit and avoid loss , it is possible for us to gain a favorable development status in the economic globalization process .
the momentum of china 's economic operations is good , and it is possible to continue to maintain relatively rapid growth rate amid the great pattern of world economic development .
we have accumulated abundant experience in macroeconomic regulation and control in the course of successfully correcting inflation and effectively curbing deflationary trends .
the general demands on economic work are : guided by deng xiaoping theory and in accordance with the demands of the " three represents , " implement the spirit of the fifth plenary session of the 15 th cpc central committee , seize the opportunities , and speed up development .
depend on innovations in system and in science and technology , lead forward industrialization with informationization , and vigorously promote strategic restructuring of the economy .
strengthen the foundation status of agriculture , intensify support and protection for agriculture , and make efforts to increase peasant incomes .
speed up the changes in enterprise operational mechanism , strengthen enterprise management , and consolidate and expand the fruits of enterprise reform and of extricating enterprises from difficulty .
do a good job in preparatory work for joining the world trade organization , enhance the level of opening up to the world , and actively develop open - style economy .
expand employment through various channels , speed up the establishment and perfection of the social security system , and further improve living standards .
correctly handle the relationship between reform , development , and stability , promote sustained , rapid , and healthy development of the national economy and all - round social progress , and make efforts to make a fine start to the 10 th five - year plan .
china 's greatest strong point is its vast domestic market .
by basing ourselves on domestic demand in the face of the ever fiercer competition in the international market and the complex changes in the world economy , we can ensure relatively big room for maneuver in our national economy and strengthen our capacity to withstand international economic risks .
upholding the guideline of expanding domestic demand in essence means upholding the important idea that development is the clincher and regarding development as the main issue .
the problem of insufficient effective domestic demand still exists at present .
a process is needed for expanding social investment , encouraging people to consume , and turning this into the major motive force for economic growth , and it is still extremely essential to have government input drawing forward economic growth .
it is also necessary to continue to increase input for strengthening the weak links in the national economy , especially agriculture .
we should make flexible use of a variety of means to spur the growth of investment by enterprises and society and guide more social funds to take part in development and construction in more fields .
the financial system must properly step up supervision , strictly observe law and discipline , and ensure secure , highly efficient , and stable financial operations .
comprehensively implement the various financial credit measures for expanding domestic demand , restructuring , and stimulating consumption .
further strengthen coordination between fiscal and monetary policy , and make flexible use of monetary policy means to regulate and control economic operations . 2 .
the all - round production capacity of agriculture has markedly increased since the ninth five - year plan , and grain and other major products have achieved a change from a long period of shortage to overall balance and a surplus in bumper years .
the party committees and government at all levels must attach great importance to this problem and regard doing everything possible to increase peasant incomes as a major task in economic work next year .
closely depend on science and technology , optimize the structure of agricultural products , and take advantage of regional strong points , so as to greatly improve the overall quality and returns of agriculture .
the industrialization of agriculture , on the basis of the household contract operational system , is an effective way of achieving agricultural operations of scale and guiding the peasants to enter the market , and is a major force in drawing forward agricultural restructuring , and it should be vigorously promoted and supported .
we must correctly handle the relationship between restructuring agriculture and stabilizing grain production .
the sown area of grain should be kept relatively stable .
pay attention to arranging some construction projects that will help the peasants to directly increase income , help to improve the capacity of agriculture to resist natural disasters , improve rural market conditions , and help to enhance agricultural competitiveness .
we should speed up the reforms of rural taxes and fees and rural financial reforms , attach great importance to lightening the peasants ' burdens , and let the peasants recover their strength .
seriously do a good job in reforming the township and town organs , and be resolved to reduce the number of staff nourished by the treasury .
speed up system reform and the progress of science and technology , to promote the strategic restructuring of the economy .
in carrying out restructuring it is essential to closely depend on deepening the reforms and on system innovations , and regard the enterprises as the main players .
we must make efforts to expand the fruits of reform and of extricating the enterprises from difficulty , and persistently and dauntlessly push the reform and development of the state enterprises .
it is necessary to speed up the promotion of the standard company system in large and medium - sized state enterprises in line with the orientation of establishing a modern enterprise system , promote the switch to the share - holding system , and perfect the legal entity administrative system .
grasp the technological revamping of a number of key and backbone enterprises , enhance the technology and product structures , continue to knock out backward productive forces , and prevent the reckless launching of projects and the pursuit of low - standard duplicate construction .
vigorously develop hi - tech industries which are relative strong points in china and which have market potential , lead forward industrialization with informationization , actively promote the wide - ranging application of information technology in all sectors , and vigorously develop common and key technologies which support restructuring and industrial upgrading .
speed up the pace of reforms of the science and technology system , and further perfect the state science and technology innovation setup .
we should act in light of local conditions , take advantage of our relative strong points , and pay attention to handling well the following three relationships .
the first is the relationship between hi - tech industries and traditional industries .
the second is the relationship between technology and capital - intensive industries and labor - intensive industries .
the third is the relationship between east and central china development on the one hand and the development of west china on the other .
we must do a number of big things and get a good grasp of the construction of major projects of strategic significance during the 10 th five - year plan .
looking at the long term , there are many constraining factors in china 's economic development , such as water resources , energy , and communications .
we must also attach great importance to stepping up ecological construction and environmental protection and achieving sustainable development . 4 .
do a good job of preparatory work for joining the wto , to greet a new stage in opening up to the world .
we must get a good grasp of taking stock of , revising , and perfecting the relevant economic rules and regulations .
in opening up to the world we must first open up internally , break down departmental monopolies and regional blockades , and eliminate irrational restrictions on market entry by various ownership systems .
we must make efforts to expand exports and make active and effective use of foreign investment . 5 .
to continually improve living standards is the ultimate expression of the party 's purpose of wholeheartedly serving the people and of the demands of the " three represents , " and is the point of integration of handling the relationship between reform , development , and stability .
the party committees and government at all levels must regard expanding employment as an important work target .
we must continue to do a good job in development for poverty relief , and care for low wage - earning groups in the towns .
step up the building of spiritual civilization and promote all - round social progress .
we must speed up the building of the force of talent and improve the quality of the people .
we must actively establish an ideological and moral setup suited to the development of socialist market economy .
we must intensify credit awareness in the whole of society , and step up moral education for the citizens in being honest and trustworthy .
the central authorities demand that we must clearly understand the situation , strengthen confidence , assume overall responsibility , grasp the focal points , vigorously grasp implementation , and forge ahead on the basis of victory .
in order to achieve these demands , it is necessary to strengthen and improve party leadership over economic work .
- - make efforts to improve the standard of leadership over economic work .
- - constantly pay attention to maintaining social stability .
they must go down to the grass roots and take the initiative in investigating and dealing with various contradictions and hidden dangers .
the main guidelines for the next five years have been set , and the tasks for next year have been specified .

the collapsed building was previously a one - story building , with more than 20 shops along the street . before its collapse , the roof of an additional two stories was just completed . construction workers were decorating the building .

after the accident , leaders of the cpc committee , the government , and other relevant departments of dongwan city , as well as leaders of houjie township , rushed to the site . they organized and commanded the rescue work .

put in a tough position as the " rear guard " of the country 's reform , as the country changed tracks from the planned economic system to the socialist market economic system , shanghai 's economy went through a very difficult process back then .
following comrade deng xiaoping 's strategic thinking characterized by its broad and long - term view , the party central committee , with comrade jiang zemin at the core , established shanghai 's strategic position and asked the municipality to be turned into an international economic , financial , and trade center as soon as possible .
shanghai was ahead of the rest of the country by about five years in this kind of readjustment .
there was no ready - made model for us to copy in this kind of drastic and sweeping structural readjustment . we had to boldly explore , daringly take risks , and truly implement a complicated " systems engineering " project .
under the strong guidance of the municipal party committee and the municipal government , ideological education , practical projects , reemployment centers , and social security work were launched at the same time .
the traditional industries reflected on the inertia ingrained in the old system and decided to take on new roles . the masses of workers ' concept of employment underwent a profound change , and people made the difficult conversion from being " the unit 's people " to " society 's people . "
shanghai finally broke free from the shackle of the old system , and after going through the " labor pains " of some drastic changes , it daringly wrote a new page on structural readjustments .
during the " tenth five - year plan " period , the primary mission of shanghai 's economic development will be to go all out to promote the optimization and upgrading of the industrial structure .
six mainstay industries - - information , finance , commerce , automobile manufacturing , manufacturing of complete sets of equipment , and real estate - - are already established .
when shanghai implemented reform to convert to the shareholding system in the 1980 's , it was very controversial .
shanghai has 113 enterprises selling shares in the stock market ; they have raised nearly 100 billion yuan .
shanghai 's 113 listed companies ' average per share earning and net rate of return on investment are higher than the shanghai market 's , the shenzhen market 's , as well as the national average .
shanghai 's state properties management commission is the first of its kind in the country . it authorizes the management and administration of state - owned properties at three levels to make the assets work more efficiently and give play to the proper circulation and optimal reorganization of state - owned assets .
in recent years , shanghai has actively explored ways to facilitate the change from an ownership structure with a single form of ownership to a structure with diverse ownership formats in a very large city .
the latest statistics show that the non - public - owned economy now accounts for more than 25 percent - share of the municipality 's gnp .
civilian - run technology enterprises set up by returning phd 's who lead the investments in the areas of information technology , biomedicine , new materials , environmental protection , and other burgeoning industries with great potential have become the bright lights of shanghai 's economic development .
in the wake of the establishment of the investor 's system , and as the property rights representatives are put in place , more and more of the managers empowered to manage state properties in the state - controlled shareholding companies and in the enterprises groups are selected through the market system and are subject to independent evaluations .
by gathering funds through diverse channels to pay for " quitting " expenses that include resettling the workers , paying compensation for dissolving contracts , and paying back bank loans at bankruptcy rates .
statistics show that in the last three years , of the more than 100 billion yuan 's worth of assets put to use by shanghai 's industrial enterprises , nearly one - fifth was used to cover expenses as the inferior enterprises quit .
by properly handling the relationship among reform , development , and stability and insisting on taking small steps to build great strides , shanghai proceeded in an orderly fashion to tentatively set up four channels for the inferior industries , trades , and enterprises to get out of the market .

guangzhou , 3 dec ( xinhua ) - - the collapse of a building in chiling village in houjie township , dongguan city , guangdong province , has drawn much attention from the dongguan city cpc committee and the city government .
in their emergency action yesterday morning [ 2 december ] , the dongguan city cpc committee and the city government made the best use of the situation and organized relevant departments city - wide and 30 - plus township and district officials concerned for examining the scene and investigating the course and cause of the incident .
an " on - the - spot city meeting on 1 december " was then held to draw a lesson from the collapse . it was decided that all illegal structures across the city must be thoroughly checked to eliminate the risks of collapse and prevent a repeat of similar incidents .
yesterday afternoon guangdong vice governor xu deli specially went to the scene in dongguan to find out about the incident . he organized efforts to give first aid to the wounded and went to the hospital to express his solicitude to them .
the collapse in chiling fully exposed a serious loophole in the supervision of certain private houses .

belgrade , 3 dec ( xinhua ) - - chinese foreign minister tang jiaxuan , who is on an official visit here , and foreign minister goran svilanovic of the federal republic of yugoslavia [ fry ] signed a prc - fry joint communique on the afternoon of 3 december .
the communique says : both the prc and the fry hold that the right of the people of all countries in choosing development roads according to their national conditions and needs should be respected and that different social systems and concepts of value should not become obstacles to the smooth development of relations among countries .
continuing to maintain and develop equal and mutually beneficial cooperation in various fields between both sides corresponds with the fundamental interests of the two countries and two peoples and also benefits the peace and stability in the region and the world .
the communique says : the yugoslav side fully values the prc 's important role in international affairs and highly appreciates the positive contributions of the prc , as a permanent member of the un security council , to preserving world peace , including the peace and stability in the southeast european region .
yugoslavia reiterates its stand on upholding a one - china principle and maintains that taiwan is an inseparable part of chinese territory and that the prc government is the sole legitimate government of china .
the fry will not establish official relations with taiwan or conduct official contacts with it and will not support taiwan in trying to join international organizations only sovereign countries are entitled to .
the chines side holds that yugoslavia is an important factor in maintaining the peace in the southeast european region , preserving regional stability , and promoting regional cooperation .
china will continue to support yugoslavia 's efforts to fully return to the international community , and calls on the relevant parties to lift their sanctions against yugoslavia as soon as possible .
the communique says : yugoslavia thanks china for providing humanitarian aid and economic assistance to the yugoslav people during yugoslavia 's most difficult period .
both sides acknowledge that they will continue to carry out bilateral agreements on economic cooperation and ensure the smooth implementation of these agreements .
the chinese side will continue to encourage chinese enterprises to take an active part in yugoslavia 's economic reconstruction .
both sides will , in accordance with the principles of market economy , encourage their enterprises and corporations to engage in all kinds of mutually beneficial and cooperative economic and trade exchanges , and they will devote their efforts to developing markets in a third country .
both sides encourage their nationals to conduct all kinds of economic and trade activities in each other 's country and will provide convenience for contacts between both sides ' nationals .
both sides specially encourage further friendly cooperative activities of all kinds between china 's heilongjiang province and yugoslavia 's serbia republic , between china 's guizhou province and yugoslavia 's mentenegro republic , and between china 's beijing and yugoslavia 's belgrade .

the navy is evaluating whether to lease four kidd - class missile destroyers demobilized by the us navy .
in terms of anti - submarine capabilities , the destroyer is equipped with a complete system comprising various types of sonars , anti - submarine torpedoes , and anti - submarine helicopters .
in terms of surface attack capabilities , the destroyer is equipped with the harpoon anti - ship missile , which has above - surface attack capabilities , as well as five - inch automatic guns .
as for electronic warfare capabilities , the destroyer is equipped with the most advanced electronic countermeasure system , interference rockets , and interference chaff targets for torpedoes .
under actual circumstances , deploying the destroyer in the waters surrounding taiwan may or may not produce the same air - supremacy combat strength it had produced for the us navy . there would be a difference in the level of combat strength .
within the navy , there are widely different opinions for and against introducing the kidd - class destroyer .
furthermore , another development target of the navy - - the diesel - powered submarine - - would likely to be scrapped due to constraints of the budget or even manpower and material resources of the navy .

beijing , 4 dec ( xinhua ) - - state council vice premier qian qichen met in zhongnanhai this afternoon shaykh hamad , foreign minister of qatar , who has made a special journey to china as a special envoy of the emir .
hamad relayed an oral message from the emir to president jiang zemin and briefed qian qichen on the ninth islamic summit recently held in doha , capital of qatar .
hamad said , this was a successful meeting which focused on discussing the iraq issue and the mideast peace process .
the meeting authorized qatar to continue to mediate between iraq and kuwait .
the islamic conference organization also discussed the palestine problem and condemned israel 's slaughter of palestinian people .
hamad said , china has important influence in international affairs as a permanent member of the un security council , and qatar and the islamic world are ready to listen to china 's views on the mideast and iraq issues , and will continue to brief china on relevant events and to coordinate stances with china on these issues .
qian qichen congratulated the emir of qatar on being elected president of the islamic conference .
he said , in the past two months , there have been continuous bloody clashes between israelis and palestinians causing heavy casualties on both sides , especially among the palestinians , and seriously setting back the mideast peace process ; the situation throughout the region is in turmoil .
the chinese government profoundly expresses its disquiet and serious concern at this situation ; in the un security council china voted in favor of resolution 1322 condemning israel 's excessive use of force against the palestinian people , causing casualties .
china notes that the recent ninth islamic summit in the qatari capital doha approved a series of documents appealing to israel and palestine to stick to the path of peace talks ; this is identical with china 's stance .
qian qichen said , on the iraq issue , china advocates the comprehensive and practical implementation of the relevant security council resolutions .
china has done a lot of work inside and outside the security council to push the lifting of sanctions against iraq .
china believes that it is necessary to start some consultations to resolve the iraq issue , and iraq also should adopt some positive postures and cooperate with secretary general annan 's mediation work .
china also believes that it is extremely important that countries in the region bury old grudges and establish mutual trust and good neighborliness .
he said , as a permanent member of the un security council , china is ready to make efforts with the international community , including qatar and the islamic conference organization , to bring about an early solution to the iraq problem and promote regional peace and development .
he emphasized that china attaches importance to developing ties of friendly cooperation with qatar ; the economies of the two countries are strongly complementary , and there are broad prospects for cooperation .

it is now deep autumn season in korea .
i was invited by the south korean public opinion conglomerate to visit south korea .
visiting south korea for the first time , i was naturally curious about everything i saw .
to be sure , it is important to understand the korean culture and customs . people are now paying greater attention to major changes on the korean peninsula .
south korean experts , scholars , government officials as well as ordinary south korean people are all elated about the summit meeting that took place on the korean peninsula at the turn of the century .
they said that president kim tae - chung has aggressively promoted north - south exchanges since becoming president and that the two - koreas ' summit meeting and the joint declaration made by the two koreas represented a milestone in the development of relations between the two koreas ' .
the korean people i met all talked about the friendly relations between china and rok and they thanked china 's contributions to the promotion of peace and stability on the peninsula .
panmunjon was the korean war truce talks site .
people call it a " historical spot " for the splitting of the " three - thousand - mile country . "
the panmunjon joint security area is situated at the 38 th parallel line . the two koreas set a two - km buffer zone in the demilitarized zone . a total of 1,292 border demarcation stones that run from the east to the west cut the korean peninsula into north korea and south korea .
in the central area of panmunjon , both the rok and the dprk built their own roads and six blockhouses that serve as venues for talks that stand in the middle of both roads .
a 50 - cm width cement slab becomes a dividing line for the northern side and the southern side at panmunjon . both sides station elite troops there .
i was told that since the issuance of the " joint declaration , " panmunjon has begun to turn from a place of military confrontation to a venue for " talks and dialogue " and the past exchange of slandering remarks between the two sides has become remarks about " peace , cooperation , and national reconciliation . "
in late september , the dprk defense minister kim il - chol headed a military delegation to visit rok via panmunjon . this marked the first visit of a dprk defense minister to rok in the past 50 years .
despite this , one can still sense a tense atmosphere brought about by the north - south military confrontation .
the rok military escort told me that except for the first meeting between the two koreas ' defense minister , military confrontation and the tense situation along the " 38 th parallel line " have yet to see a substantive breakthrough .
during my stay in seoul , i witnessed a routine nationwide " civil defense exercise . " strict traffic control was imposed during the exercise . all vehicles and pedestrians were forbidden to circulate .
from a short trip to rok and from what i saw and what i heard , i am convinced that the ice of the cold war has started to thaw on the peninsula .
the situation on the peninsula has entered a new stage .
for the people on the peninsula to realize a peaceful reunification of their country , they will still have to continue on a long and twisted road

to meet the requirements of modern warfare , all the officers and men of the regiment concentrated on studying the theory of new armament , vigorously researched tactics and methods of operation , and tackled many complicated technological problems .
since battlefield is a necessary material condition for two sides to confront each other , battlefield environment , be it favorable or unfavorable , will have a vital bearing on success or failure of a war .
our army 's network building should aim at creating a favorable network environment for a battlefield in order to fight and win a hi - tech war of a medium or bigger scale in future .
as regards software and hardware parts , our army has pursued more windows , bigger volume , and higher speed .
please note : though it is true that technological requirements can form the basis of network quality , our purpose in building a network is to serve operations . therefore , our network building should proceed in light of our actual conditions and with our future operational needs as the premise .
we should first and foremost meet needs of combat tasks and then needs of vertical command or control and horizontal coordination as well .
in my view , we should focus on realities .
though a general computer software set seems complete with all necessary parts , it has adopted a compulsory mode , and the more complete it is , the more restrictive it is to its own development and upgrade .
on this issue , should we try to modernize our armed forces by following foreign countries ' train of thought or by seeking development through " making it up , " the result would certainly become such an elementary mathematical formula as " unequal amount minus equal amount is the same . "
weaponry is an outstanding element of defense power .
on this issue , people tend to exhibit either one of two tendencies . one is a fear of things foreign . people who have this tendency regard china 's weaponry as backward and unable to compete with that of the powers .
the first law : productive forces determine the combat power of weaponry .
by that time , 60 percent to 70 percent of the work force may consist of scientific and technological personnel .
of all weaponry deployed by the developed nations in the several limited wars in the world in recent years , over 80 percent consisted of newly researched and developed high - tech equipment . the battlefield has become a laboratory for high - tech weaponry .
science and technology , especially high tech , has become the outstanding element of combat power .
social productive forces in china are at a historic turning point today . even though a fully mature modern market economy and industrial system have yet to take shape , we are rushing headlong into the knowledge economy .
correspondingly , while the chinese military 's weaponry has yet to achieve full mechanization , the drive for information has become a task of burning urgency .
to keep up with the times and achieve both an economic take - off and military buildup , we must go all out to develop high technology and promote the application of high - tech in all fields across the board , and put the modernization of weaponry on the strong foundation of the " first productive forces . "
the second law : in weaponry , technological gaps determine the " generation gaps " of weaponry .
for instance , guided missile weaponry is now in its fourth generation of development .
generally speaking , guided missiles of the first generation were powered by liquid - fuel rocket engines . surface - to - surface missiles and surface - to - air missiles were launched from fixed sites with inertial guidance or wireless guidance . anti - tank guided missiles , in contrast , featured wired command and guidance .
by and large , fourth - generation guided missiles use a high - energy propellant . the airframes are made of lightweight materials . they also feature a terrain contour matching system and a satellite positional guidance system .
as it goes through generations of development , every weapon is marked by a number of critical indicators . upgrades in these indicators constitute the generation gaps for that weapon . in essence , this kind of " generation gap " is a " technological gap . "
technology is the growth point and multiplier of the combat power of any weapon . technological breakthroughs are the critical reason behind weaponry advances .
the third law : comprehensive national strength determines the overall level of weaponry .
researching , developing , and mastering one or two kinds of advanced new weapons is within the reach of most countries in the world today . however , it is much more difficult to raise the level of modernization of all weaponry .
there is an objective factor at work here , which is not subject to human will .
the more advanced a weapon , the pricier it is .
therefore , new weaponry coexists with old weaponry even in an economic power like the united states . there are other weapons besides high - tech weapons in the arsenal .
weaponry development in a country must be compatible with the size of its economy . the relationship between economic development and defense buildup must be properly handled . do what one 's capable of and pursue coordinated development .
the key to weaponry development is technological innovation . at the heart of weaponry secrets are technological secrets .
it is easy to buy advanced weapons on the arms market in the world today , whereas the import of advanced technology is subject to all manner of strict controls . purchasing technology is better than purchasing weapons , but what is even better is creating new technology .
in weaponry development , every country in the world opts for the same approach : emphasize research and development , with import as a supplement .
for that reason , not only must we be able to learn and assimilate advanced science and technology , but , even more important , we must develop the capacity for scientific and technological innovation .
under specific conditions , on the contrary , beating an enemy with better equipment actually validates , from another perspective , the law that the superior would win and the inferior would be eliminated .
any weapon has its strengths and weaknesses .
the unique shape of the stealth bomber is dictated by its invisibility , but it has the effect of limiting its maneuverability .
night vision equipment produces a clear view of the target under dim light or in the absence of light , but such equipment does not operate well in strong light . the c4isr system enhances battlefield transparency and command autonomy , but creates more opportunities for magnetic soft attack and sabotage by hackers .
high - tech equipment may boast superior combat and technical capabilities , but it has some unavoidable flaws .
sometimes , the strength of a piece of sophisticated equipment could well turn out to be its weakness , whereas the weakness of an outdated piece of equipment just may be its strength .
overall superiority or inferiority does not mean total superiority or inferiority .
because of economic constraints , no country can afford all the most advanced weapons out there . some of the weapons in its arsenal are necessarily outdated . moreover , advanced equipment may not exist perfectly with old equipment .
the superiority or inferiority of the capabilities of a weapon does not amount to superiority or inferiority in actual combat effectiveness .
strength and the deployment of strength are very different concepts .
the battlefield deployment of a weapon is subject to multiple constraints . when a piece of advanced equipment is not used well or properly , it will not display its inherent superiority . on the contrary , it may cause damage .
during the gulf war , 20 percent of the u.s. military 's apache helicopters could not be deployed because of damage caused by sand .
in contrast , yugoslavia adopted the correct tactic of combining hiding with attack . consequently , not only did it safeguard 90 percent of its military forces , but it also shot down nato fighter planes and guided cruise missiles , including f-117 stealth bombers .
numerous war stories show that when outdated equipment is deployed properly and its potential put to use , it can still do a good job in active combat .
the decisive factor is man , not weapons .
it is man that develops weaponry . and it is also man that puts weaponry to use .
effective ways to turn weakness into strength turning inferior weaponry into superior weaponry must take place under a specific set of conditions . in most cases , those conditions must be created by man .
trying to defeat a well - equipped opponent on the battlefield , one must take advantage of the opponent 's errors and make it commit errors . but we must not put our fortunes at the mercy of our opponent 's errors .
in terms of military combat readiness , we must take a string of measures to accelerate weaponry modernization .
moreover , we must emphasize both r & d and transformation ; diligently transform existing weaponry with high technology , focusing on the transformation of combat platform fire control systems ; intensify the development of the c3isr system ; and raise the level of automation .
study tactics in depth .
in china 's ancient and recent wars , action centered around man . in a contemporary war , however , action revolves mainly around the deployment of weapons . this is a significant change .
we also need to examine how man and weapons can best work together , how combat forces can be put to use overall , how weapon deployment can be coordinated with weapon protection .
on the one hand , we cannot completely rely on the commander 's will . on the other hand , we cannot just let nature take its course and do nothing .
what is important is not for us to get our hands on one or two pieces of advanced weaponry , but to create an operating mechanism that would facilitate our effort to continually develop and accelerate the development of weaponry .
the only way to expedite the development of science is to master the science of development .

beijing , 5 dec (zxs) - - economic globalization has become a hot topic all over the world in recent years .

for instance , if the trend of the constantly widening " south - north gap " between the developing and developed countries fails to be resolved in a timely and effective way , what will it mean to the developed countries ?

in this sense , economic globalization is also a challenge to mankind , so all human beings should ponder deeply over it in face of this challenge .

affected by the psychological expectation of nt dollar depreciation , which prevails the foreign exchange market , panic buying of foreign currencies in taipei 's foreign exchange market has become increasingly fierce .
in the stock market , the average rate of returns of investment in the market was minus 37.78 percent in the first 11 months of this year , according to statistics of the taiwan securities exchange .
this shows that investors were losing money . affected by taiwan 's unstable political situation and the nosedive of us stocks , corporations continued readjusting their stocks and indexes . as no improvement was made in this situation , most investors lost money last month .
according to statistics , electronics stocks had witnessed the largest loss by the end of november . electronic and information industries are the pillar on which taiwan relies to develop its economy , and their large decline suggested the great damage taiwan 's entire industries had suffered .

in order to develop the capacity for protection against nuclear , chemical and biological weapons , an anti - chemical warfare corps school was set up 50 years ago to train anti - chemical warfare cadres for the armed forces .
fifty years ago , to cope with the threat of the possible use of nuclear , chemical and biological weapons at any time by the us military during the war of aggression against korea and to suit the need of a modern war , the central military commission decided to establish anti - chemical warfare units .
with the approval of chairman mao zedong and premier zhou enlai , the chemical warfare school of the chinese people 's liberation army [ pla ] was established in december 1950 to train anti - chemical warfare cadres for the whole army . this was the beginning of the building of anti - chemical warfare units of new china .
however , china has firmly opposed the proliferation of nuclear and chemical weapons and is one of the few countries in the world that have promised not to be the first to use nuclear weapons .
adhering to the active defensive strategy and strengthening the defensive capability against nuclear , chemical and biological weapons are the persistent policy in promoting modernization of our army .
the building of anti - chemical warfare units has entered a new development period .
in the future local war under high - tech conditions , there will be not only the threat of nuclear and chemical weapons but also the new danger of nuclear and chemical pollution due to striking at nuclear and chemical facilities .
in the theoretical study , we should closely follow the advanced development of nuclear , chemical and biological weapons in the world and understand the direction of development in building protection against nuclear , chemical and biological weapons .
we should further raise our capability of supervision and detection , prevention , cleanup , disinfection , and smoke - screen protection .
in the building of specialized units , we should follow the principle of making gradual progress in reaching various targets , develop from fighting under actual conditions of nuclear and chemical warfare to training under simulated condition , and constantly deepen the reform of specialized training in anti - chemical warfare .
so long as we keep our mission firmly in mind and boldly make active progress in a pioneering spirit , we can certainly grasp the future of anti - chemical warfare units in the 21 st century and be worthy of the title of being " magic troops to conquer devils ! "
since the beginning of the 1990 s , the gulf war and other local wars have clearly demonstrated that the threat of nuclear and chemical weapons still exists and the environment of nuclear and chemical warfare will be more complicated .
the reform of anti - chemical warfare has thus been carried out on a large scale .
some people even doubt whether there is still a need to make preparations against nuclear , chemical , and biological weapons for the whole army under the new historical conditions .
when we hesitated , the western countries stepped up development in this field . officers and men of the anti - chemical warfare units of our army have noticed the gap .
in the past several years , the reform of training of anti - chemical warfare has been launched in the whole army like a raging fire .
the experiences of those achievements have been promoted in the whole army and effectively advanced the in - depth development of reform of training in anti - chemical warfare .
seek breakthroughs in reforming contents of training anti - chemical warfare troops of the whole army have actively implemented the strategic thinking of " strengthening the army with science and technology " and created a new road with own characteristics .
through in - depth research and with a deeper understanding of the threat of nuclear and chemical weapons in a future local war under high - tech conditions , anti - chemical warfare troops of our army have carried out a bold reform of the contents of traditional training .
through those reforms , the contents of training for anti - chemical warfare troops have been improved , and overall capability in anti - chemical warfare has been raised .
anti - chemical warfare schools of the whole army , various military units and scientific and research institutes have made joint efforts in the spirit of " three in one " to tackle difficult problems . breakthroughs have been made in training means and methods .
anti - chemical warfare troops have concentrated their efforts to " win " in a future war with frequent good results .
