the two - day expert - level talks on revision of the status of forces agreement between the republic of korea and the united states have ended .
the agreement was signed in 1966 and became effective in 1967 .
it is generally agreed among the south koreans that the agreement has relegated south korea to an unequal position .
south koreans helpless before crimes committed by us servicemen the agreement has practically given extraterritorial rights to the united states .
during this process , korean procurators must go through the us military authorities to gather evidence from the suspect .
a certain miss lee of korea 's " national movement to eradicate crimes committed by us troops in korea " said that in recent years the korean judicial departments have been able to exercise their trial rights on only 3 to 5 percent of all the us soldiers who commit crimes in korea .
even those us soldiers who were handed over to korea for handling were accorded " sympathetic treatment " by the korean authorities in line with the agreement .
they could not get over the fact that maccarthy was only given an eight - year term , for it is most natural that a killer must pay with his life for killing others .
us prisoners enjoy five - star hotel treatment a korean civic organization exposed that there is a secret clause in the agreement formulated specifically for crime suspects , that is , to provide " sympathetic treatment " for us soldiers detained by the korean judicial authorities .
that is , even if the gis stay in jail , they would like to be treated as if it were a five - star prison .
out of control in the " country within a country " according to the agreement , us troops can use korean land without compensation .
the occupied land is korean territory in name , but as a matter of fact , it has become " a country within a country " over which the korean government has no say .
without consulting the yongsan district government , the us army built a six - storey hotel , brushing aside the yongsan district government 's repeated protests .
a car park in yongsan was provided by the korean government to the us army for military purposes , but the us army turned it into a car - leasing facility .
oil leaks from the base 's oil depot and the inability of the korean quarantine departments to check meat products and vegetables imported from the us mainland and from other countries for the us troops ' consumption are just small cases .
in addition , the korean labor laws do not extend to protect many who work on the us base .
although bullied and exploited , these workers have no place to air their grievances .
many koreans say that the us troops are laws unto themselves by taking advantage of the agreement . to them , there are no korean laws and no human rights for the koreans to speak of .
all they care about are the special privileges they enjoy in south korea , and the agreement serves to perpetrate such privileges .
poison - detecting equipment during the war to resist us aggression and aid korea in the early 1950 s , chinese military personnel had to fight against poison gas .
anti - poison equipment gas masks , protective clothing , frog - suits , and other individual protective equipment represent a shield for protecting personnel from damages caused by toxic agents , bacteria , and radioactive ash contamination .
as far as this aspect is concerned , our armed forces now have a series of advanced protective equipment , which is suitable to the physiological feature of all ethnic groups in china and which meets various operational needs . in addition , china also has a group of world - renowned experts on poison protection .
decontamination equipment thanks to the hard work done by several generations of our sci - tech workers , who are specializing in anti - chemical technology , china has made remarkable progress in the development of decontamination equipment .
smoke - generating equipment modern smoke - generating technology is based on new material technology , which can effectively resist the enemy 's reconnaissance and observation equipment .
we have developed new types of smoke - generating agents with an aim to jam or obstruct the enemy 's advanced reconnaissance , observation , and control - and - guide methods .
flame - injecting equipment flame injectors are powerful weapons for attacking key points and for carrying out short - range combat . today , our armed forces have made new achievements in developing flame injectors . our military units have a series of flame injectors , which can meet the needs of various battlefield operations .
united nations , 5 december ( xinhua ) - - the un security council [ unsc ] unanimously adopted a resolution on the evening of 5 december , deciding to extend again the execution of iraq 's " oil - for - food " program to another six months .
in line with this resolution , iraq will begin implementing its ninth " oil - for - food " program on 6 december .
during the period , iraq may export oil as much as possible .
the unsc also decided that during its ninth " oil - for - food " program , iraq may earmark $ 600 million of its income from oil exports for imports of oil production equipment .
the unsc said that if iraq comprehensively implements un relevant resolutions , it would consider allowing iraq to set aside $ 15 million of its income from oil exports to be used as payment of its overdue membership fees .
the unsc also urged the un iraq sanctions committee to examine and approve more expeditiously the contracts for iraq to import humanitarian materials and improve the procedures for the examination and approval .
the unsc asked the un secretary - general to submit to the un iraq sanctions committee before 31 march 2001 a report containing proposals for iraq 's use of additional export routes for oil and oil products .
to ease the pain iraqi people have suffered in their everyday life due to the long period of sanctions , the united nations has allowed iraq to implement the " oil - for - food " program since late 1996 .

in the past half year , with the development and changes in the cross - strait situation , the taiwan oriented branches of the mainland government were quite satisfied with the promotion and results of the above - mentioned five directives .
thus , unless taiwan takes the radical action of suddenly [ announcing ] taiwan independence , it is unlikely to have a tense situation of military conflict .
the high tech industries intend to march westward and to be integrated into the mainstream economy of the mainland due to the fact that both sides across the strait are going to join the wto . these situational developments are advantageous for the mainland .
there is no need for beijing to show its hands . instead , it only needs to keep on pressing , then various considerations about their own interests by the forces within taiwan would compel taiwan 's leadership to make adjustments or compromises on the cross - strait relationship .
due to considerations of the international environment and of the cross - strait relationship , beijing has intended to use the framework of the " one china principle " to establish the cross - strait relationship as a domestic affair of " one china " and to nip off taiwan independence from its root .
therefore , the insistence on the " one china principle " is beijing 's bottom line toward taiwan and also its strategic goal .
beijing has always publicly maintained that it requires taiwan to unequivocally admit that the two organizations across the strait had in 1992 reached the position that both sides shall orally articulate [ its own version of ] " both sides across the strait insist a one china principle . "
however , as long as taiwan can return to the position of " one china , with each side free to make its own interpretation " or the articulated contents of the " guidelines for national unification , " beijing will consider it as a gesture of good will for improving the cross - strait atmosphere .
thus , as long as taiwan returns to the position in the " guidelines for national unification , " a breakthrough in the current political deadlock across the strait can be expected .
both sides across the strait are about to join the wto and enter a new juncture in cross - strait trade .
due to the principle of free trade , taiwan has to open up for mainland products or capitals .
at the same time , both sides have to face the problem of the " three links , " trading included . beijing utilizes the direct three links as its bargaining chips on taiwan and demands taiwan to accept the " one china principle " politically .
for instance , now whenever beijing mentions the three links , it would always reiterate " as long as it is under the one china premise , the two sides across the strait can discuss the direct three links right away . "
thus as long as taiwan accepts the " taiwan / hong kong model , " then the mainland can " comprehend " it as taiwan has accepted the one china principle and then promote the cross - strait three links .

beijing , 6 dec (zxs) - - according to a prediction report of the state information center , china 's foreign trade will maintain a fairly good growth momentum next year , and the total volume of its imports and exports will hopefully top $ 500 billion for the first time , reaching a record of $ 533 billion .
according to the report , there is hope that the course of china 's accession to the world trade organization (wto) will be completed next year . on that occasion , china will enter a period of opening up in all directions , and its foreign trade will definitely register significant development .
as the import thresholds will be lowered , it will certainly lead to a greater import volume . it is estimated that imports from the united states alone will increase by at least 10 percent .
since the beginning of this year , the contract amount of foreign funds to be used by china has registered considerable growth . this shows that foreign direct investment will also increase next year , and the growth in foreign funds actually used will inevitably lead to corresponding increases in imports and exports .
these are all " favorable " factors contributing to a sustained growth in foreign trade next year .
the growth of domestic demands is likely to slow down , and this will also play a role in restraining foreign trade imports .
given that tariffs will be lowered continuously , it is necessary to apply non - tariff means to provide appropriate protection to the domestic market .

specifically , tncs deal blows at developing countries in the following four main respects .
first of all , interference in the host country 's sovereignty .
since a tnc is a worldwide network organization , the host country can hardly influence its impact in monetary and fiscal policies , sales arrangements , and so on .
it always happens that the host country invests heavily in infrastructure and the tnc , having made a profit , becomes insufferably arrogant and makes irresponsible remarks .
the tnc also attaches particular important to strategic control over joint venture companies , with the result that the fine hopes of developing countries for learning advanced technology and economic management always come to nothing , and in addition they have no room for bargaining at all .
for instance , in the course of privatization in recent years , many state - owned companies in latin america that originally held the national economic lifelines have been bought by tncs of the developed countries , with the result that the governments have to a very great degree lost their control over these departments .
third , stepping up efforts to wrest talent from the host country .
this point is particularly conspicuous in poor developing countries .
when occupying the markets of developing countries , tncs regularly engage in a great deal of propaganda and publicity to simultaneously bring into the local markets the values and culture outside the company , and this has a tremendous impact on the culture of the host country .
experts concerned point out that host countries should have specific antimonopoly restrictions on the business behavior of tncs , and lay down a degree of political permission for their non - business activities .

compared to the rather complicated and profound changes of last year , the international situation this year has been relatively stable with no major collisions . what is particularly conspicuous is the fact that various countries have been making adjustments to their internal and external policies that are oriented to the new century .
the tide of economic globalization has brought the world even closer together . meanwhile , some new conflicts and problems have also emerged that call for immediate solution .
the new century is right in front of us .
peace and development remain the mainstream in the development of international situation as the cold war ended , so did the situation where the united states and the soviet union vied for hegemony in the world and the east and west confronted each other .
over the past decade or so , a main feature of the international situation has been the termination of the hostility , especially comprehensive hostility and antagonism , which used to exist among some major world powers for a long time .
for example , though conflicts of various kinds still exist between the united states and russia or between the united states and china , all of them being major powers , their overall relations are different from the antagonistic relations of the cold - war era .
in the first 50 years of the 20 th century , the relations among major powers mostly underwent the test of two world wars ; in the second 50 years of the 20 th century , the relations among major powers were in a state of cold - war confrontation most of the time .
looking ahead at the relations among the world 's major powers in the 21 st century , one can say that neither of the two main modes of major - power relations in the 20 th century would fit .
in the new century , national strategies that regard as their ultimate objective the pursuit and realization of the countries ' own national interests has not changed and will not change in essence , but the form in which national interests are realized has completely changed .
the development and change of the world security situation will be constrained by the development and change of the world economic and political situation to a greater extent .
faced with the world trend moving forward , hegemonic forces wishing to dominate the world and do whatever they like will find themselves increasingly unpopular .
" the world trend surges ahead with great might ; he who goes with it shall prosper and he who goes against it shall perish . "
behavior of hegemonism and power politics is the main danger to world peace there are many factors that undermine peace and development in the development of the world situation , but the main threat to world peace and development is still hegemonism and power politics .
this is because only those forces that are capable of practicing hegemonism and power politics can make a significant impact on the overall development of the world situation and cause harm to the security and development of the leading countries of the world and that of most of the countries .
ethnic and religious conflicts and splittist forces cause incessant turbulence in limited areas over the past decade or so since the end of the cold war , the conflicts , disputes , and turbulence that have occurred internationally roughly fall into three categories .
in the first category are infringements on other countries ' territories and sovereignty , caused by the behavior of hegemonism and power politics .
in the second category are regional conflicts and civil wars , caused by ethnic and religious conflicts and splittist forces , such as the situation in bosnia - herzegovina and kosovo prior to the western intervention and the conflicts in places like east timor and chechnya .
of all the factors that cause clashes and confrontations , intervention by external forces , such as hegemonism and power politics , is an important reason .
missile defense system threatens global strategic balance and stability today , at the turn of the century , no negative factors that affect the global strategic balance and stability and the overall state of international relations are greater than the missile defense program that the united states is currently implementing .

beijing , 7 dec ( xinhua ) - - the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation issued for the first time here today a " report on the situation of foreign trade in china , " which is called a " blue paper " on china 's foreign trade .
according to the statistics of the customs of china , the total import and export volume of the whole country from january to october this year reached $ 387.1 billion , 35.1 percent higher than the same period last year .
that exceeded the total import and export volume of all of last year , which was $ 360.6 billion .
this blue paper was written jointly by a group formed by the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation and the international trade and economic cooperation academy .
the appearance of an important turning point in the development of the domestic economy , the state policies that encourage the development of foreign trade , and the quickened steps in reform and opening up have provided a great impetus to the development of china 's foreign trade .
the report holds that the speed of growth in china 's imports and exports in 2001 will be considerably lower than this year . nevertheless , a considerable growth will be maintained , which is expected to be about 8 percent .
the report points out that international oil prices have remained high and this will have an adverse impact on the development of the global economy and the export and import trade of our country .

beijing , 9 dec ( xinhua ) - - with wto accession imminent , china 's enterprises are encountering an endless stream of antidumping litigation : color tv , garlic , shoes and hats , apple juice , chemical products . . . all sorts of aspects of export goods are involved .
the ever fiercer antidumping accusations are showing a warning light for us : it is essential to leap over the antidumping " pit " in order to contend for a place in the international market .
since the eu made its first antidumping accusations against chinese saccharin in 1979 , a " red card " of antidumping has frequently been shown to chinese goods on the international scene .
by now , there have been nearly 400 antidumping lawsuits against chinese products , directly affecting over $ 10 billion worth of exports , and china has become the country that has suffered the heaviest losses from antidumping charges .
shang ming , deputy director of the treaties and laws section of the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation , said that so - called antidumping means that the prices of a country 's exports to another are lower than the normal value .
in the wake of the rapid development of china 's foreign economic cooperation and trade , international trade disputes have tended to increase .
in particular , since the 1990 's , china 's export commodities have frequently encountered accusations , which have caused many factors for uncertainty in our foreign trade . this is conspicuously expressed in the following respects : the number of countries masking antidumping charges has increased .
the categories of goods subjected to antidumping charges are increasing all the time .
at present this involves many products of the iron and steel , light , machinery and electrical , textile , and electronics industries .
the antidumping duty rate set to be levied has risen vertically .
mexico levies the following duty rates at over 100 percent on chinese export commodities : 129 percent on domestic electrical appliances , 144 percent on bicycles , 315 percent on toys , 537 percent on garments , 673 percent on organic chemical products , and as much as 1,105 percent on shoes .
the great amount of antidumping measures against chinese commodities has in fact already become a " tiger blocking the road " to our exports , and this problem will encumber china for a long time as the scale of exports gradually expands year on year .
experts believe that there are both objective reasons and also discriminatory factors involved here .
since there are many enterprises and not enough intensity in sector management and coordination , the flames of abnormal price competition easily spread from the domestic to the international markets , resulting in antidumping accusations .
according to statistics , about 75 percent of china 's export commodities ( including those transhipped through hong kong ) are concentrated in the north american and european markets .
for example , returns on the export of apple juice were quite good some years ago , but then factories were set up everywhere , with the result that foreign markets were quickly saturated by the large quantities exported , and this eventually led to antidumping cases .
as china 's foreign trade and exports have rapidly increased , fierce competition has developed with the industries in the importing countries .
since chinese products have strong points in labor force and raw materials , we were always in a favorable position in competition .
it can be predicted that antidumping litigation by foreign enterprises against china will increase further in the future .
take up the sharp sword of self - protection on the international scene , economically developed japan and the rok have also become key targets of antidumping moves .
what is regrettable , however , is that when importing countries make extensive use of the legal means of antidumping measures , the most common means used by chinese enterprises is inaction in responding to the litigation .
all such behavior results in many antidumping cases being decided by other countries , and the final result is that we are forced to pay high antidumping duties and painfully lose our market .
experts therefore point out that in dealing with antidumping moves , we need to both " stab outside " and ensure " peace inside . "
so - called " stabbing outside " means directly dealing with antidumping moves at both government and enterprise levels .
in fact , it is not the case that chinese enterprises subjected to antidumping investigations are " killed off right away . "
as for the enterprises themselves , failure to respond to litigation means tacit acquiescence in irrational judgements , automatic capitulation , and the subsequent loss of markets .
it is necessary to strengthen sectoral self - discipline , open up foreign markets by legal procedure and with rational prices , and engage in orderly competition .
looking at the long term , to ensure that chinese products can truly advance on the international market , it is essential to enhance the technical content and added value of export commodities ; winning by quality is the effective way to deal with antidumping accusations .
sector associations should help the enterprises concerned to make full legal preparations , and the enterprises should coordinate their fight .
relevant statistics show that in the past 10 years the eu has raised an average of over 20 antidumping cases a year , and the united states an average of over 30 .

japanese prime minister yoshiro mori has reshuffled his cabinet twice in the eight months since he took office in april this year .
the reshuffle this time , unlike the previous ones , will take the plan for reshuffling central ministries and agencies as a prerequisite . a new cabinet will take office in january next year . in other words , new cabinet members will make up the first cabinet after the government streamlines its administrative structure .
beginning 6 january 2001 , the japanese government will cut the number of ministries and agencies to 12 from the current 22 .
since the new komeito party adopts a prudent attitude toward this proposal , the liberal democratic party [ ldp ] has temporarily shelved the issue of upgrading the defense agency , to avoid creating a rift among the three coalition parties .
the greatest feature of the new cabinet is that two ex - prime ministers will be brought into the cabinet . this cabinet lineup will be unprecedented in history .
as far as yoshiro mori is concerned , the inclusion of ryutaro hashimoto , head of the largest ldp faction , in the cabinet will help stabilize the political power base .
the so - called " political power with actual strength " is that besides the two ex - prime ministers , three ex - presidents of the ldp will be brought into the cabinet . the three ex - presidents of the ldp are kiichi miyazawa , ryutaro hashimoto , and yohei kono .
as before , the new cabinet will be ruled jointly by the three coalition parties . the new komeito party and the new conservative party each get one post in the cabinet .
the number of persons selected as cabinet members from the ldp factions is the same as before , with " rewards and punishments being fairly meted out . "
although the force calling for mori 's resignation has been defeated and a new cabinet , through two reshuffles , has made a public appearance , the support rate of the mori cabinet still remains low .
thus , the cabinet is faced with urgent tasks as follows : 1 ) resuscitation of the economy : this has been a top priority task since obuchi took charge of the cabinet .
besides , it is necessary to carry out a reform program to change a large number of departments under the jurisdiction of the government into corporations .
in the diplomatic area , the issue of japanese - russian and japanese - dprk relations is undoubtedly a top priority task facing the new cabinet .
yoshiro mori cannot be without anxiety until the ldp elects its new president in september next year .

according to some media , china 's state - owned banks have many problems and cannot compete with foreign - funded banks after the wto accession ; and we had better establish some non - governmental banks before opening our financial sector to the outside world , so that we can resist the impact of international capital .

the four state - owned commercial banks currently have 140,000 outlets , which hold 82 percent of the deposit market share , and which make it very convenient for people to draw money .

according to us newspaper reports , it takes at least 40 minutes for aircraft to take off from us navy aircraft carriers in normal conditions . after revising the procedures , preparation time may be shortened by approximately 15 minutes in the " kitty hawk " aircraft carrier .
a news spokesman of the us navy also said that it would take less than 30 minutes for aircraft carried by " kitty hawk " to take off to carry out operations after receiving orders .
this improvement measure , however , is implemented on a trial basis in the " kitty hawk " aircraft carrier only , and other aircraft carriers of the us navy will still continue their patrols and warning duties according to the original operational procedures .
delayed take - off of us aircraft for the purpose of interception was because the " kitty hawk " was being refueled .
kevin wensing also said that the delayed take - off of the f/a-18 " hornet " fighters responsible for intercepting the russian fighters on 17 october was that the " kitty hawk " was being refueled by another logistic supply ship at that time .
" air defense radar of the carrier discovered the russian planes soon after they took off , and the commander immediately ordered the f/a-18 planes responsible for the interception to fly to ' escort ' the russian planes out of our air defense zone . "
russians went so far as to transmit to " kitty hawk " website system administrators through the internet the pictures of russian planes flying over the deck of " kitty hawk " aircraft carrier , which indicated when and where the pictures were taken as well as the scenes at that time .

russia and the united states have not taken any similar action after the disintegration of the soviet union .
military experts of the west need to conscientiously study the true motivation of russia 's recent series of actions .
meanwhile , the danger of confrontation caused by the taiwan issue between china on the one side and the united states and japan on the other cannot be totally ruled out either .
the disproportionate growth of military strength is the main reason that sharpens contradictions among big asian - pacific countries on military security interests .
ever since the end of the cold war , the defense budgets of the united states and japan have been maintained at around $ 280 billion and $ 50 million respectively ; and such amounts prove to be several times higher , or even several dozens of times higher , than the respective defense expenses of china and russia .
over the past decade , the number of nuclear submarines deployed by russia has reduced from 55 to 16 , yet the number of those deployed by the united states has grown to more than 70 .
the united states intends to set higher goals for its strategic security interests through the establishment of a nmd system , with a view to weakening the strategic security interests of both china and russia .
as for japan , it wishes to expand its security interests from its own land towards places beyond its territories , especially towards the taiwan straits ; and this contradicts china 's strategic security interests .
meanwhile , the disproportionate growth of military strength in the region has also upset the foundation for a military security equilibrium among big asian - pacific countries .
if such a disproportionate growth of military strength continues , conflicts of security interests will surely worsen among big countries in the asian - pacific region .
if the united states continues to pursue such a policy of unilateralism , even if there is no arms race in its traditional sense in the asian - pacific region , there will certainly emerge phenomena of an accelerated arms expansion in the region .
ever since the end of the cold war , separatism has become a political trend , and the number of countries in the world has increased by more than 20 over the past 10 years .
among asian - pacific countries , there is quebec in canada [ as published ] ; the aborigines in australia ; chechnya in russia [ as published ] ; aceh , irian jaya , and maluku in indonesia ; the mindanao in the philippines ; and tamil in sri lanka .
without external military support , such separatist forces usually have extremely limited military capacities , and can hardly confront the central government .
in other words , between themselves , they will give no support to separatist forces in one another 's countries ; yet they will decide whether or not to extend support to separatist forces in non - western countries according to their own strategic needs .
the security prospect of the asian - pacific region remains stable with a worrying tendency within a short period of time from now , there is relatively little possibility that a military conflict would break out among big countries in the asian - pacific region .
at the same time , the bilateral and multilateral security cooperation among big countries will undergo further growth ; and the contents of the us - japan military alliance and the china - russia strategic cooperative partnership are expected to be further replenished .
as the chance increases for the united states and japan to deploy a tmd system in the region , the strategic security relations among big asian - pacific countries tend to become strained .
meanwhile , the deployment of the tmd will inevitably add to the inclination of the united states to settle its security interest contradictions with china and russia by force .
what is more , the united states has already begun to sell its long - range pre - warning system to taiwan ; and once taiwan has its own independent anti - missile pre - warning system , the united states may begin to sell its patriot-3 anti - missile system to taiwan .
if this is the case , the separatist forces in taiwan would surely speed up their pace of " taiwan independence , " and this would constitute a direct threat to china 's security .
during this period , the united states may still be able to maintain its dominance in the information industry , and this may possibly result in an even wider gap in the military strength between the united states and other big asian - pacific countries .
moreover , during the same period , there exists the danger that the united states might deploy the primary system of the nmd system in certain parts of this region .
particularly , once the united states completes its nationwide deployment of the nmb system , it will become the only country in this world that is not subjected to the deterrence of any nuclear weapons ; in that case , the united states might possibly reactivate its policy of nuclear blackmail .
however , if no proper solution is found to the contradictions and problems that are existing with the region 's security structure , the aforementioned destabilizing factors will surely exert an adverse impact on the economic development of this region , and this is obviously not the outcome that people wish to see .

hopefully , both sides will continue to work out some methods and take measures to seek a basic balance in bilateral trade in the course of expanding it .

beijing , 12 dec ( xinhua ) - - the party central leading body and the state council have approved the " opinion of the ministry of civil affairs on promoting the building of urban communities . "
following is the full text of the " opinion of the ministry of civil affairs on advancing the building of urban communities " : a community refers to a common social life entity formed by people in a certain geographical area .
at present , the scope of an urban community generally refers to an urban area administered by an urban resident committee with its size being adjusted after the community structural reform .
therefore , it is very necessary to more effectively advance the building of urban communities in all parts of the country on the basis of properly summing up the experience of the pilot projects in building urban community experimental zones over more than one year in the past .
first , fully understand the great significance of advancing the building of urban communities ( 1 ) advancing the building of urban communities is an urgent need in reform , opening up , and socialist modernization .
at the same time , with the continuing enhancement of the people 's living standards of the masses and the in - depth development of the reforms of housing , medical , pension , and employment systems , relations between urban residents and their communities will become closer and closer .
( 2 ) advancing urban community building is an effective measure for enriching the people 's cultural lives at the grass - roots level and enhancing the building of socialist spiritual civilization .
there exists such problems as rights are not integrated , responsibilities and tasks are not explicit , the scope of management is too narrow , the personnel of urban resident communities are getting too old , and the working conditions are poor .
continuously satisfying social needs of community residents and raising the life quality and civilization degree of the residents should always be taken as the fundamental purpose , providing services for community residents should be taken as the fundamental starting point of community building .
2 ) sharing resources in the joint efforts for improving the common living environment .
all strength of institutions , organizations , military units , enterprises , and government organs should be fully mobilized to participate in community building so that community resources may be jointly shared and used by them to the maximum degree and a benign atmosphere and environment may be built by all those inside the same community .
4 ) expanding democracy and promoting resident self - management .
the main objectives of urban community building in the next five to ten years are : 1 ) strengthening community party organizations and resident self - management organizations according to the requirements in urban modernization , building up new community with local features on the basis of the bond of people 's common sentiments for the same community .
3 ) strengthening community management , building good community relations , improving community functions , reforming the urban grass - roots management system , establishing a community management system and mechanisms in keeping with the socialist market economic structure .
in large and medium - sized cities , it is necessary to properly set up and run community service centers in all urban districts and neighborhoods and service centers in all community residents ' committees , and give priority to the work in this regard .
social services should be the key development projects in community building . community services have broad development prospects , and should consistently be developed in the orientation of basing services in society through industrial operation .
it is necessary to continuously enhance the quality of community services and the level of community management , and make community services play a more positive and effective role in improving the living conditions of the residents , expanding employment , developing a social service system for social security , and greatly promoting the development of the service industries .
( 2 ) developing community public health .
( 3 ) enriching and enlivening cultural activities in communities .

sheng huaren , minister of state economic and trade commission , the other day declared in beijing : our country has basically fulfilled the goal of extricating state - owned enterprises from difficulties through reform within three years .
breaking free of an old planned structure and swimming into big waves of market economy is indeed a rigorous challenge unknown in the past to every state - owned enterprise or every person who has shared weal and woe with state - owned enterprises .
over the past 20 - odd years since reform and opening up , state - owned enterprises have carried out reform by first obtaining more decisionmaking power and then turning profits into taxes ; implementing a contract system ; ensuring transformation towards a joint - stock system ; and furthering explorations in other fields as well .
contradictions cannot be evaded and problems must be tackled .
by employing different means at the same time , state - owned enterprises have tackled bottlenecks on schedule and resolved in a centralized way some major contradictions or outstanding problems which had hindered their reform and development .
on 23 january 1998 , some 120,000 backward cotton spindles were thrown into a blast furnace for melting in pudong of shanghai , which ushered in a key battle for state - owned enterprises to tackle bottlenecks and extricate themselves from difficulties through reform .
positively expanding domestic demand , stimulating economic growth .
in 1998 , the asian financial crisis emerged as a " road - blocking tiger , " and this cast another shadow over china 's economy for a period of time .
over the past few years , the state has set up a batch of large enterprise groups one after another , including china national petroleum corporation , china petrochemical ( group ) corporation , some 10 major defense industry groups , shanghai baoshan iron and steel group corporation , and so on .
in the course of reform , a batch of small state - owned enterprises have found a development mode suited to themselves through reorganization , amalgamation , merger , leasing , contracting , auction , and so on .
by simultaneously employing means like merger , bankruptcy , turning debts into shares , offering loans at subsidized interest rates for technological transformation purposes , and so on , the state has devoted more efforts to invigorating stock assets and lightening enterprises ' financial or cost burden and this has infused enterprises with a lease of life and vigor .
the past three years has seen more enterprises merged or going bankrupt than ever before and this has spelt an end to such an old practice as allowing state - owned enterprises to survive but not to die .
stepping up diversion , lightening enterprises ' burden .
at the same time , various areas have also rapidly introduced a social security system and built a reemployment project and this has helped enterprises cut personnel and raise efficiency .
of some 11 million people laid off last year , some 5.6 million have found new jobs .
establishing a modern enterprise system is not only a direction for the state - owned enterprise reform but also a permanent cure for state - owned enterprises .
the past three years have seen state - owned enterprises establishing a modern enterprise system at an " accelerating " pace .
completing structural transformation or not doing so has given rise to " a world of difference . "
jilin province , which has had more large and medium - sized state - owned enterprises , have listed some 130 large and medium - sized state - owned enterprises one after another in a plan aimed at establishing a modern enterprise system and has since made breakthroughs and progress in this regard .
some state - owned enterprises have viewed scientific management as a foothold for establishing a modern enterprise system and have turned from pursuing " structural transformation " only as they had done in the past to stressing " mechanism transformation . "
in a spirit of seeking truth from facts , the guangxi zhuang autonomous region cpc committee and government have pressed ahead with an enterprise reform by " making it up " or through internal rectification and have completed an internal reform for all state - owned enterprises in the local areas .
since handan iron and steel group in hebei province introduced simulated market accounting and a cost veto mechanism and yaxing group in weifang of shandong province began managing price ratios for purchases and sales , other state - owned enterprises have started rapidly introducing a new management mode by taking them as an example .
after the sea subsides , shores become larger .
according to statistics released at a national economic and trade work conference held the other day , in the january - october period of this year , state - owned industrial enterprises or state - owned industrial holding companies registered a 160 percent rise in profits as compared with the same period of last year .
more than 80 percent of large or medium - sized backbone state - owned enterprises will have preliminarily established a modern enterprise system .
truly , such a historical topic as extricating state - owned enterprises from difficulties through reform is likely to witness both difficulties and hopes .
in particular , as for establishing a modern enterprise system , though a basic framework for a new structure has been built , such a framework still has to be further deepened , standardized , or systematized in the course of reform , and thus the burden is heavy and the road is long .

as the relationship between residents and the community was becoming closer and closer , it became an immediate demand of large numbers of urban residents to stimulate community development , expand community service , and improve the living standard .
statistics show that by late last year there had been in china 667 cities , 749 districts under city governments , 5,904 subdistrict offices , and 115,000 neighborhood committees .
these subdistrict offices and neighborhood committees directly faced several hundred million residents and undertook the heavy tasks of developing the community , making the community prosperous , and serving residents .
at the turn of the century , the rapid development of the socialist market economy has set stricter demands on community development in the new period .
it is an existing major task for us to vigorously stimulate community development and step up the building of grass - roots level organizations of political power and organs of self - government of the masses that will pave the way for the management of grass - roots urban society the chinese way .
at the same time , over 20 provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities chose about 100 provincial level ( or municipal level ) districts for carrying out the same experiment .
organizational building is the core of community development and is the most important part for the autonomy of community members .
in the course of setting up and improving the community 's organizational system , various places have made remarkable achievements in strengthening community - level party organizations as well as the self - government organizations of community members .
many residents praised the party - member cadres for their services , saying : " they have proved themselves to be a red flag in community building . "
various experimental districts also strengthened the self - government organs of community members . many urban communities have set up neighborhood committees for self - administration , self - education , self - service , and self - supervision .
now , many experimental districts have established community residents ' self - government organizations .
beijing , shanghai , qingdao , wuhan , nanjing , urumqi , and other cities also tried to choose the neighborhood committee 's director by direct election , and worked out an electoral system for the neighborhood committee .
an autonomic system for community members featuring democratic election , democratic decision - making , democratic administration , and democratic supervision is gradually being formed in various experimental districts .
it is necessary to transform government functions and adjust the core downward . it is a hard nut to crack for community building , but it is a very important key link .
in the process of promoting community development , various experimental districts have vigorously transformed government functions following the principle of " authority is granted according to the matter to be tackled , money is given according to the job to be done , " giving back to the community the authority which should belong to it .
quanyuan subdistrict office in dongling district , shenyang city , granted to the community the four types of rights covering making policy decision , managing financial affairs , regulating , and supervising .
the community now also had the right to dispose of its income from paid services . the subdistrict office transferred the administrative expenses provided by the three - tier city - district - subdistrict financial department , to the community in full and on time .
the community was allowed to manage and dispose of the money independently and rationally , thus greatly arousing the enthusiasm of the community 's neighborhood committee .
staff of the neighborhood committee of karamay district in karamay city , xinjiang , provided free health service for its residents putting first prevention , medical treatment , and health care . they also built " health files " for over 30,000 retired oil workers .
wuhan city merged the campaign to create a culturally advanced image and the campaign to promote community cultural building , thus beautifying its appearance and enhancing its civil image .
xuanwu district in nanjing gave the party members , cadres , high school students , and primary school pupils in the community an education on patriotism by making use of the nearby museum in memory of the victims of the nanjing massacre , and other bases for patriotic education .
the office of the community committee of xuanwu district , nanjing , measured 150 square meters and was equipped with telephone sets and computers . gone were the days when a neighborhood committee had only " two room and three staff . "
with the arrival of a new century , china 's socialist modernization drive will enter a new development stage .

beijing , 13 dec (xinhua) - - the national financial work meeting was held in beijing today .
with regard to the concrete arrangements for the financial work next year , li lanqing said emphatically : first , we should continue taking firm control of the collection and management of tax income .
xiang huaicheng , minister of finance , said at the meeting that since the beginning of this year , the central authorities ' macro - control policies have been effectively carried out , and remarkable achievements have been scored in the financial work .
it is necessary to reinforce the coordination in providing services and the building of a clean administration , earnestly improve the work style of financial organs , speed up the study of financial theory and various kinds of professional knowledge , genuinely enhance the overall quality of financial cadres , and heighten the efficiency of financial work .
during the january - november period , the nation 's revenue reached 1,191.277 billion yuan ( not including the revenue from debt repayments ) , which was 208.464 billion yuan , or 21.2 percent , higher than that of the same period last year .
this revenue included the central revenue of 632.457 billion yuan , which was 26.7 percent higher than that of the same period last year ; and the local revenue of 558.82 billion yuan , which was 15.6 percent higher than that of the same period last year .
the nation 's expenditure during the same period was 1190.925 billion yuan ( not including the debt payments ) , which was 203.322 billion yuan , or 20.6 percent , higher than that of the same period last year .
this expenditure included the central expenditure of 390.608 billion yuan , which was 32.6 percent higher than that of the same period last year , and the local expenditure of 800.317 billion yuan , which was 15.5 percent higher than that of last year .
xiang huaicheng said : next year will be the first year for implementing the 10 th five - year plan . accomplishing next year 's financial assignments has important significance for achieving the five - year plan and maintaining a sustained , rapid , and healthy national economic growth .
we will test the system under which the national treasury will collectively disburse the money for projects built with capital raised through floating national bonds . we will also tighten the supervision and checking of the use of the capital , and strive to make sure the capital is used more efficiently .
we will tighten the collection and management of revenue to ensure a steady growth of revenue .
we must work in coordination with the relevant departments and support them in cracking down on smuggling and the crime of defrauding export tax refunds .
we must earnestly implement the central government 's uniform wage policy , making sure that the wages for the working staff of government organizations and institutions are paid in full and on time .
this is an obligation of governments at all levels . it is also an important measure for stimulating consumption and expanding internal demand . financial departments at all levels must strive to follow through this policy without fail .
we must raise enough money for funds against risks in grain production , make sure that the money is appropriated on time , and follow through all the policies governing grain purchasing and marketing - - especially the policy of buying , at protective prices , all the grain the peasants want to sell .
restructuring is a top priority of the current economic work .
we must increase the intensity of our support for the efforts of adjusting and optimizing the industrial structure , and actively promote the reform and development of state - owned enterprises .
we must follow through the " accountancy law , " and firmly crack down on such lawless behaviors of forging receipts , forging account books , and forging auditing reports .
we must create the mechanisms for making follow - up checking and giving feedback so as to supervise the use of funds earmarked for various projects .
wu yi said this year 's domestic and foreign trade work has been fairly successful .
the local departments in charge of economic and trade matters must tightly seize this advantageous time of economic growth and the opportunity of the country 's impending wto accession to vigorously forge ahead , actively make breakthroughs , and work hard to open up new prospects in domestic and foreign trade .
wu yi asked the localities and departments to diligently prepare for the wto accession .
we must use more transparent work methods and management methods and realistically work hard to strengthen administration according to law .
we should bring in international advanced sales and marketing techniques and management experiences , so that more chinese products can enter foreign businesses ' international sales and marketing networks and spur more exports of chinese - made products .
with regard to the reform of the circulation system , we must further implement the party central committee 's guiding principles of " advance and retreat " and " give and take " to make some strategic readjustments of the state economy in the circulation sector .

zhu rongji pointed out : consolidating and regulating the market 's economic order is an important task for next year 's economic work . currently , chaotic economic order is a relatively serious problem .

vice president gore , the democratic party candidate stated on 13 december that he acknowledges republican party candidate and texas governor bush as the next president of the united states .
this was the most fiercely fought us presidential election campaign since 1876 .
although the new president won the electoral votes , he lost the popular vote by over 300,000 .
the election this year was held at a time when the us economy is prospering for the ninth successive year , the social environment is relatively stable , and the united states has maintained its strong international status .
apart from that , in respect of political experience and qualifications , there are obvious disparities between bush , who has only been a state governor for six years , and gore , who has been a congressman for more than 10 years and vice president for eight .
throughout the entire election campaign , however , bush locked gore into inextricable struggle , and he finally triumphed by the narrowest of margins .
why was this so ? first of all , this was the result caused by two different lines in the election .
apart from that , bush adopted more inclusive social policies to actively win the votes of afro - americans , hispanics , asians , women , and the elderly .
second , bush 's campaign strategy was slightly more astute than gore 's .

beijing , 14 dec ( xinhua ) - - the " regulations on management of the labor market " were recently promulgated for implementation .
these are china 's first department - specific regulations standardizing management of the labor market in an all - around manner , and they will have a positive significance in advancing the healthy development of the labor market .
at present , the task of re - employing laid - off workers and unemployed personnel from state - owned enterprises is extremely arduous ; services for managing the labor market have not adapted to the requirements of the new situation and the new tasks very well .
the regulations deal with job hunting and employment of workers , hiring by employers , and management of various job placement activities by job introduction organizations .
employers may make use of job introduction organizations , job fairs , job advertisements , and every other legal means of recruiting workers .
the regulations prohibit employers from providing false employment information , collecting hiring fees from job seekers , collecting a deposit or withholding documents , or any other activity that infringes on the rights and interests of the job seeker .
those unemployed persons who have a registration certificate can enjoy public employment services , employment support policies , or , in accordance with the regulations , can apply for unemployment insurance .
the system of hiring records and employment registration means that , upon hiring employees , employers should go to a labor and social security department to complete paperwork for the hiring records and should register the employees as employed .
how are they defined ? [ wang ] the regulations divide job introduction organizations into the two categories of non - profit job introduction organizations and for - profit job introduction organizations .
to qualify as a non - profit organization , any income received legitimately in the course of carrying out the activities stipulated in the organization 's articles of incorporation must be used in full for the business activities stipulated in the articles of incorporation and shall not be distributed to members .
currently public job introduction organizations must provide free services to laid - off workers who turn to re - employment centers for help , unemployed persons who are receiving unemployment insurance , and unemployed persons who are receiving local subsistence pay .
all localities should actively lay the groundwork for gradually expanding the scope of its free services to include all other unemployed persons in cities and towns who register themselves as unemployed .

the middle east situation has always been complicated and unsettled , but these recent large - scale clashes which resulted in more than 300 people killed and over 10,000 people injured have no doubt dealt a mortal blow to the middle east peace process .
syrian - israeli peace talks resumed in washington at the end of last year after being suspended for nearly four years , with israeli prime minister ehud barak openly talking about a complete withdrawal from the golan heights for the first time .
the two countries have reached an understanding on many issues after frequent contacts and intense talks .
due to differences on conditions for the return of the golan heights , however , the syrian - israeli peace talks broke up in mid - january .
in order to break the deadlock , former syrian president hafez al - assad went to meet us president clinton in geneva in march this year in spite of his illness in an attempt to persuade the americans to exert pressure on israel .
unfortunately , assad died of a heart attack in june .
after assuming office , the new president bashar al - assad badly needed to consolidate his power base and had to assign first priority to political and economic problems at home . he does not have any more energy to spare for peace talks with israel .
the contradictions between lebanon and israel were basically resolved , but the hostility between the two sides has not been removed and military conflicts still occur from time to time .
through the direct mediation of us president clinton , israeli prime minister ehud barak and palestinian national authority chairman yasser arafat met in camp david in mid - july for direct talks on the ultimate status of palestine .
during the 15 - day marathon talks , the two leaders explored major issues never discussed before , such as the return of occupied territory , the delineation of borders , jewish settlements and jerusalem sovereignty , but the talks ended without accomplishing anything because of the failure to cross the " red line " regarding jerusalem .
the palestinians and israelis reacted differently to the camp david peace talks .
yasser arafat received a warm welcome because of his uncompromising stand on questions like jerusalem sovereignty .
for more than two months , israel bombarded important palestinian targets with heavy weapons , including tanks , armored vehicles , canons and helicopter gunships , and imposed military and economic blockade against palestinian autonomous areas .
beset with difficulties both at home and abroad , israeli prime minister ehud barak suddenly announced his resignation on december 9 after agreeing to dissolve parliament and call for an early election at the end of november .
under israeli law , a new prime minister must be elected before a lapse of 60 days after the resignation took effect .
changes in israel 's political situation have cast new shadows over the complicated and confusing middle east peace process , but the general situation in the middle east will not get out of control because of this .
it is hoped that politicians in the middle east would resolve their historic disputes as quickly as possible with extraordinary wisdom and courage and bring the region into a new era of prosperity without the smoke of gunpowder .

thus , for the international community and especially the asia - pacific region , unification is better than no unification between the taiwan strait .

this year 's general election in the united states has a distinguishing feature that attracts people 's attention ; namely , in the whole country , the strength of the democratic party and that of the republican party are equal in match and extremely close .
in the presidential election , bush is only one vote more than the half needed in winning the presidency in the electoral college , while al gore has been the winner of the popular vote .
in the congressional election , the result of the election left the senate in a 50 - 50 tie and republicans only got five more in the house of representatives .
an article carried by the " washington post " pointed out : through the balance of power between the two parties , the us constituency " delivered a strong signal , " asking the new president to " administer the country with a middle - of - the - road stand . "
an important reason for bush 's winning the election is that he has put forward a centrist line that takes consideration of the market and the government , efficiency and fairness , and the rich and the poor .
however , quite a few republicans still hope to return to the traditional conservatism of the reagan period ; while trade unions , environmental protection and human rights organizations within the democratic party are quite active in recent years , opposing free trade and intensifying their liberal stand on many social issues .
the radicals within the two parties will pose a strong challenge and threat to bush 's centrist line .
in this year 's election , bush and gore waged " court battles " and " verbal wars " on the decisive votes in florida for as long as 36 days .
although withdrawing from competition , gore still expressed " strong disagreement " with the decision of the us supreme court . due to the unfinished vote count in florida , many democrats have doubts on the legitimacy of bush 's winning the presidency .
after bush 's being elected president , some non - government organizations may conduct new investigations on vote - count disputes and some people may even continue to resort to litigation .
the current general election has also shown rifts between different economic strata and different nationalities , especially the contradictions between the broad masses of black americans in the lower social stratum and the republican party that traditionally represents the interests of the rich white people .
according to statistics , bush only received one - tenth of black votes in the whole country , receiving the lowest number of black votes since 1984 .
in taxes state , bush only received 5 percent of black votes . in florida , the number of black votes increased by 50 percent as compared with the election in 1996 and bush only won 7 percent of black votes .
most of those counties with vote discrepancies in florida are homes of black voters , and so the republican party did its best to prevent recount by people . this has aroused great indignation among black voters in florida and other places .
at a time when bush has become the new master of the white house , the us economy has seen a red light after many years of sustained prosperity .
since the election date of 7 november until today , the nasdaq index has fallen by 17 percent and dow index has also fallen to a great extent .
the retail consumption index , sales of automobiles and factory orders are all falling .
according to the forecast by a concerned authoritative organization , us economic growth in the next year may be lower than 3 percent .
some economists are convinced that signs of us economic recession have already appeared .
economic decline will also force the bush administration to slow down the pace of reform of social welfare policy and will be strongly objected to by those with middle and lower income .
therefore , cooperation with the democratic party to prevent economic recession has been included in the most urgent daily agenda of the bush administration .
in foreign affairs , the new administration also faces a series of tough subjects .
in middle east , us mediation has run up against a stone wall . a large - scale bloody conflict broke out between the palestinians and israelis . how to continue efforts to promote the cause of peace in the middle east will be a difficult task for the bush administration .
in handling relations with russia , china , japan and the european union , whether the bush administration can follow the consensus of the two parties and maintain continuity in policies will be related to strategic balance and stability among major powers .
if the new administration acts arbitrarily in disregard of opposition by the international community , it will certainly endanger peace in the world and will also bring serious harm to the own interest of the united states .

today , at the horgos frontier defense company , the tv picture of the troops on patrol can be transmitted over the network to the company , regiment , military region , or even headquarters at any time . the boundless frontier is quietly ushering in information modernization .
there have been many dreamlike changes over the past century .
at the beginning of the 20 th century , information from the western frontier defense area was passed to beijing by a pony express approach from station to station .
before the red frontier gate , long vehicles waiting to pass through form a long line , while platoon leader zhang fuqiu leads the soldiers in driving off a goat that is next to the border .
the frontier hinterland that is thousands of kilometers away is now within arm 's reach .
the electronic map in the company control center displays the correct coordinates for the patrol squad at all times .
you can see at a glance whether or not it has " reached a certain point or place . "
in the past , when one ascended a mountain on patrol to survey the territory , the observation was done using the naked eye or a telescope .
today , the soldiers can monitor every move along the boundary lines over the network .
sitting in front of a computer , you can see everything for three kilometers around perfectly clearly , even tiny sparrows .
the wire entanglements are also " smart , " with " electronic induction cables " suspended from them , so as soon as something unusual happens , an alarm is immediately sounded .
since 1996 , china has launched the most massive land frontier defense infrastructure development project since the founding of the country .
as of this year , a total of more than 6000 miles of patrol roads have been built , more than 2000 kilometers of border wire entanglements have been erected , and more than 400 border control assistance markers have been set up .
relying on such infrastructure developments , the various units have accelerated their " digitization " process , and there has been a marked increase in the degree of computerization of border duty controls .
this year , the border defense company stationed in the karakorum - shan mountains has already launched a " networking project , " and satellite telephones have now been installed in the plateau frontier sentry posts .
in the motherland 's xisha [ islands ] , the troops guarding the island can read today 's " jiefangjun bao " over the network , and the naval staff officers can also communicate with the troops through the network .
there are those who envision that , in the next century , we will see " unmanned " " outpost sentry duty " in one place after another along the borders which are very inhospitable to mankind .
the " digital revolution " brings happiness , but even more , it poses challenges .
in the late 1980 s , the companies put in some " machines " and trained a few " young hotshots " to deal with them .
however , to run the " digitized " facilities that are high - tech affairs , the " tricks " of the " young hotshots " in the companies are far from sufficient .
as china prospers and gets stronger , " digitized frontier defense " may become the motherland 's new " impregnable wall " at an early date .

the united states ' electoral system is an important part of the united states ' political system .
for a long period of time , the united states has always hailed its electoral system as the most perfect and democratic in the world ; it has always considered itself the teacher and has been going around giving other countries " lectures on democracy " and asking other countries to follow its example .
it is undeniable that the us electoral system has its desirable side , but it would be a gross mistake to say such an electoral system is the best in the world .
first , the us electoral system is built upon money .
the law stipulates that any citizen who was born in the united states , has lived there for 14 years or more , and is more than 35 years old is eligible for the presidency .
the media reported that the total amount of money spent in the election campaign this year amounted to $ 3 billion !
it is no wonder that americans themselves said : " money is mother 's milk in politics " ; the road to the white house is " paved with money . "
where do such huge sums of money come from ?
besides the fixed amount of campaign funds given to each candidate by the federal government , most of the money comes from donations by large corporations , big companies , and all sorts of interest groups .
second , looking at the election methods , it is also hard to say that the system is a democratic one . in every election year , various candidates and their backstage bosses and followers go out in full force .
americans give emphasis to acting like a gentleman , but in elections they throw any and all good manners aside .
for the sake of attacking other people , they often use unscrupulous approaches - - exposing blemishes , digging out shameful secrets , mudslinging , using foul language , and employing every means to the extreme .
incidents of presidential candidates being assassinated during election years are not rare in the history of the united states .
even more common are creating obstacles to deter opponents ' voters or even threatening them on voting day , and fraud in vote counting .
many black voters encountered such unfair treatment in this year 's election . in response to that , the national association for the advancement of colored people , the biggest ethnic minority organization in the united states , has already filed a lawsuit in court .
that aside , what is worse is that they often use sweet words and honeyed phrases to cater to different needs of voters from different social classes . they would say whatever appeals to the voters and make many empty promises .
they even create an impression of being " close to the people , " visiting people at their homes and showing concern to the poor and deprived .
their sole aim is : get the vote in your pocket .
the united states uses an " electoral college system " in its presidential elections , whereby a candidate wins all electoral votes of a state even if he only receives one popular vote more than his opponent does in that state .
it therefore happens very often that a candidate who wins most popular votes in the entire country actually does not become the president and the one receiving fewer votes actually wins the election .
can such a president be said to win the mandate of the majority of americans ?
now , people are focusing their attention on the question as whether bush 's economic measures , which he proposed during the election days , can really solve the problems that are currently facing the us economy and thus add a new chapter to the sustained economic boom of the united states .
bush becomes the new host of the white house at a time when the united states has repeatedly hit new records in maintaining a sustained economic boom but is also faced with the danger of a drastic economic slowdown .
various latest economic statistics are also suggesting a continued slowdown in the growth of the us economy .
the core of bush 's economic policy is big tax cuts .
this will prove the biggest ever tax relief scheme since the reagan administration in the early 1980 s .
bush 's economic advisors believe that the tax cuts can encourage savings and investments , which will subsequently boost the country 's economic growth and create more jobs .
he pledged that he would make no compromise when pushing ahead with this scheme .
however , many analysts have doubts about bush 's economic scheme .
first of all , distant water cannot quench present thirst .
since bush 's tax relief scheme cannot be materialized until fiscal year 2002 which starts on 1 october next year , this scheme can hardly produce any effect on the us economy next year .
denny hastert , speaker of the us house of representatives , has also indicated recently that bush should put off his schedule of submitting an all - round tax relief scheme to the congress , but try to deal with the situation by solving problems one by one .
third , from a medium - and a long - term point of view , bush 's economic scheme is not necessarily favorable to the us economy .
in the 1980 s , the reagan administration introduced a scheme of huge tax cuts , in the hope that the tax reductions could stimulate the country 's economic growth , bring about an increase to its tax revenue , and gradually reduce its budgetary deficits .
however , reality did not accord with hopes . the country 's financial deficits kept rising ; and by the final year of the tenure of bush sr. ( the fiscal year of 1992 ) who succeeded reagan as us president , the country 's financial deficit reached a historical high of $ 290 billion .
as far as the chinese are concerned , following bush 's hard - won victory , a primary issue is naturally what impact the election of a new president will have on the us china policy .
to show some differences from the wording of the administration of the democratic party on " building a strategic partnership " between china and the united states , bush must , in words and expressions at least , build up his own policy hallmark .
if one should base oneself on this to judge the essence of his policy , it would be misleading .
american sinologists and campaign experts have also analyzed this , saying that what george w. bush has said about his policy toward china are just " empty talk " during the general election and that he has said this in only one of his speeches .
furthermore , there is bound to be competition even among strategic partners , and a competitor does not necessarily mean an enemy . there are no substantive differences between this wording and the actual present us policy toward china .
according to his explanations , there will not be fundamental changes in the us policy toward china under the new administration because the united states does not have other options .
however , both the american and the chinese experts are worried that if the bush administration persists in doing so , it will considerably weaken china 's nuclear deterrent capability , increase china 's sense of insecurity , and force china to make a corresponding response .
this is likely to lead to tensions between china and the united states .
as for the other two aspects on which there has often been a dispute between china and the united states , namely , the issue of human rights and the issue of economy and trade , it is reckoned that there will be no major changes in the us policies .

as everyone knows , the rapid development of the internet has injected a powerful new force into economic development and social progress the world over , but objectively it has also had certain negative effects on national security and social life and set new problems in social management .
it is precisely for this reason that countries throughout the world are actively looking into effective ways of managing the internet .
back in 1996 the united states and canada drew up laws to regulate and restrict the transmission of harmful information on the internet .
the european union has also formulated laws to protect juveniles from being harmed by illegal information on the internet .
it is obviously unfair and totally unreasonable for human rights watch to use this as a pretext to attack china 's internet controls as " infringing on human rights . "
the " report " also accuses china of " not permitting human rights bodies to openly engage in activities on the mainland and tibet . "
the chinese people have the final say on the state of human rights in the country .
at present china 's economy is recording sustained , rapid , and healthy development , people 's living standards are generally at a comfortably well - off level , and the state of human rights is the best in china 's history .
according to statistics , in the first half of 2000 , average disposable income of urban residents was 3,208 yuan , 8.7 percent up of the corresponding period of 1999 ; and average peasant income was 1,013 yuan , up by 1.5 percent .
basic freedoms such as freedom of the press and publication granted to citizens under the chinese constitution have been protected .
china now has over 5,000 domestic news media , and 550,000 people are engaged in journalism .
china joined up to the internet in 1994 , and there were only 10,000 users at the end of that year ; by now there are over 17 million users and 27,300 domestic websites .
as the nihon keizai shimbun reported on 31 july , " the internet in china has entered the era of a hundred flowers blooming . "
china has strengthened human rights guarantees in human rights legislation and adjudication .
courts in china have strengthened the protection of citizens ' legitimate rights by comprehensively implementing the system of open trials , strictly practicing the withdrawal system , establishing and perfecting the jury system , and instituting the judicial aid system .
china now has 110,000 lawyers and more than 9,300 law offices , and the role of lawyers in criminal procedure is becoming more and more prominent .
no country in the world can say now that it has a perfect human rights record that leaves nothing to be desired .
due to limitations of natural conditions , history , and level of development , there are also many problems awaiting solution in the state of human rights in china .
these problems , however , must in the final analysis be resolved through continual reform and development under the prerequisite of stability .
