the summit meeting is an important milestone in the inter - korean relations and represents a new beginning for the two koreas to seek reconciliation , peace , and dialogue .
following that , to implement the " north - south joint declaration , " the two koreas jointly took such concrete actions as holding red - cross meeting , ministerial - level talks , defense minister talks , and other relevant working - level talks .
both sides reached a number of consensus and agreements on reconciliation and cooperation .
the situational change on the korean peninsula is closely related to the two koreas ' adjustment in their diplomatic polices ; this helps generating an interactive role .
since the beginning of this year , the two koreas have markedly enhanced exchanged visits and consultations with relevant countries .

russian president putin 's first visit to the dprk has restored the two countries ' good - neighborly relations .
the dprk carries out comprehensive diplomatic activities and opens up the door of improving relations with western countries . australia , italy , britain , and other western countries have established or restored diplomatic relations with the dprk . germany , france , and other countries will also establish relations with the dprk .
talks on normalization of relations between the dprk and japan , after an interruption of eight years , has resumed .
relations between the dprk and the united states have achieved a breakthrough . the meeting between jo myong rok , first vice chairman of the dprk 's national defense commission , and the us secretary of state madeleine albright represented the highest level of exchanged visits between the two countries .
both the dprk and the united states stated that they want to build " a new relationship free from past enmity ; a trend toward seeking improvement of relations has taken shape .

a few days ago , george w. bush appointed colin powell and condoleezza rice secretary of state and national security adviser to the president , respectively . this has made eu countries more concerned about the direction of the new bush administration 's diplomatic and security policies .
clear inclinations the eu has seemingly followed the present us presidential election more closely that it did before . although many of the countries did not express it publicly , their inclinations were pretty clear . they all hoped that the democratic party 's candidate , al gore , would win .
of course , what they are most worried about is the diplomatic and security policy stand bush took during the election campaign , especially the three major issues involving eu - us relations .
first , bush calls for a reduction in us military involvements that are not vital to us interests .
if the us troops are withdrawn , the eu will not be in a position to fill the vacuum . second , bush is firmly opposed to the establishment of a apid reaction force by the eu , holding that the establishment of such a apid reaction force will directly threaten nato 's survival .
the eu is worried that contradiction on this issue between us - led nato and the eu will become even more acute .
national interests third , bush 's position on implementing the national missile defense system (nmd) , which has been shelved by the clinton administration , has made eu countries even more restless .
however , there is no need to be excessively serious about a politician 's statements during an election campaign .
lots of restrictions it is generally held that the bush administration will be a weak one .
the first is that the difficulty to produce a new president , as well as the litigation battle , which has gone on for more than a month , has turned both parties into losers .

on 16 december , us president - elect bush nominated colin powell as secretary of state .
powell , 63 , was born in new york on 5 april 1937 .
his parents were immigrants from jamaica . they came to the united states to earn a living in 1920 .
powell was graduated from george washington university in 1971 and gained a master 's degree in industrial and commercial management .
as a member of the special military adviser group for president kennedy , he went to the vietnam battlefield .
in 1989 , the senior bush promoted powell , who already had gained the military title of general , to the post of chairman of the us joint chiefs of staff .
in 1991 , the us dispatched sea , air and ground forces to kuwait to trigger the gulf war called " desert storm . "
he also said that he will hold talks with other countries on the plan to develop a missile defense system .
the dust finally settled when george walker bush emerged a winner after a gruel presidential campaign that lasted some 40 days to become the new president of the united states .
in his election platform , bush said that he would dedicate to building an army with better equipment and with enhanced combat strength that is oriented toward the 21 st century .
here , we would like to take a look at the content of bush 's " military plan " gathered from his speeches and from the remarks made by his aides to reporters .
at present , the united states tops the world in both the number and scale of its nuclear potential and it boosts 7,000 nuclear warheads in its arsenal alone .
delivery vehicles for land - based strategic nuclear weapons ( simultaneous launching of 500 intercontinental ballistic missiles from the silos could trigger detonation of 1,350 warheads ) account for 19 percent of the offensive strategic nuclear potential .
the remaining 16 percent are concentrated on the us air force air combat command ( six air wings , 200 bombers , a combat sortie may carry 1,500 aviation bombs and cruise missiles ) .
moscow 's experts optimistically predicted that the delivery systems of russia 's " nuclear trinity " ( referring to nuclear missiles , strategic nuclear bombers , and nuclear submarines ) are expected to reduce to 2,000 warheads before 2005 .
if the reduction is made , the number of the us strategic forces ' delivery systems will still exceed the combined total of russia and other " nuclear club " members .
us experts hold that bush 's proposed reduction of the nuclear potential is totally realistic since the implementation of this plan will not only not threaten the us national security but will also substantially reduce strategic nuclear forces ' military spending .
improve the " national missile defense " plan bush 's second military plan is to continue implementing the " national missile defense " plan [ nmd ] .
in september 1996 , congress approved the c-1-prim plan . the system is used to intercept the so - called non - strategic weapon delivery systems .
this means that an anti - missile can only intercept one warhead of the enemy . add to the problem of the need to differentiate dummy targets , the interception task is made further complicated .
the current national security concept was put forward by clinton in 1993 . clinton held that as the united states holds obvious military strength and military technology superiority over any other potential rivals , it is completely possible to effectively respond to certain crises and to deal with uncertain factors anytime in the future .
adopt active measures to ensure the us troops ' absolute superiority in speedily carrying out combat actions in various war theaters . 2 . advance troop deployment .
to achieve that objective , it is necessary to effectively make use of the air force transport units and landing forces to carry out reasonably risky actions .
most americans approve of such views and hold that it is completely workable .

the policy of " one country , two systems " has entered a new period in which it is being implemented comprehensively in hong kong and macao .
we have achieved gratifying results in and gained valuable experiences from implementing this policy in hong kong over the past three years and in macao over the past year .
the principle of " one country , two systems " is an integral concept . in handling hong kong affairs , people should not view hong kong in such a one - sided way , namely , as an entity separate from its parent , the motherland .
only by properly handling relations between overall interests and local interests is it possible to bring into play unity of these two types of interests . backed by a strong and prosperous motherland , hong kong 's economy is bound to thrive by leaps and bounds .
as hong kong 's fate is linked with that of the motherland , the motherland will certainly show concern for or offer support to hong kong and thus hong kong should safeguard the motherland interests and offer support to four modernizations .

thus peaceful coexistence is bound to benefit the two sides whereas confrontation is bound to harm the two sides .
safeguarding authority of the chief executive is a key content of implementing " one country , two systems " and a prerequisite for social stability as well .
only by maintaining social stability will we be able to attract investment and secure economic prosperity .
the residents ought to display their democratic quality in : once a decision is made through an election , all the residents will support it and work together with unified will to do things well instead of engaging in an endless dispute .
once a chief executive is elected , all the residents should support him by allowing him to perform his duties and implement the government principles in his capacity as the leader and in accordance with the law so as to ensure efficient operation of the hong kong society and press ahead with robust economic growth .
freedom of the press and safeguarding prosperity and stability are related with each other and supplement or complement each other as well . freedom of the press ought to be exercised for the sake of safeguarding overall interests of the members of a society and this should be news workers ' social responsibility .
thus we should not set freedom of the press against the sar 's prosperity and stability or the state interests . news workers ought to lay stress on personal integrity and a sense of social responsibility , for only by so doing is it possible to give fuller scope to freedom of the press .
should news workers fail to lay stress on personal integrity or view social responsibility as nothing that matters or should the media indiscriminately fabricate stories ; please the public with claptrap ; engage in distortion or exaggeration ; or spread rumors , freedom of the press would be sullied .
if they respect themselves , the media are bound to win trust or respect from the residents .

in the motion submitted for deliberation , premier zhu rongji said : since its implementation , the copyright law has played a positive role in protecting the legitimate rights and interests of copyright holders , arouse their creative initiative , and promote the development of economy and science and technology and the prosperity of culture and art .

in november 1998 , the state council submitted a motion to the npc standing committee for the deliberation of a draft amendment to the copyright law .

beijing , 22 dec ( xinhua ) - - on the afternoon of 22 december , two new high - altitude and high - speed fighters touched down safely at a certain airfield in south china after completing their training .
the air force has scored good records in flight safety this year despite having carried out many major military activities and military exercises and performed heavy , difficult , and arduous training tasks .
the 10,000 - flight hour rate refers to the ratio of the number of serious accidents in 10,000 flight hours , which is adopted by various countries ' air forces in the world as a major guideline of the level of flight safety .
according to an air force relevant department , at present the air force has 19 air divisions and flight schools that have ensured flight safety for over five years . six nine air regiments have ensured flight safety for over 10 years running .

24 december ( zhongguo tongxun she of hong kong ) - - china 's " proposal " on the 10 th five - year plan points out that while concentrating on developing the national economy , it is necessary to vigorously carry out national defense construction .
at the same time , establish a defense science - technology and industry system of a new type ; develop high - and new - technology armaments ; and work hard to raise the level of modernization .
after 20 years of hard work , outstanding achievements have been made in defense modernization construction .
jiang zemin watched the " century review of troops " held in north china in october of this year . the troop review fully demonstrated the achievements of china 's defense modernization construction , arousing worldwide attention .
china 's defense modernization effort started with moves to downsize the military significantly in an effort to have a streamlined military .
in 1986 , based on a judgment that because of the relaxation in international relations , no world war would break out in the next 20 - 30 years , china resolutely declared that it would unilaterally cut its military by 1 million personnel .
at the same time , china has used the funds resulting from military cuts for developing new armaments , thereby achieving tremendous results in the modernization of the military 's armaments .
the army has now achieved regularization and serialization of its general - purpose armaments and improved its capabilities for fire suppression , ground assaults , battlefield mobility , battlefield intelligence and reconnaissance , operational command , and protection , thereby meeting requirements for multi - branch joint operations .
the second artillery ( the missile strategic force ) now has short - range , medium - range , long - range , and continental missile systems as well as capabilities for rapid responses and mobile operations .
the chinese military is moving from having semi - mechanized and mechanized armaments to achieving automation and informationization , in an effort to ensure the fulfillment of the sacred mission given by the country to the military .
according to china 's nation defense white paper , china 's national defense policy puts special emphasis on following a military strategic policy of active defense .
such defense represents the unity of peace - time efforts to prevent wars and to be ready to win a self - defense war as well as the unity of war - time moves to carry out strategic defense and operational offensives .
the chinese military proceeds on the basis of its existing armaments in an effort to be prepared for defense operations under modern technological conditions , especially high - tech conditions .
china 's defense modernization construction is entirely for the purpose of carrying out self - defense .
china works hard to prevent and suppress wars and to use peaceful means for resolving international disputes and problems left by history .
china 's possession of a few nuclear weapons , the national defense white paper pointed out , is entirely based on the need of self - defense .
china has committed itself to the principles of no first use of nuclear weapons and no use or threat of nuclear weapons against non - nuclear weapon states .
china will not take part in an arms race or deploy nuclear weapons abroad .
china maintains a streamlined and effective nuclear counterattack force in order to deter any possible nuclear attack from any other country , and any such attack will lead to china 's nuclear counterattack carried out in retaliation .
the fact is that china 's national defense policy is based on " active defense , " which is mainly aimed at defending territorial integrity and national unity , and that china will not proactively attack any other country .
in terms of defense expenditures , china 's military construction has been very moderate .
premier zhu rongji said in explaining the national defense construction policy for the 10 th five - year plan period that strong national defense was a fundamental guarantee for national security and modernization construction .
as the national economy develops , it is very necessary to vigorously proceed with national defense construction , in an effort to enhance the national defense capability and to improve the capability for defense operations under modern technological conditions , especially high - tech conditions .

wang shucheng said that over the past 50 years , serious and extremely mammoth floods have taken place one after another along the valleys of chang jiang , huang he , huai he , hai he , liao he , songhua jiang , and zhu jiang .
when dwelling on the tasks facing flood prevention and drought control , wang shucheng emphasized that rapid economic development has set increasingly high demands on flood prevention and water resources protection .
if we do not consider flood diversion methods , the dykes of major rivers can only resist the floods occuring once in 20 years , and small and medium - sized rivers can only resist minor floods and will be in flood when medium floods occur .
however , one fourth of large and medium - sized reservoirs and two fifths of small reservoirs are dangerous .
along with the development of the economy and the increase of population , river courses have been seriously occupied , and lakes have been seriously enclosed for cultivation .
because rainfall is not evenly distributed in china in terms of time and area , water shortages have been getting more and more conspicuous .
therefore , the present task on flood prevention and drought control is very arduous .
wang shucheng added that to resolve china 's flood problem , attention should be paid to the non - facilities measures while strengthening the building of water conservancy facilities .
construction projects should not be conducted in the areas threatened by floods , particularly the areas liable to mountain torrents , landslides , and mud - rock flows .
flood prevention and drought control headquarters at all levels should further strengthen self - construction .
with regard to this problem , wang shucheng said that the key to resolving the water shortage lies in water conservation . at the same time , unified management of water resources should be strengthened .
unified planning and management should be conducted for the upper , middle , and lower reaches of rivers , for urban and rural areas , for surface and underground water , for volume and quality of water , and for development and protection of water resources .
by regulating water prices , we should encourage water conservation and optimize the distribution of water resources .

graduated from beijing university in the 1960 s . studied military strategy and international strategic issues for a long time . editor of such works as " concise military strategy " and " deng xiaoping 's thoughts on strategy . "
peace will enable both to benefit and win unlike the historical emergence of a new power which would have a relationship of competition with the existing powers , the emergency of china and the revitalization of the chinese nation will not necessarily pose challenges to the existing international structure and the legitimate interests of countries .
as different from some historical big powers which achieved development through military conquests and the plundering of external resources , china has been achieving its development and growth through internal development based on self - accumulation .
china 's development interest is compatible with the international interest structure , and there is no mutual rejection in this regard .
meanwhile , the united states have a lot of funds as well as advanced science , technology , and management experience , which will provide the external conditions for china 's progress in achieving modernization .
even when china is developed and powerful in the future , china 's military capability will always be defensive in nature and be limited to satisfying the minimum security requirement of being able to defend the country 's sovereignty , territorial integrity , and legitimate interests .
the nature of chinese society , china 's highest national interest , and china 's peace - first cultural tradition in relation to strategy and national character will not permit china to pursue external military expansion and hegemonism .
china - u.s. relations can only move forward , and cannot move backward , even less toward confrontation .
this is an important principle which must be followed in the development of china - u.s. relations and international relations in general .
first , discard the erroneous cold war thinking .
fully understand the growing mutual dependence in the interests of countries and the integral character of multinational security in the era of globalization ; it is necessary not to engage in any cold war after the cold war period , thus ignoring fundamental national interests .
security is relative , not absolute .
fourth , discard the error of political short - sightedness .
as a new century is coming , the most sensitive and core issue remains the question of taiwan .
in the early 1970 s , the united states wisely opened the door of china - u.s. relations in order to change its passive posture in the world strategic situation , severing " diplomatic relations " with taiwan , " abrogating treaties , " and withdrawing its forces from taiwan .
the united states has indicated that it will adhere to the " one china " principle , will not support the idea of " two chinas " or " one china , one taiwan , " will not support taiwan independence , and will not support taiwan 's joining international organizations which only sovereign states may join .
the bell announcing the arrival of the new century is beginning to toll faintly , and the 20 th century is about to pass .
from the perspective of warfare , what insights and things to think about has the 20 th century left us ?
what should we do to contain warfare or prevail in war ?
a few days ago , we invited experts on international issues from the national defense university to a round - table discussion , and here we will summarize some of the major points they made .
- - the editors taking issue of nationalism very seriously in new century ma jun ( professor , strategy teaching and research office , national defense university ) : today i would like to talk a bit about understanding the causes that led to two world wars from the perspective of nationalism .
pan - germanism , pan - slavism , pan - turkism , and great - russianism , etc. , were all extremely clear reflections of the historical phenomena of the great flood of nationalism during the imperialist period .
all these formed the major sources of international conflicts and turmoil .
after the end of wwi , the world structure arranged by the victors in keeping with the logic of " the winners become kings while the losers become bandits " was an international system based on national inequality , which destined the international system to be a skyscraper built on top of a volcano .
therefore , after less than 20 years , a new round of fighting on an even greater scale broke out - - world war ii .
from this we can see that conflicts resulting from the inability to realize the demands of nationalism meant that the problems in the relationships among the various capitalist nations could only be resolved through war .
to see that this happy hope can be realized , we should take the issue of nationalism very seriously .
today , after end of cold war , many things from cold war continuing in undisguised manner jin yinan ( assistant professor , international relations teaching and research office , national defense university ) : from the perspective of the 20 th century , the first half was hot wars and the second half was the cold war .
although the cold war is now over , it still has a rather significant impact on the current international situation .
the forward command estimated that there would be 5000 casualties , while the person who estimated the fewest number of casualties was jcs ( joint chiefs of staff ) chairman powell , who felt that they could be effectively controlled at around 3000 .
the us had not imagined it would be able to achieve such an " unprecedented victory . "
some americans say that the united states now has the ability militarily to inflict massive damage on an opponent while not losing a single us soldier .
we note that , during the clinton administration , according to statistics from the usaf air combat command , the use of the air force has increased 400% over the cold war era , with wide use of the air force in air strikes against iraq , in bosnia - herzegovina , and including massive bombing of kosovo .
because of this , what we have noted even more is the further development of military power .
the conclusion of the cold war was by no means like a so - called " win - win " or " lose - lose " situation that we like to talk about so much .
the conclusion of the cold war was a sudden and massive decline on one side , while the other side suddenly achieved a position of unprecedented strength , and the powerful side cannot help but want to take full advantage of its own unipolar world .
military alliances are still continuing to get stronger , with the eastern expansion of nato ( north atlantic treaty organization ) being a typical example .
this form of military alliance is essentially a freak of the cold war - - what we term a cold war dinosaur - - but when the cold war disappeared , it did not at all become the dinosaur that we had imagined and become extinct as a result of changing conditions .
we note that its continuing worldwide expansion is just beginning to unfold , with no sign of letting up .
the eastward expansion of nato and the issue of the southward trend of the japan - us security treaty will have no small impact in the future .
what we note is that , in the aftermath of the cold war , there are many things from the cold war that have taken different forms , or in some cases still continuing undisguised without changing their outward appearances .
shape of war will become more non - nuclear , high - tech jiang lingfei ( deputy director , international relations teaching and research office , national defense university ) : to study the insights from warfare in the 20 th century , we must also pay attention to study of war in the 1990 s .
because the final decade of the 20 th century was a period of peace and development , although power politics and hegemonism were still present .
in studying war over the final decade , the first questions to be answered are : can there still be war in an age of peace and development , and if so , what kind of war is it ?
what is the position and role of war under the conditions of this age with regard to overall social development and national and international security ?
counting all the local wars and conflicts of various sizes from the cold war period to the late 80 s , statistically speaking there were 280 of these , or an average of 6.2 per year .
at the present , there are quite a few developing countries which are just entering the industrialization stage .
whether we can make that statement or not , the history of the 20 th century still corroborated the rule that war is a continuation of politics , and the history of war in the 20 th century was actually the entire course of international relations in the 20 th century in microcosm .
war is still the final means of resolving international disputes ; at the same time , with regard to every country , military means still represent a final assurance safeguarding national interests and national sovereignty .
under certain conditions , this viewpoint may be correct , but if you turn it into a general rule in the abstract , it is one - sided .
for example : with the multipolar trend in the world and the advance of economic integration , the trend of unequal political and economic development in various countries may become even more obvious .
while the interests of the developing countries and those of the developed countries will converge , at the same time the situation in which they [ the developing countries ] are constrained by the developed countries will become more pronounced .
from that perspective , future international relations will still find themselves in an extremely complex situation that is fraught with contradictions and struggles , and this itself provides the soil for conflict .
- - for a fairly long time during the start of the new century , the developed countries will rely on their powerful political , economic , and advanced - technology advantages to strive to expand and consolidate their dominance of international affairs , remaking the rules of the game for international behavior .
in international relations in the future , the struggles will be extremely intense over control and counter - control , interfering in the internal affairs of other countries and safeguarding national sovereignty .
the tendencies of the major powers to cooperate with each other while guarding against each other - - of mutual reliance and mutual mistrust - - will exist side by side for a long time .
- - rapid advances in weapons technology may trigger a new round of the arms race among the major powers , promoting the further proliferation of weapons of mass destruction among the developing countries and becoming a new destabilizing factor affecting the global strategic balance and setting off regional turmoil .
the military interventionism and adventurism of the united states will grow and become more prominent .
there will also be numerous uncertain factors in the asia - pacific region . in particular , intervention in the taiwan problem represents a serious challenge and threat to the development of our country .
it must be noted that china 's national security situation at the crossroads of the centuries is intricate and complex , with numerous uncertain and unknown factors .
among these , there are five factors which should attract our serious attention .
as far as we are concerned , this issue will be of particular importance in the next century .
we are now actually standing on the threshold of possible breakthrough developments in weapons technology , and in particular the development of information technology is now changing the look of war .
our military forces must carry out reforms , otherwise we will be unable to keep up with the developing situation of warfare .
in the process of establishing a national defense force , we must stick to the policy of promoting coordinated development in an overall manner .
the first thing is to increase our investment in national defense , striving to raise the level of modernization of the armed forces .
two is to develop national defense science and technology vigorously , laying a solid foundation for the national defense industry .
in the new century , china 's national security interests will be reflected in a concentrated fashion in whether or not we are able to achieve the " three big tasks . "
accordingly , the objective of our national security strategy in the new century should be to strive to create the three basic conditions of sustained economic development , national security unity , and an excellent external existence environment , ensuring the realization of the strategic goals of the " three big tasks . "
background material : mankind underwent wars of unprecedented disaster in the 20 th century - - xu yan - - professor , strategy teaching and research office , national defense university the 20 th century was the most dazzling century - - as well as the century with the most violent turmoil - - in human history .
in this century , in addition to a high degree of accumulation of scientific knowledge , the rapid development of the productive forces , an enormous increase in social wealth , and miraculous changes in the way the world looks , we also entered a stage of unprecedented contradictions , conflicts , and change .
there were 61 combatant countries in world war ii . 110 million troops were mobilized , there were 70 million military casualties , property losses were as high as $ 400 billion , and direct war outlays came to $ 1.352 trillion .
looking at those riveting figures , we cannot help but ask : what was it that caused mankind to fight two world wars in the first half of the 20 th century ?
the primary causes for the two world wars in both cases were the sharp contradictions between the new imperialist states , which were fighting for colonies , and the older imperialist states , which were fighting for so - called " lebensraum . "
at the turn of the century , the majority of the countries in the world are still opposing a unipolar world dominated by one country and are actively pushing forward development of a multipolar world .
however , owing to such factors as unbalanced political and economic development and so on , multipolarization development is set to take another protracted or tortuous process .
today , the world is still moving toward multipolarization instead of unipolarization , and this complies with such an objective law that the world is varied .
this year has witnessed development of all forms of partnership and this has reflected such a trend .
china and russia have entered into strategic partnership in light of the 21 st century and forged new - type state - to - state relations with each other on the basis of the five principles of peaceful coexistence .
indeed , enhancement of the sino - asean partnership and solidification of the asean - china - japan - korea ( 10 + 3 ) cooperation have pushed forward the trend of multipolarization .
aside from facilitating closer cooperation between the asian countries and the european countries , such a mechanism has also played a positive role in promoting the trend of multipolarization in the world .
the europeans have also acknowledged that they are way behind the americans in this field .
japan has vowed to catch up with the united states in the field of information industry within five years and has regarded this as a motive force for accelerating its economic recovery and development .
irresistible though this trend is , it is unlikely to be attained within a short period of time , for it involves a protracted process .
china and russia have time and again pledged to enhance cooperation with each other in opposing hegemonism or power politics ; furthering the process of multipolarization in the world ; and establishing a new international order .
besides , the us plan for deploying a missile defense system has also met condemnations from various countries .
on the other hand , since the united states is too ambitious , it has already shown a sign of being unable to do as much as it would like to .
on the questions of east timor and chechenya , the united states has adopted a completely different attitude or approach .
in particular , this year , after the united states failed to prevent the arab - israeli conflict from escalating further , the middle east peace process suffered a setback .
the dawn of a new century will soon break .
first came the 1911 revolution , which overthrew the feudal monarchical dictatorial system that had ruled china for thousands of years .
this was accomplished under the leadership of the cpc 's first - generation collective leadership revolving around mao zedong .
the third change was the launching of the great enterprise of reform and opening and the huge success of the all - out drive for socialist modernization with chinese characteristics .
this constituted a new revolution initiated under the leadership of the party 's second - generation collective leadership revolving around deng xiaoping .
by the time the clock of history ticked to the 18 th century , however , the chinese nation was gradually falling behind .
but their epic struggles succumbed again and again under the joint assault of imperialism and feudalism . countless people with lofty ideals went to their graves with the regret that their ambition remained unfulfilled .
the 1911 revolution led by dr. sun yatsen occurred just as the chinese nation tottered on the brink of collapse .
it took a tumultuous revolutionary upheaval like the 1911 revolution to overthrow the corrupt qing dynasty and put an end to the feudal monarchical dictatorial system that had ruled china for millennia .
two , ideologically it thoroughly liberated the chinese people . the idea of republicanism began to penetrate the public psyche .
in this sense , the 1911 revolution blazed a trail for the vitalization of the chinese nation . its victory was unmatched by that of any of the peasants ' uprisings in history . "
soon the warlords seized power , the powers set up separate spheres , and the long dark night continued in the divine land .
however , true revolutionaries and patriots never gave up . carrying on the cause of the pioneers , they pressed ahead with the struggle on a tortuous path full of thistles and thorns amid the most difficult of circumstances .
standing tall among the ranks of nations the may 4 th movement broke out seven years after the failure of the 1911 revolution .
this new cultural movement held high the banner of " democracy " and " science " and mounted a massive onslaught on the old ideology , old culture , and old ethics of feudalism .
the enlightenment of the democratic and scientific spirit spawned a marriage between marxism and china 's proletarian movement and gave birth to the most advanced political force in china , the communist party of china (cpc) .
the cpc 's founding in 1921 was a great event comparable to the fire that lighted up the land in a dark night .
after a 28 - year heroic struggle , after bloodshed and sacrifices , the cpc finally forged a new china .
because of my support for the chinese revolution and socialism , i took out chinese citizenship after new china was founded .
since then we have mainly devoted ourselves to the second historic task .
the times we live in and the prevailing social and historic conditions determine that the chinese people must take the socialist road if they are to make the country strong and prosperous and make everybody rich .
it is our mission to destroy the old world and build a new world , with the latter being the more magnificent and more arduous half of the task .
thus the triumph of the chinese revolution is not the end of revolution but a new beginning ; starting with the birth of new china , a great long march that would end in the creation of a modern country , prosperous , powerful , democratic , and civilized , has begun .
after seizing their own destiny , the chinese people have greatly changed the look of their country and society and created magnificent earth - shaking achievements .
under the cpc 's leadership , the chinese people stood up and forged ahead with an indomitable spirit . despite difficulties and setbacks , their achievements in socialist modernization were vast .
the plenary session was a great landmark in the process of modernization in china and was also the third great change in 20 th century china .
after reviewing the lessons of history , comrade deng xiaoping made the historic decision to pursue reform and opening .
it would not work if we did not reform .
without reforming and opening , productive forces would not have been liberated .
reform and opening have lifted the income level of china 's urban and rural populations multiple times .
the per capita disposable income of the urban population surged from 343.5 yuan in 1978 to 5,854 yuan in 1999 , while the per capita disposable income of the rural population rose from 133.6 yuan to 2,210 yuan in 1999 .
the chinese people relieved themselves of the burden of history through reform and opening , which had no precedent in history , and broadened their own horizons , becoming even more confident in the process . their self - esteem has been enhanced .
needless to say , we must conscientiously integrate ourselves into society , stay abreast with the times , and move forward in tandem with the people .

( 1 ) 25 december telegram from xinhua she of beijing to cpccc and the state council general office that was a circular about implementing the opening administrative affairs to the public by the nation 's town and township political power organizations .
a ) the ideology of guidelines , basic policy and basic requirements the town and township political power organizations are the basic level organizations of the political power organizations . those accredited agencies are working organizations that are accredited by related government .
the basic rule for implementing the system of open administrative affairs is : a ) open according to the law .
the open content should be true and trustworthy . the result of handling affairs should be fair and just .
it has to be convenient for people handling affairs , be convenient for people realizing the situation , and make people exercise their supervisory power .
d ) further implement the systems of democratic policy making , democratic management and democratic supervision .
among them , the key point is opening the financial situation .
the open financial situation should be open to the general public , enterprise business units and the cadres , and staff of our organs .
opening has to adopt the correspondent form .
the constant work has to be open regularly . transitional stage work has to open in stages . temporary work has to open any time .
( to be continued ) circular of implementing the open system of administrative affairs issue of town and township political organizations that was issued by cpccc general offices ( ii end ) .
c. supervision and guarantee system the core of implementing the open system of administrative affairs is to strengthen supervision .
we have to build a complete supervision system of town and township political power organizations and of the inside of accredited agencies , to guarantee the truth of the open content .
we have to connect the result of opening of work and the democratic policy - making before and in the middle of work and democratic supervision , and connect the internal supervising with the external supervising , to build a set of restraint mechanisms that are convenient , useful and with restraint .
the important content of open administrative affairs has to be reported to people 's congress .
they have to implement a system regarding important matters that groups discuss and decide .
they have to implement the pre - open system .
the town and township organizations and the accredited agency discuss in groups and then make a decision regarding the important matters involved with group benefits .
they should formally open the scheme to the public before they make formal decisions or start work .
we have to implement the regular audit system .
the audit department of city and county governments has to operate the audit supervision of the implementation of the town and township financial budgets , final accounting of revenue and expenditures and all kinds of funds and capital revenue and expenditures according to the law , and open the audit result to the public .
the party commission united the leadership of the work of the open administrative affairs of towns and townships . and the government is the main control .
discipline inspectors and control organizations have to help the government to strengthen the supervision and inspection . the general office of government has to strengthen the organization and coordination of the work .
county and city ranks of party commission and governments start the important function to the open system of administrative affairs of towns and townships , so we have to strengthen the organized leadership and substantial guidance , and fiercely grasp and implement .
the towns and townships party commissions and governments are responsible for organization and implementation of the opening of the administrative affairs of towns and townships .
every town and township has to establish an opening of administrative affairs leadership group that is run by the head of the town and township , according to the policy of who is in charge and who is responsible and exactly implement this work completely .
every place has to bring the open administrative affairs of accredited agencies to the comprehensive situation of open administrative affairs of towns and townships , accredited agencies have to accept the united leadership from town and township party commissions and governments voluntarily .
at the same time , the higher rank executive department has to put forward the requirements to the open administrative affairs of basic level 's stations and institutions and strengthen the supervision and guidance of the related rules and practicalities of the business of the department .
implementing open administrative affairs in towns and townships , we have to interpret the construction of the town and township parties , political power and village affairs publicly , integrating every item of basic management , comprehensive management , and promote them overall .
we have to make the opening of administrative affairs an important content of the party leading cadre annual work exam and responsible system of the honest political structure of the party discipline , and use the results of the exam as the important fundamental of punishing and rewarding the cadres .
when we implement the open system of domestic affairs , we have to strengthen the work of ideology and the work of education and publicizing .
we have to educate the vast cadres , especially those basic level cadres . we have to strengthen the democratic consciousness and build the group concept . protect the democratic rights and legal power and benefit of the general public voluntarily .
at the same time , we have to educate and lead the vast general public , and use their democratic rights according to the law , to protect the fundamental benefit of our country .
at the same time of implementing open administrative affairs of towns and townships , the political power organizations that are higher than county and city rank have to explore the effective ways to implement the open administrative affairs aggressively , and step by step implement the open system of administrative affairs .
every province , and municipality directly under the central government and self government area and the central national related departments should integrate the practicality and formulate substantive measures according to the spirit of this circular .
though sino - us relations have developed relatively smoothly , yet not all has been well . the deliberation of us congress over two motions attracted much attention .
of the two motions , one concerned china 's pntr [ acronyms as published ] status , the other the " taiwan relations act. "
the former motion was passed by the senate and the house of representatives and put into law after it obtained president clinton 's signature in october .
the latter motion , however , was only adopted by the house in february , and it is still in a drawer .
whether the " trade war " between china and the united states will enter a new stage after china was granted a pntr [ acronyms as published ] status , is an issue under the consideration of many experts and scholars .
most experts and scholars believe that the pntr status is of great importance to promoting closer and more stable sino - us trade relations .
in fact , the sino - us " trade dispute " is far less noticeable than the " taiwan " issue .
the united states is pursuing a so - called " balance policy " or " ambiguous strategy " toward the taiwan strait . they keep selling weapons to taiwan for temporary interests , but from the long - term point of view , such an act is detrimental to us safety .
well - informed presonages have pointed out that it is very dangerous for americans to overestimate the democratice progressive party 's wisdom .
the chinese side must take its own security into consideration and work out a corresponding policy .
while it keeps saying it would abide by the one - china principle , the three sino - us joint communiques , and the " three noes " pledges , it sold a large quantity of weapons to taiwan and tried to include taiwan in its tmd system .
china has consistently pursued an independent foreign policy of peace . there is no denying that sino - us relations are the most important bilateral relations in the world pattern .
since 1979 , when china and the united states established diplomatic relations , sino - us relations has developed amid struggle .
powell , us secretary of state - designate , said a few days ago : china is neither the enemy nor the partner of the united states .
people will wait and see what course the new us government will follow , especially in handling the taiwan issue .
due to serious drought and other causes , it is estimated that peasant incomes will only rise by 1.8 percent in 2000 , a situation that has attracted a high degree of attention on the part of the cpc central committee and state council .
in accordance with the arrangements of the central economic work conference , doling everything possible to increase peasant incomes has become the basic goal and central task in rural economic work in the new period .
the slowdown in the increase of peasant incomes is the eruption of the contradictions in agriculture that have accumulated over a long period .
agricultural production has developed rapidly since the launch of reform and opening up , and the situation in the supply of agricultural products has changed from the long period of shortage to supply exceeding demand , with a surplus in bumper years .
in particular , in recent years supply of many agricultural products has exceeded demand , and prices have plummeted ; township and town enterprises are in the process of readjustment , their capacity to absorb rural labor has declined somewhat , and the momentum of increased peasant incomes from these enterprises has correspondingly weakened .
after the launch of reform and opening up , as a result of depending on increased prices for agricultural products , the miracle of increasing peasant incomes by an annual average of 16.5 percent was achieved in the early years .
in the new stage of agriculture , we need to think up new ways of opening up more channels in view of the contradictions in agriculture and the rural economy , and devise more ways of increasing peasant incomes .
increased state input not only effectively strengthens the body of agriculture and thus leads forward peasant incomes ; in addition a considerable portion of this increased input is directly converted into peasant incomes .
however , the phenomena of restricting or refusing to accept grain and forcing down grades and prices exist to a serious degree in many places , with the result that market grain prices go on falling and the peasants ' returns from growing grain continually decline .
it is necessary to step up supervision and take effective steps to promote the smooth implementation of the grain reform policies so as to properly protect the peasants ' interests .
on the surface the overall planning retention charge [ tong chou ti liu fei ] is still within the stipulated 5 percent , but making a realistic calculation , it has long exceeded that figure .
many places have also thought up many ways of helping the peasants to increase incomes , but at the same time they have demanded more from them , and far from increasing , peasant incomes actually decline there .
with enhanced science and technology content of agricultural production , agricultural returns will improve and peasant incomes will naturally increase .
agricultural industrialization operations of " companies plus peasants " can not only closely integrate agricultural production with the market but can also return to the peasants the profit from processing and circulation , thereby enabling them to gain more income .
developing small towns , switching surplus rural labor , and narrowing the gap between town and countryside is a great long - term scheme for increasing peasant incomes .
the shift of surplus rural labor to small towns can ease the contradiction between rural population pressure and what the land can bear , reduce the production costs of agricultural products , enhance agricultural production efficiency , and promote the development of agriculture in a high - precision direction , thereby increasing peasant incomes .
from now on , doing everything possible to increase peasant incomes , starting by developing agriculture and rural economy , must be truly assigned an important position in the minds of the leaders at all levels .
beijing , 25 dec ( xinhua ) - - the fifth plenary session of the cpc central committee discipline inspection commission [ central discipline inspection commission - - cdic ] opened in beijing today .
the state council also put forth a string of important moves to be followed in handling government affairs and carrying out administrative duties strictly according to the law .
acting on the central authorities ' decisions and plans , party committees and governments at all levels have upheld the policy of managing party and government affairs strictly and tightened their efforts in fighting both the root causes of corruption and its phenomena .
as result of the joint efforts of party members and the people , the fight for promoting ethical party and government conduct and for fighting corruption has achieved new , noticeable successes .
these successes can be observed in the following respects : in accordance with the instructions about the " three represents , " leading cadres have continued to exercise self - discipline .
discipline inspection and supervisory organs at all levels have carried out a special project of reviewing the problems that have aroused the masses ' strong resentment , and addressing certain newly emerging issues .
they have charged leading party and government cadres to return 5,154 sedans that they used or borrowed against regulations ; and returned 4,465 personal computers purchased which leading cadres purchased with public funds for their own use .
a total of 86 departments of central party and state organs have drawn up regulations specifying the types of businesses that are off - limits to the spouses and children of cadres at and above departmental and bureau levels .
by the end of november , party and government organs had handled a large number of cases concerning those businesses that are off - limits to the spouses and children of provincial - , ministerial - , regional - , and departmental - level cadres .
the work to ensure the ethical conduct and self - discipline among grassroots leading cadres has also tightened .
discipline - inspection and law enforcement organs at all levels have intensified their efforts in investigating the important cases , and different departments and regions have built stronger mechanisms for coordinating their efforts in investigating cases .
by doing so they have achieved new progress in investigating cases .
a large number of large and important cases that had created a serious impact at home and abroad were seriously handled .
fairly good results have been achieved in the important project of preventing and controlling corruption from the source .
central and provincial departments , sub - provincial cities and provincial capitals have instituted a government procurement system . they have conserved 1.78 billion yuan from the 14.4 billion yuan they paid on procurement projects .
under different systems , the government has appointed accountants to 257 prefectures and cities , and 1,029 counties and districts in the nation 's 31 provinces , regions , and municipalities under the central government 's jurisdiction .
new successes have been achieved in building the socialist democratic system under which the masses can exercise more efficient supervision .
efforts to implement the accountability system set up for promoting party and government conduct , prompting party and government organs to enforce ethical rules , and urging all departments to discharge their responsibilities have made new headway .
the principal responsible comrades of many party committees and governments have heightened their sense of accountability , some competent authorities have achieved noticeable progress in discharging their responsibilities , and the work of holding people accountable for their conduct has been strengthened .
he said : the nation is proceeding with its fight against corruption at the present stage under the historical conditions when the country is engaged in deepening reform , opening wider to the outside world , and restructuring the economic system ; and also when the many social problems interact with one another .
wei jianxing stressed : in 2001 , we will continue to control leading cadres ' behaviors and leading cadres must tighten their efforts to discipline themselves .
we will institute a system under which provincial and ministerial cadres must report their family assets .
leading cadres will not be allowed to accept any cash and negotiable instruments from the following units and individuals : those who work for these leading cadres ; units and individuals under their supervision ; other units and individuals on whom the exercise of these leading cadres ' authority has a bearing ; foreign businessmen and business owners .
whoever violates the regulations will be punished by disciplinary rules and the law .
without exception , all leading cadres who take part in physical fitness activities are not allowed to accept any rewards or financial support from any units , individuals , foreign businesses , or private business owners upon whom the exercise of these leaders ' authority has a bearing .
when leading cadres go abroad for visit , the trips must be in line with the public office they hold and the expenses must be strictly within their units ' budgets for foreign activities . they may not go abroad for visit with the financial support or invitation from domestic businesses or from chinese - funded enterprises overseas .
we must continue to increase the intensity of investigating and prosecuting cases of indiscipline and lawlessness .
cases of lawlessness and indiscipline that involve leaders of state - owned enterprises and grassroots leading cadres of townships and towns must also be seriously investigated and prosecuted .
we must continue to reform the rules governing institutional mechanisms , and continue to intensify our efforts of preventing and controlling corruption from the source .

the marriage law is a law that has a direct bearing on the lives of the broad masses . ever since the draft amendments to the marriage law were submitted to the npc standing committee for deliberations in october of this year , there has been widespread interest in all sectors of society .
this is the first time that the ninth national people 's congress has held a joint committee meeting to deliberate a draft law .
the focus of deliberations : bigamy and acts in violation of monogamy since the draft amendments to the marriage law were submitted for deliberations , all sectors of society have focused on how to define bigamy and acts in violation of monogamy as well as how to punish such acts .
she suggested redefining the concept of " bigamy " to impose legal restrictions on acts violating monogamy and destroying family harmony .
he maintained that the marriage law , which falls into the category of civil law , may spell out the consequences of marriage - related acts in the context of civil law but should not stipulate criminal charges and penalties .
five members - - zhao di , li shuzheng , li mingyu , wang jiaqiu , and nie li - - made a joint statement saying that acts in violation of monogamy are extremely complicated and should be handled differently and should be restricted through various means and channels .
he called for allowing those couples who met the essential requirements for marriage but who had failed to take care of the registration paperwork to register their marriage , upon which their marital relations would take effect retroactively .
should income from intellectual property be viewed as common property ?
with the development of economic and social life in china , there are new circumstances and changes with regard to household finances , such as huge increases in income , ever - growing household assets , and more diversified sources of income such as income from intellectual property and capital .
these all require that detailed standards be set in regards to household assets .
concerning income from intellectual property as part of household assets , standing committee member wu shuqing said that the draft provides that assets from business activities and income from intellectual property usually controlled by one party while the marriage was in effect are common property .
zhao di and the other four standing committee members maintained that it is not appropriate to define income from intellectual property as common property . aside from instances where the owner voluntarily makes this income common property , it should be the special property of an individual who has the right of disposition over the property .
standing committee member wu shuqing also voiced his opinions on making arrangements for assets .
he said that some foreign countries require notarization while others require registration in court and a proclamation .
making arrangements for assets involves not only the husband and wife , it could also involve other parties ; thus , provisions in the draft on making arrangements for assets should proceed from reality and should be clearer and more concrete .
standing committee member wang youhui also maintained that making arrangements for the assets of husband and wife is a legal action , which should be in written form and could only go into effect upon registration at a marriage administration office .
the draft amendments to the marriage law establish a system for determining fault and damages for the first time ; however , there were varying opinions among the standing committee members on how to determine fault and damages .
standing committee member li denghai maintained that the provisions in the draft concerning the award of damages in divorces follow the civil law principle of equity .
he raised objections to those provisions of the draft that only the party not at fault has the right to seek compensation .
he maintained that , in practice , when a husband and wife break up , it is never a one - sided story . there are often many reasons and intertwined cause and effect . for example , if the woman has an affair this might cause long - term domestic violence from the man .
punishment for domestic violence should be more severe in recent years domestic violence has clearly been on the rise .
standing committee member shu huaide maintained that domestic violence should be punished more severely .
the draft stipulates that , in cases of domestic violence or other acts of abuse toward family members , the victim may petition the village committee , the neighborhood committee , or the unit where she belongs to mediate . these provisions are not sufficiently strong because domestic violence and abuse are not simple disputes .
in cases of domestic violence and other acts of abuse toward family members that are in progress , the draft should provide for an immediate end to such acts .
however , standing committee member li denghai maintained that the draft has already made clear and thorough provisions prohibiting domestic violence .
as for how to stop domestic violence , it is not appropriate to have too detailed provisions in the marriage law. he suggested being more proactive in publicizing the need to prohibit domestic violence in order to create an atmosphere throughout society that prohibits and opposes domestic violence .
at the same time publicity and reporting on the amendments should be stepped up in order to create a great upsurge throughout society to study and implement the marriage law and to publicize the legal institution of marriage .

editor 's note : the 20 th century is now over , the dawn of the 21 st century is at hand .
in china , marxism has been carried forward and developed in the form of mao zedong thought and deng xiaoping theory .
the first form of marxism in the 20 th century appeared as the mao zedong thought .
mao zedong 's ideas are the product of combining the general principles of marxism with concrete chinese practice . the china that gave birth to mao zedong thought was a backward oriental country .
even though the old democratic revolution under the leadership of sun zhongshan overturned the rotten qing dynasty government , facts proved that due to the flabbiness of its national bourgeoisie , china 's status absolutely could not be changed in reliance on this class .
only by relying on the countryside , the proletariat starts an armed uprising of workers and peasants , establishes red political power , surrounds cities with countryside , and then finally seizes the cities .
the first question we faced at this beginning stage was this : can an originally poor and backward country like china skip capitalism and make a transition to socialism ?
upon completion of the socialist transformation , mao zedong led the entire party in an arduous exploration of the socialist construction and further gained numerous victories .
the errors of mao zedong 's later years are not only his personal tragedy , they are a tragedy of our party and our state .
furthermore , " tragedies are admittedly painful , but their pain leaves the deepest impression on people , and thus frequently becomes a turning point that creates new thoughts and new things . "
having experienced a period of setbacks , it finally extricated itself from its predicament and again advanced towards victories .
deng xiaoping theory is a continuation and development of mao zedong thought , it is the result of combining the common principles of marxism with the practice of building socialism in china ; it is a new stage in the evolution of marxism .
on the other hand , chinese marxists represented by deng xiaoping , in response to the " two whatevers " viewpoint distinctly argued that mao zedong thought must be understood in their entirety and accurately and initiated a huge discussion on the criterion of truth .
this discussion resulted in the victory of the viewpoint according to which " practice is the sole criterion of cognitive truth . "
this removed the ideological obstacles interfering with the convening of the third plenum of the 11 th national party congress central committee that had an epoch - making significance , while also forming the ideological foundation of deng xiaoping theory .
it is according to this ideological line that deng xiaoping suggested that with regard to our past mistakes , we need to conduct a radical theoretical overhaul and bring order out of chaos .
he emphasized that from the standpoint of theory , our past mistakes stem from a lack of accurate understanding of what is socialism and how to build socialism .
for a radical reform and restoration of order , we would first need to pay special attention to this fundamental issue .
the report at the party 's 15 th congress highly praised deng xiaoping theory , emphasizing " practice proves that deng xiaoping theory which is a continuation and development of mao zedong thought is an accurate theory that guides the chinese people in their victorious implementation of socialist modernization in the midst of reform and opening up policy .
after the death of deng xiaoping , the task of carrying on and developing deng xiaoping theory fell on the shoulders of the third generation of party leaders with comrade jiang zemin at the core .
comrade jiang zemin said , " while upholding deng xiaoping theory , continuously enrich and creatively develop this theory in practice - - this is the solemn task of the party 's central committee leadership as well as all party comrades . "
under the guidance of the great banner of mao zedong thought and deng xiaoping theory , socialism has ultimately gained a huge victory in china , whose population equals roughly a quarter of the world 's population .
first of all , at no time can the fundamental principles of marxism and scientific socialism be swayed .
the socialist society is a society that has eliminated the system of exploitation , its appearance is different from the change of dynasties in history .
the change of dynasties in history was the transition from one kind of exploitation system to another kind of exploitation system , or even a supersession of power within the same exploitation system .
when capitalism is replaced by socialism , a society of exploitation is replaced by a society without any exploitation . this is indeed an earth - shaking change , it is bound to cause violent repercussions in society and arouse unbridled resistance of the exploiting classes that do not want to take their defeat lying down .
at the same time , precisely because socialism is a society that has eliminated all exploitation , it must accumulate a lot of experience from scratch and pursue exploration anew .
second , only through incessant innovation and development does marxism acquire vitality and fighting capacity .
from its birth till the present marxism , it has been around for more than 150 years . the reason for its long prosperity and eternal youth is the innovation and development it experienced at various stages in history .
once again , we must adopt a correct stance towards mistakes committed in the process of socialist exploration .
because socialism is an unprecedented new social system , it is inevitable that people commit certain mistakes in the process of building socialism .
the other attitude is to conceal faults and gloss over wrongs , do one 's best to cover up mistakes , and even uphold mistakes .
theoretically , socialism is consistent with people 's interests .
if such situations are not corrected , their consequences are extremely grave .
comrade jiang zemin 's important thinking on the " three represents " pointed out that the chinese communist party must become a true representative of the needs of developing china 's advanced social production forces , of the course of progressing china 's advanced culture , and of the fundamental interests of the broad masses of people .
of these , representing the fundamental interests of the broad masses of people is the foothold and the conclusion .
but good aspirations are not enough by themselves , what is needed is accurate practice , a party line , course , and policy capable of realizing these aspirations .
if our practice is incorrect , and the party line , course , and policy run counter to people 's aspirations , if they jeopardize the people 's interests , this can naturally cause their dissatisfaction and even meet with their opposition .
at present , when humanity is about to enter the 21 st century , the new century offers an abundance of challenges and opportunities .
whether or not marxism will be able to orchestrate a new historical composition depends on whether or not the proletariat and its political party can adopt a correct attitude to history , scientifically summarize their experience and continue to fight and advance .
if this is genuinely accomplished , then marxism has not only carried on into the 20 th century , it will surely be carried in the 21 st century too .

in july 1931 guo yonghuai chose to major in physics and became the protege of professor gu jingwei .
two years later gu jingwei recommended that he continue his studies under the tutelage of optics expert professor rao yutai at beijing university .
in march 1938 guo yonghuai overcame a number of difficulties and proceeded south by a circuitous route to kunming , where he worked part time and studied part time in the physics department at xi ' nan joint university , which had been established by beijing university , qinghua university , and nankai university .
he knew that a nation without a strong military would always be vulnerable to attack , and it was precisely because of this fierce patriotism that guo yonghuai abandoned optics , the specialization he loved , and switched to aviation engineering , vowing to struggle his entire life for our nation 's military science .
aviation engineering is closely connected with the study of mechanics , and thus guo yonghuai became involved in the study of aerodynamics .
during this period , he studied fluid mechanics under the direction of professor zhou peiyuan , researching a well - known problem in fluid mechanics - - " turbulence theory . "
in the summer of 1938 the boxer indemnity fund overseas students committee held the seventh round of exams to recruit students to study abroad . as a result of these tests guo yonghuai , qian weichang , and lin jiaqiao were admitted together .
with this , guo yonghuai and his classmates became the first group of students from china to pursue specialized studies at that university .
in the fall of 1946 , feng kamen 's student , professor william sears , established the graduate institute of aviation engineering , based at the department of aviation sciences at cornell university and invited guo yonghuai to teach there and to work with him in administering the school .
all the advice backfired , and the more people advised him , the more exercised old guo became , saying : does the fact that the country is destitute only mean that there is nothing its sons can do for it ? " on the day before the national holiday in 1956 guo yonghuai came home at last !
" look , the red flag with five stars ! " someone started shouting .
guo yonghuai leapt up like a teenager , raised his head and was motionless for some time .
his family was warmly welcomed by the party and government as well as the scientific community .
immediately following his return to the homeland , guo yonghuai got his wish by beginning scientific leadership work with qian xuesen and qian weichang at the newly - organized institute of mechanics .
at the end of 1956 the institute of mechanics , which had only been established for a few months , quickly developed into a national mechanics research center .
soon , guo yonghuai received orders to serve as the institute 's managing deputy director .
soon , he was selected to be the deputy director of the china aviation society .
on october 15 , 1957 , our nation signed the " agreement on new technology for national defense " with the soviet union .
in the agreement , the soviet union clearly promised to provide china with mathematical models and written materials on the atomic bomb .
in 1958 , the 9 th bureau of the 2 nd mechanized division responsible for the development of nuclear weapons was established in the capital .
later , the 9 th institute , which became the development and design institute responsible for the entire process of developing and producing nuclear weapons ( it was the forerunner of the china engineering physics institute ) began work on developing the " two bombs . "
the soviet union 's unilateral breach of the agreement and contracts caused unimaginable difficulties for our nation 's nuclear industry that was just getting started .
he , along with wang ganchang and peng huanwu , formed the earliest " three pillars " of china 's nuclear weapons development .
in 1960 , 105 of our own experts formed a special corps .
guo yonghuai was appointed as the deputy director of the 9 th institute , in charge of leadership work in mechanics and engineering .
in order to facilitate technological breakthroughs , the 9 th institute established four crack technological committees . guo yonghuai led the field experiment committee , responsible for conducting testing and weaponization of nuclear weapons .
at the same time , guo yonghuai was also responsible for directing research on technology related to the underwater explosive mechanics of anti - submarine nuclear weapons and water tunnel mechanics .
in addition , he made major contributions in the areas of experimental research on submarine to surface missiles , surface to air missiles , hydrogen - oxygen rocket engines and counter missile systems .
to establish the structural design of nuclear weapons devices , guo yonghuai proposed " proceeding along two parallel roads and choosing the superior one in the end " in order to determine the optimum plan for the first nuclear bomb detonation , which played a decisive role in deciding several critical questions .
in order to speed up the development of nuclear weapons , in 1963 party central decided that expert scientific research personnel should go to the newly - established nuclear weapons development base in qinghai .
due to the special demands of his work , guo yonghuai was required to go back and forth between beijing and qinghai frequently , resulting in increased occurrences of the altitude sickness .
as the mushroom cloud spread upward , guo yonghuai and his comrades jumped for joy .
on may 30 , 1965 in the great hall of the people , premier zhou enlai , deng xiaoping , he long , and seven other vice - premiers personally received guo yonghuai and the other experts and scholars who had participated in the first and second nuclear weapons tests .
the successful detonation of a nuclear bomb and the encouragement of party central invigorated guo yonghuai and his colleagues , and they immediately plunged into a new struggle . . .
in september 1965 , work on the development our nation 's first artificial satellite was restarted . guo yonghuai was ordered to participate in the organizing and leadership of the " dongfanghong " satellite body and recoverable satellite recovery research .
less than two years after the loss of guo yonghuai , on april 24 , 1970 our nation 's first artificial satellite was successfully launched .
with regard to the hydrogen bomb , guo yonghuai proposed scientific opinions concerning the structural form , the weight of the bomb , deceleration devices , etc. , thereby ensuring the complete success of the aerial delivery tests of our nation 's first hydrogen bomb .
on june 17 , 1967 , our nation 's first aerial detonation test of a hydrogen bomb succeeded . . .
however , when guo yonghuai spoke of this , he usually said something to this effect : " as a common scientific worker in new china , and especially as a member of the communist party , i only hope that the motherland will become strong very soon and never be bullied .
when china is strong , then it can play a greater role in world affairs . " on october 3 , 1968 , guo yonghuai was again at the test base , working on preparations for the launch of our nation 's first thermonuclear missile weapon .
he wanted to rush back to beijing and did not wait a moment in arranging a flight .
