however , we still have a rather significant gap with the advanced levels of the world with regard to our competitiveness in science and technology , environmental protection , and sustainable development , etc. , and this will pose serious challenges to our development in the new century and participation in a new round of world competition .
since china initiated its family planning policies in the 70 s , over several decades china has reduced its births by more than 300 million .
however , based on the current population base figures and birthrates , around the year 2010 china 's population will pass the 1.4 billion mark , and by the middle of the new century it will approach 1.6 billion .
this makes it extraordinarily difficult for china to achieve across - the - board progress in the social system through rapid and sustained economic development and makes china 's wings exceptionally heavy for the takeoff to modernization .
in today 's world , s & t talent determines the size of high - tech industries , while the high - tech industries determine a country 's competitive abilities .
with regard to high - tech industries , the " high ground " for competition in the new century , china 's situation does not admit of optimism .
standing on the threshold of the new century , we must face the following reality squarely : china is a major country in terms of population , but it is far from a major country in terms of talent , or a power in terms of science and technology .
although the number of scientific and technical personnel in china has gone from less than 50,000 fifty years ago to the current figure of one million , this still accounts for less than one ten - thousandths of china 's total population .
along with rapid economic and social development , china 's demand for high - tech talent continues to grow .
naturally , talented s & t personnel are important , but even more important are talented managers .
of the 7000 high - tech companies in silicon valley today , approximately 2000 were founded or are managed by people of chinese origin .
related experts believe that for a developing country to maintain a 2:1 ratio of those who return to those who stay [ in another country ] during the economic takeoff stage is fairly reasonable and beneficial .
the situation in china is just the other way around , with the ratio being 1:2 , and this number provides food for thought .
a country thrives when it gains people , and perishes when it loses them .
as a result , we have no choice but to turn our gaze to water , oil , grain , and other strategic resources .
in particular , the per capita figures for strategic resources are far behind the level of the advanced countries , and they are also below the world average .
water is an extremely important economic resource , an assurance of economic prosperity .
in the 21 st century , the importance of water to mankind will be the same as that of oil during the 20 th century .
however , the drought this year , the first in ten years , brought the seriousness of china 's water crisis into relief .
in the serious drought year , a crisis in the supply and demand of water resources exploded : agriculture and industry lacked water , and there were even frequent emergencies in the daily water for the people .
china 's per capita fresh water resources are a mere 2300 cubic meters , only equivalent to one - fourth of the per capita figure for the world .
however , china 's consumption of water is growing unabated .
in 1949 china 's annual water consumption came to 103 billion cubic meters , but by 1999 it had grown to 559.1 billion cubic meters .
china 's support of 22 percent of the world 's population on the seven percent of cultivated land has been dubbed " the most successful example of agricultural progress in the world today . "
however , china is facing the reality of a continuing decline in arable land .
because chinese agriculture is lagging behind with regard to infrastructure development , the ability to resist natural disasters is not strong , and each year natural disasters destroy around 25 to 30 million hectares .
it was particularly noticeable this year , with serious damage to 100 million mu of crops and harvests abandoned over 15 million mu of farmland .
concerned experts believe that , by 2010 , china 's net import of petroleum will reach 100 million tons , and 200 million tons in 2020 .
thus , our oil shortfall in 2010 will be from 80 million to 120 million tons , and by 2050 it will reach 400 million tons .
china 's population will continue to grow for a fairly long time , and it is estimated that , over the next decade or so , the net average annual growth will be over 10 million people .
to deal with this , the only wise option is to make provisions for a rainy day .
water pollution is particularly prominent .
several of china 's principal rivers are generally polluted , of which the pollution in the liaohe and haihe rivers is serious . the water quality of the huaihe river is relatively poor , while that of the huanghe river is not conducive to optimism .
according to statistics from concerned departments , of 338 cities nationwide , only 33.1% have attained level two in the national air quality standards , while the remaining 66.9% all exceed level two , of which 137 exceed level three standards , accounting for 40.5% of the cities covered in the statistics .
the majority of our grasslands have already or are in the process of deteriorating .
the deterioration of the agricultural ecology will lead directly to a weakening of china 's ability to sustain agricultural production .
environmental pollution not only affects economic development , to an even greater degree it also affects social progress .
a red light has come on in our living environment , and there are frequent warnings over the resources situation .
only by facing the crisis and challenges squarely , plucking up courage from a sense of shame and making a greater effort will we be able to have a clear conscience in the new century , creating greater glories for the chinese people .

to realize the state 's preferential support for the west , the state council has formulated some policies and measures to implement the strategy of developing the west .
below is a notice on the issues involved : 1 . principles for formulating the policy and focuses of support 1 ) principles for formulating the policy .
act according to our capability and plant our feet firmly on the here and now , but also take a long - term view , plan comprehensively , verify scientifically , emphasize the priorities , implement them step by step , avoid the herd instinct , oppose extravagance and waste , and steer clear of ostentatious projects .
2 ) key tasks and strategic objectives .
turn west china into a new west that enjoys economic prosperity , social progress , and national unity , and where people live a stable life amid beautiful mountains and rivers .
3 ) key areas .
the policy of developing the west applies to the following municipality , provinces and autonomous regions : chongqing , sichuan , guizhou , yunnan , xizang autonomous region , shaanxi , gansu , ningxia hui autonomous region , qinghai , xinjiang uygur autonomous region , inner mongolia autonomous region , and guangxi zhuang autonomous region .
raise the proportion of capital funds in the state budget allocated to the west .
tap state bank loans , loans from international financial organizations , and foreign government preferential loans to fund as many projects in the west as possible as long as the terms of lending are complied with .
the central government will use a variety of methods to raise funds earmarked for financing the development of the west .
accelerate the creation of a legal - person responsibility system , project capital funds system , project bidding system , project quality supervision and management system , and project environmental supervision and management system for development projects in the west as well as their early - phase work .
in the case of cereal seedlings subsidy funds and cash subsidies required by state - approved projects designed to re - afforest farmland , to restore grassland on existing farmland , or to prevent desertification , most of such subsides should come from the central treasury .
where the revenue of a local government decreases because of projects aimed at restoring forests or grassland on existing farmland or because of natural forest protection projects , the locality thus affected should be offered appropriate subsidies by the central treasury .
in accordance with the principles of commercial credit , banks should increase lending to basic industries in the west , focusing on projects involving railroads , arterial or main highways , power , petroleum , natural gas and other large and mid - sized energy projects .
expedite the loan review and evaluation process in which loans are matched with proceeds derived from the issuance of state bonds .
in some cases , a loan for an infrastructural project is secured by the future ability of the project to collect fees or its future earning power .
credit support should be boosted for agriculture , ecological and environmental protection , industries that enjoy an advantage , small town development , the technological transformation of enterprises , the development of high - tech enterprises and small and mid - sized enterprises in the west .
increase loans in the west to fund student grants and student housing construction .
in the case of loans for rural electric network modernization and loans going to industries that enjoy an advantage , if the amount involved is substantial and the project in question is a priority project , the loan should come directly from the headquarters of the agricultural bank or the head office of any of the commercial banks .
allow joint - stock banks to set up branches in the west in stages . 3 .
policy to improve investment climate 1 ) vigorously improve the soft investment climate .
deepen the reform of state enterprises in the west . speed up the creation of a modern enterprise system . make the strategic adjustment of the state economy and the assets reorganization of state enterprises a success .
intensify the nurturing and development of commodity and capital goods markets in the west .
actively guide the accelerated development of non - public economies in the west , including the individual economy and private economy . in accordance with the applicable laws and regulations , all domestic enterprises regardless of their ownership system should in principle be allowed to enter any field open to foreign investment .
2 ) adopt a preferential tax policy .
both domestic enterprises and foreign - funded enterprises in the west that are in industries encouraged by the state may pay income taxes at the reduced rate of 15 percent each year for a given number of years .
new enterprises in the west that involve transportation , electricity , irrigation , postal services , radio or television broadcasting will be exempt from income taxes for two years and then pay income taxes at only half the normal rate for the next three years .
incomes derived from special agricultural products grown on former farmland now replanted with trees or grass in the interest of ecological protection shall be exempt from the special agricultural product tax for ten years .
3 ) implement a land and mineral resources preferential policy .
in the west , it is government policy to give land use rights to the party that plants trees or grows grass on wasteland or barren hillsides or that takes farmland out of cultivation and replants it with trees or grass .
the state land use rights may be inherited and are transferable .
when the government must take the land back for development purposes , it must compensate the economic organization or individual affected in accordance with the law .
increase support for policies on the surveying , appraisal , prospecting , development , conservation , and intelligent utilization of mineral resources in the west .
deepen price reform . continue to increase the proportion of prices regulated by the market .
accelerate the reform of water charges . in the interest of water conservation , gradually raise water charges to a reasonable level . improve the collection and management of water charges .
tighten the unified management of water resources from the valley . strictly implement the planned water and water distribution system . promote the fair utilization and development of water resources .
universalize the urban sewage and solid waste management fee - collecting system ; the funds thus collected shall be used to treat sewage and solid waste .
the prices of airline tickets for feeder routes between two provinces or within a province or autonomous region shall be set by the operators themselves .
encourage foreign companies to invest in agriculture , irrigation , ecology , communications , energy , municipal works , environmental protection , mineral production , tourism , and resource development in the west . also encourage them to build technology research and development centers .
allow them to open accounting firms , law firms , engineering and design companies , railroad and freight companies , and urban public utilities in the form of sino - foreign joint ventures .
2 ) further widen the channels of foreign capital utilization .
conduct pilot projects that test foreign capital utilization using either the bot or tot method .
support foreign - funded enterprises in the west that meet the requirements in issuing stock for trading on the domestic and international stock markets .
support enterprises in industries allowed or encouraged by the state in attracting foreign investment through the transfer of management , by selling stock , or through mergers and acquisitions .
when a foreign company invests in an infrastructural project in the west or in an industry that enjoys an advantage , rules governing the share of the foreign stake shall be relaxed as appropriate , as shall the rules specifying the proportion of renminbi loans that domestic banks are allowed to provide .
allow some projects in the west to increase the share of their total investment that consists of foreign preferential loans .
make an effort to give preference to the west in allocating multilateral and bilateral grants .
3 ) vigorously develop foreign economic relations and trade .
further augment the decision - making power of production enterprises in the west in managing their foreign trade . encourage the development and export of products where the west has an advantage , foreign project contracting , labor cooperation , and overseas investment , especially in neighboring countries . ease restrictions on the exit and entry of personnel .
give proper consideration to easing import controls on technology and equipment badly needed to develop the economy of the west .
4 ) further inter - regional cooperation and support geared toward a particular sector .

there are all kinds of indications that china has already started adjusting its grain security strategy and is making every effort to establish a grain security policy with a relatively low price , cost , and risk .
at the beginning of the year , the chinese government , for the first time since the founding of the new china , instructed relevant departments to cut the production capacity of corn , wheat , and paddy .
this year 's total grain output is estimated at 490 million metric tons , a reduction of 10 million metric tons from last year 's actual output .
china also decided to exclude low - quality spring wheat of the north and early season rice , wheat , and corn of the south from the government 's price protection beginning last year .
some varieties of grain are low in market prices and massively overstocked . therefore , it has become imperative to readjust the plantation industry 's regional distribution , crop mix , and variety and quality mix .
china 's per capita share of grain has now touched 400 kg , which ranks among the highest in the world .
agricultural experts believe that by setting about the strategic readjustment of the agricultural structure , china is now in the process of seeking an even more rational approach to balancing grain supply and demand .
studies and analyses indicate that there has not been any obvious correlation between fluctuations in world cereal output and in china 's cereal output over the past two decades . therefore , regulation by partially using the world grain market is relatively safe .
experts think the expansion of china 's cereal imports not only can guarantee this country 's grain security at a low cost but also will bring tremendous trading profits to grain exporting countries .

question : current us president clinton , who came to office officially on 20 january 1993 , has served two terms and occupied the white house for eight years , and is leaving office on 20 january next year .
over the eight years , china - us relations have been stormy at times , but have been moving forward on the whole .
after being elected president , clinton did link the most favored nation treatment for china to the issue of china 's human rights in 1993 , resulting in serious harms to china - us relations .
after may 1996 , clinton 's policy on china underwent a significant change .
president jiang zemin visited the united states in 1997 , and clinton made a return visit in 1998 . china - us relations developed rather well in the latter phase of the clinton administration .
question : the development of china - us relations can be described as advancement with zigzags and fluctuations .
the most important incident in the recent period was last year 's us bombing of the chinese embassy to yugoslavia .
what experience and lessons do you believe to be worth learning in terms of crisis handling on the part of china and the united states ? tao : in recent years , there have been many crises in china - us relations .
there have been three major crises since 1989 : the first was the united states ' application of pressure on china after the june 4 , 1989 incident ; the second was li teng - hui 's visit to the united states ; and the third was last year 's embassy bombing incident .
the three incidents have reflected the three fundamental differences and contradictions in china - us relations : the first is the human rights issue ; the second is the taiwan question ; and the third is that the united states wants to be the world hegemon , while china is opposed to us hegemonism .
it is necessary to see that both sides follow a principle in handling crises ; in other words , neither side is willing to see a fundamental breakup of relations , and both sides understand that despite all the differences , there also exist far - reaching , extensive common interests .
consequently , after each crisis , china - us relations were able to get recovered and , in addition , to get developed further .
but , after president jiang zemin and president clinton met in new zealand in september , china and the united states swiftly resumed negotiations on china 's entry into the wto and quickly reached an agreement , leading to new progress in china - us relations .
all this itself shows that china - us relations are full of vitality and staying power .
despite fluctuations , they have been developing and improving .
people have now become ever wiser and calmer .
politicians and people at large of both countries will think about china - us relations in a wiser and calmer way .
as should also be mentioned , chinese government agencies , academic institutions , economic departments , and business and trade establishments have more contacts with their counterparts in the united states than with their counterparts in any other country .
in the past years , such contacts never stopped even when there were political problems between the two countries .
this has also been one important reason why china - us relations have been able to recover from one crisis after another and to continue to improve .
however , china policy was , for the first time , not a focus of debate between the two sides in the general election of this year .
in my view , since the end of the cold war , the united states ' policy toward china has been under debate , which has not ended yet .
we can discern three views : let us call the first view optimists ' view .
according to this view , china 's economic development seems to be having good prospects , and it is inevitable that china will rise to the position of a major power .
let us call the second view pessimists ' view .
they believe it inevitable for china and the united states to fight over interests .
those holding such a view constitute a small minority .
certainly , such norms have been made mainly by western countries , with the united states being a dominant one .
most politicians and scholars , including chinese scholars , support this view .
by talking about a consensus , we do not mean that all in the united states are in agreement .
the united states is a very pluralistic society .
each political party is also pluralistic .
after the normalization of us - china relations , this election was the first presidential election in which the united states ' policy toward china did not become a hot issue of debate .
during the election campaign , he criticized the clinton administration for being too soft on china and repeatedly emphasized that he would change the clinton administration 's policy toward china .
according to many americans , including many democrats and republicans , china - us relations are very complicated , and it is difficult to use one term to clearly characterize the bilateral relations .
therefore they do not support the use of the term " strategic partnership " to characterize the relations .
in my view , bush is unlikely to continue to use this term , for he will have to show his being different .
i do not believe this to be something serious .
for , in today 's world , a partnership , or any kind of relations , does not rule out competition , while competition does not rule out partnership .
the united states maintain true strategic partnerships with the european union and japan , respectively , but the united states still has competition with the european union and japan in trade and other areas .
nevertheless , as bush did say those things , we should expect that the bush administration is unlikely to use the term " strategic partnership . "
question : another important aspect of china - us relations is china - us economic and trade relations .
over the past dozen of so years , china - us political relations have been fluctuating , and economic and trade relations have also bee affected . however , on the whole , economic and trade relations have been continually developing , and the volume of trade between china and the united states has been growing rapidly .
in the recent years , china has been having a growing surplus in its trade with the united states .
this year the democratic and republican parties of the united states agreed to passing the measure of granting permanent normal trading relations [ pntr ] to china .
in the house of representatives , more republican members than democratic members voted in favor of the measure .
therefore , it can be expected that us - china economic and trade relations will continue to make progress .
china - us economic and trade relations have developed quickly this year .
according to us data , the us trade deficit against china exceeded the us trade deficit against japan in september .
the us economy grew at a slower pace in the third quarter .
some believe this situation to be one of recession . but some do not agree to this view . according to them , a growth rate of a little over five percent is too high for the united states , constituting a kind of economic overheating .
if bush jr. 's stance on the question of taiwan is interpreted by taiwan independence forces as a kind of " encouragement , " then there may take place a new crisis between the two sides of the taiwan strait .
it does not say how concerned the us government will be or what means the us government will use .
bush said during the election campaign that if the mainland should use force , the us government would use appropriate means to help taiwan defend itself .
this can be described as a republican response to some people 's demand that the united states ' policy toward taiwan be made clear .
but , he only slightly improved the clarity .
no one will permit the destruction of the things which have been responsible for maintaining and stabilizing china - us relations as well as us - taiwan relations over the past 20 years .
neither unification nor independence is in accord with us interests , and to maintain the existing state of affairs will be the most in accord with the us interests .
therefore the united state will continue to follow this course of action . thus , in my personal view , he will not make substantial changes in regard to issues of taiwan policy , and will basically continue the current policy .
certainly clinton did make the " three - no " statement publicly during his visit to china ; thus , people in taiwan feel that the democratic administration is not friendly and is difficult to work with .
taiwan certainly did not want to hear such a remark and was very uncomfortable and unhappy to hear it .
therefore , people in taiwan hope that a republican administration will be better to taiwan .
historically , in the 1940 s and 1950 s , forces supporting taiwan in the congress were mostly republicans .
it is very difficult to characterize this situation in a simple manner .
question : lastly , what are your expectations about china - us relations in the new century .
tao : we hope that in the new century we will continue to improve relations with the united states during the bush administration .
as has been said clearly by president jiang zemin , vice premier qian qichen , and foreign minister tang jiaxuan , improvement in china - us relations will benefit both china and the united states ; this has been proven by the history of china - us relations over the years .
problems in us - china relations will not only harm china and the united states , but will also harm peace and stability in east asia .
this has been proven by history over many fears .
as i have just said , after so many years of debate , most people in the united states have now established a consensus .
china and the united states do have some fundamental differences , but also have extensive and far - reaching common interests . these common interests have made china and the united states join hands .
we are confident about the future of china - us relations .
the united states , west europe , and japan are experiencing balanced economic growth .
developing countries are expected to reach 5.6% economic growth this year ; economies in asian countries could grow by an average of 7.5% this year .
sustained development of the world economy is a powerful support for the stable development of world trade .
as international trade develops steadily , there are three characteristics to this development : the first is the continuous climb of the proportion of high - tech and high - value - added commodities .
the ninth five year plan goal of $ 400 billion in total imports and exports has been reached ahead of time .
there are various reasons why china 's exports have grown relatively quickly . the first is that china 's national economic development has taken an important turn for the better , which has provided a solid material foundation for export growth .
the third is that , in recent years , china has made macroeconomic adjustments to encourage exports ; the policy effects of these measures are now coming into full play .
thus , foreign economic relations and trade will give impetus to and serve the needs of large - scale development of the western region .
for those foreign - invested enterprises in the national incentive categories in the central and western regions , we will levy enterprise income tax at the reduced rate of 15 percent within a specified period of time . 3 .
in comparison with the coastal regions , infrastructure in the central and western regions is meager , the degree of opening up is insufficient , and the investment environment needs to be improved .
what is your evaluation of the economic effects on china of these opportunities and challenges ? [ shi ] acceding to the wto will bring china 's reform and opening up into a new historical period , and it will bring new opportunities for developing china 's national economy .
after acceding to the wto , china will do business according to current international rules and will continuously improve the socialist market economic system , thereby creating a fine institutional environment for china 's national economic development .
after acceding to the wto , in accordance with wto rules and commitments made through bilateral consultations , china will open up more areas to the outside , amend and improve laws and regulations , and create a more unified , transparent , and stable investment environment . this will obviously make china more attractive to foreign investors .
after acceding to the wto , china will participate more broadly and actively in international competition and the international division of labor . this is beneficial in developing and expanding industries in which china has a dominant position , enhancing china 's international competitiveness , and creating favorable conditions for restructuring china 's economy .
however , during the 20 years of reform and opening up , we have acquired a fairly firm material base and considerable experience in coping with market competition ; our ability to compete internationally and withstand risk has been improving continuously .
we are confident of confronting the challenges . [ reporter ] this year the central authorities proposed an opening up strategy of " going out " in order to fully utilize markets and resources at home and abroad .
as of the end of november this year , 6,289 offshore enterprises were approved and registered by the state with total contracted investment of $ 11.06 billion .
please say a few words about the current situation in sino - african economic and trade cooperation as well as china 's new moves to expand bilateral cooperation . [ shi ] the chinese government attaches great importance to friendly relations with africa and to economic and trade cooperation with africa .
since reform and opening up began , china has continuously consolidated and strengthened economic and trade relations with african nations , and africa has become an important economic and trade partner to china .
the chinese government 's principles for developing economic and trade cooperation with africa are : " equality and mutual benefit , diversity , stressing actual results , and common development . "
in addition , china has also established bilateral economic , trade , and technological cooperation committees with several african countries .
chinese enterprises have actively undertaken contracted construction projects and labor services in africa .
for many years china has provided africa with what aid it could and has helped african countries build 648 projects of different types , including those in the areas of agriculture , animal husbandry , and fishery as well as infrastructure .
it is extremely important to do a good job in foreign economic relations and trade .
we must take every opportunity to speed up development , complete all of the tasks related to foreign economic relations and trade in 2001 , and play a positive role in maintaining sustained and rapid development of the national economy .
however , there are still many uncertainties that influence and hinder the development china 's foreign economic relations and trade . we must fully anticipate and recognize the new situations and new problems that could arise and take a proactive approach in our work .
we will earnestly do a good job in all relevant work to ensure that the apec meetings that china organizes are a complete success .
in sum , we will accomplish all aspects of work in foreign economic relations and trade and strive to get the 10 th five - year plan off to a good start .
no doubt , china 's more than 20 years of reform and opening up has constituted an extremely important historical period in this century .
this period marked not only the beginning of the great rejuvenation of the chinese nation but also a leap forward in the chinese communists ' theory and practice of " what is socialism , and how to build socialism ? " this period will surely leave a mighty and brilliant work in the long process of history .
a correct road - - building socialism with chinese characteristics socialism is the historical choice of the chinese people because this system represents the orientation of human progress and reflects the fundamental interests of the chinese people .
however , in the final analysis , how do we take the road of socialism ?
now , your socialism is more colorful and full of vigor . the people are colorfully , brightly and fashionably dressed . dressing themselves up , girls , in particular , can match with beautiful girls in any place in the world .
best choice - - establishing socialist market economy system regarding the building of socialist market economy system as the target of reform is a great pioneering work , which has opened up a brand - new realm for socialist theory and practice .
actually , market economy and planned economy are two different forms of resources allocation , having nothing to do with the basic systems in society .
" socialist society can also practice market economy . " as early as 1979 , comrade deng xiaoping grasped the crucial point of the question .
planned economy does not necessarily mean practicing socialism because a capitalist society also practices planned economy . market economy also does not necessarily mean practicing capitalism because a socialist country also practices the market economy . "
market economy was thus written for the first time on the banner of socialism .
in september 1997 , the 15 th national party congress also made new explorations in a series of major issues such as the ownership structure , thus reaching a new height in the understanding of the law governing the building of socialism .
market economy is also a kind of open economy .
china 's development can never be separated from the world . carrying out construction with a closed door will not work . only by boldly absorbing and drawing lessons from the achievements of human society 's advanced civilization can we win the superiority that can match with capitalism .
the 80 - year - old elderly man feng tianshun , who was china 's first director of foreign capital bureau , personally participated in the examination and approval of china 's first sino - foreign joint - venture enterprise project - - the beijing aviation food limited company .
solid ice must be eventually broken up and times must advance after all .
call of the times - - further deepening reform , expanding opening up at the turn of the century , everything looks new and fresh .
the new century calls for further deepening reform and expanding opening up .
structural readjustment and economic development have to rely on reform in the end .
viewed from the world 's historical progress , as a new socialist system , socialism is still in the early stage of practice and development .

three , the aircraft carrier formation possesses fast mobility , a strong group attack capability , and also a strong concentrated attack capability .
the aircraft carrier combat group is difficult to conceal , it gives multiple radar signatures , and its reflective surfaces are too large . in addition , infra - red , electromagnetic , sonar , and other physical properties are very strong .
second , the aircraft carrier formation causes ship - borne aircraft to be influenced in take - off and landing by natural conditions , especially weather and the ocean environment . as well , the aircraft carrier formation is limited in its mobility near shoals at sea with complex terrain or in coastal sea territories .
fourth , the aircraft carrier formation has poor anti - submarine and anti - mine capabilities .

the aircraft carrier combat group is equipped with a large amount of advanced electronic instruments and electronic warfare instruments , enhancing its attack and defense capabilities .
anti - ship missiles , to bomb the aircraft carrier formation .

in the last three years , bond - financed investments have produced clear results ; they have become the key factor in this year 's crucial turnaround of the national economy .
in 1999 and 2000 , the state separately issued another 110 billion yuan 's and 150 billion yuan 's worth of long - term construction bonds , and while making arrangements to continue the state bond - funded projects already under construction , some new projects were added .
at the npc standing committee 's request , the arrangements and utilization of long - term treasury construction bonds have focused on expanding domestic demand to spur economic growth , promote structural readjustments , and lay a solid foundation of the country 's long - term development .
over the last three years , treasury bonds have been used to fund 6,620 projects , with total investments worth 2.4 trillion yuan .
q : the state has invested a lot of money with the treasury bonds . what sort of result have they produced ?
a : the state 's investments have been very fruitful especially in the following areas : one , we have effectively expanded investment demand and have promoted economic growth .
since 1998 , the state has issued a total of 360 billion yuan 's worth of long - term construction treasury bonds . they have directly spurred local , departmental , and enterprise matching fund input and bank loans worth approximately 750 billion yuan , and together they have played an important role in promoting economic development .
the treasury bond - funded projects accounted for 1.5 percentage points of 1998 's economic growth and 2 percentage points of 1999 's growth , and it is expected that they will account for about 1.7 percentage points of 2000 's growth .
funded by the treasury bonds , we undertook large - scale embankment constructions around the large rivers and lakes and worked to repair damages caused by flood water .
we have also funded the development of water - conserving irrigation of 65 million mu of farmland and supported other projects along the changjiang river to level some embankments to allow water flow , turned some farmland back into lakes , and move people out of some areas and build new towns in other areas .
since 1998 , china 's highways , railways , and civilian aviation have gone through an unprecedented period of rapid growth .
we have built 174,000 kilometers of new highways , 10,230 kilometers of which are high - speed freeways . we have thus increased china 's highways to 1.4 million kilometers and freeways to 15,000 kilometers .
with respect to railroad construction , by the end of this year , we will have completed 16 projects and opened up another 2,070 kilometers of tracks , 586 kilometers of which are multiple tracks .
with respect to airport renovation and construction , at the end of the year , 24 airports , including those in nanchang , changsha , deqen , yinchuan , lanzhou , urumqi , baotou , chongqing , altay , kuqa , and xining , will be completed and go into operation .
we have improved the situation with regard to grain storage facilities .
these will greatly ease the chronic shortage of grain storage capacity and will clearly increase the state 's ability to regulate and control the grain market and ensure the successful implementation of the state 's grain reform policy .
we used treasury bonds to fund a large group of technological transformation and high - tech industrialization projects and projects to convert to chinese - made equipment .
to date , more than 85 percent of the treasury bond - funded technological transformation projects are underway ; some have already been completed and are in operation , but most will be completed before the end of 2001 .
the high - tech industrialization projects , the special projects pertaining to new materials , the special projects pertaining to information networking , and some high - tech industrialization demonstration projects we especially supported have all made good progress .
it is estimated that by the end of 2000 , we will have completed 68 high - tech industrialization projects .
we have developed the test broadcast system and receivers for high - definition television ; they were successfully tested at the ceremony commemorating the 50 th anniversary of the founding of the prc .
four , we have promoted the readjustment and optimization of the makeup of the different regions ' productive forces and have made substantive progress in promoting the great western development .
between january and november , investments in basic construction in the central and western regions increased 14.6 percent and 18.5 percent respectively , which were 8.9 percentage points and 12.8 percentage points more than in the eastern region .
at the end of this year , we will have completed 44 water pollution treatment projects in the " three rivers and three lakes " districts to generate 3.30 million - ton per day water treatment capacity .

beijing , 29 dec ( xinhua ) - - shi guangsheng , minister of foreign trade and economic cooperation , today has signed decree no. 9 of the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation (moftec) in 2000 and promulgated the " procedures for the administration of trade with the taiwan region . "
consisting of 15 articles , the newly promulgated " procedures " clearly define the guiding principles for trade with taiwan and set down methods for managing trade with taiwan and the solution of disputes , thus providing an open guiding basis for trade with taiwan .
an min gave an account of the three principles followed in the formulation of the " procedures , " namely , the principle of " one country , two systems " ; the principle of market economy ; and the principle of being consistent with the management procedures currently in effect .
over the past 20 years and more , cross - strait economic exchanges and trade have started from scratch and grown from small to large , developing into the present - day pattern in which cross - strait trade serves as the mainstay , with cooperation between taiwan - invested industries on the mainland and those promoted by them .
it is understood that cross - strait trade , which was $ 46 million in 1978 , is expected to reach $ 30 billion this year .
the state administration of industry and commerce [ saic ] today announced that as of 1 january 2001 our country will start using new business licenses for enterprises with foreign investment .
a saic responsible person concerned said : at present , there is a world of difference between the procedures for setting up and registering enterprises with foreign investment in the country and those for ordinary domestic enterprises .
by contrast , the current practice of uniformly affixing the saic seal to all business licenses of enterprises with foreign investment has made it difficult for various social circles to find out and inquire about the particulars of an enterprise 's registration .
to make the particulars registered by an enterprise tally with the actual circumstances , the saic will also popularize , on an experimental basis , a system of registered capital transparency to indicate on a company 's business license the amount of its paid - up capital .
from 1 january through 30 june next year , industrial and commercial administrative organs will issue the new business licenses , as replacements , to enterprises with foreign investment through the yearly enterprise inspections or alteration of enterprise registrations .
it has also been learned that the country presently has a total of more than 200,000 enterprises with foreign investment .

these " measures " codify the guiding principles , management methods , and dispute resolution in trade with taiwan and provide a public reference for the development of trade with taiwan .
as everyone knows , we have made unstinting efforts to develop economic and trade relations between the mainland and the taiwan region .
on 1 january 1979 , the standing committee of the national people 's congress issued the " notice to the compatriots on taiwan , " clearly pointing out : " economically , taiwan and the mainland have always been a whole unit . "
" between the two of us , we should develop trade , meet each other 's needs , and conduct exchanges .
under the guiding principles of " peaceful unification and one country , two systems , " the mainland has adopted a series of effective measures to promote the development of cross - strait trade .
in 1991 , moftec proposed five principles to stimulate economic and trade exchanges across the strait , which were : direct bilateral contact , mutual benefit , diverse formats , adherence to contracts , and long - term stability .
in 1994 , the state council confirmed the general guidelines for developing cross - strait economic relations as " actively taking the initiative , giving full play to advantages , mutual benefit , and common development . "
from january through november of this year , the total volume of cross - strait trade was $ 27.82 billion , an increase of 32.1 percent .
by the end of 1999 , the cumulative total of cross - strait trade reached $ 160.4 billion , of which exports from the mainland to taiwan accounted for $ 26.0 billion , and imports from taiwan accounted for $ 134.4 billion .
taiwan is the mainland 's fifth largest trading partner and its second largest import market . the mainland ( including hong kong ) is taiwan 's second largest export market and largest source of trade surpluses .
faced with the situation of continuing expansion of cross - strait trade , moftec has consolidated the practice and experience of trade with taiwan over the past 20 years , and on this basis has issued the " measures " in order to further promote the " three links " across the strait .
the following principles were observed in drawing up the " measures " : the first is the principle of " one country , two systems . "
for a long time now , in the area of trade with taiwan we have resolutely and thoroughly put into practice the basic guiding principles of " peaceful reunification , and one country , two systems , " and in the " measures " we have strictly adhered to this principle .
this means that cross - strait economic and trade exchanges occur within one sovereign nation , and under the premise of one china , are exchanges between the main body of the nation on the mainland and the taiwan region .
taking as our point of departure the different economic and trade systems on the two sides of the strait , we have used current laws and regulations regarding the management of foreign trade as a reference in codifying trade with taiwan .
at the same time , they create the conditions for direct trade across the strait .
cross - strait trade has developed to the scale of $ 24 - 25 billion annually , but can only be conducted indirectly , which wastes time and energy , increases costs , and lowers the competitiveness of products on the international market .
the approach taken by the authorities on taiwan flies in the face of the laws of economics and harms the basic interests of the people on both sides of the strait .
we have consistently maintained that the " three links " across the strait is an internal affair of the nation and should adhere to the principles of " one china , direct bilateral contact , and mutual benefit . "
we will continue to steadfastly promote the " three links " directly connecting the two sides of the strait , and will continue to adopt flexible and pragmatic measures to develop cross - strait economic and trade exchanges .

beijing , 30 dec ( xinhua ) - - a few days ago , the prediction team , composed of the chinese academy of sciences and xinhua news agency , predicted that there will arise " 10 major scientific and technological trends , which may produce a great impact on mankind " in the new century .
the progress in the basic study of the science of matter will derive a series of new technological principles . the progress in the study of materials will undoubtedly provide scientific bases for the development of new materials and energy resources .
at the same time , ecology will end up making macroscopic and microscopic fields a coordinated process combining different hierarchical structures of life , such as molecules , cells , individuals , groups , and communities , into an organic system for in - depth study .
genes causing specific serious diseases will be discovered ; some specific diseases that endanger human life , cured ; the biology of human behavior , defined ; and the human physiological quality , improved .
under extreme environments and conditions , the study of biological forms and phenomena warrants more and more attention .
over the past years , great changes have taken place in our understanding about the range , quality , and study of resources , environments , and casualties .
in the process of developing and utilizing secondary energy resources , such as solar , wind , geothermal , ocean , and water energies , scientists predict that secondary clean energies will be used to meet 50 percent of the world energy supplies in the 21 st century .
besides , there are great prospects for developing gas hydrates , with reserves surpassing the total proved reserves of petroleum , coal , and natural gas . 6 .
the core issue concerning the development of materials science and technology in the 21 st century is the discovery and development of new - type advanced materials .
it is foreseeable that revolutionary breakthroughs will be made in the 21 st century in the new methods and new technology used in discovering new materials .
the breakthroughs and development of materials science and technology in the 21 st century will provide more room for development in such areas and industries as information , telecommunication , medicine , manufacturing technology , aviation and space technology , and military . 7 .
the three platforms already established in biological technology - - dna recombination , cell cultivation , and dna chips - - have yielded considerable results and nurtured new biological technology industries .
third is the platform of stem cell biology , which is the foundation for cloning animals , tissues , and organs .
the key technology being developed is one on controlling the differentiation and growth of totipotent and pleuripotent stem cells . for example , nerve stem cells can grow into various types of cells of the nervous system .
the high technology of using computers to design the new types of organisms will also materialize in the next century .
high - level neuro - activity of human beings , such as sensation , cognition , and thinking , will ultimately be analyzed at the molecular level and cell level .
new biological technology will emerge in this platform in the foreseeable future , which , on the one hand , will bring good news to persons suffering from mental diseases and , on the other , will bring about production of highly intelligent computers and robots .

the promotion of the strategic readjustment of the economic structure is one of the extremely important macroeconomic management tasks at present and for a fairly long time in the future .
this is because , against the backdrop of the operation and development of the national economy , obvious changes of a phased nature are making an appearance , and the reforms and opening up and drive to modernization have now entered a new development phase .
this then requires that , when promoting economic structural reforms , the government have new approaches and new methods , implementing readjustment involving survival of the fittest and advancing on some fronts while retreating on others , with the advances being promising and the retreats orderly .
this likewise is an important task that we must accomplish in going from a " developing economy " to an " intermediate developed economy . "
main attack direction is readjustment of industrial structure , optimal industrial upgrades there are two strategic priorities in the readjustment of the agricultural structure , one being the mix of crops cultivated and the other the structural mix of farming , animal husbandry , by - products , and fisheries .
it is of strategic significance with regard to the long - term , stable growth of crop cultivation in china and in dealing with the impact of the international grain market after we join the wto .
the readjustment of the secondary industry - - particularly the internal industrial structure - - covers more items and is more complex . in general terms , there are two main aspects , one being traditional and modern industries ( particularly the information industry ) and the other being resources - oriented industries and the manufacturing industries .
modern industries primarily include the information , biotechnology , new energy , and new materials industries , etc. these are areas where we are weak at present , and we should increase the proportion they account for among industries as a whole .
relatively speaking , there should be a readjustment of the structural setup of such representative " traditional industries " as the metallurgical , petroleum , coal , textile , machinery , and shipping industries , improving their growth quality and shifting from extensive development to intensive development .
this is one of the strategic priorities in the future readjustment of china 's industrial structure , as it will lay the foundation for boosting the international competitiveness of china 's industries .
from a strategic perspective , china may face a relatively serious energy crisis in the not - too - distant future .
in addition to developing renewable resources , this also requires us to implement conservation - oriented development of existing resources , and for a certain period of time the growth of " resources - oriented industries " should be curbed .
there is also a readjustment problem in the internal structure of the tertiary industry .
what this basically entails is that we must be skillful in the correct handling of the relationship between the " traditional service industries " and the " modern service industries . "
the government must concentrate more on accelerating the development of " modern service industries . " this is necessary to deal with international competition in the modern service industries once we join the wto , and it is also necessary to improve the overall quality of the national economy .
the share of direct government investments among the total amount of investments society - wide will be reduced , while the share of independent , non - government investments , including individual , private , and foreign capital , will go up .
from the perspective of what the government invests in , public investments will be a priority in the selection of its investment mix , as these have a bearing on economic security and resource monopolies and are industries which play fundamental support roles in national economic development .
with regard to the regional structure , the priority is on the phased implementation of the large - scale development of western china .
in addition to those specifics discussed above , the strategic readjustment of the economic structure will also be expressed in the urban and rural , foreign trade , and ownership structures .
the priorities will be on accelerating the urbanization process , increasing the proportion of manufactured goods in overall export trade , increasing the proportion of the non - public - ownership sector of the economy , and establishing a new ownership structure system suited to the development needs of a socialist market economy .

beijing , 30 dec (zxs) - - guoji shangbao [ international business newspaper ] run by the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation [ moftec ] today carried a full text of the " measures on the management of trade with taiwan area " signed and issued by shi guangsheng , minister of the moftec , yesterday .
article 2 : these measures apply to trade of goods , trade of technologies , and trade of services between mainland and the taiwan area ( hereinafter referred to as trade with taiwan ) .
article 3 : undertaking trade with taiwan should abide by the laws , administrative rules and regulations , and other relevant regulations of the state , and should not do harm to the state security and social public interests .
article 4 : the moftec of the people 's republic of china is the organ in charge of trade with taiwan .
article 6 : the contracts and goods for trade with taiwan cannot carry any words or marks that violate the principle of one china , nor can they have any contents that impair the reunification of the motherland .
article 7 : in the trade with taiwan , if an indication of source area is required on the goods and their packages , those from taiwan should bear the mark of taiwan as the origin of products , as to those from the mainland , neutral packing can be used according to actual conditions .
article 9 : the mainland goods re - exported or transshipped to the taiwan area via the hong kong sar or the macao sar should abide by the state 's stipulations regarding trade in the hong kong sar and the macao sar .
article 10 : in the trade with taiwan , commodities involved in the reunification of the country , joint operation , and control of total quantity as well as commodities controlled by permits and quotas should be handled according to the state 's stipulations on import and export .
article 11 : customs duties on the goods for trade with taiwan are levied according to pertinent laws and administrative rules and regulations at the preferential tariff rate , and taxes on import links are levied in accordance with the law .
article 12 : the disputes arising in the trade with taiwan are resolved by the parties concerned through negotiation or mediation .
in the cases where the parties concerned are unwilling to negotiate or mediate or have failed to negotiate or mediate , they may submit the cases to the chinese arbitration organizations for arbitration in accordance with the reference clauses of the contracts or the written arbitration agreement reached afterward .
article 13 : trade between mainland and the taiwan area in small amount applies to the " measures on the management of small amount trade with the taiwan area " promulgated by the moftec and the general administration of customs .

after acceding to the wto , china will have to open up her insurance sector in an all - round way and so will foreign insurance companies start flocking into china 's market in every possible way . how should china 's insurance sector , which is still in its infancy , seek continued growth amidst fierce competition ?
nevertheless , compared with insurance sectors in foreign countries , china 's insurance sector is still very young and still way behind in terms of depth of insurance , density of insurance , national sense of insurance , number of insurance companies on a per capita basis , insurance premium income , total assets , and so on .
faced with such an aggressive offensive from foreign insurance companies , china 's insurance companies are truly under unprecedented pressure . however , those in the insurance sector are still exceptionally cool and calm , believing that the key lies in making a success of what they ought to do .
china 's insurance sector has of late advanced such a slogan : " developing a national insurance sector , taking part in international competition . " indeed , drastic changes unknown in the past are under way .
as for the ratio of insurance premium income to balance of savings deposits of residents , in developing countries , the total insurance premium income generally accounts for 7 percent of the balance of savings deposits whereas in developed countries , the total insurance premium income generally accounts for 15 percent of the balance of savings deposits .
by 1999 , the balance of savings deposits of residents had reached almost six trillion yuan in china , of which the insurance premium income still accounted for only 2.3 percent .
besides , china 's insurance premium income and total insurance assets have remained at too low a level .
as for total insurance assets , china 's insurance companies possess assets valued at 238.958 billion yuan or about $ 28.8 billion whereas antai , a us life insurance company , alone possesses assets valued at more than $ 90 billion or 3.4 times more than china 's total .
it is thus clear that china 's insurance sector is still in its starting stages at the moment .
china 's insurance sector still has enormous potential in terms of development .
in order to greet challenges brought by china 's entry into the wto , the insurance sector has also begun transforming itself into an investment - oriented sector at an accelerating pace .
at present , china 's domestic insurance market , domestic life insurance market in particular , is still at a crucial stage of replacing traditional life insurance products with non - traditional ones .
in the past , only insurance policies attached with fixed interest rates were sold on china 's life insurance market .
since china 's pingan insurance company introduced " pingan millennium financial management and investment insurance " in shanghai last year as the first insurance policy integrating investment and insurance in china , pingan insurance company 's shanghai office has collected insurance premium equivalent to 70 percent of its total life insurance premium income .
pingan insurance company has of late introduced in beijing one more new insurance policy integrating investment and insurance and collected several million yuan of insurance premium on the first day , accounting for 15 percent of its own insurance premium income in the same month .
personalities in the insurance sector maintained that such fast sale of investment - oriented insurance policies shows that china 's insurance sector has started moving into non - traditional operation in light of challenges brought by entry into the wto .
zhou xiaochuan , chairman of china securities regulatory commission , has also time and again invited financial enterprises , including insurance companies , to list themselves on the market .

at the turn of the century , the international community which is in a period of change is in the midst of a fierce collision between tradition and transformation .
in the face of the complex and changeable international situation , in order to preserve their national security and defend their national interests , the great powers are regarding the enhancement of their military capability as one of their priorities and are readjusting and formulating their corresponding military strategy .
relying on its status as the only post - cold war superpower and its powerful military strength , the united states is making efforts to establish its unipolar hegemonist status as world leader and to build a world order that suits american values .
in recent years the united states has greatly increased its national defense input , with the aim of ensuring that it can possess in the 21 st century the best - equipped and strongest combat force in the world to back its diplomatic and military strategy .
the united states believes that since the situation in europe is relatively stable , asia is the region where the united states is most likely to be involved in military conflict in the future .
the united states stresses that it must uphold its military deployment in east asia and continues to maintain 100,000 troops there .
russia has revised its security concept and military doctrine in order to cope with the new security environment .
according to the new military doctrine , russia has abandoned the " purely defensive " military guiding thinking and replaced it with the guiding thinking of active defense .
given that its conventional military forces are in a relatively parlous state , russia has further enhanced the status of the nuclear deterrent in its military strategy .
the new doctrine has lowered russia 's nuclear threshold , showing that russia reserves the right to use nuclear weapons in retaliation against a large - scale attack with conventional weapons , when the security of the russian federation is facing a critical situation .
after drawing up with the united states new defense cooperation guidelines , japan has also formulated and passed the " law on peripheral events " and the " bill on revising the law on the self - defense force " and other relevant laws on japanese - us cooperation .
this will have a major impact on the pattern of forces and the security situation in the asia - pacific region .
the european union [ eu ] has strong aspirations of becoming an independent pole in a multipolar world after the cold war .
the eu has made decisive progress in economic integration , but the serious lag in its defense integration has a very great effect on the eu 's status and role as an entity on the world stage .
the eu has decided to set up a 60,000 - strong rapid reaction force by 2003 ; its task will be to independently carry out peacekeeping and other missions when nato and the united states are not participating .
india 's international status has declined somewhat since the cold war due to various international and internal factors .
india believes that possessing and maintaining nuclear capability is an essential condition for preserving its great - power diplomacy .
in order to boost the reliability of its nuclear deterrent capability , india is currently stepping up the building of a three - dimensional strategic strike capability .
as far as carrier vehicles are concerned , india is stepping up research and development of the " sun god " [ ? surya ] icbm with a range of 8,000 to 20,000 km , the " agni " irbm with a range of 1,500 to 5,000 km , and the " prithvi " srbm .
what catches the eye is that the indian navy has already started to exceed its traditional sphere of activities in the indian ocean and is extending toward the pacific .
india will become a factor that cannot be neglected in influencing the asia - pacific strategic pattern .
