beijing , 3 jan (zxs) - - how will china 's legislative work develop in the new century ?
li lin , a researcher of the law institute under the chinese academy of social sciences , said during an interview with this reporter that china 's legislative work should be improved in five respects in the 21 st century .
legislative democratization - - legislative democratization requires that legislation reflects the spirit of the constitution , political system , state rights and interests relations , legislative system , and legislative value consideration . li lin pointed out : the democratization for legislative purpose should play a role of guiding , appraising and restraining legislation .
concrete practice of democracy should be shown in the realm of rights and benefits . through legislating the citizen 's rights , benefits and freedom , the spirit , principle , system and procedures of democracy will be embodied in the realm of rights and benefits .
open legislative process - - there should be systems and procedures for the legislative organ to publish its agenda and records , permit visitors at legislative meetings , listen to people 's comments and accept supervision ; and for citizens to participate in legislation .
in the new century , the development of socialist democracy will set high requirements for bringing china 's legislative process into the open .
for this reason , the openness of legislation will be shown in various respects and stages of the legislative process .
the practice of legislative drafting monopolized by government organizations will gradually decline .
to meet actual need , a practice of legislative drafting by neutral , non - governmental organizations will gradually be popularized .
li lin said : pluaralized legislative power will be shown in the limits of authority in legislation . the legislative power will be defined more clearly between central and local governments , among principal central organizations that make laws , regulations and rules , and among various local legislative organs .
li lin believes that experts and scholars are neutral and generally do not have any interests in most legislative bills . besides , they can use their specialized knowledge in designing , improving , analyzing and commenting on some legislative bills .
so , experts and scholars should be let participate in drafting laws , and they should be entrusted by the legislative organ to join its legislative staff in drafting legislative bills .
legislative internationalization - - in domestic legislation , china may draw on the experience of some international legislation or foreign legislation , or even adapt them as domestic legislation according to our actual needs .
we may also adapt some international treaties and conventions for use in domestic legislation .
i. the theory and practice of scientific socialism blazed a new trail for the development of human society just as the emergence of capitalist system , conjured huge wealth , " as if by magic , " from under ground , a new pandora 's box was sprung open .
capitalism did not bring freedom and wealth to the proletariat and broad working masses , instead , it brought barbaric plunder and exploitation .
it is in the course of exploration in search of the right approach to transforming the capitalist society that marx and engels founded scientific socialism clearly showing the only right path for the proletariat and all working classes to free themselves from a lot of oppression and exploitation , and for the humanity to take towards a bright future .
following the victorious october revolution and the establishment of socialist state power in a number of countries , scientific socialism turned into a 20 th century world setup and gave impetus to large - stride progress in human history .
all of the above goes to explain that the foundation and development of scientific socialism are logical results of mankind 's pursuit of the shared ideal of happy society .
however , until the emergence of scientific socialism , there was no theory that could indicate a true road to the realization of happy ideals .
therefore , the scientific socialism created by marx and engels is not only a scientific theory that overcomes all of the contradictions and evils inherent to capitalism but also a crystallization of ideas on how to realize the happy future .
scientific socialism is also an inevitable result of the progressive evolution of the social history .
the development of human society is always directed from lower forms to higher forms . the transition from capitalism as the last exploitation system to socialist system devoid of all exploitation is a necessary trend and an irrefutable regularity of history .
however , the 20 th century socialism overthrew this assumption by gaining victories first in economically and culturally backward countries and then in east europe , china , and other asian countries .
the masses of people in backward countries suffered from feudal exploitation and oppression in their own countries while at the same time suffering from colonial plunder .
this meant that they were subject to double suffering and double tragic fate , which made the social and class contradictions of the undeveloped nations even more acute , such that they had no other way out except revolution , and outbursts of democratic revolutions in these countries became an inevitable necessity .
with regard to these counties , the immediate choice for their revolutionary goal was the establishing of a bourgeois democratic republic but in practice their efforts mostly failed .
the following examples give the best explanation of this situation : for a long time , england supported a feudal regime in its colony india ; imperialism jointly with feudal forces choked to death the chinese capitalist democratic revolution .
furthermore , the historical evolution of humanity is not mechanical but vivid and vibrant .
as far as a certain time period , or a certain specific ethnic group or nation is concerned , they quite frequently either lag behind and catch up with the old - timers or leap forward in their development towards a higher stage .
slavery reached it peak on the northern shores of the mediterranean , in greece and rome , but the first to replace slavery with feudalism was china , where the slavery system had not been all that advanced .
while the feudal system reached its peak in china , capitalism first started in the west european nations whose feudal civilization was inferior to that of china .
economically and culturally relatively backward nations can skip the capitalist stage of development and enter socialism but this does not mean that these nations can totally negate the historical tasks that have to be completed during the capitalist stage .
full awareness of the tremendous progress of socialism and its influence on the historical process in the 20 th century even though the economic and cultural basis in the countries where socialist revolutions were successful was relatively backward , their achievements in socioeconomic development were truly amazing , to which the old regime was no match .
this was not only a drastic change from what the old china was , but it was also something that could not be matched by most nations implementing capitalism whose historical basis and development starting point were close to those of china .
some people have asked the following question : if the socialist system is so superior to capitalist system , why has n't it yet caught up with the developed capitalist nations ?
the countries where socialism first won a victory inherited a feudal , colonial and semi - colonial mess , this difference from the " immense wealth of capital " accumulated by capitalism over a long period of plunder is a great disparity .
secondly their methods of economic development are different .
by contrast , the development of socialism depends on self - reliance and hard struggle of the country 's people .
by contrast , capitalism has a history of 300 - 400 years , it has accumulated a solid basis and abundant experience .
fourth , there is the difference in development environment .
during the time when capitalism was developing on a major scale , feudalism was thoroughly fading into decay in the world as a whole , and capitalism enjoyed quite a favorable international situation .
the history of the development of socialism in the ' 80 s has not only radically changed the face of these countries , but , which is more important , it has made a tremendous , profound and lasting impact on the course of human society 's history .
what should the attitude be to the errors and setbacks that appear in the development of socialism .
especially in the ' 80 s , when the soviet union collapsed after a history of more than 70 years , and mutual relations between the east european socialist countries underwent drastic changes , the world socialist movement entered a low - tide period .
how to regard this setback is a big issue that needs to be clarified through accurate through accurate understanding of the historic course of the development of socialism .
- - for the most part , when socialism emerged from feudal forces , it was still a parent society in full vigor , so that in the process of strengthening and building socialism we had to face a double historical task of resisting both feudalism and capitalism .
since the struggle against capitalism were more real , more urgent , the existence and danger of feudal ideology and mentality were frequently overlooked .
this transformation was much more formidable , difficult and complex than any other transformation before .
all of this goes to explain that the emergence of errors and setbacks in socialism has deep social and historical reasons as well as objective real causes .
as regards the great cause of the building of socialism we need not be afraid of the errors and setbacks occurring in the progress of exploration . the important thing is to accurately clarify and correctly deal with the causes that create errors and setbacks .
v. china 's reforms and the successful exploration of the road to the development of socialism in the building of socialism in china , like in the building of socialism in other countries , there were a few mistakes , and in particular , we experienced such a major setback as " the great cultural revolution " .
in particular , having successfully weathered political storms , having endured the asian currency crisis and singularly large - scale natural disasters , socialism in china has displayed exuberant vigor and vitality .
the world socialism is currently at the low ebb , but the tremendous success of the chinese reforms has a far - reaching , pioneering and especially profound significance for the development of the theory and practice of scientific socialism : first , the fundamental issue of " what is socialism , how to build socialism " .
in the previous practice of building socialism , often things that meet the essential requirements of socialism were considered capitalist and criticized , while things that do not meet the essential requirements of socialism were considered socialist and tenaciously defended .
since the representatives of the socialist productive forces are themselves in charge of the state , the continuous resolution of the basic contradiction can be achieved through the continuous reforming of the relations of production and the superstructure . thus we are required to consistently regard reforms as the motive force of socialist development .
in order to uphold reforms we must basically proceed from the realization and protection of the interests of the broadest people 's masses ; this is not only an essential requirement of the socialist system , but also a fundamental prerequisite and condition of successful reforms .
third , we must energetically develop social productive forces .
the basic principles of socialism are shared by all , but the specific practice must be lifelike and diverse .
practice has proven that since the actual foundations on which individual countries establish socialism vary , their methods of gaining political power vary , and their ethnic and national conditions vary , there can be no single model of development that fits every country .
every country must proceed from its own reality in its effort to explore a specific road leading to socialism .
fifth , we must take care to overcome the influence of decadent ideas and culture , strive to absorb the best achievements of human civilization .
as determined by the fundamental essence of socialism , the leading core force in this great cause must be and can be only a proletarian party .
errors in the building of socialism must be corrected under the party leadership , socialist reforms must be conducted under the party leadership .
in the process , the party will continuously reinforce its self - building and actively promote the building of socialist democratic politics .
history is a continuously flowing river , in its surging and torrential advance there may be countercurrents and whirlpools , no force can hinder its progressive trend .
in the past 80 - odd years - long history of socialism , there have been triumphs and there have been setbacks .

we should no longer miss optimum opportunity reporter : to carry out political reform and make the nation strong is an enthusiastic aspiration of the chinese nation for more than a century . the magnificent reform program carried out for more than 20 years is undoubtedly a music movement that has stirred up the people 's feelings .
during this new revolution , the question as to whether china should follow the road of planned economy or that of market economy has become a major dispute on which there have been several face - to - face confrontations .
the " cultural revolution " had pushed china 's economy to the brink of a total collapse . it also gave some of us something to think about on planned economy .
in 1980 , the " preliminary views on economic restructuring " drafted by xue muqiao and others had explicitly pointed out that " the socialist economy in china 's current stage is a commodity economy with the ownership of means of production playing the leading position and various economic sectors developing side by side . "
however , the policy makers at that time had not agreed with this kind of concept .
nevertheless , the demand for reform towards market regulation cannot be stifled .
those who upheld market economy began to launch their counterattacks in 1984 .
this kind of request drew responses from the various sectors and gained approval from the leadership .
as a result , the building of a " socialist planned commodity economy " or " socialist commodity economy " became the basic topic at the third plenary session of the 12 th cpc central committee held in september 1984 .
finally this formulation was written into the " decision with regard to restructuring the economy " of this session and made a major breakthrough in the realm of socialist theories .
the term " socialist planned economy " was somewhat not so clear - cut . it sounded like beating about the bush . however , it pointed out the correct path for the reform program after all .
most of the economists believed that the so - called commodity economy was precisely market economy that allocated economic resources with the market as its foundation .
however , the dispute between planning and market regulation had not ended .
at a high - level meeting held in july 1990 , economists had a face - to - face confrontation on this question .
at that time , those who upheld market regulation were not so strong . at that meeting , i was on the frontline in defending market regulation .
after the meeting , there was a saying that " there is planning , but wu is for market regulation . " it criticized me for not agreeing with the cpc central committee .
many scholars and leaders had worked hard on this issue . deng xiaoping 's speech during his 1992 inspection tour in south china gave the final word .
the 14 th national cpc congress had set the objective for the reform of china 's economic structure .
reporter : china is never short of men and women of insight . what china needs are people who believe in truth .
more than 40 years have passed since gu zhun first put forward the reform of china 's market orientation in 1956 . china has spent a great deal of time in exploring its own way for development . it has also lost too many opportunities .
what is your comment on this ?
wu jinglian : gu zhun did not see the light of day when he passed away .
sun yefang died at the time when he was trying to find the way to carry out reform .
i am not overjoyed because some of my opinions have been accepted . what i regret is that the correct decisions are not implemented fast and well enough .
after that , the various sessions of this cpc central committee attended by party deputies required that a basic framework be completed for the development of commodity economy during the " seven five - year " plan ( 1986 - 1990 ) .
this task has not been fulfilled .
tremendous progress has been made between 1993 and now in building the market economic system . however , some of the major setups such as a modern banking system have yet to be established .
disparity between the poor and the rich due to unequal opportunities reporter : the essence of socialism is common prosperity . however , the widening gap between the rich and the poor is an irrefutable fact . this makes some people wonder if market economy is able to lead us to prosperity ?
wu jinglian : it is quite easy to choose market economy , if we conduct our analysis from the point of view of efficiency . however , people often raise a question about the relationship between efficiency and equality .
the theory on the " tradeoff between efficiency and equality " put forward by american economist arthur okun said that the more equal the distribution is , the harder it will be to increase efficiency and that the more unequal the distribution is , the easier it will be to raise efficiency .
the equality that may take the place of efficiency as mentioned by okun refers to the equality of outcome .
the equality of opportunity and efficiency generally complement with each other .
the ongoing reform of china 's economic structure is aimed at doing away with the inequalities and inefficiency that we had encountered under the planned economic system and making use of market economy to create equality of opportunity and efficiency .
it should be said that attaining equality is in keeping with market orientation reform .
the widening gap between incomes of the people of different strata and the great disparity between the rich and the poor are mainly created by inequality of opportunity , not by inequality of outcome .
for example , under the conditions of knowledge economy , those with higher education have better employment opportunities , higher salaries and better job offers . on the other hand , those with lower education or without applicable professional skills will face tremendous employment pressure than ever . their incomes are relatively lower .
in working out and implementing the forms and steps in carrying out reform , we must prevent a small number of people from using the power in their hands to take by force and encroach upon public properties and plunder the general public to fatten ourselves .
( 1 ) we must reduce the number of projects that require the procedure of examination and approval and improve such procedure so as to provide less opportunity to those who rely on their power to carry out their " rent - seeking " activities .
on the one hand , it must help those who are old , weak , ill , or disabled , while on the other hand , it must prevent a small number of people from becoming excessively rich in an effort to attain common prosperity .
wu jinglian : it is necessary to carry out specific analysis with regard to the losses of state assets .
there is indeed the problem of abusing one 's power to seek personal gain . however , this is not so in some cases .
for example , the third plenary session of the 14 th cpc central committee held in 1993 decided to adopt a system of combining old - age pension fund with individual accounts .
at that time , some people were opposed to this proposal under the pretext of causing the " losses of state assets . " as a result , we were not able to establish a system of combining the old - age pension fund with individual accounts .
in my view , there are two erroneous trends at present . some people hoist the banner of " safeguarding socialism " to attack the reform program . there are also some people who flaunt the banner of " reform " to oppose reform . resistance to reform comes from the old concepts .
some of the vested interests that run counter to reform are generated from the old planned economic system , while others are picked up from the past irregular practices in carrying out reform .
for example , the requirements for the development of a standardized securities market met resistance from some people who claimed that such requirements were aimed at " cracking down on new things . "
however , there are also some people who clearly understand the situation . they said this because it represented a form of interest .
thus , they have an antipathy to reform . these people are precisely those for whom we try to seek fairness .
reform may indeed bring us sufferings . however , not all these sufferings come from the reform program . they come from matters other than reform .
some of them are inevitable , while others are artificial .
however , many economists still believe that china 's economy is in a crucial stage .
in a speech that i made at the beginning of this year , i said that right now , we have not yet passed the major barrier in reform , because the state - owned sectors that have not gone through restructuring are still regulating the allocation of some important resources .
this is the main source of many of the economic problems that are plaguing us . however , we have made comparatively rapid progress in carrying out reform this year .
since the convocation of the 15 th national cpc congress , china has made major breakthroughs in both theory and policy .
in carrying out reform at present , we must not only solve the institutional problems created under the planned economic system but also those created in the course of relinquishing part of the power and profits to enterprises during the past 20 years .
the longer we delay our actions , the more passive we become . we must steel ourselves to basically carry out reform .
it is for this that we must quicken our pace in reorganizing the state sector of the economy . in doing so , we must advance in some areas and retreat in other areas .
second , we must solve the issue of granting national treatment to private enterprises as soon as possible .
to give private enterprises equal treatment is not an expedient measure under the condition of underdeveloped productive forces . it is a long - term policy for at least 100 years required by our basic system during the initial stage of socialism .
market economy is not a cash - on - sale transaction . it is necessary to rely on credits .
therefore , the issue of credit is a life - and - death one . right now , a credit system has not been established . the problem of credit loss is extremely serious .
fourth , we must firmly establish rules of the game that are fair and open .
we must help the ordinary people understand what kind of rights they may enjoy and ensure that they have enough means to protect their own rights and interests .
we must also ensure that the government officials may exercise their functions and powers according to law and within their legal limits , while accepting legal supervision .
striding into the 21 st century , mankind is greeting the dawn of a new millennium , and the steps of cross - strait direct " three links " are moving toward us .
in the past 21 years , there have been 2.4 million people coming and going across the strait each year , cross - strait trade has developed to $ 25 billion , and over 45,000 taiwan businessmen are investing in the mainland , with total investment exceeding $ 45 billion .
at present the volume of cross - strait electronic communications respectively ranks first and second in the external volume for each side , and over 45 million cross - strait postal items are delivered each year .
the taiwan authorities block cross - strait direct " three links " under the pretext of preserving taiwan 's " security " and " dignity " and apply the notion of " no haste , be patient " to restrict taiwan business investment in the mainland .

the promulgation and coming into force of the " law of the people 's republic of china on active - duty officers " ( referred to as " active - duty officers law " hereinafter ) is an important reform of the pla 's cadre work system and a major event in army building .
the " active - duty officers law " caused quite a big stir soon after it was promulgated .
chairman jiang raised clear requirements on the adjustment and reform of some policies and systems of the army , especially its cadre policies and systems .
based on chairman jiang 's instructions , the cmc defined the main content of the adjustment and reform of the army 's cadre policies and systems and decided to set up a leading group and concentrate resources on research and feasibility studies .
adjusting and reforming the existing system of service of officers and amending the " regulations on the service of officers on active duty " is an important part of the reform of the army 's cadre policies and systems .
the " regulations on the service of officers on active duty " were promulgated in 1988 and amended in 1994 .
also , a series of important reforms have been conducted in army building in recent years and some successful experience has been obtained through exploration in the adjustment and reform of the cadre policies and systems , some of which needs to be incorporated into the " regulations . "
starting in the first half of 1999 , the four general departments of the pla organized resources to visit organs , units , and institutions of learning for extensive investigation and research and conducted surveys and comprehensive analyses of the officer service systems of foreign armed forces .
after full feasibility studies were completed , an " amendment to the regulations on the service of officers on active duty ( draft ) " was drafted .
the " regulations " were an act formulated by the npc standing committee and a basic statute for the construction of the officer contingent and the army cadre work .
chairman jiang once profoundly pointed out : " whether or not we can win the future war and the army will change its nature depends on the personnel as the key factor .
in the new century , in order for the pla to speed up its development , meet the challenge , and perform its mission , the key is to build a contingent of high - quality officers .
secondly , it is conducive to further straightening out the relationships in respective of cadre work and make the management of the officer contingent better codified into law and more scientific . to implement the cmc 's principle of administering the army by law , the first task is to administer officers by law .
the " active - duty officers law " applies strict legal criteria to the whole process from an officer taking up his post to him leaving his post , so that all aspects of the construction of the officer contingent has a law and regulations to go by .
this marks another important step toward the codification of the process of building the officer contingent of the pla . this will make an important contribution to achieving a virtuous circle of entry , exit , promotion , and training in the construction of the officer contingent and boosting the vitality and dynamism of the officer contingent .
in the context of developing the socialist market economy , how to establish and perfect policies and systems that help arouse the enthusiasm of the broad ranks of officers is an important question that must be answered in the construction of the officer contingent .
the " active - duty officers law " has assimilated the results of reform in the area of officer benefits in recent years and laid down clear provisions for the status , benefits , and post - demobilization placement of officers in light of the unique characteristics of officers ' profession .
i. it has a distinct hallmark of the times .
it embodies the spirit of reform .
on the basis of inheriting the fine tradition of the pla 's cadre work , it attaches importance to innovation and has made certain breakthroughs in some policies and systems by drawing on , to an appropriate extent , the experience of reforming the civilian personnel system and the beneficial practices of foreign armed forces .
on the basis of the original regulations , this law incorporates some new contents and is therefore able to make rather clear stipulations on all aspects of the construction of the officer contingent .
it caters to the realities of the officer contingent and the demands of its long - term development .
first , it has adjusted and made additional regulations on the basic conditions , sources , and training of officers .
the principle , scope , subject , and conditions for officer exchange have been clarified and the challenge system for officers in respect of family connections , geographic affinity , and public function established .
these are important measures for the comprehensive training and tempering of officers and for strengthening the management of the officer contingent .
fifth , the conditions for the demobilization of officers have been adjusted and perfected .
the minimum length of service of officers in peacetime has been stipulated and the upper age limit for the active service of officers ranking at the level of principal regiment commander has been relaxed , so as to give better play to the role of talent and improve the stability of the officer contingent .
sixth , some new regulations have been made regarding the status and benefits of officers .
from the beginning of the 20 th century to the end of ww ii , the diplomatic means of regulating political relationships was replaced by military confrontation and war on a great scale . " war of dialogue " was the main character of international diplomacy in that stage .
that war involved 33 nations in europe , asia , and africa , and 1.5 billion people were sucked into the whirlpool of war which resulted in more than 30 million people being wounded or killed .
countless property was damaged . ww ii was the largest and most destructive war in history , and was started by german , japanese , and italian fascists .
sixty countries and regions were involved in the war , and more than 55 million soldiers and civilians died , and the economic losses were as high as $ 4 trillion .
ww i produced the first socialist country , the soviet union , and resulted in the independence of finland , czechoslovakia and yugoslavia .
ww ii was the most important opportunity for national independence and liberation .
after ww ii ended , the national liberation of colonized countries and semi - colonized countries spread like a storm . the old colonial system broke down . a lot of nations gained independence .
the rise of new china is one of the most important historical events .
not too long after the end of ww i and ww ii , there was serious confrontation between the two big military blocs of the east and west .
after ww i and ww ii were over , the capitalist camp that was led by america , and the socialist camp that was led by the soviet union were formed .
germany , which became split due to ww i and ww ii , was the front line of confrontation between the two big camps of the east and west . the berlin wall was the symbol of the confrontation between the east and west .
in february 1972 , us president nixon visited china after more than 20 years of isolationism .
later , many western countries strove to be first to establish diplomatic relations with china and feared lagging behind , and chinese diplomacy won a splendid victory .
nixon visiting china was one of the most important events in international diplomatic history .
after entering the 1990 s , the international situation eased further .
the dissolving of the warsaw treaty put a stop to the military confrontation of these two camps .
in recent years , along with integration of the economy and the development of globalization , the heightened importance of economic factors in international diplomacy has further increased the degree of dependence between nations .
the great changes in the international situation show that every main country in the world has to rule its own development strategy surrounded by the historic theme of peace and development , and at the same time , they have to adjust their relationships with other countries .
the new kind of relationship that eventually forms in competition and coordination among every country benefits the general international tendency of moving toward relaxation , and benefits the forming of the new international political and economic order .
the adjustment in relationships between countries is the result of the growth and decline of power , and the evolution of the new situation .
after the end of the cold war , in the moment of the new century , the adjustment of relationships between every country possess historical characteristics .
all kinds of partnerships between them and developing toward the establishment of mechanisms .
this means that the relationships among these countries tend to be stable . it is an aggressive phenomenon of the transitional period in building a new international order .
the strengthening degree of dependency between every country is the internal motivating power that causes every country to constantly adjust relationships among each other .
however , the partnerships that all countries are trying to build one after another has not , and will not likely solve the fundamental conflicts between countries . they have not even solved the military treaty relationship that was left after the cold war .
nato and the us - japan security treaty have not been eliminated and , to the contrary , they have strengthened ; nato is still looking to develop to the east ; the threat of cold war and global hegemony still exist .
even though the power to restrain us monopoly of the world is growing , and the strength of us world domination is subsequently declining , the us is still the only superpower .
looking to the future of international diplomacy in the 21 st century , because every country likes to maintain and expand its own benefits , relationships will continue the adjustment process along with competition , restraint , and cooperation with each other .
along with the coming of the new century , the readjustment of relations between various countries continues to deepen along with the development of the process of pluralization of the world and , at the same time , promotes the accelerated development of the process of pluralization .

as have been strongly testified to by facts , the recent increasingly fierce " falungong " trouble - making activities have fully revealed the cult nature of the " falungong " organization . confused " falungong " elements ' blind and ignorant , fanatical actions have profoundly demonstrated the cultic character of the cult .
i. on new year 's day of 2001 , there was joyous singing and laughing in a happy and celebrating holiday atmosphere across the motherland .
at this moment of celebration to send off the past year and welcome a new year , a few extremist and diehard " falungong " elements were gathered again at tiananmen square in beijing to create a disturbance and chaos and to disrupt social order , thereby bringing a shadow in the dawn of the new century .
their acts disrupted normal social order , and were in sharp contrast to the harmonious and serene holiday atmosphere in the square and sight - seeing people 's happy sentiments , thus causing strong indignation on the part of the broad masses of the people .
the happier the masses of the people feel at a moment , the harder the diehard " falungong " elements will try to create a disturbance . this has become a major characteristic of the " falungong " cult organization .
for several days in late december of last year , several hundred diehard " falungong " elements would engage in trouble - making activities each day in tiananmen square .
when police officers on duty proceeded to stop " falungong " followers from carrying out illegal acts or to forcibly remove the diehard elements among them , these people openly obstructed and resisted acts to enforce the law .
at 11:00 am on 1 january last year , police officers on duty brought nine " falungong " troublemakers onto a vehicle , so as to carry them away from the square ; then , one " falungong " follower opened the vehicle window to throw flyers and was stopped by a police officer in a timely way .
while continually instigating trouble - making on the part of the confused elements , the " falungong " cult organization has also manufactured and fabricated large amounts of propaganda material to attack the chinese government 's handling of the " falungong " cult issue and has worked to extensively spread such material through illegal channels .
shandong province 's public security agency discovered a secret printing establishment , which had illegally printed over 200,000 pieces of " falungong " propaganda material , spreading and mailing such material to 10 local towns and townships .
the public security agency of zhangjiakou city , hebei province , intercepted " falungong " followers trying to release carrier pigeons at tiananmen square , seizing 16 carrier pigeons carrying illegal " falungong " propaganda banners .
on the evening of that day , backbone " falungong " elements in macao also talked to diehard " falungong " elements in hong kong by phone , asking them to take 30 " falungong " followers to macao so as to perform " exercises " there .
as the macao police adopted preventive measures , overseas and hong kong backbone " falungong " cult followers were refused entry .
on the afternoon of 19 december , a dozen or so " falungong " elements suddenly got together at tongma square and attempted to perform public " exercises , " trying to create an impact .
on the morning of 20 december , over 20 macao " falungong " followers performed collective " exercises " in yayonghe park , with a few individuals even attempting to fly banners attacking national leaders .
some diehard " falungong " elements also tried to get informed of the route that the central delegation would travel in macao . wearing yellow " exercise jerseys " underneath and hiding in crowds , they attempted to stage demonstrations by taking off their outer garments when the central delegation would pass by .
after the trouble - making plan for macao failed , li hongzhi and the " falungong " organization did not give up .
they described the coming turn of the century as the opportunity for the " ultimate fulfillment " and stepped up efforts to organize " falungong " elements ' large - scale concentrated cult activities in the taiwan , hong kong , and macao regions , in an attempt to create a momentum and to pressure the chinese government .
since mid - december of last year , " falungong " organizations outside the country have , for consecutive days , bought newspaper pages to carry " falungong " propaganda articles in taiwan , hong kong , and other places , in an effort to create a momentum .
as many facts have demonstrated , the " falungong " cult organization 's recent frequent activities and rampant trouble - making have entirely been the result of li hongzhi 's single - handed instigation and direction .
he attended the so - called " seminar to exchange understandings " and " falun law seminar " held in san francisco , the united states , and the north american great lakes region on 21 october and 9 december , respectively .
the fundamental reason why the " falungong " cult organization 's recent trouble - making activities have been so rampant has been the all - out support from some western anti - china forces and such hostile forces as the " taiwan independence " and " democracy movement " forces .
they have also established a for - profit television production center and started a new command and action plan , and intend to change distributed " falungong " propaganda material from being in a written form into being in the forms of compact discs and soft disks .
some agencies of a country have clearly indicated the intention to use more resources for supporting " falungong , " providing it with special communication and liaison safeguards , and have even explicitly indicated the intention to provide security for li hongzhi 's residence and travel [ the replacement version omits the preceding sentence ] .
the " falungong " cult organization has become increasingly open in colluding with forces within and outside the country , such as " taiwan independence " and " democracy movement " forces .
li hongzhi explicitly suggested that " it is necessary to join forces with other people and foreigners . "
the " falungong " organization has also provided the " hong kong information center for human rights and democracy movement " with activity funds and has asked the head of that organization to serve as its public spokesperson .
on 23 december , lu hsiu - lien , notorious for fanatically advocating " taiwan independence , " also attended the " 2000 asia - pacific seminar to exchange understandings on the great law of falun , " and expressed the wish that " falungong " elements would " be successful in both intellectual and physical cultivation . "
efforts to punish the " falungong " cult according to law and to combat its illegal and criminal activities embody the authority of the law of the state and serve to maintain normal social order , and are thus in accord with the wishes of the broad masses of the people .
those western anti - china forces which still hold illusions about li hongzhi and his " falungong " cult organization , considering them an " important force " for harassing , infiltrating , and subverting china , should not wrongly judge the situation .

guangzhou , 5 jan (zxs) - - a certain bomber aviation regiment under the command of the guangzhou military region 's [ mr ] air force unit recently successfully conducted a long - distance combat flight exercise .
the air force officers and men trained in the unfamiliar and complicated air space under complicated meteorological conditions . after nearly 10 hours of long - distance flight and maneuvering , all the regiment 's aircraft reached pre - determined target zones on schedule and successfully completed their missions by bombing the targets with great precision .
at this important historical moment , the cpc central committee and the state council held a central conference on rural work to study and plan agricultural and rural work for the beginning of the new century .
the conference relayed general secretary jiang zemin 's important instruction on successfully carrying out agricultural and rural work and stressed that in the new century , we must unremittingly solidify and strengthen the agricultural foundation and not relax our efforts even for a moment .
this fully reflects the party central committee 's strategic plan to continue strengthening agriculture and place agriculture on the top of our economic work .
to a large country with a huge population like china , this is an amazing historical progress .
thanks to the important and distinguished contributions of agriculture , china has an excellent situation of reform and opening up today , its national economy witnesses sustained and rapid development , and more than 1 billion chinese people are marching toward a comfortably well - off life without worrying about food or clothing .
in the new century , china will begin to implement the third step of its strategic plan to build a comfortably well - off society in an all - round way and to accelerate the modernization process .
the next five to 10 years is a crucial period serving as a link between past and present , a period for laying the foundation . whether china 's economic structure can be readjusted smoothly and the national economy can develop faster and more successfully , to a great extent , hinges on whether the agricultural foundation is strong .
the issues of agriculture , the countryside , and the peasants always have a bearing on the overall national economic and social development .
the enormous losses suffered by agriculture as a result of flood and drought disasters in recent years have made it clear that our agriculture 's ability against natural disasters is not very strong .
after agricultural development enters the new stage , agricultural production will be subject to the double constraints of resources and market , and this will increase the market risk .
against the backdrop of economic globalization , china 's agriculture will face even greater pressure of competition .
we must earnestly increase the state 's support of agriculture and the construction of a protective system .
to strengthen the agricultural foundation , we must make every attempt to increase the peasants ' income .
increasing the peasants ' income is the basic goal of the strategic restructuring of agriculture , although it is a prominent contradiction at present .
without a higher income , peasants will cut down their investment in agriculture . as a result , the agricultural foundation will be shaken , and the current supply and demand situation of agricultural products will likely be reversed .
without a higher income , peasants will reduce their consumption expenditures , the rural market will remain stagnated , and the good macroeconomic situation will be difficult to maintain .
we can also increase the peasants ' income by reducing their burden .
we must actively advance the reform of the rural tax and fee systems to earnestly reduce the peasants ' burden .
china 's agricultural and rural economic development is at an important turning point . china 's agriculture is in a phase where we must make painstaking efforts to scale the heights and where we see great hopes .

the granting of npr eliminated from future sino - u.s. relations , including economic and trade relations , one factor that may give rise to conflicts , disputes , and disruptions . as such it will have positive effects on the steady and healthy development of bilateral relations .

as the " third world " countries had more or less the same historical experience , they became the principal force against colonialism , imperialism , and hegemonism and developed a political confrontation with the great powers of the north .
this has determined that the relationship between north and south has a dual character , namely , confrontation and cooperation .
in the past decades , the developing countries have consistently struggled to shake off poverty and achieve economic independence . some have succeeded , while others failed .
a number of countries have risen to prominence . taken as a whole , however , the gap between rich north and poor south has widened instead of narrowing .
the united nations has made a resolution , demanding that rich countries devote 0.75 percent of their total output value to aiding poor countries .
even though this does not mean that they should repay their historical debts , it is still based on their due responsibility which has won worldwide recognition .
in the past few years , however , with the exception of a small number of north european countries in the scandinavian region , the official aid provided by other rich countries accounted for only an average of about 0.25 percent of their total output value .
the 1994 foreign aid of the united states , the no. 1 economic power in the world , was $ 12.5 billion , accounting for only 0.2 percent of its total output value that year , which was $ 6.7 trillion .
for some years it has appropriated nearly 0.7 percent of its total output value for foreign aid , most of which has gone to the french - speaking countries in west africa .
of the 48 most impoverished countries in the world , 33 are in africa . consequently , there was an appeal long ago that " africa needs the world . "
in 1996 the united nations development program put forward another appeal , " the world also needs africa . " it pointed out that as the world today has become smaller , the development of the world will be incomplete without africa 's development .
world bank president james wolfensohn recently issued another warning : " the serious imbalance of wealth poses a threat " and " an unjust world is a dangerous one . "
therefore , it can be said that " the world needs africa , " or the argument that the world needs the development of the impoverished regions , is an important strategic idea facing world development in the 21 st century .
this argument must have made it clear to rich nations that helping impoverished countries also means helping themselves and the world .
under the great tide of economic globalization , the rich nations are also aware that the economies of all countries are interrelated and that the backwardness and turmoil of impoverished countries are detrimental to all and , therefore , they have started adjusting their policies toward the south .
in 1999 the rich nations ' aid to the south was $ 51.5 billion , an increase of 8.9 percent over the previous year .
in june of the same year , seven western industrialized nations reached a consensus on reducing or exempting from parts of the $ 2.5 trillion debts of the developing countries .
it is regrettable that the reduction of or exemption from debts was still linked to " human rights conditions " and the degree of democratization .
we can thus see the harassment of values to north - south relations .
in march 1998 , us president bill clinton visited africa to build " a new us - african partnership " for the 21 st century .
not content to lag behind , the eu has stepped up its trade activities in africa and , at the same time , established a mechanism for dialogue and cooperation with asia and latin america .
britain has introduced a " trade , investment , and development " program for africa to increase its economic and trade ties with member countries of the british commonwealth .
in 1998 japan hosted the second international conference on african development in tokyo and decided to provide $ 776 million in aid to africa .
it is impossible for all countries to attain even development , and uneven development is absolute .
the problem now is that not only has the gap between north and south widened , but the gap between south and south has also been apparent . this is especially conspicuous between the east asian and south asian regions and between the regions south of the african sahara .
this shows that if poor countries want to jump on the bandwagon of the world development , they cannot do without outside support and assistance , but the decisive factor is themselves , the south itself , and the nations and countries themselves .
this may well be another awakening for the developing countries .

hong kong , 7 jan (zxs) - - in recent days , many members of the " legislative yuan " and some people of ocean shipping and aviation circles in taiwan visited beijing , shanghai , and other places to exchange opinions with the relevant mainland quarters on the question of " three links . "
to this end , gaoxiong ( kaohsiung ) port , taizhong ( taichung ) port , taibei ( taipei ) airport , and gaoxiong airport , as well as a number of aviation and shipping companies , are vigorously making preparations for direct " three links " between the two shores .
as a person in taiwan aviation circles pointed out , if there is direct flight or route between the two shores , it will bring taiwan 30 billion new taiwan dollars in benefits annually .
as is known to all , establishing " three links " between the two sides of the strait has always been a consistent stand of the mainland of china .
just as vice premier qian qichen said when he met with members of the taiwan " legislative yuan " a few days ago , the mainland has called for " three links " between the two shores for more than 20 years and have made a lot of practical preparations to this end .
it can thus be seen that everything else is ready for the " three links " between the two sides of the strait , and that all that is needed is fair wind .
recently , under the pressure of public opinion , the taiwan authorities had to allow the so - called " mini - three links " between jinmen and xiamen and between mazu and mawei .
facts have proven that the establishment of comprehensive " three links " and direct , two - way exchanges between the two sides of the strait is not only the intrinsic needs of economic development in taiwan 's society but also the inevitable trend of development in cross - strait ties .
as cross - strait economic , commercial , and cultural exchanges are growing day by day and , as china will soon join the wto , the taiwan authorities ' ban on the " three links , " as well as their " no haste , be patient " policy , will eventually be broken thoroughly .

in the steering room , young helmsman zhang haizhen stood on the operation platform as steadfastly as a nail .
several sudden stormy waves plunged the ship 's bow into the water , and waves over 10 meters high surged over the steering room , which was 15 meters above the sea level . succumbing to the storm , zhang haizhen began to vomit , but he still stuck to his post .
in the steering room , noise exceeded 100 decibels , and the temperature was as high as 50 degrees centigrade . this plus the pungent odor of oil made everyone sick .
yu jiankang , a veteran crewman who had worked in the ship for 15 years , vomited so hard that he had his bile out , but he still conducted patrol persistently .
it is difficult to imagine who else dared to challenge the disastrous big sea , except the crew who shouldered noble missions and sacred responsibilities .
latest weather report right after the tense 24 - hour training said there would be greater storms in the coming few days . still more rigorous tests were waiting for the crew of the " yuanwang no. 4 " ship .

in recent years , china has made fairly significant progress in relations with several big powers of the world .
in particular , the sino - russian strategic partnership has become closer since putin assumed the russian presidency .
according to a beijing source , the drafting of a sino - russian friendly cooperative treaty began early this month .
the treaty includes the stipulations that when either china or russia experiences military aggression , the other signatory state to the treaty should provide political , economic , and military support at its request .
through consultation , china and russia decided that a friendly cooperative treaty should be drafted first by government and military officials at the vice - ministerial level before being finalized through consultation by chinese and russian officials at the vice - premier level .
on the eve of drafting the friendly cooperative treaty , jiang zemin and putin talked on a telephone hotline .
the treaty will stress the need to oppose international hegemonism , power politics , and military blocs ' military invasion and blackmail against sovereign states . it will advocate the multipolarity of the world and joint efforts to safeguard world peace .
cooperative treaty to be signed this fall the treaty will put emphasis on safeguarding state sovereignty and territorial integrity and on opposing military intervention by foreign military blocs and national separatism .
when a signatory state to the treaty experiences military aggression , the other signatory state should , at its request , provide political , economic , and military support and launch joint attacks against the invading forces .
according to a beijing expert on sino - russian relations , the drafting of the sino - russian friendly cooperative treaty , if it proceeds smoothly , is expected to be signed this fall .
the signing of the treaty is precisely an embodiment of the development of the sino - russian strategic cooperative partnership . it signifies the entry of sino - russian relations into a new stage in the early 21 st century .
china lags behind the united states in national defense modernization . there are static gaps caused by the different starting time of their development . there are also dynamic gaps caused by their different growth rate and acceleration rate .
in air force and naval armament , china has successively developed and produced guided missile destroyers , high - speed gunboats , nuclear submarines , supersonic fighters , bombers , attackers , transports , helicopters , and various ship - based and air - launched missiles .
the chinese people 's liberation army [ pla ] is beginning to become an integral and powerful modern combined - arms military force displaying its brand - new majestic appearance in the world military arena .
us armed forces have completely eliminated their first - generation armament . the ratio of third - generation main armament is more than 90 percent in us navy and air force and 52 percent in us army . they are also actively developing fourth - generation and fifth - generation armament .
" gaps " also exist between chinese officers and men and their counterparts in advanced countries in terms of level of education .
for instance , more than 98 percent of us military officers have a college education background , more than one third of them hold the master 's degree , and 7.7 percent of them have the doctor 's degree .
generally speaking , china 's military organizational structure is still not yet adapted to the requirements of modern military development ; and in particular , some deep - seated structural problems have not yet been thoroughly solved .
experience through these years has shown that the most fundamental thing is to keep on using the method of development to solve the problems on the road of advancement .
the wheels of development are rolling .
as the human race stepped into the 21 st century , china inspired another gasp of admiration from the world .
in the past five years , this country that is in the midst of advancing socialist modernization not only reined in the unbridled horse of inflation , but also curbed the trend of deflation . china accomplished the unusual feat of yearly economic growth of eight percent accompanied by improvement of quality and efficiency of economic growth .
speed up the change of functions , let the market drive development forward in march 1998 , the first meeting of the ninth national congress discussed and passed the plan for structural reform of the state council , deciding to reduce the number of departments and committees from the original 40 to 29 .
this action brought about a huge reaction in china and abroad . foreign press considered this to be a revolution of historical significance .
in this structural reform , one of the notable measures is the state planning council changing its name to the state development planning council .
while downsizing bureaus , decreasing the number of personnel , and sorting our functions , the state planning council is concentrating on promoting functional changes in four areas : one is changing the emphasis from activities of microeconomic intervention to macroeconomic adjustment and control .
four is changing from excessive administrative applications and approvals to the creating of a market environment characterized by fair competition .
state planning council vice director wang chunzheng explained that he was deeply moved by the changes of the last few years .
the categories and scopes of the products whose prices are determined by the government have been reduced , and the prices of commercial items and services are mainly determined by the supply and demand of the market .
now we have set up a national storage system . when the market price of cotton goes up , the state puts cotton out for sale . this can effectively adjust market supply and demand . another example is the state planning commission 's sponsorship of the drafting of the request for proposal law .
a look at the annals of china 's economic development since 1998 reveals that in many policies and actions that affect the whole situation , the new development planning committee has played an important role .
in 1998 , the continual spread of the financial crisis in asia piqued the vigilance of the party and the state council .
on the eve of spring festival that year , leading cadres of the state council urgently gathered together departments related to the state planning commission for a meeting to study possible solutions to the crisis .
by the first third of june , they proposed more than 140 billion yuan of loans to banks , ultimately deciding to start work on 72 new large - and mid - scale projects with a total investment of 124.5 billion yuan .
perhaps the readers did not know that comrades from many departments did a lot of very effective work in order to put the central committee 's correct policy into practice to achieve this result .
the state planning commission purposefully implements and enforces all of the central committee macroeconomic adjustment policy decisions to the letter , demanding real accomplishments and true results .
in recent years , the central committee has addressed the problems of overproduction and constant lowering of prices in china . in order to curb the trend of deflation , the central committee authoritatively made major policy decisions that included increasing domestic demand , the implementing positive fiscal policy , and stable and healthy currency policy studies .
in deciding policy for these items , they utilized methods of joint management and collective appraisal . this sped up the progress of the work , ensured that policy - making was scientific , and prevented duplicate construction .
with related departments , the state planning commission studied and then suggested a series of measures to implement the central committee policies .
during the ninth five - year plan , china 's economy sustained its rapid , healthy development , and various social causes made progress on all fronts .
the per capita gnp income reached more than 800 $ us in 2000 , and foreign trade imports and exports looked to top 450 billion $ us . for the most part , people lived fairly well to do lives .
speeding up development requires expansive goals , clear tasks , workable procedures and scientific policy - making .

for most of taiwan 's past 100 years , it has been separated or estranged from the mainland and under japanese colonial rule for 50 of those years .
from a strategic standpoint , taiwan was japan 's bridgehead for its expansion into southeast asia during the first 50 years . from an economic standpoint , taiwan was japan 's colony .
in the 50 years since the end of the second world war , scars from japan 's era of colonial rule have deeply affected taiwan 's social consciousness and economic system .
in its relations with the rest of the world , taiwan 's trade with japan has become one of its most important relations .
for security during the cold war , japan relied on " protection " provided by the us - japanese alliance while continually emphasizing that , as taiwan 's neighbor , the cross - strait situation directly affects stability in northeast asia and japan 's " security . "
in addition , the shifts in political ecology , which appear in taiwanese society and relates to japanese elements of " taiwan self - reliance " and " taiwan localization , " provided an opportunity for change among taiwan - japanese relations which drifted during the cold war .
starting in 1993 after lee teng - hui took power , taiwan also gradually " stopped being discreet " and started to promote " expansion of great nation relations " as the center of their " pragmatic diplomacy , " with japan as its focal point .
beginning in 1995 , numerous taiwanese political players met with " heavyweights " in japanese political circles . pro - taiwan forces in japan once tried to invite lee teng - hui to visit japan .
since 1997 , the democratic progressive party (dpp) leader has visited japan on several occasions and " explored asia - pacific security issues " with japanese defense agency personnel .
although japan maintains limited involvement in taiwan issues , overall , japan - taiwanese high - level meetings have crossed the boundary that only civilian and unofficial personnel are to attend .
in july 1999 , taiwan 's lee teng - hui trotted out the " two states theory . "
on 13 july , a us spokesperson issued a statement on the us position toward the " one - china " principle .
on the same day , a japanese spokesperson reiterated the 1972 joint statement between china and japan and the 1978 peace treaty between the two countries . the statement and treaty contained passages on the " one - china " principle , " regional relations , " and " unification through peaceful means . "
by clarifying its basic position on security issues , japan , on one hand , remained consistent with the us strategy and , on the other hand , continued to use civilians to maintain open channels in relations with taiwan .
however , upon careful observation , the tension in the cross - strait situation is becoming the point of integration for japan 's security interests .
after the cold war , under the pretext of a cross - strait crisis , japan openly fired two reconnaissance satellites right under the nose of the us . this created the conditions necessary for military intelligence exchanges between japan and taiwan .
from taiwan 's perspective , inciting the " china threat theory " is not simply pandering to japan , but rather seizing the opportunity to pursue " taiwan independence " from a " security " standpoint and " strengthened cooperation " with japan .
the standoff between the public and the government over the " fourth nuclear power plant " had just ended when the " three - party opposition alliance " formed bent on " impeaching the president . "
afterward , taiwan 's stock market plunged .
attempts to maintain continuous development of taiwan 's economy have been of utmost urgency .

on the other hand , he spoke ambiguously in his new year 's address about " relying on the republic of china 's ' constitution ' " and " one china " is essentially " not a problem . "
china 's economic development and its prospects after gaining admission to wto have created the groundless notion of a " threat . "
the price they will pay is severely damaging china 's national sovereignty and territorial integrity and the calm situation in the taiwan strait .
the taiwan strait is innocent , so why conceal the shame ? glancing back on world history , nationalities and nations exist forever . no nation that upholds unification and opposes splittism will tolerate and abet evil .
what needs asking is : who exactly is creating the tense situation and who exactly constitutes a threat to people on both sides of the strait ?

" at present , the ' mini three links ' impose too many restrictions on the people . they are not normal links . originally we have facilitated indirect links through hong kong . now the current ' mini three links ' are still indirect .

since december 2000 , taiwan authorities continually issued statements : the " mini three links " embody peace and goodwill . they must be carried out before the direct " three links . " they even said : without the " mini three links , " the direct " three links " cannot be facilitated .
in contrast , taiwan industrialists and businessmen have been very calm and expressed their views realistically .

on 4 - 8 january , in the company of municipal party secretary he guoqiang and mayor bao xuding of chongqing , zhu rongji conducted investigations on issues concerning agriculture and rural development , the state enterprise reform , and the social security system .
he also inspected the southwest aluminum industrial ( group ) company ltd. , and called a discussion meeting for the responsible persons of some state enterprises .
during the inspection , he heard work reports respectively submitted by the municipal party committee and the municipal government of chongqing , and fully reaffirmed the remarkable results that chongqing had achieved in all aspects of its work in recent years .
this is a clear statement of both the strategic plan and the requirements that the party central committee has drawn up for the work of continuously strengthening agriculture in the new century , which we must put into effect with firm and effective measures .
particularly , we should center our efforts around the need for strengthening the role of agriculture as a foundation and for increasing the income of peasants , and vigorously make strategic readjustments to the country 's agricultural structure .
we should persistently gear ourselves to the demands of the market , rely on scientific and technological advances , give full play to the relative advantages of different regions in agriculture , rationalize the mix of crop cultivation as well as the industrial structure in rural areas , and introduce an industrialized management for agriculture .
we should deepen the reform of the grain circulation system , persist in the practice of purchasing surplus grain from peasants without limits at a protective price , and tighten control over the grain purchase market according to the law .
we should reform the system of rural taxes and fees , reduce the burdens of our peasants once and for all , and let our peasants recuperate and build up strength .
we should deepen the rural financial reform , and improve financial services in rural areas .
at the same time , however , we should also see clearly that all of these are just phasic results , and the foundation of our work in this respect is still not firm enough .
a task of the first importance for this year 's social security work is to implement the letter of the existing policies and measures of the central authorities , and see to a solid implementation of " two ensure 's , " zhu rongji stressed .
we must ensure that both the basic subsistence allowances for laid - off workers of state enterprises and the old - age pension for retired workers are issued on time and in full amount , and any delay beyond the same year is by no means allowed .
he indicated : while ensuring a good job in providing social security services , we must also open up new avenues of employment , and take active steps to boost the reemployment of laid - off workers .
road construction , environmental protection and rectification , the planting of trees and grass , and community services can all provide a host of employment opportunities ; while the development of labor - intensive industries and non - public - owned enterprises can also create a large number of work posts .
therefore , we should guide the laid - off workers to change their concept on employment , and encourage them to seek employment through the labor market .
the municipality should persistently proceed with its work from the reality , abide itself by the objective law , lay stress on achieving practical results , and give full play to its geographic advantage as well as its economic fanning and leading roles as an extraordinarily large city .
chongqing has achieved remarkable results ever since it became a municipality ; and judging by the new vigor showed by some of the city 's enterprises as well as the changes that have taken place in the look of the city , we can see that chongqing 's modernization building does have bright prospects .
we should conscientiously carry out policies that are designed to encourage local residents to move to and resettle in other places ; and see to it that migrants are willing to move out , have ease of mind , and can enjoy a better life than before .
by actively taking in and resettling the migrants , the provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities involved have also made their due contribution to the construction of the three gorges project .
we should practice strict economy , combat luxury and waste , and strictly forbid the malpractice of extravagant eating and drinking paid by public funds .
meanwhile , we should tighten control over production safety in real terms , and eliminate all the hidden troubles that may lead to accidents of various kinds .
we should reinforce the comprehensive management of social security , and go all out to maintain the stability of our society .

the research and development of the spaceship and the system for protecting the survival of astronauts is a highly comprehensive science and technology systematic project that reflects the latest progress of china 's metallurgical industry , new materials industry , information industry , biochemical industry , and nanotechnology .
these experiments cannot be done on earth and breakthroughs can only be made in space .

with the curtain of the 21 st century slowly opening , the incoming tide of economic globalization is surging into every corner of the world . economic globalization is sure to have widespread and profound effects on tomorrow 's world , including the economic , social , cultural , and military spheres .
the term " economic globalization " refers to the trend in which capital , goods , technology , labor , services , and information transcend markets , and boundaries between countries expand , flow , and are configured on a worldwide scale .
the overall effect of economic globalization on the entire world and all of humanity is that it brings unprecedented , excellent opportunities for development , but it also brings new problems and challenges .
peace at that time was " the peace of nuclear terror . "
the development of economic globalization changed this perilous state in which humanity lived .
it must be said that these are favorable factors which promote peace and suppress war .
economic globalization is not " universal harmony in the world . "
one is that it promotes mutual dependence among the economies of various countries . the other is that it will intensify economic competition among countries , and produce economic friction and conflicts of interest . the conflicts of interest may not only give rise to economic and political turbulence , they may also lead to wars .
this certainly constitutes a threat to the military security of numerous developing countries .
economic globalization increases the risk to the operation of the economies of various countries . it poses new challenges in particular to the economic sovereignty and security interests of developing countries which are in a weak position .
the rules of world economics and trade by which globalization is to be achieved are based on the old international economic and political order , formulated mainly with the interests of the developed countries in mind . for the developing countries , the " rules of the game " are unfair .
in the course of economic globalization , the big western countries will rush to seize the high ground in economics , science and technology , trade , and competition , and do all they can to gain the advantage in the " new order " of globalization .
we must also note that , along with advances in science and technology and the development of the information superhighway , humanity has entered a new era of information networks .
while all - pervasive information networks bring convenience to economic development , without doubt they also reach down to bury hidden dangers for the world 's military security .
information warfare now threatens people 's livelihoods and their survival with a completely new form of war . it is especially a threat to the sovereignty and security of developing countries .
along with progress in economic globalization , ill - defined , destabilizing factors will clearly increase in number . developing countries must maintain a high degree of vigilance , prepare in peace for times of danger , pursue interests while avoiding risk , and gain the initiative in the course of economic globalization .

the air force showed to the news media for the first time its mysterious " chien - an project " underground fighter aircraft hangars on its t ' aitung base yesterday [ 10 january ] .
the strategic purpose of the project is to accommodate the fighter units from western taiwan with shelter in wartime so as to preserve the air force combat strength , facilitate gradual deployment of military strength to battlefield , and extend the time of defense operations while seeking international assistance .
the tunnels , built under granite , are capable of withstanding direct hits by conventional missiles and strong earthquake of magnitude 6 and above .
to maintain serviceability of the living and combat facilities in the tunnel , both the air crew and the ground crew are required to work one 24 - hour shift a month in the tunnel and even cooking is conducted underground on that day .
