kampala , 17 jan ( xinhua ) - - chinese vice president hu jintao , who is currently visiting uganda , had talks with ugandan vice president kazibwe on 17 january .
hu jintao said : there is traditional friendship between china and uganda .
china and uganda also have identical views on many issues such as human rights , cracking down on cults , and supporting the abm treaty , and the two countries have always closely cooperated and supported each other .
we feel satisfied with the development of our bilateral relations .
the friendly exchanges and cooperation over 38 years between china and uganda show that sino - ugandan relations built on the five principles of peaceful coexistence have powerful vitality and broad development prospects .
promoting this traditional friendship and deepening bilateral cooperation is the common aspiration of china and uganda , and also accords with the fundamental interests of the two countries .
the chinese government attaches very great importance to developing ties of friendly cooperation with uganda , and in order to help uganda to develop its national economy , the chinese government has decided to waive part of uganda 's time - expired debts .
kazibwe warmly welcomed hu jintao and his party on their visit to uganda .
she said , uganda and china have maintained close and friendly ties of cooperation over many years , thus expressing the strong aspirations of the peoples of the two countries to develop uganda - china friendship .
kazibwe reiterated that uganda resolutely practices a one china policy and recognizes the prc government as the sole legitimate government representing china .
kazibwe highly appreciated and thanked china for its support for the entire cause of development in africa .
she said , the " china - africa forum - - beijing 2000 ministerial conference " held at china 's advocacy last year was a specific expression of china 's active support for construction in the countries of africa .
the people of uganda particularly thank china for reducing or waiving african countries ' debts , and believe that this move will play a positive role in promoting friendship between africa and china .
uganda is ready to comprehensively strengthen friendly cooperation with china in the new century , and to actively explore the opening up of new fields for mutually beneficial bilateral cooperation .
uganda hopes in particular that more chinese enterprises will come to uganda in the future to launch economic and trade cooperation .
the two sides exchanged views in particular on cracking down on cults .
the " falungong " cult has emerged in china in recent years .
the " falungong " organization has also seriously violated the law by obtaining large sums of money under false pretences , and besieging government organs and media units , thus causing serious disruption in social and public order ; it has become an antihuman , antisocial , and antiscientific cult .
these moves of the chinese government are upheld and supported by the masses throughout china .
kazibwe thanked hu jintao for his introduction of the situation regarding the " falungong " cult . she agreed with hu jintao 's thorough analysis of the cult issue , and held that china and uganda can learn from and refer to each other in cracking down on cults and establish cooperative relations in this respect .
the two sides also exchanged views on the political and economic situation in africa .
hu jintao said : the chinese government has always attached importance to africa ; strengthening and developing ties of friendship and cooperation with african countries has always been an important component of china 's peaceful foreign policy of acting independently and keeping the initiative in its own hands .
hu jintao emphatically pointed out in conclusion : in order to strengthen sino - african solidarity and cooperation and promote the establishment of a fair and rational new political and economic order , china and africa convened the " china - africa cooperation forum - - beijing 2000 ministerial meeting " in beijing last october .
this meeting was a complete success , thanks to the common efforts and close cooperation of china and africa , and built a good framework for the further development of sino - african ties in the new century .
china attaches extremely great importance to implementing the results of this forum , and has set up a follow - up action committee with the participation of 21 ministries and commissions , which has already started specific implementation on various issues such as reducing or waiving debt .
the main members of hu jintao 's party attended the meeting , along with the ugandan ministers of foreign affairs , finance , planning and economic cooperation , tourism and trade , education and sports , labor and social development , public health , and energy .
after the meeting , hu jintao and kazibwe attended a signing ceremony .
in the evening kazibwe gave a banquet to welcome hu jintao and his party to uganda .
the hong kong special administrative region (hksar) government has advanced the legal grounds and made suggestions to the court of final appeal to seek an interpretation of the relevant provisions of the basic law from the standing committee of the national people 's congress (npc) .
this is an indication showing that the hksar government has matured and made progress in handling such problems . the way of handling matters like this conforms to the pertinent stipulations of the basic law and has embodied the spirit of safeguarding the judicial independence in hong kong .
the move will avoid repeating the tremor that arose from the request of the sar government to the npc standing committee for an " interpretation of the law " in june 1999 .
this argument is ungrounded .
article 158 of the basic law provides in black and white as below : " the power of interpretation of this law shall be vested in the standing committee of the national people 's congress .
in fact , there are thousands upon thousands of cases similar to this , so if the boy is granted the right of abode , any mainland couple coming to hong kong with a round - trip permit or even illegally stealing into hong kong can obtain the right of abode for giving birth to a child .
for this reason , the mainland departments concerned will by no means sit by idly and remain indifferent .
therefore , the case involving the mainland must be interpreted by the npc in accordance with the provisions of the basic law .
under such circumstances , it is imperative to ask for an interpretation in accordance with the provisions of the basic law .
since the request of the court of final appeal for an interpretation is well grounded , then , it is perfectly logical , reasonable , and rightful for the sar government to advance the legal grounds and make relevant suggestions to the court of final appeal to ask for an " interpretation of the law . "
according to these two - point principle , the high court 's decision to grant the right of abode to chuang feng - yuan a few days ago has roused the queries of personalities from various social sectors .
bangalore , 17 jan - - national people 's congress standing committee chairman li peng 's official visit to india , made by invitation , just after the bells have rung in the new century , has opened a new chapter in china 's diplomacy of good neighborliness with its periphery in the new century .
during the visit chairman li peng was given a warm , ceremonious , and high - standard welcome and reception by the indian parliament , government , and people .
he also met a wide range of leaders of indian parliamentary parties and groups , inspected india 's hi - tech industries , and gained a thorough knowledge of the state of development of india 's economy and science and technology and its outstanding cultural heritage .
he made an important speech in new delhi entitled " enhance understanding , develop friendship , and strengthen cooperation , " and was also interviewed by the indian media , during which he expounded china 's views on major international affairs and its policy on india .
developing an enduringly stable relationship of good neighborliness and friendship with india is china 's sincere aspiration and unswerving guideline , and is also an important aspect of china 's foreign policy of peace on the periphery .
understanding and trust are the common needs of the people of the two countries , friendship and cooperation are the inevitable development of history , and promoting understanding and mutual trust is the overriding task in developing our bilateral relations .
he also solemnly reiterated that china is ready to build a constructive cooperative partnership with india ; far from posing a threat to each other , the two countries should become good neighbors and good friends .
during the visit , in a frank and friendly atmosphere , chairman li peng and indian leaders discussed spheres and ways of improving and developing bilateral relations and highlighted the strong desires of both countries for good neighborliness and friendly cooperation .
they should make efforts together to properly resolve through peaceful consultation certain differences and problems between them that have not yet been resolved ; this is an important piece of information relayed by these summit talks .
china and india are the two largest developing countries and have common interests in many fields ; the two countries ' basic national conditions are similar , both face the tasks of developing their national economy and improving living standards , and they also have a broad consensus regarding preserving world peace and promoting common development .
chairman li peng emphasized many times that china and india have more points in common than differences , and they have a broad space for cooperation in the international arena .
the countries only have reasons to be friends , and there is no justification for noncooperation .
this visit fully embodied the unique role of friendly exchanges in the parliamentary sphere in promoting state relations .
he said , although the political systems and forms of democracy in china and india differ , the two parliaments can still carry out mutual exchanges and refer to each other .
chairman li peng 's suggestions on strengthening friendly exchanges between the two parliaments met a positive response from the indian side .

india takes land - to - land missiles as the dominant factor of its strategic missiles and they are missile systems developed by india since the 1980 s .
at present , india has successfully developed a series of short - , medium - and long - range missiles . the " prithvi " missile is a short - range missile series developed by india on its own . its range is 150 - 350 km and it can carry a conventional or a nuclear warhead .
at present , india is stepping up the research and development of the " agni - iii , " a missile with a medium or long range of 2,500 - 3,000 km .
the development of a long - range missile exceeding 5,000 km is also included in its research and development plan .
besides , with the assistance of russia , india is stepping up the research and development of nuclear - powered submarines and the " sagrika " cruise missile , which is to be launched by a submarine .
on the basis of developing its missile nuclear weapons , india has planned to have initially developed its strategic deterrence capacity consisting of land - based missiles , the strategic bombers and air - to - land missiles of the air force , and the missiles launched by submarines of the navy , in the early 21 st century .

at present , the contradictions in the ideological and cultural field have much closer relations with the international political struggle . the appearance of a complicated situation in the ideological field of a nation is always linked to a profound international background .

marxism holds that ideology and culture reflect certain socioeconomic and political trends , and also reflect the needs and tendencies of certain classes , strata , and interest groups in society .
we need to apply the scientific world outlook and methodology of marxism to analyze and distinguish these things .
only thus can we continuously enhance our political sensibility and distinguishing power , clearly draw a line of demarcation between the right and the wrong on major principled issues , and firmly hold a favorable position in the struggle in the ideological field .
practice has showed that reform and opening up represents the only path for strengthening our nation and the correct option for realizing our national regeneration .

in the process of opening up to the outside world , we must persistently learn from and absorb all good achievements of human civilization , and at the same time , also resolutely resist the corrosive influence of the decadent ideologies and cultures .
in the evolution of human civilization , the appearance and development of a new civilization is always a process of dialectical process of inheritance and abandonment through maintaining the useful elements of the old civilization and overcoming its negative elements .
socialism and capitalism are two interrelated links in the chain of human historical development .
only by extensively absorbing all useful things in the development of capitalism can we develop ourselves and enhance our own comprehensive national strength and competitive power , thus showing the superiority of socialism in the struggle against capitalism and outperforming the capitalist civilization .
at the same time , we must soberly aware that being the last exploiting system in human society , capitalism has brought about many things going against the progressive trend of human civilization , and even people of insight in the bourgeois and capitalist class also hold a negative attitude toward such things .
as a socialist nation , we should more resolutely criticize and resist those decadent , backward , and reactionary things in the western ideologies and cultures in the course of expanding our opening up policy toward the outside world .
to effectively resist the corrosive influence of the decadent western ideologies and cultures in the course of opening up to the outside world , we must make great effort to boost our socialist ideological and cultural building .
practice shows that to win a victory in the ideological struggle , we should not only resolutely resist and criticize the erroneous thoughts and decadent lifestyles from the west , but should , more importantly , also effectively develop our own culture and arm the minds of the people with progress ideology and culture .
it is necessary to persistently and unceasingly conduct ideal and belief education , thus boosting the sense of national self - esteem and self - confidence among the people .
ideal and belief is the spiritual backbone of a person and a nation .

we should also go all out to develop socialist culture with chinese characteristics .
amid the mutual impact and the merge of various contemporary civilizations , only cultures with distinct national features can maintain a strong vitality .

the state council of the people 's republic of china the central military commission of the people 's republic of china decree no 298 this is to promulgate " procedures for implementing the law of the people 's republic of china on protection of military facilities . "
these measures are drawn up in accordance with the provisions in the " prc law for the protection of military installations " ( to be called law for the protection of military installations below ) .
in areas where there are military installations , county - level and higher people 's governments and the local military organizations shall set up military installations protection committees together to coordinate and guide the work of protecting the military installations in their administrative districts .
under the leadership of the state council and the central military commission [ cmc ] , the general staff headquarters of the chinese people 's liberation army [ pla ] is in charge of protecting the nation 's military installations and guides the work of military installations protection committees at all levels .
the headquarters of a military district is in charge of protecting the military installations in areas under its jurisdiction , and it guides the work of all military installations protection committees in the district under its jurisdiction .
within the scope of their responsibilities , relevant state council departments are in charge of affairs relevant to protecting military installations , and they assist military organizations in implementing the measures for protecting military installations .
county - level and higher people 's governments are in charge of the work relevant to protecting the military installations in areas under their jurisdiction , and they assist the local military organizations in implementing the measures for protecting military installations .
chapter ii .
military restricted waters are off - limits to non - military vessels ; to the construction of and placement of non - military facilities ; to the breeding of aquatic products , fishing , and other activities that obstruct military vessels ' movements and affect their security .
the military installations protection committees of all provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities under the central government 's direct jurisdiction shall set the requirements for the designs , materials , and specifications of these signs .
when the boundary of military restricted waters or a military administrative zone cannot be marked by any sign or barrier , the local communications and fishery administration shall inform the public of the situation , and the mapping department shall mark the locations of these waters and the zone in marine charts .
chapter iii .
the protection of operations facilities article 13 . the term " operations facilities " mentioned in the law for the protection of military installations " refers to tunnels and permanent constructions , and their ancillary facilities , including water and power supply facilities and barracks .
in regions where the operations facilities are concentrated , contiguous areas may be delimited for guarding the security of these facilities .
article 18 . for new construction projects that cannot avoid the operations facilities , requests for the removal , relocation , and reconstruction of these facilities should be submitted in accordance with the relevant regulations of the state . operations facilities shall not be removed , relocated , or rebuilt without approval .
chapter iv .
the standards for clear space for military airports shall be set according to relevant state standards .
chapter v. the protection of military telecommunications and power transmission lines and military oil and water pipelines article 27 .
article 29 . units managing military telecommunications and power transmission lines and military oil and water pipelines ( called military lines and pipelines below ) shall tighten their management and maintenance of these lines and pipelines and check and inspect them according to rules .
article 31 . there should be mark stones or other permanent markers to mark all the underground military pipelines and cables , and there should be signs to mark the sections susceptible to damage .
underwater military pipelines and cables should also be marked in nautical charts .
article 32 . the specific requirements set for the protection of military pipelines , and the handling of situations where military pipelines and cables and other facilities intervening one another shall be executed according to relevant state council and cmc regulations .
chapter vi .
article 34 . in the areas for protecting the military electromagnetic environments , there shall be no construction , placement , and use of equipment that send or reflect electromagnetic signals and objects that block electromagnetic signals .
article 37 . units that manage permanent radio facilities should be fully knowledgeable of the situations of protecting the military electromagnetic environments , and they shall immediately report all the problems they have discovered to the upper military organizations and the local committees for the protection of military installations .
chapter vii .
chapter ix .
supplementary articles article 52 . the law for the protection of military installations and these measures are applicable for the protection of the military installations of the chinese people 's armed police units .

the new us administration of george w. bush has made a totally unexpected change in the us policy towards china and taiwan .
colin powell 's remarks have signaled a major change in the foundation of the us policy towards china .
ever since the 1970 s or in the era of the nixon administration , the united states has persistently upheld the following stand in its policy towards the two shores : " the united states acknowledges china 's position as such : there is only one china , and taiwan is part of china . "
the united states acknowledges that china 's position is : there is only one china , and taiwan is part of china . "
nevertheless , in his written testimony submitted to a senate hearing held to confirm his nomination by the bush administration as the secretary of state , colin powell has recognized in no uncertain terms that " taiwan is part of china . "
nonetheless , taipei has failed to see the seriousness of this issue nor has it taken note of the latest change in us policy towards taiwan . rather , it is still moving in the opposite direction , thus turning cross - strait relations from bad to worse .
as a result , while answering a question in beijing university in 1998 , bill clinton further made it clear that the us policy towards the two shores is " peaceful reunification . "
nonetheless , taipei has again turned a blind eye to that .
nevertheless , up to the mid-1998 at least , the us policy concept for an intermediate agreement had failed to demonstrate a so - called direction on its own .
in other words , for the two sides , namely washington and beijing , such a concept had meant nothing more than an intention for narrowing differences or settling a dispute between the two shores .
it was some time after that period that the united states started referring to the signing of an intermediate agreement and the establishment of a confederation between the two shores in the future as two related issues or as a direction , and this was also due to one more policy mistake on the part of taipei .
after the us side put forth such a concept as an intermediate agreement , lee teng - hui openly advanced his " theory of special state - to - state relations " on 9 july , 1999 , which once resulted in beijing 's intention to use force against taiwan .
however , due to the use of both the stick and the carrot by the us side , beijing made a compromise for the time being .
as a result , taipei held a presidential election in 2000 , and chen shui - pien [ chen shui - bian ] , a dpp [ democratic progressive party ] candidate , whom beijing has all along had doubts and misgivings , won the election .
for instance , certain personalities in taipei and in the united states have called for examining or even reconsidering the concept of " one china , " which was spelled out in the shanghai communiqu .
for this reason , richard bush , director of the american institute in taiwan , the other day called on kuomintang [ kmt ] chairman lien chan , and the two sides exchanged views on issues relating to the establishment of a confederation between the two shores .
besides , as the chinese communists have of late renovated their concept of " one china " through qian qichen 's " three sentences , " the us side believes that the chinese communists have infused something new into their policy .
as a matter of fact , given such an outcome of overall development , it seems that people were not taken by too much surprise when they heard the bush administration say that it believes " taiwan is part of china . "
by as early as the early 1980 s , the reagan administration had adopted such a policy towards china and taiwan : the future of the two shores " shall be determined by the people on the two shores on their own . "
now that us policy has returned to a position upheld in the 1980 s or in the cold war period , whether or not such is a good change or a bad one has to be assessed by history , i 'm afraid .
the supreme people 's court 21 january made public explanations on certain questions concerning the specific application of law in the trial of cases of stealing , making secret inquiries [ ci tan ] of or buying state secrets and intelligence and illegally providing gathered state secrets and intelligence for units outside the country [ jing wai ] .
in cases of a gross violation of law and where especially serious harm is caused to the state and people , law offenders may be sentenced to death and their properties will be confiscated by the state .
those who steal , make secret inquiries of or buy classified information of the state and illegally provide gathered information for units outside the country and the circumstances are not very serious will be sentenced to fixed - term imprisonment of less than five years , punishment of detention or control , or deprivation of political right .
those who illegally provide state secrets or intelligence for units , organizations and individuals outside the country through internet with serious consequences will be punished according to stipulations of the criminal law .
those who steal , make secret inquiries of or buy intelligence [ qing bao ] other than state secrets and illegally provide such intelligence for units , organizations and individuals outside the country will be punished according to punishment for stealing , making secret inquires of or buying intelligence and illegally provide such intelligence for units outside the country .

hong kong , 21 jan (zxs) - - at a symposium held in hong kong , a scholar from beijing said that in the world trade organization [ wto ] , the world 's largest international trade organization , four seats will be held simultaneously by china and the hong kong , macao , and taiwan regions of china .
hua xiaohong , director of the international trade affairs research institute and the taiwan , hong kong , macao research center of the beijing foreign trade and economic relations university , said that according to the relevant wto regulations , hong kong and macao have separately become wto members in the capacity of independent tariff zones .
once the mainland of the motherland enters the wto , taiwan will then also become its member very soon .
after their return to the motherland , hong kong and macao 's economic and trade relations with the mainland of the motherland are strictly locked in the framework of " one country , two systems , " and economic and trade relations among the three sides still follow general international economic and trade rules .
after the two sides of the strait enter the wto , china 's four - party economic and trade relations will be bound to the principle of " one country , different systems " and also the wto rules at the same time , and the bilateral pattern will be expanded to a multilateral pattern .
in international economic and trade relations , such complicated economic and trade relations existing in different regions of the same country will be unique and unprecedented .
she pointed out : in the same wto framework , the coexistence of four economic entities in china will help to gradually remove the existing structural and legal obstacles , lower the transaction costs in economic and trade exchanges , increase the transparency of information , and enhance the accuracy of the forecasts on market prospects .
hua xiaohong said : it is necessary to fully estimate the impact of all possible unstable factors . first , while both sides of the strait will enter the wto , this will not indicate that the current abnormal economic and trade relations between the two sides will be changed very quickly .
in addition , while wto membership will enhance the degree of liberalization in economic and trade relations among the four sides , it will also intensify business competition and cause higher business risks .
if the interests of economic and trade cooperation between the four sides are harmed , the authorities concerned should consider and work out special policies to deal with the issues .
hua xiaohong expressed the above - quoted viewpoints at the symposium entitled " analysis of the prospects of wto and economic relations between the two sides and straits and hong kong . "

at noon on 20 january , bush , the 54 - year - old republican and former governor of texas , held onto a " bible , " and in the howling winter wind and continuous drizzle took the oath to become the 43 d president of the united states .

on the 17 th , secretary of state designate powell systematically elaborated the new government 's foreign policy before a hearing conducted by the us senate foreign relations committee .
on the 17 th , powell once again reiterated that building a " comprehensive strategic framework , " comprising both offensive and defensive systems , was very important .
first , the united states will put greater emphasis on a policy of strength .
on the question of foreign affairs , bush said in his inaugural speech that the untied states would continue to participate in world affairs and build up an " unmatched " national defense force to protect the interests of the allies and the united states in the whole world .
the essence of the notion of " new pragmatism " put forward by bush in his election platform is to maximize the national interests of the united states in international affairs by relying on its great might .
thus , ensuring us national security through arms expansion will be of the utmost importance in the defense policy of the bush administration .
the new defense policy is bound to emphasize on the use of us political , economic , military , scientific and technological strength , especially military strength , to firmly establish and defend the leadership of the united states .
he repeatedly declared that the united states must take a tougher stance against its strategic adversaries and " countries worthy of attention " and must rely more on its strength to take unilateral action on questions of nato 's eastward expansion , arms control negotiations , non - proliferation and missile defense .
second , the united states will step up nmd research and deployment .
the nmd system is a major strategic project aimed at seeking absolute military supremacy for the united states .
the majority of countries have voiced their objection to the project because it will upset the fragile balance of international strategic strength .
in spite of this , a major commitment of the bush administration on the issue of national defense is to step up the project and build an efficient nmd system .
bush also declared that this project would go ahead whether or not russia agrees .
although bush has yet to speak specifically on the nmd project , we can see from his appointment of rumsfeld , a resolute supporter of the project , as secretary of defense and from the remarks made by other important cabinet members that his decision to deploy the system will only be a matter of time and scale .
third , the united states will adhere more to the principle of national interests in its dispatch of troops abroad .
the new administration will continue to adhere to the strategic principle of " winning two large - scale theater wars at the same time , " but its principle of dispatching troops abroad will be very different from that of the clinton administration .
bush maintains that the united states should act strictly in accordance with its core national interests and should not go around resorting to the use of force , playing the boss and taking everything into its hands so as not to waste its strength for no good reason and ending up losing more than it gains .
he believes in being prudent in the use of force to ensure that the united states will have sufficient force to win when its key or major interests are threatened .
to this end , he thinks that the united states should be a " world police sergeant " rather than a " world police " and should fully bring into play the role of us allies in regional crises .
the new us national security adviser jones [ sic ] also said that the united states should minimize its intervention in " humanitarian " disasters . at the same time , the united states will assign greater importance to the asian region .
in order to counter the former soviet union during the cold war , the strategy of the united states was mainly directed at europe , with asia on the sideline only .
as the only superpower in the world , every adjustment of the security strategy of the united states will have a major impact on the international security situation .
normally , it will take six to 12 months for the defense policy of a new administration to ultimately " get into shape . "

beijing , 22 jan (zxs) - - a new book entitled " china : challenging corruption " written by mr. hu angang , director of the china national situation research center of the chinese academy of sciences and qinghua university , was published recently in beijing .
according to a briefing by mr. hu angang , at the invitation of the cpc central discipline inspection commission , last may , he attended an expert forum chaired by secretary wei jianxing , and expressed his personal opinion on the comprehensive strategy for preventing and eliminating corruption .
after that , he discussed this issue many times with the research office of the central discipline inspection commission , and had an idea about compiling and publishing the book " china : challenging corruption . "
what economic , social , and political consequences may be caused by corruption ?
what are the economic factors that may most easily engender corruption ?
what major anti - corruption measures have been adopted so far in china ?
how to further work out the state 's strategy and major policies and comprehensive measures for preventing and eliminating corruption ?
the book " china : challenging corruption " is mainly divided into two major parts on the corruption issue in china and the international experience that can be taken as reference .
most essays and articles included in the book have been published in " chinese national situation analysis and research reports " edited and issued by the national situation research center of the chinese academy of science and qinghua university as reference materials for central and provincial - level leaders .

four major commercial banks make profit of 14.6 billion yuan dai xianglong said that in 2000 the four major commercial banks made a profit of 14.6 billion yuan ; they reduced losses and increased profits by 21.7 billion yuan , and their profits could not be called great .
that is to say , profit calculations are more cautious , and the state - owned commercial banks have made contributions in supporting state enterprises .
net deposits ( discounted ) of china - funded financial institutions in banks abroad stood at $ 61.8 billion .
he also pointed out that after joining the wto , there may be quite big changes in trade , and the changes in international payments and receipts may also be correspondingly a bit greater , so there should be some flexibility in the exchange rate .
since the liquidity of china 's industrial capital is rather poor , it is necessary to provide support for some industries and regions ; the self - constraint ability of commercial banks is not yet strong , so it is very difficult to have the interest rate completely determined by the market .
as far as the central bank is concerned , there are not many and there are far from adequate instruments for practicing open market operations , so its ability to regulate and control market interest rate remains rather poor .
for a long time to come , therefore , the central bank will still need to determine the interest rate levels on bank deposits and loans .
we will , however , actively push the reform of having interest rate determined by the market .
for instance , we have already carried out reform of the foreign exchange interest rate , and in the future we will expand the range of float in bank deposit and loan interest rates ; generally speaking there is no change in the orientation of interest rate reform , and the steps taken will be steady .
we have seen the bottom of non - performing loans dai xianglong said , so - called seeing the bottom means that the true state of the non - performing loans of the state - owned commercial banks has been made clear and the time has now come when these should decline .
in 1997 the central bank hoped that the proportion of non - performing assets in the state - owned commercial banks would drop by a bit more , but the predicted target was not met .
dai xianglong revealed that the amount of term - expired loans which had not been repaid by the end of last year represented one - quarter of total loans .
he held that in the past the error in the proportion of non - performing loans reported was too great .
he held that some hanging loans which have expired more than one year may be irrecoverable , and the final actual bad debts may exceed 3 percent , but not by very much .
since the operational state of state - owned commercial banks may involve the operating state of the entire financial sector , dai xianglong said that he will attach great importance to the development of state banks so as to maintain a good international reputation .
he also said that the scale of trust and investment companies with foreign debts is rather great ; the majority of them will be retained , and they will repay the foreign debt capital and interest in accordance with their contracts , and foreign investors will not suffer loss .
the hainan trust and investment company will be included in the list of enterprises to be straightened out .
it is necessary to pay attention to and curb the illegal entry into the stock market of credit funds .
it is necessary to apply policy and legal measures and strengthen supervision by society to resolutely crack down on practices for dodging bank debts .

spring breezes bring warmth , and falling snow brings good luck . bid goodbye to the hustle and bustle of the old year and welcome the scintillating new year .
this year is the first year of the new century , the first year of china 's 10 th five - year plan , and it is also a crucial year for maintaining the excellent momentum , taking advantage of it to forge ahead .
a path winding among high peaks : china 's economy begins to climb the year 2000 is certain to be a red - letter year in the history of china 's economic development .
according to disclosures by the state statistical bureau , last year china 's economic growth rate hit eight percent , extricating itself from the situation of continued slowdowns in recent years .
unlike the past few years , last year most of the macroeconomic indicators were moving in a good direction , giving rise to a situation of an across - the - board start up and overall upswing .
investments continued to maintain strong growth , there were frequent spikes in social consumption , and growth in foreign trade exports was gratifying .
it is estimated that growth of the overall retail value of social consumables last year may be around 9.8 percent , an increase of three percentage points over the previous year .
last year new strides were made in structural adjustments , with a noticeable increase in economic returns .
the information industry developed rapidly , becoming the main pillar supporting industrial growth .
news of victory on the tax revenue front continued to pour in , with receipts for the entire year breaking the 200 billion yuan mark for the first time . the capital contribution rates , profit rates , and other main indicators of returns all were much better than the previous several years .
according to the most recent statistics , last year nationwide power generation grew 9.5% , while power consumption throughout society grew 9.7% , with a noticeable increase in the coefficient of elasticity of electric power .
looking at it from the surveys done by some offices , most people are optimistic about the prospects for economic development this year .
we are seeing a steady upswing in both the resident consumer confidence index and the enterprise confidence index of the state statistical bureau .
this shows that , after several years of stagnation , there is a clear improvement in people 's expectations for the future .
firming up the foundation for long term peace and stability we should note soberly that the foundation of the current economic upswing is still not sufficiently firm , and the " major turn for the better " still requires consolidation and development .
for the past few years , because of the success of the rural policies of the central authorities , agriculture in china - - particularly grain production - - has ascended to a new level , and the problem of having enough to eat that has bedeviled us for thousands of years has been resolved .
however , there are still a number of problems in agriculture and rural work , and in particular the slowdown in the growth of the income of farmers has become a " bottleneck " constraining rural economic development .
the central authorities are taking the agricultural problem very seriously , and the central economic work conference that was held at the end of last year made the consolidation and strengthening of agriculture and boosting the income of the farmers the foremost task for economic work this year .
the cpc central committee and the state council have adopted a series of measures and , as of the end of last year , we were able to guarantee a basic subsistence for around 95% of the laid - off workers , while around 98% of retirees received their pensions in full and on time .
with the amount of increase in the income of the farmers declining several years in a row and the marginal consumption of urban residents tending to be low , it is hard to further stimulate the consumer market .
although exports are showing a strong growth trend , the high growth is mainly due to quantitative expansion , with rather significant fluctuations , and the task of adjusting the product mix of exports is still rather pressing .
studies by related departments show that , in recent years , the fact that provinces such as zhejiang , jiangsu , fujian , and guangdong have " leapt ahead " in the national rankings of overall economic competitiveness is closely related to their encouragement of the development of the non - state - owned sector of the economy .
actually , developing the non - state - owned sector of the economy and adjusting the ownership structure is by all rights something that should fall under the heading of soe reforms .

two days ago , russian defense minister igor sergeyev told the press that withdrawing from the abm treaty will lead directly to a new round of the arms race , including the most dangerous missile technology race .
to seek the establishment of the capability to protect its abm system , the united states is striving for unilateral absolute security so as to gain the absolute freedom of using force and military threats in international relations .
as a result , the nuclear blackmail of the cold war period could reemerge .

hence , years of efforts by the united states and russia would be wasted in striking bilateral deals on nuclear disarmament .
meanwhile , the us nmd plan is bound to mar the process of multilateral disarmament and arms control and undermine international efforts in preventing nuclear and missile proliferation .
it will also harm mutual trust among various countries .
on 1 september last year , president clinton decided to shelve the nmd plan for the time being .
when global strategic balance is broken and a fresh round of the arms race is fully launched , it will spur nuclear and missile proliferation , and the united states will not be safer than it is now .
it is hoped that the new us government will proceed from the considerations of safeguarding global peace and stability and will completely abandon the nmd plan and strictly observe the abm treaty .
meanwhile , it is also hoped that the international community will continue to make vigorous efforts in preventing the abm treaty from being ruined and thereby safeguarding global strategic stability and the peace and security of all mankind .

the us strategic idea is the result of carrying forward the essence of the three major british strategic ideas , namely , " colonialism , balance of power , and indirectness , " and taking imperialist ideology as its ideological basis .
what it pursues is a hegemonist strategy , which " took shape when it claimed in 1850 that its fate and future were to go beyond the pacific . "
this determines the us position in china 's peripheral security and the prospect of its strategic conduct .
that also explains why , following the declaration of the us - soviet heads of state in malta , the united state immediately shifted its strategic focus to china .
in the dozen or so strategic guiding principles , the us authorities confirmed the strategy of inspiring changes in , attacking , and weakening china through all aspects of social life , including politics , economy , diplomacy , military , trade , culture , and education , in a planned and systematic way .
in south asia , the us policy of befriending india at the expense of pakistan has a very clear aim , namely , targeting the focus of its south asia policy at china , and the essence of this tactics is to " gain advantage with borrowed strength and exchange space for time . "
when , in the 1990 s , the united states finished making overall deployment and exerting political , military , and diplomatic pressures and strategic probes against china , the united states will , in the years to come , gradually step up tests of china 's determination to safeguard its security strategy .
in the past centuries , japan has always regarded china as its enemy and strategic adversary and , strategically , it had the greatest inordinate desires for china .
comprehensively containing china and establishing a strategic protective screen against china has become an unspoken fundamental strategic idea of japan .
it was only in a short period of 15 years , from tanaka being in power to the mid-1980s , that japan , out of its strategic needs , began to develop relations with china .
using china 's promotion of the modernization drive as a pretext , japan considers china as a major threat among the " multiple threats " and holds china up as strategic adversary .
in fact , during the 1996 taiwan strait crisis , japan provided the united states and taiwan with its collected intelligence about china 's military movements .
although japan 's marine protection area has been clearly defined , in terms of japan 's overall strategy , people are inclined to overlook japan 's strategic attempts to land in northeast asia .
today , japan still intends to get involved in the peninsular issue and topple the important strategic protective screen of china .
in japan 's view , mongolia is " a knife stabbing into the hearts of china and russia " and " a huge stone weighing on china 's back . "
we can thus see the importance of mongolia 's strategic position .
in recent years , at the back of japan 's efforts to comprehensively strengthen relations with mongolia , with money to clear the way , there is also the aim of influencing china 's internal problems .
india and china , which were similarly the " invaded continents " in history , established good international relations in the 1950 s .
in the early 1990 s , india again adjusted its national security strategy , explicitly setting forth the objective of becoming a first - rate powerful nation in the world in the early 21 st century .
to this end , it has made a strategic switch from the " regional limited deterrent , " which was established in the 1980 s , to the " regional overall deterrent . "
this is a regional hegemonist strategy , which is different from the us strategically global " overall deterrent " and the strategically " regional deterrent " characterized by " attack on pakistan and protection against china . "
in india 's " regional overall deterrent " strategy , the strategy toward china has always been an important component part .
it can be said that the 1993 " ss milky way " incident is of epoch - making symbolic significance to us in considering the issue of state security .
however , territorial disputes and maritime traffic are by no means the whole problem .
to achieve its strategic objective against china , india has taken measures in every aspect , politically , diplomatically , and militarily .
obviously , the peripheral factors affecting china 's future security are not merely the three major factors cited above . the impact of interaction among the three major characters will be even greater .
first , through instantaneous adjustments , the asian region 's " alliance strategy " in wake of the cold war has been revived : the us - japanese alliance has taken a new step toward joint operation , with its sphere of influence extending still further .
second , the development of us - indian and japanese - indian relations has penetrated through military exchanges , arousing widespread concern all over the world . such cooperation , which is based on makeshift measures , is likely to accelerate its destructive impact on china .

hanoi , 2 feb ( xinhua ) - - on the evening of 2 february , the vietnam news agency [ vna ] carried the full text of a draft political report of the eighth communist party of vietnam [ cpv ] central committee to the ninth national congress of the cpv .
the draft report pointed out that the ninth national congress of the cpv would mobilize and give play to the efforts of the entire nation to continue with the " doi moi " [ program of economic reform ] , to energetically promote the state 's industrialization and modernization , and to build and defend the socialist vietnam .
the draft report also emphasized the need to firmly carry out fight against corruption at various levels and various departments of the state organs .
the fight against corruption needs to go hand in hand with the opposition to waste and extravagance , to bureaucratism , to smuggling , and to such acts as extortion through abuse of power , embezzlement , bribe - taking , and getting rich through illegal means in particular .
the draft political report pointed out the need to help vietnam shake off from the state of non - development and to markedly raise the people 's material and spiritual life level by 2010 , so as to lay a foundation for vietnam to basically become an industrialized country by 2020 .
according to a resolution laid down at the 11 th plenary session of the eighth cpv central committee , the draft political report will be publicized on 3 february to extensively solicit the people 's suggestions and views when the country marks the 71 st founding anniversary of the cpv .

in staff establishment , provincial party committee department staff have been reduced by about 20 percent , and the establishment of provincial government administrative staff by 48.2 percent ; the reduction is 50 percent in beijing , shanghai , tianjin , fujian , and shaanxi .

notable results have been achieved in harmonizing relationships , and a number of problems of overlapping and duplicate responsibilities have been resolved .

according to the report , the " hsiungfeng - iii " missile employs ramjet propulsion . the chung shan institute of science and technology has been studying and developing ramjet propulsion for many years and exhibited the " chingtien " experimental carrier in june 1999 .
it has been learned that besides the " hsiungfeng - iii " missile , the tienkung [ sky bow ] 3 surface - to - air missile developed by the chung shan institute of science and technology may also use ramjet propulsion .
the test will be held at the chiupeng base in pingtung . this is the most important missile launching site of the military . the tests of new weapons and the annual test firing of various missile units are mostly held at the base .
the report noted that due to the relatively large size of the " hsiungfeng - iii " missile , it would not entirely replace the " hsiungfeng - ii " missile .
in addition , hsiungfeng - iii missiles can also be installed on chengkung class frigates and other large vessels . they can be used to attack ships in ports and port facilities .

the dprk [ democratic people 's republic of korea ] government has officially elevated its computer center to the ministerial level and placed it under the direct supervision of the cabinet in an effort to strengthen the center 's management and operations .
today the rapid development of the information industry has brought earth - shaking changes to the world , and enhancing the role of information technology has become the main theme of global economic development .
the dprk is currently behind other countries in the development of the information industry , because it started off late .
yet , since the beginning of the 1990 s , the dprk government has given more attention to the information industry and has increased investment in the sector . it is trying its best to catch up with the world by popularizing computer knowledge and developing computer technologies .
over the last 10 years since the establishment of the center , general secretary kim chong - il has issued instructions on more than 140 occasions asking the " dprk computer center to play a core role in strengthening and improving science and technology and achieving computerization of the operation and management of the national economy . "
in 1996 , the dprk government officially elevated the computer center to the ministerial level and placed it under the direct supervision of the cabinet .
the dprk computer center has seven subordinate branches located in various parts of the country , which are responsible for disseminating computer knowledge while developing computer technologies at the same time .
in recent years , all middle schools in the dprk with the necessary conditions have begun offering computer courses , and various colleges have established a computer department .
" computer colleges " established especially for training specialized computer personnel have also emerged to meet the requirement and strengthen computer education .
in addition , the " dprk information center , " the computer science college of the kim il - song university , the computer research institute of the kim chol university , computer research institutes of various industries , and various large , intermediate , and small research institutes have been established one after another .
its partners include the rok 's samsung and hyundai groups .
according to han chun - chol , foreign affairs counselor of the dprk computer center , the dprk has scored progress in the research and development of system procedures , multimedia technology , operation systems , application procedures , and other areas .
han chun - chol told reporters that the " dprk has made all the technical preparations for getting on to the internet , and we will be on the internet as soon as the commander issues the order . "
the dprk 's cabinet ministries and commissions , departments directly under the workers party of korea central committee , and the news media have all established their own computer networks , and many have established wan systems .
describing the recent development , a comrade with the foreign affairs department of the nodong sinmun said that the newspaper 's correspondents in various localities were able to send dispatches and photos using the internet .
counselor han chun - chol , however , was very confident about the prospects of the dprk 's information industry .
during his two trips to china , he visited the lianxiang group and the shanghai software development and research institute .
the dprk 's information industry has started only 10 years ago . our lagging behind is only a temporary phenomenon . there is still a chance for us to catch up with the world , if we are willing to work harder .

beijing , 5 feb ( xinhua ) - - preparations for spring farming are now unfolding from south to north across china .
investigations by authoritative departments have shown that the sown area of grain initially arranged by the localities this year is maintaining the trend of decline , and this is a sign that merits our vigilance .
getting a good grasp of preparations for spring farming , stabilizing the area sown to grain , and ensuring grain security have become the overriding tasks in agricultural production .
in particular , last year the sown area fell to 160.7 billion mu , a decline of 90 million mu compared with 1999 .
although the big drop in production did not affect overall balance , and market fluctuations were not alarming , thanks to ample grain reserves and commercial stores , a continued fall in the sown area of grain directly affects grain security and threatens the overall situation of the national economy .
if we allow a continued decline in the sown area of grain and wait till there is a grain shortage and prices soar before getting back to producing food , strategic restructuring of agriculture will be impossible and the goal of increasing peasant incomes will finally come to nothing .
the farming season does not wait for man ; the central authorities demand that the departments concerned swing into action , and cooperate with each other in making careful preparations for spring farming .
the important thing in stabilizing the grain area is to properly protect the peasants ' enthusiasm for growing grain .
at the same time , we must pay special attention to protecting the basic farmland , and prevent arable land from being dug up for fish ponds and being used for permanent construction projects . we must stabilize grain production in the main grain - growing areas and build these into marketable grain bases .
grain crop and variety production should be arranged according to the different requirements of ration grain , grain for processing , and fodder grain , and we should expand the production of high - quality rice , wheat and maize for special requirements , and fine - quality soybeans .
we must ensure the security of total grain output and also satisfy the requirements of structure and variety .

french evil cults of every description the birth or proliferation of evil cults in france has had a long history .
in the early 20 th century , some protestants arrived in france from the united states and britain as members of a minority sect and began merging with some non - mainstream catholic groups in france , where they set up a new cult .
therefore , as a matter of fact , the earliest evil cults in france were organized by several sects formed by people dissatisfied with or divorced from some traditional churches .
aside from carrying out activities known for strong mysticism or for typical oriental witchcraft , those evil cults also advocated doctrines known for anti - society or antiscience contents .
as it is rather difficult to place under control the source or flow of their capital , it is highly likely that they will pound at a financial market .
over the past few years , the french evil cults have infiltrated into the government departments to a growing extent and this has undermined the normal operation of judicial or executive institutions in france to a certain extent .
in 1999 , the paris court and the marseilles court lost their files about " god of science " in a mysterious way .
an investigation conducted by the french ministry of justice and keeper of the seals concluded : it is highly likely that some followers of " god of science " had found their way into the judicial system and had waited for an opportunity to commit a crime .
government has stepped up its crackdown on evil cults step by step the french government had once adopted such a policy towards evil cults as " making prevention primary and crackdown subsidiary . "
first , the government departments have each set up an anticult institution .
the french government set up the interministerial committee for opposing evil cults in december 1998 , which has since held itself directly responsible to the prime minister ; has coordinated anticult activities among various government ministries or commissions ; and has planned to set up a national anticult information center as well .
the french parliament has also held at irregular intervals a meeting attended by its special committees , at which it discusses the problem of evil cults , and has published specialized reports on evil cults as well .
the french courts have also each appointed a judge for handling only cases involving an evil cult ; second , france has launched a crackdown on evil cults by fully applying specific articles of its law .
in the meantime , news media and several nongovernmental organizations in france have also coordinated with the government in launching a crackdown on evil cults with fruitful results in this regard .
from september to november 1999 , the marseilles court held a trial on a case involving " god of science , " which was accused of causing personal injuries or disability .
there are two major nongovernmental anticult organizations in france , namely , " national alliance of associations for protecting families and individuals " and " information , education , and action center for opposing spiritual manipulation , " and these two organizations have done a lot of work by gathering information about evil cults and helping victims .
in order to intensify a crackdown on evil cults , the french government has of late decided to introduce an appropriate amendment to the law on " disbanding combat groups or private militia organizations , " which was promulgated in 1936 , with an eye on disbanding " god of science " or some other extremely dangerous evil cults .
however , since the move may involve complex operational procedures and the amendment may also incur difficulties for enforcement , failure to properly handle this issue is likely to land the french government in passivity .
on the issue of launching a crackdown on evil cults , france has also faced pressure from the united states .
several us congressmen also wrote letters to the european committee , demanding that the european countries ban the publication of reports aimed at laying bare the harmful nature of evil cults .
thanks to this , the evil cult has started time and again bringing pressure to bear on the french government in an unbridled way and has even openly issued a personal threat to the members of the french anticult institutions .
france has also encountered enormous difficulties in securing a joint crackdown on evil cults with other european countries .
being widely different from one another in history , culture , religion , or philosophical thinking , various european countries have never come up with a consensus on how to define an evil cult or on what corresponding measures should be taken in this regard .
for instance , though the cult investigation committee of the french parliament has time and again appealed to other european countries to launch a joint crackdown on evil cults , " the european convention on opposing evil cults " is still at the stage of discussion at the moment and has yet to be drafted .

the us scramble for the commanding height in space has boosted the early maturing of space war , and the impact of this has already exceeded that of space war itself .
the history of war has proven that under the impetus of the unseen giant hand of technology , whoever first occupies the commanding height in military technology may be able to seize the initiative in war .
around the time of world war ii , when the old empires of britain and germany were very keen on " huge battleships with big guns , " the united states and japan were vigorously developing aircraft carriers , and the battle of the coral sea was the opener to carrier warfare .
the history of war similarly proves that technical invention is always closely linked to the military .
as soon as advanced technology is invented , it is bound to display its ability in the military sphere .
in addition , the emergence of revolutionary weapons sometimes changes the pattern of war .
when cold weapons replaced fighting with bare hands , the nature of human warfare became more bloody ; when gunpowder spurred the invention of guns and cannot , the bloodiness of human warfare became suffocating ; and navigational technology carried the space for human warfare into the oceans .
and the emergence of aircraft 100 years ago pushed warfare into the air .
we should recall that not all the objects flying over us every day are natural bodies , and there are also eyes there closely watching you .
since the rhythm of technological development is speeding up , fighting in space will not be like air warfare , and only a few decades have elapsed to complete the shift between observation and surveillance at the start to the strategic breakthrough of today .
space fighting is not far off .
the modes of defense will no longer be to fight on our own territory and fight for marine rights and interests , and we must engage in space defense as well as air defense .
third , national defense and army building the world over will undergo all - round severe tests .
as preparations for space warfare by the major powers speed up , while updating their national defense concepts , all countries will carry out major readjustments in their army building , and new branches of the armed forces will emerge in the ranks of armies around the world .
for the major powers , " space forces " are no longer just a new term .
certain countries not only have organizational bodies for commanding space warfare but are also actively training personnel for " space forces . "
in 1981 the united states set up air force and naval space commands .
in the first half of the 21 st century , the united states can establish at least three space divisions , each with 300 personnel , equipped with space carriers , spacecraft , space tugs , orbiting fuel stores , and space supply stations .
the three space divisions will be deployed at different points in space , and will be able to operate either independently or as a joint force ; the command center will be on the space carrier , and the combat personnel will be deployed in various spacecraft .
it can be predicted that in the future a number of space powers will organize and build their own " space forces , " and will engage in still more thorough exploration in space war theory and weaponry development .

compared with arleigh burke - class destroyers , kidd - class destroyers are equipped with less powerful weapons or radar systems . nevertheless , once obtained by taiwan , kidd - class destroyers are set to become both the largest and most powerful warships taiwan 's navy has ever had .
once done , the deal is also likely to turn into the largest us - taiwan arms sales deal ever since 1992 , when the us administration of george bush decided to sell some 150 f-16 fighter planes to taiwan .
as disclosed by " jane 's defense weekly , " a kidd - class destroyer , which is more than twice the size of the largest warship taiwan 's navy has at the moment , is capable of directing an air defense platform , an antisubmarine platform , as well as a surface combat platform on the sea .
equipped with both the advanced standard sm-2er missiles and the 3 d radar in their " combat systems , " kidd - class destroyers are bound to help taiwan 's navy " make a giant stride forward " in terms of fighting capacity and raise its fleets ' air defense capability on the sea as well .
when president clinton was in office , taiwan was dissatisfied with the extent of the us arms sales .
as the democratic party often failed to see eye to eye with the republican party on defense issues and on the taiwan question , many taiwan officials hoped that george w. bush would bring taiwan more benefits or at least inherit his father 's tradition on the issue of arms sales .
due to this reason , taiwan 's military had begun whipping up opinion about taiwan 's " fragile defense " even before george w. bush formally took office .
on 13 january , at the end of a visit to taiwan , an investigation group from the us defense department expressed worries about taiwan 's war facilities in sustaining " the first strike . "
the investigation group also made a detailed assessment of taiwan 's armed forces with regard to software organization or integration , command , management , telecommunication , duties , as well as fighting capacity or defense of major military installations .
taiwan 's top brass have also revealed their heads or shown their faces to directly push for the us arms sales to taiwan " with an extra effort . "
at the start of the year , li chieh - nien , " commander " of taiwan 's navy , publicly admitted : taiwan 's navy is discussing with the us side on purchasing four kidd - class missile destroyers at the moment .
in future , we will form four attack groups centered on those warships of a new model and assign them such a task as " moving towards distant sea waters . "
taiwan 's military has anxiously come up to raise this issue in public because it wants to show its disappointment with the clinton administration 's policies towards taiwan and its ardent expectations for the bush administration as well .
where does the united states want to lead taiwan ? in his article published in the " washington post , " jesse helms said : being a rising power , china has a strong military strength .
he maintained : the clinton administration has already destroyed the structure of the us military strength and has also " failed to come up with a firm decision on the issue of preparing military strength for defending taiwan . "

at present , a time when the new us congress is about to start business , some people within the us congress are planning to again dish out " the taiwan relations enhancement act " in an effort to coordinate with taiwan 's request for another round of arms sales .
truly , the us policies towards the taiwan strait , lacking in clear - cut strategic foresight , have found concrete expression in the us arms sales to taiwan and have objectively facilitated the spread of taiwan independence forces as well .
over the past 20 years , the united states has sold fighter planes , warships , missiles , and some other weapons with advanced functions to taiwan , worth more than $ 38 billion in all .
since taiwan 's new leader took office , the united states has increased rather than reduced its arms sales to taiwan and has also provided taiwan with a large amount of offensive weapons or equipment which are not just " defensive " in nature .
last june , the united states announced two arms sales deals with taiwan , including some 39 sets of aiming guidance device and some 48 sets of electronic confrontation device , which were to installed on f-16 fighter planes , worth $ 356 million in all .
the so called " new strategic thinking " has undoubtedly raised a new demand for the us arms .
they may join forces in reproaching china on political , military , human rights , and even environmental protection issues or some other issues as well and may also try to secure substantial help for taiwan in some other areas by making certain " concessions " to the government .

though this looks like a clever choice , the united states will be unable to control how the taiwan authorities will interpret this or how the situation in the taiwan strait will evolve on such a basis .

according to what is understood , a risk analysis regarding china 's importation of pest - carrying logs - - carried out by experts from inspection and quarantine departments and organs - - indicates that the percentage of imported logs carrying quarantine pests is over 70 percent , with the epidemic coming from 36 countries or regions .
all ports of entry together have intercepted 252 species of forest pests since 1996 , 174 of which are quarantine pests that pose great harm .
although the existing quarantine regulations stipulate that no imported logs may carry quarantine pests , there are no specific measures for enforcement .
the expenses for pest elimination shall be borne by the importer .
customs at all ports of entry must intensify the vigor of supervision and management over imported logs , and logs which have passed quarantine inspection will be cleared upon presentation of a " customs clearance form for imported goods " signed by exit - entry inspection and quarantine organizations .

however , china 's opening of its mainland to the outside world will certainly bring competition and challenges to hong kong enterprises .
the question is whether hong kong people are able to seize opportunities and meet challenges and to turn challenges into business opportunities .
after china enters the wto , the mainland will see an increase in its direct ocean trade and transportation without the need to pass through hong kong . after the three direct links between the mother mainland and taiwan are realized , transportation of goods between the two sides of the strait via hong kong will be reduced .
second , over the past 20 years , most of manufacturing industries in hong kong have moved northward to the mainland and witnessed rapid development in the mainland .
however , the reduction of production costs has affected the restructuring of manufacturing industries .

editor 's note : wang yang from a certain unit under the beijing military region and other readers have written in asking us what the national missile defense [ nmd ] system of the united states is all about .
we have asked experts from the academy of military sciences to give us an answer to this question . [ end editor 's note ] the new century has just begun when the newly sworn - in bush administration announced that it would go ahead with its planned nmd deployment .
origin of nmd what does nmd mean ?
in1995, the united states promulgated the " ballistic missile defense law " and began working on the bmd program .
role of nmd and its deployment plan bmd includes tmd and nmd .
nmd is mainly intended to intercept long - range and intercontinental missiles with a range of over 3,000 kilometers that can reach the us continent .
according to the nmd program , the united states will deploy one land - based abm base each in alaska and north dakota .
the first step is to deploy 100 interceptor missiles and one x - band advanced radar in alaska . the first batch of 20 of these missiles will be combat - ready by 2005 , and the full deployment of the alaska base will be completed by 2007 .
deployment at the second base ( that is , the north dakota base ) will be completed around 2011 .
the x - band radar will provide accurate target tracking data for the launched interceptor missile through the " flight interceptor missile communications system . "
the interceptor missile will make use of these data to approach the target missile , and its on - board lethal weapon sensor will distinguish warheads from decoys . it will then make the final precision calibration to ensure that the target is ultimately destroyed .
nmd and abm treaty the sdi goes against the 1972 abm treaty signed between the united states and the soviet union and the 1974 protocol to the abm treaty .
the direct consequence of the deployment of nmd will be the destruction of international strategic balance based on the " mutually assured destruction " mechanism .
we will continue to work to push all - round and direct cross - strait " three links " at an early date .
this principle is not only the basis for negotiations on cross - strait " three links " but is also the basic norm for actual operations in the future .
deciding on the cross - strait routes by applying the one china principle means that cross - strait shipping is shipping within one country which benefits the shipping interests of the chinese on both sides of the strait .
within this framework , many issues within direct cross - strait " three links " can be resolved and the procedures will subsequently be simplified .
the mother mainland also advocates that the sectors concerned on both sides of the strait can engage in consultations through a variety of means , so long as this is based on the one china principle .
so long as it is acknowledged that cross - strait " three links " is a matter within one country , these can be opened up as soon as possible through consultations between nongovernment bodies , sectors , and companies .
the article emphasizes that developing cross - strait economic exchanges and cooperation and putting into effect direct cross - strait " three links " accords with the basic interests and basic consensus of the compatriots on both sides of the strait .
