the upshot is an extensive readjustment of the structure , which enables the economy to rebound and reach new heights . effective demand lagged as the chinese economy stagnated during the latest round of deflation . with that in mind , the government has adopted an expansionary fiscal policy and monetary policy .
of course , such a shift is contingent on deflation becoming less and less severe .
it is important that the macroeconomic regulatory policy be so adjusted based on changes in economic trends for the following reasons .
the focus of macroeconomic policy to shift to structural readjustment 1 ) it will not be possible to continue the expansionary policy on a long - term basis .
although it must remain in place for now , the expansionary policy will drive up the budget deficit and has the potential danger for inflation down the road .
a policy that adjusts the supply structure and then the industrial structure not only seeks to trim excess production capacity and lowers the volume of output , but , even more important , creates new effective supply through innovation .
today , with deflation already on the wane , we need to make a greater effort to support innovation , adjust the supply structure , and increase effective supply even as we continue to implement a demand - boosting policy .
china 's accession to the world trade organization , economic globalization , and participation in international division of labor also require that china 's industrial structure be overhauled in a way that would highlight its strengths and downplay its weaknesses in order to enhance the country 's international competitiveness .
this is what the policy demands . in fact , at a time when market forces in china remain weak , it is all the more important for the government to do so .
in the future , as we gradually shift our emphasis to structural readjustment , we need to rely more on the market and let the market play the leading role .
let market competition drive structural readjustment .
when the issue of the regulation of supply comes up , people often mention tax cuts and accelerated depreciation . these measures have positive significance for lowering enterprise costs , improving enterprise competitiveness , increasing effective supply , and promoting enterprise development .
the government 's effort in recent years to readjust the industrial structure using administrative tools has also run into resistance from local protectionism .
in our drive for structural readjustment in the future , we should make use of the market under the guidance of government policy . in other words , we should readjust the structure amidst market competition .
support structural readjustment with institutional innovation third , the readjustment of the supply structure and industrial structure should be integrated with that of the mix of ownership systems .
in a broad sense , the readjustment of the mix of ownership systems is part of structural readjustment .
readjust the strategic distribution of state enterprises in a big way . getting rid of state enterprises that do not enjoy an edge in the competitive industries should facilitate the development of those industries .
their role in structural readjustment is growing by the day .
enterprise reform is fundamental .
in the case of the capital market , if we readjust the structure of the volume of capital and the increase in capital , that would help the development and application of new technology .

after hearing the case , the guangdong provincial higher people 's court made a ruling last december . it rejected the appeals of zhuo zhenyuan and others , maintained the original sentences and , in accordance with the law , made a report to the supreme people 's court for examination and approval .
after reexamination , the supreme people 's court held that the conduct of zhuo zhenyuan and others of jointly counterfeiting the renminbi among themselves or in conjunction with others constituted the crime of counterfeiting money and that they were all principal culprits playing a major role in this case .

the exceptionally big counterfeit money case in shanwei , guangdong , is the biggest money counterfeiting case since the founding of the republic . it is also one of the biggest cases in which the people 's court has given the heaviest sentence and dealt the strongest blow .

our military now has its first law for maintaining information safety and secrecy - - the " chinese people 's liberation army [ pla ] provision for maintaining safety and secrecy of computer and information system . "
with the approval of the central military commission , the four headquarters and general departments co - signed this " provision " the other day , indicating that our military 's information safety and secrecy work has started to enter the path of development and be secured in line with law .
the newly promulgated " provision " has nine chapters and 41 clauses .
based on the " chinese pla secrecy regulations " and the " chinese pla technology safety and secrecy regulations , " this provision highlights network security and secrecy . in addition to basing itself on realities , this provision also keeps eyes on development , integrating science with practice , advanced nature with workability , and perspective with reality .
the phenomenon of " placing the building of network ahead of protection , " and " paying attention to construction while belittling secrecy " should be banned .
in line with the demands of information warfare and the present situation in the current network information security and secrecy , the " provision " clearly calls for establishing a mechanism to cope with emergencies in the computer information system and establishing contingency organizations in order to deal with sudden events and carry out emergency guarantee tasks .
particularly , the " provision " also stresses the issue of testing , assessing and legalizing the security products , demanding that all products for ensuring safety and for testing the military computer information system should be submitted to testing , evaluation and certification by the pla information security evaluation and certification center .
the implementation of this provision has provided an effective guarantee for our military to manage the " network " in line with law and to ensure information safety .

it is only three weeks since bush 's inauguration on 20 january , but president george w. bush himself and his cabinet members have been unable to hold themselves back and have talked a lot about the national missile defense system (nmd) , thus showing their " firm determination " to deploy the nmd .
all at once , the nmd has again become the focus of a heated debate and argument between the united states and the international community .
first , the bush administration has basically abandoned the clinton administration 's " conditional deployment , " which was determined by " four major variables , " and has regarded such deployment " indispensable " once relevant technology is mature .
however , bush has put forward that on the one hand , it is necessary to deploy a large - scale ballistic missile defense system , and on the other hand , to speed up nuclear disarmament . he even said the united states and russia could reduce the number of their respective nuclear warheads to less than 1,500 .
at the surface of things , the bush administration seems to use further reduction of nuclear weapons as a " condition " for deploying the nmd , thus giving prominence to the " defensive nature " of its military strategy .
as a matter of fact , even if the united states reduces the number of its offensive strategic nuclear warheads to less than 1,500 , it can still maintain its super - powerful offensive strategic deterrence .
if the united states deploys the nmd , it will be the only country in the world that can maintain powerful offensive strategic deterrence as well as powerful defensive strategic deterrence , and the global strategic stability will certainly be upset .
therefore , the bush administration 's emphasis on further reduction of strategic nuclear weapons , using this to disguise its nmd plan , does not change in the least the nmd 's disastrous impact on international strategic balance .
third , with regard to the nmd weapon system plan , the bush administration will further expand the scope of the unitary land - based interceptors put forward by the clinton administration , and boosting phase interception and ship - based interceptors will gradually become part of the bush administration 's nmd deployment plan .
fourth , the clinton administration 's nmd plan was mainly to defend the us territory against attacks of ballistic missiles , but the bush administration has planned to put all its allies under the nmd protective umbrella .
the purpose of the bush administration is not just to quiet down its european allies ' worries and opposition against the nmd plan , but also to strengthen the us obligation concerning the security of europe and other regions of the world , and to further dominate the defense cooperation between the united states and its allies .
fifth , the bush administration has added new military strategic demands on the nmd .
integrating the deployment of the nmd with the us information security and space security and stepping up militarization of outer space have become a new priority in the us military strategic development .
the bush administration has bent on deploying the nmd to seek absolute strategic advantage . this will inevitably incur the strong opposition of russia , china and european countries .
the implementation of this plan will entail serious negative consequences to the security of other countries , the united states ' own security , and the global strategic stability .
in other words , the nmd policy of the bush administration has given off a strong signal that the united states will further pursue its hegemonic policy in the 21 st century , which has cast a dark shadow on international relations in the new millennium , and the international community must maintain high vigilance .
just when people have expectantly arrived in the new century , a bad omen is covering the world : the us administration which has just come to power has repeatedly announced that no matter how the international community opposes it , the united states is determined to deploy the national missile defense (nmd) system .
the united states will carry out the fourth test of nmd interception technology in may and june this year .
why is the united states determined to deploy nmd ?
the behavior of the united states in stubbornly sticking to its course on the nmd issue is precisely an expression of this hegemonist psychology of " i alone command respect . "
in order to seek absolute security and exercise world hegemony , the new administration has right from the start been impatient in proposing changes to the clinton administration 's nmd program .
according to reports , in contrast to clinton 's " limited nmd program , " bush 's ideas on nmd are more radical and big , and the most important change is to switch the nmd system from land - based interception to three - dimensional interception from land , sea , and space .
the space war exercise codenamed " (sclaf) 2001 " recently conducted in secret by the us air force was aimed at paving the way for the deployment of nmd .
as everyone knows , the abm treaty signed by the soviet union and the united states in 1972 laid down that the united states and the soviet union cannot build nmd systems for intercepting attacks by each other 's long - range nuclear weapons .
this mechanism for mutually assured destruction gradually formed into a strategic balance between the major powers and played the role of preventing the outbreak of nuclear war .
today , however , the determination of the united states to tear up the abm treaty and unilaterally deploy nmd in pursuit of hegemony is bound to deal a serious blow at the world security situation .
first of all , the us - russian nuclear disarmament process will suffer a serious setback and could go into reverse .
the us - russian nuclear disarmament process is actually an equal reduction of the number of each side 's nuclear weapons , based on abm [ as received ] , that is , both sides maintain roughly equal numbers to ensure mutual deterrence .
if the united states deploys nmd , the already fragile strategic balance between the united states and russia will be broken .

beijing , 12 feb ( xinhua ) - - foreign investment in china in real terms during 2000 amounted to $ 40.772 billion , up 0.93 percent from the previous year , according to ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation [ moftec ] statistics .
the impact of the asian financial crisis in the second half of 1997 on china 's economy was felt first in china 's foreign economic relations and trade .
in 1999 , actual foreign investment in china was near $ 40.4 billion . this figure , even though considerable , was 12.8 percent lower than that in the previous year . it was the first negative growth in recent years .
the volume of contracted foreign investment also declined , a rare development unseen in many years .
there were notably more high - tech projects and more research and development centers set up by foreign businesses in china . in addition , the average amount of investment in projects further increased , and there were more multinational corporations investing in china , reflecting china 's increased appeal to them .
china faces new opportunities in attracting foreign investment in the new century .
the flow of capitals from multinational corporations will provide favorable external conditions for china to attract foreign investment .
we must accelerate the pace of improving our foreign investment management structure and introduce new policies to encourage foreign investment .
we must build a number of large high - tech foreign - invested projects , represented by those in the it sector , to bring about a major improvement in the mix of foreign investment in our country .
at the same time , we must also realize that the base number of foreign investment in china is already quite large . on top of this , since 1995 , the proportion of multinational buyout , takeover , and merger has gradually increased and has become a principal form of direct foreign investment .
in the year 2000 , global investment by multinational corporations is expected to top $ 1 trillion , with takeover and merger accounting for 85 percent .
because china 's relevant legal code is still not quite sound and comprehensive , its market mechanism not quite mature , and its capital market not fully open , some 70 percent of direct foreign investment in china are through joint venture and cooperation , with only a portion invested in wholly - owned companies .
in light of this , while direct foreign investment in china in the next few years will maintain positive growth , the growth rate will not be very big .
just before the spring festival , the state council office for checking unhealthy tendencies in business activities , the state economic and trade commission , and the people 's bank of china [ pboc ] jointly issued a notice , strictly banning the issuance and use of any kind of token money coupon ( card ) .
but why should the issuance of token money coupons ( cards ) be banned ?
to answer this question , this reporter visited the experts in relevant departments .
also , because it is impossible to deduct tax directly from the token money coupons ( cards ) , when token money is given out as gifts , it would be very difficult for the unit to deduct and pay personal income tax on behalf of the recipients .
furthermore , for promotional purposes , businesses tend to offer a certain amount of rebate on block buying in proportion to the amount purchased and almost none of the recipients of such benefit would pay personal income tax on their own accord .
many consumers and businesses are of the opinion that using token money in consumption is a modern method of settlement and a natural product of the market economy .
senior financiers pointed out that this viewpoint is biased .
swiping cards by consumers is indeed a modern means of electronic payment and is fast and convenient . in the field of payment , the gradual replacement of cash consumption by electronic money is increasingly becoming the choice of consumers .
but this is perfectly possible to achieve simply with all kinds of bank cards issued in accordance with the regulations . the financial sector is also providing ever - improving electronic services .
therefore , it is not hard to see that to stubbornly insist that " token money must be able to exist as a modern means of settlement " will only create opportunities for bribery and corruption , because payment without cash would definitely give the green light to unhealthy practices .
this is because after token money is issued and used , group purchases will increase and this tends to bring in considerable sales for the businesses within a short time , but this is actually a false boom and huge crises are lurking behind these pretty bubbles .
as the desire for greater profits escalates and because the use of coupons and cards has been confined to individual stores , the consumers has no choice and businesses tend to allow the quality of their services other than sales to go down .
a person in charge of a large state - owned store in guangzhou talked about the negative experience that they had had in this respect and said with profound feeling : " just the thought of it still scares me . "
having experienced the failure brought on by shopping cards , this person expressed the wish that major stores would not repeat this mistake .
many businesses have made an appeal that stores under all forms of ownership , be they state - owned , joint ventures , or foreign - funded , should strictly abide by state regulations and create an environment of fair competition .
it seems that in order to firmly put an end to the issuance of " token money , " it is imperative to strengthen government regulation and not to let the prohibition end up merely as a gust of wind .

fuzhou , 12 feb (zxs) - - statistics released by the fujian provincial procuratorate show that , in 2000 , fujian 's procuratorial authorities prosecuted a total of 52 bribery cases , which involved more than 35 million yuan .
one case involved bribes of 5.8 million yuan , the highest . the main causes of these bribery cases were : 1 . people bribed their superiors because they wanted to buy official positions .
for example , ding yangning , secretary of the zhenghe county cpc committee , bought the position through bribing his superiors . after he assumed the office , many of his subordinates also bribed him in order to be promoted to higher positions . the number of people and the amounts of bribes involved were shocking . 2 .
some people bribed party and government organs , administrative officers , and law enforcement personnel to seek " protection " for their smuggling and counterfeiting activities .
some people gave bribes in the form of " commission " in order to market their products , especially salesmen .
they sold their merchandise , such as pharmaceuticals , schoolbooks , insurance policies , and motor vehicles , by giving the buyers a " commission , " usually a certain percentage of the money they paid for the purchases . 5 .
criminal suspects who bribed judicial personnel in order not to be punished by the law .
in one gang rape case in gutian county , the families of the three suspects bribed public security , procuratorial , and court personnel with tens of thousands of yuan . as a result , the three were acquitted in the first trial . the case created an extremely bad influence in the county .
meanwhile , fujian 's procuratorial authorities are studying the distinctive characteristics and the laws of bribery in an effort to improve their investigation and intensify their efficiency .

using the " basic standards " to solidify the foundation the aim of state - owned enterprise reform is to establish a modern enterprise system , and the perennial main theme of developing state - owned enterprises is improving management .
in october 2000 , the general office of the state council transmitted the " basic standards for establishing a modern enterprise system and improving management in large and medium - sized state - owned enterprises ( trial implementation ) " drafted by the state economic and trade commission and other relevant departments .
these " basic standards " are the result of many years of practice and experience in establishing a modern enterprise system and improving enterprise management . they are the norms of conduct for institutional innovation and management innovation in large and medium - sized state - owned enterprises .
through implementation of the " basic standards , " the establishment of a modern enterprise system in state - owned enterprises will be standardized in a step - by - step fashion ; the standard of management will be improved daily ; and the foundation for development will become stronger and stronger .

however , our problem is how to scientifically and realistically introduce the mechanism of competition .
now , people still have many disputes and different opinions on this question .
since 1985 when china implemented the policy of allowing various enterprises to run power stations with the funds raised through various channels , great changes have taken place in the organizational structure of the power industry .

to this end , it is necessary to strengthen the unified planning and construction of power transmission network to ensure the safe and stable operation of power grids and expedite the progress of the national integrated power network .
establish modern enterprise system given the market economic system , competition is the most effective method to intensify the external restraints of enterprises , to optimize the distribution of resources , and to improve efficiency .
however , to give full play to the role of competition mechanism , it is also necessary to build power companies into enterprises with diversified stock rights through the form of inter - enterprise equity participation , and establish a mutually controlled and standardized structure of corporate management .

a mv-22 osprey of the us marine corps crashed on the night of 11 december 2000 in northern california during a training mission .
it was a serious accident in the wake of the sudden crash of another osprey on 8 april during a combat evaluation flight , which killed 19 people .
the next day of the crash in california , the us department of defense ordered the postponement of mass production of this innovative tilt - rotor craft .
on 8 april last year , a no. 14 mv-22 osprey deviated westward from its normal course during a combat assessment flight in marana air force base in tucson , arizona . immediately afterward , its head tilted downward and crashed on the ground , causing explosions and fire .

beijing , 14 feb ( xinhua ) - - beginning 20 february , the evaluation commission under the international olympic committee [ ioc ] will investigate beijing , osaka , toronto , istanbul , and paris that have presented their bids for hosting the 2008 olympic games .
an ioc executive board meeting was held in senegal days ago to unanimously pass the letter from ioc president juan antonio samaranch to hein verbruggen , chairman of the ioc evaluation commission .
samaranch stressed in his letter that investigation of candidate cities should focus on investigation of their hosting capabilities and refrain from political issues .
ioc executive member he zhenliang said at an exclusive interview on 14 february that this was the first time for the ioc to define a principle on separating bidding from politics .
the ioc has 15 executive members , who all attended the executive board meeting held in senegal .
samaranch also mentioned that the evaluation commission should not take political factors into consideration .
samaranch signed the letter and sent it to the chairman of the ioc evaluation commission and various candidate cities .
after the meeting , samaranch convened a press conference in which he reiterated , while answering reporters ' questions , the principle that he had mentioned in his letter .
he zhenliang maintained that the principle that samaranch expounded in his letter completely conforms to the ioc regulations . that is , the ioc must not have political , religious , racial , and gender prejudice .

us bush administration is inclined to deploy the national missile defense system ( nmd ) . the chinese communists ' official and academic circles , after some debate , have suggested that china should carry out a " limited arms expansion " and continue to develop corresponding nuclear weapons " in excess of defense need . "
according to informed sources , the chinese communists ' official and academic circles have discussed whether the chinese communists will get involved in an arms race caused by the nmd and how they should cope with the dilemma .
one of their views is that once the united states deploys the nmd , the arms race of the cold war era will reappear ; and that for its own security , the chinese communists will join the nuclear arms race and risk a serious economic collapse .
the former soviet union suffered an economic collapse precisely because of its participation in an arms race with the united states .
some people believe that us deployment of the nmd is aimed at the chinese communists and is designed to get the chinese communists involved in an arms race , and large military spending on arms will delay china 's economic development .
so , if the chinese communists will indeed spend a large amount of money on arms development , they will fall into the us trap .
a second view is that to prevent arms race from causing economic collapse , it is better not to make any response to us development of the nmd .
those holding this view believe that the chinese communists should not develop any more inter - continental nuclear strike force and they should only maintain a small nuclear arsenal as a deterrence against non - nuclear countries and the countries which possess a small quantity of nuclear weapons .
however , since both views contain some lopsided aspects , there is also a compromise view that the economic collapse of the soviet union was not necessarily the result of arms race ; and that judging from mainland china 's present economic situation , a limited arms expansion will not harm the chinese communists ' economy .
to give up the development of nuclear weapons will not only weaken national defense , but also cause a sense of crisis which will adversely affect finance , the society and economic development and weaken foreign relations as well .
the theory is that if on a defense system , it requires four [ anti - missile ] missiles to defend against one attacking missile , the defender 's spending will be three times that of the attacker .
the person who is familiar with the debate pointed out : although the chinese communists know that the probability of using nuclear weapons is very low , " continuing to moderately develop a small nuclear arsenal " has still become their main thinking because of a sense of security and the symbolic significance of nuclear weapons .
in a period to come , the chinese communists will step up the development of nuclear arms , and the scale will be that of a nuclear deterrence " in excess of defense need . "
however , he has also acknowledged that such a thinking of the chinese communists with respect to arms development is giving the us side a justification to develop the nmd .

dong bingyin was one of the best experts in air - to - air missiles nurtured in new china .
dedicating his whole life to cause of air - to - air missiles [ subhead ] an air - to - air missile is a kind of tactical missile which is loaded on aircraft to attack enemy aircraft .
as attacking aircraft and the aircraft to be attacked are all in highly agile movements , air - to - air missiles should be both small and light and have long range and high precision . therefore , its research and development are the most difficult and challenging .
" for the security of national defense , we must succeed in developing advanced air - to - air missiles ! "
since he graduated from university and was assigned to china 's research institute of air - to - air missiles , dong bingyin dedicated his whole life to the cause of air - to - air missiles of the motherland .
as early as in 1984 , dong bingyin was determined to develop a new generation of missiles .
subsequently , he submitted reports to departments concerned with unflagging patience and even ventured to write to deng xiaoping requesting to develop a new generation of air - to - air missiles .
not long afterward , china 's research institute of air - to - air missiles started the prelude to the development of a new generation of missiles .
when he died of illness , he was still concurrently the chief designer of two key models .
" chief designer dong worked himself to the point of collapse with the building of a powerful national defense ! "
in 1997 , the first range test of a certain key model was not successful .
he could neither sleep nor eat properly and felt short of breath . his two legs were like lead and trembled with every step . nevertheless , he still withstood the pressures and endured the pains .
on the one hand , he comforted other comrades and on the other hand he organized people to find out the cause of troubles .
seeing dong bingyin , deputy commander yang of the base who was kind - hearted felt greatly surprised : " how come you are in such a state ?
you must stay in a hospital for treatment ! "
while having an intravenous drip , dong bingyin still asked the scientific and technological personnel to his medical ward to discuss again and again and look for the cause for this incident .
he said : " i seek neither fame nor profit . i should do another key model for the country even at the cost of my old life ! "
to conduct scientific research , it is most necessary to attach importance to facts [ subhead ] the new type of missiles which dong bingyin took charge of its development is only possessed by a few developed countries .
at that time , a foreign expert claimed that if china wants to develop a new generation of missiles it must let foreigners assume the post of chief designer .
in 1997 , the first range test of a certain key model in a certain base in northwestern china was unsuccessful .
at that time , there were two entirely different opinions : some people said that the generator was not good enough and strongly demanded to change the generator .
but if this new type of generator is changed , undoubtedly the advanced nature of this missile would be greatly discounted .
however , if the cause of trouble was really the generator , who should take up the responsibility , then ?
dong bingyin and his test team as well as officers and soldiers at the base looked for the fragments in the vast gobi desert in a manner of fishing for needles in the ocean .
the yearly water evaporation capacity in the gobi desert is over 60 times the rainfall there and in midsummer the gobi desert is even as hot as an oven .
it created two international precedents and filled up one domestic gap , thus raising the development level of china 's air - to - air missiles go to a new stage of self design from copying .
he said that we could talk about it by the end of the year after we have made several more successful tests .
therefore , this news was not widely known to people until dong bingyin died .
the research of air - to - air missiles has congregated several thousand experts of numerous units and numerous scientific disciplines and dong bingyin could not possibly be well versed in all these fields of specialized knowledge .
however , whenever he had the opportunity he would consult others and read study materials . he paid special attention to the exchange and study with other experts on equal footing .
in the end , he became surprisingly knowledgeable .
but as long as dong bingyin was around , people felt at ease because chief designer dong could always balance all the arguments .

beijing , 15 feb ( xinhua ) - - recently the cpc central committee , state council , and central military commission issued a joint circular on a decision to promulgate a " provisional procedure for placement of military cadres transferred to civilian jobs . "
according to the procedure , the state will , from now on , adopt both the planned - assignment and free - choice - of - work methods in placing military cadres transferred to civilian jobs .
with regard to military cadres to be transferred to civilian jobs by the planned - job - assignment method , the " provisional procedure " stipulates that the party committee and government concerned should assign jobs to them according to their qualifications , ranks in the military , previous contributions , and expertise .
however , they may be placed in equivalent non - leadership positions if the local party committee and government have too many divisional and regimental leading cadres to settle and if it is certainly difficult to place all of them in leading positions .
in the assignment of jobs to cadres who were holding divisional or regimental positions in the military , consideration should be given to the need for strengthening local leading bodies .
cadres who choose the free - choice - of - work method should be given the same political treatment as retired civilian cadres . each month , they should receive a retirement pension from the local government .
for cadres who were models with meritorious deeds , who have worked for a long time in border , remote , and difficult areas , who were flying crew members , or who have worked on ships , their pension will be increased in a certain proportion according to their respective conditions .
in terms of medical care and social insurance , military cadres assigned civilian jobs in party and government organizations or institutions should receive the same treatment as other personnel at the same level or with equivalent qualifications .
when recruiting employees , party and government organizations , enterprises , and other units should give priority consideration to those military cadres who choose the free - choice - of - work method , provided that the vacancies are suitable for them .
all departments concerned should make earnest arrangements and coordinate closely to see to it that military cadres transferred to civilian jobs are properly settled whether they come under the job - assignment plan or are in the free - choice - of - work category .

the national defense budget was $ 267.6 billion in 1998 , $ 278.2 billion in 1999 , $ 289 billion in 2000 , and $ 296 billion in 2001 .
the us national defense budget has not only increased in real terms in recent years , since its percentage increases have also risen year on year .
us military spending has successively set new records since the end of the cold war , and this trend is likely to continue for a time .
even such a high national defense budget can hardly satisfy the demands of us defense expenditure .
according to a report published by the congressional budget office on 14 september 2000 , although the defense budget for fiscal 2000 was $ 289 billion , actual expenditure was over $ 340 billion ( at 2000 values ) , $ 51 billion higher than the budgeted amount .
as in past years , armaments and equipment research and development and procurement remain the biggest item on the national defense budget for fiscal 2002 .

beijing , 15 feb ( zts ) - - with close cooperation between china 's judicial administrative organs and legislative bodies , a law governing reeducation through labor is expected to be introduced this year .
a reform of rural fees and taxes which is aimed at thoroughly lightening peasants ' burdens and increasing peasants ' income will be carried out in china 's rural areas in an extensive scope .
a senior official of the chinese government pointed out that the reform of rural fees and taxes is another major reform in china 's rural areas after the land reform and the practice of contractual management on household basis .
the recently ended rural work meeting of the cpc central committee pointed out even more clearly that this reform will help maintain social stability in china 's rural areas and promote china 's agricultural and rural economic development .
since china universally practiced the household contract responsibility system with remuneration linked to output in the rural areas in mid-1980's , the interests between peasants , state , and collective are mainly defined through the agricultural taxes and pertinent fees .
with the passage of time , such an interest distribution relationship has been seriously out of line with the realities .
the excessively heavy burdens of the peasants have triggered a series of problems and aroused the attention of the central authorities .
in 1992 and 1996 , the state council twice issued documents stipulating that the fees concerned must not exceed 5 percent of the peasants ' annual per capita net income .
an economist pointed out that the excessively heavy burdens of peasants have made them short of sufficient financial resources to put into production and directly affected the economic development and social stability in the rural areas .
in march 2000 , the chinese government decided to make experiments of tax and fee reform in the entire province of anhui first , which will be popularized in some provinces and cities across the country this year and basically completed in 2002 .
the core content of rural tax and fee reform in anhui province is to abolish or adjust these " fees , " so that the interest distribution relationship between peasants , state , and collective will be expressed in the form of " taxes , " thus enabling the relationship of the three to be more standardized and legalized .
except the agricultural tax and its additional charge , no department has the right to levy any other fees from the peasants in any name .
in anhui 's rural areas , big halls for handing in taxes have been set up in many places , and the modes of tax collection have been initially standardized .
in the meantime , the chinese government has made plans to subsidize the gap between the normal revenue and expenditure of townships and villages by the central and provincial finances .
in the experimental sites for the reform of rural taxes and fees in anhui province , the structural reform in the township and town organs and institutions has begun to be carried out one after another in various localities .
in shaoying township , yingquan district , fuyang city , the number of village cadres across the township was reduced from 348 to 138 , the office expenses were cut by a big margin , and various tasks at the village level were in normal operation .
anhui is the province where china 's rural reform originated , as the contract responsibility system for production with remuneration linked to output was first practiced here in 1978 .
but as three gorges project resettlement and socio - economic development have gone forward , new situations and new problems have begun to appear during the process of resettlement .

the jinhua county court in zhejiang recently sentenced wang yougui to seven years in prison in accordance with the law on charges of creating trouble , blackmailing , and extortion . his 15 gang members received sentences ranging from four years and six months in prison to two years under surveillance .
wang yougui is a native of tangxi town , jinhua county , and was formerly a worker at the jinlan reservoir waterway administration in jinhua county .
in 1997 , he became a member of the county 's cppcc committee and a local " celebrity . "
in april 1998 , wang yougui brought some people to zhejiang 's jiufeng liquor factory . because nobody in the factory paid him any attention , he gave the factory chief a thrashing and also punched and kicked other people who came forward to help .

military experts believe that the blind addition of military outlays by the us and their vigorous development of new and advanced weaponry will inevitably result in a serious imbalance in the world 's military force and will trigger a new round of the arms race , having an adverse impact on the stability of the world 's security environment .
just as last year , the research & development ( r & d ) and procurement of weaponry is still the main part of the us national defense budget for fiscal 2002 .
at present , weaponry r & d and procurement costs are already as high as $ 90 billion , and in the budget for the coming fiscal year this may approach or exceed the $ 100 billion mark .
the united states is the most powerful military country in the world , but it is still continuing to pursue absolute superiority and absolute security .

military experts point out that the restoration of the glonass satellite system means that russia will be able to provide high - precision satellite navigation and position - finding at any time and any place .

the official media of communist china formally issued a " correction " yesterday ( 15 february ) regarding an incorrect report on acceptance of " one country , two systems " voiced by taipei mayor ma ying - jeou [ ma ying - chiu ] during his recent visit to hong kong .
this practice is rarely seen , and has aroused attention from both chinese and foreign media based in beijing .
therefore , communist china has attached importance to the issue and taken the initiative to put forward a " correction " in order to avoid creating any trouble for ma ying - jeou .
when questioned by these reporters , the chief editor 's office of the china daily said frankly that the report on 14 february was " indeed inappropriate . " however , the newspapers were printed , and the only thing that could be done was to make a " correction " the next day .
according to people at the chief editor 's office , the newspaper took the initiative to put forward a " correction " since it was the first to discover the mistake , and that there were no letters from outside demanding a change .
however the " correction " put forward by the china daily mentioned only the first half of the statement , and omitted " each side having its own interpretations . "
asked what they would do if ma ying - jeou writes to ask for a correction , the people at the chief editor 's office said , " let 's deal with that issue when it happens ! "
it is rare that the official media of communist china admit to mistakes , and it is indeed unprecedented that any official chinese media take the initiative to put forward a correction on the remarks reportedly made by political figures in taiwan .

during the cold war , us military attached great importance to guam and turned it into a large front line base . the us military not only repaired anderson air base but also repaired and built important military facilities including the agana aviation station and a nuclear submarine base at apra harbor .
during the vietnam war , guam fully demonstrated its strategic position . us b-52 long - range bombers departed from here to carry out wanton bombing of vietnam .
after the cold war , due to strategic adjustment , us troops in guam were reduced by a great extent .
however , in recent years , the military role of guam has again be emphasized . the united states has been constantly strengthening its military forces in guam .
in august last year , the us department of defense confirmed that it would deploy 64 cruise missiles in guam . those cruise missiles can be carried by us strategic bombers to attack any place in asia within 12 hours .

because of this , except for the industries that need to be specially controlled by national regulations , the field of non - government capital investment must be broadened .
the next point is that policies must be implemented that give equal treatment .
aside from this , restrictions on qualifications for investors must be relaxed .
according to what data reveal , the sluggish situation of china 's non - government investment since last year has already started preliminary steps toward recovery , and it is estimated that the increase in non - government investment in the year 2000 may possibly approach 8 percent .
sources from china 's business and economic circles optimistically indicated that , following the appearance of further broadening of individual investment channels and the situation of a future economic upsurge , the demand for china 's non - government investment will reach a peak .

beijing , 19 feb ( xinhua ) - - under the leadership of the cpc central committee and the state council , the task of carrying out institutional reforms in state bureaus administered by the state economic and trade commission and reorganizing the institutions inside the state economic and trade commission has now been basically completed .
today , the state economic and trade commission gave a briefing on the results of such reforms . then , why should the nine state bureaus administered by the commission be dismantled in the institutional reorganization ?
according to the briefing , in 1998 , when a major institutional reform was carried out in the state council , some specialized economic management departments were reorganized into state bureaus , and there were a total of 10 state bureaus administered by the state economic and trade commission .
the state bureaus were taken as transitional institutions to be kept for a transitional period of three years .
so the specialized economic management ministries were first changed into state bureaus , and the state bureaus might be dismantled in the next step .
at the same time , corresponding institutional reforms were also carried out in all provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities , where the bureaus specialized in economic administration were mostly dismantled , and their administrative functions were transferred to the local economic and trade commissions .
all this created necessary conditions for the eventual dismantling of the commission - administered state bureaus .

question : how should the shanghai stock exchange and the shenzhen stock exchange prepare themselves for mainland residents investing on the b - share market ?
question : how should mainland residents with legitimate foreign exchange funds enter the b - share market ?

answer : insofar as i know , in the past , we did come across such a problem that some mainland residents had opened an account in disguised form on the b - share market .

as demonstrated by facts , the putting forward of the " three represents " principle represented an inevitable conclusion reached by comrade jiang zemin in the process of conducting in - depth thinking on the various risks and challenges confronting party building in the new period from the perspective of the overall historical trend and the overall world situation .
the " three represents " principle profoundly reveals the inherent requirements regarding our party 's effort to control the overall situation amid complexities reform , opening up , and the development of a socialist market economy have given unprecedented vitality and vigor to our country 's work in all areas .
in building socialist economics , politics , and culture with chinese characteristics , it is necessary to sum up a lot of practical experience , to resolve many important practical problems , and to explore many areas not well understood , and there are no ready - made formulas to follow .
the putting forward of the " three represents " principle has not only further concretized the overall goal of the great project of party building in the new period , but has also provided a fundamental criterion for evaluating the practical results of party building in the new period .
if the " three benefits " principle is the fundamental criterion for determining whether the party 's principles and politics are correct or not , then the " three represents " principle constitutes the fundamental criterion for evaluating the successfulness of party building .
with the " three represents " principle serving as a criterion and guarantee , our party will be able , in a fundamental way , to correctly view and resolve many new situations and new issues in regard to its own construction .
acting steadfastly to comprehensively enhance party building in accordance with the " three represents " requirement is fundamental to achieving the grand goals of reform , opening up , and socialist modernization construction .
the spirit of being indifferent to personal fame and interests and dedicating oneself to one 's career is incompatible with those corrupt ideas by nature .
is it unrealistically demanding to advocate the spirit of being indifferent to personal fame and interests and dedicating oneself to one 's career in light of the fact that profit plays an increasingly important role in the development of the socialist market economy and social life ?
however , we must understand that developments and changes in social consciousness are not synchronous with those in social existence .
components of ideology , ideas and mentality do not reflect the economic situation in a passive and mechanical manner but in an active and dynamic manner .
being the first to show concern but the last to enjoy oneself and keeping the people and the party 's projects firmly in mind are characteristics that should be found in party members .
they should hold correct attitudes towards themselves , the organization and the masses .
the spirit of being indifferent to personal fame and interests and dedicating oneself to one 's career is both an excellent tradition and a political quality of our military .
despite new historical conditions , this spirit is still an indispensable ideological and political guarantee that assures our military of new achievements and new accomplishments .
let us imagine if without the spirit of being indifferent to personal fame and interests and dedicating oneself to one 's career we could correctly understand and enthusiastically participate in the reform , given the adjustment of various interest relationships that are brought forth by deepening the reform ?
if without the national feeling that " i would sacrifice my life to meet the requirements of my ancestors , " could we concentrate on preparing for the military struggle , fulfilling our sacred duties and carrying out the mission of protecting the national security , realizing the national reunification and maintaining social stability ?

new york , 19 feb (zxs) - - zhou mingwei , deputy director of taiwan affairs office of the state council , said today that there are old as well as new meanings in the " three sentences " of qian qichen 's recent remarks , and there are new ideas in the old wording too .
he said : on behalf of president jiang zemin and the central authorities , vice premier qian qichen made remarks regarding the issue of reunifying the motherland in three sentences on some important occasions .
what is the difference ?
in my opinion - - i am not officially authorized to put it this way - - there are old as well as new meanings in the " three sentences , " and there are new ideas in the old wording too .
during his informal talk with some personalities from the overseas chinese circles in new york on the taiwan issue today , zhou mingwei gave an interpretation to the " three sentences " of qian qichen 's recent remarks , for which people at home and abroad have showed great concern .
he said : the first sentence is " there is only one china in the world . "
i can interpret it this way : one china is not what i said and imposed it on others , because in your " constitution " and in mine , we all acknowledge that there is one china .
even the countries having " diplomatic ties " with taiwan also maintain that there is only one china .
this is a fact too .
this time , the meaning is more clearly expressed .
is there any other implications ?
when interviewed by the phoenix satellite television , vice premier qian qichen unequivocally said that this sentence indicates that in the future political talks across the strait , we will hold negotiations on an equal footing .
a large number of articles in taiwan maintain that these words show great tolerance and there is considerable room for reasonable exposition and development .
this has also demonstrated our sincerity .
president jiang zemin said on many occasions that any issue can be discussed through equal consultations .
the third sentence is : " china 's sovereignty and territorial integrity cannot be separated . "
there is no leeway for it .
no sooner was the new leader of taiwan elected than president jiang zemin said : i can go there and he can come here .
mexico city , 18 feb ( renmin ribao ) - - on 16 february , us president george w. bush paid an eight - hour lightning visit to mexico .
he and mexican president vicente fox held working talks for nearly three hours in the latter 's private mansion .
after the end of the talks , the two parties issued a joint statement and met with reporters together .
according to mexico 's official statistics , there are 8.3 million mexicans living in the united states , including more than 3 million migrants without a license ( i . e . , illegal immigrants ) .
the mexican side holds that the mexican migrants have made important contributions to us development and prosperity .
the mexican government has consistently called on the united states to eliminate the discrimination against the mexican migrants , accord them humanitarian treatment , grant amnesty to those migrants without a license , and open the border to facilitate free personnel exchanges .
the policies and measures taken on the question of migration should reflect the interests of both countries and remove problems that exist in the aspect of migration .
drugs are a problem that frequently gives rise to disagreement between the two countries .
the united states , which always has no confidence in mexico 's antidrug operations , has called on mexico to fight drugs more ruthlessly .
mexico holds , however , that the large numbers of drugtakers and the massive demand for drugs in the united states are the key reasons for the overflow of drugs in the united states .
on the basis of respecting each other 's judicial power , the two countries will examine and adjust the relevant policies , intensively crack down on drug - related crimes , and step up bilateral and multilateral cooperation in fighting drugs .
to this end , both parties will set up a high - level work team to study corresponding measures .
with regards to the trade disputes between the two countries , as well as the existing problems in their cooperation in the fields of energy , science and technology , environmental protection , education , and culture , both parties expressed the need to study and resolve them .
in their view , the summit meeting of the american states to be held in canada in april this year will be an important meeting to consolidate the regional " democratic mechanism " and promote economic growth .
both parties expressed their support to expedite the setting up of the american free trade area .
however , bush 's present visit has given people the impression of failing to achieve concrete results .
the us side has merely uttered some empty words , such as " improving relations , " " stepping up cooperation , " and " common prosperity , " but the practical problems have not been resolved and differences between the two countries still remain .
although bush and fox said that they would maintain regular meetings during their terms of office , the long - standing problems between the two countries can hardly be resolved quickly .
beijing , 19 feb - - the 20 th century witnessed the great glory of the chinese people , yet it also left behind a feeling among chinese people of regret at not having unified the motherland .
the new century is here and the important task of achieving complete unification of the motherland has historically fallen on the shoulders of all chinese sons and daughters at home and abroad .
although the two sides of the taiwan strait have disagreed in the several decades since 1949 over the political meaning of " one china , " both insist that there is only one china .
the " one china " principle is the common position and basis of cooperation for both sides of the strait .
only on the foundation of the " one china " consensus can the two sides become engaged , start exchanges , and allow dialogue and negotiation to achieve results .
the " one china " principle is also a recognized fact among the international community .
no matter what kinds of changes occur in taiwan 's regional political circles , taiwan 's status as part of china cannot be changed .
quick resolution of the taiwan issue and realization of complete unification of the motherland are major undertakings that involve the basic interests of people on both sides of the strait .
however , although the taiwan authorities ' new leader has used seemingly moderate words in his series of statements , he has yet to clearly state his position of whether he accepts the fact of " one china . "
failure to do so has resulted in political turmoil , an economic landslide , a depressed stock market , and volatility among popular will . not only has it failed to break the cross - strait political deadlock , it has also caused ever - increasing uncertainty .
although the two sides of the strait have yet to unify , they still belong to one china .
this elaboration is entirely accurate and magnanimous .
under the principle of " one china , " we have no objections toward taiwan maintaining economic and cultural relations with foreign countries . however , if someone meddles with the " two states theory , " taiwan 's living space will further shrink .
if people push for " taiwan independence , " it will fail to pass muster not only with the international community but also among chinese people , including a majority of taiwanese compatriots .
before this , the head of china 's association for relations across the taiwan strait (arats) wang dao - han indicated that the two sides of the taiwan strait can negotiate on even standing and jointly discuss unification on the basis of the " one china " principle .
those who submit , prosper .
looking back over the past 10 years , all areas of cross - strait exchanges and cooperation have expanded continuously . we are optimistic about future development of cross - strait relations .
the taiwan authorities ' leader should judge the hour and seize the situation , carefully consider the pros and cons , and recognize the history and reality that the two sides of the taiwan strait belong to a single china .

washington , 19 feb ( xinhua ) - - just as people are striding into the new millennium and looking forward to a secure and fine new century , the us bush administration , heedless of opposition from the international community , has publicly stated that it will continue to develop and deploy the national missile defense (nmd) system .
after bush set the tune , vice president cheney declared that if russia does not agree to revision of the " abm treaty " signed by the united states and the soviet union in 1972 , " the united states can decide to longer observe the treaty . "
according to the clinton administration 's plans , nmd is mainly to protect the whole territory of the united states from icbm attack , whereas the bush administration advocates expanding the coverage of the system by protecting us allies as well as the united states itself .
so far , of the three tests of nmd interception technology conducted by the us military , the first was successful and the other two failed .
the pentagon announced on 6 february that the us military plans to carry out the fourth test of nmd interception technology in may or june .
why is the new us administration so enthusiastic about stepping up the deployment of nmd ?
according to analysis , it is for the following main reasons : first , this is the requirement of us global strategy .
second , us arms manufacturers are unreservedly banging the drums for nmd in order to reap huge profits .
congress ' passage of the nmd bills was to a considerable extent linked to the efforts of interest groups such as the arms manufacturers in adding fuel to the flames .
at present , several large defense enterprises are undertaking contracts for parts of the nmd system ; boeing is making the missiles , lockheed - martin is making the boosters , trm is making the satellite communications equipment , and rayson is making the intercept devices .
so far , us arms manufacturers have made a profit of several billion dollars from research and development of the system .
third , the us military is vigorously carrying out propaganda for nmd to create public opinion , in order to enhance its status and influence in national security decisionmaking .
for this reason , although two of the missile interception tests have failed , the us military is not slackening in the slightest its claim that failure of the missile interception tests will not affect the implementation of the program .
from the reagan administration 's " strategic defense initiative " ( " star wars " ) to george bush 's " global defense system for dealing with limited strikes , " all of them emerged with the republicans in control .
for this reason the republicans proposed bills in the senate in 1997 and 1998 calling for speeding up the nmd program .
during his election campaign bush promised to speed up nmd research , development , and deployment , for which he was strongly supported by the arms manufacturers and by military personnel and their dependants .
after taking up office bush hired a number of former government officials with military backgrounds .
it is evident from this that the republican party 's policy on nmd can be traced to the same origin .
the us nmd program is not only strongly opposed by countries such as russia and china but is also boycotted by us allies such as france , germany , and italy .
in this way the united states can wantonly intervene in the internal affairs of other countries and control international affairs .
however , the us missile defense system cannot effectively protect us security .
a history of world arms development is a history of spear and shield vying for the upper hand .
nmd cannot change this law .
on 15 february , michael klosson , us consul general to hong kong , made comments in houston on hong kong 's affairs , citing examples to show his worry about the central government tightening its control over hong kong 's basic freedom .
these are facts for all to see . the hong kong sar 's affairs are china 's internal affairs . as the us consul general to hong kong , it was inappropriate for michael klosson to make willful comments on these .

mine - sweeping operations carried out by fishing boats - - the method which is commonly used by all countries during the world war i period , the belligerent countries placed about 310,000 mines on the sea . germany , which launched the first offensive , planted the mines and made britain lose 269 warships .
mine - sweeping operations required a great number of mine - sweepers . for this reason , britain promptly requisitioned over 5,000 fishing boats , remodeled them into minesweepers and sent them to participate in mine - sweeping work .
in order to remove the mines as quickly as possible , the british government requisitioned more than 2,000 fishing boats and remodeled them into minesweepers , thus breaking open the mine blockade set by germany .
during a naval battle in the british ama island , all the three minesweepers of the british task fleet were all remodeled from fishing boats .
map inference - - formulate a detailed preliminary plan during recent years , the mine - sweeping brigade organized mine - sweeping training at night or under bad weather conditions such as foggy and stormy days on several occasions .
they highlighted the drill by adopting the combat method of carrying out zone mine - sweeping and all - around mine - sweeping operations , as well as magnetic mine - sweeping and joint land - sweeping operations under the conditions in which the mine - sweeping formation did not know the locations of the mines .
they also completed the training of new subjects by organizing a four - ship mass echelon to remove shallowly planted mooring mines and a double - line formation to clear away untouched mines , and succeeded in enhancing skills in removing mines and destroying obstacles in future high - technology operations .
to rapidly and effectively remove mines and open a safe navigation route on the sea , the minesweeper brigade drew on the experience of china and foreign countries in history of remodeling fishing boats into minesweepers and put forward the task of having army - civilian to jointly remove mines .
they set up a task research group and established the basic combat method of removing mines on the sea through army - civilian joint efforts .
drill on the sea - - an attempt to achieve success at one time the key to ensuring the success of army - civilian joint mine - sweeping operations on the sea is to see whether the performance of fishing boats can meet mine - sweeping requirements .
if these fishing boats are deployed with a professional diving detachment to retrieve mines and professional technical personnel to dissect mines and to test and analyze the property of mines planted by the enemy and their working system , the mine - sweeping operations will be more effective and purposeful .

this joint mine - sweeping drill was a success , setting a precedent for the navy to use fishing boats to carry out an army - civilian joint mine - sweeping drill on the sea and providing a valuable reference for future mine - sweeping operations .
hong kong , 21 feb (zts) - - china securities regulatory commission (csrc) made an announcement on 19 february , allowing domestic residents to open b - share accounts and trade b shares with their legally owned foreign currencies .
personalities from the securities circles think that the introduction of this policy signifies an extremely important breakthrough of china 's unfledged securities markets after a decade of development , which indicates that china is quickening the tempo of internationalizing its securities markets .
with regard to the domestic residents , china has all along allowed them to maintain the foreign currencies that they have legally acquired , and used the residents ' foreign exchange deposits in the domestic economic construction projects that required foreign exchange .
the situation has changed in recent years , particularly since last year , as the foreign exchange deposits of domestic residents have grown relatively fast , and a considerable portion of them have been lent overseas or used to buy foreign bonds by domestic banks .
presently , excessive export of capital is still unsuited for china , being a developing country . allowing domestic residents to invest in b shares with their legally owned foreign currencies , therefore , is a new subject stemming from the changes in the macroeconomic situation .
opening markets on a smaller scale will help avoid the emergence of more serious problems , and opening b shares to the domestic investors also shows that china 's foreign exchange policy will hopefully make breakthroughs .
for a long time , the convertibility of china 's renminbi under the capital accounts has been the focal point of renminbi heading for the world .
according to an analysis , opening b shares to the domestic investors , in essence , means that b shares have extremely large space for development .
at the very beginning , the b - share markets were set up for foreign legal persons and natural persons and aimed at opening up an international financing channel for domestic enterprises , but judging from its course of development , the financing functions of the b - share markets have practically lost .
the overseas analysts are of the opinion that as far as the overseas corporate investors are concerned , opening b - share markets to the domestic residents will boost the attraction of the securities markets in china .
as the main body of investment keeps expanding , the overseas investors will think that they have something to accomplish here , and it is expected that an " upsurge " is brewing , in which a large number of foreign funds will flow into the b - share markets .

over 5,000 satellites have been launched by various countries in the past 40 years since the first manmade satellite was launched in 1957 , of which 70 percent had military uses .
will there be space security in the 21 st century ?
the united states is far and away the leader in the race to conquer space .
the second test came during the kosovo war of 1999 , when nato deployed 15 to 20 different types of satellites totaling more than 50 in coordination , intelligence , and air attacks . the skies over the balkans were blanketed with " sky eyes . "
it may be argued that the space force played only a supporting role in the two wars mentioned above , a mere " spy " that provided information and intelligence for the troops on the ground . today , however , the space force has emerged from behind the scenes to take center stage .
ignoring powerful pressure from world opinion , the new bush administration wasted no time in testing its national missile defense system and has begun devoting even more funding and energies to space .
this string of secret military preparations in space by the united states has caused widespread concern around the world . even before the space war game came to an end , president putin of russia convened an aerospace work conference at the kremlin that adopted a national aerospace plan up to year 2010 .
a decision was also made to remove the military space units and the guided missile space units from the strategic rocket forces to form a separate space force within the year .
the powers jockeying for position in space , setting their sights on space control .
after the soviet union broke up , russia reorganized its space units in august 1992 , which had been scattered among the ministry of defense , launch units , test and control units , military space flight academy , and the central research institute for space weapons under the ministry of defense .
on 30 october 1997 russia consolidated its aerospace units with the strategic rocket forces and guided missile defense forces to form what is now collectively known as the strategic rocket force .
the main reason russia now had the confidence to put together a space force was its mastery of fairly sophisticated space weapons systems , both in theory and in technology .
the information logistical role played by satellites in ground combat in several recent limited wars has enabled many countries to better understand the powerful uses of space weapons systems .
the space plane , which can perform a host of military missions and is particularly suited as a vehicle for powerful strategic weapon systems , has seen rapid developments in recent years .
moreover , various countries in the west have formulated plans to explore the solar system , build a permanent space station , establish a base on the moon , and send astronauts to mars . they also have launched research projects to build a cargo space plane and advanced space planes .
the development of these technologies has laid a solid foundation for combat in space .
space weapons systems refer to all weapons deployed in space .
the orbital combat plane , which has been under testing in recent years , is also a member of the family of space weapon systems .
america 's kinetic - energy guided missile space weapon system boasted relatively mature technology . it survived the end of the star war plan and continued as part of other weapon systems .
today it is the space weapon with the most potential in the united states . after successful testing and development , it will be deployed at the beginning of this century .
in october 1997 , the army carried out another test where lasers were used to hit satellite targets .
the military claimed that the test achieved the desired results .
that test marked a major turning point in the research and development of laser anti - satellite weapons . many countries have expressed the utmost concern about the event , noting that it might trigger off an arms race in anti - satellite weaponry among the countries with the necessary capability .
after launching a weapon , it can return to orbit and even to the base , completing the entire mission within two to four hours .
russia is a world leader in anti - satellite satellite technology and anti - satellite guided missile technology .
this satellite can navigate in the earth 's orbit and is capable of approaching and identifying enemy satellites and spacecraft in response to ground commands . the shrapnel created by its self - explosion can destroy an enemy satellite .
it weighs 2 to 3 tons , is four to six meters long , and has a combat altitude of ( as published ) kilometers .
2 ) the battle for control of space . as space technology develops and matures , space systems become more and more closely integrated with other weapons systems and are therefore able to play an expanding tactical role .
the space plane can freely and readily fly in and out of the atmosphere and because it is entirely reusable , it can significantly lower space transportation costs .
it is a foregone conclusion that space - to - ground attack in the 21 st century will present a band new look .

meanwhile , with an ability to bring about a net increase of nearly 3 million jobs to the country 's job market each year , private enterprises had helped ease the employment pressure on the society , thus contributing to maintaining the country 's social stability .

then , the peasants no longer had decision - making power to agricultural production .
in the early 1980 s , china carried out in all rural areas the system of contractual responsibility on a household basis with payment linked to output .
the implementation of this system greatly mobilized the enthusiasm of the peasants , promoting swift increases in the output of grain and cash crops . the peasants became rich and the rural economy developed swiftly . the people basically had adequate food and clothes .
the third reform - - rural areas ' fee - to - tax reform in the early days to carry out the all - round contract system , the peasants basically had no social burdens , but merely handed over fixed amounts of grain to the state and the collectives .
