beijing , 21 feb ( xinhua ) - - the national meeting on trial implementation of the reform of taxes and charges in selected rural areas was held in anhui province from 17 to 19 february .
the general demands and principles are to strengthen leadership , improve policies , expand trial at selected localities , accumulate experiences , make careful arrangements , promote the reform with supplementary measures , effectively reduce the peasants ' burdens , and ensure the success of the tax - for - fees reform in rural areas .
wen jiabao pointed out : since last year , a number of counties and cities in anhui province and other provinces and autonomous regions have carried out the trial reform of taxes and charges in rural areas in accordance with the arrangements made by the party central committee and the state council , and have achieved initial good results .
it is a policy to fundamentally solve the problem of the " arbitrary collection of fees , unreasonable penalties and unjustified financial levies " in rural areas , to reduce the peasants ' burdens , and to protect and whip up the peasants ' enthusiasm for production .
wen jiabao said : the experiments in anhui and other localities have accumulated many beneficial experiences for promoting the tax - for - fees reform in an all - round way in rural areas . 1 . party committees and governments at all levels have attached great importance to the reform and effectively strengthened leadership over the work .
leaders in the province have followed the mass line and entrusted the basic level cadres and masses to discuss the implementation of policies so that the masses can correctly understand and truly support the reform and actively take part in the reform work . this is the foundation for the success of the reform . 3 .
leaders in the province have paid attention to studying new situation and new problems , and continuously improved policies in the course of the reform . 4 .
leaders in the province have properly handled interests of all sides , done a good job in related reforms , and guaranteed the normal operation of grassroots organizations while ensuring the reduction of peasants ' burdens .
the fundamental purpose of the reform is to reduce peasants ' burdens and regularize tax and fee system in rural areas .
regularizing various systems means we should regulate relations of distribution among the state , the collective , and the peasants , and the methods of distribution . we should legalize the relations of distribution in rural areas and formulate a system to fundamentally guarantee the curbing of wanton collection of fees from peasants .
after the tax - for - fees reform , peasants pay taxes according to regulations , and the government collects taxes according to the law . the rights and obligations of both sides will be clearly defined . the local authorities can no longer wantonly collect fees from peasants under all sorts of pretexts without legal basis .
we should not only ensure long - term stability of the tax system , but also maintain a long - term stability of peasants ' overall burdens . we must not wantonly increase their burdens .
various localities must seriously study whether there are conditions for promoting the reform in an all - round way in light of the actual local conditions , and make a careful decision .
whether we can successfully implement the reform of taxes and charges in rural areas , the key lies in whether we can properly implement related policies formulated by the central authorities or not .
the core issue in implementing those policies is to strictly follow the central guidelines and fairly and reasonably decide the peasants ' burdens .
the reforms of government organizations , financial system and rural education of townships and towns are important component part of the tax - for - fees reform in rural areas and also important guarantee for achieving success in the reform .
we should implement the system of separation of government administration from business management , and properly handle operational and service charges to prevent the increase of peasants ' burden in a disguised form .
we should continue to implement the work responsibility system for party and government leaders and departments in charge of special projects .
party committees and governments at various levels must fully understand the complicated and arduous nature of the reform work , enhance their sense of responsibility , and effectively strengthen leadership over the reform work .
first , the top leaders of party and government organizations should personally handle the matter and be responsible for the overall success or failure .
second , it is necessary to seriously carry out investigation and study and carefully formulate plans for implementation .
fifth , concerned departments should work in close cooperation and act in a coordinated manner .

beijing , 21 feb (zxs) - - one of china 's basic features is the distinctly different conditions of various regions , which has resulted in an imbalance in economic development . it can be said that " there are four worlds in one china . "
this is what professor hu angang , director of the qinghua university national conditions research center , has said in his new book entitled " region and development : new strategy for western china development . "
the 1999 per - capita gdp 's of shanghai and beijing were $ 15,516 and $ 9,996 respectively , clearly higher than the corresponding figure of $ 8,320 of moderately developed countries across the world .
the populations of shanghai and beijing account for 2.2 percent of china 's total population .
the second world comprises large and medium - sized cities and moderately developed cities in coastal areas .
the fourth world includes poor regions in central and western china , minority nationality regions , rural areas , remote areas , and low - income areas .
over half of china belongs to the fourth world , which ranks behind 140 th place in the world in terms of per - capita income . the population of the fourth world makes up 50 percent of china 's total .
the book " region and development : new strategy for western china development , " which was published by hu angang , following the publication of his another book " china challenges corruption , " is his recent masterpiece .

hefei , 22 feb ( xinhua ) - - in march 2000 , the chinese government decided to restructure rural taxes and fees , and began its initial experiments in the whole anhui province and in several counties ( or cities ) in other nine provinces and autonomous regions .
now , a year has passed . what happened to china 's reform of its rural taxes and fees ?
during 16 - 19 february , china held a meeting on the experiment of rural tax - for - fees reform in hefei , capital of anhui province .
their summarized views were : the tax - for - fees reform has considerably lightened peasants ' burdens , and effectively curbed the willful fee charges , fund - collection , and fines .
china is a big agricultural country , and some 900 million people live in the countryside at present .
the chinese government has always been paying its closest attention to the issues concerning peasants , agriculture , and rural areas .
according to investigations , before the reform of rural taxes and fees , the agricultural tax alone paid annually by the 1.1 million peasants across huaiyuan county in anhui province was 26.63 million yuan . furthermore , the total amount of pertinent fees that they paid was as high as 80.81 million yuan .
but according to the ministry of agriculture 's surveys over 100 counties nationwide , peasants in some localities continued to shoulder heavier burdens in 2000 , with per capita taxes and fees going up 6.0 percent over the previous year . their fee - charges , fund collection , and illegal fines rose by as much as 21 percent .
wang taihua , secretary of the anhui provincial party committee , said : after the reform of rural taxes and fees , anhui 's total revenues of agricultural taxes , taxes for special agricultural products , and surtaxes amounted to 3.761 billion yuan , or 1.164 billion yuan less than the total collected before the reform .
when the abolition of slaughter tax and fund - raising for education was also taken into account , anhui peasants ' burdens of shouldering the tax - and - fee payments were reduced by 1.69 billion yuan , or 31 percent less than previously .
meanwhile , the meeting also held : the tax - for - fees reform has expanded the domestic markets ' effective demand .
the chinese government has implemented positive fiscal policies in recent years , hoping to sustain economic development by expanding china 's domestic demand .
as far as the peasants are concerned , tax and fee cutbacks mean income increase .
consequently , some peasants refused to pay various taxes and fees .
to accomplish their missions of collecting taxes and fees , some township and town cadres simply seized and confiscated grain and goods from peasants ' houses .
because grass - roots cadres ' workstyle was simple , rude , and gross , conflicts between peasants and cadres were frequent . incidents involving a lot of people occurred regularly in some localities .
shilidun guanyin administrative village , wuwei county , anhui province sent letters and tax payment notifications to peasants who have gone elsewhere to work . after receiving the letters , over 20 peasants immediately remitted 7,500 yuan for agricultural taxes via post offices .

the meeting of g7 finance ministers ended in palermo on the isle of sicily , italy , on 17 february .
according to the communiqu published by the meeting , world economic development will be slowing down , but the basic factors supporting the sustained development of most of the major industrial nations have remained unchanged .
compared with the previous meeting of finance ministers more than five months ago , the forecast made by this meeting is obviously more worrying , and this worrying mood is aggravated by the strong reaction of financial markets to us treasury secretary paul o ' neill 's remarks .
in an interview with a german newspaper last friday , o ' neill said that the united states would not be pursuing a policy of a strong dollar as in the past .
market interpretation of his remarks was that with the economic downturn , there was no longer any need for the united states to keep the dollar at a high level .
many experts also feared that the united states might use a falling dollar to avert the impact of economic recession .
treasury secretary o ' neill who took up his post less than a month ago had no idea his words would produce this kind of market reaction and found that he had to exert great efforts to dispel the negative impact of his remarks .
he emphasized that the united states had no plans of shifting its stance on its exchange rate policy .
in order to convince others to take his words seriously , he said that if he decided to shift that stance he would hire out yankee stadium and some rousing brass brands and announce that change in policy to the whole world .
the " o ' neill phenomenon " shows that the international market is very uptight about the trend of us economic downturn .
like scalded cats dread cold water , investors are worried that any bad news would turn out to be the last straw that overwhelms the camel .
during the meeting of g-7 finance ministers , the international monetary fund further lowered its forecast for global economic growth from 4.2 percent to 3.4 percent and slashed the forecast for us economic growth from 3.2 percent to 1.7 percent .
thus , an important task of o ' neill 's at the meeting was to convince europe and japan that the us economy was still well under control in spite of its downturn , and that it would be able to rally its forces and steadily sail out of the low ebb with proper government policies .
o ' neill said that the us economy is at a stage of moderate adjustment in its development cycle , noting that fed interest cuts and the massive tax cut program likely to be introduced by the bush administration would definitely be able to boost sustained economic growth and contribute to global economic growth .
o ' neill 's words obviously produced their effects . the italian finance minister called o ' neill 's explanation very satisfying .
although the euro region is performing most beautifully among the three major economic systems of the united states , japan and the european union , with its economic growth rate projected at three percent this year , the european union has its own difficulties .
as pointed out in the communiqu of this meeting , although the euro region has strong domestic demand and good economic prospects , it still has to carry out structural reform , raise its labor productivity , reduce public spending and reform its social welfare system .
by comparison , the difficulties facing japan are much bigger .
the finance ministers of the seven countries believed that the japanese economy was beginning to show signs of recovery , but must suitably ease money supply because the threat of deflation was still there .
public opinion in brussels was that it was simply impossible to work out a solution to the problems of the japanese economy in a one - day meeting .
japan is facing many problems in its reform of financial institutions , government budget , government - corporate relations , corporate culture and other issues , and the crux of the problem is economic restructuring .
japan had tried to cut public spending and readjust its monetary policy to little avail .
with his years of experience working in big corporations , o ' neill was able to make this figurative comment : " when you have tried all the tools in the toolbox and none of them work , then maybe it is time to find another tool . "
the question is , who can design this new tool ?
the meeting noted that global economic development still relies to a large extent on the us economy .
the us economic downturn has had a negative impact on the global economy .
it takes the close cooperation of the seven nations to ensure a smooth soft landing for the us economy .
in the course of building socialism with chinese characteristics , we need rule by law and rule by virtue , as well .
for sometime , people acquired a better understanding about the importance of rule by law , without sufficient understanding of the importance of rule by virtue and even ignored the functions of the latter . as a result , the desired results in rule by law were not achieved .
in view of this situation , comrade jiang zemin clearly pointed out at the national meeting of propaganda department directors held early this year : " in the course of building socialism with chinese characteristics and developing the socialist market economy , we should unswervingly step up the building of socialist ethics and strengthen rule by law .
rule by law comes under the category of political construction and political civilization ; rule by virtue falls into the category of ideological construction and spiritual civilization .
we should constantly pay attention to aligning the building of the legal system closely with that of ethics and integrating rule by law closely with rule by virtue . "
" rule by law " mainly implies the need to rule the country by the legal system and restrain people 's conduct with coercive measures .
speaking in terms of safeguarding social order and social stability , law has indispensably key functions .
especially at a time when society is experiencing major changes , old systems cannot meet the requirements of social development . thus , setting up new rules , regulations , and systems is of more urgent significance .
since the implementation of the reform and opening - up policy , we have been paying full attention to regulating people 's conduct with legal means in order to meet the requirements of developing the socialist market economy . meanwhile , rule by law has been defined as a basic strategy for ruling the country .
virtue is an important component of superstructure , as well . being different from law , virtue relies on means of education but not coercive means for practice . virtue contains stringency and persuasion , which may affect and improve social members ' awareness of virtue and make people consciously observe the norm of conduct .
public opinion , though intangible , cannot be ignored .
this kind of public opinion , once aligned with people 's innermost conviction , may bring its roles into greater play .
in a word , speaking in terms of safeguarding social stability , law and virtue have similarly important functions and are interrelated and supplementary to each other .
thus , moral norm and legal norm should be interrelated and jointly bring their functions into play .
the concept of " rule by virtue " is an important component of the political and theoretical thoughts of confucian school .
over 2,000 years ago , confucius was aware that the purpose of safeguarding social order could not fundamentally be attained when there were only law and penalties and that people 's morality , concepts , and qualities played a key role in safeguarding social order .
confucius maintained that if one paid no attention to moral education and blindly relied on coercive and punitive means and strong forces to subdue lawbreakers , people would have difficulties building up a " sense of shame , " not know that violation of laws was " shameful , " and not guard against committing crimes .
this kind of understanding is not completely in conformity with the original meaning of the thought of " rule by virtue , " which originated from confucius school .
thereby , this kind of understanding is not correct . however , we must understand that the thought of " rule by virtue " used to have distinct class nature and historical limitations in ancient china .
that is because it worked to safeguard the rule by the landlord class and exaggerated the role that virtue played in society . as a result , " rule by persons " actually took shape to a certain extent at a time when " rule by virtue " was emphasized .
however , the legalists took another one - sided approach by opposing , without any analyses , the thought of " rule by virtue " as advocated by confucius school and negating the important functions of moral education and transformation through moral education .
thereby , we must take a correct attitude toward the thought of " rule by virtue " as advocated by ancient confucius school by absorbing its reasonable and accurate aspects and rejecting its wrong parts unsuitable to the demands of modern society .
in china 's traditional political and theoretical thoughts , " rule by virtue " mainly contains the following few contents : first , all state officials and administrative personnel , either elected in various forms or appointed , must " have virtue . "
people will not obey decrees if rulers do not uphold justice . " " if rulers uphold justice , they will have no problems with their official performances . "
these are the explanations of " rule by virtue . "
third , full attention should be paid to the sense of virtue and the role that the sense of shame plays in governing people 's conduct .
fourth , the moral incentive method should fully be used in actual political activities . through moral education , we should make virtue play an especially important role in improving social practice , harmonizing personnel relations , and safeguarding social order .
confucius said : " if a ruler regulates people with virtue , people will obey him wholeheartedly . if a ruler has vile characters , people will obey him just like grasses leaning with the wind . so , a ruler with vile characters will be doomed to failure . "
to guarantee the smooth progress of socialist modernization and accurately handle and resolve all contradictions under the socialist market economic conditions , it is extremely essential to lay stress on " rule by law " in our country 's strategy of ruling the country .
meanwhile , we are never allowed to ignore or even deny the important functions of " rule by virtue . "
the new type of " rule by virtue " affirms the important significance of " rule by law " and involves both " rule by virtue " and " rule by law . "
this is also one of the important different features between the new type of socialist viewpoints on " rule by virtue " and confucius school 's viewpoints on " rule by virtue . "
in this way , how can we align the " building of the legal system closely with moral construction and integrate " rule by law " closely with " rule by virtue " ?
close integration of " rule by law " and " rule by virtue , " of " ruling the country according to law " and " ruling the country with virtue , " and of " building the legal system " and " building morality " should become one of our basic strategies for ruling the country .
law lays emphasis on punishing lawbreakers while ethics places stress on educating those people who have not yet violated law and committed crimes , upgrading their moral qualities , and enabling them not to commit crimes . in a sense , penalties merely bring about a temporary solution while moral construction gives a permanent solution .
all these are good for upgrading people 's moral qualities , improving social practice , and further giving a push to the building of the legal system .
third , in the course of building and developing the socialist legal system suitable to the socialist market economy , we should strive to build and develop the socialist moral system , which is in conformity with the socialist market economy .
this has become a task of urgent importance to our realities , as well as a key issue of realistic significance to judging whether our country can maintain social stability , better develop the socialist market economy , and better build socialism with chinese characteristics .

an article in the american time magazine of 8 january said with complacency when discussing the relationship between the us and asian economies : " if america sneezes now , asia will catch pneumonia . "
is the problem that serious ?
under the tide of globalization , relations of mutual dependence between countries and regions have become closer .
a boom or recession in the us economy , the most powerful in the world , naturally has an impact on other countries ; the question is how great that impact is and how deep its extent .
in the past six months , however , there have been many signs of a slowdown , in particular , hi - tech shares have plummeted on the stock market , and this has affected individual consumption as well as investment in plant .
after going through the financial crisis of 1997 , the economies of asian countries started to recover in 1999 , and the average growth in east asian countries ( excluding japan ) was 7.8 percent in the first half of 2000 , while some countries ( regions ) achieved double - digit growth .
it is worth noting that asian countries have scored quite great success in hi - tech industries in recent years .
on the whole , however , this has been more marked in the production of parts or completion of main parts , so they export a great deal of electronic products to the united states .
according to a deutsche bank report , electronic products account for 75 percent of singapore 's export commodities , 60 percent of the philippines ' , 58 percent of malaysia 's , and 37 percent of both the rok and taiwan region .
us publications have pointed out that electronic products are the first to feel the blow in an economic slowdown , and their sales decline in dramatic fashion .
there has been excessive investment and surplus production capacity throughout this sector in recent years , and some companies are already running at a loss .
business week believes that " the boom time for pcs is over , " and looking at the share prices of those companies , " it seems that the pc business already has one foot in the grave . "
the computer industry , however , made profits of 94 percent in 2000 , but this year their profit may only grow by 11 percent , a big difference .
the related transistor industry also feels over - equipped , and investment has been greatly reduced .
according to the us merrill - lynch securities corporation , last year investment increased by 94 percent in the 34 leading transistor plants throughout the world , the biggest annual increase on record , but the increase this year may be only 6 percent .
in the capital market , us investment in thailand , malaysia , and the rok in 1999 exceeded that of japan , and this was helpful for extricating asia from the financial crisis ; it is estimated that this investment may be reduced this year .
in short , a us economic slowdown indeed has a certain impact on asia , and cannot be taken lightly .

recently , the national rural fee - to - tax reform trial work conference was held in anhui province .
a significant reform aimed at reducing chinese farmers ' burden , while protecting and developing the rural production force will be carried out on a more extensive scale in china 's rural areas .
and in order to do well in agriculture , china must first take care of its farmers .
the party and the government have always devoted much attention to agriculture , to the countryside and to farmers ' issues , and a long time ago stipulated the principle of giving more to farmers while asking less from them .
however , as the situation for agricultural products has changed from demand exceeding supply to supply exceeding demand , chinese agricultural development has encountered new problems , the most prominent being that difficulty selling agricultural products results in falling prices which in turn holds down farmers ' incomes .
even in so economically advanced a province as guangdong , the average net income growth for farmers in 2000 was less than 1 percent .
in some major grain - producing areas , farmers ' incomes declined even further , which increased their income gap compared with urban residents .
farmers who could not bear these heavy burdens had no choice but to reduce what they put into their lands , or even abandon the land to some degree .
the direct cause of the inability to reduce farmers ' burden is that township financial budgets have to support too great a population , have to meet goals and upgrade in various activities , and complete " cosmetic projects " which cannot be halted despite repeated attempts to do so .
in march 2000 , the party central authorities and the state council issued an order to set up trial sites for conducting rural fee - to - tax reform .
anhui , the initial starting point for " big contracting " once again took the lead in this reform in the chang jiang and huai river areas . other provinces also selected parts of counties and cities for conducting the trial , and the reform was under way .
the number one objective of this reform is practical reduction of farmers ' burden .
on this foundation , the taxation level for farmers should stay unchanged for quite a long time .
they excitedly spread the news and sincerely support it and proactively participate in it ; their enthusiasm for production has also increased considerably .
jingshi city , which is located in the dongting lake in hunan also conducted a trial rural fee - to - tax reform .
after the fee - to - tax reform was implemented , the new agricultural tax , the agricultural unique product tax , and their attachments were only 14.53 million yuan , which was 24.77 million yuan less than that of 1998 , a a 63 percent cut .
gannan county in heilongjiang is a semi - farming , semi - livestock raising county but the focus is on agriculture . in the past , farmers bore a heavy burden and the relationship between cadres and masses was tense .
these major reform measures were all aimed at too many overly complicated tax counts , where corrupt officials filled their own purses and the farmers could not bear such a burden . basically , the content of these reforms was to convert fees into taxes and change complexity into simplicity .
the great thinker huang zongxi of the ming and qing dynasties labeled it precisely : " an accumulation of harm as well as profits . " the is the " huang zongxi law. "
this year , fee - to - tax will be expanded on a greater scale .
countryside fee - to - tax reform is not a simple " merger of fees into taxes " , but is a complex , in depth , social reform , an " action which affects the overall situation " , and relates to the overall layout and long term significance .
in order to bridge the gap between township government and village organizations ' income and expenses to guarantee normal operations of grassroots authorities , the central government has called for increasing the capacity of payments for grassroots financial transformation , and central government finances will input 20 billion yuan this year for the project .
at present , relevant departments are speeding up the stipulation of rural tax collecting and administration methods in order to provide legal protection to agricultural tax collection and administration .
zhu bangzao made the above comments on this .

however , on the other hand , the authorities are bound to face a difficult issue , namely , how to check foreign exchange transactions on the black market at home and safeguard stability of the domestic foreign exchange market .

" rent - seeking corruption " means the traditional net losses caused by the use of rare resources and resources in shortage merely to effect a shift from one system to another and caused by monopoly , restriction , and other relevant systems and practice .
" tax loss corruption " means the loss of tariffs and other taxation income caused by various kinds of legal tax reduction and exemption that violate the principle of fair competition and by bribery , collusion and sharing booty among officials in the customs and other taxation departments .
many heavy losses caused by corruption often occurred in these areas in china .
after analyzing these phenomena of hidden corruption , this specialist specially pointed out that these four forms of corruption mentioned above do not exist separately , and they sometimes are interwoven .
hu angang spoke penetratingly in measured tones .
he said that at present , all these corrupt activities are well hidden in china , only a very small percent of relevant corruption cases is exposed , and the percentage of those involved in such cases being punished is even smaller .
he , therefore , strongly urged the whole society in china to gain a fresh understanding of corruption and to study and analyze corruption .

the promulgation of the " measures " has signaled china 's official introduction of a mechanism for withdrawal from a stock market , which is expected to turn such a phenomenon as " entry only , no withdrawal " into history on china 's stock market .
nevertheless , contrary to what had been hoped for , both st companies and pt companies , which are in no danger of being evicted from the stock market , have managed to cultivate a phantasm via constant reorganization so that their shares have been hotly pursued by investors .
moreover , the market has turned crazy about speculating in st shares or pt shares or about buying shells of st companies or pt companies . had the absence of a system for withdrawal from a stock market not revealed grave consequences with each passing day , the market would have witnessed more irrational phenomena .
thus , it is rather difficult for a stock market to bring into full play its role in distributing resources ; to introduce an evaluation standard ; or to uphold such a common market law as survival of the fittest .
instead of looking into a listed company 's basic situation , prospects of development , or value of investment , investors will tend to pursue flash points ; look for speculators who may control a share price ; or obtain information concerned without giving even the slightest thought to such a possibility that a listed company may go bankrupt .
today , still listed on the shanghai stock exchange and the shenzhen stock exchange are as many as 49 st companies and eight pt companies .
indeed , a market , on which a company can be listed but which it can never be removed from listing , is an unhealthy one divorced from benign development .
a mechanism for withdrawal from a stock market will effectively restrict a listed company in terms of behavior , for a market without restrictions for listed companies is the key factor behind all sorts of market irregularities .
a market without a mechanism for withdrawal from listing , namely , a mechanism for restricting listed companies , will certainly wink at the listing of companies which have sustained grave losses or are unable to repay debts with assets .
the introduction of a mechanism for withdrawal from a stock market is expected to teach a lesson to both listed companies and investors with a vivid fact or a heavy price and to wake up all participants in a market to a sense of rational investment .

beijing , 26 feb ( xinhua ) - - during the second meeting of the ninth npc standing committee this afternoon , members formed into small groups to review revised draft amendments of the law regulating medicines and the law on regional autonomy for minority nationalities .
the revisions of the draft amendments were done well overall , and tend to improve matters , so these further revisions have been recommended to this session of the standing committee for examinations and approval .
when reviewing the amended draft of the pharmaceutical control law , some standing committee members suggested that when the relevant administrative agencies levy major administrative penalties against pharmaceutical enterprises , such as license revocation and shutting down operations , there should also be corresponding procedures for levying these penalties , to prevent granting excessive power to the agencies .
members also raised the point that the penalties stipulated in the draft are too light when it comes to cases of drug regulatory agencies or inspection organs set up by these agencies which are involved in the manufacture or marketing of drugs , and which may take actions in violation of the law regarding collection of inspection fees .
the relevant article in the proposed draft further stipulates that legal investigation will be relied on to determine whether there is any criminal responsibility .
the relevant articles of the draft stipulate that medical providers under medical insurance must by law make known publicly and accurately the purchase prices of their medicines and the prices at which they sell these to patients .
some standing committee members objected to this , holding that medical providers may use different channels to purchase the same drug , and in different lots ; and while occasional public announcements of prices may help to hold down prices , doing anything specific to control them would be somewhat difficult .
it was recommended there be an appropriate amendment regarding this , empowering patients to appeal to health care agencies about improper use of medicines . health care agencies should strengthen their oversight of drug prices and the proper use of drugs .
when reviewing the amended draft law on regional autonomy for minority nationalities , the members of the npc standing committee expressed several viewpoints and suggestions concerning the education of minorities , particularly in the minority regions .

budapest , 26 feb ( xinhua ) - - visiting chinese state councilor wu yi held a talk with romanian foreign minister geoana here this morning . both sides said their countries will do their best to promote constant expansion and the development of their bilateral relations , particularly economic and trade cooperation ties .
geoana first extended a welcome to wu yi on her visit .
he hoped the two countries would be able to inject still more substantial and concrete content into their bilateral relations .
wu yi said , it is precisely for the purpose of further advancing the development of relations between the two countries , particularly economic and trade cooperation ties , that the chinese government delegation is making the visit .
she stressed that there exists a traditional friendship between china and romania .
the overall situation of development of economic and trade relations between china and romania is good . but there are also some difficulties . the bilateral trade volume is still relatively low .
the chinese side will continue its effort to make the two countries ' economic and trade relations accord with their political relations . it is hoped that , aside from commodity trade , the two sides will be able to increase mutual investment and cooperation .
china wishes to use its own technologies and equipment to participate in romania 's construction .
he stressed , with regard to the question of developing bilateral economic and trade relations , it is necessary to shift from having the government play the leading role to letting the enterprises play the dominant role .
in conclusion , the romanian foreign minister emphasized , with respect to the taiwan question , the romanian government 's position has been clear and definite .
he also said that romania actively supports china 's application to host the 2008 olympics .
after the meeting , wu yi went to the romanian exhibition center to deliver a speech to more than 200 chinese and romanian entrepreneurs who were holding economic and trade negotiations there .

in her speech , wu yi also emphatically introduced the achievements china has made in recent years in economic development and in reform and opening up and the strategy being implemented in china to develop its west region .
she stressed , under the conditions of market economy , development of bilateral economic and trade relations will , to a very great extent , depend on common efforts of entrepreneurs of both countries .
after the speech , wu yi also answered questions from the audience .
wu yi arrived here on the 24 th to begin a four - day official visit at the invitation of the romanian government .
romania is the last stop on her five - country tour to central and eastern europe . prior to her visit here , she successively visited slovakia , hungary , croatia , and slovenia .

boao , 27 feb ( xinhua ) - - on 27 february , qian qichen , vice premier of the state council , made a speech at the founding meeting of the " boao forum for asia . "
the political multi - polar trend and the process of economic globalization are forging ahead continuously . seeking peace and development and promoting cooperation has become the common voice of all peoples and the mainstream of the times .
the economic restructuring in a global scope is advancing at a quicker and quicker pace . science and technology are making rapid progress every passing day . the knowledge economy is rising .
i believe , through seriously summing up both positive and negative experiences , improving the mode of development , carrying forward the strong points and overcoming the weakness and shortcomings , and being firmly determined to make further progress , asia will certainly be able to create another miracle in economic development in the new century .
when facing the challenges and opportunities brought about by economic globalization , it is necessary for asia to further expand and deepen regional economic cooperation .
economic globalization is an unavoidable process of development . its impact includes both positive and negative factors .
at the same time , asia is keeping close ties with other regions of the world , and asia 's development cannot be separated from the world . openness should be a prominent characteristic of regional cooperation in asia .
in 1998 , mr. hawke , mr. ramos , and mr. hosokawa jointly put forward an idea about setting up an " asian forum , " and this proposal met with warm response from people in various circles from relevant asia - pacific countries and from people who are concerned about asian development .

now , the " forum " selects china as its permanent meeting place and is located in boao . the chinese government expresses welcome and support .
the " forum " is an open one for conducting dialogue on an equal footing and for pooling collective wisdom .
its development will depend on the active participation and valuable support from everyone here and from people in all circles .
being a member of the asian and world economic system , china has maintained a good development momentum over many years in the past .

i can say with complete assurance that china 's market will be opened more widely ; laws and regulations in china will become sounder ; and its investment environment will become better .
china 's development cannot be separated from asia nor from the world . it is hoped that people from various circles attending the " boao forum for asia " will continue to care for and support china 's development and continue to expand cooperation with china in all fields .
the chinese government always supports and actively participate in multi - tiered and multi - channeled regional dialogue and cooperation in various forms .
china 's local government in hainan will continue to provide all necessary services and support for the " forum . "
i believe the " boao forum for asia " will , with equality , mutual benefit , cooperation , and win - win as its basic principle , become a strong bond for asian people in all circles and people who are concerned about asian affairs to increase mutual understanding , consolidate friendship , and expand cooperation .
cairo , 26 february ( xinhua ) - - us secretary of state powell visited the middle east region from 24 to 26 february .
during his three - day tour , he visited egypt , israel , palestine , jordan , kuwait , saudi arabia , and syria , and held a meeting with the top leader of each country .
powell 's visits were conducted while us middle east policy was in a deliberation stage and the development trend of the middle east situation was still unclear .
on the one hand , the bloody conflicts between palestine and israel , which have been going on for several months , still cannot be settled in the foreseeable future and israel 's political situation currently is still changing - - these have posed a rigorous test to the middle east peace process .
arab countries will hold a meeting of head of states in late march in amman , capital of jordan , in an effort to strengthen unity among themselves .
how the middle east situation develops will have a direct bearing on the united states ' vital interests .
stopping the loophole of the sanctions on iraq to enable the united states to continue to effectively implement its strategy to contain the saddam regime was the primary task of powell 's middle east visit .
he said : " even if saddam possesses mass killing weapons , he cannot pose a threat to the united states .
he said , therefore , sanctions against iraq must be continued .
however , powell met a setback in egypt , the first leg of his middle east trip .
at a news conference jointly held by him and egyptian foreign minister moussa , he was strongly refuted by moussa .
moussa added that , during powell 's stay in cairo , he was sure that powell had sensed the " displeasure " of the people of egypt and the middle east region over the recent air raids on iraq by the united states and britain .
saudi minister of interior nayif said " saudi arabia will never be an enemy of the iraqi people . "
another saudi official revealed that , at a meeting with powell , the saudi leader warned the new us administration not resort to using force against iraq because such moves " can only worsen the situation in the gulf region . "
sabah , kuwaiti first deputy prime minister and minister of foreign affairs , also said that kuwait " sincerely wishes that the gulf region will enjoy peace and stability . "
not without deep feeling , powell said he was surprised by the " excessively strong " protests of the arab countries against the recent air raids on iraq by the united states and britain .
at the same time , conflicts on the palestinian territories have continued .
recently israel has tightened blockade in the palestinian autonomous region and carried out several assassinations of senior officials of palestine 's military organization .
in his meeting with powell , palestinian national authority chairman arafat expressed the hope that the palestine - israel peace talks will resume from where they were interrupted .
he stressed that peace process is a strategic choice of the palestinian people and palestine will continue to go forward along the road of peace talks .
powell offered some contingent proposals to the two sides , including urging israel to lift its economic blockade against the regions under palestine 's control and to return tax revenues collected on behalf of palestine , and the two sides immediately stopping their violent conflicts .
on the palestine - israel peace talks , powell did not present any specific proposals except reiterating the united states ' principled stand .
moreover , in his talks with syrian president bashar , powell also did not offer any proposal on resuming the syria - israel peace talks .
on the day of his visit , the " fuxing bao " [ name as transliterated , ] an organ of syria 's ruling party , published an article criticizing powell for only being concerned about how to contain iraq but being totally indifferent to israel 's atrocity of suppressing the palestinian people .
the article pointed out : powell discussed the iraq issue most . he asked arab countries to follow us steps on this issue , but remained indifferent to israel 's killing the palestinian people .

comrades , fellow villagers , with the loving care shown for us by the party and the selfless support from the people of all nationalities across the country , tibet , which has entered a new century , will fare better in the future .

that the chinese government has banned and cracked down on the " falungong " cult organization according to law is precisely to safeguard and protect the basic human rights and freedoms of the chinese citizens , and this has won the resolute support of all the people in china and the extensive support of the international community .
liu jing said this at a press briefing held by the information office of the state council .
liu jing said : the decision of the chinese government on banning " falungong " was based on the demand of the broad masses and was aimed at safeguarding social stability and protecting the people 's basic human rights and freedoms . the action has sufficient legal grounds and is completely in keeping with the legal procedures .

liu jing pointed out : evil cult has become a public plague in the contemporary world .
cracking down on evil cults on the basis of the laws is the duty of a responsible government .

the rights of people being send to receive labor re - education are fully guaranteed by the laws .
" in china , we have a complete set of legal operational system for labor re - education .

former us president kennedy conceded long ago that the american people " must give up their oversimplified views on international affairs " and must give up " the theory that the mission of the united states is to remold the world after its own image . "
our world has now entered a new century . is it not the time for the new us administration to adopt a new way of thinking ?
charles krauthammer 's " the unipolar moment , " huntington 's " the lonely superpower , " richard hass ' " how america became big brother , " and william c. wohlforth 's " the stability of a unipolar world " were all articles centered on " unipolarity . "
" the stability of a unipolar world , " published by the magazine international security in 1999 , unequivocally put forward the " unipolarity - for - stability theory " for the first time ever .
wohlforth held that the soviet union 's disintegration produced the greatest change in world power relationships since world war ii and the united states has become the sole surviving superpower .
the united states has a unique geopolitical position and also is the only great power with the capability of global operations .
in the absence of any great power in the world that is capable of countervailing it , a strength structure in which there is a lone superpower without any opponent has been formed .
this structure has brought an unprecedented " unipolar era . "
wohlforth asserted that the united states ' absolute power advantage means the source of conflict in previous systems - - rivalry over leadership of the international system - - no longer exists . the reason is that the leading state 's strength advantage restrains the tendency of hegemonic rivalry .
the clearer and larger the concentration of power in the leading state , the more peaceful the international order associated with it will be .
he preached : " unipolarity is the least war - prone " because both alliance choices and the calculation of power are very clear - cut in this system .
therefore , the present unipolar structure would give rise to not only a motive for cooperation but also a change in concept - - worldwide hegemonic rivalry and security competition no long are inevitable .
having " demonstrated " in detail that " unipolarity is prone to stability , " wohlforth advanced his policy propositions on us diplomacy : first , the post - cold war transition stage is over and the world has entered the true " pax americana " ; the united states ' strategic decisions should be based on this .
second , " doing too little is a greater danger than doing too much . " us intervention is a subjective " need , " even more a " necessity " in the mechanism . the united states is " duty - bound to choose " to seize the opportunity and establish security cornerstones in every region .
third , the united states should not exaggerate the costs of maintaining hegemony .
because of the united states ' strength advantage , the whole system of the international structure absolutely can be run at comparatively low costs .
the goal can be attained in this way .
editor 's comments the intrinsic logic of the " unipolarity - for - stability theory " is : if unipolarity is prone to " stability , " then all measures ( including warfare ) taken to safeguard unipolarity would be " conducive to stability " and hence " legitimate . "
the military has always been called the " absorber " and " condenser " of new science and technology .
military high technology is even considered the peak of high technology .
a well - known example is the " star wars " project proposed by us president reagan on 23 march 1983 . in fact , it was a project aimed at comprehensively raising its military high technology .
then german chancellor kohl sharply pointed out : " in the us sdi project , 10 percent of it is strategic theory and 90 percent is advanced technology . "
therefore , " five major technologies " immediately became popular in the world - - survey technology , directional energy weapons ( laser ) technology ; kinetic weapons technology , c3i systems technology , and logistical support technology .
china 's " 863 " project was proposed in response to the development trend of the world 's high technology .
the project includes eight high - tech areas : biotechnology , information technology , automation technology , new - material technology , energy sources technology , aerospace technology , laser technology , and oceanographic technology .
it is like a booster device that will also pioneer a new period in high - technology development of our country 's military .
in addition , like the " two bombs and one satellite " of the past years , the " 863 " project is also an enhancer of combat effectiveness which will promote comprehensive progress of our army 's military theories , military establishment , and military experts .
we have to specially point out that in china , among the numerous achievements of our army 's high technology , the " 863 " project itself is also a successful achievement as a high - technology project and should occupy the top spot .
this is because high technology is a complex and systematic project relating to science and technology , politics , military , economics , culture , and society .
no wonder in modern scientific and technological development , it is necessary to follow the principle of " designs by top authorities , " and stress that " mistakes in decision - making are the greatest mistakes . "
in short , a high - technology project is like a blueprint that scientifically organizes high - technology development . it is also like a banner that scientifically mobilizes the whole country .
in this aspect , our country and army possess exceptional advantages !
the proposal and implementation of the " 863 " project sounded the clarion call for high - tech development by leaps and bounds in china .
the battle of 15 years has demonstrated to the people in the world the wisdom of chinese .
at the occasion marking the 15 th anniversary of the implementation of the " 863 " project , this reporter interviewed ma songde , vice minister of science and technology , with the questions concerned about by the broad masses of readers .
progress of the " 863 " project to speed up during the " 10 th five - year " period the state is to make investment worth 15 billion yuan within five years [ zhang feng ] the " 863 " project is of great significance to the high - tech development in china .
since seven years ago , several thousand scientific research personnel members have participated in research and argumentation . it can be said that part of the " 863 " project to be implemented during the " 10 th five - year period " has been officially started .
the investment will reach 15 billion yuan within the future five years .
this amount is several times that of the past . second , emphasis is put on development by leaps and bounds .
the field of information technology is ranked first place , and the amount of investment in the field will be much bigger than in the past .
the breakthroughs made in key techniques regarding the shuguang serial high - performance computers have ensured performance index of the computers to greatly exceed the export limit on china imposed by the united states . computers have been used in such industries as meteorology , petroleum , education , railway , biology , and network communications .
second , china has significantly narrowed the overall gap between its research and development level in the high - tech field which enjoys focused support and the advanced world level .
the successful development of the satellite born synthetic aperture radar prototype and aerospace remote sensing system symbolizes that china has grasped the key techniques applied to observe the earth .
with these products , china has started to form strength which enables it to compete against the developed countries . these products have also become the growth point and source of high - tech industries .
for instance , a group of breakthroughs made in the communication network technology which concerns national security and economic lifeline and in the technique of digital program - controlled switchboard have brought along the development of the overall communication industry in china .
china has constantly increased its market share of biological engineering medicine and vaccines , with 11 types of genetic engineering medicines and vaccines being put on the market , and 10 types of genetic engineering medicine having passed the examination and approval of the state and entered the stage of clinical trial .
currently , the major genetic engineering medicine introduced at the market abroad has basically been introduced to the market in china . china has constantly increased its market share of these products , and occupied the majority of the market share for some products .
nearly 10,000 excellent , top - notch high - tech talents have been cultivated there is a leap in comprehensive scientific competitiveness [ zhang ] the implementation of the " 863 " project has indeed made china take a stride in the high - tech field to see development by leaps and bounds and achieved quite a few successes .
with the " 863 " project , not only have we achieved many tangible successes which people can see and touch , we have also obtained enormous intangible fortune .
during the 15 years of implementing the " 863 " project , more than 40,000 scientific workers , more than 200 research institutes , and more than 100 colleges and universities participated in the implementation nationwide .
a total of 25 research and development centers , laboratories , and pilot lines , including the experimental engineering research center on computer integrated manufacturing system , has been set up successively .
the emergence of strategic talents such as these is an important sign that china is equipped with the capacity of engaging independently in the development of science and technology , and an important guarantee for china to develop into a scientific power .
a group of outstanding talents , young and middle - aged , have become eminent in the implementation of the " 863 " project .
according to statistics , among the members of the " 863 " project expert committee ( group ) , more than 30 percent are young experts under 45 .
through the talents cultivated by the " 863 " project , and through the proliferation of the project among enterprises , growth of a group of high - tech enterprises has been brought along .

scientific research , pre - research have established a foundation building of national defense has a backup force [ zhang ] the " 863 " project in china is a high - tech development project for civil use , and can be said to have no direct relations with the building of national defense .

for instance , the " training system of simulated intelligence warfare , " which was developed for the purpose of enhancing the training standard of our military , has become a necessary means for our military in training senior commanders to make strategic decisions and enhancing their commanding abilities in combat involving various arms of services .
to sum up , the implementation of the " 863 " project has made important contributions to the high - tech development , economic construction , and national security in china .

beijing , 28 feb ( xinhua ) - - the 20 th meeting of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] standing committee concluded today in the great hall of the people , having completed all its agenda .
state president jiang zemin signed presidential orders 45 and 46 , and these two legal documents were promulgated .
standing committee chairman li peng chaired the full meeting this afternoon .
the meeting voted to decide to submit the draft agenda for the fourth session of the ninth npc to the session preparatory committee for examination and discussion , and decided to submit to the preparatory committee the draft list of names for the presidium and secretary general of the session .
the standing committee members present at this meeting seriously examined and discussed the draft report on the work of the npc standing committee and put forward views on a number of amendments .
chairman li peng spoke when the meeting 's agenda was completed .
the revised laws on autonomy of ethnic regions and on pharmaceuticals administration are two important laws .
the system of autonomy of ethnic regions is a basic political system , and the revision of the law on autonomy of ethnic regions has a bearing on economic and social progress in regions of ethnic autonomy and on ethnic solidarity and national unity .
as a result of the revision , the provisions of these two laws are more perfect , and the key now lies in their earnest implementation .
in short , drawing up and revising laws is naturally important , and implementing the laws is just as important .
taking a view of the general situation , all aspects of china 's economic and social life now basically have laws to follow , but a rather conspicuous problem is that the laws are not followed , the laws are not strictly enforced , and people are not held accountable for violating the laws .
li peng said , this meeting has also ratified the international convention on economic , social , and cultural rights .
this convention was submitted to the npc standing committee for examination and discussion by the state council in 1998 .
this session will open in a few days time .
much of the agenda at this standing committee meeting concerns the preparations for this session .
in accordance with the provisions of the constitution , the standing committee is the permanent organ of the npc and is responsible to the npc .

the 20 th standing committee meeting of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] discussed the " international convention on economic , social and cultural rights " again on 28 february and decided to ratify it ( hereinafter called convention for short ) .
the " convention " is one of the most influential legal documents in the field of human rights in the international arena . it was adopted by the un general assembly and opened for signatures in 16 december 1966 .
so far , 142 countries have ratified this " convention , " most of who are developing countries .
the chinese nation has the cultural tradition of advocating people 's dignity and value .
with the successful accomplishment of china 's ninth five - year plan and the second - step strategic target for modernization , chinese people have further enjoyed all kinds of economic , social and cultural rights .
this is a new milestone in the history of development of the chinese nation as well as a tremendous contribution of china in the development of global human rights undertakings . this has also created a favorable condition for china to further carry out the obligations o outlined in the " convention . "
the ratification of the " convention " is in the fundamental interests of the broad masses of chinese people and conforms to general secretary jiang zemin 's important thinking of " three represents . "
china has consistently adhered to the principle of the international norm which states that " conventions must be abided by , " and has really carried out the 17 international conventions on human rights which it has signed .
china has adopted essential legislative , judicial and administrative measures to gradually realize all rights stipulated in the " convention " because this is an internal affair of a sovereign country .
the orientation stipulated in the " convention " coincides with china 's final goal of reform , opening up and building socialism with chinese characteristics . china will realize all kinds of rights stipulated in the " convention " in line with national conditions and in a planned and step - by - step manner .

it is a fact that although the united states is economically one of most developed countries in the world , it is not " well - developed " as far as its human rights conditions are concerned . one might even say that it is not a good model .
the united states publishes its " country reports on human rights practices " every year . as usual , the " country reports on human rights practices - - 2000 " came out on 27 february this year .
a distinctive feature of this report is that it points accusing fingers at other countries and regions , especially developing countries , often overstating the case and barking up the wrong tree .
one of the reasons is that in the " country reports on human rights practices , " the united states is a blank page that needs to be filled by others .
since it is impolite not to reciprocate , other countries and regions should also say something about human rights conditions in the united states .
the fact is , many countries have already spoken out on us human rights conditions .
many of the facts cited in the " us human rights records in 2000 " have already been reported in the media of different countries and regions .
human rights as the ideal of mankind have their universal nature .
in the sphere of human rights , mankind needs dialog rather than confrontation .
it is only through dialog that different countries can achieve a consensus on the universal nature of human rights ; it is only through dialog that different countries can develop mutual respect for their cultural peculiarities .
only by properly handling problems in both respects will it be possible to promote and develop the cause of human rights throughout the world .
the united states has not shaken off the cold war mentality in its approach to the human rights issue . it is using human rights as its big stick in beating up others , its wedge in subverting other countries , as well as its pretext in making moral justifications and practicing verbal hegemonism .
this attitude of the united states has seriously interfered with the development of the global cause of human rights .
this " humble " attitude should also apply to the human rights issue . it is a good thing that the united states is thinking this way .
in the meantime , teachers and students of the people 's university issued a proposal to university teachers and students throughout the country calling on them to uphold science , disseminate civilization , resists cults , and protect human rights .
reading the " us human rights record : 2000 " has really enlightened and frightened me .
the serious problems observed from the numerous facts about human rights infringements in the united states are shocking .
the most important human right is the right to live .
sixty - eight percent of the death verdicts in the united states are results of misjudgment .
the four policemen , who killed an innocent black immigrant by firing at him 41 times , were acquitted .
this is a case of judicial injustice and racial discrimination combined .
in the united states , over 5,000 children die from gun - related homicides each year , and the nearly one million homeless children live precariously .
the 31,000 depleted uranium bombs the us air force used against the federal republic of yugoslavia in 1999 have dramatically increased the number of patients with malignant tumor and the number of infants born with deformities .
while the united states , clearly realizing the danger of these depleted uranium bombs ' radiation , required the american soldiers to take preventive measures . since the united states treats the people of other countries not as human being , what right does it has to hawk human rights !
however , an increasing number of countries have denounced these reports , which the united states considers as its masterpieces .
this shows that interfering in other countries ' internal affairs in the name of human rights violates the norms governing international relations and is very unpopular , and that china is not the only country that strongly denounces the united states ' brutal conduct .
while distorting and fabricating facts to accuse other countries , it acts arrogantly , pretending that it is unaware of its poor human rights situation . what right does it have to demand other people to be neat while itself is filthily dressed !
most countries that the united states has unjustifiably denounced have demanded the united states to take a look at itself and improve its own human rights situation , instead of creating troubles and trying to profit from them in the name of human rights .

question : yesterday , the npc standing committee of our country ratified the " international covenant on economic , social , cultural rights . "
answer : according to my knowledge , the government of our country signed the " international covenant on economic , social , cultural rights " on 27 october 1997 . within a period of less than one year , the state council for the first time submitted the international covenant to the npc standing committee for ratification .
on 28 february , according to the legal procedures in our country , the ninth npc standing committee ratified the international covenant at its 20 th meeting .
answer : the " international covenant on economic , social , cultural rights " was adopted by the un general assembly in 1966 , and took effect in january 1976 .
now , 142 countries have ratified the international covenant .
the covenant includes a preface and 31 articles .
to a certain extent , this reflects the demand and requirement of the developing nations on the issue of human rights , and is of positive significance . this is also a product of compromise between the major political forces in the world .
answer : this was determined by china 's needs in its economic development and in the building of its democratic and legal system .

the chinese government always conscientiously perform the duties specified by these international treaties .
in my view , the chinese government will continue to gradually enable the chinese citizens to enjoy all the rights specified by the " covenant " step by step in a well - planned way through the adoption of legislative , judicial , and administrative measures according to the needs in the country 's economic and social development .

beijing , 1 mar - - today , all major newspapers in beijing devoted large space to publishing the report about china 's national people 's congress [ npc ] ratifying the " international covenant on economic , social and cultural rights . " the report has elicited great interests among many law and human rights experts .
this morning when this reporter telephoned gu chunde , member of the china human rights institute standing committee , a noted law expert , and professor at the law college of china people 's university , he told me that he was in the process of writing an article on the implementation of this covenant in china .
he said the ratification of the covenant means that the chinese government and people support the international standards for universal human rights ; that the course china follows in safeguarding human rights has merged with that of the international community ; and that the chinese government is determined to undertake the provisions in the covenant .
some countries took longer time before they ratified the covenant . for example , after more than 20 years , the united states has yet to ratify the covenant , even though it signed this covenant in 1977 .
on the other hand , china not only attaches importance to political rights , but also to chinese citizens ' economic development rights .
thus , the fact that china 's move to ratify the covenant only a lapse of three years is totally acceptable .
moreover , the ratification also indicates the chinese government 's cautious and positive attitude toward this issue .
interpret according to the chinese law gu chunde pointed out : so far 127 countries in the world have signed and ratified this international covenant . of these countries , 47 countries and regions have indicated their reservations on more than 150 points in the covenant .
as far as china is concerned , the 20 or so rights prescribed in the covenant are generally consistent with those prescribed in the chinese constitution and law .
the acftu is the only legitimate trade union in china .
thus , the provision must be interpreted according to china 's situation and chinese law .
the chinese constitution used to have a clause similar to that of the covenant , but the chinese law has deleted this clause .
meanwhile , the provision in the covenant on free education is not in line with china 's situation .
certain chinese laws and regulations permit some schools , especially vocational schools , to collect fees from their students .
the covenant should have an explanation on this and many other relevant situations .
in particular , certain provisions in the covenant should be reflected in the " social security law. "
moreover , certain chinese laws formulated under the planned economic system should be revised because they no longer meet the needs of the development of the market economy .
these laws include the " copyrights law , " the " patent law , " the " accountancy law , " and the " labor law. "
gu chunde noted that since the constitution has not incorporated any covenant provisions , these provisions should not serve as the basis for the enforcement of the chinese laws .
the " general rules of the civil law " and the " law of civil procedures " have detailed provisions .
i think we can apply this spirit in the implementation of the " international covenant of economic , social , and cultural rights . "
such acts of japan to help the wicked perpetuate wicked deeds can only please the united states but may not do any good for itself , and even may compromise its own security .
recently , four russian warplanes suddenly intruded into the airspace north of ( liwen ) island in japan 's hokkaido , and japan 's self - defense air force sent warplanes to cope with the emergency . at one point , warplanes of the two sides confronted each other in the air .
why was the peaceful situation suddenly broken recently ? this has something to do with the delicate relations between the united states , russia , and japan .
however , because differences between the two countries over the four northern islands were too serious and both of them refused to make any concession , the peace treaty was unable to be reached .
moreover , over the last few years , japan has followed the united states and the two countries have continued to strengthen their security cooperation - - this has further worsened relations between japan and russia and increased russia 's doubts , misgivings , and displeasure .
therefore , it was not strange that russia took the opportunity to take action against japan and applied pressure on them .
russia has refused to bow to the united states pushing ahead its nmd program , ignoring other countries ' opposition and has strongly responded .

question one : in a review of 40 years , just what achievements has china 's satellite project made ?
the " zi yuan " global resource satellite series and the " bei dou " series of navigational positioning satellites have also been designed .
these satellites mentioned above have made major contributions to china 's national economy , national defense construction , cultural education , and scientific research , but also have enhanced the strength of unity among our people , greatly raising china 's political status among the nations of the world .
speaking concretely , the retrievable remote sensing satellite series includes three different models of near - earth orbit retrievable satellites , and today china has launched and retrieved 17 of these satellites , each of which operated in an orbit for 3 - 15 days , thus basically forming a public - use platform of retrievable satellites .
we have utilized retrievable satellites to obtain a large quantity of valuable satellite remote sensing information , which has already been employed in resource investigation , cartology , geological surveying , selection of railway lines , and archaeological research .
this satellite has already been entered into china 's satellite communications industry systems , and its social and economic efficiency has been remarkable .
in september 2000 , the " zi yuan " no. 2 indigenously developed and manufactured by china was successfully launched , and its resolution was even higher than the resolving power of the " zi yuan " no. 1 satellite .
the primary technical specifications for the two " zi yuan " satellites has already achieved the international level of the early 1990 s of the twofer . the design and manufacture of the satellites and their successful launch has shown that china 's transmission remote sensing satellite design and manufacture has achieved breakthrough advancements .
the " bei dou " navigational system is system which provides satellite navigational data in all - weather , any time of day . it is primarily used is for providing navigational positioning services for highway transport , railways transport , and on - sea operations .
in addition to the direct applications of the aforementioned types of satellites , the various new technologies used in design and manufacture have been applied to many departments in the national economy where they have seen second development and use , creating an extremely optimistic indirect economic benefit .

china in the near term ( for the next ten years or for a short period ) has the following development goals : 1 . establish a satellite ground observation system that will operate stably for a long period of time .
establish a satellite broadcast communications system that is independently operated .

establish an independent satellite navigational position system . separately establish a navigational positioning satellite series .
