the picture is of a police patrol at the university . [ picture not included ] human rights expert fan guoxiang the united states state department released the " year 2000 special human rights report " on february 27 .
just what is the united states government trying to do ?
what are its motives ?
as an independent expert on human rights who has worked for many years to promote and protect human rights with the united nations human rights committee , i would like to discuss my views .
the united states was not willing to see china become a more powerful nation with an ever - improving position on the international stage .
after the second world war , respect and protection of human rights was the common aspiration of all the people of the world . all the united nations member states took on this duty .
human rights may exist , but human rights and the understanding of the level of human rights are two different things , and nations with different historical and cultural backgrounds may have different consciousness .
the united states and other western nations felt that human rights are a system of rights centered on the rights of the individual , and only if the innate rights of the individual were protected was a nation democratic .
the rights of people , nationalities and nations as a collective system were not democratic .
the american " declaration of independence " from 1776 , even before the 1789 french revolution and " declaration of rights of the citizens " , brought forth the idea of " god - given rights " and a political system based on a division of power between the three branches .
on the surface , every man has equal opportunity , and an individual can rely on his own efforts to create his prosperity and his wealth .
however , in reality , only a small number of rich and powerful people hold political positions , and the majority of people can only pass their lives being slavishly dependent on others .
therefore , the united states naturally acts as the " human rights policeman of the world " in the name of " humanitarian interference " to butt into the internal politics of these nations .
in beautifying herself and making others appear ugly , the united states has but one goal : to fool americans and people in other nations , in order to implement power politics thinly veiled with humanitarianism .
with every breath , the united states talks of how others do not respect international standards of human rights . well then , how does the united states herself treat the legal obligations of the regulations in her international human rights treaties ?
the united nations has six major human rights covenants in all . these are subject to international monitoring .
and the three other major human rights treaties - - the international covenant on economic , social and cultural rights , the convention on the elimination of all forms of discrimination against women and the convention on the rights of the child - - have still to be ratified by the united states .
the united states has gone to great lengths to enter reservations to these covenants , more than any other signatory nation .
the egyptian delegate said that the united states required other nations to obey the treaty , but the fact that she herself delayed considerably before ratifying it , and had so many reservations , showed that the united states was playing a double standard .
in 2000 , in the us state department " human rights report " , the portion attacking china made several mentions of the report by the committee against torture . let us take a look at just how the us government has carried out its responsibilities under this covenant .
one committee member said that the us government considered itself the world 's human rights policeman , but that she should use the same yardstick when considering torture within the united states and outside of its borders .
" amnesty international " said that us law and government directly violated the standards of the international human rights treaty , could not enforce it , and were actually engaging in torture and cruel punishment .
the overwhelming weight of fact shows that the united states has always used two - faced methods in regard to policies on human rights questions . they use one set of standards on others , and use a different set on themselves .
yesterday it was one set , today it is another .
her own human rights problems are not something to be questioned by international society , yet human rights problems under the jurisdiction of other nations should be protected internationally .
for a long time , the united states was not active on the issue of human rights , and in recent years , she has become uncommonly active .
the us state department has stinted neither personnel nor resources in twisting and shaping truth , and in announcing attacks on the " human rights reports " of many nations , including china . this is the " might is truth " policy ingredient of the us government .
on 27 february , the u.s. department of state released its " country reports on human rights practices for 2000 . "
each year when the " human rights reports " are drafted , it is the time for various special interest groups in the united states to do their best to exert influence .
they vie to have the reports contain something to reflect their respective interests and desires .
" human rights reports " in recent years reveals that they have not only advertised the american values , but flagrantly judged the human rights situations in more than 190 countries in the world .
any practices not in conformity with the american values have been condemned as acts of " infringement upon human rights . "
what is noteworthy is that this year in the first group of organizations refuting the u.s. " human rights reports " is france 's interministerial committee for the struggle against cults .
such a stance taken by a government organization of a european country reflects the fact that currently the united states is in an isolated position on the human rights issue .
more ironically , while shouting " safeguard of human rights , " the united states itself has refused to sign many international conventions on human rights . even though the government might sign these conventions , the u.s. congress would not ratify them and let them implemented in the united states .

beijing , 28 feb ( xinhua ) - - the chinese legislature voted through a decision today to ratify one of the two major un human rights covenants , namely , the " international covenant on economic , social , and cultural rights . "
at the time of ratification of this covenant , the standing committee of the national people 's congress [ npc ] stated that the chinese government shall go by the relevant provisions of the chinese constitution , labor union law , and labor law in respect of paragraph 1 ( a ) , article 8 .
this stipulation in the covenant concerns the issue of workers organizing and joining trade unions .
since 1949 , chinese workers have always been organizing and joining trade unions in accordance with applicable chinese laws and will continue to do so in the future .
zeng jianhui pointed out that it took all western countries rather long periods of time to ratify this covenant .
for example , britain spent eight years , italy seven years , belgium 15 years , and both germany and austria , five years .
the united states signed this treaty 24 years ago , but has not ratified it yet .
he maintained that the main content of the " covenant " basically agrees with the relevant laws , policies , and practices of china and the direction specified in the " covenant " is also in line with the basic objectives of china 's reform , opening up , and its effort to build socialism with chinese characteristics .
the " international covenant on economic , social , and cultural rights " is one of the most influential documents in the area of international human rights . it was adopted and opened for signature [ as received ] by the un general assembly on 16 december 1966 .
another " human rights covenant " that the chinese government has signed and has yet to ratify is the " international covenant on civil and political rights . "
through a democratic election , zhang wannian was made head of the delegation and chi haotian and yu yongbo , deputy heads .

beijing , 5 mar ( xinhua ) - - today , at the fourth session of the ninth national people 's congress , state council premier zhu rongji enunciated the work objectives in the next five years in our country and the guiding principles for the formulation of the " outline " of the tenth five - year plan .
zhu rongji pointed out : the " outline " of the tenth five - year plan mainly embodies the following important guiding principles : - - consistently take development as the main theme .
stress the combination of speed and efficiency , achieving comparatively fast development on the basis of enhancing efficiency .
only a growth speed with marketability and business returns can be considered as real development and is meaningful .
with consideration being given to factors in all aspects , the planned target for the average annual economic growth rate in the period of the tenth five - year plan is set to the level of around 7 percent .
at the same time , there still exist some uncertain factors at home and abroad , so certain leeway should be kept when fixing a planned target .
this will be conducive to guiding all quarters to concentrate efforts mainly on structural adjustments and the enhancement of economic efficiency , and will also prevent the appearance of an overheated economy and duplicated construction at a low level .
the economy in our country has reached a critical juncture at which no further development can be made with structural adjustment being made first .
it is necessary to adjust the economic structure in the course of development and also maintain a rather high speed of development through economic restructuring .
- - consistently take reform , opening - up , and scientific and technological progress as a major driving force .
in the next five years , we should firmly and continuously advance reforms , expand opening up , break through the structural obstacles that affect the development of the productive forces , and provide a strong driving force for economic and social development .
- - consistently take the enhancement of the people 's living standards as the fundamental starting point .
- - consistently combine economic development with social development .
as for the method of formulating the plan , stress is laid on increasing the degree of social participation and turning the process of formulating the plan into a process of promoting democracy and pooling collective wisdom and a process of reaching consensus of opinion among all quarters concerned .
on the steps of the great hall , lu xinjiu , a deputy from liaoning , said : " last night i carefully read through the whole of the 10 th fyp outline .
i feel that this is a fine plan , pragmatic and inspiring ! "
a number of economic experts attending the fourth session of the ninth cppcc national committee gathered together in the jingfeng guesthouse , where they are staying .

testing support capacity under simulated real - war conditions though time has passed , the long span of history has written down all remarkable deeds the fuzhou air base has performed .
in the 1990 s , the central military commission listed the fuzhou air base as a key unit for army building , and since then , the base has served as a forward post for china 's air force to safeguard national sovereignty and territorial integrity .
in order to accomplish a new and sacred mission , the base has trained its officers and men with science and technology in hopes of raising its own capability of providing logistic support for flight missions under hi - tech conditions .
this was the case especially during the " 96 - 2 " exercise , which was staged under clear - cut stress involving units from different services and arms .
in a training preview , after a new - model fighter plane took off , the weather suddenly turned nasty , and soon , the base was covered with thunder and lightning . for the sake of safety , the fighting eagle turned to another airfield on the southeast coast and landed there .
over the past few years , the base has fulfilled similar tasks in providing support to different types of planes or a large number of personnel at the same time every year and has thus trained its officers and men under simulated real - war conditions and tested its own emergency support capacity .
meanwhile , the base has also scored fruitful results in technical innovation : it has developed a vehicle driving simulator through cooperation with nanjing engineering institute , and the simulator has raised training efficiency , shortened the training cycle , saved fuel , and ensured safety to a significant extent .
the base has also scored marked results in training its officers and men with science and technology , especially in applying computer technology to its support operation .
in the past , its grassroots units had to keep accounts by hand .
in the past , its financial officers had to visit individual units to conduct a check on accounts and had to read account books one by one .
nowadays , all types of officers at the base have received training on computer skills ; have passed a test at different grades in this regard ; and have become capable of operating a computer on their own .
of its commanding officers , each and every one has attended at least a three - year college course and two are attending a postgraduate course at the moment .

ever since he took office , george w. bush has showed a fairly tough stance towards the issue of building up a national missile defense [ nmd ] system , and he has pledged to push ahead with the deployment of this system .
it believes that while the threat of global large - scale conflicts and mass attacks against the united states is declining , weapons of massive destruction as well as the proliferation of the carrier technology have now constituted a major threat to us security .
in july 1998 , a committee in charge of the strategic reassessment headed by donald rumsfeld , who is now us defense secretary , pointed out in its report : the united states is currently facing the threat of biological and nuclear weapons .
this treaty has imposed restrictions on both the soviet union and the united states concerning the development of a national missile defense system .
the bush administration stands for the idea that the nmd system should not be confined to a land - based deployment , but should instead be expanded to both the ocean and the sky to form a 3 - d all - directional defense system .
ever since 1997 , the us defense department has established a joint projects office to oversee the projects under the nmd system and to coordinate the operation among different departments .
born out of the " star wars program " it has been long since the united states planned to build up a nmd system in the country , and the origin of the plan can be traced back to the later stage of the second world war .
upon knowing that nazi germany was developing missiles , the us army immediately began to study ways to intercept attacking missiles .
in 1972 , the soviet union and the united states signed the " anti - ballistic missile treaty " to restrict missile defense deployment .
as soon as the program was made public , it evoked public outcry both inside and outside the united states .
gorbachev , former leader of the soviet union , used to tell reagan to his face : " i think you are just wasting money , for the system will not work .
but if that is what you want , just go ahead . "
to many americans , the star wars program was just " too costly , too crazy , and too risky . "
the first - phase structural design of the program started in september 1987 .
by then , the united states believed that it needed to readjust its strategic deployment , and focus on its defense against limited missile attacks instead of any mass attack from the soviet union .
however , after the end of the cold war , some people held the view that it was the " star wars program " which caused the collapse of the soviet union and helped the united states win the cold war .
( lukin ) , former russian ambassador to the united states and chairman of the foreign affairs committee under russia 's state duma , reckoned that because of the " star wars program , " the cold war came to its end at least five years earlier than it should have .
of course , all these are subsequent judgments , and there is no way of knowing whether the reagan administration actually had such a strategic foresight in those days .
what is indisputable , though , is that the scientific research projects under the " star wars program " have laid down a certain technological foundation for the country 's deployment of the nmd system .
a batch of scientific research achievements were attained in the research work under the program , and they can all be put to use in the new nmd system .
that is why people have joked : the nmd system is a " son " to the previous " star wars program . "
one was a " freakish offspring " of the cold war , while the other is a product of the new situation after the cold war .
( 2 ) the two have different defense targets .
the " star wars program " was mainly designed to resist mass missile attacks from the soviet union , while the nmd system is mainly aimed at defending the country against missile attacks from so - called " rogue states " as well as " accidental " attacks from china and russia .
( 3 ) the two cannot be mentioned in the same breath in terms of scale .
in comparison , the nmd system is a defense system against limited attacks .
therefore , it can be said that the nmd system is a simplified version of the " star wars program " of the old days .
( 4 ) when comparing the two , one can see that the aircraft missile defense system [ as published ] is a more feasible system , though both have its technical problems .
as a matter of fact , by 1987 , due to technical limitations , many of the designs for the " star wars program " had been found inapplicable and given up .
in those years , the united states used to try to dissuade ( kirskin ) , the then leader of the soviet union , from building up a missile defense system , saying that such a system had its inherent defects and what was gained could not make up for what was lost .
one may find it somewhat ironic to see today that after so many years , the americans themselves should push ahead with such a defense system .

why is it necessary to emphasize " enhancing the downstream efficiency of agriculture ? "
it is learned that in recent years , because of china 's rather weak capability in processing and transforming agricultural products and ineffective marketing channels , there has been a surplus of agricultural products at a low standard .
by putting forward the concept of " downstream efficiency of agriculture , " it is possible to help primary agricultural products appreciate in value through processing , transformation , and circulation and eventually raise the efficiency of agriculture and the income of peasants .
the production of primary agricultural products must extend into secondary and tertiary industries before it can achieve higher efficiency .
ours is a large agricultural country , but this is only in terms of the total volume of agricultural products produced .
if we are speaking in terms of the total output value of agriculture , especially in terms of the value added of processed agricultural products and the value of agricultural exports , china is lagging far behind advanced , developed countries .
in the developed world , the ratio of output value of agricultural product processing industry to that of agriculture is mostly over 3:1 , but this ratio is only 0.5 : 1 in china .
the output value of the food industry in a developed country is usually 1.5 or two times the total output value of its agriculture , but in china , the output value of its food industry is less than one third of the total agricultural output value .
in some countries where fishery is well developed , over 75 percent of their fisheries products are processed , but in china , only 30 percent of our fisheries products are processed .

beijing , 5 mar ( xinhua ) - - the rural tax - for - fee reform is a major focus of attention at the " two sessions " this year .
" standardizing " means standardizing , in terms of institution , the distribution relationships and methods between the state , collectives , and farmers .
by " stabilizing " it means that , on the basis of reduction and standardization , it is necessary to maintain farmers ' tax obligation at a fixed level for a fairly long time .
it refers to the need to stabilize for a long time not only the tax obligation system rather than making policy changes at will , but also the overall level of farmers ' burden rather than increasing it at will .
the reform conducted in anhui has reduced farmers ' burden by 31 percent .
second , it has initially standardized the rural distribution relationships and promoted reform of the financial and taxation collection and management system in townships and towns .
third , it has improved the system under which villagers discuss official business and promoted the building of political democracy at the grass - roots level in rural areas .
the institution of the practice of all people discuss , do , and manage things that concern all people has further promoted villagers ' self - autonomy and the standardized management of rural collective affairs and aroused the initiative of farmers to participate in democratic politics at the grass - roots level .

6 march , beijing ( xinhua ) - - although 7 percent is just a simple numeral , it has been one that has been discussed and pondered most in the last few days by deputies attending the fourth session of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] .
the economic growth rate has always been a hot topic of discussion at npc sessions , and this year is no exception .
lateral comparison : the growth is relatively high but it must be maintained ( subhead ) deputy liu xiangrong , vice chairman of liaoning provincial economic and trade commission , said : from an international viewpoint , economic growth of 6 percent is considered quite high .
the economic growth of european countries , the united states , and other developed countries is usually from 3 to 4 percent , and , if economic growth exceeds 4 percent , some countries will increase interest rates or take other measures to cool down their economies .
from 1997 to 2000 , us economic growth stayed slightly above 4 percent and the eu was less than 3 percent .
in comparison , china setting its economic growth at 7 percent is comparatively high .
for example , china 's gdp in 2000 exceeded $ 1 trillion , but us gdp in 1999 was $ 9.3 trillion .
from this viewpoint , it is very necessary to maintain 7 percent growth .
in other words , although economic growth comparatively slowed down , the absolute economic strength increased .
in their discussions , the deputies also reached this consensus : because the base of the gdp has increased , appropriately slowing down economic growth is in line with economic development law .
more importantly , as economic globalization develops , china 's economic development is already fused into the world economic tide in which undercurrent pants , and is increasingly affected by the tide .
under such circumstances , leaving room for the growth target enables us to effectively prevent possible dangers . if dangers do occur , we will have room to maneuver .
growth rate generating markets and economic results is the optimum growth rate ( subhead ) while analyzing the 7 percent , the deputies pondered : what kind of growth rate is the optimum one ?
setting the 7 percent growth rate manifests this viewpoint and therefore should be fully approved of .
this indispensable " about " lightens the color of being mandatory and gives greater stress to being a guiding one .
lu xinjiu , a deputy from liaoning , said : development does not mean solely pursuing growth , development should be accompanied by a market , and we are not supposed to produce overstocked products .
development should be accompanied by economic results and quality .

" we must vigorously train young people and children to become informationization personnel , and the key to determining whether the informationization effort will succeed or not lies in personnel , especially young talent . "

beijing , 6 march ( xinhua ) - - a key word frequently appears in the draft of the outline of the 10 th five - year plan submitted to the deputies to the national people 's congress [ npc ] for deliberation .
wang li , a careful deputy , found after seriously reading the document that the term " reform " appears in the text of the outline for more than 70 times .
the term " reform " has been accompanying us as inseparably as a shadow for more than 20 years .
in the great national development plan for the first year of the new century , 70 " reforms " converge into one sentence , that is , using reform to guide and promote the overall situation and persistently taking reform and opening up as the driving force for further advances .
persistently carrying out reform and opening up is the quintessence of deng xiaoping theory , a " magic weapon " that enables us to win one victory after another , and one of the basic past experiences encountered for more than 20 years .
today , while stepping across the threshold of the new century , reform remains a strong driving force for us to formulate and fulfill the 10 th five - year plan and accomplish tasks in all fields .
if they are anything different from reforms in the past , then we may say that the starting point of reforms in the future be much higher , the reform tasks will get more arduous and difficult .
however , only by continuously deepening reforms can we smoothly achieve the strategic objectives set forth by the 10 th five - year plan and make a good beginning for our work in the new century .
the fundamental purpose of reform is to emancipate productive forces . to measure our current conditions with the criterion of productive forces , we may find that many things have yet to be reformed .
after entering the new century , reform is moving into the stage of solving the toughest problems . a series of established reform policies and measures have yet to be further implemented in depth .
although we have established a basic and preliminary framework for the socialist market economic structure , it has yet to be gradually improved . in particular , the tasks for readjusting and improving the ownership structure and establishing and perfecting the market system will be rather arduous .
in the period of the 10 th five - year plan and a even longer period , state - owned enterprise reforms and rural reforms will be two " prolonged battles " that are full of difficulties .
this will become a stern challenge for us .
a great long - term undertaking has just been started and will be accomplished through unswerving efforts .
a great plan full of the term " reform " in the new century has been put in front of the deputies to the ninth npc and the entire people throughout the country as well .
we need new work styles to meet the new situation and take on our new tasks in the new century .
peace and development are still the main themes of the times . the trend of the world multipolarization is developing ceaselessly . the international situation is continuously moving toward relaxation , in general .
the current international environment ahead of china is much better than that in the late 1980 s and early 1990 s when east europe experienced a drastic change and the soviet union disintegrated .
at present , the people all over the country have been determined to realize socialist modernization , make the country strong and the people wealthy , and rejuvenate the nation under the leadership of the party .
the major indicator for the domestic situation is that the whole party and the people throughout the country are united as one and confidently promote reform , opening up and modernization . we are now making ceaseless efforts to maintain the good situation featured by economic development , political stability , social progress , and national unity .
the people 's living standards have improved further .
new achievements have been seen in reform , opening up , and modernization .
we must clearly understand the problems and challenges ahead of us .
our current tasks are extremely arduous , such as deepening the reform of state - owned enterprises , realigning industrial structures , increasing peasant income , re - arranging laid - off workers , expanding social employment , balancing the distribution of incomes , and setting up and improving the socialist security system .
hostile forces at home and abroad never stop playing their strategic plots to " westernize " and " separate " us . they have collaborated with one another to attempt in vain to disturb our country 's gratifying situation featured by stability and development .
china has entered a new development stage of comprehensively building a moderately wealthy society and stepping up the pace of socialist modernization .
continuously promoting modernization , realizing national reunification , and safeguarding world peace and promoting common development are three major historical tasks that we are undertaking in the new century .
the ideological and political foundation , the material and technical foundation , and the mass foundation , that we have already possessed to realize the three major historical tasks in the new situation , have been laid by the people of the whole country under the leadership of the party .
the party is the leading core in our endeavors to build the cause of socialism with chinese characteristics .
a good situation can be destroyed and ruined when we depart from the leadership of the party .
this is a truth repeatedly proven by countless positive and negative realities .
the party style is directly related to the party 's image and combat effectiveness .
to accomplish our modernization task , we should constantly do a good job in observing the purpose of serving the people wholeheartedly . the comrades of the whole party , especially all levels of party leading cadres , must have good work styles .
without good styles of work , the party will seriously divorce itself from the masses and realities .
on leadership style , we must adhere to democratic centralism and oppose the practice of making arbitrary decisions , taking peremptory action , and being weak and lax ; adhere to party discipline and oppose liberalism ; and adhere to principles governing the work of cadres and oppose unhealthy trends in employment .
on study styles , we must persist in integrating theories with practices and oppose the practice of mechanical imitation and book worship .
beijing , 7 mar ( xinhua ) - - how will china 's modernization reach a higher level in the new century ?
how will china jump to a superior position and be in a driving position for long - term development ? " we must tap human resources and place them high on the agenda to build a mansion in this century for the nation . "
if we conduct a detailed analysis , china does not have a very rich base of human resources : as of 1999 , china had over 700 million employees with only 38 percent of them having an education beyond vocational training , while over 80 percent had less than a junior high school education . .
in a sense , china is a big country in human resources , but not when it comes to talented human resources .
the shortage of talented human resources , especially the shortage of high - quality talented human resources , has become the greatest constraint on development of the chinese economy .
in 2000 , in 29 professional skill series , there was a total of 1.57 million professionals with titles above the associate senior level , which is only 55 percent of the total number of professionals .
of every 10,000 employees , 11 are r & d scientists and engineers ; the comparable figure in developed countries is nearly or more than 100 .
the capacity for creativity is an important standard in judging talented human resources , but the problem of lacking creativity is a very significant one in china , with a very serious situation of intellectuals being out - of - date .
" we lack a group of leading talented people who are capable of leading and directing in global science and technology , and we lack a large number of high quality operational and managerial talents who are familiar with market economic law . "
fight , fight : the " human resources battle " has quietly begun " qinghua university 's electrical engineering department last year produced 16 graduate students , and 12 of them went to the united states .
' classmates ' can be found all over silicon valley . we have become a training ground for other countries . "
managerial talent , commanding talent and top talent , from the process of capital penetration to human resource penetration , the competitive strategy of the western developed nations is undergoing a fundamental transformation .
through jointly established labs , setting up scholarships , and establishing global r & d institutes , they will obtain chinese talents locally here .
the human resources battle has already begun in elementary and high schools : the battle for talent has become the nurturing of talent .
member wang wenyuan went on to say that " this is also an important measure for achieving leaps in development and the third strategic goal . " the establishment of the highest science and technology prize , an award of 5 million yuan , shows scientific and technical personnel that they have a future in the motherland .
his ministry is formulating relevant regulations and rules .
talent must be trained and developed .
jiushan institute central recommends there be further input into education in the future .
in the long term , we must strengthen education in patriotism to retain their hearts . "
creativity , creativity : create a new environment which encourages producing more talent and utilizing talent there is an old saying that water flows downward and people walk upwards .
producing talent requires proper soil and environment .

the main theme of the 10 th five - year plan - - structural adjustment - - has become a hot topic of discussion for delegates to the chinese people 's political consultative conference [ cppcc ] in the last few days .
the delegates expressed their incisive views on various aspects of structural adjustment , from its strategic vision and specific methods and tactics to the driving force behind it .
they were of the view that china would not be able to attain its development goal in the new century without the strategic adjustment of its economic structure .
what this strategy involves are issues that have a bearing on the overall situation and are of a long - term and fundamental nature . it is aimed at the realization of structural optimization and upgrading . hence , he said that strategic adjustment is different from adjustment in the general sense .
economic restructuring is an extremely pressing task .
delegate qu shijing said that in spite of its rapid development , the chinese economy has serious structural imbalances , such as its imbalanced industrial structure , urban - rural structure , distribution structure , investment structure , fiscal structure and regional economic structure .
delegate xiao zhuoji , a leading economist , said by way of analysis that the industrial structure developed under a planned economy is a very irrational one .
in the section on agriculture in the outline of the 10 th five - year plan submitted for review and discussions at the " two sessions , " a lot of space is devoted to the structural adjustment of agriculture for the purpose of agricultural modernization .
deputies to the national people 's congress [ npc ] and delegates to the chinese people 's political consultative conference [ cppcc ] believe that this major adjustment in agricultural policy will change the previous emphasis on total grain output and gradually push china 's agricultural modernization forward .
for a country with the largest population in the world , agriculture remains " a matter of paramount importance " in china .
in order to tackle the question of feeding its people , china put particular emphasis on the boosting of grain output in the past . the quality of farm produce was comparatively poor .
we must reduce in a planned way the output of farm produce concerned and devote more efforts to their qualitative improvement , " cppcc delegate li renlin pointed out .
li renlin emphasized that the structural adjustment of agriculture and the rural economy , the improvement of the quality of farm produce , and the acceleration of the processing and conversion of farm produce are the principal means for boosting agricultural yield and increasing farmers ' income .
cppcc delegate liu chengguo believed that in the overall philosophy of structural adjustment , the government should always look at the enhancement of the competitiveness of agriculture , the improvement of the overall quality of agriculture and the ending of the weak position of agriculture from the overall perspectives of strategic adjustment .
the " strategic adjustment of importance to the whole situation " which the chinese government is carrying out on agriculture and the rural economic structure is bound to lay a solid foundation for china 's advance toward the target of socialist modernization .

the division of our nation 's socialist modernization construction into " three steps " is a strategic deployment proposed by comrade deng xiaoping and officially confirmed by the 13 th national party congress .
beginning with the 6 th five - year plan , our nation has drawn up and implemented long - term , mid - term , and short - term development plans , all carried out following the " three step " economic development strategy .
thus , the ' outline ' of the " 10 th five - year plan " is an important link continuing this development strategy from the past and bringing it into the future .
what is a macroscopic view ?
highlighting the macroscopic view of development plans means highlighting macroeconomic and adjustment goals within the plans . in terms of the tools used to implement plans , macroeconomic measures are highlighted . in terms of defining goals and selecting policies , the overall interests of the nation are highlighted .
with regard to achieving the goal of a socialist market economic system , this is very significant to improving our nation 's level of plan management and promoting the development of the society and economy .
at the same time , it has increased prediction indexes that reflect structural changes .
economic policies are the manifestations of the nation 's economic function and are a series of measures and policies adopted by the government to implement planned goals .
with these kinds of policy principles , in the new development , we can be clear about our direction and our methods and can thus thoroughly accomplish the goals and missions stipulated in the ' outline ' of the " 10 th five - year plan . "

at today 's afternoon plenary session of the fourth meeting of the cppcc , chen bangzhu spoke on behalf of the cppcc population , resources , and environment committee .
chen bangzhu said that china is one of 13 nations worldwide which suffer from a water shortage . there is an average of 2,200 cubic meters per person nationwide , a figure which is one - fourth of the average amount of water per capita worldwide .
while the north suffers from such a severe lack of water , a huge surplus of water resources flow into the ocean in southern china .
since the early 1950 s , experts with the authorities and organizations concerned have done in - depth studies of the question , and have gradually formed the current plan for water diversion , one which features three canals : the eastern , central and western .
although the diversion of water from south to north is an enormous undertaking , we have prepared the infrastructure conditions and have not only accumulated a huge amount of experience in building , but also have a certain amount of accumulated resources .
clarification of the nature of the project , optimizing project planning and plans for work progress , completely estimating and carefully weighing all the risks of a long - distance water diversion , and appropriately managing the various interests involved in the project 's construction are the major problems awaiting solution at this time .

beijing , 8 march (xna) - - at the second plenary session of the fourth session of the ninth cppcc national committee today , cppcc member xiao zhuoji called for efforts to promote theoretical innovation and deepen people 's understanding of the marxist theory of labor and labor theory of value in giving guidance to economic practice .
according to this noted economist , many of the practical issues we encounter in socialist practice are in need of theoretical innovation .
xiao zhuoji pointed out : we must deepen our understanding of " productive labor . "
he said that scientific and technological work , as complicated labor , could create value several times , dozens of times and even hundreds of times that of simple labor .
thus , he said that we should deepen our understanding of the role of scientific and technological work in social production and in the creation of value .
his recommendation was that we should fully reflect the importance of scientific and technological work in distribution , encourage the inclusion of technology in distribution , and gradually achieve the goals of putting scientific and technological innovation into application , turning intangible assets into tangible assets , turning tangible assets into securities , and monetizing securities assets .
management is similar to scientific and technological work .
in xiao zhuoji 's opinion , outstanding managers should be paid substantially higher than ordinary workers .
the labor of private entrepreneurs in management is also a kind of value - creating labor and should be affirmed .
the consensus of economic experts attending the session is : " extrication from difficulties within three years is just the achievement of one phase , and certain deep - seated contradictions and problems still await fundamental solution . "
deputy wu shuqing , an economic scholar , said that although the goal of extricating the state enterprises from difficulties within three years has been basically achieved , this only means attaining the target of one phase of state enterprise reform , and moreover this achievement was mainly due to state input and government action rather than enterprise action .
wu shuqing said , " extricating the enterprises from difficulty does not mean that they will not get into difficulties again in the future , nor that their competitive and innovative ability has been fundamentally changed . "
the chinese government has consistently had a sober understanding of the state of affairs in state enterprises , and zhu rongji emphasized in his government work report this year : continue to deepen reforms of the state enterprises so that they will truly become main players in market competition .
" the key to state enterprise reforms is to resolve structural obstacles . "
deputy zhuang yi , a middle - ranking cadre from a medium - sized state enterprise , the beijing car and motorcycle joint manufacturing company , has deep feelings about the enterprises ' lack of independent decisionmaking .

deep - seated problems in the state enterprises themselves also urgently await solution .
" in science and technology innovation , the enterprises should not only possess the fruits of their own development but also use capital forces to apply the fruits of hi - tech development in society . "
the success or failure of state enterprise reforms also depends on resolving the problems of redundant personnel and of establishing a social security system ; these problems are triggered by these reforms .
in recent years the chinese government has consistently focused on building a perfect social security setup in order to help extricate the state enterprises from their heavy social burdens .
beginning this year , china will carry out trial - point work in 100 cities in bringing retired workers into management by the community ; at the same time , the chinese government has decided that in the future redundant personnel will directly enter the unemployed market .
experts believe that " this is the first step " to ensuring that the enterprises can truly go into battle with a light pack .

sources show that china 's military spending was 93.47 billion yuan in 1998 , 107.67 billion yuan in 1999 and 121.29 billion yuan in 2000 . this year 's figure is about 19.7 billion yuan more than last year .
professor hu siyuan of china 's national defense university pointed out that this year 's increase is quite normal , given that military spending has been on the increase in the previous three years .
finance minister xiang huaicheng and foreign minister tang jiaxuan both talked about the background and reasons of the increase in military spending at the " two sessions . "
first , with the progress in economic development and the improvement in the people 's livelihood in the urban and rural areas , especially the rise in the level of per - capita wages , it is only natural that military personnel should be assured the same increase in income .
local government institutions will have a pay rise of 30 percent across the board this year , and military personnel will have an increase 20 percent higher than local officials .
second , this is necessitated by defense modernization and the reform of the military system , in other words , to meet the needs of defense and combat preparations .
professor hu siyuan of national defense university pointed out that china 's population is the largest in the world , but its military spending only ranks seventh in the world .
last year , china 's military spending was equivalent to us $ 14.6 billion , only five percent that of the united states , 30 percent that of japan , 40 percent that of britain , 48 percent that of france , and 64 percent that of germany .
the proportion of china 's military spending in its gross domestic product is also lower than in countries like the united states , the republic of korea , india , britain and france .
their aim is simply to find an excuse for themselves when they increase their own military spending and expand their military supremacy .
professor hu siyuan pointed out that china has a sound process for the management and monitoring of its military spending , which makes it difficult to hide anything even if its wants to .
the overall budget for military spending , the budgets for different projects and departments , and the implementation of the budgets are audited and supervised by state and army auditing organs .
in terms of expenditure , china 's military spending covers living expenses for its personnel , expenses for activities and expenses for armament . the first two items already account for the bulk of the outlays and very little is spent on the actual purchase of arms .
experts also questioned why there are always people in the west who keep associating increases in china 's military spending in recent years with issues such as the " china threat theory " and " the mainland is going to use arms against taiwan . "
at a recent press conference held in beijing , chinese foreign minister tang jiaxuan also reminded the foreign media not to arbitrarily tie china 's normal increase in budgetary military outlays to the taiwan question , saying that they are questions of different categories .

in accordance with the stipulations of the " constitution of the people 's republic of china " and relevant laws , the procedures for elections of the session have been formulated .
first , four npc standing committee members will be elected at the by - elections of the session . these will be single - candidate elections and the method of secret ballot will be adopted .
second , the candidates for the npc standing committee members to be elected at the by - elections are nominated from the deputies by the presidium . after deliberation and consultation by various delegations of deputies , a formal list of candidates will be decided by the presidium in accordance with the opinions of the majority of the deputies .
a candidate is considered elected if he wins affirmative votes from more than half of the entire deputies .
sixth , places for marking the ballots in secret will be set up during the by - elections .
seventh , 35 people are elected at the session to scrutinize balloting . the 35 examiners are formed by having each deputies delegation choose one deputy to be an examiner . the presidium will appoint a chief examiner from the 35 examiner .
the people responsible for the work of vote count are designated by the secretariat of the session .
ninth , a total of 27 voting boxes will be set up at the session venue . the deputies will cast their votes at designated voting boxes decided by the section of their seats .
tenth , during the vote , the examiners should vote first according to their own seat sections before scrutinizing the voting situation at the voting boxes they are in charge of .
twelfth , when the vote count ends , the chief examiner will report the election result to the presiding chairman of the session , and the presiding chairman will make an announcement .
thirteenth , these election procedures are adopted for implementation at the plenary meeting of the fourth session of the ninth npc .

summing up achievements during the ninth five - year period and formulating the 10 th five - year plan are the key themes of the two sessions this year .
the 10 th five - year plan is the first five - year plan of the new century . it is also the first five - year plan in implementing the third - step strategic arrangement in the modernization drive and the first five - year plan after the socialist market economic system has been preliminarily established .
from a new historical height and a world perspective , the proposal put forth goals , strategic arrangements , and key tasks for economic and social development . it is a program of action guiding our great march in the new century .
it is a magnificent goal as well as an arduous task .
properly carrying out this year 's economic work and various tasks has important bearing on accomplishing the 10 th five - year plan and on realizing the " three - step " strategic goal .
the departments in 15 provinces and cities have intensified their support that they had pledged for counterpart departments in tibet . in fact , 62 projects had been completed and began to function and produce results when the autonomous region marked its 30 th founding anniversary .
practice is the only criterion for examining truth .
in the new historical period , we must fully understand the importance of the projects to be carried out in tibet .
we must work hard together so that " we will never permit tibet from separating from the motherland , nor will we let tibet always be in a state of backwardness . "
speaking on projects to be accomplished in the first year of the new century , luo gan said : development and stability are the most important and most fundamental projects tibet must accomplish in developing western china .
we must correctly handle the relationships between reform , development , and stability .
we must seize the opportunity and go all out to prepare the holding of the meeting .
currently we must do a good job in planning the construction projects to be launched in tibet , and actively organize the counterpart assistance projects and coordinate the various preferential economic policies that will facilitate tibet 's development .
the central committee 's decision to build the qinghai - tibet railway is an important policy made for ensuring tibet 's stability and development . the decision will produce significant political and economic effects and so we must ensure the progress and the quality of its implementation .
this railway , when completed , can promote the development tourism and other businesses in tibet .
tibet is an immense region with rich underground resources . we must intensify our geological prospecting in order to find these resources .
in conclusion , luo gan pointed out : in recent years , tibet has taken the initiative to fight secessionism , instead of acting passively to deal with contingencies as before , and the situation has been stable .
however , the hostile forces in the west are still doing everything possible to undermine tibet 's stability . we must never approach this problem lightly .
we must continue to educate the people on patriotism and the importance of national solidarity . we must not slacken the controls over the monasteries , and we must intensify our border controls with effective measures .
with the untiring efforts we make , we certainly can achieve long - term stability and leap - and - bound economic and social development in tibet in the new century .
gyaincain norbu , vice chairman of the npc nationalities affairs commission , was present at the delegation meeting . lie que , deputy secretary of the regional party committee , chaired the meeting .
railways minister fu zhihuan , and comrades of the state planning and development commission and finance ministry were also present at the meeting to hear the deputies ' review of the outlines of the 10 th five - year plan .
but due to historical reasons and environmental limitations and the fact that tibet remains very backward , there is still a big gap .
we now have in front of us two great opportunities , the large - scale development of the west and the stability of our region 's political situation . we must seize and never lose these opportunities .
in the case of tibet , to always represent the demand of developing advanced productivity is to persist in the principle that development is the real truth and carry out innovation in terms of our thinking , systems and science and technology so as to realize a leaping economic and social development .
we should gradually narrow the gap and realize marching in the fore of the drive for modernization as comrade xiaoping had hoped .
to always represent the way forward for advanced culture is to persist in developing what is useful and discarding what is not , correctly handle the relationship between inheriting the national traditional culture and blazing new trails , and strengthen cultural exchanges between fraternal nationalities so as to absorb all fruits of civilization of the human society .
the key to acting what the " three represents " call for in tibet lies in accelerating development and safeguarding stability and in " never letting tibet separate from the motherland , and never letting tibet remain backward for long . "
beijing , 9 mar (xinhua) - - during the " two sessions " this year , deputies from state - owned enterprises are exceptionally joyous because remarkable results have been achieved in state enterprise reform and difficulty - relief .
transnational corporations are coming the wto is getting closer and closer to us and transnational corporations are entering the china market on a large scale .
" this is a great challenge for us , " said deputy cai dongchen from a state - owned enterprise , who was agitated whenever transnational corporations were mentioned .
he gave a pile of data to this reporter , all about how his enterprise - - the shijiazhuang pharmaceutical group - - should respond to the challenge of wto entry .
he said to this reporter with a sigh , " to be honest , last year 's achievements in reform and difficulty - relief were remarkable , but this is only something at a very primitive stage , we still have a very long way to go . "
cai dongchen said : with the acceleration of the global economy 's integration process , enterprises are faced with more and more intense competition , and the level of competition is getting higher and higher .
now , none of the enterprises in our country dare says that we are in an absolutely superior position in global competition .
we must not stick with the old beaten path and go along the accustomed way of a planned economy . if we take up the challenge with such a mentality , things will go all wrong if we do not handle it well .
besides , we must speed up the grooming of enterprises ' innovation capability and core competitiveness , which is the key to meeting the challenge .
deputy qin chaozhen , who has been engaged in economic and trade work for a long time , has deep feelings about it .
he said , " with the goal of state enterprise reform and difficulty - relief basically fulfilled , we must lose no time in readjusting the structure because time flies . "
according to qin chaozhen , right now we can focus our attention on mainly three aspects : first , keep broadening the channels and domains for the withdrawal of state - owned capital , perfect the mechanism of enterprise exit .
enterprises long running in the red , with more debts than assets and without any hope of eliminating the deficits , must go bankrupt according to law , the " five smalls " [ wu xiao ] must be shut down according to law , and those enterprises that should have withdrawn from the market must basically quit .
we must , in time of " quitting , " optimize the capital and property rights structure and , in time of " advancing , " develop at a faster pace , so that enterprises with superiority will become stronger .
second , push ahead with the reorganization of enterprise assets , get into the international capital market , try as quickly as possible to groom a number of large enterprises with their own intellectual property rights and strong core capability .
third , vigorously support medium - and small - sized enterprises , particularly science and technology - oriented enterprises , enable medium - and small - sized enterprises to develop into something " specialized , refined , unique , and new . "
according to the deputies , it is a good document , the key is to make a great effort to carry it out .
he cited an example , saying : now a lot of enterprises are very messy in terms of credit management , or even do not have any credit at all , hence the problem of debt chains thus caused has long been fettering their development .
if all of the state - owned enterprises can start doing something from within and exercise efficient and well - performed management , then state - owned enterprises will certainly be able to take on yet a better look .
in recent years , cross - strait economic and trade exchanges have increasingly expanded .
beijing , 9 mar ( xinhua ) - - in his speech on behalf of the central committee of the revolutionary committee of the chinese kuomintang , zhu peikang , a member of the chinese people 's political consultative conference (cppcc) national committee , today called for further strengthening democratic supervision over the work of the government .
on behalf of the central committee of revolutionary committee of the chinese kuomintang , he made four proposals for political parties taking part in the administration of state affairs to fulfill their historical missions and further strengthen democratic supervision : - - perfecting mechanism and further institutionalizing and standardizing democratic supervision .
we propose that the news media step up propaganda on the significance , role , mechanism , and ways of democratic supervision and publicize typical cases of democratic supervision that have produced good results .
- - attaching importance to theoretical research to provide theoretical basis and foundation for democratic supervision .
- - strengthening the construction of political parties taking part in administering state affairs to raise their ability and standards in conducting democratic supervision .
in the next five years , how to carry out institutional innovations and in which aspects can institutional innovations be carried out are questioned being intensively discussed by members of the national committee of the chinese people 's political consultation conference [ cppcc ] in the past few days .
institutional innovations are related to various aspects of the political and economic life , and in essence , such innovations will lead to the readjustment of production relations .
the integration and interaction of the two sides will provide a driving force for economic restructuring .
committee member wang guangyuan said : to advance institutional innovations , the key lies in adopting " innovative " thinking , further emancipating people 's minds , overcome the mentality of sticking to the old conventions , and making breakthroughs in advancing institutional innovations .
he proposed that in the next five years , institutional innovations should not only break the old institutional structure , but should also establish new development ideas .
wang guangyuan said : innovation will require the intelligence of the intellectuals , and will also require the participation of the broad masses .
with the increasing maturity of the market economy , reforms driving by local governments , various new economic organizations , and other social forces will become more and more distinct .
in the course of uniting and coordinating all social forces , a profound social foundation will be laid for institutional innovations .
as for what can be done in china 's institutional innovations , many cppcc committee members expressed their opinions .
the capital market and the technology market are still in a comparatively backward condition , and have become the " bottleneck " that restrains economic development .
in the next five years , institutional innovations should further promote the building of the market system , thus paving the way for the building of an complete market system in keeping with the requirements of the market economy .
as china will soon participate in the world trade organization , in the period of the 10 th five - year plan , a unified nationwide big market must be shaped as soon as possible through institutional innovations .
committee member wang huijiong said : institutional innovations aimed at creating a market condition for fair competition must be carried out .
enterprises under different ownership systems should be given accession to the market now under the monopoly of some departments and organizations . it is also necessary to set up independent supervisory institutions to restrain departmental monopolies by making public the monopoly costs , thus preserving the public interests .

in debating premier zhu rongji 's work report and draft outline for the 10 th five - year plan , delegates to the fourth session of the ninth npc expressed numerous opinions and suggestions regarding the work of harnessing and protecting the environment and natural resources .
the delegates believed that natural resources and the environment should be treated as a serious issue , and that efforts to harness and protect them should be comprehensively strengthened .
efforts to harness runoffs from soil erosion have yet to reach predicted targets .
serious water shortages affect not only the economic development of many localities , but also directly influence the survival of many people .
at present the problems of over exploited natural resources , unbalanced industrial structures , ecological destruction , and environmental pollution have already begun to constrain sustained development in these cities .
moreover we ca n't rely on these cities to clean up these problems on their own . they must rely on the nation to seriously research and promulgate related policies to deal with these critical and unique problems .
during deliberations some delegates stated that an investment management system for environmental protection be developed in accordance with the demands of a market economy in order to prevent desertification .
delegate qu geping suggested the country waste no time in making public a law to prevent and control desertification .
delegate zhu tiankai also suggested the country develop an investment management system for environmental protection in accordance with a market economy .
he suggested the country implement a permit system for eradicating pollution , whereby limits are placed on the overall amount of pollution produced by a given enterprise .
delegate wang xia said , the country should strengthen reforms within the water conservancy management system , implementing unified , capable , effective and modern supervision over all aspects of the system .
he suggested wasting no time in revising the nation 's water laws , perfecting rules and regulations , standardizing our country 's water conservancy behavior , and adjusting water prices in order to bring about the sustained development of the country 's water resources .
delegate pei duqing said , in recent years there has been a rapid increase in the amount of aquatic breeding farms in our country 's coastal areas . the residue from these farms creates serious pollution problems and red tide [ chi chao ] frequently forms as a result .
he emphasized the importance of opposing " taiwan independence " and promoting the reunification of our motherland .
the fifth plenary session of the 15 th cpc central committee listed the reunification of our motherland as one of the three major tasks for the new century .
more and more members of the public in taiwan are growing dissatisfied with the taiwan authorities ' mainland policy .
he emphasized : " taiwan independence " is unpopular and is an impassable blind alley .
the taiwan authorities should respect the will of the people , go with the trend , return to the principled position of one china , acknowledge the history and reality of both sides of the straits belonging to one china , and conduct political dialogue and negotiation with the mainland as early as possible .
beijing 9 mar (xna) - - " the tenth five - year plan " outline draft was clear in its call for implementing an urbanization strategy that will help the urban and the rural economies move forward together .
it will completely demolish the long - standing pattern of " countryside and farmers versus city and urban dwellers " ; it will carry rural economic and social development to a brand new stage and will create an urbanization development path with chinese characteristics .
yang xin said that if we examine the practice of each of the world 's countries , we see that while the direction of urbanization development is the same for each , the paths to development are unique .
many people believe that we should focus on developing our existing large and medium - sized cities , because their larger economic scales and wider variety of economic sectors mean they could provide greater employment opportunities .
second , in china , if we try to gather the population from the top down , it would require 200 cities of one million population each to transform a 200 million population , and could only be done at a huge cost , well beyond china 's current national capacity .
third , if we gather the farmers in the big cities , china will have a severe " urban disease . "
the time is ripe a correct choice still requires ripe conditions for its successful implementation .
member li jinpei said that 20 years experience with development and reform have significantly improved the level of chinese agricultural production .
delegate xu zhenghu from heilongjiang said that starting in the 1980 s in the last century , many experts began raising the theory of developing small cities and towns .
as part of the reform , masses of farmers not only established township enterprises but also built up a web of small cities and towns .
at present , china has several ten thousands of small cities and towns , and has accumulated rich experience in developing these .
the " tenth five - year plan " is set to implement an urbanization strategy which will help build small towns and cities in a better regulated , healthier and faster manner , and will bring us to a new stage of urbanization development .
delegate xu zhenghu said that further development of the domestic economy has led to increased urgent demands for implementing urbanization .
the rural economy is at an important transformation stage , with increasingly less space for working under the existing framework .
delegates said the most important and pressing need right now is strengthening reform and breaking through obstacles .
member li jinpei said the long - standing policy of segregating urban and rural areas through the residency system restricted population flow and blocked the urbanization process .
we should try to reform the residency system and change policies ; for example , allow farmers to become city residents if they have a legal dwelling , a stable job and means of making a living . this would be a breakthrough in speeding up the urbanization process .
how can a favorable environment for operations be constructed for medium - and small - sized enterprises ?
wu jinglian said that in terms of the degree of restriction on capital and the flexibility of production management , independent small - sized enterprises have their own advantages . however , in terms of financing , developing new and high technologies and obtaining market information , they have their weaknesses .
moreover , due to their small scale , small - sized enterprises are often unable to access large markets through self - run supply and marketing methods . this has caused all sorts of difficulties . we should assist these enterprises , especially individual enterprises , that jointly form their own cooperative supply and marketing organizations .
at the same time , we must improve the business environment , strengthen market supervision , ensure orderly regulations for competition , improve the social status of non - public proprietors and provide them legal protection of their fundamental rights .
second , there remain some problems in transferring the social security responsibilities for the laid - off workers from enterprises to the insurance networks .
fourth , in some areas , the management of services for laid - off workers does not meet the established requirements .
the employment relations of the laid - off workers should be handled concretely according to different conditions .

the pla delegation of npc deputies held its second plenary meeting this afternoon .
after listening attentively to the speeches by various deputies , president jiang made an important speech .
he first affirmed the achievements made in the building of the armed forces during the ninth five - year plan period .
jiang zemin said : our country made tremendous achievements in economic and social development during the ninth five - year plan period .
the first question president jiang stressed in his speech was to gain a clear understanding of the situation and tasks and effectively undertake the historic mission of the people 's army .
he said : a central working conference , which was held not long ago , made a comprehensive analysis of the current international and domestic situations and also made plans for the important tasks the whole party has to carry out well in the early new century .
in the world today , the international situation generally continues to tend toward relaxation , peace and development remain the theme of the times , multipolarization of the world and economic globalization have further developed , and scientific and technological progress is being made with each passing day .
the world is still far from being peaceful and tranquil , and we are still facing some severe challenges . overall , however , the international environment is favorable to us in continuously concentrating our efforts on the modernization drive .
the whole party , the entire armed forces , and the people throughout the country should fortify their confidence , seize the opportunity to speed up development , and work together to keep pushing various undertakings forward .
it is necessary to pay close attention to the development and change of the situation , to strive to make full preparations for military struggle , and to actively assist local authorities in maintaining social stability .

we should carry out extensive and in - depth activities to train troops in science and technology and improve the quality and efficiency of military training .

in view of this situation , the npc environmental and resources protection committee and other units have submitted a draft desertification prevention law to the npc standing committee for examination in an effort to stop the ecology from worsening .
governments at all levels must strive to stop the spreading of desertification by tightening planning , heightening their sense of responsibility , and increasing investments .
generally speaking , the project of diverting water in southern china to the north is still on the stage of conducting feasibility studies . how to protect the ecology is the biggest consideration .
he said : " conserve water first , divert water later ; control pollution first , supply water later ; protect the environment first , use water later . " if we can do this , then all the problems caused by the project of diverting water in southern china to the north can be resolved .

xiao yang , president of the supreme people 's court , gave a report on the work of the supreme people 's court .

district courts handled a total number of more than 5.35 million first - trial cases , and trials of more than 5.38 million cases ( including backlog cases ) were concluded , of which 88 percent were civil cases of various kinds .
all courts took effective measures to deal with difficulties in executing court verdicts , thus upholding judicial authority and prestige .

last year , 45,113 criminal cases involving corruption , bribery , and dereliction of duty were put on file for investigation , and by investigating these cases , more than 4.7 billion yuan in the state 's direct economic losses were recovered .
npc deputies , totaling 2,747 people , attended today 's meeting .
