beijing , 10 mar ( xinhua ) - - at a time when a number of millionaires are drawing forward consumption in china , it is not hard to find in the towns and villages people whose earnings are less than 200 yuan a month .
the gradual widening of disparities in income distribution has become a question of concern to the npc deputies and cppcc committee members currently attending the two sessions .
" it is very hard for consumption to increase without rational distribution . "
in the view of sichuan deputy tao wuxian , the current income disparities in society are mainly shown in the following ways : between urban and rural areas , between regions , and between sectors .
he cited as an example the fact that the average wage of workers in sichuan in west china is under 6,000 yuan , while in the eastern coastal regions the figure is already about 20,000 yuan .
according to an investigation conducted by the state statistics bureau on incomes in 40,000 urban households in china in 2000 , high income - earners who accounted for 20 percent of the survey possessed about 42.5 percent of the wealth .
although people have noted the widening of income disparities , no one wants to go back to the era when everyone ate out of the same big pot .
in the past 20 and more years per - capita income in the towns has increased by 260 percent , and rural incomes by 370 percent .
xiao guxin , a member of the national committee of the cppcc , said that there are many causes for income disparity , and they are also complex .
the main cause is that the reforms are not yet in place .
the chinese government is currently devising ways of continually increasing urban and rural incomes , especially of people with low incomes .
a number of deputies also put forward some good ideas regarding this problem : first , intensify direct aid and assistance for communities living in poverty and difficulty , so as to properly resolve the problem of their basic living necessities ; in the towns , it is necessary to further perfect the system of guaranteeing minimum basic necessities .
" egalitarianism and widening of income disparities both mean unfair distribution . "
jin renqing said that in future consideration will be given to adopting a combined comprehensive and categorized method in levying income tax ; individuals will need to report on income they have earned in addition to their wages , so as to perfect the income tax system .
deputy li chengyu , executive vice governor of henan , said that when carrying out reforms of the distribution setup , it is necessary to express the labor value of laborers without quantization [ liang hua ] of state assets for individuals , in order to regulate order in social distribution and prevent excessive income disparities .
xiao yang said : in the past year , the spc conducted second hearings , reviews of death sentences , and justice supervision involving 4228 cases , and concluded 4832 cases . local courts at all levels and special courts handled some 5.35 million cases of first hearing and concluded some 5.38 million cases .
the spc approved the death sentences for criminal elements cheng kejie and hu changqing in accordance with the law , upholding the principle that everyone is equal under the law and showing the firm resolution of the party and country in severely punishing corruption .
meanwhile , in accordance with the law , the court punished and dealt with criminal elements who blatantly bribed state officials for illegal benefits .
courts at all levels earnestly received visits and letters from people , which realistically resolved the people 's reasonable demands and prevented intensified contradictions . last year , the courts handled a total of 9.39 million letters and visits , playing an active role in maintaining social stability .
xiao yang said : people 's courts continued to implement the important directives of the central government on resolving the issue of " difficulty in the enforcement of court verdicts , " further improved the enforcement mechanism , and raised the efficiency of enforcement .
throughout the year , a total of 2.64 million cases were enforced at the request of the concerned parties in accordance with the law , involving a total value of 306.4 billion yuan , an increase of 22.7 percent over the previous year .
xiao yang said : " helping people whose legitimate rights and interests have been infringed upon , but cannot afford to pay lawsuit fees because of economic difficulty , engage in lawsuits " is another solemn promise of the spc .
to truly protect the people 's litigation right in accordance with the law despite their economic difficulty , the spc improved the judicial rescue and assistance system .
to parties of civil and administrative cases who were truly in economic difficulty , the court allowed them to postpone , reduce , or be exempted from payment of fees .
xiao yang said : courts throughout the country last year implemented the chief justice system .
in accordance with the regulation on the system of avoiding cases where there is a conflict of interests , 6759 judicial personnel throughout the country voluntarily recused themselves from such cases . a total of 46 court personnel in the country were prosecuted for criminal liability for perverting the law in adjudication and violating law enforcement .
xiao yang said : in the first year of the new century , the people 's courts will firmly crack down on and mete out stern , legitimate punishment to those crimes that jeopardize national security , subvert the state power , and sabotage national reunification .
the principle of " stern crackdown " shall be upheld and crimes such as organized crimes of an underworld nature and violent crimes shall be firmly cracked down on and receive stern punishment based on law , so as to ensure social and political stability .
they shall continue to make full use of judicial means to resolve social conflicts .
xiao yang said : economic crime should be cracked down on according to law .
stern punishment should continue to be awarded to such crimes as corruption , bribery , and misappropriation of public funds and crimes of inveigling and corrupting state civil servants by offering them bribes should also punished according to law .
judicial protection of human rights should continue to be strengthened and a strict line of demarcation drawn between crime and non - crime .
xiao yang said : it is necessary to intensify the effort to prevent and deal with the corruption of a minority of judicial personnel at source .
the system of leading cadres taking the blame and resigning should be comprehensively introduced . those leading cadres who are directly responsible for major cases of law or discipline violation should not only be given appropriate disciplinary penalties , but also offer to resign on their own initiative .
if such a person fails to tender his resignation himself , it is suggested that the people 's congress at the same level and its standing committee should dismiss or replace him .
in the struggle against the evil cult of " falungong , " procuratorial organs resolutely arrested and prosecuted a tiny minority of criminals who had used the " falungong " cult to carry out criminal activities , undermined the enforcement of the law , caused the death of people , and had gathered crowds and disturbed social order .
meanwhile , procuratorial organs also took an active part in dedicated " crackdown " campaigns in specific fields .
moreover , procuratorial organs also reinforced supervision of adjudication as well as supervision over the enforcement of criminal penalty .
last year , a total of 4,626 criminal cases involving judicial personnel were placed on file for investigation .
meanwhile , they are also working hard to build their ranks into stronger contingents by improving their overall competency and law enforcement efficiency .
in some major state construction projects , they prevented the commission of crimes by helping establish and improve the bidding and material procurement systems .
han zhubin said : to build more efficient contingents of procuratorial officers , the spp also pushes forward projects of restructuring the personnel management system .
second , there are still some procuratorial officers who disregard the law and disciplinary rules .
third , the personnel management system operating according to the judicial law remains defective . problems caused by lacking controls over hiring and dismissing law enforcement personnel still exist . some places have hired people who do not have the credentials to serve as procuratorial officers , and some places are unable to remove those who are incompetent .
fourth , the mechanism governing budgets for procuratorial operations remains unsound . the problem of lacking operating budgets and budgets for replacing outmoded equipment is particularly noticeable in remote , impoverished areas .
he proposed that the procuratorial work for 2001 be conscientiously and successful conducted , focusing on the themes of strengthened supervision and impartial law enforcement . han zhubin said : this year is the first year for implementing the 10 th five - year plan and marching toward the third - step strategic goal of modernization .
han zhubin proposed that procuratorial organs conscientiously perform their procuratorial responsibilities and better serve the overall interests of the party 's and the state 's work .
they should go all out to safeguard social stability , intensify the work on investigating , handling , and preventing crimes committed by taking advantage of the convenience of office , and further strengthen supervision on litigation .
it is necessary to improve and strengthen ideological and political work , focusing on enhancing procuratorial personnel 's awareness of their aim and professional ethics .
it is necessary to optimize the structure of the procuratorial contingent and organize nationwide uniform examinations and assessment of the basic quality of procuratorial personnel . those who fail their examinations should leave their posts to receive training and those who fail again shall be dismissed .
han zhubin said : procuratorial organs should further strengthen the construction of clean and honest administration within themselves and conscientiously implement the system of responsibility for the construction of party conduct and clean and honest administration and the system of self - criticism of leading cadres .
focused education and rectification should be conducted in depth across the whole sector in accordance with the requirements of the central authorities and tremendous efforts should be made to deal with the problems of law and discipline violation .
washington , 9 mar ( xinhua ) - - rok president kim tae - chung wrapped up his four - day visit to the united states on 9 march .
during the visit , he and us president bush had a summit to emphatically discuss the korean peninsula issue .
after the north and the south of the korean peninsula held a historic summit last june , the situation on the korean peninsula has obviously been eased up , and the us - dprk relations saw the tendency of improvement as well .
then us present clinton repeatedly expressed hope that he could visit the dprk within his tenure of office . although his visit was not realized due to a variety of reasons , he himself and officials of his government all expect that the new bush administration will keep improving the us - dprk relations on the existing foundation .
in the light of this situation , the dprk government has responded by criticizing the bush administration 's hard stance on dprk policy and by expressing that the dprk is likely to reconsider its attitude on missile and nuclear issues and prepares to adopt corresponding countermeasures in line with the developments of the us policy toward the dprk .
kim tae - chung has actively advocated engagement with the dprk and hopes to continuously improve relations with the dprk through economic , trade , cultural , and personnel exchanges in an effort to terminate the cold - war situation on the korean peninsula as early as possible and realize the peaceful unification of the peninsula eventually .
according to the disclosed circumstances , during the summit , kim tae - chung and bush , in fact , each sang his own tune over the korean peninsula policy .
in particular , president bush used a lot of cold - war terms to express his suspicion about the dprk government 's commitment to improving relations with the united states and its sincerity in relaxing the korean peninsula situation . president bush also emphasized that the dprk remains a " threat . "
the bush administration excluded the possibility of resuming dialogues with the dprk side in the near future on the excuse of conducting a comprehensive review of the us - dprk relations .
on the eve of kim tae - chung 's us visit , the us media reported that the bush administration would probably revise the " geneva agreement on dprk - us nuclear framework " signed in 1994 and would plan to replace the light - water reactor nuclear power station , mentioned in the agreement with a hydropower station .
meanwhile , the so - called " missile threat " from the dprk is precisely one of the major excuses the bush administration is using to justify its nmd system domestically and internationally .
in this sense , the elimination of the so - called " threat " from the dprk is not what the bush administration would like to see .
second , maintaining its troops in the asia - pacific region has always been a major component part of the us policy toward the asia - pacific region , and the relaxed situation on the korean peninsula will probably arouse controversy over the issue of us troops stationed abroad .
this will surely exert a negative impact on the situation of the korean peninsula and even on the security and stability of the east asia as a whole .

beijing , 11 mar ( xinhua ) - - " the land and the mountains shake if the foundation is unstable . "
since the beginning of the " two sessions , " issues related to agriculture , peasants , and rural areas have always been major topics for and concerns of both deputies of the national people 's congress [ npc ] and representatives of the national committee of the chinese people 's political consultative conference [ cppcc ] .
china 's ability to overcome many economic difficulties and maintain sustained , rapid , and healthy economic development over the past 20 years since the drive of reform and opening up can be attributed to great service rendered by the agricultural sector .
as far as hundreds of millions of peasants are concerned , it is rather difficult to increase their incomes by simply relying on growing crops . having insufficient stamina , township enterprises , which flourished some years ago , find it hard to become a major channel for increasing peasants ' incomes in a short period of time .
with failure in reducing peasants ' burdens and increasing difficulty in developing the rural economy , unstable factors have increased in rural areas .
agriculture has a fairly long production cycle . therefore , if something goes wrong , it may take several years to regain its strength .
the " 10 th five - year plan " period represents a critical stage for china to accelerate its industrialization and industrial restructuring .
the courses of development in some countries show that issues such as the outflow of resources and the decline in agriculture are most likely to crop out in this stage .
failure in solving agriculture issues will have a direct impact on the enthusiasm of the broad masses of peasants and people , on the efforts to consolidate the alliance of workers and peasants , and on the efforts to realize common prosperity .
the realization of the third - step strategic goal is impossible without sustained and stable development of the rural economy , without sustained and stable growth of peasants ' incomes , and without hundreds of millions of peasants , who account for the majority of china 's population , being rich and prosperous .
without a solid foundation , our efforts to expand domestic demand will inevitably be affected .
despite the fact that the time when china participates in the world trade organization [ wto ] is approaching and that china 's wto entry will provide us a rare opportunity to enter the international market , the international market , however , is highly volatile .
only by fully tapping both domestic and international market , can we find larger room for maneuver .
the key to solving well the expansion of the domestic market lies in solving well the issues related to rural areas , agriculture , and peasants .
it is difficult to encourage peasants , who have low incomes , to spend more on consumer goods .
at present , the issues that have cropped out in the agricultural sector have drawn a high degree of attention from the cpc central committee and the state council .
general secretary jiang zemin pointed out that agricultural development represents a long - term and arduous task . it is necessary to give agriculture the highest priority in the promotion of the national economy . we should make sure to lay a solid agricultural foundation .
conscientiously carrying out the party 's basic policy in rural areas as well as protecting and mobilizing peasants ' enthusiasm represent the basic experiences that china has gained over the past 20 years .
the double - tier system that combines unified and separated operations based on the household contract responsibility system represents the fundamental operation system in china 's rural areas . it is the cornerstone of the party 's rural policy , which absolutely cannot be shaken at the current stage .
we should firmly carry out the principled policies adopted by the cpc central committee regarding the alleviation of peasants ' burdens , particularly the policy of reforming rural taxation and fee collection .

if this work is not done well , or is not done effectively , it may very well result in our being unable to fulfill our set targets on schedule .
we must therefore grasp ever more tightly and do still better this major item of economic and social work , without the slightest slackness or relaxation .
the party committees and government at all levels must understand the importance and long - term and arduous nature of population and family planning work in the new situation , and do this work really well .
the central authorities have specified that the main task in population and family planning work is to stabilize the low birth rate , while at the same time efforts must be made to improve the quality of the population .
improving the quality of the population has a direct bearing on the future of china 's modernization and the rejuvenation of the chinese nation .
first of all , we must start by improving the quality of births , and the family planning , public health , and education departments must make concerted efforts in this respect .
in the course of implementing the western development strategy , we must persist in tackling both economic development and population control , intensify input in the work of family planning in the western regions and ethnic minority regions , do a good job in building a grassroots technical services network , and strengthen the service capacity .

we must further readjust and improve the structure of the development and use of land .
we must continue to control overall coal production , promote the clean and highly efficient use of coal , and make efforts to economize oil resources and find substitutes for them .
we must vigorously carry out investigation and assessment of new energy sources and studies for exploiting and using them .
we should gradually unfold the work of comprehensive land improvement , intensify the management and improvement of mine environment , step up the work of preventing and dealing with geological disasters , and achieve coordinated development of resource exploitation and environmental protection .
we must adapt to the new situation of economic globalization , make full use of the " two kinds of resources and two markets , " and make efforts to establish a sustainable supply setup for mineral resources , especially oil resources .
we must strengthen the comprehensive management of marine resources and intensify the work of supervising and checking on marine environmental protection and law enforcement .
first of all we must prevent and deal with new environmental pollution and ecological damage .
we must continue to knock out enterprises , products , and production methods that are backward and have a serious impact on the environment , and adopt methods such as technical revamping and cleaning up production to control industrial pollution from the source .
we must make efforts to improve the level of dealing with urban pollution and garbage , and properly control urban sewage , air , noise , and solid waste pollution .
we must actively develop ecological agriculture and organic agriculture , and ensure the safety of agricultural products .
we must continue to get a good grasp of key environmental projects and ensure that they produce good results .
the localities should also determine key environmental projects and get a good grasp of resolving a number of environmental issues that evoke strong reactions among the masses .
we must persist in focusing on prevention and regard the prevention of artificial ecological damage as the key point .
we must continue to carry out the work of returning farmland to forest and pasture in a planned and orderly way .

stepping up water conservancy construction and the management of water resources is both a long - term task and also an extremely urgent task .
the leading cadres at all levels must enhance their awareness of hardship .
at present we must speed up the harnessing of the great rivers and lakes , get a good grasp of building dykes and control projects along the great rivers , and speed up the work of reinforcing reservoirs that are in a dangerous condition .
we must assign a prominent position to the economical use of water , vigorously promote measures for this purpose , develop water - economizing agriculture , industry , and service trades , and build a water - economizing society .
we should do a good job in the rational allocation of river basin and regional water resources ; economic and social development must take full consideration for the water resource conditions , and it is necessary to coordinate well the use of water for daily life , production , and the ecology .
we should adopt a variety of ways to ease the contradiction of water shortage in north china ; in this respect , the transfer of water from south to north is a measure of strategic significance .
while doing a good job in economizing in water and preventing and dealing with water pollution , we should step up the early - stage work for transferring water from south to north , and start construction work as soon as possible .
we must ceaselessly do a good job in soil conservancy and protecting water resources .

beijing , 11 march ( xinhua ) - - the gradually widening income gap among residents in china and an emerging tendency of polarization between the rich and the poor in the country have aroused the close attention of the members of the cppcc national committee .
according to a survey on family income conducted last year by the state statistical bureau among 40,000 urban households in china , an equivalent of 42.4 percent of the social wealth is held in the hands of high - income makers who account for 20 percent of the total .
at the same time , however , there has been a clear tendency that the social stratum of the poor is being polarized .
discussions on levying a tax on inheritance and on heightening the tax threshold of personal income tax have begun to appear in newspapers , all based on the consideration that certain restrictions need to be imposed on the group of high - income makers .
the cppcc members fully reaffirmed all the aforementioned moves and measures taken by the government . meanwhile , they also gave their views on how to narrow the gap between the rich and the poor more effectively in the future .
cppcc member ding junfa considered it necessary for the government to reform the country 's distribution structure .
efforts need to be made to readjust the income level of those working within the structure , yet " such a readjustment has to be based on the consideration of the original welfare guarantee system , and necessary compensations need to be made to workers and staff after the monetary reform . "
through reforming and readjusting its tax - and - fee system , the country can appropriately readjust the income distribution of its residents .
for example , the country can begin to collect taxes on interests , assets , and inheritance .
meanwhile , as people 's income level increases , it is also necessary to heighten both the tax threshold and the progressive tax rate of personal income tax .
speaking of the emergence of a well - off group in the country , the cppcc members pointed out that one must not doubt the correctness of china 's market reform , or the correctness of the country 's multi - element ownership structure , just because of this .

beijing , 12 mar ( xinhua ) - - the full - set equipment industry , represented by heavy machinery , power generators , and ship - building , metallurgical , and petrochemical equipment , has made major contributions toward the republic 's industrial development .
however , due to constraints in its mechanism , structure , technology , and market , the equipment industry has become " old and frail " and has increasingly fallen behind the developed countries , which will severely affect china 's industrial restructuring process in future .
the low standard of our information technology also puts us in an unfavorable position amid competition .
we have not been able to do without " foreign walking sticks " while competing with others .
deputy tian yushi , who participated in the first tender bid for the three gorges project , said : in the three gorges project 's tender bid for power generating equipment , we had no choice but to form alliances with sweden and other countries because of our lack of strength .
furthermore , the price of introducing advanced foreign technology has become increasingly high , and there is no way we can buy the core technology .
difficult for mechanism to survive if system is sick what hinders development in the equipment industry ?
deputy tian yushi holds the view that , first , the low degree of competition has led to huge redundancy in production capacity .
the national production capacity of the boiler industry is 20 million kilowatts , whereas the domestic annual demand is only half of that amount .
with over 4000 enterprises fighting intensely with each other , nobody is having a good time . second , enterprises weighed down with heavy burdens suffer at least a 50 - percent drop in their competitiveness .
the expenses spent by enterprises on teachers , doctors , and retired personnel are too high .
deputy tian yushi said that most equipment enterprises own a comprehensive set of facilities , including casting , forging and pressing , lathing , milling , clamping , riveting , and wielding .
another obstacle hindering development in the equipment industry is backward manufacturing equipment .
therefore , to maintain production is already difficult , not to mention buying new equipment or carrying out technological upgrades , which easily cost 100 million yuan or more .
npc deputies hold the view that the fundamental way out for the equipment industry is through reform .
deputy wang guoxue said that , taking the experience of the textile industry as reference , we must cut redundant production capacity and make competitive enterprises stand out .
deputy liu haisheng proposed separating subsidiary enterprises from main enterprises and setting up specialized factories , thus increasing enterprises ' profits by 20 percent .
he said that if an enterprise with 30,000 employees can cut its staff strength by 10,000 , it will be able to save 100 million yuan of expenses each year and use that money for restructuring and technological upgrades . how can the enterprise not become reinvigorated then ?
jia shaoji holds the view that , by devoting 1 percent of its profit to technological investment , an enterprise will inject into itself the staying strength for development .
the draft outline of the 10 th five - year plan puts forth that the state will formulate policy measures for the equipment manufacturing industry and rely on major projects to vigorously rejuvenate the equipment manufacturing industry .
that will provide an excellent opportunity for restructuring the equipment industry .
deputy tian yushi raised a new idea on how the state should support the equipment industry .
it is better to adopt the tender system instead of " sprinkling salt and pepper " in providing state support , so that the fund goes to the enterprise that is the most suitable for the project .

some deputies who are acquaintances of this reporter raised the following question whenever they saw this reporter recently .
they said that according to the relevant department , the registered unemployment rate at towns and townships at the end of 2000 stands at 3.1 percent ; however , they feel that there are some differences between this number and the unemployment situation in real life . why do they feel this way ?
by the end of 2000 , a total of 103.46 million people nationwide have participated in the program of unemployment insurance .
the unemployment rate at towns and townships remains at 3.1 percent for two years in a row . since the base number , the population , is big , this is a hard - earned result .
second , our country has adopted the system of registered unemployment . a person who meets the conditions of unemployed personnel and is registered with the local labor and social security department is counted as one of the unemployed . those who are not registered are not included in the unemployed .
third , the current unemployment rate in our country means the registered unemployment rate at towns and townships , which excludes the surplus labor in the rural areas and the laborers from the rural areas who work in towns .
with a rising degree of urbanization and the reform of the household registration system , the state will gradually change the means of accounting for the number of the unemployed based on household registration in towns and townships , and adopt the means of accounting for the unemployed based on residency .
it should be pointed out that either for the workers who are removed from the work place or for the unemployed personnel , the situation of " concealed employment " is prevalent .

beijing , 10 mar - - for china , joining the wto meets its internal need of deepening reform , opening up wider to the outside world , and building a socialist market economy , said fang jiamin in an interview with this reporter .
fang jiamin , a member of the chinese people 's political consultative conference [ cppcc ] national committee and a law professor with tianjin commercial college , is attending the fourth session of the ninth cppcc national committee held here .
fang jiamin pointed out that china 's wto accession has advantages and disadvantages , but generally speaking , advantages outnumber disadvantages .
on the whole , advantages outnumber disadvantages first , china 's wto admission is conducive to export expansion and absorbing foreign funds .
while china can exploit the opportunities of other countries and regions opening up their markets , the discriminative measures against china by its major trading nations will be gradually lifted .
in the meantime , china will have to improve the investment environment for foreigners , remove customs barriers , and cut tariffs .
china will also have to provide a better legal environment for foreign investors , and thus better absorb their management skills .
third , china 's wto accession will help deepen its economic reform .
the rules laid down by the wto are , in essence , the application and development of the rules governing the market economy , on a world scale .
china 's economic restructuring aims at building a socialist market economy , allowing the market competition mechanism to play its role .
the wto demands nongovernment intervention , openness , and transparency . therefore , china must carry out reform , abandoning black - box operations , must cut down administrative interventions , and must thoroughly change the government 's functions .
fourth , china 's wto membership will allow china to join other countries in working out new rules for international trade .
if china does not gain membership in the wto , china can only follow the rules laid down by other people .
to be involved in the large international economic cycle is a major international development trend .
after joining the wto , china must adapt itself to the process of economic globalization .
china must open its market , so must its trading partners , so that the two sides can be mutually complementary to each other economically , give full play to each other 's comparative edges , and develop characteristic industries .
after joining the wto , while introducing advanced technology , funds , and management expertise from foreign countries , china will be able to build up its own transnational corporations , joining the world .
fang jiamin said that three aspects , among others , will be obviously affected : car industry , agriculture , and monopoly industries ( such as telecommunications , finance , and insurance ) .
fang jiamin said by way of analysis : the wto has formulated a large set of rules concerning agriculture .
the worldwide agricultural situation shows that in the 50 - year period from 1950 to 1999 , the area sown to maize increased by 42 percent , but the output by 240 percent ; the area sown to rice increased 35 percent , but the output by 175 percent .
worldwide , the growth of every agricultural product exceeds the growth of population .
it is all the more the case with the breeding industry . in the 50 - year period , the world population doubled , but the livestock products increased by eight times .
worldwide , the supply of farm produce exceeds the demand . naturally the development is uneven : while some countries have excessive stockpiles of agricultural products , the people of many african countries go hungry .
when china opens its market , its farm produce will suffer a great deal .
in the face of a large quantity of cheap agricultural products from the united states , china must take countermeasures . we must move from the simple contract system with remuneration linked to output , to other modes . we must adjust the industrial structure and develop agriculture of scale .
china should deepen and speed up reform and open wider to the outside world to meet the challenges brought about by its wto entry .
rok president kim tae - chung visited the united states last week and met with president bush for the first time .
the situation in the korean peninsula and the us policy toward the dprk were naturally the major topics of the us - rok summit .
after taking office , bush was busy handling major domestic and foreign affairs and did not list the relationship with the dprk in the foreign affairs agenda of the us new government .
people were not clear about the us policy toward the dprk .
this was exactly the mindset of kim tae - chung when he visited the united states .
from the speeches of president bush and some us high - ranking officials , however , people find that the united states is still having doubts on the sincerity of the dprk and is still regarding the dprk as a military threat to the united states .
relationship between south and north koreas is restrained .
the united states recognizes the rok 's " leading role " in the policy toward the dprk , but kim tae - chung clearly understands that " if no breakthrough can be made in the us - dprk relations , development of the relations between south and north koreas will be hindered . "
this caused great disappointment to the dprk , which was devoted wholeheartedly to making a breakthrough in the dprk - us relationship .
after bush took office , the dprk wished to resume talks with the us new government as soon as possible .
one month after bush took office , the spokesman of the dprk foreign ministry , for the first time , attacked the us new government 's policy toward the dprk , threatening to reconsider the dprk 's stance on the missile issue if the united states continues its intransigent attitude .
if the us new government continues delaying the negotiations with the dprk and implements a more intransigent policy toward the dprk , it is difficult to predict what moves the dprk will take in the next step .
liu ji , referred to by foreign media as jiang zemin 's think tank , gave an exclusive interview to the " takung pao " while attending meetings of the national people 's congress and the national political consultative congress .
i will address you as committee member liu since you are attending the " two meetings " as a political consultative congress committee member .
for several years now , foreign media has looked at you as president jiang zemin 's think tank , so in this interview i will ask more sensitive " think tank " questions .
what proposals did you bring to these meetings ? liu ji : do not say that ! the foreign media do not understand the chinese communist party system . there is no such thing as a think tank , rather i act as an intellectual , only using knowledge to dedicate myself to the service of my country .
for many years , the national anthem has been played at the opening and closing of the " two meetings . " i am proposing that the national anthem be sung rather than played .
singing the national anthem is the norm at important solemn gatherings in many countries worldwide as well as being a reflection of patriotic spirit . some countries even require that one 's right hand be placed over the heart when singing the national anthem , and this is extremely moving .
i am proposing that singing the national anthem also has another deep meaning .
back in the years when mao zedong , zhou enlai , and other members of the elder generation made the " march of the volunteers " the national anthem , it was to exhort future generations to be vigilant in times of peace and to ensure that the people 's republic would be everlasting .
later , however , i do n't remember when we stopped singing it , it seems like it was when the " cultural revolution " started , but because the composer of the national anthem , tian han , was labeled a " class enemy of all descriptions , " we could not sing it anymore .
the ancients said : " life springs from sorrow and calamity ; death comes from ease and pleasure . "
so let us begin with " singing the national anthem . "
president jiang and the party 's central committee have always instructed the entire party to uphold the great banner of deng xiaoping theory , and political system reform is an inseparable part of deng xiaoping theory .
deng xiaoping instructed us : " if the political system is not reformed , economic system reform cannot be deepened , and the achievements made by economic system reform may even be lost . "
" whether our great socialist reform can in the end achieve success hinges on the success or failure of political system reform . "
we truly must deeply grasp this meaning ! actually , this is also the fundamental tenet of marxism . that is to say , the economy is the foundation , politics are the upper level of the structure , and the economic foundation determines the building 's upper level .
china 's current economic foundation has been transformed from a traditional planned economy into a socialist market economy . should its upper level not change ? if it does not change , the upper level of the structure will in turn inevitably have an obstructive , even destructive , effect on the new economic foundation .
according to the teaching of deng xiaoping , " not to reform is a dead end road . " if we do not reform the political system , there will absolutely be no way out .
if , however , reform of the economic system is carried out first , but political system reforms are not correspondingly put forward , then that is also in violation of basic marxist tenets and will have bad results .
the government still retains authority to do all traditional economic examinations and approvals , but it also is hurrying enterprises into the market with the result that " authority and money exchange " is inevitable .
authority can be made into money with the result that buying officials has become a common practice .
as soon as we begin speaking about political system reform , the independent groups immediately advocate a multi - party system , separation of the three powers , free elections , etc. , etc. , believing that by indiscriminately copying the west , everything will be just fine .
i believe that indiscriminately copying indicates , at least ideologically , laziness . moreover , the only effect is to oppose the actual foundation and sufficient reason provided by reform 's " left " faction and enable the " left " faction to easily equate political system reform to liberalization of the capitalist class .
one can well perceive that communism and democracy cannot be separated .
without democracy , it is not real communism .
during the 1940 s , when mr. huang yanpei questioned how the communist party would prevent again following the historical cycle of " revolution to corruption " , mao zedong responded , saying , " the communist party has already found a way , it is democracy . "
it is a pity that , after the communist party became the party in power , he did not earnestly research and bring about democracy while acting as the leader , and especially in the later years when democracy was even more seriously damaged .
people living in china are best qualified to speak on this . now is the best time in china 's history for democracy and legalization .
if it is said that democracy and legalization in today 's china have already been perfected , that an ideal democratic mechanism has already been built , that cannot be changed and does not need to be reformed , this also is an out and out lie .
everything proceeds from reality in china - - one generation takes care of one generation 's affairs , gradually moving towards the final goal .
it is hoped to accomplish one 's goal in one step , but that is an empty fantasy devoid of reality which in the end can only cause upheaval .
the chinese constitution stipulates the communist party as the ruling party , it is an inseparable component of the chinese political system .
if the communist party is not reformed , then how can it adapt to the reformed china ?
for example , how to handle the problem of scientifically and democratically selecting cadres and successors with both political integrity and ability is a long term difficult issue for the communist party .
at that time , the revolution had not yet succeeded , and the people 's faith was not unswerving and so could be lost at any low ebb or setback .
if we were constantly being defeated in battle , the enemy 's bullets certainly do not discriminate who they are aimed at , so it is by luck that you could dodge a bullet once or twice , but perhaps by the third of fourth time you have lost your life .
is n't society in the " 12 character rhymed formula " of official promotions ? " respect the aged and love the young , investigate and research - this way is leak proof " .
they can have no moral integrity whatsoever , yet demonstrate sincerity to leading individuals without the party cause nor individual devotion to their work and ambition . their entire objective is to be an official and win promotion .
second is bringing false charges against good people .
in the interest of removing obstacles to their officialdom , these people will bring false charges and attacks against good people , find fault with others , and inform secretly on colleagues - - these are their specialties , even fabricating rumors to sow dissension .
historically , the decline and fall of successive chinese dynasties has always been closely related to bad people being rampant or blocking the way .
the subjugation of the soviet union state and party was also a result of bad people within the party .
if i cite a number for this , it will be clear at a glance : in today 's russia , from the president at the top to the town and village level cadres at the bottom , 92 percent were cadres in the communist party of the soviet union .
at that time in the soviet union , however , if you wanted to criticize the dark side of socialism or make suggestions for socialist reform , these people would be very hard on you , attacking and persecuting you .
so people could not refrain from asking how these people graduated up to those positions ? even though there are not 92 percent of cadres in china as was the case in the soviet union , i am afraid in china the cadres constitute 29 percent .
in reforming china 's political system and making innovations for democratic mechanisms within the party , the most important problem to resolve is the cadres constituting 29 percent .
if this problem cannot be resolved , it will be a lesson learned from the soviet union 's mistakes . i have some tentative ideas for scientific democratic mechanisms , but because theory stresses thoroughness and using natural science terminology to describe it is " harmonious , " i am unable to explain it at this time .

the increased portion of china 's military spending is mainly used in four areas .
the chinese government 's move to increase its military spending by a big margin immediately aroused the concern of various countries in the world as well as the concern of china 's taiwan .
in view of the reactions and queries of various sectors abroad , it is necessary to make some comments on the purposes and impact of the increased budget .
the business activities of army - run enterprises for over 10 years were on the whole profitable although some enterprises suffered losses caused by improper management , corruption or dereliction .
however , unhealthy trends developed in the business activities conducted by the army and government offices , which tarnished the image of the army and the government .
therefore , the chinese government resolutely determined to ask the army and government departments at all levels to cut ties with all establishments and enterprises run by them and to transfer the management of these establishments and enterprises to the state economic and trade commission .
this move won the support of all the people across the country , but also reduced the total military spending . as a result , it was impossible to increase the wages of servicemen and funds for updating armament were insufficient .
there are also two major reasons for increasing the wages of servicemen .
therefore , the wages of servicemen should also increase . in his government work report made this year , state council premier zhu rongji said the wages of civil servants will generally increase by 30 percent this year .
second , the chinese government is conducting a comprehensive reform of the social security system and will increase by a big margin the input into old - age insurance , medical insurance , housing commercialization , and so on .
like other sectors , the armed forces also have to consider the employment , social security , housing , and other problems of demobilized servicemen .
in reality , the armed forces have to provide various subsidies , which also have to come from the government budget .
having our eyes on winning a high - tech war the gulf war in 1991 and the war on the balkan peninsula in 1999 fully demonstrated the importance of high technology in military operations and in winning a war .
this means the amount of funds for input determines whether or not advanced science and high technology can be acquired .
therefore , the government 's financial support is the necessary and best guarantee to science and technology output .
the chinese government and all the chinese people absolutely want to safeguard the country 's reunification , sovereignty and territorial integrity . the chinese leaders and people have a strong desire and sense of mission to settle the taiwan issue and to realize the final reunification of the motherland as soon as possible .
in particular , the development of the situation on the island has caused worry and has heightened the vigilance of the chinese government and people and they think they should make proper preparations .
moreover , some western countries have regarded china as the target for blockade , attack and oppression and their involvement in the taiwan issue has increased . therefore , it is only natural for china to appropriately increase its military spending to deal with challenges of various sides .
besides , most of the increased budget is used to increase the wages of servicemen and not much is used for armament .
washington , 10 mar ( renmin ribao ) - - rok president kim tae - chung paid a four - day visit to the united states from 6 to 9 march .
he is the first asian state leader george w. bush has met since taking office as us president .
his purpose in making this trip was to coordinate with the united states their policies toward the dprk and , at the same time , to clarify rok 's position on the missile defense system issue .
after the end of the talks , secretary of state colin powell said in a press briefing that the two leaders " very frankly " and " explicitly " exchanged views , which , in diplomatic parlance , usually suggests that both parties had differing views on issues discussed at the talks .
during the talks , kim tae - chung reportedly also tried to defend his policy and the dprk side in an appropriate manner .
kim said : " since the end of the cold war , the dprk has always been frozen outside the international community . "
in recent years , " amazing " changes have taken place in the dprk , and all countries must seize this rare opportunity to help the dprk break away from the " icy - cold world . "
he put forward a " comprehensive mutually beneficial " strategy toward the dprk .
in the statement , the rok did not openly oppose the nmd energetically advocated by bush , but it was evident that the rok supported russia 's attitude against the nmd .
although the rok immediately made an explanation to the bush administration , the united states was completely relieved by this .
he said that the joint statement he recently issued with russian president putin was not a criticism of the bush administration 's nmd and that he resisted pressure from russia to specifically refer to the us nmd in the joint statement .
kim said he is sorry that the statement has caused a misunderstanding .
the " us - rok joint statement " released on this occasion has puts it this way : due to the emergence of new threats , such as mass antipersonnel weapons and missiles , it is necessary to have new methods of deterrence and defense .
the conclusion the us side has drawn is that kim tae - chung does not support or oppose the us nmd program .

the fourth session of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] today started examining and discussing the " revision ( draft ) of the prc law on sino - foreign joint ventures . " the participants and experts and scholars held that this is another major move in china 's wto accession .
wu shuqing , a chinese people 's political conference [ cppcc ] national committee member from hong kong , recalled the situation in past years : when the first sino - foreign joint venture - - the beijing aviation catering company - - opened in beijing in 1980 , this law had just been tabled .
obviously , this is a clear signal that china will continue to encourage the development of sino - foreign joint ventures .
in 2000 the increase in foreign exclusive investment enterprises outstripped that of joint ventures for the first time and became china 's most active method of attracting investment .
in the 20 and more years since the launch of reform and opening up , considerable competitiveness has been built up in some of china 's raw materials , while their prices have also fallen and supplies are ample .
in these circumstances , the revision of this law will not deal a blow at the domestic market .
for enterprise operators , it is even better , because they have a higher degree of freedom and make choices according to market laws .
this will help to enhance the competitive edge of chinese enterprises through market competition .
he held that " in the face of the possible blows after wto accession , chinese enterprises have the confidence to meet the challenges . "

the 2002 middle school history textbook , compiled mainly by the japanese " new history textbook committee , " is currently being examined and approved by the ministry of education , culture , science and technology .
this textbook , compiled by right - wingers , views some accurate portrayals of history used up until now in textbooks as " national self - abuse , " and attempts to use a clear twisting of historical facts and beautification of encroachment and war to infuse japanese youth with right - wing revisionist history .
the reason that the distortions of history by japanese textbooks would reach this point today is inextricably linked to the rapid rise of the right wing in japan .
imagine that if this type of textbook were approved and issued , not only would it be very hurtful to the feelings of those asian countries and peoples who were the victims of japanese militarist aggression , but would also mislead japanese youth and even influence the future of japan .
right wingers glorify militarism education is very important to young people , and textbooks are the foundation for giving young people an education .
when mentioning the nanjing massacre , the book says only that japanese citizens found out about this affair only after the conclusion of the war , and that consequently it was necessary to do further survey of the true nature of the facts .
and as for japan 's history of encroachment on east asia and her slaughter of the local people , the textbook merely glosses over the period in whitewashed terms .
as politics in japan have moved dramatically toward the right , japanese textbooks have become more severe in their twisting of history .
although the " new history of japan " had already completely twisted around the historical japanese encroachment , quite a few japanese were still not satisfied .
in 1998 , a few local assemblies in japan passed a demand that all references to " comfort women " be deleted from textbooks . an assemblyman from gangshan county said : " can students who study a textbook with one - sided descriptions of our country be proud of being japanese ?
we should promote history education which allows students to feel pride and glory . "

however , the ministry of education , culture , science and technology 's opinion on review and approval was still far from an accurate historical view .

the fourth session of the ninth npc heard the report on the central and local budgets for 2000 and the draft central and local budgets for 2001 prepared by finance minister xiang huaicheng at the request of the state council . the delegations examined the draft budgets and the report of implementation .
the financial and economic committee of the npc examined the draft budgets and the report of implementation on the basis of the views of various delegations and ad hoc committees .
the figures on the implementation of the 2000 budget presented by the state council : national revenue amounted to 1,338 billion yuan , 104.2 billion yuan , or 8.4 percent cent , more than the budgeted figure ; national expenditures amounted to 1,587.9 billion yuan , 74.3 billion yuan , or 4.9 percent , more than the budgeted figure .
in 2000 , the state council and local governments at various levels conscientiously put into practice the principles and policies laid down by the central government and implemented the resolution of the third session of the ninth npc on the implementation of the central and local budgets for 1999 and the draft central and local budgets for 2000 .
state revenue has played a positive role in ensuring reform , development and stability .
financial distortions , extravagance and waste and other violations of financial and economic discipline prevail in spite of repeated prohibitions .
the draft central and local budgets for 2001 put forward by the state council . national revenue is expected to reach 1,476 billion yuan and national spending is expected to reach 1,735.8 billion yuan .
total revenue in the central budget is 842.3 billion yuan . this figure includes 783 billion yuan collected by the central government and 59.3 billion yuan turned over by local governments .
of this , 584.5 billion yuan will be incurred at the central level , while subsidies to the local authorities will total 517.6 billion yuan .
a deficit of 259.8 billion yuan will be left after setting revenue against expenditure .
government loans to be issued will total 500.4 billion yuan , which include this year 's budget deficits , 200.6 billion yuan for servicing domestic and foreign debts , and 40 billion yuan in loans issued by the central government in the name of the local authorities .
the draft budgets are feasible because the measures put forward by the state council to ensure their fulfillment are appropriate .
based on the views of the deputies in their examination , the financial and economic committee is making the following recommendations to ensure the better fulfillment of the tasks set out in the budget for 2001 : ( 1 ) taxation should be strictly administered according to law and the taxation system should be further improved .
tax collection and management should continue to be strengthened and taxation should be administered according to law and levied at the stipulated rates .
efforts should be made to seize the current favorable moment to further improve and perfect the taxation system and actively and steadily promote the fee - for - tax reform in accordance with the principle of fair taxation , reasonable distribution of burdens , guaranteed income , regulated distribution and favorable development .
( 2 ) the patterns of expenditures should be readjusted to ensure the needs of major expenditures .
at the same time , it is also necessary to energetically promote and carry forward the fine tradition of plain living , hard struggle and frugality , streamline administration , and vigorously halt practices of extravagance and waste and indulging in luxury and squandering .
financial authorities at various levels should actively study the question of funding for voluntary education in the rural areas and gradually change the situation where funds for voluntary education are mainly taken care of by the township and village authorities .
efforts should be made to improve the pattern of fiscal investment in education and increase fiscal investment in and transfers of payment to voluntary education in the rural areas in order to guarantee the basic needs of rural voluntary education .
the auditing of the implementation of the central budget and the final accounts of different departments should be strengthened in accordance with the approved budgets .

according to opinions expressed by deputies through examination , the financial and economic committee puts forward the following suggestions : ( 1 ) we should effectively strengthen the foundation position of agriculture , and strive to increase peasants ' income .
this is the primary task of economic work .
we should further increase input in agriculture , strengthen the construction of foundation facilities and ecological projects , and promote the use of science and technology in farming .
we should accelerate the adjustment of economic structure in agricultural production and rural areas . we should stabilize grain production and protect grain - producing ability . we should also develop diversified farming operation . we should guide village and town enterprises to promote technical progress , structural adjustment and new development .
we should actively and properly develop more small towns , and gradually shift surplus labor from rural areas . on the basis of persisting in household - based contract system , we should vigorously promote industrialized operation of agriculture . we should support the establishment of leading enterprises and bases of production , processing and export .
we should strengthen study on the feasibility of planned projects and prevent redundant construction . we should do a good job in the inspection and supervision of current projects , raise effectiveness in the use of funds , and guarantee good quality of construction work .
we should actively promote reform in investment financing system and implement registration system for building non - restricted projects by enterprises .
we should break away from departmentalism , trade monopolization and regional blockade . we should eliminate unreasonable restrictions on market competition and give full play to the basic role of market in the allocation of resources .
( 3 ) we should vigorously adjust and optimize economic structure and raise quality and efficiency of economic growth .
we should firmly grasp the mainline of structural adjustment and maintain a relatively fast development speed on the basis of ensuring quality and efficiency .
we should accelerate the development of new and advanced industries , promote the improvement of industrial structure , and develop the role of information in national economic and social development .
we should further increase investment in technical transformation of enterprises , remodel and improve traditional industries with applicable new and advanced technology , and revitalize equipment and manufacturing industries .
we should continue to phase out backward enterprises and reduce excess plant capacity .
we should actively adjust and develop the tertiary industry .
we should strategically adjust the layout of state - owned economy to meet the demand of improving overall quality of the economy , and persist in encouraging , supporting and guiding the healthy development of individual and private economy while adhering to the principle of keeping public ownership in the dominant position .
we should make scientific plans , seriously implement policies and measures formulated by the state , give prominence to key points , and ensure a good beginning .
( 4 ) we should deepen the reform of state - owned enterprises , and improve the social security system .
we should accelerate the establishment of modern enterprise system , improve corporate management structure , encourage state - owned large and medium - sized enterprises to implement joint - stock system through listing and other forms , change operational system , and vigorously develop products that have a ready market according to demand in market .
we should deepen the internal reform of enterprises , improve and strengthen enterprise management , develop encouragement and restraining system , and strengthen supervision .
we should further implement the policy of separation of the functions of the government from those of the enterprises , effectively change the functions and roles of the government , and reduce administrative examination and approval .
we should find ways and means to increase employment opportunities for the people .
( 5 ) we should continue to implement a stable and sound monetary policy and strengthen supervision and management of finance .
we should handle things strictly according to the law , strengthen financial supervision and management , strictly investigate and handle financial crimes and violations of rules and regulations , sternly crack down on financial fraud , and maintain normal financial order .
we should seriously implement the security law , promote normal development of the stock market , and protect investors ' interests .
we should strengthen and improve management of foreign exchange and prevent loss of foreign exchange .
( 7 ) we should continue to implement the strategy of using science and education to prosper the country and a sustainable development strategy to promote an all - round social progress .
we should continue to increase investment in education , ensure the basic need in promoting compulsory education in rural areas , support the construction of foundation facilities for schools of higher learning , develop middle and high level professional education , strengthen vocational and technical training , and encourage people in the society to run schools .
we should vigorously promote the building of socialist spiritual civilization , prosper socialist culture , and develop news , publication , broadcasting , film and television work . we should strengthen the building of public cultural facilities and attach importance to protecting cultural relics .
we should further strengthen the management of cultural market , network and mass media . we should persist in " wiping out pornography " and " fighting against illegal activities . "
we should promote fitness exercise for the whole people , improve people 's physique , and raise the level of sports .
( 8 ) we should effectively strengthen administration and improve and regulate economic order in the market .
we should , on the basis of improving the legal system , perform administrative work according to the law , implement the law in a strict manner , and strictly rectify and improve the order of a market economy .
we should stop local protectionism and market segmentation . we should crack down on production and selling fake products , smuggling , swindling tax rebate in export , evading foreign currency owed to the government and obtaining foreign exchange under false pretenses , and other illegal activities .

the deputies and cppcc committee members said that the background to these two " over 40 percents " reflects the widening of the disparities between rich and poor and the imperfections of the distribution system , and this should arouse a high degree of vigilance on our part .
unless these two problems are properly resolved , they will have a serious impact on china 's economic development and social stability .
deputy xu bingzhong of the beijing delegation said , the " gini coefficient , " which is the index in common international use to reflect income disparities , indicates the amount of total social wealth owned by 1 percent of the population .
for instance , if the gini coefficient is 0.5 , this indicates that 1 percent of the population possesses 50 percent of social wealth .
the present " gini coefficient " in china is 0.45 , which already exceeds the warning level for disparity between rich and poor .
it is right that the salaried class should pay income tax , but it is not normal that they should pay such a high proportion of it .
some deputies pointed out that this shows that there are still big shortcomings in our revenue and tax collection system and that social distribution is not fair enough .
will excessive disparities have an impact on society ?
deputy fu gui , secretary of chengde city cpc committee , held that if you receive a high salary for working in business requiring high intelligence or for highly physical or dangerous work , people are psychologically balanced regarding this .
if you win a big lottery prize , people will be psychologically somewhat unbalanced , but there are after all very few instances of " manna from heaven being there for the taking , " and it gives little cause for criticism .
however , people cannot be psychologically balanced if similar brain power , similar labor , and similar contributions to society enable one to make a different size of income and result in excessive disparity in income on account of abnormal competition , sector monopoly , or through pursuing speculation , lawbreaking , or corruption .
chaotic and unfair distribution is the hotbed for the germination of corruption and is the corrosion agent that saps people 's morale , and does endless harm and no good to the country and people .
the deputies and committee members held that the method for resolving the current widening disparity between rich and poor can be summed up in three phrases : the first is " raise upward . "
draw up a policy of " bias , " and take proper measures to raise the income level of low income earners .
increase input in the rural infrastructure , restructure agriculture and rural economy , and do everything possible to increase peasant incomes .
the second is " readjust downward . "
adhere to the principle of giving priority to efficiency while taking full account of fairness , deepen the reforms of the distribution system , and regulate the order in social distribution .
the third is " restrain things . "
unless stopped , these things not only will affect social order and nullify our economic achievements but will also endanger the building of our socialist market economic system and adversely affect our great national development strategy .

promote balanced development among population , resources , and the environment .
" we must succeed in four critical areas if we are to achieve leapfrog development , " wang yunkun said , first .
expedite the course of industrialization , informationization , and urbanization , and work hard to achieve unconventional development .
in wang yunkun 's opinion , industry still accounts for a relatively small share of the jilin economy and the task of industrialization is still incomplete . likewise the level of urbanization is rather low .
meanwhile , there is the challenge from informationization and the knowledge - based economy .
third , pursue uneven development and help key regions , key sectors , and key industries take the lead in making breakthroughs .
by making breakthroughs ahead of others , the key regions , key sectors , and key industries should take the lead in expanding the overall economy and raising its level of development .
fourth , firmly take man as the center and promote full - fledged economic and social progress .
first , reconcile taking the lead in achieving breakthroughs with developing simultaneously .
however , this does not mean that other regions can therefore go slow in their development . nor are we favoring one region at the expense of other regions .
regions that have a relatively solid foundation for development and favorable conditions and stand a chance of developing faster should put their strengths to use and go full steam ahead . they should seize the opportunity to push ahead with leapfrog development .
second , reconcile expanding the overall economy with improving quality . "
as wang yunkun sees it , without a sizeable economy , so - called overall returns or economies of scale are out of the question ; similarly , without a quality economy , returns could not be all that good .
at the same time , it must pay a good deal of attention to the problem of quality and economic restructuring and go all out to bring about the " two changes . " the idea is to build a larger economy on the basis of better quality so that the economy perpetuates itself in a positive way .
instead , we need to apply high technology and new technology to transform the traditional industries , upgrade their technology and equipment , and increase the s & t content of their products , thus creating a new industrial advantage .
fourth , reconcile turning around and energizing the state economy with developing the private economy .
in wang yunkun 's opinion , jilin must readjust the mix of ownership systems . make the state economy a success , but also develop the private economy as a matter of priority .
provided state assets are secured , we need to change the forms of state assets and the way of operating them so that they are managed as a form of capital and allocated through the market , thereby achieving the objective of value maintenance and appreciation .
" build up our confidence and courage in development , at the same time clearly - headedly facing up to the difficulties and challenges that line our road of progress . work hard to bring about unconventional economic and social development . such is the principle the people of jilin must follow in the new century . sichuan 's national economy maintained rapid growth .
in 2000 , the province 's gdp grew by 52.3 percent over 1995 , representing an average annual growth of 8.8 percent during the ninth five - year plan period , which was slightly higher than the country 's average of 8.3 percent .
the living conditions of our people were improved remarkably .
the respective proportion of the primary , secondary , and tertiary industries was readjusted from 29 : 40.7 : 30.3 in 1995 to 23.3 : 42.7 : 34 in 2000 .
relations between the supply and demand of both means of subsistence and means of production have changed from a seller 's market to a buyer 's market .
the province 's infrastructural construction was reinforced , and investment was showing a remarkable pulling effect . a batch of major projects was completed in the fields of communication , telecommunications , energy , and water conservancy ; and the " bottleneck " restrictions , which had been plaguing the province for many years , were basically eased .
economic restructuring was further deepened , phased results were attained in the state enterprise reform , the basic role played by the market mechanism in the allocation of resources was notably strengthened , the government 's economic control and regulation system was further reinforced , and a socialist market economic structure took its initial shape .
the province opened itself wider to other parts of the country and the world .
comprehensive progress was made in science and technology , education , culture , public health , sports , and other social undertakings ; while new achievements were attained in the building of a socialist spiritual civilization and in the building of democracy and a legal system .
the decision of the central authorities to implement the strategy of developing the country 's western region on a large scale has provided sichuan with a golden historical opportunity of speeding up its development , zhang zhongwei noted .
meanwhile , we conducted special studies on such pillar industries as agriculture , electronics and information , hydropower , machinery and metallurgy , medicine and chemical industry , beverages and foodstuffs , and tourism ; and drew up development programs , implementation plans , and supporting policies for the future development of these industries .
the province took earnest steps to implement the policies and measures that aimed at expanding domestic demand , concentrated its energy on speeding up its growth , attained a comprehensive progress in various undertakings , strengthened unity among different nationalities , and successfully maintained social and political stability .
zhang zhongwei told this reporter : starting the new century , sichuan is to enter the new stage of building itself into a well - off society , accelerating its implementation of the country 's third - step strategy for modernization building , and bringing true the development of a catching - up style by leaps and bounds .
he said : today , all provinces and municipalities in the western region are trying to outdo each other . under such circumstances , if sichuan fails to develop itself or fails to develop itself fast enough , it will surely fall behind .
zhang zhongwei also listed other major objectives for the province 's economic and social development in the coming five years : the average annual increase in the province 's financial income will slightly exceed its gdp growth .
the urbanization level will be enhanced by an average annual rate of 1 percentage point , reaching about 24 percent by 2005 .
the province 's ecological environment will be notably improved , and the forest coverage rate and the afforestation coverage rate in already completed urban residential districts will both reach 28 percent .
education of different types at different levels will undergo further development , social undertakings of all kinds will make a comprehensive progress , and new results will be achieved in the building of a spiritual civilization and the building of democracy and a legal system .
to bring true a new leap forward , we must speed up our strategic economic restructuring , indicated zhang zhongwei .
sichuan will consolidate the fundamental role of agriculture , center its work around the need to increase the income of peasants , readjust the structure of agriculture and the rural economy , challenge the traditional agriculture , and give shape to a modern agriculture .
the province will introduce the strategy of urbanization , upgrade the modernization level of extraordinarily large cities , speed up the development of large cities , vigorously promote the construction of medium and small cities , actively boost the growth of small towns and townships , and accelerate the process of urbanization .
with chengdu and mianyang as major bases , the province will give play to the combined effect of technologies , human talents , funds , and new and high technological enterprises .
to bring true a new leap forward , sichuan must also speed up its infrastructural construction .
the province will devote vigorous efforts to the development of hydropower , and will optimize its energy mix .
meanwhile , the province will also step up the construction of its basic water conservancy facilities , and improve its ability of preventing and fighting natural disasters .
meanwhile , zhang zhongwei also stressed the need to further deepen reform , accelerate structural innovation , and to open the province wider to the outside world in an all - directional way and at multiple levels .
the province will reinforce its ecological building and environmental protection ; pay continued attention to the protection of natural forest resources , and to the pilot projects of returning grain plots to forest and grassland ; persistently carry out family planning ; and bring about a well - coordinated development to population , resources , and environment .
to bring true a new leap forward , sichuan must act in line with the requirement of general secretary jiang zemin 's important thinking of " three represents , " uphold the aim of serving the people wholeheartedly , and earnestly change the functions of the government .
in this way , we can surely bring true a new leap forward in the course of catching up with others .

by 2005 the total volume of china 's imports and exports should reach $ 680 billion , with imports and exports striking a general balance .
the respective shares of electrical and mechanical products and hi - tech products in total exports should rise to about 50 percent and 20 percent ; the scale of direct foreign investment should be kept at an average of about $ 40 billion a year , and efforts should be made to achieve further growth in this respect .
