beijing , 13 mar ( xinhua ) - - this morning , jiang zemin , general secretary of the cpc central committee and state president , attended , one after the other , the plenary meetings of the jiangsu and anhui delegations to the fourth session of the ninth national people 's congress (npc) .
at the plenary meeting of the jiangsu delegation , deputies hui liangyu , wu ruilin , wang hongmin , su dingqiang , feng jianqin , and ju baocai made speeches one after another .
at the meeting of the anhui delegation , deputies wang taihua , meng fulin , zhao shucong , and xu li aired their respective views on developing democracy and strengthening the building of the legal system at the grassroots level , increasing peasants ' income and reducing their burden , and improving work style .
after attentively listening to the speeches of the deputies of the jiangsu delegation , jiang zemin made a speech .
he said that in the ninth five - year plan period , jiangsu seriously implemented central principles and policies , carried out reform at a deeper level , centering on the central task economic construction , forged ahead in a pioneering spirit , and pushed the modernization drive to a higher level .
jiangsu should give play to its strong points , maintain a good momentum of development , strive to stand at the forefront in reform , opening up , and modernization , and take the lead in the realization of modernization .
jiang zemin pointed out that modernization is a concept of comprehensive development .
first , we must persistently ensure coordinated economic and social development .
this is a very important guiding principle .
we must persistently take economic construction as the center , build a high degree of material and spiritual civilizations , speed up the comprehensive progress of various social undertakings , and strive to satisfy the people 's increasing material and cultural needs .
in addition , we should make unremitting efforts to strengthen the building of socialist democracy and the legal system and the building of ideology and ethics .
with the development of industry and the tertiary industry , the comprehensive productive capacity of agriculture is constantly increasing , and more and more people of the agricultural population will break away from traditional agriculture and move to industrial and urban areas .
we must develop small towns and cities , give full play to the role of market mechanisms , strengthen planning and management , and suit measures to local conditions in developing small towns and cities .
third , we must promote coordinated development of different regions .
this is the need to promote the sustained , rapid , and healthy [ chi su jian kang fa zhan ] development of the national economy and is also the requirement for enhancing unity among ethnic groups and maintaining social stability .
the central authorities have put forward and implemented in good time the strategy of developing the western region . we must provide great support to the central and western regions while maintaining the rapid development of the eastern region .
we must adopt practical and effective policies and measures to promote economic and technological cooperation between regions to benefit each other , supplement each other 's strong points , and achieve common development .
since our country is a country with the largest population in the world , we must control the total number of the population and strive to improve its quality .
reducing the peasants ' burdens and increasing their income was a hot topic in the speeches of the deputies of the anhui delegation .
jiang zemin listened carefully to their speeches and jotted down notes from time to time .
in developing any locality , we must give full consideration to these important factors , respect economic laws and natural laws , make the distribution of the productive forces and the production setup more rational , and increase the competitive power of the economy .
the 10 th five - year plan period is an important period for the perfection of the socialist market economic structure , and there is still a long way to go in tackling difficult problems in reform .
we must fully respect the creative spirit of the people .
the implementation of the " general contract " system in xiaogang village was the prelude to rural reform in our country .
third , we must earnestly improve our work style and work in a down - to - earth manner .
we must advocate speaking the truth , do solid work , and emphasize actual results , and must oppose and overcome formalism and bureaucracy .
fourth , we must bring every positive factor into play in realizing our common magnificent goal .
transforming cadres ' work style in a down - to - earth manner and doing our own jobs well - - with an attitude of holding ourselves highly responsible for the party , the people , and history and with a sound mindset - - are the basic guarantees for the implementation of key party and state policies .
to fulfill our magnificent goals , we have to rely on vast numbers of cadres to lead the people throughout the process .
without making a great resolve , without taking tough measures , we will not achieve practical results in transforming cadres ' work style .
agricultural , rural , and peasant issues are major issues with a bearing on the overall situation of reform , opening up , and modernization drive .
we must take concerted action , from the leadership to the rank and file , to impose strict control on activities of making inspections and appraisals and activities of hitting the target and upgrading , and to cut the number of meetings to a minimum .
" china 's opening up has made a giant stride again , " commented ni shaojie , a deputy from hong kong special administrative region .
the world is amazed at discovering that the ancient oriental country has brought to them the enchanting opportunities for investment apart from the fortitudinous terracotta warriors of the qin dynasty and the great wall that runs zigzag over ten thousand li .
in face of the economic globalization trend and the rapid development of new high science and technology , the chinese nation is confronted with new challenges .
in history , we failed to seize several exceptionally good opportunities that had brushed past us and were thrown behind the world 's advanced level .
now , we must seize hold of the opportunity to quicken the pace of development .
introduction from abroad means introducing new technology and advanced management to facilitate industrial upgrading so that a new round of foreign investment upsurge will be set off against the large backdrop of economic restructuring china is entering a well - to - do society in the new century .
the deputies and members maintain that to cope with the challenges of wto entry , we should look squarely at the gap between ourselves and others , accelerate the pace of structural adjustment , achieve industrial upgrading , and augment our strength in international competition .
in the new round of " introduction , " we should climb up to a new height with heavy responsibilities on our shoulders .
the grand opportunity has once again emerged in china , and the immense market with infinite charms has once again presented before the eyes of investors across the world .
it will also establish an administrative management structure featured by honesty , high efficiency , coordinated operations , and standardized behaviors .
the new round of tidal waves for investment in china in a still greater scale and at a still higher level is approaching .
the access of china 's products into the international markets will be much easier than before , which will bring opportunities to china 's enterprises to enter the international markets , and enable china to make new breakthroughs in using the " two resources and two markets " at home and abroad .
in the opinion of cppcc member gao shangquan , under the new situation of economic globalization and the accelerated world economic restructuring , only by " going out " can china meet the requirements of wto entry and develop its open economy in a larger scope and at a higher level .
some chinese enterprises which started off earlier on have made fruitful exploration in implementing the strategy of " going out . "
" compared with the developed countries , china 's overseas investment is limited in quantity and small in scale .
with the implementation of the strategy of " going out , " chinese enterprises have to assume heavy responsibilities and have a long road ahead , " said npc deputy liu benren .
traveling over thousands of miles , the constant wind has swept across a thousand and one barriers .
taking hold of the general situation in the world today , seizing the opportunity of acceding to the wto , and accelerating the tempo of opening to the outside world on all sides , at multiple levels , and in broad spheres , we will certainly add an illustrious chapter to the development and prosperity of the chinese nation .
according to the relevant stipulations of the " cppcc national committee 's rules for the work of handling motions , " after the motion committee examined these motions , 3,372 of them were taken as official motions and 361 pieces were handled as letters from committee members .
the number of committee members submitting motions was 1,787 people , accounting for 79.4 percent of the total number of committee members .
the cppcc motions were treated seriously by all relevant units . in many departments , leaders personally attended to , or made arrangements for , the handling of the cppcc motions . these departments enhanced their work efforts to promote the effective handling of the motions .
opinions and proposals in 2,711 motions were resolved or included in the work plan for settlement , and the number of such motions accounted for 82.1 percent of the total .
due to the restrictions of conditions , the issues raised by some motions could not be resolved for the time being , and the recipient units also gave realistic explanation .
according to the feedback from cppcc committee members , most people who submitted the motions were satisfied or basically satisfied with the handling of their motions .
through the conscientious handling of the recipient units , the motions have played a positive role in promoting reform , opening up , and socialist modernization .
motions concerning economic construction numbered 1,502 , accounting for 44.5 percent of the total .
this has been taken by the beijing municipal government in the formulation of its plan for reforming the management of water resources .
in nearly 500 motions , committee members provided advice and proposals around the implementation of the strategy of relying on science and education for national regeneration .
this aroused close attention from the central leading comrades , and they wrote down important instructions on the summed - up materials on the education - related proposals of the cppcc committee members at the third session of the ninth national committee .
the motion " on quickening the pace of technological innovations and advancing the environmental protection industry in our country " and the motion " on developing the intensive processing technology of non - metal ore and setting up sampling science and technology development zones " provided important reference for the relevant departments in making policies .
motions related to the building of the legal system , social security , and united front work numbered 882 , accounting for 26.2 percent of the total .
according to the motions on quickening the building of the social security system , the ministry of labor and social security decided to include the proposals in the " plan for the pilot projects of improving the social security system . "
to enable committee members to better know the process of motion handling , on the basis of the quantity and quality of the motion handling , the work of five units involved in the handling of the motions was summed up as an appendix to this report for committee members to scrutinize .
(iii) practice over many years has proved that to give full play to the role of the cppcc motions , the key lies in enhancing the quality of the motion handling work . this includes the quality of the motions , the quality of the handling of the motions , and the quality of services .
the three sides are inseparably linked to each other , and promote each other .
separately at the meetings of motion handling meetings and the discussion meetings with the motion recipient units , vice chairmen chen junsheng and sun fuling stressed the importance of the motion handling work and set forth requirements for properly handling the motions .
on the basis of summing up the previous work experience , the " motion work rules " were revised last years . basic requirements were set from the selection of subjects to the contents of a motion , and explicit stipulations were made for the examination and handling of the motions .

the full text of the article is reprinted as follows : in recent years , it is obvious that japan has accelerated its steps in terms of the constitutional amendment . recently , another new upsurge of amending and commenting on the constitution has been unfolded .
it is known to all that the current constitution in japan has played an important role in the aspect of guaranteeing that the country stays on the path of peaceful development after the war . the development of the constitutional amendment will no doubt catch the attention of the people .
it should be acknowledged that nothing in the world stays unchanged , which is also true for the constitution of a country .
in addition , there are plenty of precedents in the world in terms of constitutional amendments . switzerland in north europe has amended its constitution 140 times since the end of the world war ii .
however , some political forces in japan have increasingly felt that these ideas and stipulations pose as barriers for japan to march toward being a " common country . " therefore , they have vigorously tried to break away from the confinement of the constitution .
afterwards , on the occasion which marked the 50 th anniversary of the implementation of the constitution in 1997 , there was an upsurge of the call on the diet to set up discussions on the constitution .
during the election for president of the ldp in september 1999 , all three candidates , including keizo obuchi , koichi kato , and taku yamasaki , made the proposal of revising the constitution .
at that time , kato , who is secretary general of the ldp and has always been associated with the dovish people , said in his works : " the thinking that constitutional amendment belongs to the forbidden zone is not realistic . "
research commission on constitution conducts activities frequently during the regular sessions of japan 's diet in january 2000 , both the house of councillors and house of representatives established a research commission on the constitution to formally kick off discussions on the constitution at the diet .
the research commissions were made up of 50 members from the house of representatives and 45 from the house of councillors respectively . the principles of meetings conducted by the commissions are made public , and the commission maintains normal working hours when the diet is not in session .
since the establishment of the research commission on the constitution in january 2000 to the time prior to the election for the house of representatives in june 2000 , the house of representatives and house of councillors held 10 and eight meetings , respectively .
in the aspect of creating public opinion on constitutional amendment , it should be said that prime minister mori has voiced his support without exception .
since then , the research commission of the house of representatives has invited the so - called men of insight to act as reference people when conducting discussions on the procedure of formulation of the constitution .
the discussions have centered mostly on the theme of " gesture of japan in the 21 st century , " whereas the research commission of the house of councillors has conducted a new discussion every six months since 15 november 2000 , and held question and answer sessions by inviting the reference people .
the most striking among the reference people is ishihara . he said undisguisedly : " the constitution bears the label of peace , and has existed as an ideological symbol only . we should first deny the constitution at the diet . "
in addition , the new conservative party , established in april 2000 , has stated clearly in its party outline : " make great efforts to formulate new constitution at an earlier date in the 21 st century . "
based on the intention of its party representative yukio hatoyama , the research commission on the constitution of the democratic party decided in october 2000 to propose a basic thinking of the party within the next two years .
hatoyama said afterwards that the contents of japan being allowed to practice the rights of collective self - defense should be written into the constitution .
on the issue of constitutional amendment , generally speaking , the liberal party and new conservative party are positive , and both the positivism and negativism exist within the ldp and the democratic party , whereas the communist party and social democratic party oppose the idea .
diet members of the new conservative party - - " it is necessary to revise the constitution as soon as possible . "
diet members of the democratic party maintained that it is the way to safeguarding the constitution by revising in accordance with the changes of the times ; however , it is not absolutely necessary to make amendments , what is required of us is to engage in discussions actively .
what deserves careful pondering is that the proposal of constitutional amendment made by some political forces in japan has obtained support from the right - wing groups in society .
to put it precisely , the words and deeds of some people of the political circles have reflected exactly the political intention of the right - wing forces .
in summary , since those in power endorse revision of the constitution . different figures who advocate revision of the constitution have successively stated their views .
although it is still a topic in dispute as to how the constitution , which has been used for more than half a century , will be revised exactly , the development of the issue has become a focus of attention by the people of the world .

therefore , guangxi should effectively raise the level of urbanization and industrialization through implementing the strategy for the great development of the western areas so that industrialization and urbanization can become a driving force for economic growth and substantially increase the employment of rural population .

sha zukang said at a press briefing on the abm issue that china does not want to engage in confrontation with the united states over the abm issue and also has no intention of engaging in an arms race with the united states .
as everyone knows , china has the smallest and most backward nuclear weapons of the five nuclear powers , but china was the first of them to undertake not to be the first to use nuclear weapons .
of course , china will not permit its legitimate means of defense to be weakened or deprived in any way .
he said , from the international aspect , us implementation of the nmd program will have a whole series of far - reaching and negative effects on the international security environment .
if the united states develops and ultimately deploys the nmd system , this will fundamentally wreck the existing strategic balance relationship between the powers and threaten the security interests of other countries .
the inevitable consequence will be to spark mutual suspicion and distrust between the powers and hamper their coordination and cooperation in international security affairs .
second , us development of the nmd system will seriously hamper the international arms control and disarmament process , and may even trigger a new round of the arms race .
this us move obviously carries within itself the danger of triggering an arms race at a still higher level .
third , the us nmd program will seriously damage the international antiproliferation mechanism and efforts .
the united states claims that it is developing nmd in order to counter an ever - growing missile proliferation threat .
fourth , us implementation of the nmd program will cause an increase in the military factor in international relations and will not help to preserve international peace and security .
more and more far - sighted people on the international scene have understood that the true motive in the us development of the nmd system is to pursue absolute security for itself .
fifth , the nmd system is not helpful for peace and security in the asia - pacific region .
us promotion of the nmd program will not only wreck global strategic balance and stability but will also deal a blow at security efforts in the asia - pacific region .
not only that , the united states has also decided to deploy theater missile defense [ tmd ] in the asia - pacific region .
researching and developing tmd may not in itself contravene the " abm treaty , " but the key question is , how great is the scale and what is the nature and role of the so - called tmd system that the united states is preparing to deploy in the asia - pacific region ?
if this tmd system can be used as a component part of the nmd system and constitutes a forward deployment of nmd in the asia - pacific region , the blows it will cause to regional security and stability will be no less than those of the nmd system .
sha zukang said , the united states has declared that it is willing to engage in frank dialogue with countries such as russia and china on the nmd question .
we hope that we can promote mutual understanding and narrow the differences through serious and frank dialogue , so as to benefit the overall situation of preserving world peace and stability .
china practices a foreign policy of acting independently and keeping the initiative in its own hands , and will not form an alliance with any country .
on the question of the modernization of china 's nuclear weapons , sha zukang said , it is first necessary to see what is meant by so - called modernization of nuclear weapons .
in this sense , china and other nuclear powers cannot carry out modernization of their nuclear weapons , while non - nuclear countries cannot seek to develop nuclear weapons . withdrawing and updating old nuclear weapons is completely different from modernizing nuclear weapons ; i understand that this is something that all nuclear powers are engaged in .
he emphatically pointed out that china 's development of nuclear weapons is entirely for self - defense , and china will continue to practice the policy of not being the first to use nuclear weapons .
china will not take part in a nuclear arms race , but neither will it sit and watch threats to the effectiveness of its limited nuclear forces .

beijing , 14 mar ( xinhua ) - - spring is a season of hope , a season for the growing of all things on earth , and a season which is overflowing with vigor and vitality .
after a journey of 47 years and with its successes and explorations , undertaking the great trust and hope of the people and walking with firmer and more self - confident steps , the npc system has ushered in the new century and begun writing a new chapter about the people exercising state powers .
from then on , a completely new fundamental national political system was formally established in this ancient country of china and constantly perfected .
on the very first day of its birth , the communist party of china which represents the interests of the broadest masses of the people conformed with the calls of the people for democracy and began the exploration for an organizational pattern of the people 's political regime in the future .
people being the master of their own affairs is the essence of this npc system .
through holding democratic elections , people can elect their own deputies to form the people 's congresses at all levels .
being from the people , the npc deputies expressed the voices of the people , represent the opinions of the people , accept the supervision of the people , formulate laws and elect and supervise organs of political power on behalf of the people , and decide important matters concerning the country 's plans and people 's livelihood .
this system has already deeply taken root on the great land of china and supported by the people .
during the process of governing the country according to law and building a socialist country governed by law , we should constantly perfect this npc system and better display the superiority of this system .
an important path for realizing governing the country according to law the brilliant achievements of the npc system are cast into the great historical monument of building democracy and legal system for the republic .
in december of 1982 , the fifth session of the fifth national people 's congress passed a new constitution .
on the basis of summing up the historical experiences and proceeding from the national conditions in our country , this new constitution worked out a series of important provisions for perfecting the npc system .
for a fairly long period of time , the timing of npc sessions was very irregular . sometimes , it was called in spring , sometimes it was called in summer , and on a few occasions it was even delayed until the end of a year .
starting from 1985 , the annual npc session has always been held in the first season of a year and the meetings of npc standing committee have been held once every two months .
as a law indicating the complete realization of legalization in the legislative work of our country , the law of legislation passed at the third session of the ninth npc conference has more strictly standardized the legislative procedure .
it is in the towering great hall of the people that the popular feelings of the party and the people have condensed into the will of the country and one law after another have paved up a road of institutionalization and legality for the party and the country making important policy decision of reform , development , and stability .
supervision is for pressing state organs and its working personnel to administrate state affairs according to law , exercise laws in a fair manner , and work for the interests of the people .
it is fundamentally different from the parliamentary system of western countries in exercising check and balance over governments and judiciary organs .
the npc system faces an arduous task and long road in the new century building a democratic , wealthy , powerful , and civilized socialist china and realizing the great rejuvenation of the chinese nation is our magnificent goal in the 21 st century .
and upholding and perfecting the npc system is the only road for developing the socialist democracy .
the people are always the masters of the npc .

beijing , 15 march ( xinhua ) - - the fourth session of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] convened its fifth meeting at the great hall of the people this morning to hold by - elections for members of the ninth npc standing committee .

today 's meeting first voted on the chief scrutineer and the scrutineers .
the chief scrutineer and scrutineers supervised the issuing , casting and counting of ballots under the leadership of the presidium .

the ballots were printed both in chinese and in seven ethnic languages , including mongolian , tibetan , uygur , kazakh , korean , yi and zhuang .
ballot booths were set up in the meeting hall .

beijing , 15 mar ( xinhua ) - - the fourth session of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] approved on 15 march the revised " outline of the 10 th five - year plan for social and economic development . "
the state council made revisions and improvements to the outline according to those suggestions .
premier zhu rongji submitted to the session presidium a written report on the revision of the draft outline .
in the same chapter , " increasing the financial transfer payment to impoverished areas " was revised to become " increasing the scale of financial transfer payments to impoverished areas . " 5 .
in the same chapter , " enhancing the building of the teachers ' ranks and raising the quality of teachers " was amended to " enhancing the building of the teachers ' ranks and raising the ideological and professional levels of teachers . " 13 .
in chapter 12 of " implementing the strategy of training talents and of expanding the rank of talents , " " particularly pioneers with international - level academic background " was changed to " particularly pioneers in various disciplines with world 's advanced knowledge . " 15 .
in the same chapter , " establishing a rational water price mechanism " was revised to " establishing a rational water resource management structure and a water price mechanism . " 17 .
in the same chapter , " amending irrational pollutant discharge standards and enhance the enforcement and supervision of environment protection laws " was revised to " amending irrational pollutant discharge standards , improving environment supervision and checking system , and enhancing the enforcement and supervision of environmental protection laws . " 21 .
in chapter 16 , " actively easing up and gradually standardizing ways for enterprises , loss - making listed companies in particular , to pull out from the market " was added to the phrase " promoting reform , perfecting socialist market economic structure and deepening reform of the state - owned enterprises . " 22 .
in the same chapter , " in principle domestic capital will be permitted to enter areas that are open to foreign capital " was revised to " domestic capital be will permitted to enter areas that are open to foreign capital . " 23 .
in the same chapter on promoting reform of administrative management system and of government organs , " giving play to the roles of intermediary organizations like chamber of commerce and trade associations " was added . 25 .
in chapter 18 of " actively expanding employment and improving social protection system , " " developing labor - intensive industrial sectors with market outlook " was revised to " developing advantageous labor - intensive industries . " 27 .
it is necessary to fully reflect sci - tech work 's and operation management 's labor value in income distribution was revised to " establishing a sound encouragement system on income distribution . it is necessary to raise wages of senior management personnel and technicians at state - owned enterprises and to fully reflect their labor value .
an annual salary system can be carried out on a trial basis .
at the same time , there is a need to establish a strict , oversight , and restraining system . " 29 .
" enhancing protection and construction of martyrs ' cemetery and educational bases on patriotism " was added into the same chapter on expounding the need to enhance ideological and ethical building . 31 .
in addition , there were also some revisions to wording and to punctuation .
15 march , beijing , (zxs) - - wu jichuan , chinese minister of information industry , today revealed that regulations governing foreign capital 's participation in the operation of china 's telecommunications industry definitely will be announced before the " law governing the telecommunications industry , " and they must be announced before china enters the wto .
he said opinions on the regulations were solicited from various departments and the regulations have been submitted to the legislative affairs office of the state council and are currently undergoing legal proceeding .
discussion of the united states ' at & t 's participation in the shanghai xintian company , china 's first telecommunications company with chinese and foreign capital , began as early as four or five years ago ; there is no need to arrange new experimental joint investment projects in the near future .
preparatory work for establishing the " law governing the telecommunications industry " has been going on all the time . the current government intends to quicken the pace and the npc also is considering enacting the law as early as possible .
the influence of the drops in nasdaq index on china 's internet - related industry is an objective fact ; however , china 's internet - related industry will continue to develop actively . it is very important to eliminate speculative factors to ensure healthy development of the industry .
minister wu said : " to get listed to raise funds , the basic thing that china 's internet - related industry companies should do is to improve their operating quality and economic efficiency .

hu angang gave the keynote address on " china 's comprehensive strategy for fighting corruption . " by invitation , thomas chan chi - sun delivered a special report titled " the hong kong independent commission against corruption 's method of preventing corruption . "
corruption was the number one problem affecting the development of china 's society in 1999 and 2000 . according to professor hu angang , this was a finding of a survey conducted by the central party school of 140 cadres at the prefectural and departmental levels .
hu angang pointed out , " the proportion of corrupt officials that were sentenced is too low . out of every 100 cadres that received party or government disciplinary action , only 6.6 were sentenced . of every 100 cadres against whom cases were filed and investigations launched by procuratorial organs , less than 16 people were sentenced . "

arms sales to taiwan is of long standing over the past 50 - odd years , the united states has never stopped supplying weapons to taiwan ; and the little change in mid - stage was the change from " presenting weapons to taiwan as gifts " to " selling them to taiwan " afterwards .
to resolve the issue of selling weapons to taiwan , the chinese and us governments held several talks .
through intense talks , china and the united states finally concluded an agreement on 17 august 1982 and issued the " 17 august communique . "
however , in consideration of the restrictions outlined in the " communique , " the united states had to act one way in the open and another way in secret .
since then , such kind of arms sales has continued every year and has never been interrupted .
whenever there was the need for the united states to express its political stance to support the " one china " principle , it would sell some weapons to taiwan so that the taiwan authorities would have some " advantages " for " resisting reunification with force . "
over the past 20 - plus years since the establishment of sino - us diplomatic ties , there has been ups and downs in the relations between the two countries . trials and hardships have never stopped . the fundamental reason for this lies on the taiwan issue .
china wants reunification . however , in spite of the fact that the united states has supported the " one china " policy in public , it has covertly helped taiwan resist reunification and contend with mainland china .
soon after the promulgation of the " 17 august communique , " the united states declared that it would agree with taiwan to cooperatively produce 30 f-5e and f-5 fighters . following that , it sold military equipment worth more than $ 500 million to taiwan .
whenever the taiwan authorities made new schemes to split the motherland , the united states would noticeably increase its portion of arms sales to taiwan .
after that , it openly proposed " splitting both sides of the strait and allowing them to have separate rule . "
taiwan saw a historical change in its political pattern in the year 2000 . during that year , the united states sold weapons to taiwan three times and these arms sales totaled $ 1.982 billion .
whenever taiwan 's endeavors to buy advanced weaponry were obstructed , the united states would try by all possible means to help taiwan mend its " regrettable imperfections " through technical cooperation or renting weapons to taiwan .
it was learned that the functions and weaponry of this kind of fighter were not inferior to the us f-16 fighters .
after the renting period expired , the taiwan authorities seized the opportunity and bought these warships at a low price .
in this way , the united states could more covertly guarantee an unimpeded channel for arms sales to taiwan , taiwan could get familiar with the functions of the us military 's weaponry through the introduction , digestion and assimilation of software , and could develop and improve its own weaponry .
over the years , the united states has proceeded from the strategic need of controlling the whole world and considered the sudden rise of east asia and europe as the biggest threat preventing the realization of its global strategy .
based on statistics , in 21 years , since the promulgation of the " taiwan relations act " in 1979 to the end of 2000 , the united states has 47 arms sales dealings with taiwan .
by taking full advantage of the opportunities of selling and delivering a great quantity of weapons to taiwan , the united states strengthened the training of taiwan professionals and carried out us - taiwan cooperative training .
in accordance with these provisions , since the mid-1990s taiwan military personnel who went to the united states to take over warships or aircraft had received training of various degrees . during the training period or on the way of sending warships and aircraft to taiwan , they even conducted a certain cooperative training with the us military .
the united states sold aim-120 medium - range guided missiles to taiwan in 2000 but did not intend to deliver them to taiwan immediately . however , it allowed pilots of the taiwan military to go to the us air base or training ground to test fire such guided missiles or receive relevant operational training .

all activities of sino - foreign joint ventures should be in compliance with stipulations in relevant prc laws and regulations .
under special circumstances and based on needs of social and public interests , the state may requisition sino - foreign joint ventures following legal procedures and provide them with appropriate compensations .
sino - foreign joint venture agreements , contracts , and regulations signed by all partners of a joint venture should be submitted to a state department in charge of foreign trade and economic cooperation ( hereinafter referred to as examination and approving organ ) for examination and approval .
after establishment of a sino - foreign joint venture is approved , it should be registered with a state department in charge of administration of industry and commerce , should apply for a business license , and begin business operations .
article 4 . sino - foreign joint ventures are to be companies with limited liability .
approvals of all partners of a joint venture must be obtained for the transfer of the registered capital of any partner .
technology and equipment used as investment by foreign partners of a joint venture must truly be advanced technology and equipment meeting china 's requirements .
if a foreign partner intends to cheat with outdated technology and equipment that result in losses , it should be held responsible for paying for the losses .
investment of chinese partners of a joint venture may include the right to use the premises provided for the operations of the joint venture .
if the right to use the premises is not provided by the chinese partners as a part of their investment , the joint venture should pay the chinese government a fee for the use of the premises .
article 6 . sino - foreign joint ventures should form a board of directors . the number of directors of the board is to be discussed and decided by all partners of a joint venture and stipulated in its contracts and regulations .
chairman and vice chairman of the board are to be appointed by all partners of a joint venture or elected by the board of directors .
if chairman of the board is of the chinese side , the vice chairman is to be of the foreign side , and vice versa .
hiring and dismissal of staff members and workers of a joint venture , remunerations and welfare for them , and labor protection and labor insurance for them , should be specified in the joint venture 's contracts as required by the law .
staff members and workers of a sino - foreign joint venture organize a trade union according to law to conduct trade union activities to safeguard legitimate rights and interests of the staff members and workers .
if a foreign partner uses its net profits to reinvest in china , it may apply for a refund for a part of its paid income taxes .
with their business licenses , sino - foreign joint ventures should open foreign exchange accounts at a bank or other financial institution licensed by a state foreign exchange control organ to conduct foreign exchange business .
all insurance of sino - foreign joint ventures should be bought from insurance companies in china .
raw materials , fuels , and other materials needed by sino - foreign joint ventures within the scope of their business may be purchased from domestic or international markets based on the principle of being fair and reasonable .
sino - foreign joint ventures are encouraged to market their products in overseas markets .
they also may be sold through chinese foreign trade organs .
products of sino - foreign joint ventures also may be sold in chinese markets .
foreign partners of sino - foreign joint ventures are encouraged to deposit their foreign exchange allowed to be remitted to overseas into chinese banks .
article 12 . after paying personal income taxes according to prc taxation law , wage incomes and other legitimate incomes of foreign staff members and workers of sino - foreign joint ventures may be remitted to overseas according to prc foreign exchange control regulations .
article 13 . business operational periods of sino - foreign joint ventures are to be agreed upon depending on the trade of the joint ventures and the situation .
partners of joint ventures of some trades may agree upon the operational periods of their joint ventures while partners of joint ventures of some other trades may not need to agree upon the operational periods of their joint ventures .
chinese and foreign partners of sino - foreign joint ventures that have agreed upon business operational periods who agree to extend the operational periods should submit applications for extension to the organ which examined and approved the establishment of the joint ventures six months before the operational periods expire .
the examination and approving organ should decide whether or not the applications are to be approved within one month after the applications are received .
if arbitration clauses are not included in relevant contracts or a written arbitration agreement is not reached on settling disputes , partners of a sino - foreign joint venture may refer the case to a people 's court .

the first expression : " the theory of historical superiority . "
federal protection for american blacks ' voting rights only became a fact some 30 years ago .
even today it cannot be said that american blacks and other ethnic minorities and women have achieved " the equality of all men " in civil rights and the right to participate in politics .

"
what then of the american theory of historical superiority ?
the second expression : " great power superiority . "
after the cold war , some americans believed that the united states is the no . 1 economic , political , and military power in the world , so naturally it is the power with the best democracy and human rights .
thus they were qualified to disdain and even criticize human rights in other countries .
this actually will not pass in logic and does not exist in fact .
although the united states can flaunt its wealth , its human rights record is not brilliant .
since the end of the cold war , the united states has indeed enjoyed nearly 10 years of sustained economic growth , but in respect of citizens ' rights of existence , the gap between rich and poor in american society is growing and the population living in poverty is increasing .
the us department of agriculture says that even when us economic conditions are at their best , at least 10 percent of households in 18 states and dc are often hungry or are not getting enough nourishment .
in social order , over 30,000 people die violent deaths every year .
the united states has more people in prison than any other country ; the us judicial policy studies institute 's report of february 2000 revealed that over 2 million people were in prison , representing one - quarter of the prisoners in the whole world .
how can a great power with such wealth , which is still unable to properly resolve its own domestic basic people 's livelihood problems , be qualified to criticize others ?
the third expression : " moral superiority . "
as everyone knows , it is precisely america 's own actions that have wrecked its image of a moral paragon .
one - third of these will be given a placebo , their treatment will be abandoned , and they will be left to die .
it is evident from this that the american feeling of superiority in human rights is baseless , and its qualifications as a " judge " of human rights have even less leg to stand on .
us secretary of state powell said something right in his forward to the " country - by country report on human rights " : including the united states , " no country dare claim that its human rights situation is absolutely perfect . "
there are differences between the countries in speed of development , but there is no division into superior and inferior .

centering around the effort to form combat effectiveness as soon as possible by using new communications equipment , an upsurge of learning how to use new equipment as well as exploring new training methods and combat methods has swept across the division .
the division has intensified the training of high - quality personnel who master new communications equipment .
later , they took another test . those who sat for the test were the same best - qualified personnel . the result was exciting because they all got an a - level score .
leaders of the division felt at east and began to smile .
among the weapons that the us has already sold or is preparing to sell to taiwan , the " aegis " destroyer represents the most serious threat !
this is because it violates the ' abm treaty ' and , at the same time , it can only lead to an international arms race .
we have expressed our attitude to the us clearly on numerous occasions .
for that reason , we had an exclusive interview with sha zukang , director of the department of arms control and disarmament in the ministry of foreign affairs , regarding an issue that is of universal concern to readers in general .
- - the editor .
nmd runs counter to peace question : director sha , since the new administration has taken office in the us , their behavior regarding research on nmd and the overseas deployment of tmd has aroused general concern in international society . what is your assessment ?
director sha zukang : as everyone knows , the us nmd program has already attracted the general concern of international society .
our opposition to nmd is really not because we want to use the nuclear weapons we have to threaten the security of the us .
the small number of nuclear weapons that china possesses are entirely for use in self - defense .
second , us research on nmd will seriously impede the international arms control and disarmament process , and may even trigger a new round of the arms race .
fourth , the us implementation of the nmd program would result in an escalation of the military factors in international relations and would be detrimental to maintaining international peace and security .
i recall one time that there was a foreign journalist who asked , if the us goes ahead on its own with regard to the nmd issue , will china be afraid or not ?
i told him what our chairman mao had said years ago , that is , the chinese people are not even afraid of death , but china will not engage in an arms race .
china did not take part in the arms race during the cold war , we are not participating in it now , and we will not do so in the future .
first , we hope that the us will abandon the nmd program , just as they abandoned the " star wars " program years ago .
chinese and russian experts have both come up with assessments , and they believe that the so - called " missile threat " is seriously overestimating the concerned countries .
based on our assessment , the missile capabilities of those countries that the us has put on the " list " basically do not constitute any threat to a country like the us .
in 1998 , president jiang zemin issued a joint statement with visiting president clinton . in this statement we promised that " we will actively study the question of participation in the ' missile technology control regime ( mtcr ) . ' "
nmd is not the way to resolve the problem .
the ctbt is an extremely important treaty in the area of nuclear disarmament .
so - called nuclear disarmament is both a qualitative and quantitative reference .
in a situation in which they are not conducting nuclear detonation tests , no country - - not even a country as technologically advanced as the us - - can develop a new generation of nuclear weapons .
the reason the ctbt is important is because it represents a qualitative freeze on the development of nuclear weapons .
in signing the ctbt , china expressed an enormous amount of good faith .
however , out of respect for the wishes of international society in general , china decided to halt its nuclear tests .
at present , the chinese government has now submitted the treaty to the national people 's congress for deliberation .
we also hope that the us will ratify this treaty at the earliest possible date .
former president clinton listed four criteria that had to be considered in making the decision to deploy nmd , including the assessment of the missile threat , the cost , the technical feasibility , and the impact it would have on the arms control , disarmament , and non - proliferation process .
question : there is some public opinion in the west that holds that , regardless of whether or not the us pursues nmd , china will still modernize its own nuclear weapons . what is your view on that ?
china has never participated in the arms race , nor do we have any intention of doing so .
china 's nuclear weapons are entirely for self defense .
as for the program to modernize china 's nuclear forces , it should be noted that the ctbt agreement stipulates that the nuclear states may not modernize their nuclear weapons .
the test detonation of nuclear weapons is a necessary step in developing and improving nuclear weapons .
the ctbt treaty bans all nuclear weapons tests and other nuclear explosions , and this limits the development and qualitative improvement of nuclear weapons .
weeding out and upgrading the original nuclear weapons is not the same thing as modernizing them , and as far as i know , this is something that all the nuclear states are engaged in .
china 's nuclear weapons were developed in the 60 s , which now is nearly 40 years ago .
weeding out and upgrading some of these nuclear weapons will make them safer and more reliable and avoid an accidental launch or accidents involving them .
if this is the modernization that some of the western media are talking about , then yes , china is in the process of this modernization , but the other nuclear states are also doing the same thing , so why just single out china for censure ?
you have already accomplished your modernization , but we are still working on ours , and using that as a pretext for exaggerations and stirring things up , or even going so far as to attack the modernization of china 's nuclear weapons , is not fair .
china opposes us sale of " aegis " ships to taiwan question : according to some public opinion , the us intends to sell " aegis " destroyers to the taiwan authorities . what is your comment on that ?
taiwan is an inseparable part of china 's territory .
we hope that the us will carry out to the letter the promises it made in the " 17 august " communique , and reduce or halt arms sales to taiwan .
i would like to emphasize that the taiwan problem is an issue for the chinese people themselves , and we will not allow others to order us around or tell us what to do .
among the weapons that the us has already decided to sell to taiwan , the " aegis " destroyers represent the most serious threat .
naturally , any arms sales to taiwan are bad , but the " aegis " is the worst !
experts in china tell me that the " aegis " destroyers are outfitted with extremely advanced radar and communications systems , and if they are linked to the us systems , the us and taiwan will form a de facto or quasi military alliance .
if the us sells the " aegis " system to taiwan , it will be an extremely grave political incident , and will result in incalculable damage to sino - us relations .
as everyone knows , sino - us relations were established on the three principles of the us renouncing its treaties with taiwan , withdrawing its troops and ending diplomatic relations .
question : why does china oppose the us going ahead with its tmd plan in asia ?
however , up to now , from a technical perspective it has been very difficult to distinguish between tmd and nmd , as there is a gray area there .
question : some public opinion holds that the us may transfer a tmd system to taiwan . how does the chinese government plan to discuss this issue with the us ?
sha : we are firmly opposed to the transfer of tmd to taiwan by the us , and we hope that that situation does not occur .
regardless of what form it takes , whether it is done openly , or disguised , or breaking it up and proceeding piece by piece , a transfer of tmd to taiwan by the us represents serious intervention in china 's internal affairs and is an action that will impede the peaceful unification of china .
china would inevitably respond strongly .
china and the united states have common interests in almost every area .
china has taken heed of this point , and welcomes it .
ultimately , regardless of how serious the differences are between china and the us , we all need to engage in cooperation and dialogues .
china and the us - - one is the largest developing country , while the other is the world 's only superpower .
cooperation is good for both parties , and it is also good for the world and other countries .
the new us administration has recently indicated a number of times that the us plan to develop nmd is not targeted at china , and we have taken note of and appreciate this policy - related declaration .
policy - related declarations show a country 's political motivations , and political motivations are the key , because people 's actions are guided by political motivations .
it is this that we are focused on .
personally , i think that , whatever words are used to describe the relationship between china and the us , it is still the same thing , and what is important is that neither china nor the us can exist independently apart from each other .
sino - us cooperation is mutually beneficial .
i see no reason why china and the us must become adversaries , whether it is " potential " or " non - potential " !
however , one should not take that to mean that china is afraid of the us , as that is not the case .
we have already gone through the nightmarish , painful cold war period together .
sino - us relations have followed a tortuous course with ups and downs , and having gotten through this , the relationship is becoming more mature , with both sides having a deeper understanding of the other , so both sides should be able to achieve a common resolution of more complex and important issues .
the debate over the militarization or arming of outer space has gone on for a number of years in the area of arms control .
i believe that this debate will continue .
at present , there are many satellites orbiting in outer space , and they have varied and different roles .
what i advocate personally is that the utilization of outer space should be divided into two lines , with militarization being open for discussion , but arming being banned .
another line can be drawn with regard to militarization , which is that the military uses of outer space should be divided into two types , defensive and offensive .
the offensive type should be banned .
this suggestion has gotten widespread support from international society , with only the us opposing it .
joint effort by china and russia to maintain the abm treaty question : last year , when russian president putin visited china , both countries issued a joint statement regarding the abm issue .
recently , russia also proposed working with europe to build a " european tmd . " would you please say a few words about the prospects for cooperation by china and russia to work together to maintain the " abm treaty " and oppose nmd ?
sha : regarding the nature of the relationship between china and russia , foreign minister tang jiaxuan elaborated on this very clearly at the press conference he held the other day .
he stated that china and russia both have ardent hopes of becoming " good neighbors , good partners , and good friends . "
as an " abm treaty " signatory state , russia has its legitimate concerns .
these concerns have brought us together .
china is also willing to have an exchange of views and dialogues with any concerned countries .
it was proposed last year by president putin during his visit to britain , and at present russia is filling out the specifics .
the proposal was directed at europe .
china appreciates russia 's approach of notifying us , but as for our assessment , more study is needed .
negligence of either of the two principles , like the two wings of a bird or two wheels of a cart , will lead to our failure in ensuring a profound , continuous and healthy development of our ongoing military training through science and technology .
chairman jiang made extremely important expositions on these two principles regarding military training through science and technology .
on the one hand , chairman jiang called on the majority of commanders and soldiers to " vigorously promote the spirit of being scientific in an effort to drive forward military training through science and technology along a standard and scientific track . "
he required " that leading institutions and leading cadres at all levels further correct their guiding principle on their work , change working styles , improve their working methodology , resolutely prevent and overcome formalism and bureaucracy , and strive to improve their work in military training through science and technology and their preparation for the military struggle . "
only when we study , understand , carry out and implement these important speeches made by chairman jiang as a whole can we correctly understand the development direction of military training through science and technology .
however , there are still some issues deserving our attention .
some other military forces do not dare to take bounding steps in reform and innovation , forge ahead , resolve high and difficult problems in military training through science and technology , depart from precedents , or explore new battle tactics and training methods .
on the other hand , they should also understand that since high - tech wars are fierce competitions in science and technology , a military that is brave in innovating and walks at the leading edge of military science and technology will gain the upper hand .
science and technology are the dominant factor of military training through science and technology .
the nature of this training requires that leaders at all levels with responsibilities for guidance must acquire better attainment and quality in science and technology .

they should not stay elevated above grassroots units , take everything for granted , and give arbitrary commands , but rather go deep into the reality for investigation and study . they should do solid work , devote solid efforts , tell the truth and pursue solid effectiveness .

agricultural enterprises and the establishment of enterprises for agricultural production according to hu angang , setting up enterprises to carry out agricultural production is an important issue that has a bearing on the realization of agricultural modernization under the actual national conditions in china .
agricultural enterprises are different from township and town enterprises , as the latter are mainly engaged in non - agricultural production in the rural areas , and only a few of them belong to agricultural enterprises .
second , it has brought about the changes from the family farm owners as the main bodies of most production and operation to enterprise managers and operators and also from family farms to commercialized enterprises , and achieved the objective of converting the main bodies of production and operation into enterprises set up for agricultural production .
third , it has achieved the specialization of agricultural production .
agricultural industrialization is achieved in the same process as the establishment of enterprises for agricultural operation what is the relationship between agricultural industrialization and the establishment of enterprises for agricultural production ?
hu angang explained that according to economic classification , establishment of enterprises for agricultural production belongs to microeconomics , agricultural industrialization belongs to meso - economics , and rural economic development belongs to macroeconomics .
rural macroeconomic development cannot be separated from agricultural microeconomic development , and agricultural industrialization is the one in between .
agricultural industrialization is the manifestation of setting up enterprises for agricultural production , and the process of the former is the same as that of the latter .
second , rural financial institutions should be further reformed to change the current situation which is far from meeting the requirements for the development of agricultural enterprises .
third , the mechanisms of agricultural investment and financing should be remolded and intensified to optimize investment and financing environments and ensure the lasting and highly efficient operation of agricultural investment and financing .
fourth , impetus should be given to transferring surplus rural labor forces to nonagricultural sectors .
fifth , measures in multiple forms and at multiple levels should be adopted to select and train agricultural entrepreneurs .

beijing , 22 mar ( xinhua ) - the building a water - conserving society and realizing a sustainable development forum to commemorate the ninth " world water day " and the 14 th " chinese water week " was held at the great hall of the people today [ 22 march ] .
li peng said : water is a lifeline for people 's survival as well as for economic development and social progress . it is an important material foundation for realizing a sustainable development .
the total quantity of water resources in our country is 2.8 trillion cubic meters . the per capita quantity of water is 2,220 cubic meters , about one - fourth of the world average .
at present our country 's total annual water supply was 560 billion cubic meters . with the sustained , rapid , and healthy development of our economy and society , our demand for fine quality fresh water is increasing daily .
according to estimates , when china 's total population reaches 1.6 billion by the year 2030 , the average per capita quantity of water will decrease to about 1,760 cubic meters . the total quantity of water consumption may reach 700 - 800 billion cubic meters .
li peng said : on the one hand , water resources are inadequate in our country ; on the other hand , there is still the situation of wasting water in production and consumption . the economical use of water still has a great potential .
li peng said : in order to do a good job in conserving water , we should actively carry out reform of the water management system , study water price and other economic policies that are conducive to conserving water , and encourage the whole society to practice economy in using water .
we should carry out reform of the system for deciding water price and the water resource fee , formulate a reasonable water price , and appropriately adjust water price and the extent of collecting the water resource fee .
regarding this work , we should take full consideration of the endurance of people and enterprises . we must not increase unreasonable burden on residents and peasants . what is taken from the people should be used in the interests of the people . we should promote economic use of water in the whole society .
li peng emphatically pointed out : the water law is an important law and has played an important role in strengthening the management of water resources and promoting reasonable development of water resources since it was promulgated 12 years ago .
li peng hoped that , through commemorative and propaganda activities for " world water day " and " chinese water week , " we could promote water conservation work in our country .

the first criterion is straightforward and simple , that is , one can judge by the fact whether or not the guru of a certain religion or a certain religious faction is still alive , or to say , still in existence .
why do we consider such a seemingly ridiculous criterion as the most important criterion for judging a religious cult ?
if the principles advocated by the founder are not that sacred , then the sacredness of this religion will be in doubt .
second , if the founder himself is still alive , he will have to answer all the questions posed to him by his followers ; yet in the realistic life , anyone will have the risk of making mistakes if he provides solutions to specific problems .
that is why the " buddha " is not supposed to open his mouth and judge the rights and the wrongs , and this is what is called : god 's design must not be revealed to mortal ears .
of course , fundamentally speaking , every normal religion has the nature of transcending worldliness ; however , it is impossible for man to truly possess such a property . therefore , when man tries to turn himself into the embodiment of the god , the nature of the whole thing cannot but be distorted .
the second criterion is to see whether a religion has told its acceptors that it can provide them with a means or a way to get instant benefits of all sorts .
take some of the world 's major religions for example . their founders also used miracles and pleasant promises of various kinds to attract followers , for instance , jesus can make the blind see and the crippled walk .
the strong motive power that christianity of the west has provided for the moral growth of western society is a fact known to all .
according to the " falungong , " it is very easy for anyone to reach the peak of merits and virtues : by simply striking a match , they can burn themselves to the heaven .
the third criterion is to see whether the concept of this life and the stress on the afterlife are in appropriate " proportion " in the doctrine of a religion , and this serves as a major criterion for differentiating an orthodox religion from a religious cult .
all religions are faced with the issue of handling relations between this life and the afterlife .
every religion has a wonderful paradise of its own ; and generally speaking , it represents the longing of man for a wonderful future , and it reflects man 's ideal to a certain extent . man is a species that needs not only materials but also a spiritual life .
conversely , the afterlife theory built on such a mental foundation also has a positive significance to man 's behaviors in this life .
only when a religion makes the afterlife as an idealistic reference for people in this life and encourages people to work hard and take a positive life attitude in this life can it truly possess the value that its followers are hoping for , and can it truly become a spiritual home for people .
basing on the aforementioned three criteria , we can also see the considerable differences between the historical and the modern looks of the world 's several major orthodox religions . during their initial founding period , heresy persecution , the doomsday theory , as well as the advocacy of various behaviors of autonomy all had their irrationalities .
this proves that there is no an impassable line between a religion and a cult : once you push a certain criterion , especially the relations between the afterlife and this life , to an extreme point beyond a " limit " comprehensible to people , the gate of a religious cult will be opened for you .
today , by opening the gates of our country to the outside world , we aim to make improvement to our life and build up a healthier mentality among our people ; therefore , we must by no means bind ourselves up in new fetters after smashing the old ones .

domestically , china has entered a new developmental stage and its economic restructuring is now in a critical period . in reform , we are now tackling the most difficult issues . accession to the world trade organization [ wto ] is expected to give rise to a string of new problems .
looking back at that process , we think there are many experiences that are worth reviewing .

it is reported that the china securities regulatory commission recently organized forces to inspect in a unified manner whether relevant securities investment funds are operating according to norms . the commission collected irregular business records of various fund management corporations and technically and quantitatively analyzed in a unified manner how these corporations used fund assets for securities exchange .
through inspections , statistics , and analyses , the commission has classified , tabulated , and arranged the irregular business aggregates recorded by various fund management corporations for a specific period of time .
through analyses of relevant security trading records , investigators indicated that the quoted prices that this corporation applied for security trading were noticeably different from market knock - down prices of the same periods of time .
through repeated investigations and queries , this corporation could not reasonably explain its irregular trading behaviors and phenomena .
to safeguard the normal order of securities markets , the china securities regulatory commission has decided to put this corporation 's case on file for investigations according to article 168 of the " securities law " and article 24 of the " interim procedures for banning fraudulent behaviors . "
persons directly responsible for relevant irregularities and persons involved in other comparatively serious problems were punished according to corporations ' discipline . four persons were removed from corporations ' payrolls ; two , fired ; and one , downgraded .
in addition , many people were punished according to discipline , such as deducting bonuses and giving warnings .
the china securities regulatory commission will make ceaseless efforts to collect evidence by investigating whether relevant units and persons had ever violated the securities law .
the spokesman for this commission pointed out that to promote the regular operation of fund management corporations , we should first upgrade their understanding and change their ideas .
fostering a concept of winning the trust of markets and society is the most fundamental requirement for fund workers , especially fund managers and senior managers .

moscow , 23 march ( xinhua ) - - the united states announced expulsion of 50 russian diplomats to the united states on 22 march . the russian side launched a protest against the united states that very same day and stated that it would take corresponding retaliatory actions against the united states .
a russian intelligence official said : russia has prepared a name list of us diplomats to be expelled and may probably apply the " pro rata principle " so that the two sides will suffer the same losses .
the russian side will also make public the intelligence activities carried out by us spies , which have not been known by the general public .
this has been the worst diplomat expulsion war between russia and the united states since the end of the cold war .
it is a direct reflection of the us execution of an uncompromising policy toward russia since president george w. bush assumed office .
since the us presidential election last year , russian leaders have repeatedly expressed the hope to hold constructive dialogues with the new us government , but in disregard to russia 's strong opposition , the bush administration adopted a series of diplomatic actions , leading to tension in russian - us relations .
the us side has announced that it would withdraw without hesitation from the us - soviet 1972 " amb treaty " and accelerate the deployment of national missile defense system . thus there is a heated wrangling between russia and the united states over the anti - missile issue .
the united states has also announced that it would further cut assistance to russia and speed up the process of further nato eastward expansion , which was strongly opposed by russia .
the united states has intensified its inference in russian internal affairs .
the us side has recently stated that the united states would have official contacts with representatives of the chechen illegal armed forces in russia .
the us government was also dissatisfied with the russian resumption and development of relations with the democratic people 's republic of korea , cuba , and iran .
public opinion makers here agreed : the united states considers itself to be the only superpower in the world and has been attempting to contain and weaken russia .
the principal line of the us policy toward russia has become quite clear : the united states hopes that russia will yield to the us interests and abandon its endeavor to reshape its status as a big power .
on the day of his nomination as us secretary of state , powell pointed out : russia and the united states are " neither partners nor adversaries . "
the united states also maintained : russia has not been for a long time a superpower . on the us diplomatic scales , russia has lost the important status of the soviet union in former times .
he maintained : this is the doing of the forces that oppose constructive dialogues between russia and the united states in an attempt to make the two countries return to the cold war times .
as pointed out by bush , china is a great nation and has huge potential .
what needs to be stressed is that china 's huge potential does not pose any threat to any country but is conducive to promoting world peace and development . in fields where china and the united states have common interests and things in common , good progress has always been made in sino - us relations .
us arms sales to taiwan currently is the most sensitive issue in sino - us relations that is most concerns people .
bush said that currently a decision had not been made on arms sales to taiwan and the united states would pay attention to china 's views on this issue .
to taiwan 's splittist forces , which have begged the united states for arms sales to taiwan and attempted to " resist reunification with force , " this not only has dealt a head - on blow at them , but also serves as a prescription to cool their heads .
the bush administration has realized that the taiwan issue is the most important and sensitive issue between china and the united states and must be seriously and properly dealt with , and china 's view on this issue must be taken into account .
the leader of the taiwan authorities should squarely face the reality , not try to rely on luck , and , more importantly , not be blinded by his inordinate ambition and try to resist the tide of opposing taiwan independence and working for reunification .
qian qichen 's visit to the united states was very successful . he put into practice the consensus reached between president jiang zemin and president bush through exchange of letters , laying a good foundation for development of sino - us relations in the new century .
