the dalai clique 's relations with the taiwan authorities then changed from collusion in secret to open collaboration and cooperation , and their bilateral relations entered the stage of substantive engagement .

the central decision to unfold a study and education drive in the important thinking on " three represents " throughout the rural areas and to implement the demands of the " three represents " in the rural grass roots is of very great and far - reaching significance .
first , unfolding in depth the study and education drive in the " three represents " is the urgent requirement of promoting the strategic restructuring of agriculture and rural economy and consolidating and strengthening the foundation status of agriculture .
agriculture is the foundation of the national economy and the strategic industry for steadying people 's minds and ensuring tranquillity throughout the land .
strengthening agriculture is related to the overall situation of economic development and social stability .
in order to achieve the 10 th five - year plan and the third - stage strategic goal in modernization , we must unswervingly assign agriculture the prominent position in developing the national economy , and make efforts to maintain sustained and steady development of agriculture and rural economy .
it is an amazing event in the world that china with its 1.2 billion population has basically solved its food problem .
we must also soberly realize , however , that there are also many factors constraining the development of our agriculture and rural economy ; the total output level is not high , and we are also facing many problems that urgently await solution .
china lags far behind developed countries in per - capita output of major agricultural products and in science and technology contribution to agriculture .
in particular , china 's agriculture and rural economy have now entered a new stage of development and have encountered unprecedented new circumstances and problems .
the comprehensive role of these problems has resulted in a slowdown in peasant income growth .
hence , it is essential to regard actively promoting the strategic restructuring of agriculture and rural economy , improving the quality and economic returns of agriculture and rural economy , and doing everything possible to increase peasant incomes as the central tasks in agriculture and rural work in the new stage .
however , there are still many contradictions in the work .
one conspicuous contradiction is that the quality of the rural grassroots cadres does not yet meet or does not completely meet the requirements of the new stage .
otherwise , the pace of restructuring will be delayed , and this will have a direct impact on the development of agriculture and rural economy .
second , unfolding in depth the study and education drive in the important thinking of " three represents " is the urgent requirement of realizing , safeguarding , and developing the peasants ' vital interests in the new situation and further protecting and mobilizing their enthusiasm .
in recent years the party and government have achieved some success in adopting a series of policy measures in light of the new situations and problems that have arisen in the rural areas .
we must also realize , however , that certain problems affecting the peasants ' vital interests are still rather prominent .
the problem of heavy burdens on the peasants has now become a major factor affecting rural social stability .
second , the state of spiritual cultural life in the rural areas can be called worrying .
third , the state of social order in the rural areas is grim [ yan jun ] .
we need to make efforts in various respects in order to resolve these problems , and this will be determined to a very great extent by whether or not the rural grassroots cadres can resolutely implement the party 's rural guidelines and policies , and by their ideological and political standards and their ability in practical work .
third , unfolding in depth the study and education drive in the important thinking on " three represents " is the urgent requirement of strengthening the ideological and work style building of the rural grassroots cadre contingent and enhancing the cohesion and combat strength of the rural grassroots party organizations .
they have worked in the frontline for a long time , endured hardship , willingly borne the burden of office , overcome difficulties , worked in sound fashion , and made tremendous contributions to promoting rural reforms and developing and preserving rural social stability .
this is certainly not saying something frightening just to scare people .
in doing a good job in rural work , we must not only depend on correct theory , line , guidelines , and policies , but also on a rural grassroots cadre contingent of a quality capable of withstanding severe tests , with good ideological and work style , and genuinely bent on pursuing the masses ' interests .
judging by the situation in trial - point work in the previous stage , the majority of comrades agree with launching the rural study and education drive in the important thinking on " three represents , " and hold that it is very necessary .
some comrades , however , have doubts and vague understanding regarding launching this study and education drive .
these ideological obstacles directly hamper and affect the smooth unfolding of the study and education drive , and must be seriously overcome .
getting a good grasp of the study and education drive in the important thinking on " three represents " in connection with current rural reality is an effective spur and stimulus for all rural work , and must absolutely not be regarded as a task divorced from the key tasks .
the key to whether or not it is done in superficial fashion lies in the ideological understanding and work intensity of the leaders at all levels .
so long as the leaders attach importance to the task , unify their thinking , adopt effective measures , and do their work in sound fashion , they will be able to overcome the difficulties , resolve the problems , and ensure good results in this study and education drive .
we must treat this study and education drive with a high degree of political responsibility and sense of historic mission .
in addition to summoning up great resolve for unfolding this study and education drive , we must also devote great energy to getting a really good grasp of this work and produce notable results .
in carrying out this work it is essential to strictly act in accordance with the principles , methods , and measures laid down by the central authorities , and pay particular attention to getting a good grasp of the following issues .
comprehensively enhancing the quality of the rural grassroots cadres , especially the township and town cadres , is the key link in doing a good job in rural work , and is also an important goal that we must strive to attain in this study and education drive .
this is an important criterion for judging whether this study and education drive has been successful or not .
while protecting and raising grain production capacity , we should guide the peasants to be oriented to the market , depend on science and technology , consciously restructure crop cultivation and stockraising , and ensure fine quality of all agricultural products .
we must strengthen support and guidance for agricultural industrialization , promote the development of secondary and tertiary rural industries , and enhance the follow - up returns of agriculture .
second , we must see practical results in lightening the peasants ' burdens .
fourth , the building of socialist spiritual civilization and of democracy and legal system must be further stepped up .
we must launch in depth a drive to create civilized villages and townships and advocate a scientific , civilized , and healthy life style ; and strengthen the building of grassroots democracy and legal system , implement measures for comprehensive tackling of social order , and make efforts to preserve rural social stability .
only by tightly grasping and properly resolving these issues can we ensure that this study and education will genuinely produce good results and gain the support and approval of the peasant masses .
all localities must proceed from reality and analyze and identify their local specific issues , centering on these four aspects ; they should solve whatever problem exists and focus on resolving the conspicuous problems .
this is a very important criterion for judging how this study and education drive has been done and whether it has been conducted in superficial fashion or not .
this is the basic premise and important guarantee for making a success of the study and education drive .
hence , it is necessary to do a good job in handling contradictions between work and study and ensure that they have the necessary time for reading .
fourth , it is necessary to persist in combining the upper and lower levels and curing both the symptoms and the cause .
in these circumstances , if we only resolve the problems by considering them as they stand , we will be unable to resolve them well and maybe cannot even resolve them at all ; it is essential to have joint action and mutual coordination between the upper and lower levels .
the party committees at all levels must strengthen leadership , vigorously grasp implementation , and ensure that the study and education drive yields practical results the key to ensuring that this study and education drive reaches its predicted goals in accordance with the unified arrangements of the central authorities lies in the leadership .

the outline has proposed a series of anticipated targets for china 's economic and social development in the coming five years .
through these figures , we can envisage what new strides the chinese nation will make in the early years of the new century .
the gdp will leap from the current 8.9 trillion yuan to a high level of 12.5 trillion yuan , and the per capita gdp will also rise from the current 6,900 yuan to 9,400 yuan .
during the ninth five - year plan period , china 's gdp grew at 8.3 percent a year on average .
although this speed is a little bit lower than that of the ninth five - year plan period , still it is relatively high .
our economic foundation is still comparatively weak , the people 's living standards are comparatively low , and the development among different regions is still unbalanced . hence , we must make painstaking efforts in order to achieve this target on the basis of enhancing effectiveness .
by the end of 2000 , china 's gdp for the first time broke through the barrier of $ 1 trillion , which was basically at the same level as italy .
however , owing the huge base number , china 's per capita economic aggregate will still be at a middle lower level in the world , and its gap with the developed countries is still considerably large .
comparing the above figures , we can see that in the coming five years , the trend of industrial structural changes in china will be : the primary industry will fall , the tertiary industry will rise , and the secondary industry will basically remain unchanged .
at present , the overall quality of china 's labor forces engaged in agricultural production is still very low and the production modes are very backward . in developed countries , the proportion of laborers engaged in agricultural production is less than 5 percent , but it is as high as 50 percent in china .
the insufficient development of the tertiary industry is a principal problem existing in china 's industrial structure .
during the 10 th five - year plan period , china will have a relatively great pressure on employment , and the tertiary industry will be a principal channel for absorption of jobs .
making an analysis of the above targets , we can see that during the 10 th five - year plan period , stress will be put on the following three facets in carrying out the strategy of rejuvenating the country through science and technology : 1 ) substantially increasing the funds for scientific research and development .
in 1999 , the funds for scientific research and development were 67.89 billion yuan , accounting for 0.83 percent of the gdp , the highest in history . however , it was still lagging far behind the average level of developed countries , which exceeded 2 percent in the same year .
2 ) substantially increasing the net enrollment rate of senior high school education .
the rate was 38.2 percent in 2000 and will be raised to about 60 percent during the 10 th five - year plan period , so there will be a great development in senior high school education .
3 ) substantially increasing the net enrollment rate of tertiary education .
it is precisely because of this that the call for green water and blue sky has become the consensus of people from all walks of life .
during the ninth five - year plan period , china 's population reproduction pattern underwent a historical change from " high birthrate , low mortality rate , and high growth rate " to " low birthrate , low mortality rate , and low growth rate , " with the natural population growth rate declining to 9.7 percent .
during the 10 th five - year plan period , china will continue to adhere to the national policy of family planning , maintain a low birthrate , and control the natural population growth rate within 9 percent . by 2005 , the country 's total population will be controlled under 1.33 billion .
this way , we will be able to create a favorable environment for economic and social development .
showing solicitude for the people 's lives ; constructing a well - off society an outstanding characteristic in the 10 th five - year plan is that the masses ' lives are greatly concerned about , which can be seen from the anticipated targets set in the outline .
aiming at the enhancement of the people 's living standards , the outline for the first time clearly lists the anticipated targets as follows : the per capita disposable income of urban residents and the per capita net income of rural residents will grow at about 5 percent a year on average .
at the end of 2000 , the per capita housing area of urban residents reached 13.6 square meters . it will be increased to 22 square meters at the end of the 10 th five - year plan , which is a rather arduous task .
the outline also proposes that in five years ' time , the jobs newly increased for urban residents and rural laborers transferred from agriculture reach 40 million each , and the rate of registered unemployment in cities and towns be controlled within 5 percent approximately .
this is also an important aspect for the increase of income and enhancement of the people 's living standards .

guangzhou , 1 apr ( xinhua ) - - these reporters have learned from the guangdong provincial public security department today that over the past few days , police in guangdong , hong kong , and macao have conducted a joint antidrug " spring thunder operation " and scored marked successes .
in the short space of 2 - 3 years , the quantities of " ice " and ecstasy seized by public security organs have increased by more than 10 times .
for this reason , the work meeting of persons in charge of criminal police in guangdong , hong kong , and macao , which was held in march this year , decided to launch a joint antidrug operation , codenamed " spring thunder , " by the police in the three places .
since 24 march , police in the three places have simultaneously launched the " spring thunder operation , " with the focus on cracking down on the crimes of manufacturing and trafficking in " ice " and ecstasy .
in light of the public order situation in various localities , the public security organs have also cracked down on the " double robbery " crimes , infiltration of triad societies from outside the border , and printing and selling of counterfeit money .
during this operation , police in the three places have checked more than 10,000 places of all kinds , arresting 1,243 criminal suspects , seizing 303.242 kg of " ice , " 39,623 ecstasy tablets , and 4,645 grams of marihuana .
in the course of this operation , public security organs in various parts of guangdong have successively cracked a number of major cases .
in shenzhen city , the buji police department has cracked a major ecstasy trafficking case with a background of international drug trafficking ring , arresting six criminal suspects ( including three members of a hong kong triad society ) and seizing 3,400 ecstasy tablets and certain quantities of marihuana and overused pharmaceuticals of a new type .
to strike at the drug crimes more effectively , the guangdong provincial public security department and the provincial financial department recently worked out the " procedures of guangdong province on awarding those who perform meritorious deeds by informing against drug crimes , " which will officially go into effect today .

there were two possibilities for this us aircraft 's accidental landing : first , the us aircraft was damaged and could not go back . second , the us crewmembers were mortally afraid of death .

the united states is trying every possible means to protect the already earned interests , is seeking omnidirectional absolute superiority , and is eager to guard against all possible rivals . this will aggravate us contradictions and conflicts with china , russia , europe , and japan .
if the united states continues to act willfully , insists on developing and deploying the nmd , and revises the antimissile treaty , the already weak international strategic balance could face the risk of being broken , followed by a new round of arms race , particular space arms race .
in this way , the 21 st century will possibly become a century fuller of gunpowder than any time in the past .
the united states is swaggering and pursuing hegemony in all parts of the world . this goes against the trend of history and does not enjoy popular support .
most big countries in the world , including us allies , take counteracting us influence as the main theme of their foreign policies . this has become the main trend of present - day international politics .
pursuit of development by some regional big powers and groups through regional economic and security cooperation will also serve as a restriction on the hegemonic strategy of " this single superpower , " weaken its global influence , and make it more difficult for it to maintain its " single superpower " status !

on 9 may last year , the day after the united states bombed china 's embassy in yugoslavia , a us reconnaisance plane entered china 's airspace ; the pla air force special - grade pilot zhang junsheng scrambled to intercept and forced the us plane to go away .

in comparison with past conflicts between the two sides , though the circumstances of this accident are serious , the two sides have so far been relatively controlled and retained room for negotiation .
the united states ' future plans for sale of arms to taiwan appears to be an especially sensitive related trend . in considering arms sales to taiwan , the united states lays particular emphasis on hemming in the chinese mainland as well as giving top priority to the security of taiwan .

from beijing 's point of view , this is out and out hegemonic behavior as well as hemming in the chinese mainland .
if beijing does not carry out serious and principled negotiations , china 's position on the international stage will be weakened , and there will be objections within the country having some extent of an impact on the stability of the regime .
for these reasons , it can be predicted that china will handle this affair rather painstakingly .

in reality , the degree of seriousness with which both parties handle the military plane collision incident and how they observe it from the point of view of a longer range strategic plan as well as their weighing of future relations may rather be seen as a turning point for improvement in the relationship between the two sides .
moreover , beijing has clearly been affected by the increasingly apparent hostile trend of the new u.s. administration towards the chinese mainland as well as its increasingly tight encirclement of the chinese mainland .

problems , issues arising from military plane collision on 1 april , a collision between an american reconnaissance plane and a prc pla fighter forced the american plane to land on hainan island and the pla craft to plunge into the sea .
now , twenty - four american fliers are being held by the prc . highly secret electronic equipment has also fallen into the hands of the pla , and these are all bargaining chips for the prc to use with the united states .
the prc has various strategies at its disposal . they may cause unending delays , or they may " split the men and the machine , " first showing friendship by allowing the personnel to leave china , but keeping the military aircraft and the equipment for leisurely study .
if it is the former , given certain conditions and negotiations , the situation could be smoothly resolved . however , if it is to be characterized as the latter , the matter would be handled viewing the players as an enemy plane and prisoners of war , and there would be no flexibility .
according to foreign reports , according to foreign reports , three american destroyers are moving toward the south china sea , and although this is one of the ways that the us is applying pressure , this could turn around and bite them , increasing the number of factors involved in negotiations .
however , we will be forgiven for saying right out that today 's world situation is no longer that of the cold war era , nor is it the eve of a world war. military preparedness is necessary for all nations , but cooperative exchanges and coexistence are the mainstream .
every country in the world hopes that the two superpowers in asia will not experience heightened military tensions due to this affair . even japan is no exception , and taiwan 's standpoint must also be the same .
secondly , up until today the collision and its aftermath are already two days old . the prc has only issued one short statement . it can be imagined that internal departments are now gathering for consultations on possible countermoves ; however , taiwan and the us should pay attention to the nationalism gradually stirred up inside the prc .
judging from reactions on the internet , the special increase in the guards in front of the us embassy , this sentiment indeed exists and is difficult to control .
according to the judgment of our side , the collision happened accidentally , not on purpose . it was very likely that the incident resulted from misjudgments by both sides and the pressing time , because the jian-8 fighters wanted to press the us aircraft to turn around but the us aircraft continued to fly straight forward .
in fact , the us side has never notified us of its reconnaissance mission , which " cannot be called a reconnaissance mission if notification is given beforehand . "
our conclusion is that the us aircraft did not turn around despite the pressing of the chinese communists ' fighters , or both sides might make wrong judgements , thus causing the collision .
as has been learned , the jian-8 interceptors took off from lingshui airport , which is chinese communists ' air base where fighters sent in rotation for training purpose are stationed .
as has been learned , our side already learned about the situation on the morning of 1 april . in addition to judging the aircraft flying at a low speed of 300 nautical miles as a us ep-3 plane , our side also used some ways to monitor the talks between the pilots of the two jian-8 fighters .
it has been learned that our side provided relevant information on the incident to the us side for its reference through proper channels .
according to kao yang , in addition to the air identification zone , we have the radar system and " other " ways to monitor .
speaking on whether the collision incident would create tension in the relations between the united states and the chinese communists , he emphasized that the ministry of national defense " is not in the position to comment . "
in the future , the key point which may impact relations between china and the us is not the collision itself , but rather the timeframe and manner in which the chinese hand over the plane and crew .
some analyses say that the prc fighter intentionally struck the american craft , thinking to force the us plane to land on chinese soil . some people also say that the american plane made a sudden turn toward the jian-8 as though it were a bicycle moving forward of its own volition .
in reality , us military reconnaissance planes have been flying over the sea on a line from xisha to hainan , following the border of prc airspace for more than a decade .
looking at the incident from the viewpoint of prc fighter interception procedures and the demands of coordination with war technology on the ground , no reason exists for intentionally taunting the american plane .
the pilots on patrol on the line between xisha and hainan island are mostly old hands who are capable of flying in any weather .
this is a tacit agreement between the two .
but why did a problem occur with this routine maneuver ?
some analyses say that it is possible that the chinese crew were having technical problems . others say that the " chinese " - us relationship has worsened of late , and that the prc pilots had something of an emotional response and piloted the craft in an inappropriate way .
the us plane suddenly dropped its nose , and that might have been against the tacit understanding , but the jian-8, as a fighter plane , would have had the maneuverability to get away .
under the stipulations of international agreements , fast planes must yield to slower planes in flight , and the fact that the jian-8 was not able to get away may very well be because the jian-8 lacked sufficient maneuverability .
perhaps this affair will let the " chinese " and the us really appreciate the need to strengthen their mutual air safety , just as in the " ocean military safety accord " both signed in 1998 with the goal of preventing collisions between ships .
if the chinese communists should hold such a stand , then they will release only the personnel and hold the plane in custody or return it to the united states after making a thorough study of it .
the chinese communists probably will not go to the extent of taking such an unwise move ; otherwise , bush will have got to show his " firm " side .
this is still the first time a us military aircraft has been forced to land on the chinese mainland .
from the 1952 downing in northeast china of a c-47 carrying central intelligence agency agent donny and facto to the 1962 downing of a u-2 piloted by taiwan air force pilot ch ' en huai - sheng over east china , there was no exception .
ch ' en huai - sheng died in the course of performing his duty ( the present huaisheng junior high school in taipei commemorates him ) .
this matter can be resolved only through diplomatic avenues but diplomacy must have the backing of strength and this probably was the reason for the united states to dispatch three destroyers to sail toward hainan island and cruise the south china sea .
whether this will work , however , still depends on how the chinese communists respond .
if the chinese communists recognize bush 's " firm determination " through this exploratory behavior and shrink back from difficulties and do him a favor at little cost , the ep-3 incident is likely to be resolved at an early date . neither washington nor beijing will benefit if it drags on .
following standard practice , the chinese communists also ordered ten engines .
several years later the chinese communists had developed the " yunshi " large transport plane , which at first glance looked exactly like a boeing 707 .

the chinese government has made solemn representations to the us government and lodged a protest over the incident . after the plane collision , rather than offering an apology to the chinese side , the us side defended its conduct by citing so - called legal reasons .
it is necessary that we give our analysis on this incident from the angle of international law so as to ensure a correct understanding of the matter .
first of all , the plane collision occurred in the sky over the coastal waters of china , which belongs to the airspace covering china 's exclusive economic zone .
although it is stipulated in the un convention on law of the sea that foreign aircraft enjoy the freedom of flyover in the airspace over an exclusive economic zone , a flyover of this kind is subject to certain conditions and is not free from restrictions as advocated by the us side .
even us scholars maintained that limited by article 58 , section 3 of the un convention on law of the sea , the freedom of flyover in an exclusive economic zone and the freedom in international waters are different in principle .
it can be imagined that if foreign military reconnaissance airplanes engage in reconnaissance activities in the coastal waters off the united states , the us side will never sit idle to abide by the principles of " freedom of flyover . "
second , the fact that the us military reconnaissance airplane entered china 's territorial sky without authorization and landed in chinese territory is an encroachment on china 's sovereign right over territorial sky .
the world 's first multilateral convention on air legislation , the paris aviation control convention which was established in 1919 , has officially defined the principles of sovereign right over territorial sky .
article 1 of the convention stipulated clearly : each of the signatory states acknowledges that every country is entitled to complete and exclusive sovereignty over the airspace above its territory .
based on this principle , the convention stipulated : without special permissions , military aircraft of a signatory state are prohibited from flying over or landing in the territory of another signatory state .
the so - called " complete and exclusive " sovereignty means exactly complete jurisdiction and control of a country over its territorial sky .
the act of neither applying for nor making notification on the part of the us airplane is a manifestation of complete disregard of china 's sovereignty .

editor 's note : in the 21 st century , new military changes will continue to take place , and joint operations will remain a leading subject amidst this tide of change .
all these issues and questions need to be solved through our continued studies and explorations . [ end of editor 's note ] joint operations have been a hot academic topic in recent years .
the questions of what kind of a war we are going to fight in the future and how we are supposed to fight such wars are issues of fundamental importance that we need to be very clear about in our current preparations for the military struggle .
to settle the issue of " winning the war , " what counts is a clear theoretical understanding .
when we talk about making preparations for the military struggle , it is true that we need to ensure a good job in weaponry preparation , battlefield building , training through science and technology , and defense mobilization ; yet the preparation of operational theories still proves the most important of all .
during the period from the end of the 1970 s to the beginning of the 1980 s , a new upsurge was set off again in the study of coordinated operations .
in a military - wide discussion on campaign theories launched in 1987 , our military drew on the new ideas of foreign militaries and subsequently put forward the theory of combined operations and combined campaigns .
however , we should see more clearly that there is still a lot of virgin territory in our present theoretical studies of joint operations which urgently awaits our cultivation ; and it also takes an arduous transformation process if we want to successfully apply our theoretical achievements to the building , reform , and practice of joint operations .
the increasingly mature theory on combined operations , which placed the army in a dominant position while making other services subordinate , gave birth to a heroic army and a heroic era of the army .
the inertia of our guiding principle of operation , which mainly focused on ground - based operations and the army , hindered us from making substantive studies on the basic principle of joint operations , which stood for defeating one 's opponent by integrated and joint operations .
even a coordinated operation among different services was often planned and carried out within the scope of a combined operation , with its focus being placed mainly on the army .
in the face of the present new historical conditions under which the form of war is evolving from mechanization to informatization , our thinking must not remain at a standstill at the platform of mechanization .
joint operations are not only an operational mode in future high - tech wars , but also a brand - new operational concept .
at present , the us military has already completed the transition in the combined grouping [ he cheng pian zu ] of its operational forces from a multi - arm combined grouping within a particular service towards a cross - service multi - arm integrated grouping , or even towards an all - service integrated grouping .

< > the theory and practice of joint operations in the us military is constrained by various structural contradictions .
of these , the ones that are fairly prominent are : competing interests among the various service arms , a gap with allies in terms of operational capabilities , and the inherent uncertainty of warfare . . . .
during the gulf war , the us military carried out large - scale joint operations in five dimensions - - ground , sea , air , space , and electronics , launching the new revolution in military affairs .
in 1991 , the us jcs issued joint publication no 1 - - " joint operations of the us armed forces . "
the jcs issued the " joint vision 2010 " and " joint vision 2020 " in 1996 and 2000 respectively , and these are programmatic documents guiding the establishment of us joint forces and future joint operations .
this is the first time the us military has made a strategic unit at the joint command level the main innovating entity for the development and testing of joint operational concepts .
over the past two years , the us military has continued to enhance the functions of this command , making it the hub for the development and testing of joint operational concepts .
at present , joint operations in the us military have two prominent characteristics , namely they are strategic and asymmetric .
in fairly large - scale joint operations involving multiple armed services , " strategic " is a concept that pervades military actions from beginning to end .
at the joint forces level , the commander of the joint forces must take every measure to enhance cooperation among the various armed services , specialized military units , and logistical and support forces , ensuring a high degree of unity in joint operational activities .
joint operations in the us military concentrate on achieving strategic goals by using asymmetric forces and methods , with the goals being strategic and the methods asymmetric .
the major method used by the us military to achieve asymmetry is by bringing its technical superiority to bear and taking advantage of the technological gap between the weapons and equipment of the two sides .
the us military believes that , based on its technical superiority , in future joint operations they " will be able to achieve decisive superiority through asymmetric actions using the power of joint forces to strike at the enemy 's weak points and the skillful use of troops in terms of time and space . "
long - range precision strikes are the main method used by the us military at present to achieve asymmetric joint operations .
in recent years , in addition to continuing to strive to enhance its " asymmetry " with regard to adversaries , the us military has also put particular stress on preventing an adversary which is at a technological disadvantage from using its particular strengths to strike at the particular weaknesses of the us .
the competition among the army , navy , and air force in the us has been around for a long time .
because each of the three services in the us has different military technology , core competencies , military traditions , and particularly because each service controls its own budget independently , from the start the three services engage in force building from the standpoint of the interests of their own service , not the overall strategic demands .
us military joint operations are generally conducted together with allied military forces .
fighting to get allied military forces to participate in war is of major significance with regard to getting budgets , establishing forward bases , getting public support domestically , and reducing us military casualties .
joint operations require " interoperability . "
information technology has provided new ways of conducting war , and it has also brought with it new uncertainties .
the " transparent battlefield " is fine , as is " dispelling the fog of war " and having an " information umbrella , " but all these theories are merely expressions of a kind of hope , a trend , and an ideal state where resistance does not exist .
innovative power , the strategic inertia of the traditional forces , and changes in the international situation will have a major impact on the development of joint operations in the us military .
in 2020 and beyond , they will study concepts and technologies which have the potential to bring about revolutionary changes in joint operations , concentrating on robot systems , automated operations , nanometer technology , " biotechnology - centered operations , " and energy substitutes .

a current issue that has received great attention information security refers to the prevention of any leakage of information when it is generated , transmitted , used , and stored so that its usefulness , secrecy , integrity , and authenticity can be preserved ; and so that the reliability and controllability of the information system can the ensured .
because of these threats , we may divide information security into these four aspects : security of the computer , security of the operation system , security of the data , and security of the management .
security of the computer refers to the process of protecting the computer facilities ( including the network ) and other media from sabotaged by earthquakes , floods , fires , toxic gases , and other environmental incidents ( including electromagnetic pollution ) .
security of the operation system refers to taking security measures - - such as security appraisal , follow - up check , backup , restoration , and emergency measures - - to safeguard the security of information processing for the sake of ensuring the computer system 's security .
the pdrr model uses the protection of information security as the basis . but the protection of the information system is an active process , which requires detective measures to discover security loopholes and stop them immediately . meanwhile , it must also have responsible emergency measures to stop all forms of intrusion .
information security makes the notion that one side in an advantaged situation and the other side in a disadvantaged situation in a military struggle a relative concept .
in information warfare , the difference between a developed country and an undeveloped country will be far smaller than the difference they would have in a conventional war .
today we must urgently build a stronger information security system and draw up an information security strategy and information defense system . this is a necessity of the time , and it is also essential for the strategy for ensuring national security and for building stronger armed forces .
it is also essential for real struggles .
measures that countries have taken the struggles among countries for the acquisition , use , and control of information resources have become increasingly fiercer . all countries now regard building a reliable security system their basic national policy .
then , in january 2000 , the us president , in another order , issued the decision called " protect the united states ' cyberspace - - the national plan for information system protection v. 10 . "
while establishing a centralized national system for safeguarding its information security , it also has drawn up the " doctrine of the federated republic 's information security , " and proposed in the international community the signing of an international peace treaty of stopping the information warfare .

particularly over the past few years , the party central committee and the state council have taken a series of key measures and achieved marked results against the outstanding problems of economic disorder in certain fields .
the meeting pointed out : at present , there are some new features in law - breaking and criminal activities that disrupt the market economic order , such as committing crimes by gangs , across regions , by colluding with people inside and outside , by specialized and intelligent means , and in an increasingly covert way .
the meeting noted : in the course of economic system conversion , there are complex economic , social and ideological reasons accounting for certain chaotic phenomena in the market economic order .
this year , we must concentrate our efforts on rectifying problems that directly jeopardize people 's immediate interests , that cause strong grievances in society , and that the masses can play an active part .
as for key areas not listed in the this year 's rectification and regulation program , relevant departments in charge must , in accordance with their job functions and areas of responsibility , conscientiously handle well the work of rectifying and regulating the market economic order in their respective spheres .
on this basis , the work of rectifying and regulating the market economic order will be put into the orbit of systematization and unremittingly carried out for a long time .
the meeting stressed : to rectify and regulate the market economic order , the key is that we must reach a common understanding .
second , we must highlight key points and devote our energies to seriously investigate and handle a batch of big and important cases .
we must proceed from the investigation and handling of big and important cases , mete out severe punishment to criminal rings and principal culprits .
we must mobilize the masses to actively give us tip - offs and establish a tip - off and reward system .
we must bring into full play the supervisory role of people of all walks of life and the news media , so that law - breaking and criminal elements disrupting the market economic order will be placed under extensive supervision .
fourth , we must deepen reform , transform government functions , and build up a mechanism of administration according to law .
we must cut down on administrative examination and approval , standardize the procedure of examination and approval , and give whoever is in charge of examination and approval power that is commensurate with their responsibilities .
the management of administrative charges , which " separates revenue from expenditure , " should be perfected from mechanism .
fifth , we must improve the scientific nature and effectiveness of government administration .
all law - enforcement organs must adhere to strict and fair enforcement of the law , regulate the conduct of law - enforcement , and make it less arbitrary .
substituting penalty for jail sentence is strictly prohibited .
we must improve the political and vocational quality of the law - enforcement contingent , resolutely punish corrupt elements within the law - enforcement contingent .
all localities must try as quickly as possible to abolish local laws and regulations that run counter to state laws and regulations .
eighth , we must vigorously advocate professional ethics based on honesty and fulfillment of promises , expedite the building of a sound social credit system .
we must conscientiously enhance propaganda and education on rule by virtue , vigorously elevate the societywide level of business ethics , and instill a stronger credit concept among all the people .
we should build up archives on enterprise conduct by means of computer technology and network technology , so that law - and rule - breaking enterprises and business operators with a serious contract - breaching record will have no place to hide .
the meeting also urged that while carrying out the work of rectifying and regulating the market economic order , we must be very careful about our policy and strategy , we have to protect law - abiding business operators in real earnest and ensure the normal running of social and economic activities .

lingshui , 5 april ( jiefangjun bao ) - - on 5 april , the full - scale action of searching wang wei , the parachuting pilot of the military plane of our army collided and destroyed by the u.s. military surveillance plane , entered the fifth day .
wang wei , the pilot who parachuted , is a flight squadron chief and a pilot with rich flight experience in the four different weather conditions .
after receiving the report about wang wei parachuting into the waters , jiang zemin , chairman of the central military commission , was deeply concerned about his safety , and issued several instructions to the navy and the relevant departments , ordering them to go all out to organize the search and rescue action .
on the morning of 3 april , when meeting with visiting prime minister of qatar , president jiang stressed : human life is most precious .
i am deeply concerned about the safety of our pilot , and have issued several instructions on going all out to search and rescue the pilot at all costs .
several minutes after our plane was bumped and destroyed by the us military surveillance plane and pilot wang wei parachuted , the search activities were started intensely .
on the same evening , everyone inside the command continued to work all through the night .
they carefully analyzed the wind direction , the wind speed , the sea currents , and other information , further improved the search plan .
the forces being dispatched to the search action continued to increase .
beginning the next day , they consecutively flew eight to nine hours every day .
the crew headed by vice regiment commander zhang jianjun was the first to participate in the search action on the first day . in the following days , they continued to fly intensively beyond normal standards . the plane made several flights a day and the total flight time was as long as 11 hours .
over the past few days , clouds were low above the seas , and there were winds and waves . all this added to the difficulty of the search actions .
the crews participating in the search actions were all led by leading cadres , who personally piloted the planes . they watched carefully , and did not miss any possible targets on the sea surface .
wang shaojun , commander of a flight regiment , personally piloted a helicopter , boldly descending to an altitude of 10 meters above the surface to carefully observe the target area .
now , five days have passed , but wang wei is still nowhere to be found .
the calls with deep feelings echoed above the boundless seas : wang wei , where are you ?

zhou jianhai , professor of international law at the china university of political science and law and council member of the chinese society of international law , gave his views on the mid - air collision when interviewed by our reporter .
according to provisions of the law on china 's territorial waters and their contiguous areas and the law on china 's exclusive economic zone and continental shelf , the actions of the united states not only defied international law but defied china 's domestic laws .
the right of self - defense in international law covers two aspects : first , a country can strengthen and consolidate its own national defense in order to protect its coastal defenses and prevent foreign aggression . second , it can rise in counterattack when its sovereignty and territorial integrity is violated by a foreign force of aggression .
us plane has no immunity zhou jianhai emphasized that the us plane was deemed to have deliberately caused the collision because it had gone beyond the so - called scope of free over - flight in the airspace above the exclusive economic zone .
for example , when an aircraft flies in a normal manner in the airspace above chinese waters , its immunity is protected by chinese laws provided that it does not violate international law or the domestic law of the littoral state .
however , the us military surveillance plane had entered china 's airspace illegally without china 's permission and landed on a chinese airport after colliding with a chinese military aircraft . this amounted to illegal entry , even an act of aggression in violation of territorial airspace . how could such a plane be eligible to immunity ?
united states must bear legal and moral responsibilities zhou jianhai said that the chinese side has every right to detain the us plane after the investigations .
legally speaking , the intrusion of the us military aircraft into china 's territorial airspace constitutes a violation into china 's territorial sovereignty , because territorial airspace is a component part of state sovereignty .
china has the right to demand the us side to shoulder economic responsibility for colliding with an aircraft and causing the life of its pilot .
he said : the easing - up and settlement of a crisis always starts from a tiny progressive change .

the results of the examination - and - approval process are a far cry from its objective . people have been stunned by the news that the new middle school history textbook written under the guidance of the new history textbook writing committee has been examined and approved by the ministry of education .
ever since the book was submitted for approval in its white - cover version , its contents have been published in the newspapers little by little , revealing the serious errors both in the thinking behind its writing and in the way it interprets historical facts .
now that the textbook has been approved , its possible negative effects on japan itself and on the international community , especially the possible shadow it may cast over the healthy development of sino - japanese relations , cannot be ignored .
the purpose of textbook examination and approval is to ensure " objectivity and fairness " in the recounting of facts . yet the historical accounts in this middle school textbook are ridden with fundamental errors and are a far cry from " objectivity and fairness . "
whether or not its narrative is " objective and fair " affects not only japan 's international image but also japan 's relations with those countries .
this is precisely the reason why enlightened people in japan , whether or not they are in the government , have taken a cautious attitude and acted sensibly over the textbook issue since the 1980 's . their goal is to prevent the textbook issue from hurting japan 's relations with its neighbors .
since that time , some textbooks have begun to include accounts of the nanjing massacre and describe the historical facts surrounding japan 's instigation of a war of aggression during world war ii .
in the summer of [ as published ] , japan 's neighbors reacted with criticisms and protests to the distortion of history by japanese textbooks . references to the " 731 " forces were deleted , as were accounts of women being raped by japanese troops . instead , japanese aggression was referred to as " advance . "
furthermore , accounts of japan 's colonial rule in places like korea and china taiwan were gradually amplified .
one of its writers even goes so far as to declare that " mythology is history " and devotes a lot of space to myths and folk tales , complete with maps , about the ancient japanese monarchy . in so doing , he blurs the boundary between mythology and history .
the scientific spirit and democracy have become deeply embedded in the public psychology today , but those people are doing their level best to preach a view of history based on the divine status of the japanese emperor . people cannot help but wonder about where they are leading the young people of japan .
as a matter of fact , this type of textbook that revises historical facts may well set the stage for japan going down a dangerous road . how can they even begin to talk about " self - defense ? "
how can they " preserve peace ? "
playing with words , covering up facts of aggression when it comes to recording the facts of history , the middle school history textbook written by the new history textbook writing committee has serious problems .
in the name of getting rid of so - called " nationally self - abusive " materials , it is totally silent on the crime of aggression committed by japanese militarism in china , korea , and all over southeast asia . nor does it mention the historical fact of japanese militarism forcing people into slave labor in china .
they assert that history is not science and that the purpose of studying history is not to understand past events but to " study how people in the past understood facts in the past . "
" conscience derives from facts . " history is the truth . history is not a product of subjective creation , but the tracks of the truth .
without historical facts , history would simply be lies that everybody is free to make up as he pleases .
if we do not respect the truth in history , then history will become a heap of mud so malleable that it can be shaped any way one desires .
writers who adopt the " laissez - faire " model of history - writing distort historical facts as they please and tailor the writing of history textbooks to suit their subjective wishes , which totally violates the purpose of studying and writing history .
the fact that the middle school history textbook written under the auspices of the new history textbook writing committee won approval is a sign that certain right - wing forces in japan have run rampant since the mid - 1990 's .

on 1 april , flying along with wang wei on a mission , zhao yu witnessed the entire course of the chinese - us plane collision , which still makes him angry .
he said : " the us plane had carried out reconnaissance activities at our doorstep and caused our plane crash . such a barbaric act makes one indignant . "
zhao yu and wang wei quickly identified the plane as a us ep-3 type electronic reconnaissance plane .
at 0905 , the us plane adjusted its navigation direction to 110 degrees . our planes also switched to 110 degrees and flew in the same direction and at the same speed with the us plane .
according to zhao yu , chinese pilots are required to check aerial targets that could endanger state security and to follow them and monitor them .
this is a sacred task to maintain the state security , which is also a normal duty performed by our country 's pilots .
" at 0907 , the us plane made a big and sudden movement toward the direction of our planes and bumped against the plane piloted by wang wei , " said zhao yu , whose voice was a bit agitated .
i reminded wang wei : " your plane 's vertical tail has been struck off . pay attention to remain in condition , pay attention to remain in condition . "
wang wei replied , " roger . "
about 30 seconds later , i found wang wei 's plane was rolling to the right side and plunging . the plane was out of control .
wang wei requested to parachute . i replied : " permission granted . "
afterward , i lost contact with wang wei. "
ten minutes later , the us plane , also landed at our lingshui airfield without our government 's permission . "
after wang wei parachuted and fell into the sea , the navy and relevant departments immediately made all - out rescue efforts .
by the afternoon of 5 april , the navy has made 74 air sorties , dispatched 42 vessels , and mobilized 10,000 persons in the rescue efforts .
zhao yu also expressed thanks to the leaders of the cpc central committee , the central military commission , and the navy who have organized all - out rescue efforts for wang wei as well as to the people in the nation who are concerned about the safety of wang wei .
in conclusion , zhao yu spoke in a firm voice : " my comrade - in - arms and i resolutely support the solemn position adopted by our government in handling this event . "

china has the right to monitor , observe and control our exclusive economic zones .

beijing , 6 apr (zxs) - - china 's military paper jiefangjun bao today carried a commentator 's article on the incident in which a us military reconnaissance plane collided into and damaged one of china 's military aircraft , and pointed out that china 's sovereignty cannot be violated .
the commentator 's article from jiefangjun bao said : china 's sovereignty and territorial airspace were seriously violated in the incident caused by the us military reconnaissance plane , and the responsibility for it lies fully on the us side .
the facts are there , and the evidence irrefutable .
the villain sued his victim before he himself was prosecuted , and found fault with the chinese side for no reason . all of china 's military officers and men expressed great indignation over the united states ' ugly act of hegemonism !
the article pointed out : it was not only today that us military reconnaissance planes violated china 's sovereignty and territorial airspace . for many years , us military planes have continuously conducted such dangerous provocative activities in the sky above china 's coastal area .
the era when for hundreds of years western aggressors only had to set up a few big guns on a coast in the east in order to occupy a country is gone forever .
this kind of attitude is not helpful to the ultimate resolution of this issue .
zhou jianhai who is a professor of international law at china politics and law university expressed that the us military reconnaissance aircraft deliberately rammed into china 's fighter plane which was performing its normal shadowing duty , resulting in a chinese pilot being missing and the plane crash in to the sea .
according to the " maritime convention of the united nations , " when flying over the sub - territorial waters and territorial waters of the exclusive economic zones of a certain country , a foreign aircraft should take the safety and interests of the coastal country into consideration .
nevertheless , this us aircraft not only did not take china 's safety and interests into consideration but also deliberately rammed into china 's aircraft which was performing its normal shadowing duty , thus directly violating the above - mentioned international convention .
for example , on the premise of not violating the international laws and the domestic laws of a coastal country , the right of immunity of an aircraft normally flying over the territorial water of china should be protected by the laws of this country concerned .
how can an aircraft like this still enjoy the right of immunity ?
therefore , after clearly finding out the truth of facts , the chinese side can surely detain this aircraft of the united states .
but we did not shoot it down but took the safety of the aircraft and the life of its crewmembers into consideration . we did handle it in a sufficiently rational manner .
however , this should happen on the premise that the united states must undertake the legal responsibility of violating the international law and the state sovereignty of china . otherwise , the chinese people will not just let them go !
if the united states wants to use this incident to threaten china with its arms sales to taiwan , it is not appropriate nor feasible .
to this , the united states should also demonstrate its sincerity and apologize to the chinese side .
this demand of the chinese side is legal , rational , reasonable , and completely correct .
whether this incident can be properly handled or not will have a bearing on the development of sino - us relations in the future .
shi yinhong who is a famous chinese expert in international relations pointed out that the happening of this incident of the collision between sino - us aircrafts was not accidental .
nevertheless , this kind of unilateral judgment of the us side regarding sino - us relations coming to china [ lai hua , as received ] harming china 's interests is not wise nor comprehensive .
however , shi yinhong said that after meeting with yang jiechi who is the chinese ambassador stationed in the united states on 5 april , the us secretary of state powell said that the us side expressed regret over the missing chinese pilot .
even though the us government still refuses to make an apology to china over this incident of collision of aircrafts , this development can be regarded as a positive change .
and the relaxation and solution of a crisis often starts from a small progress .

strong reaction the " kyoto protocol " was adopted by the un weathers conference in japan 's kyoto at the end of 1997 . the agreement calls for cutting emissions of greenhouse gases below the 1990 level by 5.2 percent from 2008 to 2012 by developed countries .
the adoption of the agreement marked an important step taken by mankind to forestall planet - wide warming .
president bill clinton signed the protocol in 1999 .
president bush on 28 march announced that the unites states would not implement the " kyoto protocol . " it has aroused strong reaction among us allies including eu countries and japan .

the united states is a country with the largest emissions of harmful gases . its population only accounts for less than five percent , but its emissions of harmful gases account for one - fourth of the total quantity of emissions in the world .

since the us military reconnaissance plane bombed into and destroyed china 's military fighter and illegally intruded into china 's airspace and landed at china 's territory , us government and military officials have not only ignored our solemn and just demands but also resorted to sophistry by every means and raised unreasonable demands .
such a hegemonic conduct of the united states has evoked the great indignation of the chinese people and has also been censured by most international public opinions . 1 .
the point - blank military reconnaissance activities conducted by the us military reconnaissance plane in the skies above china 's exclusive economic zone surpassed the scope of the " overflight freedom " stipulated by the international law .
the us military reconnaissance plane bombed into and destroyed china 's fighter while conducting military reconnaissance activities in the airspace covering china 's exclusive economic zone .
everybody who has little , elementary knowledge of the international law knows that the exclusive economic zone is the major outcome of the long - term struggle waged by numerous developing countries for their legal rights and interests after world war ii .
according to the relevant stipulations of the 1982 " un convention on the law of the sea , " exclusive economic zones are neither territorial waters nor international waters , and they themselves have formed a category of regions with a special legal regime .
this indicates that the freedom of overflight enjoyed by a state in another state 's exclusive economic zone is not an absolute freedom , but is added with conditions and restrictions .
of course , this kind of rights include the right of overflight freedom enjoyed by the planes of the coastal state , the right of sovereignty over the natural resources in the zone , the right of jurisdiction over the zone , and the right of safeguarding the security and interest of the coastal state .
failing to faithfully perform this obligation means abusing and violating the principle of " overflight freedom . " so , it is only right and proper that china is entitled to take necessary measures .
when two sides ' military aircraft meet in the international airspace , the two sides shall abide by the present international law and the international practice and shall give due consideration to the flight safety of the opposite side in order to prevent dangerous approach and avoid collision .
however , the us military plane did not respect this consensus at all , nor did it observe the flight rules stipulated by the international aviation convention .
such a behavior of the us plane violated the relevant stipulations of the international aviation convention and sabotaged the china - us consensus . therefore , the united states must assume all responsibilities . 3 .
the us military reconnaissance plane 's intrusion into china 's territorial airspace and landing at china 's airport without application in advance and china 's permission constituted a serious infringement upon china 's territorial sovereignty .
as everybody knows , every state has the complete and exclusive right over the airspace above its territory , and this sovereign principle has been generally recognized by all the states in the world .
the article 2 of the " prc law on civil aviation " stipulates : " the prc enjoys the complete and exclusive sovereignty over its territorial airspace . "
the so - called complete and exclusive sovereignty means that the state exercises a complete jurisdiction and control over its territorial airspace .
this convention interprets national aircraft as the aircraft used by military , customs , and police authorities .
the us military reconnaissance plane which is the national aircraft of the united states intruded into china 's territorial airspace and landed at china 's airport without the permission of the chinese government . thus , it seriously violated the stipulations of the international law .
during the whole process of colliding with china 's military fighter , intruding into the airspace of china 's territorial waters , and landing at china 's airport , the us military reconnaissance plane did not issue any entrance or landing request to the chinese side .
however , the us military plane did not do so . thus , the us plane 's arbitrary intrusion into china 's territorial airspace constitutes an infringement upon china 's sovereignty and a threat to china 's national security and interest .
so , the chinese side has every reason to raise just demands and to take necessary measures against the incident . even some us legal experts also maintain : " the wording that the us reconnaissance plane is like the us sovereign territory is entirely groundless .
after the chinese government conducts an all - round investigation of this incident , the us government should give compensation to the chinese side .

air force defense strength the sophisticated air defense weapons of the air force are primarily the su-27 fighter plane , the tu-30 multi - purpose fighter , the " feibao " attack plane , the j-7, and j-8 fighter planes .
the su-27 is the new generation of russian - made supersonic , all - weather heavy fighter plane .
it has a sustained flying time of up to five hours and can intercept intruding bombers a great distance from the coastline .
the " feibao " ( fbc - 1 ) is a two - seat , twin engine multi - purpose , all - weather supersonic fighter / bomber plane developed entirely by china using its own resources .
it employs variable sweep aircraft technology .
this plane has seven external connections , and has strong attack capabilities .
the maximum operational speed is 1,210 km per hour , and the maximum level flight mach number is 1.7 .
the flight control system is composed of a 3 - axis control stability augmentation , automatic stability augmentation and auto pilot systems , achieving a high degree of automation in the on - board equipment .

right - wing textbook sallies forth this revision by japan of her history textbooks began last year .
in april 2000 , many publishers in japan sent their manuscripts for history books to the ministry of education , culture , science and technology , and among these manuscripts was the new history textbook written by the history textbook committee which denies the invasive history of japan and beautifies the history of war .
after the contents of the manuscript were released , a strong reaction was set off both inside and outside of japan , with the vain attempt of the japanese right - wing factions to promote militarism meeting serious criticism from china and both koreas .
under the serious concerns of china , and both koreas , the japanese government 's ministry of education , culture , science and technology made a few revisions to these right - wing textbooks that distorted the facts .
however , these few revisions failed to thoroughly eradicate the influence of the imperialist historical view , and there was still beautification and whitewashing of japan 's aggressive history . the resistance put up by the peoples of asia was omitted , and their determination and actions to obtain freedom were twisted and vilified .
consequently , the ministry of education , culture , science and technology became the lead agency of the japanese government in approval of textbooks , and has the responsibility to thoroughly revise the untrue descriptions in the manuscripts in accordance with the countries clause .
but in actuality , the manuscript still retains serious problems in terms of both historical viewpoint and historical facts after these revisions .

"

since a us military reconnaissance plane bumped into and destroyed a chinese military plane on 1 april , the united states has been refusing to admit its mistake and trying to seek a so - called international legal rationale to shirk its responsibility .
as such , it is necessary to analyze from an international legal principle viewpoint the us act violating international law in the incident so we can see just on which side the responsibility should lie .
from a legal principle viewpoint , whether or not an act violates international law mainly depends on whether or not the act simultaneously meets the four conditions that constitute an international illegal act . the four conditions are the subject important condition , subjective important condition , object important condition , and objective important condition .
then , do the series of acts on the part of the united states in the plane collision incident simultaneously meet the four conditions that constitute an international illegal act ?
first , judging from subject important condition , the subject of an international illegal act can only be a state or an international organization , and an individual and a social organization cannot be a subject violating international law .
therefore , the act of the us military personnel and the reconnaissance plane 's being state - owned decide that the united states is the subject violating international law in the incident .
third , judging from object important condition , the object encroached upon in an international illegal act is the international legal relations , which are protected by international law .
fourth , judging from objective important condition , an international illegal act is a kind of concrete act that violates international law and results in some kind of social harm . the act is mainly being unlawful , being harmful , being concrete , and consists of other essential acts .
as analyzed above , us behavior in the incident simultaneously consists of the four important conditions that constitute an international illegal act , and therefore , we completely can affirm the unlawfulness of its act .

all was quiet at the barracks located at the foot of the mount yan .
after undergoing training for a whole week , the recruits were still sleeping soundly in dreamland .
within five minutes , some 600 fully armed recruits had already assembled in lines on a drill ground .
in the meantime , more than 10 camouflaged support vehicles had begun leaving for a designated assembly zone .
all of a sudden , an originally relaxing sunday had been filled with tension .
we reporters got on a field command vehicle , which was equipped with all sorts of advanced command apparatuses .
the frozen river had begun melting , and the grass had begun sprouting , for the weather had turned warm . however , after leaving their barracks , the recruits had no time to watch the natural scenery , for they knew that countless hardships and difficulties were waiting for them on their way forward .
at noontime , camouflaged single soldiers began hiding themselves on a barren hill or an open field - - a long camouflaged dragon turned invisible on an open field by noon 19 march , the recruits had entered a thickly forested hill full of sheer precipices , overhanging rocks , and wide and deep gorges .
all of a sudden , the recruits heard the ear - piercing sound of an " air raid " alarm .
after the air raid , the recruits began digging more than 100 bunkers at once , waving picks , spades , and shovels . each bunker could accommodate three to five soldiers . some recruits wearing camouflage uniforms began skillfully covering up the bunkers with the camouflage materials the brigade had developed for use in a hilly area .
in the twinkling of an eye , the 600 recruits turned invisible on the hilly land .
searching at a low altitude , it discovered no traces of the troops .
since the " enemy " had sealed off a narrow valley , the support vehicles failed to show up , and the recruits had no food to eat .
" look , there are black fruits hanging from a dried tree on the hillside . they are wild fruits , are n't they ? " said a soldier , putting down his telescope .
it was only natural that the recruits had thought about finding some dried fruit on a piece of barren , wild , and uninhabited land .
after analyzing the situation , fu shibo , commander of a recruits ' company , immediately ordered some soldiers to get the wild fruits .
the hungry soldiers finally found something to eat . after gobbling up their " meal , " they immediately set off along a mountain path , and traveled for more than one hour .
after receiving an order from brigade chief of staff feng xiansheng , the first echelon formation , which comprised five female recruits , including jia chengfang , set out .
by 0325 the next day , the first group of the second echelon formation had found the third " information " site . in accordance with the " information , " they quickly set off for the precipice located on the " cliff mountain . "
by 0450 the next day , a shock team of recruits suddenly heard gunshots and roars of cannons in the front and received the following order : " position : 15 - - 00 ; distance : 800 meters ; the ' enemy 's ' observation post ; destroy it ! "
