a major factor that causes the disorderly condition to the economic activities is the short - sighted behavior of the economic entities .
traditionally , we did not have a firm sense of creditability and did not have a strong sense of abiding by laws and regulations , so some economic entities began to do business in an immoral and illegal way for seeking higher profits , and began to do something benefiting themselves at the expense of others .
the credit system is the primary cornerstone of the modern market economy .
the improvement of the market economic order cannot completely rely on the self - discipline behavior of the economic entities . forming a set of effective operational mechanisms and management systems and building a competent market managing contingent is a necessity in the development of the socialist market economic system .
at present , we cannot just generally say that the legal system is not perfect and there is no rule to follow , nor can we complain that the supervisory and law enforcement departments are short of working funds and manpower , or their work efficiency is not high enough .
actually , the main problem is the ineffectiveness in the enforcement of the established laws and regulations , and it is quite common that illegal activities are not stopped and those acting against the laws are not punished .
in some cases , the quality of the law enforcing personnel was lousy , they did not strictly abide by discipline , and even colluded with lawless people .
in some government departments and law enforcement institutions and also in some go - between organizations in society , irregularities and malpractices existed extensively .
therefore , increasing the strictness and effectiveness of law enforcement is the most important factor for really improving the order of the market economy .
in short , when facing the current important task of straightening out and regularizing the order of the market economy , we must clearly size up the situation , unify our thinking , explicitly assign tasks , properly plan and arrange the relevant work by taking effective measures to solve the existing problems .
straightening out and regularizing the order of the market economy is a long - term task , requiring both measures for solving existing problems and providing fundamental guarantees .
the work should be done in the key fields first , and should also be advanced across the board . there should be long - term plans , and also targets for the current stage .
this is a priority in the economic work throughout the implementation of the tenth five - year plan .
all activities that violate the regulations of market economy must be effectively checked and suppressed .
in the early stage of reform and opening up , comrade deng xiaoping set forth the important idea about " using both hands to grasp our work without any letup on either side . "
all these measures played an important role in eliminating the root causes and resolving the institutional problems , effectively checking the disorderly condition of market economy in some economic sectors and in some areas .
as long as we pay serious attention to the problems , adopt effective remedies and measures , and eradicate various soils for its appearance and expansion , then we can certainly bring about a fundamental turn for the better in the order of market economy .
this indicated that the work of regularizing the market economic order entered a new stage . a new campaign for straightening out and improving the market environment has been started in the whole country .
thus , in the course of implementing the spirit of the meeting and making work arrangements , special attention should be paid to following points : strengthening leadership should be integrated with mobilizing the masses , increasing the effectiveness of the remedy measures , and also increasing the driving force for the remedy measures .
principal departments should effectively perform their functions , strengthen coordination , take joint actions ; the responsibility system for administration and law enforcement should be carried out .
at the same time , it is necessary to mobilize the extensive participation of the broad masses .
in a market economy , consumers are market participants and also market supervisors . to mobilize the masses , it is necessary to first protect the legitimate interests of the masses .
when the rights and interests of the masses are harmed in the course of consumption , the relevant departments should handle the cases without delay , thus effectively safeguarding the interests of the masses .
if our administrative and judicial organs react slowly to the complaints from the masses , or even shield and abet the responsible parties by replacing sentences with fines , then the evildoers will become more arrogant and unscrupulous in harming the masses .
therefore , it is necessary to further advance the reform of the administrative system , further separate government institutions from enterprises , transform the administrative functions , and reduce the administrative procedures for examination and approval .
it is also necessary to further quicken the reform of the monopolized trades , introduce the mechanism of competition , change the situation in which the government acts as a " player " and a " referee " at the same time .
the results of regularizing the market order should be consolidated and expanded effectively .
commercial ethical education , mainly the sense of credit , should be strengthened . the enforcement of the laws and the improvement of the moral standards should complement each other in the maintenance of the market order so that a solid foundation for the continuous improvement of the market economic order can be laid .

the revised textbook tries to cover up the attempt to distort and rewrite the history of the japanese aggressive war , only to make it more conspicuous .
from any perspective , lianhe zaobao continues , the purpose of japan 's new history textbook is not to teach its new generation how to get a correct understanding of history , but to imbue its young people with the concept that " japan has a valid reason to start a war at that time . "
as stated in a report by that paper , the controversy over the revision of the history textbook commenced in 1982 .

the crux of the japanese history textbooks is attempt to beautify the war of aggression waged by japanese militarism and completely change the traditional evaluation of the war of aggression .
the textbooks use the " gangster logic " to explain japan 's war of aggression , holding that war means killing people and " japan is no exception . " what is actually meant is that it is logical that japan should have killed people in the war .
all these arguments , which confuse right and wrong and confound black and white , are attempts to cover up japan 's criminal history of aggression with a " beautiful veil " and deceive the future generations so as to attain the aim of completely changing the traditional evaluation of the war of aggression .
the third is that the right - wing forces have evolved into an adverse political current .

between 1994 and 2000 , the taiwan authorities imported weapons and equipment worth more than $ 15 billion , which accounted for 11 percent of arms and munitions sales in the world , thus putting taiwan in the first place .
this year 's " national defense " budget has increased 6.7 percent over that of last year 's ; the secret portion of military spending has reached nt $ 58.3 billion .
taking a panoramic view of the military spending of the taiwan authorities in the past half a century , one finds that the proportion of their military spending to their financial budget has always been large .
the statistics based only on official data announced by the taiwan authorities show : the average figure for the 50 's was 46.5 percent ; 41.83 percent for the 60 's ; 28.19 percent for the 70 's ; 22.44 percent for the 80 's ; 24.92 percent for the 90 's .
such a gigantic amount of defense spending will certainly bring about a negative influence to taiwan 's economic development and the livelihood of its people .
but when the weather changes , half of the water in the saucer will dry up under a scorching sun .
therefore , if taiwan wishes to achieve a steady and firm development for its economy , it should not depend solely on foreign investment . it must integrate its technology and management experiences with the mainland 's resources , manpower , and markets , using the mainland as its hinterland . only thus can there be further development .
but if the spending for the purchase of weapons each year can be saved , the amount may reach thousands of billions of new taiwan dollars .
besides , reconstruction following the " 21 september " earthquake requires nt $ 150 billion ; " health care " expenses for the people of taiwan are growing at a deficit rate of nt $ 4.4 billion a month ; the amount of unemployment compensation fees on the island still requires more than nt $ 10 billion .
as each category of expenses is extremely urgent , money is urgently needed .
under these circumstances , the taiwan authorities recently handed to the us 30 arms and munitions purchase plans worth more than $ 30 billion , equivalent to nt $ 1,000 billion .
however , it is regrettable that the taiwan authorities have not done so . on the contrary , they have used a large sum of badly needed money for the so - called " national defense " spending .
selling weapons to taiwan will eventually harm the united states ' owned interests selling arms to taiwan is like a double - bladed sword .
any sensible person will be able to see this fact : compared with ten years ago , great changes have taken place in the situation in the mainland of china and taiwan and in the trade relations between china and the united states .
the import growth rate has increased at an average rate of 12.99 percent a year . china has become the united states ' fourth largest trading partner , while the united states has become china 's largest trading partner .
meanwhile , us investment in china in the recent ten years has been increasing at an average rate of 25.4 percent , with the aggregate volume reaching $ 28.11 billion by 2000 .
in particular , the acceleration of reform and opening to the outside world in china has also provided more trading opportunities for the united states and for the entire world .
but in the 21 years between 1979 and 2000 , us arms sales to taiwan only created a profit of $ 41 billion . besides , this has become the greatest obstacle to the development of sino - us relations .
it can be said that the prospects of trade between china and the united states will be inestimable so long as sino - us relations develop in a normal way .
in particular , after china 's accession to the wto , it is expected that more american enterprises will come to make long - term investment in the chinese market , which is increasingly opening wider to the outside world .
to maintain this win - win healthy development of sinn - us trade relations , it is necessary to have a stable and peaceful environment as a prerequisite .
but the growth of the independence forces will certainly make dialogue on the basis of the principle of one china between the two sides of the strait more difficult and will also aggravate tensions in this region and even in east asia as a whole .
thus , arms sales to taiwan will , in the end , not only affect sino - us relations but also create an enormous negative influence for us investment and trading activities in china and the surrounding regions , thereby eventually harming the united states own interests .
the united states is the largest commodity exporting country , capital importing country , and debtor nation in the world . nearly 80 percent of its people do not directly engage in material production . its virtual economy accounts for 156 percent of its material economy .
one third of us markets are in the east asian region .

from a long - term point of view , the best policy for the united states is to have contacts and exchanges with china . "
therefore , adopting a method of creating enemy internationally to elevate oneself is the most preposterous and laughable conduct .
compared with the national interests of china and the united states and the prospects of long - term economic cooperation and development between the two countries , the small amount of money earned by the united states through arms sales to taiwan is but a very little amount .
they should recognize that china and the united states have sufficient reason to live in peace with one another and that china 's peaceful reunification and further development accord with the interests of the world , including those of the united states .
under these circumstances , the us government should adopt measures to develop its economy in order to stimulate growth in the world 's economy instead of using the method of increasing arms sales , promoting an arms race , and enhancing tensions and instability in the region to expand its needs .
therefore , although the development of the world 's economy is very much unbalanced , yet the potential of development of the world 's economy is still large . the united states has not reached the stage where it needs to increase arms sales to adjust its economic contradictions .
on the contrary , the us economy can maintain the trend of sustained growth only if there is peace and prosperity in the entire world .
the way out is returning to the one - china principle and realizing the principle of reunification and one country , two systems . only thus can there be an outcome with the lowest cost , the most dependable result , and the best effect , which benefits all sides .
the strong motherland after reunification will always be a reliable guarantee for taiwan 's security .
according to available reference material , the us reconnaissance plane that collided with our military fighter and caused trouble came from us kadena air base .
the kadena air base is located in the southwestern region of the island of okinawa . it is the largest us military air force base in the far east with an area of 19.976 square km . right now , more than 9,000 military personnel are stationed there .
the military base is well equipped including many barracks , telecommunication facilities , housing areas , golf courses , movie theaters , and schools .
the history of the us occupation of the kadena air base may be traced back to the period prior to the iwo jima campaign launched by the us armed forces during world war ii .
a local construction company built a simple small airfield near a small village called kadena .
that airfield was the major target of the us armed forces in its iwo jima campaign .
in addition to combat troops , the us armed forces have also deployed six air force units and troops of other military services .
right now , air force units stationed at this base include the 390 intelligence squadron , the 82 nd reconnaissance squadron , the 18 th wing intelligence detachment , and the 353 rd special operations group .
stationed at this air force base , the us reconnaissance planes often come and go in the west pacific region . the kadena air base has become an important frontier base of the us armed forces to collect intelligence and spy on other countries .

11 april , beijing ( xinhua ) - - it has been 10 days since a us military reconnaissance plane bumped into and destroyed a chinese military plane on 1 april . can wang wei , the pilot of the chinese military plane who was ejected from the plane , still survive ?
liu feng , an expert in aerial rescue , said , minus a miracle , the possibility of wang wei 's survival is very small .
because the food , sea water desalination device , and other items critical to survival were all on the life raft , if the raft was accidentally separated from him , he would be unable to get any drinking water and food and therefore it would be difficult to hold out for 72 hours under normal conditions .
liu feng said : if the ejection was normal , the life raft was intact , wang wei had no problems separating himself from the survival chute , and the food and sea water desalination device were correctly used , he also could only survive for 72 hours .
liu feng said : although the possibility of wang wei 's survival is extremely small , a miracle cannot be ruled out .
this incident has yet to be completely settled .

new york , 12 apr (zxs) - - the incident about the midair collision between a chinese and a us aircraft had eventually had an important turn . on 11 april , us ambassador plenipotentiary prueher delivered a letter of apology to the chinese government on behalf of the us government .

in my view , the main experiences we have gained from obtaining the preliminary results are these five : first , we must give top priority to the interests of the whole .
by this , i mean sino - us relationship .
while this incident was being handled , both chinese and us leaders were able to give first priority to safeguarding sino - us relationship and subordinate the considerations of other secondary issues to the interests of the whole , namely sino - us relationship , thus keeping the handling of the issue from interferences from certain quarters .
first of all , we should not become " arrogant . "
the united states and china must respect each other and convince the other side by means of reason .
acting like this will not help solve any problem . secondly , we must not act rashly . a complex issue takes a long time before it can be resolved .
not acting rashly is not the same as deliberate procrastination .
fourth , a consultative spirit and a cooperative attitude are essential .
this time , the chinese side acted reasonably to safeguard its interests in a restrained manner and treated the american crewmen in a humanitarian spirit ; and the american side was also receptive to the chinese side 's views and requests .
fifth , the energetic support and coordination of american and chinese people are essential .

comrade zhao shiyan was a pioneer in the chinese communist movement and one of the founders of the cpc organization .
in order to find the truth for saving the country and people , he traveled far away by going to france for part - work and part - study .
in the practice of revolutionary struggle , he acknowledged marxism as the sole truth for proletarian revolution and thus devoted himself to lofty faith in the communist cause , and actively threw himself into activity for founding the cpc .
he was chief editor of the party 's internal publication zhengzhi shenghuo [ political life ] , which played an important role in enhancing the level of marxist ideology and politics in the party .
from 1924 to 1926 , he personally wrote more than 70 highly influential articles propagating marxism and attacking the malaise of the times .
comrade zhao shiyan made important contributions to ideological and theoretical building and propaganda work in the party 's early days .

beijing , 15 apr ( xinhua ) - - on the morning of 1 april , a us ep-3 military reconnaissance plane flew over china 's hainan island 's coastal waters to conduct a military reconnaissance activity .
in accordance with the existing principles of international law , although a country enjoys freedom of flight in the airspace over another country 's exclusive economic zone , this freedom of flight is not unrestricted . when a country performs this freedom of flight , it is restricted by the relevant rules of international law .
article 58 of the 1982 un convention on maritime law provides that a country only enjoys freedom of flight in the airspace over another country 's exclusive economic zone under restrictions by the relevant rules of the convention .
according to article 56 of the convention , a coastal country is entitled to other rights specified by the convention , apart from enjoying the right to exploit , utilize , raise , and manage the natural resources of its exclusive economic zone .
these provisions indicate that " other rights " of a coastal country over its exclusive economic zone include its sovereignty and territorial integrity being free from violation as well as its right to protect its national security and peace and other rights granted by international law .
based on this , when a country 's plane performs freedom of flight in the airspace over another country 's exclusive economic zone , it must respect the coastal country 's sovereignty and territorial integrity and must not harm the coastal country 's national security and peace .
in this plane collision incident , the offending us plane was not an ordinary aircraft , but a military reconnaissance plane carrying state - of - the - art electronic reconnaissance equipment .
its fly - across activity over china 's exclusive economic zone was not an ordinary one , but a military reconnaissance activity directed at china . the activity was not an isolated one , nor was it accidental .
they violate a basic principle of international law , which says that countries should respect each other 's sovereignty and territorial integrity . the chinese side has always resolutely opposed such threatening and provocative acts of the us side , and has on numerous occasions raised strong protests to express china 's solemn stance on the issue .
in fact , tracking and monitoring foreign military aircraft flying over the country 's coastal waters is a conventional practice of countries around the world .
the united states is especially outstanding in such practice .
as pointed out bluntly by francis boyle , professor of international law at the us illinois state university , if china carries out acts in the united states ' air defense identification zone similar to the us military airplanes ' actions over china 's coastal waters , the united states will absolutely not tolerate it .
after colliding with and destroying the chinese plane , the us plane entered china 's territorial airspace without permission and landed at china 's military airport , seriously violating china 's territorial sovereignty .
this principle was first specified in the " paris treaty on aviation management " of 1919 .
the treaty 's article 1 clearly stipulates : signatories to the treaty recognize that every country has complete and exclusive sovereignty over its territorial airspace . "
the act violating this rule is considered an infringement upon the territorial sovereignty of another country , and that country has the right to stop this infringement in any form allowable by the international law .
it is very clear that the act of encroachment upon china 's sovereignty is illegal .
the us side defended and said that its plane was in danger after the collision incident , and that under this situation , out of the emergency to avoid danger , it is not illegal to enter china 's territorial airspace and land on china 's territory without permission .
the so - called " avoiding of an emergency " put forward by the us side simply cannot be used as a legal basis for absolving the plane that caused the incident of its illegal nature of violating china 's territory and sovereignty . moreover , the dangerous situation the us plane was in was brought about by itself .
the chinese side absolutely could have taken necessary coercive measures in accordance with the right for self - protection stipulated in international law against such a foreign military plane that illegally entered china 's territorial airspace and landed on an airfield inside a military prohibited zone in china .
after the plane collision occurred , the us side did not offer any apology [ biao shi ren he qian yi ] , but asked china to immediately return the plane that caused the incident together with its crew and tried with threats to prevent china from embarking the plane for inspection .
in order to legalize this rude and unreasonable demand , the us side even made up the absurd argument that the us military plane causing the incident was a part of its territory and us state property and therefore , was eligible for sovereign immunity .
the established international law principle on this issue is that it is possible for foreign military forces ( including military personnel and military installations ) to enjoy sovereign immunity in a country , that is , they do not come within the jurisdiction of that country , only if that country has agreed to do so .
that already constituted an incident of serious violation of international law .
in the plane collision incident , the illegal acts of the united states mentioned above very seriously encroached upon china 's rights , interests and dignity .
according to reports , the ep-3 surveillance plane which collided with and destroyed a chinese plane along the southeastern coast of china 's hainan island is equipped with all kinds of electronic systems , such as radars , radio waves , emails and facsimile machines , for collecting china 's electronic information for the us national security bureau .
in their activities along china 's coastal areas , us surveillance planes often threatened chinese pilots by all kinds of dangerous movements and provocative actions , such as slowing down and making rapid ascents or descents , sudden change of direction and sharp bands .
thus , there could be similar incidents and the healthy and steady development of bilateral relations would be seriously affected if us planes did not stop their surveillance activities along china 's coastal areas .
the paper said that the surveillance activities of us planes along china 's coastal areas had befouled the international atmosphere and undermined peace and stability in asia and the world .
after the incident of the collision and destruction of the chinese plane , the international community all stood up to denounce the hegemonic deeds of the united states and pointed out that this incident had destroyed peace and stability in the asia - pacific region and the world .
the paper went on to say that the surveillance activities of us planes along china 's coastal areas also violated china 's relevant laws .
thus , china 's is doing something that is completely just and legal conducting investigations into the incident of the collision and destruction of a chinese plane by a us spy plane .

in less than three months , the japanese army occupied the three provinces in china 's northeastern region .
in 1932 , the japanese imperial army seized pu yi and founded the puppet manchukuo by announcing the secession of china 's northeastern region from china . on 10 march of the same year , the japanese imperial army forced pu yi to sign a secret agreement with japan .
on 15 september of the same year , the puppet manchukuo and japan signed the so - called " japan - manchukuo protocol , " under which the manchukuo recognized japan 's enjoying all types of privileges in northeast china .
hence , the japanese imperial army became the overlord of the puppet manchukuo , and northeast china completely became japan 's colony .
the japanese aggressors committed indescribable crimes against the chinese people in northeast china , trampling the beautiful lands of northeast china and making it suffer a calamity .
the number of enslaved labor workers increased with each passing year . in 1942 , the japanese imperial army caught nearly 1 million labor workers ; in 1943 , the number caught was 1.2 million ; in 1944 , 1.3 million ; and in 1945 , 1.6 million .
these two departments were renamed " unit 731 " and " unit 100 " in june 1940 .
" unit 731 " was established at pingfang , near harbin . it had more than 3,000 personnel and was mainly engaged in cultivating germs causing plague , cholera , and typhoid fever , and also other types of germs .
during the process of research , chinese , koreans , mongolians , and citizens of the soviet union were used for living body experiments and vivisection . each year five to 600 people were slaughtered .
unit 100 , established at fanjiatun , was an institute especially engaging in cultivating and manufacturing glanders , anthrax , and pest bacteria .
in 1940 and 1941 , " unit 731 " used aircraft to scatter plague - carrying fleas in areas surrounding ningbo and changde . this caused many people in china 's zhejiang area to die after being infected by the germs .
when japan withdrew in retreat in 1945 , it scattered infectious disease - causing bacteria in various areas of northeast china . the resulting epidemic plague wrested the lives of more than one million chinese people .
during their rule of northeast china , the japanese colonialist rulers brought in capital and advanced machinery in order to satisfy their needs of frenziedly plundering china 's resources .
to realize their aims of monopolizing the economy of northeast china and of finally taking over the national economy of northeast china , the japanese colonialist rulers suppressed national capital and forcefully carried out the so - called policy of " integrating the economy of japan and that of manchukuo " in an attempt to rule northeast china economically .
as a result , between 1932 and 1944 , the japanese imperialists plundered a large quantities of gold , silver , grain food , and steel , and other materials from northeast china .

along with the application of high - tech weaponry to the military area , many new features of joint campaign have emerged .
how to intensify the reform of joint logistics systems and improve the efficiency of joint logistics support to meet the needs of joint campaign is an important task that our military should fulfill for military struggles .
revolutionary changes have taken place in joint operations and operational environments under high - tech conditions .
the emergence of man - made earth satellites , spaceports , space shuttles , deep - sea submarines , and spacecraft has made the expansion of operational space to an all - time high and turned out a four - dimensional battlefield where " land , sea , space , and air " are integrated into one .
the wide use of electronic weapons and information systems in the military area over the past few years has brought the tentacle of wars into electromagnetic space and thus created a five - dimensional battlefield where " land , sea , space , air , and electronics " are integrated into one .
multidimensions of operational environments have triggered a high combination of operational forces .
in terms of organizational structure , logistics forces for joint operations consist of general and specialized service forces , immobile and mobile service forces , and military and civilian service forces .
joint operations call for a corresponding increase in the ratio of logistics forces .
joint operations should be launched on informationized battlefields .
along with high consumption and diversification of goods and materials for operations , joint logistics subunits should quicken the tempo of building information networks and systems .
with high consumption of goods and materials ; complex structures ; various procurement , transportation , storage , distribution , and supply channels ; and difficulties in organizational coordination , modern joint operations cannot compare to previous wars .
at present , joint logistics subunits , without permanent channels to know the needs of the units that they serve , have been investigating and studying the situation of their service targets merely through visits or convocation of coordination meetings .
however , changes in service targets ' tasks , staff numbers , and personnel movement have , to a certain extent , affected joint logistics units ' service efficiency . so , needs for providing logistics services for joint operations cannot be met .
at present when the time is not ripe for resolving structural problems , joint logistics subunits within and outside the military should actively exchange information , so as to overcome the situation of " separation " between organizations and facilities through " combination " of information and attain the goal of improving service efficiency .
mobilizing and using local resources to provide logistics services is a fine tradition of our army .
in the information era when society relies more and more on networks , logistics service subunits should actively use local information networks to get to the situation with distribution of local resources , make mobilization plans and preparations through networks , and expand the " circulation of information , goods and materials , and energy and human resources . "
the new stage of joint logistics services of the three armed forces cannot be divorced from the " visual " assets of logistics units .
with information networks , joint logistics subunits should play a leading role in logistics support and acquire capacities to provide long - distance , consistent , and reliable support to all fronts through various means .
after implementation of joint logistics systems , joint logistics subunits should handle a large number of additional expenses , goods and materials , and information in the course of organizing logistics services .
to meet this changing situation , joint logistics units have been proceeding to their needs and trying all possible means to develop their own " local area networks " ; so it would be prone to cause waste of resources and make development platforms inconsistent .
they should make full use of state optical fiber , satellite , microwave communications , and other modern information transmission channels to ceaselessly expand their visual information networks .
along with the quick progress of operations and new changes in combat organization , joint logistics subunits are required to set up , in the course of reform , a well - organized command pattern in line with the law governing logistics support .
although coordination between logistics support and operational command is a general policy on warfare , it does not mean that logistics support systems must completely be identical with command systems .
from the perspective of our military research on joint operations , joint logistics subunits should foster a concept of command - - " appropriate separation , " " beyond control , " and " parallel coordination . "
future joint operations will no longer be protracted positional warfare to be carried out within limited space but they will be wars of quick decisions in need of quick mobilization and surprise attacks and to be launched within vast all - dimensional space .
joint logistics subunits should serve as a foundation for these four kinds of forces and command these forces in a unified manner .
joint logistics subunits should be subordinate to organizations for joint operations in theaters and organizations for joint operations in specific theaters and be in relationship of administrative subordination with logistics command organizations of joint operations units .
joint logistics subunits should mainly be subordinate to campaign army groups and responsible for joint command and support in specific theaters .
first is matrix and coordinate command .
second is direct command .
this form is applied either to copy with special situations or at a time when communications are inconvenient or when command rights and decision - making rights should be delegated to lower levels .
the us defense logistics agency , established in the 1960 s , is mainly responsible for providing logistics services for the three armed forces . up until now , 2.3 million of 4.2 million kinds of goods and materials used in the military have been brought under unified computer - based management .
it could be said that the transparency of battlefields had reached an all - time high in the history of warfare and many attack targets had been " determined " before the war .
joint logistics subunits should shift focus of construction from emergency support to overall support of all units and change focus of peacetime construction from emergency support to construction of rear bases and emergency mobile operations .
joint logistics subunits must exert efforts to resolve tough problems that affect rear bases ' prompt reaction capabilities and prompt receiving and transmitting capabilities , actively change ideas , bravely explore new ways , and strive to improve processing capabilities and speed .
armed forces should be prepared for wars and joint logistics support must not remain only at the level of " ensuring a thrifty life . "
so , we must concentrate more energy and thinking on operational services , go out of outdated ways through reform , and expand the dynamics of reform , so as to actually connect joint logistics systems and forms of services with joint operations .
now that it has become a consensus among various countries in the world that peaceful use of nuclear energy is beneficial to mankind , armed forces are expected to serve as a vital force in launching a rescue operation during a nuclear accident in peacetime .

large us companies has showed dissatisfaction at the change in the bush administration 's policy not because they are willing to spend large amounts of money on environmental protection or they favor the kyoto protocol so much .
fundamentally speaking , they did hope the bush administration would take measures to resist the kyoto protocol but not completely ignore the existence of the kyoto protocol and go its own way .
they understood that global warming is a problem that exists in reality and major greenhouse gas emitters like them would sooner or later be subjected to restrictions and limitations .
such being the case , these large us companies of course hoped the bush administration would not dissociate itself from the process of setting international environmental protection standards and instead would get relevant quotas lowered through bargaining to enable them to pay only a minimal price when being subjected to restrictions and limitations .
no wonder " business week " of the united states had to bawl at the bush administration : " mr. president , the real danger is that when you brush aside the issue of global warming you are greatly reducing the us business circles ' chance to gain the initiative in handling this issue . "
french president chirac told visiting us secretary of state powell that france and even all of europe were deeply concerned about this us decision : " we should respect a decision we ourselves made and we are responsible to our future generations . "
german environment minister jurgen trittin stressed : the kyoto protocol is the " basis for global climatic protection " and giving it up would be as good as the international community falling back a few more years in the struggle against global warming .
he fiercely lashed out at the us government for withdrawing from the kyoto protocol and considered the us action a major blow to the policy of international environmental cooperation .
in refusing to execute the kyoto protocol , the united states is taking a hostile action against people throughout the world , particularly children who will shoulder the future .

china , brazil , south korea , cuba , iran , and other developing countries also severely criticized this us decision , speaking against the united states ' domineering act of pursuing " unilateralism " in handling international affairs .
un secretary general annan believed the united states made an " unfortunate " decision and hoped the united states could change its mind .
he also stressed , however , that the international community 's determination to go all out to promote the cause of environmental protection will not change , regardless of the us stand : " global warming is a problem that exists in reality and there are sufficient scientific bases for proving this .
an eu official even said : the eu diplomatic effort will not stop unless all countries canvassed by the eu express support for its stand of acting on its own in the event the united states does not participate .
the eu indicated the hope that the united states could return to the stand of executing the kyoto protocol before the united nations convenes a conference on climatic issues in bonn , germany this july .
nevertheless , the overall target of reduction in greenhouse gas emissions is not among the items to be discussed .

beginning in 2001 , japan 's policy on aid to china will undergo a major adjustment .
the actual method will be : china will propose a list of projects corresponding to a three - year amount of funds , from which some projects will be selected in consultation with the japanese , and the yen loan will not be obtained until there is agreement on the projects .
there is no fixed annual amount of funding , which is instead entirely based on the cumulative total of the projects .
japan states that this method increases flexibility and facilitates annual adjustments based on changes in the economic situation , thereby increasing the practical efficiency of the loans .
however , from the chinese perspective the new method presents higher requirements - - projects must satisfy the japanese requirements while at the same time being urgently needed by china and capable of producing benefits . otherwise , the amount of funding from the yen loans may decrease .
yen loans are one of the japanese government 's main forms of economic assistance to china .
against this backdrop , there are increasing calls in japan to reduce the amount of foreign aid . aid to china has also been criticized , and some have even proposed reducing aid to china 30 percent .
actually , adjustments have been taking place in the last four yen loans in the amount and the area of distribution , which is reflected in fewer infrastructure , industrial , energy , and transportation projects , and more projects relating to environmental protection , education and the central and western regions .
shabenxinxing gives high marks to the chinese government on its use of the yen loans .
the japanese government always believes in the reputation of the chinese government and its ability to repay the loans .
according to informed sources , as of january , china has already used 1.6539 trillion yen in yen loans , and has repaid 571.4 billion yen in principal and interest .

according to the circular , at present , the plans for monetizing housing distribution have been proposed by the great majority of cities and counties throughout the country , and the monetized housing distribution system has been instituted in many cities and counties .
the incomes from the sales of public houses must not be retained or diverted to other uses on any account .
the circular stresses that after an organ or institution has suspended the housing distribution in kind and practiced the monetary distribution , it must not , in principle , build houses for staff and workers any longer either by itself or with others , and its financial budget should exclude funds for building houses .
this move will standardize the order of real estate market fees , lighten the burdens of enterprises engaged in real estate development and property buyers , and promote the healthy development of housing construction .
the " circular " stresses that various localities should strictly control the fees for housing construction . except those prescribed by state laws and regulations , no new administrative and institutional fee items that involve housing construction should be introduced in the near future , and the fee standards for the retained items should not be increased .
those who do not abide by the stipulations and fail to cancel fee collection , lower fee standards , or continue to collect fees under disguised forms should be strictly investigated and dealt with according to pertinent stipulations , and relevant persons responsible for them should be subjected to disciplinary sanction .

i remember that a chinese scholar living in canada once made an estimate according to which , if sino - us economic exchange is completely cut off , china 's unemployment population will increase by several million people and the us ' will increase by a few hundred thousand .
this consequence will hurt both sides and the key issue is who will be able to bear the burden of loss .
although the us unemployment population resulting from a sino - us trade war will be smaller than china 's , i believe that the united states will be more unable to bear the consequence because us interests groups of various trades and public opinion will apply great pressure on the government and congress .
regarding the pntr bill , zhang yuyan said : the united states has been playing this card for years . china and the united states had more intense friction than the current one , such as lee teng - hui 's [ li denghui ] visit to the united states and the bombing of the chinese embassy in belgrade .
following those incidents , although sino - us relations sank to unprecedented low ebbs , no bigger problems concerning china 's pntr status , then called most - favored - nation [ mfn ] status , arose .
judging from this viewpoint , the intentions of some us congressmen in making excessively radical remarks are nothing but to serve the purposes of deterrence , coercion , and warning . so , in the end , this will not change the overall sino - us relations .
on the whole , sino - us relations are becoming more mature .
however , such maturity does not mean that there will not be any friction and conflicts between the two countries , but , instead , will enable the two countries , in case of a crisis , to remove all kinds of interference and sit down to rationally seek an appropriate solution through negotiations .

i anticipate that the united states will never give up conducting reconnaissance flight in the airspace above china 's coastal waters .

the sino - us ties will undergo a test in this negotiation .

western hostile forces are vigorously advocating that the armed forces should be " separated from the party " [ fei dang hua ] , " depoliticized " [ fei zheng zhi hua ] , and " placed under the state " [ guo jia hua ] .
" separating the armed forces from the party " totally distorts the inherent relationship between the armed forces and the political party .
the armed forces have their origin in class and class struggle and are the instrument that a certain class uses to fulfill its political task .
western armies are absolutely not " separated from the party " ; although they are not subordinate to control by any particular political party , whichever party is in power , it is a matter of bourgeois parties taking turns to hold power , and the armed forces are always under the leadership of a bourgeois political party .
the reason why western countries practice this system is because the bourgeoisie there exercises and consolidates its rule over these countries through a variety of parties holding power in turn ; in this pattern , although the armed forces are not directly led by any one political party , in the final analysis they belong to the bourgeoisie .
lenin sharply pointed out in 1906 that the armed forces cannot and should not stay neutral ; that the armed forces should not be concerned with politics is the slogan of the bourgeoisie and the hypocritical lackeys of the czarist government , and in fact they have consistently dragged the armed forces into reactionary politics .
today the armed forces of the west , headed by the united states , exert themselves in preaching that " human rights transcend sovereignty , " and " fighting for values , " and act as the " world policeman " everywhere , stirring up partial wars .
in today 's complex and ever - changing international and domestic situation , the officers and men of our armed forces must strengthen their political awareness , always remember their duties , and undertake at all times the political tasks assigned them by the party and people .
" placing the armed forces under the state " totally separates the integration of party leadership over the armed forces and state leadership over the armed forces .
the state is a class state which holds the ruling status , and the ruling class is generally led by the political party , and so state leadership of the armed forces and party leadership of the armed forces are identical .
although the " chief capitalist " - - the bourgeois state - - directly leads the armed forces in western countries , this cannot erase the true nature of bourgeois political party leadership over the armed forces .
in china the people 's liberation army is the armed force led by the party and also led by the state .
in overthrowing the former soviet union and the socialist countries of east europe , they regarded party leadership over the armed forces as an insuperable obstacle to be eliminated .
the western hostile forces have aimed at this point and are doing everything possible to sow discord between the armed forces and the party .
we must keep clear heads , continually strengthen our awareness of the " soul of the armed forces , " and build an ideological embankment for resisting the reactionary trend of thought of " separating the armed forces from the party , " " depoliticizing them , " and " placing them under the state . "
we should sharpen our political sensitivity , and recognize the whole by observing the part while properly fulfilling the demand that the party exercises absolute leadership over the military .
we should correct the way we think and ensure , in a down - to - earth and concrete manner , realization of the demand that the party exercises absolute leadership over the military .
we should straighten out the guiding thought for work and truly ensure realization of the demand that the party exercises absolute leadership over the military .
comrade jiang zemin pointed out : " the key to ensuring that the army is always put under the absolute leadership of the party lies in the proper selection of cadres and the training of a large number of reliable successors . "
comrade mao zedong said : after the political line is defined , cadres are the decisive factors .
in the army , the demand for the party 's advanced nature is fulfilled by upholding the absolute leadership of the party , and the proper use of cadres is particularly important .
our forefathers said : " he who has able and virtuous generals , his army is powerful and the country is prosperous ; he who lacks able and virtuous generals , his army is weak and the country is doomed to perish . "
we will select and appoint cadres according to the requirements of the " three represents " to always maintain the advanced nature of the contingent of cadres , and take it as the fundamental guiding ideology for personnel selection and appointment .
the important thinking of " three represents " has also set requirements for training and bringing up high - quality cadres under the new situation .
this thinking is a succinct summary of the correct world outlook , outlook on life , and concept on value for the communist party members , which has reflected the demands on cadres by the new situation and tasks , and embodied the unity in the criteria for political integrity and professional competence .
at present , a large number of young cadres are being selected to replenish the leading posts at various levels .
we should start our work with the young officers and men , and repeatedly intensify their awareness in military spirit to lay a solid foundation for training qualified successors .
beijing , 18 apr 18 ( xinhua ) - - at around 1500 [ beijing time ] today , china and the united states started negotiations on the incident in which a us military reconnaissance plane rammed a chinese military plane , and other related issues .
the incident in which a white policeman shot and killed a black caused large - scale race riots in this city for a time .
on 7 april , the 19 year - old black timothy thomas was chased and arrested by a white police officer .
according to information provided by the police , thomas had done nothing particularly bad , but was just suspected of 14 petty offenses , including driving without a license and not using a safety belt .
the citizens of cincinnati were extremely angry after this incident of acting with total disregard for human life occurred , and protest demonstrations developed into violent citywide racial clashes .
according to reports , more than 60 people were injured in the violent clashes and more than 100 were arrested by the police .
us president bush had to intervene by demanding that attorney general ashcroft consider a plan for helping the city to restore normal order .
it showed yet again that racial discrimination in america is deep rooted .
there are profound historical roots of racial discrimination in the united states .
since the first blacks from africa were shipped to the new world in 1619 , they were subject to discrimination and tragically forced into slavery .
although the slave system was abolished by the 13 th constitutional amendment of the us federal court in 1865 , slavery was not ended in the country on that account , and certain states only officially abolished slavery in march 1995 .
blacks are still suffering profound racial discrimination and have fully endured the bitterness of racial hatred .
actual racial segregation can be seen everywhere in america .
nearly 2 million native indians pass their days on the streets of the big cities , and 40 percent of them have nothing to eat for two or three days a week ; these are the poorest people in this richest country on earth .
blacks and other ethnic minorities have always been second - class citizens in the united states , and suffer political , economic , educational , and social security discrimination in varying degrees .
no black is chief executive of any of america 's 500 largest companies , and hardly any are senior executives or directors of wall street 's major investment companies .
in addition there are marked differences between whites and blacks in educational standards , employment rate , average wages , and so on .
according to a un investigation report , blacks and colored people in the united states are punished three or four times more heavily that whites for the same crime .
at the same time , american blacks have always lived under an unfair legal system .
indiscriminate use of violence by police , and police infringements of human rights , including inflicting their own punishment on blacks , trumping up charges , and illegally detaining them are common occurrences .
the united states used machineguns , flame - throwers , and tanks to subdue the headquarters of the davidian cult , while indiscriminately condemning china for banning according to law the " falungong " cult which has caused the deaths of over 1,000 people .

beijing , 18 apr (zxs) - - wu xiaoling , vice president of the people 's bank of china indicated in beijing that china will adopt six measures to cope with the challenges brought about by wto entry .
at the " chinese enterprise summit of the world economic forum 2001 " , wu xiaoling said that entering the world trade organization will create major changes in chinese economic and financial environments , and our financial operations will increasingly be subjected to the influence of international financial domains .
foreign financial institutions are gradually achieving treatment on par with chinese nationals , which represents both an opportunity and a challenge for reforms and development in chinese financial sectors .
looking at the opportunities , wto entry will help introduce foreign capital and improve china 's investment environment ; it will help promote the progress of chinese financial reform , enhance the overall quality and competitiveness of chinese financial sectors , and promote progress of internationalized chinese financial sectors .
at the same time , greater numbers of foreign capital banks entering the chinese market will challenge the chinese banking industry to scramble for high - quality clients and excellent management personnel and do better work with bank management systems and administrative mechanisms , and it will challenge the supervisory and administrative abilities of people 's bank of china .
first , we will speed up the pace of commercialized reforms in state - run financial enterprises .
we must , through such methods as self - investment by financial enterprises , increasing financial capital , issuing long - term bonds and other methods , expanding the capital funds of state - run commercial banks and bringing their capital sufficiency within reach of international specifications .
we must do a good job at managing the existing stock system of commercial banks and support them in speeding up their supplemental capital funds , and , in addition to specified source fund - raising through stock sales , we must promote public offerings of qualified commercial banks .
third , we will develop and improve financial markets , and enhance the level of capital management and social capital efficiency of chinese financial enterprises .
we must further develop the money markets , expand lending among same - sector enterprises and bond financing between banks .
fourth , we will amend and improve existing legal frameworks .
in conformity with the basic principles of the wto , we must strictly take hold of market entry criteria .
following the trend of comprehensive management of international financial business , we must gradually improve the operation and management systems for separate sectors by the chinese financial industry .
sixth , we will pay close attention to training management personnel in the financial industry and enhance the level of computerized finance in china .
ma xiuhong made the above remarks in response to a question posed by this reporter at a news conference held today for the fifth china investment and trade fair .
china first formulated the industrial catalog for foreign investment in 1987 . the catalog was made public in 1995 and revised once in 1997 .
she pointed out that although china has not yet joined the wto , the industrial catalog for foreign investment will allow a greater degree of opening up in the service sector .
comrade wang enmao was born on 19 may 1913 in yongxin county , jiangxi province .
during his youth he searched for truth .
in 1933 he assumed the position of secretary to comrade ren bishi , secretary of the hunan - jiangxi provincial cpc committee .
at the same time , he assumed the position of secretary general of the political department of the 6 th army group of the red army .
in september 1937 , after the 2 nd front army of the red army was reconstituted as the 120 th division of the 8 th route army of the national revolutionary army , he was appointed chief of the education division of the political department and propaganda department of the 120 th division .
beginning in december of that same year , he successively served as chief of the propaganda division of the political department of the 359 th brigade of the 120 th division , member of the brigade 's military and political committee , deputy director of the brigade 's political department , and deputy political commissar of the brigade .
in march 1941 , he studied at the chinese people 's anti - japanese military and political college in yanan and at the central party school .
after the 359 th brigade entered and garrisoned in the nanniwan area , he assisted comrade wang zhen in carrying out the three major tasks of military reorganization , production , and education .
in march 1945 , the cpc central committee and the central military commission decided to change the name of the southbound detachment of the 8 th route army to the hunan people 's anti - japanese and national salvation army .
soon afterward , the army crossed the chang jiang to the south . after a half year of arduous long - distance marching and fighting , it arrived in central hunan where it fulfilled its mission of establishing an anti - japanese base area centered around heng shan .
in october 1946 , comrade wang enmao , along with the 359 th brigade , again crossed the huang he to the east , arriving in shanxi where he participated in the people 's liberation war in north china .
in october of the same year , he took part in the joint military operations of the 2 nd column and the 4 th column , scoring great victories by capturing in turn hancheng and yichuan , thereby expanding the people 's liberation war in the northwest to areas under chiang kai - shek 's command .
in december of the same year , he took part in commanding the capture of yuncheng by the 2 nd column and the 8 th column .
in mid - february 1948 , he participated in the 2 nd column 's wazijie campaign , which completely wiped out the reorganized 29 th army of the kuomintang in one fell swoop , achieving the first major victory since the people 's liberation war in the northwest shifted to strategic offense .
in the latter part of july of that same year , he again led the 2 nd army in liberating tianshui and linxia in gansu province .
afterward , he led the troops in crossing qilian shan and pressing on toward xinjiang , making an important contribution to bringing about the peaceful liberation of xinjiang .
at the end of 1949 , comrade wang enmao and comrade guo peng , the army commander , led the broad ranks of the officers and men of the 2 nd army to enter and garrison in southern xinjiang , after undergoing untold hardships .
at the same time , he led the broad ranks of officers and men to carry out productive work , open up wasteland and cultivate land , strive to lighten the burden of people of all nationalities , do everything possible to popularize new farming technology , restore and revitalize the southern xinjiang economy , and safeguard social stability .
in july 1952 , comrade wang enmao assumed the positions of first secretary of the xinjiang cpc subbureau , chairman of the xinjiang financial and economic committee , and acting political commissar of the xinjiang military district to take overall charge of the work in xinjiang .
in accordance with the plans of the central authorities , he directed the work of drawing up xinjiang 's first five - year plan for economic and social development .
in april 1955 , he served as commander and concurrently political commissar of the xinjiang military district .
after july 1960 , he was also a member of the secretariat of the cpc central committee 's northwest bureau .
he kept firmly in mind the party 's aims , and served people of all nationalities in xinjiang heart and soul .
he proceeded in a steady and prudent manner to carry out socialist transformation of rural and urban handicraft industries in line with the local conditions in xinjiang .
he acted in accordance with the instructions of the central authorities in waging a tit - for - tat , justified , and principled struggle against those pursuing hegemony and territorial expansionism in order to safeguard the territorial integrity and dignity of the motherland .
he led people of all nationalities to work hard to bring about major changes in xinjiang .
the work in xinjiang won the approval and praise of the party central committee and chairman mao on several occasions .
he showed the noble character and sterling integrity of a veteran communist party member .
in october 1975 , after chairman mao personally took up the issue , he was transferred to the nanjing military region to serve as deputy political commissar .
in march 1977 , after the " gang of four " was smashed , comrade wang enmao assumed the positions of first secretary of the jilin provincial cpc committee , first political commissar and first party committee secretary of the jilin military district , and deputy political commissar of the shenyang military region .
in october 1981 , the party central committee decided that comrade wang enmao should return to his work in xinjiang , where he was appointed first secretary of the xinjiang uygur autonomous region cpc committee and first political commissar and first party committee secretary of the urumqi military region .
after the xinjiang production and construction corps was reinstated , he concurrently served as first political commissar and first party committee secretary of the corps in 1984 .
he comprehensively implemented the party 's policies on nationalities and religion , beginning with a vigorous effort to promote ethnic unity .
at his initiative , xinjiang led the way in launching " ethnic unity education month " activities .
he conscientiously carried out party policies , enabling the verdicts to be reversed in cases where people were unjustly , falsely , or wrongly charged during successive political movements .
in accordance with the plans of the central authorities , he conscientiously carried out reform of the cadre system and trained and promoted a group of young cadres that combined ability with political integrity , in particular young minority cadres .
in october 1985 , he assumed the position of chairman of the xinjiang uygur autonomous region cpc committee 's advisory committee .
since the 1930 s , comrade wang enmao kept a diary with amazing perseverance , a habit that he kept up almost without interruption .
during his 70 - plus - year revolutionary career , comrade wang enmao always showed a firm belief in communism and a strong party spirit . he stressed the overall situation in everything he did .
he was fond of thinking and learning , and he persevered in studying marxism - leninism , mao zedong thought , and deng xiaoping theory and in combining theory and practice .
during his work over a long period in ethnic minority areas , he implemented party policies on nationalities in an exemplary fashion and made contributions to the practice and development of party theory on nationalities .
he showed a deep sense of revolutionary dedication and responsibility and always kept in mind the well - being of people of all nationalities .
he was hard working and plain living , modest and prudent , strict with himself and lenient toward others , honest in performing his official duties , and esteemed and loved by the broad masses of cadres and people .
the life of comrade wang enmao was a life of revolution , a life of fighting , a life of wholeheartedly serving people of all nationalities , and a life of waging struggles for the cause of communism .
his great contributions will be forever inscribed in the annals of history .
eternal glory to comrade wang enmao !

beijing , 18 apr ( xinhua ) - - the latest figures show that our country 's imports and exports continued to increase in the first quarter of this year and increased by 15.9 percent over the volume in the same period last year .
at the same time , the amount of foreign funds being absorbed also increased . of the 10 leading countries and regions to make investment in china , only singapore recorded a decrease in its investment in china , and all others substantively increased their investment in china .
this showed that the foreign trade situation in our country in the first quarter was very good .
today , ma xiuhong , assistant minister of foreign trade and economic cooperation , said that this year , our country will strive to achieve the target of increasing the gross volume of imports and exports by 8 percent .
last year , our country 's foreign trade continued to increase at a high speed , and this became a light point in all the national macroeconomic indicators .
at present , the degree of our economy 's dependency on foreign trade increased from 40.2 percent in 1995 to 43.9 percent in 2000 .
as the base figures of our foreign trade in 2000 was already quite big , and the world economy continued to slow down , many people were worried about this year 's foreign trade situation in our country .
however , the foreign trade statistics revealed today show that there remains certain room for going up in our country 's foreign trade situation this year .
this first benefited from the sustained stable development of our national economy .
the amount of foreign funds being attracted and used by our country also increased by 11.7 percent as compared with the same period of last year .
secondly , the environment for foreign investment in our country continued to improve , and the momentum of foreign investment in china was not affected by the slowdown of the world economy .
in the first three months of this year , 5,300 foreign enterprises became new investors in china , the foreign funds involved in the investment contracts amounted to $ 16 billion , and the foreign funds being actually used amounted to nearly $ 8 billion .
the statistics show that in the first three months of the year , foreign investment from north american and asia continued to increase by substantive margins .
in particular , the foreign funds from north america in investment contracts and being actually used increased by 46.7 percent and 35.6 percent ; and those from japan increased by 12.3 percent and 18.32 percent separately .
of course , there still exist many uncertain factors that may affect and restrain the development of our country 's foreign trade .
the slowdown of the world economy will inevitably bring about a negative impact on our foreign trade , and may increase pressure on the increase in our country 's exports .
therefore , it is necessary to be fully aware of all possible new problems in our future development so that our work can be done more pertinently and effectively .
according to comprehensive analysis , along with the continuing improvement of the investment environment and the economic restructuring , although the situation that our foreign trade is facing within this year has changed or will continue to change , there remains certain room for growth .

this is the fifth day of the incident , and the first statement that bush has made about the fact that wang wei is missing .
reporters note that bush has a resigned look on television .
on 6 april , the chinese side indicates that it welcomes the expression of regret by us president bush , and also insists that the us should make a formal apology over the collision incident .
the same day , bush states that the us and china have " made progress " over the issue of releasing the 24 us crew members and returning the us plane .
also on the same day , at a meeting of us ceos in virginia , bush states that " we are working hard through intense discussions with the chinese government to allow them to come home , and we believe we are making progress . "

an international symposium on the network economy and economic management was held in beijing this morning .
premier zhu rongji sent a congratulatory message to the gathering , as did un secretary - general kofi annan .
vice premier wen jiabao addressed the symposium at the opening ceremony .
in his congratulatory letter , zhu rongji said , " mankind has entered a new century .
as we all know , the rapid development of the computer and the internet was one of mankind 's top achievements of the 20 th century .
during the new century , the meteoric development of information technology , especially networking technology , is bound to produce a wide - ranging , powerful , and profound impact on all aspects of the world economy .
mankind will enter the information society in the 21 st century . "
zhu rongji pointed out , " internet technology and its applications have brought the whole planet into the new network economy era . the processes of economic globalization , information networking , and regional economic cooperation have all been accelerating markedly even as they gain in depth .
new opportunities for economic development await china and other countries in the world , especially developing countries .
but these countries also face daunting risks and challenges . "
as the countries of the world go about reordering their economies , it is also necessary to improve economic management on a global scale .
in keeping with the flow in the world toward a global information revolution , china has made the accelerated development of an information society and information economy one of its top priorities .
as china continues to deepen reform and opens itself further to the outside world , it will vigorously shake up and standardize the order of the market economy . "
wen jiabao said in his opening address , " china 's achievements in reform , opening , and economic construction over the past 20 years and more have captured world attention .
wen jiabao said , " in the course of developing a socialist market economy , china has always taken pains to strengthen macro regulation and control by the state , make full use of the market as the basic allocator of resources , emphasize macroeconomic management , and protect order in the market economy .
he added , " for a variety of reasons , developing countries find themselves at a disadvantage in economic globalization . the north - south gap is widening and the digital dividing is getting deeper and deeper all the time .
together they must work out a set of rules that are in the interests of all nations and will promote joint economic development and establish a new international economic order that is fair and equitable so that all countries will benefit tangibly from economic globalization and the push for an information economy .
kofi annan said in his congratulatory letter , " new information and communications technologies are influencing world developments in many ways .
it may promote economic and social progress , narrow the gap between the rich and the poor , and break down geographical barriers to the market and to prosperity . but it also may exclude or leave behind those countries that lag in technological innovation and drive them to a even lower level of development . "
close cooperation between national and local governments , on the one hand , and the private sector and private organizations , on the other , will play a most critical role .
wen jiabao met with some of the delegates to the international symposium on the network economy and economic management before the opening ceremony .
the main discussion topics included the following : the current development trends in the global network economy ; challenges and opportunities offered by the network economy to developing countries and countries in economic transition ; and the necessity of establishing the proper national and international economic management systems to meet the needs of the development of a network economy .
the symposium was attended by more than 300 people , including government officials from over 40 countries ; officials from the united nations , other international organizations , and non - government organizations ; senior leaders from foreign multinational corporations and large chinese enterprises ; and well - known chinese and foreign experts and scholars .

beijing , 19 april ( xinhua ) - - on 18 and 19 april 2001 , the organization department of the cpc central committee held a special meeting to arrange the work of selecting , promoting , and training young cadres .
first , new progress was made in the work of selecting , promoting , and appointing young cadres to leading positions .
all localities and departments promoting a large number of outstanding young cadres to leading bodies at all levels according to the four - point criteria for the cadre contingent and according to the principle of promoting cadres with both political integrity and work ability .
fourth , new breakthroughs were made in the methods of selecting and promoting young cadres .
the meeting stressed the need to focus efforts on doing a good job in following aspects : first , increase the intensity of promoting outstanding young cadres and ensure that the goal set forth by the central leadership for promoting young cadres will be fully achieved .
thus , efforts to select and promote outstanding young cadres should be stepped up . in particular , a batch of well - educated female young cadres of political integrity should be added to principal leading positions at various levels . attention should also be paid to appointing cadres from minority ethnic groups and cadres outside the cpc .
second , properly and carefully examine the political quality , work ability , and personality of all candidates before appointments and promotions are decided so that only young cadres who are competent to shoulder heavy responsibilities and are able to withstand the tests of winds and waves will be appointed and promoted to leading posts at all levels .
if such people have been appointed to leading posts , they must be resolutely removed .
third , strengthen the party spirit tempering of the young cadres , help them firmly adopt a correct outlook on power , position , and interests .
it is necessary to encourage young cadres to work at the grass - roots level and particularly in a difficult condition , and arrange them to work there in a planned way .
the more promising a young cadre is , the more necessary it is to assign him or her to work in a place with difficulties .
the plan of assigning young cadres to work in difficult conditions should be combined with the implementation of the strategy for the great development of the west .
the central organization department will dispatch young cadres by groups in rotation from central and state organs , from local leading bodies in the eastern areas , from backbone state - owned enterprises , institutions and higher learning , scientific research institutes to leading posts in western areas for testing and tempering these cadres .
this year , 100 cadres will first be dispatched from central and state organs .
at the same time , it is necessary to step up efforts for building the reserve cadre forces , further reform and improve the system for selecting and training young cadres , and create a better situation where a large number of outstanding personnel keep cropping up .

since 1990 the united states has directly or indirectly put forward a so - called " deteriorating human rights situation in china " resolution at the annual meeting of the un human rights commission ten times in an attempt to demonize china and interfere in china 's internal affairs .
during the first few years , the resolution was co - sponsored by some eu countries , which gave it an extra menacing aura .
nonetheless , the u.s. - sponsored resolutions were repeatedly blocked by developing countries from asia , africa , and latin america .
on the eve of the 53 d annual meeting of the commission in 1997 , leading eu member countries like france and germany announced that they would no longer be a co - sponsor and proposed that countries give up confrontation in the international human rights arena and instead strengthen human rights exchange and cooperation through dialogue .
only through a mix of arm - twisting and incentives did the united states manage to have denmark co - sponsor its resolution .
by 1999 , the united states could not find a single western ally to lead the charge , which left it with the unpleasant task of submitting the resolution all by itself .
at the commission 's 57 th annual meeting this year , the united states is more isolated than ever . not a single country co - sponsored its resolution .
according to reports in the u.s. media , an unfavorable international situation this year prompted the united states to work extra hard to drum up support for its anti - chinese resolution .
