when all is said and done , the united states time and again tables anti - chinese resolutions because it does not want to see a china that is politically stable , enjoys rapid economic development , and adheres to the socialist road with chinese characteristics .
as was the case last year , the united states this year failed to find a single co - sponsor for its anti - chinese resolution , so once again it stood alone .

during a joint training , both sides stand rival to each other , strictly follow actual combat requirements , and engage in a confrontation exercise very much like actual combat , without knowing each other 's situation beforehand .

the first quarter of the first year of the new century has come and gone quietly .
judging from the major statistical data for the first quarter of this year , the chinese economy will maintain a robust growth momentum and there will be steady growth throughout the year .
china 's gdp stood at 1.9895 trillion yuan in the first quarter , up 8.1 percent from the same period a year ago , basically unchanged from the growth rate last year and beating that of the last quarter of 2000 by 0.7 percentage points .
specifically the secondary industry grew 9.5 percent and was the principal contributor to the steady growth of the entire economy .
tax revenue amounted to 355.9 billion yuan in the first quarter , up 26.7 percent from the year - ago period .
historically speaking , increases of this magnitude point to a good year .
in the first quarter , $ 15.993 billion in contracted direct foreign investment was utilized , up 44.34 percent from the same period a year ago , while the amount of foreign investment actually utilized grew 11.74 percent to reach $ 7.978 billion .
as of late march , 370,000 enterprises with foreign investment had been approved nationwide . their contracted foreign investment totaled $ 692.7 billion , of which $ 356.6 billion were actually utilized .
fixed assets investment for all society reached $ 387.8 billion in the first quarter , up 12.4 percent from the same period last year .
specifically , fixed assets investment in the state economy and other economies increased 15.1 percent from the same period last year , collective investment rose 14.1 percent , and individual investment increased 3 percent .
the incomes of both urban and rural populations continued to rise in the first quarter . the per capita disposable income of township residents increased 4.7 percent from the same period a year ago , while the peasants ' per capita cash incomes went up 4.8 percent .
according to analyses by deputy director qiu xiaohua of the state statistical bureau , four major reasons accounted for the sustained and rapid growth of the chinese economy in the first quarter .
although the chinese economy performed better than expected overall , both government officials involved and economists have noted that the economic development environment this year is more complex with a host of variables .
the u.s. economy has shown signs of weakening since the second half of last year , decelerating at a rapid pace . the softening of the american economy together with the prolonged stagnation of the japanese economy may have an impact on china . this is something that must be taken into account .
china must watch the world economy with its eyes wide open and successfully stimulate domestic demand .

the foreign affairs , economic , science and technological , cultural , and defense departments of the two countries will maintain regular , frequent contact and strengthen coordination to constantly enlarge the realm of cooperation and enrich the cooperation in content . 4 .
the rob reaffirms its consistent principled stand on the taiwan issue - - there is only one china in the world , the prc government is the sole legitimate government representing the whole of china , and taiwan is an inalienable part of chinese territory .
the rob supports the prc 's principled stand of opposing " taiwan independence " and any plots to create " two china 's " or " one china , one taiwan " and reiterates it will not establish official relations in any form with taiwan .
both sides point out that multipolarization serves the demands of the present age and the interests of the overwhelming majority of countries and people and is conducive to safeguarding world peace and stability . 7 .
both sides declare they will under no circumstances accept plots to interfere in a sovereign state 's internal affairs under any pretexts and against the un charter 's purposes and principles .
both sides reaffirm the " treaty on the limitation of anti - ballistic missile systems " ( " abm treaty " ) of 1972 as the cornerstone of global strategic stability and international security and as the basis for framing international agreements on reducing and limiting offensive strategic weapons and preventing the proliferation of weapons of mass destruction .
both sides hold that the establishment of a national missile defense system , in violation of the " abm treaty , " will produce a negative impact on global strategic stability , the course of international disarmament , and the nonproliferation effort .
both sides point out that the present plan of certain countries to develop a theater missile defense system in the asia - pacific region will undermine peace and stability in that region .
the chinese side is firmly against the incorporation , in any form and by any countries , of china 's taiwan into the theater missile defense system , while the belarussian side supports this principled stand of the chinese side .
in this connection , both sides point out that the resolutions for " upholding and observing the ' abm treaty , ' " which were jointly proposed by the prc , the rob , and the russian federation and adopted at the un general assembly in 1999 and 2000 , are of great significance . 10 .
both sides hold that terrorist , splittist , extremist , and transnational criminal activities of all forms pose a serious threat to the security of sovereign states and to peace and stability in the world .
both sides reaffirm their determination to take specific , effective actions through bilateral and multilateral cooperation to crack down on the above criminal activities . 11 .

new delhi , 24 apr ( renmin ribao ) - - indian prime minister atal bihari vajpayee recently paid a four - day official visit to iran .
the current visit has yielded fruitful results as the two countries not only signed three memorandums of understanding and two protocols , but also published the " tehran statement " on the establishment of a " strategic partnership " for friendly cooperation between india and iran .
taking into account the relations between india and the islamic countries for a long time , public opinion here universally maintains that vajpayee 's current visit is a " pioneering " one , and is a " turning point " of india 's foreign policy toward the islamic countries .
owing to the long - term conflicts and disputes with its islamic neighbor pakistan , india has all along been discriminated against and left out in the cold by the islamic world for years .
after the cold war ended , a new diplomatic setup emerged in india 's neighboring region , especially in the region of middle asia .
for the sake of regional stability in middle asia , the isolation of pakistan to the maximum , and its own domestic economic reform , india began to realize the importance of improving its relations with the islamic world since the early years of the 1990 's .
over the last three years , the vajpayee government took still greater pains to improve its relations with the islamic countries .
in recent years , such countries as saudi arabia , iran , turkey , and so on have , one after another , begun to enter india 's diplomatic field of vision , among which the most influential of all and the most possible to come by is none other than iran .
iran 's becoming a strategic partner of india is attributable to its consideration of strategic interests and geographic politics , as well as its immediate needs for the economy and trade .
it is precisely on the issue of stabilizing middle asia that india 's purpose and requirement coincided with those of iran .
in particular , the afghan taliban 's activities in recent years have been regarded by both india and iran as a threat to their border areas .
not only can the indian products gain access to iran , but penetrate through iran into numerous countries in middle asia .
more importantly , the energy power iran has fixed its eyes on india , the rising big power in terms of energy consumption and imports .
for many years , india and iran have worked painstakingly to build a natural gas pipeline from iran to india but , out of security consideration , india has rejected iran 's proposal of building an inland gas pipeline to india via pakistan .
it is thus obvious that the pakistan factor is still a dark shadow in the indian - iranian relations which can hardly be removed .
it is not very likely that iran will give up its traditional good - neighborly relations with pakistan in order to curry favor with india . hence , it is not an easy job for india to totally bypass pakistan and establish close contact with the islamic world .
it not only improved and strengthened the existing friendly relations between the two countries , but also established a diplomatic foothold for india to push on into the islamic world .

the implementation of the great western development strategy to accelerate the development of the central and western regions is a major decision made by the party central committee to promote china 's modernization and cross - century development .
the active implementation of this strategy is of great importance to further promoting the political stability , economic development , social progress , national unity of the western region and the reinforcement of our frontier defense .
therefore the active support and participation in the western region 's great development and the vigorous promotion of the coordinated development of the military economy and the national economy are the issues of the century confronting china 's military .
implementation of the great western development brings rare historical opportunity to the western regions ' military economic construction the economy is the material base for the military and war .
the western region 's economic situation is closely tied to our national defense .
looking back at the several rounds of western development in china 's history , we have successfully promoted the region 's national defense construction each time .
accompanying this round of great western development no doubt will bring great advancement to the western region 's military economic construction .
the construction of strategic logistical facilities is an important part of and a basic measure for the military 's combat readiness . it must be integrated into the state 's infrastructure construction .
the western region 's economic development has been relatively slow ; the condition of its social base is poor , and the strategic logistical facilities have always been a weak link and have never been able to meet the new demands of military combats .
the state 's implementation of the great western development will provide the financial and material resources for opening up the west 's own resources and accelerating its infrastructure construction . in particular , with regard to funding , it will mean a step - up in transfer of payment .
in this round of great western development , the state has made transportation the most important of its important infrastructure constructions .
because of the unique natural geographic environment , the work and living conditions of the western region 's base area are relatively poor .
but overall , this is still a fairly problematic area .
the main contradiction plaguing the western regional garrisons ' logistical construction is the low standard of scientific and technological innovations and the key logistics elements ' low scientific and technological content .
the western region 's garrisons have formulated some concrete implementation measures , but society 's low overall scientific and technological standards have made it very difficult in practice for the troops to develop an awareness for science and technology , to coordinate science and technology to tackle the tough problems , and to introduce and propagate the successful results .
actively explore the work characteristics and order that suit the great western development ; vigorously create a new environment for the western region 's military economic construction to clearly recognize the opportunities is to firmly grasp the opportunities and to lose no time in moving forward with our work .
what should the troops do for the great western development ?
to protect and build up the motherland is the sacred duty bestowed on the people 's army by the chinese constitution .
from this perspective , supporting and participating in the great western development is the unshirkable responsibility of the troops stationed in the western region in the new era .
to implement the great western development , it is important that we set our sight on national security , meet national defense needs , link tracks with the military tasks , and keep pace with the construction of the military economy .
this guiding ideology must be manifested in full at the beginning when our work commences .
this sets the direction as we push forward the northwestern region 's military economic construction .
the plan should be based on long - term considerations , and we should include the military economic construction plan into the state and local development programs and make sure that the western region 's military economic construction goals will be achieved step by step and in separate stages .
the laws and regulations should stipulate military and local responsibilities and obligations ; laws and regulations should be used to regulate and govern the localities , the departments , and the construction projects .
the great western development must not neglect the planning and implementation of programs that accommodate both the military and the civilian and in times of war and peace .
in the near - term , we should concentrate on the following : one , make sure our military needs are met , and promote a radical change in strategic logistical facilities .
in this round of great western development , the state and the provinces ( municipalities and autonomous regions ) are giving top priority to infrastructure constructions .
such projects , for instance , should include the construction of roads and dedicated rail lines leading to and from the garrison areas , warehouses , depots and stations ; the construction of campaign - oriented military airports and heliports at key points and key locations , and the construction and maintenance of primary roads along the border .
two , do a good job with economic mobilization preparedness and raise the national economic mobilization work to a higher level .
we must promptly organize a study of our national economic strength and ascertain and understand the law of change in the economic indicators and the key mobilization elements .
three , do a good job protecting the environment and thoroughly optimize the officers and men 's work and the living environment of the .
the western development process is also a process of gradually creating a beautiful environment of green mountains and clear water .
we must take advantage of the western great development to promote military economic construction and make scientific and technological innovation and the propagation of results the focal point as we resolutely embark on the road of using science and technology to invigorate rear services and find ways to raise the scientific and technological contents of logistical work .
five , do a good job with the reform to socialize logistical safeguard and continuously improve the quality and efficiency of logistical safeguard .
to implement the socialization of the troops ' logistical safeguard is a major decision made by president jiang upon taking into consideration the state 's and the military 's construction strategies ; it is a necessary requirement if the military is to strengthen quality construction and embark on the road of becoming a crack troop .
the army must make full use of the new market condition created by the great western development and seize the opportunity to promote the reform to socialize logistical safeguard .
the great western development is a systematic project and an unprecedented grand undertaking that requires several generations of relentless efforts .

it mainly uses satellites , aircraft , and its global electronic surveillance network to steal all kinds of intelligence and information on other countries .
spy satellites : these are mainly imaging reconnaisance satellites , also called photographic reconnaisance satellites , and are used to gather strategic intelligence , for target identification , and for monitoring the implementation of arms control treaties .
according to the 18 march los angeles times , the united states is now carrying out a top - secret $ 25 billion program to develop a new generation of spy satellites so as to greatly enhance us satellite reconnaisance and military intelligence collection capacity in the next 20 years .
the new generation of spy satellites will be equipped with higher performance radar and telescopic systems and will be able to take high - resolution photographs of military installations anywhere on earth in all weathers .
these satellites will operate at higher orbits in space , hence they will be more concealed ; moreover these satellites will be able to stop longer above a spot on earth and will thus be able to take many more photographs of that spot .
the types of these satellites now in use are general survey , synchronous , large elliptical orbit , and new acute - angle orbit .
the " magnum " [ da jiu ping ] synchronous satellite has very powerful on - board information processing capability ; it is a multifunctional military satellite that can provide many kinds of information to us commanders all over the world .
missile early - warning satellites : these are used to detect missile launches and provide early warning information .
satellites of this type have developed to the state where they can detect submerged submarines and sense a change of 0.003 degrees in water temperature , because a submarine warms the water as it passes through it .
in addition , marine surveillance satellites can also monitor cruise missile launches .
during the vietnam war , the program used a large number of planes to collect intelligence .
the majority of surface warships use several score different systems , and if the signals they emit are successfully deciphered , their equipment , purpose , and scope of use can be identified .
the plane was equipped with more radar aerial housings and used for testing a whole series of electronic reconnaisance equipment , while the magnetic detection pole on the tailplane was removed .
later two p-3bs were modified into ep-3es and handed over to the navy for its use .
from 1971 to 1975 , 10 more advanced ep-3e " aries - ii " were supplied to the navy ; their mission was to provide " signals war " support for various units , especially aircraft carriers .
for instance , during the 1991 gulf war , these unmanned reconnaisance planes flew 533 reconnaisance sorties over iraq and kuwait , to indicate targets , observe enemy losses , and correct battleship firing points .
the report pointed out that the us national security agency had for a long time been using a global monitoring and control system to steal intelligence on all countries , including commercial secrets from the eu countries , resulting in serious economic losses to those countries .
campbell said in his report that this communications spy network covering the whole globe could hardly be operated by the united states alone .
it controls 120 satellites in space .
it has two major handling centers on earth , one in the united states and the other in england , standing like two feet astride the atlantic .
the center in the united states is located at nsa headquarters in maryland , and the one in england is located at gchq , 150 km west of london .
apart from that , there are also several score large receiving stations in canada , new zealand , and australia ; the system is like countless antennae stretched out all over the world .
this spy network costs $ 800 million a year , and has 15,000 employees operating it throughout the world .
former us air force chief of staff fogleman has publicly stated : " in the first 25 years of the new century , you will be able to promptly discover , focus on , track and aim at any major influential target moving or located anywhere on earth .
paying any price to develop hi - tech reconnaisance systems intelligence systems can be found everywhere in the world .
the united states has consistently used its powerful reconnaisance and intelligence systems to monitor and control every corner of the globe , and intercept and steal government and military information from every country , including its allies .
during the airstrikes against the yugoslav federation , us signals intelligence was able to listen to chat between yugoslav commanders , and directly aim at and attack them .
it is precisely for this reason that the united states has established many reconnaisance and surveillance sites throughout the world .
ascension island : this british territory in the south atlantic hosts a control point of the us global positioning satellite .
the united states has set up anti - narcotics surveillance radar in ecuador , dominica , brazil , peru , colombia , and the bermuda archipelago .
these intelligence stations are branch units of large us intelligence centers in europe , the middle east , and east asia .
at present , the united states is continually establishing new reconnaisance bases in latin america , south asia , and africa .
the united states uses these bases for large - scale intelligence prying ; in 2000 alone , the united states and other nato countries carried out over 1,000 air reconnaisance missions against russia , and russian air defense radar could track 60 us reconnaisance planes every week engaged in air reconnaisance in the russian far east .
in order to step up worldwide surveillance , the united states has adopted the method of simultaneous intelligence gathering through many channels and at many levels ; from submarines to land radar to satellites in space , all are carriers of us intelligence equipment .
even without using the space satellite system , reconnaisance and eavesdropping by us bases throughout the globe and planes , warships , and submarines can exercise surveillance and control over every corner of the earth .
underwater intelligence collection .
the communications of many countries pass through undersea cables , but although these are hidden deep below the sea , they are not secure .
in 1981 , when surveying the kamchatka peninsula coast for repairing the undersea cable , the pacific fleet of the former soviet union discovered by accident an eavesdropping installation secretly placed there by the united states ; inside the device were as many as 32 tape recorders and a miniature nuclear reactor .
air reconnaisance .
the us military also uses in its reconnaisance system a large number of planes for air reconnaisance , and these have captured a great deal of valuable information .
the scope of this project also involves items such as ec-130 " compass call " [ luo pan hu jiao ] ( electronic jamming ) and " lone shocktroop " [ dan ren tu ji dui ] ( used in electronic jamming and the interception and relay of radio and tv stations ) .
space electronic reconnaisance .
this is a major means by which the united states obtains intelligence .
for instance , this includes the " ladder " [ jie ti ] space eavesdropping system built up by the united states , britain , and other countries , which was mainly aimed at the former soviet union .
after the end of the cold war , the strength of the " ladder " was actually boosted , and it could eavesdrop on economic intelligence from europe and indeed the whole globe .
us satellite reconnaisance activities come under the general responsibility of the national reconnaisance office .
this is one of the us government 's most secret organs ; it comes under the defense department , and has an annual budget of $ 6 billion , more than the cia and the nsa .
as everyone knows , in 1998 the us intelligence departments did not obtain in time intelligence on india 's nuclear test , and the reason for this was that the indian government and military used optical fiber communications to plan and command the test .
the us air force plans by 2030 to complete the organization and building of its information warfare units , to step up the development of a new generation of reconnaisance , surveillance , and early - warning equipment , and to develop a new generation of reconnaisance satellites and high - performance unmanned reconnaisance planes .
at present , relying on their own forces , the us army and navy already possess very strong intelligence gathering capability and are hurrying to develop new reconnaisance systems .
for instance , before mobilizing their forces , certain countries first calculate the time when spy satellites will be overhead , and take advantage of the window after they have passed to go into action , thus successfully evading us satellite reconnaisance .
during the gulf war , some us commanders complained that data from spy satellites arrived too slowly , with the result that the us side felt that there were not enough spy satellites at present .
the new spy satellite network array will be vast , and it will enable the united states to greatly increase the frequency of reconnaisance and photography of any place on earth .

the 1911 xinhai revolution 90 years ago toppled the rule of the last emperor in our country .
there are one drama after another adapted from history books or novels about the imperial families and the imperial courts .
readers and viewers may love some artistic images .
however , this is exactly the seriousness of the problem . on works with unhealthy contents , the higher their artistic quality , the more harmful their influence .
just because of such fondness , the concept of emperors unwittingly makes inroads into our minds and poisons our life .
china is a country with more than 2,000 years of feudal history . it is hard to find another country in the world with so many emperors in history and such a long history of monarchy .
what did so many emperors and such a long history of monarchy bring to us ?
we are historical materialists , acknowledging and also affirming that the replacement of feudal society for slave - owning society was the result of the development of productive forces , and was an inevitable process of history , and also a progress in human history .
we are also clearly aware that when europe was struggling in the darkness of the middle ages , the chinese nation had created its brilliant ancient civilization . before the 15 th century , the chinese civilization continued to be the pacesetter in the evolution of human civilization as a whole .
however , beginning from the renaissance in europe , the bourgeoisie overthrew the feudal autocracy and created modern and contemporary civilization .
in 1800 , the wealth produced in our country accounted for 33 percent of the world 's total ; but in 1900 , the proportion declined to 6.8 percent . our country fell into the predicaments of being poor and weak step by step , and our nation was bullied and humiliated by the foreign powers again and again .
this was " great accomplishment " of the time - honored feudal dynasties , and the " meritorious virtues " of the emperors now still being mentioned with great relish by some people .
to overthrow the imperial system and topple the rule of the emperor , the chinese nation paid heavy costs and sacrificed innumerous outstanding sons and daughters .
the dead people are still gripping on alive people .
even though the emperors were overthrown , the thoughts of emperors remained in some people 's minds and may float back again when there is an opportunity , causing new tragedies .
in prosperous cities and remote villages , one may find so many restaurants and recreation places named " emperor " or " monarch . "
a more harmful phenomenon was that the thoughts of emperors still kept its corrosive influence in our social and political lives .
the mentality of being privileged , the patriarchal behavior , the practice of cronyism , the concept of hierarchy , the tendency to form factions , and the mentality of rule by one man are all derived from thinking about emperors , and all are obstacles to our development and progress .
our writers and artists should enthusiastically eulogize the great practice of our people in creating the new world , and should not still memorize the rusty feudal chains .
we want the status of being masters of our society , we want the mentality of democracy .
emperors have long been discarded by history . so we should also cast the thinking about emperors to the trash bin of history .

in different fields , sectors , and areas , however , the degrees of marketization are also different ; the degree is higher in some localities and lower in others .
it should be said that market order is not man - made and that market rules are not a product of planning and designing but are improved day by day through the " gaming " of self - interest , altruism , and mutual benefit by principal competitors in the market .
european countries , the united states , and other countries have spent more than 100 years and paid a tremendous price for market rules , and now their market rules have tended to reach perfection .
the constraining force of the market rules will be greatly weakened when there lack a long - term driving force and pressures for development .
every principal party participating in market competition should be given an opportunity for fair competition ; only thus will it be possible to bring about the survival of the fittest , to establish the market rules , and to build an integrated , open , competitive , and orderly market system .
however , there exist in varying degrees trade monopoly , regional blockade , coercive trade , discriminative treatment , and other problems , which have cut the market apart , restricted fair competition , and disrupted market order as well .
for this reason , it is necessary to lay down the " rules of various games " conducive to fulfilling contracts .
fulfilling a contract is based on the trade concept of " honesty " and " credit . "
the market economy should attach great importance to morality as well as to rule by law ; rule by law is external constraints while morality is internal self - discipline . both the legal system and morality must be able to play their roles simultaneously , and neither is dispensable .

chongqing , 26 apr (xinhua) - - as the time for water storage of the three gorges project is drawing near , the issue of geological disasters in the reservoir area has gradually drawn attention from home and abroad .
interviewed by a reporter while leading an expert team to conduct inspections at the reservoir area recently , sun wensheng , vice minister of land and natural resources , said the technical personnel of the project in china are completely capable of preventing and bringing the geological disasters in the three gorges reservoir area under control .
investigation shows that there are more than 1,300 landslides and collapsed areas at the three gorges reservoir where the water storage line marks 175 meters above the water .
according to incomplete statistics , since 1982 , 70 geological disasters of a relatively large scale have taken place at the reservoir area .
although there are many hidden dangers and the possibility of disasters are serious , sun wensheng said that judging from the current national power and the technical capacity of prevention of geological disasters of the project , we are completely capable of preventing and bringing the geological disasters in the three gorges reservoir area under control .
prevention , avoidance , and bringing under control - - these are the three major means for the prevention of geological disasters .
in addition , several remote sensing flights have been conducted in the three gorges reservoir area , thus obtaining a color photograph of the entire reservoir area on a scale of 1:10,000 by infrared aerial photography , and completing a map of geological disasters in the three gorges reservoir area .
utilization of modern technological means has provided a better scientific basis for the prevention of geological disasters in the reservoir area .
geological workers have conducted surveys on the project facilities , residential points , and surrounding areas in the three gorges reservoir area , and obtained better information on geological disasters .
on the basis of field investigations , the gps datum net in the reservoir area will be further improved .
it is necessary to build professional monitoring points at crucial geological disaster points in addition to establishing a three - level system which includes county , town , and village to conduct controlled monitoring on disaster points .
it is necessary to build a data transmission system throughout the entire reservoir area , and ultimately establish a modern warning system that is capable of collecting and handling disaster - related information .
in the three gorges reservoir area , we have completed with success projects to harness the landslides in wan county 's douyapeng , landslides in badong 's huanglashi , and the dangerous rocks in zigui 's lianziya .
currently , an expert team on the prevention of geological disasters in the three gorges reservoir area has been established in chongqing , which marks the beginning of a large - scale project of prevention of geological disasters in the reservoir area .
sun shengwen said that the ministry of land and natural resources will promulgate and implement in the near future the " procedures on management of prevention of geological disasters in the three gorges reservoir area , " so as to further intensify law enforcement efforts .

the world - famous chernobyl nuclear accident , which happened in the former soviet union on 26 april 1986 , caused heavy casualties and serious environmental pollution .
fifteen years have passed , but the shadow of the nuclear accident still cannot be wiped out .
the experts pointed out , the chernobyl nuclear accident cannot change the conclusion that energy is a safe and clean source of energy .
reports that chernobyl nuclear accident has caused the death of 7000 and even tens of thousands of people frequently appear in numerous media , causing people to take a skeptical attitude toward the development of nuclear power plants and the application of nuclear energy .
then , how many people have died as a result of the chernobyl nuclear accident ?
after synthesizing data from various quarters , academician pan ziqiang confirmed that the incident caused the acute death of 30 people , of whom 28 died of radiation and two others of explosion and severe burn respectively .
of the 499 people hospitalized for observation , 134 were finally diagnosed as suffering from an acute radiation sickness .
after a survey was conducted among 11,600 people in belarus , it was confirmed that no civilian was exposed to a sufficiently high dosage of radiation to contract acute radiation sickness .
as for the reports on death of 7,000 people , the experts pointed out that the figure was actually the number of natural death among 300,000 - plus people , who joined in meeting the emergency .
in terms of the environment , in the wake of the chernobyl nuclear accident , there has been no report on a species being extinct as a result of partial radiation , nor has there been a sustained serious impact observed among animal species or ecological systems .
the chernobyl nuclear accident occurred as a result of the hidden safety trouble in the reactor , as well as serious violation of the safety regulations .
there were safety defects in its design . this , plus various factors , such as the poor safety cultural quality of personnel in all categories , led to the total destruction of the reactor in a few seconds .
the second lesson is the lack of an emergency plan to deal with accidents .
in the view of hu zunsu , director of the science and technology commission of the china institute of radiation protection from taiyuan , the impact of the chernobyl nuclear accident itself was limited , but the resulting social psychological consequences was very serious .
as nuclear energy has an inseparable family relationship with atom bombs , at the mention of nuclear energy , people immediately think of nuclear weapons , and a hideous nuclear feature appears in their minds .
ensuring safe operation of nuclear power plants academician pan pointed out : so far , a total of 73 people have died of nuclear accidents or radiation accidents in the world .
compared with coal fuel , the number of death caused by acute accidents of nuclear power fuel chain accounts for only one - sixtieth of that caused by coal power fuel chain , while the equivalent greenhouse gas discharged by nuclear power fuel chain is smaller than that discharged by coal power fuel chain by two orders of magnitude .
on a worldwide scale , there has been a momentum of regenerating and developing nuclear power in the world .
by the end of 1999 , 436 nuclear power generating units were in operation , more than 30 others were being built , and the share of nuclear power in the global electricity generation remained at 16 percent .
in the view of the experts , this is a correct choice .
so long as we draw lessons from the chernobyl nuclear accident and step up nuclear safety measures and emergency measures , the safe operation of nuclear power plants can be guaranteed .

while granting an interview to the washington post , bush said on his initiative that the united states and communist china have different views on the issue of " defending taiwan , conscientiously defending taiwan . "
at the time before the breaking off of taiwan - us diplomatic relations , they had a joint defense treaty . according to the provisions outlined in the treaty , the united states had the obligation to assist taiwan in defending itself .
except for the words " grave concern " [ preceding words in english ] , the taiwan relations act does not state that the " united states has an obligation to defend taiwan . "
is it that president bush said something wrong or had a slip of the tongue ?
however , viewed from his conversation with reporters of abc and the washington post , he said twice that he would " defend taiwan . " obviously , this is not a careless mistake . but it is likely that he has overstated the case .
he said : " the united states would use all methods to help taiwan defend itself . "
the real bottom - line of us policy toward taiwan is " to help taiwan defend itself , " and is not to " defend taiwan " with us efforts . taiwan should clearly understand this point .
it is undeniable that the new bush administration 's policies toward taiwan , especially the policy on the issue of defending taiwan , have been gradually changed from " strategic confusion " or " strategic ambiguity " [ preceding two words in english ] in the past to more " clarity " [ preceding word in english ] .
the current most influential members of the bush administration , deputy secretary of state richard armitage and deputy secretary of defense paul wolfowitz , also proposed this and signed an open letter to offer this proposal .
the " strategic clarity " stand adopted by bush on the issue of defending taiwan and the " strategic ambiguity " proposed by assistant defense secretary joseph nye of the clinton era ( the current president of the kennedy institute at harvard university ) have entirely different interests .
changing over to a new way , the bush administration aims to convince communist china not to misjudge the determination of the united states or interpret " confusion " as weakness .
it can be said that bush 's arms sales to taiwan , his " strategic clarity " on the defense issue , and his repeated expressions that he " would be firm " in making contacts with communist china complement each other .
it is not likely that it has always been united states policy , but " continues to be the united states policy " is a message welcomed by taiwan .
but taiwan should be mentally prepared if bush 's diplomatic advisers decide that what bush said has exceeded the limit of the taiwan relations act , and if they want to " tone down " [ preceding two words in english ] his policy stand , taiwan should not be surprised by this .
as for bush 's remark that the united states would " defend taiwan , " taipei should believe it , but should not take it as a " life - saving charm . "

in november 1992 , arats and sef reached a consensus on respectively stating in a verbal form that the " two sides across the strait adhere to the one - china principle . "
sef told arats that , " in the course of the two sides of the strait making efforts to seek national reunification , both sides adhere to the one - china principle but hold different interpretations on the meaning of one china . "
arats told sef that , " both sides adhere to the one - china principle and work hard to seek reunification ; however , the routine cross - strait talks should not involve the political meaning of one - china . "
that was the noted " 1992 consensus , " which laid the foundation for the " wang - ku talks . "

zhang xingyun , director of the supervision department of the beijing municipal telecommunications administration , said in an interview that the objective of administering internet cafes is not to " smother " them , and that regulating internet cafes is to seek advantages and avoid disadvantages so that internet cafes will develop in a regular manner .

and with the constant escalation of us arms sales to taiwan in recent years , this barrier has caused a widespread unease in the international community .

the us " arms sales control bill " stipulates : " export of arms will only be approved if there is specific proof that such arms sales can enhance the us national security and are in accord with the us foreign policies . "

despite the fact that china is yet to join the world trade organization , the annual trade amount between china and the united states is close to $ 100 billion , which keeps growing at an annual rate of 20 percent .
the us investment in china is rising at a rate exceeding 25 percent . if the us politicians can cast aside of the cold war mentality , they will see that a peaceful and developing china is where the us interests lie .

as to where should taiwan go in the future , that obviously is not something the chen shui - bian government is concerned about .
what can be expected is that , by the end of the year , there will not be much space for compromise and development between the two sides of the strait .

beijing , 28 apr ( xinhua ) - - the national people 's congress [ npc ] standing committee , china 's legislative organ , today passed the national defense education law in order to promote and step up national defense education , carry forward the spirit of patriotism , and spur national defense construction .
the law has 38 articles in six chapters , laying down regulations on national defense education in schools and society and on backup for this education .
during their deliberations , the npc standing committee members all agreed to the establishment of a national defense education day .
many of then , however , suggested that a date be selected which marked incidents that caused still greater trauma , such as the " 7 july incident " or the " 18 september incident " of japanese aggression against china .
committee members held that the signing of the " xin chou treaty " was a historic incident that should be remembered for ever by the chinese people .
in 1900 a joint force of britain , the united states , japan , russia , germany , france , italy , and austria attacked beijing and suppressed the yi he tuan anti - imperialist patriotic movement , while empress cixi fled in panic .
on 7 september 1901 these eight powers plus belgium , spain , and the netherlands forced the qing government to sign a treaty in which national sovereignty was humiliated and its sovereignty forfeited to an unprecedented extent .
that year was the xin chou year according to the old calendar , so the treaty is known as the " xin chou treaty . "
the " xin chou treaty " was a great auction of the political , economic , and military sovereignty of the qing government , as a result of which that government totally became an instrument of imperialist rule in china .
committee member liang guangda said , china was bullied during the past century , and war inflicted huge trauma on the nation , which has still not healed .
hence it is essential to step up national defense education for the younger generation and strengthen awareness of danger for the whole people . "

marriage chapter iii . family relations chapter iv . divorce chapter v. support measures and legal liabilities chapter vi .
this law serves as the basic norms of marriage and family relations . article 2 .
married people are prohibited from cohabiting with the persons other than their spouses .
domestic violence is prohibited .
the marriage between a man and a woman shall be based on their own free will , and shall not be forced onto one party by the other or intervened by a third party .
once they are issued marriage certificates , they shall become husband and wife .
the disposal of property concerning marriages nullified on grounds of bigamy shall not harm the legitimate property rights and interests enjoyed by relevant parties in legitimate marriages .
family relations article 13 .
article 15 . both husband and wife enjoy the freedom to participate in production , work , study , and social activities ; and one party shall not restrict or interfere in the activities of the other .
article 16 . both husband and wife shall have the duty to practice family planning .
such an agreement shall be established in written form .
stipulations under articles 17 and 18 of this law shall apply should such an agreement not exist or be ambiguous .
an agreement established between husband and wife concerning property acquired during the existence of their marriage relationship as well as premarital property have binding force on both parties .
article 21 . parents shall have the duty to rear and educate their children , while children shall have the duty to wait on and support their parents .
article 23 . parents shall have the right and the duty to protect their underage children .
article 24 .
biological father or biological mother who does not directly care for his or her illegitimate children should pay for the upbringing and education of these children until they have the ability to depend on themselves .
article 26 .
article 29 . elder brothers and elder sisters with necessary financial means shall have the duty to provide for their underage younger brothers and younger sisters if their parents are already dead or lack the ability to rear their underage younger brothers and younger sisters .
article 30 . children shall respect the right of marriage of their parents , and must not intervene in the remarriage or the remarried life of their parents .
chapter iv .
both parties concerned are required to apply for a divorce with the marriage registration department .
article 33 . divorce application filed by the spouse of a serviceman shall have the consent of the latter , except for serious faults committed on the part of the serviceman .
article 34 . the man 's side is not allowed to ask for a divorce during the period of the woman 's pregnancy , within one year of her delivery , or within six months of the disco nuance of her pregnancy .
article 35 . a divorced couple wishing to resume their husband - wife relationship out of their own free will are required to register their remarriage with the marriage registration department .
children are still the children of both their divorced parents , no matter whether they are put under the direct care of the father or the mother .
article 38 . upon divorce , the father or the mother who is not given direct custody of children shall have the right to visit the children , while the other party shall have the duty to assist such visits .
an agreement can be reached between parties concerned as to the form and the times for one party to exercise his or her visiting right . the people 's court shall rule if such an agreement fails to be reached .
the respective rights and interests enjoyed by either husband or wife in the household - based land contract practice shall be protected according to the law .
article 42 . at the time of divorce , if one party meets difficulties in life , the other party shall extend appropriate assistance by using his or her own property , including accommodation .
in the case of domestic violence and maltreatment of family members , the victim shall have the right to make a request ; while the relevant neighborhood committee , the villagers ' committee , and the victim 's work unit shall engage themselves in dissuasion and mediation .
in the case that family members are abandoned , upon the request of the victim , the people 's court shall give the ruling of paying maintenance expenses , upbringing expenses , or alimony according to the law .
in the case that the other party discovers the malpractices prescribed above after the divorce , he or she can lodge a suit with the people 's court for a reviewed partition of the couple 's property in common .
the people 's court shall give sanctions according to the civil procedure law against the malpractices prescribed in the previous clause that hinder civil proceedings .
article 48 . the people 's court shall enforce according to the law any ruling and verdict on the payment of maintenance expenses , upbringing expenses , and alimony , on the partition of property , on the inheritance of legacy , and on the visits with children that have failed to be executed .

where the joint property is insufficient to pay off the debts or where there are separate ownership of property , the two parties shall agree on a way to pay off the debts ; if they fail to reach an agreement , the people 's court shall give a judgment . " 29 .
article 33 shall be changed to article 42 and be amended as : " if , at the time of divorce , one party has difficulty subsisting , the other party shall give appropriate help out of his or her housing and other personal property .

law of the people 's republic of china on national defense education ( adopted by the 21 st session of the standing committee of the ninth national people 's congress on 28 april 2001 ) table of contents chapter i. general provisions chapter ii .
national defense education at school chapter iii . national defense education in society chapter iv . safeguards of national defense education chapter v. legal responsibilities chapter vi .
this law is enacted on the basis of the national defense law and education law , for the purpose of popularizing and strengthening national defense education , enhancing the spirit of patriotism , and promoting the construction of national defense and the construction of socialist spiritual civilization .
to popularize and strengthen national defense education is the common responsibility of society as a whole .
all state organs and armed forces , all political parties and social groups , all enterprises and nonprofit institutions , and grassroots self - rule mass organizations should organize national defense education in their own areas , departments , and units in accordance with their own realities .
the state council shall provide leadership for the nationwide work on national defense education .
the local people 's governments at all levels shall provide leadership for the work on national defense education within their own administrative divisions .
military organs in the places where armed forces are stationed shall assist and support the local people 's governments in the conduct of national defense education .
the state working body for national defense education shall plan , organize , guide , and coordinate the work on national defense education nationwide .
education , civil administration , culture , propaganda , and other departments shall assume responsibility for the work on national defense education within their respective terms of reference .
the state shall support and encourage social organizations and individuals to conduct activities that are conducive to national defense education .
article 11 . the state and society shall confer commendations and rewards various forms of upon such organizations and individuals who have made outstanding contributions to the work on national defense education .
administrative departments for education shall bring national defense education into their agenda ; strengthen their organization of , guidance for , and supervision on national defense education at school ; and assess the work on national defense education at school at regular intervals .
article 14 . elementary schools and junior middle schools shall bring the content of national defense education into the relevant curricula and educate the pupils in national defense by combining classroom teaching with extracurricular activities .
administrative departments for education , cyl organizations , and other departments concerned shall strengthen guidance for , and management of , junior military academy activities .
article 15 . institutions of higher learning , senior middle schools , and schools equivalent to senior middle schools shall educate their students in national defense by combining classroom teaching with military training .
the military training for the students of an institution of higher learning , a senior middle school , or a school equivalent to a senior middle school shall be organized and executed by the organization within the school responsible for military training or its military instructor in accordance with the relevant stipulations of the state .
military organs shall assist schools in organizing the military training for their students .
article 17 . various types of education institutions responsible for the training of state functionaries shall include national defense education in their training programs and introduce appropriate curricula of national defense education .
the state shall , as and when such demand arises , select and send persons in charge of localities and departments to relevant military academies and schools to receive training , so that they can study and master such knowledge of national defense that is essential for the performance of their duties as leaders .
national defense education in society article 18 . state organs shall conduct national defense education , in a variety of forms , for their staff in view of the nature and characteristics of their work .
the staff of state organs who are engaged in the construction of national defense must study and master such knowledge of national defense that is essential for the performance of their duties .
article 19 . enterprises and nonprofit institutions shall introduce national defense education into their staff education programs and conduct national defense education for their staff in combination with such activities as political education , professional training , and culture and sports .
enterprises and nonprofit institutions undertaking such tasks as national defense research and production , the construction of national defense installations , and the assurance of national defense communications shall draw up appropriate national defense education programs in accordance with the tasks they are charged with and conduct well - targeted national defense education for their employees .
social groups shall conduct national defense education in light of the characteristics of their respective activities .
article 22 . culture , press , publishing , broadcasting , film , television , and other departments and units shall conduct national defense education in a variety of forms in accordance with what is required by the circumstances and tasks .
central radio stations , television stations , and newspapers and periodicals and those of provinces , autonomous regions , municipalities , and cities divisible into districts shall introduce national defense programs or columns to disseminate knowledge of national defense .
chapter iv .
safeguards for national defense education article 24 . the people 's governments at various levels shall bring national defense education into their national economic and social development plans and guarantee funding required by national defense education in their fiscal budgets , in accordance with the demand of national defense education .
article 26 . the state encourages social organizations and individuals to make donations to fund the conduct of national defense education .
the state encourages social organizations and individuals to provide or donate , for purposes of national defense education , material objects in their collection that are meaningful to national defense education .
the units that use them shall take proper care of the material objects that have been supplied to them for use and return them to their owners promptly after use .
for those designated national defense education bases that no longer meet the conditions described above , their designation shall be cancelled by the original approving authority .
people 's governments at various levels shall strengthen the collection , sorting , and protection of the relics that are of significance to national defense education .
the national defense education syllabus shall be formulated by the state working body for the work on national defense education .
the teaching material for national defense education that applies to different regions and different categories of recipients shall be created by the departments or localities concerned on the basis of the national defense education syllabus and in light of the characteristics of such localities or departments .
teachers of national defense education shall be selected from among the personnel who love the cause of national defense education and have a basic knowledge of national defense and essential military skills .
on the national day , the army day of the chinese pla , and the whole - people national defense education day , the barracks that have received official approval may open to the public .
the measures for opening barracks to the public shall be stipulated by the cmc .
article 35 . those who encroach upon or sabotage the facilities of national defense education bases or damage exhibits shall be criticized and educated by the competent department concerned and ordered to put it right within a specified time ; the persons liable shall bear corresponding civil liability according to law .
article 37 . state functionaries in charge of national defense education who commit dereliction of duty , abuse their powers , or practice irregularities for favoritism shall receive disciplinary sanctions awarded according to law ; if their behavior constitutes a crime , their criminal liability shall be affixed according to law .
supplementary articles article 38 .
the formulation of this law aims to regulate trust relations , standardize trust activities , protect the legitimate rights and interests of trust parties , and promote the healthy development of the trust industry .
trust mentioned in this law refers to the management or disposal of the property rights , which the trustor transfers to the trustee out of his trust in the latter , by the trustee according to the trustor 's will in his own name in favor of the interests or specially designated ends of the beneficiary .
this law is applicable to the civil , commercial , and charitable trust activities that are carried out by trustors , trustees , and beneficiaries ( generally called trust parties hereafter ) in the territory of the people 's republic of china .
the state council shall formulate specific methods for the organization and management of the trust activities carried out by the trustee in the form of trust institution .
the creation of a trust shall have ascertainable trust property , and the property must be the trustor 's legally owned property .
property mentioned by this law includes legal property rights .
in the creation of a trust , the trust property that is required by relevant laws and administrative rules to go through registration procedures shall go through trust registration procedures according to the law .
article 12 . in the event of the creation of a trust by the trustor infringing on the interests of his creditor , the creditor has the right to apply to the people 's court for revocation of the trust .
in the event that the creditor does not exercise the application right stipulated the first section of this article within a year from the date he knows or must know the revocation reasons , the right shall wither .
article 13 . the creation of a testamentary trust shall follow the provisions of the inheritance law concerning wills .
the property gained by virtue of the trustee 's management , utilization , disposal of the trust property or other conditions shall also belong to the trust property .
article 15 . the trust property shall be differentiated from the other assets of the trustor , which are not formed into a trust .
in the even that the trustee dies or the trust is dissolved , revoked or declared bankrupt and terminated according to the law , the trust property does not belong to his heritage or liquidation property .
in the event of the trust property being forcibly executed in violation of provisions in the preceding section , the trustor , the trustee or the beneficiary has the right to raise an objection to the people 's court .
article 18 . the debts incurred in the trustee 's management , utilization , and disposal of the trust property shall not be offset with the debts incurred in his inherent assets .
the receiver of the transfer of the trust property who is aware of the offer is in violation of the ends of the trust shall return the trust property or pay compensation .
trustees shall be natural and judicial persons who are completely competent in managing civil affairs , unless otherwise stipulated by laws and administrative rules .
article 26 . the trustee shall receive remuneration in accordance with this law and shall not seek interests for himself with the trust property .
article 27 . the trustee shall not convert the trust property to his inherent assets .
in the event of the trustee converting the trust property to his inherent assets , the trust property shall be restored to the former state .
article 29 . the trustee shall manage the trust property and his inherent assets separately and set up separate accounts and manage the trust property of different trustors separately and set up separate accounts .
article 30 . the trustee shall manage trust affairs himself and may trust others for management on his behalf , unless otherwise stipulated by the trust deed or in the event of having no other alternatives .
in the event of the trustee trust the trust property to others for management on his behalf according to the law , the trustee shall be responsible for their management of the trust property .
article 31 . a same trust may have more than two trustees . they are called common trustees .
common trustees shall manage the trust matters jointly , unless it is stipulated in the trust deed that some specific matters are to be separately handled by the trustees .
common trustees shall manage the trust matters jointly . should they differ in opinion , the management of trust affairs shall be done according to the provisions of the trust deed . in the absence of such stipulations , the trustor , the beneficiary , or other persons who have common interests shall decide .
article 32 . in the event of the debts owed by common trustees from a third party in the administration of the trust property , common trustees shall bear joint liabilities to pay the debts .
the trustee shall keep complete records of his administration of trust affairs . the trustee shall report the management , utilization , and disposal of the trust property to the trustor and the beneficiary every year at regular intervals .
the trustee has the duty to keep the trustor , the beneficiary , and the administration of trust affairs and materials secret in accordance with the law .
article 34 . the trustor has the duty to pay trust benefits to the beneficiary to the limit of the size of the trust property .
the costs for the trustee 's administration of trust affairs and the debts he owed from a third party shall be reimbursed out of the trust property . in the event of the trustee paying the costs and debts in advance with his inherent assets , the trustee has the right of first refusal .
as this law provides provisions governing the resignation of the trustees of charitable trust , defer to them .
when the trustee 's duties are terminated , his successor or the heritage manager , the guardian , and the liquidator shall put the trust property under proper management and assist the new trustee to take over trust affairs .
the former trustee shall be relieved from the liabilities for the items listed in the report upon the approval of the trustor and the beneficiary , but he will not be exempted when he has performed misconduct .
article 42 . in the event of the duties of one of the common trustees being terminated , the trust property shall be managed and disposed by the other trustees .
section iii - - beneficiaries article 43 .
a beneficiary is a person who enjoys the trust benefits of a trust .
beneficiaries may be natural and judicial persons or the other organizations created according to the law .
the trustor may be the beneficiary but he shall not be the sole beneficiary of a same trust .
the beneficiary enjoys trust benefits from the date the trust takes effect , unless otherwise stipulated in the trust deed .
article 45 . common beneficiaries enjoy trust benefits as stipulated in the trust deed .
in the absence of provisions in the trust deed on the distribution ratio and methods of trust benefits , they enjoy trust benefits on an equal ratio basis .
article 46 .
in the event of all beneficiaries relinquishing the right to trust benefits , the trust shall be terminated .
in the event of some beneficiaries relinquishing the right to trust benefits , the ownership of the relinquished right shall be determined in the order as follows : ( 1 ) persons stipulated in the trust deed ; ( 2 ) other beneficiaries ; ( 3 ) the trustor or his successors .
article 49 . the beneficiary may exercise the right the trustor enjoys in accordance with the provisions of article 20 to article 23 of this law .
in the event of the trustor having divergent views on the beneficiary 's exercise of the right , the beneficiary may apply to the people 's court for ruling .
in the event of the trustee having one of the cases mentioned in the first section of article 22 of this law and one of the common beneficiaries applying to the people 's court for revocation of the disposal , the people 's court 's ruling on revocation is applicable to all common beneficiaries .
chapter v - - modification and termination of trusts article 50 .
in any one of the cases mentioned in the ( 1 ) , ( 3 ) , and ( 4 ) subsections , the trustor may dissolve the trust .
after the ownership of the trust property has been determined in accordance with the provisions stated in the preceding article , in the process of the transfer of the trust property to the rights owner , the trust is deemed as continuing to exist , and the rights owner is viewed as the beneficiary .
article 57 . after the termination of the trust , when the trustee exercises the right as provided in this law to ask for remuneration and to be compensated out of the trust property , he may have a lien on the trust property or may apply to the rights owner of the trust property for remuneration .
in the absence of provisions in this chapter , they shall be covered by the provisions of this law and other relevant laws .
article 61 .
article 62 . the appointment and determination of trustees of charitable trusts shall get the approval of relevant public welfare services management institutions ( called the public welfare services management institution hereafter for short ) .
without the approval of the public welfare services management institution , charitable trusts shall not carry out their activities in the name of charitable trusts .
the public welfare services management institution shall render support to the activities of charitable trusts .
article 63 . the trust property and its gains of charitable trusts shall not be used for purposes other than charity .
article 64 . charitable trusts shall have trust controllers .
trust controllers are appointed in accordance with the provisions stated in the trust deed .
article 66 . trustees of charitable trusts shall not resign without the approval of the public welfare services management institution .
the trustee shall make a report of his administration of charitable trust affairs and financial situation at least once a year . upon the approval of the trust auditor [ xin tuo jian cha ren ] and submission to the public welfare services institution for verification and approval , the trustee shall make the report public .
article 68 . in the event of the trustee of a charitable trust infringing on trust duties or becoming incompetent to discharge his duties , the public welfare services management institution may change the trustee .
article 69 . after the creation of a charitable trust , in the event of unforeseen situations taking place , the public welfare services institution may modify the relevant provisions in the trust deed in favor of the ends of the trust .
article 73 . in the event of the public welfare services institution violating the provisions of this law , the trustor , the trustee or the beneficiary has the right to bring a suit to the people 's court against it .
the amendments and supplements made by this decision to the marriage law are needed to safeguard citizens ' marriage and family rights and interests and to promote the stability of marriage , family and the entire society as well as the civilization and progress of society .
with marriage as the foundation , families are the cells of society and the basic living units of the people . the legal readjustment to marriage and family relations touches upon the personal interests of men and women , old and young , and every household and also touches upon the public profits of society .
the whole process of amending the marriage law constitutes another important practice of china 's legislative democratization .
the marriage law is one of the basic civil laws and the basic norms of marriage and family relations . china 's marriage law features a long - term revolutionary tradition , a clear - cut socialist essence , and strong ethnic characteristics .
the law has been formed and developed in the process of abolishing the feudal system of marriage and family and establishing a new democratic and socialist system of marriage and family .
the " prc marriage law " adopted in 1950 is the first basic law promulgated after the founding of new china .
all these stipulations have filled in , to some extent , the gaps in legislation , enriched the contents of marriage legislation , and made china 's marriage , family , and divorce systems tend to be flawless .
with regard to the division of property during the divorce , the support and education of children after the divorce , and the legal responsibility for violating the marriage law , the revised law has provided even more specific and detailed provisions than the previous one .
the npc standing committee 's decision on amending the marriage law has already been adopted , and the marriage law has been promulgated again after being appropriately revised according to this decision .
the vast numbers of the masses should study the law , understand the law , and regard the revised marriage law as the code of conduct in their marriage and family lives .
the propaganda of the legal system in this aspect should be effectively integrated with the education of the socialist marriage and family morality .
for these purposes , the following resolution is hereby adopted : 1 . it is necessary to continue publicizing and study the constitution profoundly in order to enhance all citizens ' awareness of the constitution .
efforts should be made to give publicity to and conduct education in the laws and regulations that are closely related to citizens ' rights and duties to strengthen their sense of observing the law and discipline and protecting themselves according to law .
we should persistently integrate governing the country by law with governing the country by virtue , combine education in the legal system with ideological and moral education , and promote the improvement of socialist democracy and the legal system and the building of the spiritual and material civilizations at the same time . 2 .
all citizens should receive an education in the legal system .
judicial personnel and administrative law - enforcers should profoundly study and proficiently grasp the laws and regulations related to their jobs , administer justice impartially , perform their official duties according to law , conscientiously guard the integrity and authority of the law , and protect the legitimate rights and interests of citizens .
enterprise operators and managers should strive to study the laws and regulations related to their businesses and enhance their consciousness in operating and managing their businesses according to law . 3 .
giving publicity to and conducting education in the legal system are a basic task in building a country under the rule of the socialist legal system .
we should give full play to the role of neighborhood and villagers ' committees and other grass - roots organizations in bring the publicity to and education in the legal system to each household . 5 .

beijing , 29 apr ( xinhua ) - - with the spirit of " striving unceasingly to seek self - strengthening , keeping great virtues and making great progress , " qinghua university , a famous institution of higher learning in our country , today celebrated its 90 th birthday .
jiang zemin , general secretary of the cpc central committee and president of the prc , gave an important speech at the meeting and pointed out : by the middle of this century , our country will basically realize socialist modernization , and fulfill the great regeneration of the chinese nation .
qinghua university 's precursor was qinghua school founded in 1911 . it was renamed qinghua college in 1912 .
it grew stronger in the eventful years of the 20 th century . with efforts of several generations , it shaped revolutionary tradition and a good study and school style . it fostered a large number of outstanding scientists , writers , engineers , professors , entrepreneurs , and high - quality human resources of all types .
at the celebration rally , with a happy feeling , jiang zemin delivered a heart - warming speech .
he said : in the 90 years since its founding , qinghua university has made important contributions to the development of science and education in our motherland , and to the liberation and regeneration of the chinese nation .
jiang zemin stressed : the level attained by the universities of a country actually reflects the level of scientific , technological , and cultural development attained by the whole country , and this is also a major embodiment of this country 's comprehensive national strength .
the university has 11 schools , 44 departments , and has basically formed the comprehensive layout of all branches of learning as a comprehensive university , and has become a major education center and a scientific research center of our country .
qinghua university represents the advanced level of our country 's higher education and our country 's science , technology , and culture .
