the central military commission [ cmc ] recently approved and circulated the general logistics department 's " scheme for reforming the drawing up of the armed forces budget . "
reporter : in the view of many people , drawing up the armed forces budget is a task with a high sense of specialization . please give us a brief introduction on the work .
ding jiye : as everyone knows , the state has a financial budget , and the military departments at all levels also have budgets .
in accordance with the unified arrangements of the central authorities and state council , the ministry of finance is at present vigorously pushing reform of drawing up the budget , the main contents being " dual budget , zero - base budget , departmental budgets and comprehensive budget . "
the current method of drawing up the armed forces budget gradually took shape under the planned economy setup and has played a positive role in ensuring the building of the armed forces , but there are also a number of deficiencies .
all this directly affects the enhancement of the returns on military spending .
through carrying out the reform , we will introduce scientific methods , make the contents of the budget more detailed , intensify supervision and constraint , manage and use the limited military funds in proper fashion , and spur the building of good party style and honest administration .
reporter : what new contents are prominently added to the new method of drawing up the armed forces budget ?
reporter : what are the main special features of this reform ?
reporter : what new changes will the new method of drawing up the budget bring to this work ?
ding jiye : according to the reform scheme approved by the cmc , changes will occur in five respects in drawing up the budget : first , the time for drawing up the budget will be brought forward .
at present the work of drawing up the following year 's budget starts in the fourth quarter of each year .
second , the demands on item demonstration will be higher .
all budget items must undergo full demonstration and assessment and strict verification before funds can be assigned them .
whether it is direct expenditure at one 's own level or money for the units , the budget items , expenditure sums , and the specific units must be listed in detail , and level - by - level distribution should be reduced .
at the same time , an item database must be set up for construction - type expenditure , and the system of item selection and priority order should be instituted .
fifth , budget constraints will be stronger .
reporter : the reform of drawing up the armed forces budget is a complex piece of systems engineering , what associated measures will be adopted in the future ?
ding jiye : this reform involves many aspects , and it is necessary to consider things in a comprehensive way and tightly organize things from designing the scheme and producing the system to specifically implementing it .
expand the scope of standardized supply , and gradually include in the standardized supply system the relatively stable items within existing quota distribution funds .
we should look into and draw up limits for administrative consumption funds .
second , gradually put into effect a regulated government purchase system .

the new historical conditions have given rise to new strategic requirements , which call for respecting objective laws while having the courage to break new ground in strategic studies .
expanding the subjects of strategic studies is an objective historical process , not a subjective and willful " generalization " there is no dispute over the fact that strategic studies involve research on warfare .
in his december 1936 article , " problems of strategy in china 's revolutionary war , " comrade mao zedong offered his famous definition of strategy as follows : " the science of strategy deals with the laws that govern the war situation as a whole . "
in the beginning , mankind 's military activities took the form of war .
apart from military struggles in the form of warfare , non - warfare military struggles have arisen , to include military deterrence , military diplomacy , military conflict and crisis management , arms control and disarmament , coastal air defense , and riot control aimed at maintaining domestic social stability .
under many circumstances , they can be used directly as strategic means to achieve specific political goals , just as the means of warfare is adopted for similar purposes .
to some extent , this is one reason why there has not been any war comparable to the two world wars over the past 50 years or so .
people engaged in strategic studies cannot but notice this objective reality .
on both the domestic and international fronts , the scope of strategic studies has invariably expanded in this manner .
this objective general trend has gained prominence with the passage of time .
this is perhaps a misconception .
inclusion of military struggles covering a wider range of activities in strategic studies naturally involves a confirmation of the intrinsic role and core status of warfare and strategy .
far from having an adverse effect , it has , to a certain extent , promoted the systematic study of warfare , especially the issues of preparing for war and preventing war .
in certain circumstances , it is perhaps essential to elevate certain forms of non - warfare military struggles to a position of relative prominence for study and application in order to achieve specific strategic goals . there is no question of " the secondary superceding the primary . "
the basic functions of military strategy during a period of relative peace are not confined to preparedness for war although we are in a state of relative peace , the purpose of our strategic studies is not to examine peace but to consider military struggles in a state of relative peace .
to prepare for war is to combine peacetime strategy with wartime strategy ; to some extent , it is to link the two into an organic whole .
in preparing for war , a basic factor that should be considered at all times is how to win potential future war .
in any event , war preparedness should be based upon the assumption that there will be a complex , difficult situation to deal with , and nothing should be left to chance .
apart from war preparedness , another important mission of peacetime strategic application is to contain war .
as a function of strategy , war containment is a product of the developments of the times .
containment of war means proactive application of various means of peacetime military struggles , along with political , diplomatic , and economic struggles , to delay , prevent , or avert war , in accordance with the strategic requirements of national interests .
preparedness for war and containment of war are a dialectical unity .
nevertheless , whether war can be contained or not depends not on good intentions but on scientific strategic planning and top - quality strategic guidance .
in today 's world , peace is largely maintained from a position of strength . by the same token , war can only be contained on the basis of powerful strength .
war preparedness in peacetime helps amass material and spiritual resources that are needed for winning future war while at the same time having the strategic effect of containing war .
history abounds in instances that illustrate the following : the greater the level of war preparedness , the more effective it is in containing war ; conversely , neglecting the role of strategic planning and guidance in peacetime and not making the necessary preparations due to diminished vigilance against the danger of war would bring on war itself .
the saying , " one must be able to do battle before one can talk peace , " applies here .
by containing war , a country gains more time to plan for the long term and lay a more solid foundation for war preparedness .
during peacetime , therefore , preparedness for war and containment of war should be combined into an organic whole .
for example , military diplomacy , arms control , and even conflict and crisis response and management are all important measures that are indispensable to containing war , and they need to be accorded strategic consideration .
when a situation undergoes tremendous changes , there are bound to be changes to strategy . the new century and the new situation currently facing us have imparted new characteristics and new missions to military struggles .
in the international arena , various countries - - major powers , in particular - - are undertaking a strategic realignment in order to gain strategic primacy in the new century , bringing a flurry of activity to the realm of strategic studies as never before .
in addition to setting the tone of taking development as the main theme , the party and government have laid down magnificent goals of development .
meanwhile , the great cause of reunifying the motherland has yet to be accomplished , and the nation 's sovereignty and territorial integrity have come under threat .
a key topic of strategic studies is how to manage the relationship between development and reunification and how to turn the situation to our advantage , gain the initiative , avert being thrown into a passive position , and maximize our strategic interests in the midst of various forces that condition and interact with one another simultaneously .
whether a strategy works or fails depends , first and foremost , on whether or not there is a profound understanding of the requirements of national interests and whether or not there is an accurate prediction of the basic trend of developments in the situation .
the most important topic of strategic studies is to find out what specific forms future war might take , including special battlefield circumstances and operational types and modes .
the rules for commanding war vary according to the form of warfare .
an important mission in warfare research is to study new rules for commanding war in light of changes in the form of warfare , with special emphasis on the way operational guidelines and strategic military operations are prepared and executed .
it is necessary to explore ways to gain the upper hand in modern people 's warfare .
some people have questioned the effectiveness of people 's warfare under high - tech conditions .
thanks to efforts over the past several decades , the resources that the country and people pour into supporting warfare have increased vastly , generating an enormous wealth of strategic assets .
as a matter of strategy , it is essential to study ways to effectively convert this war - fighting potential that exists in the county and among the people into real war - fighting power , especially in direct support of military operations .
strategy is not just about directing efforts to apply military strength ; it is also about directing efforts to build up military strength .
without the means of subduing the enemy or the ability to put up effective resistance against strong enemies in important arenas of conflict , there is no possibility of winning in military struggles .
it is necessary to further study the issue of applying a combination of means and methods of waging military struggles .
in peacetime , strategy is applied in a wide range of activities , including war preparedness , non - warfare military struggles , and even limited application of the means of warfare .
these means and methods each have their own unique strategic value . however , taken together , they form an integral part of peacetime strategic activities and serve as a link in the chain of military struggles .
as a matter of strategy , it is necessary to study the art of applying these means and methods of waging struggles , as well as the issue of how to choose and change strategies quickly and regulate the pace of struggles swiftly in accordance with actual requirements , in the interest of maintaining strategic flexibility and initiative .

bush 's first major move on taking office was to come up with his tax cutting scheme , to reduce taxes by $ 1.6 trillion in the next 10 years .
some $ 958 billion of this would be cuts in personal income tax .
bush pointed out that americans had borne too heavy a tax burden in recent years and it was now time to " pay them back . "
according to investigations , it is the wealthiest 5 percent of the population who will benefit the most , and even the middle class are victims of bush 's tax cut scheme .
the washington post and abc jointly carried out a public opinion survey regarding bush 's tax cut scheme .
the results showed that nearly half of americans are not in favor of the scheme , holding that this is a plan for " robbing the poor to aid the rich " ; only about one - third are in favor of the scheme .
senator murray pointed out on 27 april that bush 's tax cut scheme only brings joy to a few wealthy people , and in order to carry out this policy , he does not hesitate to reduce spending on environmental protection and law enforcement , thus causing a decline in health and safety standards for the laboring classes .

beijing , 3 may ( xinhua ) - - in an exclusive interview with xinhua today , a responsible official of the state office for computer network and information security said that china 's computer networks have been frequently attacked by hackers since mid - april .
in view of this , he reminded that network providers should carefully guard against hackers to ensure network security .
as revealed by this responsible official , among the thousands of cases of hackers ' attacks on international networks discovered in april , several hundreds were aimed at the chinese mainland , the percentage being as high as 13.82 percent .
as to the type of websites attacked , commercial websites accounted for 54 percent , government websites 12 percent , education and scientific research websites 19 percent , and other websites 15 percent .
according to a technician with a renowned idc enterprise in our country , in april this enterprise found as many as 80,000 cases per day where its networks were scanned and probed . the number of cases in which its networks were actually attacked was more than 100 per day , well above the average in the past .
if any attack on a network is found , this responsible official said , details of the instance should be reported to the state computer network emergency treatment and coordination center ( website : http://www.cert.org.cn).
united nations , 3 may ( xinhua ) - - the un economic and social council (ecosoc) held a meeting on 3 may to elect members to its subordinate organizations .
the united states was voted off the un human rights commission during the election .
public opinion here believes that the fact that the united states was voted off the un human rights commission shows many ecosoc members were not satisfied with the us over its practice of imposing its own human rights standards on other countries .
the un human rights commission was established in february 1946 in accordance with a resolution adopted by the un ecosoc . it is one of the principal un organizations for systematically considering human rights issues .
the ecosoc elects members to the human rights commission based on geographic distribution . the commission currently has 53 members , each serving a term of three years .
china is a member of the commission .
president bush 's speech at the national defense university in washington on the afternoon of 1 may has confirmed that this is true and real .
in his speech , bush declared that the united states must move beyond the constraints of the abm treaty signed between the united states and the former soviet union in 1992 and establish a global defense system against the attack of guided missiles .
he said : " that 's why we should work together to replace this treaty with a new framework that reflects a clear and clean break from the past , and especially from the adversarial legacy of the cold war. "
bush chose the us national defense university as the venue for delivering his speech , the same place where his predecessor bill clinton announced the temporary suspension in the development of the missile defense program .
in march , bush was criticized for not informing the country 's allies before declaring that the united states would abandon the kyoto protocol on global warming .
bush also had a phone conversation with russian president vladimir putin on nuclear disarmament and bilateral relations .
the united states has long planned to expand the " national missile defense " [ nmd ] into a global missile defense system , according to us media .
this is a global missile defense system , which incorporates sea , land , air , and space capabilities , and it is a " missile defense system covering the entire globe . "
it is replaced by a global international defense system , which is much broader than the one envisioned by president clinton . even reagan 's " star wars " program would pale into insignificance by comparison .
the timetable for building bush 's new missile defense system is also more pressing than the one envisioned by clinton .
up until the day before he left office at the end of last year , clinton had designated 2005 as the target year for deploying a limited , first - stage land - based missile defense system . in contrast , bush plans to build a preliminary system with 10 missile interceptors set up in alaska by 2004 .
after bush gave his speech , fred eckhard , spokesman for un secretary general kofi annan , said , " secretary general kofi annan firmly believes that in promoting respect for the rule of law in international affairs , there is a need to consolidate and build upon existing disarmament and nonproliferation agreements . "
anna lindh , foreign minister of sweden that holds the eu rotating presidency , refuted bush 's new plan the same day .
britain , the closest ally of the united states , also issued a statement later , saying it does not support the new us missile defense plan .
canada also issued a statement on 1 may , saying it does not support the us decision .
canadian foreign minister john manley claimed that us unilateral abandonment of abm " will bring big troubles to us . "
many democratic members of the us congress also strongly denounced bush 's plan .
at least 30 scientists and missile experts gathered in washington on 2 may to protest the government 's promotion of the missile defense system .
first a senior military figure confirmed that us defense secretary rumsfeld had ordered a freeze on all contacts with the chinese military , and then a defense department spokesman hastily issued a clarification , stating that the relevant order was the result of rumsfeld 's assistant " misunderstanding the defense secretary 's intention . "
this us decision aimed at lowering the level of exchanges between the military of the two countries and reducing the number of their exchanges is not surprising , and on the contrary this little episode of making oneself a laughingstock in front of experts causes people deep reflection .
military exchanges between china and the united states started after the establishment of their diplomatic relations and have now gone on for more than 20 years .
after the 1989 tiananmen incident , military exchanges between the two countries were totally broken off .
after former president clinton took up office , exchanges between the military of the two countries started to be revived in 1992 , and there have been many major twists and turns since then , with several temporary breaks ; at present they are at a new low on account of the air collision incident .
some people in the pentagon have consistently held that china has gained the advantage in these bilateral exchanges , since in addition to finding out some us military secrets , it has also enhanced its own international status .
after the united states started military exchanges with china , the military of other countries also greatly increased exchanges with china .
the united states has made certain gains in these two respects , otherwise us generals would certainly not insist on demanding that this kind of bilateral exchange be continued .
the uss blue ridge , flagship of the us pacific fleet , visited shanghai just before the air collision incident .
judging by reports in the american media , military engagement between china and the united states is in fact on a very small scale ; it cannot be compared to the broad exchanges between the united states and its allies , and also pales in comparison with us engagement with countries such as russia .
some of bush 's advisers advocate putting greater pressure on china , and breaking off military exchanges with china is one of the schemes considered by these people .
certain other advisers are worried that if this happens it will increase the hostility of the chinese , especially in the military , toward the united states , which could not be remedied , and it would be better to consider other schemes .
this memorandum issued to senior generals in the us armed forces and military attaches stationed overseas specifically pointed out that the secretary of defense has demanded " ceasing all engagements and activities with the prc , until further notification . "
the memorandum also specified that military attaches stationed in embassies abroad can take part in social activities in which chinese officials participate , but defense department officials cannot have any contact with chinese diplomats in washington .
defense secretary looks for a scapegoat when us media reported on this memorandum yesterday , the pentagon hastened to telephone a number of news organizations to clarify this item of news .
defense department spokesman quigley put the blame on williams , stating that rumsfeld 's assistant had " unintentionally misunderstood the secretary 's intentions . "
john warner , republican chairman of the senate armed services committee , also confirmed that he had discussed with rumsfeld the question of stopping sino - us military contacts , and he himself was very much in favor of this , because such exchanges were only beneficial for china 's military modernization .
this " blunder incident " shows not only that there is a lack of unified china policy in the us government but also that its various departments are in a " period of gearing up together " and lack coordination .
adopting a more hardline stance on china may already be the consensus , but to what extent this should be taken and whether or not to be " hard with one hand and soft with the other " has not yet been settled .

united nations , 3 may ( xinhua ) - - the third of may was the most embarrassing day to the united states .
that day , the united states , a self - claimed " human rights champion , " found itself in an embarrassing situation in the world stage of the united nations when it was ousted from the un commission on human rights in its re - election .
the united states has failed to keep its seat on the commission for the first time since the un human rights commission was formed in february 1946 . the loss of seat implies that it will not have the right to vote on any resolutions of the human rights commission at least within the next 12 months .
" we are very disappointed , " said james cunningham , the acting us permanent representative to the united nations , after the vote .
all the conservatives in the (us) administration will see this as proof that we are in an organization full of enemies , " he said .
the cuban government pointed out in a statement that " the defeat of the united states clearly shows that the international community resents the arrogance of the united states , and the human rights commission does not approve of the discriminatory and arbitrary acts of the united states . "
the permanent representatives of some developing countries to the united nations described the us ouster as an inevitable outcome of its long practice of hegemonism in international human rights and other spheres .
france , which was on the same panel as the united states , came first in the balloting with 52 votes .
respecting and protecting human rights is the hope of the people throughout the world , and dialog and cooperation represent an irresistible historical trend in international relations .
people of vision here pointed out that if washington wants to avoid such an embarrassing situation in the future , it has to renounce hegemonism and enter into dialog on an equal footing with other countries in international human rights and other spheres .
if it insists on having its way , it will only find itself in an even more embarrassing situation in the international arena , they said .

after the democratic progressive party took power last year , the taiwan economic situation began to turn from bad to worse .
in the past few months of this year , the economic situation showed no sign of improvement , and continued to decline . the situation became even more stern .
people began to worry that taiwan 's " economic miracle " could be ruined by the ruling democratic progressive party , and that people " will be facing more hardships in their future days . "
although taiwan 's industrial production achieved a rather good result last year , its growth began to slow down in the second half of 2000 , and a negative growth rate was recorded in december .
however , in the past months of this year , as the external economic environment was getting worse , taiwan 's foreign trade also declined .
bad debts exist to a serious degree although the financial crisis forecast by some western economists did not break out around the spring festival in taiwan , the financial situation remained uncertain , and problems still existed .
the rate of overdue loans , that is , the issue of bad debts in the financial institutions of taiwan was not effectively solved after the democratic progressive party took power , but became more serious than before .
while facing the sluggish economic situation and the enterprises being bogged down in business difficulties , the financial institutions will find it more and more difficult to improve the condition of bad loans , and the amount of bad loans may continue to increase .
recently , a financial fraud related to chingwen technology college was exposed . in that case , the loan of nt $ 4.5 billion provided by the banks will become a batch of new bad debts .
in such circumstances , the banks cannot but tighten control over credits , and this will in turn inevitably aggravate the enterprises ' business difficulties . recently , new york times of the united states reported that more than 200 enterprises in taiwan were bogged down in a financial crisis .
as the current economic situation as a whole is slack and the bubble of the new economy has burst , the taiwan stock market will remain bearish , and it is hard to avoid a substantive fluctuation in the next months .
in taiwan , the real estate market remained slack for more than 10 years .
the price of real estate continued to decline against the background of a worsening economic environment . according to statistics , last year , the volume of housing transactions in taiwan declined by 15.3 percent ; in the first two months of this year , the business of the house construction industry declined by 11.6 percent .
this indicated that the situation in the real estate industry had become more stern .
this caused the decline of the land price .
the land price of residential areas in taipei city fell by 4.1 percent , marking the largest margin of decline in the last 10 years . the recession in the real estate market was the extension of taiwan 's bubble economy and will further deteriorate along with the worsening of the overall economic situation .
plus its inexperience in administration and its confused and ambiguous financial , economic , environmental protection , and social welfare policies , all caused the worsening of the investment environment and forced a large number of enterprises to close down or move out of taiwan .
in all of 2000 , 4,995 enterprises were closed down , up 25.4 percent .
in the first two months of this year , more than 800 enterprises closed down .
many enterprises were not closed down , but are also bogged down in operation difficulties and lowering profits .
some enterprises were forced to move out of taiwan and seek new development opportunities elsewhere . unemployment is getting more and more serious in the past , there was no serious unemployment in taiwan .
after the democratic progressive party took power , because the sluggish economic conditions , unemployment become more and more prominent and serious . according to taiwan 's official statistics , in the first half of 2000 , the unemployment rate in each month was less then 3 percent .
the number of people who once lost jobs or may lose jobs reached 940,000 .
in january this year , the united states ' businessweek published a survey report about taiwan 's unemployment situation , saying that the unemployment rate in taiwan was 11 percent , 2.5 times the official figure .
at present , while the economic situation is getting worse and the enterprises are bogged down in business difficulties , workers are being laid off batch by batch across the island , not only in traditional industries , but also in high - tech industries .
in addition , it is expected that taiwan 's accession to the world trade organization will make another 100,000 people lose their jobs .
chen shui - bian set forth a policy target of " three priorities , " that is , giving priority to investment , to the economy , and to taiwan .
at the same time , the authorities also planned to carry out aggressive financial reforms , promoting the mergers of financial institutions , setting up assets management corporations , and also carrying out taxation reforms .
however , all these high - sounding slogans only displayed a great dream . there is no way to realize such plans . the plans also invited criticism from the opposition parties , which held that the " executive yuan " was just putting on a " show . "
it was just the tactic used by the authorities of the democratic progressive party to maintain the policy of " no haste , be patient , " restrain the development of cross - strait economic and trade relations , and delay the adjustment and opening of the mainland economic and trade policy .
such opinion and practice are just like putting the cart before the horse .
the economic recession and increasing unemployment in taiwan were caused by the sluggishness in the international economic environment and the worsening economic environment on the island , and were not caused by the investment of taiwan businessmen on the mainland .
this not only guaranteed that taiwan still maintained a foreign trade surplus and thus alleviated the difficulties that the taiwan enterprises were facing , but also provided a broader room for maneuver and development prospects for taiwan 's economic development .
this hits home by pointing out the crux of taiwan 's economic problem and the solution .
otherwise , taiwan 's " economic miracle " will be ruined in the hands of the democratic progressive party , and it will have to hand over the power to other people in the next " presidential " election .

china 's image as a large foreign trade country was again demonstrated at the guangdong trade show , china 's largest foreign trade showcase , which concluded several days ago . however , it also revealed certain problems with chinese export products in such areas as structure , administrative levels , and competitiveness .
the speed with which china 's foreign trade has grown has also attracted the attention of the world . average growth of foreign trade over the past 20 years has exceeded 15 percent , higher than the rate of growth of the gdp , and leapt to seventh in the world from 32 nd .
china , however , is a large foreign trade country but not a foreign trade power .
labor intensive and resource intensive products still occupy a pillar position among exports , there were not a lot of products with a high technology content , and foreign trade order still needs to be reworked and standardized .
there were some enterprises at the guangdong trade show that are still fighting a price war and vying for sales with low prices . business departments are also receiving constant complaints of intellectual property rights violations and counterfeit products .
the chaotic state of the foreign trade order has not only upset the market and undermined the reputation of chinese products , it has also led to a certain extent to the use of restrictive trade protection measures by some countries towards china .
it is reported that by the end of 2000 , over 410 cases by 28 countries and regions of implementation of anti - dumping , anti - subsidy , and safeguard measures had been examined , and china had become the country whose global export products were most subject to anti - dumping examinations .
since 1999 , china 's implementation of the strategy to revitalize trade by applying scientific and technological advances has had some clear achievements . in 2000 , total national exports of new high technology products was us $ 37 billion , 50 percent higher than the previous year and 22 percentage points higher than national growth of export trade .
currently , the commodity structure and export structure of products exhibited at the guangdong trade show is experiencing a big change .
" china is in the process of working hard to move from being a large foreign trade country to a powerful foreign trade country . we hope that this objective can be realized within one or two five - year plan periods , " said gao yan , news spokesperson for the ministry of foreign trade .

germany 's daimler - benz 's buyout of the us chrysler three years ago started the ball rolling .
during the ninth five - year plan , the state invested 58.8 billion yuan in the car industry , with 80 percent of the funds going to 13 major enterprises , thus giving rise to a relative concentration in the auto industry .
let the car industry return to the path of being a competitive sector and follow the road of competitive reorganization traced by the color television manufacturers .

[ begin editor 's notes ] : as the focus of today 's competition is turning more and more towards the field of qualified talent , the building of able personnel is now carrying an increasingly great weight in the overall army - building strategy .
implementing this important thinking and giving full scope to the energy and ability of high - quality talent is an urgent demand to ensure that our army " wins the war , " to successfully " guard against moral degeneration , " and to realize a development by leaps and bounds .
chairman jiang has pointed out : " without a large number of high - quality personnel , we can find no way to master the use of new weapons , can find no way to create and apply new combat methods , and therefore will not be able to win the victory of future wars . "
a knowledge - based military calls for talent with expertise in specific fields .
today , large numbers of high - grade , precision , and sophisticated weapons have been put into use on the battlefield ; a drastic increase has been noticed in the technology intensity of weaponry ; and operations have become more electronic - controlled , intelligence - based , and digitalized than ever before .
this is marked by the fact that high - quality talent have become the ones who hold the initiative of the military struggle ; and who can promptly and extensively absorb advanced technologies and knowledge on the one hand , and can fully and efficiently transform scientific and technological achievements into fighting capacities on the other .
some people even compare high - quality talent to storage transformers that can constantly absorb and store energy and then give full scope to and release the energy upon digestion and processing .
when qian xuesen broke through numerous obstructions and returned to the motherland in the 1950 s , a person of authority in the then us administration said with regret : " one qian xuesen is equal to five divisions . "
combined operations have the need for commanding talent who have combined capabilities .
a high - tech war is a " five - in - one " combined operation among all arms and services under the navy , the army , and the air force and also involves the space [ tian ] and telecommunications [ dian ] .
on the battlefield of a combined operation , electronic confrontation is becoming increasingly intense , the degree of command control automation is growing higher and higher , and the battlefield situation is undergoing instantaneous changes ; and all these have constituted a severe challenge to the quality of commanding officers .
the task of reinforcing the army through science and technology has a thirst for decision - making talent .
all studies and explorations concerning decisions on major reforms in an army , all consultations and theoretical verifications , and the formulation and implementation of all policies cannot do without the creative work of high - quality talent .
in order to gain the initiative of future military struggles , the united states and a number of other advanced countries have all adopted various preferential policies to vigorously bring up and contend for talent with high academic backgrounds .
the us army believes : " high - quality military talent are the most important decisive factors in ensuring the military power of the united states . "
in russia , 98 percent of military officials have received higher education ; in japan , all the military officers have the tertiary educational level and above ; while india also requires its military officers at and above the battalion level to hold master 's degree .
it is just as chairman jiang has pointed out : " at present , the quality of the cadres contingent of our army has yet to totally suit the demands of our military strategic requirements for the new period , and this is an issue that has to be settled urgently . "
what has caused the present situation wherein high - quality talent are not put to good use and cannot be kept in our troops ?
even today , some people in our contingent still have , in the back of their minds , the outdated concept of resenting intellectuals and being wary of high - quality talent ; and according to the one - sided belief of these people , the more knowledge one has , the less he should be trusted .
in some of our units , however , respecting able personnel is only in form ; and people are respected and entrusted with heavy responsibilities not because they have more knowledge and a higher quality or they have made greater contribution .
on the contrary , the traditional concept of " respecting whoever is holding a high official position " is more popular ; in other words , the higher one 's official position , the greater respect he can expect .
at present , a prevailing one - sided understanding is that high - end talent with high academic backgrounds are those who " have academic qualifications but no work ability , and who have knowledge but no practical experience . "
all these erroneous practices of using defects to obscure virtues and focusing on one 's shortcomings to the neglect of his good points have greatly dampened the initiative and the self - confidence of high - quality talent .
the limitations of material conditions have also made it hard for high - quality talent to fully display their abilities .
however , the limitations of material conditions in the army have made it hard for them to fully fulfill their original wish of attaining something big in their career .
competition is an important lever that promotes the progress and the development of army building , and is also a driving force that spurs our talent to exert themselves .
however , a fair competition and incentive mechanism that rewards the advanced and gears up those lagging behind has yet to be completely built up in many departments in our army .
as a result , high - quality talent in these units are not valued or entrusted with important responsibilities ; and what is worse , a phenomenon of reversed elimination has been noticed due to the restrictions of a number o f conditions , such as seniority , experiences , and age .
to make high - quality talent produce a group effect , what is the kind of supporting environment and conditions we need to create ?
to do this , we need to renew our concepts , get out of the wrong areas in our understanding , and create an humanistic environment of " searching for , respecting , and being generous to human talent . "
marx noted : man is the product of the environment .
qu yuan , a great chinese poet , said in his " ode to tangerine " : tangerine is a fruit grown in the south , and the suitable climate there makes it taste nice and sweet ; however , if tangerine is transplanted to the north , it will turn into dry and tasteless orange .
comrade deng xiaoping once pointed out in explicit terms : " we must create an environment that enables our top - notch talent to show their outstanding abilities . "
regarding the use of able personnel , we need to establish a correct direction of valuing people 's achievements and abilities ; rely on sound systems to select and recruit able personnel ; and encourage able personnel , by means of competition , to strive for higher attainments .
establishing a mechanism of " judging and selecting horses from the race course " through systems has proved to be a more reliable and fair method than the practice of " bo le judging horses , " and we should further systemize and standardize this method in our selection and recruitment of able personnel .
material benefits are one of the major driving forces that arouse and stimulate people 's enthusiasm and creativity .
marx said : " all the things that people are fighting for are related with their own interests . "
to high - quality talent , benefits and remunerations corresponding to their work results and abilities means a recognition of their ability and value .
this is the fundamental basis of promoting this educational campaign and the key to differentiate between this campaign and ordinary campaigns that educate party members .
it is true that we did pay attention to maintaining the advanced nature of party members in previous campaigns to educate party members , but the historical conditions prevented us from using the " three represents " requirement as the criteria for the advanced nature of party members .
differences in standard leads to corresponding differences in content , methods and procedures .
another obvious characteristic of the current campaign lies in the emphasis on closely associating study with putting into practice and uniting education with activities .
this campaign is neither a usual theory study program nor an ordinary educational activity focusing on a given subject ; instead , it is a year - long and regular activity to study and put that into practice .
although centralized study is necessary for some development periods of this campaign , the study of theory , inspection , rectification for improvement , and practice should permeate every aspect of the regular party - building and party members ' study , work and lives .
to harmoniously associate the study with the practice and unite the education with the activity , many units took initiatives to explore in schedule planning , content designing , and measure implementation .
these four implementations are fundamental requirements for the party as a whole in order to study and put into practice the important thinking of the " three represents . " they are also fundamental requirements for the military to satisfactorily carry out this educational campaign .
when promoting this educational campaign , we , the military , should permeate these requirements in every aspect regarding the military , science and technology , logistics supply , armament and the preparation for the military struggle , and use this campaign to boost the comprehensive military construction .

to properly accomplish the economic rural restructuring in our country , we must clearly understand and master the regularity in the evolution of agricultural and the rural economic structure , and then seize the key points based on such understanding , thus making advances in an orderly way .
understand and master the general regularity in structural evolution adjusting the rural economic structure is a dynamic process for development . developments and changes in this process are governed by various objective regularities .
according to the historical and current facts in agricultural development at home and abroad , following main regularities exist in the evolution of the agricultural structure and the rural economic structure : social demand is playing a guiding or leading role for structural changes .
agriculture is the foundation for mankind 's survival . its main products are food and fiber , and the basic function is to satisfy mankind 's subsistence needs for food and clothing .
if people still cannot get sufficient food and clothing for their subsistence , primary demand in society becomes grain , where as farm produce has a feature of not becoming diverse ; then the main purpose of agriculture becomes production of sufficient grain to meet people 's subsistence need .
after people can get sufficient food and clothing , social demand for farm produce will change and become more diverse .
the level of industrialization and urbanization represents the degree of social progress , and also reflects the industrial structure and the employment structure in society .
in a country , with the advancement of industrialization and urbanization , the proportion of agriculture in the national economy will become smaller and smaller , and the proportion of the rural population in the whole country 's total population will also become smaller and smaller .
science and technology is the primary productive force .
the adoption and application of advanced science and technology in agricultural and the rural economy will inevitably bring about changes in the mode of agricultural production , and at the same time , will give rise to changes in the structure of agriculture and the rural economy .
for example , the spread of a large - scale breeding technique will inevitably promote the development of specialized animal or aquatic farming , thus further promote the division of work and production in the rural areas and bring about changes in the production structure .
the adoption of a farm product processing technique will promote the development of the secondary and tertiary industries in the countryside and will also promote the transfer of rural labor force to non - farming industries and bring about changes in employment structure .
under the conditions of a traditional self - sufficient economy , the development of agriculture mainly relies on the face - to - face impartment of experience , and does not require a high standard of work skills and good education among peasants .
with the scientific and technological progress and the development of modern education , peasants can master better work skills and richer scientific and general knowledge . this will provide a major driving force for changing the structure of agriculture and the rural economy .
with the improvement of people 's living conditions , the output of such products with a higher degree of demand as vegetables , meat , eggs , milk , and edible fungus will be substantively increased in farming production .
fifth , agricultural products will change from raw materials for industry into manufactured products in industry .
key points in rural economic restructuring on the basis of understanding and mastering the general regularity in the evolution of agriculture and the rural economic structure , we should , proceed from the actual conditions of agriculture and rural economic development in our country , seize the key points and advance the rural economic restructuring in an orderly way .
the so - called rural basic structure refers to the institutions and facilities that create common conditions and provide public services for rural material production and rural residents ' livelihood .
at present , the backwardness of the rural basic structure is a prominent issue that substantively affects peasants ' production and daily life .
therefore , it is necessary to increase the effectiveness of adjusting the rural basic structure , go all out to develop infrastructure facilities in rural areas , improve peasants ' working and living conditions , and continuously enhance their live quality .
however , under the condition of a buyer 's market when agricultural products are oversupplied , although peasants know that they should produce whatever is profitable , they still frequently encounter a situation in which what they produce is oversupplied on the market , and they often find it very difficult to sell their products well .
at present , the farming structure has come to a juncture of requiring an instant adjustment .
with the leadership and organization of these enterprises , individual peasant households can specialize their production on a large scale and provide stable raw materials for the leading enterprises .
adjust the structural variety of agricultural production .
at present , the short supply of farm produce in our country has been basically terminated . however , high - quality products still account for a low proportion of the total agricultural output .
adjusting the employment structure of the rural labor force is an inevitable need in the effort to enhance the agricultural labor productivity , increase peasants ' income , expand social demand , and promote the growth of the national economy .
on the other hand , it is necessary to broaden the employment space in non - farming industries in rural areas through actively developing the secondary and tertiary industries in rural areas , developing the rural individual and private economies , and developing the export of labor services .

a us government delegation composed of senior washington officials began visits to nato headquarters in brussels , the republic of korea , and japan on 8 may to start lobbying for the deployment of a missile defense system .
on the same day , us secretary of defense rumsfeld announced that in order to enhance us superiority in space , the defense department plans to bring all us military activities in space under the banner of the us air force space command .
to protect itself and its allies from attack , the united states is continually stepping up its space military plans , and the ambition concealed behind its back to control space and thus continue to exercise world hegemony for the next 50 years is being more and more revealed beyond doubt !
the nmd system alone will require the deployment of 15 radars and 29 satellites , and apart from that , there will also be three ground command centers and five communications relay stations .
this surveillance and early warning system constitutes the nerve center of the nmd system .
an article in the 19 march issue of the us republican party 's " insight " weekly , entitled " the militarization of space , " quoted us space commander general ralph eberhart as saying : " control of space is much more important than missile defense . "
since the clinton administration did not attach sufficient importance in nmd deployment and space planning , in january , with the support of bush who was about to take office , republican senator smith used the legislative process to set up the national security space control and organization commission , called the space commission for short .
this commission is composed of 13 world - ranking space experts , and incoming secretary of defense rumsfeld became its chairman .
a study report published by the space commission on 11 january concluded : " the sky and the oceans were the theaters of the 20 th century , and space will the theater of the 21 st century .
the united states , however , has not made good preparations for coping with the next generation of warfare in this respect . "
the then chairman rumsfeld made a strong appeal to the united states to develop its space superiority and thus control space .
if the establishment of the space commission was just a small step , it was certainly not a small thing that on 7 may secretary of defense rumsfeld announced a plan to place all us military activities in space under the flag of the us space command .
rumsfeld specifically announced that this is an important move of the defense department for giving priority to protecting us supremacy in space , and a major readjustment of its administrative and organizational structure " in order to enhance the us leading position in space defense and space intelligence . "
rumsfeld 's assistant said that strengthening and rearranging the relevant space projects will help in giving these projects an important place in the defense department 's strategic deployments , and at the same time will help in getting more funds for these projects .
secretly conducting space exercises in order to explore the rules of space warfare , the us air force secretly held a space war exercise codenamed " (scliaf) " at springs airbase in colorado from 22 to 26 january .
this was the first large - scale space warfare exercise in usaf history . according to the usaf website , the exercise was supposed to portray events around 2017 with the imaginary enemy as the " reds " and us space command as the " blues . "
the us space units with powerful space military forces were able to defeat the enemy by " effective surprise moves . "
according to colonel ( rob hergestlon ) , on - the - spot commander in the exercise , who was in charge of the simulators in the space combat center of us space command , the aim of this " ( scliaf } 2001 " space warfare exercise was to probe in depth relevant problems in space warfare .
controlling space in a bid to dominate the world since the pattern of the cold war was broken , along with the development of economic globalization , the trend of multipolarization has become the unstoppable tide of the times , and the us ambition to exercise hegemony over the world will become ever harder to achieve .
hence , a number of military and think tank figures are trying to find a new breakthrough point in order to gain good opportunities for the united states to establish world hegemony in the next 50 years , and this breakthrough point is the control of space .
russia organizes space force the united states and the former soviet union launched space rivalry long ago .
ivanov revealed that the russian military will restructure its branches ; starting in 2001 , the strategic rocket forces will part with their antimissile units and military space units , and a new branch will be organized - - the space force .
in 2002 the strategic rocket force will be revamped into a branch of the armed forces and it will be merged with the air force in 2006 .
the future russian armed forces will include the army , navy , air force , paratroops , and space force , and at the same time they will change the policy of laying too much emphasis on manned space flight and step up input in other space military preparations .

the nation - wide struggle to crack down on fraudulent claims for export tax rebates is another important policy undertaken to crack down on serious criminal activities in the economic sphere , and is a harsh crackdown launched by party central and the state council on smuggling and fraudulent payments over the last few years .
from august 2000 until now , a total of 533 cases of fraudulent claims for export tax rebates have been cracked nationwide , and 88,000 forged value - added checks have been uncovered . it is suspected that 8.386 billion yuan in fraudulent taxes was stolen , and 411 persons have been apprehended .
this has dealt a harsh blow to the criminal activity of unrestrained fraudulent claims for export tax rebates , and the struggle to crack down on fraudulent claims for export tax rebates has achieved an interim victory .
the implementation of export tax rebates is an important policy adopted by the nation in order to expand exports .
in order to counter the adverse affects of the asian financial crisis on our nation 's economy and to achieve renewed growth of external trade , since 1998 our nation has repeatedly raised the amount of tax rebates on a portion of exported goods .
this has played an important role in stimulating the nation 's foreign trade and export and in helping the national economy maintain rapid , healthy development .
beginning in august of last year , the state council dispatched a task force to conduct major investigations in the cities of chaoyang and puning in guangdong province .
the fraudulent tax network that had been operated for years by criminal elements was brought down .
practice proves that the decisions taken by party central and the state council on launching the crackdown on fraudulent claims for export tax rebates were completely correct and very timely .
it has great significance in terms of strengthening and improving macro - regulation , avoiding the loss of national tax revenue , stimulating healthy economic development , thoroughly implementing the strategy of governance by the rule of law , rectifying and regulating the socialist market economic order , and severely punishing corruption .
at present , although the work of cracking down on fraudulent claims for export tax rebates has achieved an interim victory , in order to achieve party central 's and the state council 's proposed requirement of " total victory , " a great deal of work remains to be done .
we must continue to track down every last case , investigate all details thoroughly , and allow perpetrators of export tax rebate fraud no place to hide , striving for the achievement of a total victory in the struggle against this type of fraud as early as possible .
in the long run , stopping the occurrence of fraudulent tax cases will require applying technological measures , using improved mechanisms and strengthening law enforcement units to achieve the goal of curing both the symptoms and the root cause of the disease .
this year , our national economic development has shown a good trend . foreign exports are growing , and the day when we enter the wto is approaching .
beijing , 11 may ( xinhua ) - - the supreme people 's court today released information about some major cases concerning tax - related crimes committed in guangdong 's chaoyang and puning areas .
the criminal cases about writing false receipts for obtaining vat rebates in guangdong 's chaoyang and puning involved inordinately huge amounts of money virtually unprecedented since the founding of new china , and so were the pernicious effects these cases have created .
with these receipts , which involved more than 32.76 million yuan , they collected service charges from the recipients , who in turn wrote off more than 30.9 million yuan of taxes and defrauded more than 770,000 yuan of export rebates from the state .
during the period from 1998 through 2000 , he tao , another native of puning city , guangdong , used unlawful measures to purchase three businesses ' operating licenses and tax payment documentations , and forged 227 vat receipts totally more than 10.48 million yuan .
by the time the investigation of the case was completed , the state had yet to recover more than 5.65 million yuan .
after completing the first trial this morning , the people 's courts of shantou and jieyang cities in guangdong also pronounced verdicts on 34 defendants and six units implicated in 16 cases about forging vat receipts .

in the five decades of constant changes , china and pakistan have strictly pursued the five principles of peaceful coexistence , understood and trusted each other , stood and gone through thick and thin together , forged profound friendship , and thus became a model of peaceful coexistence between countries of different social systems .
at the end of 1996 , chinese state president jiang zemin paid a successful state visit to pakistan , and china and pakistan established a comprehensive and cooperative partnership geared toward the 21 st century .

last year , the volume of bilateral trade reached a record high of $ 1.16 billion or two times the figure in the last 10 years .
cooperation between china and pakistan in technology and complete sets of equipment is unceasingly expanding in terms of size and field .

china and pakistan have gratifying prospects for mutually beneficial cooperation .

after equipping itself with a new model of fighters , a certain air force aviation regiment has received widespread attention from around the country , the entire army , and various relevant circles : can the regiment handle advanced weaponry well ?
can it win a local high - tech war ?
focusing on the characteristics of modern air battles , they actively explore the potential of the new fighter model , boldly break with traditional training modes , and frequently organize extreme - weather , high - intensity , and high - difficulty flight training .
flight training in extreme weather conditions requires superb technical competency and , more importantly , courage and vision .
by then , someone advised them not to go any further : " that is good enough . it would be disastrous to have accidents happen to such expensive fighters . "
if at the crucial moment our fighters could not fly and could not defeat an enemy because of the weather , then we would all become the persons condemned by history ! "
a very important military action at a certain airfield in the southern part of the country , a fleet of airplanes was all set and ready to take off the moment the order was received .
suddenly , dark clouds gathered low in the sky and a downpour came .
the front - line command center called and asked : " can the planes take off with the sudden change in weather ?
" the planes will take off as per normal and arrive punctually ! "
from the sky , rain poured down quick and heavy ; on the runway , water overflowed like a rushing river .
" take off ! "
the heavy fighter turned on its lights , accelerated , and took off with a roar in the rain .
brilliant lights shone through curtains of rain . water splashed high as the aircraft sped along the runway . burning flames from its tail pipe turned rainwater into hot vapor . the fighting eagle was like a ship cutting through the waves in a choppy sea .
one after another , the fighting eagles roared off into the sky and shot toward the clouds . very quickly , their thundering roar vanished among the clouds of lead . the planes arrived over the designated theater punctually .
formidable sword must be matched by good sword - fighting skill colonel liu guosheng , incumbent regiment commander , is a " tiger " of the blue sky .
he told his pilots on numerous occasions : " do not regard our high - tech weapons , which the party and the country have paid huge sums to equip us with , as common weapons .
in order to give full play to the performance of high - tech weapons , we must train ourselves in the tactics of defeating an enemy and win a victory . "
over the past few years , the regiment has established a firm understanding of future battle opponents and battlefield environments , and has realized the change from focusing on techniques in their training to focusing on tactics , thus narrowing the gap between training and reality .
in 1999 , the higher level gave the regiment the task of studying tactics of attacking advanced enemy fighters . the regiment immediately formed three flight problem - solving teams led by different leaders of the regiment .
after repeating such practice several times , they finally came out with several sets of feasible tactics and were ready to test these tactics in the air .
one fighter acted as the fighter of the " blue army " and another acted as that of the " red army . "
when one tried to strike the other , the latter would quickly shake the other off .
a group of men and equipment acted as the " blue army , " simulating the enemy 's advanced fighters employing " unique , superb tactics . " another group of men and equipment acted as the " red army , " using its strength to attack the enemy 's weaknesses , surprisingly and unexpectedly .
after carrying out confrontation tests similar to real battles , it was proved by the rate of winning that the several sets of tactics studied by the regiment and used in its training are effective and feasible .
by now , these tactical maneuvers have been made into cd - roms and multi - media software and have been promoted in all air force units .
one day at the end of the 20 th century , the azure , tranquil sky over the exercise site of a certain unit was disturbed by a series of rumbles and tongues of flames .
a small target raging arrogantly at minimum altitude was totally unaware that our fighters had locked on to it .
li mingquan , deputy head of the 3 d group of the certain aviation regiment , who was on combat - ready duty , and jiang shibao roared off toward the sky in the new model of fighters .
quick - witted li mingquan let jiang shibao monitor the plane from a high altitude using the big - wheel tactic [ da che lun zhan fa ] , while li himself circled close around the small plane , thus keeping the target in the " net . "
thus a live act of pitting against each other 's wits and courage was played out between the heavy fighters and the small plane in the sky above the southern region .
the cunning small plane continued to climb lower in altitude and tried to shake off our planes by flying at low altitude . deputy group chief li therefore circled the small plane at a low altitude in order to prevent the small plane from " slipping through the net " and to avoid a midair collision .
deputy group chief li continued to chase the plane closely and " stick " to the target tenaciously .
after making the forced landing , he praised time and again : " the chinese air force is terrific ! "
the successful forced landing of the small plane meant that the tactics studied and used by the pilots in their training worked brilliantly even at the first try and had undergone a real - battle test .
it also signified that pilots in the regiment have scored gratifying achievements in constantly improving the technical and tactical performance of equipment on hand and in studying and training feasible tactics .
dare to break into " forbidden zone " in order to win battles while refitting the new model of fighters , pilots of the certain aviation regiment were all fully aware of this technical requirement : fighters are not allowed to lower their landing gear at a high altitude of more than several thousand meters above sea level .
at 1123 on a certain day last summer , upon receiving an order from the commander , deputy regiment commander luo yingquan and deputy group chief wang tao zoomed off in the new model of fighters toward the clouds .
in the blue sky amid the white clouds , the fighting eagles looked sometimes like swallows soaring in the sky and sometimes like carp playing in the water , freely whizzing and whooshing past mountains and valleys on the highland of the motherland .
the highland test flight of the new model of fighters was successful !
the real - troop mobilization at an unfamiliar region was called the " midnight action " in short .
in the new historical period , new models of weaponry mean combat capabilities ; science and technology means combat capabilities ; talents all the more mean vibrant combat capabilities .
with its superb overall quality , the regiment is like a tiger that has been given new wings . the regiment has become the " knockout " aviation unit of the air force with rapid maneuverability , quick response , and advanced combat means .

mankind has marched into the 21 st century .
the world is now experiencing profound changes .
world multipolarization is developing in tortuous fashion , economic globalization is continually deepening , and science and technology are forging ahead with each passing day .
mankind is facing new challenges and , still more , new development opportunities .
the exploitation and use of material resources represent the basis of the development of human society , while the development of human wisdom and capacity determines the depth and breadth of the exploitation of material resources .
mankind has boundless wisdom and creativity , and this is the inexhaustible source of the driving force for the progress of civilization .
developing human resources and stepping up human capacity building has become a major question which bears on the development of all countries today .
continual social development has opened up broad prospects for giving full play to human capacity .
mankind is continually creating new fruits of civilization , and the progress of civilization , especially the major breakthroughs in science and technology , are continually creating new conditions and setting new demands on human development itself .
while enhancing the social productive forces , every technological invention and application brings new impetus for enhancing human capacity .
the problem of talent shortage exists everywhere ; there are many irrational and unfair phenomena in the international competition for talent ; the disparities between the developing and the developed countries in human capacity building are widening all the time , and there is a serious outflow of talent from the developing countries .
promoting the building of human capacity requires that all countries step up this work and also requires concerted efforts by the international community .
for this reason , i advocate the following five points on human capacity building in apec : first , establish new development concepts and step up human capacity building .
we should regard human capacity building as an important field in apec exchanges and cooperation and as an important measures for assisting the economic growth of its developing members , narrowing the south - north gap , and promoting coordinated development .
education is the basis of human capacity building , and learning is the basic way to enhance human capacity .
we should encourage people to take part in lifelong learning through various forms , so as to expand and update their knowledge , improve their quality , and enhance their talent .
third , popularize the information network and optimize methods of learning and self - improvement .
information network technology is of great significance in promoting people 's learning and work and enhancing the quality of the laborers .
we should regard the development and use of the information network as an important means in human capacity building , draw up popularization plans , and take effective measures to create conditions for popularizing the information network and developing long - range education .
we should increase the proportion of network users , and help weak groups to develop their ability , so that still more people can benefit from information network technology .
fourth , carry forward the spirit of innovation and cultivate young talents .
in line with the demands of economic development , social progress , and the advance of science and technology , we should regard cultivating the innovative spirit and developing innovative ability as an important task in human capacity building , and actively push this forward .
we must pay particular attention to cultivating young talents and create conditions for their talent to show itself .
we should promote their studies and exchanges , encourage them to clear the way to forge ahead , and support them in their innovations .
we should build an effective incentive mechanism and a fair and equal competition order to create a good environment for the growth of talent and the continued development of economy , science , and technology .
with the start of the new century , the task of asia - pacific countries and regions in stepping up human capacity building is very heavy .
i hope that the developed member - states will support the developing members in finance , material , and technology , to speed up human capacity building in the developing members .
this will not only benefit economic and social development in the developing members but will also help to bring about common prosperity in the region at an early date .

china has scored tremendous achievements in economic and social development since the launch of reforms and opening up .
china , however , has a large population and a weak foundation ; its development is unbalanced , and it remains a developing country .
the development of china 's human resources still does not meet the requirements of economic and social development , and lags far behind advanced world standards .
china is now actively implementing the talent strategy , vigorously developing its talent resources , comprehensively improving the quality of the laborers , and striving to gain an edge in human resources , so as to provide powerful support for reforms , opening up , and modernization .
we are ready to further strengthen exchanges and cooperation with apec member - states , and will make efforts to make our proper contribution to human capacity building in the asia - pacific region .
ladies and gentlemen , at the start of the new century , we are scaling the heights and looking into the distance , and studying together human capacity building , which is a major issue related to future development . everyone has a common feeling , that is , we shoulder common responsibilities for the future of the world .
