we will never rest before winning complete victory .
the main threat in future warfare comes from the air , and the trial of strength between air attack and air defense will become the trial of strength of decisive significance .
in the first 70 years this was on the whole an even confrontation , with victories and defeats for both attack and defense .
by the 1970 's , air defense reached its apogee , and the brilliant achievements of the egyptian and syrian air defense units in the opening phase of the fourth mideast war caused people to exclaim in alarm that " the era of controlling the air from the ground has now arrived . "
experts said : by using the eyes of science to weigh up recent combat between air attack and defense , we will find that there is a contrast between different eras in the " asymmetrical " phenomenon .
in the partial wars fought since the 1980 's , confrontation between air attack and defense has become confrontation between two generations of combat pattern .
this change is composed of two aspects , one is the change that has occurred in air attack , with hi - tech attack mounting the stage of history ; and the other is that air defense development has stagnated and fallen into crisis .
the combination of the natural advantage of air attack with the new technological revolution is the basic cause for the crisis in air defense .
it can be predicted that along with the new developments in science and technology , the " air attack revolution " will continue to develop in new breadth and depth , posing new challenges to air defense .
the core task in national security is to be ready to meet the 21 st century military challenges , and the key to protecting national security in the future lies in information technology , air and space capability , and command and control .
some other experts believe : due to different levels of development of the productive forces , the " air attack revolution " first occurs in the militarily developed western countries .
since the 1980 's the western countries headed by the united states have relied on hi - tech air strikes to frequently wreak havoc in the world , and used their hi - tech air forces to convey and impose their will on every corner of the globe .
they have tasted the sweetness of the air attack revolution and gained tremendous security interests from it .
corresponding to this , the crisis in air defense first appears among the developing countries , since the air defense lines that they have built up over many years have suddenly become loose and fragile , and their national security has been seriously damaged and threatened to a tremendous extent .
the harsh facts of the gulf and kosovo wars have warned peace - lovers : " there is no airspace without aviation , and there is no national defense without air defense . "
hence , we should carry out a profound change in the field of air defense , completely discard the old air defense concepts , and establish an air defense combat setup that meets the requirements of future air combat ; only thus can we keep pace with the steps of the " air attack revolution . "
we must squarely face the " air attack revolution , " but there is no need to panic .
" multidimensional air defense " becomes more and more urgent the experts and professors candidly said : in the first 20 to 30 years of the 21 st century , " multidimensional air defense " should become the basic pattern of air defense .
second is the integration of air and space .
" multidimensional air defense " takes the scope of defense beyond the atmosphere and extends it to outer space ; this is the inevitable choice commensurate with expanding military action into space .
" multidimensional air defense " seeks to safeguard national interests within the sphere of non - sovereign as well as sovereign space .
" multidimensional air defense " seeks to preserve national spiritual as well as material interests from harm .
we should establish the concept of the integration of air and space and attach importance to controlling the aviation and spaceflight environment .
only thus can we lay the foundation for victory in future air defense combat .
for any country , building a new pattern of air defense for the 21 st century will have a bearing on national interests and honor or disgrace in the new century .
military experts have predicted that armed helicopters will become an irreplaceable new branch of the armed services in future warfare .
their powerful attack fast like a thunderbolt in the depths of yan shan , two china - made defensive helicopters-9 were hedgehopping at an altitude of less than 20 meters .
suddenly , two helicopters were pressing against the back of the mountain , flying over the top of the mountain , and diving toward the group of tanks . in a flash , the tank group became a sea of fire after being bombarded by a few rockets .
following the attack , two helicopters ascended and left . the whole process of the sudden attack took less than 10 seconds .
while looking for our helicopters back and forth , the " enemy " helicopter went into range of our helicopters . in a decisive move , our armed helicopters fired missiles . instantly , a fire broke out and smoke was rising from the enemy helicopter .
the helicopter regiment has started training on these new ways of operation .
the regiment has never come into contact with direct aerial confrontations between armed helicopters , nor has the army found any information on the tactics . no specific examples of combat are available for reference either .
on a pitch - dark night in late autumn in 2000 , six armed helicopters took off on time .
the flight was conducted in a blind area where it was completely " invisible " by radar .
there were many trees and wire poles along the way . the height of the trees and wire poles was between 10 and 20 meters , which was exactly the flying altitude of the helicopters . it was too dangerous !
like six big dragonflies with eyes , the six helicopters dodged here and there . sticking to the route set by previous reconnaissance , the six helicopters flew near the airport of the " enemy " in complete secrecy .
four helicopters were hovering at an altitude of one meter . forty fully armed special troops jumped off the helicopters once the cabin doors were opened .
twenty special troops slid down ropes hanging from another two helicopters which were hovering at a position where landing was impossible .
the amount of time needed for all soldiers to jump off the helicopters was exactly the same as required by the drill .
when the " enemy " was sent into chaos , three armed helicopters arrived . the helicopters fired missiles and rockets simultaneously , and the defense works of the " enemy " airport were immediately inundated in smoke of gunpowder and flames of war .
for this kind of sudden attack , there are very precise requirements for every link of the entire operation .
" god of war " has added another " eye of heaven " during the reporting assignment , this reporter was constantly inspired by new and strange matters .
the aerial command center was in fact the reconnaissance and fire - adjusting planes . the responsibility of the planes in warfare is to conduct supervision and control at any time on the depths of the combat field of the enemy , and conduct reconnaissance on targets on the ground .
under the condition of good visibility , the ground observation post enables soldiers to see over a distance of several km , and with aerial observation , the distance will be increased by ten times or even 100 times .
in order to master the techniques of reconnaissance and command , qi yuhai and his comrade - in - arms made use of every drill conducted and took the initiative to add more tasks and press themselves with more burdens .
by judging the error between bombing point and target , and swiftly transmitting commands of fire - adjusting , he constantly explored keys to problems during drills . finally , he was able to finish fire - adjusting command within the smallest amount of time .
in recent years , they have accumulated experiences in aerial reconnaissance and command during many major drills in which they had to cooperate with ground forces to accomplish the tasks of resisting landing , raiding targets on the sea , launching a ground attack , and building an artillery cover .

indeed , both sides of the strait will soon accede to the wto . one may well say that there will be greater room for economic development between the two sides of the strait when they are both members of the wto and apec . those who cannot see this point are missing an opportunity for development .
however , both sides of the strait are facing serious challenges , which include setbacks from economic globalization , a weak economic recovery in asia , and a deadlock in political relations between the two sides of the strait after taiwan 's democratic progressive party [ dpp ] came to power .
it is our belief that the early years of the 21 st century are a historical period that has great significance as a pointer of the direction of economic and trade relations between the two sides of the strait .
japan , another asian economic power , in addition to holding negotiations with singapore , has also embarked on different stages of separate bilateral free trade negotiations with the republic of korea , mexico , canada , and malaysia .
with regard to the establishment of small multilateral free trade areas at the subregional level , membership in asean has expanded from five countries to 10 . the possibility of establishing a new asean - australia - new zealand free trade area before the year 2010 has been confirmed .
thus , of the 21 apec members , 17 have signed or are in the process of holding negotiations on bilateral trade agreements , and are conferring on the establishment of a subregional trade area .
obviously , those countries and regions that are signing bilateral trade accords with the most countries and are also able to participate in multilateral trade accords are getting the most out of this upsurge of bilateralism and small multilateralism .
the trade diversion effect arising from this upsurge will hurt those who are not taking part .
although both sides of the taiwan strait will soon accede to the wto , given the growing functions and membership of two regional economic organizations - - the european common market and the free trade area of the americas , the functions of the wto might be diluted in some respects .
if one considers the possibility that the wto could be reduced to this kind of international economic and trade organization , then from now on the two sides of the strait should give full attention to considering the prospects for cross - strait economic cooperation and trade from the angle of the asian - pacific regional economy .
in this sense , one could say that establishing an economic and trade framework with common economic functions would be a direction for future cross - strait development .
this has had an influence on taiwan 's overall economic growth , which has not been good in the past several years .
the recent turmoil in taiwan 's political and economic situation has also caused a contraction in the level of total social consumption .
however , on the other hand , as far as economic " security " is concerned , they have started to consider the significance that the mainland 's economic development holds for taiwan 's economy .

internal factors include the loss of equilibrium in taiwan 's economic structure , the rifts in political parties , and the psychological pressure brought on society by the confrontational state across the strait .
( in 1988 , the value of taiwan 's exports to the united states accounted for 38.7 percent of total export value . this ratio declined gradually over the next decade , falling to 24.2 percent in 1997 .
in the same period , taiwan 's exports to hong kong and the mainland increased , rising to 24 percent in 1997 .
the united states was taiwan 's number one export market .
on a practical level , the pressure from business circles is compelling the authorities to show flexibility on some policy provisions , such as the announcement on the gradual elimination of restrictions on investment by mainland firms in taiwan .
the above phenomena show that the ability of the taiwan authorities to restrict cross - strait economic and trade relations is weakening by the day .
in particular , the idea of elevating cross - strait economic cooperation to a " common market system " and regularizing it accordingly , as proposed by the highest - level opposition figure from taiwan with great influence on economic policymaking to visit the mainland in recent years , indeed reflects a high degree of creativity .
at the same time , increasing the influx of taiwan funds and improving cross - strait economic cooperation has an extremely important significance for the mainland 's current modernization drive .
the two sides of the strait must avoid differences and stress accommodation in the regional context . adoption of the formulation of establishing a cross - strait common economic area reflects the current actual requirements even better .

at an assembly on 3 may , japan 's constitution day , the proponents of constitutional revision read the " constitutional revision draft " they prepared . they proposed that the japanese emperor should be the head of state , and that japan should have its " collective self - defense right . "
the assembly also passed a resolution that calls for revising the constitution as quickly as possible .
however , koizumi , japan 's new prime minister , declared that japan 's constitution of peace could be revised .
against this background , a new constitution of japan came into being in 1946 .
since peace is the theme of the constitution , and especially article 9 , which clearly provides that japan renounces war , people call the constitution the " constitution of peace . "
thinking that their opportunity had come , the small number of rightwing elements in japan , who wildly attempted to rearm japan , whipped up a gust of wind to revise the constitution in disregard of japanese people 's strong objection .
in the early 1960 's , japan 's rightwing forces headed by prime minister nobusuke kishi whipped up the second gust of wind to revise the constitution , taking advantage of the revision of the " japan - us security pact . "
the wind resided once again as result of the vigorous struggles waged by the reform forces , such as the social party and the japan communist party , which held high the banner of protecting the constitution .
the third gust of wind whipped up in japan to revise the constitution had its international and domestic factors .
however , because of japanese citizens ' strong objection , those who wanted to revise the constitution again could not attain their goal .
how did the adverse current of revising the constitution appear in the 1990 's , the calls in japan for revising the constitution suddenly grew strong because of two developments .
under the circumstance that the constitution cannot be revised immediately owing to obstacles from various quarters , the proponents have been pushing the japanese government and the national diet to make a law that permits external use of military force .
in june 1992 , the miyazawa cabinet pushed the diet to pass the " law for cooperation in the un peacekeeping movements " ( also called " law of sending troops overseas " ) .
this law authorizes the sdf to intervene militarily when " emergencies occur in surrounding areas . " these legislations have grossly run counter to the course set in japan 's " constitution of peace , " making the constitution look increasingly like a mere scrap of paper .
early last year , the house of representatives and the house of councilors of the japanese diet both set up their committees for studying the revision of the constitution , and decided to spend five years to study issues concerning constitutional revision and another five years to revise the constitution .
on 19 april 2000 , the party decided to act alone to draft the revised constitution and to revise many articles of the constitution , especially article 9 . because the ldp was determined to revise the constitution , it came up with a plan to revise it in about six months .
in the next defense plan that japan recently drew up , japan will throw in more money to develop large weaponry with powerful long - range operational capabilities .
this will include two 10,000 - ton class destroyers ( under the plan , the ships will have missile defense systems ) , two 13,500 - class transport ships , four tanker planes and awacs , and so forth . at the same time , japan will also throw in more money for the development of the tdm system .
we can say that , through revising and adopting these laws , japan has achieved a breakthrough for its military development , and once the constitution has been revised , the space for japan 's military development will be even bigger and the likelihood for japan to carry out military intervention overseas will be much greater .
asian countries cannot afford to ignore the impacts that japan 's constitutional revision will have had on them .
its current constitution was drawn up after it learned its lessons from history . revising japan 's constitution will remove the restrictions that bind the development of japan 's military strength .
people cannot help worrying what negative impacts japan 's constitutional revision will have on the world ?
will its militarism resurrect ?
according to analysis , japan may accelerate its pace in revising the constitution after koizumi became japan 's prime minister , but japan will also have to withstand strong pressures from public opinions at home and abroad .
the governments and people of asian countries also strongly object to japan 's plan to revise the constitution of peace .
people are waiting to see where will japan 's constitution of peace go .

beijing , 18 may ( xinhua ) - - zhao meizhuang , deputy director of the ministry of information industry 's policy and regulation department , said today that the chinese government would continue to tighten supervision and control over the internet to ensure the healthy development of the internet industry .
zhao meizhuang made these remarks at today 's closing session of the " 33 rd world telecommunications day commemorative forum and internet applications forum . "
zhao meizhuang said : the chinese government is expediting the process of enacting telecommunications law . the law covers the internet , with special emphasis on network security .
he said : although china 's current " regulations on telecommunications management " address certain issues in this respect , further regulation is needed . for example , issues such as how to define hackers and viruses and what laws to apply need further examination .
he said that he hoped internet companies would improve self - discipline and that society at large would foster ethical behavior .
china plans to increase its online population to some 200 million during the period covered by the 10 th five - year plan .
since the latter half of last year , china has promulgated a succession of laws and regulations to improve internet management , including " measures for the management of registration of internet sites to provide information services " and " regulations on the management of electronic bulletin services . "
beijing , 5 apr ( xinhua ) - - the china securities regulatory commission promulgated the " guiding opinions on restructuring and reorganizing companies planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market ( draft for soliciting public comment ) " today .
article 5 : when enterprises that have been operating continuously are transformed into companies planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market , they shall adopt the method of complete reorganization and are not permitted to strip away assets or businesses .
article 6 : if the sponsors or stockholders use non - monetary assets for investment purposes , they shall make a complete investment of fixed assets , projects in progress , intangible assets , and other assets that are needed for the business of the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market .
article 7 : a company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall emphasize its main business and shall have a stable source of revenue in order to achieve competitiveness in its core business areas .
moreover , the business being invested should be similar or must have an upstream - downstream vertical relationship or a horizontal relationship in the production chain .
article 9 : without special permission , a company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall not be an investment company or a holding company incorporated primarily through investment with equities or financial claims .
in addition , investment companies or holding companies applying to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall comply with the provisions of the " company law " and relevant regulations of the china securities regulatory commission .
( 2 ) for those social functions that have been stripped away and for non - operating assets , complete agreements must be drawn up . the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market may not lease out management of non - operating assets or authorize others to manage them by proxy .
( 3 ) businesses and assets that have been stripped away may not depend on the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market in the areas of operations and expenses .
chapter ii : concrete requirements for standardizing restructuring and reorganization article 13 : those state - owned companies and state - owned holding companies that meet the requirements of the " company law " shall restructure themselves into joint stock limited companies in accordance with the principles of standardized restructuring and complete reorganization .
under the premise of meeting the requirements for standardized restructuring and complete reorganization , a company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market that is being incorporated with complete operating assets as investment may carry over the operating record of the original company based on the businesses and assets invested by the original company .
in cases where it is still difficult to achieve three continuous years of profits when the operating record of the original company is computed retroactively , it is not permissible to trace the record back to the legal person at the next higher level .
article 16 : without special permission , the same enterprise group may not have more than two companies with similar or related business activities listed on the stock market .
( 3 ) profits related to the replacement , acquisition , or sale of assets account for more than 30 percent but less than 70 percent of the net profits of the company after the last audit .
( 2 ) the competitor transfers the relevant business to an unrelated third party .
article 28 : without special permission , a company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market may not draw up plans to raise funds to purchase assets from individuals or legal persons with actual power of control .
( 3 ) organizations that exclusively provide production and operating services for the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall be reorganized and incorporated into the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market .
( 4 ) affiliated parties shall incorporate professional services that are undertaken principally for the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market into the company ( via investment or sale ) ; alternatively , these services shall be transferred to an unrelated third party to manage .
for natural monopolies such as services to provide water , electricity , gas , or heating , fair and transparent pricing shall be guaranteed .
article 30 : in addition to observing relevant business accounting standards , the principle of strictness shall be adhered to when making judgments about and determining what constitute affiliated parties , affiliations , and affiliated transactions for a company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market .
when a stockholders meeting votes on affiliated transactions , it shall strictly follow the avoidance system stipulated in the articles of incorporation .
for those affiliated transactions that require discussion by the board of directors or a stockholders meeting , affiliated stockholders or directors who have affiliations shall avoid discussion or issue statements as necessary on the fairness and appropriateness of the transactions .
chapter iv : independent and standardized operations article 33 : in the course of restructuring , reorganizing , and continuous operations , a company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall guarantee standardized operations in the areas of organizing form , corporate management structure , and corporate decision making and operations .
article 34 : the assets of a company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall be independent and complete .
( 1 ) the property rights with regard to assets between the sponsors or stockholders and the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall be clearly defined and separated .
assets invested by the sponsors or stockholders shall be delivered in full , and relevant paperwork for changing the ownership rights to assets and equities must be completed .
( 2 ) if the sponsors or stockholders are incorporating an operating business into the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market , any trademarks required by that business shall also go to the company .
( 3 ) patented or unpatented technology that is related to the production of primary products or the provision of labor services shall go to the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market , and relevant paperwork to transfer the technology shall be attended to .
( 4 ) the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall have a place for production and operations that is independent of the sponsors or the controlling stockholder .
in principle , the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall obtain land use rights through transfer arrangements . if legal land use rights are obtained from the main sponsor or the controlling stockholder through leasing , a relatively long leasing period and a definite payment method shall be guaranteed .
( 1 ) the production , operations , and administrative organs of the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall be completely separate from the controlling stockholder ; it is not permissible to have mixed operations or shared offices .
( 2 ) the controlling stockholder or any other unit or individual is not permitted to intervene in the organizational setup of the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market .
article 37 : a company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall be financially independent .
( 2 ) the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall have its own bank accounts and is not permitted to have joint accounts with its stockholders ' unit or any other unit or individual .
( 4 ) the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall independently declare its taxes and fulfill its tax obligations .
( 5 ) the company planning to issue shares to be listed on the stock market shall independently sign external contracts .
chapter 5 : supplementary articles article 38 : the china securities regulatory commission is responsible for interpreting these guiding opinions .

thinking of danger in times of peace is a piece of political wisdom and a part of life 's experience ; its essence lies in its warning of the opposite in times of success , plain sailing , and comfort .
for example , during the halcyon days of the reign of emperor tai zong of the tang dynasty , when the country was both culturally and militarily advanced , wei zheng presented " 10 - point advice to tai zong , " in which he enumerated signs of danger in 10 areas that could arise from success .
the material and cultural wealth that could be accumulated in 100 years without the distractions of war or civil strife - - not to mention in a state of eternal peace - - is remarkable .
however , people 's wishes are one thing , and objective reality is often independent of people 's will .
a storm may lurk in balmy weather ; danger may lie hidden in peace and quiet ; and a healthy - looking body may have been infected by a virus .
a significant portion of our work is devoted to establishing a system of safeguards as a preventive measure .
comparatively speaking , it is easier to think of order in times of chaos and to think of peace in times of danger .
just as a patient appreciates the value of good health , a war - ravaged nation appreciates the value of stability .
how can they relax when they are fighting for their survival ?
history is replete with countless instances of great misfortune caused by pleasure - seeking without regard to signs of danger .
comrade jiang zemin has stressed on several occasions the need to think of danger in times of peace and to foster a sense of danger .
china 's reform and construction have scored great achievements that have won international acclaim , and the country is enjoying a level of prosperity and stability seldom seen in history .
we must never give in to recklessness , complacency , sluggishness , or conceit because of this .
we must understand that rapid national development will bring us more acute challenges and more complicated problems .
anti - china forces have kept growing , and separatist elements are anxious to make trouble .
as long as china is developing and progressing , their plot to " divide " and " westernize " china will not stop .
this is not even counting the numerous unpredictable threats .
regardless , we must think of danger in times of peace , fully reckon with our difficulties , and make thorough planning in order to eliminate danger even before it arises .
we must heed the ancient adage that " a sense of danger helps preserve life while pleasure - seeking leads to death , " and show foresight and take precautions against any and all contingencies .
this ensures that we can fulfill the great cause of rejuvenating the chinese nation .
this week 's focus : regulation of internet bars internet bars have grown rapidly over the past three years , particularly since last year .
the problems they have caused , especially violent computer games , obsessive online chatting , and pornography , have become a public peril that jeopardizes young people 's mental and physical health . therefore , the growth of internet bars has aroused the concern of people in all walks of life in society .
perspective on the internet bar phenomenon , by reporter yan xiaoming a fast - growth industry computers with access to the internet first appeared in the mid - 1990 's . at first these computers could be found only at the telecommunications bureau 's demonstration sites .
subsequently five - star hotels offered similar computers for use by businesspeople .
the development of feiyu internet bar is typical .
located at the south gate of beijing university , feiyu internet bar is said to be the largest in the nation at the moment .
when it opened for business in february 1998 , there were only 25 computers . by last spring , it boasted 1,400 computers and its membership topped 300 .
uniform - clad service circulate among the stations .
a middle school student who did not want to reveal his name said , " whenever you see lots of mountain bikes parked in front of some decrepit door , chances are you will find an internet bar .
in november china net and the feiyu chain of internet bars began talks on a cooperative venture .
everyday he slept on the chairs at the bar and survived on instant noodles . the bar simply ignored him .
of the 30 students admitted by a certain department at a beijing university in 1999 , five had their names removed from the rolls because they were so engrossed in the internet that they neglected their academic studies .
of the 200 plus students who were demoted or had their names removed from the rolls by a university in shanghai last year , 80 percent had spent so much time surfing the internet that they neglected their studies .
what is it about the internet that proves to captivating to these young people ?
the beijing public security bureau conducted an inspection of an internet bar that we must say is fairly upscale and large in size . its random survey on the 860 computers connected to the internet shows that 56 displayed web pages from illegal pornographic web sites .
some bar owners store gambling materials , the prohibition of which has been the subject of many a government order , in their computers , thus putting further distance between young people who have seen little of the world and their schools and parents .
multi - pronged approach needed for standardized regulation of internet bars the standardized regulation of internet bars must begin with the banning of unlicensed illegal bars .
the world 's first internet bar opened in london in 1994 . it rapidly gained popularity in the developed world and became an up - and - coming industry .
in contrast , only in the mid-1990's did the digital industry emerge in china 's large cities . in just five or six short years , internet access fees tumbled from 20 - 30 yuan per hour to 2 or 3 yuan , thus fueling the popularity of internet bars .
it is no exaggeration to suggest that the development of internet bars in china kept pace with that elsewhere in the world .
reportedly ordinary americans found this amazing .
just two years later , an overseas chinese who had returned to china wrote an article suggesting that the internet bar has made it possible for unemployed young people on the street to have access to the internet .
the internet bar has indeed effectively brought the internet within the reach of ordinary people .
all it takes to surf the web is a couple of dollars and a few minutes worth of demonstration by the service personnel at the bar .
going online at an internet bar is that simple .
the boss of feiyu internet bar started out as a peasant entrepreneur in shanxi who knew nothing about computers . in 1997 he himself had his " first intimate contact " with the internet at an internet bar .
the popularization of the internet is precisely an important foundation for the development of an information society .
the haphazard development of some internet bars and their exclusive pursuit of profits have become a public peril .
there are too many unlicensed illegal internet bars out there trying to woo customers by offering pornography , gambling , violence , and superstition , seriously jeopardizing young people 's mental health and physical health . in the process , they have become an " electronic heroin . "
there is a mingling of the good and the bad in the information available on the internet , whose impact on mainstream moral values cannot be overlooked .
if the internet is allowed to develop unchecked , it may well end up a public enemy , like the rat on the street that everybody wants to kill .

on 23 march , new united states secretary of defense rumsfeld delivered to president bush the quadrennial " comprehensive defense study report , " proposing that the united state 's strategic core should soon turn towards asia .
this area chiefly has united states troops in korea , in japan , the united states navy 's seventh fleet , and us military personnel and facilities scattered across pacific island chains and various countries in southeast asia .
currently , there are a total of 37,000 united states military troops stationed in korea , 25,000 of these personnel are in army units , 9000 are air force , approximately 1000 are navy , and the remaining personnel are staff and civilian .
military troops stationed in korea are made up into one army command ( presiding over one infantry division ) , one air force , and a small number of marines .
the units that it presides over include the 2 nd infantry division , the 17 th aviation brigade , the 8 th military police brigade , the 43 rd anti - aircraft corps , the 19 th theater [ support ] command , the 18 th medical command , etc. .
it is deployed in 15 camps north of seoul , and is the mobile campaign ready unit of the united states military in korea north of the han river .
the 2 nd infantry 's mobility capability is strong , its weaponry and equipment are modern , and it is capable of mounting a highly potent , air / ground unified combat force .
because this division not only possesses heavy equipment , but also has the capacity for air mobility , in coordination with attack helicopters , the division is capable of projecting its combat force 30 - 70 kilometers deep from its already front - line [ forward positions ] .
currently , this command presides over the 17 th area support group ( in honshu ) , the 10 th area support group ( in okinawa ) , the honshu army medical department , and others .
the united states air force in japan is mainly organized by and subordinate to the 5 th air force of the united states pacific air forces , its command is also at the yokota air force base ; and its command is also undertaken concurrently with the us military command in japan .
the 5 th air force has a total of 15,000 military and civilian personnel , and is formed into three wings . it is equipped with over 170 various [ types of ] combat aircraft ( including helicopters ) .
relying on this base , united states military surveillance aircraft often come and go in the western pacific area , and it has become an important forward base for the united states military to spy on other country 's intelligence .
the 3 rd marine expeditionary force of the united states military in japan , which is deployed in okinawa , is , in scale , the largest amphibious unit of the united states military stationed overseas , its position and function are unusual .
of these , the 3 rd marine division and the 1 st marine aircraft wing , responsible for air cover and support , are capable of conducting air / ground unified and coordinated combat .
the seventh fleet , including its two segments , the surface ship unit and the submarine unit , employs two organizational methods : administrative organization and mission organization .
the administrative organization is split between the surface vessel command and the submarine command .
the surface vessel command manages all surface ships with the exception of the aircraft carriers ( including amphibious ships ) . the submarine command manages all submarines . mission organization is also called task force organization , and it organizes task forces for conducting combat , exercises , military tactics practice , and special military missions .
it is only responsible for matters concerning the performance of battle , and the tactics direction of its units , and not responsible for the administrative .
" island chain deployment " is a chess board full of pieces looking overall at the military deployment posture of the united states military in the asia / pacific area , it is not hard to see that the united states is painstakingly building a " pacific chain " to surround and check china , and the asian mainland .
this chain is based on a line of united states military bases in the pacific ocean - - the core of the chain is centered on the bases and facilities of japan , korea , okinawa , guam , and others . .
in recent years , besides reinforcing the scope and position of stationed troops in japan and korea , the united states military is , in many aspects , strengthening this area 's military deployment .
this year , 23 march , the renovation and expansion work on the singapore changi deep water aircraft carrier pier was completed . united states aircraft carriers and large scale formations can enter the harbor for repairs - - thus allowing united states military ships more convenience and freedom in the south china sea while coming and going .
singapore has always been looked upon by the united states as an outpost for overseeing the south china sea , and entering the indian ocean .
setting out from this place , united states military ships can pass through the strait of malacca within 24 hours , bearing west through the indian ocean , and arriving in the gulf area . moving east then , they can cruise into china 's south sea .
therefore , it does not matter how magnanimous and appealing the united states ' diplomatic language is , looking at the situation of united states military bases and facilities scattered in various corners of the asia / pacific , the united states ' intentions for the asia / pacific area are unmistakably self evident .

combat requirements drive logistical support .
the multidimensional nature of joint combat space and the combined nature of forces , the rapid pace , and the high attrition of equipment not only result in the sudden escalation of the status of logistical support , they also highlight the contradiction between support resources and combat requirements .
with the in - depth development of the revolution in military affairs around the world , joint combat has now undoubtedly become the basic mode of combat in modern war .
actively adapting to this profound change and developing joint combat logistical support doctrine that has the characteristics of the chinese military is an important topic with regard to practicing the " powerful support " called for by president jiang and driving the in - depth development of equipment construction .
in the age of cold - steel weapons based on smelting technology , whether it was the initial phalanx tactics or cavalry tactics that came later , for the most part the various weapons were carried by the combat units , so logistical support was mainly spot - support of the " tinker " type .
however , in the age of information technology (it) weapons based on computer technology , with combat forces which are a combination of the three service arms , the multidimensional , integrated battlespace , and combat methodology which combines offense and defense , the result has been to highlight the integrated features of combat operations .
logistical support thus is tailored to what kind of battle is involved .
commensurate with this demand for integrated features on the part of joint operations , integrated support has now become the inevitable choice .
from the perspective of the object of the support , it represents a change from the past approach of support mainly for a single service or branch to organic , integrated support for the three services .
two is to strengthen the awareness of " intensive support . "
three is to enhance our awareness of " multidimensional support . "
the greatest feature of a linked - echelon support layout is that it contains enormous support tensile strength , with the equipment commander making meticulous plans and deployments on his side of the battlefield " board " for the various kinds of support forces so as to maximize support potential .
in establishing a linked - echelon support system , the following key points must be mastered : echelon linkage and forward deployment of the various kinds of equipment and materials , mainly ammunition .
combine dynamic and static methods and have regional deployment of a variety of technical support forces , primarily for maintenance .
during the 4 th middle east war , the highly - effective technical support of the israeli forces played a major role in ultimately turning defeat into victory .
integrated supply and repair , creating a support situation in which the material / equipment and maintenance forces are linked in an integrated manner .
only when the two form an organic whole and there is unified planning so that the two rely on each other is it possible to make full use of powerful support functions .
the establishment of multidimensional supply and support links is needed to adapt to the trend toward a multidimensional battlefield in joint combat and to ensure the sustained stability of logistical support .
first , achieve seamless links for the entire in - depth support system .
this means relying on support deployment to see that an organic linkage is achieved for various support resources , ensuring an effective combination of support systems between the defensive and offensive combat battlefields so that the need to support joint offensive and defensive combat operations can be met at the same time .
on defensive combat battlefields , attention should also be paid to the need to support different combat operations , such as countering air raids , coastal defense efforts , and local emergency response operations . on offensive combat battlefields , the establishment of reliable distribution channels for supply and repair resources should be ensured .
second , enhance system reliability through the integrated use of various methods .
in joint combat under high - tech conditions , the battlefield situation changes dramatically in an instant , so timely , accurate , and comprehensive information support is a precondition for arranging effective coordination .
ensure the optimal allocation of support resources .
emphasize intellectual and knowledge - oriented cooperation .

calmly deal with economic risks people still clearly remember that , at the outset of the " ninth five - year plan " in 1996 , we were faced with inflationary issues .
in 1996 , the first year of " the ninth five - year plan " , we accomplished a " soft landing " in the national economy , and the inflation rate dropped from 14.8 percent in the previous year to 6.1 percent .
soon afterwards , china alone weathered the recession of the asian financial crisis , stabilized the renminbi value , and maintained economic growth at a level between 7 and 8 percent .
between 1998 and 2000 , financial organs under the central authorities have issued long - term national construction debt worth 360 billion yuan to domestic commercial banks , have promoted supplementary capital in the local areas , departments and enterprises , and have expanded investment scales .
they energetically developed consumer credit loans , sped up the construction of infrastructures beneficial to the upgrade of consumer structures , and got rid of and canceled certain restrictions in consumer policy .
third , they integrated , using every possible means , increases in domestic demand with a strengthening of exports .
they readjusted the structures of export products and gave priority to supporting the export of high - tech products .
they established sound insurance mechanisms for export credit and strengthened banks ' capital assistance to export enterprises .
they readjusted agricultural and planting structures , led agricultural production on the path toward progress in high quality and efficiency .
in the area of capital distribution of national debt , they stressed and expanded introduction forces in construction of the infrastructure and reduced projects involved in ordinary processing industries .
they supported and guided enterprises in making additional introductions in technological transformation , and sped up development in the technological transformation of traditional industries and high - tech industries .
the blue print for " the tenth five - year plan " has been drawn .
the basic orientation of macroeconomic adjustment and control during " the tenth five - year " period should be as follows : we must continue to carry out positive financial policies in the short term , promote investment from enterprises and society , and stimulate spending .
we must implement a steady monetary policy , flexibly apply the tools of monetary policy , properly regulate currency supply , ensure basic stability between the renminbi value and the exchange rate , and support economic structural readjustment as well as economic growth .
we must keep centered around structural readjustments , guide investment directions , and promote investment in fixed assets , especially by enterprises and areas that have faster growth , and we must adjust and control the overall investment rate in fixed assets in our society around 35 percent .
we must support export policy and give full play to the driving role of export demands on economic growth .
we must carry out proper and reasonable regulation of macroeconomic adjustment and control forces based on economic trends .

" after several negotiations and full consultations between the central people 's government and the local government of tibet 50 years ago , an ' agreement between the central people 's government and the local government of tibet on peaceful liberation of tibet , ' called ' 17 - article agreement , ' was signed on 23 may 1951 .
since its 1959 defection , the dalai clique has argued that the legitimacy of the " 17 - article agreement " should be doubted , and that tibetan representatives were forced to sign the agreement .
refuting this , jimzhong gyaincain puncog pointed out : " although i was not a representative to the negotiations on the agreement , i witnessed the entire process of and participated in the signing of the agreement .
the sophistry of the dalai clique is a sheer lie . "
seventy - six - year - old jimzhong gyaincain puncog is now vice chairman of the tibetan autonomous regional committee of the chinese people 's political consultative conference .
before the liberation of tibet , he was an official of the retinue of ngapoi ngawang jigme , then head of qamdo of tibet and now vice chairman of the standing committee of the national people 's congress [ as published ] .
not long after the establishment of the prc , the central people 's government ordered the people 's liberation army [ pla ] to advance toward tibet and notified the kashag of tibet to send representatives to beijing to negotiate on matters relating to the peaceful liberation of tibet .
the chinese pla liberated qamdo on 19 october 1950 , opening up the gate to tibet .
jimzhong gyaincain puncog said : " like other officials and aristocrats , i did not understand the policies of the cpc , did not trust the pla , and was afraid of it before the liberation of qamdo .
but , later i witnessed the strict discipline of the pla and experienced the broad vision of the central government . "
after returning to qamdo , jimzhong gyaincain puncog accompanied ngapoi ngawang jigme to beijing to hold negotiations with the central government 's plenipotentiaries , including li weihan .
after more than 20 days of consultations , the two sides signed the " 17 - article agreement " on 23 may 1951 , proclaiming the peaceful liberation of tibet .
in his telegraphy to chairman mao zedong in october 1951 , the 14 th dalai lama said that the " 17 - article agreement " was reached by the " two sides on the basis of friendship . "
in conclusion , jimzhong gyaincain puncog pointed out : " ' tibet independence ' advocated by the dalai clique will get nowhere .

on 19 october 1950 , the chinese pla liberated qamdo , thus opening the gate to tibet . this forced the tibetan authorities to accept the peaceful - liberation measures proposed by the people 's government .
in april of the following year , the local government of tibet sent a five - member delegation headed by ngapoi ngawang jigme to beijing to hold negotiations with li weihan , zhang jingwu , and other plenipotentiaries of the central government .
after several rounds of consultations , the two sides officially signed a " 17 - article agreement , " declaring the peaceful liberation of tibet .

lhasa , 22 may ( xinhua ) - - an agreement between the central and tibet local governments on peaceful liberation of tibet was signed in beijing on 23 may 50 years ago ( it is called the " 17 - point agreement " for short ) .
from then on , tibet has got rid of imperialist aggression and yoke and embarked on a bright road to socialist development .
an epoch - making day talks with a far - reaching impact on modern chinese history started in beijing in april 1951 .
when the central government representatives proposed incorporating the post and rights of bainqen to the agreement , the tibet local government representatives said they had no right to handle this matter and that it was hard to accept the proposal .
i said we could accept this suggestion .
thus the talks were resumed . "
on 23 may 1951 , through full consultations and frank and conscientious discussions , representatives of the central and tibet local governments solemnly signed the agreement in qinzheng palace , zhongnanhai , under the motherland 's national flag and emblem .
the signing of the agreement allowed tibet to get rid of the imperialist yoke forever and return to the big family of the motherland , where there is equality , fraternal love , mutual help , and unity .
ngapoi ngawang jigme was sitting beside mao zedong at that time . he still remembered what mao zedong said : " from now on , our different nationalities will develop and progress in the political , economic , and cultural fields on the basis of unity . "
inevitable historic choice after the opium war , the chinese people - - the tibetans were no exception - - suffered from imperialist humiliation and bullying .
british troops occupied lhasa in august 1904 and forced the tibet local government to sign the lhasa treaty .
like other powers invading china , british troops demanded a war compensation from the local government after invading tibet .
in a statement , then interim president sun yat - sun declared : the people are the foundation of the country ; regions inhabited by the han , man , meng , hui , and zang nationalities should be united as one country .
it was a matter of course that the central government of china refused to sign an arrangement targeted at splitting the country .
in october 1950 , the advance troops of the 18 th army , which were waiting by the jinsha jiang for the tibet local government to accept peace talks , launched a battle in chamdo to open the gate for tibet peace talks .
influenced by the central government 's correct policy on ethnic groups and religion and with the efforts of patriotic personnel in tibet higher - level circles , in january 1951 the tibet local government agreed to send representatives to beijing for peace talks .
with the establishment of the yuan dynasty , tibet was formally included as a part of chinese territory .
in 1951 , the " 17 - point agreement " signed in beijing on peaceful liberation of tibet sent imperialists ' plot to split tibet from china to total bankruptcy . all ethnic groups in china achieved great unity under new historic conditions .
historical facts show that these three major events played a tremendous role in promoting tibet 's political , economic , and cultural development .
democratic reform afforded a million tibetan serfs the right to live as human beings and own land and livestock , and unprecedented enthusiasm in production .
the founding of the tibet autonomous region in 1965 marked the establishment of the political system under which the tibet people are masters of their own affairs .
the right of regional autonomy provided for ethnic minorities by the chinese constitution came true in tibet .
the last seven years of the 20 th century were one of the fastest economic and social development periods for tibet .
last year its domestic gross product amounted to 11.7 billion yuan , with a growth rate higher than the country 's average for many consecutive years .
it has basically realized self - reliance in grain , oil , and meat production , most poor people have resolved the problem of adequate food and clothing , and some people have reached moderate prosperity .
tibet stepped into the 21 st century with a new feature .
the tremendous changes over the last 50 years on this roof of the world started from peaceful liberation , from the 17 - point agreement .
since the beginning of april , there have been extraordinarily serious accidents in china 's coal industry , and the situation of safety in production is extremely grim .
according to statistics , from 1 april to 15 may , there were 62 extraordinarily serious accidents in coal mines across the country , in each of which more than three people were killed , and 503 people were killed in all .
neither is china happy to witness such a situation . china has always attached importance to sino - us ties .
we are optimistic about the prospects of sino - us ties .

we must control environmental pollution and ecological destruction at the project sources , and we must strictly implement a system for evaluating the environmental impact of a construction project regardless of whether it involves new construction , renovation or expansion .
we must reach comprehensive environmental and developmental decision for major economic and social developmental policy , regional exploration and city planning .
we must end the production and construction in our region of backward crafts and equipment prohibited by the state by formal decree .
we must continue do a good job in the work of " a single control with dual aims " , and through pollution control , get the discharged pollution by industrial enterprises , civic boilers , hospitals , hotels and guest houses throughout the region within the discharge standards specified by the state .

compared with the 1993 version of " military doctrine , " the new version of " military doctrine " explicitly demonstrates russia 's gallantry in reestablishing its military prowess . moreover , the new version for the first time makes clear russia 's opposition to the united states ' stand of building a single - polar world .
to deal with this situation , putin favors further strengthening construction of the national defense foundation to enhance the capability to defend national territory .
in coping with the internal threat , russia has gradually increased national defense input since the beginning of last year and has continued to adjust its military deployments .
russia 's military spending has increased to 260 billion rubles , creating a new high since the reorganization of the russian armed forces in 1992 .
the first measure is appointing or dismissing high - ranking military officers of the defense ministry to maintain stability in the upper layer of the military .
the third measure is developing the military arms and services of the armed forces in a balanced way by pursuing the principle of " equilibrium . "
the three military services are the army , navy , and air force . the three military arms are the strategic rocket force , airborne force , and space force .
beginning in 2001 , the strategic rocket unit will separate the guided missile space defense unit and the military space unit under its jurisdiction and establish a space force ( known as the so - called " space troops " and the original strategic rocket unit will be transformed into an arm beginning from 2002 ) .
from now on , the russian army will put more stress on the building of a standing force and a rapid reaction force . in the principal strategic area , it will deploy in advance military groups with strong mobility power in order to cope with crises that may emerge in that area .
in the future the russian navy will gradually increase joint naval exercises , organize mobile groups of a temporary nature , and dispatch special mixed formations to important sea areas so as to restore the past gallant appearance of the navy .
favoring special policy to develop sophisticated equipment of high grade and precision at the beginning of this year , putin approved " the plan for developing weapons and equipment of the russian armed forces before 2010 . "
in the past year , the russian armed forces have achieved marked results in successively developing new fighters , submarines , and guided missiles . the russian armed forces have constantly enhanced the quality and operational efficiency of existing weapons and equipment by modernizing existing weapons and equipment with advanced technology .
the outline stipulates : efforts will be made to put a stop to the decline of social security of military personnel by 2005 and " to create a condition for establishing a social security system for military personnel that conforms to the meaning of military labor and the complexity and intensity of military affairs " by the year 2010 .
to achieve this objective , russia has begun pursuing preferential policies toward military personnel .
this way , by 2010 the salary income of military personnel will have increased from 60 percent to 100 percent .
besides , putin has demanded that middle school students undergo a week of military training every year so as to strengthen the people 's national defense awareness and their understanding of and support for the profession of military personnel and also to strengthen citizens ' sacred sense and sense of honor in serving in the military .
within the military , putin has issued orders to strictly rectify military discipline and strengthen the management of the military .

hu angang : china is now in a period of switching its economic setup .

however there is also another essential condition for economic development , that is , investment in social capital .
social capital refers to a complete set of social system arrangements , such as the credit system , banking system , taxation system , technical standards , technical testing , and so on .
here , systems include not only official but also unofficial systems , such as mutual trust between people , regulation by social ethics , and so on .
investment in social capital can greatly reduce investment risks and uncertainties in market economy , reduce business costs , ensure the interests of all parties in the form of contracts , and effectively put the legal procedure to work to deal with disputes that arise .

an important task , therefore , is to resolve the problem of information transparency , that is , to establish a system for releasing information and ensure that everyone can share the information .
the 50 th anniversary of the signing of the agreement between the prc government and the tibetan local government on the peaceful liberation of tibet falls on 23 may this year .
safeguarding the motherland 's unification and liberating the tibetan people was the cpc 's glorious historic mission and sacred duty . it also was the common wish of the people of all nationalities in the country , including the tibetan people .
in 1950 the pla triumphed in the battle of changdu , which paved the way for the peaceful liberation of tibet .
tibet 's peaceful liberation and democratic reform were an important component of the liberation and democratic revolution of the chinese nation . it was part of the party 's glorious achievements . it is a shining example of the way our party applied the marxist nationality theory to solve the nationality problem creatively . 2 .
economy and society developing by leaps and bounds in the 50 years since peaceful liberation , tibet 's achievements , political , economic , and cultural , have captured world attention . - the regional national autonomy system has been implemented properly across the board and safeguarded the right of the tibetan people to be their own masters .
the third central work conference on tibet in 1994 made it even more specific that the ideological realm is the main battlefield in our struggle with the dalai lama .
tibet 's leading role in the national economy is becoming more prominent by the day . before peaceful liberation , taiwan did not have a decent highway . after peaceful liberation , a transportation network centered on lhasa and providing access to all points has taken shape .
to date construction has been completed on the gongga and bangda commercial airports . there are regular scheduled domestic flights linking lhasa with beijing , chengdu , chongqing , xian , and xining . there also are scheduled international flights between lhasa and katmandu .
the qinghai - tibet oil pipeline from geermu to lhasa has been built . with a total length of 1,080 kilometers , it is situated at a higher altitude than any other oil pipeline in the world . currently over 80 percent of the oil are transported to tibet through that pipeline .
gratifyingly , the state council has formally approved the construction of the qinghai - tibet railway , so tibet will soon have its own railroad .
postal and telecommunications services in tibet have developed by leaps and bounds .
the region played host to 149,441 tourists in 2000 . tibetan tourism has a bright future as an industry with regional characteristics .
in the early days of peaceful liberation , for instance , pla forces and some technical personnel stationed in tibet already threw themselves into the development of tibet .
later , cadres , scientific and technological personnel , teachers , doctors , literary workers , and technicians from the interior answered the party 's call in large numbers by rushing to tibet where they made major contributions to all sorts of undertakings .
since tibet 's peaceful liberation , the central authorities have made available to tibet more than 40 billion yuan in combined investments and financial subsidies .
the central authorities care about tibet and the whole country has given aid to tibet , fully demonstrating the superiority of the socialist system . the future is bright for people of all nationalities in tibet as they stride toward common prosperity in the big family of the socialist motherland .
the building of a socialist spiritual civilization is in full swing . all sorts of undertakings are prospering and making progress . the look of society has changed fundamentally .
television and radio reach 65 and 55 percent , respectively , of the tibetan population . the number of newspapers and periodicals published in tibet now reaches 52 , including more than 20 in the tibetan language .
the role of marxism , which represents the forward direction of advanced culture , as a guide in the ideological realm has been established and strengthened . deng xiaoping theory is the common ideological bedrock and powerful spiritual support for people of all nationalities in tibet as they build a new united , prosperous , and civilized socialist tibet .
their ideological and moral character has broadly improved and their scientific educational standards have risen . 3 .
the lessons of 50 years of history a review of the journey that tibet has taken in the past 50 years and its shining achievements drives home these most basic lessons : upholding cpc leadership and taking the socialist road is the fundamental guarantee of the success of the tibetan revolution and development .
the cpc is the loyal representative of the fundamental interests of the people of all nationalities in china and provides the core of leadership for the socialist enterprise .
it was precisely under cpc leadership that tibet achieved peaceful liberation and expelled imperialism . through democratic reform , the tibetan people were able to stand up and be their own masters as part of the big socialist family . there have been unprecedented social and economic developments .
we must conscientiously enforce the regional national autonomy law , maintain and perfect the regional national autonomy system , and ensure political stability , national unity , strong border defense , economic development , social progress , and steady advances in all undertakings in the region .
it is the fundamental task of socialism to liberate and further productive forces and promote the all - round development and progress of the tibetan economy and society .
launching an in - depth struggle against separatism and preserving the motherland 's unification , the unity among the various nationalities , and social stability is the foundation and precondition for expediting tibet 's development .
" combat confusion " means straightening out the ideological confusion among the masses caused by the dalai 's disruption , trouble - making , and sabotage .
" combat ignorance " means raising the masses ' low scientific educational standard and ending their severe shackling by the remnants of feudal serfdom , superstition , ignorance , outworn conventions and bad customs , and the negative impact of religion .
we must perseveringly press ahead with the building of a spiritual civilization in tibet by closely revolving it around " combat confusion and combat ignorance " so as to provide a powerful spiritual force and intellectual support for economic and social development in the region and promote balanced development between the material civilization and spiritual civilization .

this is the first gathering of foreign ministers of asian and european countries in the new century and has attracted close attention from the international community .
on the eve of the convening of the meeting , i would like to discuss briefly my own views on the significance , prospects , and characteristics of the cooperation between asia and europe under the asem framework .
one is the rise of asia , especially east asia ( including southeast asia and northeast asia ) .
what needs pointing out is that as an integral party , the 15 eu countries make up 29 percent of the world 's gnp .
as a matter of fact , east asia , west europe , and north america are now the three pillars of the world economy .
europe and america , which extend across the atlantic ocean , have all along maintained close links , and the ties between the pan - pacific east asia and north american have been strengthened with the establishment of the asia - pacific economic cooperation [ apec ] organization .
asem members take up 40 percent of the world 's total population with their 2.4 billion people , and their economic size takes up 50 percent of the world 's gdp [ gross domestic product ] .
the cooperation between asia and europe is of far - reaching significance in the maintenance of peace and stability in asia and european and the world as well and the development of the tendency toward political multipolarization .
over a decade has passed since the cold war ended , and it is now the trend of the contemporary era to seek peace , stability , development , and cooperation .
this has laid a firm foundation for asia and europe to carry out equal , friendly , extensive , and intensive cooperation .
asia boasts rich natural and human resources and a vast market with great potential .
asian countries have all along explored a path of economic development in the light of their own concrete conditions and scored a quite rapid development over the years .
northern european countries are among the few developed countries whose official aid for developing countries accounts for 0.7 percent of their gnp , as required by the united nations .
in july 1997 , the asian financial crisis occurred and some people were worried about the future of asia - europe cooperation .
however , as i see it , so long as the two sides abide by the principles of equality , friendship , and mutual benefit , those differences will be the driving force and content for dialogue , cooperation , and exchanges rather than obstacles .
characteristics of asia - europe cooperation compared with some other important international organizations or cooperation mechanisms , asem has its own traits .
first , the asia - europe cooperation within the framework of asem basically demonstrates the principle of equality .
many members of asia and europe have emphasized that asia - europe dialogue should be based on mutual respect , equality , the promotion of basic rights , the observation of obligations laid down by international laws , and non - interference in other countries ' internal affairs .
second , asia - europe cooperation boasts a wide - ranging coverage and a large number of discussion topics .
the asem cooperation covers a wide range of fields , and it is not just confined to the sphere of economy and trade , nor just to the asia - europe region .
both sides can exchange views on international and regional issues of their common concern .
as a matter of fact , many important international and regional issues such as economic globalization , cultural diversity , strengthening the role of the united nations , and maintaining the global strategic stability are all issues requiring asia - europe cooperation .
third , asia - europe cooperation is practical and effective .
the asia - europe foundation was launched in singapore in 1997 to promote the academic , cultural , and personnel exchanges between asia and europe .

beijing , 24 may ( xinhua ) - - the 23 d of may this year marks the 50 th anniversary of the signing of " the agreement on the methods of peacefully liberating tibet " ( namely , " the 17 - point agreement " ) between the central people 's government and the former tibet local government .
as the chief plenipotentiary of the then tibet local government who signed this " 17 - point agreement , " i contemplate the present and recall the past with emotions and have all sorts of feelings in my mind .
the practice of revolution and construction in tibet over the last 50 years has made us deeply realize that : 1 ) the reunification of the motherland and the unity of nationalities are the fundamental guarantees for the development and prosperity of tibet .
under the guidance of the " 17 - point agreement , " the people in tibet drove out the imperialist invading forces , put an end to the state of permanently being backward , sealed off , and stagnant , and made great progress which has attracted worldwide attention in the short period of 50 years .
the history of 50 years has proved that the communist party of china truly seeks happiness for all nationalities in tibet .
during every period of revolution and construction in tibet , the central authorities have always called a series of important meetings , issued a series of important directives , and given guidance and made arrangements for the work of tibet .
with the enthusiastic support of all the fraternal provinces , regions , and municipalities in the whole country , the people of all nationalities in tibet deeply feel the warmth of the big family of socialism .
without the communist party , there would not have been the new socialist tibet , and without socialism there would not have been the development and progress of all nationalities in tibet and the happy life of the people , which is a truth proven by history .
3 ) seeking truth from facts , comprehensively and correctly understanding tibet and proceeding from the actual conditions in tibet in doing everything are the ideological lines and working methodology which must be permanently upheld in the work of tibet .
at present , they are also jointly building the socialist motherland and striving for the great rejuvenation of the chinese nation . this is a historical reality as well as the common character of the chinese nation .
meanwhile , on the other aspects like nationality and religious issues , cultural traditions , living habits , historical development , geographical environment , natural conditions , and so on , tibet also has its own special characteristics .
due to historical reasons , in tibet the religious influences have infiltrated into the culture , arts , and customs of the tibetan nationality as well as many aspects in daily life , and most of the masses of tibetan nationality profess a religion .
subsequently , they also put forth the important guiding principle of " making prudent and steady advance " for the work of tibet .
looking back on the past , we know deeply that what we have achieved is hard - earned and worth being treasured .
4 ) establishing a new - type ethnic relationship of equality , unity , and mutual help as instructed by the party to handle ethnic contradictions and affairs is a powerful guarantee for realizing the great unity of all nationalities and safeguarding social stability .
it was not plain sailing either when the " 17 - point agreement " was signed at that time .
5 ) establishing and perfecting this basic political system of the regional autonomy of minority nationalities and vigorously developing economic and other social undertakings are the cornerstones for the prosperity and flourishing of the tibet autonomous region .
with the vigorous support and concern of the central authorities , the number of minority cadres in the whole region of tibet have already reached about 50,000 , accounting for more than 70 percent of cadres in the whole region .
6 ) upholding , developing , and expanding the patriotic united front is a magic weapon for our revolution and construction undertaking winning victories .
therefore , the successful conclusion and smooth implementation of the " 17 - point agreement " have not only signified the great victory of the patriotic united front of our party but also reflected from another angle the history of the patriotic progressive personages in tibet having genuine meeting of minds and sharing weal and woe with the party .
through the revolution and construction over 50 years , the upper - class patriotic personages in tibet have already become members of the broad masses of the people who have played important roles in safeguarding the reunification of the motherland , promoting the healthy development of the socialist ethnic relations , and pushing forward the socialist modernization drive .
this historical experience not only displayed an important role in the early ' 50 s but also should continuously display a role in building socialist undertakings with chinese characteristics .
all the nationalities in our country have their own history and characters , yet form close bonds as flesh and bones with each other in the endless river of history , thus having jointly created the brilliant chinese civilization .
