beijing , 24 may ( xinhua ) - - the central work conference on poverty relief through development was held in beijing today .
upon a comprehensive analysis of the present new situation in the field of poverty relief through development , the party central committee and the state council believe that poverty relief through development is a historical task that will run through the entire initial stage of socialism .
this work conference on poverty relief through development , which is held by the party central committee and the state council at the beginning of the new century , is a meeting of a great immediate importance and a profound historic significance .
wen jiabao pointed out in his work report : the " state eight - seven anti - poverty program " is the first program of action for the work of poverty relief through development in china 's history which has clearly defined targets , objects , work methods , and time limit .
not only is this a major event in the history of the chinese nation , but is also a magnificent feat in the development history of the mankind .
fourth , only when we vigorously carry forward the fine traditions of the chinese nation are we able to constantly enhance the unifying power of our nation , make our nation prosper , and turn china into a strong and powerful nation .
wen jiabao said : in the new century , china is to enter a new development stage during which it will comprehensively build itself into a well - off society , and will speed up its building of socialist modernization ; and its work of poverty relief through development is also expected to enter a new stage .
at its new stage , the work of poverty relief through development will be carried out against the backgrounds that a socialist market economic system has been initially established and that the country 's national economic and social development has entered a new stage .
we should adapt ourselves to this new change in the distribution of the poverty - stricken population , so that we can better define the key objects and the scope for our work of poverty relief through development at the next stage .
meanwhile , we should firmly grasp the sound opportunity of the current large - scale development of the country 's western region .
consolidating our achievements in the work of poverty relief and bringing true a well - off life on this basis still entails a long process of struggle ; and we must establish the concept of fighting a long - term battle , and make unswerving efforts to usher our work of poverty relief through development into a new stage .
these are the areas where the poverty - stricken population is mainly grouped today .
by selecting key counties for the work of poverty relief through development , the central authorities aim to further highlight the responsibilities of governments at the county level in the work of poverty relief .
key counties in the work of poverty relief through development are required to persistently center their efforts around the work of poverty relief through development , and put the work on a prominent position in their economic and social development .
today , under the condition that the poverty - stricken population is grouped in certain types of areas , it is more important for us to stress the point of carrying out the work of poverty relief through development down to every village and every household .
we should base our efforts on the specific situation of every village and every household , work out concrete relief and support plans , and adopt measures with a clear objective in mind .
meanwhile , studying and drawing up work plans on helping the poor through development for impoverished areas is also a task of fundamental importance in our current efforts to successfully carry out the work of poverty relief through development at the new stage .
meanwhile , steps should be taken to actively and steadily expand the scale of labor exports in impoverished areas .
secondly , we should enhance the infrastructural building and the building of a sound ecological environment in impoverished areas , and take further steps to improve the production and living conditions in these areas .

beijing , 25 may ( xinhua ) - - the two - day central work conference on providing development - oriented assistance to alleviate poverty closed in beijing today [ 25 may ] .

during such a short period , we have solved the clothing and food problems for so many poor people . this is unprecedented in the history of the world and is a great achievement .
helping the poverty - stricken areas develop economy and culture and helping poor people in those areas take on the road of common prosperity are historical tasks in the entire course of the primary stage of socialism . the whole party and all people in the country must wage an incessant and prolonged struggle .
zhu rongji , member of the standing committee of the cpc central committee 's political bureau and premier of the state council , presided over today 's meeting .
in the past two decades , china has reduced its rural poor population by 220 million , and the proportion of impoverished population to the total rural population went down from 30.7 percent to about 3 percent in the year 2000 .
first , the hard work done by our party and state to solve poor people 's production and living problems through development is an important embodiment of the advantages of the socialist system . it has greatly strengthened the confidence of people of various nationalities in the country in building socialism with chinese characteristics .
in our future work , we should persist in employing those important experiences and develop and improve them through practice . jiang zemin pointed out : we must also see that the task of achieving the fighting goals of alleviating poverty through development in the next decade will be very arduous .
there are still 30 million people living under the poverty line in rural areas .
it is a prolonged and arduous mission to fundamentally change the look of poor areas .
however , we must also see that there are more favorable conditions for achieving our goals .
our country 's comprehensive national strength has increased and we can now invest more for the development of poor areas .
the production and living conditions in poverty - stricken areas have been greatly improved . we have laid down a foundation for accelerating the pace of developing the economy to alleviate poverty .
first , we should continue to adhere to the road of promoting development through reform .
the achievements we have made in alleviating poverty were the results of our implementing deng xiaoping theory and deepening reform .
we must fully trust and rely on the masses and work with concerted efforts to achieve success in helping the poor through development .
to adhere to the thinking that development is the last word , the most important thing is to continuously strengthen the capability of self - development in poor areas .
this is the true meaning of helping poor areas through development .
we should pay special attention to market changes and explore new ways to help poor areas through development according to the market demand .
central and local finances should adjust the structure of finance disbursement and increase input in the work of helping poor areas .
we should further formulate related policies to attract more social funds for helping poor areas .
we should develop the chinese nation 's fine tradition of helping the poor areas and give full play to the important role of all circles in the society in helping poor areas .
sixth , we should continue to do a good job in promoting cooperation and coordination between the east and west regions in helping poor areas .
the work of having the 13 eastern provinces and municipalities give support to the development of the 10 western provinces and autonomous regions is an important measure to implement comrade deng xiaoping 's thinking of " two great prospects " to promote coordinated development of regional economy and reduce the economic gap between the east and the west regions .
helping poor areas through development is systems engineering work .
we must properly study how the government should promote the work , how can we mobilize the social forces , and how shall we start various work in poor areas and implement various measures .
we should strengthen the management of funds for helping poor areas and strive to increase the results of those funds . we should use funds for the benefits of poor villages and poor households and reduce all intermediate links that may burn up funds .
helping poor areas through development is a major strategic arrangement of the party central committee and the state council and also a common task of the whole party and country .
party committees and governments at various levels in the eastern regions should also attach importance to the work and effectively put the work in an importance place .
top leaders of party and government should be responsible for the overall work . each level should grasp the work of the next level to ensure the implementation of the work .
jiang zemin pointed out : over the past years , the broad masses of cadres in poor areas have worked in a solid manner despite the difficulties , endured hardship , and made great contributions to promoting reform , development and stability in poor areas .
the new situation and tasks have set an even higher demand on the work of helping poor areas .
the cadres in poor regions must continue to unite and lead the people to work hard in a pioneering spirit , increase their ability to help people eliminate poverty and be worthy of the trust of the party and expectations of the people .
leading groups at various levels in poor areas should strengthen unity and be able to tackle hard and difficult tasks . we should pay attention to select and promote those cadres , who have profound feelings for the people and work hard despite of difficulties with the spirit of dedication , to leading positions .
we should strive to promote the improvement of the ranks of cadres in poor areas in conjunction with the current activities of study and education on the " three represents . "
party organizations should truly show concern for cadres , especially cadres at the grassroots level of poor areas , and help them solve actual difficulties in their work .
this will be very important to realizing the strategic goal of large - scale development of the western region , strengthening unity of various nationalities , consolidating the frontiers , and maintaining long - term peace and stability of the country .
people in the old revolutionary bases made great contributions to the cause of the party and people during the war years and made great sacrifices .
we should concentrate some funds , supplies and manpower to solve problems in those areas as quickly as possible .

in strengthening and improving party building , we must integrate our work with reform , opening up and the modernization drive , with the constant improvement of people 's living and with the solving of people 's actual difficulties and problems .
we should consider it as a good system and persist in carrying out the work .

the building of industrial projects in poor areas must be very prudent . we must avoid redundant construction , waste of funds and damage of raw materials .

corruption and embezzlement of public funds are serious crimes and must be investigated and handled in a strict manner . concerned leaders should be investigated and held responsible for the wrong - doings of their subordinates .
zhu rongji said : helping the poor through development is the cause of the whole party and the entire society .
various central ministries and departments and party committees and governments of various localities must pay attention to promoting the work of helping the poor areas through development and make greater contributions to helping the poor eliminate poverty and become rich when they look at problems , formulate policies and plans , and make arrangements in using funds .
the " state 's 1987 [ ba qi 0360 0003 ] plan for aiding poverty - stricken areas by tackling key problems " has been basically carried out . the new plan for aiding poverty - stricken areas will be carried out soon .
the large numbers of cadres and people in the poverty - stricken areas , with unprecedented courage and enthusiasm , went all out unceasingly to achieve success .
their arduous efforts have brought about a great change in the look of poor areas : their production means and living conditions have been markedly improved ; their production level raised by a big margin ; and great progress has been made in the scientific and technological , educational , cultural , and public health fields .
the problem of food and clothing for the poor population in the rural areas throughout the country has been basically solved .

the meeting was the first gathering of asian and european foreign ministers of the new century - - it was a good beginning of asia - europe cooperation in the new century and has great significance for the deepening and development of asia - europe cooperation .
foreign ministers attending the meeting unanimously stressed the importance of stepping up social exchange and cooperation between asia and europe and exchanges and cooperation in the cultural , educational , human resources , environmental , judicial , and other fields .
the " chairman 's statement " adopted by the meeting reflects the extensive consensus reached between asia and europe on cooperation in political dialogue , in the economic and trade , financial , science and technological , environmental , and educational fields , as well as in cracking down on transnational crimes .
the chinese government attaches great importance to the meeting . chinese president jiang zemin attended the opening ceremony of the meeting , premier zhu rongji attended the closing ceremony of the meeting , and both of them spoke at the meeting .
jiang zemin said : aspiring for peace and stability , seeking development , and working for cooperation - - these are the tide of the times .
he said : asia and europe have common interests in maintaining world peace and working for joint development .
premier zhu rongji said : there are no conflicts on fundamental interests between asia and europe . the two sides have identical or similar views on many important international issues and are strongly complementary to each other in the economic and trade field .
vice premier qian qichen said : convictions and policies of asian and european countries are not all identical ; however , through regular high - level sincere dialogue and consultations on an equal footing , mutual understanding and trust between them have kept deepening and cooperation has continued to increase .

although the foreign ministers had some different opinions , they reached consensus in many fields , which is very important to asia , europe , as well as the whole world .
a eu member attending the meeting said : we think that this was an important meeting . the meeting yielded fruitful results and was very encouraging .
the two continents , asia and europe , are important participants of economic globalization .
in his speech at the opening ceremony , chinese state president jiang zemin advanced the following four views : first , asem should act as an exemplary model of intercontinental equality and cooperation .
second , asem should play a still greater role in spurring comprehensive cooperation between asia and europe .
third , asem should become a major channel for exchanging eastern and western civilizations .
fourth , asem should become a major force promoting the establishment of an international political and economic new order .
the first asem was held in bangkok in 1996 , at which the framework of dialogue , cooperation , and development in asia and europe on the basis of equality was set up .
the current members of asem have a total population of over 2.4 billion , accounting for 40 percent of the world population , and their scale of economies accounts for one half of the world 's scale .
there is no fundamental conflict of interest between the continents of asia and europe . rather , they share identical or similar views on a number of major international issues .
this has laid a solid foundation for equal , friendly , extensive , and in - depth cooperation between asia and europe .
many european countries take a positive attitude in providing funds and technological transfers to the developing countries to help them eradicate poverty and protect the environment .
over the past five years , asem has carried out a wide variety of dialogues and cooperation , and leaders of the asian and european countries have conducted useful discussions on some major international and regional issues .
the activities of exchange and cooperation launched by the two sides in economic and trade , financial , scientific and technological , cultural , environmental protection , and other spheres have boosted the in - depth development of the asia - europe relations .
china 's economy is growing at a rapid speed , domestic political situation is stable , and the comprehensive national strength is continually expanding .
under the guiding principle of expanding consensus , stepping up interchanges , maintaining close ties , and deepening cooperation , china will continue to make unremitting efforts for the establishment of a new - type partnership of cooperation between asia and europe .
as long as asia and europe adhere to the principle of respecting each other , treating each other on an equal footing , seeking common ground while reserving differences , and achieving unanimity through consultation , the asia - europe cooperation will certainly attain a healthy development in the new century .
there is a vast vista for the cooperation between asia and europe .

all comrades of the party , leading cadres at all levels in particular , must unceasingly enhance their legal sense and ability to act according to the law and strive to promote the improvement of the entire people 's legal sense and quality and lay a solid foundation for building a socialist country ruled by law .
beijing , 27 may ( xinhua ) - - under the leadership of the party central committee and the state council , three five - year plans for giving publicity to and conducting education in the legal system have been carried out through the country , making tremendous achievements .
attention should be paid to fostering citizen 's modern legal concept of equal rights and obligations and strengthening their sense of abiding by the law and discipline , protecting their own legitimate rights and interests , and engaging in democratic participation and supervision .
exercising management according to law is an internal requirement of giving publicity to and conducting education in the legal system .
work requirements 1 . all citizens who are able to receive an education should conscientiously study the knowledge of the constitution and basic laws of the country , keep enhancing their awareness of socialist democracy and the legal system , and strive to study , understand , abide by , apply , and defend the law .
leading cadres at various levels , judicial personnel , and administrative law enforcers , teenagers , enterprise operating and managing personnel are the important targets of giving publicity to and conducting education in the legal system .
judicial personnel and administrative law enforcers should strive to improve the quality of their knowledge of law , be faithful to the constitution and other laws , administer justice impartially , enforce the law strictly , and conscientiously guard the authority and sanctity of the state legal system .
teenagers and students should make efforts to acquire a good quality in the knowledge of law .
various types of schools at various levels should offer courses in the legal system , do a good job in making planning , scheduling times , and preparing teachers and teaching materials for such courses , and ensure that the task of disseminating the basic knowledge of law will be accomplished within the nine year of compulsory education .
with the stress on such links as local legislation , administration of justice , law enforcement , dissemination of the general knowledge of law , legal supervision , and law service , it is essential to gradually exercise institutionalized management of local political , economic , cultural , and social affairs .
on this basis , efforts should be made to comprehensively promote the management of various undertakings according to law . 3 .
we should vigorously promote the system of legal advisers to governments at various levels .
we should institute and improve a system for the training , examination , and appraisal of government functionaries in the knowledge of law .
we should hold examinations in a unified way and implement a system of issuing certificates of qualifications , an important basis on which government functionaries are appraised , appointed , assigned a rank , or promoted .
the propaganda department of the cpc central committee and the ministry of justice will be responsible for compiling , examining , and approving teaching materials to be compiled in a unified way and recommended teaching materials .
b. methods 1 .
we should pay attention to study and investigation , continue to sum up experiences , and give full play to the exemplary role of various typical cases .
at the same time , according to the characteristics of different regions , departments , industries , and other targets , it is essential to set specific objectives and requirements for them to fulfill so that publicity given to and education conducted in the legal system will adapt to the change and development of the situation . 5 .
we should give full play to the role of mass media and do a good job in sponsoring special columns , special - topic programs , and series of lectures on the legal system on radio , television , and the internet and in the press .
the constitution day in our country , 4 december , is also designated as a day for giving publicity to the legal system every year .
institutions in charge of the work of giving publicity to and conducting education in the legal system in various departments under the party central committee and the state council should work out plans according to the actual needs of relevant departments or units and organize people to carry out such plans . 4 .
various regions , departments , and industries should institute and implement a responsibility system for giving publicity to and conducting education in the legal system , clearly define their responsibilities , exercise objectives management , and check up on the implementation of plans .
it is necessary to set up and improve a supervision and incentive mechanism so as to arouse the enthusiasm of various regions , departments , and industries and to promote the in - depth development of the work in giving publicity to and conducting education in the legal system .

the democratic character of the communist party of china is already written into the party constitution ; and a number of principled stipulations , such as those on equality among members inside the party and on various inner - party democratic rights enjoyed by party members , are also carried in the party constitution .
due to various complicated reasons , however , the democratic political building , especially the inner - party democratic political building , has been overlooked for a long period of time in the past ; and this has resulted in a certain gap between the party 's practical operation and the stipulations carried in the party constitution .
a deep - rooted cause was that democracy , which serves as the foundation of democratic centralism , was severely damaged at that time ; and under a horrible atmosphere of constant public criticism and denouncement , how many people dared to " sincerely " express their views and intentions ?
therefore , if we want to prevent and reduce the number of major blunders in our decision - making process , we must fully develop inner - party democracy .
how should we promote the inner - party democratic political building ?
professor wang guixiu pointed out : first , we must ensure that protection is provided for the rights of party members that are given by the party constitution ; and must completely do away with the patriarchal system that either exists in practice or appears in disguised forms .
deng xiaoping used to say : " without eliminating the work style of such a patriarchal system , we can by no means start talking about inner - party democracy or socialism . "
deng xiaoping once pointed out when speaking of this issue : " for a leader , if he selects his own successor , he is actually following a practice originated from feudalism . "
the practice that leaders select and appoint their own successors has resulted in " cloning " the patriarchal system on an unceasing basis .
third , we should completely do away with the life tenure of leading posts for cadres .
on this issue , deng xiaoping used to point out : " the emergence of the life tenure of leading posts for cadres is related , to a certain extent , to the adverse influences of feudalism . "
upon stepping down from their posts in party committees , some leading cadres will take up new posts , first in the people 's congress and then the cppcc ; and after making such a round , their age has already far exceeded the age limit set for retirement .
the state has already worked out preliminary stipulations on the establishment of a tenure system ; however , these stipulations have yet to be strictly practiced today .

washington 28 may ( xinhua ) - - the us congress recently passed legislation containing a 1.35 trillion dollar , 10 - year tax cut package that president bush is expected to sign into law soon .
this is the largest single us tax cut package in the past 20 years .
given the current woes of the us economy , this tax cut plan will no doubt help revive the slumping economy .
however , the tax cut plan extends over a long period of time , and it is still uncertain whether the projected huge budget surplus for tax relief will materialize .
the focus of bush 's tax relief plan is to reduce personal income taxes , which make up 65 percent of the full 1.35 trillion dollar tax cut .
major tax relief is at the core of bush 's economic policy .
however , the us economy was extremely hot when bush mentioned this tax cut plan during his campaign .
bush said , after congress passed the final tax cut bill , that this tax relief plan will provide an " important stimulus " for us economic growth .
furthermore , both bush and the republic party feel that , over the long - term , individual spending efficiency is higher than government spending efficiency , and thus , refunding the budget surplus back to the taxpayers will increase us economic efficiency and will help long - term growth of the us economy .
a negative side to bush 's tax relief plan lies in the fact that it might turn the us federal government budget surplus into a deficit .
the white house and the congressional budget bureau project that the federal budget surplus will reach 5.6 trillion dollars over the next 10 years .
however , after paying down the national debt and social security , the budget surplus available for tax relief and for expansion of other government expenditures and projects other than social security will be only 2.5 trillion dollars .
because of the tax cuts , the federal government will have to reduce the amounts it expends in paying down the national debt , and it will have to pay an additional 370 billion dollars on interest toward the national debt over the next 10 years .
based upon these numbers , the total cost of bush 's tax cut plan will exceed 1.7 trillion dollars .
in addition , bush 's tax cut plan clearly benefits the rich , and , as a result , it will further widen the gap between the rich and the poor in the us .
some democrat senators have said that they will take advantage of their new majority status in the senate to delay or even repeal implementation of parts of the bush tax cut plan .

li jisheng lost his parents at an early age and relied on government funding to finish college . after working as an ordinary engineering technician , he grew to become a well - known scientist in china 's space flight realm of monitoring and an academician at the chinese academy of sciences .
" using my knowledge to repay the country is the greatest happiness of my entire life . "
reporter : looking back on the road that led you from being an orphaned child to growing up to be an academician at the chinese academy of sciences and making tremendous achievements in your field , what do you have the deepest thoughts and feelings about ?
when i was in my third year of college , my aunt and uncle also passed away . i relied on the party and the government to provide the entirety of my tuition to finish school .
for this reason , my own deep love for our party and the socialist motherland as well as deep love of this generation is very real . the feelings nurtured in that type of hardship are more precious than anything .
for many years , my strong desire to serve the motherland and devote myself to penetrating scientific research for the country has become deeply rooted in my heart and have become the driving force that i unswervingly pursue .
reporter : so for perhaps more than 30 years , you have been inspired by this spiritual force to devote yourself to space flight ?
li jisheng : it should be said that it is an ideological foundation .
after i graduated from the astronomy department at nanjing university , i was assigned to the jiuquan satellite launch center . i was so excited that i could n't sleep .
the space flight mission is very intriguing . maybe it is because it is so closely connected with national strength and state power .
throwing myself into the cause of space flight and repaying the country with my knowledge is the greatest happiness of my entire life .
reporter : many people believe that the key to determining the quality of one 's life lies in making the correction choices at critical junctures . what are your thoughts about this ?
there are only a few stages which are the most critical in a person 's life , but the choices made at these stages often determine the direction of a person 's life , the magnitude of the contribution to society , and the level of realization of their life 's ideals .
there have been three major decisions in my own life .
actually , reflecting back it is easy to see that only if a person links his own undertakings and his own future with the future and fate of his country will he have greater creative space .
reporter : when you were still an ordinary , basic level engineering technician , did you every think you could become a space flight monitoring specialist and even a select academician ?
as a technician , i was only thinking about doing my work well .
even though i had chosen the work that i loved , i only wanted to throw all my energy into it and march forward courageously , duty bound not to turn back .
in the past 30 years , my most profound realization is that if a person wants to make certain accomplishments , he must first have ambitious ideals and he must second quietly immerse himself in hard work .
in working with fixed track precision , i did not complete my work until 1993 , but in reality , from 1970 when i was working on the " east is red , no. 1 " satellite , i made up my mind to create a set of precision track calculation programs .
in over 20 years , i have never let go of the pursuit of my own ideals .
reporters ' reflections : while i was interviewing li jisheng , i asked him if it is very dull and dry to work with the numbers " 0 " and " 1 " every day when writing the computer programs .
his answer was just the opposite : " for you , these are only the numbers " 0 " and " 1 , " but for me , when compiled they are a tool for realizing the track calculation program , and it is thrilling beyond comparison when the predicted results are attained . "
how should the relationship between the individual and the collective be handled ?
on the foundation of the summation of my program work experience over the previous few years , i bravely proposed a design idea with a certain risk involved monitoring software that was " modularized , standardized , and generalized . "
after i proposed this new software concept , wang mengyuan , the director of the center , right away indicated that he agreed with rewriting the software according to this program design , and any problems that arose would be the responsibility of the center 's party committee .
i have always believed that only by reliance on the power of the group can a cause be promoted and the cause be made to prosper .
" the greatest pursuit of a scientist is limitless creation . "
li jisheng : a play is split into what goes on onstage and what goes on backstage , though a space flight launch is far more complex than acting .
it cannot be said that development of launch is onstage and monitoring is backstage . the liftoff of a rocket is very glorious , but do the common people know who the designers and the people who push the buttons are the same they know who a few of the familiar movie directors and actors are ?
when you wholeheartedly throw yourself into this magical cause , struggle unremittingly to its end , and work hard to create for it , perhaps even without fame or fortune after a number of years , when you look back on life you will discover that you already have climbed to the top of an even higher mountain .
reporters ' reflections : " to live a simple life and show one 's goal in life , to accomplish something lasting by leading a quiet life . "
penetrating academician li jisheng 's insights on life , we cannot help but wonder if scientists have forged noble character in the process of creating scientific achievements and , because of this noble character , have they also created tremendous scientific achievements ?

one of the purposes of the united states ' expediting the development and deployment of the missile defense system is to raise the capability of information war and space war in an all - round way , gain superiority in military technologies , and have the initiative in the selection of war patterns .

the current us strategic adjustment is to strengthen its military presence in the asia - pacific region and also signifies a new phase in its geostrategy for european and asian continents .
what are the motives of the current us adjustment of military strategy ?
the united states has considered the current situation a golden opportunity to establish its absolute hegemony by utilizing its utterly superior forces .
after largely absorbing its victorious " achievements " in the cold war , the united states has started a new round of strategic expansion and will need the guidance of a new and appropriate military strategy .
based on us geostrategy , the united states is an isolated island far away from europe and asia . the european and asian continents are the core of us global strategy . any power centers either east or west will constitute a threat to the united states .
to prevent this situation , the united states must control the periphery of the two continents .
based on this understanding , the united states enforced the policy of " preserving peace in europe and containing the soviet union " after world war ii .
under the guidance of these strategies , the united states squeezed strategic space from russia through eastward expansion by nato and got rid of the last nail in europe through the kosovo war. in this way , the united states has placed the western part of the eurasian continent under its firm control .
in order to gain absolute strategic superiority in future wars , the united states must vigorously develop capabilities of information war and related space war .
after assuming office , he has claimed that the united states will build an " unbeatable " national defense force to protect the interests of the unites states and its allies in the world .

the us new military strategy stresses power politics and has a more offensive nature and is riskier than the containment strategy during the cold war era .
with the us strategic adjustment and its strengthening of power and superior position , the barrier to restrict its use of force abroad will be greatly lowered . this will certainly make many countries unsafe .
the united states insists on promoting the development and deployment of the nmd system , raising military expenditures by a great extend and energetically developing its capabilities to fight space and information wars .
the goals of us new strategy are to achieve " absolute security " and " absolute hegemonic power . " it stresses the enforcement of " unilateral " policy . in order to reach its goals , it will use all means including military means to deal with all so - called " challengers . "
in particular , the asia - pacific region has always been in a less stable situation because of contradictions of various forces and lack of a security mechanism .

at a conference , a leading cadre said , " identifying problems represents one 's ability while exposing problems embodies one 's party spirit . "
i was deeply moved by this remark .
when i repeatedly thought of this remark in light of reality , i was really inspired by this remark and learned a great deal .
in the new situation , party members , cadres , particularly leading cadres should understand and put into practice the idea that exposing problems is an embodiment of the party spirit and , to stress the party spirit , one must be brave to expose problems .
what does " expose " mean then ?
the dictionary says it means to uncover concealed issues or things .
it can be said that every unit will have problems of one kind or another and that problem - free units do not exist at all .
will leaders be brave enough to expose problems in their units ?
obviously , the strength of their sense of party spirit will make a difference in each case .
leaders must have the following qualities before they can admit weaknesses or errors in work and take initiatives to expose " interior scandals . " first , leaders must be honest .
concealing problems not only gets in the way of solving them , but also may allow " small holes " to grow into " big holes " and allow " minor diseases " to become " major diseases . "
principles are the lifeblood of the party .
to stick to principles , one must sacrifice personal interests [ for interests of the party and the people ] , and avoid disdainful facial expressions , ironic statements and even " revenge . "
they just try their best to keep these problems secret so as to prevent leaders at higher administrative levels from learning these problems . leaders of some units even claim in public that whoever " turns problems in " to leaders at higher administrative levels will receive " payback . "
second , leaders of some units ignore problems .
some comrades say , " every unit has its interior scandals .
for instance , when an accident happens in a unit , this unit does not meticulously investigate the causes of the accident but rather exclusively disseminates exemplary figures and heroic deeds in remedying the accident in an attempt to turn the accident into " a heroic deed . "
why are there such cases ?
some comrades say that leaders of these units are not brave enough to expose problems because they are afraid of impacting the reputation and glory of these units . they do not want to damage " the fame and reputation " built up through the accumulative efforts of leadership groups .
to sum up , being afraid of exposing problems will seriously impede us from developing our work in a more profound manner .
a party member who is responsible to the party 's causes should be open - minded , should tell the truth , and report everything as it is .
to do so , party members must strengthen their party spirit , work according to high standards , give the top priority to the party 's interests , regard the interests of the masses as important issues and disregard personal losses and gains .
second , party members should cultivate healthy trends .
stressing healthy trends is a spiritual quality that a party member must have .
stressing healthy trends not only means being brave to expose problems in other units and other people but also to expose problems one 's own unit and problems in himself or herself .
to tell the truth , party members should be indifferent to comments made by other people and not seek revenge .
third , party members should improve their abilities to identify and solve problems .
personal quality is also an important factor for whether or not a party member can correctly understand and expose problems .
identifying , exposing and solving problems calls for a certain ideological and theoretical level and fairly strong abilities to analyze and judge [ problems ] . exposing problems is the prerequisite of solving problems .
only when problems are spelt out so that leaders at higher levels have a clear picture of these problems and the masses are aware of these problems can we profoundly study these problems and proceed to find reasonable solutions .

100,000 army , navy , and air force troops assemble on dongshan island a pla landing exercise directed at taiwan , conducted by the army , navy , and air force , is about to be held in three stages along the coast of dongshan island in fujian .
the exercise is commanded by the fuzhou theater [ zhan qu ] ; 100,000 army , navy , and air force personnel will take part , and they will also use modern hi - tech weapons on a large scale ; rapid reaction forces spanning different military regions and theaters will also exercise for the first time .
the cmc therefore proposed to the central authorities that a large - scale military exercise should be held near taiwan in order to warn the united states and the taiwan authorities not to play with fire over the taiwan issue .
hence , the scale of this exercise will be second only to that in 1996 which was aimed at former taiwan president lee teng - hui ; and the leading status of hu jintao in the military will also be highlighted .
sources point out that about 100,000 pla personnel will take part in the exercise , all of whom are crack units which have undergone toughening training . this is the first time that the nanjing and guangzhou theaters plus the east and south sea fleets have been brought together for an exercise directed at taiwan .
display of crack troops and sophisticated weapons the fujian provincial national defense mobilization committee recently issued a circular to port affairs and communications departments demanding that all units prepare the vessels and vehicles to be requisitioned .

wang shucheng , deputy head of the national general headquarters for flood prevention and drought control and minister of water resources , made a report on the work done since the flooding season last year and put forward views on arrangements for work in the next step .
the meeting held that in recent years , the rainfall in most parts of northern china has decreased in a sustained manner and last year the most serious droughts occurred since the founding of new china and the problem of water shortage was quite conspicuous .
after spring this year , the temperature rose rapidly . in may , the temperature in many places remained high and sandstorms occurred in the north on many occasions .
this intensified the evaporation of water from the ground , caused farmlands to be dry , and gave rise to the problem of serious water shortage in towns and cities .
it should be pointed out that china has a vast territory and floods and droughts often occur at the same time . while properly grasping drought control , we must never lower our guard against floods .
regarding this , various localities must remain sober - minded , take all possible unfavorable situations into full account , be well prepared for droughts as well as for floods and waterlogging , and do solid work to gain the initiative in flood prevention and drought control .
it is necessary to adhere to the principle of emphasizing both broadening water sources and saving water while putting saving water in a prominent position .
the third is to make great efforts to properly grasp the work of drought control in agriculture .
various localities should extensively arouse the enthusiasm of the people about drought control and grasp saving water , regarding it as a fundamental measure .
it is necessary to readjust the structure of agriculture . dry areas should reduce crops that need a large quantity of water and develop dry farming .
the fifth is to grasp the prevention of water pollution earnestly and properly . the prevention of water pollution is a very pressing task at present and preventing water pollution is also saving water .
in readjusting the economic structure , it is necessary to put the prevention of pollution in a prominent position , resolutely close down enterprises that cause serious pollution to the environment , and set time limits for discharging waste water according to required standards .
at present , emphasis should be laid on four aspects of work : first , it is necessary to implement the responsibility system at various levels .
in accordance with the requirements of the " duties of chief executives of local people 's governments at various levels in flood prevention " formulated by the national general headquarters for flood prevention and drought control , those who are in charge of flood prevention work at various levels should strengthen supervision and inspection .
in case any flood or waterlogging occurs , leading cadres must give command on the first line , scrupulously abide by their duties and perform their responsibilities .
second , it is necessary to continue to properly grasp the construction of contingency projects for flood prevention .
in particular , it is necessary to take effective measures to deal with grave potential dangers that may seriously affect safety in the flood season this year as soon as possible .
third , it is necessary to give priority to the work of ensuring the safety of reservoirs and make comprehensive preparation for flood prevention .
it is necessary to ensure the implementation of plans , by relevant units , for the safety of reservoirs , the organization of people and the supply of materials for dealing with emergencies , and the establishment of telecommunications facilities for dealing with emergencies .
coastal areas should seriously and properly take precautions against typhoons .
mountain areas should earnestly take precautions against disasters common in mountain areas .
fourth , it is necessary to properly grasp the building of flood prevention headquarters and raise the level of modernization in flood prevention and drought control .
various localities should carefully design and organize such headquarters and provide advanced means to support the process of making decisions for directing and managing work in flood prevention and drought control .
the circular stresses : public security institutions , procuratorates , and people 's courts should share their work and responsibilities , closely cooperate with each other , and form a coherent force in tackling gun - and explosive - related crimes .

at the diet session held on 9 may , newly appointed japanese prime minister koizumi said he would pay homage to yasukuni shrine in his personal capacity .
five days later , however , he said at a meeting of the budget committee under the house of representatives that he would do so as " prime minister " of the cabinet .
the criterion for judging aggression since world war ii , over the last few years in particular , japan 's yasukuni shrine , has become a sensitive cite for its connection with japan 's aggressive war .
yasukuni shrine is located at kudan , chiyoda ward in tokyo , where japanese soldiers who have given their lives in wars since meiji are venerated .
" yasukuni " means protecting the country .
there are 2.5 million memorial tablets for japanese soldiers who have given their lives in wars since meiji , including those for 14 a - class war criminals including hideki tojo , who was sentenced to death by the far east international military tribunal after world war ii , which japan lost .
yasukuni shrine bears not only a religious character , but also , especially , a political character .
what got one 's hackles up , in particular , was that japanese soldiers committed in china countless extremely tragic cases of slaughter including the nanjing massacre .
according to the report findings released by the far east international military tribunal , in nanjing massacre , as many as 340,000 chinese soldiers and civilians were shot dead and buried alive .
during the period of japanese invasion of southeast asia , the people of various countries in the region were also brutally killed : in vietnam , 2 million people were killed or injured ; in indonesia , 4 million ; and in the philippines , 1.11 million .
the visit to yasukuni shrine by public political figures , especially by government leaders , highlights the fact that the japanese political circles still insist on negating the aggressive war .
in the recent contest for the post of the ldp 's president , the eto - kamei faction changed from cooperating with the hashimoto faction into supporting koizumi at the critical moment , making it possible for koizumi to win the contest .
when obuchi and mori were prime ministers , they , advised by the " dove faction " in the ldp , resigned as president of the " association of diet members willing to visit the yasukuni shrine , " and acted with discretion on matters relating to yasukuni shrine .
in the japanese society , the right - wing stream of thought is deeply rooted in history .
after world war ii , though a - class war criminals headed by hideki tojo were condemned to be hanged , a large number of key militarists who had a unshirkable responsibility for starting the aggressive war , were protected by the us post - war cold war policy .
not long after the end of world war ii , a large number of war criminals , who had not conscientiously examined their crimes and sorted out their militarism , were freed from the allies ' prisons by the united states or on account of the us mediation .
these people , with the support of the right - wing forces in the financial sector or in the society , returned to the political arena and occupied important posts by foul means , with some even acting as prime minister .
therefore , up to now japan has not fully understood what a just war or unjust war is .
the expansion of japan 's economic and military forces has helped boost quite a few japanese politicians ' parochial nationalism . they have fearlessly expressed their intention to pay homage to yasukuni shrine , irrespective of how the people of various asian countries will feel hurt .
in addition , koizumi hopes to establish his image and win over impetuous citizens by taking the " bold action " of paying homage to yasukuni shrine .
again , an upper house election will be held in two months .
believing that paying homage to yasukuni shrine will kindle certain voters ' rash national pride and sense of superiority which has been suppressed , koizumi has insisted on taking a new and novel action of paying homage to yasukuni shrine , disregarding its political impact and its impact on japan 's relations with other countries .
observers believe that the right - wing forces encouraging government officials to pay homage to yasukuni shrine were originally an adverse current .
if those who are in power deliberately cater to and guide the adverse current resulting in it becoming the leading forces in japanese society , people at large cannot but be alarmed over it .
how can history be distorted at random in japan there has been fierce controversy over visits to yasukuni shrine .
on 15 august 1985 , japanese prime minister nakasone , ignoring criticisms from all sides at home and abroad , made a formal visit to yasukuni shrine .
later , religious people and civilian bodies in many places took legal proceedings against him . the incident had great impact on every sector in japan .
based on the legal proceedings taken by iwate prefecture , the sendai supreme court decided that the prime minister went against the constitution by paying homage to yasukuni shrine .
now , koizumi as prime minister intended to break through the barrier .
if paying homage to the memorial tablet for hideki tojo is considered to be a religious act , what do japanese political leaders want to believe in ?
hideki tojo received a systematic militarist education when he was young , and later became an important leader of the japanese fascist ruling clique .
all his life , hideki tojo was a vicious invader .
over half a century after he was hanged , some people still believe in and pay homage to him ! given this , how can people not feel anxious and exercise vigilance ?
since he indicated that he would pay homage to yasukuni shrine , koizumi has been criticized by many people in or out of government .
given the situation , we do not know what is the reason for koizumi to pay homage to yasukuni shrine .
the editorial urges koizumi to " think twice . "
on " 15 august " every year , which marks japan 's defeat in world war ii , japan 's anti - war bodies , including the japan association of war bereaved families for peace , hold a protest rally outside yasukuni shrine in opposition to the visit to the shrine by government officials .
prior to world war ii , a series of aggressive wars were waged by japan 's militarists and they all had much to do with fascism advocated by japan 's rightwingers .
during world war ii , japan 's rightwingers closely colluded with warlords and financial magnates and frantically pursued a policy of aggression and expansion .
however , after the cold war began and sheltered by the united states because of its anti - soviet union and anti - communism goal , the old rightwing forces revived and new rightwing organizations were set up one after another . they gradually produced an impact on the political , economic and social life in japan .
since the cold war was over , japan 's rightwing forces have expanded with each passing day . the incident of using textbooks to distort history initiated by japan 's " new history textbook compilation committee " is a typical example .
after japan surrendered on 15 august 1945 , a total of 233 japanese rightwing fascist organizations were got rid of by the allied countries .
by 1989 , their number had reached 840 and they had 125,000 members .
most of the japanese rightwing organizations are located in several big cities . there are 350 such organizations with 80,000 members in tokyo alone .
during world war ii , funds for the activities of the japanese rightwing organizations mainly came from japan 's mitsui , mitsubishi and sunitomo , three major comprehensive financial magnates .
for example , there are 95 enterprises of 16 financial groups that support the " new history textbook compilation committee . "
another example , the president of the rightwing organization " japan council " is koichi tsukamoto , chairman of wacoal corporation , and the " osaka council , " a branch of the " japan council , " also has the support of a large number of enterprises .
the " new history textbook compilation committee " has enlisted almost all rightwing scholars in japan and its funds for various activities each year exceed 420 million yen .
in the past three years , it has published over 1 million copies of pictorials that deny historical facts . each year , it organizes about 100 rallies , report meetings and forums in various parts of japan to deny the crime of invading china .
as a matter of fact , the major financial resources of the committee are powerful enterprises and financial groups , including the kashima construction , mitsui , mitsubishi and sunitomo , which people are quite familiar with .
these enterprises and financial groups brazenly plundered china 's resources and enslaved the chinese people in world war ii and they have continued to do things that hurt the feelings of the chinese people since the war was over .
recently , japan 's rightwing forces have caused a great disturbance on the issue of historical textbooks that has shocked all peace - loving people of the world and aroused their indignation . their obstinate attitude has even caused a diplomatic crisis between japan and its neighbors .
the reversals and zigzags , as well as the tendency of intensified efforts of the rightwingers , on the issue of the historical textbooks in japan can only make people think deeply : why has the japanese government abetted the rightwing forces to such an extent ?

beijing , 3 jun ( xinhua ) - - china 's laid - off workers can get effective assistance from the government in finding another job .
people who will receive such assistance include those who will soon graduate from reemployment service centers and those who have graduated from the centers but have not yet landed a job .
during this campaign , each and every laid - off worker will receive a special service handbook provided by labor support departments . the handbook serves to provide laid - off workers with information regarding relevant policies .
these laid - off workers will receive , without any charge , relevant employment information three times from labor support departments .
relevant departments will also carry out a system in which laid - off workers who has an identification card can enjoy preferential treatment as guaranteed by the policy .
they should make it easier for those who have found a job by themselves to pay social insurance fees . with regard to those who are unable to pay insurance fees , they should properly help them maintain a social insurance status in a bid to free them from family worries .
reemployment service centers shall carry out investigations into the situation of the family life of laid - off workers . in addition , they should submit a name - list of laid - off workers who experience particularly difficult livelihoods .
according to the rule , unemployment insurance agencies should give medical subsidies to those people whose unemployment insurance benefit period has not yet expired .
for unemployed personnel who meet the requirement of the regulations concerning protection of the minimum livelihood of city dwellers , unemployment insurance agencies should provide them assistance in a timely fashion in accordance with the regulations of relevant policies .
laid - off workers and unemployed personnel who have a hard time landing a job and who experience particularly difficult family life can receive assistance . in addition , labor support departments should provide them on a priority basis with a job in community service .
success in implementing these guidelines is of utmost importance to opening up a new situation and getting a good start for the united front work in the new century .
at present , we should avail ourselves of the favorable opportunity to advance our work and see to it that the guidelines of the national united front work conference are carried out thoroughly and successfully .

shenzhen 3 jun - - the two - day second senior officials meeting ( som ii ) of the 13 th asia - pacific economic cooperation (apec) ministerial meeting concluded in shenzhen this afternoon .
during the meeting , senior officials agreed unanimously that under the current circumstances where the economic development in the region is faced with uncertain factors , member economies of apec should make joint efforts in continuously sticking to the progress of trade and investment liberalization .
senior officials also arrived at certain preliminary understandings on important issues related to the apec trade ministerial meeting .
the som was presided over by wang guangya , and senior officials from 21 apec member economies attended the meeting .
before this event , senior officials of every apec member economy held an informal gathering on 1 june and exchanged views on how apec can play an role in promoting early launch of a new round of wto talks .
during the meeting , senior officials achieved substantial progress on review of the " osaka action agenda . "
wang guangya expressed that the accomplishments achieved at this meeting have positive significance toward maintaining and strengthening the progress of apec trade and investment liberalization .
he said that while the som stressed the importance of apec , it should also work hard to achieve substantial progress in economic and technical cooperation and in building capability to enable all member economies to deal with the challenge of globalization and the new economy .
the meeting also decided to formulate the " economic and technical cooperation action plan , " on the basis of all member economies independently and willingly submitting regular relevant actions and plans concerning economic and technical cooperation .
this not only will help propagate the progress that apec has achieved in the field of economic and technical cooperation , but also will promote every member economy to adopt more positive action in this regard .
wang guangya further said that the som also discussed ideas on cooperation in the field of new economy and building an " e - apec . "

the national assembly adopted the draft law at the first reading in june last year . the senate revised it in january this year .
this is an important legislation in france 's fight against cults .
it allows judicial authorities to dissolve any cult organization for violation of law ; allows a cult victim 's family or a social organization to file a lawsuit against the cult and , in particular , against the cult chief who inflicts psychological and mental harm on a religious disciple .
last year the " human rights report " published by the us department of state accused france of violating human rights in its crackdown on cults . what was the result of its accusation ?
the united states lost its seat at the un commission on human rights during a reelection earlier this year , whereas france gained a majority vote .
many cult - disturbed european nations are observing and studying this french law with great interest .
the french " committee for prevention and suppression of cults " indicated that as cult organizations are tending toward internationalization , france is willing to strengthen its cooperation with other european countries in building a " judicial space " for crackdown on cults .

as an important part of a series of events this year , this meeting attracts broad attention at home and abroad .
before the meeting , our reporter interviewed minister shi guangsheng of ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation about certain hot topics concerning the apec .
reporter : minister shi , china was chosen to hold the apec meetings this year . with regard to the foreign trade minister meeting , what special significance does this have ?
this year , the meeting is being held before the wto trade minister meeting in qatar in november , and this carries with it important significance .
reporter : what are the main agenda and items of the foreign trade minister meeting this year ?
reporter : since last year , the economic growth of apec members , including the us and japan , has shown signs of slowing down . in your opinion , what are the implications of holding this foreign trade minister meeting under these relatively difficult international economic circumstances ?
on the other hand , this meeting will help reach mutual understanding about situational issues in the world and regional economies , promote closer cooperation , and build confidence about economic development in the region .
reporter : under the framework of the apec , what role does china play and what has it contributed ?
at the bogor meetings in 1994 , president jiang zemin and other leaders from apec member economies established an objective of implementing trade and investment facilitation by 2010 for developed members and by 2020 for developing members .
in the osaka meeting in 1995 , president jiang announced china 's decision to reduce its import tariff levels from 1996 .
these measures forcefully made public china 's determination to adhere to the policy of liberalized reform , embody china 's positive position toward multilateral economic cooperation , and give full play to the constructive role of promoting progress of apec trade and investment liberalization .
reporter : the fourth wto minister meeting will take place in qatar this november . every party is watching closely to see whether this foreign trade minister meeting will give rise to a new round of multilateral trade negotiations . in your opinion , can apec play a role in promoting a new round of talks ?
of course , apec is an economic cooperation forum for the asia - pacific region ; it should not and cannot make decisions for the wto .
practical issues such as the form and content of a new round of talks should be determined by the wto members , and apec can only play an active role in promoting this .
even though china has not entered the wto , it has for many years supported the multilateral trade system represented by the wto . for this reason , china has made 15 - years of unremitting efforts to regain the status of signatory state in the general agreement on tariffs and trade and in joining the wto .
reporter : in your opinion , what impact will our participation and cooperation in apec have on our economic development ?
shi guangsheng : currently , the population of the 21 apec member states comprises 45 percent of the total world population , its gdp comprises 55 percent of the total world gdp , and its volume of trade comprises 46 percent of the total world trade volume ; it holds a decisive position in the world economy .
what is apec ? ( introduction to apec note 1 ) apec refers to the asia - pacific economic cooperation organization established in 1989 .
apec currently has 21 members .
at the vancouver meeting in 1997 , it was announced that apec has entered a consolidation period of 10 years and has instituted a temporary moratorium on acceptance of new members .
apec is located around the pacific ocean region , and its members are distributed throughout america , asia and oceania .
apec members have different historical backgrounds , cultures and religions , and their political and economic systems as well as their values vary ; in particular , there are worlds of differences in their economic systems , their levels of economic development , and the degree of their trade and investment liberalization .

nanning , 4 jun - - the huanjiang " luoyang gun case " that drew the attention of the ministry of public security was cracked on 29 may. twenty - one criminal suspects were arrested , and all 16 counterfeit revolvers and 236 bullets dispersed in society were found . a big hidden danger was therefore eliminated from society .
after numerous unsuccessful ambushes , the beishan mining region 's security department reported the situation to the huanjiang public security bureau .
the huanjiang county public security bureau organized its elite police force and set up a shangchao " strike hard " battle - zone task force stationed in the beishan mining region to carry out investigations .
at around 2300 on 12 may , the beishan mining region 's " strike hard " office received an anonymous phone call informing that " pan yanhua of huada hamlet , in beishan village of shangchao town , frequently bought and sold pistols . "
an underground " ordnance factory " came to the surface as a result of the raid . according to pan yanhua 's testimony , the gun was made by wei duoyu of zhongduan hamlet , in yongan village of luoyang town .
on the evening of 13 may , the police raided wei duoyu 's residence and arrested him .
in order to get rich quickly , he came up with the nasty idea of making guns and selling them .
after secretly hiding one revolver and 39 bullets , he sold the rest of his revolvers , each coupled with some bullets , at prices ranging from 200 yuan to 350 yuan to 18 people , including pan yanhua , mo x , tan x , and lin x , earning 4,950 yuan in total .
the work of tracking downing the guns and ammunitions was extremely difficult because they had spread far and wide .
the police visited hechi , xuanzhou , fengshan , dahua , and other counties and cities , and scoured various towns and townships in huanjiang county , enduring arduous fieldwork in their unremitting efforts .
for over a year , when people heard chen shui - bian [ chen shuibian ] bring out a theory , have they all been clapping , and have the theories brought joy to all ?
chen shui - bian means unending loss of hope and further disappointment .
this coalition government is simply more quackery , a new twist on an ancient game .
" opposition " parties not coming into the circle chen shui - bian says that after the election at the end of the year , regardless of what the results are , he will support the organization of a " multi - party coalition government . "
perhaps people think that it would have to be the " legislative yuan . "
chen shui - bian is not directly indicating a unitary " legislative yuan , " nor is he directly indicating that he will organize a structure for the " administrative yuan " with components from many political parties .
as a result , this so - called coalition government comes first from the goals of the democratic progressive party or chen shui - bian , who want to deny the party which wins a majority in the " legislative yuan " after the election the right to build a cabinet for unitary leadership .
after last year 's " 318 " election the kmt was the party with the most seats in the " legislative yuan . " they did not manage to get an all - kmt cabinet because chen shui - bian naturally did not allow the facts to prove the nature of his own anti - constitutional dictatorship .
this kind of thing is paramount to chen shui - bian denying the possibility of an alliance between the kmt and the people first party (pfp) .
the power of the majority is denied , which means that the non - majority parties can follow their own wishes .
only if there is a majority after an alliance would the kmt and the pfp , or the kmt and the new party , form an alliance .
the irony here is that when the time comes , the kmt would be protecting their majority in the " legislative yuan , " and might be surpassed by a coalition between the dpp and the pfp , thus becoming a special opposing minority .
this means that the dpp government under chen shui - bian always holds the initiative in its fist , and always keeps this operational power in its own hand .
on 30 may , lien chan [ lian zhan ] said openly that chen shui - bian 's motive for a coalition government was " recruiting traitors and hiring ruffians . "
the kmt and the pfp , being " opposition " parties , also clearly expressed their opposition to a coalition government in such a situation .
the biggest taboo in a political struggle is having the people think that your party lacks confidence in its progress . this is a major issue , and many votes could be lost as a result .
furthermore , any single " opposition " party must organize a coalition government in its party name together with the ruling party . here there always exist barriers of position which are hard to overcome .
the dpp government under chen shui - bian will not recognize one china , and chen shui - bian repeated at the end of may that " one china , each with its own interpretation , " was not a consensus .
if they want to establish a coalition government , it will always be necessary for one side to change their stand .
otherwise , this government will be working against itself and unable to operate , which is clearly an impossibility .
this tells us that chen shui - bian 's statement is not the unified will of the dpp . nor is it a unified decision and announcement of the " group of nine " in the dpp regime .
wu nairen said that he opposed a coalition government of individuals and proposed a coalition government between parties .
chen shui - bian has left absolute control in choice and freedom of direction here .
based on changes in party strength and position and relations across the strait , he could also cast aside the dpp . he could organize a coalition government that recognizes " one china , each with its own interpretation , " with " opposition " parties at its core .
in this way , he can spring forth from the bosom of inter - party struggle in taiwan , and become a new authoritative leader of some modicum of action .
with such differing paths , it is difficult to come together to plan , and due to differing political viewpoints , different ideologies and value systems , different ideological stances exist , and that is why there exist political parties with different names .
however , taiwan 's political parties are still political parties , and contradictions are still contradictions . if they do not jointly establish a coalition government , these situations will not disappear or change . if they organize a coalition government , the same factors will still exist .
that is to say , interest factors of " classifying people by party , " will necessarily still be a contradictory factor of struggle in the establishment of a coalition government made up of different political factions .
chen shui - bian 's idea of a coalition government , if it ever takes off in taiwan , will have to face two situations : one party being in the decisive position in terms of overall power , or evenly dividing the power among the parties so that no one would be able to unilaterally force a decision .
there are contradictions in the ideology and ideas of the people of the area or the nation , and there are great inconsistencies in what people think . the reason why different political factions are formed and struggle endlessly is quite natural .
at times , this is an impetus that is necessary for progress in development .
but all contradictions and struggles of this type are good and bad for the outcome . whether or not they can be subjected to objective regulation is not decided by subjective views . rather , this is decided by the objective , including material factors .
lien chan said at the end of may that taiwan should first work on the economy and then later talk about a coalition government .
the normal development of a material economy and the associated social phenomena can greatly weaken the intractable struggles of the people in society and the political parties , making the people focus their energies more on development .
this can be called " classifying people by nation . "
the division of people into groups by their social group or political affiliation of which people often speak is implemented on the foundation of " classifying people by nation . "
of social group , party affiliation or political beliefs , including productive life and culture , among all human activities , the most fundamental reliance and binding force is the nation .
the concept of patriotic heroes and traitors is not one of political belief or ideology .
as a result , the law of the nation is the guiding principle for any political group .
the national interests and the responsibilities an individual has toward the nation are higher than all rights and obligations .
recognizing this point we can see points of balance , compromises and factors of cooperation between longstanding contradictions and conflicts between groups of people and political parties which have always existed in society . among all these , the highest of all are national interests .
recognizing this point , the contradictory standoff between social groups and government by political parties has lost the overriding standard of evaluation and criterion for constraint , has become muddled , and everything is like shifting sands and drifting clouds , completely without a common direction .
all the public problems in taiwan at this time , whether spiritual problems of an economic , governmental , or cultural nature , on the surface can naturally be basically evaluated using the concepts of democracy , freedom , science , fairness , rule of law , or morality or the judgment methods of these concepts .
as a result , " dividing people into groups " loses the framework system of " dividing people by nation . "
people say that this is the reason why taiwan is hanging in midair .
with the fundamental question as yet unresolved , more issues pop up without limitation . this is the result of putting the cart before the horse .
and precisely because of this , the coalition must be formed in a certain way , finally yielding something which can only be new harm to the overall fundamental interests of the people of taiwan .
it is because there is yet no political or mass consensus on the question of reunification or independence that the dpp government of chen shui - bian has sunk into inextricable difficulties . only thus did the idea of the coalition government emerge .
after " 520 " last year , chen shui - bian acted arbitrarily and dictatorially denying a system of government with two heads , and wishing to construct his cabinet from dpp members only .
furthermore , people must ask why this government cannot represent the will of the majority of the people and obtain a minimum level of cooperation from each party . the answer is that this is not a question of strategy , but rather of not having planted an openly recognized multi - party banner .
the national system , political beliefs , ideology , lifestyle , customs and habits all can change with the passing of time and the concrete environmental conditions .
when will the fabrication end ?
regardless of whether taiwan has a coalition or non - coalition government , in terms of the current situation in taiwan , it is not important . the key to the current situation is that there is no way to turn away from the one china question .
the idea of the coalition government shows that chen shui - bian has evaluated his situation after taiwan 's year - end elections and no matter whether a coalition government is established or not , chen will have his own affirmation in the current taiwan situation , and hopes to continue thus .
coalition government or new middle line , both show that chen shui - bian still holds to a strategy of delay and wait on " ti . " he does not wish to solve this problem in the least .

wang guixiu said : as with economic reform , the beginning of reforming china 's political system was marked by the third plenary session of the 11 th cpc central committee .

the 13 th cpc national congress prominently presented the political reform issue to the whole party as a relatively independent and pressing task , and laid down a blueprint for political reform , enabling it to enter a new stage .
