upon joining the wto , and according to its rules and the relevant bilateral agreements , china will have very little room for maneuvering when it comes to utilizing trade policies to intervene in the economy . therefore clearly it is imperative that we look into some new foreign trade strategies .
the core of this managed trade liberalization strategy lies in a combination of policies of limited protection and mild export encouragement . it emphasizes the government 's active intervention to make structural changes and emphasizes the offsetting effects of import and export policies , so that the overall trade system is neutral .
although the paraguay round set very broad limits on import protection , we are not " without countermeasures . "
we should strengthen the organizational safeguard against damage , dumping , and subsidies and strengthen our investigation and implementation capabilities . 2 .
the policy measures to encourage exports are mainly the following : 1 . to continue to implement a managed variable exchange rate system and to reasonably undervalue the rmb exchange rate to encourage foreign sales . 2 .
if the enterprises in a country where our exports are destined or in a country that is our competitor are getting actionable subsidies which are causing damage to this country 's export goods , the chinese government is allowed to implement measures to remedy the situation .
develop key mid - tech industries after the country 's " wto accession , " if china chooses to continue to rely mainly on the labor - intensive type industries to expand its economy , such choice will only slow the country 's industrialization process .
second , reasonable economic scale is a necessary precondition for the mid - tech industries to pursue technological innovation and arrange the production of differentiated products .
furthermore , china has the real capability to tackle the core technologies of the mid - tech industries .
if we give the chinese mid - tech industries a proper amount of competitive pressure and r & d subsidy , they can quickly go through the imitation phase to enter the self - direct innovative stage .
the 10 th five - year plan will be a peak period for rural labor supply , and speeding up the development of nonagricultural undertakings in the rural areas is the focal point in china 's rural work and also the strategy for curing at the root the problem of increasing peasant incomes .
apart from that , agricultural modernization and rural urbanization must complement each other .
the urbanization process in china lags behind to a serious degree ; in 1999 the urbanization rate was only 30.7 percent , 12 percentage points below countries with similar per - capita gnp , and 24 percentage points below countries with a similar degree of industrialization .
speeding up the construction of small towns is of far - reaching significance for increasing peasant incomes , expanding domestic demand , enhancing the quality of the peasants , and changing the rural economic structure .
at present china has the conditions for speeding up urbanization , and the next step is the question of how to speed up and develop this process .
returns on input agricultural modernization cannot be done without input , but it will not do just to depend on government input .
the basic conditions for agricultural modernization and the problems that need resolving differ in different localities , and the input methods , intensity , and forms in agricultural modernization will also be different .
we should advocate a variety of input methods and attach importance to science and technology input and investment in education for agricultural laborers , as well as to capital input .

it is necessary to stress returns in agricultural modernization .
in short , we must be guided by the market and regard returns as the core in building agricultural modernization .

ensuring grain security is the basis of the strategic restructuring of agriculture and rural economy and is also the basis of achieving agricultural modernization .
without grain security , we cannot ensure the smooth progress of the strategic restructuring of agriculture and rural economy .

editor 's note : as china 's wto accession draws near , the development of the state - owned enterprises is entering a new phase of transition and innovation .
whether china will become a force to be reckoned with in the entrepreneurial world , whether its enterprises can rank among the global 500 , will become a part of the chinese nation 's challenge to economic globalization .
how can the state enterprises gear themselves to the world and become powerful contenders in the world economic competition ?
enterprises ' organizational structure has changed from a stratified pyramid system to a network - oriented partnership system , and the boundary between enterprises and the market is even more blurred .
yao zhensheng : indeed , this is how it is .
state enterprise reform is the most important matter among the important matters in the restructuring of the economic system .
almost all foreign and domestic scholars agree that the next 10 years will be the most critical decade in the course of china 's economic reform , and the most important factor is whether the restructuring of the state enterprises will succeed .
judging by today 's conditions in various localities nationwide , if we analyze the state enterprises ' maturity , stability , and rate of success in restructuring , we can say that shandong clearly is in the forefront . in particular , the best known are companies like haier and haixin .
even for a traditional enterprise like the zhangyu company , its output value has grown more than tenfold in six years , and there are many more like that in shandong province .
as we all know , beijing and shanghai 's economies are the nation 's strongest . not long ago , wu jinglian actually said that zhongguan village will soon rival silicon valley .
shanghai , on the other hand , is china 's largest industrial and commercial seaport . these attributes have to do with many years ' historical factors , and therefore although they may be advanced , they are not typical or universal . shandong is different in comparison .
historically speaking , shandong has no unique advantages ; it actually has some disadvantages that other localities do not have .
for example , before reform and opening up , shandong was known for its poverty , and even a decade or so ago , those from shandong and henan made up the bulk of people who braved the journey to the northeast .
i believe it is from learning . because the province itself has little capital of its own , the only thing it can do is to learn from the others .
huang guoxiong : indeed there are some issues that require the immediate attention of those in economic circles , and shandong 's enterprises indeed are unique .
a while back there was a man in hebei by the name of ma shengli . people called him " contractor ma. "
but contracting was just a format he used ; ma shengli actually invented two things : one , the product innovation theory , whereby he stepped up research and development , produced a generation of products while developing a second generation as backup and studying the next generation at the same time .
two , the third - party goods and materials transport theory , whereby he sold his own plants ' trucks and got rid of all the bad assets .
it is doing an outstanding job with the transport of goods and materials ; its products are reaching everywhere worldwide , and it maintains almost no spare or stockpile .
meanwhile a traditional business like the zhangyu company also utilizes its own r & d organization to constantly upgrade its products . it clearly leads all other enterprises in its line of business in terms of product variety and excellence .
shandong does not have the superiority of shanghai or beijing in terms of talent and research and development facilities .
shandong 's enterprises are characteristically at their learning stage ; they are particularly good at learning from other people 's success and further improving on it and get good practical results out of it . this sets an example for the other regions and poses a good lesson for the others .
wang zhiyun : just as elder huang said , an important reason why some of shandong 's enterprises have done so well is that they are learning - oriented enterprises .
as i understand , more than 50 percent of the global 500 enterprises are learning - oriented enterprises .
of the top 25 united states enterprises , 80 percent are still learning [ by doing ] ; 100 percent of the world 's top 10 enterprises are also learning - oriented enterprises .
in 1997 , when i first introduced in beijing the management theory of peter senge of the united states ' massachusetts institute of technology , haier was one of the first enterprises to immediately send people to come and study the theory .
i believe that what is most important to an enterprises is not just talent : a ph. d. who graduated three years ago , if he does not keep up with his study , is only as good as someone who has graduated with a master 's degree this year .
clearly the government should create all the necessary conditions to facilitate enterprises , so that through learning , the enterprises can develop and review innovative experiences .
if we had imposed rigid control on the enterprises , we would not have so many learning - oriented enterprises today .
the issues we explore today have general meaning .
at one time , we advocated the wenzhou model and the sunan model . these models provided economic development experiences back then , but the enterprises in those localities were smaller ; their enterprise culture was weaker .
enterprises in the shandong area are large in scope . for example , haier 's annual output value is in excess of 40 billion yuan , and haixin 's is over 20 billion yuan . even for the traditional enterprises like qingdao brewery and zhangyu , their annual output value is at least 1.5 billion yuan .
the enterprises are maturing very well , which means they have ample momentum , and the absolute majority of them are state enterprises that have successfully restructured .
however , there are some enterprises that may develop well at first , but because of their weak enterprise culture and their failure to learn , they can collapse after a few years . we should seriously think about that .
market development : enterprises must learn to " fly against the wind " yao zhensheng : from the point of meeting the challenges of economic globalization , enterprises must learn to " fly against the wind " when developing the markets .
huang guoxiong : on this issue , i want to make five points : one , there is no weak market , only weak enterprises .
because no product can corner the entire market .
take coca cola for example . it is popular worldwide , but it only has a 41 percent market share ; the remaining 59 percent makes up a potential market for others .
for example , back when the living standard was low , people drank juice - diluted wine .
later , the zhangyu company introduced a dry red wine , which started a " red wine craze " nationwide .
in the midst of the " red wine craze , " the company again came up with an outstanding cabernet red , and consequently , it opened up a vast mid - to - high - end dry red wine market .
recently , it has been reported that the company is opening up a winery that links tracks with the international markets to produce the internationally most expensive manor wines .
thus , with continuous scientific progress , new products are constantly being introduced , and there will be new markets being created .
four , the rising consumption standard , the changing consumer concepts , and the new consumption modes are creating new markets .
today , about one - tenth of the nation 's enterprises shut down every year , but at the same time , about the same number of new enterprises are arriving at the scene each year .
this is not a market issue but an enterprise issue .
two enterprises are in the same household appliance business . why does one shut down but not the other ?
why do some large enterprises go out of business but not the small ones ?
why do some of them even grow bigger ? nationwide , there are tens of thousands of enterprises in the liquor business , and scores shut down everyday , but the qingdao brewery and zhangyu company not only have not suffered but have increased output by several magnitudes .
from this angle , the market is not weak at all .
five , there is no weak consumption , only weak products .
from the point of the number of product categories in the world , we know that the united states has 2 million varieties , and we have less than a million , and few of them are well - known brands .
from the point of the passing grade , if the world standard is 90 percent , our standard is below 60 percent .
only the truly fine products have a free pass into the market .
take for example 1999 's global fortune forum 's annual meeting in shanghai and the chinese culture week in paris , france . they both named zhangyu 's cabernet their designated wine , because only it could represent the high standard of china 's red wine .
the restructuring track : should enterprises be bigger or stronger first ? yao zhensheng : the hottest topic today is the changing of enterprises ' system , and on that issue , many enterprises have been very successful , but when we talk about changing the system today , many people are also thinking about the risks .
the truth is , since day one of their birth , enterprises immediately have been keeping company with hazards and risks .
chen ji : this matter really should be explored from several perspectives .
we should orient enterprises from these perspectives , and summing up the experiences can provide better examples for developing the relatively backward central and western regions .
enlivening the large enterprises is a more complicated issue and requires in - depth studies .
some enterprises may be doing better and getting bigger , but they are not stable ; one may worry about their future and their sustained momentum .
wang zhiyun : people often talk about the 20 years of reform and opening up , but actually the reform of the mid - sized and large enterprises has gone on for about ten years .
how the enterprises can go from the planned economic to a market economic environment and go a step further to build a modern enterprises system is an issue that requires some serious discussion .
take for instance the zhangyu company we just talked about . it had a typical planned system before , and its products were sold exclusively by the state . this was not because it did not want to manage its own business ; it simply had no management rights .
that is why back then when foreign wines came to the domestic market en masse , the government 's exclusive sales department could not handle the business , and the enterprise itself had no sales management experience or even no sales organization , and therefore the business was almost destroyed .
first , they changed the production - oriented mode to a production - management mode and turned the state - run business first into a group company where the state held controlling shares and later into a limited liability company where the state held controlling shares , and they utilized every means to manage their sales .
if we blindly merge the enterprises together amid their strategic readjustment and reorganization and play matchmaker , it will cause many problems .
for enterprises like zhangyu and haier , they succeed because they made themselves strong first , not big first . the global 500 we talk about today are big rather than strong ; if we meant strong , we might have to make another list .
in reality , it is a way to achieve social division of labor through exchange , and this exchange impacts enterprises ' survival .
as we said earlier , the reason qingdao brewery is boldly making large - scale acquisitions is because it has digested general electric and du pont 's operating mechanism and advanced goods and materials circulation theory and has completely merged them into its own traditional culture to derive a even more advanced enterprise culture .
consolidation requires funds , but more importantly , it requires the right corporate culture , but at the same time , we must not neglect commerce as the intermediary or a good marketing format .
when haier first got started , beijing 's xidan market was handling its sales in beijing .
in addition , from the point of enterprises ' diversity , there are more failures than successes .
of course , some enterprises have no choice but to diversify . an enterprise like zhangyu is in a traditional industry ; its profit margin is thin , and it is dangerous to be too satisfy with the status quo .
furthermore , when an enterprise has stored up sufficient capacity , it would go against commercial rule to not expand .
haier went from making refrigerators to air conditioners to color televisions and mobile phones , and basically it has remained in the same familiar territory .
reportedly haier will take a step further to get into the micro electronics , computer chips , and areas with higher technological contents , but the foundation is the same , and although it is expanding , it is still solid .
zhangyu embarked on the same path a few years ago and did a good job with its wine business and created its own unique style of r & d system .
on the surface , they may appear to be crossing over to another industry , but in fact they are still standing on their existing foundation ; they are in control of the situation , and therefore such diversification is also sound .

this has not just been a finite change of the format of warfare , but a thorough change of operational thinking , weaponry and equipment , battleground space , and methodology and means of operations .
it is fair to say that the joint operations we are talking about today are a result of the new military transformation .
in ancient times , because the level of social productive forces was low and the technological equipment of armed forces was backward , with a lack of variety in arms and services and relatively simple operational methodology , the main format of operations was uniformly infantry engagement on the ground .
in modern times , the navy and air force , as important operational forces , gradually matured and became independent armed services .
today , as networking technology moves forward incessantly in the civil society , the composition of armed forces is also becoming increasingly network - based .
therefore , what is different from last century is that we must study and explore joint operations today against the broad background of the age of information networking . this is the first point that we must pay attention to .
in the limited wars around the world after world war ii , especially in the malvinas war between britain and argentina in the 1980 's and the gulf war in the early 1990 's , all - dimensional operations , stereoscopic operations , and noncontact operations emerged , bringing the thinking and theory of joint operations toward maturity .
it is obvious that " combining " information , " dividing " structural facilities , and simultaneously employing all kinds of means to achieve victory in a transparent battleground environment is where lies the true meaning of joint operations in the information age .
compared to all forms of operations that have been seen in the past , joint operations demonstrate diverse characteristics .
as far as operational strength is concerned , information technology is extensively used in the area of weaponry and equipment and the format of warfare is showing a tendency toward more precise strikes , automation of operation , and more intelligent behavior .
it is not hard to see that joint operations in the context of high technology are an advanced form of operations that incorporates wisdom , technology , and operational methodology and means .
the " synergy " of joint operations is a unity of structural rationality , spatial integration , and action in unison . it is a " synergy " of information , " synergy " of power , and " synergy " of effectiveness .
new technology was extensively employed in the military field , enabling the rapid development of weaponry and equipment , especially that of information technology , which became the " booster " of the rapid development of joint operations .
on the other hand , it also depends on the effect of a variety of factors , such as economic base .
a joint operation is a military operation involving close cooperation among different services , so it requires the backing of a certain level of economic base .
joint operations are even more affected by such factors as politics , economics , and science and technology than concerted and combined operations , thus making them a genuine trial of overall national strength of the confronting parties .
if in trying to understand joint operations , we failed to recognize the temporal background and essential characteristics of their birth and development or failed to recognize the essential distinction between informationized warfare and mechanized warfare , it would tie our understanding down to the level of concerted and combined operations .

the information from the ministry of finance has further proven that china 's financial structure will again undergo a major reform , and the way of conducting the reform will be " resolute and unswerving . "
why should it be conducted this year ?
where is the emphasis of the reform ?
and which departments ' interests will be affected ? 1 .
then , on 10 september that year , china 's financial reform - - a reform geared to the standards of socialist market economy - - started in deed . however , all the measures adopted in that reform were related to revenue .
why did we not reform the expenditure structure then ?
today , after a dozen years of reform and development , economic growth requires us to reform expenditure , and we have conditions to do so as well .
nevertheless , for the development of the country , we must reform our expenditure , no matter how difficult it may be .
as everybody knows , the major problems with china 's financial sector lie in the contradictions between revenue and expenditure , and the main aspect of the contradictions lies in expenditure .
however , the reform in the past was primarily conducted around " revenue . " that is , we drew revenues into the state treasury in the form of collecting " profit " or " tax " and did not touch the system and form of " money - spending " basically .
today , however , the " money - spending " system has obviously begun restricting the deepening of the reform .
thus , there came the cases of year - end reckless money - spending and even the illegal diversion of money to other purposes , such as building excessive office buildings , large halls , and guesthouses .
there is no need to cite other facts . those who are concerned with the country 's financial structure can all reach a conclusion : reform is unavoidable and imminent .
it is the budget management system .
this may not be exactly right , but is easy to be understood by readers .
obviously , the implementation of the department budget system will help safeguard the seriousness of budget .
that is the second advantage of the department budget system . the unreasonable base figure has led to the unfair allocation of workload and reward between different departments and projects .
viewing the present situation , there are still some problems in need of solution .
1 ) scientific expenditure norm and budget quotas have not been established yet .
3 ) the supporting reform measures have not followed .
the central government has decided to tackle the problems existing in management of revenues and expenditures from the fields of system , mechanism , and source .
similar experiments have been conducted in some localities as well , such as the system of " centralized calculation of accounts " and the system of " unified management of scattered accounts . " though different in name , the results are obvious .
establishing the system of single accounts for the treasury : the so - called single account means that all the government financial funds , both budgetary and extra - budgetary funds , are put together in the account of a bank , and all the expenditures are directly paid to goods suppliers through this account .
the setup of the existing account is that financial departments set up the state treasury accounts and the extra - budgetary fund special accounts at the central bank and the commercial bank , and budget units respectively set up accounts at the commercial bank to separately deposit , defray , and calculate the funds .
after introducing the new treasury management system , the method that budget units open accounts by themselves will change , and the ministry of finance will open , in a unified way , various categories of accounts under the system of the state treasury 's single account .
after the reform , both the budgetary and extra - budgetary funds will be turned over to the state treasury in the standardized form , and the present method of turning the funds over to the treasury through transitional account will be abolished .
steps of reform recently , the state council has already approved the " plan for reform of financial and treasury management system " jointly submitted by the ministry of finance and the people 's bank of china , and has decided to conduct experiments for the reform in some ministries and central commissions .
perhaps readers are more concerned with the date of the experiment . as disclosed by a leader of the ministry of finance , the experiment will begin on 1 july this year .
it began quite late but has been progressing very fast in china .
through several years ' implementation , a relatively complete management system has been formed for government procurement , the " sunshine project , " in the fields of basic system , management system , procurement forms , capital management methods , and supervision and inspection mechanisms .
in 1999 , most localities enhanced efforts to pursue the government procurement system , the government procurement management organs were strengthened continuously , and the scale of procurement increased gradually .
the customs have organized opening bidding on many occasions for engine , shipbuilding , vehicle , and garment projects .
the ministry of public health and the state administration of chinese traditional medicine have also procured maternity and child - care facilities through open bidding .
based on international experience , the government procurement scale of a country is 10 percent or more of the country 's gdp , or about 30 percent of the country 's financial expenditure in general .
because government procurement touches upon economic science , natural science , and many other fields of knowledge , the government procurement management personnel are not only required to understand financial knowledge but also master the knowledge and skills related to invitation of tenders , submission of tenders , management of contracts , and functions of commodities .
some localities have excluded other localities ' suppliers from the competitive bidding through the forms of conducting regional blockade and departmental monopoly .
there are many reasons for the above - mentioned problems that have hampered the progress of the government procurement work .
the first reason is the imperfect legal system .
china has not yet promulgated the government procurement law . there are only regulations for departments . the binding force of such regulations is obviously not strong . the protection of vested interests is the other reason .
those who are affected by government procurement are the units with vested interests , so it is unavoidable that some departments and industries may resist the implementation of government procurement .
working out a detailed budget is the prerequisite for conducting government procurement , and establishing the system of having state treasury defray appropriations in a centralized manner is the guarantee for promoting government procurement .
to gradually attain the development goals of government procurement system , the ministry of finance has decided that beginning next year , two or three years will be devoted to comprehensively promoting this system .

the us strategic early warning system has evolved and developed nonstop in light of the tasks undertaken by north american air defense command (norad) , and has now become the largest and most developed early warning system in the world , complete with the most sophisticated procedures .
the us system shall save in advance in a data bank the data needed for identifying and assessing various threatening targets .
equipped with two separate early warning systems , the us strategic early warning system could distinguish an early - warning strategic bomber or a cruise missile from a ballistic missile .
for example , the early warning system for detecting an incoming ballistic missile should be able to detect a target farther away and in a wider area , and carry lighter equipment .
having entered their third generation , the dsp satellites are operated by the cgs ground station on the us territory , the ogs ground station built by australia abroad , and the egs ground station built by germany in europe , respectively .
second , the ground - based air target surveillance and tracking system , which is formed by the following seven key early warning systems operated by the us air force space command and the us navy space command respectively : 1 .
the navy air surveillance system is also assisted by two smaller transmitters located at the hillah lake in arizona and the jordan lake in alabama , respectively , as well as by six other reception stations , and six sensor - radar stations . 3 .
being the oldest us ballistic missile early warning system built in 1962 , the ballistic missile early warning system was mainly used to issue an early warning against an incoming intercontinental ballistic missile (icbm) launched by the soviet union against north america over the arctic ocean .
all of its three early warning stations have set up independent telecommunication lines linking norad , and are capable of transmitting information to the norad 's missile early warning center within 10 seconds . 4 .
the submarine - launched ballistic missile detection system .
in 1972 , the united states and canada together added to the system an an\fps-85 radar and a navy par ( an \ fps - 16 ) annular search radar , for the sake of gathering warhead and ballistic information regarding an incoming intercontinental ballistic missile .
in the 1980 s , the submarine - launched ballistic missile detection system was comprehensively improved , taking in four new large - scale an\fps-115 " paving claw " alternate - control radar .
in the 1990 s , the us air force implemented in the caribbean region an over - the - horizon surveillance program , deploying an an\fps-86 radar at the egrin air base in cape verde .
the joint surveillance system (jss) .
in accordance with the us air force 's 968 h program , the jss system was built as a successor to the " sage / boke " system , an air warning and surveillance system developed to protect the us and canadian territorial air space .
the north early warning system (nws) .
besides , the nws is also assisted by a short - range early warning line called " the pine line , " which is located 49 degrees north latitude in the northernmost of the united states , running through canada 's east coast and west coast .
in 1994 , a new observation station was commissioned at the crotoranda air base in new mexico .

however , destruction of china 's ecosystems worsened and could not be effectively stopped . in the past 5 years , environmental protection has been given high priority in china . pollution treatment was put into effect in large scale .
however , in some regions and cities , pollution of ground water has worsened . china 's total industrial wastewater and urban sewage discharge is 41.5 billion tons .
the four major polluted areas , ranking by severity , are the dong hai [ east china sea ] , the bo hai , the nan hai [ south china sea ] , and the huang hai [ yellow sea ] .
coastal waters in the east china sea are getting more polluted . in the bo hai , pollution is reduced significantly . water quality in the yellow sea and south china sea essentially remained good .
in 2000 , there were 28 reported red tides . it was 13 more than the year before .
in the area of atmospheric pollution , deterioration of air quality in cities slowed down somewhat . in some cities , air quality has improved . nevertheless , the overall pollution level remains serious . the major pollutants are suspended particulates and particulates that can be inhaled through breathing .
among 228 cities being monitored , only 36.5 percent of them met the second - class national air quality standard . one hundred twelve cities exceeded third - class national air quality standard .
the communiqu also pointed out that 90 percent of the grassland in china is deteriorating by various degrees . deterioration in more than one half of the area is beyond moderate . desertization and alkalization are destroying 2 million hectares of grassland every year . the grassland ecosystem appeared grim .

beijing , 5 june ( xinhua ) - - president jiang zemin held talks with his niger counterpart mamadou tandja at the great hall of the people this afternoon .
the two sides exchanged views on bilateral relations and international issues of common concern in a cordial and friendly atmosphere , and reached consensus on a wide range of topics .
president jiang zemin first welcomed tandja for visiting china again .
he said that his excellency the president of niger is an old friend of the chinese people , and expressed the belief that his current visit would further deepen his understanding of china .
jiang zemin spoke highly of sino - niger relations .
the peoples of china and niger have a profound friendship , he said , stressing that thanks to concerned efforts by both sides , bilateral ties have quickly recovered and seen all - round development , and cooperation has scored marked achievements in all fields since the two countries resumed diplomatic relations four years ago .
he said that the two countries have supported each other and cooperated closely in international affairs .
he said that the further consolidation and development of sino - niger friendship and cooperation is in the interest of both countries in the new situation where the world is moving rapidly toward multi - polarization and economic globalization .
" i wish to join hands with your excellency to build a sincere and friendly cooperative relationship of mutual trust between china and niger in the new century , " he said .
he said that china assigns importance to the development of economic cooperation and trade with niger and will continue to do everything in its power to help niger , further strengthen inter - governmental cooperation and give chinese enterprises positive encouragement and support in going to niger to unfold diverse forms of mutually - beneficial cooperation .
he expressed the belief that china and niger would be able to make still greater headway in bilateral economic cooperation and trade if both sides would continue to exert their efforts .
he said that niger and china have maintained long - term ties of friendly cooperation and have maintained fruitful and friendly cooperation in all spheres , noting that for many years , niger has benefited from china 's selfless and valuable assistance and support in times of difficulties .
tandja said that he has brought with him sincere gratitude and cordial greetings from the government and people of niger coming to china again after 17 years .
he said that niger - china relations have undergone ups and downs , but niger is pleased to find that china is still an old friend .
he noted that there are great prospects for cooperation between niger and china in all fields , and voiced his belief that through joint efforts their bilateral cooperation would be even more fruitful .
tandja said that as a friend , niger is pleased to find that china is making rapid progress in all fields and sincerely hopes that china would complete the cause of its reunification at an early date after its resumption of the exercise of sovereignty over hong kong and macao .
after the talks , the two heads of states attended a signing ceremony of bilateral cooperation documents .
responsible officials of the two countries signed an agreement on economic and technological cooperation between the government of the prc and the government of the republic of niger and a protocol between the government of the prc and the government of niger on the exemption of the debts owed by the niger government .
beijing , 5 june ( xinhua ) - - this afternoon , vice president hu jintao held talks with vice president gustavo bell lemus of the republic of colombia at the great hall of the people .
exchange and cooperation between the two sides in political , economic and cultural aspects have been expanding .
hu jintao said that china attaches great importance to developing long - term , stable , equal , and mutually - benefical relations with colombia , and is willing to work with colombia to push the bilateral friendly cooperation between china and colombia to a new height in the new century .
as for the economic and trade relations between the two countries , hu jintao expressed that trade volume between the two sides has been on the rise in recent years , and economic and technological cooperation has been fruitful ; the economic and trade relations have expanded from one - sided trade to bilateral investment .
the economies of china and colombia complement each other highly , and there is great potential for bilateral cooperation .
hu jintao said that colombia is an important country in latin america .
your distinguished nation has pursued a foreign policy of maintaining independence and keeping initiative in one 's own hands , has protected world peace and promoted joint progress , and has played an increasingly important role in international and regional affairs .
bell spoke highly of the enormous achievements of liberalized reform and congratulated china on the achievements , saying the success of china 's economic construction shows that china has chosen a correct road of development .
bell reaffirmed that the colombian government adheres to the one - china policy , and supports the chinese people 's sacred undertaking of the motherland 's reunification .
colombia also understands and supports china 's views on human rights issues .
hu jintao said that china appreciates the colombian government 's one - china policy and refusal to develop official relations with taiwan , and its understanding and support for china 's views on the human rights issues .
on international issues , hu jintao pointed out that the multipolarization of the world and economic globalization are further deepening .
the multipolarization of the world demonstrates the reality of the variety of human civilizations , and conforms to the principle of the democratization of international affairs . economic globalization has brought both opportunities for development and severe challenges for vast developing countries .
under the current situation , the principle of sovereign equality and non - interference into each other 's domestic affairs is not out - dated . instead , it should be the basis of the new international political and economic order .
bell said that the two countries have broad agreements on international issues , and have been cooperating well with each other , a situation with which the colombian government is satisfied .
the colombian government also maintains that the world should be a multipolar one , and multipolarization is conducive to peace and stability in the world .

tonight , vice president hu jintao will hold a welcome reception for vice president bell 's china visit .

income growth for china 's peasants has been slow in recent years . peasants who engage mainly in farming in the central and western regions even saw their income declining in real terms .
at the same time , schools are imposing all sorts of fees , either establishing new categories of fees without authorization , or arbitrarily raising the old fees , or collecting fees on behalf of other departments .
in the face of mounting education expenses , a considerable number of peasants simply stopped sending their children to school .
small - peasant mentality plus pessimism shared by parents and students about job prospects after graduation has led to a new wave of thinking which says attending school serves no useful purpose .
to make things worse , many rural children who failed to pass the college entrance examination after finishing 12 years of school education find themselves without a skill to make a living .
in their minds , this not only saves them a lot of tuition but also generates immediate income .
the number of primary and middle school students in the countryside accounts for 75 percent of the nation 's total .
chinese children entering primary and middle school will peak during the period of the 10 th five - year plan .
a number of education experts have pointed out that against the backdrop of the state making all - out efforts to implement the strategy of rejuvenating the country through science and education and with the knowledge - based economy in the ascendant , the rise in school dropout rates is a " cultural sand and dust storm . "
it will dash our hope to transform the heavy load of population into an enormous human resource , which is our project of the century .
the first task is to " raise and reduce . "
we must do our utmost to raise the peasants ' income through strategic readjustment of our agriculture and the rural economy , implementation of the urbanization strategy , and other measures .
we must try constantly to improve the mechanism for investing in rural compulsory education . governments at all levels must increase investment in compulsory education in accordance with the law and gradually increase the ratio of state education budget in gdp to bring it up to 4 percent .
we must standardize fees collected by rural primary and middle schools and seriously reduce the level of tuition and miscellaneous fees .
we must reform the way elementary education teaching materials are published and distributed to provide rural primary and middle school students with affordable , suitable textbooks , and we must gradually begin to provide free textbooks to children of families having economic difficulties .
statistics shows that only 15 percent of our children in the countryside are able to finish 12 years of primary and middle schools and enter college .
the fundamental way to resolving rural education is enhancing our innovative spirit and sense of practice , making teaching and curriculum more compatible with the needs of society , organically integrating elementary education with vocational education and education preparing for school entrance examination with quality education , and bringing about the integration of agriculture , science , and education .
it is imperative under the circumstances to establish a fair mechanism for college and secondary specialized school graduates to enter the job market .
we must improve market mechanism and make special efforts to strengthen guidance , organization , and support for new potential job sectors ; adjust and improve employment policies ; and do away with the barriers and unhealthy practice in employment .

the western armed forces essentially are not " with no party affiliation . "
first , the leaders of their ruling parties serve as the commanders in chief of their armed forces .
in western countries , either the president of the united states or the prime minister of britain is responsible for commanding his armed forces ; because they assume power in the capacity of the leaders of their parties , their armed forces are actually commanded by the ruling parties .
second , most of those higher - level bureaucrats who directly control state power are politicians of the ruling parties .
this determines the leadership of the government ( state ) over the armed forces , which is essentially leadership by the ruling party .
all the parties that assume power in turn in western countries are bourgeois parties ; no matter how they assume power in turn , the states and armed forces are always under the leadership of a bourgeois ruling party .
in countries where party politics is practiced , it is impossible for the armed forces to be " with no party affiliation . "
now there are mainly four kinds of party politics in the world : 1 . the one - party system ; 2 . the two - party system ; 3 . the multiparty system ; and 4 .
in countries where party politics is practiced , either the state power or the armed forces cannot possibly be " with no party affiliation , " the nature of which are inevitably the same as that of the ruling party .
now party politics is practiced in both socialist and capitalist countries where the state and the armed forces are under the leadership of the party in power and " influenced " by its politics ; so there exists no such thing as the question of being " with no party affiliation . "
if the armed forces break away from the leadership of the political party of their class , they will inevitably become an alien force separated from their class .
resisting the erroneous view of " the armed forces being nonpoliticized " and preserving the distinctive proletarian political character of our armed forces " nonpoliticization of the armed forces " covers up the political nature of the western armed forces .
lenin pointed out as early as 1906 : " nonpoliticization of the armed forces " is a kind of philistine , hypocritical , and deceptive preaching , which is particularly conducive to covering up the true intentions of the bourgeoisie in this regard .
lenin also said : " the armed forces cannot and should not remain neutral .
it is a slogan of the hypocritical lackeys of the bourgeoisie and the czar government that the armed forces should to be made to pay no attention to politics ; in fact , however , they always involve the armed forces in reactionary politics . "
the western armed forces do not get " involved " in the relations among various bourgeois political parties at home or " remain neutral " in this regard because it is required or determined by the fact that the two or more parties involved are bourgeois parties or by the political system of multiparty competition .
that the armed forces do not get involved in a party struggle or remain neutral under such a political system actually represents a political attitude , and its essential character is to be loyal to bourgeois politics .
" nonpoliticization of the armed forces " distorts the essential relationship between the armed forces and politics .
at all times and in all countries , there is no army transcending classes , nor is there an army that does not serve politics , nor is there a war of no political nature .
concealed in the " nonpoliticization of the armed forces " is the hostile forces ' attempt to change the nature of our armed forces .
in preaching the " nonpoliticization of the armed forces , " the hostile forces are attempting to separate our armed forces from socialist politics with chinese characteristics and to " push " our armed forces into the politics of bourgeois libaralization .
" paying attention to politics is the quintessence of our army 's fine tradition . " our armed forces not only cannot be " nonpoliticized " but must persist in placing ideological and political construction before everything else in order to ensure that they are always qualified politically .
" nationalization of the armed forces " cuts off the essential relationship among the classes , political parties , state , and armed forces .
in our country , the relationship among the proletariat , the communist party , the socialist state , and the people 's army is not antagonistic but consistent .
marx pointed out that " the most important condition for proletarian dictatorship is the armed forces of the proletariat . "
" nationalization of the armed forces " gives people a false impression , and the nature of the armed forces is seemingly determined by the state .
essentially , the nature of a modern state is determined by the nature of its ruling party ; as a component of the state apparatus , the nature of the armed forces is also determined by the nature of the ruling party .
in our country , the communist party is the core of leadership , and the leadership of the party determines the socialist nature of the state and the nature of the armed forces as well .
at the nato foreign ministers council meeting that convened the other day , the united states , which had previously reaped no results from its lobbying , again took this as an opportunity to exert pressure and attempt to force nato allies to give in and support the us nmd plan .
so why have the nato allies rallied together to speak out against the united states and say " no " to nmd ?
according to the analysis of observers , the nmd plan is nominally for dealing with " rogue states , " but essentially it is for dealing with russia , among other countries .
this is not the case for the 18 nato countries . they are all in europe and are neighbors with russia .
although russia 's comprehensive power has declined somewhat over the past 10 years , russia is still a giant when it comes to military power .
moreover , under the leadership of president putin , the trend of a resurgent russia has emerged in recent years , and sooner or later a powerful russia will appear before all european countries .
up to now , there are more than 200 countries and regions in the world . only one or two countries have openly expressed support for the nmd plan , and there are very few countries or regions that secretly support this plan .
under the situation of the united states being somewhat of a loner , the 18 nato countries cannot risk universal condemnation to support the nmd plan . they are even more unwilling to go against the trend of the times by tying themselves to the united states ' war chariot .
moreover , the 18 nato countries are unwilling to be dragged into an arms race .
just for the nmd plan , according to the united states ' own estimates , up until the time of initial activation , it will cost approximately $ 240 billion .
for example , russia not only greatly increased its appropriations for military spending , but also formally announced on 1 june that it would establish a 90,000 - person aerospace force , with the desire that it act as a counterweight to the nmd plan .
though nato has positioned its relationship with russia as a " cooperative partnership , " it will always be on guard against russia .
once caught in the quagmire of an arms race , the 18 nato countries would certainly suffer heavy losses in economic construction .
in addition , the 18 nato countries are reluctant to always be slavishly dependent on the united states .
for many years , the united states has relied on its great power to occupy a decisive position in nato .
in the history of nato , for all important matters , whatever the united states said , was how things went .
in the past , the countries that held this dissatisfaction generally did not quarrel with the united states within nato , but would choose other occasions on which to say " no " to the united states .
for example , the eu currently has 15 member countries , all of which are also nato member countries .
when the united states would not allow the eu to organize and establish the " european rapid reaction force , " the eu argued against this on the basis of reason and went ahead with its plans anyway . when the united states unilaterally tore up the kyoto protocol , the eu countries immediately rallied to attack .
in the history of nato , the " flock " not following the " lead sheep " is an extremely rare situation .
conducting meticulous research on geographical conditions words such as " a good terrain is the troops ' best ally " and " to win a war , we must gauge our troops and study the terrain " show that military strategists throughout history laid stress on the role and impact of geographical conditions in military actions .
in the gulf war and the kosovo war , military forces of the united states , the united kingdom , and other countries made convenience use of countries and regions around iraq and kosovo as springboards or bases .
therefore , we must not simply focus on new and high - tech weaponry in studying foreign armed forces ; we must give emphasis to researching foreign military geographical conditions while studying the battle ideology , formation , and equipment of foreign armed forces as well as their battle principles , characteristics , and approaches .
for example , the united states continues to maintain a front - line military presence in the asia pacific . it keeps a 100,000 - strong force and is doing all it can to coax some countries and regions to join its missile defense system , thus constituting a severe threat to security in the asia pacific .
only by conducting research in such manner , can we be prepared and be able to gain the political and military initiatives .
conducting research early to make hay while the sun shines all countries in the world determine who their battle opponents are according to the threat to their national security .
such threat could be an immediate or a potential one .
therefore , we cannot simply judge who will win future wars by comparing the number of existing battle units .
only by doing so , can we be always ready and stay forever undefeated in future wars .

we have entered a new century in which we will see the great rejuvenation of the chinese nation .
in the 20 th century , marxism was like a magnificent rising sun , shining on china 's revolution and construction under way .
only by upholding and consolidating marxism 's guidance position will the entire party and the people of the entire country be able to always advance in the correct direction .
this is a piece of basic experience that our party has obtained through 80 years of fighting and also a fundamental guarantee for the continual development and growth of our party and the party 's cause in spite of all the difficulties and setbacks .
first of all , this has been due to marxism 's own historical value .
however , an objective and fair analysis of this social phenomenon leads to an opposite conclusion .
in a negative fashion this phenomenon demonstrated that violating marxism would lead to setbacks on the part of socialism .
in the second half of last century , some developed capitalist countries were characterized by steady economic development , the abatement of domestic social contradictions , and the acceptance of management conduct .
one important reason for this change was that capitalist countries had learned lessons from history , applied some socialist practices , and worked vigorously to repair capitalism .
as western bourgeois scholars have admitted : the book " das kapital " describes capitalism as riddled with problems and defects , and we have prevented the ship of capitalism from sinking and enabled it to continue to sail through repairing the ship on the basis of descriptions provided by " das kapital . "
no theory , from all the diverse schools , theories , and isms throughout history and around the world , can contend with marxism ; no theory can exert such great influence on the process of human history or play such a great role in changing the look of the world as marxism does .
marxism has been subjected to all kinds of slanders , attacks , distortions , and verbal abuses ever since its birth , but the marxist truth , like a firestone , emits ever brighter light as it gets hit harder .
even some enlightened western personalities also believe that marxism is " an insurmountable intellectual peak . "
seeing the tremendous changes over the past hundred years , the chinese people have realized that marxism provides the fundamental way to our shaking off miseries and building a powerful country and represents the only correct guiding ideology on achieving the great rejuvenation of the chinese nation .
it was only after the introduction of marxism into china and the combination of marxism with china 's practice that china got a new look .
the history of our party 's hard struggle over the 80 years has revealed the following truth : whenever marxism is successfully combined with china 's reality , our cause will develop and be victorious ; whenever theory is divorced from reality , our cause will make detours .
all this has made some people question the necessity to consolidate and strengthen marxism 's guidance position .
since the entry of humankind into class society , no society has been a society of one ownership system , but this fact has not prevented any society from having one ideology occupy the dominant position .
as marx said : " the dominant ideology is but the conceptual manifestation of the dominant material relationships and the manifestation of the dominant material relationships in the form of ideas . "
the richer , more profound , and more diversified social changes are and the more lively people are intellectually , the more necessary it is to consolidate and strengthen marxism 's guidance position .
otherwise , the diversity occurring in social life can lead to chaos and disorder and create ideological confusion and social turbulence , thereby bringing disasters to the country and people .
marxism has always respected the free development of human individuality .
practice has demonstrated that the initial establishment of the socialist market economic system has provided a better guarantee , in terms of the social system and mode of economic activities , for the free development of individuality .
it has been under the guidance of marxism that the people of our country have strengthened their autonomy consciousness , democratic - rule - by - law consciousness , competition consciousness , efficiency consciousness , and exploration and innovation consciousness , and a generation of socialist new people with rich and fully - developed individuality is growing up .
marxism has always actively advocated democracy .
our country has adhered to marxism 's guidance in socialist democracy construction because marxist theory of democracy has revealed laws of democracy construction , represents the democratic will of the people at large , and points out a clear direction for our democracy construction .
question four : will the consolidating and strengthening of marxism 's guidance position affect the implementation of the " double - hundred " policy ?
the " double - hundred " policy itself is an important content of marxism , and is aimed at achieving progress and prosperity of our country 's science , culture , and arts .
the " guidance position " that we talk about refers to the state ideology occupying the dominant position , and the " hundred schools " and " hundred flowers " that we talk about refer to various particular scientific , cultural , and artistic theories and schools under the guidance of marxism .
question five : will the consolidating and strengthening of marxism 's guidance position hamper introducing and borrowing other outstanding intellectual and cultural achievements ?
marxism is an open ideological system and developing scientific theory ; it does not constitute the conclusion of truth , but only opens a correct path for our effort to understand truth .
it critically incorporated british and french utopian socialism 's theory on fairness and justice in human society , the rational cores of dialectics of germany 's classical philosophy and materialism , british classical political economy 's method for dissecting the capitalist economy , and intellectual pith in the latest achievements of natural sciences .
over the past century and half , it has kept advancing continually in practice , developing continually in practice , studying new situations , answering new questions , and continually incorporating , borrowing , and integrating various outstanding intellectual and cultural achievements , thereby enabling marxism to always maintain its vitality and to continually open new realms .
with this character , marxism is able to be all - inclusive , while adhering to and developing its distinct characteristics .
but , this absolutely does not mean that we should obstinately hold onto individual remarks or conclusions taken from the body of marxism .
according to the marxist notion of dialectics , there is nothing in the world that does not die .
only by carrying out innovation will it be possible to have development and to achieve true continuation and real adherence , so that there will be continuation and adherence .
innovation is marxism 's life .
the reason why marxism can maintain its youth all the time and its vibrant development has been that innovation is inherently required by the essence of this theory .
marxism 's contribution to human progress not only lies in the fact that it profoundly reflects and expresses the relevant historical period , but , more importantly , lies in the fact that it advances the continual emancipation of the human mind and leads continual reform and development of the relevant historical period .
in carrying out theoretical innovation , it is necessary to respect the creative spirit of the masses of the people and to persist in considering practice the only criterion for truth .
without such innovation , there would have been neither the socialist new china nor socialism with chinese characteristics .
the important " three represents " principle is targeted at the three historical tasks facing our party and people as well as the practice of party building in the new historical period and constitutes innovation of marxist party - building theory on the basis of historical continuity , reality , and a forward - looking attitude .

throughout history , every nationality has contributed its own energy to make up the china of today .
just as the han nationality has its own traditional national culture , so too does every minority nationality have its own traditional culture . naturally , the tibetan people also have their own unique national traditional culture .
in chinese history , high - level rulers of every nationality formed joint alliances for their own interests in order to rule over every nationality under them .
the han and tibetans formed alliances in the past in order to rule if there were no participation and assistance by the mongolian and the han governors , then the qing dynasty established by the manchus could not possibly have ruled the entire country , and it would have also been difficult for it to last until 1911 .
likewise , if the mongolian gushi khan and the tibetan fifth dalai lama had not of their own free will pledged their allegiance to the qing government , then the qing dynasty 's rule in tibet would not have been so trouble - free .

splittist elements in a few areas within china , under the goading of imperialism , took advantage of the weakness of the central government and took the opportunity to carry out splittist activities .
as for china , itself a victim of imperialist aggression , being identified as an imperialist country - - if this does not show an ignorance of history , then it is surely rife with ulterior motives and evil intentions .
