republican senator james jeffords 's decision on withdrawing from the republican party triggered off an earthquake in the us political circles .
biden 's recent remarks showed that this comparatively moderate democratic senator held a position greatly different from the positions of helms and the bush administration on many issues .
helms was forced to step down in the last six years , jesse helms gained his fame from the chairmanship of the senate foreign relations committee , and became a typical " obstinate hardliner " in the us and even international political circles .
in all foreign policy debates inside the us senate and even on the issues of relations with international organizations and payment of dues to the united nations , this republican hardliner always assumed an overweening and overbearing attitude , making people feel the individualized and insensible tendency in us politics .
the first time helms drew attention from international opinion was in the autumn of 1995 , when he and republican house representative dan burton raised the helms - burton act .
after the act was put into force , it encountered strong opposition from the international community , including european countries .
when facing the strong international pressure , the us government was forced to postpone the implementation of the helms - burton act again and again . however , with the fierce opposition from helms and his like , the unpopular act still cannot be annulled .
after a brief passage of hoping for " a new beginning " of the relationship between the united states and the united nations , he even " warned " the united nations not to " infringe upon the sovereign independence " of the united states .
he also said that if the united nations insisted on demanding a full payment of dues from the united states , then that would be the " beginning of terminating " the united states ' support for the united nations .
the most prominent feature of his words and deeds was toughness .
today , i anticipate here that before the end of president bush 's tenure , he will realize the plan to visit havana and attend the inauguration ceremony of a new cuban president . "
helms also strongly complained about the china policy pursued by the previous administration , and announced that he would try hard to push congress to pass the " taiwan security enhancement act , " which was aimed at strengthening military relations between the united states and taiwan .
the mass media , which were used to the hard - line position held by helms , were also disgusted at his remarks .
now , with the defection of senator jeffords , who is objected to the policies pursued by the bush administration , helms ' ambitious plan was brought to an end all of a sudden .
who will biden challenge ?
then came joseph biden .
biden is a senator from delaware state .
in his political base area , biden could speak more freely .
when expressing his own viewpoints , biden supports almost everything opposed by helms , such as international contacts , arms control treaties , the united nations , and foreign assistance .
on domestic issues , biden also made it plain that he looked forward to being able to " lending a hand " to secretary of state colin powell , who took a relatively moderate position , and would support his struggle against the hard - line conservatives in the white house , the pentagon , and capitol hill .
he said , " i am willing to provide support to him and enable his viewpoint to get an upper hand on major international issues . "
the senate foreign relations committee under his control is rather powerful as it decides the submission of motions , the deliberation of motions , and the holding of investigations . the chairmanship of the foreign relations committee will give biden the power to block the government plans he does not like .
he can issue orders to hold wide - range hearings , obstruct official appointments , and withhold fund appropriations . therefore , his committee will control the $ 15 - billion - worth foreign assistance and diplomatic budget to a large extent .
in 1999 , when lee teng - hui , the former leader of the taiwan authorities , dished out the " state - to - state theory " which was extensively criticized , helms issued an open statement to support , but biden expressed opposition to helms ' viewpoint .
at the same time , some mass media that are rather discontented at helms said that the moderate position of the senate foreign affairs committee under biden 's leadership will partly modify the extreme part of the us foreign policy .
the analysis pointed out the following : in the layer of international relations , helms ' stepping - down and biden 's rise may , to a certain degree , reduce the hard - line color of the us senate ; in the layer of us domestic politics , the influence of the conservatives may be restrained somewhat .
however , by carefully studying biden 's remarks , one may find that his did not always hold an attitude of opposing the principled position of the united states on major foreign policy issues . he just raised questions and different approaches , and expressed different opinions on steps and methods .
the obvious difference is that biden more typically represents and embodies the partisan opinions of the democratic party .
the great changes to the chinese nation during this century have fully demonstrated the great vigor of this ancient nation , which accounts for the largest percentage of the world population .
it is true that this nation loves peace , but it will not sit silent and bear foreign oppression or bullying .
this is a fundamental conclusion inferred from the great changes that occurred for the chinese nation over the past century .
the cruel fact is that the following conditions had to be met before the chinese people could eradicate the old forces deeply and complexly rooted in china , establish a new society , win national independence and enrich , strengthen and modernize the country .
second , this political party should be able to unite every force possible , and particularly rely on and mobilize workers and farmers , which account for the overwhelming majority of china 's population .
this requires that this party be composed of advanced people who have a common ideal , strict discipline and close relations with the people and the masses and that this party be able to struggle in an unswerving manner despite the extremely difficult and dangerous environment .
the founding of the communist party of china is the most significant issue in the entire history of china .
the communist party of china was unprecedented . it was completely new .
the party represents the fundamental interests of the chinese nation as a whole and the direction in which the chinese nation moves forward .
it is true that , during the initial period after its founding , the party did not have a large number of members and the party was not mature , but the party made the situation of chinese revolution new and fresh .
the communist party of china began its [ communist ] activities when china was still a semi - colonial and semi - feudal society .
one year after its establishment , the party explicitly proposed its political opinion of toppling imperialism and feudalistic warlords .
none of the chinese people had had such a clear understanding before .
upon the failure of the great revolution , the party lived through other dangers and difficulties and then explored the china - situation - oriented correct way of seizing political power , characterized by " enclosing cities with rural areas and taking over the political power by arms . "
this victory was the first complete victory that the chinese nation had achieved over many years ' fighting against imperialist invaders .
in the liberation war that followed , the communist party of china led the people 's liberation army to overthrow the kmt 's 20 plus years of governance over mainland china , terminated the days when arrogant foreigners could do what they wanted where the communist party of china also went .
this was really a time when chinese were proud , happy and satisfied !
with unprecedented enthusiasm , the chinese people spent three years rebuilding the national economy that had seriously been damaged during war and involved themselves in large - scale economic construction .
constructing the economy on a large scale was completely new to the chinese people .
marching forward through continuous exploration marching forward through continuous exploration is not only an important characteristic in the painstaking development in the 20 th century , but also the key to correctly understanding many crucial and major issues in the chinese revolution and construction .
the reason lies in the unique differences between china and western countries .
after standing up , the chinese people still consistently feel that [ lagging behind is ] a dangerous threat [ because ] " lagging behind would mean being defeated . " this led to an extraordinary sense of urgency - being eager to get china out of poverty and backwardness .
in addition , the tough domestic and international environment did not allow the chinese to march forward slowly and the chinese people did not even have enough time to cope with problems in a calm manner .
there were shortcuts to take .
this can be compared to a boat , sailing on the sea without navigation beacons . facing the endless sea , the sailor does not know whether or not shoals , submerged reefs and vertiginous currents may lie . a negligible slack of efforts may lead to vital disasters .
since marching forward through exploration in such a complex environment , the lack of a ready - made , pre - experienced and perfect plan would be natural and it would be impossible to clearly foresee everything and to be 100% sure of everything .
during revolutionary wartime periods , the communist party of china led the people throughout the country in overthrowing the three big mountains - - imperialism , feudalism and bureaucracy - - and establishing new china within only 20 years .
however , in this process , the party did not win this victory in a smooth manner , but rather made severe mistakes and lived through two major setbacks , respectively the failure of the great revolution in 1927 and the failure in fighting against kmt 's fifth " encircle and suppress " in 1934 .
these two failures brought the revolution to the edge of a hopeless situation and led to a belief that the communist party of china would begin to die out from then on .
however , the fact was completely different from this false belief .
first , economic development and social reforms exceeded the tolerance of development of the productive forces and [ the party ] was unrealistic by rushing along blindly for quick and easy successes .
after suffering more than enough , the party mobilized itself to bring order out of chaos , understood this overextension in a heartfelt manner , returned to the correct road and in socialist modernization construction made greater achievements that attracted the attention of the whole world .
this argument , of course , does not mean to forgive our mistakes in the past , but rather to analyze issues in light of the historical reality at that time .
had we done our job better and had we been a little more modest and cautious , we could have made fewer mistakes and corrected our mistakes earlier .
we should never forget these lessons .
however , generally speaking , people will not gradually and profoundly understand the complex objective reality until they have practically experienced it . we should learn a lesson from every setback and never repeat mistakes we made in the past .
the exploration is endless .
this is similar to the case of the democratic revolution , which progressed in a smoother manner in the middle and later state of development than in the early stage , due to the positive and negative experiences in the early stage of development .
constructing socialism with chinese characteristics simultaneously developing the economy and comprehensively advancing society is a wish the chinese nation has been upholding a long time .
why did the socialist ideal arise ? why is it so attractive to so many people ?
to a large extent , it is a result of people 's strong dissatisfaction against such abnormal phenomena as the huge gap between the rich and the poor and the weak being bullied by the strong in capitalist society .
comrade deng xiaoping noted , " the most fundamental advantage of socialist [ society ] lies in common prosperity , which embodies the nature of socialism . "
the communist party of china started at the very beginning to explicitly specify [ realizing ] the socialist and communist [ societies ] as its struggle objective .
this is unprecedented in the history of the chinese nation .
the name of this party explicitly demonstrates this point .
comrade mao zedong said , " the democratic revolution is an inevitable preparation for the socialist revolution and the socialist revolution is the inevitable development trend of the democratic revolution " - explicitly the relationship between practical requirements and the long - term objective .
as constructing socialist society is a completely new and inexperienced idea , many weaknesses in the soviet model began to be exposed .
the communist party of china then strove to avoid mechanically copying the ussr model in an attempt to pave a new road suited to the chinese situation .
this was another new exploration , the initial one that the party had made since china began to walk the socialist road .
from this exploration stemmed a large number of important achievements , as said comrade mao zedong in his articles including " on the 10 major relationships " and " on correctly handling contradictions among the people . "
however , since the subjective [ ideas ] were isolated from the objective reality of china , [ the party ] made an erroneous decision , which led to the " great leap forward " movement and the " cultural revolution . "
constructing socialism with chinese characteristics includes two aspects . first , since we are constructing a socialist society , if any party member exclusively focuses on short - term interests and forgets the fundamental objective of constructing socialist and communist society , this member is not a qualified party member .
second , the socialist society we are constructing out of china must have chinese characteristics and must be based on the fact that our country is still in and will remain for a long time in the developing stage of preliminary socialist society .
constructing the socialism with chinese characteristics provides the correct road for the great revitalization of the chinese nation .
comrade deng xiaoping noted , " in the past when we marxists involved ourselves in the revolutionary struggle , it was because we were striving to realize the ideal of socialism and communism .
particularly younger generations should understand this point . but what is socialism ? how should we construct socialist [ society ] ?
the most important positive and negative experiences of all says that we must understand this issue . "
it is under the guidance of deng xiaoping theory that the chinese nation continuously studies and resolves new issues , overcomes every difficulty in the way of the new long march , and wins great victories one by one .
over the past years , the third generation of the party 's leadership group with comrade jiang zemin as the core has been uniting and leading all ethnic groups in overcoming difficulties one by one , winning victories one by one , accomplishing achievements that drew the attention of the whole world and enriching and developing deng xiaoping theory .
in 1997 , we took effective measures for calmly confronting the buffeting of the asian financial crisis , continuously advanced reform , opening up and the modernization construction and successfully lived through the test of a major and significant economic risk .
in 1998 , we fenced off the attack of unprecedented floods , continuously maintained social stability and economic development throughout the country and successfully lived through the test of a major and significant risk brought about by natural disasters .
at the turn the century , comrade jiang zemin proposed the important thinking of the " three represents " and regarded the requirements of the " three represents " as the basis for building up the party , the basis for the party 's governance and the source of strength .
the chinese nation is confidently walking towards the future and facing the new century .
on 5 june 2001 , our daily published a report on jiang shengli , political instructor of the jinan military area command 's second cannon company , an exemplary figure who has excelled at putting the " three represents " into practice .
once this important thinking is combined with practice , it will become a powerful spiritual and material strength and will greatly advance construction of party - building and comprehensive military construction .
in the final analysis , " guiding thinking and conduct " and the " four points of implementation " that chairman jiang emphasizes mean that thinking should be put into practice .
the " three represents " is the fundamental strategy for building the party in the new stage of development and is the scientific guide for party work as a whole .
the educational campaign on the advanced nature of party members , which is currently being promoted among party members in the military , is an effective means of studying and practice the important thinking of the " three represents . "
maintaining the advanced nature of party members in accordance with the requirements of the " three represents " is not only a matter of theory , but also a matter of practice .
wartime , the advanced nature of party members is embodied in whether or not these members can fight the enemy before others , retreat after others and defy the danger of a bloody death .
they are convincing not only with what they say , but also with what they do . for some party members , there is a severe problem in that theory is isolated from practice . they focus on giving lip service [ to these ideas ] while ignoring the effort to practice the theory .
they only talk about the theory , but never do as the theory says . they are very strict with other people , but they do a very bad job themselves . this is an important reason why they have no credibility with the masses .
practicing the important thinking of the " three represents " means to embody the " three represents " through conduct and to implement this thinking in work .
we should carry out the requirements not only in every party - building task and political work , but also in every task that is part of military work , science and technology , logistic supply and armament , to advance comprehensive military construction .

as soon as a country 's old government is superseded by a new one , then the old government has no right to represent that country .

beijing , 7 jun ( xinhua ) - - after the fulfillment of the objective of lifting state - owned enterprises out of difficulties in three years , economic operations of these enterprises have shown a significant turn for the better and moved into a benign cycle .
in the three - year work of lifting our state - owned enterprises out of difficulties , the improvement of the macroeconomic situation and the support of the state played a major role .
plus , some enterprises on the profit - loss borderline may possibly become loss - suffering enterprises .
on top of this , structural contradictions , a longtime problem of state - owned enterprises , have yet to be radically resolved .
mergers and bankruptcies in these years have formed an initial way for some state - owned enterprises to withdraw from the market , but there is still a considerable gap between what has been done and what is actually required .
what deserves more attention is the fact that this year has seen a remarkable increase in uncertain elements concerning state - owned enterprises ' reform and development because of changes in the macroeconomic environment .
japan , the second economic power in the world , is also suffering a slowdown in economic growth .
guangdong contributes 40 percent of china 's exports . this year the province 's january - april exports grew only 2.1 percent .
the trend of global economic slowdown will directly affect the work of " promoting to a new height " the reform and development of state - owned enterprises .
with regard to the domestic market , insufficient demand remains a relatively striking problem . there has been no basic change in the state of supply exceeding demand for most products . the growth of farmers ' income is quite slow .
as for urban residents ' consumption , a big growth is also impossible because of increased laid - off employees . the stimulating effect of consumption on the economy remains to be seen .
the growth of investment demand played a significant role in enabling china 's economy to pass the asian financial crisis and maintain its fast development .
this was a direct effect of the proactive fiscal policy carried by the state in these years . so far , however , no mechanism has been formed for the normal growth of public investment .
for the first quarter this year , collective and individual investments in urban and rural areas grew only 7.6 percent . this was 1.8 percentage points below last year 's corresponding period and 7.5 percentage points less than the investments of the state - owned and other economic sectors .
without public investment as a foundation , demand for investment cannot grow steadily , and its stimulating effect on the economy will be very limited .
judging from the growth of the three major public demands this year , the market condition will have an increasingly remarkable restricting effect on the nation 's economic growth as well as on the reform and development of state - owned enterprises .
lack of a firm foundation for overcoming difficulties , no change in the operational mechanism , still - striking structural contradictions , plus an increasingly grim external macroeconomic environment - - this is the situation confronting the work of reforming and developing state - owned enterprise this year .
in advancing the state - owned economic sector , we should , on the one hand , take the enterprises as the mainstay , respect their will , comply with the law of market , and prevent excessive government intervention , such as " arbitrarily arranged association . "
secondly , we should further deepen the reform of state - owned enterprises and promote the transformation of their operational mechanisms .
second , efforts should be made to promote the normal operation of the corporate management structure with emphasis on listed companies .

even though bigger and taller buildings have been built , it is still small - scale peasant economy .

as one magic sword after another soared into the sky , the chinese strategic missile unit - - a subject of world attention - - ushered in its 35 th birthday .
after xu haibo , a bachelor - degree soldier with a certain missile brigade , distinguished himself in the drive of strengthening the army with science and technology , his unit set aside a special fund of 300,000 yuan for him and another graduate soldier to carry out scientific research .
young high - caliber soldiers like xu are not unique individuals in the strategic missile unit but rather members of a growing group .
the number of new recruits with a bachelor 's or higher degree has risen over the years , and these recruits have injected vigor and vitality into military units .
the commanders of missile - launching battalions and companies under missile units are people who directly command missile launches , and whether they are of high or low caliber directly affects the units ' combat effectiveness .
the second artillery corps therefore introduced numerous laws and regulations on selecting , promoting , and appointing young missile - launching talents , and set strict appraisal standards .
examples of these doctorate or master 's degree - holders include a 25 - year - old senior engineer , a 28 - year - old associate professor , and a 34 - year - old professor , and these people will be our important talent resources for winning future high - tech wars .
letting a large number of high - caliber young talents take up important responsibilities has strongly promoted modernization of the units .
in recent years , the second artillery corps has made several hundred achievements in terms of tactical methods , training methods , and training reforms , most of which were accomplished by young talents .
units commanded by young talents have also successfully fulfilled their missile - launching duties in various exercises and training programs .

" explanation 2 " explicitly specifies the meaning of cult " propaganda materials " and their " manufacture " and " dissemination . "
question : how should acts of manufacturing and disseminating cult propaganda materials , of inciting people to split the country and to undermine national unification , or of inciting people to subvert the state power and to overthrow the socialist system be convicted and punished ?
question : how should cult members ' acts of assembling to make trouble , to openly carry out cult activities , or of assembling people to assault state organs , news organs , and other units be handled ?
question : how should acts of organizing , instigating , and abetting cult members to commit suicide , to injure themselves , to burn themselves to death , and to detonate explosive devices on themselves be handled ?
" explanation 2 " also does not aim the spearhead at acts of burning or detonating an explosive device on oneself ; it aims the spearhead at acts of endangering public safety by resorting to the dangerous method of burning oneself and detonating an explosive device on oneself .
therefore , this is by no means a simple act of killing oneself ; it is a criminal act of endangering public safety .
other criminal acts of endangering public safety , such as committing arson , breaching a dyke , setting off an explosive device , and spreading poison , and undermining means of transport and transport facilities , shall also be punished in accordance with the crimes stipulated by the criminal law .
question : are there any provision on punishment of cult members who repent after committing a crime ?
it is necessary to attach importance to both legal effects and social effects and to punish the criminal activities of the " falungong " cult organization and to safeguard fundamental rights of the state and the masses of people by correctly applying legal and judicial explanations .
those personnel of heretic sects who use violence or threats to obstruct state personnel from discharging their duties are to be convicted and punished on the charge of interfering with the exercise of public functions according to article 277 , paragraph 1 , of the criminal law .
those violating other regulations at the same time are to be punished more severely .
those who organize , plot , instigate , incite , and help cult personnel to kill or injure themselves are to be convicted and punished on the charges of murder with intent and intent to injure according to articles 232 and 234 of the criminal law .
those endangering public security through self - immolation , self - explosion , and other dangerous ways are to be convicted and punished on the charge of jeopardizing public security through dangerous ways according to article 114 and article 115 , paragraph 1 , of the criminal law .

the cpc 's external relations are continuously expanding , and its international influence is increasing , growing .
thus , the cpc 's international liaison work became an important part of new china 's overall diplomacy .
in the first five to six years , following the establishment of the central international liaison department , official relations were set up with more than 60 political parties in other countries around the world .
when the cpc held its eighth national congress in 1956 , 56 foreign communist parties and workers ' parties were invited to send delegations to the convention .
the prestige and influence of the cpc rapidly expanded . in the 1960 s , the cpc maintained relations with more than 90 communist parties .
however , the polemic within the international communist movement , and the subsequent serious split , lead to the breaking up of the cpc 's relations with many foreign parties .
after the third plenary session of the 11 th cpc central committee , china entered the new period of reform and opening up ; new breakthroughs were also made in the cpc 's international liaison work .
at the same time , it also established exchange and cooperation relations in various forms with the nationalist and democratic parties in african , latin american , and asian countries .
at present , the cpc maintains various forms of relations and connections to about 300 political parties of various types in developing countries .
according to the spirit of " transcending ideological differences and seeking understanding and cooperation , " in the early 1980 s , the cpc began to establish relations with socialist parties , social democratic parties , labor parties , and their international organizations in european countries .
after that , in a period of more than seven years , the cpc and most socialist parties in western europe established different forms of relations .
the friendly exchange and cooperation between the cpc and the socialist parties served to increase mutual trust , expand consensus , and develop cooperation .
in the mid-1980s , the cpc came into contact and began to make exchanges with some traditionally centralist and conservative political parties within western developed countries .
from that time , the cpc 's international liaison work entered a new stage of comprehensive development .
each year , china has received nearly 200 visiting delegations from foreign political parties ; many of those delegations were headed by their leaders , chairmen , or general secretaries .
because the economic factor holds a more important and prominent position in international relations , party - to - party relations have also been key in promoting economic and trade cooperation .
in recent years , cpc leaders and party committee secretaries of various provinces , autonomous regions , and municipalities also visited foreign countries , together with people from the economic and business communities .

us president george w. bush announced on 6 june that his foreign policy advisers had completed a full review of policy toward the democratic people 's republic of korea [ dprk ] and he would order his staff to resume dialog and hold " serious " discussion with pyongyang on a broad agenda after a suspension of three months .
after several months of so - called " review , " president bush whose foreign policy performance had been widely disputed since his assumption of office finally found that he must go with the tide , take up what his predecessor left off and face the reality of reopening dialog with pyongyang .
bush even told rok president kim dae - jung that " the dprk remains a threat to the united states " when the latter visited the united states in march .
us media took bush to task , saying that he was making the most serious " diplomatic blunder " since the cold war by putting a stop to contacts with pyongyang , that he was just bringing up the issue of " north korean threat " again so he could deploy the national missile defense system .
according to the media , there are several factors behind bush 's announcement to resume dialog with pyongyang .
as the other country on the korean peninsula , south korea realizes that dprk - us relations will have a direct impact on the korean situation .
thus , in the past months , seoul has been urging washington to end its review of policy toward north korea as soon as possible so that the korean peace process could continue .
the second factor is that washington does not want to risk being excluded from the korean peace process .
the european union has achieved substantive progress with pyongyang since the beginning of this year .
the european union has won more say on the korean peninsula after one of its delegations had achieved fruitful results on its visit to the dprk .
the third factor is that after the so - called review , the bush administration has come to realize that there is no way of implementing the agreements previously reached with pyongyang unless dialog is resumed .
in the face of domestic pressure , particularly criticism from the democratic camp , the bush administration dares not take this issue lightly . bush 's decision was welcomed by all sides .
this not only exceeds the scope of the previous dialog but will bring new variables to future talks .
a few days ago , pyongyang rejected us overtures of " guiding " the us - dprk talks with " a tough consultative manner " and urged that the dialog be conducted on an equal footing , stressing that it will pay close attention to washington 's attitude before deciding on the resumption of talks .
the disputes triggered by the implementation of the " geneva nuclear framework program " between the dprk and the united states has also come in the limelight .
according to rok officials , the united states plans to resume ambassadorial contacts with the dprk first , eventually upgrading these contacts to talks between cabinet ministers .
us secretary of state colin powell discussed details regarding talks with the dprk with visiting rok foreign and trade minister han seung - soo on 7 june .
people are hoping that the early resumption of dprk - us talks will help bring about gratifying changes on the korean peninsula .
on 31 may , when briefing the indian parliament 's consultative committee on defense , indian external affairs minister and defense minister jaswant singh announced that the indian government had formally approved launching the " agni " long - range ballistic missile system program that day .
the " agni - i " is a two - stage , liquid - fuel missile . in 1989 it was successfully tested . it has a payload of one ton , and can carry high - explosive blast warheads , chemical warheads , cluster warheads or nuclear warheads .
it has a range of 1,000 - 1,400 km . the " agni - ii " is a two - stage , solid - fuel missile that can carry a one - ton nuclear warhead . it has a range of 2,000 - 2,5000 km . in 1999 it was successfully tested .
on 31 may , india formally approved the development of a long range missile system , namely the " agni - iii " long - range ballistic missile .
according to reports , india had begun to secretly develop the " agni - iii " long ago . it has a range of up to 3,500 km .
india has now revealed this program just as a demonstration of its resolve to advance the modernization of its strategic deterrent system .
actually , india 's indigenously developed polar satellite launch vehicle was successfully launched in march 1996 . the new generation gslv-d1 geosynchronous satellite launch vehicle was successfully launched on 18 may this year . both of these [ launches ] demonstrated that india actually already possessed the capability to launch icbms .
this type of missile uses multi - trajectory mobile control technology [ duodandao jidong kongzhi jishu ] . through six different pre - programmed trajectories , it can achieve all - the - way guidance .
this has not only greatly increased the accuracy of attacks , but has also improved defense penetration ability .
the naval version , which has a censor system that is equipped with a radio precision altimeter , can fly at an altitude of seven meters above sea level , fly through waves and intercept missiles that fly along the sea surface .

with a good development foundation and with the efforts jointly made by leaders and peoples of the five countries , one has every reason to believe that the " shanghai five " mechanism will continue to grow stronger in the new millennium .

as kyrgyzstan president askar akayevich akayev said , " being the precious assets left down from many years in history in various participating countries , the spirit provides a new historic opportunity for the founding of a new regional organization on the basis of ' shanghai five . ' "
international background information - - origin of " shanghai five " china , russia , kazakhstan , kyrgyzstan , and tajikistan are friendly neighboring countries sharing over 7,000 kilometers of common boundaries and holding the common hope for maintaining good peripheral environment .
at the first five - nation summit meeting , the leaders signed an agreement on enhancing mutual trust in the military field in border areas .
on 24 april 1997 , the leaders of the five countries held their second summit meeting in moscow and signed the agreement on reciprocally reducing military forces in the border areas .
after that , the leaders of the five countries held regular annual meetings , and the contents of the meetings were extended from strengthening mutual trust in the border areas to across - the - board mutually beneficial cooperation in the political , security , diplomatic , economic , and trade fields among the five countries .
so far , all the five countries have hosted a summit meeting , and a total of five summit meetings were held in shanghai , moscow , alma ata , bishkek , and dushanbe .
as the five - nation summit meeting was first held in shanghai , the meeting mechanism was called " shanghai five . "

some people make the mistake of solving practical problems by spending money and find solutions to practical problems in accordance with the amount of money they are given - - the more money they are given , the more problems they solve . the less money they are given , the fewer problems they solve .

the two outlooks on security will bring about two contrary sequences to the peace , stability , development , and prosperity of the world in the 21 st century .

on the other hand , irrational and incorrect command decisions are bound to result in a strong belligerent being defeated by a weak one .
in a real war , the victor is often one placing tremendous emphasis on concentrating its own capability , including its superior combat forces , and especially , its superior command decisions .
nowadays , quite a few countries have begun placing enormous emphasis on establishing a joint operations command structure marked by high efficiency , in an effort to keep up with the latest trend of battlefield changes .
for example , various countries have started studying , with earnest efforts , the issue of establishing a command structure capable of simultaneously catering to " wartime and peacetime needs . "
in peacetime , armed forces will still have to integrate , in light of wartime needs , command targets , and command tasks , departments with similar functions in various services , thus laterally merging the departments concerned , and resolving problems like overlapped institutions and confusable responsibilities .
moreover , armed forces should also set store by , and study the question of command relations between different services .
after joining a joint operations group , units of different services should submit to a joint command , with their respective commands handling support and coordination issues instead of issuing orders as in the past , thus preventing different commands issuing different orders .
finally , armed forces will have to study in real earnest the issue of establishing small but competent command institutions known for high efficiency .
" concentrating one 's own ' capability ' " means that a belligerent will have to concentrate its own scattered " capability " for use in a certain direction or in a certain zone , with an eye on creating superiority over the enemy in a certain zone and during a certain period .
in a war , a belligerent will have to concentrate its own " capability , " and so will its opponent , in each and every way .
should a belligerent with superiority in rapid mobility fail to take measures to deplete the enemy 's " capability " upon receiving an intelligence report on the enemy situation , it would find it rather difficult to concentrate its own operational " capability " to the fullest extent .
in a nutshell , a belligerent will have to deplete the enemy 's " capability " by learning about the enemy situation , finding a fighting opportunity on the basis of its own superiority , and making a false or deceptive move .
for example , a belligerent will have to organize , coordinate , and apply in a flexible way its own forces of different services and arms , in light of their respective offensive capacity , before launching a strike at the enemy 's weapons systems , information systems , and logistic support systems .
concentrating traditional " capability , " and especially , information " capability " and " capability " of offensive information weapons since the military domain has extensively employed information technology , a trial of information capacity has now become a focus of joint operations .
placing emphasis on concentrating individual " capability , " and especially system " capability " the kosovo war has shown that joint operations waged under modern conditions are largely operations staged by troops of different services and arms , in coordination with one another , and the outcome of war is dictated by the belligerents ' overall fighting capacity .
in order to concentrate " capability , " a belligerent will have to give scope to its individual services ' and arms ' " capability , " and , more importantly , its entire system 's " capability . "

shanghai , 11 june - - after a cycle of five years , the " shanghai five " will again meet in its place of origin . naturally the event has caught the widespread attention of both chinese and foreign media . so far close to 400 hundred reporters have submitted their requests to cover the event .
because the meeting will open shortly , this reporter recently interviewed professor zhao huasheng , director of the division of russian studies under the shanghai institute of international studies , about the forthcoming meeting .
" shanghai five " is a name that journalists of the west invented for their own convenience . however , because the name reflects the characteristics of this mechanism and it has indicated its place of origin , it has become a very popular name accepted by all parties concerned .
he said the " shanghai five " formally came into being in april 1996 .
since then , holding the meeting in shanghai and not in the capital is considered a decision that reflects the spirit of equality among the five countries .
zhao huasheng pointed out : the forthcoming meeting of the heads of government of the five countries in shanghai , the place of origin , not only has symbolic historic significance , but also has important realistic significance .
when this meeting convenes , the " shanghai five " will step onto a new stage and enter a new period of development .
absolutely no other organization in central asia can match its strategic importance , which is irreplaceable .
second , the " shanghai five , " as a regional mechanism of cooperation , has both distinctive and comprehensively representative regional characteristics .
it is the only mechanism of cooperation that brings together china , russia and the major central asian countries .
its formation was originated from the need of ensuring common security . it is not directed at any neighbor of these five countries .
as the scope of cooperation of the " shanghai five " expands , it welcomes other neighboring countries to be members of this mechanism .
this can be proved by the fact that uzbekistan , which attended the " shanghai five " activities as an observer in 1999 , may become a full member of the " shanghai five . "
after the issue of border security , which was the primary objective of the " shanghai five " mechanism , was basically resolved , its scope of cooperation has been expanded to economic , regional security , science , technology , and humanities areas .
in fact , it is becoming a mechanism for the five countries to develop full cooperation in ensuring regional security and promoting economic development .
fifth , the " shanghai five " has had extensive recognition from the international community . it is an organization having the greatest international influence and highest prestige in this part of the world . its potential of development should not be ignored .
every meeting of the heads of government of the " shanghai five " has drawn the international community 's attention and comments .
meanwhile , the " shanghai five " has also helped several weak central asian countries gain access to the international stage and elevate their international status .
as for the future of the " shanghai five , " zhao huasheng maintained that the " shanghai five " now faces the task of deepening its members ' cooperation in two respects : creating more deep - going mechanism and cooperation .
as for creating a more deep - going mechanism , zhao huasheng said : this is naturally essential for the development of the " shanghai five " mechanism . it is also a requirement for its continual development .
after five years of explorations , adjustments , and developments , the " shanghai five " has passed its embryonic period and has set its course and scope of cooperation . the joint statements that the heads of government issued at their previous meetings also have great political significance .
the direction set for creating a more deep - going mechanism of the " shanghai five " is turning this mechanism into an organization of regional cooperation .
it will take time before the " shanghai five " can gradually transform from being a mechanism governing meetings of the heads of government to being an organization of regional cooperation .
zhao shenghua indicated that coming up with more deep - going cooperation programs is a major issue confronting the " shanghai five . "
in comparison with their needs five years ago , the priorities of cooperation among the " shanghai five " in the area of security have changed .
the prospects for regional economic cooperation economic cooperation is the other most important aspect of deepening cooperation among the " shanghai five " members .
economic cooperation is crucial for the long - range development of the " shanghai five " mechanism . when their economic cooperation fails to develop in a deep - going manner , their development potential will be greatly limited .
cooperation in the area of energy is an important area that has significant economic interests as well as economic and strategic security interests to both sides .
2 ) the construction of the eurasia bridge .
this is to revitalize the " silk road " to address the communications issue , which has long been the bottleneck that restricts central asian countries ' economic rejuvenation , and to make central asia a major corridor linking europe and asia .
the resources and certain products of central asia and china are considerably complementary . reducing and removing certain factors that restrict the development of bilateral trade will create more opportunities for achieving faster growth of bilateral trade .

why do we currently need to further emphasize staunch adherence to the socialist road ?
staunch adherence to the socialist road has been a consistent fundamental political principle of our party .
in the almost 10 years since the dramatic changes in the soviet union and eastern europe , the major capitalist nation the united states of america has experienced particular economic growth and enhanced national strength .
judging from the lessons to be drawn from the drastic changes in the soviet union and eastern europe , shaken convictions within are more dangerous than external intervention .
in the face of such a serious situation in world socialism , educating broad masses of party members to strengthen their socialist convictions becomes a work of utmost importance that needs to be constantly and continuously reinforced . it is directly related to the prospects and fate of the party and socialism .
third , reform and opening up require constantly educating our party members and cadres on persistent adherence to the socialist road .
this point is fully corroborated by the fact that the reforms in china and the reforms in the soviet union and eastern europe brought about two completely different results .
looking back on the reforms in the soviet union and eastern europe in the ' 80 s and early ' 90 s of the 20 th century , we can clearly see how some leaders of these countries slowly dragged their nations onto the capitalist road by means of so - called reforms .
by no means can we reject reforms because of this huge risk ; the key issue here is to unswervingly persist on the socialist road in the course of the reforms .
how to compare two systems the key to conscious staunch adherence to the socialist road is in correct ideological recognition and comparison of the two major current social systems - - capitalism and socialism .
even though socialism is a higher social formation than capitalism , still the current economic development level of the socialist countries is lower than that of the capitalist countries .
for these countries to catch up with advanced capitalist nations of the west it would take a very long historical process .
in the past several hundred years , the western capitalist nations were brutally plundering the entire world , turning many nations into their colonies or half - colonies . their advanced status is built on the foundation of the backwardness of colonies and half - colonies .
the superior position occupied by capitalist countries , through unjust and inequitable international economic and political order that was formed over a long period of time still seriously limits our development .
precisely for this reason , the bill for china 's backwardness is on the account of western colonialism and power politics , not on the account of socialism .
otherwise how could one explain why among the numerous capitalist countries of the world only a few western advanced nations are truly prosperous , while most of the third world countries that practice the capitalist system are more backward than china with its socialist system .
a backward economic basis determined the low starting point from which we began our economic and social development after the victory of the revolution , the complexity and enormity of the construction tasks , and the need for long - term unswerving , persevering effort .
considering the domestic situation , the establishment of socialist state power transformed china from a semi - feudal , semi - colonial country into an independent sovereign country , liberating the chinese people from oppression by imperialism , feudalism , and bureaucratic capitalism and making it the master of the nation 's destiny .
due to the 50 - odd years of hard struggle by the chinese people , socialist construction in china has achieved glorious success . by 2000 , the gdp reached 8.94 trillion yuan , making china the seventh - largest economic power in the world .
as soon as china departs from socialism , it is bound to relapse into a semi - feudal , semi - colonial society . the overwhelming majority of chinese people will not allow this reversal of history .
by contrast , the nature of socialism is in accord with the demands of social development and the basic interests of the masses , and the socialist state is fully capable of continuously resolving the problems accompanying our advance through reforms and self - improvement .
following the dramatic changes in the soviet union and eastern europe , socialism seemed to be in a dangerous situation of an impasse , but glorious new prospects have appeared after the bold rise of socialism with chinese characteristics .
and this is exactly its meaning .
in what way must we unswervingly persist on the socialist road ?
socialism is a continuously developing cause .
we need to firmly hold and raise high the great banner of deng xiaoping theory .
we must be guided by this theory and relentlessly resolve various issues arising in reforms , openness , and modernization drive - - only this can be considered truly upholding socialism .
we must fully and accurately understand and implement comrade deng xiaoping 's inference on the nature of socialism .
in a conversation in the south in 1992 , comrade deng xiaoping pointed out that the nature of socialism is in liberating productive forces , developing productive forces , eliminating exploitation , eliminating polarization , and ultimately achieving prosperity for all .
after we corrected this erroneous trend , we absolutely needed to emphasize the liberation and development of productive forces .
we must correctly handle the relations between upholding reform and opening up and persisting in the socialist road .
the crucial point is the problem whether something is to be classified as ' capitalist ' or ' socialist . ' "
focusing on these two trends , on the one hand we need to persist in the socialist road in the course of reform and opening up , and on the other hand we must clarify the meaning of persisting in the socialist road .
by no means can we engage in privatization ; by no means can we set up a western - style system with many parties taking turns ruling , two - chamber system , the division of three branches of power ; by no means can we allow the guiding ideology to become multicomponent .

reportedly , on 7 jun , the chinese representative put forward a proposal for a treaty that would prevent the weaponization of outer space ; this attracted attention at the geneva disarmament negotiations meeting .
as mankind stepped into the new century , a new arms race , in outer space , was initiated .
without regard to the strong opposition of the international community , a certain country with advanced space technology decided to step up the research and development of outer space weapons and weapon systems , including anti - ballistic missile systems and anti - satellite systems .
on 1 may , us president george w. bush announced that the united states will deploy a tiered satellite and radar system .
france , germany , italy , and spain jointly researched and developed two generations of optical photography reconnaissance satellites , which have been launched to space and put into operation . it is planned that the third generation of such satellites will be launched in 2005 .
after that , european armed forces will no longer need to rely on the united states ' satellite systems .
it is no exaggeration to say that today , outer space is full of smoke from gunpowder .
the weaponization of outer space will inevitably damage any mutual trust between countries , and cause a profound and far - reaching negative impact on the regional and international security environment .
this will inevitably give rise to new mistrust and skepticism . before the old problems are resolved , new ones will crop up . this will inevitably add new , unsafe , and uncertain factors to regional relations and state - to - state relations .
with the passing of time , such negative influences will become more salient .
along with the development of outer space weapons , a new arms race can hardly be avoided . the arms race will require money .
a space arms race based on high technology will require huge amounts of money .
it should also be noted that space arms race activities will not be independent , nor isolated .
this intensification will inevitably trigger ground , sea , and air - based arms races .
when the weaponization of outer space develops to a certain degree , the missile defense system of the superpower will reach a perfect degree , and will form a " heaven shield " in real terms . then , it will be freer to launch a war whenever and wherever it likes .
with the pending weaponization of outer space , the authority of the united nations will be greatly weakened .
the escalation of the space arms race will turn the " peaceful utilization of outer space " proposal into a mere scrap of waste paper .
at the same time , the use of outer space for military purposes directly goes against the wishes of most countries in the world for the " peaceful utilization of outer space , " causing them to doubt the position and role of the united nations in the handling of major international affairs .
people generally believe that , with the development of science and technology , mankind 's understanding of nature will continue to deepen and superstitions will gradually lose their foothold .
most people have accepted this viewpoint : only practice can verify whether knowledge is correct or not . although science is not the sole factor influencing people 's thinking , it plays a big role in the development of rationality .
the spirit of science is a force inspiring people to oppose superstitions .
generally , people with a scientific spirit will not talk about superstitions .
the authenticity of science is an important reason why people believe in science and discard superstitions .
whether it is general knowledge or experiences , religions or superstitions , their authenticity cannot be compared with that of science .
therefore , science can only continue to deal blows to superstitions and to reduce their sphere of influence , but it cannot exterminate superstitions .
in some countries where science , technology , and the economy are backward , poverty , hunger , diseases , and the worsening environment have driven many people to long for a better life or to feel that their future is dark and that they face an uncertain prospect .
therefore , when some cults preach that they can help them to go to heaven or claim that the end of the world is near , they usually believe that this is true , thereby becoming a captive of cults .
therefore , they were easily taken in when a cult like " falungong " started to bluff and cheat under the banner of " science . "
in economically underdeveloped areas , relatively impoverished people are frequently baffled by the " wonderful paradise " preached by cults .
to a large extent , this constitutes some of the reasons why some people have been fascinated by " falungong . "
as opposing cults is a complex feat of social systems engineering , it is necessary to mobilize the strength of all social sectors .
beyond doubt , science plays an important role in this struggle .
because cults try to control people 's minds , we should use a tit - for - tat method .
in addition to promoting scientific spirit , we should go all out to promote cultural spirit .
president jiang zemin put forward " rule the country with morality . " it can be said that this is an attempt to advocate cultural spirit education with the prosperity and diversity of the country and nation in mind .
coordinate warfare is warfare which does not require traditional aiming ; all that is required is the intended target 's three dimensional coordinates , then one can conduct a precision attack combat pattern against it .
coordinate warfare emerged , first , with the comprehensive maturing of the navstar satellite global positioning system [ gps ] .
after 1973 , the united states researched and produced a total of 24 new generation navstar gps satellites , and deployed them in six orbital planes at approximately 20,000 kilometers altitude .
militaries without this kind of capability can reduce damage by moving important targets underground and use electronic countermeasures decoys and frequent battlefield maneuvers , yet simple defensive measures will seriously limit a military 's combat capability .
this leads to russia , although having once invested many resources in this regard , yet , up until now still having no practical missiles , bombs and artillery with satellite navigation systems .
therefore , understanding and becoming accustomed to the navstar gps , and the development tide of coordinate warfare which it brings , and strengthening the facilities modernization and thinking in this regard has general command significance .

zhu rongji said : the holding of the national basic education work conference shows that the party central leadership and the state council attach great importance to basic education .
in more than 50 years since the founding of new china and especially since the beginning of reform and opening - up , basic education in our country has made tremendous progress . the objective of popularizing nine - year compulsory education and eliminating illiteracy has been basically achieved .
however , the general level of basic education is still not high enough ; development is uneven and many problems still exist .
without strengthening basic education , it is impossible to realize the great regeneration of the chinese nation , and impossible to build our country into a powerful modern country .
basic education must be taken as a key point in the development of education as a whole , and should be put in a more important strategic position .
zhu rongji pointed out : an important aspect of enhancing basic education is the improvement of the education management system , the guarantee of the input of funds , and especially the guarantee of the input to compulsory education .
the biggest problem in the current basic education system is the lack of guarantee for a stable source of funds for compulsory education . this also led to the problems of irregular charges and levies , which cause too heavy burdens to peasants .
so it is necessary to further improve the management system for rural compulsory education .
he pointed out : conducting basic education , especially compulsory education , should mainly be the government 's responsibility .
the government should guarantee the input to compulsory education , and should not impose the burden of raising money for this purpose on common people .
a local government must try by all possible means to guarantee the funds for basic education , even if this means that fewer construction projects are to be launched and the standard of the government office building to be built should be lowered .
zhu rongji stressed : to guarantee funds for basic education , especially compulsory education in rural areas , it is necessary to immediately adopt the following " guarantee , control , and supervision " measures .
the issuance of salaries to secondary and primary school teachers is the responsibility of local governments at all levels .
the so - called " control " refers to the resolute action in stopping the irregular fees and dues charged in some areas and by some schools , controlling the fee standards for schools , and really and effectively lessen the burdens imposed on pupils ' parents , especially those in rural areas .
the so - called " supervision " refers to the enhancement of supervision and inspection over the issuance of salaries to teachers and the fees and dues charged for education .
timely action should be taken to seriously investigate and handle the cases of violating the regulations , such as not guaranteeing the issuance of salaries to teachers or using such funds for other purposes , irregularly charging fees , and using school funds for other purposes .
in short , in any circumstances and in any areas , the input of funds to rural compulsory education must be guaranteed .
if enterprises , institutions , social organizations , and individual citizens make donations to basic education , they should all enjoy the state 's relevant preferential treatments . the amount of donations should be fully deducted from their taxable incomes .
the state and local authorities should give commendations to institutions and individuals making outstanding contributions to basic education .
the party 's education policy must be implemented comprehensively . quality education must be advanced in a down - to - earth manner .
it is particularly necessary to enhance moral education , and conduct patriotic , collectivist , and socialist education for secondary and elementary school students , conduct education in the fine tradition of the chinese nation , revolutionary tradition , and national defense , and enhance ideological and moral education .
it is necessary to make efforts to improve the forms and methods of moral education in accordance with the new situation , thus enhancing the pertinence and effectiveness of such education .
zhu rongji stressed : party committees and governments at all levels must effectively strengthen leadership over basic education and the whole educational work .
he said : at the national educational work conference in 1985 , comrade deng xiaopign said : " if an area or a department only attends to the economy and pays no attention to education , then the focus of work there has not been properly shifted or has not been completely shifted .
a leader who neglects education is not a mature leader , because he or she is short of foresight , and cannot lead modernization work .
leaders at all levels must properly manage the educational work as effectively and seriously as managing the economic work . "
it is hoped that leading comrades at all levels will seriously understand this important idea of comrade xiaoping 's and always bear it in mind and personally attend to education and really do a good job in promoting education .
in particular , leading cadres at the provincial and ministerial level should take the lead , show foresight , more keenly care about basic education and the growth of the younger generation , and create good conditions for the development of basic education .
so all departments and all organizations should care and support the work of basic education , and make joint efforts to raise the reform and development of basic education in our country to a new level .

this is the same as saying that the " taiwan security enhancement act " is not necessary and is not supported by the bush administration .
