a national conference on elementary education , convened by the state council , concluded the day before yesterday .
this was an important conference held on educational work after entering the new century .
elementary education is a project for laying a foundation for implementing the strategy of making the country strong through science and technology .
paying close attention to elementary education and accelerating the reform and development of elementary education are not only a task of top priority in educational work but also an urgent and arduous task in advancing our country 's modernization drive .
a country can introduce capital and technology from abroad , but it cannot import qualities for its citizens .
as a large developing , populous country , china can turn its heavy burden in population into tremendous human resources only by push elementary education forward .
therefore , we must vigorously strengthen our work in elementary education and strive to improve the quality of our country 's workers as a whole in order to provide reserve qualified personnel and intellectual support for reform , opening up , and the modernization drive .
in the 10 th five - year plan period , we should continue to consolidate and advance nine - year compulsory education , to make it universal , and to eliminate illiteracy among the young and middle - aged people , which we should continue to carry out as the " most important tasks . "
governments at various levels should effectively assume their responsibility for the development of compulsory education .
according to relevant laws and regulations , they should establish or improve an educational management system characterized by the leadership of the state council , governments assuming responsibility , management exercised from level to level , and counties being the mainstay .
the central authorities will continue to increase their support for compulsory education in poverty - stricken areas ; at the same time , governments at various levels should make concerted efforts to further increase their investments in compulsory education in rural areas .
counties should be responsible for the management of teachers and their salaries and really ensure that teachers ' salaries are issued on time and in full .
efforts should be made to strengthen the management of educational appropriations and to implement the auditing and inspection systems strictly .
at the same time , we should continue to do a good job in reconstructing ramshackle buildings in primary and middle schools , adjust their layouts , and keep improving the efficiency of the utilization of educational resources .
conducting quality - oriented education in an all - round way is a basic task to be carried out in the reform and development of elementary education .
we should change the concept of education , foster a new concept of educating people as the basic task , and quickly establish a system of courses for elementary education meeting the requirements of quality - oriented education .
we should improve the teachers and education system , implement a teachers ' qualifications system in an all - round way , and train a large number of outstanding teachers to play a key , exemplary role .
party and government leading cadres should often go to schools to make studies and investigations , to guide the work there , and to promptly help schools resolve difficulties and problems in educational work .
various circles in society should show concern for and support elementary education . school , family , and social education should be linked closely with one another in order to create a favorable environment for the reform and development of elementary education .
ideological and political education is our military 's fine tradition and also an important guarantee for successfully carrying out construction and reform of all areas in the military .
the military , as a whole , has now made prominent achievements in the practice of enhancing and improving ideological and political education , but the exploration has not ended .
the ongoing education activities of studying and practicing the important " three represents " principle and maintaining the advanced character of communists constitute a major part of the military 's ideological and political construction .
it is generally felt : that while prospects are bright because of the substantial progress achieved , there remain tough challenges and a long way to go and that it is necessary to continue efforts in the following several areas .
they have spent a lot of money on waging an ideological war , using such modern media as radio , newspapers , and the internet to sell western bourgeois values to us .
they have regarded the military as a key target of their corrupting and infiltration efforts , advocating the ideas of " making the military non - partisan and non - political in nature " and " nationalizing the military , " in an attempt to free our military from the party 's leadership .
in carrying out education on the party ' absolute leadership over the military , it is necessary to carry out continual enhancement in view of new situations and requirements .
it is necessary to attach importance to ceremony education and to use short and solemn ceremonies to embody loyalty to , and belief in , the party , so that officers and soldiers , first of all communists , can purify their souls and reach a higher realm in a sacred and pure atmosphere .
fully utilize stimulating mechanisms , in an effort to mobilize enthusiasm of officers and soldiers for studying basic marxist theory .
use such methods to stimulate " internal demand , " so as to change " being asked to carry out study " into " asking to carry out study , " thereby effectively improving the quality of study .
first , pluralism in values has led to complex and acute contradictions and struggles in the ideological and cultural realms .
soldiers recruited in recent years have included graduates of technical colleges and schools as well as business owners and migrant workers , with some having criminal records .
some are from well - off families , even wealthy families , while others have furloughed - worker parents and other unemployed family members and are thus worried about their families ' livelihood .
the pluralism in recruits ' value orientations and motives for joining the military has entailed higher requirements on education 's targetedness .
third , the colorful social environment for the barracks has markedly increased the difficulty and intensity of education .
in areas around barracks in urban areas , there are a lot of dance halls , hair - washing shops , foot - washing shops , saunas , and other expensive consumption establishments , with all - night " night life " and strong seductive effects on officers and soldiers .
all kinds of people visit such establishments where there are also dirty things . once an officer or solider gets involved , he will be prone to be polluted .
diversity in the context of social development is an irresistible historical tide .
however , some comrades do not have sufficient understanding of positive elements , while overly emphasize negative elements , thereby becoming fearful of difficulties and pessimistic , failing to keep up with the tide , and lagging behind society in education .
third , the notion of being special .
our military is the people 's military under the party 's absolute leadership and an armed group for executing revolutionary political tasks .
requirements on personnel of the military are very different from those on ordinary people . what is permitted in society may not be permitted in the military ; what is considered reasonable may not be considered reasonable in the military .
therefore , in carrying out ideological and political education , the military should focus on characteristics and special features , in the process of developing or discarding ideas or ethical standards existing in society in a pluralistic context .
in carrying out ideological and political education in the military , it is necessary to implement the strategic policy for the new period and to closely center on the requirements of military struggle , working to provide sustained , adequate spiritual motive force for " being able to win . "
third , it is necessary to make education closer to the requirements of actual combat .
current education has played an important role in maintaining the security and stability of the armed forces , and it is proper to further study and explore war - time ideological and political education on this basis .
contemporary warfare is characterized by suddenness , and operational opportunities exist only fleetingly .
basically , such education still consists of a blackboard , a few pieces of chalk , and a mouth , with me talking and you listening .
the education is characterized by a small volume of information , a narrow field of vision , meager contents , dullness , and hollowness ; as a result it is not interesting to people at all .
second , because of the open and widespread characters of information resources in the information age , educators and the educated can equally use various information resources . often , what educators know is also basically known to the educated .
many grassroots political cadres find it hard to collect more new information and thus do not provide the educated with enough new information when teaching the educated , resulting in officers and soldiers losing their interest and enthusiasm and in reducing the effects of education .
to improve the quality and result of education , it is necessary to adjust the line of thought on work , to improve education means , to renovate education methods , and to fully exploit the effects of information resources and information means .
first , renovate the conception of education and fully utilize society 's education resources .
i support the " greater education " concept .
some comrades understand political education very narrowly , considering only classroom teaching to be education ; in the face of diverse and complex social phenomena , they prefer to carry out education on a closed - door basis .
such education is pale and fragile , and will not be able to stand disruptive effects and tests .
second , ensure high speed and efficiency , and continually enhance the vigor of education .
no documents should be distributed to issue education instructions which can be issued through news papers , television , and networks .
third , reform education means and work hard to advance the transformation of the education model .
it is necessary to be good at using computers and networks for storing , processing , transmitting , and exchanging information .
it is necessary to establish information centers as soon as possible and to achieve the new education model based on the use of multi - media education as the main form as well as characteristics of joint ownership of information , resource sharing , joint research on difficult topics , and joint personnel development .
in addition , it is necessary to pay attention to comprehensively improving the quality of educators , making educators capable of skillfully grasping and using various advanced education means and information resources as soon as possible through enhancing training and having personnel make study tours outside the military .
on the morning of june 12 , us president bush flew to the spanish capital of madrid , to begin the first european trip of his presidency .
during his six - day itinerary , bush will visit belgium , sweden , poland and slovenia .
he will meet with nato leaders at that organization 's headquarters in brussels , attend an eu - us summit in gothenburg , sweden , and finally meet with russian president putin in the slovenian capital of ljubljana .
bush will discuss a series of topics with european union leaders , including his new missile defense plan , environmental protection , trade , and european defense matters .
he will be selling his missile defense plan ; explaining the us stand on the kyoto protocol and softening the us - european trade dispute ; seeking a means to persuade russian president putin to support amendments to the 1972 " anti - ballistic missile treaty " signed between the us and the soviet union .
but as the media also say , " this trip will be fraught with thorns and challenges " .
on june 10 , more than 700 demonstrators assembled outside the white house bearing placards reading " stop the new arms race " and shouting slogans . they were demonstrating against the bush missile defense plan .
on the evening of june 12 , the people of madrid took to the streets in an even larger parade of demonstration .
after bush brought out his missile defense plan on may 1 , a special " lobbying team " was dispatched to europe . however , the results were less than stellar .
some analysts say that bush is adopting a " listen intently to the opposing position " but " refuse to budge " strategy .
some us officials have indicated that if allies show any sign of loosening up on this question , the us will plow forward with propaganda .
in terms of the " kyoto protocol " problem , bush is also prepared to use the same methods .
ten world - famous personalities have urged bush in an open letter to change the united states ' position on reduction of greenhouse gas emissions .
there have long been trade disputes between the us and europe , particularly in terms of the united states forbidding european beef imports . europe has also controlled the importation of genetically - altered us beef .
it is generally believed that bush 's european trip will accomplish little in terms of solving these problems .
on june 7 , bush ordered an anti - dumping investigation on all imported steel products , which hints of a further worsening of trade relations between the us and european union nations .
since bush took office , he has consistently taken a hard line toward russia , expelling 50 russian diplomats .
as a result , bush 's intention to implement his missile defense plan , has met with strong russian opposition .
right now , although bush has made appropriate adjustments to his russia policy , or even tried to use preferential treatment to persuade the russians to agree to an amendment or scrapping of the " anti ballistic missile treaty " , to date russia has not made any clear response .
on 26 april 1996 , heads of state of china , russia , kazakhstan , kyrgyzstan , and tajikistan held their first summit in shanghai and signed the " agreement of enhancing trust in the military sphere in border areas , " thus giving birth to the mechanism of five - state meeting with security as the principal axis .
five years later , great changes have taken place in the mechanism of the " shanghai five " cooperation , and the contents of cooperation have extended from security to other spheres .
eurasia is the center of the international political arena . china and russia are the two biggest states in eurasia as well as permanent members of the security council of the united nations .
due to the boundary , territorial , religious , and ethnic contradictions , this area has become a hot ( or latent hot ) spot in the world .
the talks stagnated along with the worsening of the china - soviet relations .
that round of talks resulted in the signing of the " agreement of enhancing trust in the military sphere in border areas , " which led to the holding of the first " shanghai five " summit .
zhao huasheng , head of the russia office under the shanghai international issues research institute , said in an interview that during the process of continuous development , the " shanghai five " have sought a new order in resolving disputes between different countries , settling international conflicts , and readjusting the relations between different countries .
in addition , the " shanghai - five " meetings have shifted from being participated by two sides to being participated by five sides , and the contents of talks have increased continuously .
the people have noticed that in the five already - held " shanghai five " summits , the contents of talks have been increasingly rich , developing from the two agreements at the beginning to the three statements of heads of state .
in addition , the " shanghai five 's " proposal for revitalizing the " silk road " really has a great attraction .
this year , not only a summit will be held , but a meeting of prime ministers will be held as well . this shows the " shanghai five " cooperation has entered into an even more substantial stage .

the two - day " shanghai five " summit will be held in shanghai today .
this important event , which is held in the beginning of the new century , represents an epochal landmark in the process of " shanghai cooperation . " the summit will have important and far - reaching impacts on the region and the world .
as a new type of model for regional cooperation , the " shanghai five " mechanism is featured by this fact : it is not an alliance , it is not confrontational , and it is not targeted at any third countries .
the fact serves to show that the " shanghai five " mechanism is highly transparent .
as far as the region is concerned , it serves to alleviate hidden dangers in hot spots of the region by making concerted efforts to crack down on transnational evil elements .
as far as the world is concerned , the " shanghai five , " which includes two permanent members of the security council of the united nations , will effectively promote the development of multi - polarization of the world and play an important role in establishing new international political and economic order .
with the increasing impacts of the " shanghai five " mechanism , the number of its members will gradually increase .
some countries have expressed in different ways their affirmative attitude toward the mechanism and even their wishes to join it .
the " shanghai five " covers an expanse of region , which has an area of nearly 30 million square kilometers , or 60 percent of the area of the european and asian continents . the region has more than 1.5 billion of population , accounting for a quarter of the total population of the world .
while talking about this summit , russian president putin said that the mechanism has laid a foundation of all - directional cooperation , which demonstrates fine prospects for future development .
kazakhstan president nazarbayev said : this summit will show that the " shanghai five " mechanism will enter a brand - new development stage and demonstrate its strong vitality and great prospects of its development .
in its history , the cpc formed three important fine styles of work - - integrating theory with practice , forging close links with the masses , and practicing criticism and self - criticism .
this is a striking mark that distinguishes the cpc from all other political parties .
in the new century , whether or not the cpc can continue to preserve and carry forward these fine styles of work will have a direct bearing on its survival or extinction and on the future and destiny of the country .
a matter concerning the future and destiny of the party and country forging close links with the masses means doing everything in the interests of the masses , relying on them to undertake everything , always maintaining close ties with them , and never cutting ourselves off from them at any time .
this is because the masses are always the vast majority in any society at any time .
except for a very few kinds of work , such as scientific research and literary and artistic creation that can be done through individual effort , all other undertakings which need the participation of the masses must rely on them .
this is why mao zedong ( mao tse - tung ) and other party leaders have always stressed that we must forge close links with the masses no matter what work we do .
in april 1929 , mao zedong pointed out in a speech : every member of the communist party should establish the concept of trying to win over the masses ; like monks chanting " amida buddha , " he should keep talking about " trying to win over the masses . "
whether we can uphold the fine work style of forging close links with the masses has a direct bearing on the future and destiny of the party and the country .
a case in point is the rise and fall of the cpc , the chinese kuomintang , and many political parties in foreign countries .
resolutely check three unhealthy trends the fine work style of forging close links with the masses as an outstanding characteristic of the cpc is seriously damaged in the new historic period ; many party members , especially party cadres , have almost completely forgotten this fine work style or even cast it aside .
he said : the crucial aspects of bureaucratism are cutting oneself off from the masses and acting as a bureaucrat and overlord .
bureaucratism is a longstanding problem in the party and government organs .
the third unhealthy trend is corruption .
the cpc originally had an outstanding , clean , honest , and upright style of work .
it was precisely because of this that yanan became a sacred place in the hearts of the people across the country and that the communist party became the hope of the people throughout the country .
after the start of reform and opening up , especially since the establishment of a market economy , corrupt phenomena have spread ever more rapidly . this has caused strong discontent among large numbers of cadres and the masses and posed the most serious threat to the position of the cpc as the ruling party and to social stability .
more seriously , crimes committed by individuals have developed to crimes perpetrated by gangs and trades ; moreover , there are various kinds of covert corruption , such as corruption in leasing , the underground economy , the loss of tax revenue , public investment , and public spending as pointed out by some experts .
in the yanan period , mao zedong raised the question of getting out of the historical circle , holding that by giving scope to democracy , we could get out of the historical circle of " vigorous rise " and " sudden fall . "
the practice of more than 50 years shows , however , that we have not yet got out of this historical circle .
five main causes for the serious rampancy of unhealthy trends first , the concept of serving the people wholeheartedly is lacking .
what they think all day long is their own interests ; in dealing perfunctorily with higher levels and the masses , they play tricks , thus bringing formalism into being .
bureaucratism originated to a considerable extent from the " official departmental selfishness " of the feudal society in our country , and it is essentially aimed at protecting the " officials ' interests . "
one important cause for the rapid spread of corruption is people 's inflated greed and psychological imbalance .
second , it is caused by the highly centralized and unified leadership , cadre , and management systems .
the highly centralized political system is also one of the political causes for the increasing seriousness of corruption .
third , the supervisory mechanism is not sound .
now many cadres engage in formalism and bureaucratism and even become corrupt . one important cause for this is lack of supervision ; the higher position a cadre is in , the less supervision over him or her .
innumerable facts at all times and in all countries have fully proved that unlimited authority is bound to lead to corruption and to formalism and bureaucratism as well .
the masses also believe that only those soft are punished and that no measures appear to be taken to solve problems once and for all .
we have reformed government institutions several times , but there are still overstaffing and redundant administrative orders ; affairs can be handled by one department , but several departments are set up to deal with them ; work can be done by one person , but a number of persons are hired to do it .
this cannot but cause shifting responsibility to others and arguing back and forth over trifles ; in the end , there are bureaucratic manifestations in which no one takes care of work , and handling a small matter is even more difficult than climbing up to the sky .
to continue to preserve and carry forward the party 's fine work style of forging close links with the masses in the new century , it is necessary to guide us with the spirit of the " three represents " and to take practical and effective measures to resolutely check the above - mentioned three unhealthy trends .
first , we should adopt practical measures and methods to step up education in party spirit and the party 's style of work .
second , leading cadres at various levels , especially principal leading cadres , should set examples by their own deeds .
now many party members , especially cadres , are fond of engaging in formalism , bureaucratism , or even corruption ; this is because they see those above them doing the same thing or even going farther than themselves in this regard ; so they just follow suit and then go farther and farther .
if leading cadres , especially senior cadres , at various levels can set examples by their own deeds , formalistic and bureaucratic manifestations and corruption will not continue to spread .
third , a practical and effective supervisory mechanism should be set up as soon as possible . 1 .
when the supervisory mechanism is sound , there will be much fewer formalistic and bureaucratic manifestations and corrupt phenomena .
fourth , it is necessary to deal severely with formalistic and bureaucratic manifestation and especially with corrupt phenomena ; whoever is involved must be thoroughly investigated and punished with due severity .
in the early days after the founding of the prc , the party was very resolute in cracking down on those guilty of corruption and accepting bribes .
if such cases are dealt more severely with and handled according to the same standards , many people will not leave things to chance and disregard the law and discipline any more ; then they will certainly become vigilant and restrain themselves to some extent .
fifth , it is necessary to accelerate the reform of the highly centralized and unified political and economic systems , especially the personnel system relating to cadres .
efforts should be made to further reform the highly centralized and unified political and economic systems .
matters which party committees and governments at various levels should not and cannot handle or cannot handle efficiently should be resolutely assigned to other organs for handling ; problems that can be solved through market forces should be handled this way ; all functions of services that can be socialized and monetized should be socialized and monetized .
if such systems can be implemented , those indulged in practicing formalism and bureaucratism , especially those corrupt elements , will not be promoted .
sixth , it is necessary to strengthen the management of large numbers of party members , especially cadres at various levels .
this fully shows that the cpc has vitality and is capable .
we are convinced that with implementation of the concept of " three represents , " the above - mentioned problems will be solved step by step , and the party 's style of work will be gradually improved .
the meeting will be one that carries forward the past and opens up the future .
since the " shanghai five " mechanism came into being five years ago , in its vitality - filled development process , cooperation between the five nations has continued to develop in depth and in breadth , and the mechanism has been unavoidably developing from a kind of meeting mechanism into a regional multilateral cooperation organization .
this four - point proposal not only is in line with the interests of the five nations , but also goes with the current historical tide of world peace and development .
the " shanghai five " mechanism is open and its members will gradually increase . in addition to uzbekistan 's accession this year , pakistan , mongolia , and other countries also have shown great interest in joining the mechanism .
noteworthy is that the space for bilateral and multilateral economic and trade cooperation within the mechanism is very large and the potential is enormous .
we wish the summit meeting a complete success !

in 2000 , the central authorities issued to the lower level the " opinions on conducting study and educational activities on the important thinking of the ' three represents ' in the rural areas , " and decided to deeply conduct these types of activities in rural areas throughout china .

profound changes took place in the international situation in the just - ended 1990 s and the 20 th century .
facing the profound lessons gained from more than 40 years of cold war , and reviewing the vicissitudes of history in the past century in which war turmoil occurred frequently , peoples of all countries earnestly hope that mankind can step into a new century of peace and development .
the development of the " shanghai five " has been regarded as an important diplomatic practice in international relations of our times , which initiated a new type of security concept featuring mutual trust , disarmament , and cooperation security .
economic globalization and world multi - polarization are speeding up , and science and technology are developing with each passing day .
the gaps of development and economic situation between the north and the south hemispheres are further widening , which bring about a series of deep - rooted contradictions for world peace and development .
no matter what circumstances may occur , the " shanghai cooperation organization " will always abide by the above - mentioned principles and purposes and hold high the banner of peace and cooperation .
successfully developing and building the organization is our common responsibility as well as our major task .
i would like to put forward some opinions as follows for your reference . 1 .
strengthening the pioneering consciousness .
only by this way can the " shanghai cooperation organization " have powerful vitality and a bright future . 2 .
maintaining the regional security is the focus of our cooperation .
the signing of the " shanghai pact on cracking down on terrorism , separatism , and extremism " has laid a solid legal foundation for us to strengthen the cooperation in this aspect .
trade and economic cooperation is another focus of the collaboration between the member states .
the reason that the six member states have always thought it necessary to build such a cooperation organization is that we share the same interests and goals .
being solid , solid , and solid will be the essential strength for the " shanghai cooperation organization " to overcome all kinds of difficulties and obstacles and to always keep its coherence in the future . 4 .
implementing the open principle .
my fellow colleagues , according to the agreement we reached yesterday , i happily declare : the second summit of member states of the " shanghai cooperation organization " will be held in st. petersburg , russia , next summer .
looking back on the past , and looking to the future , we are full of confidence in the bright future of the " shanghai cooperation organization . "
it first proceeded from [ a discussion of ] borders and then expanded to the whole security realm .
after the cold world , along with the quickening of globalization , the dependency and permeability of the interests of all countries have accelerated and the regional cooperation mechanisms have also constantly increased .
at present , the " shanghai five " includes the two major countries of china and russia . the sustained and stable development of china 's economy is inseparable from the stable peripheral environments .
while resolving the discrepancy and disparity between rich and poor among regions inside china , the great western development that was put forth lately can also provide opportunities for other member states .
she also hankers for promoting its economic takeoff through regional cooperation to relive her dream of being a major country .
as far as the several central asian countries are concerned , after the cold war they were once called the " vacuum zone . "
their unitary economic structures caused by their background of [ having been part of the ] former soviet union have resulted in outstanding contradictions in changing economic types and very weak economic strength .
these countries urgently wish to eliminate the above - mentioned unstable factors through conducting cooperation , so as to get their economy into the fast lane of smooth development .
elevating the " shanghai five " from a forum to a cooperation organization is a process of natural development just like when waters comes , a canal is formed .
as far as the deepening of its mechanism is concerned , the first issue is how should the " shanghai five " position itself ? at this conference , the " shanghai five " has already been upgraded to the " shanghai cooperation organization . "
in fact , if the cooperation content is not deepened , this mechanism cannot be consolidated , either .
the cooperation of the " shanghai five " covers two major realms : security and economy .

therefore , it has caused special concerns in the world but some concerns are good and some are out of prudence .
therefore , we can see that the " shanghai five " has both very big development prospects in the future and the aspect of being very fragile .
we should be very prudent about it .
a series of incidents that have occurred in central asian countries in recent years have indicated that this region is being dragged into the tracks of religious extremism and international terrorism .
the analysis of the situation in this region has demonstrated that the birth of extremism and terrorism is due to internal and external factors .
regrettably , these two kinds of factors are all of a protracted and chronic nature .
at present , all the countries in this region have been adopting measures to control extremism and terrorism .

under these kind of circumstances , an urgent task is to form a security organization in this region .
i believe that the realistic foundation for forming a security organization in this region is a collective security treaty and the mechanism of the " shanghai five . "
a collective security treaty is the first level of a central asian security framework and the " shanghai five " which has included more countries is the second level of this central asian security framework .
therefore , i believe that it is now time to adopt measures to increase its official standing , expand its functions , enrich its contents , and make it become an organization of the central asian security system .

china 's membership in the world trade organization (wto) will play as stimulatory a role in the country 's economic development as the reform and open policy did more than 20 years ago .
in fact , china 's accession to wto will prompt a new quantum leap in the chinese economy against the backdrop an accelerating trend toward economic globalization .
judging from economic development in the past 20 years and more , foreign trade actually outperformed the domestic economy by 5.7 percentage points , expanding 15.3 percent each year .
these numbers are considered stunning in the academic community , not explainable by any theory .
we can thus see the magnitude of the stimulatory effect of foreign trade on the economy .
all of that will be a boost to the development of the chinese economy . in line with this development trend , as economic globalization intensifies , the significance of china 's accession to wto will be enormous . this is the second major strategic adjustment that has been in the making for a dozen years .
the reason is that any drastic social change implies a redistribution of interests . academics are concerned that accession to wto will deal a severe blow to china 's agriculture and reduce large numbers of chinese peasants to bankruptcy .
the business community is concerned that the development of domestic industries will be hampered and even grinds to a halt .
even some officials in the ministry of agriculture hold a pessimistic attitude toward china 's admission to wto .
in the short haul , it is no cause for concern either .
china has the kind of market that every country covets and is immensely appealing to foreign companies eager to expand their market in a hurry .
in the medium term , if the chinese economy has not developed to the extent that it should when the protection period ends , then china 's membership in wto will be more a challenge than an opportunity .
hardest hit will be agriculture , the manufacturing industry , and the service sector .
agriculture : adjusting the agricultural structure people are most concerned about agriculture .
thus , china 's accession to the wto is far from being as disastrous for agriculture and the peasants as we imagined .
in other words , china 's labor - intensive agricultural products do have an edge on the world market , a point validated by the recent trade wars between china and south korea over garlic and between china and japan over green onion .
as trade barriers come down after china joins the wto , this kind of labor - intensive exports will increase .
china can still impose a tariff ranging from 60 to 80 percent on that part of grain imports and exports outside the quota system , thus cushioning chinese cereals from the impact of foreign cereals .
this explains why the size of the quota is such a critical issue .
nevertheless , if we simply chalk it up to luck and leave it at that , ultimately we will suffer . we must adjust the mix of agricultural products ; make improvements on all fronts , including production , sales , and research ; take the road of industrialization ; and work hard to increase exports .
still careful research is needed to solve the problems . industrial products fall into one of two categories : labor - intensive and capital - intensive .
examples of the former include textile products while examples of the latter are electrical machinery , informational products , and automobiles .
turning to capital - intensive products like automobiles , computer chips , and computers , although we do not enjoy an advantage in those industries , the possibility that our industries will be wiped out is also quite remote .
take the automobile industry , for instance . from the consumer 's angle , or in the interests of china as a whole , china 's membership is wto is absolutely necessary .
in return for market , the domestic industry has obtained foreign funds , technology , and managerial know - how .
if that happens , it should help improve the overall quality of the chinese economy .
be that as it may , china 's banking industry should improve the quality of its services as soon as possible and lower their share of bad debts so that they can hold their own after china joins wto .
( writer is professor and director of the chinese economic research center at beijing university . article put together by reporter wang dejun . )

the " shanghai five " summit meeting was held at its birthplace - - shanghai on 14 - 15 june .
the current summit meeting is of great significance in uplifting the " shanghai five " to a new stage .
the people of the world cast their eyes on the summit meeting , on china , and on shanghai .
from the day the " shanghai five " - - a new - type international mechanism - - was established , it has manifested its vitality and gained a high reputation in europe and asia .
through five years of development , the mechanism has increasingly become a regional organization , which has rich contents and is becoming more and more influential in the international community .
as one side of the " two sides of shanghai five " in its early stage , china has played a unique role in developing the mechanism .
the good - neighborly and friendly peaceful diplomatic strategy wins the support of neighboring countries the " shanghai five " mechanism , which originated from solving the border issue , with maintenance of common security as the spindle , was later injected with new connotations in such fields as political and economic cooperation .
in the 1960 - 70 s , china and the soviet union massed troops along their borders , thus engaging in military confrontation .
in the 1980 s , the relations between china and the soviet union became relaxed , and the two countries began negotiating on maintaining tranquility and reducing military forces in the border areas .
the heads of state of china , russia , kazakhstan , kyrgyzstan , and tajikistan met in shanghai on 26 april 1996 and signed the " agreement on confidence - building in the military sphere in the border areas . ' "
the heads of state of the five nations met in moscow in april 1997 and held consultations on further reducing military forces in the border areas , signed the " agreement on mutual reduction of military forces in the border areas , " and made innovative advancers in the traditional border issue .
the heads of state of china and russia met the same year and announced all problems concerning the delimitation of the eastern section of the 4,200 - kilometer - long borderline between china and russia had been resolved .
pursuing a good - neighborly and friendly peaceful diplomatic strategy is the foundation for guaranteeing national security .
china borders on 15 countries and is just next to russia in the world in terms of the complexity of border issues .
the 7,000 - km - long borderline between north and west china and the four countries was once in a tense situation for a long time . building mutual trust in the border sphere in this regard undoubtedly has immediate significance and political influence .
the peaceful settlement of the border issue between china and the four countries not only provides a model and reference for other countries to solve the border issue but also has laid a political foundation for promoting the further development of the " shanghai five " mechanism .
to build the " shanghai five " mechanism into a formal regional organization on the basis of the previous successful cooperation , with an aim to promote cooperation among various countries in the region in the political , economic , security , cultural , and other fields has been put on the agenda as a topic for discussion .
the naming of the " shanghai five " after shanghai itself entrusts credit and a lofty mission to the chinese people .
at the same time , it also serves as a successful example of china 's independent and peaceful diplomatic policy .
china opposes the old international economic order and the economic aggression against small nations by big powers by making use of their economic and technological strong points , and advocates the establishment of a new fair and rational order .
the five nations , which are located in the same geo - economic region , are highly interdependent and highly complementary economically and strive for common development with each promoting the other . this serves as a sound material foundation for the healthy development of the " shanghai five . "
the 1999 meeting of heads of state of the five nations further proposed deepening economic cooperation within the five - nation framework .
according to statistics , in 1992 china 's total trade volume with central asian countries was just $ 465 million and in 1999 it increased to $ 1.33 billion . last year china 's trade volume with russia totaled $ 8.03 billion or an increase of 36.6 percent from the 1999 figure .
on the sound basis of political mutual trust , china attaches importance to developing economic cooperation with neighboring countries and has actively uplifted economic cooperation to a higher level .
the unique and important role that china has played in the " shanghai five " mechanism over the past five years has promoted the healthy development of the mechanism .
the party 's 15 th national congress and the fourth plenum of the 15 th cpc central committee both pointed out that under the conditions of the socialist market economy , the dominating role of state - owned economy in the national economy as a whole will mainly find expression in its dominating power .
state - owned economy further enhances dominating power through the adoption of the joint - stock system through listing state - owned enterprises on the stock market , the mainstay role of public ownership was enhanced .
in particular , such large - scale state - owned enterprises as china petroleum , china communications , and china petrochemical succeeded in raising large amounts of funds through the adoption of the joint - stock system and going public on both domestic and overseas stock markets .
according to statistics by a relevant department , between 1997 and 1999 , the total assets of enterprises controlled by state - owned capital accounted for 23.1 percent , 27.8 percent , and 28.9 percent of the total assets held by enterprises solely owned by the state in the whole country .
in the industries related to national security , such as the mints and the major defense and military industries , enterprises solely owned by the state still hold the control .
in the natural monopoly industries , such as postal and telecommunications industry , communications , electric power , railway , civil aviation , at present , the state - owned economy still holds a dominating position .
adjusted layout of the state - owned economy is favorable to the gradual enhancement and optimization of its quality the active advancement of the strategic reorganization of the state - owned enterprises optimized the organizational structure of the enterprises .
in 1999 , china petroleum and eight other large enterprises ranked among the world 's 500 top enterprises .
on the other hand , small and medium - sized state - owned enterprises were enlivened and decontrolled by means of reorganization , combination , merger , leasing , contracted operation , joint - stock system , and sales .
among the 6,599 large and medium - sized state - owned enterprises incurred losses in late 1997 , 1,415 had gone bankrupt and had been closed down by the end of 2000 . such enterprises accounted for 29.49 percent of the enterprises freed from difficulties .
the intensity of technological transformation was increased , and this enhanced the enterprises ' technological innovation capability .
after the completion of these projects , the technological and equipment level of the key industries and the key enterprises and their competition power will all be markedly raised .
the pace of establishing the modern enterprise system was quickened , and this increased the vigor and dynamism of state - owned enterprises .

shanghai , 15 jun ( xinhua ) - - defense ministers of the six member nations of the " shanghai cooperation organization " met and signed a joint communique in shanghai on 14 june .
the communique expounds the unanimous stance of the six nations on strengthening military cooperation and ensuring substantial coordination of their armed forces in cracking down on terrorism , extremism , and separatism and opposing the plan of a few countries to deploy the theater missile defense system in the asia - pacific region .
terrorism , separatism , extremism , and certain other external factors have posed a serious threat to the tranquillity and stability of the central asian region .
the ministers suggest a study into joint exercises for this purpose and a new form of dialogue on the issue of assuring security be carried out .
the ministers are opposed to the plan of a few countries to deploy the theater missile defense system in the asian - pacific region .
the ministers once again voiced their support of the proposal by central asian countries to declare the region a nuclear - free zone .

moreover , some senior us officials , including bush himself , continuously spread the threat theory and attacked the domestic and foreign policies of the dprk .
since taking office , bush has comprehensively followed a tough conservative policy on relations with china , russia , and other countries and on a series of major international issues .
affecting north - south korean relations the tough dprk policy pursued by george w. bush has not only landed us - dprk relations in an impasse but also resulted in the stagnation of north - south korean relations , which rapidly became reconciled after last june .
the pace of north - south korean exchanges has slowed down , and it has become even more difficult to fix the date of kim chong - il visit to the rok this year .
during his visit to the united states in early march this year , kim tae - chung asked bush to support the rok in implementing a unshine policy toward the dprk , and he called on the united states to resume dialogues with the dprk .
however , the united states gave him a cold response . it even criticized rok policies , such as its aid to the dprk .
affected by the strained us - dprk relations , relations between japan and the dprk have similarly made no progress at all .
since the beginning of this year , six eu countries have established diplomatic relations with the dprk ( a total of 13 eu countries have so far established diplomatic relations with the dprk ) .
this has undoubtedly served as a stimulant for the bush administration .
the new us government has begun to realize that by suspending official dialogues with the dprk it has actually weakened its influence over the korean issue , thus damaging us interests in the region .
no change in major direction after comprehensively examining and reviewing the us policy toward the dprk and repeatedly running up against a stone wall on the dprk issue in the past four months , president bush eventually announced on the sixth of this month the resumption of diplomatic contact with the dprk .
the us side shows more concern for issues in the security field , such as the dprk missile and nuclear development program , while the dprk is concerned about how to realize early normalization of diplomatic relations with the united states .
however , the resumption of the dialogues and the easing and development of relations between the two countries are in the us security interests in northeast asia and the asia - pacific region .

beijing , 15 jun ( wen wei po ) - - in anticipation of a possible deceleration of china 's economy due to the global economic slowdown , some people suggest devaluation of renminbi as a stimulus for china 's export trade .
in response to this , lou jiwei , chinese vice minister of finance , recently noted that an adjustment of the foreign exchange rate is of little avail for the time being . this remark is a hint that china is unlikely to devalue renminbi in the near future .
in face of the current economic recession in the united states and continuous devaluation of the japanese yen , " how long renminbi will be able to withstand the pressure for devaluation " once again turns out to be a focus of attention within the international economic circles .
in order to maintain economic growth , therefore , there exists the possibility of devaluing renminbi .
lou jiwei did not think the global economic slowdown would have any substantial impact on china . china 's economic growth may be lowered by 1 or 2 percentage points at most , he said .
the reason is that in china , the current growth in demand is primarily due to domestic factors .
strong domestic demand is reflected in consumer demand , which has remained constantly strong , and in investment demand , which has been gradually picking up since 1998 when an active financial policy was adopted .
as far as the financial policy is concerned , he emphasized , what can be done for the time being is to help some enterprises pull out from the market and to establish an effective social security network .
he disclosed that 20 billion yuan is expected to be paid to employees of bankrupt enterprises as settlement allowances .
second , the past three successive years witnessed a total domestic savings ratio as high as 40 percent in china ( according to current statistics ) , whereas the fixed asset investment rate was only 37 percent .
thus savings are higher than investments . from january to may this year , the growth in both residents ' and enterprises ' savings was higher than 10 to 13 percent .
all these factors indicate that china has sufficient resources to support its development .
of course , there are also some unfavorable factors , such as : lag in transformation of the operational mechanisms of state - owned enterprises and economic entities , the huge amount of bad debts owed to state - owned commercial banks , more cautious practice by banks in approving loan applications , and incompatible investment and financing mechanisms .
it is necessary to severely crack down on illegal foreign exchange business activities with the key point on cracking down on " nests " and " underground money houses " for illegal foreign exchange business .
besides , it is also necessary to increase the number of inspection on key areas and places where illegal foreign exchange business is most frequently done .
it is necessary to supervise the work of banks designated for handling foreign exchange to put in order their business networks and foreign exchange conversion establishments , and resolutely ban the use of banking establishments for illegal business activities .
with regard to enterprises that have violated regulations to obtain an enormous amount of foreign exchange , it is necessary to report to foreign trade and economic departments asking to temporarily suspend or revoke import and export right of such enterprises .

jinan , 17 jun ( xinhua ) - - affected by decreased grain production acreage and natural disasters , shandong , china 's major grain production area , will witness a further decrease in summer grain output this year .
shandong has witnessed a decrease in summer grain output for two years in a row .
shandong is one of china 's major grain production areas . in recent years , shandong has been one of the major wheat producers in china .
in almost the last five years , shandong 's annual grain output is about 40 million metric tons .
the grain acreage decreases to 110 million mu in 2000 from 120 million mu in 1999 . the wheat acreage further decreases this year .
taking into consideration of all factors for output reduction , the shandong provincial agriculture department predicts that the total output of summer grain in shandong will decrease by 1.45 million metric tons this year as compared with last year .

goteborg , 17 jun ( renmin ribao ) the two - day eu summit at goteborg has ended in an atmosphere of constantly escalating demonstrations outside the conference hall .
the presidency conclusions issued at the meeting shows that the meeting has made positive headway on various issues , such as the enlargement of member states , the strategy for sustainable development , and the foreign policy adopted toward some hot international issues .
the meeting has also agreed to provide romania and bulgaria , the comparatively backward candidate nations , with extra assistance .
another important achievement of the meeting is that it has defined a strategy for sustainable development .
it has been decided at the meeting that the eu will first take action in four fields , i . e . , the weather , transport , public health , and natural resources , to promote sustainable development .
as for the global climate changes , the eu will place its focus on the ratification and implementation of the kyoto protocol , which sets limits on the quantity of greenhouse gas emissions , and strive to win over more countries to join the ranks in implementing the kyoto protocol .
on the macedonian situation , the meeting reaffirms that the internationally recognized borders in that region are .
the meeting stresses the importance of resolving the macedonian issue by political means , calls on all parties to start genuine negotiations , and considers appointing a special envoy to promote political restructuring in macedonia and help keep the ethnic albanian illegal armed forces in the territory under control .
the eastward expansion has always been the most difficult issue in the course of european integration .
the treaty of nice , which was signed at the summit meeting held in nice , france , toward the end of last year , has set the timetable for accepting new members from 2004 .
known as a in the building of europe , the treaty has created conditions for the admission of 12 central and east european states into the eu .
since taking up the rotational eu presidency in the first half of this year , the swedish government has always listed the eastward expansion as an important task of the eu in the short term and vigorously promoted the process of relevant negotiations .
as the eu practices a approval system on major issues , which makes it impossible to implement a decision if it is opposed by a member state , the results of the irish referendum has put a stumbling block on the path of its eastward expansion .
in light of the irish referendum results , the presidency conclusions has again stressed the of expansion , saying the eu will do all it can to help the irish government find a method for ratifying the treaty so that the expansion can be completed according to schedule .
as a media commentary here puts it , it is indeed not easy for the meeting to reach agreements on the expansion timetable .
just as swedish foreign minister anna lindh has said , as long as the eu leaders can make a political resolution , the expansion process is sure to forge ahead vigorously .
the chief executive tung chee - hwa clearly pointed at the legislative council 's question and answer session last wednesday that " the falungong is an evil cult , " saying that he had given careful consideration to every word he had uttered .
this prudent , firm and clear - cut stand of the chief executive embodies a high sense of responsibility for the well - being of the hong kong people and for the peace and quiet of the hong kong society .
they said the chief executive did not want to see the falungong do harm to people 's lives in hong kong as it did on the mainland , that he was protecting public order as well as people 's life and property in hong kong .
however , certain public figures in hong kong and local leaders of the falungong distorted and attacked the remarks made by the chief executive on the basis of facts and legal principles .
echoing the democratic party , local falungong leaders also declared that they would consider suing the chief executive for libel .
however , he ignored facts and conscience and betrayed the extreme short - sightedness and stupidity of the handful of core members of the democratic party in showing an ungrudging willingness to wallow in the same mire with the falungong in their opposition to " one country , two systems " and the chief executive .
the allegation that under " one country , two systems " the falungong is not a cult in hong kong even though it is so stigmatized on the mainland is a deliberate denial of common knowledge as well as a distortion of " one country , two systems . "
as we all know , the falungong on the mainland and the falungong in hong kong are one and the same organization . they have the same leader and the same set of dogma , and the hong kong branch will not turn " from cult to orthodoxy " just because of " one country , two systems . "
on the mainland , the falungong has already led to the deaths of over 1,600 followers . its nature in harming life and jeopardizing society is more grave and terrifying than other notorious cults of the world .
the fact that the falungong in hong kong is a branch of the falungong cult as a whole determines that it has all the essence and characteristics of the falungong cult .
some people asked : who can draw the line between cults and orthodoxy ?
another important fact is that the falungong in hong kong is not just a cult organization . it is an anti - china political organization controlled by foreign forces .
the role and behaviors of the falungong in hong kong essentially pose a challenge to " one country , two systems " and undermine hong kong 's prosperity and stability .
it is precisely for this reason that the falungong has won the sympathy and support of hong kong politicians whose vocation is to oppose " one country , two systems " and the basic law .
with regard to the numerous disturbances created by " falungong " members , reports from all kinds of newspapers are already a common occurrence .
from laying siege to information departments and government organs , to the occurrences afterwards of laying siege to zhongnanhai [ seat of china 's government in beijing ] , the self - immolation on tiananmen square , and other incidents , almost every single event has been startling and shocking .
one often sees reports from foreign news services regarding the chinese government 's handling of the " falungong " problem , and they all make one confused as to whose [ reports ] are the most truthful .
the [ re - education facilities ] that have the most terrible rumors spread about them are the masanjia and beijing 's tuanhe re - education through labor facilities .
zhang jingsheng , director of this facility , briefed the reporters : the tuanhe re - education facility at present has 180 cadres and police officers , 13 functional administration offices , and 7 brigades for the administration of inmates undergoing re - education .
as for those who undergo re - education and whose thinking does not undergo a transformation , the re - education through labor facility has no power to prolong their re - education sentences .
the tuanhe re - education facility currently has 340 " falungong " inmates undergoing re - education .
zhang jingsheng said that , in accordance with the law , the chinese government absolutely places emphasis on safeguarding the legal rights and interests of those undergoing re - education .
teaching them to become people who can earn their own living , and who observe discipline and obey the law , is the fundamental mission of the re - education through labor facility .
re - education inmates enjoy all of the rights of a citizen stipulated by law while undergoing re - education .
inmates who do not accept the verdict of their judgments may apply for an administrative appeal in accordance with the regulations of the laws for administrative appeal , or may bring forth administrative litigation in the courts in accordance with the laws for administrative litigation .
last year , the tuanhe re - education facility took in 560 re - education inmates ; among them , those who received shortened sentences , early release , furloughs to return home on festivals and holidays , and other rewards , stood at 60 percent and higher of the re - education inmates .
before entering the re - education facility , and seeing that thick vermilion wall used to separate the office area of the cadres and police officers from the re - education facility , one feels that the inside must be very mysterious .
even several of the reporters traveling together sighed with emotion , [ saying ] the environment here is pretty good .
soon after , the reporters walked over to one family .
second brigade 's meng yuanguang is 30 years old this year , and used to be an anesthetist for a hospital in beijing 's daxing county .
during the time he was employed , his relations with others were very good and he worked very conscientiously .
he had always been interested in qigong [ traditional chinese breathing exercises ] and other such pursuits , and afterwards started practicing " falungong . "
in january of this year he was sent to the tuanhe re - education through labor facility , and has already transformed back after undergoing re - education .
he told the reporters that in the past he read some information on the clearwisdom.net website and thought that this place was horrible , that it had all kinds of torture devices , that peoples ' legs had been broken , and other impressions .
after seeing it , it is not at all like it was described on the website ; in fact it is the opposite , the cadres and police officers here are very civilized , they reason things out , and they talk in a friendly and agreeable manner .
the blankets are stacked like chunks of tofu , and the water bottles and toiletries are all placed with military precision .
the library in the re - education through labor facility provides all kinds of books for the re - education inmates to study .
it is reported that the rate of re - education inmates who have been transformed at beijing 's tuanhe re - education facility has always been at 95 percent or higher .
as for the " falungong " members [ who have not yet transformed ] , because their thinking and beliefs are different , getting them to transform will be much easier said than done .
the inmates ' beliefs could not be transformed in spite of many years of social and family education on the outside - - [ their ] high rate of transformation in the tuanhe re - education through labor facility can only be said to be a miracle .
meng yuanguang said that these people all wanted to hold on to their own religious beliefs to influence the thinking of the cadres and police officers here when they first entered the facility . however , after arriving , the circumstance here were widely divergent from what they had imagined , and it was them who were transformed .
meng yuanguang claims they were fundamentally transformed within a week .
the reporters came into contact with several inmates who had already been transformed ; basically , all had been transformed within 10 days .
now that these former " falungong " members have transformed so quickly , why not send them back home earlier ? zhang jingsheng said that the major reason is because there is a necessary time period to allow them to consolidate their transformation .
many with a high educational background among the re - education inmates that we came into contact with , almost all of them were people with a high level of education , with quite a few from nanjing university , xian communications university , and other famous institutions of higher learning like these .
this one point made the reporters traveling together all feel puzzled .
meng yuanguang 's parents said that when his original unit heard that he had been transformed , they immediately called his parents ' home [ and said ] they hoped meng yuanguang would continue to work as usual after he was released .
while he was in the re - education through labor facility , his wife bore him a daughter , but he has not yet seen her because she is still too young . however , his wife visits him every week .
his status is quite good , and he hopes he can return to his unit and start to work as early as possible .
twenty - five year old jin haoyi 's former job was also absolutely ideal - - he could earn at least 2,000 yuan in a month , with his highest earnings reaching 6,000 yuan . he hopes that when he returns he can find an even better unit to work for .
statements of newly arrived obsessed adherent thirty - eight year old wen bin is the only inmate encountered on this trip to tuanhe who insists on the belief that " falungong " is the universe 's fundamental dafa [ great law ] ; he was sentenced to two years in the re - education through labor facility .
he is also the inmate with the highest educational level that we saw - - he is a post - graduate student at xian communications university , and formerly had his own company .
at present , he still believes that practicing " falungong " is an extremely great thing and that [ falungong ] is beneficial for the nation , the people , and individuals .
when discussing the government sending him here for re - education , he said that " falun dafa " is a new phenomenon , and is the universe 's fundamental dafa about which humanity is still ignorant .
there has never been anyone who has used human language to tell people about the universe 's dafa .
the government at this time saying that " falungong " harms society and families is a result of misunderstanding or a lack of knowledge .
he merely violated the government stipulated system and was thus arrested and sent here .
he said that he clearly understands that this system is created from the government 's temporary lack of understanding , and that in the end a day will come when things will change .
the fundamental reason for this is that people who xiulian [ giving oneself up to religious self - discipline , especially buddhist or taoist control of the mind and body ] , " truly feel that ' falungong ' is a good thing . "
he said that members who practice " falun dafa " are very good to themselves and their relatives , and that the dafa also requires them to act in this manner . he does not believe that the incident of self - immolation [ on tiananmen square ] were the actions of members of [ falungong ] .
it seems that wen bin still insists on those doctrines of his , and that he still wants to use his own reasoning to persuade the cadres and police officers in the re - education through labor facility .

at 1500 on 16 october 1964 , a spectacular mushroom cloud rose in the skies above lop nor. henceforth china had its own atomic bomb .
on 26 november 1975 , china launched its first satellite and successfully recovered it , becoming the third country in the world with satellite recovery technology .
known as " river mother , " huang he is the second largest river in china . it is prone to flooding and has caused the chinese nation untold suffering .
in 1952 chairman mao zedong inspected the river in person and called on the whole country to " do a good job with regard to huang he. "
this famous river of sorrow , which had remained untamed for thousands of years , is gradually being brought under control by the chinese communists .
to remove the threat of devastating flooding in the middle and upper reaches of the river , the party 's first - generation leadership collective began drawing up a magnificent blueprint for the three - gorge dam project as soon as new china was founded .
in the wake of scientific studies and democratic policy - making , the party 's third - generation leadership collective led by comrade jiang zemin took the project into the formal implementation stage .
the three - gorge dam project will offer more comprehensive benefits than any other project undertaken by new china in its 50 - year history .
it will effectively control flooding in the upper reaches of chang jiang . it will generate 84.7 billion kilowatts of electricity on the average each year , saving 50 million tons of coal annually . as such it will play a major role in economic development and environmental protection in china .
the great southwest is a vast platform teeming with diverse riches . at the same time , it is isolated by mountain upon mountain , making it hard to develop .
from one dynasty to the next , the mountain people and the masses never stopped trying to dig a way through the mountain ranges , eager to reach the outside world .
in 1990 , the state council and the cpc central committee decided to build a railway - the nanjing - kunming railway - - in this mountainous land in order to link the great southwest with the blue ocean .
not only was this a cross - century transportation project , but it was also china 's greatest anti - poverty project .
jiang zemin , li peng , zhu rongji , and other comrades visited the railway construction site one after another and issued a series of instructions regarding the project .
the sincere interest of the cpc central committee 's leading comrades inspired the army of railroad workers to fight in the southwest and devote themselves to the nanjing - kunming railroad . again and again the date of completion of construction was pushed forward . finally , on 18 march 1997 , the entire railroad was opened to traffic .
in the 50 years since 1950 , china completed a total of 17.8 trillion yuan in fixed assets investment , including 7.2 trillion yuan in capital construction investment and 3.2 trillion yuan in modernization and transformation investment .
its international economic standing has risen notably .
a world bank expert has offered this evaluation , " it took china just one generation to accomplish what other countries did over a few centuries . "
through its practical actions and ceaseless effort , the cpc finally has succeeded in solving this century - old problem : feeding 22 percent of the world 's population with just 10 percent of its arable land .
in the 20 years after 1978 , china 's grain output hit the 300 - million - ton , 400 - million - ton , and 500 - million - ton marks successively .
to satisfy this demand , party committees and governments at all levels have been aggressively tackling the " food basket " project and the adjustment of the agricultural structure since china introduced the reform and open policies .
nowadays , fresh cucumbers and tomatoes are consumed year round and it is commonplace for people to eat watermelon while sitting around the fireplace . in the north , the cellar used for storing cabbages has become a historic relic .
" wear new clothes for three years , wear old clothes for three years , and patch them up and wear them for another three years . "
back in the early 1960 's , the cpc central committee already included the building of four large chemical fiber plants among its key projects in order to increase the country 's fabric production capacity .
instead of having one outfit to wear for four seasons , now the chinese people have multiple outfits for one season .
" with tens of thousand of houses , poor scholars all over the land can happily find shelter . "
since 1978 , over 2 billion square meters of urban housing have been built nationwide , and the per capita living space among the urban population has risen to 8.8 square meters .
the housing program launched in 1999 has solved the housing problem for 650,000 households in 246 cities and units . with the economy taking off , exchanges with the outside world have increased , living standards have gone up , and more and more chinese go on sightseeing trips .
a three - dimensional transportation network consisting of railroads , highways , waterways , civil airliners , and subways now links up all parts of the country . currently transportation routes of all types have a combined length of 2,975,000 kilometers , more than a fifteen - fold increase from 1949 .
chang jiang is a historical witness to the improvement in the ability with which the ordinary people can get around .
on 15 october 1957 the wuhan chang jiang bridge was opened to traffic , bringing to an end that long chapter in chang jiang 's history when the only way to cross the river was by boat .
during the 1990 's , this record was shattered by jiujiang chang jiang bridge , which , in turn , will be surpassed by the wuhu bridge , currently under construction , which will be 10,511 meters long .
after a seven - year war on poverty , poor people in rural areas who do not have enough to eat or wear have decreased to 30 million , about 3 percent of the country 's total rural population .
by and large poor people in rural china now have enough to eat and wear and the objective set by the cpc central committee in its war on poverty has essentially been accomplished .
this is a most remarkable historic achievement .
in the second half of my life , i have been full of joy as i witnessed one miracle after another . "

the japanese government has launched a 200 - day emergency curb on the import of chinese leeks , fresh mushrooms , and rush mats , beginning 23 april .
the reason put forth by the japanese side is that the sharp rise in china 's farm - product exports is impacting relevant industries in japan . to protect the japanese farmers ' interests , it is imperative to impose such tentative restrictions based on the wto 's protective measures .
however , experts say that even though such tentative protective measures are permitted by the wto regulations , they are not good strategies in international trade because they are apt to give rise to trade frictions .
even though the amounts involved in japan 's tentative restrictions on the three kinds of chinese farm products are not great , the effect is serious .
following the restrictions on the import of the three kinds of chinese farm products , trade associations in japan , including towel , necktie , hosiery , and bicycle manufacturers as well as the eel - fishing industry , have vied to file requests for similar restrictions .
currently , sino - japanese economic and trade relations are picking up from the low ebb resulting from the asian financial storm a few years ago and are showing a good momentum of development .
in view of this , china and japan should sit down face to face to exchange opinions and discuss how to solve the problem , just as china and the republic of korea did last year in the wake of the garlic storm .

beijing , 19 jun ( xinhua ) - - the state administration of foreign exchange has recently decided to rectify the foreign exchange market order nationwide with emphasis on dealing blows at arbitrage .
as pointed out by a responsible officer of the state administration of foreign exchange , presently the foreign exchange black market has disrupted to a serious extent the order of the regular market and fostered such illegal activities as smuggling , arbitrage , and tax evasion .
aimed at getting foreign exchange through deception , these activities are characterized by the large amounts of foreign exchange involved and the concealing methods they are using .
the current rectification campaign will start with authorized foreign exchange banks , aiming at dealing real blows at illegal activities of obtaining financing and foreign exchange through false letters of credit without genuine trade transactions .
if an authorized foreign exchange bank fails to guard against arbitrage , resulting in the loss of a large amount of the state 's foreign exchange , or if it collaborates with enterprises to commit arbitrage , an order will be issued to suspend or revoke its right to do foreign exchange business .
in addition , this rectification campaign will check the foreign exchange accounts in the capital - account category .
