guo dongbo , director of the state council overseas chinese affairs office , delivered a report entitled " wholeheartedly serve the overseas chinese , pursue unity and development together . "
in 2000 , china had a record year on imports and exports .
however , because of the global economic slowdown which started in 2001 , the growth of imports and exports has dropped considerably in china : exports on labor - intensive products are sluggish but exports of mechanical and electric products and high - tech products are up .
foreign trade experts predict that chinese imports and exports will end up 8.6 percent , with 7.1 percent growth in exports and 10.2 percent growth in imports . the contribution made by imports and exports to gdp growth will be significantly less than that of last year .
the new situation brings a new challenge to china 's exports .
china totaled $ 158.13 billion worth of exports during the first four months of this year , ending up with a $ 5.38 billion trade surplus .
although it has accomplished a 13.2 percent increase in exports in the first four months , exceeding expectations , it was 25.8 percent less over the same period last year .
because domestic demand has picked up , imports have been rising continuously over exports , and the trade surplus continues to shrink .
meanwhile , it was up 23.8 percent in exports of mechanical and electric products and it was up 41.0 percent for high - tech products , both of them topping the average growth level of exports .
this underscores that in an overall sluggish market , the chinese mechanical and electric products , especially high - tech products , remain highly competitive and still have a certain growth margin .
overseas - invested enterprises saw a strong growth in imports and exports .
china faces worse domestic and international trading conditions compared with last year .
but at the same time , the chinese domestic economy continues a steady growth , domestic and international investments and consumer demand are picking up gradually , and the situation of using foreign capital is also improving .
opportunities and challenges co - exist in china 's foreign trade development .
the us economy has had a great slowdown since the fourth quarter of 2000 , japan 's economy has deteriorated further and the global economy and trade have also slowed down significantly .
international market demand began to decline at the end of 2000 because of the sluggishness of the global economy . besides a slow price drop in elementary products , industrial finished products also have certain overstocks .
because of us domestic demand and the global economic slowdown , import demands on consumer products and information products will decline in developed countries especially in the us , and the international market will become highly competitive due to supplies exceeding demand at certain degrees .
but world trade will somehow maintain growth .
the chinese government will continue to carry out its vigorous financial policy and its steady currency policy in 2001 , and will steadily promote economic structural adjustment and its western development strategy , so the domestic economy will maintain steady and continuous growth .
as background for the " 10 - 5 " plan to be carried out , some new investment projects are to be implemented , and industrial production will increase continuously ; the unemployment situation having been improved and social security system being gradually established and improved , domestic investment demands and consumer demand will pick up too .
the optimists on chinese economic prospects and potential of the future together with changes of international capital flow and the direct investment of foreign businesses in mainland china is picking up too .
after resuming recovering growth in contracted and received foreign investments in the second half of 2000 , a 38.3 percent increase in contracted foreign investment and a 12.4 percent increase in foreign investments were achieved in the first four months of the year .
future trend will depend on two factors . the rapid growth of imports and exports in 2000 resulted in a high starting point .
at the base of this foundation , a slowdown of imports and exports in 2001 is evident .
we have to face two problems in considering the future direction of chinese foreign trade .
first of all , the global economic slowdown , especially the us slowdown , may bring negative effects in chinese foreign trade development .
the fact and statistics saw the us economy as the driver of the global economy since the ' 90 s of the 20 th century to a high degree , and the us provides the biggest market in the world .
whether the us economy will have a " soft landing " or a " hard landing " will impact entirely differently on the global economy .
looking at the present situation , a " soft landing " is quite likely but the global economic growth in 2001 will be the weakest in 10 years .
being china 's number one trading partner in exports , the us economic slowdown will bring considerable influences on chinese exports .
the first four months ' increase in chinese exporting to the us was less than that of last year .
we also should understand the aftereffects of such influences , because the influences have not finalized yet at present .
second , imports exceeding exports will continue to reduce china 's trade surplus .
china 's commodity imports have maintained a fast increase in the last two years ; the increase of imports is greater than exports .
the commodity trade surplus was $ 43.5 billion in 1998 , $ 29.2 billion in 1999 and $ 24.1 billion in 2000 as it declined annually .
labor - intensive exports made up the major part of the surplus for chinese commodity trading .
compared with 2000 , the trade surplus will drop substantially in 2001 due to the current economic conditions .
once china enters wto , it will have to carry out the tariff cut which it committed to during its negotiations on entering wto .
a continuous and rapid increase in imports will promote economic structural adjustment and will work positively on stress relief for rmb appreciation .

" in the past , virtually all high - ranking cadres were appointed by the organization department of the cpc central committee , " said an inside source , " but now the political bureau has agreed that many cadres at the vice minister and vice governor level will be openly recruited in the next 10 years . "
the leadership also claimed that initial results have been achieved in the dismissal of incompetent officials .
in anhui province , for instance , officials showing poor performance in their annual assessments for three years running will have to face disciplinary action .
senior officials who were recently dismissed , demoted or censured include jiangxi party secretary shu huiguo , shaanxi governor cheng andong and yunnan governor li yiating .
the majority of the provincial governors and party secretaries appointed over the past six months all belonged to three major camps , namely , jiang zemin 's shanghai camp , vice president hu jinao 's communist youth league camp , and the princelings .
political wrestling is gathering momentum as the 16 th cpc national congress approaches . at the same time , it also shows that personnel reshuffles are often the result of partisan interests and internal strife .
in the enforcement of party discipline , western analysts noted that the number of dismissals announced by the cpc showed precisely that the measure was anything but thorough .
after all , the expulsion of 500,000 party members amounted to less than one percent of its total membership .
even semi - open documents admitted that virtually one in every 10 cadres in public security and customs units is corrupt .
corrupt officials can easily get away with connections higher up the cpc may end up achieving the opposite result in its efforts to improve its cadre system if its leadership merely requires its cadres to improve their integrity , world outlook and methods of work .
jiang zemin began talking about " three stresses " and asking cadres to assign importance to study , political awareness and upright conduct two years ago .
this emphasis on " confucian loyalty " has its drawbacks : unless government power is checked and balanced and unless the media can exercise supervision , cadres may degenerate quickly even if they are saints .
within the cpc , the only organization that has the power to investigate corruption and other crimes is the central commission for discipline inspection , which is veiled in mystery .
under this system , corrupt officials will find it easy to get away if they have connections in high places .
jiang zemin said that he was more inclined toward the " elite system " of singapore and malaysia . he reiterated that the priority in china 's future reform is to openly select well - educated elites to high positions under the supervision of the cpc .
jiang zemin emphasized that beijing could practice rule by experts by recruiting experts who are both " red and expert " and are politically trust - worthy .

lee teng - hui spared no cost trying to preserve its " diplomatic relations " with macedonia and announced an aid package of us $ 300 million to it .

the taiwan authorities have made themselves notorious in their " money diplomacy " squandering the hard - earned money of the taiwan people trying to create " two chinas " and " one china , one taiwan " in the international arena . their deeds have long since aroused the strong resentment of the taiwan public .
in order to extricate itself from this predicament , taiwan must work on the real issue - - cross - strait relations .

second , support enterprise reorganization and restructuring .

in the field of industrial restructuring , the state financial authority mainly supported the textile industry 's spindle reduction , the shutdown of mines with exhausted resources in the coal and nonferrous metal mining industry , and the shutdown of five types of small enterprises .

the roar of cannons in the october revolution brought us marxism - leninism as well as socialism .
it was precisely the establishment of this objective and the exploration of this new path that enabled the communist party of china [ cpc ] to become a political force operating under its own banner and undertaking the historic mission of bringing about the rejuvenation of the nation in keeping with the new objective .
in moving toward this clear and definite objective , the cpc has trodden a long path of exploration .
in looking back over the past 80 years and ruminating on historical experience , many questions , including the relationship between the new democratic society and the initial stage of socialism , the relationship between socialist transformation and socialist reform , and the direction of china in the initial stage of socialism , have given people food for thought .
when thinking about and answering these questions , it is necessary to adopt a historical perspective and a scientific attitude .
thereafter , china 's historical development took a new turn and moved in a new direction .
is capitalism worthy of being a model ?
just as people were having more and more doubts about this , the roar of cannons in the october revolution brought us marxism - leninism as well as socialism .
advanced elements in china caught up with the trends of the times , adopted new ways , learned from russia , learned from socialism , and began to explore a new revolutionary path that would lead china toward socialism .
the first program of the cpc was originally a program for directly carrying out socialist revolution .
could socialism be practiced directly in a country as extremely backward and undeveloped as china ?
in the course of revolutionary practice , cpc members gradually recognized that the primary revolutionary task for china at that time was to oppose imperialism and feudalism ; it was not yet , nor could it be , a time for general opposition to capitalism and for the practice of socialism .
the chinese revolution must be carried out in two steps . the first step was democracy , and the second step was socialism .
in china , the bourgeoisie could not lead the democratic revolution ; only the working class could lead it .
the future of the democratic revolution led by the cpc was socialism , not capitalism ; thus , it was called " new " democracy .
this set of theories is a historical conclusion drawn on the basis of summing up the success and failure of the great revolution , the success and failure of the agrarian revolution , and the experience and lessons in the great development of revolutionary forces since the war of resistance against japan .
the theory of new democracy is to reject empty talk of socialism and to formulate theories in preparation for socialism in china in an earnest and down - to - earth fashion ; it is a major theoretical creation of chinese marxists .
mao zedong was the most prominent representative of this creation , and all the theoretical achievements that combine marxism with the practice of the chinese revolution are termed mao zedong thought .
from that time on , the cpc began another long period of exploration : exploration of the path for china to move toward socialism and establish socialism .
the new democratic period was a period of making the transition to socialism .
with the completion of the task of transformation , china made the transition from a new democratic society to a socialist society and established a basic socialist system .
beginning with the eighth party congress , the cpc continued to move forward and strove to explore a path for establishing socialism that is suited to china 's conditions .
it was originally hoped that this exploration would experience fewer failures and setbacks than the chinese revolution , enabling us to build socialism more quickly and with better results .
as a consequence , while great achievements were scored in construction and exploration , setbacks could not be avoided .
at the end of 1978 , the third plenary session of the 11 th cpc central committee was held .
reform , opening up , and the establishment of socialism with chinese characteristics became the new theme of the long exploration by cpc members .
guiding this new exploration was the theory of establishing socialism with chinese characteristics ; deng xiaoping was the key founder of this theory , so we call it deng xiaoping theory .
the initial stage of socialism is a new , fundamental judgment concerning china 's national conditions and the development stage of socialism in china .
our current line , program , and policies were drawn up in accordance with this basic national condition .
rational historical reflection in looking back over the past 80 years and ruminating on historical experience , there are many questions for people to ponder .
question 1 : the relationship between the new democratic society and the initial stage of socialism .
" on new democracy " explicitly expounds this prospect .
it was only after the third plenary session of the 11 th cpc central committee that there was a gradual understanding of the judgment that the transition from new democracy to socialism would only lead to the initial stage of socialism .
the new democratic society and the initial stage of socialism are essentially the same in one respect .
old china was a semi - colonial , semi - feudal society ; it was part of the capitalist world . from its inception , new china freed itself from that old world and became a part of the socialist world .
that is to say , judging from the viewpoint of general classification and division , the new democratic society was essentially different from capitalist society but was essentially similar to socialist society .
what is meant by establishing a basic socialist system ?
at that time , this exclusivity and purity was stressed .
now , our understanding is that the basic economic system for the initial stage of socialism in china features the socialist public ownership system as the mainstay and the common development of economic sectors under various forms of ownership .
or can we call the present initial stage of socialism a new democratic society ?
no one had ever imagined that the practice of new democracy would go on for 50 years or 100 years .
so what grounds are there for saying that 50 years after the founding of new china , we are still not socialist ?
there are two major differences .
in the early period after the founding of new china , the state - run economy played a dominant role in the cities and in the industrial arena , but the publicly owned economy was either nonexistent in most of the rural areas or had only been established in a few areas .
only after the socialist transformation was the dominant position of the socialist public ownership system established in the villages ; at that time , its dominant position was almost exclusive .
since reform , the rural economy has undergone substantial adjustment . however , the public ownership system still holds a dominant position , with farm output quotas being set for each household , and land , which is the primary means of production for agriculture , continuing to be publicly owned .
question 2 : the relationship between socialist transformation and socialist reform .
whether it be the socialist transformation of the 1950 s or the socialist reform that was launched at the end of the 1970 s , they were both bold exploration in the great historical process in which the cpc led the chinese people toward socialism ; they were different stages of exploration .
however , this is a summation of history from the vantage point of our current understanding .
people at that time could not possibly have had this understanding .
today , we have learned from our predecessors ' experience , and we also have learned lessons from our predecessors .
in addition , we also have conducted many new explorations . the new practice of more than 20 years of socialist reform proves that we are now more clear - headed in our understanding of socialism than we were in the past .
we must view the two major stages of exploration from the perspective of the overall historical process of moving china toward socialism .
the meaning of this is that , if we had known that there was going to be reform and common development of economic sectors with diverse ownership systems now , why did we have to go through socialist transformation in the first place ?
" is the present - day reform a negation of the socialist transformation of the past ? "
reform has only negated certain rigid viewpoints of the past concerning the position and form of the public ownership system . it is not trying to take the entire public ownership system and change it to or restore it to a private ownership system .
question 3 : where is the initial stage of socialism in china headed ?
since the beginning of 2001 , china has entered a new stage of development in which it will build a relatively well off society and speed up modernization .
a relatively well off society is one that is still not rich , but which is somewhat better off than the impoverished situation of the past .
by international standards , china is still at the entry level of lower - middle - income countries ; it has not yet left the initial stage of socialism .
what we can predict is , by that time , our understanding of socialism will by no means have returned to certain simple viewpoints of the past , but rather will have been greatly enriched and will have moved forward in keeping with practice and scientific development .
the consolidation and development of the socialist system requires a long historical stage ; it requires unremitting efforts by people of several generations , people of more than 10 generations , or even people of tens of generations . we must never lower our guard . "
the discussions of experts have become more and more specialized ; as a result , people outside the industry are unable to understand them .
let us discuss the principles today . please talk about issues such as the major precondition and line of thinking . first , what do you think are the problems in the discussions on the plan for telecommunications system reform ?
han xiaoming : in their discussions on the telecommunications system reform in recent years , the majority of people are talking about what tasks should be done . however , where should the model for these tasks come from ?
i feel that when discussing the issue , we should not consider the question of what should be done , but rather what are the possibilities for the reform . there are restrictive conditions when we consider the possibilities . china 's telecommunications system reform is faced with at least three restrictive conditions .
when planning for monopoly competition , we must take into consideration that some industries may have an influence on the country 's sovereignty , economic status , and economic security . when planning for competition in these industries , we must consider more our national interests so that these enterprises can have a place in the international economy .
it has two basic characteristics . first , it is an industry that relies on a fixed network similar to the power , railroad , and tap water supply sectors . the difference between these industries and the others is that the construction cost of a fixed network is very high .
based on this characteristic , i feel that it is rather impractical to propose competition based on multiple networks for the telecommunications industry .
they have to put in huge investment . china has formed a telecommunications network covering the whole country with a large room to spare . we should consider seriously whether it is necessary to establish several more networks to compete with it .
although the indices of " generalized services " of developing countries and developed countries are different , it is indisputable that the telecommunications service has increasingly become a public product .
therefore , even if the competition order is to be established in the telecommunications industry , it must be different from other industries .
xue xiaohe : i feel that your viewpoint is very important because we should promote consumer interests , including not only those who own telephones now , but also those who have yet to enjoy the telecommunications service .
therefore , the goal of the telecommunications industry should also include promoting the interests of the remaining 80 percent of the public .
han xiaoming : the situation is like this .
the third restrictive condition of the telecommunications system reform is over consumption in telecommunications service in china .
the proportion of telecommunications services spending in family expenditure is higher than that of developed countries . this is because our consumer income is lower , but the quality of consumption is higher .
the telecommunications network is a concept of a whole network and various telecommunications services which must operate by linking up with the network . based on this characteristic , the first step is to divide the telecommunications network from the telecommunications service operations .
it is gratifying for people to note that , although the ministry of information technology and telecom industries has been frequently criticized , it has always encouraged public discussions on the telecommunications policy as much as possible .
in this way , the chinese enterprise that responds to the anti - dumping suit will find itself in a passive position and even lose the case .
the use of legal weapons to defend one 's own interests is the missed lesson to which china 's industries and enterprise must make up .

washington , 20 jun ( xinhua ) - - us secretary of state powell declared on 20 june that even if the united states builds a missile defense system , the strategy of " mutually assured destruction " [ mad ] , which was the basis of nuclear deterrence during the cold war period , remains indispensable .
powell said when testifying before the us senate foreign relations committee that the mad strategy means a country has sufficient arms to prevent other countries from launching an attack on it .
he said , this strategy for dealing with attacks by other countries still applies to the us missile defense program .
russian president putin said when interviewed by american journalists in the kremlin on 18 june that the us program for building a missile defense system violates the abm treaty .
he emphasized that if the united states unilaterally develops a missile defense system , russia will enhance its strategic nuclear force by developing multiwarhead nuclear weapons .
jiang zemin said : " i have taken notice that , in your meeting with bush , you reiterated the principled position that the " anti - ballistic missile treaty " is a cornerstone for international security .
this shows that putin has not made any compromises just because of bush 's lobbying efforts . to put it another way , putin adhered to the principled position spelled out in the statement on opposition to the us nmd deployment , which he signed with jiang zemin when he visited china in july last year .
afterward he went to ljubjlina , the capital of slovenia , to meet with bush . during the meeting , putin adhered to this principled stand .
according to relevant records , the amb treaty , which the united states and the soviet union signed in 1972 , stipulates that the united states and russia shall not deploy national missile defense systems so that both sides are aware that any party that launches nuclear attacks on its opponent will surely suffer heavy retaliation .

in 1992 there were reports that not " a single soldier " was placed on dongshan ; in 1996 , when the liberation army conducted a three armed services ' landing exercise on dongshan , the dongshan people once again heard the gunshots that they had not heard for a long time .
the united states ' world journal warned that this round of exercises would show that " there is no third way or other routes of retreat between the two sides of the taiwan strait . "
looking from a distant high ground , we saw many bends and curves along the 141 km long coastline making the silvery white bay ever changing . under the azure sky , fishing boats were scattered on the boundless expanse of blue water with myriad surges , drawing myriad joys of a prosperous life .
as the goddess matsu embodies security , happiness , and health in the eyes of dongshan fishing folks , her temple is not only a place where adults and children pay homage and pray for blessings for major and minor matters alike but also a place for holding solemn rites when fishing resumes after the no fishing season .
the world was calm when you stopped by at a white beach in dongshan island where the sea was blue under the sunshine .
" hold it , no picture taking is allowed here . "
the beautiful scenery in dongshan enchanted me .
if they needed drinking water , they used tap water . there was a basket of cactus in the courtyard , which was used to feed pigs .
as a city dweller , i felt i had learned something new . of course , i learned all these things later from a girl , who lived in the house . it was a three - story house .
i told him all i knew . the captain in battle fatigues asked : do you know we are conducting military drills ?
the captain in battle fatigues was very polite to us . he said that he was sorry that he could only offer me drinking water , not tea because they were staying at a fisherman 's house .
i guessed that he just wanted to make sure whether i took pictures of the military maneuver . he seemed to be satisfied with my answer . but he also seemed to have some kind of doubt .
two hours later , some military personnel in battle fatigues turned us over to the dongshan county government . we walked passed 20 or 30 military personnel in battle fatigues . three police cars carried us to a building of the county government . there we were interrogated again .

the communist party of china has passed a glorious course of 80 years .
the party 's experience in the past 80 years can be summarized to one point , that is , the universal truth of marxism must always be combined with the specific conditions of china , and efforts must always be made to sinicize marxism .
the first two changes were made under the guidance of mao zedong thought , and the last change was started under the guidance of deng xiaoping theory .
under the leadership of the third - generation central leading body with comrade jiang zemin at the core , the cause of building socialism with chinese characteristics is continuously advancing in depth .
change from semi - colonial and semi - feudal society to new democracy old china was a large semi - colonial and semi - feudal country in the east .
under the rule of imperialism , feudalism , and bureaucratic capitalism , the nation was weak and poor , and the people suffered from hunger and cold .
where should china go became a focal issue in many people 's thinking .
the victory of october revolution in russia helped progressive intellectuals in china move out of the perplexity . they made a historical selection of taking the same road as the russians did , and became the first batch of marxists in china .
later , they became the founders of the communist party of china . the founding of the cpc brought about a fundamental change to china 's destiny .
because chinese society was a semi - colonial and semi - feudal society , the task of the revolution was to fight against imperialism and feudalism . therefore , the chinese revolutionaries had to give consideration to china 's characteristics while thinking about how to take the road of the russians .
if not , what was its relationship with the socialist revolution ?
whether this question could be correctly resolved concerned the future of the chinese revolution and also the future destiny of the country .
the chinese marxists withstood this test , and their representative was mao zedong .
mao zedong was one of the party 's founding members , and the core of the party 's first - generation leading collective .
in the period of the democratic revolution , such dogmatism represented by chen duxiu and wang ming found expression in the forms of right opportunism or " left " opportunism in political policies . though the forms of expression varied , such erroneous deviations almost ruined the chinese revolution .
this shows that the sinicization of marxism is not only an issue of study style , but an issue concerning the rise or decline of the party and the life or death of the revolutionary cause .
the rectification movement greatly enhanced the whole party 's unity on the basis of marxism , and created the ideological conditions for winning victories in the anti - japanese war and in the democratic revolution as a whole .
so mao zedong thought was a product of the combination of the universal truth of marxism with the specific conditions of china , and was the first great theoretical result in the process of sinicizing marxism .
this time , china was no longer a semi - colonial and semi - feudal country , but was not a socialist country either . then , what was its character ?
in fact , in his essay " on new democracy , " mao zedong already gave an answer to this question .
he pointed out : the state established after the victory of the democratic revolution is not a bourgeois republic like those in europe and america , nor will it be a socialist republic like the soviet union ; instead , it is a " new democratic republic . "
" this is a form in a certain historical period , so it is a transitional form . however , it is an indispensable and necessary form . "
after the end of the socialist transformation , mao zedong led the whole party to make painstaking explorations for socialist construction . by applying the marxist principles to analyze some practical issues in china in those years , he set forth some new ideas about socialist construction .
change from socialism to the building of socialism with chinese characteristics after twists and turns over 20 years in the sinicization of marxism , the smashing of the " gang of four " brought about a turning point .
the debate on the criterion for truth made the ideological preparations , and the triumphant convention of the 3 d plenary session of the 11 th cpc central committee marked the real beginning of the change .
with the plenum as a starting point , deng xiaoping theory gradually took shape , and became the basic line for the party in the initial stage of socialism . it opened up a new course of building socialism with chinese characteristics .
the 3 d plenary session of the 11 th cpc central committee marked the beginning of a new historical stage in the sinicization of marxism .
in a certain sense , deng xiaoping theory gradually took shape on the basis of summing up the previous negative experience .
the accomplishment of the socialist transformation indicated the end of large - scale violent class struggle in the socialist revolution .
this was exactly the basic guideline adopted by the party 's eighth national congress .
however , due to the wrong assessment of the situation in the later years , and especially due to the incorrect understanding of socialism , mao zedong adopted a different option and took class struggle as the party 's central task .
after the 3 d plenary session of the 11 th cpc central committee , deng xiaoping repeatedly stressed this issue .
because this is the material foundation and fundamental prerequisite of solving all issues in the building of socialism .
without enhancing the level of productive forces , it is impossible to consolidate the political power , maintain social stability , improve the living standards of the people , and develop the spiritual civilization and the democratic and legal system .
now , as we came to realize this point , we should firmly seize this key issue and never loosen our efforts .
that is to say , in any circumstances , we must consistently and invariably implement this general principle .
in the past , we only talked about developing productive forces , and did not mentioned the need to emancipate productive forces .
reform is an inevitable way to emancipate and develop productive forces , and is a strong driving force in our country 's modernization .
under the conditions of socialism , reform is carried out in a peaceful and orderly form , it does not only resolve some minor problems , but is directed at the old economic structure as a whole . therefore it is arduous and complicated , and inevitably produces a strong impact that shocks society in may aspects .
now , the revolution is still in the rise , but it has displayed and will further demonstrate its great power .
since the beginning of reform and opening , while great achievements have been made in our economic construction , major developments have also been made in the development of spiritual civilization and the democratic and legal system .
the party 's 15 th national congress highly valued deng xiaoping theory , pointing out that it represents a new stage of the development of marxism in contemporary china .
deng xiaoping theory is another great theoretical result in the course of the sinicization of marxism .
after deng xiaoping died , the cause of building socialism with chinese characteristics initiated by him and deng xiaoping theory created by him did not cease their development . under the leadership of the third - generation central leading body of the party with comrade jiang zemin at the core , new and major developments were made .
the thinking on the " three represents " is another sample of combining the universal truth of marxism with the specific conditions of china , and is another major result of sinicizing marxism .

the agricultural subsidy issue was the focus of the multilateral talks on china 's wto entry ; therefore , resolving of the issue has drawn wide attention .
long yongtu said : according to relevant wto regulations , agricultural subsidy is divided into two categories . the first kind of subsidy is support for investment in the development of agricultural technology and in agricultural infrastructure construction , also called " green box " subsidy , which is permitted .
wto regulations stipulate that developing countries ' direct subsidies for their agricultural products must not be more than 10 percent of the total value of the agricultural products , and the percentage for developed countries is five .
the consensus reached between china and other wto members is that china 's direct subsidies for its agricultural products should not be more than 8.5 percent of the total value of the products .

before renminbi becomes convertible under capital account , it is impossible for china to quicken the step of opening up the securities trade .
however , we are taking positive measures to step up supervision over the financial industry and to invigorate the financial market in order to create necessary conditions for the eventual opening up of china 's securities trade . 3 .

last year , bilateral trade between china and the united states was $ 74.47 billion , making the united states the second largest trade partner of china and the largest export market of china .

beijing , 24 jun ( xinhua ) - - the 11 th national land day falls on 25 june of this year . the theme of this year 's propaganda is that " planned land use benefits the nation and people . "
reporters had an exclusive interview with land and resources minister tian fengshan on this topic .
tian fengshan said : in the " 10 th five - year plan " period ( 2001 - 2005 ) , china began to advance toward the third - step strategic goal of modernization .
to feed all the people , build the country , and give due consideration to the ecological environment , we must make scientific planning and reasonable arrangements for land use . only by so doing will we be able to smoothly fulfill the pressing task of national development and ensure the sustainability of economic and social development .
along with the promulgation and implementation of the newly amended " land management law , " china has entered a new phase of revising its overall land use plans .
the new version of the " land management law " stipulates that land should be utilized according to plans and that land cannot be used without plans .
it has been stipulated that overall land use plans of provinces and cities with a population of more than 500,000 should go through the examinations and approvals of the state council . the ministry of land and resources , since its founding , has constantly taken land use planning as the most important link of land management .
people often say , " success is 30 percent from planning and 70 percent from management . "
so , making scientific pans for land use is only the first step . long - term , persistent , and solid efforts should be made to strictly enforce such plans .

why has the government failed to ease up the relevant restrictions ?
in accordance with usual practice , the government should have come up with a policy in advance before authorizing an unofficial institution to sign a new agreement with the mainland side .
in other words , the government had insisted that the talks be held between two sovereign states .
given this , the chinese communists of course rejected taiwan 's proposal .
nonetheless , the question is : are the chinese communists willing to give in on such a principled issue as sovereignty for the sake of nothing but a meager profit generated by the air route ?
as they would rather use force , and even go to war , for the sake of sovereignty , why should they be willing to make a concession for nothing but a civil aviation agreement ?
should the mainland affairs council refuse to change its stance , the chinese communists are bound to make no concessions at all . if so , the public and the operators of the taiwan - hong kong air route would have no idea what to do , for they really have no idea what the government really wants .
in the final analysis , this has shown nothing but the true nature of the so called " easing up policies towards the mainland . "
it is abundantly clear what the government really wants , for it has elevated the taiwan - hong kong civil aviation agreement , an issue that should have been settled without problem in accordance with usual practice , to " a clash of ancestral tablets . "
given this , people should feel the least surprised when they discover that none of the new government 's policies for " easing up cross - strait restrictions " have come into effect .
at present , the crux of the matter is : will the government stubbornly cling to its own way of doing things ?
if not , what should the government do in the next stage ? the cross - strait talks on the taiwan - hong kong civil aviation agreement have merely served as a typical example in this regard .
if the government is eager to see cross - strait restrictions eased up , the mainland affairs council should authorize an unofficial representative from the civil aviation sector to hold talks with hong kong , and consequently declare valid both the results of the talks and an agreement reached between the two sides .
nevertheless , should the government have no intention whatsoever to ease up cross - strait restrictions , it would of course launch a move aimed at provoking " a clash of ancestral tablets . "
nevertheless , could taiwan 's economy really afford such a delay ?
what is more serious , on what grounds has the government taken as its bargaining chip issues like easing up restrictions on mainland tourists visiting taiwan for a sightseeing trip , recognizing mainland academic qualifications , and renewing the taiwan - hong kong civil aviation agreement ?

it is an important part of enterprise reform to create and improve channels through which a large number of enterprises which should long have exited from the market can now do so promptly .
with 13.6 billion yuan in combined assets , these enterprises had run up a whopping 26.6 billion yuan in total debts . their debt ratio averaged 195 percent , with the highest being 661 percent .
these chronically money losers with no prospect of turning the corner have become a heavy burden on the finance departments of local governments at all levels .
in a certain sense , it means the state economy getting out of the market on its own initiative .
another was to give priority to key industries and key localities .
to aid and revive the textile industry ahead of others , a total of 35.85 billion yuan in bad debt reserve funds were tapped during the past three years , 24.1 percent of all bad debt reserve funds used during that period . these funds played a major role in reviving the textile industry one year earlier than scheduled .
between 1996 and 2000 , the national enterprise mergers and worker reemployment work leading group authorized 5,335 enterprise merger and bankruptcy projects in all and wrote off 208.64 billion yuan in bank bad debt reserve funds and losses by assets management companies .
bankruptcy and closings during those three years cut the losses of large and mid - sized state enterprises by 31.96 billion yuan .
a host of enterprises that had depleted their resources were closed , leading the way for the exit from the market of depleted resource - based enterprises .
it is a world - wide problem to see enterprises , primarily enterprises in resource extraction industries , going bankrupt and closing . to close those depleted mines , the government in 1997 chose seven nonferrous metal mines and two coal mines in liaoning which had exhausted their resources to conduct pilot projects in bankruptcy and closing .
some received severance pay . some found jobs on their own . some joined a reemployment service center . all of that ensured the successful implementation of the enterprise bankruptcy and closing .

beijing , 26 jun ( xinhua ) - - the standing committee of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] held its 22 d meeting in beijing this afternoon .
it was learned that the draft revision of the law on judges and the draft revision of the law on procurators will be put to a vote at the current meeting .
the latest draft of the law on judges clearly stipulates that " president and vice presidents of the people 's court shall be chosen on merit from judges or personnel with political and legal backgrounds . "
the law on procurators has also been revised accordingly .
the revised criminal law stipulates that anyone who destroys forests for cultivation purpose , illegally seize forest land for other uses , or commit other acts that do great harm to forest resources and forest land shall take corresponding criminal responsibility .
the draft law on prevention and treatment of occupational diseases provides detailed stipulations on early prevention , protection and management during work process , on diagnosis management of occupational diseases , and on the treatment and protection of patients suffering from occupational diseases .
the enactment of the law on management of maritime space utilization is for the purpose of safeguarding the state 's ownership over sea waters and the legitimate rights and interests of people possessing the right to use the sea waters , in an effort to promote rational development of sea waters and ensure sustainable development .

a crucial meeting regarding china 's entry into the world trade organization (wto) is expected to be held between 28 june and 4 july in geneva .
it is an important meeting for drafting legal papers for china 's wto entry after clearing the way for wto accession by reaching a bilateral agreement relevant to agricultural subsidies between china and the us , and the agreement on service industries - - such as the insurance business - - between china and the european union (eu) .
there are many indications that china is likely to become a full wto member before the trade ministers ' meeting of wto members in doha , in november this year .
long yongtu expressed his hope in geneva that the meeting would comprehensively conclude substantial talks on china 's wto accession , so that the technical check of the legal papers concerning china 's entry into the wto can begin right after the meeting ends .
he also said the majority of wto members wished china to become a full wto member before the trade ministers ' meeting of wto members in doha in november this year .
two key points are stressed : one is about china 's commitment to comply with the international market economic rules , and the other is china 's commitment to gradually open its market to become an active part of the world economy . these papers could end up as long as over 2,000 pages .
it has been learned that china has clinched bilateral deals with over 30 wto members who have asked for negotiations with the country . although mexico has not been able to work out an agreement with china , it has promised support for china 's wto entry and is not seen as a barrier .
china has also reached full consensus with the us and the eu on each remaining issue in the bilateral agreements last june ; namely differences on agricultural subsidies with the us , and differences on service industries with the eu .
as is known to all , differences on agricultural subsidies with the us remained after china and the us reached their bilateral agreement two years ago .
the biggest difference is that the us demanded china have no more than 5 percent direct subsidies on its domestic agricultural products in accordance with the standard used in developed countries . but china insisted on having as much as 10 percent subsidies on domestic agricultural products , the standard used in developing countries .
in general , china will have the status of a developing country after become a wto member ; its subsidies on domestic agricultural products can be as high as 8.5 percent to protect the interests of its farmers .
long yongtu told reporters in geneva that china at present actually only has 3.3 percent subsidies for agricultural products , therefore china will have much room to grow in agricultural subsidies after its accession to the wto .
the us officials estimate that it will gain over $ 2 billion worth of agricultural exports to china after china becomes a wto member , which is more than double the present number .
after china reached a bilateral agreement with the eu last year , the issues concerning service industry permits also remained .
the eu initially asked for having over 51 percent ownership of its joint ventures with china in banking , insurance and telecommunication businesses . later , the two parties conceded the eu would have no more than 49 percent ownership of its joint venture companies in china so china would maintain ownership control .
prior to the geneva conference , minister of foreign trade and economic cooperation shi guangsheng said china had reached full consensus with the united states and the eu on all the issues left over in the multilateral process concerning its bid to enter the wto .

recently , a very influential article entitled " bushism " was published in the flag weekly , a quite popular magazine in the elite circle of washington .
in the opinion of the article , the world has become single - polar , not multipolar , and the united states should pursue a policy of unilateralism necessary for recognizing and maintaining single - polarity .
the article said bluntly that the united states does want to be the only overlord in today 's world , and rule the world in a " kindly " fashion .
however , in the face of realities , such logic is hardly workable .
a basic fact is that a unified europe is economically stronger than the united states and japan remains a big economic power in the world .
russia 's rejuvenation centered on the europe - asia continent and japan 's resolved reform , and the rapid development of china and india - - all are the realities of the distribution of strength in today 's world .
realities are far more complicated than the aforementioned conservatism and delusion .
in the face of the united states ' hegemonic attempt , russia does not make any substantive concession and europe is even more worried about the consequences of unilateralism .
so the united states has to resort to both hard and soft diplomatic stratagem by convincing , ingratiating and inducing them .
the united states repeatedly " explains " to the countries concerned the hardly tenable reasons for the missile defense system , and has to carry out dialog with russia .
all these serve to show that today 's world can hardly be a single - polar world of the united states as asserted by the article " bushism . "
in fact , when america has the intention to monopolize outer space , other big countries do not lack the ability to get involved in the scramble for outer space .
it can be said with certainty that unilateralism not only cannot fundamentally solve the problem concerning nuclear proliferation , but also will not enable the united states to get real security .

in the first half of this year , the regiment was ordered to prepare for a rapid - mobility air training exercise .
in order to ensure safe and rapid mobility in the air , a few comrades suggested that the regiment should set out in two batches . however , other comrades insisted that the regiment should first study an unfamiliar airfield in light of its environment .
as for this , the regiment party committee made its position clear : in order to stage a training exercise in formation , the regiment should set out as a whole , without early warning , and in accordance with real - war requirements .
after tackling a series of difficulties , such as weather changes , unfamiliar flight routes , and an unfamiliar airfield , the regiment 's aircraft , flying in formation , launched a successful simulated air strike at an " enemy " radar system , locating , firing at , and destroying all targets during the first mission .
some brigades of the shenyang military district , with the help of zhouqiao [ boat bridge ] simulation boats carrying the artillery , conducted the training exercise , and exploited the water surface combat capability of ground heavy equipment .
for this undertaking , they invited related experts to conduct theoretical proving , and they transferred 50 mainstay technicians to tackle problems . they used military engineer units to produce training platforms , and water surface simulation ships to carry the artillery and conduct the firing exercise .
to organize the water surface firing exercise , and for the purpose of increasing the endurance capability of officers and soldiers , this brigade produced anti - seasickness training equipment for officers and soldiers , and moreover , employed such methods as simulated battlefield environments and designed battlefield situations .
the live firing on the water , and the artillery swaying visibly and unsteady , increased the difficulty of aiming . by means of the usual land simulation exercises , they caused their rate of hitting the target to increase .
this brigade 's successful practice provides meaningful experience for related military branch units in conducting " on - water firing . "

struggles are inevitable in exchanges with foreign countries .

second , the awareness of keeping up with the times and innovating that is embodied in the important thinking of the " three represents " is beneficial for continuously enriching and developing marxism and the party 's guiding principle in the new century .
the 15 th central committee of the party profoundly and scientifically summarized deng xiaoping theory , saying that this theory has primarily answered the fundamental question of , " what is socialism and how to construct socialism , " exposed the nature of socialism and raised people 's understanding of socialism to a higher level .
the important thinking of the " three represents , " on the basis of the preliminary understanding of the theory on socialism , further answers the fundamental question of " what will the communist party of china build itself out of and how will it build itself ? "

as long as party members can understand and build up the party from such a strategic perspective of the overall situation , our party will be able to play a greater role in realizing the great cause of constructing the socialism with chinese characteristics and to march forward in the correct direction despite winds and waves throughout the world .
proposing the important thinking of the " three represents " is a great development of deng xiaoping theory .
to realize the great cause of constructing socialism with chinese characteristics in the new century , we should continuously enrich and develop this theory .
third , the firm conviction of forging ahead for innovations that is embodied in the important thinking of the " three represents " is beneficial for continuously deepening the reform and for a stronger vitality of the party and of socialism in the new century .
at first sight , it may be a bit difficult to understand the saying that the " three represents " embodies ideas on reform .

these reforms of the party are the key to party 's successes in other reform projects .
when the party has corrected conduct that does not comply with the requirements of the " three represents , " it will be able to smoothly carry out reforms of other aspects .

to revitalize the chinese nation , cpc members conducted revolutionary struggles with extraordinarily painstaking efforts before the founding of new china and made extremely arduous explorations after the founding of new china and proposed the " three - step " developing strategy .
the party has realized objectives for the first two strategic steps .
starting from the 21 st century , the party will begin to make painstaking struggles to realize the third - step objective of the strategy .
the important thinking of the " three represents " will encourage members of the communist party of china to realize this strategic objective in the 21 st century .

last year , 2.85 million taiwan compatriots came to the mainland to visit their relatives or for sightseeing , and the number broke a record . the cross - strait indirect trade volume reached $ 30.5 billion and cross - strait exchanges in science , technology , culture and sports were carried out in a comprehensive manner .

hu angang was invited to deliver an analytical report on china 's national condition at the chinese journalists association this afternoon .
this qinghua university professor first cited some figures to illustrate the problem .
in the past five years also , less than 4 million jobs have been created in economic units such as foreign - funded enterprises , private enterprises have created 6.48 million jobs , and individual economy units 4.27 million .
in addition most of the new jobs are filled by new - emerging labor forces such as tertiary and secondary vocational school graduates and peasant workers from other parts , and very few laid - off workers find new jobs in this way .
in the face of this grim situation , hu angang held that at present china needs to redefine the meaning of employment . so - called employment means the activity of obtaining legitimate remuneration or income from various categories of labor .
hu angang said that in the future the modes of urban employment in china should shift from conventional to unconventional and from permanent to flexible employment .
the spearhead will be pointed at the sphere of people 's livelihood , which is closely related to the people and which arouses strong reactions in society .
for china , however , which is " crossing a river by the stepping stones , " market economy order is like the rising and setting of the sun - - every day is new .
problems of the people 's food , clothing , housing , and travel , specifically , the cost of their medical treatment and medicines , purchases of cars and housing , and middle and primary school fees have to be faced by practically every household .
and big price hikes , indiscriminate imposition of fees , and unregulated behavior occur from time to time in these respects , and are sometimes even very serious .
another eye - catching feature of the measures adopted by the state planning commission is that a heavy fist is aimed at certain official departments , that is , those departments and sectors that practice local blockades and monopolies by using the means of prices and charges .
departments and trades in certain areas have been using the powers in their hands to arbitrarily table standards for fees and set prices themselves , or else to block and interfere with products and services from elsewhere entering their own local markets .
he made that statement when talking about the issue of so - called " cultural taiwan independence . "
the eight - point proposal set forth by general secretary jiang zemin points out that the chinese culture is a spiritual bond that unites all chinese people at home and abroad and is also an important foundation for developing cross - strait relations and realizing national reunification .
taiwan 's culture shares the same origin with the chinese culture . in certain aspects , it reserves a lot of fine tradition in the chinese culture , and its main body is a major component part of chinese culture .
although due to historical reasons it has its special features , such special features do not change the essence of taiwan 's culture as part of chinese culture .
however , it must be pointed out that while opposing some people 's " cultural taiwan independence , " we never oppose native literature in taiwan and cultural customs with local characteristics in taiwan , and never exclude taiwan 's culture with its own specific features formed over several hundred years .

after joining the wto , the mainland will , as always , carry out its previous effective policies toward taiwan investments and , with changes in the situation , improve the policies still further .

wang replied : we encourage people in taiwan industrial and business circles to invest and develop their undertakings on the mainland , but we do not want to see taiwan entrepreneurs investing on the mainland engage in separatist activities on the island after making commercial profits .

since the founding the cpc , the party has always held high the great banner of patriotism and national regeneration , always stood in the forefront of the struggle for national independence and the people 's liberation .
in the history of the chinese people 's struggle , the cpc was the first to set forth a revolutionary program of struggling against imperialism in the world and against feudalism at home . it organized a gigantic revolutionary force led by the working class with peasants as the main body .
in the prolonged , difficult , and tortuous struggle of the chinese people for winning independence and liberation , the chinese communist made brave and indomitable efforts and made untold sacrifices .
his close comrades - in - arms song qingling and he xiangning continued to act in this orientation , and eventually became great communist fighters .

luo gan said : over many years , the leaders and members of the cppcc national committee and local cppcc committees gave great support and care to the political and law affairs work .
since the third plenary session of the central committee of the 11 th congress of the chinese communist party , our party has done a great deal of work on transforming the working style of the leadership through overcoming bureaucratism and formalism , and it has made remarkable achievements .
however , we should see clearly that in some areas , in certain organizations , and with certain comrades , the tendency towards formalism persists to varying degrees .
formalism is a metaphysical ideological viewpoint and method .
the materialist dialectics method believes that any material thing has its own content and its own form .
form and content are the unity of opposites . content decides form , form relies on content , and then there is a reaction on content .
superficially it is imposing , but in reality it strives for prestige which it does not deserve . it is an attempt at private gain for an individual or a clique .
what they think about all day is ways to show off their own " official achievements " with even less effort , how to enlarge their social " notability , " and make a good impression on higher authorities .
to this end , they do not work diligently , and instead they specialize in specious writings , even deception , so as to achieve their objective of promotion and profit .
the emergence of formalism has a profound historical and cultural background .
china experienced a very long period as a feudal society . the strong influence of " official and individual as one " in the feudal cultural tradition persists to this very day .
by " official and individual as one " is meant " seeing yourself as the official , " devoting everything to becoming an official , having an official position , having whatever you want , and " when a man ascends to heaven , even his pets go too " [ nepotism ] .
( jiang zemin , " on improving the party 's working style . " ) the concept of " official and individual as one " gives rise to bureaucratism .
bureaucratism breeds formalism , and formalism encourages bureaucratism .
being divorced from reality , separated from the masses , good at empty talk , assuming a , not dealing with facts , and not speaking of real results are basic characteristics of both formalism and bureaucratism .
bureaucratism does not go down and mix with the masses . it does not tie in with reality . it definitely lacks the profound insight , true method , and genuine responsibility needed to serve the people .
these are just the things which bureaucratism cannot do without even for a minute . formalism in china has been banned for a long time , but never stamped out .
the flood of formalism is also related to the imperfections in china 's political system .
at the same time , china 's system for selecting and assigning cadres is imperfect . objectively , this easily creates the mentality of being responsive only to higher authority , and not being responsive simultaneously to higher authority and to the masses .
strengthen ideological and political education and eliminate the soil in which formalism grows .
strengthen everyday ideological education , and place great emphasis on the healthy development of cadres .
actual practice proves that ideological and political education can improve the ideological and political qualities of party cadres , and especially of leading cadres . strengthen their awareness and initiative regarding the remaking of the subjective world .
the socialist market economy system has taken preliminary shape . the socialist economic component , socialist economic benefits , social organization , patterns of social life , and the ways in which labor finds employment are becoming more varied everyday .
strengthen the buildup of the democratic supervision system , and establish a sound mechanism to constrain the exercise of power by leading cadres .
a system is characterized by its fundamental nature , its overall nature , its stability , and its longevity .
the key to overcoming formalism is , grasp the leader and the leader 's grasp . [ zhua toutou , toutou zhua ] opposing and overcoming formalism requires hard work among all from top to bottom and left to right , but the key lies with leading organizations and leading cadres .
objectively , all of these things serve to turn a blind eye to and encourage formalism .
therefore , to effect a permanent cure for chronic formalism , we must start with leading organizations and leading cadres . we absolutely cannot look only at problems at the lower level , and fail to find the causes within ourselves .
to do so would just be to fight formalism with formalism .

beijing , 30 jun ( xinhua ) - - premier zhu rongji signed state council decree no. 309 a few days ago promulgating " regulations on managing technical service for family planning , " which takes effect on 1 october 2001 .
establishing and perfecting family planning technical service networks and providing the broad masses with standard , fine - quality family planning technical services are important elements of our population and family planning work .
family planning technical service work should likewise change from offering four simple technical services to providing citizens with reproductive health services centering on birth control , child bearing , and sterility .
the regulations provides specific stipulations for safeguarding citizens ' rights to reproductive health . the first right is the citizens ' right to know and choose contraceptive methods .
the second right is the citizens ' right to receiving appropriate technical service for family planning as guaranteed by the state .
a leading comrade of the state council has stressed that there should be no fees to add to the peasants ' burden for basic family planning technical service offered to rural couples at childbearing age on family planning programs .
in reality , technical service for family planning in rural areas is undertaken primarily by family planning technical service stations while in large and middle - sized cities , it is done primarily by medical institutions and health centers for women and children .
to rationally use existing social resources , the regulations stipulates that a family planning service network is made up of family planning technical service institutions and medical and health organizations offering family planning technical service , and that it shall be incorporated into the local health programs .

beijing , 30 jun ( xinhua ) - - renmin ribao 's editorial on 1 july : glory belongs to the cpc and the chinese people - - celebrate the 80 th anniversary of the founding of the cpc the cpc has stepped across a brilliant course of 80 years .
at the moment of joyfully celebrating the 80 th anniversary of the party 's founding , let us extend lofty respects to all communist party members fighting on various fronts and to the people of all ethnic groups throughout the country !
from the opium war in 1840 to the founding of the cpc in 1921 , the chinese nation experienced untold humiliation and perplexity , and carried out painstaking explorations and struggle .
from the peasant uprising of taiping tianguo to the yihetun movement against the foreign powers , from the 1898 constitutional reform and modernization movement to the 1911 revolution , the national salvation struggle arose round after round .
because they did not find the correct way to rescue the nation , all these struggles and movements ended up with failure .
the earthshaking changes fully proved this truth : without the communist party , there would be no new china ; without the leadership of the communist party , there would be no china 's modernization .
glory belongs to the cpc . this is a conclusion of the history .
the cpc grew from small to big and from weak to strong , rose through painstaking explorations full of twists and turns by defeating strong enemies under extremely difficult conditions , and accumulated rich experience .
the most important point of such experience is to integrate the basic principles of marxism - leninism with the concrete practice in china , and firmly advance along its own course .
the two major theoretical results are the crystallization of the practical experience and collective wisdom of the party and the people , the valuable spiritual wealth of our party , and the great banner that guides us to advance triumphantly .
keeping close ties with the masses and seeking benefits for the people wholeheartedly is the most profound source of strength for the cpc .
to handle china 's things well , the key lies in the party .
this is the valuable experience of our party in winning one victory after another in the past 80 years , and is also the fundamental guarantee for our party to win new victories in the new period .
the important thinking on " three presents " set forth by comrade jiang zemin is the foundation for our party 's development and for our party 's ruling status , and is the source of our party 's strength .
the " three represents " constitute an integrated whole , and are also linked to each other and promote each other .
to strengthen and improve party building according to the important thinking on " three represents , " we should continue to emancipate our minds , seek truth from facts , attach importance to studying new things and new issues , continue to maintain and develop marxism in the practice of reform and construction .
we should maintain the party 's advanced character , continuously strengthen the party 's class foundation and mass foundation , enhance the party 's combat strength and social influence .
we should develop inner - party democracy , strictly enforce party discipline , conscientiously implement the principle of democratic centralism , safeguard the party 's unity .

as for the report delivered by the law enforcement inspection group of the npc standing committee , li peng said : the problems found by the inspection group showed the importance of intensifying supervision and management over the securities market according to the stipulations of the securities law .
