state councilor ismail amat , president xiao yang of the supreme people 's court , and han zhubin , chief procurator of the supreme people 's procuratorate , attended the meeting as observers .
he said that our securities law system centering on the securities law plays a positive role in standardizing the issuance of securities and their transactions , protecting the legal rights and interests of investors , ensuring the economic order and public interests in our society , and promoting the development of our socialist market economy .
it is necessary , he added , to use the legal system to ensure the healthy development of our securities market .
at today 's forum , zhou zhengqing , vice chairman of the npc financial and economic committee , gave a lecture on " china 's securities law system . "
he said that the securities law system is a major integral part of the modern financial law system and holds an important position in the legal system for the market economy . in this country , the work of forming the securities law system has run through the entire process of developing the securities market .
in the main , his lecture dwelt on the purpose of the securities law , the position and role of the securities market , and the basic contents and possible development of the securities law system . opinions and proposals on how to improve the securities law system were also given .
after hearing the lecture , chairman li peng began his speech .
he said : china 's securities market is a product of reform and opening up and a major integral part of the socialist market economy .
based on the practical experience , the report of the 15 th cpc national congress made an explicit proposal to accelerate the development of the market - oriented national economy as well as the development of markets for capital and other production elements .
in the socialist market economy , there must be a securities market . through more than a decade 's development , china 's securities market is in pretty good shape .
li peng continued : a perfect securities market has to be guided and guaranteed by a seamless legal system .
the securities law , examined and adopted by the sixth session of the ninth npc standing committee on 29 december 1998 , is an important economic law in our socialist legal system with chinese characteristics .
under such circumstances , what we should do is to properly deal with development versus standardization , that is , to propel development through standardization .
he said : the npc standing committee should gear up its supervision over the implementation of the securities law and , based on the problems found in such supervision , prompt the departments concerned to earnestly carry out their duties so as to have the securities law implemented more successfully .
personnel of the securities regulatory department should faithfully carry out their duties , work in accordance with the law , and be just and clean . in no way should they take advantage of their posts to seek unjustifiable interests .
the cpc had only some 50 members at its birth 80 years ago and what it faced was a calamity - ridden old china .
eighty years ago , amidst the torrential anti - imperialist and anti - feudal struggle of the people of all ethnic groups of china and in the tempestuous movement of the proletarian revolution in the world , the cpc was founded .
this is the inevitable result of the development of social contradictions and deepening struggle of the people in the modern times of china .
after 1840 , the invasion by western imperialist powers reduced china to the status of a semi - colonial and semi - feudal society and subjected the chinese people to twofold repression by imperialism and feudalism .
the national crisis and social crisis were unprecedentedly grave .
china was then looking forward to a new social force that could find advanced theories leading to a path of salvaging the country and the nation .
it was exactly at that time , in 1917 and 1919 , two major events took place in russia and china , that is , the october revolution in russia and the 4 may movement in china .
the salvoes of the october revolution brought the advanced theory of marxism - leninism to china . starting from the 4 may movement , the chinese working class began to cut a striking figure as an advanced social force in the country .
at the same time , a number of advanced intellectuals held high the banner of democracy and science and opened up a path for disseminating the new ideas and new theories in china .
in 1921 , the cpc emerged just as the times called in the process of applying marxism - leninism in the chinese workers ' movement .
the chinese revolution thus entered a brand new period of development .
in the first 80 - year period , the feudal rulers surrendered the country 's sovereign rights under humiliating terms , the whole society was thrown into utter chaos caused by wars , the country became impoverished and weak and the people lived in hunger and cold .
the comparison of the two periods of 80 years has made the chinese people and all the patriotic forces of the chinese nation fully aware that it is precisely the leadership of the cpc that has enabled the country to materialize the great historical transformation from the most miserable circumstances to a situation that promises a bright future .
the memorable days and glorious achievements of the 80 years of our party leading the people to fight are like a huge picture scroll unfurled before the people of the world , meandering yet full of power and grandeur , vigorous yet bright and colorful .
the chinese have since stood up , and the development of the chinese nation has since ushered in a new era .
we have established a socialist system and realized the most extensive and most profound social transformation in chinese history .
we have creatively materialized the transformation from new democracy to socialism and established the basic system of socialism in an all - round way , enabling this big country in the orient whose population accounts for a quarter of the world total to enter socialist society .
we have created the cause of building socialism with chinese characteristics and started a correct road to the great rejuvenation of the chinese nation .
marked by the third plenary session of the 11 th central committee of the cpc , our country has entered a new period of development of the cause of socialism .
basing ourselves on the long period of socialist construction , we have practiced new policies of reform and opening to the outside world and formulated the basic theory , line and program of our party in the initial stage of socialism after summing up both the internal and external historical experience and through hard exploration .
we have established a state power of people 's democratic dictatorship , with the chinese people being the masters of their own destiny .
it marks china 's realization of a great leap from centuries - old feudalistic autocratic politics to people 's democratic politics .
we have built an independent and relatively complete national economic system , with our economic power and comprehensive national strength enhanced markedly .
it has taken us just a little more than half a century not only to put an end to the backward state of poverty and blankness characteristic of the old china , but also set up a modern industrial system with a complete range of production .
the ideological and ethical standards and the educational , scientific and cultural qualities of the people of the whole country have kept improving , exhibiting to the world a new mental outlook for the chinese people .
the feudalistic segmentation of the country is gone forever in this vast land of china .
the 56 ethnic groups breathe the same air , share the same fate and join their hearts as one , evolving a socialist relationship among all ethnic groups featuring equality , unity and mutual aid .
all political parties and people 's organizations unite as one , help each other and share weal and woe .
all socialist laborers , patriots endorsing socialism and patriots supporting the motherland 's reunification have formed the broadest possible patriotic united front for the reunification and prosperity of the motherland .
the exchanges between compatriots on the two sides of the taiwan straits have been increasing .
the ultimate resolution to the taiwan issue and the accomplishment of the reunification of the motherland are bound to come true .
we have forged a people 's army under the absolute leadership of the party and built a strong national defense .
the people 's liberation army [ pla ] has always upheld the purpose of serving the people whole - heartedly . it has played a major role in consolidating national defense , resisting aggression , safeguarding the socialist system and the peaceful work of the people , and taking part in socialist construction of the country .
our country 's national defense has constantly been enhanced ; steady progress has been made in the drive to build a revolutionary , modern and regular army .
we have adhered to an independent foreign policy of peace , making important contributions to the lofty cause of world peace and development .
the international standing and influence of socialist china are growing with each passing day .
facts have fully proved that the cpc is worthy of a great , glorious and correct marxist political party and that it deserves to be the force at the core that leads the chinese people in the incessant efforts to break new ground .
their meritorious deeds for the motherland will ever be remembered in the annals of history !
the people are the true makers of history .
the practice of the 80 years tells us that it is imperative to always persist in integrating the fundamental principles of marxism - leninism with the specific situation in china , and persist in taking scientific theories as the guide and unswervingly follow our own road .
this is the most essential experience we have drawn from the summing up of our party 's history .
marxism is a powerful ideological weapon for us to understand and transform the world ; it serves as a guide to action in our revolution , construction and reforms .
the two great theoretical achievements constitute marxism that have been localized in china , embodying both the basic principles of marxism - leninism and the splendid thoughts of the chinese nation and the practical experiences of the chinese communists .
it is exactly because we have had marxism - leninism , mao zedong thought and deng xiaoping theory as the guide , that it is possible for our party to lead the people in overcoming all hardships and setbacks and winning one victory after another .
holding high the great banner of deng xiaoping theory , all the comrades in the party are continuing to study new situations and resolve new problems , working to promote creatively and in an all - round manner the great cause of building socialism with chinese characteristics .
the key to upholding marxism - leninism and mao zedong thought in the new historical period lies in persistent use of deng xiaoping theory to observe the present - day world and contemporary china , incessantly sum up practical experience and generalize it in the new theoretical light and open up new ways forward .
the practice of the 80 years also teaches us that we must always consciously strengthen and improve party building , continuously enhance the creativity , rallying power and combat capability of the party , and always maintain the vigor and vitality of the party .
if we are to do china 's affairs well , the key lies in our party .
we must be good at summing up experience , uphold the truth , correct mistakes and be modest and prudent .
correctly understanding and comprehensively implementing the requirements of the " three represents " in the new century , continuing the modernization drive , fulfilling the great cause of the motherland 's reunification , as well as safeguarding world peace and promoting common development are the heavy tasks our party members will undertake .
the contradictions between the productive forces and production relations and between the economic base and the superstructure constitute the basic contradictions in society .
the movement of these contradictions determines the changes in social nature and the direction of social , economic , political , and cultural development .
the fundamental difference between socialism and capitalism lies in the difference between their production relations and superstructures .
the establishment and constant improvement of the socialist system have opened up a broad road for the emancipation and development of china 's productive forces .
all production relations and superstructures , irrespective of their nature , develop with the development of the productive forces .
if they cannot keep up with the development requirement of the productive forces and thus become obstacles to the development of the productive forces and social progress , adjustments and changes will surely take place .
after the founding of new china , we carried out socialist transformation of agriculture and the handicraft industry as well as the capitalist industry and commerce to establish socialist production relations and , on that economic base , bring the socialist superstructure to perfection so as to further emancipate and develop the productive forces .
over the past 20 - plus years , we have conducted bold explorations and practices and pushed forward the reforms in economic and political structures and other areas and greatly emancipated and developed china 's social productive forces , thereby bringing about tremendous changes in national economic development and social progress .
in all historical stages of our socialist society , it is necessary to promote the self - improvement and self - development of the socialist system through reforms in line with the demand of economic and social development . only in this way , will the socialist system remain full of vigor and vitality .
all comrades in the party should firmly implant in mind this basic viewpoint and awareness concerning socialist reform and development .
the development of human society is a historical process of advanced productive forces replacing the backward ones .
socialist modernization must be built on the basis of developed productive forces .
all comrades in the party , no matter what posts they hold , should check and review their work regularly to see whether it conforms to the development requirements of advanced productive forces . if it does , hold on to it without wavering . if it does not , correct it where necessary .
only by doing so , is it possible for communists to give full expression to their advanced nature and to the spirit of the times .
man is the most decisive factor in the productive forces .
the chinese working class , including intellectuals , is the basic force that pushes advanced productive forces forward in china .
the peasant class and other laboring people , closely united with the working class , constitute a major force that pushes china 's productive forces forward .
the future development of science and technology will result in new and major leaps .
emancipating and developing the productive forces will remain our central task for a long time .
we must develop advanced productive forces without letup .
through unremitting efforts , we will constantly improve the socialist relations of production and superstructure and open up a broader thoroughfare for the emancipation and development of the productive forces .
socialist society is a society of comprehensive development and comprehensive progress .
socialist modernization is an undertaking that features mutual supplement and harmonious development of material civilization and spiritual civilization .
in contemporary china , to develop advanced culture is to develop a culture with distinct chinese characteristics and build a socialist spiritual civilization .
that is also the fundamental expression and requirement for our party to remain in the forefront of the times and maintain its advanced nature .
we should persevere in arming the people with scientific theories , guiding the people with correct public opinions , molding the people with noble minds , and inspiring the people with superior works .
we should continue to implement the strategy of invigorating the country through science and education , further popularize education , enhance its quality and the education level of the whole society , and make greater efforts to develop scientific and cultural undertakings .
we should double our efforts to publicize scientific knowledge , scientific approaches , scientific thinking , and scientific spirit .
a vital principle we must follow in developing china 's advanced culture is to emphasize the central theme of the socialist culture , persevere in serving the people and socialism , and let a hundred flowers blossom and a hundred schools of thought contend .
we should work hard to master and develop various kinds of modern means of communication and vigorously promote the spreading of the advanced culture .
we must be aware that people will lack a common objective of struggling and lose the correct code of conduct if we only stress material gains and money to the neglect of ideals and morality .
we should combine the rule of law with the rule of virtue in order to build a lofty ideological and ethical foundation for maintaining a good public order and practice .
the socialist culture has become dominant in china .
we should work hard to remold the backward cultures , prevent and resolutely resist the corrosion to people by decadent cultures and various erroneous ideological concepts , and gradually reduce and root out the soil on which they rely to breed , through improving our policy and system , strengthening education and management , and transforming social traditions .
in developing the socialist culture , we must carry on and develop all the fine cultures , fully reflect the spirit of the times and creativity , and have the world perspective in a bid to enhance our inspiring capacity .
with regard to the rich cultural legacies left over from china 's history of several thousand years , we should select the essence and discard the dross therefrom , and carry forward and develop them in line with the spirit of the times in order to make the past serve the present .
after new china was founded , the party exhorted all its members to remain modest and prudent , guard against conceit and impetuosity , and forever retain the revolutionary spirit of plain living and arduous struggle .
in the new era , the party demands that all its comrades be able to withstand the test of reform , opening up and being in power , lead the people to work assiduously for the realization of socialist modernization .
all this is aimed at continuously accomplishing , safeguarding and developing the fundamental interests of the overwhelming majority of the people through always maintaining the party 's blood - and - flesh contacts with the people .

the communist party of china has identified itself as a political party of the chinese working class ever since its founding and has remained the vanguard of the working class , which has laid a solid class foundation for maintaining its advanced nature .
the quality of the working class has improved markedly in terms of their political awareness , moral standards , scientific and technical and educational level .
our party must remain the vanguard of the working class and unswervingly and wholeheartedly rely on the working class .
our party is a product of integration of marxism - leninism with the chinese workers ' movement .

since china adopted the policy of reform and opening up , the composition of china 's social strata has changed to some extent .
there are , among others , entrepreneurs and technical personnel employed by scientific and technical enterprises of the non - public sector , managerial and technical staff employed by foreign - funded enterprises , the self - employed , private entrepreneurs , employees in intermediaries , and free - lance professionals .
moreover , many people frequently move from one ownership , sector , or place to another , changing their jobs or capacity from time to time .
this trend of development will continue .
they work together with workers , peasants , intellectuals , cadres , and officers and men of the pla . they are also building socialism with chinese characteristics .

although tanaka 's straightforward and outspoken approach has irritated the us on numerous occasions , bush still met with her for several minutes " along the way " during her visit to the white house by way of indicating his " ardent expectations " for the us - japan summit .
site of meeting food for thought nothing is more indicative of bush 's high regard for this summit than the selection of picturesque camp david - - rather than the white house - - as the meeting site .
in years past , president roosevelt and prime minister churchill of britain held wartime summits here , and it was here that president carter brought about the middle east peace treaty .

this is entirely necessitated by the shift in the strategic focus of the us .

washington , 30 june (rmrb) - - japanese prime minister junichiro koizumi arrived at washington d.c. on board a special plane in the afternoon of 29 june .
it was also the first stop of his " big link - up " trip to the united states and europe .
howard baker , who had just been appointed by bush as us ambassador to japan , was also present at the meeting .
in a joint statement issued after the meeting , they announced an initiative called " us - japan economic partnership for growth " aimed at " building a new framework that facilitates bilateral , regional and global cooperation and involvement on trade and economic issues . "
the statement said that japan " is determined to pursue deregulation and economic restructuring in a bid to revitalize the japanese economy " and that the united states will " give japan 's economic reform its full support . "
the statement also said that " prime minister koizumi maintains that there is an urgent need for the two countries to hold high - level official talks to seek a common stance and take joint actions on the issue of climate change , and president bush welcomed the suggestion . "
at the press conference after the talks , bush praised koizumi " as a man who recognizes that his duty is not to avoid , but to lead , " saying that he would give koizumi 's " economic reform agenda " his full support .
koizumi said that in spite of their differences in standpoint on certain issues , he still hoped to hold discussions with the united states on these issues , and he was not " disappointed " by bush 's stance .
the us and japanese heads of states said that they were " willing to hold intense negotiations " on bush 's new nmd plan .
the us side said that this plan was of crucial importance to the maintenance of a balance of power in regional security .
however , koizumi had not clearly indicated his support for bush 's new nmd plan . he just said that he " understood " the stance of the bush administration on this issue .
the united states has been behind the drive to make japan play an important role in global affairs , especially asia - pacific regional affairs , since the end of the cold war .
he regards japan as the core of us policy toward asia and believes that relations with japan , which have been ignored by the clinton administration for eight years , should be strengthened .
after bush announced his new nmd plan on 1 may , koizumi only said that it was a " meaningful study " but did not indicate his position . a us submarine hit and sank a japanese fishing training vessel , killing many people .
this incident no doubt cast shadows on the koizumi - bush meeting .
koizumi even claimed that he was personally " pro - american . "
on security issues , koizumi openly called for the amendment of the existing constitution and the upgrading of the self - defense troops into an armed force capable of carrying out all combat duties .
japanese defense agency director general gen nakatani hinted during his recent trip to the united states that japan would be building its own missile defense system and that the united states and japan would be entering " a new era " of cooperation .

some newly - invested enterprises have become additional money - losing enterprises because of their excess burdens . 3 .
some enterprises have become additional money - losing enterprises because of the drastic changes in the market . 4 .
many existing enterprises have turned into money - losing enterprises . 5 .
some enterprises that had managed to turn around earlier have once again incurred losses and become new money - losing enterprises .
analysis shows that about one - third of the additional money - losing enterprises ' losses are operation losses ; two - thirds are due to non - operational factors .
statistics show that 1,215 enterprises lost less than 5 million yuan ; they accounted for 56.9 percent of the year 2000 's additional money - losing enterprises . of these , 421 enterprises , or 19.7 percent , lost less than 1 million yuan .
these enterprises are borderline enterprises between making and losing money , and this has to do with some of the state 's policy measures that mainly target the heavy losers .
relevant materials show that in countries with a well - developed market economy , the scope of money - losing enterprises generally hovers around 20 percent or more . even among the global 500 enterprises , there is a certain percentage of money - losers every year .
given the increasingly intense competition in the domestic and foreign markets , as some of china 's state enterprises turn things around and begin to make a profit , there are also additional money - losing enterprises , and this is normal and understandable .
the intensifying market competition .
the asian financial crisis has only exacerbated the market supply - demand contradiction .
given the increasingly heated market competition , many enterprises are losing money . 2 .
contradictions and problems that have accumulated over the years are not completely solved .
these contradictions and problems include improper structure , rigid operating mechanism , lack of technological innovation , low management standard , over - abundance of surplus workers , heavy debt burdens , and enterprises ' assumption of the state 's and society 's duties .
this is one of the main reasons for the widespread money - losing state enterprises .
we should adopt realistic measures to solve the problem of the additional money - losing state enterprises . 1 .
among the additional money - losing enterprises , 106 incurred losses of more than 50 million yuan , and although they made up only around 5 percent of the total number of enterprises , they also accounted for a substantial amount of the losses , 55 percent .
at the other end , we should focus on the marginal money - losing enterprises .
many of these enterprises incurred losses of less than 5 million yuan , and although each enterprises ' loss was limited , the number of money - losing enterprises still added up to 1,215 , and the impact was fairly significant .
a couple of years ago , because the money - losing enterprises were entitled to some state and local government tax reductions or exemptions , some enterprises were not eager to make a profit .
we must vigorously dredge the channels for enterprises to exit the market and speed up the inferior enterprises ' bankruptcy and shut - down process .
among the original 1,499 and the 2,135 additional money - losing enterprises , some have no hope of turning things around .
some of these enterprises that should declare bankruptcy must declare bankruptcy and those that should shut down must shut down . allowing them to drag on not only will not be conducive to the continued improvement in the state enterprises ' overall management condition but will trigger other factors of instability .
within the scope of society 's ability to bear , we should speed up their bankruptcy and shut down and eliminate the losses at the source . 4 .

at a lecture the other day at qinghua university , noted chinese economist hu angang stated that " china has now entered the best period of relatively good economic returns and growth since the founding of the country , including since the beginning of reforms . "
the primary manifestation of this is basic macroeconomic stability , i . e . , no fluctuations or inflation .
from 1953 to 1978 , the fluctuation coefficient in the gdp growth rate was as high as 54 percent .
since the beginning of reforms , the fluctuation coefficient in the annual gdp growth rate in china has shown a noticeable drop to 33 percent , of which the rate was 17 percent during the 8 th five - year plan period , dropping to 12 percent during the 9 th five - year plan period .
this shows that , over the past five years , china 's economic growth has basically been without economic fluctuations , while the long - standing problem of instability in economic growth has been effectively resolved and the government 's macroeconomic regulatory capabilities have been enhanced .
in addition , there was a marked improvement in china 's energy efficiency .
in 1997 the asian financial turmoil had an effect on asia and other countries , all of which followed a v - shaped development course , i . e . , the economic growth rate first drops , declining as far as negative growth , then gradually recovers .

hong kong , 4 jul (zts) - - in accordance with an agreement reached between china and the united states , the us ep-3 reconnaissance plane , which had stayed in hainan 's lingshui airport , was disassembles and shipped back to the united states by two russian transports .
at 2000 on 3 september , two an-124 transports of russia 's aeroflot chartered by the united states left china for georgia via the philippines and hawaii . in georgia , the plane will be reassembled at the lockheed martin aircraft company .
thus , the aircraft collision incident that caused a sensation was appropriately settled through peaceful talks .
the reasonable and restrained struggles that the chinese government carried out to protect china 's interests and safeguard china 's territorial sovereignty and national dignity compelled the us government to say that it was " very sorry . "
china and the united states had many sessions of tortuous negotiations on the manner the us spy plane would leave china .
however , china maintained that letting the spy plane " fly back directly " is not a minor " trouble , " but an infringement of china 's sovereignty and dignity . china insisted that the spy plane could not leave china unless it was disassembled .
meanwhile , a chinese foreign minister spokesman also indicated that china had clearly told the united states that the ep-3 plane could not possibly fly back to the united states , and that the us side must act pragmatically and constructively so that the aircraft issue could be properly settled .
an expert on international issues in hong kong analyzed that , according to the international law , china had the right to decide what was the most practical way to return the aircraft to the united states , but the two sides must reach a mutually acceptable agreement through diplomatic negotiations .
analyzing the issue in the context of international strategy , how could the united states guarantee that the reconnaissance plane with sophisticated equipment would not take pictures of important military facilities along the coast and carry out " legal espionage mission " once it was permitted to cross china 's territorial airspace ?
he said chinese vice foreign minister li zhaoxing 's objection is understandable .
the aircraft collision shows that if the united states characterizes china a " specific enemy " or makes china an enemy , it certainly will cause enormous damage to the united states ' international interests .

after the session , long yongtu said to reporters that the session had completed the substantial talks on china 's accession to the wto , being a turning point in the long - drawn - out talks on china 's accession to the wto .
a wto ministerial - level conference to be held in doha , qatar , in november will conduct a voting procedure for approval of china 's accession to the wto , he pointed out .

girard , chairman of the wto working party on china and swiss trade representative , commented on the progress of the 16 th session , saying that the session conducted intense and constructive talks on all important questions and achieved a major breakthrough , being a decisive session on china 's accession to the wto .
members of the working party expressed congratulations one after another on the session 's results and were anticipating the november wto ministerial - level conference 's approval of china 's accession to the organization , so that china will formally become its member as soon as possible .

[ jingji ribao ] the importance of enterprise informationization is well known .
but let 's turn to the reality : the real leading roles of enterprise informationization - - the traditional companies - - still lack enthusiasm for informationization ; less than 20 percent of enterprises have gone on the web , let alone are using the internet to conduct e - commerce .
what do you think the problems are here ? [ liu li , state economic and trade commission information center director ] investigations and studies carried out by the state economic and trade commission showed that the overall level of informationization at chinese companies is low and enterprise informationization moves forward slowly .
i once gave lectures to company ceos from beijing and did a small test on the spot . the test showed less than 10 percent of attendants had their own e - mail addresses and were using the internet daily , and less than 8 percent of the companies had their own domain names and web sites .
i have inspected many companies , and some of them were using computers in their automatic production systems or technical design areas , but they did n't realize the benefit of information technology in improving management efficiencies .
this is the true thinking of many ceos at traditional companies . [ jingji ribao ] since the 21 st century began , chinese companies have been pressed and challenged as the acceleration of economic globalization , the rapid development of information technology and china 's soon - to - be wto membership status constituting the background picture .
in front of the irreversible informationization trend , traditional companies can not afford any more hesitations .
leaders at some companies have realized the importance of informationization and have spent tons of money on acquiring loads of equipment but failed to receive the projected results . instead , they ended up with slowing down informationization significantly .
how would you address this issue ? [ liu li ] first of all , we should understand that enterprise informationization is a complex process because informationization is by no mean a simple equivalent of computerization .
second , we have to admit that presently some it companies are not providing products and services meeting actual application needs of the enterprises .
although the information technology is revolutionary , the vitality of it is at applying the technology , activating and guiding the application market . if it companies depart from practical applications , information technology will then become froth and will not result in real prosperity .
it is most urgent now to speed up informationization at the state 's key enterprises . we should start from working on state key enterprises and big enterprises to set up examples and models for the rest in order to achieve a comprehensive acceleration in chinese enterprise informationization .
as a member of the " enterprise informationization project " expert team , united innovation has always been devoting itself to fully integrating the merit of enterprise management of both eastern and western countries with information technology , and applying the benefits of integration to chinese enterprises to improve its global competitiveness in the information era .
feng rong and his united innovation have set a good example for this .

through efforts , the anti - corruption struggle has been shifting from mainly handling corruption cases and cracking down on criminals involved in these cases to mainly preventing the occurrence of corruption by adopting various measures and perfecting various rules and thus eliminating the root causes of corruption , and has shown a good in - depth development trend .
reporter : in recent years , the party central leadership and the state council have adopted a series of major measures for eliminating the root causes of corruption according to the development of the situation .
these measures had a far - reaching impact on the overall situation of the anti - corruption struggle , and aroused close attention from the general public .
under the correct leadership of the party central committee , the state council , and the central military commission , the work in this regard was advanced smoothly . in march 2000 , all business activities of these units and institutions were completely stopped , and the objective was achieved on time .
the work of establishing a visible construction market has been advancing continuously in depth .
in the 31 provinces ( autonomous regions and municipalities ) , the work of reforming the administrative examination and approval system has been started , and in many provinces , the screening of province - level projects for administrative examination and approval has been completed .
in the areas where the screening of the projects subject to administrative examination and approval was basically completed , in general , about 30 percent of such projects were freed from examination and approval ; in some areas , the proportion was as high was 60 percent .
projects that are still subject to administrative examination and approval have also been regularized .
in the field of cadre and personnel appointments , such measures as democratic recommendation , democratic assessment , leading cadres ' pre - appointment pledges , and competitive job placements have all been extensively adopted .
the system of appointing accountants has been adopted by 257 prefectures ( cities ) and 1,029 counties ( districts ) in 31 provinces ( autonomous regions and municipalities ) on a trial basis .
the work of removing the institutional factors that may cause corruption should be closely combined with the three anti - corruption tasks so that both sides can promote each other .
the reform of the cadre and personnel system should be carried on . cadre appointments should be made more democratic , open , and competitive . unhealthy practice and corrupt phenomena in this field must be better overcome .
at the same time , this should be properly integrated with the formulation of relevant laws and regulations .
after the adoption of new policies , effective inspection and guidance must be followed to guarantee their implementation . attention should be paid to various deviations in the practice work of implementing the policies in various areas . guidance should be given in a more pertinent way to solve problems of different types .
it is necessary to formulate concrete standards and strength supervision and inspection .

on the evening of 2 july , the japanese ministry of foreign affairs sent a note to the united states requesting that the us military turn over a 24 - year - old airman who was a suspect in a rape case .
the unbroken succession of sex crimes by the us military on okinawa has once again provoked the anger of the japanese public .
when the woman entered a nearby parking lot and prepared to start her car , a us serviceman threw himself on her and raped her .
after receiving the alarm , the okinawan police began to investigate the incident . based on the license plate number that was reported , they determined that the car belonged to the us military stationed on okinawa .
furthermore , based on that they confirmed that on the day in question three us servicemen had fled the scene in a car .
a technical inspection by police identified the fingerprints of the us serviceman and those of the victim on the car at the scene .
why have the us and japanese sides still not arrested a suspect five days after the incident occurred ?
according to an analysis by the host of a japanese television program , since the japan - us summit was being held on 30 june , it was only because neither side wanted the case to affect the atmosphere at the summit that the investigation and arrest were delayed .
for many years there has been a succession of arson , rape , and other such cases caused by us troops stationed in japan , which has had a tremendous impact on local social order and the lives of the people .
japan is constrained in the arrest of us military criminal suspects by the " japan - us status of forces agreement , " and often little progress is made .
on the 2 nd , okinawan prefectural governor keiichi inamine issued a protest statement , pointing out that this is yet another crime which tramples on human rights , illustrating the fact that the us military has basically learned no lessons from the past .

only when they were compelled by the pressure from the international community did the united states and britain put forward a proposal , not long ago , for lifting the embargo on food , daily necessities , and medicines against iraq .
the " smart sanction " plan did not cancel the limitation on the export of petroleum , so iraq 's source of wealth has not been opened .
although there are no shortages of food , daily necessities , and medicines in the international markets , yet the purse of the iraqi government was empty . it has no money to buy them .
even if iraq is allowed to double its oil export , the money earned will be far from meeting the masses of people 's minimum requirements for their daily life .

at that time , the world 's oil price was maintained at between $ 18 to $ 20 per barrel .
although iraq 's current volume of oil export accounts only for a small proportion of the world market , yet it still has some impact .
the iraqi government recently announced that if the un security council adopts the " smart sanction " program , iraq would cease oil export completely .
it is also very important .
the " smart sanction " program is not a smart move for solving the conflict between palestine and israel at an early date and , next , to stabilize the middle east .
palestine and iraq are members of the islamic world .
the international community should not regard this move of iraq as a trifling matter .
after suffering from the hardships brought about by the punishing war , they have again lost the condition for minimum subsistence .
under the present situation , any proposal should not aim at indefinitely lengthening the period of sanctions against iraq , but should aim at fining a way to break the impasse so as to resolve the iraqi issue in an all - round way at an early date .

beijing , 5 jul (zxs) - - as of this year , the reform of chinese telecommunications can be called storm after storm . in particular , at this time when china is achieving breakthrough progress in the form of joining the wto , china 's telecommunications industry is in the state of being overshadowed by foreign investment .
how to achieve a strategic breakout from the encirclement so as to facilitate seizing the decisive high ground of the future has become an unavoidable matter of life and death for china 's entire telecommunications industry .
although there is still doubt about whether or not policy adjustments will actually allow consumers to secure real benefits , and although the shadow of monopoly has still not completely disappeared , telecommunications in china has already begun a real industrial transformation . it is now seeking a more amiable image with which to attract more consumers .
it is just as ministry of information industry vice minister zhang chunjiang has pointed out , the core of china 's current telecommunications policy is still to bring in competition and knock down the monopoly , and to truly embody the interests of the masses of the people .
although people may not hold too much hope regarding railway communications ' ability to compete with china telecom in the area of fixed telephones in the near future , a " song and dance duet " always sparks people 's imagination more than a " one - man show . "
china unicom , a participant in the competition in the area of mobile communications , now has over 30 million subscribers and holds 24 percent of the market . china unicom exerts huge and long - lasting competitive pressure against china mobile , a sign which is very encouraging to consumers .
however , china 's telecommunications industry still has a long road to travel if it hopes to have the enduring good will of chinese consumers .
one problem is how to restore consumer confidence in the chinese telecommunications industry . quite a few consumers feel cheated over the new fee standards , implementation of which began in the first quarter of this year , and feelings of dissatisfaction are growing .
if this is the way it is , as soon as chinese telecommunications in its entirety goes public on a foreign market , will possible future fee reorganization plans give priority of consideration to the interests of foreign investors , and thus directly or indirectly harm the interests of china 's nearly 100 million fixed telephone subscribers ?
the speed at which china 's telecommunications industry is growing attracts widespread attention . but it is just now when telecommunications policy reforms are rowing into the main current that the industry faces more dangers . the description " before your eyes are fresh flowers , beneath your feet are thorns " is certainly not inappropriate .

after friendly consultation , china and britain decided to cooperate in studying climate change and its influence on china 's agriculture .

the joint project , which is to be undertaken by the chinese academy of agricultural sciences , will focus on climate change and agricultural environment in north china and northeast china . china and britain will also establish academic cooperation and an exchange mechanism between their scientists .
environmental experts have pointed out that global climate changes may produce irreversible changes to the existence and ecological environment of various countries and bring unprecedented disasters to mankind .
the united nations framework convention on climate change , which has been in force since 1994 , calls on the international community to take action and adopt measures to protect the atmosphere and ecological environment .

personal income tax policies established by local governments acting beyond their authority are to be straightened out by local taxation organs before they are submitted to local governments for correction by the end of july this year .
recently the state administration of taxation issued " provisional regulations on administrative punishment for a number of problems involving violations by tax personnel of regulations and discipline regarding taxation , " so as to strengthen the buildup of a corps of taxation cadres and standardize implementation of the law on tax collection .
applying a forgery prevention certificate to an enterprise 's reported value added tax special use receipt deduction copy and thereby effecting deduction without authorization will be punished with action from demotion to dismissal from office .
violation of joint examination regulations , not issuing or returning letters , or providing false return letters , will be punished with action from the recording of a major demerit to discharge .
recently , the state administration of taxation issued a notice requiring the strengthening of the management of the collection of value added tax from commercial trading enterprises .
the notice stipulates that an enterprise applying for registration to handle tax affairs must provide the taxation registration organization certificates and information regarding such things as the enterprise 's operating permit , registered capital , bank account number verification , identity verification , property rights verification for buildings , and rental contract for buildings .
the notice also specifies that larger commercial trading enterprises applying for registration who will use a greater number of value added tax special receipts should apply for approval at the district or city level tax affairs organization , and then notify the area or county level tax organization 's registration department of the results of the application .
after adjustment of the number and restriction on the amount of the special use receipts , the registration department forwards the relevant data and electronic information to the receipts and shipping department .

engles used to say that we should hold a scientific attitude towards marxism .
" since the time when socialism became a science , " he said , " it has needed to be treated as a science .
our theory is one that develops instead of a doctrine that one must fluently recite and mechanically use . "
he also said , " we should apply these fundamental principles in the reality consistently in light of the current historical condition , as the ' manifesto of the communist party ' says . "
everyone that regards marxism as a science will certainly hold such a scientific attitude towards marxism .
the practice shows that the development is the extension and guarantee for the adherence and that adherence without the development will be baseless empty talk .
however , we must understand that this study is still at the initial level , with existing understanding , detailed practice , extensiveness and profoundness being inadequate .

on 29 june , milosevic , former president of the yugoslav republic of serbia , was escorted onto a plane and handed over to the international criminal tribunal for former yugoslavia [ icty ] in the hague , to be tried for " crimes against humanity . "
the united states and britain and other western countries can be said to have racked their brains and resorted to all kinds of tricks since the end of the kosovo war to bring milosevic for trial before the tribunal . why are the united states , britain , and others so fixated on milosevic ?
as everyone knows , yugoslavia was the biggest obstacle to nato 's eastward expansion .
arresting and trying milosevic is intended to warn the leaders of other states that refuse to obey : you will be overthrown if you dare resist !
that is the first point .
at the same time , arresting and trying milosevic is also the requirement of the west in seeking to gain the diplomatic initiative and world opinion .
the full name of the icty is " the international tribunal for prosecuting persons responsible for serious violations of international humanitarian law committed in the territory of the former yugoslavia since 1991 . "
according to the relevant provisions of the un charter , un members should cooperate and help each other to implement the methods decided by the security council .
legally speaking , therefore , establishing the icty was a un move , and all un members are obligated to support it .
as an international criminal judicial organ , however , the icty 's independence and impartiality are extremely important .
the icty should not suffer international political or other interference , and still less can it become a political tool .
the authority of the icty can only be ensured by preserving its independence and impartiality .
and only thus can the icty 's work withstand the test of history .
russian communist party central committee chairman zyuganov has pointed out that handing over milosevic to the icty is equivalent to those who played with fire in the balkans prosecuting a statesman who defended the sovereignty and national interests of the yugoslav federation .
russia state duma speaker seleznev for his part holds that the hague international tribunal is a court that is trying nato .
he points out that nato units actually " saved " albanian terrorism , and this is the double - standard policy pursued by nato .
international opinion also holds that the extradition of milosevic is the start of weakening the state regime of the yugoslav federation .
according to reports , recently japan 's defense agency issued a guide for the conduct of research and development .
the publication of this guide indicates that from now on japan will focus on the development of new military technologies , and use this to push japan 's military development to a new height , in a further attempt to gain military technological superiority .
according to an essay by andrey kabanov in the russian newspaper nezavisimaya gazeta , in the 25 years after the end of the war the united states sold japan 32,000 items of military technology with a total value of $ 900 million .
japan always refused the us demand , citing its " three principles on the export of weapons . "
on the one hand , japan emphasizes independent development of military technology . on the other hand , it places great emphasis on cooperating with united states in developing military technology .
after clinton 's visit to japan in 1996 , japan and the united states regarded cooperation on military technology as an important component of their military cooperation .
in 1997 , ishikawajima - harima heavy industries company and three american composite materials factories including sparta , inc. , reached agreement on joint research of missile structural materials and other advanced composite materials which can be put to military uses . the japanese and american sides each bore half the cost of the research .
this was the first joint cooperation on the research of military technology between japanese and american civilian enterprises .
from the above situation it can be seen that japan has already accomplished a leap in its own military technology through independent development and through cooperative development .
the newly published guide was drafted against the background of the high tide in the worldwide revolution in information technology .
to produce this guide , as of this year japan has prepared the ground in a few places .
early this year , japan 's defense agency decided to cooperate with the ministry of the economy and industry [ as published ] , which is in charge of military industries , to take military technologies which have already been researched and development and transfer them free of charge to civilian enterprises for their use .
in april , the defense agency decided further that from now on the focus of research and development on military technologies would be in areas such as information technology and robot technology , and the defense agency is preparing to include this in the budget for 2002 .
the defense agency also indicated that from now on it would take specific measures to convert military technologies to civilian use , and apply civilian technologies in military equipment , thus allowing both military and civilian technologies to play greater roles .

trade disputes between china and japan have heated up in recent months .
after the japanese side refused to admit its error after several rounds of negotiations , the chinese side decided to add a 100 - percent special tariff on automobiles , mobile and vehicle - based phones , and air - conditioners originally produced in japan from 22 june .
after china became serious , japan panicked and accepted the chinese side 's suggestion for negotiations .
this dispute is completely stirred up by the japanese side .
it is because of this reason that japanese enterprises have shifted the production of the three products to china and exported them to japan .
meanwhile , if the chinese side does not hit back , japan will reach out for a yard after taking an inch . this will create a chain reaction . this is because a dozen or more traders in japan have forwarded or will forward a similar " emergency curb " request against china to their government .
it seems that japan is superficially protecting the interests of some farmers by stirring up the trade disputes . in reality , it is a tactic to shift domestic crisis to other areas .
first , the japanese economy has been struggling on the edge of a recession over the past decade .
to shake off the dilemma , the japanese government did not hesitate to apply trade protectionism to create outside frictions .
second , japan will hold an upper house election this month and voters for the ruling liberal democratic party [ ldp ] mainly live in the rural areas .
first , japan has practiced discrimination against a country when investigating farm product imports , which violated the non - discrimination principle .
more than 90 percent of the three farm products selected by the japanese side are from china . but , it did not investigate the sharp increase of farm product import such as tomatoes , green peppers , cauliflower , and onions from other wto member nations .
this shows that japan practices discrimination against chinese agricultural products .
second , the " agreement on safeguards " of the wto clearly specifies the conditions for applying the safeguard measure by a country .
some japanese experts feel that the main reason for the rapid increase of china 's farm product exports to japan is the superiority of chinese product competitiveness , and not because of low - priced dumping by china .
it does not bring economic prosperity to japan 's agriculture by imposing the import curbs . however , it does harm the interests of the vast consumers .
third , according to stipulations , japan should issue reasonable public notices to all interested parties in its investigations so that other interested parties could present their views as to whether or not the application of a safeguard measure would be in the public interest .
criticisms and accusations against the government within japan have risen one after another .
heizo takenaka , state minister in charge of economic and fiscal policy , said : " we face retaliation by the other side because we adopted the safeguard measure . "
japan 's automobile enterprises are worried that if the disputes drag on without settlement , the commanding rights of japanese products in the chinese market will be replaced by products of other countries .
" kobe news " and other media have asked the government to consider the issue calmly and try to explore ways for settling the disputes .
now , the " ball " is on the japanese side . only when the japanese government looks into the long term and overall situation , abandons imagination , changes to a new way , and abolishes the emergency import curb can the disputes be settled at an early date .
now , china 's agriculture has entered a new stage of development .
in the central region , agricultural restructuring should center on quality improvement and specialization .
it is imperative to give full play to the region 's comparative advantages with respect to grain , cotton , and canola production , break with the practice of indiscriminately seeking high output , introduce fine crop strains , and make ceaseless efforts to improve the quality of products and raise the efficiency of production .
meanwhile , attention should be paid to " two transformations , " i . e . the transformation of animal husbandry into a livestock - breeding industry and the transformation of farm produce into processed products .
in addition , because of its resource advantage , the central region should attract leading industrial enterprises in eastern coastal areas to come to make investment , either in setting up manufacturing plants or in building production bases to supply raw materials to meet their production needs .
the western region should seize the opportunity of developing the west and exploit every favorable factor to develop characteristic agriculture , ecological agriculture , and tourist agriculture . above all , it should take an active part in the nation 's large - scale west development projects so as to acquire more job opportunities for its rural people .
farmers should adjust their production structure from time to time in light of the change in market demand . they should not indiscriminately follow the steps of others by planting whatever crops that others plant .
in particular , we are quite short of arable land and water sources . after joining the wto , we should make all - out efforts to develop labor - and technology - intensive agriculture and gradually reduce the production of resource - intensive products , which takes up more land and uses more water .
fourth , we should respect the will of farmers , give them full freedom in making plans , and bring their creativity and initiative into full play .
in agricultural restructuring , the role of the government is to guide farmers , provide them with various services , and create a favorable external environment for them .
in no way should the government issue compulsory orders or make every arrangement for them . to do so would not only cause irrecoverable economic losses to farmers and seriously dampen their initiative , but also impair the image of the party and government in rural areas . fifth , there should be truly feasible measures for agricultural restructuring .
examples are assisting farmers in building small and medium - sized agricultural infrastructure projects ( roads , irrigation facilities , and electric power installations ) , establishing and perfecting the market system for agricultural products , speeding up the formation of the product quality examination and monitoring system , and obtaining supply of fine crop seeds .
in addition , central and local financial departments should set aside some funds for supporting farmers ' endeavor of restructuring agriculture and developing quality agricultural products .
only by properly using this surplus labor through the development of non - agricultural undertakings and the urbanization of rural areas , is it possible to provide enough space for agricultural restructuring and create a favorable environment for increasing farmers ' income .

should they be needed , japan could produce atomic and hydrogen bombs within 3 to 6 months , and within a year , could produce 1,000 - 2,000 medium - range and long - range missiles .
if it were permitted to export munitions , japan would control 60 percent of the market for naval vessels , 40 percent of the market for military electronics , 46 percent of the military vehicles and 25 - 30 percent of the aviation market .

and what do you think of this conclusion ?
li daguang ( associate professor in the sci - tech and facilities office of the national defense university ) : from japan 's military build - up of the past several years , it obviously has most of the conditions for forming a powerful , modernized military force .
to increase its military power , japan 's military spending has risen every year .
according to data provided by the uk 's " jane 's defense weekly " , and the international institute for strategic studies in london , japan 's military spending since 1993 has surpassed that of england , france and germany , making it second among the world 's powers in military spending .
at present , japan has 1,160 army tanks , 15 submarines , 62 surface warships , 100 p-3 antisubmarine planes , 170 f-15 fighters and 110 f-4 fighters .
as for the " few important conditions it still lacks , " my analysis of this indicates that besides the directive political conditions , they principally need nuclear weapons , strategic offensive weapons and long - range , large - scale transport facilities .
estimates in this area are that japan has a stockpile of nuclear materials sufficient to manufacture 1,000 " hiroshima class " atomic bombs .
should they be needed , japan could produce atomic and hydrogen bombs within 3 to 6 months , and within a year could produce 1,000 - 2,000 medium - range and long - range missiles .
so i ask you : from the standpoint of technology , what are the weapons japan cannot produce ?
and , what weapons do they not have now , but could turn out quickly in a short period of time ?
tan kaijia ( associate professor in the sci - tech and facilities office of the national defense university ) : the development of japanese military technology really does have a strong momentum , but actually , japan 's military technology capability was displayed during the 1991 gulf war .
at that time , the us press reported that without japanese electronic products , the us ' accurate guided missile weaponry would lack the means of making accurate strikes .
according to these reports , 70 percent of the electronic instruments in the us guided missiles were japanese - produced .
japan is not only strong in numerous areas of military technology , they lead the world .
for example , in the microelectronics field referred to earlier , even the us acknowledges its inferiority .
and microelectronics technology is fundamental to information technology , communications technology , electronic computer technology , even various fields of military technology .
in the field of new materials , japan has many superior products , for example in the newly emerging field of nanotechnology , japan has taken the world lead in the fields of nanoelectronic materials and nanocomposite materials .
from the technology angle , japan can produce practically any kind of high - tech weaponry that exists .
the most advanced japanese industrial technology is now being applied constantly to military fields .
as it commented on the matter , " the time when japanese military technology surpasses that of the us has already arrived . "
from combat aircraft to warships , japan designed and manufactures 95 percent of the ceramic parts used in the electronic equipment installed in the us ' most sophisticated weaponry .
li daguang : yes , japan has no military industry enterprises . its production of weapons and equipment are entrusted completely to civilian enterprises , and the larger civilian enterprises all have departments which specialize in production of military industrial products .
the japanese government has given considerable attention to fostering civilian enterprises which are capable of major military industrial production , and in placing orders for military goods it has also paid attention to balancing development among enterprises .
tan kaijia : japan 's civil aviation and shipping industries are really strong , and with adequate military funding support it could in wartime convert its production to make japan 's actual strength several times what it is , even more than 10 times .
it is estimated that in wartime there could rapidly be a 10 - fold increase in the number of aircraft in japan 's air self - defense force .
while there are only 3 plants in japan which can produce tanks , if a portion of the automobile plants were converted to producing tanks , they could turn out 10,000 annually . if 30 percent of the automobile industry 's capacity was applied to manufacturing aircraft , the annual output could exceed 10,000 aircraft .
moderator : how many people does japan have in its national self - defense forces , and how far are they from meeting the armed forces ' requirements of " strong and modernized " ?
should war break out , japan would have many military manpower resources .
japan currently has 479,000 people in its reserve forces , of which 460,000 are in the land self - defense force , 1,100 in the naval self - defense force , 800 in the air self - defense force , and 4,889 people in the rapid reaction reserve force .
for historical reasons , japan cannot maintain a large standing army on active duty , and this causes japan to concentrate more than other nations on building up its reserve forces .
in the students ' training there is simulated armed forces promotion , from enlisted personnel and ncos to officers , and they generally have to go through more than 10 promotional and course completion exams .
those whose simulated promotion takes them from the lower ranks to that of an officer candidate , each promoted one level , must all undergo testing before they can enter a military school to study the appropriate curriculum .
tan kaijia : japan 's current population is 125 million .
during world war ii , its active duty armed forces were calculated as being 13.2 percent of the population . so in a future war , japan could have over 16 million people under arms .
naturally , we realize that the ongoing development and renewal of military technology and methods of making war mean that japan can not and need not mobilize so many troops .
however , the speed of mobilization can be greater than it was in world war ii .
in short , when it comes to converting potential for warfare into actual military strength , regardless of whether it be mechanics , or manpower reserves and reserves of goods and materials , all are relatively advanced and abundant .
therefore we can say that should war break out , japan would be a military power not to be underestimated .

this action had a negative effect on the development of sino - japanese relations .
in recent years , japan has strengthened military cooperation with the us , formulating the " surrounding situation law " to intervene in the " surrounding situation , " all of which have the aforementioned as their goals .
but japan really does not feel satisfied , and to go a step further in achieving the foregoing goals , they have made revision of the constitution and the exercise of the right of collective self - defense their new targets .
playing up the " china threat " in order to achieve this goal is precisely what japan 's new scheme is .
to put it bluntly , the so - called exercise of the right of collective self - defense means that they want to go overseas with the us and other countries and intervene militarily .
japan had a plan to revise the constitution over a 10 - year period so they could exercise the right of collective self - defense , but now they are figuring on moving up this time frame considerably , that is , achieving their goal in three to five years .
some senior individuals in japan believe that , even if the constitution is not revised , they can still exercise the right of collective defense .
obviously , to carry out this scheme , japan will look for more pretexts from china in the days to come ( especially with regard to the taiwan issue ) .
china has implemented an active defense strategy all along in order to develop its military forces on an appropriate scale , and all our military activities always take place within the scope permissible under international law .
as for military deployment targeting the taiwan issue , this is purely an internal political matter for china , with the intent being to strike a blow at the flames of the forces for " taiwan independence " and keep taiwan from splitting from china .

beijing , 11 jul ( xinhua ) - - in a special nationwide operation to revamp " internet cafes " and other internet service sites , public security organs across the country waged battles together with the relevant local departments and achieved notable results .
according to incomplete statistics , public security organs have checked nearly 78,000 " internet cafes " in total , dealt with and punished 14,000 illegal or irregular " internet cafes " in accordance with the law , ordered 9,579 " internet cafes " to make rectifications , suspended 2,494 cafes , and shut down 2,337 cafes .
it was learned that the phenomenon of unlicensed , illegal , or irregular operations is a relatively prominent problem among " internet cafes " at present .
of all " internet cafes " in the country , 30.6 percent operate either without a license or a complete license . in some localities , the figure is as high as 50 percent or more . there are also cases of " internet cafes " being used as video game parlors .

beijing , 11 jul ( xinhua ) - - the state council information office held a news conference today . wang yang , vice minister of the state development planning commission , expounded on the recently released list of prices to be determined by the central government , and answered questions raised by chinese and foreign reporters .
wang yang said : compared to the 1992 list of government - set prices , the current list of prices to be determined by the central government excludes the prices of 107 types of commodities and services , which are to be completely liberalized .
the types of commodities and services subject to pricing by the department in charge of pricing under the state council and by relevant departments will number 13 , down from 141 .
wang yang said : under the planned market system , virtually all the commodity prices were determined by the government .
it will pay special attention to exercising control over those prices that are monopolistic in nature , have a bearing on the vital interests of the public , are attended by contradictions in various sectors , and are difficult to reform .
in the near future , the state development planning commission will also promulgate the " interim measures for public hearings on government pricing policies , " with a view to introducing a more scientific and transparent government pricing process .
in addition , it calls for the liberalization of prices for commodities and services for which there is full market competition , and forbids the introduction of lists of locally determined prices .
to prevent local governments from expanding their price - setting authority , all lists of locally determined prices - - after being reviewed and endorsed by provincial people 's governments - - must be submitted to the state council department in charge of pricing for examination and approval .
another reporter asked whether the inclusion of cotton prices on the new list of prices to be determined by the central government signifies a rejection of the existing reform measures that were introduced in china in 1999 to liberalize cotton market prices .
in response to a reporter 's question as to why basic telecommunications services are to be retained within the scope of government pricing , wang yang said : china 's basic telecommunications sector is not yet in a state of full competition .
the playing field is not level for different competitors in certain services where competition has just made inroads .
under these circumstances , any market economy , and not just china , needs to implement government pricing in order to ensure fair competition .
wang yang also answered questions raised by reporters regarding the basic considerations in drawing up the list of prices to be determined by the central government , the reasons for retaining certain government - set prices , measures for stopping dumping and monopoly practices , and the reform of electricity rates .
wang guoqing , deputy director of the state council information office , chaired today 's news conference . more than 80 reporters from chinese and foreign media organizations attended the news conference .

recently the state development planning commission has published a revised catalogue of prices set by the central authorities , which reflects another drastic cut of the number of commodities and services whose prices are subject to state approval .
explaining this drastic price decontrol , wang yang , vice minister in charge of the state development planing commission , said : only less control can be better control .
at that time , even the prices for matches , candy , cakes , basins , soy sauce , vegetables , radios , watches , and bicycles were set by the state .
in fact , this kind of practice did play a role in maintaining social stability and developing the economy in the early days after the founding of new china when there was a scarcity of goods and materials .
as a matter of fact , the twists and turns we have experienced in developing the economy has shown that too much control cannot give a good result .
when a price was decontrolled , economic activities in that area were invigorated .
on the contrary , the purpose of reducing control is to achieve better control . this is because less control will make it possible to save energy for the work that must be done .
this is not only in line with the law of economic development , but conforms to the trend of economic globalization .
the 13 items listed in the new controlled - price catalogue are all commodities and services that are monopolistic in nature and closely related to the vital interests of the masses . all have price - related problems of one kind or another , and it is hard to institute a price reform for them .
decontrolling the prices of other commodities and services that can compete freely in the market will enable the authorities to concentrate on managing these particular prices , which are monopolistic and closely related to the public , thus protecting the interests of the masses from being hurt by the prices .
when conditions are ripe , some of these prices can be decontrolled .
after doing away with unnecessary price control , the government department in charge of price management can spend more energy in these areas of work .

washington , 14 jul ( xinhua ) - - the us defense department on 13 july announced that the united states would increase the number of missile defense system tests from now on in a bid to deploy , before 2008 , a missile defense system that would be able to play a role .
lieutenant general kadish , director of the defense department 's missile defense office , said at a briefing on the dame day that he planned to carry out a major missile defense test once every two months from now on , or about four to six tests a year , including sea - based and land - based tests .
each test would cost about $ 100 million , but the cost of each test would drop following the increase in the number of tests .
kadish said the united states planned to build a series of facilities for missile defense tests for the defense department to test different missile defense technologies .
kadish claimed that the success or failure of the missile intercepting technology test on 14 july was not the main thing .
he said : " this is only a test in a series of tests .
if it fails , we can learn many things from the test . "
the us military has conducted three nmd missile intercepting technology tests . the test was successful , but the following two tests failed .
former president clinton decided in september last year not to authorize the deployment of this system on a temporary basis .
after he assumed office in january this year , bush indicated the united states would break with the anti - ballistic missile treaty , expand the area covered by a missile defense system in order to protect not the united states but also us allies .
this proposition has met with universal opposition and resistance from the international community , including the united states ' european allies .
