bonn , 14 jul ( xinhua ) - - bonn , the former german capital , which has been a quiet place for a long time now , has sprung to life again in the past two days .
several thousand delegates from more than 180 countries and regions will resume the sixth conference of parties to the " un framework convention on climate change " on 19 july , and the informal pre - conference consultations are already under way .
this conference will have a bearing on whether the kyoto protocol can finally come into effect , hence it is attracting widespread attention in international opinion .
the threat to the human environment caused by greenhouse gases is well known , but since the parties to the " framework convention " signed the " kyoto protocol " in 1997 , not one of the developed countries , which account for 70 percent of greenhouse gas emission , has ratified it .
so far , however , the developed countries have argued endlessly over how to implement the reduced emission targets laid down in the protocol .
the international community has universally condemned the united states for going back on its word .
this is because according to the relevant provisions of the agreement , the protocol can only come into effect if the total greenhouse gas emissions of countries ratifying it is no less than 55 percent of the emissions of all developed countries .
at present , the united states , the eu , and japan respectively account for 36.1 percent , 24.2 percent , and 8.5 percent of the total emission of developed countries .
given that the united states is not participating , the " kyoto protocol " can only come into effect if is ratified by the eu countries , east europe , the countries of the former soviet union , and japan .
so far , however , japan has never specifically supported the eu stance .
the us and japanese attitude has caused considerable pessimism in public opinion over the prospects for implementing the " kyoto protocol . "
the parties to the convention , however , are still making efforts and hoping that some substantive progress can be made at the meeting over the question of reducing greenhouse gas emissions .
they point out that carbon dioxide and other greenhouse gases are still increasing in the atmosphere even as the parties concerned are endlessly arguing about reducing greenhouse gases .
the more the developed countries delay implementation of the " kyoto protocol , " the more difficult it is to resolve the problem of global climate change .
hence , people are appealing to the developed countries to act with sincerity and boldness at the bonn conference , and take a substantive step toward the goal of reducing greenhouse gases .

over the last 10 years , the sino - russian relations have undergone three development stages , the cooperation between the two countries in all fields has been gradually developing in a thorough - going manner , and a strategic cooperation relationship has been established .
on the 15 th of this month , the chinese state president jiang zemin paid a visit to moscow to meet russian president putin and sign a " sino - russian treaty on good - neighborliness , friendship , and cooperation , " thus opening a new chapter in the annals of relations between china and russia .
development has undergone three stages since the independence of russia , the bilateral relations between china and russia have undergone three development stages .
the first stage was from december 1991 to september 1994 , in which the nature of the bilateral relationship was to regard the other as a friendly country .
meanwhile , a chinese government delegation headed by li lanqing , minister of the ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation , and tian zengpei , vice minister of the ministry of foreign affairs , paid a visit to moscow .
through the above - mentioned visits and meetings , the two sides reached common views on a series of important issues and the relations between the two countries had a smooth transition from sino - soviet relations to sino - russian relations .
during this stage , the two countries established the " constructive partnership relationship . "
in early september of 1994 , chinese state president jiang zemin paid a visit to moscow , which was the first visit by a chinese head of state to moscow since the independence of russia .
the establishment of the constructive partnership relationship has indicated that the relations between china and russia have further developed on the basis of regarding each other as a friendly country .
the third stage for the development of the sino - russian relations began in april 1996 .
it has extended to the present stage of today in which the two countries of china and russia have established a strategic cooperation relationship .
the contacts between various military services and the adjacent military regions of china and russia are also many and varied and the cooperation of military technology in many fields is also increasing . " on the issue of taiwan , the russian government has strictly abided by the standpoint of not developing political relations with taiwan .
on 15 september 1992 , president yeltsin signed a presidential decree on the relationship between russia and taiwan to clearly recognize the people 's republic of china to be the only legitimate government of china , taiwan to be part of china , and russia not to develop governmental relations with taiwan .
because the governments of the two countries exercised effective leadership and organization over the economic and trade cooperation between the two countries , a series of changes have taken place in the trade patterns , contents , and subjects of the two sides .
and the emergence of these transformations has made the necessary preparations for the future cooperation between the two countries on a larger scale and deeper level .
on 31 december 1999 , president yeltsin of the russian federation suddenly announced his resignation and meanwhile appointed putin who was serving as the prime minister of the russian government at that time to be the acting president , which put an end to the yeltsin era in the annals of relations between china and russia .
in 2000 , the three levels of the strategic cooperation between china and russia , namely the fields of global issues , regional issues , and bilateral cooperation , have all made important headway .
for example , after the resolution was put forth in november 1999 , in october 2000 china and russia allied themselves with more than 20 countries to once again submit a bill to the security council of the united nations on opposing violations of the " antiballistic missile treaty " and safeguarding the strategic stability of the entire world .
in the field of regional issues , the two sides emphasized the adoption of active and effective measures to crack down on national splittist , international terrorist , religious extremist , and transnational criminal activities .
it has been reported that the two sides reached an agreement through an exchange of letters on 27 june in beijing .
the " sino - indian consular treaty , " which was signed in new delhi on 13 december 1991 , went into effect on 30 october 1992 .
to date , china has signed bilateral consular treaties or agreements with 40 countries .
the other three sino - foreign consular treaties or agreements signed before hong kong 's handover on 1 july 1997 and macao 's handover on 20 december 1999 , will also apply to the hong kong sar .
second delivery of 24 su-30 fighter planes from russia arrived in shandong 's jinan in early july and will be assigned to the 16 th division of the air force under the nanjing military region this autumn .

beijing , 16 jul ( xinhua ) - - a national cotton work meeting was held in beijing recently .
the state council 's main purpose of convening this meeting was to implement the guidelines of the fifth plenary session of the 15 th party central committee and the central economic work conference and to deliberate and map out the further deepening of structural reform in cotton circulation and the 2001 cotton work .
wen jiabao , member of the political bureau of the cpc central committee and vice premier of the state council , attended the meeting and made an important speech on behalf of the state council .
all localities and departments earnestly implemented the state council 's string of policies and measures for structural reform in cotton circulation , doing a lot of work and achieving some success .
the channel of cotton operations has been gradually broadened , cotton buying and selling prices formed through the market , and the state 's overall regulation and control of the cotton market further enhanced .
this has played an important role in guiding cotton production , stabilizing cotton prices , protecting the farmers ' interests , and supporting the textile industry 's development .
further deepening the cotton circulation structural reform not only is necessary , but also has met with quite an opportune moment and ripe conditions .
the basic line of thought and major contents of deepening the cotton circulation structural reform can be summarized as : to lift the control over a matter , to bring about two separations , to strengthen three things , and to follow the path of industrialized operation .
to lift the control over a matter means to decontrol cotton procurement to break up monopolistic operations .
this is the core of this round of cotton circulation structural reform as well as the fundamental precondition for encouraging orderly competition and giving full scope to market regulation .
to implement the two separations in essence is to deepen the reform of cotton enterprises to really turn them into economic entities that make their own managerial decisions , take full responsibility for profits and losses , develop on their own , and exercise self - discipline .
this is the crux of this round of cotton circulation structural reform .
this is an important guarantee for promoting an overall balance between supply and demand , safeguarding the cotton market order , and guaranteeing cotton quality after the cotton market is decontrolled .
to follow the path of industrialized operation means to devote major efforts to advancing industrialized operation in cotton and encouraging cotton spinning enterprises to set up raw material production bases in cotton - producing areas and establish various forms of common interest communities with cotton farmers .
governments at all levels and the departments concerned must establish a consciousness of the overall situation and , with a highly - developed sense of political responsibility , conscientiously strengthen leadership over this work , carry out meticulous organization , and implement various policies and measures without any reservation to ensure smooth progress of the cotton circulation structural reform .
they must take stern measures against acts of destroying cotton resources , such as adulteration for the purpose of trickery and selling seconds at the prices of fine cotton .
relevant departments of the state council should make a united effort , each perform its own functions , act in close coordination , and make careful and thorough arrangements to change the way of administration and establish a new type of administrative functions as required by the market economy .
to supply and marketing cooperatives , this round of cotton circulation structural reform is both a severe challenge and a development opportunity .
supply and marketing cooperatives should proceed from the overall interests of the reform and development to seize the opportunity to deepen their self - reformation , open up new development spaces , and try hard to enhance their ability to compete according to market economic principles .
wen jiabao stressed : the 2001 cotton year is coming soon . making a good job of cotton purchase and marketing in the new year will be of extremely great significance to deepening the cotton circulation structural reform , stabilizing cotton production , protecting the farmers ' interests , and promoting sustained , healthy development of the textile industry .
all localities and departments must conscientiously make a good job of cotton purchase and marketing in the new year along the principal line of deepening the cotton circulation structural reform so as to be sure to bring about a good start for deepening the reform .
ma kai , deputy secretary general of the state council , presided over and responsible comrades of the departments concerned spoke at the meeting .

china supports russia 's policy on issues of preserving the national unity of the russian federation and its territorial integrity .
russia supports china 's policies on issues of preserving the national unity and territorial integrity of the people 's republic of china .
russia reiterates that there is no change in its principled stance on the taiwan issue expounded in the political documents signed and approved by the two heads of state between 1992 and 2000 .
russia holds that there is only one china in the world , and the government of the people 's republic of china is the sole legitimate government representing the whole of china , and that taiwan is an indivisible part of china .
the two parties point out with satisfaction there are no territorial demands between them , and they are resolved to actively work to turn the building of their border into a border of everlasting peace and friendship for all generations .
the two parties will observe the international principles on the inviolability of territory and national borders and will strictly abide by the national border between them .
in accordance with the " prc - ussr agreement on the eastern section of the sino - soviet border " signed on 16 may 1991 , the two parties will continue to hold negotiations to resolve questions of border demarcation on which sino - russian unanimity has not yet been reached through consultation .
the two parties will expand and deepen measures for trust in the military field , so as to strengthen their own security and consolidate regional and international security .
based on the principle of reasonable sufficiency of weapons and armed forces , the two parties will make efforts to ensure their national security .
the military and military technology cooperation carried out by the two parties in accordance with the relevant agreements is not aimed at any third country .
neither party will participate in any alliance or bloc which damages the sovereignty , security , and territorial integrity of the other party , and will not adopt any similar action , including not concluding a similar treaty with any third country .
neither party to the treaty will permit a third country to use its territory to damage the national sovereignty , security , and territorial integrity of the other party .
if one party to the treaty believes that there is a threat of aggression menacing peace , wrecking peace , and involving its security interests and is aimed at one of the parties , the two parties will immediately make contact and hold consultations in order to eliminate the threat that has arisen .
the two parties oppose actions that may threaten international stability , security , and peace , and will cooperate in preventing international conflicts and in their political solution .
article 13 . the two parties will step up cooperation in the united nations and its security council and specialized agencies .
the two parties will make efforts to strengthen the united nations as the highest authoritative and most universal international organization in handling international affairs , and especially its core role in peace and development , and ensure the main responsibility of the un security council in the field of preserving international peace and security .
article 14 . the two parties will vigorously promote stability with their peripheral regions , establish an atmosphere of mutual understanding , trust , and cooperation , and spur efforts to establish a mechanism for multilateral cooperation suited to the actual security and cooperation issues in these regions .
article 18 . in accordance with their international obligations and national laws and regulations , the two parties will carry out cooperation in promoting the attainment of human rights and basic freedoms .
in accordance with their international obligations and national laws and regulations , the two parties will take effective steps to ensure the legitimate rights and interests of legal and human entities of one party in the territory of the other party , and will provide each other with the necessary assistance in civil and criminal adjudication .
article 20 . in accordance with their national laws and their international obligations , the two parties will actively cooperate to crack down on terrorism , separatism and extremism , and to crack down on organized crime and criminal activities such as illegal trafficking in narcotics , amphetamines , and weapons .
article 21 . the two sides attach importance to the development of exchanges and cooperation between their central ( federal ) legislative and law enforcement organs .
article 22 . this treaty does not affect the rights and obligations of the two parties as parties to other international treaties , nor is it aimed at any third country .
article 24 . this treaty needs to be ratified , and will come into force on the day that instruments of ratification are exchanged .
the exchange will take place in beijing .
this treaty is signed in moscow on 16 july 2001 in two copies , both in chinese and russian , and the two languages are equally valid . [ signed ] jiang zemin , on behalf of the people 's republic of china valeriy putin , on behalf of the russian federation

moscow , 16 jul ( xinhua ) - - chinese president jiang zemin and russian president putin signed here today the " joint statement of chinese and russian heads of state . "
the full text of the statement follows : moscow joint statement of chinese and russian heads of state at the invitation of russian federal president putin , prc president jiang zemin pays a state visit to the russian federation 15 - 18 july 2001 .
the two sides have put forward a long - range plan for developing their bilateral relations in the 21 st century .
the treaty provides that the two countries ' friendly relations are new state relations built on the basis of nonalignment , non - confrontation , and not targeting on any third country .
the chinese and russian heads of state are convinced that , with the treaty as the strong foundation , sino - russian relations will reach a new and even higher level in this century .
two the chinese and russian heads of state reiterate : the two countries will continue to maintain the tradition of and the mechanism for the two countries ' high - level exchanges of visit and meetings at regular intervals , and will regularly exchange views on important bilateral and international issues .
broadening the two sides ' friendly exchanges and cooperation in the spheres of education , culture , public health , and sports will be good for strengthening and consolidating the social foundation of the two countries ' good - neighborly friendship and mutual trust .
in this respect , the sino - russian committee of friendship , peace and development will play an important part .
in view of this , the chinese and russian heads of state attach great importance to the sixth regular meeting of the two countries ' premiers in saint petersburg in september 2001 .
the two sides maintain that the successful implementation of the " agreement of the governments of the people 's republic china and the russian federation on the common exploitation of some islands in border rivers and their adjacent waters " shows that the two sides have the political will to address their historical issues .
they maintain that the status quo of these sections should be maintained before an agreement is reached .
six the chinese and russian heads of state point out : national independence , sovereignty , and territorial integrity are the core elements of international law , the basic principles for international relations , and the essential conditions for the existence of each and every country .
it is the legitimate rights of each and every country to rebuff with firm resolve all attempts and actions to undermine these principles .
the continuous spreading of terrorism , secessionism and radicalism has constituted a serious threat to sovereign countries ' security and global peace and stability .
the chinese and russian heads of state maintain that only when they join hands and work hard together can they stop these phenomena and solve these problems .
objectively , this tendency is in the fundamental interests of all countries .
china and russia must work hard together to strengthen the leading roles of the united nations and its security council in handling international affairs , and will oppose any attempts to undermine the basic guiding norms of international law in the name of " humanitarian intervention " and " limited sovereignty . "
china and russia share a consensus of views on the issue of safeguarding the security and stability in their neighboring areas .
on these issues , the positions of china and russia are the same .
the chinese and russian heads of state maintain that it is imperative to firmly prevent the deployment of weapons in the outer space , and to conclude international legal instruments about banning the deployment of weapons in the outer space .
the chinese and russian heads of states reiterate that they will abide by the " final document " approved at the 2000 meeting to examine the nuclear nonproliferation treaty , and will strengthen their cooperation in the sphere of nuclear nonproliferation and disarmament , including urging all the members of the international community to join the nuclear nonproliferation treaty .

moscow , 16 july ( xinhua ) - - chinese president jiang zemin and his russian counterpart vladimir putin signed a sino - russian treaty on good - neighborly friendship and cooperation in moscow on 16 july .
the sino - russian treaty on good - neighborly friendship and cooperation is extremely important and covers a wide range of issues .
it lays down the principles and directions for future bilateral cooperation in the fields of politics , economy and trade , science and technology , culture and international issues , and is the guideline for developing good - neighborly friendship and cooperation in the long run .
after the cold war , chinese and russian leaders decided to establish a new type of interstate relationship based on the five principles for peaceful coexistence out of their respective strategic needs for national construction and their common desire to work for world peace and development .
having decided on the guidelines and principles for the establishment of a new type of interstate relationship , china and russia have made major headway in their bilateral relations in the past 10 years and more .
they have established a strategic partnership , strengthened mutually beneficial cooperation in all spheres , and achieved fruitful results in their cooperation .
they have also established a mechanism for regular meetings between their top leaders , and exchanges and contacts between personnel at all levels have become increasingly frequent .
they support each other in the protection of their national sovereignty , independence and territorial integrity , and have basically resolved boundary issues left by history .
the sino - russian treaty on good - neighborly friendship and cooperation establishes the peaceful thinking that " china and russia will be friends for generations to come and will never be enemies , " thus opening up even broader prospects for the development of bilateral relations .
the chinese and russian peoples have developed a deep traditional friendship , and share a common wish to remain friends for generations to come .
it is believed that sino - russian relations will definitely reach a new height in the new century under the guidance of the treaty .
the signing of the sino - russian treaty on good - neighborly friendship and cooperation not only concerns the long - term , sound and stable development of bilateral relations but will have a deep and far - reaching impact on safeguarding peace and security in the region and in the entire world .
china and russia are big countries with important influence in the international arena , and both shoulder the important mission of safeguarding world peace and stability .
at present , the trends of political multi - polarization and economic globalization are developing , and new and complicated factors are emerging in the international situation .
under this new situation , the further strengthening of mutually beneficial cooperation and strategic collaboration between china and russia becomes particularly important , because this is not only in the fundamental interests of the people of both countries but will be of help to peace and security in the asia - pacific region and the whole world .
the sino - russian treaty on good - neighborly friendship and cooperation faces the next generation and faces the new century . it lays the political foundation for the long - term development of sino - russian relations .
sino - russian relations will definitely set a good example for good - neighborly friendship as long as china and russia firmly adhere to this " treaty of the century . "

democratic election of cadres is a comprehensive revolution and a complete renovation of the cadre personnel work in terms of ideology , concept , work method , management system , and operational mechanism .
democratic election of cadres is a concrete embodiment of the party 's nature and purpose in the work related to cadres .
the party 's nature and purpose show that the cpc does not have any special interests except representing the interests of the working class and the broad masses of people .
democratic election of cadres is a basic requirement for building a socialist democracy .
the socialist system determines that all power must in the hands of the people , that the masses of people are the masters of the country , and that the various types and levels of cadres of the party and the state are the public servants of the people .
therefore , every cadre should be selected by the masses , responsible to the masses , and supervised by the masses ; in carrying out our work related to cadres , we should promote democracy , pay attention of the will of the people , and ensure that the masses of people can exercise their democratic rights .
whether the people are for or against us concerns the success and failure of our undertakings .
democratic election of cadres is needed to perfect the form of party control over cadres .
this form is by no means unchangeable , but it must be subordinated to and serve the party 's general line and general task in various periods .
history and facts have proved that only by embodying the party 's mass line in the political and social activities of the state by means of institutionalization and standardization can bureaucratism be eliminated and socialist democracy develop in a healthy way .
democratic election of cadres is the inevitable choice for rectifying the common practice in the work related to cadres .

"
the key to effectively putting a stop to these unhealthy trends is to trust the masses and to rely on the masses .
only by relying on the method of democratic election of cadres can we solve problems from the roots .

pioneering a new method of replenishment in the absence of harbors in late autumn last year , a warship in " combat " the had exhausted its oil and water sailed to a military port and requested for fresh supplies .
when the people at the port did not know what to do , a convoy of cross - country trucks suddenly appeared on the beach . a team of emergency logistical support personnel skillfully unloaded equipment such as an oil hose and pump to quickly set up a field refueling system in the absence of a port .
they then used a rubber boat to connect the oil hose and pump with the " anxious " warship and urgently needed war materials such as oil and water were soon transported to the warship .
recently , a more advanced method of " replenishment container in the absence of port " has been added for the use in emergency logistical support .
to make a breakthrough in this logistical support at sea , this base has organized missile technology experts and officers and men of battleships and logistical support ships to jointly study various operational measures for overcoming adverse weather conditions and formulated scientific plans on missile replenishment .
rapid response for emergency submarine rescue on one morning , when the east china sea fleet commander suddenly issued an emergency submarine rescue mission to a certain base 's ship rescue regiment , everyone was worried for them . without any preparations , could they set off quickly and accomplish this difficult and complicated rescue operation on the sea ?
on receipt of the submarine rescue order , a large rescue and salvage ship , tow ship , and dive boat quickly completed various sailing and rescue preparations .
on arrival at the predetermined sea area , the officers and men searched and quickly found the float indicating the submarine accident site . they established communications contact with the submarine and began to provide power to it in only 15 minutes after determining its position .
the rescue team later provided ventilation , food , and rescue tools to the submarine and dispatched divers to assist the submarine crew to escape .
raising the submarine rescue capability has been a new task of the base 's maritime logistical department .

london , 16 jul ( xinhua ) - - us president bush will begin a formal visit to britain on 18 july .
according to the media here , the two leaders will focus their discussions on such issues as the united states ' missile defense system and the " kyoto protocol . "
because of existing differences between the two countries on these issues , the " special relations " between the two countries will face the test during president bush 's forthcoming visit .
as regards the united states ' missile defense plan , since becoming the president of the united states , bush has always lent full support to developing and deploying the national missile defense system . the success of the fourth missile interception test on 14 july has further consolidated president bush 's resolve to pursue this plan .
however , the british government has all along adopted a wait - and - see attitude .
during his visit to the united states last week , british foreign secretary jack straw reiterated britain 's cautious stand on president bush 's decision to build the missile defense system .
straw said that britain understands the united states ' worries on the threats of " rogue countries " but also held that building the missile defense system is not necessarily the " correct choice . "
on the " kyoto protocol " issue , british and us stands are in sharp contrast to each other .
british environment secretary margaret beckett said that britain will overfulfill the targets specified by the " kyoto protocol " and cut greenhouse gases by 23 percent by the year 2012 and that the protocol is only the " first step " in resolving the problem of global climate warming .
however , judging at the current situation , it will be very difficult to eliminate the differences through the forthcoming talks between the two leaders . in addition , britain and the united states have different stances on the issue of establishing a rapid response force of europe .
it is also one of the countries that have taken the most positive action and adopted the firmest attitude .
therefore , the two leaders will have to go through a lot of trouble to solve existing differences between the two countries in military cooperation .
when blair visited the united states at the beginning of this year , the two sides stressed that they should maintain these " special relations . "
bush has clearly expressed the hope to establish a special private relationship with blair through this visit .

prc president jiang zemin , who was currently visiting moscow , and russian president putin signed the " treaty of good neighborly friendship and cooperation " on 16 july 2001 .
the treaty is an important milestone in the history of sino - russian relations ; it will not only promote the sustained , steady , and healthy onward development of their bilateral relationship but will also have a major impact on regional and world peace , security , and stability .
the core content of the sino - russian relationship is good neighborly friendship and mutually beneficial cooperation .
in order to consolidate and develop the sino - russian strategic cooperation partnership , the treaty lays down the principles that must be observed by both parties and the obligations that they must carry out .
there are specific provisions for application of the five principles of peaceful coexistence according to different circumstances .
next , regarding the application of the principle of mutual respect for sovereignty and territorial integrity , they support each other in preserving national unity and territorial integrity .
building the border between the two countries into a border of everlasting peace and of friendship for all generations the border issue has always been in history the most sensitive issue between states .
at the same time , the two countries have stepped up military confidence and reduction of military forces in the border areas and eliminated hostility and tension ; the border between the two countries has become a border of peace and friendship .
the treaty lays down specific provisions regarding border territory and border confidence issues .
prior to these issues being settled , the two countries will maintain the status quo in such sections .
neither party will permit a third country to use its territory to harm the national sovereignty , security , and territorial integrity of the other party .
second , neither party will permit the establishment on its territory of an organization or bloc that harms the sovereignty , security , and territorial integrity of the other party , and will ban such activities .
these provisions express the depth of the two countries ' strategic cooperation partnership .
third , strictly abide by the " abm treaty " and preserve global strategic balance and security .
fifth , strengthen the key role of the united nations and its security council as the most authoritative and universal international organization composed of sovereign states in handling international affairs , especially in the field of peace and development , and ensure the main responsibility of the security council in preserving international peace and security .
the current core task of this cooperation organization is to crack down on the three forces of terrorism , separatism , and extremism .
the " three forces " are poisonous tumors jeopardizing the security of this region , and the struggle against the " three forces " will be a long - term task . china and russia will make ceaseless joint efforts to grasp the struggle through to the end .
all - round political , economic and trade , and cultural cooperation , strengthening the basis of the two countries ' friendly cooperation the present momentum of development of sino - russian relations is good .
economic and trade cooperation has ended its stagnancy of recent years , and bilateral trade last year grew by 40 percent over 1999 , reaching $ 8 billion , and there are prospects for exceeding $ 10 billion this year .
it is hoped that bilateral economic and trade cooperation will increase further in the future .
history and reality show that engaging in bloc politics , forming new military alliances , or strengthening and expanding existing military alliances do not accord with the tide of development of history and run counter to a country 's own interests , and in addition , do not help world peace and stability . such things should be discarded .
the signing of the " sino - russian treaty of good neighborly friendship and cooperation " displays the depth of sino - russian cooperation and the extent of the trust between them .
it will further increase political trust between the two countries , deepen their traditional friendship , expand their mutually beneficial cooperation , promote their joint development , inject new vitality into the sino - russian strategic cooperation partnership , and raise all - round sino - russian cooperation to a new stage .

the " one country , two systems " formula has received increasing attention from all sectors in taiwan . it has been accepted and supported by more and more people on the island . this has been the most notable sociopolitical phenomenon since the dpp became the ruling party .
as for polls held by the island 's media , the results are practically the same as those conducted by the authorities , the only difference being that the rate of " one country , two systems " supporters given by the media 's polls has shown an even greater rise .
a poll by taiwan 's tvbs on 5 june showed that 31 percent of the respondents were in favor of " one country , two systems . "
a 21 june poll by chung - kuo shih - pao [ china times ] showed that the rate of supporters for " one country , two systems " was 29 percent , and 20 percent of the supporters said " it is tolerable even if the country name , republic of china , is eliminated . "
the result of a poll published by the lien - ho pao [ united daily ] system on 1 july , the fourth anniversary of hong kong 's return to the motherland , showed that 33 percent of the people on the island could accept " one country , two systems . "
the most direct reason is , of course , the economic factor , in particular the sharp difference between the two sides in economic strength .
during the past year since the present taiwan leader took office , the island 's political situation has been chaotic , economy has slackened , stock prices have dropped , society has been out of order , and both the unemployment rate and the " misery index " have climbed up .
" unable to see a tomorrow of economic prosperity and political stability , " the people on the island have an increasingly unstable and insecure feeling about their future .
in sharp contrast , the motherland has steadily beefed up its overall strength , its economy has shown a sustained and fast growth , and the living standard of its people has improved considerably .
under these circumstances , says chung - kuo shih - pao , the " one country , two systems " formula has offered the people on the island a " blueprint that they can expect to lead them to a happy life . "
another reason , which is rather deep - rooted , is the growing interactions and exchanges between the two sides of the strait .
in 1979 , the standing committee of the national people 's congress issued the " message to compatriots in taiwan , " officially setting forth the cross - strait " three links " proposal , which has greatly promoted trade , economic exchanges , and visits between the two sides .
now , there are 50,000 taiwan businesspeople , 500,000 taiwan compatriots , and $ 50 billion taiwan capital on the mainland . the number of cross - strait visitors each year has exceeded 2.5 million by turnstile count .
without doubt , this has formed a solid cultural basis for the people on the island to refuse becoming a vassal of the western anti - china forces and to willingly accept the " one country , two systems " formula .

over the past few days , there have been signs that a debate over " air mechanization " within the us ground force is drawing to a close , as several representative views have surfaced , receiving a great deal of attention from the parties concerned .
though computers may excel human brains in handling a dynamic and complicated situation , it is human beings that will come up with numerous decisions during real operations .
besides , team spirit is also something technology is incapable of yielding .
stressing " crisis response " mentality , and ensuring rapid delivery and deployment the us ground force believes that the future ground force should be able to wage intercontinental mobile offensive operations .
preparing for assuming a unique role in a campaign .
the us military maintains that in order to secure a victory in a ground offensive campaign , the us ground force should build mobile units capable of fighting and encircling an enemy in a vertical way .
the us military has long before advanced the idea of air mechanization , and is likely to attain this goal with the existing us technology in the near future .
rapidly building " digitized forces , " and building combat units in light of information operations the us ground force has managed to enhance through digitized technology an operational command system in terms of functions , thus making it possible for a ground unit to mount high - speed operations , employing all types of weapons through coordination .
in view of this , the us ground force has taken building digitized forces as a top priority , and has demanded that all ground units arrive at a designated zone , taking part in fighting , within a period of several days .
refining operational support and duties , and training soldiers for close fighting the us ground force is expected to focus on increasing to the maximum the number of units able to fight an enemy within close quarters , aside from fostering and sustaining superior operational support capacity and operational duties support capacity .
insofar as structure is concerned , a new - type ground unit is set to be provided with modern combat vehicles and a rifle squad .
meanwhile , the us ground force has decided that in the event of a national - level crisis , which has to be handled by troops of more than three armies , the ground reserve units should be able to continuously supply a large number of mobilizable strategic personnel .
us colonel - level military officers on active service participated in the entire process of this year 's " hankuang 17 " exercise for the first time after taiwan and the united states severed their diplomatic ties and the us military assistance advisory group withdrew from taiwan .
inside the [ taiwan ] military , people think that the us military will ultimately come up with the " taiwan defense operation plan , " and , if everything goes smoothly , they hope to war - game the plan in the hankuang exercises in 2002 or 2003 .
in addition for the united states to " sending personnel to observe " the hankuang exercise , the most important exercises of the national army , the entire taiwan - us military cooperation in recent years includes the following : codenamed " lecheng , " taiwan - us military cooperation started intensely two years ago .
officers on active service of the us marine corps conducted field investigations in taiwan twice in december last year and march this year .
after air and ground survey , the us military agreed to [ taiwan ] military 's explanation that taiwan has 17 areas good for landing , seven in the east coast and 10 in west coast , and named them as " red areas . "
when evaluation of the combat capabilities of the three armed services is completed , important us government officials are expected to visit taiwan late this year or early next year to sign in secret a memorandum on taiwan - us military cooperation .
as it is very complicated , the " posheng project " has produced such sub - projects as posheng no. 1 and posheng no. 2 .
the us military has also assisted the army to establish an " electronic warfare battalion " in secret . it has leased all the necessary electronic warfare equipment and delivered to the army a set of mobile equipment , which is the most advanced equipment in service .
in communication combat capability , thanks to the support of the us side , the chungshan institute of science and technology has acquired key " frequency hopping " technology , which will change " constant frequency " communication of the three armed services to " frequency hopping " in the future .
during wars , constant frequency communication is liable to interference and interruption .
" lecheng " was the codename of the operation plan for the past taiwan - us mutual defense treaty .
the " lecheng " plan proves that the military contacts between taiwan and the united states involve a wide range of areas and are not confined to arms sales only .
after the taiwan strait crisis , the us side found that it had only " limited knowledge " on the combat capability of our national army .
thanks to the combat capability evaluation , however , the us military started strengthening the national army 's software and hardware combat capability , which finally led to the formation of the " lecheng " plan .
should a war break out in taiwan strait , the national army would be able to sustain for some time in order to strive for international involvement , intervention , or mediation .
president chen has expressed the wish for increasing taiwan - united states joint military exercises . this was the first time our side publicized such a wish after the termination of the taiwan - us mutual defense treaty . moreover , as it was proposed by the president , follow - up developments merit close attention .
in 1996 when the united states involved in the taiwan strait crisis , a realistic question arose : " how will the united states communicate with the national army once its military force involves ? "
they were indeed unable to communicate at that time .
in fact , communication of war intelligence involves a wide range of work .
for instance , as the three armed services have several thousand air defense missiles of various types and ranges , attack errors can happen easily if there is no communication in war intelligence . for this reason , the us military urges the national army to plan a " safe air - sea corridor . "
without a safe air - sea corridor , how can us planes and ships dare to enter the taiwan strait to conduct military exercises ?
as taiwan is not a military ally of the united states , it has the initiative in deciding whether to accept us defense ideas or take them as references .

the police quickly launched investigations , and found that the deceased was a female " falungong " practitioner named liu renfang .
after the " falungong " was outlawed as an evil cult by the government , liu remained obsessed with the " falungong , " and even went around to incite fellow " falungong " practitioners on several occasions , urging them to go to beijing to " defend the law " by making trouble .
as the place was small , with filthy air , liu renfang , who was very tired after having traveled for a few days , had a relapse of tracheitis .

a few days later , liu was unable to eat anything . " on the night of 30 december , i found liu 's throat full of phlegm , but she was too weak to spit . i heard liu moaning and groaning in a thin voice .

the public security personnel led ji yueqiong and several " falungong " practitioners to yanjiao town in hebei province , where ji found the apartment they had once lived in .

what is important now is to have the woman 's corpse sent to a mortuary in a hospital , thus avoiding suspicion .

zhao guifeng also expressed the hope that li hongzhi would give an " instruction " on the case . she asked zhou genzheng to go on - line , reporting the case to a us - based " falungong " organization , urging it to find a way to tell li hongzhi about this .

zhao guifeng repeatedly told others : " we must handle the case well , for if found out by a public security organ , it may be used as negative example , which may do more harm to " dafa " than the self - immolation incident in tiananmen square . "

zhao guifeng asked the woman practitioner to speak to a neighbor and a security guard working in the residential area , where the apartment was located , to help find the apartment owner and get the key to the apartment .

please tell ' the master ' about this . "

hu jintao , standing committee member of the political bureau of the cpc central committee , vice president of the state , vice chairman of the central military commission and leader of the delegation of the central authorities , attended the grand gathering where he delivered an important speech .

hu jintao gave a speech brimming over with warm feelings .

hu jintao stressed , situated in the southwest frontier of the motherland and vast in area , tibet is in a very important strategic position .

as one of the key areas in the west targeted for large - scale development , tibet is facing an opportunity it never had before .
hu jintao said , tibet is a beautiful and richly endowed piece of land of the great motherland .

bush 's efforts to strengthen the british - us special relationship evoked a positive response from british prime minister blair .
blair stated that britain will make the greatest efforts to maintain and develop ties with the united states and strengthen their bilateral cooperation in regional security , and will also strive to continue to play its unique " role as a bridge " between the united states and other european countries .
bush for his part stated that he greatly cherishes the " unique " special relationship between the united states and britain and will work to develop this tie .
at the same time , the two sides did not conceal their differences on a number of major issues .

bush for his part emphasized that in order to preserve its own national interests and solve its employment problem , the united states will not implement the " kyoto protocol " and has no intention of changing this stance .
analysts thus believe that the serious differences between britain and the united states over the two key issues of the us missile defense program and the " kyoto protocol " can hardly be reconciled within a short time .
at the invitation of ukrainian president leonid d. kuchma , president jiang zemin of the people 's republic of china paid a state visit to ukraine on 20 - 23 july 2001 .
the leaders of the two countries exchanged in - depth views , and reached wide - range consensus , on ways to promote bilateral relations and on a number of international issues of common concern in a sincere , cordial , and friendly atmosphere .
the two sides believe that 21 st century has opened up a broad prospect for the development of relations between china and the ukraine .
the people 's republic of china and ukraine are willing to further promote the traditional friendship between the two peoples , and expand the scope of an all - round cooperation so as to bring benefits to the two countries and the two peoples .
both sides point out that the move by china and ukraine to deepen their all - round friendly relations of cooperation on the basis of mutual respect , noninterference in each other 's internal affairs , and equality and mutual benefit is in the fundamental interest of the two countries and the two peoples .
the ukrainian side reiterates the stand on the taiwan issue that has been stated in a series of state - to - state documents between china and ukraine , and stresses that it recognizes only one china and that the government of the people 's republic of china is the only legitimate government of all of china .
the chinese side recognizes and respects the independence , sovereignty , and territorial integrity of ukraine ; and reiterates the nuclear security assurance it proposed to the ukrainian side in 1994 .
in the economic area : both sides have attached great importance to promoting the mutually beneficial relations of cooperation in all fields between china and ukraine ; and highly appreciate the work of governmental commissions of the two countries on business and trade , science and technology , and utilization of space for peaceful purposes .
both sides will encourage and support institutions and enterprises of the two countries to engage themselves in the construction of major infrastructure facilities and energy projects in china and ukraine as well as in third countries in the world .
both sides will sponsor business and trade conferences and exhibitions of various kinds , with the assistance of the china committee for the promotion of international trade , the ukrainian alliance of industrialists and entrepreneurs , and federations of industry and commerce as well as other institutions of both countries .
both sides reaffirm that they hold identical or similar views and stands on current major international and regional issues , and are willing to strengthen their close cooperation within the united nations and other international organizations .
both sides firmly believe that the united nations , consisting of sovereign states , is an international organization that enjoys the greatest universality and highest authority in the world , is a guarantee for safeguarding world peace and security , and is playing an important role in bringing about common development and prosperity .
both sides support the move to improve the efficiency and functions of the united nations , and to strengthen the role of the united nations as a core mechanism in international relations .
president kuchma accepted the invitation with pleasure .

how is the situation of the compulsory education in anhui since the party central committee and the state council decided to carry out an experimental tax and fee reform there ?
this is an important question that premier zhu rongji is very much concerned about .
wherever he went , he had heart - to - heart conversation with township and village cadres , teachers and people . while familiarizing himself with how the peasants ' burden was reduced there , he also inquired in detail about the situation of compulsory education amid the tax and fee reform .
while inspecting the experimental tax and fee reform in fuyang city , zhu rongji took a special trip to songyang primary school at shibalipu township , yingshang county .
songyang primary school is a key village primary school with a history of more than 30 years . it has 508 students and 13 teachers .
wang wei explained , " to save school spending , students are required to bring their own stools .
" how old are these desks ? "
zhu rongji asked .
" twenty years . "
" ever replaced ? "
" no. "
" in the middle . "
wang taihua , secretary of the anhui provincial party committee who was chairing the meeting , came straight to the point and said , " the premier is very much concerned about whether the tax and fee reform will affect rural compulsory education , or not . please speak your mind freely and tell the truth .
do n't be afraid of saying something improper , but absolutely do n't tell lies . "
from july 2000 to june 2001 after the tax and fee reform , it was still in arrears with 720,000 yuan of teachers ' allowances . "
wang wei said , " we owed the teachers two months ' wages each in 1998 and 1999 and four months ' wages in 2000 . their wages for the first half of this year were fully paid . "
" are there any allowances ? "
a township cadre said , " some teachers have extra income from the land they contract to grow crops . "
" you should not be in arrears with the payment of teachers ' wages merely because they have contracted land to grow crops , " said zhu rongji in a stern tone .
anything which passes " special discussion " indicates that it indeed conforms to the peasants ' interest .
zhu rongji added , " the orientation of geographical layout readjustment for middle and primary schools is correct . however , we must proceed from reality and make the readjustment gradually according to local conditions .
our limited funds should be used first to ensure the payment of teachers ' wages , normal school operation , and rebuilding of unsafe school buildings . "
he asked zhang yongji , headmaster of xiaqiao primary school at xiaqiao town : " how much fees does your school collect from students ? "
zhang yongji said , " we collect 140 yuan apiece from first - and second - grade students , and 160 yuan apiece from third - through fifth - grade students . "
" what kind of fees are they ? "
each student pays 50 yuan for miscellaneous fee , 49 yuan for textbooks and 10 yuan for notebooks each semester . "
is the town head here ? "
zhu rongji made a detailed inquiry .
since xiaqiao town head was not there , zhu rongji asked jiangkou town party secretary li jingye , " do you get a cut from the schools also ? "
" yes , 35 yuan apiece . "
" no , we do n't , but we are required to fund one month 's wages for our teachers with a portion of our receipts . "
he said emphatically , " the rural areas selected for conducting experimental tax and fee reform must ensure the payment of teachers ' wages on time and in full amount .
we should conscientiously reduce the burden of rural parents . "
after they finished speaking , zhu rongji said , " many problems still exist in rural basic education , particularly in rural compulsory education .
whether or not the peasants ' burden can be lightened and whether or not the necessary funding for compulsory education can be guaranteed are an important indicator showing whether or not the tax and fee reform is successful .
stepping out of the conference room , zhu rongji shook hands with the teachers , saying , " we will certainly pay the arrears of wages .
the compulsory education has a bearing on the rejuvenation of the chinese nation .
premier zhu rongji has showed great concern over anhui 's pilot reform .
practices have shown that the central policies and principles on the rural fee - to - tax reform are completely accurate and extensively enjoy the heartfelt support among the broad masses of the peasants .
however , there have been many problems in need of resolution at present and the current tasks are still arduous .
zhu rongji encouraged the broad masses of cadres and people in anhui to work ceaselessly and unremittingly , bravely explore ways , seek truth , blaze new trails , work hard to resolve contradictions and problems arising in the course of reform , straighten out achievements in reform , and deepen this reform in an overall manner .
zhu rongji said that the rural fee - to - tax reform is a profound social change and deals with a wide range of work . so this reform cannot be accomplished in one move but should be carried out in a positive and steady manner . there are several reasons .
second , this reform has been carried out under the current circumstances in which grain prices are continuously going down , channels for increasing peasants ' incomes are insufficient , and towns and townships are financially strained in general . many thorny problems need to be resolved .
various contradictions and problems accumulated for years will possibly be exposed in the course of reform and there must be a process to ceaselessly improve policies and auxiliary reform measures .
third , since the natural and economic conditions of localities vary greatly , the peasants bear different burdens of fees and taxes . thus , we are required to proceed from actual conditions to resolve conspicuous problems .
fourth , the rural fee - to - tax reform cannot do without state financial assistance . so , we must consider the state financial affordability while comprehensively carrying out this reform .
therefore , the central authorities decided that the rural fee - to - tax reform will be carried out nationwide after noticeable achievements are seen and mature experiences summed up in anhui .
to succeed in the rural fee - to - tax reform , we must work in line with central requirements , give a big push to various auxiliary reforms , downsize town and township organizations , reduce the number of financial dependents , and standardize criteria for administrative expenses and operating expenses and methods for management of these expenses .
zhu rongji pays full attention to the issue concerning the rural compulsory education following the rural fee - to - tax reform .
zhu rongji said that in the course of the rural fee - to - tax reform , we must ensure the allocation of the expenses earmarked for the rural compulsory education .
what we worry most at present is that there will be a big shortfall in the funding of expenses to be earmarked for the rural compulsory education after the rural fee - to - tax reform .
thereby , ensuring the expenses earmarked for rural compulsory education is an important task for the fee - to - tax reform .
localities must conscientiously implement the criteria and systems of state council relevant departments governing collection of charges for the compulsory education in poor rural areas . none are permitted to try to collect various charges from the peasants under various concocted excuses .
in particular , localities must not collect charges recklessly under the pretext of redistributing primary and middle schools , nor are they allowed to use loans to go in for large - scale construction .
meanwhile , the teaching and administrative staff contingents of primary and middle schools should be readjusted into crack ones .
this reform is a test to all levels of cadres ' ideological quality , understanding about policies , leadership capabilities , and work styles .
therefore , all levels of cadres should conscientiously implement comrade jiang zemin 's important thinking on the " three represents , " firmly foster the fundamental goal of serving the people wholeheartedly , actually bear the peasants ' interests in mind , and ensure a smooth progress of the rural fee - to - tax reform .
north china was hit by the serious drought this year .
such problems , once discovered , should be investigated and handled and must not be tolerated . zhu rongji pointed out that at the time of greatly reducing the peasants ' burdens , we should try every possible means to increase the peasants ' incomes and ensure to achieve the work in these two areas .
what is most important is that all localities should proceed from actual conditions , take market as an orientation , focus on optimizing varieties of goods and improving the quality of products and efficiency , and continuously work hard to readjust the agricultural mix .
various forms , such as " order form - based agriculture " and " companies plus peasant households , " should be popularized . it is necessary to develop industries engaged in processing and preservation of farm produce and those to keep farm produce fresh .
we should greatly rejuvenate agriculture with science and education and popularize fine varieties of goods and advanced and applicable technologies .

this unmanned spacecraft is called " shenzhou - iii , " which has entered a phase of intense preparations prior to launch . per specialists ' predictions , this spacecraft will be launched soon following a period of tests and assembling .
shenzhou - iii carrying dummy men on board china launched the " shenzhou - i " and " shenzhou - ii " unmanned space capsules on 20 november 1999 and 10 january 2001 , respectively .
the " shenzhou - i " was aimed at testing its weight - bearing and retrieval techniques .
" shenzhou - i " and " shenzhou - ii " landed safely after orbiting the earth 14 times and 107 times [ as published ] , respectively .
per specialists , astronauts , when travelling in space , are faced with the temperatures , pressures , humidity , and atmospheres in their capsules ; the mechanic environments that mankind can bear ; as well as questions concerning eating , drinking , and going to the bathroom .
per specialists ' analyses , china will have to test launch unmanned spacecraft at least three times before sending its astronauts to space .
per predictions by relevant personages , china will launch for the first time a crewed spacecraft in the second half of next year .
in particular , a number of valuable scientific findings , such as space material science , life science , astronomical explorations , and environmental monitoring and forecast , have been achieved .
the research on effect of space biology , conducted by " shenzhou - ii , " was based on the comprehensive study of various species and living things ; it was of great significance to ensuring the safety of lives .

leaders from the united states , britain , france , germany , italy , japan , canada , and russia discussed the current world economic situation and a series of international issues .
the meeting achieved some consensus and results , but differences still exist on a number of major issues .
at the same time , the protest activities and the ensuing bloody clashes during these three days caused the eight leaders to start to consider the challenges facing summit meetings in the future .
this year 's summit was held against the background of a slowdown in global economic growth .
they held that although economic growth has slowed , the economic policies of the leading developed countries are rational , the basic indices are good , and the prospects for global economic growth continue to look good .
they undertook to make efforts to launch a new round of multilateral trade negotiations at the world trade organization ministerial conference to be convened at yearend in order to promote economic growth .
the eight leaders issued the " genoa africa plan " and decided to appoint liaison officials to draw up development plans together with the african countries , to facilitate their adoption at next year 's g-8 summit .
the eight leaders also undertook to take full account of the interests of developing countries in the new round of trade negotiations , and announced with un secretary general annan the establishment of a global health fund to deal with aids , malaria , and tb .
the establishment of this fund will help to improve health conditions in the developing countries .
hence , attaching importance to the problems of the developing countries , especially the least developed , was the common commitment of the eight leaders and also a major characteristic of this meeting .
in addition , the g-8 summit also formed consensus on hot regional problems such as the mideast peace process , macedonia , and the korean peninsula .
compared with previous years , however , this meeting gave a false impression of achieving more results while actually achieving less .
another important issue at the meeting was that of how to resolve the iraqi sanctions issue , but the meeting was unable to form a consensus ; the united states and britain tried to persuade russia and others to support their " smart sanctions " plan , but to no avail .
what attracted people 's attention was that from beginning to end this meeting was accompanied by massive protests , which became another prominent characteristic of the meeting .
the forerunner of the g-8 summits was the western g-7 group which was launched in 1975 ; its purpose then was to discuss economic problems in the manner of " fireside chats , " coordinate the developed countries ' macroeconomic policies , and spur economic development .
beginning in the 1980 's , however , the western g-7 started to discuss political topics , and the number of these topics grew and grew . by now , these summits discuss almost every issue with a bearing on the global political and economic fields .
while the number of topics is increasing all the time , the scale of the g-8 summits is also continually expanding , while their efficiency is continually declining .
the security of the national leaders and the delegates was a great headache for the host country .
at the same time , the g-8 summit is after all a " club " type of forum , and the documents it approved are wordy , empty , and lack substance , and even those with specific contents are only written down on paper and their actual implementation is extremely difficult .
the genoa meeting thus causes people to ponder , is it worth spending so much money on holding such a meeting ?
under heavy external pressure , since 1999 the g-8 summit has started to discuss the question of reducing or waiving poor countries ' debts , and eliminating poverty became a key topic at this summit .
the eight can only avoid facing the embarrassment of genoa in the future by adopting specific action , holding wide - ranging dialogue with poor countries and nongovernmental organizations , and gradually changing their image as a " rich man 's club . "
apart from that , although russia started to become an official member of the g-8 in 1997 , it cannot yet take part in discussions on economic topics , and the 7 + 1 pattern remains unchanged ; another difficult problem facing the eight leaders is how to genuinely change 7 + 1 into 8 .
italy claims that this will be " the last " g-8 summit of this type .
whither it will go in the future is a problem to be explored by the eight leaders and also a topic of concern to the international community .
according to informed sources in beijing , the cpc organization department is formulating specific measures to admit owners of private enterprises into the party .
sources have said that the chinese communists have a plan to recruit 200,000 private entrepreneurs as new party members during the one - year period from now to the eve of the 16 th cpc national congress scheduled to be held in the fall of next year .
since jiang zemin 's " 1 july " speech was published , upwards of 100,000 private entrepreneurs across the country have filed applications for party membership .
at the beginning of this month , the authorities concerned issued an order to the effect that no articles expressing opposite opinions should be published , and no more argument should be made on this question .
the cpc constitution states explicitly that the communist party of china is the " vanguard of the chinese working class . "
in the past , the cpc only accepted workers , peasants , military personnel , intellectuals , and revolutionaries as members .
in the chinese communists ' traditional concept , private entrepreneurs were the same as " capitalists . " they were the " targets of revolution . "
sources have further revealed that at this time party organizations around the country are organizing campaigns to study jiang zemin 's speech and working on measures to implement his instruction on recruiting private entrepreneurs as party members .
the target set by the cpc central committee 's organization department is to admit 200,000 private entrepreneurs into the party before next year 's 16 th cpc national congress .

beijing political circles believe that the democratic component in the content of this reform plan is greater than before .

early in 1984 , when the momentum was strong for china 's implementing reform and opening up and developing the economy , japan then had scholars who put forth the " china threat theory , " exaggerating that " one day china becoming strong will create a threat to the world . "
the facts mercilessly counterattacked the fabricators of the " china threat theory , " causing this absurd argument to collapse on its own , gradually losing market .

in reality , china has never viewed japan as an opponent , but on the contrary it is japan that views china as a threat .

after taking office , us president bush initiated a readjustment of the global military strategy of the us .
on 25 may , at a graduation address at the us naval academy , bush claimed that he would establish an " unrivaled " military force , and he also enjoined the pentagon to undertake a major adjustment of its army - building policies , strategic focus and military deployment .
at present , although the new military strategy of the us has not yet made a formal appearance , based on related reports in the us media , some faint inklings about the new strategy can be seen .
the us believes that , in the future , the military threats that the us will face will come primarily from the asian region . accordingly , it has become imperative for its strategic focus to shift from europe to the asian region .
during the clinton administration , this policy served as the basis for planning force size and determining the organizational structure of military units , as well as their weapons and equipment .
the army has 10 combat divisions , the navy has five fleets , 11 carrier battle groups , and 10 carrier air wings , and the air force has four air forces and 47 wings , and these were determined based on this policy .
it is estimated that the us will vigorously promote the revolution in military affairs (rma) , further reducing military manpower , reforming the organizational structure , enhancing the development and deployment of high - tech weapons and equipment , strengthening the establishment of its air and space forces , and carrying out space combat research .
the deployment of military forces in asia may be moved forward .
at the same time , some b-52 bombers are already stationed on guam , and the base for some of the navy 's nuclear - powered attack submarines is also being moved forward to guam .
in the asian region , the us does not have any multinational military alliances similar to nato , but it does have five bilateral military alliance treaties .
in addition , the us is also attempting to develop military cooperation relationships with other countries in southeast asia , establishing a us - led , wide - ranging multilateral defense and security cooperation mechanism , as well as gradually transforming this mechanism into a collective defense system .
first , [ it has encountered ] quite a bit of censure within the us , resistance in military circles is even greater , and it will inevitably be constrained by different interest groups within the us .
when implementing the eastward shift of their strategic focus and carrying out the major readjustment of their military strategy , the bush administration must also think about not allowing this to damage the vital interests of the us .

nanning , 23 july ( xinhua ) - - at about 10 a.m. on 1 july , an obsessed " falungong " practitioner set himself on fire at the minzhu square in guangxi 's nanning .
the " 110 " command center of nanning 's public security bureau dispatched police to the scene as soon as it received the report and quickly sent the man to the hospital for emergency treatment .
however , the self - immolator still died from serious injuries early the following morning in spite of treatment .
at about 10 a.m. on 1 july , a young man carrying a light blue sack was seen sitting in meditation at the open space at the eastern corner of nanning 's minzhu square .
two security guards of the square 's management offic immediately ran to stop him when they saw this .
when they were just about 15 meters away , the man set fire to the liquid on his body .
in the course of emergency treatment , the self - immolator said he was " learning ' falun dafa , ' but , realizing that he was too bad tempered and had ' obsessions , ' decided he should have these undesirable things burned away . "
poisoned by li hongzhi and his heresies , he was obsessed with the idea of " attaining a higher level " and seeking the so - called " fulfillment , " or nirvana .
in the morning of 1 june , he went back to the bargain center to buy 10 more bottles , totaling 6,000 milliliters .
the medical personnel took all necessary measures to keep his heart beating and to keep him breathing , but the injured till died from serous burns , multiple organs failure and ultimately heart and lung failure at 8:40 on 2 july in spite of efforts to save his life .

the first three topics have a direct bearing on whether or not the " kyoto protocol , " which is designed to reduce developed countries ' greenhouse gas emissions , will go into force , and the last topic concerns the obligations undertaken by developed countries in the " framework convention on climate change " and other international treaties .
due to the united states ' withdrawal from the " kyoto protocol , " according to relevant provisions , the protocol can go into force only if the eu , japan , and other countries accede to it .
however , japan had refused to expressly support the " kyoto protocol " at the bonn climate meeting .
at private talks , japan , canada , and australia even raised the price , demanding that they get to use their forests and farmland management and overseas " green investments " on a large scale to lower their greenhouse gas emissions targets .
although the eu had always been opposed to using forest vegetation to lower the greenhouse gas emissions targets and to using other means to dilute the concrete contents of the " kyoto protocol , " last year 's fruitless meeting in the hague was still fresh in the minds of europeans .
if the bonn climate meeting again were to end in failure , not only the " kyoto protocol " could be abortive , the eu 's creditability also might suffer a blow .
therefore , at the critical moment when the talks were in a deadlock , pronk submitted a package proposal that satisfied japan and other countries ' demand on using forest vegetation to lower their greenhouse gas emissions targets .
however , after the eu had completely satisfied its demand , if japan still refused to compromise with the eu , it would be bound to bear the guilt of undermining the " kyoto protocol " and to be condemned by the international community .
although all parties concerned have reached an accord on the basic issues , relevant technological details still remain to be discussed , which does not rule out the possibility that some countries may back out in the future .
the outcome of the bonn climate meeting not only will contribute to reducing greenhouse gas emissions , but also will have an impact on the future international political landscape .
