a great coincidence is that a year ago , on 13 july 2000 in beijing , the second intermediate people 's court also gave its first instance verdict on three cases of taiwan spies .
these spies were not as " lucky " as li shaomin .
actually , taiwan spies have been very rampant on the mainland these past years , and the number of taiwan spy cases cracked by mainland national security organs have been on the increase .
xian 's national security bureau cracked the zhu jingmin spy case in 1997 ; nanjing 's national security bureau cracked the wang guandu spy case in the same year ; sichuan 's national security department cracked the wang ping spy case in october 1999 ; wuhan 's national security bureau cracked the yue qing spy case in november 1999 .
why were these taiwan spies so fond of the identity of " taiwan businessman " ?
it has been proven by facts that the overwhelming majority of people who sold intelligence were dragged into the mire out of a greed for money .
at one point , a taiwan spy organization targeted the daughter of a mainland citizen who was studying in the united states . a " handsome guy " was dispatched to the united states to befriend her .
when the opportunity was ripe , the " handsome guy " disclosed his real identity to her and asked the woman to help him steal confidential mainland intelligence .
people like li shaomin were in want of nothing , but decided to join taiwan 's espionage organizations under the spell of hostile ideology .
" military intelligence agency " keeps spying on mainland in the above spy cases , most of the culprits were members of taiwan 's " military intelligence agency " or had worked under its instigation .
the precursor of the " military intelligence agency " was the " renowned " " bureau of investigation and statistics of the military council " during chiang kai - shek 's autocratic rule .
it was renamed the " security bureau of the ministry of defense " in 1946 , and this name was later changed to the " second department of the ministry of defense . "
it was further renamed the " intelligence agency of the ministry of defense " when the taiwan authorities reshuffled their intelligence departments in 1954 .
in the 1960 s it was merged with the " office of special duty of the ministry of defense " to become the " military intelligence agency , " coming directly under the command of the " chief of general staff . "
after fleeing to taiwan , many big cases which shocked taiwan and the world had something or other to do with the " military intelligence agency . "
in addition to the " military intelligence agency , " other spy organizations in taiwan include the " national security bureau , " the " coast guard headquarters , " the " general political operations department , " and the " investigations bureau of the ministry of justice . "
these spy organizations are all involved in mainland intelligence activities to a greater or lesser extent . they sometimes work in collaboration , but at other times they conspire against one another and try to take credit for themselves .
scaring themselves the taiwan authorities keep sending spies to the mainland for espionage activities because they have all along regarded the mainland as " the main force of hostility threatening taiwan 's security . "
while dispatching spies to the mainland for sabotage on the one hand , they keep imagining that the mainland has " planted a lot of moles " in taiwan . they have therefore organized several " clean - up " drives , which turned out to be nothing more than shadow chasing and wasted efforts .
first , the taiwan authorities are scaring themselves thinking that the mainland is preparing to attack them . they are thus sending out large numbers of spies to the mainland in an attempt to find out about its military and political moves . second , taiwan spies are scaring the taiwan authorities .
the intelligence gathered by taiwan spies mainly emphasizes the " mainland threat " and does not care about much else .
as " evidence of mainland threat against taiwan " piles up , the taiwan authorities grow more panicky , and the more they panic , the more they see the need to dispatch spies . this turns into a vicious cycle .

beijing , 25 jul ( xinhua ) - - the china securities newspaper today reported that the ministry of finance recently decided a plan for issuing 16 billion yuan of 20 - year , book - entry - style treasury bonds for 2001 ( the seventh term ) .
the interest will be paid from 31 january to 31 july each year . ( the interest payment day will be postponed to the next day when there is a festival or holiday . ) the treasury bonds will mature on 31 july 2021 .
qualified bidders of the current treasury bonds are 58 stock companies , insurance companies , and trust companies that have been approved .
in accordance with the arrangement , the current treasury bonds will be distributed from 31 july . the end of the distribution is set on 7 august . after the distribution , the treasury bonds will be floated in the trade market .

guangzhou , 25 jul ( xinhua ) - - a meeting on the special campaign against the manufacturing and sales of counterfeit currencies , which was held by the state council joint conference for the work against counterfeit currencies upon the approval of the state council , ended in guangzhou today .
we should take firm and effective measures to smash crime syndicates and destroy their manufacturing and sales bases ; resolutely check the trend of counterfeit - currency manufacturing and sales ; and strive to safeguard the reputation of the renminbi , maintain the country 's economic order and social stability , and protect the interest of the masses .
the meeting decided to launch a special campaign this year against the manufacturing and sales of counterfeit currencies in all parts of the country , particularly in such key provinces and autonomous regions as guangdong , guangxi , zhejiang , henan , anhui , and yunnan .
as statistics have showed , during the period of the joint crackdown campaign , 470 million yuan of counterfeit renminbi was seized in different parts of the country , 3,562 cases involving the manufacturing and sales of counterfeit currencies were cracked , more than 10,000 suspects were arrested , and 36 manufacturing bases were destroyed .
the meeting pointed out : we should carry out this special crackdown campaign in close connection with the nationwide special action for rectifying and regulating the market economic order , and should work out effective measures so that the campaign can be conducted in a thoroughgoing manner .
we should give rein to the roles played by offices under the joint conference in conducting combined and coordinated actions ; and should reinforce their functions in guiding , supervising , and inspecting the struggle against counterfeit currencies in key areas and in key townships and towns .
hanoi , 25 july (xinhua) - - chinese foreign minister tang jiaxuan addressed the eighth apec regional forum ministers ' meeting on 25 july , saying that the apec regional forum was the asian region 's most important venue for discussions of security problems in the area .
the chinese place great emphasis on this forum , and are willing to step up cooperation with all sides within the framework of the forum , jointly working hard for peace and stability in the region .
after passing through a difficult period , the relationship between china and the us , which was the focus of world attention , has begun to move in the direction of improvement of late .
since the two koreas successfully held the first talks between their heads of state , relations on the korean peninsula have noticeably warmed , and the situation has taken a positive turn .
the economy of east asia has not yet completely emerged from the shadow of the financial crisis , and right now is facing some new difficulties .
multinational problems pop up daily and present new threats to the security structure of the region .
continuing with research and development toward a missile defense plan will destroy the global strategic balance , and injure the peace and stability of the region . it will impact international arms control and the progress on anti - proliferation , and will be detrimental to trust and cooperation between nations .
a fundamental consensus was reached on three documents : the concepts and principles of defensive diplomacy , the purview of experts and famous persons , and strengthening the function of the chairman of apec . this embodies an important result obtained by the forum in establishing trust amid a too - high degree of defensive diplomacy .
china supports the forum 's hard work in implementing the documents on which a consensus has been reached .
tang jiaxuan also said that because non - traditional security is becoming more and more important with each passing day , china approves of the forum gradually developing dialogue and cooperation in the arena of non - traditional security , and is willing to take a positive attitude in participating in and developing the appropriate functions .
tang jiaxuan said that the world is richly diverse , and the asian region is even more so .
the use of one kind of political system or one kind of economic model to unify the asian region is not necessary and is also impractical .
china feels that the various social systems , development models and values systems in asia should be able to coexist for the long term , and supplant the weaknesses of any individual in competition , for common development in an environment of common goals and cherished differences .
the cold war has already concluded , and the security which each nation is seeking is mutual .
tang jiaxuan pointed out that the goals of china 's asian security policy were threefold . first is china 's own stability and prosperity ; second , the peace and stability of neighboring countries ; and third , the development , dialogue and cooperation among all asian nations .
china 's asian security policy has a foundation of special characteristics . these include emphasizing the peaceful nature of foreign policy , and the defensive nature of military strategy and cooperation in regional security , atop the foundation of maintaining the sovereignty and development of the nation .
he said that in recent years , china , like the majority of nations in asia , had established a friendly , good - neighbor policy for her relations with other asian nations as the world moves into the new century .
for this reason , china needs good relations with the nations on her borders . she needs a mutually beneficial and cooperative outside world .
last , tang jiaxuan pointed out that in the future , china would continue to work together with all the members of the forum to maintain and protect the peace and security of the asian region , and to stimulate mutually beneficial cooperation among all the nations of asia .
a prosperous , strong and more open china is a positive , constructive factor for asia and the world , and is absolutely not a threat .
powell indicated : the united states has taken note of chinese leaders ' emphasis on the importance of peace and development . the united states , like china , also faces the mission of preserving peace and promoting development . the united states wants to strengthen cooperation with china and work with china in creating a peaceful international environment .
one of our successful experiences in the rural reform is to fully respect the will of peasants . we must uphold this principle in the same way in our practice of land circulation " land is our lifeblood , and our fear is that our cadres may chant good scriptures in a distorted way . this worries us . "
these are the most commonly made remarks that these reporters have heard from peasants during their visit in rural areas .
the land issue has always been one of the most sensitive issues in rural areas .
for many years , any change with the land policy , even a slight alteration in wording , would evoke immediate response from peasants .
however , during the practice of land circulation today , what some cadres are doing has , intentionally or unintentionally , infringed upon the land contracting rights of our peasants .
seeing that many local rural households refused to accept the decision , the township authorities resorted to coercive means , ordering all land - tilling peasants to withdraw from their land within a certain time .
facing the land they had lost , the peasants were feeling very depressed : " all the cadres used to tell us that we would soon have ' gold eggs . ' today , even the hen that lays the eggs has ' flown away , ' what are we supposed to do in the future ? "
similar practices also exist , to varying degrees , in other parts of the country .
" it is true that the state encourages a legal circulation of land use rights , yet such a practice must never go against the will of peasants ! "
the experiences we have attained in rural development ever since the founding of new china have proved repeatedly that whenever we respect the will of peasants , the peasants will show a high enthusiasm and agriculture will undergo a rapid growth ; otherwise , agriculture will stop growing and will even shrink .
" land is where the greatest interest of peasants lies , and also the biggest factor that ensures stability in rural areas .
during the practice of land circulation , cadres must never resort to coercion and commandism at the expense of the interest of peasants ! "
if our cadres fail to have a clear or a thorough understanding of the party 's rural land policy , they will surely make mistakes without knowing why . "
a township cadre who used to force peasants into circulating their land and met opposition from peasants cited his personal experiences : we must not do things blindly or make choices for peasants .
if we force things through , peasants will be against us and disturbances will occur in rural areas !
these reporters have found during their visit in rural areas that some cadres still set the idea of " keeping land contracts unchanged for 30 years " against the practice of land circulation , and a household - based operation and collective ownership against the development of a modern agriculture .
guided by the aforementioned outmoded concepts , some localities even separated the land contractual period from the land management period during the second - round signing of land contracts , adding such a clause to the contract : the contractual period will last 30 years , with a five - year management period .
this makes many peasants worry that they may forever lose their land once they agree to put their land into circulation .
the practice in some localities by which land circulation is directly manipulated by township and village authorities is also apt to constitute an infringement on the contractual rights and interests of peasants .
the reason for such a situation is that the prices for reverse land leases and reverse land contracts , as well as the distribution of differential income , are all determined by cadres alone .
a city in fujian province has contracted a piece of well - located and fertile land to a foreign company , at an annual rental of as low as 90 kg of rice per mu ; and such a situation has prompted local peasants to appeal to the higher authorities for help for many times .
in a number of localities in hainan province , the lease period of some land contracts lasts as long as 50 - 70 years , while others even have an indefinite duration . peasants commented angrily : this is tantamount to taking away the land already contracted to us , is it not ? !
what is more , some localities have resorted to the practice of pooling land in the name of the villagers ' congress , and this actually represents an alteration to land contracts which are supposed to remain unchanged for 30 years .
in other localities , village cadres are the ones to decide to whom and at what price a land contract shall be issued , and this is all the more a practice that denies the status of rural households as the principal part of the market economy .
according to the statistics released by a department handling the petitions and appeals of the masses under the ministry of agriculture , the number of petitions and appeals made by peasants concerning the issue of land in the first quarter of this year increased by over 50 percent as compared to the same period last year .
among these petitions and appeals , many are related to land circulation . a sociologist has expressed belief that under china 's current imperfect social security system , land remains the most reliable social security for peasants ; and the fact that some peasants have temporarily left their land does not mean they no longer need the land .
today , peasants working as laborers in other parts of the country are mostly leading an unstable life , and the piece of land they have kept in their hometown still serves as the last defense line in their life security .
as an authoritative source has stressed , a continued and sound implementation of the policy on extending land contracts for another 30 years without change serves as the basis for a successful circulation of land use rights .
rather than separating the land use rights of rural households from their contractual rights , the practice of land circulation aims to further consolidate the land contractual rights of rural households , and to make peasants understand the rights they are entitled to with relation to land .
governmental departments must provide guidance for and exercise control over the work encouraging the circulation of land use rights has always been a major content of the central rural policy .
today , from our practice in this aspect , we can see that problems emerged during the process of land circulation must not be overlooked , but should be subjected to a more strict regulation and control .
the authoritative source has also pointed out the need to make clear the following several points during the present period : first , land circulation has to be based on a sound implementation of the land contract extension policy .
in other words , it is up to rural households themselves to decide whether their land needs to be circulated .

the g-8 summit ended amid anti - globalization protests .
meetings dogged by protests beginning as early as 1995 , anti - globalization protests became violent during the 1999 wto seattle meeting , raising worldwide attention .
protests during the recent g-8 summit in genoa were unprecedentedly violent , leaving one dead and more than 300 injured .
the rise of the anti - globalization movement is the negative fallout from economic globalization .
rapid economic globalization has not only sparked dissatisfaction from impoverished countries , it has also met strong opposition from environmentalists and trade unions in developed countries representing social sectors that will suffer from globalization .
negative fallout anti - globalization activists have condemned modern capitalism for only taking economic growth and business profits into account , showing no regard for social welfare , and even undermining culture and the ecological environment .
they hold that the globalization process with multinationals and international economic organizations as representatives has exacerbated the disparity between rich and poor and social unrest in underdeveloped countries .
for this reason , the tide of anti - globalization protesters has focused its criticism on multinationals , accusing them of infringing on labor rights , damaging the ecological environment , and aggravating the poverty of the third world .
they have also denounced the world bank , imf , wto , and other international economic organizations for vigorously pushing forward the globalization process and for being reduced to " slaves " of multinationals .
the rapid development of the anti - globalization movement has presented rigorous challenges to the g-8 summit ; that is , how to eliminate the negative fallout from economic globalization and help poverty - stricken countries embark on the road of sustained development .

new characteristics of us economic slowdown what people are concerned about at present is this : is the slowdown in the us economic growth an omen of an economic recession or is it a cyclic adjustment in order to " build up the potential " for a new round of long - term growth ?
judging by the circumstances observed so far , this economic slowdown in the united states is different from any other in the past .
since world war ii , almost every recession of the us economy has stemmed from the deterioration of inflation , but this time , the economic slowdown is taking place when the inflation rate is very low , the banking sector is healthy , and economic efficiency has by and large improved .
the ratio of bad accounts among us banks is currently still at a low level of 0.6 to 0.8 percent .
this is also the main reason why the current stock market volatility in the united states is different from the outcome of previous financial crises .

the " culture of the emperor 's people " does not enjoy popular support recently , some promoters of " taiwan independence " culture in taiwan have stressed in their writings the effect of " the culture of the emperor 's people " during japan 's 50 years in taiwan .
on this , professor zeng points out , " that sort of talk is historical ignorance .
in the era of japanese occupation , japan committed heinous crimes in taiwan . in 50 years , the japanese murdered 600,000 taiwan compatriots . this explains the fierce resistance of the people of taiwan . "
professor zeng brought up two examples to explain the centripetal force which draws taiwan compatriots towards the motherland .
the first is the spoken and written language .
nevertheless , after the recovery of taiwan in 1945 , the streets were full of people starting to speak mandarin .
as for the overwhelming majority of taiwan compatriots who at that time spoke the minnan dialect , studying mandarin and studying japanese were both new things to them , and both about as difficult . but the people of taiwan felt that to study mandarin was glorious , while speaking japanese was shameful .
the second example is religious beliefs .
the gods which are worshipped in taiwan today all came from the mainland , not japan .
mainly there are three objects of worship : mazu [ ma - tsu ] , guan yin , and guan gong .
their temples are to be found all over the island .
taiwan 's oldest buddhist temple is the longshan temple in lugang . what is revered here is a tang dynasty copper statue of guan yin brought from the longshan temple in quanzhou [ fujian province ] .
professor zeng said , " the core of culture mainly has two parts : first , the spoken and written language , and second , religious beliefs .
" independent taiwan culture " is a road not to take the greatest effect of culture is imperceptible change , imperceptible influence , " internal change " in people 's minds without their knowing or feeling it .

since the change of political power in taiwan , the authorities of the democratic progressive party have refused to acknowledge the one - china principle , and they have repudiated the 1992 agreement regarding both sides of the strait upholding the one - china principle .
xu shiquan , director of the institute of taiwan studies of the chinese academy of social sciences , has published a detailed analysis in the latest issue of zhongguo pinglun here in hong kong , reviewing the entire course of events of the 1992 agreement .
after 1987 , when the taiwan authorities opened the way for taiwan compatriots to travel to the mainland to visit relatives , more and more issues arose which required joint handling on both sides of the strait .
faced with this unavoidable fact , the sef agreed to discuss the issue of the one - china principle at the talks in hong kong .
at the meeting , the arats proposed five plans regarding the written expression of the one - china principle . the sef also provided five such plans , and later it proposed three plans for the verbal expression of it .
the third of these verbal expressions was , " as both sides of the strait work hard together in the process of seeking national unification , although both sides uphold the one - china principle , they differ in their understanding of the meaning of ' one china . '
but in light of the frequency of interaction between people on both sides of the strait , so as to protect the rights and interests of people on both sides of the strait , there should be a better resolution to the question of examining and verifying documents . "
when the two associations concluded their talks in hong kong , they had not reached a common view on a plan for a statement .
although the plan proposed " a difference in understanding " by the two sides regarding the meaning of " one china , " the arats could consider , along with sef , using the content of the individual verbal statements described above as an expression of each side 's attitude toward support of the one - china principle .
also , the arats hoped that the sef would be able to confirm that this was the formal view of the taiwan side .
the letter formally notified the sef that the key points of the verbal statement by arats would be , " discussion of routine affairs by the two sides of the strait will not touch upon the political meaning of ' one - china . ' "
on 3 december , the sef sent the arats a letter in reply to the letters of 16 and 30 november .
so the two sides acknowledged verbally that both sides of the strait supported the one - china principle , and also that their routine discussions would not touch upon the dispute over the meaning of one china .
this was how the issue of a common understanding stood in 1992 .
xu shiquan believes that the common understanding of 1992 is still the most practical foundation on which to restore cross - strait dialogue and consultations .
at present , the cross - strait issue is a matter of " everything ready , except the crucial element , " and that crucial element is one china .
experts have been of the view that domestic consumption has become an important force supporting china 's economic rebound this year .
since the beginning of this year , while growth in exports demand has been noticeably slowing down , china 's domestic consumption market has been maintaining an active sales trend .
consumption , investment , and exports have always been regarded as a " triad " that supports china 's economic growth .
following an increase in 1999 , in january 2001 , the chinese government again raised wages for state functionaries and employees of state - owned institutes .
tourism and shopping fever during holidays have continued to contribute to consumption growth .
now there are 52 " short holidays " and three " long holidays " - - " may day , " " national day , " and " spring festival " - - in a year in china , and total holidays in a year are nearly one - third of the total number of days in a year .
these festivals and holidays provide consumers with ample shopping time and a good consumption atmosphere , and the consumption market has seen three high - growth periods in a year , respectively during the three " long holidays . " urban residents ' leisure activities and entertainment consumption during festivals and holidays have gradually become a new consumption trend .

with great fanfare , china is currently preparing its manned space flight project .
aerospace experts here believe that if china wanted to build a space station in this new century , it could make the technical breakthroughs , and based on current technology a lifespan of at least five years would be assured .
china 's manned space flight project , the current shenzhou spacecraft , is just a tool , a system for transport between the ground and space .
we have the technology for prolonging the life of a space station experts from the aerospace field here point out that the most difficult thing about building a space station is resolving the problem of long life , and that one good point about a space station is that it can be repaired .
china already has a definite technical foundation for solving the problem of longevity . for example , the lifespan of the dongfanghong-2 satellite was to be five to six years , but the designed lifespan of the dongfanghong-3 satellite is eight years ( and it has now been operating for three years ) .
the second major difficulty in building a space station is the need for long - term maintenance of conditions in which people can live and work .
experts believe that the key to whether or not china could build a space station is how much investment the nation would make in the project .
if these problems are not resolved , the conditions are not present for the construction of a long - lasting space station .

the use of social surveys to understand the views of the public on particular issues is actually quite a good way of understanding public opinion .
i have also organized and personally conducted such social surveys and know that differences in the way questions are set , the methods of sampling , the number of samples taken , where the surveys are conducted , the methods of statistical computation and even the attitude on the part of the opinion pollsters will produce very different figures .
moreover , given the differences in the standpoint and aim of the pollsters , especially if the pollsters do not keep track of fixed targets over an extended period , the data obtained may not necessarily reflect the true picture and can at best serve as references .
however , we should not stop eating for fear of choking and negate opinion polls altogether .
as long as we can take the poll results without preconceptions or expectations and can scientifically analyze the figures obtained , we will still be able to draw some valuable conclusions .
since these are not commercial surveys of a general nature but are important social surveys on a cross - strait issue that may influence the decisions of the authorities , they are naturally worthy of our attention .
" since they gave a strong hint of the pollster 's stance and sounded intimidating , one can well imagine the results . "
taking a neutral stand , popular polls seek to gauge the true opinion of the people in order to provide a correct basis for the public and the decisionmakers . official polls seek to " create popular opinion " for government policies and mislead the people .
the difference in position and differences in people 's cognition of " one country , two systems " are the main reasons why official and popular polls came to different conclusions .
this is also proven by facts .

since the taiwan question is a question left by the civil war between the cpc and the kuomintang , and the two sides of the strait have been separated for over 50 years , achieving reunification naturally involves a fair amount of difficulties , as it will take painstaking negotiations and agreement between the authorities on both sides .
of course there must be a precondition for talks , namely , that both sides must recognize the one - china principle and that the solution of the taiwan question is china 's internal affair .
this precondition is a necessary indication that both sides are sincere in their wish to achieve reunification .
the policies and methods of the chinese communists for the solution of the taiwan question will not be the same as those for the solution of the hong kong and macao questions . they will not be carbon copies of the " hong kong model . "
it is therefore all right to hold talks on the future country name and taiwan 's political status in the course of cross - strait reunification . the name does not necessarily have to be prc , and taiwan does not necessarily have to be called the " taiwan special administrative region " after reunification .
" one country " is an indication of china 's complete realization of national reunification , while " two systems " just shows that hong kong , macao , taiwan and the mainland have their own social systems .
in short , taiwan 's official and popular polls are both conducted on erroneous information , at least inaccurate information , which naturally means that they cannot lead us to a correct understanding of whether the taiwan people choose " one country , two systems . "
however , after a - bian came to power with less than 40 percent of voter support , he got dizzy with success and thought that " taiwan independence " was the popular opinion in taiwan .
in the 1990 s , opinion polls in taiwan showed that only three to four percent of respondents were in favor of " one country , two systems . " today , the percentage of support for " one country , two systems " is 10 times the figure 10 years ago .

cpc central committee 29 july 2001
in his summing - up speech at the study meeting , wu guanzheng , member of the cpc central committee political bureau and secretary of the shandong provincial party committee , emphatically pointed out : " comrades in shandong should further emancipate their minds and make great strides forward amid innovation . "
wu guanzheng said : at present we are encountering in our work many practical contradictions and problems that we are unable to resolve through past experience or find a solution in past documents .
as the broad masses of the people are the mainstay in innovation , leading cadres at all levels must respect their pioneering spirit and know how to discover advanced models and popularize advanced experiences to guide and promote work in the entire area concerned .
in the new historical period , we must , in the light of the realities of economic development and social progress , constantly build up the party 's class base and broaden its mass base to constantly enhance the party 's social influence .
many delegates looked back on shandong 's party building history over the past eight decades , pointing out that shandong had , in all historical periods , had large numbers of excellent cadres with party membership bringing along the development of the revolutionary and construction causes and social progress with exemplary actions that commanded admiration and respect .
among them , jiao yulu , kong fansen , xu honggang , han suyun , zhang haidi , wang tingjiang , zhang ruimin , and other excellent representatives became models for chinese communists in different historical periods .
comrade jiang zemin 's party founding anniversary speech has given the shandong cadres and masses an encouragement and impetus to pioneer another great cause .
leading cadres attending the study meeting had lively discussions and expressed their views freely both inside and outside the meeting hall .
governor li chunting and vice governor han yuqun talked , in conjunction with the reality of steady growth in the provincial economy during the first half of the year , about the sense of urgency and responsibility in further accelerating shangdong 's economic development .
in the face of the good situation of steady growth in the provincial economy , leading comrades attending the study meeting always kept a cool head .
we should , in accordance with the requirements of " three represents , " make great efforts to bring about a new leap in the development of shandong 's productive forces .
we must vigorously enhance the quality of workers and promote economic development by relying on the deepening of the reform and on scientific and technological advancement and paying particular attention to making a good job of reforming state - owned enterprises and enhancing their vitality .
at the same time , we must accelerate the course of urbanization and combine urban reform with rural reform , economic structural reform , and political structural reform to open up an even broader thoroughfare for the advanced productive forces to develop .
wu guanzheng 's speech at the study meeting - - " shandong should make great strides forward amid innovation " - - vigorously struck a responsive chord in the hearts of the participating comrades .
in their speeches , many comrades mentioned that the ideological line of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts ran through the entire speech of comrade jiang zemin at the party founding anniversary and that the speech was an example of bravery in making innovations .
we must understand and grasp this quintessence very well in studying the " speech " and emancipate our minds , seek truth and be practical , be bold in making innovations , and progress with the times .
sun shuyi , deputy secretary of the provincial party committee and secretary of the jinan city party committee , mentioned : it is necessary to take the innovation of the style and techniques of leadership as the substance of and critical link in implementing the guidelines of the speech and practicing the " three represents . "
he said : scientific and technological innovation is the key , industrial innovation the core , system innovation the driving force , and environmental innovation the guarantee .
wu bangguo , member of the cpc central committee political bureau and vice premier of the state council , wu yi , alternate member of the cpc central committee political bureau and state councilor , and wang zhongyu , state councilor and secretary general of the state council , joined zhu on his inspection trip .
afterward , they had a discussion with the cadres of the sgaic ranking at and above the level of deputy department head .
at the discussion meeting , zhu rongji extended his greetings to the broad ranks of cadres and employees working in the industrial and commercial administration sector across the country and offered his condolences to the families of those employees who had laid down their lives in industrial and commercial law enforcement operations .
zhu rongji pointed out : under the new circumstances , it is necessary to fully appreciate the important status of industrial and commercial administration departments and the responsibility that they shoulder .
he said : to reinforce the government function in market regulation and law enforcement is an essential requirement for the establishment and perfection of the socialist market economic system .
there is no socialist market economy to speak of without strong and effectiveness regulation and law enforcement .
industrial and commercial administration departments are important functional departments for market regulation and administrative law enforcement , as the important burden of responsibility for regulating and maintaining the market order rests with them .
in a nutshell , they should keep effective control of the points of entry into the subject of market , act as competent " referees " for market operation , and be staunch defenders of the market order .
this fully demonstrates the great importance that the central authorities attach to industrial and commercial administration work .
in some places , the activities of making and selling counterfeit shoddy commodities are still very rampant and many " five - small " businesses that have been closed down and businesses that operate without license are still operating . major safety accidents that occurred in some places recently were mostly connected to this .
secondly , cases of resisting law enforcement with violence have increased , as some lawless individuals have openly hurt law enforcers .
these circumstances indicate that the tasks for rectifying and regulating the market order are very arduous and complicated .
zhu rongji pointed out : to conduct the rectification and regulation of the market economic order in depth is an important measure for consolidating the current positive economic situation and overcoming the difficulties facing us .
at present , they should focus on the following aspects of work : first , they should concentrate their resources to continue the stern crackdown on the lawbreaking and criminal activities of making and selling counterfeit and shoddy commodities .
secondly , they should give full play to their function in registration management , strengthen the supervision on business registration , and keep a tight control of market access .
thirdly , they should intensify law enforcement against irregular competition and monopoly .
the focus should be placed on investigating and handling irregular competition or restriction of competition ; firmly break regional blockade and monopoly of industry ; and promote fair competition in the market .
fourthly , they should strengthen regulation of trademarks and advertising .
supervision on the smuggled goods markets that have been banned should be strengthened , to prevent the dying embers from flaring up again .
firstly , they should change their mindset conscientiously and make sure that their proper function is brought into play .
the complete disconnection of industrial and commercial administration sector from the market it runs is an important issue of principle that does not allow an ounce of ambiguity and not even the slightest connection is allowed to remain .
all departments in the industrial and commercial administration sector must strictly implement the stipulation of " keeping separate accounts for revenue and expenditure " in relation to the revenue from administrative fees and fines and confiscations .
it is necessary to firmly redress any form of linking revenue to expenditure , so as to ensure impartial and strict law enforcement with the right mechanism and system .
thirdly , it is necessary to strengthen the building of the contingent and raise the standard of regulation .
overall , the contingent of staff of industrial and commercial administration departments we have today is good and a batch of excellent law enforcers who are brave to enforce the law , defy violence and brute force , and do not hesitate to lay down their lives have come to the fore .
it is necessary to punish corruption among law enforcers in a stern manner and strengthen the building of clean and honest administration .
they should make a good job of market regulation and law enforcement by presenting a clean , honest , and lofty image ; demonstrating the mighty power of dispensing the law without bias ; and embodying the laudable spirit of standing by their principle .
fourthly , it is necessary to take full advantage of modern information technology to improve the means of regulation and law enforcement .
it is necessary to strengthen and push forward the informationization of the nationwide industrial and commercial administration sector ; continue to conduct well the construction of computer networks ; upgrade the equipment in such areas as communications , transportation , and regulation ; recruit professionals from extensive sources ; and strengthen market regulation and law enforcement more effectively .

today 's international economic competition ultimately is a competition among the transnational corporations . without such companies of our own , we have no means to compete with the international transnational companies , nor do we have the means to handle the challenges posed by our wto accession .
furthermore , the most important thing in enterprise reorganization is to create some core enterprises , some dragon - head enterprises . without the core enterprises and dragon - head enterprises , reorganization and readjustment will be very difficult , and no matter how we piece things together , it will not work .
( 1 ) after the hard work over the last few years , state enterprises reform and development have made great strides .
( 2 ) in the last decade or so , we have actively explored the development of enterprise groups and have accumulated some beneficial experiences , and of course we have learn many hard lessons too .
by reviewing those experiences and lessons , we have gained further understanding of the objective laws of development of large companies and enterprise groups .
( 3 ) china has tentatively developed some large companies and enterprise groups of good size and strength with good developmental prospects .
although compared with the world 's first - rate enterprises , these enterprises still lag far behind , and overall they are still not that strong and are still in the fledgling stage of development , they have laid a solid foundation for participating in international competition .
under the circumstances , the work to develop some large companies and enterprise groups must follow market economic order , and we must adopt more market measures to create the conditions for enterprises to continue to develop and strengthen amid the market competition .
one , we cannot simply play matchmaker in organizing and setting up the enterprise groups ; we cannot use administrative means to put them together .
moreover , we are also in possession of some successful experiences in following market order to reorganize and set up enterprise groups .
we must give prominence to their main businesses and work on increasing their competitive edge .
in the last two years , we have successfully supported and organized the listing on the overseas markets such companies as china mobile communications , china national petroleum , china national petrochemicals , china united telecommunications , and china national offshore oil .
therefore , it is very inadequate for the large companies and enterprise groups that have good developmental prospects and tentative international competitiveness to be listed only on the domestic market to compete only with other domestic enterprises . without going on the big stage of international competition , we will never learn about our own deficiencies .
at the same time , if we want to break the bondage of the traditional concepts and systems and replace them with more effective incentive and restraint mechanisms , the most practical and effective way is to list the companies on the overseas markets .
large companies and enterprise groups are formed , and continue to thrive , amid market competition .
greenhouses never produce towering trees .
in the past , to encourage and support the development of enterprise groups , we formulated many favorable policies and fed the enterprise groups a " special diet . "
at the same time , we must put more force into supervising and managing the large companies and enterprise groups to guarantee the safety and appreciation of the state 's assets .
two , some reform measures can be tested first in the large companies and enterprise groups .
if the pilot programs turn out to be a success , we not only can solve the large companies ' and enterprise groups ' problems but can then broaden the application and solve everybody 's problems .
therefore , one important policy in supporting the large companies and enterprise groups ' development is to give priority to these companies and enterprise groups to pilot the reform of the socialist market economic system .
problems in the development of large companies and enterprise groups that require proper solutions today 's tasks of state enterprises reform and development are arduous and complicated ; the development of large companies and enterprises groups also has many problems that require prompt solutions and tasks that need to be tackled .
a. take aim at the world 's first - rate enterprises ; gauge the distance , and set the goal the large companies ' and enterprise groups ' major competitors are the internationally renowned transnational corporations .
china 's large companies and enterprise groups should not just put themselves in the " a - team " of the national soccer league but should rate themselves by the " world cup " standard .
only by comparing can we separate the good from the bad , gauge the distance , and set the direction of reform and development , and only then can we increase our sense of urgency , sense of responsibility , and sense of mission .
our large companies and enterprise groups must have this kind of ambition and aspiration .
if we spend five years or more and work hard to create 30 to 50 world - class enterprises , it will be a huge contribution to the chinese nation .
today , many enterprises still have high revenues from sales , but their profit is low . this is mainly because they are overstaffed and the labor productivity rate is low , which eat up their profit .
the wage is not much , but there are a lot of benefits , and while the apparent cost is not high , the hidden cost is not low , and no matter how low the wages , there are too many mouths to feed .
of course , personnel retrenchment is premised upon the maintenance of social stability .
instead , we must increase enterprises ' r & d and market operation and sales capabilities , promote specialization and cooperation , and rectify and improve enterprises ' organizational structure .
if this problem is not solved , if enterprises ' r & d capability is not raised , if their market operation and sales are not strengthened , and if the main businesses are not emphasized , it will be impossible for them to adapt to the market or develop new markets .
three , we must solve the problem of making enterprises take up social work .
c. accelerate the establishment of the technological innovation mechanism , increase enterprises ' technological innovation capability increasing enterprises ' technological innovation capability is the key to increasing enterprises ' core competitiveness .
many of our research institutes are technologically very strong ; the scientific and research personnel are very career - minded and highly qualified , and if we are willing to invest in them , they can come up with the new technologies .
the workers will understand and even support this kind of reform , because it facilitates enterprises ' development and will benefit the workers themselves .
if nothing works , we can still resort to " physical isolation " and separate technological innovations from general production and management .
we must strive to do a good job turning money into technologies and from technologies back into money ; we must promote the benign money - - technology - - money cycle , so that enterprises can continuously increase their technological innovation capability and their competitiveness .
enterprises must pay close attention to the nurturing and utilization of scientific and technological personnel and management and administrative personnel , especially the young and talented . they should strive to create a good environment for utilizing and attracting the talented and build the mechanism whereby the talented can stand out and are put to full use .
enterprise competition ultimately is the competition of talent .
today , one very important criterion gauging the performance of the enterprise bosses is whether they have successfully nurtured some young , outstanding senior management personnel .
sending workers out to undergo training is an important way to nurture the talented .
after three to five years , when they come home , they can be put to good use in the enterprises .
this is an urgent necessity if the large companies and enterprise groups hope to increase their international competitiveness , and it will have a profound impact on their long - term development .

according to statistics released by taiwan 's " ministry of finance , " 4,995 factories stopped operations or were closed in 2000 , up 25.44 percent over 1999 .
in the meantime , the industrial sector , including the manufacturing industry , and the commercial sector have shown stagnation and recession in varying degrees .
the stock market and foreign exchange market , which serve as the " barometer " of the economic situation and popular faith , have plunged over the last year .

we must continue to study the new situations and new problems arising from the reforms , constantly improve our policies and measures , and explore and create new mechanisms so that the reforms will continue to develop in depth .
we must continue to reform the basic medical and health care system for workers , improve all the related policies , expand the coverage of the insurance program , and establish a rational mechanism governing the sharing of medical expenses .

we must speed up reforming the management of medical institutions of different categories and implement the policies that define property rights , regulate operations , supervise the medical trade , and oversee development plans , so that medical institutions of different categories can compete and develop together fairly .

we must strictly regulate the centralized purchase of pharmaceuticals through bidding .

we must develop chain pharmacies and centralized drug delivery service , support the development of the outstanding pharmaceutical manufacturers , and make them the main suppliers of pharmaceuticals so that the masses will feel safe in using their products .

the general and specific policies for the " three reforms " have now been clearly defined .

reporter : in his " 1 july " important speech , general secretary jiang zemin incisively expounded the important idea that " peace and development complement each other " and that " the questions of peace and development are in essence the question of north and south . "
we often say that peace and development are the themes of our times . how should we understand the dialectical relationship between peace and development ?
ni jianmin : peace and development complement each other .
since the end of the bipolar pattern , the peace forces have gotten stronger day by day , and development has increasingly become a most important issue of general concern to various countries .
with the extensive and in - depth development of economic globalization , regionalization , and grouping , whether developing countries will be able to make effective economic development in the 21 st century will directly influence and restrict the economic development of all other countries in the world .
through decades of development after the end of world war ii , the gap between the poor and rich countries in the world has not narrowed but widened .
per capita income in some poor countries is even less than 1 percent of that in developed countries .
in the 1960 s , africa was more than self - sufficient in grain , but now it has become a continent where people are suffering from poverty and hunger .
in the 21 st century , it is the duty of the whole world , including the developed countries , to find a way out for the development of the world economy and to prevent the gap between the rich and poor countries from widening and a crisis resulting from a widening gap .
the tendency toward the widening of the gap between north and south will have a serious influence on peace and development in the world .
viewing from the situation , it is difficult to effectively eliminate the opposition between north and south , and the gap between north and south may further widen as a whole .
now there is serious poverty in developing countries , and the basic needs of life for a considerable number of people still cannot be satisfied ; the rate of resource utilization is low , and economic development is hardly sustained ; the capacity for environmental protection is poor , and environmental pollution is serious .
in this sense , the current international mechanisms is not only nonconducive to narrowing the gap between north and south but may contribute to widening it and lead to a grimmer situation in opposition between them .
viewing from structures , both the north and the south have become further divided internally and weaker as a whole .
the economic disparities within countries in the south have increased , which have led to differences in their respective economic policies and market demand . therefore , it is very difficult for countries in the south to form an integrated group or speak with one voice in dealing with economic affairs , as they did in the past .
viewing from countries in the north , they are not so divided as countries in the south , but their policies and attitudes toward the countries in the south are not so consistent with one another as they used to , owing to their increasingly fierce contention for markets ; so different countries are pursuing quite different policies .
ni jianmin : in view of the fact that both the north and south are considerably divided internally so that they can hardly speak each with one voice , it is practically impossible to hold a north - south dialogue worldwide .
the old international economic order was a product of the imperialist colonial age , including an international production system with irrational international division of labor as its basis , a capitalist international trade system with the exchange of unequal value as its basis , and a capitalist monetary and financial system with monopoly as its basis .
it was an important material foundation for economic growth , technological progress , and social stability in the developed countries after world war ii , where lay the crucial reason for the economic backwardness and social poverty of developing countries .
reporter : what can china contribute to solving the question of north and south ?
ni jianmin : china is a developing country , and the question of development is a question china wants to solve with all its energies .
these remarks fully express the aspirations of the peace - loving chinese people .

beijing , 31 july (xna) - - china 's military is currently and with full enthusiasm studying high - tech knowledge , mastering the techniques of its new equipment , and carrying out large - scale sci - tech military exercises .
the entire military has carried out comprehensive and key reforms , from military tactics to military campaigns , from individual military branches to joint forces , and from military methods to training methods . in doing so , they have greatly increased the overall capabilities of the troops to wage warfare .
the large - scale sci - tech military exercises have made many achievements using new experiments , such as combined operations drills , internet warfare against directorate organizations , rapid reaction training of artillerymen , training in offshore composite formation by numerous naval vessels , mobile launch training for missile troops , and others .
training concepts that unceasingly challenge tradition have effectively improved the quantity and quality of training , and have spurred the military to increase its combat capability through the use of its new equipment .
these large - scale sci - tech military exercises have utilized techniques on the training fields such as using new high - tech equipment with electronic deception , intelligence interference and deception , precision strike , and other features ; new techniques [ as received ] ; new military tactics ; and others .
in addition , the emphasis has been on training a new type of personnel who can master modern information techniques and then " devise strategies on the internet to ensure victory on the battlefield . "
the entire military has continually established automated command systems , and the levels of small arms performance and inspections and testing of defense against chemical attack have entered the advanced international ranks .
more than 90 percent of the high - and middle - level commanders throughout the entire military have gone through training at the national defense university , and within the ranks of the high - and middle - level commanders are a host of doctorate and master 's degree holders .
a vast group of military talents with modern scientific and cultural knowledge and administrative knowledge , and who are able to master modern weaponry and are able to organize and command modern warfare , is currently forming .

"
could you first discuss the meaning of " perception of security " ? [ peng guangqian ] so - called " security " is a state of survival in which subjectively one does not feel threatened and objectively a threat does not exist .
all these perceptions of security had a common characteristic - - the cold war mentality .

the essential difference between the new perception of security and the old perception of security is that the new perception completely discards the cold war mentality and is a new type of security idea in line with the needs of the times that has universal significance .

shenyang , 2 aug ( xinhua ) - - on 31 july , the first meeting of the 10 th shenyang city cpc committee elected zhang xingxiang [ 1728 5887 3276 ] secretary of the city cpc committee .
it has been over a year since the change of political parties in power .
under the atmosphere of both the ruling and opposition parties failing to win the majority approval in public opinions , it is not highly possible that in the future election for the legislative yuan a single political party can obtain more than a half of seats .
regarding the kmt who has for the first time played the role of an opposition party , the negative appraisals from the public have also increased : the dissatisfaction rate has increased from 42 percent to 54 percent and the satisfaction rate was maintained at 29 percent .

a navy normally must have three carriers of the same class before it can be considered as forming a really effective carrier combat force , and the price of three of the same class of aircraft carrier over their whole life span is $ 66 billion .

when put into direct opposition , carriers and other naval weapons systems , such as submarines and missile attack systems , cannot be regarded as among the most cost - efficient combat systems .

for the first time in march 1999 , comrade jiang zemin made in - depth explanation on the rich content of managing the army according to the law at a group discussion meeting of the chinese people 's liberation army [ pla ] during the second session of the ninth national people 's congress [ npc ] .
his remark at the meeting has elicited strong echoes at various levels of army 's leading organs and among troops units , which also pointed out the direction of progress for the army 's legal system building during the " ninth five - year plan . "
as these military laws , regulations , and rules dovetailed with one another and supported one another , they have enabled the progress of the defense and army building work according to the law , thereby creating favorable conditions for the shaping up of a military legal system with chinese characteristics .
since the enforcement of the " people 's air defense law " some 900 cases of damaging and destruction of air defense installations have been investigated and handled in the nation , resulting in the collection of compensation fees to the tune of 160 million yuan .
various levels of people 's courts in localities handled 4,961 cases involving the military with 4,182 cases closed , arranged and provided 15,733 out - of - court settlements of disputes and consultations , thereby greatly contributing to troop units ' and social stability .
some 40,000 officers and men from the army and from armed police corps attended lectures on laws . the army and armed police corps also handled some 7,000 legal issues .
some 42,000 military members have been awarded college certificates .
legal service work with special characteristics in may 1996 , the npc standing committee passed the " lawyer law " to define the legal status of the army 's lawyers , which laid a legal foundation for the thriving development of the army 's legal service work .
between 1996 - 1999 , various levels of legal service organs under the armed police corps handled 3,140 legal cases , provided 5,680 pieces of legal consultations for leaders and officers and men , opened 860 legal system courses , and saw 175,419 officers and men attending the courses .
in the past five years , the army has greatly promoted the legal service work and the number of army lawyers has constantly increased .
the army now has 272 legal consultation offices and 1,688 full - time and part - time lawyers .
on 31 july , the chinese ministry of foreign trade and economic cooperation [ moftec ] and the us trade and development agency [ tda ] , on behalf of their respective governments , signed in beijing a framework agreement on trade development and cooperation .
the signing of the agreement is important to sino - us economic and trade ties and sino - us ties , and symbolizes a new development in sino - us economic and trade ties .
as beijing will host the olympic games and china will join the world trade organization [ wto ] soon , the prospects for china and the united states to develop their economic and trade ties are bright .
on 13 january 2001 , the united states declared that the tda would resume its projects to assist china .
besides the cooperation framework agreement , both sides also signed four other agreements including an agreement on utilizing tda aid for shenhua 's liquefied coal project . the agreements will have significant impacts for both sides to expand cooperation in energy resources , infrastructure , and technology for environmental protection .
bush has become the us president for over six months . china and the united states have repeatedly encountered conflicts earlier . when commenting on sino - us economic and trade ties during that period , bush still said : " china is a rising major power [ xin xing de da guo ] .
he believes facilitating bilateral trade with china is beneficial to us entrepreneurs , high - technology personnel , and farm owners . according to chinese customs departments ' statistics , the trade volume between the two countries in 2000 amounted to $ 74.5 billion .
out of the total , china 's exports to the united states amounted to $ 52.1 billion , or 21 percent of china 's total exports . china 's trade surplus was $ 29.7 billion .
by then , after taking into consideration the accounts of both goods and services , china and the united states will have considerably reduced their bilateral trade imbalances .
for example , the coca - cola corporation attained 16 percent of its asian sales in china .
the proctor & gamble corporation , us biggest producer of household cosmetic products , is rapidly increasing its production of shampoo and hair care products in china . the amway corporation , us biggest distributor of daily products and food dealer , is also rapidly increasing its production of skin lotions and hair care products in china .
a us chamber of commerce senior adviser on trade issues pointed out : " all the major firms are selling their products to china . china 's biggest assets are its buying power . "
an important reason why sino - us economic and trade ties have been developing is that they are mutually highly complementary to each other .
the value of direct and indirect business opportunities involving beijing 's hosting the olympic games can amount to $ 100 billion . investors from various countries including us industrialists and businessmen have expeditiously made their moves , and striven to be the first to seize the opportunities by successively making contacts with beijing 's relevant departments .
the situation definitely will further advance sino - us economic and trade ties .
favorable sino - us economic and trade ties not only suit the fundamental interests of china and the united states , but also are conducive to an all - round development of sino - us ties .

in dealing with marxism , there have always been two stances : 1 . the dogmatic , empirical , and metaphysical stance on marxism . 2 . the scientific stance on marxism , or the objective stance of integrating theory with practice .
marx and engels always opposed treating their theories as an unchanging dogmatic and self - sealed system .
engels repeatedly stressed the need to treat marxism with a scientific stance .
he said that : " since socialism has become a science , we have to treat it as a science . "
" our theory is a developing one , not a dogma that has to be learned thoroughly and repeated mechanically . "
all who treat marxism as a science should and must adopt such a scientific stance .
it requires us to act in line with the basic principles and methods of historical materialism and dialectical materialism , steadily integrating them with the changing realities , to explore solutions to new problems .
real marxists cannot require the authors of the [ marxist ] classics to provide ready - made solutions to the problems that have occurred since their death .
from the day of its founding , the cpc has made marxism its theoretical grounds for guiding its ideas and actions .
comrade jiang zemin 's key " 1 july " speech symbolized a new stage in the development of sinified marxism .
from a historic perspective , the decline of a political force often starts first with an ideological decline .
but emancipation of the mind and seeking truth from facts is a powerful force for guiding social progress .
china 's basic national conditions are also far different from the western society that gave birth to marxism and the russian circumstances in which leninism emerged .
to fully practice the key thinking of the " three represents , " we have to always adhere to the ideological line of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts .
the process of emancipating the mind will not end , with the requirements of seeking truth from facts being unending .

can you tell us something about the background of energy restructuring in china ? [ wang jian ] the chinese economy grew more rapidly in the past 20 years than in any other period , its gdp expanding a fast 9.6 percent each year on the average .
china 's overall national savings rate since 1990 has risen notably , from 37 percent in the 1980 's to 42 percent . moreover , heavy industry now accounts for a markedly larger share of the gross value of industrial output , having increased from under 50 percent in the late 1980 's to 60 percent to date .
these are the characteristics of china 's energy resources .
petroleum consumption exceeds 40 percent of all energy consumption in every industrialized country .
what about boosting imports ?
some experts say that china should utilize petroleum in the world at the least possible cost and to the greatest extent possible . what 's your opinion ? [ wang jian ] i do n't think we should rely on imports excessively . besides , relying on foreign oil has many problems .
it is questionable that 100,000 - ton oil tankers bound for china would have a smooth passage through the already congested strait of malacca . [ xue xiaohe ] would it work if we do not adjust the energy structure ?
industrialization relies on cities and the development of cities , in turn , relies on plains .
plains account for just 12 percent of china 's total area , of which 90 percent are concentrated in the coastal region .
these facts suggest that with technological advances , even coal may become a clean energy . [ wang jian ] the problem these days is that energy conservation technology , the development of new energy and renewable energy , and coal - cleaning technology all come with a high price tag .
what role will prices play in energy restructuring ? this is a very important issue .
what they do consider is the costs they will have to pay for using new energy or adopting new technology . therefore , if their choices are to meet the long - term interests of society as a whole , we must make it economically feasible for them to do so .
toward that end , we must use prices as a guide . it is hoped that the authorities concerned would give more credence to the role of prices when they make plans for energy restructuring . we believe the market is more effective than administrative orders and even the law in guiding the behavior of profit - seekers .

significance of this telegram the full text of this congratulatory telegram of the cpc central committee to the kmt is only a bit over 100 words but its implications are far - reaching and thought - provoking .
first , kuomintang is a political party that has a long and glorious history . no matter in the northern expedition or in the war of resistance against japan , it had made important contributions .
at present , in taiwan the kmt has suffered a new setback and it was amid introspection that the whole party convened this congress .
it is quite unavoidable that any political parties or individuals would meet with setbacks and failures but it is undesirable that they fail to understand the setbacks and sum up the experiences and lessons .
and this is the first thing which is worth being congratulated at present - - that the kmt can review its past , wake up to reality , strive to pull its forces together , start afresh , raise its morale , and be bathed in fire for a new life .
personally , i highly appreciate these three points of lian zhan , which proves that the two parties of the kmt and the cpc still share a consensus in some basic aspects .
third , these three points mentioned by lian zhan are an important sign that the kmt is straightening out its line and direction .
when li denghui was kmt chairman , he first of all turned the " taiwanization of kuomintang " into " the kuomintang of taiwan , " which was in essence not different from " the democratic progress party of taiwan " at all .
it seems that some changes have already taken place within the kmt .
expectations of the people so far , the " 16 th congress " of the kmt has been concluded .

it is imperative to closely integrate loving taiwan with loving the motherland and democracy with reunification .

solidarity is the life of a political party .

members of the kmt cannot but maintain sharp vigilance against this .
without the solidarity of the kmt , there is not the solidarity of the supra - party " pan - blue army " ( including the kmt , people first party , and new party ) within taiwan island .
it must be pointed out that even within the " pan - green army " there is still only an extremely small number of people who belong to the diehard faction and resolutely oppose identifying themselves with china .

when second - round farmland contacts are to be concluded in all parts of the country , the central leadership made a policy decision to extend the tenure of the existing land contracts for " another 30 years without any change . "
rural reforms have been carried out for more than 20 years . the great success of the household contract farmland management system has been acknowledged by the whole world .
however , whenever difficulties and problems appeared in rural areas , criticisms against the household contract system would increase .
now , some cadres have not yet really understand the significance of contracting land management to households . as a result , they still attempt to do something to encroach upon the rights and interests of the peasants undertaking the land contracts .
some cadres held that keeping things " unchanged for 30 years " just referred to the right to undertake contracts , and did not refer to the specific piece of land being contracted and the specific people who were undertaking the contract .
in some areas , land being contracted to peasants was changed again and again frequently , and peasants could hardly understand which piece of land was put under their management .
in the name of developing scale operation , the local authorities in some areas forced peasants to change the land under their contracted management ; in some areas , the local authorities unilaterally terminated the land contracts , coercively retrieved land from peasants , and then issued land leases again at higher rates .
to stabilize and improve the household land contract system , we must first ensure that cadres at all levels have a correct understanding of the party 's land policy .
stabilizing and improving the household land contract system is the foundation for developing the rural economy , deepening rural reforms , and advancing rural work in all fields . cadres at all levels must bring their thinking into line with the central policy .
since the beginning of the rural reforms , the party 's land policy has been extensively supported by peasants .
over many years in the past , any little changes in the land policy , even the slightest change in the wording of a specific rule , may have caused rapid reactions from the peasants .
firmly keeping the household land contracts unchanged over a long time is the key to protecting peasants ' production enthusiasm and activeness .
to properly protect peasants ' production enthusiasm , the key lies in truly guaranteeing their material interests .
giving long - term and guaranteed rights to manage some fixed pieces of land under land management contracts is to give peasants full rights to use land , enjoy benefits from the use of land under the legal system .
peasants constitute the main force for developing the market economy in rural areas .
it was peasants who initiated such rural reforms as adopting the household land contract system , running township and town enterprises , and pursuing the system of villagers ' self - management .
land is the basic production material for peasants . according to our basic national conditions , in a fairly near period to come , agriculture will continue to be the main income source for most peasants .
land provides the most reliable livelihood guarantee for the peasants .
without the land as a guarantee , there will be no stable livelihood for the vast number of peasants .
at present , the prices of farm products remain at a low level ; the market for farm produce is sluggish ; the comparative economic efficiency of agriculture is still decreasing .
we should not set the household land contract system against agricultural modernization .
in the new century , people in many rural areas throughout the country are trying hard to advance agricultural modernization by means of attracting and absorbing investments and business opportunities and by means of developing high - efficiency agriculture .
the departments concerned should seriously make inspection , and order subordinate units that did not properly renew land contracts with peasants to take remedies within a set time limit .
the foundation for household contract - based operation will be further consolidated . only thus can rural social stability be guaranteed and the rural economy develop healthily .
the land use rights should mainly be transferred among peasant households .
party committees and governments at all levels should give more effective guidance , often inspect and supervise the work at lower levels , and guarantee the complete implementation of the party 's rural land policy .
