after entering russia on 26 july , kim chong - il , leader of the democratic people 's republic of korea [ dprk ] , arrived in moscow on 3 august to begin his official visit in russia - - the first one a top dprk leader pays russia since the 1980 's .
on 4 august , kim chong - il and russian president putin held talks and signed the " moscow declaration . "
kim chong - il 's current visit to moscow is another important event in the history of the development of relations between the dprk and russia since putin visited pyongyang last year .
following the disintegration of the soviet union , russia began to bend more on developing relations with the republic of korea [ rok ] and the development of russia - dprk relations came to a stop for a time .
after putin became president , he adjusted russia 's diplomatic policy toward the dprk and began to follow a policy of developing balanced relations with the rok and the dprk in the korean peninsula .
first of all , russia 's adjustment of its foreign policy toward the dprk has a close bearing on the fact that the two countries have common views on many international issues , especially on the russia - us disputes over the antiballistic missile [ abm ] treaty and other issues relevant to the world 's strategic stability .
both the dprk and russia have criticized the us accusation as totally groundless , and they are unequivocal in opposing the us deployment of the nmd system and the deployment of theater missile defense [ tmd ] system in the asia - pacific region .
the " moscow declaration " points out that the abm treaty is the cornerstone of the world 's strategic stability and the foundation of further reducing the offensive strategic weapons .
during the talks , kim chong - il indicated to putin that the dprk would continue to abide by its commitment that the dprk would not conduct missile - launching tests by the year 2003 .
since 2000 , putin has visited the dprk , mongolia , cuba , and vietnam in an effort to reinstate and develop russia 's relations with these countries that had been sluggish for many years .
his visits to these countries have important significance for reinstating russia 's influence in these countries , strengthening russia 's political and economic cooperation with these countries , expanding russia 's diplomatic space in the international arena , and winning more political , economic and strategic benefits for russia .
moreover , russia 's purpose of strengthening its ties with the dprk is to reinstate and increase its influence and right to speak over korean peninsula affairs .
according to reports , the peace process in the korean peninsula was one of the principal topics of discussion between kim chong - il and putin .
the two sides indicated in the " moscow declaration " that they would continue to push forward the process of achieving peaceful reunification in the korean peninsula and opposing outside forces from influencing the korean peninsula 's process of peaceful reunification .
the efforts russia has made to reinstate and strengthen its ties with the dprk also reflect the needs of the two countries to develop the economic and trade cooperation .
during their talks , the russian and the dprk leaders focused on discussing the cooperation projects , such as modernizing the korean enterprises built with assistance from the former soviet union , modernizing the railways in the dprk , and connecting russia 's siberian railway with the railways that link the dprk and the rok .

beijing , 6 aug ( xinhua ) - - since the beginning of this year , the volume and growth rate of our country 's foreign trade exports has seen a marked decline , and a negative growth rate was recorded for the first time in june .
the downhill trend of foreign trade exports and the substantive decline in the growth rate of exports has become a prominent problem in our country 's economic development for the time being .
in the first half of this year , the whole country 's foreign trade exports increased by 8.8 percent over that in the same period of last year , but after march , the amount and growth rate of exports decreased month by month .
first , the economic slowdown in the united states and the economic recession in japan continued to deepen their negative impact on our country 's exports .
the united states is the largest export market for our country , and japan is the largest trade partner for our country .
in recent years , with the continuing increase in the costs of production in our country , the competitive power of some traditional export commodities , especially such labor - intensive products as textiles , shoes , bags , and toys , and some mechanical and electrical products has declined markedly .
in our country , the degree of reliance on foreign trade exceeds 40 percent , and the degree of reliance on exports alone reaches 23 percent . that is to say , over one - fifth of our country 's gdp comes from foreign trade and exports .
the expansion of foreign trade and exports will guarantee the healthy development of the national economy and play an important role in promoting the steady increases in employment , tax revenue , and the state 's foreign exchange reserve .
the maintenance of an appropriate growth rate of foreign trade and exports is directly related to the growth rate of gdp in our country .
currently , in our counties , over half of the exports are made by foreign - funded enterprises . in the first half of the year , the growth rate of exports in this sector was far more higher than the national average .
exports made by collective , private , and other enterprises also increased by big margins .
the party central leadership and the state council attach great importance to the current export work .
since the beginning of this year , the state council leaders have issued many important instructions on export work .
we must seriously implement the spirit of the state council 's instructions , effectively step up efforts to do a good job in promoting exports in the remaining months of this year , and try by all possible means to expand exports .
since the beginning of this year , the state has successively adopted a series of new measures for encouraging people to expand exports .

lhasa , 6 aug (zxs) - - since the peaceful liberation of tibet 50 years ago , earth - shaking changes have taken place in its society and economy .
moving from being sealed up to being open before its peaceful liberation , there was no significant foreign trade in tibet and barter trade with people in border areas of neighboring countries was the only trading activity .
only after that did tibet 's foreign trade really began to develop .
at that time , tibet 's border trade was mainly sino - indian border trade for importing grain , textiles , building materials and hardware goods from india .
according to statistics , tibet 's gross foreign trade volume from 1953 to 1962 was only slightly over 115 million yuan . barter trade was the basic form of trade and silver dollars were used only to make up for any shortage .
after the relations between china and india discontinued in 1962 , nepal replaced india as tibet 's main border trade partner .
this was the second stage in the development of tibet 's foreign and border trade .
according to statistics , from 1962 to 1979 , tibet 's gross foreign trade volume exceeded 228 million yuan , of which border trade accounted for over 60 million yuan .
suolang duoji told the reporter that tibet has as many as over 300 channels for border trade with neighboring countries and regions , over 30 ports with stable trade , and 12 ports with regular trade .
these ports are distributed in ngari , shannan , nyingchi and xigaze , of which zhangmu port on the boundary between tibet and nepal has developed to a considerable size .
suolang duoji said that in 2000 , tibet 's border trade exceeded $ 100 million for the first time , of which export accounted for over $ 102 million , an increase by 43 percent .
they include livestock products , such as sheep 's wool , cashmere and sheep , agricultural products , such as rapeseed and broad beans , and industrial products , such as textiles and mechanical and electrical products .
he said that in the long run , border trade will surely become an important form of tibet 's foreign trade .

this friend had been in prison in china during the cultural revolution , and was well - known for being sloppy .
we started to joke around that i was in the democracy movement and i should go to prison in china , so now i could get used to the conditions right here .

after four hours i was taken to the shenzhen ministry of state security , where i lost my freedom .
i was very angry , and i asked them why they had taken me .
on the second day " the superiors " came .
they were from the beijing ministry of state security .
solitary confinement in the " supervision residence " at the beginning of 1990 , i , together with a handful of scholars who were concerned about china 's future , organized various activities to research reform and liberalizations in china .
the union is not a spy organization .
at the beginning of the ' 90 s , i was working on three projects about cross - strait relations : a comparative study of economic systems on either side of the strait , one comparing political systems across the strait , and one on marriage across the strait .
because the chinese government would not extend my passport , i could not go home to china . so i asked a couple of chinese students studying in the united states and some friends in china to help me collect data .
for the purposes of the study , of course the more complete the data the better .
but freedom of information in the mainland is much different from the world standard , and some common data might very well be regarded as " secret " or " internal . "
all these restrictions and standards were actually difficult even for the chinese officials to keep straight , let alone an outsider .
so this time when the mainland authorities said they had " large quantities of proof " that i was collecting intelligence for a spy organization in taiwan , what they were talking about were the materials for my research .
actually , after the court investigation and appraisal , these materials were not state secrets . there was nothing outside the scope of scholarly research , so how could there be a " threat to national security " ? they said that i had been collecting intelligence for the " union . "
on july 14 , the court in beijing tried my case .
it could be called " self - investigation , self - proof . "
therefore , i was innocent . trial in the morning , verdict in the afternoon but although our arguments were the truth , and were all legal , they were of no use .
the decision had already been made .
the trial began at 9:00 in the morning , and ended at noon .
after the lunch break , the verdict was announced .
the arguments my lawyer and i made were all in vain .
the court did not take them into account .
therefore , the charges of espionage were upheld , and the court ordered my expulsion from china . this is my espionage ! naturally i could not accept this conviction . that is why i prepared to appeal , thinking to find the path of truth .
but my father and my lawyer got me to stop that way of thinking .
they told me that an appeal was just a waste of time .
actually , the reason i provoked this lawsuit was by no means accidental .
the policemen who interrogated me said that they had always been watching my activities , and had known everything about me for a long time .
as early as the beginning of 1987 , when hu yaobang - - the communist leader with a bent toward liberalization - - was purged , i and some chinese students at princeton organized more than 1,000 chinese students studying abroad for a petition drive protesting the chinese communist " opposition to the freedom of the proletariat . "
the price of this protest was that the chinese consulate refused to extend my passport .
at the time , i thought , the chinese communists cannot even put up with the enlightened leftists within the party . they will never tolerate a " rightist " like me . so their refusal to extend my passport was quite " reasonable . "
what made the chinese communists most angry about this survey was that almost no one agreed with writing the chinese communist leaders into the constitution .
these studies were very much in line with the definition of " crime " that the police were interrogating me about : taking money from taiwan , and collecting data in the mainland .
the chinese police were actually doing surveillance on me , and had spoken to my family members and my friends about my activities .
i said that was unnecessary , i knew too much about the implications of the special chinese " legal methods . "
my father , li honglin , was in the " surveillance residence " for nearly a year following the 1989 " june 4 " incident .
his " crime " was to tell the students to leave tiananmen square on behalf of the chinese communists . afterwards , he was accused by the authorities of " further instigating the students " ! no wonder the policemen interrogating me said that my family had a " reactionary " tradition .
how can you save them all ? " the old man picked up a starfish that was about to die and put it back in the ocean . he said , " what i am doing has a lot of meaning for this one starfish . "
the first part of this statement is true enough .
it is because i am concerned about the future of china , and because i have made a contribution to the reforms and liberalization of china that i was embroiled in this " show . "
particularly , in recent years , i have received many invitations to go to china to lecture . this includes invitations from the central government to lecture on network economy and the attraction of foreign capital to china .

the kuomintang wanted to capture him because my father wanted to overturn them ; the communists captured him because my father was working hard to save them ! twelve years later , it was i who was captured .
naturally , now i have gained my freedom there are a lot of things for me to do .
i am afraid there is no time to write that book . it took me five months to take a trip that should have been a half hour , from shenzhen to hong kong .
but i was on the road for five months before finally coming back ! after i lost my freedom , i finally truly felt the high value of freedom !

this mine area has only one mining permit , and is owned by seven individual bosses who put their capital together to create a joint venture .
and so a very disorderly situation was created where seven bosses were all doing their utmost to quickly get the ore out .
on the morning of 17 july , the great flooding accident occurred in the xialajiapo mine owned by the nandan longquan metallurgy factory .
according to information from the local area , this is a rich mine , with more than 30 grades of ore , and the tin ore which is extracted is even more valuable than gold .
consequently , the mine owners thought only of making profits , and paid no attention to any government regulations .
it is said that more than 2,000 miners worked in three shifts , day and night , down the shafts of the mines owned by the seven companies .
on the morning of 4 august , reporters at the site saw armed policemen at the entrance station to the mine . ordinary people were not allowed to enter the mine , and water was being pumped out of the mine area while compressors were pumping air in .
a worker from the county and township enterprise department told reporters that between 0700 hours on 4 august to 0700 hours on 5 august , a total of 24 hours , the water level in the mine had dropped only 1 meter .
reporters at the mining area interviewed a few miners who were in the vicinity . the miners said that the temperatures inside the mine were very high , from 40 to 50 degrees celsius .
the miners said that no telephones could be installed down the shaft , because the temperature was so high and the humidity so severe that normal telephones would corrode in just a few days after being installed in the mine .
a related person gave the analysis that right now , the victims have been in the mine for 18 days , and the pumping will take another 20 days at least . that makes a total of 40 days altogether . the corpses may have completely decomposed and the bones may be buried in mud .
or is there another effective method ?
some people say that first , the seven owners should confirm the list of just who was down the mine that day using their records , and then confirm the list of the victims .
before each shift goes down the mine , they must make their mark on the register of the shift office to record their work hours .
at the end of each month , the financial department of the mining area pays the miners their wages based on these registers .
he said that at 0700 hours on the morning of 17 july , when he came on , he saw no miners coming up from the 16 july night shift , nor did he see the miners go down for the next shift .
consequently , it can be concluded that based on the july registers , the victim list could be completely settled .
chairman henry fok , presidium members , committee members and guests : we have just experienced great joy over beijing 's successful bid for the olympic games when we are looking forward to the red - letter day marking the 52 d anniversary of the founding of the prc .
on the whole , the situation in the interior of our motherland is very good .
through over 20 years of reform , the opening up and sustained economic development , our country has arrived at a new starting point and is entering an important period of development .
the deep impression our country 's situation has made on us is : the society is full of vitality and development opportunities .
a salient feature of the exuberant vitality is sustained , rapid , and healthy economic development .
the completion of the " ninth five - year plan " means china 's overall national strength has scaled a new height . last year , china 's gnp exceeded $ 1 trillion , and its economic size ranked seventh in the world .
throughout the " ninth five - year plan , " china enjoyed an annual average economic growth rate of 8.3 percent , much higher than the world 's annual average economic growth rate of 3.8 percent for the same period .
now china has a more solid foundation for development than it had 20 years ago .
- - the capability for effective supply has been raised a lot , and the industrial structure is being adjusted faster than ever .
the proportions of the three major industries are 15.9 , 50.9 , and 33.2 percent , respectively . the proportion of the primary industry dropped apparently , while the proportion of the tertiary industry kept growing .
the posts and telecommunications service , transport and communication trade , energy industry , and information industry have developed faster than other industries , further increasing the potential for economic development .
china has become the eighth - largest trade system in the world and is trying to do better in opening to the outside world . foreign funds are being utilized on a larger and larger scale .
- - in general , the people have lived a comfortable life , with their living quality being improved remarkably .
china 's per - capita gdp exceeds $ 800 . in urban areas , an average citizen 's annual disposable income is 6,280 yuan . in rural areas , an average peasant 's net income per year is 2,253 yuan . therefore , china is no longer a " low - income " country .
in urban areas , the per - capita living space is 10.3 square meters ; in rural areas , the figure is 24.8 square meters .
a social security system has been initially established .
the poor population in rural areas decreased from 200 million 20 years ago to 65 million in 1995 and to 30 million in late 2000 .
during the " ninth five - year plan , " china made major achievements in scientific and technological fields . china is now in the lead in the world in genetic engineering , nanoscience , and other scientific and technological fields .
radio and television programs have been made available to 90 percent of the population .
greater efforts are being made to improve the ecological environment .
with such a favorable basis , china is pushing forward various undertakings steadily .
since the beginning of this year , the outside world as a whole has suffered economic slowdown , but china has managed to maintain a comparatively high economic growth rate , outshining other economies in the world .
in the first half of this year , china 's gdp registered a 7.9 percent increase growth over the same period last year [ as published ] .
the positive financial policy pursued by the central government yielded due results . internal demand served as the principal motive force for economic growth . many investments were made .
foreign businessmen 's actual investment hit $ 20.7 billion , up 20.5 percent over the same period last year .
we have scored great achievements , but many problems remain to be solved .
the quality of the national economy as a whole remains poor , development of various regions is not well coordinated , the market economy remains imperfect , work to protect ecological balance and handle pollution is arduous , the employment pressure is on the rise , and peasants fail to increase income rapidly .
all these problems have cropped up on our way ahead .
the central authorities , which look upon these problems as serious ones and have taken measures , are determined to earnestly solve these problems step by step in the course of adhering to reform and development .
holding the 2008 olympic games will help the gdp grow by another 0.3 to 0.4 percent economic growth every year . but what is more important is that holding the olympic games will greatly boost our nation 's cohesive forces .
development needs opportunities , and development itself also creates opportunities .
it is has rarely been seen even in the prc 's history of over 50 years that so many major strategic opportunities appear at the same time . this will certainly give a strong impetus to china 's development .
now , it is the consensus and unwavering will of the people of the whole of china to seize upon the opportunity , step up development , get rid of every sort of interference , and firmly push forward reform , the opening - up , and the modernization drive .
this is the most basic source of strength for achieving great national rejuvenation .

while the impact the asian economic crisis has on hong kong 's economy has yet to be completely eliminated , a new global economic recession has brought new difficulties and pressure to hong kong .
in the face of this situation , we must correctly judge actual conditions .

for the party to lead the people forward , it has to build itself well .
(i) market environment [ zhang ] in my opinion , the market environment will undergo the following three changes . first , the trend of internationalization of the domestic market will become more pronounced .
as china 's market gradually opens up and the threshold for trade and investor access is gradually lowered , domestic businesses will be confronted with competition from more foreign businesses . this will speed up the internationalization of the domestic market and intensify market competition .
second , the competitors on the market will be diversified and their number will increase greatly .
third , the division of labor in the market will become increasingly minute and the degree of specialization will continuously rise .
(ii) financing environment [ kang ] regarding the change to the financing environment after china 's wto entry , i think it will be for the better .
firstly , the number of avenues of financing for businesses will greatly increase .
as china 's policies for foreign trade and economic cooperation become increasingly transparent and unified and the geographic areas and fields for opening up also expand incessantly , domestic businesses wishing to directly take advantage of foreign capital may be presented with more opportunities .
(iii) talent environment [ kang ] talking of talent , the current situation is worrying .
this situation may throw chinese businesses into the predicament of shortage of talent . [ zhang ] in the era of knowledge - based economy , human resources have become the principal factor that determines the success or failure of a business .
but where are the opportunities and what are the challenges ?
first , they should make a good job of the specialization and segmentation of their operation .
there are three key elements in specialization : accurate positioning , sustained and comprehensive innovation , and that decisionmakers of a business must be experts in its industry and must stand in the foreground of innovation .
the market is complex and mercurial and demand is diverse .
the first dimension of such competitiveness is product competitiveness .
but its core products may not be final products . they can be intermediate products and may also be parts , raw materials , formulas , or intermediates .
the second dimension is core market .
in order for a business to obtain core competitiveness , it must have a core market .
the third dimension is core technology .
virtual operation is not a mode of operation that every business must adopt , but the rationale behind this option is something that every business can draw upon , i . e . , maximizing business competitiveness by using one 's strongest advantages and limited resources .
furthermore , most of the scientists , technologists , and scientific and technological findings are held in institutions of higher learning and research institutions ; there is still a rather big gap between research findings and market demand ; and the percentage of scientific and technological advances transformed into productive forces is still rather low .

on 6 august , the stock market repeated the " black monday " of 30 july , and sparked great surprise among the general public .
last monday , the composite indices in shenzhen and shanghai market decreased by 5 percent , a rare phenomenon in recent years .
by the past monday , the declining trend still could not stop . the stock markets in shenzhen and shanghai fell by nearly 4 percent .
experts believe that the current significant fluctuation in china 's stock market is a normal cyclical change , and is favorable for removing the stock market bubble . it does not alter the trends toward a favorable macro - economic structure in china . the overall quality of companies listed on the stock market has not fundamentally changed .
consequently , investors should have confidence . some other stock market commentators think , however , that china 's stock market experienced two successive " black mondays " in two weeks . this indicates the end of the bull market in china , and the beginning of a prolonged bear market .
for several days , a few analysts in china have tried to analyze the stock market 's drastic fall , and searched for the cause in order to come up with appropriate measures .
according to chinese media reports , one non - publicized investigation report estimated that the volume of total bank credit funds deposited in the stock market , in the form of commercial discount notes , was as high as 650 to 700 billion renminbi , which is divided one - half in the primary and secondary markets respectively .
analysts think that prohibition and eventual withdrawal of illegal credit funds in the stock market would inevitably cause the stock market prices to plummet . there is no alternative except for selecting the less harmful measure .
facing the sudden drop of the stock market , many stock analysts lay emphasis on the following three reasons : first , the sell - off of the state - controlled shares is set at a price too high to be accepted by the market .
recently , a plan to sell off state - controlled shares was unveiled , and it caused the stock market to plunge .
but because the state - controlled shares are priced the same as new issues , this sell - off greatly damaged the expectations and confidence of investors .
from later march to end of july this year , 110 companies initiated plans to increase issues . moreover , in the first quarter of this year , 14 companies realized additional issues . thus , within six months , there were as many as 124 listed companies issuing new shares . third , listed companies have poor performance .
these announcements of predicted loss and pre - warnings further damaged the market confidence .
to summarize the above , the current decline of china 's stock market is caused by various factors .

in the broad overview of wars , ancient and modern , chinese and foreign , nearly all have been waged on two fronts : one being the struggle on the battlefield of blood and flame ; the other the contest on the " psychological battlefield . "
sunzi 's " art of war , " so highly praised by strategists , confirms psychological warfare 's position at a strategically high degree , maintaining the guiding ideology that " attacking the mind comes first , attacking the city is second ; mental warfare is highest , troop warfare is second . "
in the pla 's military conflicts with our enemies , the older generation of proletarian revolutionaries represented by mao zedong adhered to merging military strikes with political collapse , and thereby enriched and developed the ideas of psychological warfare .
experience shows that , as the content and methods of warfare are constantly replaced , psychological warfare is indispensable and becoming increasingly important .
after the west 's armed forces led by the united states had sampled the " sweet taste " of victory , they intensified their theoretical research and brought forth new ideas about actual combat : building modernized psychological warfare training centers , and establishing specialized psychological warfare units .
the united states has now organized four psychological warfare groups , 12 psychological warfare battalions and 22 psychological warfare companies . these are manned by more than 70,000 personnel and expend $ 2.5 billion annually ; these psychological warfare units will have a high priority in the high tech aspect of war .
in view of this , we should actively explore psychological warfare training methods which have pla characteristics , paying attention to the basic theoretical research on psychological warfare , stressing mastery of " desensitization " training , striving to raise the ability of officers and men to accept the psychology of the battlefield .
energy is the basic industry in the national economy . in the new century , striving to maintain a sustainable development of energy resources , economy , and environment is the major strategic task we are shouldering .
the installed power capacity nationwide will reach 370 million kilowatts and the power output will reach 1.73 trillion kilowatt hours , showing an annual average increase of 3.2 percent and 5.08 percent respectively .
judging from the structure , compared the year 2005 with 2000 , the proportion of primary energy coal consumption will drop by 3.88 percentage points ; the ratio of clean energy such as natural gas and hydroelectric power will reach 17.88 percent , an increase of about 5.6 percentage points .
as for petroleum and natural gas , by the year 2005 , we will strive to stabilize the petroleum reserve and production ratio , and enable it to show a slight increase .
in the electric power field , we will rationalize the power generation , transmission , and allocation ratios , basically complete the building and transformation of agricultural power grids and urban power grids , and achieve noticeable progress in trans - regional power transmission and in regional power grid integration .
judging from the efficiency and efficacy , by the year 2005 , the energy efficiency nationwide will reach 36 percent , up four percentage points over 1997 .
during the " 10 th five - year " plan period , the coal consumption for per unit output value will drop by 15 to 17 percent and the total power saving volume will be 300 million to 340 million tonnes of standard coal .
in some large coal producing provinces such as shanxi , shaanxi , shandong , inner mongolia , henan , anhui , and yunnan , coal dressing plants with a capacity of 100 million tonnes of coal will be built .
china will demonstrate advanced typical examples of clean coal technology , and build in a timely manner the liquefied coal demonstration project of the shenhua group , and coal mine underground gasification demonstration projects in liaoning and fushun .
as for petroleum and natural gas , we will further intensify prospecting work ; in line with the principle of economic development , efforts will be made to develop and adjust oil and gas fields .
during the " 10 th five - year " plan period , we will strive to build crude oil fields with a production capacity of 96.3 million tonnes or so and natural gas fields with a production capacity of 40 billion cubic meters .
with regard to electric power , we will complete rural power grid construction and transformation projects nationwide , and basically complete the urban power grid transformation projects at and above the prefectural level in china .
we will grasp nuclear power projects that are under construction , and seek opportunity to initiate the construction of nuclear power projects by relying on china 's own efforts .
second , we will establish and improve a macro regulation and control system for energy development with economic and legal means playing a dominant role while being supplemented by essential administrative measures , such as building environmental protection rules and systems , reforming the price and charge collection systems , improving tax collection and interest discount policies .
fourth , we will further implement the " energy saving law , " and raise the energy efficiency .

after the victory of the october revolution of russia in 1917 , the salvos of the october revolution of russia brought marxism to china .
in the may 4 th movement of china in 1919 , the chinese people found the glorious starting point of marxism .
in the may 4 th movement , marxism was extensively disseminated by means of integrating intellectuals with the chinese workers ' movement and this created ideological and organizational preparation for the emergence of the communist party of china .
the formulation of mao zedong thought greatly enriched and developed the theoretical treasure vault of marxism .
this kind of integration promoted two historical leaps forward in marxist development in china , and as a result , the two major theoretical results , namely , mao zedong thought and deng xiaoping theory , came into being .
first of all , to uphold chinese - style marxism , we must persistently proceed from the specific conditions of china and draw up correct lines , principles , and policies conforming to chinese characteristics .

this article makes clear our orientation around the principle of persisting in integrating the basic tenets of marxism with the specific practice of the chinese revolution as well as our orientation around independently solving issues in relation to the chinese revolution on our own .
in the sixth plenary session of the sixth party central committee in 1938 , comrade mao zedong clearly put forward the historical mission of developing " chinese - style marxism " which further established chinese - style marxism as the conscious practice of the communist party of china .
in 1942 , the yanan rectification movement against subjectivism further criticized the split between the theory and reality of subjectivism and dogmatism in particular , and created profound impact on the style of study of upholding marxism by the whole party and promoting chinese - style marxism .
after the " cultural revolution , " the development of marxism in china has faced a severe situation .
china found itself at a crucial historical turning point .
in may of 1985 , comrade deng xiaoping further pointed out that " the reason why lenin is a truly great marxist is that he did not find his revolutionary road in books , but rather in reality , logic , philosophical thinking , and marxist ideals and thereby brought the october socialist revolution to a backward country .
the combination between the basic tenets of marxism and the fine results of chinese traditions and culture not only is necessary for upholding and developing marxism , but also is necessary for bringing about the modernization of chinese traditions and culture .
they not only inherit and carry forward the revolutionary culture and traditions , but also are good at drawing up the fine traditions and culture of the chinese nation as well as the results of all advanced civilizations created by human society .
the view of seeking truth from facts not only is the quintessence of marxism and the key point of marxism , but also is the cream and principle spirit of chinese traditional philosophy and culture .
the stances , viewpoints , and methods running throughout mao zedong thought and deng xiaoping theory show distinct chinese characteristics , namely , the substance of seeking truth from facts , the mass line , and being independent and standing on one 's own .
our devotion to integrating the basic tenets of marxism with the specific situation in china and taking our own road arms the lofty realm of thought and the distinct character of the chinese communists with a scientific world outlook and is the basic summation of the glorious practice of the chinese communists over the course of 80 years .

the important thinking of the " three represents " is the latest major theoretical achievement .
herein lies the " innovative " significance of the " three represents . " to begin with , for the first time , the " three represents " has become an integral whole and forms a complete and thorough theoretical system for building up the ruling party .
authors of marxist classics expounded on similar ideas and views on various occasions and from various angles . the requirements of the " three represents " have consistently been initiated and adhered to by our party , and comrade mao zedong and deng xiaoping also made specific and brilliant expositions in this regard .
this constitutes a new result on the party 's theoretical construction and forms a new theoretical system for building the ruling party .
second , the " three represents " endow the advanced nature of the party with new significance for the times .
the important thinking of the " three represents " further reveals the nature , mission and purpose of our party in light of the new conditions , new characteristics and new requirements of the development of the times and adds new flavor to its content .
at the same time , the integration and reunification representing the basic interests of the overwhelming majority of the chinese people , representing the requirements of the development of china 's advanced social productive forces and representing the orientation of the development of china 's advanced culture is a new development in marxist theory on party building .
third , the important thinking of the " three represents " makes clear the orientation of the advanced and fundamental channels in further strengthening party building , maintaining its advanced nature and materializing the overall goal of party building .
the objective of party building , namely , what kind a party to build , is the most imperative issue in party building .
general secretary jiang zemin put forward the important thinking of the " three represents " from the high plane of historical materialism and this provides a scientific answer to the issue of how to materialize this overall goal and how to reflect it in all areas of party building .
the correctness of the party 's leadership , in essence , relates to the success or failure of china 's socialist modernization and it relates to the happiness of the people and the future of the nation .
history and reality tell us that once the communist party is strong , socialism will gain vitality ; if the communist party is weak , socialism will collapse .
provided that the primary question in need of answer in connection to the development of our socialist cause is " what socialism is " and " how to construct socialism , " then this question has always been related to the question of " what kind of a party to build and how to build it . "
the important thinking of the " three represents " creatively put forward by general secretary jiang zemin not only is vital to the survival and the development of our party , but also determines the success or failure of socialist construction with chinese characteristics .
only by regarding the development of the productive forces as the primarily basic mission , can we gradually and truly establish socialism on the strong and consolidated foundation of the productive forces .
for those socialist countries built on the foundation of backward productive forces , it is a matter of primary importance and great urgency to develop the productive forces .
with regard to unification of the basic purpose , the overall social progress and development is an important symbol of the socialist society and is the basic goal of the socialist construction .
with regard to unification of the basic purpose , the basic purpose of socialism is to eliminate exploitation and polarization and materialize the common good .
comrade deng xiaoping pointed out that " what differentiates socialism from capitalism is the common good , not polarization . "
poverty is neither socialism nor communism .
socialism does not promote richness in the minority of people nor poverty in the majority of people .
the socialist richness belongs to the people and is the common wealth of the people .
to serve the interests of the vast number of people and materialize the common good of the entire people is the purpose of our party and is the basic goal for our party 's engagement in revolution and social construction .
the emergence of the important thinking of the " three represents " provides comprehensive scientific and specific basic criteria for judging the achievements of the work of the party and is a creative development of the criterion of the " three beneficials " in party building .
this has clearly put forward that the release and development of the productive forces are the basic criteria for judging the party 's policies and practices .
generally speaking , what the " three beneficials " sum up are usually the critical matters related to liberalized reform and the task of modernization ; what the " three represents " attach importance to are the issues in connection with party building and the specific embodiment of the characteristics and requirements for party building .
the statement clearly manifests the meaning of " criteria for judgment . "
the line and program that our party drew up and the victories it won and the setbacks it encountered in the course of struggle over the past 80 years are , in the final analysis , closely related to the " three represents . "
after the founding of new china , our party became the ruling party , and the advanced nature of our party is reflected in the specific practices of leading the people to carry out socialist revolution and construction , promoting liberalized reform , and building socialism with chinese characteristics .
the criteria for judging these specific practices is to see whether they conform to the requirements of the " three represents . "
the important thinking of the " three represents " requires that we uphold the " three represents " as the fundamental basis and the criteria in formulating and implementing the party 's theories , lines , principles and policies .
the " three represents " are also the basic criteria for judging whether party organizations at all levels and all members , and leading cadres at all levels in particular , are true communist party organizations and communist members .
the " three represents , " as the scientific criteria for judging the construction of the communist party , not only attach importance to the essence of the matter , but also are very simple , and very easy to understand and remember ; once we work hard on them , we can put them into practice .
in this way , party building will not only be a party event , but it will also be a great cause that the people of the whole nation care about and can take part in .

beijing , 9 august (xna) - - state council decree no. 313 of the people 's republic of china . the " petroleum and natural gas pipeline protection regulations " were passed on 26 july 2001 in the 43 rd standing committee meeting of the state council , and are hereby promulgated .
prime minister zhu rongji 2 august 2001
" the regulations for protecting oil and natural gas pipelines , " promulgated by the state council in march , 1989 , has played a vital role in maintaining the normal operation of oil and natural gas pipelines and facilities , and in safeguarding public security as well .
nevertheless , due to the development of economic construction , some articles of " the regulations " have grown outdated for the purpose of protecting pipelines and facilities , becoming unable to ensure a forceful crackdown on the relevant unlawful or criminal behaviors , such as seizing , sabotaging , stealing , and looting pipelines and facilities .
given a series of outstanding problems in the work of protecting pipelines and facilities at the moment , we have found it highly necessary to replenish , revise , and refine " the regulations . "
question : what major changes have you made to " the regulations " ?
question : why have you made " the regulations " applicable to more areas , and protective of pipelines and facilities on a bigger scale ?
question : what principle have you spelled out in the revised " regulations " for handling a conflict between an existing pipeline or facility and a construction project to be built at the same site ?
question : what new responsibilities have you introduced in the revised " regulations " for the pipeline enterprises for the sake of ensuring the safe operation of pipelines and facilities ?
in the meantime , in order to prevent a pipeline enterprise 's staff and workers from jeopardizing the safety of pipelines and facilities through collusion with some lawless or criminal elements , we have also laid down clear - cut legal consequences for their behaviors .
internal return rate of the investment project , which involves 220 million yuan renminbi , will be 17.3 percent annually within 10 years , so the total investment will be recouped within 5 to 6 years .
these regulations are not applicable to the protection of urban pipeline networks for oil and gas delivery , or to the protection of internal pipeline networks within the plant area of petrochemical enterprises .
article 12 . pipeline enterprises are responsible for recollecting and disposing oil leaked or released from pipelines , and no unit or individual is allowed to keep the oil for its or his own .
article 13 . pipeline enterprises enjoy the land use right over the land they have requisitioned according to the law , and no unit or individual is allowed to take possession of the land by illegal means .
with the consent of pipeline enterprises , local peasants can grow shallow - rooted crops on the land requisitioned by pipeline enterprises ; however , pipeline enterprises shall make no compensation for any losses inflicted upon the crops during their check - up rounds , maintenance , and emergency rush repairs of pipelines .
article 14 . pipeline enterprises can appoint full - time pipeline caretakers , or employ part - time pipeline caretakers , according to their own needs .
pipeline enterprises shall make compensations according to the law for any losses inflicted by the aforementioned maintenance operation and protection works on the legitimate rights and interests of relevant units or individuals .
article 22 . any construction of pipelines and auxiliary facilities that traverse a river course , a river dam , and a waterway , and any construction of pipeline protection works built in the middle of a river course , shall comply with both the flood control standards and the navigation standards of the state .
article 36 . these regulations shall go into effect on the day of their promulgation .
the " regulations on protection of oil and gas pipelines " issued by the state council on 12 march 1989 shall cease to be effective at the same time .

beijing , 9 august - - a great number of " junk requests " are moving through the internet , and an abnormal flow of data is unceasingly flashing across monitor screens like snowflakes .
" it is as if we are in the first line of defense against a flood and are sending relief to the disaster areas " - - these were the first words spoken by the general manager of an anti - virus software company in beijing when meeting with this reporter today .
not a few people have reported that e - mail transmission [ speeds ] for a portion of the websites in china have clearly declined , and some emails have been delayed for over 24 hours .
outside china , the " code red " virus has already caused enormous losses to the networks of many large businesses and government organizations , including the official website of the united states white house .
once it enters the network , it will send a large quantity of service requests , causing servers to be unable to respond , overloading routers , and resulting in paralysis of the entire network .
this virus is different from former viruses , and only exists in the random access memory [ ram ] . when transmitting , it is not carried via documents , and can directly infect a computer 's random access memory from another computer 's ram . therefore , its contagiousness is particularly virulent .
therefore , the harm to the network is even more conspicuous .
in addition , everyone should establish a perfect network security system within their business 's network as soon as possible , and take precautionary measures to prevent possible problems .

never before has the " tin capital " nandan attracted so much attention .
the " 17 july " accident involving nandan has become a particular indicator of extremely high use by many of the media , especially the internet , in recent days .
beijing has been highly concerned about nandan .
following the investigation conducted in nandan by the central investigation team headed by state economic and trade commission director li rongrong , a state council investigation team headed by the state production safety supervision and management bureau director and vice ministers of the ministry of public security and ministry of supervision hurried to nandan on 9 august .
veteran journalists , sensing a story , have also gathered in nandan .
people all over the country are talking about nandan .
what have you done , remote little nandan ?
internet news certainly not just rumormongering the news of the nandan " 17 july " accident first appeared on the internet .
almost simultaneously , some shanghai , beijing , and overseas media also carried the story .
we started to pay attention to these reports on 28 july , and sought to find out the facts through the relevant channels .
the reply from the mine authorities was extremely categorical : such a thing never happened .
we then heard about the " unusual " thing that happened to local media journalists in guangxi who were the first to rush to nandan : they were intercepted , chased away , and even pursued and killed !
we were shocked : how could such things still happen in a civilized world ?
we felt it was necessary to find out as soon as possible : had an accident really happened at the nandan mine ?
in that case , should the true facts of the suspicion about " 17 july " which involved the lives of hundreds of workers in nandan mining area be unearthed in a truth - seeking way ?
during those few days , it seems that we made all the phone calls we needed and found all the people we could find .
to tell the truth , our judgement at that time was actually that we would " prefer to believe them . "
through following many clues and traces , we felt that the rumors of all kinds going around were certainly not just rumormongering : if there had been no major accident , why were so many people from various angles risking death to report it ?
why should the mine boss , the customary vegetarian and apparently benevolent li dongming , block , intercept , chase , and threaten journalists and even not shrink from mobilizing evil forces to pursue and kill people ?
early on 2 august , we achieved a major breakthrough : we got hold of the names of 12 of the dead who lived in duan county , and the villages where their families lived .
the story that " it is an absolute fact that no deaths occurred " was finally revealed as a big lie .
although these 12 were only a small part of the total number of victims , it was enough to pierce through that lie .

washington , 11 august ( xinhua ) - - us defense secretary rumsfeld left for a visit to moscow on 11 august . on 13 august , he will hold talks in moscow with russian defense minister sergey ivanov on establishing a new international security system .
a brief statement issued after the talks said that the two countries held " substantive discussion " on a wide range of issues concerning strategic stability and international security .
observers here have been of the view that the us and russia 's disputing stance over missile defense have changed notably , and the struggle between them has moved from initially holding onto their own views and diametrically opposing each other to a more pragmatic stage of attempting to resolve contradictions between them through dialogue .
the core of the treaty is to ensure each side 's nuclear deterrence on the other side by banning developing a nationwide missile defense system by the two sides , so as to prevent a nuclear war with so - called " balance of nuclear horrors . "
however , in order to develop a missile defense system , the bush administration has repeatedly claimed that the " abm treaty " is an outdated " remnant of the cold war " and threatened to unilaterally abolish it .
facing extensive pressures from the international community , the bush administration has begun to gradually make strategic adjustments to the missile defense issue and to soften its hard - line stance , expressing its willingness to consult with russia on the issue and listen to russia 's opinion .
bush and putin held two summit meetings in the last two months .
although their differences over the major issues have remained , they have established a dialogue mechanism ; in particular , at their meeting in genoa , they found the cut - in point of dialogue - - linking the missile defense issue to reducing strategic offensive weapons .
however , russia has firmly denied this allegation .
russia expressed the hope that russia and the united states will reduce their own strategic offensive weapons to 1,500 by the year 2008 .
what results will us - russian dialogue yield in the end ?
russia needs the united states and other western countries ' aid for its economic development , and being on bad terms with the united states will do no good to russia 's economic development .
with long and arduous talks , the united states and russia probably will reach a new strategic relations treaty , rendering the " abm treaty " to exist only in name .
dispute over the missile defense issue is yet another wrestle between the united states and russia in the strategic security field following nato 's eastward expansion , as well as the focus of us - russian relations in a period ahead .
us - russian talks centering on this issue have not yet entered a substantive phase , but the prelude has already started .
the genes that exist on chromosomes are dna ( deoxyribonucleic acid ) molecular segments with a genetic effect .
every chromosome has a dna molecule , and every dna molecule has four [ ? rna ] . since differences in the order of the [ ? rna ] determine genetic differences , one of the key missions in the human genome project is to map the sequence chart of 3 billion base pairs .
while the human genome project was first initiated by the united states , countries such as britain , france , germany , and japan have joined in . china only joined in september 1999 , undertaking the mission of mapping the sequence of roughly 30 million base pairs on the 3 chromosome .
in april 2000 , chinese scientists were the first to complete the largest part of the sequence - mapping mission , for a sequential coverage rate topping 90 percent .
on 26 june 2000 , it was announced that the " working framework diagram " for the human genome had been mapped successfully .
in contrast to the sketch diagram , the complete diagram has a coverage rate up from 90 percent to 100 percent , and an accuracy rate up from 99 percent to 99.99 percent .
after the acceptance test meeting , the highest strategic coordination conference for the international human genome project , or the human genome sequence mapping 10 th international strategic conference , will be held in hangzhou . the world 's top biologists will gather together to sum up the past and decide the human genome direction .
it is understood that , since the " cavity filling " is much larger that had been anticipated , it is projected that the completed diagram for the whole human genome project will be completed by april 2003 .

responsible person of the national internet contingency group coordination office gave a briefing , saying that according to the earliest record , china educational net was the first net to be attacked by the " code red - ii " virus .
on 1 august , the contingency group of china educational net discovered at the network of the automobile department of tsinghua university that its rate of dataflow on the internet was very abnormal . after looking into the matter , the contingency group ascertained that it was hit by " code red - ii " virus .
relevant personnel of the guanqun jinchen anti - virus monitoring network said that they still received reports from internet users on 13 august saying that their computers were being attacked by " code red - ii " virus . however , the number of reports were fewer than last week .
the " code red - ii " virus is a variant type of " code red " virus . it is a rarely - seen " virus plus hacker " program . in the history of virus development , it is another strongly destructive virus following the morris worm virus in 1988 .
therefore , its ability to be contagious is particularly virulent . when the computer is infected , the virus will release a " trojan horse " program to widely open the door for invaders . the hacker may remotely control the infected computers .
the program designer of this " trojan horse " program may control the programs of the computer systems of users and this hacker may hide itself in the downloaded application programs or games , and thus damage or even paralyze the computer systems of users .

built in 1869 ( the second year of the meiji restoration ) , the shrine was originally called the " tokyo beckon the spirits shrine . " its name was changed to " yasukuni [ peaceful country ] shrine " in 1879 .
the yasukuni shrine is located in tokyo 's kudan district . the shrine occupies more than 100,000 square meters . on each side of its gate stands a stone pagoda on which are relief sculptures glorifying japan 's war of aggression against china .
in rows of buildings are japanese army weapons , war trophies , possessions left by the deceased , and photographs from the years of aggression against china .
within the shrine are more than 2,460,000 tablets memorializing the war dead from japan 's expansionist wars since the meiji restoration .
in october 1978 , the memorial tablets of 14 class - a war criminals including hideki tojo , and more than 2,000 class - b and c war criminals , were also moved into this shrine .

to stabilize the rural policies , the key lies in stabilizing and improving land contract relations .

in the course of rural reforms , cadres at all levels should be determined to make innovations and bold explorations ; at the same time , they must also have a scientific and realistic attitude and act strictly according to the established policies and according to the laws .
the basic principle for rural work adopted by the 3 d plenary session of the 11 th cpc central committee is to guarantee peasants ' material interests and respect peasants ' democratic rights .
this principle is applied to the adjustment of production structure , that is to respect peasants ' self - determining rights in their production activities .
this is a basic principle in the method of doing rural work .
through the study of the important thinking on " three represents , " the vast number of grass - roots rural cadres should change their ideas and strive to enhance their ability to do the rural economic work well under the conditions of the market economy .
first , they should work hard to study the modern market economy , study modern science and general knowledge , and enhance their own quality .
third , they should enhance their ability to offer services and enhance their service quality .
every rural cadre should master some practical skills , study and understand the market conditions of farm produce , act according to the objective laws that govern economic activities , and strive to become experts in guiding the development of the rural economy .
third , preserve peasants ' interests and effectively lessen burdens on peasants .
the issue of reducing burdens imposed on peasants is just a fundamental issue of preserving peasants ' interests .
in particular , irregular school fees for primary and secondary school pupils , irregular fees for rebuilding power grids and power supply facilities , irregular fees for housing construction , coercive subscription of newspapers and journals , and fees collected for unrealistic upgrading activities must be stopped .
at the same time , careful work should be done to reduce or exempt agricultural taxes in areas afflicted by natural disasters so that peasants can really be rehabilitated from their economic losses .
it is necessary to more effectively and severely investigate and punish those who continue to add burdens to peasants in violation of the policies , and seriously handle the evil cases and mass incidents caused by the adding of burdens to peasants .
such management should mainly be conducted through the implementation of the policies and through performing administrative functions on the basis of laws and providing services .
it is necessary to effectively change the functions of township governments , and improve cadres ' working methods . they should be good at persuading and educating the masses , promote their work with their own exemplary behavior , apply democratic methods and legal means to mediate civil disputes , and resolve social contradictions .
rural cadres should always keep themselves aware of social conditions and the people 's sentiments . they should be aware of things that may cause trouble before trouble really occurs , and take preventive actions to remove the unstable factors in their communities .
