this is a very dangerous trend because the economic reason for the aggressive war against china and other asian countries launched by the japanese militarists was no other than the economic crisis that broke out in the early 1930 's .
over the years , military friction between the united states and iraq has not been something of rare occurrence . that being the case , why is it necessary for the united states to create tension in the gulf recently ?
championed by the united states , the un sanctions against iraq have been going on for as long as 10 years . though they have caused tremendous difficulty to iraq ( especially its general public ) , they have neither completely brought iraq to its knees nor forced the collapse of the existing iraqi regime .
on 3 july , the security council decided to postpone , indefinitely , the vote on the draft proposal for " smart sanctions , " thus thwarting the united states ' design .
instead , it wishes to maintain and even reinforce sanctions against iraq . the deliberate intensification of the situation in the gulf by the united states is obviously aimed at justifying the maintenance of its policy of sanctions against iraq .
consequently , in february this year , the united states and britain bombed the iraqi army 's radar and communications system near baghdad .
the confrontation between the united states and iraq has gone through three us presidents , from bush senior to bush junior , but saddam 's position in iraq has not been shaken .
speculation is rife in the outside world that he might have been " paving the way " for his successor .
last month , british newspapers even published the news that saddam would " retire " this september and let his second son , qusay , succeed him .
to put it bluntly , the us strategy is to " catalyze change with pressure , " pressing for significant changes in iraq 's political situation and policies to the advantage of the united states .
under these circumstances , by instigating a new round of tension in the gulf , the united states may be able to divert the attention of the parties concerned , rid itself of the embarrassment of achieving nothing in resolving the palestine - israeli conflict , and highlight the us presence in the middle east .
it is predictable that either option that the united states may go for will find it hard to achieve the main objective , i . e . , forcing the iraqi regime to change hands .
the united states has major strategic interests in the gulf and sees saddam " a thorn in its side , " which must be removed before it would feel satisfied . the " cat - and - mouse game " between the united states and iraq will go on .
we should acutely seize the objective trend that the rapid growth of science and technology has given a tremendous impetus to the development of productive forces , vigorously push forward scientific and technological progress and innovation , and strive to bring about a leap forward in the development of productive forces in china .
this is a major duty that our party ought to fulfill in representing the demands for the development of advanced productive forces in china .
our conscientious study of the gist of comrade jiang zemin 's speech is of a great significance to our current efforts to gain a profound understanding , and to ensure a comprehensive implementation , of the requirement of " three represents . "
taking a panoramic look at the development history of human civilization , every major breakthrough in science and technology will lead to profound changes in productive forces , and will bring about tremendous progress in human society .
to do this , we should , first of all , step up our technological innovation , promote the development of new and high technologies , and upgrade the technological level of our industries .
we should stress launching a batch of engineering projects using new and high technologies , which include high - performance computers , photoelectronic materials and apparatus , the design and manufacturing of submicroscopic and deep - submicroscopic integrated circuits , biological technologies and their industrialization , biochips , and agro - biological projects .
during the process , we need to pay special attention to successfully linking technologies , such as electronics and information , with our traditional industries .
promoting " four innovations " to speed up economic development innovation is the soul of a nation 's progress and the inexhaustible driving force behind its growth and prosperity .
in his 1 july speech , general secretary jiang zemin once again demanded that the party engage in theoretical innovation , structural innovation , and scientific and technological [ s & t ] innovation . a scientific attitude toward the study of new issues and the solution of new problems and an innovative spirit permeate his entire speech .
as far as jinan is concerned , one important thing about fully implementing the spirit of general secretary jiang zemin 's 1 july speech is to properly persevere in the " four innovations " and speed up economic development .
the " four innovations " are s & t innovation , industrial innovation , structural innovation , and environmental innovation .
s & t innovation has been an outstanding success since it was proposed and first into practice .
currently there are 46 enterprise technological centers in jinan , including 8 at the national level and 15 at the provincial level , and 222 high - tech and new - tech enterprises .
the development of tourism and the information industry has also been expedited . education , public health , sports , and culture are gradually being commercialized . industrial restructuring has been promoted , as has the sustained , stable , and rapid development of the national economy .
meanwhile , backward under - performing small enterprises have been eliminated and their assets returned to circulation .
all industrial bureaus in the city have been reorganized as trade associations and an assets management company has been set up , which has been instrumental in overhauling government functions and promoting marketization .
on that basis , we have further regularized the fee - collection behavior of all units ; over 1,400 fee - collection registers have been distributed among enterprises with foreign investment and more than 500 fee - collection registers have been issued among city - run enterprises .
the rectification of the order on the market economy has been intensified , thus creating a level playing field for competition in the market economy .
third , government functions have been overhauled and the administrative examination - and - approval system has been reformed .
fourth , key enterprises , foreign companies , and enterprises with foreign investment have been given protection on a priority basis .
our understanding in the early phase when the " four innovation " document was being drafted was far less sophisticated than that today . in order to realize innovation , we must conduct research ahead of time and we must be forward - looking .
s & t innovation is the key , industrial innovation is the core , structural innovation is the driving force , and environmental innovation is the safeguard .
we need to succeed in all four ; it will not work if we fail in any one of them .
the reason is that there are more problems in that area and the resistance to innovation is also greater there .
if we are not sufficiently determined to do well on that front , the other three innovations will fail .
the key is to unify our thinking , achieve a breakthrough in our understanding , and update our ideas .
in particular , we must do a good job in the following five areas : first , we must uphold economic construction as the center and create a social environment that promotes economic development .
fourth , we must orient ourselves to urban modernization and build a first - rate tangible environment for economic development .
hu : a student asked me when i was in korea if china 's economic growth could continue as it had .
the basis for that judgment is that the population migration accompanying china 's economic growth will continue for at least another 20 years .
from an historical perspective , the takeoff of any country 's economy accompanies mass population migration .
during the period of world war i , a large number of foreign immigrants entered the united states and , at the same time , there was a mass migration westward within the united states that became the primary momentum for america 's post - war economic growth .
moreover , prior to world war i , north america and australia 's 100 years of continuous , large - scale immigration flow also accompanied the entire industrialization process .
through research and forecasting , peasant workers constitute approximately one quarter of the urban work force . in such large cities as beijing and shanghai , peasant workers have for a time constituted about one third of the urban work force , between two and three million workers .
the urban population in the fifth census had increased by more than 62,780,000 over the last census , and this data represents a relatively conservative estimate .
more equitable estimates show that from the beginning of reform and opening up until now , peasant workers migrating into the cities have numbered from over 60 million to 100 million peasant workers , and the remainder has been local rural population transforming into urban population .
reporter : the migration of peasant workers into the cities is having an increasingly profound impact on the entire social economy . how would you assess this impact ?
in 1990 , almost 21.1 percent of the per capita net income of china 's peasants came from labor wages . by 1999 , this proportion had reached close to 30 per cent , 46 percent of which was from the eastern region , and had become the principal source of income .
another aspect of the contribution of peasant workers to the economy is embodied in increased domestic demand .
with 90 percent under 40 years of age , peasant workers constitute the youngest part of the urban work force . not only are the peasant workers the mainstay of manufacturing , they are also the main component of consumption and savings .
in addition , their need for housing , medical care , and urban infrastructure will constitute an strong force in expanding domestic demand .
since the beginning of reform and opening up , surplus rural labor has exhibited an increasing trend . it reached its highest point in 1990 with almost 200 million people , or more than half of the agricultural work force . by 1996 , it had decreased to 160 million .
in addition to this , after entrance into the wto , unseen unemployment in china 's rural villages will be aggravated and the surplus time of the labor force will be greatly increased , thereby resulting in the greatest waste and idleness in the labor force resource .
on the other hand , the migration of peasant workers into urban areas will result in a decreased rural surplus labor force which will greatly increase agricultural productivity .
there currently is not only a tremendous difference in income between the cities and the villages , even more important are the differences that exist in the systems .
there are two different identification systems , two different employment systems , and two different public service systems for cities and villages . the disparities in such public service areas as telephone universality , internet facilities , and education , health , and cultural facilities are vast .
hu : before answering this question , i would first like to cite a few statistics .
peasant workers have received 9.2 years of education on average , while the entire population has received 6.5 years on average . 37.2 percent of the peasant workers are members of the youth league , a far higher ratio than that of the national population .
this study was done only a few years ago and is sufficient to show that peasant workers represent a relatively high quality group among the peasant population .
they are different from the general blind floating population . they have comparatively fixed places of residence , their employment is relatively stable , and their source of income is somewhat guaranteed .
peasant workers have already become an important component of the population in cities and townships in each province and prefecture across the country .
peasant workers not only are not an urban burden , they actually are the young work force model that has directly spurred on an increase in productivity .
according to statistics , the transition of agricultural labor into the industrial sector will increase the original labor productivity 610 percent , and into tertiary industries will increase labor productivity 300 percent .
the innate character of modernization is the modernization of man .
in china , modernization is a process of allowing the hundreds of thousands of peasants fulfill their own self - modernization in the cities . moreover , as they are being modernized by the cities , they are also advancing the urban modernization process .
in the face of this new wave of peasant worker migration into the cities , what policy adjustments does the government need to make ?
hu : in general , policy regarding peasant worker migration into the cities has gone through three phases . the first phase is the red light phase when migration of the rural population into the cities was strictly forbidden under the planned economic system .
second was the yellow light phase when peasant migration into the cities was restricted or conditionally permitted . for example , in 1984 the state allowed peasants to go to the cities to find work if they brought their own grain rations , thereby setting a precedent for peasant migration into the cities .
the third phase was the green light phase in which the system splitting the cities and rural areas is being dismantled as has recently been stipulated under the 10 th five year plan , and a new type of relationship between the cities and rural areas is gradually being established under market economic system .
the household registration system for cities and towns is being reformed , and a mechanism for the ordered flow of urban and rural population is being formed .
in some other cities , however , policies for the peasant workers with different levels of discrimination and restriction still exist .
from the point of view of future development , the government should formulate fair employment policies for laborers working on public projects in order to promote china 's structural change and the process of urbanization . the government must make a transition from discriminatory policies to courteous and fair policies .
one study shows that only 0.6 percent of peasant workers with residency registration in rural villages and working in cities engage in agricultural occupations . the remainder work in the service industry , the building industry , and the manufacturing industry , etc. naturally they are industrial workers , an important segment of the working class .
for this reason , the current residency registration system must be reformed , and a reporting and registration system for the resident population must be implemented .
in reality , because the peasant workers in the cities are not beneficiaries of the different security systems , they are further from the land with each passing day and find themselves in an increasingly embarrassing situation .
hu : should peasant workers one day become city people , how to handle the land they originally possessed will undoubtedly be a sensitive issue as well as a difficult point in the future formulation of peasant worker policy .
i have proposed a tentative plan to " replace the land for the residents . " if the peasant workers are willing to choose staying in the city to work and live , then they should be given city or township permanent resident registration to allow them to enjoy the same rights and interests as the city people .
peasants going to the cities to find work is a necessary historical trend . this is a vast and might wave that cannot be stopped .
nanning , 16 aug ( xinhua ) - - the state council investigation group has made headway at the present stage in investigating the disastrous flooding incident that the guangxi 's nandan county tried hard to cover it up .
xinhua reporters have taken direct part in investigating the incident since 27 july . many unclear events have come to light .
the 20 days and nights were replete with unforgettable hardships and frustrations .
( 1 ) at noon on 27 july , xinhua 's guangxi branch received a telephone call , and the caller told the branch that over 200 miners had died in a serious flooding that occurred at nandan 's dacang mining district .
taking the information seriously , xinhua branch immediately made some calls to verify the authenticity of the information . but the response it got was all the same : " no such thing . "
at that time the no. 7 typhoon of 2001 was slashing northwest guangxi with heavy rains .
the mine is located in high mountains in northwest guangxi . under the night sky , it looked gloomy .
the only lights we could see were those from a few mining lamps and the lights of our suv .
we told him that we were there to investigate whether or not an incident had occurred in the mine .
with a puzzling look , he said : " people everywhere said that many people here had died . the internet even claimed that hundreds of people had died . strange !
how come i did n't know ?
when we looked around , the mine appeared to be quiet .
some young women were brushing teeth in front of their houses . off - duty miners , their half - naked bodies covered with dirt , went by us in a hurry , with their heads bowed . trolleys rolled into the pits .
in the workshops , some people pulled up the blinds , then lowered them down again . . .
we asked li and wei to lead us to the shaft entrance .
speaking in front of the camera lens , they swore : " nobody has died here for more than a year .
just when our tv reporter was about to take pictures of the notice , it was torn into pieces .
after we arrived at the mining site , chen hongbiao , an official of the mine 's administrative office , warmly received us with cigarettes and water .
as soon as the day broke , he even ordered hot meals for us for breakfast .

we asked deputy director wei why there were not the july records . he laughed and said : we have abolished that system , thinking that it was too complicated .
he kept offering us cigarettes and tried to please us .
we interviewed more than 60 miners and dependents . most of them replied , " no such thing . "
some said , " we do n't know anything . we moved here only a few days ago . "
groups after groups of miners went by us in a hurry , looking nervous or indifferent . a few seemed that wanted to say something , but decided not to .
there was a row of stalls and shops by the roadside , but when we approached them , the owners would leave to avoid us .
one miner nervously told us that his name was wei guizhong and was a native of sancha , a town in yizhou city .
he said somebody did tell him that many people had died in the mine , but that this informant had disappeared for two days .
between 1000 and 1200 , reporters from zhongguo xinwen she , guangxi television , nanning wanbao , bagui duzhi bao and nanguo zaobao also came to the mine one after another .
that friend told us that he was also informed that many people were killed .
we , and the reporters of the aforementioned media , rushed to the tongkeng mine , which is 16 km away , to investigate .
there , a miner told us at his house that he also heard that many people were killed in the mine .
so we , and the reporters of the several other news media , decided to meet at a restaurant at the dacang mining district to discuss what to do .
early in the morning on 29 july , we returned to our news agency in nanning and reported our findings to the party group , which in turn reported to the editorial department at the headquarters .
the headquarters instructed our branch to continue with the investigations and collect evidence .
those attending the meeting heard instructions from leading cadres of the state council and the autonomous region party committee and government .
meanwhile , the nandan public security bureau also mobilized more than 100 police to investigate the case from three areas - - the county seat , chehe town , and dacang town .
we joined some public security personnel to the headquarters of the longquan mining and metallurgical plant .
that was li dongming , one of the wealthiest persons in that area . it is said that his property had a value of nearly 1 billion yuan .
at 0233 ( time as received ) , li dongming had talks with personnel at an office of the public security bureau for over an hour . the gist of his remarks was : because of poor health , he no longer managed the mine .
if one or two miners died , the mine would take care of the matter without even bother to inform him .
he said he had read the internet report , which the plant downloaded from the internet , and printed it out for him to read .
he said he did not believe that there was such an incident . he said it might be somebody who wanted to harm him by creating the rumor .
these words were the same as those by li jiaxi , director of the lajiapo mine when we interviewed him on 28 july ; by wei junqiang , deputy director of the office of the plant , on the afternoon of 28 july ; and by some government personnel on 1 , 2 and 3 august .
on 1 august , we visited the lajiapo mine again .
compared with our last visit , it was different this time in several ways . first , the contingent of investigators that the government of the autonomous region formed was a big one . under its well - conceived investigation plan , several groups of investigators would conduct investigations separately with the determination to achieve some breakthroughs .
third , since the night before , the public security authorities were in their custody of the personnel concerned and records .
he said , normally a work shift would have about 30 people , but the shift that worked early in the morning of 17 july had only a dozen people or so because the mine had closed some pits for improvements projects . 2 .

after the public security personnel asked him to take them to the upper floor to find the rosters , he brought down a bag of rosters 15 minutes later .

economic experts felt that the stability of the chinese political regime and china 's continued economic development , have raised the position of the renminbi .
some people have mentioned that the rmb should be devalued , mainly because china 's export growth has dropped dramatically.net exports have made a negative contribution to the overall economic growth , and devaluation of the monetary unit would be the most effective means of stimulating export growth .
" how long can the rmb hold out ? " has once more become a topic of concern among international economic circles .
in terms of domestic growth trends within china , exports experts say that under the influence of an overall slowdown in the global economic growth , many asian nations and regions have experienced a slump in their economic growth this year .
with the leadership of the government 's active fiscal policies , investment has continued relatively strong growth , and domestic demand will continue to maintain its rapid growth . it is hoped that the rate of increase for china 's gdp for 2001 will surpass 7.5 percent .
on this point , economics experts feel that this year , the chinese economy has already become one of the bright spots in the global economy .
the good news of china 's entry to the wto this year accelerated the pace of the flow of foreign capital into china .
from january to june of this year , foreign direct investment in china reached nearly $ 20.7 billion , an increase of 20.5 percent over the same period last year .
the shrinking difference in interest rates for the renminbi and the us dollar has clearly alleviated the pressure for devaluation of the rmb .
at the same time , the short - term bank rate guidance standard was adjusted from 0.025 percent to 0.15 percent .
in order to increase capital supply , the japanese central government bought short - term state bonds on the open market , which in actuality was tantamount to japan bringing back the zero - interest policy .
not opening up capital transactions is beneficial to the stability of the rmb exchange rate .
experts indicate that among capital transactions , since china 's foreign debt structure is mainly long - term bonds , capital flow is basically slow .
some data indicate that at the end of 1999 , china had approximately $ 15 billion in foreign debt , with only around 12 percent of that figure in volatile short - term debt .
after china 's entry to the wto , she will have to act according to the relevant regulations , and with the basic premise of protecting the stability of the renminbi , use a phased liberalization of chinese domestic capital markets .
some people close to the issue feel that international and domestic experiences all indicate that social stability is the fundamental guarantee of stable and rapid economic growth , and is also the foundation for a stable exchange rate for a currency .
looking at the situation from an overall point of view , since china 's second - and third - generation leaders have smoothly completed their handover , the chinese regime has maintained its stability , and the economy is showing rapid growth .
following further growth of the chinese economy , the common people will begin to look kindly on the renminbi , and confidence in the currency will grow daily .

for many years , ufo ( unidentified flying object ) has left mystery to people as well as attracted attention to a great extent .
according to the report published in popular mechanics , the flying saucer has " the operational mission design of six weeks ' duration at a nominal orbital altitude of 300 nautical miles , with a crew of four men . "
a considerable part of the design study focuses on the details of building a 40 - ft . - dia . airframe and strengthening it against the acceleration of 8 g 's and wind shear it would experience during launch .
however , no mention is made of the type of booster the disc would ride into space .
the nuclear - tipped rockets would be stored in the rear segments .
although these rockets were not called multiple independent reentry vehicles ( mirvs ) , they match the description of these multiple - warhead - delivery devices , which were later banned by disarmament treaties .
in normal operations , the capsule would function as the flying saucer 's flight control center .
in an emergency , the crew could fire the independent 50,000 - pound - thrust solid - fuel rocket motor and return to earth .
the final descent would be slowed by a parachute , much like the x-38 " lifeboat " planned for the international space station now under construction .
the declassified document detailed the entire flying saucer returning to earth .
it would fire its nuclear or liquid - fueled main rocket to brake , then travel edge - first into the atmosphere .
its disc form would dissipate the heat of re - entry , then act as a wing .
a minute or so before landing , skids would extend and the flying saucer would settle onto a stretch of dry lakebed .
a further indication that the flying saucer flew comes from a retired air force contractor .
the area is in the vicinity of what was then a secret australian testing range where the british and americans conducted some of their most secret atomic experiments .
since the flying saucer was to carry a small nuclear reactor to provide electricity for flight systems , it is conceivable that tests would have been conducted at this isolated location .
interested in learning if the debris was extraterrestrial , dick smith , a sydney businessman , arranged for the university of new south wales to perform a chemical analysis .
we were also curious about two points that were raised in the university 's chemical analysis , but not pursued once it was determined that the debris originated on earth .
like the german me 163 rocket plane , the main engine of the flying saucer was designed to burn hypergolic fuel , highly reactive fluids that can explode on contact , releasing tremendous amounts of energy .
plans show that the flying saucer would have carried 9375 pounds of nitrogen tetroxide and hydrazine .
in germany , landing me 163 s were plagued by on - board fires , caused by the sloshing of a type of hypergolic fuel in mostly empty fuel tanks .
according to the design study , the tanks aboard the flying saucer could never be completely emptied either , making accidents like those aboard me 163 s all but inevitable .

on 13 august , under the clear blue sky of moscow , russian defense minister sergey ivanov and the visiting us defense secretary donald rumsfeld was sailing off in a boat on the water of the picturesque moscow river .
nevertheless , it was precisely just several hours ago in this palace on the bank of the moscow river that rumsfeld and russian president vladimir putin engaged in a heated verbal exchange on the missile defense program put forth by the united states .
there have all along been grave differences between russia and the united states on the issue of the " anti - ballistic missile treaty " for a long time .
the core of the treaty is to ensure the other party 's nuclear deterrent through banning united states and russia from developing their domestic anti - missile systems and prevent the outbreak of a nuclear war through the so - called " nuclear terror balance . "
however , to develop national missile defense systems , the bush administration has again and again threatened abrogating the treaty unilaterally on the pretext of the " anti - missile treaty " being an outdated product of the cold war .
during his trip to moscow , russia and the united states exchanged views on revising the " anti - missile treaty " and establishing a new international security system .
moreover , the russian side wanted to know what specific measures the united states would take in the field of offensive weapons so as to strengthen mutual supervision and trust .
putin pointed out : the us attitude toward the " anti - missile treaty " will have a bearing on russia 's decision on whether or not it will persist in reducing its nuclear warheads .
when reiterating the us stand on withdrawing from the " anti - missile treaty " and deploying national missile defense systems , he did not put forth any new suggestions on the issue of strategic stability .
when explaining the reasons for withdrawing from the " anti - missile treaty , " he stressed : according to the provisions set in the treaty , any signatory party to the treaty is allowed to withdraw from the treaty six months after it informed the other party in advance .
if the us manufacture of national missile defense systems goes smoothly and concludes an agreement with russia on revising the anti - missile treaty , the united states will then withdraw from the treaty .
in the two - day talks , both russia and the united states repeated the sentences that they already knew well .
nevertheless , there are indications that as both sides have something to pursue from each other , russia and the united states still hope to carry on the dialogue centering on the issue of missile defense .
during the talks , although they stressed their own firm positions on the issue of strategic stability and the " anti - missile treaty , " both russia and the united states did not say anything definite , thus leaving more or less room for maneuvers .
the united states and russian will hold negotiations on the issue of strategic stability " in stages . " this may perhaps help gradually change both sides ' " mindset . "
ivanov also disclosed to the press that there has been a positive beginning in the negotiations between russia and the united states on the issue of missile defense . russia agreed to " seek a constructive and mutually supporting way " to coordinate the two countries ' positions on strategic stability .
he said : russia and the united states are being actively engaged in dialogue . presently , the viewpoints of the two sides are getting closer and closer .
after the talks , rumsfeld attended a " round table meeting " sponsored by the information telegraph agency of russia [ itar - tass ] and delivered a speech .
analysts maintained : as there are enormous differences between russia and the united on the issue of the " anti - missile treaty " and missile defense , the possibility for both sides to reach a compromise in a short time is very little .
although both sides are willing to continue holding dialogues , the bargaining on such diametrically different positions will apparently not be a cushy job .
nevertheless , because russia 's national strength is declining for the moment , it is impossible for russia to engage in an arms race with the united states any more at present . so there is also the possibility for russia to reach a certain compromise with the united states after sharp bargaining .

beijing , 18 august - - aerospace dongfanghong satellite corporation was founded in beijing today . this marked the beginning of batch production of mini satellites in china .
according to experts , the company will have the capability to produce six mini satellites a year within a short period of time . afterwards , it will have the capability to build more than 10 mini satellites every year .
the new company will also bring in capital from the public to propel china 's mini satellite industry forward . general manager wang liheng called it a " daring attempt to develop aerospace industry with diversified funding . "
according to our understanding , aerospace dongfanghong satellite corporation was initially funded by china institute of aerospace technology and casc .
because of its advantages such as high function density , short development cycle , and low cost , it is viewed as a very attractive approach .
over a long period in the past , china solely relied on the government to develop aerospace technology .
it will expand the scope and investment vehicle for china to develop its aerospace technology using a new organizational structure and management system . it will speed up technological advancement and stimulate commercialization .

beijing , 20 aug ( xinhua ) - - to further strengthen supervision over the offshore organizations of commercial banks and further prudently manage and healthfully develop these organizations , on 20 august , the people 's bank of china promulgated " a guide to supervise the offshore organizations of commercial banks . "
commercial banks should be timely , comprehensively , completely , and realistically report to the people 's bank of china on their basic business situations , information concerning supervision and management of credit quality , balance sheets , and profit and loss statements .
the " guide " stipulates that commercial banks should set up and improve a system to control their offshore organizations , be timely in updating the system in line with supervision and management regulations and development of business situations , and fully and effectively ensure supervision over their offshore organizations .
commercial banks should strengthen management of the rights authorized to their offshore organizations , improve the system to request instructions and submit reports , and sternly investigate and handle activities of overstepping authorities , so as to ensure that offshore organizations do business within their authority .
a risk control system should be set up for commercial banks and their offshore organizations so as to effectively monitor , assess , and manage offshore organizations ' credit , market , liquidity , and operating risks and ensure the safety of commercial banks .
before conducting onsite inspections of offshore organizations of commercial banks , the people 's bank of china should send letters to supervisory departments of host countries and notify the head offices of commercial banks on onsite inspections .
after learning that supervisory departments of host countries have discovered offshore organizations involved in serious problems , the people 's bank of china should communicate and consult with foreign supervisory departments and then adopt active and effective supervisory measures .

qian qichen briefed hollings on the current situation of reform and opening up in china and efforts made by china to join the wto .
he said the process of china 's accession to the wto is in its final stage .
china is seizing the time to make preparations in terms of personnel , laws and regulations for joining the wto . he believed that after making full preparations , china will be able to meet the needs of its development after joining the wto .
qian qichen said that china welcomes more us congressmen to visit china in order to increase mutual understanding and seek mutually beneficial cooperation . mei zhaorong , president of the chinese people 's institute of foreign affairs , was present at the meeting .
li peng said , we uphold the guideline of " peaceful reunification , one country , two systems , " and we have the greatest sincerity in striving for a prospect of peaceful settlement , and we will also absolutely not tolerate any attempt to separate taiwan from china .
so far , however , the taiwan authorities refuse to accept the one china principle , and this is the key reason why cross - strait negotiations cannot resume .
li peng pointed out that since nixon was president , successive us administrations have upheld a one china policy , and president bush also stated after taking office that he will continue to practice a one china policy and abide by the three sino - us joint communiques , and will not support taiwan independence .
we attach importance to these us commitments and hope that the us side will take practical action to carry out its commitments , and in particular halt its arms sales to taiwan and specifically support china 's peaceful reunification .
china needs a long - lasting peaceful international environment , and the objective of the country 's foreign policy is to maintain world peace and promote common development .
there is more common ground than differences between china and the united states . we hope to develop a constructive cooperation relationship [ jian she xing he zuo guan xi ] with the us side .
li peng said : president bush will be visiting china this autumn . china hopes his visit will achieve positive results and help promote the development of relations between the two countries .
shelby said that this is his sixth visit to china since the first in 1983 .

" what is the most difficult thing in an armed swimming crossing at night ? "
here we are about 1,000 meters from the tide line of the beach to be seized .
just after i enter the water with the combat team of the 2 nd platoon , i really feel that nameless terror which special forces group [ da dui ] leader jiang jianxiong had described .
this is a night swimming crossing with tactical content .
time : 4 august .
weather fair , moonlight .
i followed the swimming crossing bareback , but the fighters were fully armed ; they had new - type automatic rifles slung across them , and bore fully loaded grenade carriers and ammunition pouches .
a water bottle full of fresh water , and a pair of rubber shoes carried on the arm , which they could rapidly put on when they reached the shore , to prevent injury through treading on sharp sea shells .
their trouser legs and sleeves were rolled up .
ahead of me , however , i could only see one fighter .
no true battle can be fought if the swimming crossing is unarmed .
the hands and feet must keep paddling all the time , otherwise the soldier will be dragged down into the water by his heavy equipment .
on the other hand , the " handy equipment " for the swimming crossing was traditional , simple , and innovative : three knapsacks and three spades , tied into a " triangular rain cape bundle . "
the " enemy " to our front could not see these flashes .
this too was an innovation of the fighters themselves . previously they used light bulbs powered by dry batteries ; now they use the small fluorescent batons which concert fans wave .
liu junqiao , an old soldier of the first squad , told me : the closer we get to the shore , the less can we raise our heads .
the arms must paddle below the surface .
in this way the rate of paddling and the energy used increases and it is very easy to choke with water , but it is essential to keep the mouth and nose close to the surface .
for the sake of my safety in the training , the group leadership insisted on not letting me do the swimming crossing in training uniform , nor did they let me carry any equipment .
in basic training on land , every day they do leapfrogging for nearly 1,000 meters and squatting deep on the heels while carrying someone [ ren kang ren shen dun ] , doing this 50 times .
the outline regulations for armed swimming crossing stipulate a distance of 500 meters , but they swim 3,000 meters , and the record for the whole company is 58 minutes !
after several score minutes , i landed on the right - hand side of the beach , following the 2 nd platoon , thus completing my night swimming crossing .
the battle to seize the beach , however , had only just started .
i was handed a night vision device by cao junping , leader of the group responsible for directing the exercise , and looked to the left along the beach ; the series of combat methods bring practiced by the special forces turned into pale green scenes of battle in the observation glasses .
i went to nearly eye vision distance of the training reconnaisance spot to see what was going on : the group led by chen yongfang , leader of the 7 th squad , were " wriggling along " on all fours , the sand filling their trousers and sleeves , and each limb bleeding .
a new fighter , meng fanlian , was injured in the wrist by oyster shells because he had been close to the edge of a reef when making a concealed sudden attack through a crack in the rocks .
all the sea water on their bodies was evaporated by their body heat and replaced by glistening sweat .
this was the pattern for every tactical move .
this calls for an integral space logistics support . take landing operation for example .
in the war between britain and argentina over the malvinas island that lasted from the 18 th century till 1982 , the battlefield 's area expanded 3,500 times , its height nearly 10,000 times .
logistics support for this war also grew from two - dimensional to three - dimensional , and from three - dimensional to multi - dimensional , making coordination and control that much more difficult .
this calls for " combining the general - purpose with the special - purpose " in providing logistics support . in terms of strength in a joint operation , there is no ranking disparity between various arms and services , which are all in a position equal to and on a par with each other 's .

studying and understanding these theories is a major practical and theoretical task and has great significance to socialist modernization and development of marxism .
the basic theories of any economic schools are indispensable to the study and judgement of value . these theories deal with a series of basic questions concerning socio - economic operations , such as how to produce value , how to distribute the value that has been realized , and how much value one should get .
this labor theory of value laid a foundation stone for the marxist political economy and has constantly been radiating indelible brilliance in the history of economics .
what we need to see is that the labor theory of value that marx summed up through high , abstract , and scientific studies encountered misunderstandings and doubts when it was used to guide the development of the socialist economy .
for instance , some people unilaterally considered the labor theory of value " a theory of value of manual labor " and ignored the roles that mental labor , scientific and technological work , and management play in creating value .
in this case , science and technology , organized management , capital , and land are non - labor factors .
labor will become meaningless if labor is disconnected with capital , technology , and other means of production and if labor value cannot be realized on markets .
labor , capital , or technology cannot independently create value . if owners of means of production , such as capital and technology , are not allowed to gain benefits , the process of creating and realizing value will be suspended and social productivity will not develop rapidly .
however , the economic theories constituted without sufficient theories of value and with improper judgments on value will certainly involve serious deficiencies . such theories cannot be used to work out effective economic policies and may impede development of social productivity .
in the new century , the world 's gigantic changes and innovations have provided more favorable backgrounds for newly developing the marxist economic theory .
therefore , on the basis of comprehensively and accurately understanding and grasping the basic principles and scientific essences of marxism , we should comprehensively and accurately study and understand the labor theory of value and ceaselessly improve and develop this theory .

beijing , 23 aug ( xinhua ) - - a national grain work conference was convened in beijing yesterday .
the main tasks of the conference are , guided by comrade jiang zemin 's important 1 july speech , to look into the implementation of the state council 's policy measures on further deepening reforms of the grain circulation setup and doing a good job in grain procurement work .
wen jiabao pointed out that while fully endorsing the marked achievements in reforms of the grain circulation setup , we must also soberly realize that there are at present a number of prominent problems in grain production and circulation .
as a result of many years of reforms and changes , very great changes have taken place in china 's grain circulation setup .
china is about to join the world trade organization , when grain production and circulation will face ever fiercer international competition .
in view of the current prominent problems , and in the face of the new circumstances and situation , early this year premier zhu rongji issued an important comment on speeding up the reform of marketizing procurement and sales in the main grain sales areas .
wen jiabao said , opening up the sales areas means promoting the reform of marketizing grain procurement and sales in the main sales areas , and opening up grain procurement , the grain market , and grain prices under the state 's macroeconomic regulation and control .
this is not only the objective demand of promoting agricultural restructuring and taking advantage of the relative strong points of each region , but is also an essential step in advancing the reform of orienting the grain circulation setup to the market and enhancing the competitiveness of china 's agricultural produce .
by taking these lively moves , the main grain producing and sales areas can each take full advantage of their relative strong points and stimulate improved agricultural returns and peasant incomes .
second , they must take the initiative to establish stable grain purchase and sales links with the main producing areas .
second , the state must provide keypoint support for the main grain producing areas and take care of these areas in respect of subsidies for the contingency funds , granary construction , increasing the scale of central grain reserves , and so on .
wen jiabao said , having the provincial governor responsible means that the provincial - level people 's governments must truly take responsibility for their provinces ' grain production and circulation and implement and perfect the system of having the provincial governor responsible for grain .
guided by the state 's macroeconomic regulation and control and policies , the provincial - level governments must take all - round responsibility for grain production and circulation in their provinces , and the central authorities cannot undertake the whole business .
hence , the state council has decided to further perfect the method of responsibility for the grain contingency fund , and at the same time is granting the provincial people 's governments still more decisionmaking powers in managing grain production and circulation .
third , it is necessary to actively promote reforms of the state - owned grain purchase and sales enterprises and ensure that they are truly geared to the market , take their own operating decisions , and are responsible for their own profit or loss .
wen jiabao pointed out that strengthening regulation and control means strengthening the state 's ability to regulate and control grain , putting the regulation and control mechanism on a sound basis , and enhancing the level of regulation and control .
in carrying out regulation and control of grain , the government mainly practices purchase at protective prices and establishing systems of grain contingency funds and reserves .
it is necessary to perfect the grain reserve system , further expand the scale of central grain reserves , and put the vertical management setup of the central grain reserve on a sound basis .
we must practice strict management of the central grain reserve , and ensure that the amount is as reported and the quality good , so that the state can move and use the grain when the need arises .
we must continue to press on with building the state reserve grain granaries .
wen jiabao emphasized that this deepening of the reforms of the grain circulation setup is a further perfecting , in the new situation , of the grain reform policies since 1998 , and also makes a substantive breakthrough ; it has a major impact and is of far - reaching significance .
we must fully understand the complexity and difficulty of reforming the grain circulation setup , and correctly handle the following three relationships : first , correctly handle the relationship between " open " and " open - ended . "
the " opening up " in the main sales areas and the " open - ended " purchase in the main producing areas represent a further perfection and deepening of the reforms of the grain circulation setup , and are an organic entity , and both must be resolutely implemented .
grain production and grain reforms complement and stimulate each other .

hong kong , 21 aug (zts) - - the taiwan authorities have once again raised the hopes of people in taiwan with their recent talk of abolishing the " no haste , be patient " policy .
people in taiwan 's business community maintain that , if anything , the " no haste , be patient " policy has only cut off taiwan 's business opportunities and chances of survival , causing taiwan 's economic superiority to vanish quickly .
in the second quarter of this year , it tumbled to minus 2.45 percent , the lowest growth rate in 26 years . people in all circles in taiwan , who find themselves in miserable conditions for the first time in several decades , are burning with anxiety .
people in business and political circles believe that taiwan will be able to sharpen its competitive edge and revive its flagging economy only through the opening of cross - strait economic relations and trade and the integration of resources on both sides of the taiwan strait .
wang yung - ching [ wang yongqing ] , a prominent businessman in taiwan and chairman of formosa plastics corporation , has time and again urged the authorities to return to the position of " one china , " in order to break the deadlock in cross - strait relations .
the business community will surely be disappointed if the current ban on investment projects exceeding $ 50 million is merely replaced with case - by - case evaluation .

he said , we advocate achieving cross - strait " three links " in accordance with the principle of " one china , direct two - way links , and mutual benefit " and have done a great deal of preparatory work for the cross - strait " three links . "
wang fuqing emphasized that whatever problem is discussed , it is essential to keep trust .
how can people be trusted and how can so - called " sincerity " and " goodwill " be believed if not even such a fact as the " consensus of ' 92 " is acknowledged ?
wang fuqing said , we have recently noted that certain strong appeals in taiwan for easing the policy of " no haste , be patient " and speeding the opening up of " three links " have aroused the attention of various circles on the island .

in a manner that is not nuclear explosion , the warhead can produce the radioflash equivalent to a tactical nuclear explosion that can instantly destroy all the command , control , telecommunications , and logistic support systems within an area of 10 [ square ] km in a war zone , or cause a crash in them .
the us air force used this awesome weapon for the first time when its aircraft attacked yugoslavia in 1999 . the affects of using radioflash missiles are extensive , and its use has a close bearing on winning or losing a war .

in a speech last monday , president bush asked congress to approve the military budget for 2002 .
this $ 329 billion budget has aroused considerable controversy in the united states and also caused world concern and unease .
what kind of concept is this $ 329 billion budget ? it accounts for about 40 percent of total world military spending and exceeds the combined military expenditure of britain , france , germany , japan , and russia .
since 1998 the us military budget has increased by about $ 10 billion a year .
the first military budget submitted by bush since taking office shows an increase of $ 33 billion over the previous year , the biggest increase in the past 20 years .
despite this , officials of departments such as the us defense department still complain that military spending is too small .
does not all this require huge sums of money ?
take the development of the nmd program which bush and his aides never cease advocating - - this is a bottomless pit of military spending .
after taking office bush not only relaunched nmd but also proposed a much bigger program than clinton 's .
many people in america have adopted an attitude of opposing nmd precisely because the cost is so great and the system will not be of much use .
a big increase in military spending is also the requirement of the new us administration in readjusting its global strategy .
the bush administration has recently carried out a major readjustment of us global strategy , and the focus has started to shift from europe to asia .
many people in america have also questioned this , especially when the us economy is on a downturn .
however , there are plenty of people who welcome this increase in military spending , including arms manufacturers and their related financial groups .
bush received a great deal of donations and support from the military industrial complex during his election campaign , and now that he is on the presidential throne bush naturally needs to repay them .

beijing , 23 august ( xinhua ) - - the ministry of labor and social security today published a report of sample surveys conducted in shenyang and nine other cities .
the report showed a growing number of unemployed as well as growing difficulties for laid - off workers to find jobs again .
the cities surveyed included shenyang , qiqihar , nanjing , hefei , zhengzhou , yichang , changsha , chengdu , guiyang and xian . a total of 27,000 questionnaires were sent out , 85.9 percent of which were effectively recovered .
nearly 30 percent of the unemployed had never looked for jobs , and over 10 percent of them did not want to work right now .
what the unemployed cared most were whether they could claim unemployment insurance , whether they could find jobs as quickly as possible , and whether their insurance relations could be continued .
most of the laid - off workers were getting on in age . they had long working years , fairly low educational attainments and poor skills , and heavy family burdens . nearly 40 percent of them would be leaving their re - employment service centers and returning to society in the second half of this year .
seventy percent of laid - off workers still had ties of liabilities , such as arrears of wages and unclaimed medical expenses , with their former employers . this was an important reason why laid - off workers had difficulty ending their labor relations with their former employers .
nearly 30 percent of the laid - off workers surveyed had not taken the initiative to find jobs .
stable social security was the biggest wish of laid - off workers , and what they cared most was whether they were entitled to unemployment benefits after losing their jobs .
beijing , 23 aug ( xinhua ) comrades , the central military commission [ cmc ] holds a forum here today to mark the centenary of comrade chen yi birth .
comrade chen yi was a seasoned proletarian revolutionary , a strategist , a diplomat , one of the founders and leaders of the chinese people liberation army [ pla ] , and an outstanding leader of the party and state .
in his early years , comrade chen yi studied at an engineering school , where he made up his mind to save the country .
in the winter of 1923 , he joined the cpc . since then , he plunged himself , without any thought of turning back , into the cause of the chinese revolution led by the party until the last moment of his life .
in 1926 , he was sent by the party to engage in the soldiers movement among the troops of sichuan warlord yang sen and , together with comrades zhu de and liu bocheng , participated in the organizational preparations for the lushun uprising .
in 1927 , chiang kai - shek and wang jingwei betrayed the revolution one after another , and the revolutionary situation turned into its nadir .
after the main force of the insurrectionary army was defeated in the chaoshan area , he assisted comrade zhu de in reorganizing the troops and fighting the enemy in the borders of fujian , guangdong , jiangxi , and hunan .
in the days immediately after the founding of the fourth army of the red army , there were disputes over some major issues within the leading strata .
in line with the spirit of the letter , comrade chen yi assisted comrade mao zedong in organizing and holding the ninth cpc congress of the fourth army of the red army , which approved the well - known resolution of the gutian congress .
the - point law of meiling , which was written by him , expressed his staunch and firm belief in the party and the revolutionary cause .
after waging a guerrilla war for three years , he preserved a large number of core fighters in the south , laying a foundation for the subsequent formation of the new fourth army .
after the breakout of the war of resistance against japanese aggression , comrade chen yi was appointed deputy secretary of the subcommittee of the new fourth army of the cmc and head of the first detachment of the new fourth army .
he resolutely implemented the party principle of independently launching a guerrilla war behind the enemy line and led his troops into the enemy rear area to open up anti - japanese base areas .
in 1954 , he was appointed a vice premier of the state council , vice chairman of the people revolutionary and military committee of the central people government , and vice chairman of the national defense commission .
in 1958 , he was concurrently the minister of foreign affairs .
comrade chen yi made a major contribution to the socialist cause of the motherland and the development of diplomatic work .
comrade chen yi spent his whole life in the army , rendering illustrious military service .
he devoted a lot of painstaking effort to the founding and development of the people army , the establishment of the system of political work in our army , and the modernization drive of new china national defense and armed forces .
he applied the marxist stand , viewpoints , and methods in studying the distinctive features and laws of the chinese revolutionary wars , put forward many military theories and principles of great significance , and contributed to the formation and development of mao zedong military thinking .

according to reports carried by mainland 's media yesterday , the communist troops used civilian trading ships to carry heavy - caliber artillery for exercises with live ammunition .
the " ship - carried artillery " tactic is an " indigenous tactic " developed by the communist troops as a remedy for insufficient firepower for landing operations . our troops have closely followed such a tactic for many years and have discovered that the communist troops have already mastered it through many years of practice .
there is no difficulty to fire on a ship artillery usually used on land , but it is not easy to attain accuracy because ships are constantly rocked by waves and the artillery is fired without a platform installed with a stabilizing device .
however , according to the analysis of the military , ship - carried artillery still has many restraints despite its high percentage of hits and it is not a match to artillery mounted on ships . for example , it cannot be fired if the sea is too rough . otherwise , the percentage of hits will be affected .

beijing , 26 aug (zxs) - - the present grim situation in which illegal pyramid scheme organizations are rising from the ashes and rapidly growing and spreading shows that these organizations are now developing and evolving into an " economic cult " which seriously disrupts social order , damages consumers ' interests , and directly threatens social stability .
an official of the ministry of public security has pointed out that during the recent period illegal pyramid scheme activities under a multitude of names have been running rampant in many localities in china . these have already caused huge economic losses to several hundred thousand of the masses and done serious damage to state economic order .
in view of this , in april 1998 the state council issued a " circular on prohibiting pyramid scheme activities , " which specifically laid down that pyramid schemes in any form are illegal . this comprehensively prohibited all kinds of pyramid schemes and disguised pyramid schemes .
beginning in march 1999 , however , illegal pyramid schemes which had disappeared from the scene for a time were dished up in different forms , rapidly staged a comeback in areas such as guangdong , guangxi , shanxi , and hainan , and developed and spread throughout the country .
according to statistics , nearly 500 cases have now occurred nationwide of lawbreaking and criminal activities in the use of pyramid schemes and disguised pyramid schemes , with several million people involved - - including those involved more than once - - and the illegal business done totals nearly 10 billion yuan .
in many cases , the price of the commodities being handled in the schemes exceeds the market retail price by four or five times and more .
subsequently the lawless elements take advantage of these people to fabricate recruitment and hire of labor and develop their relatives , friends , and fellow townsmen to join ; in this way the victims turn into people doing harm .
after paying their fee of several thousand yuan , the participants gain no return at all ; some of them hang around in places away from their home for a long time , while others can only live by sponging .
in order to recoup their losses , some participants eventually embark on the road of crime by committing burglary and robbery ; some even hold sit - ins at government departments , surround and attack government organs , and blockade national highways and so on , thus seriously disrupting normal market and social order .
in order to avoid crackdowns , these illegal pyramid scheme organizations often choose relatively remote and small habitations to hire premises and to assemble ; they lay it down that the participants are forbidden to leak anything to outsiders about the organization , otherwise they will be " taught a lesson . "
guided and controlled by these concepts , many participants gradually enter a state of addiction and wallow in illegal pyramid and disguised pyramid schemes .
officialdom is attaching great importance to the serious consequences caused by the resurgence of illegal pyramid scheme activities .

china 's first trade union law was enacted by the central people 's government in 1950 and was revised once in 1992 .
the draft amendment stipulates : " the all - china federation of trade unions and its trade union organizations represent the interests of employees and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of employees in accordance with the law " ; " it is the basic duty of trade unions to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests .
the enterprises and institutions should look at ways of dealing with it and make a response to the trade unions .
if the enterprises and institutions refuse to correct it , the trade unions can call on the people 's governments at or above county - level to handle it according to law . "
these additional regulations will facilitate trade unions ' work in safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of employees ; step up the cohesion of trade union organizations , and give better play to the role of trade union organizations .
the draft amendment provides an additional chapter on legal liability . with specific objectives , it establishes and improves the corresponding legal liability system in order to facilitate the implementation of the trade union law .

the " code red ii " computer virus , which has become globally rampant in these days , has affected and hurt china 's information networks to a rather serious extent . as a result , some networks cannot operate normally or even have become paralyzed .
to this , the whole society should pay particular attention .
recently , in view of the problems exposed by the spread of the " code red ii " virus , they have launched a security - examination campaign aimed at preventing computer viruses and guarding against the invasion of computer systems by hackers .
the national people 's congress [ npc ] standing committee chairmanship meeting submitted a bill to the npc standing committee requesting deliberation on the draft revision of the trade union law. trade unions ' function to ensure staff members and workers ' legitimate rights and interests is stressed and strengthened in the draft revision of the law .
china 's first trade union law was promulgated in 1950 by the central people 's government , and was revised in 1992 .
the law sets forth trade unions ' position in china 's political , economic , and social life , defines trade unions ' rights and obligations , and has played a positive role in trade unions carrying out activities and performing their various functions according to law .
according to the npc standing committee 's legislative program , after having extensively solicited the opinions of various quarters , the npc standing committee legal work committee and all - china federation of trade unions prepared the draft revision of the trade union law .
therefore , the draft revision stipulates : " trade unions have the right to make representation with enterprises and institutions that seriously infringe on their staff members and workers ' labor rights and interests and to demand that they take measures to make necessary corrections .
trade unions may ask a people 's government at or above the county level to rule on the situation if enterprises and institutions concerned refuse to make necessary corrections .
meanwhile , the law committee has come up with opinions on revising 17 areas of this draft law .
for this reason , the law committee suggested that the following stipulation be added to the draft law : " employers should establish a responsibility system for the prevention and treatment of occupational diseases and hold the responsibility for the occupational diseases they cause . "
" the units and individuals who make outstanding achievements in the prevention and treatment of occupational diseases will be awarded . "
some localities and experts said : all projects that cause occupational diseases should be subject to supervision and should not be left unchecked to harm laborers . therefore , projects that may cause occupational diseases should be reported and registered .
in view of this , the law committee suggested the following stipulations be added : " projects that may cause occupational diseases as included in the list of occupational diseases published according to law should be reported and registered . "
" employers engaged in the projects that may cause occupational diseases should make timely and truthful reports to health administration departments and subject themselves to supervision . "
the law committee suggested that the following stipulation be added : " employers should know the occupational diseases that may be caused by the technology and materials they use , and they should hold the responsibility for the consequent occupational diseases if they conceal the danger of such technology and materials and use them . "
expenses for the occupational health examination should be borne by employers . "
the law committee also offered opinions on revising 12 areas of the law .
the law committee held that as turning maritime space utilization funds over to higher authorities and distributing such funds are a complicated matter , it is better to authorize the state council to work out regulations in line with specific conditions .
therefore , it is suggested that the relevant article of the draft law be revised as the following : " the units and individuals who use maritime space should pay maritime space utilization funds according to state council regulations .
some standing committee members and experts said : with regard to the maritime space users who refuse to pay maritime space utilization funds , the people 's governments that issued the maritime space utilization certificates should confiscate their maritime space utilization right .

what is worse , in so doing , major shareholders have seriously violated the principle of " being open , fair , and impartial , " namely , a principle governing the stock market , and have directly encroached upon small and medium - sized investors ' legitimate rights and interests as well .
moreover , in order to misappropriate funds from a listed company , major shareholders have employed all sorts of measures , even running the risk of publishing a false financial report , in an effort to cover up facts and mislead small and medium - sized investors .
should this situation continue unabated , spreading unchecked , china 's stock market would most likely degenerate into an " atm " for major shareholders , and if so , investors ' confidence in china 's stock market would be damaged , and speculation run wild .
the suichang industry and commerce bureau in zhejiang province discovered many such cases while managing registration of sole proprietors recently . it was learned that suichang alone has discovered 40 such cases , and the phenomenon of applying for license using borrowed pass is on the rise .
some sole proprietors were even prepared to cancel their original business license and apply for a new one using the above method .
for laid - off workers , preferential policy treatments given by the state cannot truly materialize and the workers are being robbed of their legal rights and interests .
to the state , there are losses in tax and fee revenue and disruption in normal market economic order . the phenomenon undermines a market order based on honesty , trust , lawful business operation , and fair competition , and creates new difficulties for relevant departments in their administration work .
the phenomenon of applying for license using borrowed pass is bound to blur the distinction between market entities and civil entities and could easily trigger new problems and disputes .
any violations of law , regulations , or economic disputes would only lead to the registered license holders being held accountable instead of the actual business operators .
what merits vigilance is that some localities describe such moves which clearly go counter to the central authorities ' intentions as " bringing about a new breakthrough in enterprise reform , " and " the reform orientation is correct . "
the leading comrades at all levels must attach great importance to this matter and resolutely put a stop to this erroneous trend .
investigations have shown that the following are the main ways employed to dole out state assets to individuals gratis : first , state assets are directly doled out gratis to the staff and workers .
third , after administrative measures are applied to shrink and " discount " state assets , they are bought out by the staff and workers ; this is called selling them , but in fact it is giving them away .
these practices without exception cause a serious erosion of state assets ; they not only clearly violate the relevant state policy regulations but also do not square with the basic rule of market economy that " the investor profits . "
doling out state assets to individuals gratis is bound to have a serious impact on state enterprise reforms and economic development .
carrying out the reform of changing to the share - holding system involves a whole series of sensitive issues such as owner rights , worker settlement , handling of debts and so on .
medium - sized and small state enterprises should be further opened up and enlivened through various forms of reform .
it must be pointed out that whichever method is adopted to carry out state enterprise reforms , it must protect the rights and interests of investors and creditors from infringement .
we must bring our thinking and understanding into line with the spirit of the 15 th party congress and the fourth plenary session of the 15 th cpc central committee , and uphold the correct orientation for state enterprise reform .
localities which have already doled out state assets to individuals gratis must rapidly act to put things right .

the proportion of those hopeful that the economic situation will improve in the next year has increased to 30 percent from last month 's 25 percent . in addition , the proportion of those who are more pessimistic has decreased to 54 percent from 62 percent .
according to the survey , the economic development advisory conference was held for more than a month , but there were still 24 percent of those surveyed who did not know the conference was convened .
of those who knew of the conference , 32 percent were satisfied with the conclusions reached by the conference , 32 percent were not satisfied , and 36 percent had no comment .

since july , some extremely serious accidents have happened one after another in guangxi , shaanxi , shanghai and jiangsu and the news about them rapidly spread through television , newspaper and the internet .
at the same time , there are different views on whether the media exposure of negative things is beneficial or harmful .
some people believe that too much exposure of bad accidents will affect social stability and hurt the prestige of the party and the government .
so , they will usually stop the media from covering accidents .
if an accident is handled secretly without supervision and without finding out who is to blame , the one who caused it could blur the line between right and wrong and shirk responsibility .
even when higher - level government officials come to investigate it , maybe he still can manage to buy some of them off if the investigation is not supervised by the media or the general public .
keeping the media a long distance away is perhaps what a few officials want .
they are afraid that if the accident is exposed , their job performance will be affected and their positions will be at stake .
of course there are times when they are indeed unable to evade the media . even in that case , some of them will cleverly let only a few carefully selected reporters to cover the accident and make a false report on it according to their need .
of course , the courage of the media has apparently exposed more accidents to the people today .
a more rational view has gradually been accepted by more people .
this no doubt means social progress . we are gratified that chinese news media today can directly report accidents .

bush was not just talking and early on moved to make it real .
