why has the us now given up the use of the title " rogue state , " changing it instead to " states requiring attention " ?
what is the difference between these two terms ?
what is the real story behind this ?
of the personnel in the white house , the more popular term was " nations which have been deserted by society . " officials of the reagan administration liked to say " prohibited states . " the elder bush preferred the term " rebel states . "
after the 1990 s , the clinton administration went one step further in clarifying the concept of " rogue states . "
just after the conclusion of the cold war , clinton stated his views on the " rogue states " in brussels , saying that " the clear and present danger " is the threat to europe from " missiles from ' rogue states ' such as iraq and libya . "
she blamed these states for buying weapons of mass destruction , and supporting international terrorism .
she divided the nations of the world into four groups : " nations in the international system , " " transitional nations , " " lost nations , " and " rogue states . "
nations like north korea , iran , iraq , yugoslavia , and libya were all on the united states list of " rogue states . "
for the us , exposing and putting down the " rogue states " could be grandly called " maintaining human rights " or " guarding humanitarianism . " wanton promotion of the so - called " new interference - ism " therefore was in the interest of united states hegemony .
second , it could serve as a warning to others , with armed threats used to further consolidate the us scope of power .
four , it could further enhance and broaden the military alliances already established during the cold war period , and shrink the strategic space of the large nations involved .
during all of the 1990 s , one of the major aims of us foreign policy was to counter the threat posed by the so - called " rogue states . "
with the breakup of the former soviet union , the united states discovered that isolating the above countries was easier , and implemented a series of strategic controls and pressures on them .
one was called the " maintenance of regional security " or " maintenance of humanitarianism , " and consisted of military attacks on these nations .
for many years , the united states has used various means and different degrees of economic blockade and political pressure , as well as cultural insinuation , on countries like cuba , north korea , libya , iran , iraq , and yugoslavia .
they have even , without regard to the american slogan of " humanitarianism , " severely injured the people of those nations , including the lives and health of women and children , and caused severe difficulties in the construction of those countries and to the people there in the building of their lives .
however , the united states policy of blockade and attacks on these nations has not obtained the results the united states hoped for .
saddam husayn is still in power , as are kim and castro .
they have been pressed , but they have not been destroyed .
not only that , but these countries are constantly enhancing their diplomatic efforts , struggling for the sympathy and understanding of the international community .

at a certain airfield in the northwest , two fighter aircraft carrying new types of air - to - air missiles rolled slowly down the runway .
he checked a batch of missile warheads and found the same phenomenon to varying degrees .
where did this problem arise ?
with the problem clarified , the military representative office supervised and encouraged a research institute to take corrective measures and protect product quality .
the challenge of difficult high - tech problems the cause of a high rate of malfunctions in the gyroscope of a certain type of missile could not be found . this was having a serious , negative influence on unit training with mounted missiles .
members of the office talked with aviators at the airfield , and listened to the opinions of the equipment service personnel , arranging and checking possible causes from all angles .
through theoretical calculations and simulation experiments , they finally clarified the cause of the malfunction as being an unsuitable design of the gyroscope component .
with the cause of the malfunction found , the military representative office conferred numerous times with technical personnel of a research institute .
following repeated tests , they proposed a plan to improve the design . through dozens of experiments , a new product , researched and developed mainly by military representatives , finally went into trial production .
more than a year of trial usage in air force units proved that the new product had a lifespan nearly three times as long , and that its main specifications reached the international level of the 1990 s .
at the same time , they bring back with them any tough problems learned in feedback from the units . they work along with the concerned technical people of a research institute to study measures and methods of improvement .
after a certain type of air - to - air missile was fielded in units , there were several instances of hot batteries accidentally catching fire .
after the military representative office learned of the situation , on the one hand it took the initiative to inform a research institute of the problem , and on the other hand it worked together with a concerned scientific research organization . after several experiments , a stabilizing apparatus was added to ensure safe usage by units .

"
prime minister thaksin expressed his thanks for the warm , friendly reception accorded by the government and people of the prc . the two sides agreed that the visit was a complete success and further promoted the omnidirectional cooperative relationship of good neighborliness and mutual trust between china and thailand . 2 .
they agreed to consolidate the already existing traditional friendship between china and thailand and advance their strategic cooperation , believing that this would not only be in the fundamental interests of the two countries but also be conducive to peace , prosperity , and development in this region . 3 .
both sides were gratified at the positive progress that the two countries had made in recent years in friendly cooperation in various fields and acknowledged the great significance of the " joint statement " in guiding the future development of sino - thai relations .
the two sides agreed that the two countries ' cooperation in the political , economic , cultural , educational , public health , and scientific and technological fields had brought tangible benefits to both countries and their people .
the two sides agreed that constantly expanding their exchanges and cooperation in the above fields is of great significance to comprehensively developing relations between the two countries . 5 .
both sides indicated they would continue to work for opening up new fields for trade and economic cooperation between the two countries , vigorously advance large projects of economic cooperation between the two countries , and expand bilateral trade and two - way investment based on the principle of equality and mutual benefit .
both sides reaffirmed their wish to sign the " sino - thai swap agreement " at an early date .
in addition , given the prospect of tariff rates in the asean free trade area being reduced to zero to five percent by 2002 and completely abolished by 2010 , the thai side hoped china would take this investment and trade opportunity to move its manufacturing industries to thailand and other asean countries .
both sides expressed support for expanding trade and economic exchanges and cooperation between china 's southwestern region and thailand 's northern region , particularly in land transportation between the two countries .
the thai side said that a stable , prosperous china would be beneficial to peace and development in this region and beyond .

the chinese side expressed high appreciation for the above stand of its thai counterpart .
the chinese side congratulated the thai government on its achievements in eliminating domestic poverty , reviving economic development , and advancing regional cooperation , believing that thailand 's economic and social development would be of great significance to stability and prosperity in this region . 7 .
both sides fully affirmed the fruitful cooperation between the two countries in international and regional affairs .
both sides welcomed the ministerial conference of china , laos , burma , and thailand on antinarcotics cooperation , which was held in beijing on 27 and 28 august 2001 , and the positive results it produced .
the two sides agreed that strengthening antinarcotics cooperation among the four countries is conducive to cracking down on narcotics crimes and promoting peace and development in this region .
both sides held that under the circumstances of accelerated progress of economic globalization , asian countries must further strengthen regional cooperation to jointly respond to the opportunities and challenges brought about by economic globalization .
the chinese side expressed appreciation for its thai counterpart 's active efforts toward strengthening dialogue and cooperation among asian countries .
the chinese side expressed its wish to see an even more united , stable , and prosperous asean and its support for a greater role for asean in regional and international affairs . 9 .

shenyang , 29 aug ( xinhua ) - - china 's liaoning masanjia reeducation center is a unit famous for sincerely helping and rescuing falungong practitioners who have committed minor offenses . however there have been a lot of hostile rumors circulating overseas . the reporters recently revisited masanjia reeducation center .
the field for physical exercises was big and the buildings were new .
when we arrived at building no. 2 , we noticed that the place was neat and that the atmosphere was relaxed , just like six months ago .
however , when we met with sun fengwu , deputy director of the center , she angrily told us : " the ' falungong ' cult organization in the united states once again fabricated rumor about us . this time , they said over 130 inmates here were on a hunger strike .
it was absolutely groundless .
how could they circulate such a lie ? "
now they are not worried at all . the 56 - year - old sun guizhen was put into the center for disturbing social order last december . she somewhat excitedly told the reporters that she gained some weight at the center .
she said : " when reminiscing the past , it was really like a nightmare . since practicing ' falungong , ' i did not even want to do domestic chores .
she said that each time her family members came to visit her , she regretted more for having followed " falungong " in the first place .
at noon , sun guizhen and her family members specially paid 80 - odd yuan to the guesthouse canteen for some extra dishes . the tempting smell made her young grandson impatiently and loudly yell for lunch .
zhang yanli , a former falungong practitioner from huludao city , told the reporters : the food here is much better than what she had expected . we have different food for three meals a day .
zhang yanli agitatedly said : " it was absolutely nonsensical . it was a sheer lie ! "
since she had no appetite , su jing , director of the center , had instructed someone to get her a patient 's meal from the canteen .
in front of the dormitory on the square stands a tall flagpole . every monday morning , like many chinese units everywhere , the center organizes its inmates to attend a flag - raising ceremony .
a basketball court and a volleyball court are situated to the east of the field .
director su jing said : besides playing basketball and volleyball games , sometimes the inmates will also perform rural folk dance and discotheque dance .
inmate liu shuwen told the reporters : we can watch television every evening . we can even watch entertainment programs besides the news on weekends .
as if she was afraid that the reporters would not believe her , she raised her voice : " really , we were really happy for beijing and proud of our own chinese people . "
actually it was not the first time that they spread rumors against us .
their aims are to instigate " falungong " addicts to remain under their psychological control , to refuse reeducation and transformation , and to become their sacrificial lambs .
she said : despite whatever lies circulated by li hongzhi and his gang , we will , as always , earnestly implement the policy of " unity , education , and rescue , " strictly carry out the reeducation - through - labor policy , and more properly reeducate and transform inmates including the " falungong " practitioners .

he held that " the lee wen - ho case is an example of mistaken judicial investigation . "
the fbi first " sniffed " something in april 1994 , and ordered the fbi office in albuquerque to investigate a " leakage of nuclear secrets . "
in december 1997 the fbi focused its " surveillance lens " on a series of " major suspects " including lee wen - ho and his wife sylvia .
in march 1999 , however , 15 months after receiving the order , the officers at albuquerque languidly picked up the case and chose a " sacrificial lamb " - - lee wen - ho .
for as long as four years after the lee wen - ho " espionage case " was put on file for investigation , individual agents were responsible for investigating it , and moreover they were not doing this full time ; sometimes they had to busy themselves with other cases such as robbery .
as far as the albuquerque fbi office was concerned , there was non difference between the lee wen - ho case and cases of " minor assault and disturbance . "
in december 1996 , fbi headquarters in washington initially sent two new fbi hands to albuquerque to " help " in investigating the lee wen - ho case .
one public prosecutor subsequently described what it was like working with the first of these : " working with him was just like urging a dead mule to pull a cart . "

in 2000 , he vigorously intensified the deployment of military strength in guam .
in july 1999 , clinton signed the " national missile defense act , " which in essence was a restoration of the " star wars " program that the republican president reagan had proposed in 1983 .
the foreign policy that the bush administration has adopted today is in essence no different from the policy of the clinton administration , especially during its latter days , except that it is manifested as more arrogant and intransigent , showing a more pronounced unilateralist tendency .
no essential change to foreign policy in pursuing his missile defense program , the bush administration merely changed its dictatorial style and assumed a posture of ostensible humility , consulting various parties and listening to their viewpoints , but in the meantime , it adopted the tactic of crushing the opposing forces one by one .
therefore , just before and during his meeting with president putin , he suddenly changed his attitude to russia and called russia a " friend " of the united states .
however , the bush administration 's stance on the establishment of the missile defense system did not change in the least .
the so - called package deal for dialogue that the bush administration proposed not only requires discussions on the missile issue , but also demands restrictions on the dprk 's conventional weapons and the withdrawal of its troops and artillery stationed north of the 38 th parallel .
china policy remains tough in essence in the eyes of chinese people , the most obvious of all the changes in the bush administration 's foreign policy is probably in the area of its china policy .
when meeting with chinese state leaders , he once again let it be known that the united states hopes to establish constructive relations with china and reiterated that the bush administration honors the " one china " policy .
however , we must also recognize at the same time that as with all previous us governments , the bush administration 's china policy also clearly has two sides to it .
the bush administration is making energetic efforts to persuade china 's neighboring countries to accept the united states ' national and theater missile defense programs .
us newspapers and experts on international issues have made no secret of this .
what is more conspicuous is that on the taiwan issue , besides reiterating that " the one - china policy has not changed , " the bush administration has not made any substantive policy adjustments .
on the one hand , the bush administration says that taiwan independence is not in line with the united states ' " one china " policy ; on the other , it supports and helps , either overtly or covertly , taiwan in joining international organizations that are for the participation of sovereign states .

meanwhile , the united states and taiwan have recently made a series of military cooperation moves .

as the study and development of the boundaries of our theater and other missile defense systems continue , the united states may very well consult the taiwan authorities on this . "
the above - mentioned facts indicate that the united states and taiwan are moving toward a " quasi - military alliance , " as termed by the taiwan press .
it is therefore apparent that not only has the side of the united states that pressurizes and contains china failed to relax , but it has shown a tendency of intensification .

china set up a non - aligned , non - antagonistic new - type strategic partnership with russia without aiming at any third country , and the framework of good - neighborliness and friendly cooperation is being continuously added with substantive contents .
china seriously deals with its differences with the united states , and also attaches great importance to the common interests it shares with the united states . as a result of both sides ' common efforts , sino - us relations can still develop and make advances by undergoing twists and turns .
he stressed : china has comprehensively improved good - neighborly , friendly , and cooperative relations with its peripheral countries , and has completed the delimitation of boundaries with most neighboring countries .
territorial disputes account for a substantially smaller part in china 's foreign affairs .
he pointed out : when dealing with history , the most important thing is a correct understanding .
it is a basic fact in history that the japanese militarists committed the crimes of burning , killing , raping , and looting in china . china only requires that japan correctly and objectively approach this part of history .
if lee teng - hui 's taiwan independence position is encouraged somewhere else , this will inevitably aggravate the tension in the cross - strait situation , and will not bring benefit to any people . it is believed that people with political strategic insight will not be taken in by lee teng - hui .
beijing , 31 aug ( xinhua ) - - the standing committee of the ninth national people 's congress (npc) held its 22 nd lecture on the legal system in the great hall of the people today .
in his speech at the lecture , li peng pointed out : a real - right law will be an important component of the civil law in our country . it will not only be an important law affirming and protecting various socialist systems of ownership but also includes the basic rules for standardizing the socialist market economy .
the system of real - right laws holds a important position in the system of laws on property .
the ninth npc standing committee has included enacting a real - right law in its legislative plan , and it is organizing personnel from various sectors to draft the law in earnest .
the real - right law should be formulated according to the actual requirements of the developing socialist market economy in our country , with the stress on solving new problems arising from the reform of enterprises , land contracting , and the transfer of property .
we should give full scope to democracy , solicit opinions from all sides , conduct in - depth studies and investigations , and conscientiously listen to the views and suggestions of the broad masses of the people , especially those of legal experts .
he said that mainland compatriots eagerly hope to visit the beautiful taiwan island of the motherland , adding that admission of mainland tourists will generate plenty of opportunities for economic development and create many new jobs for taiwan .
he said that the early solution of the taiwan is the common aspirations and hope of mainland , taiwan and overseas compatriots , and for this reason the leaders of the cpc and the chinese government have already decided to take this as one of the three main tasks that they must grasp well in the new century .
in the wake of cross - strait economic development , reunification is the common aspiration of the people and the general trend of development . no one can stop this trend , and no one can put it off .
we will do our best to achieve settlement by peaceful means , but we will also make preparations against attempts by taiwan 's separatist forces to split the country .
at every crucial moment in the development of our cause , our party has paid great attention to first grasping theory building .
the experiences of the 80 years of our party 's history show that attaching importance to theory innovation is an important guarantee for the onward advance of the party 's cause .
an important task for us at present is to further bring the thinking of the whole party , the whole army , and the whole people into line with the central line , guidelines and policies in connection with studying the 1 july speech , so as to promote the still more successful unfolding of all work .
hu jintao , member of the standing committee of the cpc central committee politburo , vice president , and vice chairman of the cmc , attended the forum . zhang wannian , member of the politburo of the cpc central committee , secretary of the secretariat , and vice chairman of the cmc , presided .
jiang zemin came to the university this morning , and made an important speech after listening to reports on the progress of the course and speeches by the participants .
jiang zemin pointed out that the 1 july speech took shape as a result of the party 's deep - going exploration and careful consideration ; it was a scientific summation of new practice , which concentrated the wisdom of the whole party and reflected the will of the whole party .
many profound changes have taken place in the world today and the era we are living in , compared with the past .
whether looking at the international or the domestic scene , we are facing many new conditions and problems , and we must answer these in theory and practice and resolve them .
we must move with the times and continue to enrich and develop marxism .
theory innovation is the fundamental demand of marxist dialectical materialism .
jiang zemin emphasized that in carrying out theory innovation it is essential to uphold two basic demands ; the first is , it is essential to uphold marxist stance , viewpoint , and method and basic marxist principles .
the second is , we must implement the ideological line of emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts , and uphold the revolutionary spirit of being bold to pursue and explore the truth .
jiang zemin pointed out that in emancipating the mind and seeking truth from facts , it is first necessary to resolve the problem of taking a correct view of marxism .
when proposing new viewpoints and ideas , we must weigh them up by applying basic marxist theory , and test them through practice to see if they are correct and can stand up .
in this process we must pay great attention to the proper handling of one issue , that is , we must uphold the marxist scientific approach .
looking at our party 's history , it is vitally important to handle this issue properly .
in upholding marxism , however , we absolutely cannot adopt an approach of dogmatism and book worship but should adopt the scientific approach of seeking truth from facts and moving with the times , persist in proceeding in everything from the developing and changing reality , and regard marxism as a science that continually develops as practice develops .
they were never dogmatic or ossified but always moved with the times and continually developed and perfected their own theory in accordance with changes in the historical conditions .
a basic marxist tenet is that we cannot use books to restrict practice but can only use practice to develop books .
jiang zemin emphasized that in applying the basic principles of marxism it is essential to move along with the changes in the historical conditions ; this too is a basic tenet of marxism .
we must fully estimate the impact of these changes .
we must break through our predecessors , and our successors must inevitably break through us .
jiang zemin emphasized that establishing the method of studying marxism centered on practical problems is the scientific methodology that our party has always advocated .
jiang zemin pointed out that social existence determines social awareness ; this is a basic marxist principle on the relationship between social material and social spiritual movements .
the masses ' ideological awareness is determined by this social existence .
it is impossible to achieve the " three represents " if we are unable to grasp the masses ' thinking and awareness from this great social existence .
the comrades of the whole party , especially senior cadres , must persist in the method of studying marxism centered on practical problems , actively get their brains working , seriously consider problems , and make common efforts to advance our party 's theory and practice .
jiang zemin pointed out , our army is a people 's army under the party 's absolute leadership .
in studying in depth and implementing the party 's theoretical line and program and its guidelines and policies , the army must set still higher standards and demands and do its work still more soundly and well .
jiang zemin emphasized that political leadership is the most important thing in party committee leadership .
the number one task of the party committee , especially the secretary , is to get a handle on the political orientation and ensure that the party has ideological and political grasp over the army units .
the party committee must take a firm and clear - cut stand at key moments and on major issues .
it must appropriately step up education and guidance in light of problems in ideological understanding and comprehension , do a good job in resolving doubts and confusion , and patiently and carefully help to untie ideological knots .
through the work of the party organizations at all levels , the smooth implementation of the policy decisions and instructions of the cpc central committee should be ensured .
we must further intensify study , research , and propaganda , thoroughly appreciate the scientific connotations of the 1 july speech , comprehensively and accurately understand the new ideas , viewpoints , and theses in the 1 july speech , and truly study and thoroughly understand them .
also present were leaders of the four general departments and members of the standing committees of the party committees of large units stationed in beijing .
